patterns.context: Passive be known states that a type of design has existed for a long time.

patterns.name: Negated ability/possibility
patterns.context: A modal negation modifies an action, indicating that something cannot change an established fact.

patterns.name: “be difficult to accept”
patterns.context: be + evaluative adjective + infinitive evaluates an idea as difficult to accept.

patterns.name: “be the perception”
patterns.context: perception follows be, describing the preceding text as a perception.

patterns.name: Passive exposure of a problem
patterns.context: A passive expression in a relative clause indicates that an event clearly revealed a shortcoming.

patterns.name: “that is not the case”
patterns.context: A fixed rebuttal expression denying that the preceding situation applies to the current case.

patterns.name: “be questionable”
patterns.context: An evaluative adjective modified by a degree term follows be, questioning a phenomenon.

7_127.description: 覆盖从句中以 be 系词或情态动词引出的判断、评价和状态谓语：关注对象、重要性、已知性、可接受性、看法、缺陷暴露、案件适用性及可疑性；另有 cannot alter。

patterns.name: “be the focus/subject”
patterns.context: 现在完成时中，说明某问题已成为研究或关注对象。

patterns.name: “be of little importance”
patterns.context: 用“be of + 抽象名词”评价某事实的重要性。

patterns.name: 已知的构造
patterns.context: 被动式 be known，陈述某类设计早已存在。

patterns.name: 否定能力/可能性
patterns.context: 情态否定词修饰动作，表示某事不能改变既有事实。

patterns.name: “be difficult to accept”
patterns.context: be + 评价形容词 + 不定式，评价某观点难以接受。

patterns.name: “be the perception”
patterns.context: be 后接 perception，将前文描述为一种看法。

patterns.name: 被动暴露问题
patterns.context: 关系从句中的被动表达，说明缺陷被事件显著揭示。

patterns.name: “that is not the case”
patterns.context: 固定反驳表达，否定前述情形适用于当前案件。

patterns.name: “be questionable”
patterns.context: be 后接程度修饰的评价形容词，质疑某现象。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various syntactic structures and styles: they commonly occur in structures involving the, be/been, and that/it, as well as judgments, negation, and abstract discussion. No stable content theme runs through all passages, and many strongly activated tokens are far apart.

patterns.name: The and following noun structures
patterns.context: Often occurs in noun phrases or copular constructions; it appears across corpora but not every instance of the activates, and some highly activated tokens are far apart.
patterns.domain: Narrative, academic, and legal texts across domains

patterns.name: been in perfect/copular constructions
patterns.context: Follows an auxiliary and links a statement to a following noun or evaluation; also occurs in the ordinary expression “been quietly deemphasized.”
patterns.domain: Expository writing, commentary, academic discourse, forum discussions

patterns.name: be forms in judgment and evaluation sentences
patterns.context: Judges, evaluates, or describes the nature, problem, or legal principle of something; the trigger position is not fixed and need not be adjacent to be.

patterns.name: Issues, focuses, and subjects of inquiry in general discourse
patterns.context: Discusses research subjects, issues, or evaluations of phenomena, often in abstract discourse; the specific triggering words differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Academic, policy, commentary, and technical writing

patterns.name: Propositions or reference introduced by that/this
patterns.context: Refers to prior text or introduces a proposition or clause, often in argumentation, judgment, or explanation; capitalization and syntactic position vary.
patterns.domain: Argumentative writing, legal texts, forum discussions

patterns.name: Negation or rebuttal expressions
patterns.context: Denies facts, limits judgments, or questions something; scattered across narrative and commentary.

patterns.name: it with evaluative or temporal expressions
patterns.context: it functions as a referent or dummy subject, followed by an evaluation or description of an event’s occurrence.

patterns.name: Emphatic or resultative past participle
patterns.context: A past participle describes a problem being exposed, in discussion of technical-system problems.

patterns.name: Statements of legal principles
patterns.context: A formal legal construction describes a specific right as a fundamental principle established by precedent.

7_127.description: 激活分散在多种句法与文体中：常见于 the、be/been、that/it 等结构，以及判断、否定和抽象论述；没有贯穿全部段落的稳定内容主题，且许多强激活 token 相距较远。

patterns.name: “the”词形及后续名词结构
patterns.context: 多出现在名词短语或系表结构中；不同语料里均有，但并非每次出现 the 都激活，部分高激活 token 与其间隔较远。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、学术文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 完成时/系表中的“been”
patterns.trigger: «been»，尤其“has «been» the «focus»”“have «been» the «subject»”“is «been» …”（原文分别为“has … been the focus”“have been the subject”“has … been the subject”）
patterns.context: 在助动词之后，连接陈述与后续名词或评价；也有普通“been quietly deemphasized”用法。
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论、学术论述、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 判断与评价句中的 be 系列
patterns.context: 判断、评价或说明某事物的性质、问题或法律原则；触发位置并不固定，也未必紧邻 be。

patterns.name: 广义论述中的问题、焦点与调查对象
patterns.context: 讨论研究对象、问题或对某现象的评价，常见于抽象论述；各段具体触发词并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 学术、政策、评论、技术说明

patterns.name: that/this 引出的命题或指代
patterns.context: 指代前文或引出命题、从句，且常位于论证、判断或解释中；大小写和句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 论述文、法律文本、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 否定或反驳式表达
patterns.trigger: “«isn’t» helped”“«don’t» actually exist”“«didn’t» stop”“«not» all … «it’s» cracked up to be”“«not» scrutinized”
patterns.context: 否定事实、限制判断或质疑某事；分散在叙述与评论中。
patterns.domain: 说明文、故事叙述、论坛评论

patterns.name: “it”与评价/时间表达
patterns.trigger: “«it» … cracked up to be”“«it» apparently came about in 1969”
patterns.context: it 作指代或形式主语，后接评价或事件发生描述。

patterns.name: 强调或结果性过去分词
patterns.context: 以过去分词描述问题被揭露，位于技术系统问题的论述中。

patterns.name: 法律原则表述
patterns.context: 正式法律句式，将特定权利表述为既有判例的基本原则。

en.description: Activation often occurs near predicates used for statements, judgments, and inferences, especially evaluations of evidence, facts, and rules in legal texts; it also appears in quantitative statements, quote attribution, research reviews, and summaries of principles. Function words and trigger positions are unstable, so no single semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Sentence-final predicates or judgment terms
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near predicates that make assertions, judgments, or inferences; common in evaluative statements, but trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: News reports, legal arguments, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Legal negation and evidence judgments
patterns.context: In legal contexts, evaluates whether evidence, facts, admissibility, or inferences are valid; activation sometimes falls on a negation or a nearby predicate.

patterns.name: Degree, emphasis, or contrast markers
patterns.context: The sentence contains expressions of emphasis, qualification, or contrast; their specific functions differ, with no stable fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Quantitative and proportion statements
patterns.context: Activation occurs near proportion expressions describing county populations and the distribution of gun homicides.

patterns.name: Attribution or reason expressions
patterns.context: Describes the reason for a dismissal and its basis, then moves into a legal evaluation of the relevant facts.

patterns.name: Introducing frameworks, rules, or principles
patterns.context: Introduces rules of evidence in law or general principles in a research field.

patterns.name: Quotes and attribution in reporting
patterns.context: A news quote includes speaker attribution, with activation near the name and surrounding narrative words.

patterns.name: Retrospective expressions in research background
patterns.context: The background section of a paper reviews prior research, stating that a phenomenon had previously been discussed.

patterns.name: Possible irregular or split-token local activation
patterns.context: Some activations fall on common function words, with no consistent, verifiable semantic condition in the surrounding context; this may reflect local syntax or tokenization factors.

7_127.description: 激活多见于陈述、判断和推论的谓语附近，尤其是法律文本中对证据、事实及规则的评价；也散见于数量陈述、引语归属、科研回顾和原则概述。功能词及触发位置不稳定，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 句末谓语或判断词
patterns.context: 激活集中在句子中承担断言、判断或推导作用的谓语附近；常见于判断性陈述，但触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、法律论述及一般说明文

patterns.name: 法律否定与证据判断
patterns.trigger: “not”[5]、“does not”[8,10]、“absence of accident or mistake”[6]、“findings is … material fact”[3]
patterns.context: 法律语境中评价证据、事实、可采性或推论是否成立；有时激活落在否定词或其附近谓语上。

patterns.name: 程度、强调或转折标记
patterns.context: 句中带有强调、限制或转折的表达；各段具体功能不同，未形成稳定固定短语。

patterns.name: 数量与比例陈述
patterns.context: 描述县域人口及枪支凶杀分布时，比例表达附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 归因或理由表达
patterns.trigger: “reasons for the firing”[2]、“citing the customer complaint”[1]
patterns.context: 叙述解雇理由及其依据，随后进入对相关事实的法律评价。

patterns.name: 框架、规则或原则的提出
patterns.context: 介绍法律证据规则或研究领域中的概括性原则。

patterns.name: 报道中的引语与归属
patterns.context: 新闻引语中出现说话人归属表达，激活落在姓名及周围叙述词附近。

patterns.name: 科研背景中的回顾性表达
patterns.context: 论文背景部分回顾既有研究，说明某现象此前已被讨论。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（材料/器件研究）

patterns.name: 可能不规则或拆分标注的局部激活
patterns.context: 部分激活落在常见功能词上，且与周围上下文未见一致、可确认的语义条件；可能反映局部句法或分词因素。

en.description: Activates across news, commentary, history, and academic papers, commonly in expressions of judgment, anaphora, and summary, and also on was and word-internal fragments; there is no single stable lexical or thematic pattern.

patterns.name: Judgment after qualifying or emphatic expressions
patterns.context: The surrounding text explains a phenomenon, action, or judgment. Activations are distributed across emphatic, referential, and evaluative expressions; there is no fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: News reports, encyclopedia entries, online comments

patterns.name: Transitions and summary statements in papers
patterns.context: Academic discussion refers back to prior text, introduces evidence, or describes the paper’s topic; words such as this/the and study/paper are common.

patterns.name: English past-tense auxiliary or copula “was”
patterns.context: English narratives or papers state a past condition or prior discussion; activation falls on was and nearby words.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments and proper-name/morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Portuguese words or fragments of English word forms/proper names; their shared semantic conditions are difficult to determine from the fragments.
patterns.domain: Portuguese European Parliament texts; book reviews or academic commentary

7_127.description: 激活跨新闻、评论、历史及论文文本，常见于判断、回指、总结等表达，也包括was及词内片段；没有单一稳定词汇或主题模式。

patterns.name: 限定或强调性表达后的判断
patterns.trigger: [1] «the» «center»«found»；[2] «apparent» «behavior» «has been the focus»；[7] «it's not all it's cracked up to be»
patterns.context: 周围出现对现象、行为或判断的说明，激活分散在强调、指称及评价性表达中；并非固定短语。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、百科说明、网络评论

patterns.name: 论文中的承接与总结语句
patterns.trigger: [6] «the lessons from these 2 states formed the basis»；[8] «This is further confirmed by a recent study»；[10] «This question is the subject of the present paper»
patterns.context: 学术论述中回指前文、引入证据或说明论文主题，常见 this/the、study/paper 等词。

patterns.name: 英语过去时助动词或系词“was”
patterns.trigger: [4] «That was the main picture»；[9] «was already discussed»
patterns.context: 英语叙述或论文中陈述过去状态、既有讨论；激活落在 was 及邻近词上。

patterns.name: 零散词片及专名/形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部的子词片段或英语词形/专名片段，难以从片段确定共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本；书评或学术评论

en.concept: Focal expressions in judgments and exposition
en.description: Activation is distributed across various styles: it often falls on expressions of judgment, state, or research progress, and also covers legal argument, behavior receiving attention, quote summaries, Portuguese emphasis, and epistemic qualifiers in papers; no single stable trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Judgmental expressions following complements/predicates
patterns.context: Describes research, a survey, or a state as ongoing, reported, or currently available; activation falls on the copula and the progress/state word following it

patterns.name: Focal words and sentence-final conclusions in judgments
patterns.context: A narrator or quotation summarizes, rebuts, or evaluates preceding text, often in a judgment sentence or fixed expression
patterns.domain: War memoirs, legal opinions, online commentary

patterns.name: Reference and claim comparison in argumentation
patterns.context: Legal argument compares a current claim with precedent or a claim made by the opposing party

patterns.name: Behavior and becoming an object of attention
patterns.context: Describes a behavior as having already attracted attention or scrutiny

patterns.name: Summative contrast after a news quote
patterns.context: After a quotation, introduces a summary or emphasis in a definitive tone

patterns.name: Emphatic phrase in Portuguese academic discussion
patterns.context: In Portuguese philosophical prose, uses “especially/most importantly” to emphasize an argument; activation spans subword tokens

patterns.name: Epistemic qualifier in academic literature
patterns.context: The paper's authors qualify the scope of their knowledge, stating that, to their knowledge, a result is novel

7_127.concept: 判断与论述中的焦点表达
7_127.description: 激活分散于多种文体：常落在判断、状态或研究进展表达中，也覆盖法律论证、行为受关注、引语总结、葡语强调及论文中的知识限定语；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 补语/谓语后的判断性表达
patterns.context: 描述研究、调查或某种状态正在进行、已被报告或当前可用；激活落在系动词及其后的进展/状态词上

patterns.name: 判断句中的焦点词及句末结论
patterns.context: 叙述者或引语对前文作概括、反驳或评价，常见于判断句或固定表达
patterns.domain: 战争回忆、法律意见、网络评论

patterns.name: 论证中的指代与主张比较
patterns.context: 法律论证中比较当前主张与先例或对方提出的主张

patterns.name: 行为及其成为关注对象
patterns.context: 把某种行为描述为已经受到关注或审视
patterns.domain: 百科叙述，工业间谍主题

patterns.name: 新闻引语后的概括式转折
patterns.context: 引语之后以确定语气引出总结或强调

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语学术论述中的强调短语
patterns.context: 葡语哲学论述中用“尤其／最重要的是”突出论点；激活跨越分词子词

patterns.name: 学术文献中的认识限定语
patterns.context: 论文作者限定知识范围，说明某结果据其所知具有新颖性

en.concept: English case expressions and sporadic structures
en.description: Primarily activates on the English “This/That is (not) the case” expression and nearby words; there is also one instance of the “among the ones that” structure, and relazione in the Italian “Nella mia relazione.”

patterns.name: “This is [not] the case” expression
patterns.context: Demonstrative This/That + be + (optional not/adverb) + the case; activation often falls on case, and sometimes on is, the, not, or nearby words.
patterns.domain: Across legal, academic, patent-background, philosophical, and news genres

patterns.name: “among the ones” structure
patterns.context: After a plural subject, are among the ones that describes several options as belonging to the solutions currently under consideration.

patterns.name: relazione in an Italian relative clause
patterns.context: An excerpt from an Italian parliamentary speech; relazione occurs in a relative-clause context, with activation concentrated on that word.

7_127.concept: 英语 case 表达式及零散结构
7_127.description: 主要对英语“This/That is (not) the case”表达式及其邻近词激活；另有一例“among the ones that”结构，以及意大利语“Nella mia relazione”中的 relazione。

patterns.name: “This is [not] the case”表达式
patterns.trigger: “This is especially the case”, “this is not the case”, “That is not the case”, “That’s certainly the case”, “This is the case”
patterns.context: 指示词 This/That + be +（可选 not/副词）+ the case；激活多落在 case，部分也落在 is、the、not 或周边词。
patterns.domain: 跨法律、学术论文、专利背景、哲学、新闻等文体

patterns.name: “among the ones”结构
patterns.trigger: “are among the ones that are currently being explored”
patterns.context: 复数主语后接 are among the ones that，描述若干选项属于当前探索的方案。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／通信网络技术

patterns.name: 意大利语关系从句中的 rel​​azione
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言片段；关系从句语境中出现 rel​​azione，激活集中于该词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会／意大利语政治发言

en.description: Activation often falls near sentence judgments, conclusions, or evidential endpoints, especially stance expressions such as “in my/our view” and “to our knowledge”; other samples involve emphasis, case or event outcomes, observation markers, and quoted wording, with no unified lexical trigger yet apparent.

patterns.name: Postposed stance phrase in a clause or summary judgment
patterns.context: After stating an argument, judicial conclusion, or academic finding, a first-person stance phrase appears; activation is concentrated near expressions such as view / knowledge.
patterns.domain: Court rulings, academic papers, philosophical argument

patterns.name: Evaluative judgment or outcome endpoint
patterns.context: The sentence advances to a point describing an emphasized object, comparison focus, case conclusion, investigation result, or whether an event occurred; trigger words are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Philosophical argument, legal texts, news reports, sports reporting

patterns.name: Observation/evidence marker in a quotation
patterns.context: A phrase in technical discussion that introduces what a figure or result shows.

patterns.name: Person's possessive and evaluative wording
patterns.context: When discussing a book or an author's views, a possessive introduces a quotation of their wording.
patterns.domain: Book reviews, social science or anthropology discussion

7_127.description: 激活多落在句子判断、结论或证据落点附近，尤其是“in my/our view”“to our knowledge”等立场表达；其余样本分别涉及强调、案件或事件结果、观察标记及引述措辞，尚无统一词汇触发。

patterns.name: 分句/总结性判断中的后置立场短语
patterns.trigger: “in my view”“to our knowledge”“in our view”
patterns.context: 在陈述论点、裁判结论或学术发现后，出现第一人称立场短语；激活集中在 view / knowledge 等表达附近。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、学术论文、哲学论述

patterns.name: 评价性判断或结果落点
patterns.trigger: “above all”“the one”“the case here”“the center found”“has happened”
patterns.context: 句子推进到强调对象、比较焦点、案件结论、调查结果或事件是否发生的位置；触发词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、法律文本、新闻报道、体育报道

patterns.name: 引文中的观察/证据标记
patterns.context: 技术论述中用来引出图表或结果所显示内容的短语。

patterns.name: 人名所有格及评价措辞
patterns.context: 讨论一本书或作者观点时，以所有格引出对其措辞的引用。
patterns.domain: 书评、社会科学或人类学论述

en.description: Activations concentrate on case-related judgments and exemplification, and also respond to discourse-linking expressions involving quotation, limits on knowledge, contrast, and objects of review; there is also a French opinion word and a demonstrative pronoun. The examples span languages and domains and are difficult to reduce to a single meaning.

patterns.name: French opinion and uncertainty
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses Descartes’s judgment about opinions acquired through education, describing those opinions as uncertain.

patterns.name: “the case” in a negative judgment
patterns.context: First states that a condition does not hold or apply, then explains that the case does not fall under that situation.

patterns.name: Demonstrative pronoun “celle”
patterns.context: A French academic sentence uses a demonstrative pronoun to refer back to the previously mentioned method (here, a clustering method).

patterns.name: Findings of fact in appellate review
patterns.context: Explains that the trial court’s findings of fact are subject to review by the appellate court.

patterns.name: Quoting a pleading or lawyer’s brief
patterns.context: Introduces a direct quotation from the appellant’s brief.

patterns.name: Authorial knowledge limitation and systematic review
patterns.context: In a review-style scientific text, limits claims to the authors’ knowledge and states that no relevant systematic review exists.

patterns.name: Contrast word “however”
patterns.context: Introduces a contrast or additional limitation after describing a technical solution, cost, or component.

patterns.name: “the case” in an affirmative judgment
patterns.context: A legal argument makes an affirmative judgment, then limits the objects or matters to which it applies.

patterns.name: Giving a concrete example
patterns.context: After introducing a device or technology, gives a specific example to illustrate the preceding claim.

patterns.name: A specific situation involving the study population
patterns.context: After describing a measurement or reliability problem, states that the problem applies to a specific population or measure.

7_127.description: 激活集中于“case”相关判断与举例句式，也响应引述、知识限定、转折、审查对象等篇章连接表达；另有法语观点词及指示代词。跨语言、跨领域，难归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法语观点与不确定性
patterns.context: 法语句子谈笛卡尔对受教育时传来的意见之判断，意见被说成不确定

patterns.name: 否定判断中的“the case”
patterns.context: 先述某条件不成立或不适用，再说明该案不属于这种情形

patterns.name: 指示代词“celle”
patterns.context: 法语学术句中以指示代词回指前述方法（此处为聚类方法）

patterns.name: 上诉审查中的事实认定
patterns.context: 说明审判法院的事实认定是上诉法院审查的对象

patterns.name: 引述诉状或律师文书
patterns.context: 引出对上诉方文书内容的直接引用

patterns.name: 作者知识限定与系统综述
patterns.context: 综述性科学写作中限定作者所知，并称不存在相关系统综述

patterns.name: 转折词“however”
patterns.context: 在说明技术方案、成本或组件之后引出转折或补充限制

patterns.name: 肯定判断中的“the case”
patterns.context: 法律论述先作肯定判断，再限定其适用对象或事项

patterns.name: 例示具体案例
patterns.context: 在介绍设备或技术后，用具体实例说明前述说法

patterns.name: 研究对象中的具体情形
patterns.context: 在说明测量或可靠性问题后，指出该问题适用于特定人群或指标

en.description: Activation occurs in several types of discourse expressions: authorial stance qualifiers, causal-purpose explanations, negated verification, technical enumerations, evaluations, and reporting language; there is also a pollutant citation and a Portuguese connective expression. No single clear trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Epistemic stance qualifier
patterns.context: The author qualifies the basis of a statement or judgment with “to our knowledge / in our view.”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal opinions; passage [4] is academic prose, passage [9] is judicial prose.

patterns.name: Causal and purpose explanations
patterns.context: Explains the motive, purpose, or partial reason behind a proposal or decision.

patterns.name: Negated verification statement
patterns.context: Denies that a research proposal has been verified.

patterns.name: Enumerated objects and current progress
patterns.context: In an enumeration of technical measures, notes that some options are being explored.

patterns.name: Pollutant examples and citation
patterns.context: Lists pollutants in a water-treatment problem and includes a literature citation.

patterns.name: Emphatic evaluation
patterns.context: In Portuguese, an emphatic phrase introduces an evaluation of an opinion.

patterns.name: Portuguese contrast/conclusion connective
patterns.context: Uses “therefore” to link to preceding text and describes difficulties faced by an action.

patterns.name: Reporting expression
patterns.context: When quoting a person's statement, ends with the speaker and a speech verb.

7_127.description: 激活出现在多类论述性表述中：作者立场限定、因果目的说明、否定验证、技术列举、评价及报道语等；另有污染物引文和葡语连接表达。没有单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 认识立场限定语
patterns.context: 作者用“据我们所知／依我们看来”限定陈述的依据或判断。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律意见；段[4]为学术文体，段[9]为司法文体。

patterns.name: 因果与目的说明
patterns.trigger: “an attempt to protect”“in part due to a desire to appeal”
patterns.context: 说明提案或决定背后的动机、目的或部分原因。

patterns.name: 否定验证表述
patterns.context: 否定某项研究提议已得到验证。

patterns.name: 列举对象及当前进展
patterns.trigger: “among the ones that are currently being explored”
patterns.context: 在技术措施的列举中指出某些方案正在探索。

patterns.name: 污染物举例与引文
patterns.context: 列举水处理问题中的污染物，并带有文献引用。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生／环境医学论文。

patterns.name: 强调性评价
patterns.trigger: “acima de tudo, incertas”（最重要的是，不确定）
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中用强调短语引出对意见的评价。

patterns.name: 葡语转折／结论连接语
patterns.context: 用“因此”承接前文，并描述行动面临的困难。

patterns.name: 报道语
patterns.context: 在引述人物说法时，以说话者加言说动词收尾。

en.description: Across domains, prominent activations often fall on English expressions that continue or introduce a judgment, observation, or subsequent event, especially transitions in legal opinions; there are also local triggers in Portuguese philosophical judgments and in news, academic, and product reporting.

patterns.name: Concluding/argument-introducing phrases in English opinions
patterns.context: Continues a legal argument, points out how facts correspond to or differ from precedent, or introduces the court’s judgment; often appears at the start of a sentence or at a paragraph transition.

patterns.name: Fact-finding language in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Discusses the trial record, evidence, findings of fact, and appellate review; highlights how the court handles existing findings of fact.

patterns.name: Judgment word in Portuguese philosophical discourse
patterns.context: In a discussion of Descartes and views on educational tradition, gives a general evaluation of an opinion; activation concentrates on “acima”.

patterns.name: Follow-up events and announcements in reporting
patterns.context: Reports a follow-up announcement or news event, organized around when the event occurred; this example concerns a television program and a dispute over an investigation.

patterns.name: Response and follow-up measures in business reporting
patterns.context: First describes management’s response as undisclosed, then recounts the next action taken by a government department.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia English articles, real estate and administrative affairs

patterns.name: Summary of observations in a research paper
patterns.context: Based on data or phenomena described earlier, begins listing observations; the topic is recurrence of excessive involvement behavior.

patterns.name: Additional selling point in a product introduction
patterns.context: Adds a noteworthy product feature after introducing a smartphone’s camera hardware and software functions.

7_127.concept: 论述与事件的承接引导
7_127.description: 跨领域文本中，显著激活常落在承接或引出判断、观察、事件后续的英语表达上，尤其是法律判决中的论证衔接；另有葡语哲学判断及新闻、学术、产品报道中的局部触发。

patterns.name: 英语判决中的结论／论证引导语
patterns.trigger: “That is not the case here”, “That was the case”, “The courts have, it is true”, “This argument was made”
patterns.context: 在法律论证中承接前文、指出事实与先例的对应或差异，或引出法院的判断；常出现在句首或段落转折处。

patterns.name: 法律审理中的事实认定措辞
patterns.trigger: “the trial court's findings are the ones which are before this court on appeal”
patterns.context: 讨论审判记录、证据、事实认定及上诉审查；突出法院对既有事实认定的处理。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语哲学论述中的判断词
patterns.context: 笛卡尔及教育传承观点的讨论中，对意见作概括性评价；激活集中在“acima”。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 葡萄牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 报道中的事件后续与公告
patterns.context: 以事件发生时间为线索，报道公告或新闻事件的后续；此例涉及电视节目与调查争议。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的回应及后续措施
patterns.trigger: “Following the response, which was not made public”
patterns.context: 先描述管理层回应未公开，再叙述政府部门采取下一步行动。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文条目，地产与行政事务

patterns.name: 研究论文中的观察总结
patterns.trigger: “One of the observations that can be made”
patterns.context: 基于前文描述的数据或现象，开始列举可得观察；主题为过度参与行为的复发。

patterns.name: 产品介绍中的补充卖点
patterns.context: 在介绍智能手机相机硬件及软件功能后，补充值得注意的产品特点。

en.description: Activation is distributed across my, Portuguese opinion expressions, reference-number strings, and various discourse transitions and attribution phrases: observations suggest, he said, Another point worth noting, All this work, One of the observations, our goal. The patterns differ substantially in semantics and domain.

patterns.name: First-person singular possessive my
patterns.context: my is followed by intended audience; the same passage also contains first-person discourse such as I am and my intended audience, but activation is most concentrated on my

patterns.name: Portuguese opinion and degree expressions
patterns.context: Portuguese text discusses opinions received from Descartes's education, including opiniões and acima de tudo; activation is concentrated on opinião(s) and acima

patterns.name: Number and citation-marker string
patterns.context: A continuous numbered string composed of digits, square brackets, [@bibr…] and other reference markers; similar citation numbers also occur later in the same passage

patterns.name: Prompt for observations and inference
patterns.context: Plural observations followed by suggest, a construction that draws an inference from clinical observations

patterns.name: he said quote attribution
patterns.context: News narration uses he said after a direct quote or statement to identify the speaker; the passage also contains said-attribution expressions

patterns.name: Citation-number marker
patterns.context: A superscript-style reference marker at the end of a body-text sentence, containing bibr and a numeric identifier

patterns.name: Another point worth noting
patterns.context: Uses Another point worth noting to introduce an additional argument; the passage is product-review text

patterns.name: All this work
patterns.context: After reviewing prior research, uses All this work to summarize previous work and transition to a related issue

patterns.name: Academic expression of observations
patterns.context: The academic-discourse construction One of the observations that can be made…

patterns.name: our goal purpose statement
patterns.context: It is our goal to… explicitly states the authors' research objective

7_127.description: 激活分散于 my、葡语意见表达、参考文献编号串，以及多种论述衔接和归属短语：observations suggest、he said、Another point worth noting、All this work、One of the observations、our goal。各模式语义和领域差异明显。

patterns.name: 第一人称复数所有格 my
patterns.context: my 后接 intended audience；同段还出现 I am、my intended audience 等第一人称论述，但激活最集中于 my

patterns.name: 葡语意见及其程度表达
patterns.context: 葡语中讨论笛卡尔所受教育传来的意见，出现 opiniões 及 acima de tudo；激活集中在 opinião(s) 和 acima

patterns.name: 数字与引文标记串
patterns.context: 数字、方括号、[@bibr…]等参考文献标记组成的连续编号串；同段后续也有相似引文编号
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的引文格式

patterns.name: 观察及其推论提示语
patterns.context: 复数 observations 后接 suggest，作为从临床观察引出推论的句式
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的医学说明

patterns.name: he said 引语归属
patterns.context: 新闻叙述在直接引语或陈述后以 he said 标明发言者；段内也出现 said 的归属语

patterns.name: 引文编号标记
patterns.context: 正文句末的上标式参考文献标记，含 bibr 和数字编号

patterns.name: Another point worth noting
patterns.context: 用 Another point worth noting 引入补充论点；段内为产品评测文字

patterns.name: All this work
patterns.context: 回顾此前研究后，以 All this work 概括已有工作并转入相关问题

patterns.name: 观察结果的学术表述
patterns.trigger: «One»1« of»2« the»5« observations»9« that»6« can»4« be»4« made»8
patterns.context: One of the observations that can be made…这一学术论述句式

patterns.name: our goal 目的陈述
patterns.context: It is our goal to…明确陈述作者研究目标

en.description: Primarily responds to academic arguments that refer back to evidence or phenomena and explain their evidential role; it also responds to introductions of additional points, replies based on personal experience, first-person academic statements, and descriptions of legal proceedings and appellate review.

patterns.name: Observations and their evidential role
patterns.context: In academic or patent discourse, refers back to prior evidence, phenomena, or arguments and explains how they support a hypothesis, belief, or solution.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, patent background

patterns.name: Summary and quotation in argumentation
patterns.context: Introduces an additional point in expository writing or summarizes previously presented material.

patterns.name: Recounting personal experience
patterns.context: In informal conversation, responds to another person’s statement with personal experience.

patterns.name: First-person statement in philosophical commentary
patterns.context: In philosophical commentary or academic writing, the author shifts to the first person to explain their writing, argument, or speaking plans.

patterns.name: Countermotion in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes a litigant filing a motion and its scheduling.

patterns.name: Appellate deference to trial findings of fact
patterns.context: States that despite conflicting evidence, the appellate court reviews the lower court’s findings of fact.

7_127.description: 主要响应学术论证中回指证据或现象并说明其支持作用；也响应引出补充要点、个人经验回应、第一人称学术发言，以及法律程序与上诉审表述。

patterns.name: 观察及其论据作用
patterns.trigger: “observations”，以及 “This is another argument in favor of”
patterns.context: 学术或专利论述中，回指前文证据、现象或论点，并说明它们对假设、信念或方案的支持作用。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 论证中的总结与引述
patterns.context: 说明文中引出补充要点，或对前述材料作归纳。

patterns.name: 个人经验回顾
patterns.context: 非正式对话中以个人经历回应他人陈述。

patterns.name: 哲学评论中的第一人称发言
patterns.context: 哲学评论或学术文本中，作者转入第一人称说明写作、论述或发言安排。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的反动议
patterns.context: 描述诉讼当事人提交动议及其排期。

patterns.name: 上诉审对审判事实认定的依循
patterns.trigger: “the ones which are before this court on appeal”
patterns.context: 指出虽有证据矛盾，上诉法院仍审查下级法院的事实认定。

en.description: Primarily responds to the summary and interpretation of prior observations, data, findings, and research results in academic or legal writing, often accompanied by citations to literature, patents, or figures and tables; also occurs in evidence transitions and comparisons of results.

patterns.name: Deictic expression introducing research findings
patterns.context: The preceding text states results or phenomena, and the following text interprets their significance using words such as suggest/indicate; also includes “observations would add support”

patterns.name: Research findings and evidence statements
patterns.context: Summarizes research findings, court findings, or prior research results, often accompanied by citations or comparisons
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, legal documents, academic papers

patterns.name: Citations to references, patent literature, and figures and tables
patterns.context: Refers in the body text to references, patent documents, or figures and tables, often with structured markers

patterns.name: Interpretive transitions in academic discussion
patterns.context: Connects evidence, interpretation, or different research results; not every passage uses the same transition word
patterns.domain: Medical papers, reviews, and academic discussion

7_127.description: 主要响应学术或法律文体中对既有观察、数据、发现和研究结果的总结与解释，并常伴随文献、专利或图表引用；也见证据衔接和结果对比。

patterns.name: 指示词引出研究发现
patterns.context: 前文陈述结果或现象，后文用 suggest/indicate 等解释其意义；也包括“observations would add support”

patterns.name: 研究结果与证据表述
patterns.context: 总结研究发现、法院认定或既有研究结果，常伴随引证或对比
patterns.domain: 专利背景、法律文书、学术论文

patterns.name: 引文、专利文献及图表引用
patterns.context: 正文中指向参考文献、专利文件或图表，常带有结构化标记

patterns.name: 学术论述中的解释性转折
patterns.context: 连接证据、解释或不同研究结果；并非每段都出现同一种连接词
patterns.domain: 医学论文、综述及学术论述

en.description: Strongly responds to summary phrases in biomedical papers, such as “These observations/data/results,” that refer back to prior findings, data, or experimental results, especially when followed by an inference, conclusion, or statement of significance.

patterns.name: “observations” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After describing clinical findings, experimental results, or observations, uses “These observations” to introduce an inference, support a hypothesis, or explain significance.

patterns.name: “data” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After reporting experimental or clinical data, uses “These data” to summarize the conclusions they suggest or support.

patterns.name: “results” as the subject of an evidence summary
patterns.context: After describing results from a procedure, experiment, or figure, uses “These results” to introduce a conclusion or interpretation.

7_127.description: 对生物医学论文中“These observations/data/results”这类回指前述发现、数据或实验结果的总结短语强烈响应，尤其是其后接推论、结论或意义陈述的语境。

patterns.name: “observations”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文陈述临床发现、实验结果或观察事实，随后以“These observations”引出推论、支持某假说或说明意义。

patterns.name: “data”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文报告实验或临床数据，随后用“These data”概括其提示或支持的结论。

patterns.name: “results”作为证据总结主语
patterns.context: 前文描述处理、实验或图表结果，随后用“These results”引出结论或解释。

en.concept: Evidence summaries and references to literature and figures
en.description: Primarily responds to summary inferences introduced by intersentential deictic expressions, as well as references to figures, figure numbers, and literature in patent technical texts; also shows sporadic responses to legal quotation cues and news quote attribution.

patterns.name: Explanatory deictic expressions
patterns.context: After evidence, observations, or results are stated, a deictic expression introduces an inference, summary, or further explanation; the clearest examples are These data/observations/discoveries.

patterns.name: Patent figure references and citation markers
patterns.context: Refers to figures, patent literature, or structures in figures in patent or technical texts, often accompanied by numbering, parentheses, and citation formats.

patterns.name: Quotation cue
patterns.context: Introduces a verbatim quotation from the opposing party’s legal pleading in a legal account.

patterns.name: Quote attribution and closure
patterns.context: Attributes a statement to a speaker in news writing and closes with a quotation or conclusive participle.

7_127.concept: 证据总结与文献图示指引
7_127.description: 主要响应句际指代词引出的总结推论，以及专利技术文本中指向附图、图号和文献的引用表达；另对法律引述提示和新闻引语归属有零星响应。

patterns.name: 说明性指代词
patterns.context: 前文陈述证据、观察或结果后，用指代词引出推论、总结或后续说明；最明显的是 These data/observations/discoveries。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景技术

patterns.name: 专利图示与引用标记
patterns.context: 专利或技术文本中指向附图、专利文献或图中结构，常伴随编号、括号及引用格式。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、技术说明

patterns.name: 引述提示语
patterns.context: 法律叙述中引出对方当事人书状的原文引述。

patterns.name: 引语归属与收束
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中将陈述归于说话者，并以引语或结论性分词收尾。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道或非虚构叙述

en.description: Activation appears across several local patterns: summaries of academic results (especially “These data/results” and indicate/suggest), transitions to proposed solutions and citation/figure-number formats in patent background sections, and figure references; it also covers specific content concerning dialysis, cell experiments, disease, quartz inspection, Romanian statements, and ferry news.

patterns.name: Result-section summary lead-in
patterns.context: The preceding text states experimental results, observations, or data, followed by “These data/results indicate/suggest” to introduce an interpretation or conclusion; nearby triggers often include commas and indicate, suggest.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedical experiments and research papers

patterns.name: Problem-to-solution transition in patent background sections
patterns.context: A patent background section first presents a problem to be solved, then introduces an existing or proposed solution; nearby text often includes “approaches,” “proposed,” and figure-number references.

patterns.name: Patent literature citation at paragraph end
patterns.context: A citation or reference marker at the end of a patent background paragraph, often in parentheses or on a separate reference line.

patterns.name: Figure-reference sentence
patterns.context: Describes a device, setup, or result as having been shown in a figure, followed by a figure number and link-style citation.

patterns.name: Romanian first-person narrative
patterns.context: First-person past-tense expressions and emotion words such as “hope” in Romanian sentences; the given passage also contains narrative content about young victims.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Romanian political/personal statements

patterns.name: Paragraph connective adverb Moreover
patterns.context: Moreover adds information at the beginning or within a sentence; the passages cover experimental papers and news quotations, with no consistent specific context.

patterns.name: Patent figure-number format
patterns.context: Patent texts label figures using FIG. followed by a number and letter, appearing near introductions of solutions or embodiments.

patterns.name: Academic paper results sentence pattern
patterns.context: The results paragraph uses results as the subject to introduce research findings; overlaps with the “These results” summary framework.

patterns.name: Dialysis and hepcidin research content
patterns.context: Discusses intravenous iron, hepcidin levels, and erythropoiesis in hemodialysis patients; this topic does not appear in other passages.

patterns.name: Cell death and iron-ion experimental content
patterns.context: Describes cell death after treatment and Fe²⁺ accumulation, with figure or table citations; co-occurs with a general result-summary sentence pattern.

patterns.name: Sickle cell disease and infant symptoms
patterns.context: Explains that infant symptoms usually appear after fetal hemoglobin declines, and introduces methods to increase its level.

patterns.name: Dicer mouse experiment
patterns.context: Compares Dicer expression or treatment outcomes in specific mouse myeloid cells, followed by a research conclusion.

patterns.name: News narrative about emergency passage on a ferry
patterns.context: Reports that vehicles carrying emergency supplies were allowed through during a ferry service disruption, restrictions on private vehicles were eased, and a speaker was quoted.

patterns.name: Defect inspection in synthetic quartz glass
patterns.context: A patent describes suppressing defect formation and inspecting substrate surfaces with high-sensitivity equipment, followed by patent literature citations.

7_127.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：学术结果总结（尤其“These data/results”及 indicate/suggest）、专利背景的方案过渡与引文/图号格式，以及图示引用；另覆盖透析、细胞实验、疾病、石英检测、罗马尼亚语陈述和渡船新闻等特定内容。

patterns.name: 结果段总结引导语
patterns.context: 前文陈述实验结果、观察或数据，随后用“These data/results indicate/suggest”引出解释或结论；触发附近常有逗号及 indicate、suggest。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学实验与研究论文

patterns.name: 专利背景中的问题—方案过渡
patterns.context: 专利背景先提出待解决的问题，再引出已有或拟议方案；附近常出现“approaches”“proposed”及图号引用。

patterns.name: 专利文献引用尾部
patterns.context: 专利背景段落末尾的引文或参考文献标记，常位于括号或独立参考文献行中。

patterns.name: 图示引用句
patterns.context: 描述设备、设置或结果已在图中展示，后接图号及链接式引用。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语第一人称叙述
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中的第一人称过去时表达与“希望”等情绪词；所给片段同时含年轻受害者等叙述内容。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，罗马尼亚语政治／个人陈述

patterns.name: 段落连接副词 Moreover
patterns.context: 句首或句中用 Moreover 添加补充信息；片段涵盖实验论文和新闻引语，具体语境并不一致。

patterns.name: 专利图号格式
patterns.context: 专利文本中以 FIG. 加编号和字母标注附图，出现在方案或实施方式介绍附近。

patterns.name: 学术论文结果句式
patterns.context: 实验结果段落以 results 作主语，引出研究发现；与“These results”总结框架重合。

patterns.name: 透析与铁调素研究内容
patterns.context: 讨论血液透析患者静脉铁剂、铁调素水平及红细胞生成；该主题本身未见于其他片段。

patterns.name: 细胞死亡与铁离子实验内容
patterns.context: 描述处理后细胞死亡及 Fe²⁺ 累积，并引用图表；与通用结果总结句式并存。

patterns.name: 镰状细胞病与婴儿症状
patterns.context: 说明婴儿症状通常在胎儿血红蛋白下降后出现，并引出提高其水平的方法。

patterns.name: Dicer 小鼠实验
patterns.context: 比较特定小鼠髓系细胞中的 Dicer 表达或处理结果，随后给出研究结论。

patterns.name: 渡船应急通行新闻叙述
patterns.context: 报道渡船服务中断期间允许紧急物资车辆通行、放宽私人车辆限制，并引述发言者。

patterns.name: 合成石英玻璃缺陷检测
patterns.context: 专利描述抑制缺陷形成并以高灵敏度设备检测基板表面，随后列出专利文献。

en.concept: Citation and attribution markers in technical literature
en.description: Primarily responds to prior art, method descriptions, and patent citation formats in patent backgrounds; it also activates on news quotations and speaker attribution, figure and reference cross-references in medical papers, and citation parentheses, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Patent literature citation labels
patterns.context: Cites or summarizes prior art in patent background paragraphs, often in a parenthetical citation at the end of a sentence or in a reference on a new line; activation also occurs near citation numbers.

patterns.name: Narration of patent prior art
patterns.context: Introduces methods, materials, or technologies proposed in prior patents or non-patent literature; adjacent to literature labels and citation numbers.

patterns.name: News quotations and attribution
patterns.context: In news reports, identifies the speaker after a direct quotation or uses a conjunction within the quotation to continue an explanation; may occur alongside periods and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Figure or literature cross-references in medical literature
patterns.context: Medical papers cite a figure or earlier study in the methods/results narrative, with figure numbers, bracketed numbers, author names, or footnote links nearby.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and method descriptions in patents
patterns.context: States the roles and steps of materials, devices, biomolecules, or manufacturing methods in patent backgrounds or technical descriptions; not necessarily adjacent to a citation label.

patterns.name: End-of-sentence punctuation and parenthetical citation structure
patterns.context: Cited material is often placed in parentheses at the end of a sentence, followed by a period or comma; activations occur around parentheses, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Figure/reference markers in papers
patterns.context: The main text points to a figure and includes a web anchor or Markdown link format.

patterns.name: Statistical measures and author citations
patterns.context: Medical research reports measures and cites prior work using author names and footnotes/hyperlinks.

patterns.name: Splitting personal names in reported quotations
patterns.context: A name is tokenized or split in news text, appearing in attribution after a direct quotation.

patterns.name: Checkpoint phrasing in emergency access reporting
patterns.context: Disaster or traffic-control news describes a checkpoint being set up; this occurs in the article text after a quotation and has no direct connection to patent citation formats.

7_127.concept: 技术文献中的引用与归属标记
7_127.description: 主要响应专利背景中的现有技术、方法描述及专利文献引用格式；另对新闻引语/发言归属、医学论文的图表与参考文献交叉引用，以及引用括号、编号和标点有激活。

patterns.name: 专利文献引用标签
patterns.context: 专利背景技术段落中引用或概述现有技术，常在句末括号或换行参考文献处出现；引用编号附近也有激活。

patterns.name: 专利现有技术叙述
patterns.context: 介绍既有专利或非专利文献提出的方法、材料或技术；与文献标签及引用编号相邻。

patterns.name: 新闻引语与报道归属
patterns.context: 新闻报道中直接引语之后标注发言者，或引语中以连接词继续说明；也可能伴随句号和引号。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的图表或文献交叉引用
patterns.context: 医学论文在方法/结果叙述中引用图或先前研究，附近有图号、方括号编号、作者名或脚注链接。

patterns.name: 专利中技术术语及方法叙述
patterns.trigger: «suppress» the» formation» of»、«method» for» obtaining»、«method» of» controlling»
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术描述中陈述材料、器件、生物分子或制造方法的作用与步骤；本身不一定紧邻引用标签。

patterns.name: 引文句末标点及括号结构
patterns.context: 引用内容常置于括号内并位于句末，随后接句号或逗号；括号、编号和标点周边均有激活。

patterns.name: 论文图像/参考文献标记
patterns.context: 正文指向图示并伴随网页锚点或 Markdown 链接格式。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及数字化排版

patterns.name: 统计指标与作者引文
patterns.context: 医学研究报告测量指标并以作者和脚注/超链接形式引证既往工作。

patterns.name: 报道引语中的人物姓名拆分
patterns.context: 新闻文本中姓名被分词或拆分，出现在直接引语后的发言归属位置。

patterns.name: 急救通行报道中的检查站措辞
patterns.context: 灾害或交通管制新闻中叙述检查站设置，属于引语之后的报道正文，与专利引用格式无直接联系。

en.description: Primarily responds to interpretive conclusions in research texts drawn from data or results, especially verbs such as “indicate,” “suggest,” and “highlight” following “These data”; also shows sporadic activation on patent citation titles, news quote attribution, and paper objective phrases.

patterns.name: Indicative research-conclusion verbs
patterns.context: In research writing, experimental results, observations, or evidence are first presented, followed by a summarizing verb introducing an interpretation, inference, or conclusion; activation centers mainly on the conclusion expression.

patterns.name: Patent literature citation title
patterns.context: A patent specification’s background section lists and cites patent document numbers in a fixed format.

patterns.name: Quote-attribution verb
patterns.context: At the end of a direct quotation in news writing, a person’s pronoun and “said” identify the speaker.

patterns.name: Statement of a paper’s research objective
patterns.context: When describing predictions or tests, the paper’s authors explicitly state the main objective of the paper.

7_127.description: 主要响应科研文本中由数据或结果引出的解释性结论表达，尤其是“These data”后接“indicate、suggest、highlight”等动词；另对专利引证标题、新闻引语归属及论文目标短语有零星激活。

patterns.name: 指示性研究结论词
patterns.trigger: “data”后接“indicate/indicated/suggest/highlight”或相近表述，如 “These data indicate”“These data suggest”“These data highlight”
patterns.context: 科研叙述中先给出实验结果、观察或证据，随后用总结性动词引出解释、推论或结论；触发点主要落在结论表达附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其他科研论文

patterns.name: 专利文献引证标题
patterns.context: 专利说明书的背景技术部分，以固定格式列出并引述专利文献编号。

patterns.name: 引语归属动词
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中的直接引语末尾，由人物身份代词加“said”标明发言者。

patterns.name: 论文研究目标表述
patterns.context: 论文作者在描述预测或检验安排时，明确指出本文的主要目标。

en.concept: Citation and summary markers in scientific and patent texts
en.description: Primarily responds to citation markers in patent texts and the biomedical paper result-summary phrase “These data”; also includes sporadic local triggers such as as well as, in, and are, as well as a few sentence patterns that cannot be explained uniformly.

patterns.name: Patent document numbers and citation format
patterns.context: Cites existing patents or references in patent background sections, often with numbered markers and adjacent punctuation or line breaks

patterns.name: Scientific paper result-summary sentence
patterns.context: After experimental or clinical results, “These data” introduces evidence, interpretation, or a conclusion; the paragraph may also contain nearby common words such as “This manner,” but they are not core triggers for this pattern

patterns.name: English phrase as well as
patterns.context: Uses “as well as” to connect an additional item when listing or contrasting multiple options

patterns.name: Contextual use of the English connective as
patterns.context: Occurs in “as they carried emergency goods,” indicating cause or circumstance; this example has no confirmed patent-citation or result-summary pattern

patterns.name: Local activation of the word in
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrases “in HFR/HFA+M group” and “in the sub-nanometer order,” respectively, with different semantic functions
patterns.domain: Biomedical research and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Local activation of the word are
patterns.context: Occurs in “the TFT … are known” and “bone graft are illustrated”; there is no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Patent citation wording proposes a method
patterns.context: Introduces a method proposed in an existing patent; activation evidence is sparse and may co-occur with patent citation format

patterns.name: Local phrase in this manner
patterns.context: Describes assembly convenience resulting from the preceding structure; adjacent to general patent narration, but not a stable pattern across passages

patterns.name: Figure-reference wording illustrated in Figure
patterns.context: The paper’s body text cites a figure to illustrate an intraoperative device and bone graft
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper figure and table citations

7_127.concept: 科学与专利文本中的引用及总结标记
7_127.description: 主要对专利文本中的引文标记及生物医学论文结果总结短语“These data”响应；另有 as well as、in、are 等零散局部触发和少数句式，不能统一解释。

patterns.name: 专利文献编号与引用格式
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中引用既有专利或参考文献，常见编号标记及其相邻标点、换行

patterns.name: 科学论文结果总结句
patterns.context: 实验或临床结果之后，以“These data”引出证据、解释或结论；段内也可能出现“This manner”等相邻常见词，但不构成这一模式的核心触发

patterns.name: 英语词组 as well as
patterns.context: 列举或对照多个选项时使用“as well as”连接补充项

patterns.name: 英语连接词 as 的语境用法
patterns.context: 出现在“as they carried emergency goods”中，表示原因或情境；本例中没有可确认的专利引用或结果总结模式

patterns.name: 单词 in 的局部激活
patterns.context: 分别位于“in HFR/HFA+M group”及“in the sub-nanometer order”等短语中，语义功能不同
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与专利技术描述

patterns.name: 单词 are 的局部激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在“the TFT … are known”及“bone graft are illustrated”中；缺少共同的明确语义或句式条件
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 专利引用措辞 proposes a method
patterns.context: 介绍既有专利提出的方法；激活证据稀疏，且与专利引用格式可能共现

patterns.name: in this manner 的局部短语
patterns.context: 描述前述结构带来的装配便利；与通用专利叙述相邻，但不是跨段稳定模式

patterns.name: 图表说明措辞 illustrated in Figure
patterns.context: 论文正文引用图示来说明术中装置与骨移植物
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文图表引用

en.concept: Discourse continuation and summarization in formal discussion
en.description: Primarily responds to formulaic expressions used to connect evidence, summarize results, evaluate propositions, or introduce literature in academic or formal discussion; also covers news quote attribution, negative explanations, and case-focus statements.

patterns.name: “This result(s) is consistent with” result-consistency statement
patterns.context: In paper discussions or results sections, “This result(s) is consistent with” introduces support for prior findings or observations; activation falls on result(s), is, consistent, and related words.

patterns.name: “These results indicated” result-inference statement
patterns.context: In a paper’s results section, plural results serves as the subject and indicated introduces a conclusion supported by experimental results.

patterns.name: Continuation and contrast in legal argument
patterns.context: A legal decision first acknowledges that a proposition holds, then uses but to qualify its effect and continue the argument.

patterns.name: Negative explanation or causal account
patterns.context: A legal argument rejects an explanation, stating that it does not adequately account for an earlier fact or delay.

patterns.name: Reporting verb in quoted speech
patterns.context: News narrative closes a direct quotation by attributing it to a source and using says.

patterns.name: Reporting verb in quoted speech
patterns.context: A news report identifies the speaker with said after quoting a viewpoint.

patterns.name: Retrospective introduction in patent background sections
patterns.context: A patent background section reviews prior solutions and introduces a patent number or literature source.

patterns.name: Prior research focus in a quotation
patterns.context: States that a type of behavior has been the focus of many cases; activation is distributed across expressions such as has been the focus.

patterns.name: Parenthetical citation markers in academic literature
patterns.context: Uses parenthetical numbers to mark references in background or discussion; the passage also contains protein nomenclature and citations.

7_127.concept: 正式论述中的话语承接与归纳
7_127.description: 主要响应学术或正式论述中用于承接证据、总结结果、评述命题或引入文献的程式化表达；也覆盖新闻引语归属、否定解释及案例焦点表述。

patterns.name: “This result(s) is consistent with”结果一致表述
patterns.context: 论文讨论或结果段落中，以“This result(s) is consistent with”引出对既有发现或观察结果的支持；激活落在 result(s)、is、consistent 等词上。

patterns.name: “These results indicated”结果推断表述
patterns.context: 论文结果段落中，以复数 results 作主语、indicated 引出实验结果所支持的结论。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的承接与转折
patterns.trigger: “This proposition is true, but it is only a starting point”
patterns.context: 法律判决书先承认某命题成立，再用 but 限定其作用并继续论证。

patterns.name: 否定解释或因果说明
patterns.context: 法律论证中否定某个解释，指出其不足以说明先前事实或延迟。

patterns.name: 引述语句中的报告动词
patterns.context: 新闻叙述以引述来源及 says 收束直接引语。

patterns.name: 引述语句中的报告动词
patterns.context: 新闻报道在引述观点后以 said 标明发言者。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的回顾引介
patterns.trigger: “A review of such schemes is given in”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术回顾先前方案，并引出专利号或文献出处。

patterns.name: 引述中的既有研究焦点
patterns.trigger: “has been the focus of numerous … cases”
patterns.context: 说明某类行为已成为大量案例关注的对象；激活分布在 has been the focus 等表述。

patterns.name: 学术文献中的括号引文标记
patterns.context: 背景介绍或论述中以括号数字标注参考文献；本段同时出现蛋白质命名和引文。

en.description: Activations are distributed across common function words, inter-sentence contrast or elaboration, transitions between patent problems and solutions, literature citations, and the aims of paper discussions; there are also sporadic terms and formatting noise, with no overall unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Start of an inter-sentence contrast or addition
patterns.context: At a paragraph or discourse transition, a connective introduces a contrast, addition, or new point; the marker often occurs at the start of a word.

patterns.name: Problem-to-solution transition in patent background
patterns.context: Describes a problem with an existing structure, then introduces a proposed solution or a later embodiment.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Literature citations and evidence references
patterns.context: Refers to existing solutions or literature through review, quotation, or patent numbers.

patterns.name: Statements of discussion or research aims
patterns.context: Discusses research results or describes predictions and the aims of the current study.

patterns.name: Common function words such as «in»
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English syntactic positions; nearby activations also cover expressions such as 「more detail」. The fragments alone do not reveal a specific semantic condition.

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Appear in varied syntactic positions, with no confirmed shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Patents, academic papers, news narratives, and other texts

patterns.name: Noise and uncertain subword fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in formulas, citations, or formatted text, so no stable pattern can be confirmed from them.

7_127.description: 激活分散于常见功能词、句间转折补充、专利问题与方案过渡、文献引用及论文讨论目的等位置；另有零散词项和格式噪声，整体未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 句间转折或补充起始
patterns.context: 段落或论述推进处，用连接词引出转折、补充或新观点；标记常出现在词首。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、论文及报告

patterns.name: 专利背景中的问题—方案过渡
patterns.trigger: «problem»、«above»、«In order to solve»、«As will be described»
patterns.context: 描述现有结构的问题，再引出拟采用的方案或后文实施例。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: 文献引用与证据引述
patterns.context: 通过回顾、引述或专利号指向已有方案或文献。

patterns.name: 讨论或研究目的表述
patterns.context: 论文讨论研究结果，或说明预测及当前研究目标。

patterns.name: «in» 等常见功能词
patterns.context: 出现在普通英文句法位置，附近激活也覆盖「more detail」等表达；单凭片段难以判断是否有特定语义条件。

patterns.name: 其余零散词项
patterns.context: 散见于不同句法位置，未形成可确认的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文、新闻叙述及其他文本

patterns.name: 噪声与不确定子词
patterns.context: 嵌在公式、引用或格式化文本中，无法据此确认稳定模式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及格式化文本

en.concept: Clues in academic and technical texts
en.description: Activation is distributed across citation markers, connective words in technical descriptions, research-narrative phrases, and words in philosophical arguments in papers and patents; there is no clear single semantic theme, and it more likely reflects local formatting or syntactic cues in academic and patent texts.

patterns.name: References and citation markers
patterns.context: Citations in parentheses, numbered square-bracket references, and surrounding punctuation; these occur across materials with different content

patterns.name: Function words and technical descriptions in patent narrative
patterns.context: Continuous explanations in patent background sections or technical solutions; activation falls on common connectives, prepositions, and words describing problems

patterns.name: Phrase linking in academic argument
patterns.context: Academic discussion explains prior research on receptor ligands and introduces what follows

patterns.name: Judgment and entailment words in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Philosophical argument discussing belief, rationality, and experience; activation centers on expressions of assertion and logical relations

7_127.description: 激活分散在论文、专利中的引文标记、技术说明连接词、研究叙述短语及哲学论证词上；没有清晰的单一语义主题，较可能反映学术与专利文本中的局部格式或句法线索。

patterns.name: 参考文献与引文标记
patterns.context: 括号中的引文、方括号编号及其周边标点；不同材料内容中均出现

patterns.name: 专利叙述中的功能词和技术说明
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术方案的连续说明，激活落在常见连接词、介词及问题描述词上

patterns.name: 学术论证中的短语连接
patterns.context: 解释受体配体已有研究并引出后文的学术叙述

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的判断与蕴含词
patterns.context: 讨论信念、理性及经验的哲学论证；激活集中于断言和逻辑关系表达

en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of local structures: quote-source verbs, paper results pointing to tables, prepositions and punctuation, discourse connectives, and subword fragments in proper names; there are also sporadic words and phrases in scientific texts. No single theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: Quoted source or speaker
patterns.context: After quoted or paraphrased content, a personal or source subject appears with a reporting or speech verb; activation centers on verbs such as said, says, tell, and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Results and table references in papers
patterns.context: Research results, clinical characteristics, or sensitivity data are presented and linked to a table number or citation marker.

patterns.name: Multiple local collocations of the preposition in
patterns.context: In occurs before a patient count, before a table reference, or within an ordinary narrative sentence; neighboring words are not consistent, and the trigger may simply be a local syntactic position.

patterns.name: Comma and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Commas occur in clause transitions, parentheticals, quotations, or lists; several examples activate near punctuation, but not every comma triggers activation.

patterns.name: Discourse markers in quotations
patterns.context: Near direct quotations or interview paraphrases, supplementary information or quoted content follows a speaker verb.

patterns.name: General function words and discourse transitions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial connectives, prepositional phrases, and explanatory transitions; there is insufficient evidence that one fixed phrase triggers activation.
patterns.domain: News, papers, and patent background sections

patterns.name: Local activation near entities or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments in split personal names, place names, or cited author names, possibly related to tokenization of proper names.

patterns.name: Scientific text passages without a stable pattern
patterns.context: Activation occurs near protein notation, in the patent structure been isolated, and in the ordinary collocation records exist; these lack an evident shared condition.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, biomedical texts, general expository writing

7_127.description: 激活分散在多类局部结构：引述来源动词、论文结果指向表格、介词与标点、篇章连接词，以及专名分词；另有科学文本中的零散词句。没有单一主题能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 引述来源或发言者
patterns.trigger: « she»9« says»3；« she»9« said»5；« he»9« said»7；« sources»4« tell»9
patterns.context: 引号内或转述内容之后，出现人称/来源主语并接报道、发言动词；激活集中在 said、says、tell 等动词及相邻词。

patterns.name: 论文中的结果与表格引用
patterns.trigger: « results»1« of»4« the»2…« are»5« presented»6« in»10« [»5«Table»4« 1»2]；« is»4« shown»5« in»9« Table»3
patterns.context: 研究结果、临床特征或敏感性数据被呈现、展示，并引向表格编号或引用标记。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的多种局部搭配
patterns.trigger: « in»3 591 patients；« in»10 [«Table»；« it»1…« in it»；« I»5 do»3 not»9 know
patterns.context: in 出现在患者数量前、表格引用前，或普通叙述的句内位置；邻近词并不统一，触发条件可能只是局部句法位置。

patterns.name: 逗号及其邻接标点
patterns.context: 逗号常出现在从句衔接、插入语、引用或列表中；多个样例在标点附近激活，但并非所有逗号都触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、新闻、一般叙述

patterns.name: 引文中的话语标记
patterns.trigger: « she»9« says»3,« concluding»1: ``I wouldn«'t»1；« she»9« said»5
patterns.context: 直接引语或采访转述附近，发言者动词后连接补充说明或引述内容。

patterns.name: 一般功能词与篇章衔接
patterns.trigger: « Moreover»1, we« also»2；« according« to»2 the；« as»2 discussed»6« in»9« more»2 detail»6
patterns.context: 句首连接词、介词短语及说明性过渡语；没有足够证据表明同一固定短语触发。

patterns.name: 实体或专名附近的局部激活
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的姓名、地名或引用作者名称的子词片段上，可能与专名分词有关。

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定模式的科学文本片段
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在蛋白质记号附近、专利句中 been isolated 的结构，以及 records exist 的普通搭配；彼此缺少明显共同条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、生物医学文本、一般说明文

en.concept: Guidance to evidence or subsequent text
en.description: Activation often occurs in formal technical texts in expressions introducing figures, tables, or prior publications; a few instances occur in paper corroboration, news predictions about possible candidates, and patent previews of differences. A possible commonality is that formal narrative connects to and points toward evidence or subsequent text, but the trigger forms vary.

patterns.name: Introduction of figures, tables, or diagrams
patterns.context: Describes results, structures, or factors and uses shown/illustrated/presented to introduce a table, figure, or diagram number; activation centers on “in” and the following figure or table reference.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedical and chemistry papers

patterns.name: Figure examples in patent background sections
patterns.context: A patent background section explains a technical solution, structure, or embodiment, then points to a figure using FIG plus a number.

patterns.name: Patent or publication references in literature
patterns.context: Patent background sections discuss existing technology or testing devices and refer back to a previously mentioned publication.

patterns.name: Prediction of possible candidates
patterns.context: A news report discusses a company leadership transition; activation falls on a person’s name after “are” and in the predictive statement.

patterns.name: Confirmation of research conclusions
patterns.context: A paper discusses existing results and cites recent research for further corroboration.

patterns.name: Preview of differences or results
patterns.context: A patent text previews that a later section will show the differences between the invention and existing solutions.

7_127.description: 激活多出现在正式技术文本中引出图表、附图或既有出版物的表达；少数落在论文佐证、新闻人选预测和专利差异预告中。共同点可能是正式叙述中承接并指向证据或后文，但触发形式不一。

patterns.name: 图表或示意图的引出
patterns.context: 描述结果、结构或因素，并用 shown/illustrated/presented 引出表、图或示意图编号；激活集中在 “in” 及后续图表引用附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学与化学

patterns.name: 专利背景中的图示举例
patterns.trigger: “is presented in FIG” 和 “as shown in FIG”
patterns.context: 专利背景说明技术方案、结构或实施例，随后以 FIG 加编号指向附图。

patterns.name: 文献中提及专利或出版物
patterns.context: 专利背景讨论已有技术或测试装置，并回指前述出版物。

patterns.name: 可能人选的预测表达
patterns.trigger: “are the most likely candidates to take over as co-CEOs”
patterns.context: 新闻报道公司领导层交接；激活落在 “are” 后的人名及预测语句中。

patterns.name: 研究结论的确认
patterns.trigger: “This is further confirmed by a recent study”
patterns.context: 论文讨论既有结果，并援引近期研究作进一步佐证。

patterns.name: 区别或结果的预告
patterns.context: 专利文本预告后文将展示本发明与既有方案的差异。

en.concept: Words in citation and discussion contexts
en.description: The most consistent pattern is in introducing figure numbers, patent numbers, or literature sources in patent backgrounds; there are also discussion/citation contexts and a few scattered function-word, pronoun, and infinitive triggers that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Citation-introducing expression in patent background
patterns.context: Occurs in patent backgrounds or prior-art narratives, followed by a figure number, patent number, or literature source; activation concentrates on in within the citation phrase.

patterns.name: Academic statements about discussion/descriptions
patterns.context: Activation appears in discussion, citation, or description of prior research or evidence, often in literature contexts introduced by in, though the distribution is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Patents, academic papers, medical research, and legal texts

patterns.name: to in an infinitival purpose construction
patterns.context: to appears in the purpose construction in order to, followed by solve; prominent only in this example.

patterns.name: Negative word not
patterns.context: Occurs in a negative judgment; this example is is not always high. Activation is weak, with no stable pattern of neighboring words.

patterns.name: Pronoun I
patterns.context: The first-person pronoun occurs in a sentence where the narrator says they do not know something.

patterns.name: Sporadic function words or unclassified triggers
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a passive perfect construction, a demonstrative expression, and a patent sentence that continues a description of a device; the current sample is insufficient to group them into a shared pattern.

7_127.description: 最一致的模式是在专利背景中以 in 引出图号、专利号或文献来源；另有讨论/引用语境，以及少量分散的功能词、代词和不定式触发，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的引证引出语
patterns.context: 位于专利背景或现有技术叙述中，后接图号、专利号或文献来源；激活集中在引证短语中的 in。

patterns.name: 讨论/描述类学术表述
patterns.context: 激活出现在对既有研究或证据的讨论、引用描述中，常见于 in 引导的文献语境，但分布并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文、医学研究及法律文本

patterns.name: 不定式目的结构中的 to
patterns.context: to 位于 in order to 目的结构中，后接 solve；只在此例突出。

patterns.name: 否定词 not
patterns.context: 处于否定判断中；本例为 is not always high，激活较弱且未见稳定邻接模式。

patterns.name: 代词 I
patterns.context: 第一人称代词处于叙述者说明自己不知道某事的句子中。

patterns.name: 零散功能词或未归类触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在被动完成式、指示语及专利设备承接句中，当前样本不足以归为共同模式。

en.description: Activation is distributed across common function words and narrative transitions in texts from multiple fields; some examples involve paper figures/tables and results, patent background sections and numbered citations, as well as first-person negative arguments. There is no single stable content-word trigger.

patterns.name: Common grammatical words within sentences
patterns.context: These frequent function words occur in continuous narrative or explanatory sentences; activation positions are distributed, with no single fixed word or syntactic position
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, papers, and patent texts

patterns.name: Figure, table, and patent figure-number references
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to figure, table, patent figure-number, and cross-reference citations when describing results or solutions

patterns.name: Solutions and problem statements in patent background sections
patterns.context: First identifies a problem with existing technology, then introduces a solution or cites prior disclosure

patterns.name: First-person negation and argumentative qualification
patterns.context: A first-person author expresses epistemic limitations or qualifies an argumentative conclusion

patterns.name: Presentation of results or research content
patterns.context: Summarizes research results, table contents, or prior research

patterns.name: Articles and prepositions near patent subject matter or technical terms
patterns.context: Patent narrative introduces an existing device, solution, or patent number; activation falls on common words rather than specialized terms

patterns.name: Legal-relation statements without an evident shared trigger
patterns.context: Describes evidence and agency relationships, with no indication of a specialized semantic trigger shared with other highly activated sentences

7_127.description: 激活分布在多领域文本的常见功能词及叙述连接处；部分例子涉及论文图表/结果、专利背景与编号引用，以及第一人称否定论证。没有单一稳定的内容词触发。

patterns.name: 句中常见语法词
patterns.context: 这些高频功能词出现在连续叙述或解释性句子中；激活位置分散，未见单一固定词或句法位置
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、论文和专利文本

patterns.name: 图表与专利图号引用
patterns.context: 描述结果或方案时，紧邻图、表、专利附图编号及交叉引用

patterns.name: 专利背景中的方案与问题表述
patterns.trigger: “In order to solve the above problems”“approaches”“is presented”“described”“publication”
patterns.context: 先指出既有技术的问题，再介绍方案或引用先前公开内容

patterns.name: 第一人称否定与论证转折
patterns.trigger: “I do not know”“I do not think”“What I do not think”
patterns.context: 第一人称作者在表达认知限制或对论证结论作限定

patterns.name: 结果或研究内容的呈现
patterns.context: 概述研究结果、表格内容或既有研究
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤见医学论文

patterns.name: 专利权利客体或技术名词周边的冠词介词
patterns.trigger: “in the past”“a review”“such schemes”“U.S. Pat. No.”
patterns.context: 专利叙述中介绍既有装置、方案或专利号；激活落在常见词而非专属术语

patterns.name: 未见明显共同触发的法律关系表述
patterns.context: 描述证据及代理关系，未显示与其他高激活例句相同的专门语义触发

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions that introduce figures and present results in papers; it also responds more weakly to first/latest events, further explanation or judgments, argumentative transitions, and emphatic words in news quotations. Triggers are distributed, with no single strict grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Figure/figure content presentation
patterns.context: Introduces a figure, figure number, or figure content in a research paper; activation concentrates on “in” and nearby figure-related expressions.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedical, materials science, and crystallography

patterns.name: Superlative or highlighting recent developments
patterns.context: An event or action is described as occurring for the first time or emphasized as the latest step in a series; activation falls around first/latest.

patterns.name: Further explanation or explicit judgment
patterns.context: Signals that a point will be elaborated later in the text, or uses further to introduce a stronger claim.

patterns.name: Contrast and argumentative transition
patterns.context: A philosophical argument first acknowledges some criticism, then qualifies its conclusion with however; activation is prominently concentrated on not.

patterns.name: Emphatic statement in a quotation
patterns.context: A news report quotes a speaker and continues with a description of the situation or consequences; activation falls near he or what.

7_127.description: 主要响应论文中引出图示、结果呈现的表达；另对首次/最新事件、进一步说明或判断、论证转折及新闻引语中的强调词有较弱响应。触发形式分散，未见单一严格语法模式。

patterns.name: 图示/图中展示
patterns.trigger: “illustrated in Figure”“results are shown in”“are shown in Fig.”
patterns.context: 研究论文中引出图、图号或图中内容，激活集中在 “in” 及后续图示表达附近。

patterns.name: 最高级或突出最新进展

patterns.context: 事件或行动被描述为首次发生，或被强调为一系列行动中最新的一步；激活落在 first/latest 一带。

patterns.name: 进一步说明或明确判断
patterns.trigger: “as discussed in more detail below”“It is further clear”
patterns.context: 正文中提示后文会详述某点，或以 further 引出加强的论断。

patterns.name: 对照与论证转折
patterns.trigger: “What I do not think Kant shows, however”
patterns.context: 哲学论述中先认可部分批评，再以 however 限定其结论；激活显著集中在 not。

patterns.name: 引语中的强调性陈述
patterns.context: 新闻报道引述发言，并接续对处境或后果的描述；激活落在 he 或 what 附近。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code identifiers and routing, scientific terminology and paper phrasing, names and personal descriptions, energy news, and patent mechanical wording; there is no trigger concept that is stably shared across passages.

patterns.name: index string within a word

7_251.description: 激活分散在代码标识符与路由、科学术语和论文表述、人名与人物描述、能源新闻及专利机械措辞中；没有跨段稳定共享的触发概念。

patterns.name: 词内 index 字符串

7_251.description: 激活分散在多类内容中：突出数字/索引及网页路由代码，也见研究术语、拆分人名、政治人物描述和专利结构措辞；没有明显统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 索引、编号及类似索引的词
