patterns.trigger: 日文字符，如「資」「金」「移」「動」「業」「務」「提」「供」「され」「いかにも」「山」「独り」「生き」「心地」「悟り」「形而上学」「哲学」
patterns.context: 日语句子、书名或术语中，激活落在连续的日文汉字、假名词素上；并无单一固定词义。
patterns.domain: 日语金融说明、文学引文、书目及哲学文本

patterns.name: 中文双字词与语义搭配
patterns.context: 中文说明文字中，激活常落在双字词的组成字上，尤其是术语或信息较密集的表述。
patterns.domain: 算法注释、IDE 文档、浏览器安全说明

patterns.name: 中文网页导航及致谢用语
patterns.context: 网页导航标签、项目致谢等简短中文界面或说明文字。
patterns.domain: 网页源码与开源项目文档

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在俄语词形内部，覆盖程序及配套材料、许可条件等表述。

patterns.name: 希伯来语词素
patterns.context: 希伯来语词内的字母或词素被激活，位于英语百科正文引用的机构名称中。
patterns.domain: 百科文章中的希伯来语专名

patterns.name: 零散拉丁字母及数字表达
patterns.context: 代码注释、链接或许可文本中夹杂的字母串；激活较零散，未显示稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页源码及许可文本

en.concept: Natural-language fragments in multilingual technical text
en.description: Activation occurs in natural-language explanations in Chinese software technical documentation, code comments, and Q&A, and also in Japanese and Russian text and webpage navigation. It often falls on Chinese words or technical explanatory fragments, but no single fixed term or stable grammatical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Chinese technical explanations in code and documentation
patterns.context: Chinese words embedded in code, comments, configuration, or technical documentation; punctuation, line breaks, and English identifiers are often nearby
patterns.domain: Software engineering documentation and code comments

patterns.name: Common words in Chinese technical prose
patterns.context: In the body text of technical Q&A or documentation, activation falls on common Chinese or Japanese words rather than an obvious fixed technical term

patterns.name: Mixed-language and multilingual text
patterns.context: Continuous natural-language text appears in Japanese verse or Russian program descriptions

patterns.name: Web navigation and link labels
patterns.context: Text in HTML links, navigation bars, and other webpage interface elements

patterns.name: Markers and symbols in technical code
patterns.context: Near code or comment syntax markers; activation is weaker and co-occurs with surrounding Chinese explanations

patterns.name: Line-break markers at the start of a passage
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of lines or text boundaries in multiple passages, but does not mark activation in every occurrence, making its independent trigger role difficult to determine

7_251.concept: 多语种技术文本中的自然语言片段
7_251.description: 激活分布于中文软件技术文档、代码注释和问答中的自然语言说明，也见日文、俄文文本及网页导航；常落在中文词语或技术说明片段上，但未见单一固定术语或稳定语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码、文档中的中文技术说明
patterns.trigger: 如「最大堆」「默认值」「具体配置」「实验现象」「标准文件」及相邻说明文字
patterns.context: 中文词语嵌在代码、注释、配置或技术文档中；常有标点、换行和英文标识符相邻
patterns.domain: 软件工程文档与代码注释

patterns.name: 中文技术正文中的常用词
patterns.trigger: 「根本目的」「保护」「何らかの原因」等说明性表达
patterns.context: 技术问答或文档正文中，激活落在普通中文词语或日文词语上，而非一个明显固定术语

patterns.name: 混合语言及多语种文本
patterns.trigger: 日文「いかにも」「心地して」、俄文「в соответствии с условиями」
patterns.context: 日文诗句或俄文程序说明中出现连续的自然语言文本

patterns.name: 网页导航与链接标签
patterns.context: HTML 链接、导航栏等网页界面文字

patterns.name: 技术代码中的标记/符号
patterns.context: 代码或注释语法标记附近；激活强度较低，且与周围中文说明并存

patterns.name: 段首换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在多个片段的行首或文本边界，但并非所有出现处都标记激活，难以确定独立触发作用

en.description: Activations concentrate on continuous fragments in Chinese, Japanese, and other non-Latin scripts, especially Chinese technical explanations; they also cover multilingual quotations embedded in English and Chinese entertainment-related words. Topics vary across segments.

patterns.name: Functional descriptions in Chinese technical documentation
patterns.context: Chinese technical documentation, code comments, or explanations, especially consecutive Chinese words, grammatical particles, and punctuation; specific topics vary across segments
patterns.domain: Github code comments/documentation, Chinese website text

patterns.name: Japanese text fragments
patterns.context: Japanese sentences or technical Q&A; activations are distributed across multiple tokens in continuous Japanese text

patterns.name: Non-Latin scripts and multilingual proper names
patterns.context: Multilingual proper names or quotations appear in English narratives, biographies, or Q&A

patterns.name: Chinese entertainment-related words
patterns.context: Chinese words interspersed among English news, music-related text, and proper names; the context differs from other Chinese technical segments

7_251.description: 激活集中于中文、日文及其他非拉丁文字的连续片段，尤其包括中文技术说明；也覆盖夹在英文中的多语种引文和中文娱乐词语。跨段主题不统一。

patterns.name: 中文技术文档中的功能说明
patterns.trigger: 如“最…堆”“同源策略”“关联信息”“串口输出”“需要观察串口”等中文技术词语与说明文字
patterns.context: 中文技术文档、代码注释或说明中，尤其是连续的中文词语及其语法助词、标点；各段具体主题并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释/文档、中文网页文本

patterns.name: 日文文本片段
patterns.trigger: 「いかにも山の中に」「HTTP 200はOKという意味で」等日文假名、汉字及助词
patterns.context: 日语句子或技术问答；激活分布在日文连续文本的多个 token 上

patterns.name: 非拉丁文字与多语种专名
patterns.trigger: 希伯来文「המכון להסברת…」、俄文「Здравствуй」、中文「超级女声」
patterns.context: 多语种专名或引文出现在英文叙述、人物介绍或问答中

patterns.name: 中文娱乐类词语
patterns.context: 夹在英文新闻、音乐相关文字及专名之间的中文词语；上下文与其他中文技术段不同
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 混合语言网页文本

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the letter substring “ummy”: it appears in dummy (test, placeholder, or mock objects) and gummy (food), as well as in several semantically unrelated or abnormally segmented contexts.

patterns.name: dummy in strings
patterns.context: dummy combines with prefixes or suffixes to form code identifiers, test data, or names of temporary/mock things; activation centers on the substring ummy in dummy.

patterns.name: gummy food word
patterns.context: ummy occurs in the word gummy, adjacent to fajitas or bears; one other instance is adjacent to a non-food string.

patterns.name: ummy substring inside other words
patterns.context: The activation fragment appears as a substring within a word or near a string boundary, but the context does not form a clear, consistent semantic category; some words are split or appear in garbled text.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, medical abstracts, energy emails, and trading Q&A

7_446.concept: 字符串子串 ummy
7_446.description: 激活最稳定地落在字母子串“ummy”上：出现在 dummy（测试、占位或模拟对象）和 gummy（食品）中，也出现在数个语义不相干或切分异常的上下文里。

patterns.name: 字符串中的 dummy
patterns.context: dummy 与前缀或后缀组合成代码标识符、测试数据或临时/模拟事物名称；激活集中在 dummy 的子串 ummy。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、选举测试叙述

patterns.name: gummy 食品词
patterns.context: ummy 出现在 gummy 一词中，分别邻接 fajitas 或 bears；另有一次与非食品字符串相邻。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 随文文本、饮食/营养文章

patterns.name: 其他词内部的 ummy 字符串
patterns.context: 激活片段呈现为词内子串或字符串边界附近，但上下文不构成清楚一致的语义类别；其中有词语被切分或乱码样式文本。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、医学摘要、能源邮件及交易问答

en.description: The strongest and most repeated cue is Dummy and its morphological fragments, appearing across code, test text, and encyclopedia contexts; other high activations are scattered across words such as yummy, Normal, far, Chen, and LOCALLY, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Dummy and its morphological fragments
patterns.context: dummy appears as a marker, test object, fictional example, or placeholder; activation is concentrated on Dummy and its subword fragments, without requiring a fixed syntactic position
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including forums, code, encyclopedias, and academic titles

patterns.name: The phrase yummy fajitas
patterns.context: Appears near a line break in a HackerNews quote or comment, with tilde delimiters before and after the phrase; activation mainly falls on fragments of yummy

patterns.name: Normal-state category term
patterns.context: Listed alongside Aberrant and Degenerate in a title as one of the categories to distinguish in image analysis

patterns.name: Degree use of far
patterns.context: Occurs in “so far been highly resistant,” meaning up to the present

patterns.name: Food name gummy
patterns.context: Appears in “gummy bears” as an example of candy in a ketogenic diet context

patterns.name: Proper name Chen
patterns.context: Appears as part of the place name “Grand Chen(i)ere” in an email body

patterns.name: Internal fragment of LOCALLY
patterns.context: Embedded in “MEW LOCALLY,” describing local execution; activation is on a capitalized subword fragment, not an obvious standalone semantic pattern

7_446.concept: 词形片段触发，偏向 Dummy
7_446.description: 最强且重复的线索是 Dummy 及其构词片段，跨代码、测试文本和百科等语境出现；其余高激活分散于 yummy、Normal、far、Chen、LOCALLY 等词，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Dummy 词及其构词片段
patterns.context: dummy 作为标记、测试对象、虚构示例或占位内容出现；激活集中在 Dummy 及其子词片段，不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 论坛、代码、百科、学术标题等多种文体

patterns.name: yummy fajitas 短语
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 引文或评论的换行附近，短语前后有波浪线分隔符；其中主要激活落在 yummy 的片段

patterns.name: 正常状态类别词
patterns.context: 标题中与 Aberrant、Degenerate 并列，作为图像分析要区分的类别之一

patterns.name: far 的程度用法
patterns.context: 位于“so far been highly resistant”中，表示迄今为止

patterns.name: gummy 食物名称
patterns.context: 出现在“gummy bears”中，作为生酮饮食语境下的糖果例子

patterns.name: 专名 Chen
patterns.context: 作为“Grand Chen(i)ere”地名的一部分出现在邮件正文

patterns.name: LOCALLY 的内部片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“MEW LOCALLY”中，描述本地运行；激活的是大小写词片段，而非明显的独立语义模式

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the split ummy fragment in dummy/gummy, with varied prefixes and contexts; there are also isolated activations on pixel in code and far in a medical abstract.

patterns.name: Substring ummy
patterns.context: When the letter sequence dummy or gummy is split by a tokenization boundary, activation is concentrated on the fragment ummy; prefixes vary, as does capitalization.
patterns.domain: Forum text, code, encyclopedias, medical abstracts, and web text

patterns.name: pixel identifier
patterns.context: Appears in a C/C++ code rgb_pixel struct and function parameters.

patterns.name: far collocation with highly resistant
patterns.context: In the phrase “so far been highly resistant,” describing the limited effectiveness of treatment to date.

7_446.concept: 分词片段 ummy
7_446.description: 主要对 dummy/gummy 中被分开的 ummy 片段强烈响应，前缀和语境多样；另有代码中的 pixel 与医学摘要中的 far 各自孤立激活。

patterns.name: ummy 子串
patterns.context: 字母序列 dummy 或 gummy 被分词边界切开时，激活集中在片段 ummy；前缀各异，大小写也有变化。
patterns.domain: 论坛文字、代码、百科、医学摘要及网页文本

patterns.name: pixel 标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 代码的 rgb_pixel 结构体及函数参数中。

patterns.name: far 搭配 highly resistant
patterns.context: 短语“so far been highly resistant”中，描述治疗干预迄今效果不佳。

en.description: The strongest activations mostly occur on the spelling fragment «ummy» (Dummy/yummy); others occur on heh in the name Maragheh and word-initial he in healing. Triggers span code, food, encyclopedia, and web contexts, suggesting a response primarily to local character or subword forms.

patterns.name: Dummy substring
patterns.context: Mixed-case “Dummy” appears in code identifiers or ordinary words; in segments 1, 5, and 6 it is part of an identifier, while in segments 2 and 3 it occurs in garbled, delimiter-like text.
patterns.domain: Code, encyclopedia narratives, and web text

patterns.name: yummy substring
patterns.context: Inside the lowercase word “yummy,” or in garbled text beginning with y followed by “ummy”; associated with food or adult-content contexts.
patterns.domain: Food reviews, health articles, adult web text

patterns.name: Fragment in the name Qush Qayeh
patterns.context: In the Persian name transliteration “Qush Qayeh Maragheh,” activation falls on the “heh” part at the end of the name.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in healing
patterns.context: In the quoted word “healing,” activation centers on the initial “he”; the sentence mentions healing springs.

7_446.concept: 对特定子词片段的响应
7_446.description: 最强激活多落在拼写片段 «ummy»（Dummy/yummy）上；另有名字 Maragheh 中的 heh、healing 词首 he。触发跨代码、食品、百科及网页语境，可能主要响应局部字符或子词形态。

patterns.name: Dummy 子串
patterns.context: 在代码标识符或普通词中出现大小写混合的 “Dummy”；第 1、5、6 段中它是标识符的一部分，第 2、3 段中处于乱码式分隔文本内。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科叙述及网页文本

patterns.name: yummy 子串
patterns.context: 小写单词 “yummy” 内，或乱码文本中以 y 开头、紧接 “ummy”；对应美食语境或成人内容语境。
patterns.domain: 食品评论、健康文章、成人网页文本

patterns.name: Qush Qayeh 名字中的片段
patterns.context: 波斯名字转写 “Qush Qayeh Maragheh” 中，激活落在名字末尾的 “heh” 部分。

patterns.name: healing 的内部片段
patterns.context: 引号括起的单词 “healing” 中，激活集中于词首 “he”；句子提到疗愈泉水。

en.description: Responses are cross-domain and scattered: activations occur in test code, Dummy/URL identifiers, Scala and other code naming, paper abstract terminology, forum English, and mod_ module names; the most salient repeated cue is the Dummy/yummy fragment, but it does not explain all instances.

patterns.name: Dummy/test placeholder identifiers
patterns.context: Dummy or yummy fragments appear in code or user comments; the first examples are test data or placeholders, while the last two are the signature-like string “yummyfajitas” repeated in HackerNews posts.

patterns.name: URL-related identifiers
patterns.context: URL appears as MVC content, a function parameter, or a test placeholder value; it sometimes co-occurs with Dummy.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and paper openings
patterns.context: Abstract- or paper-style statements opening with a research subject, experimental finding, or disease characteristic; fragments 2 and 10 also contain “cyclic,” and fragment 9 contains “k4.”

patterns.name: mod_ pattern in code identifiers
patterns.context: Server extension module names beginning with mod_ appear in a list in a HackerNews sentence.

patterns.name: Local high responses in ordinary English discussion
patterns.context: Several ordinary words receive responses in comments about scientific views or metrics and optimization consequences; there is no obvious shared local trigger word.

patterns.name: Generic code syntax and naming fragments
patterns.context: Types, function names, field names, and language syntax in code; specific syntax and languages vary, with no single stable trigger condition.

7_446.concept: 混合词片段与标识符
7_446.description: 响应跨领域且分散：测试代码、Dummy/URL 标识符、Scala 等代码命名、论文摘要术语、论坛英文及 mod_ 模块名均有激活；最醒目的重复线索是 Dummy/yummy 片段，但不足以解释全部实例。

patterns.name: Dummy/测试占位符标识符
patterns.context: 代码或用户评论中出现 Dummy、yummy 片段；前几例是测试数据或占位符，后两例是 HackerNews 帖子中重复出现的签名式字符串“yummyfajitas”。

patterns.name: URL相关标识符
patterns.context: URL 作为 MVC 内容、函数参数或测试占位值出现；有时与 Dummy 同现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 代码

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及论文开头
patterns.context: 摘要或论文式表述，以研究对象、实验发现或疾病特征开篇；片段2和10另有“cyclic”，片段9有“k4”。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 mod_ 模式
patterns.context: 以 mod_ 开头的服务器扩展模块名在 HackerNews 句子中并列出现。

patterns.name: 普通英文论述中的局部高响应
patterns.context: 关于科学观点或指标与优化后果的评论中，若干普通词获得响应；没有明显共同的局部触发词。

patterns.name: 通用代码语法与命名片段
patterns.context: 代码中的类型名、函数名、字段名及语言语法；具体语法和语言不一致，未见单一稳定触发条件。

en.description: Activation centers on the literal fragments “1038” and “url,” especially in DOIs, URLs, or URL-like identifiers; the rest is sporadic across local tokens in code, field names, API documentation, plotting Q&A, queries, and directory names, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: 10.1038 DOI identifier
patterns.context: Journal names, DOI prefixes, or DOI numbers occur; sometimes the DOI is split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: URLs and related identifiers
patterns.context: Code contains URL parameters, URL helper functions, or fictional URLs, or an identifier appears as a domain-like string

patterns.name: Hash algorithm name fragment
patterns.context: Appears as part of an identifier in Rust code near secp256k1-related code

patterns.name: Test users and status fields
patterns.context: User records and status text appear in Laravel/PHP test data construction

patterns.name: Ad campaign and label relationship
patterns.context: Google Ads protobuf resource names and their documentation strings describe the relationship between campaigns and labels

patterns.name: Plotting terminology
patterns.context: A ggplot2 Q&A title discusses line and point geometries for different data series

patterns.name: Bitmap and icon fallback
patterns.context: Test code calls an icon service and falls back to a style when icon retrieval fails

patterns.name: Spelling fragment and memory query
patterns.context: Code mixed with data records is followed by a SQL-like “select Mem… limit” query; the name/key fragment and the word for memory may trigger separately

patterns.name: Names and page-number typography in a directory
patterns.context: Names in bibliography-style directory lines are split by spaces, underscores, or tokenization and accompanied by page numbers

7_446.concept: URL/DOI 标识符片段
7_446.description: 激活集中于字面片段“1038”和“url”，尤其是 DOI、URL 或 URL 式标识符；其余分散在代码、字段名、API 文档、绘图问答、查询及目录姓名中的局部 token，缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: DOI 的 10.1038 标识
patterns.trigger: «1038»10，常与前面的《Nature Communications》及 DOI 片段同现
patterns.context: 出现期刊名、DOI 前缀或 DOI 编号时；有时 DOI 被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: URL 及其相关标识符
patterns.trigger: «url»10、«Url»10；也包括「10.1038/」中的 URL 式斜杠结构
patterns.context: 代码中出现 URL 参数、URL 辅助函数或虚构 URL，或标识符以域名式字符串呈现
patterns.domain: 软件代码与学术元数据

patterns.name: 哈希算法名称片段
patterns.context: Rust 代码中，作为标识符的一部分出现在 secp256k1 相关代码附近

patterns.name: 测试用户与状态字段
patterns.context: Laravel/PHP 测试数据构造中出现用户记录和状态正文

patterns.name: 广告活动与标签关系
patterns.context: Google Ads protobuf 资源名及其文档字符串描述活动与标签的关系

patterns.name: 图形绘制术语
patterns.context: ggplot2 的问答标题讨论不同数据系列的线和点几何对象

patterns.name: 位图与图标回退
patterns.context: 测试代码调用图标服务，并在图标获取失败时回退到样式

patterns.name: 拼写片段与内存查询
patterns.context: 代码夹杂数据记录，随后出现 SQL 式「select Mem… limit」查询；该姓名/键名片段与内存词可能分别触发

patterns.name: 目录中的姓名与页码排版
patterns.context: 书目式目录行中，姓名被空格、下划线或分词拆开，并附页码

en.concept: Compound identifiers and linked titles in technical text
en.description: Activation centers on technical strings with underscores or subword segmentation: code identifiers, configuration keys, and documentation terms; it also often occurs in Wikipedia Markdown link titles in HackerNews. Isolated cases involve diagnostic documentation, image-processing steps, and measurement expressions; link boundaries may contribute to triggering.

patterns.name: Wikipedia links and link text
patterns.context: Embedded Wikipedia or Markdown links in HackerNews posts, with titles split into multiple tokens; often accompanied by link previews, citations, or adjacent links.

patterns.name: Identifiers and underscore naming in code
patterns.context: Identifiers appear in code, configuration, or SQL/data-processing snippets, often adjacent to field, variable, or function names.
patterns.domain: Github code, configuration files, StackExchange programming answers

patterns.name: Subword segmentation within code identifiers
patterns.context: Class names, constants, configuration keys, or abbreviations in code are split into multiple subwords/tokens; not every occurrence of an underscore triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Github test code, documentation examples, configuration files

patterns.name: Documentation titles and linked technical terms
patterns.context: Occurs mainly in the title portion of Wikipedia links; words in titles are joined with underscores, or appear as proper names or technical terms.

patterns.name: Status/diagnostic text in technical explanations
patterns.context: Documentation text explaining program input handling, escaping rules, or exit status, mixed with command/manual-page markup.

patterns.name: Image-processing steps and label/contour terms
patterns.context: Describes steps for sorting by coordinates, extracting regions of interest, and binarizing labels.

patterns.name: Numeric and measurement expressions in natural language
patterns.context: A sentence gives terrain elevation difference as a number and unit, followed by a Wikipedia link title.

patterns.name: Numbering and Markdown link boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in quoted posts or Markdown link lists; these boundary tokens occur together with link titles, making it difficult to determine whether they trigger independently.

7_446.concept: 技术文本中的复合标识符与链接标题
7_446.description: 激活集中在带下划线或子词切分的技术字符串：代码标识符、配置键、文档术语；另常见于 HackerNews 的维基百科 Markdown 链接标题。单例还涉及诊断文档、图像处理步骤和测量表达，链接边界可能参与触发。

patterns.name: 维基百科链接及链接文本
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中嵌入的维基百科链接或 Markdown 链接，标题被拆成多个 token；常伴随链接预览、引用或相邻链接。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及下划线命名
patterns.trigger: “_status_es_for_a_user”“todo_include_todos”“predictions”“pred_and_labels”等，特别是下划线分隔的标识符
patterns.context: 代码、配置或 SQL/数据处理片段中出现标识符，常与字段名、变量名或函数名相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、配置文件、StackExchange 编程回答

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部的子词切分
patterns.trigger: “TestDummy::times”“m_db_load”“cf”“RTD”等混合大小写、缩写或分词后的代码片段
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、常量、配置键或缩写被拆成多个子词/token；并非所有出现下划线的情形都触发。
patterns.domain: Github 测试代码、文档示例、配置文件

patterns.name: 文档标题与技术术语链接
patterns.context: 主要出现在维基百科链接的标题部分；标题内部使用下划线连接词，或呈现专名、术语。

patterns.name: 技术说明中的状态/诊断文字
patterns.context: 说明程序输入处理、转义规则或退出状态的文档文字，夹杂命令/手册页标记。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、命令行手册风格

patterns.name: 图像处理步骤与标签/轮廓术语
patterns.context: 描述按坐标排序、提取感兴趣区域并对标签二值化的操作步骤。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术回答，图像处理

patterns.name: 自然语言中数值与测量表达
patterns.context: 句子中以数字和单位表达地形高差，后接维基百科链接标题。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 地理/铁路相关讨论

patterns.name: 编号及 Markdown 链接边界
patterns.trigger: “[1]”“[4]”“](http://...”等编号、方括号和链接分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在帖子引用或 Markdown 链接列表中；这些边界 token 与链接标题共同出现，难以断定单独触发。

en.concept: Lists of proper names and Swedish
en.description: One activation pattern occurs in dense lists of proper names and metadata such as institutions and personal names, often alongside numbers and punctuation; another broadly covers word subfragments in Swedish parliamentary or document text.

patterns.name: Lists of proper names and institutional entities
patterns.context: Proper names such as people, companies, organizations, and places occur densely, often comma-separated or in tables, legal bill names, email headers, author attributions, and institutional addresses; activation also covers some adjacent numbers, punctuation, and common words.
patterns.domain: Directories and tables, legal documents, code comments, encyclopedia entries, email, and academic attributions

patterns.name: Swedish text
patterns.context: Continuous Swedish sentences or parliamentary/document contexts; activation covers many Swedish words and their subword fragments, not just proper names.

7_446.concept: 专名串列与瑞典语
7_446.description: 一类激活于密集专名及机构、姓名等元数据串列，常伴随编号和标点；另一类广泛覆盖瑞典语议会或文书文本中的词语子片段。

patterns.name: 专名与机构实体串列
patterns.trigger: “Diners Club”“USA & Canada”“Charles G. MILLER”“Oracle Corporation”“Attaque 77”“Enron Energy Services”“Samuel”“Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona”
patterns.context: 姓名、公司、组织、地点等专名密集出现，常以逗号分隔，或处于表格、法律案名、邮件头、作者署名和机构地址中；激活也覆盖部分紧邻的编号、标点和普通词。
patterns.domain: 目录与表格、法律文书、代码注释、百科条目、邮件及学术署名

patterns.name: 瑞典语文本
patterns.trigger: “Angående den andra frågan”“Herr talman, ärade ledamöter”“Muntlige stemmeforklaringer”
patterns.context: 连续的瑞典语句子或议会/文书语境；激活覆盖大量瑞典语词及其子词片段，而非仅专名。

en.concept: Proper names and fields in structured text
en.description: Activation spans several kinds of structured text: email addresses and headers, IP/access logs, Swedish parliamentary speeches, Scala code, physics paper citations, and sports rosters. The shared feature appears to be a response to formatting markers, proper names, and segmented fields rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Email headers and routing information
patterns.context: Email headers, forwarded messages, or recipient lists contain email addresses, domains, and routing fields; the email body need not have any particular content.

patterns.name: IP addresses and server logs
patterns.context: In server access or security logs, IP addresses are adjacent to structured fields such as requests and timestamps.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary discussion text
patterns.context: Continuous Swedish sentences concerning social conditions, the environment, health legislation, or parliamentary debate.

patterns.name: Types and success values in code
patterns.context: A combination of Future, Success, and long class-like random strings in Scala-style code.

patterns.name: Symbols and citations in physics papers
patterns.context: Theoretical physics paper text discussing central symmetry, ensembles, and related literature citations.

patterns.name: Player entries in sports rosters
patterns.context: Line-by-line lists comprising names, position abbreviations, schools, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Sports player rosters or draft materials

7_446.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与字段
7_446.description: 激活覆盖多种结构化文本：邮件地址与邮件头、IP/访问日志、瑞典语议会发言、Scala 代码、物理论文引文及体育名单；共同特征更像对格式标记、专名和分段字段的响应，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 电子邮件头部与邮件路由信息
patterns.trigger: “Received: from”“From:”“mail to:”以及地址中的“@”“.”和逗号
patterns.context: 邮件头部、转发邮件或收件人列表中出现邮箱地址、域名及路由字段；不要求特定邮件正文内容。

patterns.name: IP 地址与服务器日志
patterns.context: 服务器访问或安全日志中，IP 地址与请求、时间戳等结构化字段相邻。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 引用的服务器日志

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会讨论文本
patterns.context: 连续的瑞典语句子，涉及社会条件、环境、卫生立法或议会辩论。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型与成功值
patterns.context: Scala 风格代码中，Future、Success 与长的类随机字符串的组合。

patterns.name: 物理学论文的符号与引文
patterns.context: 讨论中心对称性、系综及相关文献引用的理论物理论文文本。

patterns.name: 体育名单中的球员条目
patterns.trigger: “(135)-x Matt Johnson, db, Eastern Washington”“(1152) Danny Coale, wr, Virginia Tech”“Oklahoma”
patterns.context: 姓名、位置缩写、学校和编号组成的逐行列表。
patterns.domain: 体育球员名单或选秀资料

en.description: Mostly occurs at boundaries of structured fragments in code or logs: the closing parenthesis, line number, and newline in Java stack frames are most prominent; also covers assignments, numeric lists, and field lines. One other case activates on the word ending of arrestering in a Swedish political sentence and is difficult to unify with the code pattern.

patterns.name: Android crash stack-trace line endings
patterns.context: Call frames in Java/Android exception stack traces, especially the closing parenthesis and newline after the line number

patterns.name: Android Activity crash stack trace
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime error logs containing Activity call frames, with a closing parenthesis and newline after the line number, followed by subsequent logs

patterns.name: Java/Spring call-frame endings
patterns.context: File line number and closing parenthesis at the end of Java stack frames, followed by a Maven artifact marker

patterns.name: Code assignment or field-initialization line endings
patterns.context: Code lines end after an assigned number or a closing parenthesis, often with indentation or a newline

patterns.name: Numeric expressions in statistical code
patterns.context: Near R-style numeric vectors, parameter assignments, or scientific notation expressions

patterns.name: Numeric matrices or coordinate data
patterns.context: Multiple comma-separated decimal values followed by code such as alpha1 <- par[1]
patterns.domain: Numeric data and statistical code / StackExchange

patterns.name: Specific word ending in a Swedish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A formal condemnation concerning Israel's arrest of the Palestinian people; activation centers on the word ending

patterns.name: Indented attributes and form fields
patterns.context: Consecutive indented field/attribute names, comma-separated values, and null-coalescing-style assignments

7_446.concept: 结构化片段边界标记
7_446.description: 主要出现在代码或日志中结构化片段的边界：Java 调用帧的右括号、行号与换行最突出；也覆盖赋值、数值列表及字段行。另有一例激活于瑞典语政治语句的 arrestering 词尾，难与代码模式统一。

patterns.name: Android 崩溃堆栈行结尾
patterns.context: Java/Android 异常堆栈中的调用帧，尤其是行号后面的右括号和换行
patterns.domain: Android 日志／StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: Android Activity 崩溃堆栈
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime 错误日志中含 Activity 的调用帧，行号后接右括号、换行及后续日志
patterns.domain: Android 日志／StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: Java/Spring 调用帧结尾
patterns.context: Java 堆栈调用帧末尾的文件行号、右括号，后跟 Maven artifact 标记

patterns.name: 代码赋值或字段初始化行结尾
patterns.context: 代码行在赋值后的数字或右括号处结束，常伴随缩进或换行

patterns.name: 统计代码中的数值表达式
patterns.context: R 风格数值向量、参数赋值或科学计数法表达式附近

patterns.name: 数字矩阵或坐标数据
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的多组小数数值，后接 alpha1 <- par[1] 一类代码

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会演说中的特定词尾
patterns.context: 关于以色列拘捕巴勒斯坦人民的正式谴责语句；激活集中在词尾部分

patterns.name: 缩进式属性与表单字段
patterns.context: 连续缩进的字段/属性名、逗号分隔值和空值合并式赋值

en.description: Primarily responds to number-dense math problems: consecutive variable definitions, decimal arithmetic involving negative numbers, and requests to round or determine number properties. There is also sporadic activation on date/legal number formats and Jenkins Java environment code.

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems rounding decimals
patterns.context: A math problem first gives decimal values or an expression and asks for the result to be rounded to a specified precision; activation centers on the rounding wording, numbers, and operators.

patterns.name: Consecutive variable definitions and questions about results
patterns.context: Problems define multiple variables using Let, then form a subsequent expression with addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division, and ask for the result, rounded value, or a property; this can occur even without an explicit rounding request.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics arithmetic and number theory Q&A

patterns.name: Negative numbers and subtracting negatives
patterns.context: A numeric expression contains negative numbers, consecutive minus signs, or subtraction of a negative number, often alongside variable definitions and decimal-precision questions.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and numeric formats
patterns.context: Structured text contains numbers, dates and times, commas, decimal points, and periods, without visible mathematical reasoning context.
patterns.domain: StackExchange JSON/technical text; FreeLaw case titles and citations

patterns.name: Jenkins/Java environment code
patterns.context: Groovy-style build-script code involving directory cleanup, a try block, and setting Java environment variables.

patterns.name: Prime or composite classification
patterns.context: A numerical relationship or constructed expression is given first, followed by a question about whether the result is prime or composite.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice options and continuation of fill-in questions
patterns.context: A problem fragment contains answer options or is cut off mid-question; it may coexist with subsequent variable definitions, but the trigger evidence is weak.

7_446.concept: 数值密集文本与数学运算
7_446.description: 主要响应数值密集的数学题：连续定义变量、进行含负数的小数运算，并要求舍入或判断数的性质。另对日期/法律数字格式及 Jenkins Java 环境代码有零散激活。

patterns.name: 舍入小数的算术题
patterns.trigger: “rounded to”“rounded to four dps”“Round … to 5 decimal”“rounded to 7 decimal”
patterns.context: 数学题先给出带小数的数值或算式，并要求将结果舍入到指定精度；激活集中在舍入措辞、数字和运算符附近。

patterns.name: 连续定义变量并询问结果
patterns.context: 题目通过 Let 定义多个变量，使用加减、乘法或除法组成后续表达式，再问结果、舍入值或性质；即使未明确舍入也可出现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 算术与数论问答

patterns.name: 负数及减去负数
patterns.context: 数字表达式包含负数、连续负号或减去负数，常与变量定义及小数精度问题同现。

patterns.name: 数字、标点及数值格式
patterns.context: 结构化文本中有数字、日期时间、逗号、小数点和句点；没有可见的数学推理上下文。
patterns.domain: StackExchange JSON/技术文本；FreeLaw 案例标题与引证

patterns.name: Jenkins/Java 环境代码
patterns.context: Groovy 风格的构建脚本代码，涉及清理目录、try 块和设置 Java 环境变量。

patterns.name: 素数或合数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is u a prime number?”“Is r composite”
patterns.context: 先给出数值关系或构造表达式，再询问所得数的素数/合数性质。

patterns.name: 选择题选项与填空续接
patterns.context: 题目片段包含选项或在提问句中途截断；可与后续变量定义并存，触发依据较弱。

en.concept: Text about math problems and numerical operations
en.description: Activations occur mainly on numbers, arithmetic expressions, Let variable definitions, and rounding instructions in math problems, also covering digit-place and primality questions; a CMS configuration code segment and an Italian parliamentary text segment do not fit the math pattern.

patterns.name: Place-value rounding instructions
patterns.context: Asks or instructs the reader to round a value to a specified precision, nearest order of magnitude, or decimal place; often follows a complex arithmetic problem, but can also appear in a standalone question.

patterns.name: “Let” variable definitions in math problems
patterns.context: Introduces an intermediate variable with Let, then uses assignment, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, or combinations of earlier variables to construct a new quantity; often followed by a rounding question, and also seen in prime, composite, or digit-place problems.

patterns.name: Numbers and operator strings in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Dense, irregularly formatted arithmetic expressions; activation can fall on numbers, variables, and operators, not only in rounding problems.

patterns.name: Digit-place questions
patterns.context: Asks for the tens or hundreds digit of a number, possibly with another algebra problem nearby.

patterns.name: Prime and composite classification
patterns.context: Asks whether a computed number is prime or composite; a short answer such as True may follow.

patterns.name: CMS/HCAL configuration code identifiers
patterns.context: Python-style configuration code containing CMS objects, file paths, and experimental reconstruction parameter identifiers.

patterns.name: Italian political text segment
patterns.context: Continuous Italian parliamentary remarks mentioning members of parliament and amendments; clearly distinct from the mathematical expression pattern.

7_446.concept: 数学题及数值运算文本
7_446.description: 主要激活于数学题中的数字、运算式、Let变量定义及舍入提示，也覆盖数位和素数判断题；另有一段CMS配置代码与一段意大利语议会文本，无法归入数学模式。

patterns.name: 位值舍入提示
patterns.trigger: “rounded to”“Round”“nearest”以及后接的位值单位，如“5 dps”“one million”“10000”“decimal”
patterns.context: 询问或要求把数值舍入到指定精度、最近的数量级或小数位；常出现在一段复杂算术题之后，也会出现在单独的问题中。

patterns.name: 数学题中的“Let”变量定义
patterns.context: 以 Let 引入中间变量，随后用赋值、加减乘除或前述变量组合构造新量；常接舍入问题，也见于素数、合数或数位题。

patterns.name: 算术题中的数字与运算符串
patterns.context: 密集、格式不规则的算术表达式；激活可落在数字、变量和运算符上，不限于舍入题。

patterns.name: 数位提问
patterns.context: 询问某个数的十位或百位，前后可能夹有另一道代数计算题。

patterns.name: 素数与合数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is u a prime number”“Is r composite”
patterns.context: 对计算得到的数作素数或合数判断，问题后可跟 True 等短答案。

patterns.name: CMS/HCAL 配置代码标识符
patterns.context: Python 风格的配置代码，包含 CMS 对象、文件路径及实验重建参数标识符。

patterns.name: 意大利语政治文本片段
patterns.trigger: “non credo di dover aggiungere nulla, tranne che la giustificazione dell'onorevole Frassoni”
patterns.context: 连续的意大利语议会发言，提及议员及修正案；与数学表达式模式明显不同。

en.concept: Structure and operations in multistep math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to the structure of variable definitions, equations/operations, and multistep evaluation in DM math problems, especially rounding and precision instructions; it also responds to linear equations, prime/factor questions, decimal digit strings, and problem-formatting remnants.

patterns.name: Variable definitions and assignment links
patterns.context: Math problem text gives consecutive variables, expressions, or equations, often followed by a question about the result after multistep operations. Activation falls on lead-in words, variable names, equals signs, and some numbers/operators, rather than a single fixed token.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Rounding precision and digit-place expressions
patterns.context: Asks to round a variable or result to a specified precision/order of magnitude; the rounding phrase appears at the start of the problem or after multistep definitions, with local activation on some words in the instruction.

patterns.name: Evaluating variable expressions or their properties
patterns.context: After defining variables or listing equations, asks to calculate a variable, factor an integer into primes, or determine whether it is prime; activation covers some words in the question and nearby definitions.
patterns.domain: Algebra calculations and number theory exercises

patterns.name: Multiplication equations in systems of linear equations
patterns.context: A multiplication sign and adjacent variables occur in problems giving two linear relations, unknown variables, or intermediate quantities; there is also clear activation around the symbol.

patterns.name: Decimal precision and decimal digit fragments
patterns.context: Occurs near high-precision decimal inputs, calculation results, or precision requests; digit strings are split into multiple tokens, with varying activation strength.

patterns.name: Standalone numeric line after a rounding problem
patterns.context: A standalone number line resembling an answer or extra data appears between a rounding problem and subsequent variable definitions; its semantic relationship to the following problem is not always clear.

patterns.name: Function or power expression following equation solving
patterns.context: A function or variable expression is defined after a linear equation; this is adjacent to the common multistep evaluation problem structure, but is not a rounding instruction.

patterns.name: Truncated question stem or context fragment
patterns.context: The context begins midway through a problem or ends before a sentence is complete, leaving fragments involving parentheses, variables, or numbers that cannot be fully reconstructed; this may reflect context-window truncation rather than an independent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Prime factors and primality checks
patterns.context: After defining a number or expression to test, asks for its prime factors or whether it is prime; shares the algebraic definition framework with general evaluation problems but has a different goal.

7_446.concept: 多步数学题结构与运算
7_446.description: 主要响应DM数学题中变量定义、等式/运算及多步求值的结构，尤其常见舍入与精度指令；也响应线性方程、素数/因数问题、小数数字串及题目排版残片。

patterns.name: 变量定义与赋值连接处
patterns.trigger: “Let”以及紧随其后的变量名和“=”（如 «Let»、«f»、«=»；另有«Suppose»引入方程）
patterns.context: 数学题文本中连续给出变量、表达式或方程，常在多步运算后继续询问结果。激活集中在引导词、变量名、等号及部分数字/运算符上，并非只落在某个固定 token。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术、代数题

patterns.name: 舍入精度与位数表达
patterns.trigger: “Round … to …”及“rounded to”，包括«nearest»、«one million»、«6 dps»、«two decimal places»、«seven decimal places»
patterns.context: 询问将某个变量或结果按指定精度/数量级舍入；舍入短语出现于题目开头或多步定义之后，局部激活落在舍入指令的若干词上。

patterns.name: 求变量表达式或其性质
patterns.context: 在定义变量或列出方程后，要求计算变量、分解质因数或判定素数；激活覆盖疑问句中的部分词，也覆盖附近定义内容。

patterns.name: 线性方程组中的乘法方程
patterns.context: 在给出两个线性关系、待求变量或中间量的题目中出现乘法符号及其邻接变量；符号周边也有明显激活。

patterns.name: 小数精度及小数数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在高精度小数的输入、计算结果或精度要求附近；数字串被分成多个 token，激活强弱不一。

patterns.name: 舍入题后的独立数值行
patterns.context: 在舍入问题与后续变量定义之间，出现像答案或额外数据的独立数字行；不总能确认其与后续题目的语义关系。

patterns.name: 方程求解后接函数或幂式
patterns.context: 线性方程之后另定义函数或含变量的式子；这些内容与常见多步求值题框架相邻，但并非舍入指令。

patterns.name: 被截断的题干或上下文残片
patterns.context: 上下文从题目中途开始或在句子未完处结束，出现括号、变量、数值等无法完整还原的碎片；可能是上下文窗口截断，而非独立语义触发。
patterns.domain: 语料片段与题目排版残片

patterns.name: 质因数与素数判断
patterns.context: 在定义待检验数或表达式之后，询问质因数或素数性质；与一般求值题共享代数定义框架，但目标不同。

en.concept: Numerical operations and rounding in math problems
en.description: Activations are concentrated in DM Mathematics problem contexts, especially “Let” variable assignments, numerical calculations, and rounding requirements; they also cover equations, fractions, extrema, and common-factor/common-multiple problems, with decimal precision and answer fragments.

patterns.name: Math variable definitions with “Let”
patterns.context: Introduces variables in a math problem and gives equations involving decimals, integers, fractions, or operations; often adjacent to a subsequent evaluation or rounding question.

patterns.name: Rounding instructions and precision expressions
patterns.context: Requests rounding a value or variable to a specified hundred, thousand, or decimal place; may appear in an opening fragment of a problem or after a variable definition.

patterns.name: Question-style math-solving prompts
patterns.context: Poses a short calculation, comparison, or solving request in the context of variables or expressions; these words occur broadly and the specific goals vary.

patterns.name: Common-factor, multiple, and denominator terminology
patterns.context: Asks about common factors, common denominators, or common multiples of integers or fractions, often mixed with preceding variable definitions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics number theory and fraction problems

patterns.name: Wording for comparing extrema
patterns.context: Requests the minimum among candidate values or uses number-theory terms containing greatest/smallest; the trigger form differs from rounding problems.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics comparison and number theory problems

patterns.name: Fraction expressions and variable equations
patterns.context: Problems contain variable equations, negative-number operations, or fraction expressions and ask for a variable or further calculation; rounding is not necessarily involved.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics algebra and arithmetic problems

patterns.name: Very small decimals and precision-related values
patterns.context: Very small or high-precision decimals occur, usually in rounding problems or numerical definitions; sometimes the value itself appears as an answer.

patterns.name: Zero or standalone numerical answer fragments
patterns.context: Isolated numbers or answer fragments appear before or after a problem; some are related to adjacent rounding or calculation tasks, but the fragments alone do not establish a unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Answers or truncated context in math problems

7_446.concept: 数学题中的数值运算与舍入
7_446.description: 激活集中于 DM Mathematics 数学题语境，尤其是“Let”变量赋值、数值计算和舍入要求；也覆盖方程、分数、极值及公因数/公倍数题，伴随小数精度与答案片段。

patterns.name: 含“Let”的数学变量定义
patterns.trigger: “Let”以及其后的变量赋值，如 “Let i =”, “Let d =”, “Let z =”
patterns.context: 在数学题中引入变量，并给出含小数、整数、分数或运算的等式；常与后续求值或舍入问题相邻。

patterns.name: 舍入指令及精度表达
patterns.trigger: “Round … to the nearest”, “rounded to … decimal places”, “rounded to … dps”
patterns.context: 要求将数值或变量舍入到指定的整百、整千或小数位；可能出现在题目开头片段或变量定义之后。

patterns.name: 问句式数学求解提示
patterns.context: 在变量或算式背景下提出简短的计算、比较或求解要求；这些词本身广泛出现，具体目标各异。

patterns.name: 共同因数、倍数及分母术语
patterns.context: 询问整数或分数的公因数、公共分母或公倍数，且常与前面的变量定义混合出现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数论与分数题

patterns.name: 比较极值的措辞
patterns.trigger: “the smallest value”, “the greatest common divisor”, “smallest common multiple”
patterns.context: 要求在候选值中找最小值，或使用带 greatest/smallest 的数论术语；此处触发形式与舍入题不同。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 比较与数论题

patterns.name: 分数表达式与变量方程
patterns.context: 题目含有变量方程、负数运算或分数表达式，要求确定变量或进一步计算；不一定涉及舍入。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 代数与算术题

patterns.name: 极小小数与精度相关数值
patterns.context: 出现极小数或高精度小数，通常在舍入题或数值定义中；有时数值本身也以答案形式出现。

patterns.name: 零值或单独数值答案片段
patterns.context: 题目前后可见的孤立数字或答案片段，部分与相邻舍入或计算任务相关，但无法仅据片段确定统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学题中的答案或截断上下文

en.description: Primarily responds to equations and solution workflows introduced in natural-language DM math problems, often activating near “Suppose” equations, equals signs, and numbers; it also covers prime factors, magnitude comparisons, rounding, digit places, and function definitions, and may be affected by newlines and problem-joining boundaries.

patterns.name: “Suppose” in algebra reasoning problems
patterns.context: Activation repeatedly occurs in math problems that give consecutive definitions or equations and then ask for evaluation, comparison, or factorization; strong activation often falls on the 0 at the end of an equation or nearby.

patterns.name: Prime-factor questions
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of a function or variable expression, often after an equation or function definition.

patterns.name: Comparing magnitudes or distances
patterns.context: Starting from a given equation or candidate results, asks for the minimum, the value closest to a number, or the maximum.

patterns.name: Finding a specific digit place
patterns.context: Asks to approximate a computed number or determine the tens digit of an expression's result.

patterns.name: Function expressions and primality checks
patterns.context: First defines a function and asks whether its value is prime, followed by other equation problems.

patterns.name: Short function or variable definitions
patterns.context: A function assignment or definition serves as a prerequisite for a subsequent algebra problem; the trigger itself is weak, and the segment also contains other problems.

patterns.name: Numbers near newlines or problem boundaries
patterns.context: Multiple fragments contain newlines, numbered sentence fragments, or concatenated adjacent problems; activation sometimes falls near boundaries, possibly related to problem separation or number formatting.

7_446.concept: 数学题中的方程求解语境
7_446.description: 主要响应 DM 数学题中由文字引出的方程与求解流程，常在 “Suppose” 方程及其等号、数字附近激活；也涵盖素因子、大小比较、取整、位数和函数定义等题型，并可能受换行与题目拼接边界影响。

patterns.name: 代数推理题中的 “Suppose”
patterns.trigger: “Suppose” 后接由变量、数字和运算符组成的方程，常见结尾为 “= 0.”
patterns.context: 激活集中反复出现：数学题连续给出定义或方程，再要求求值、比较或分解；强激活常落在方程末尾的 0 或其附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自然语言数学应用题

patterns.name: 素因子提问
patterns.context: 询问某个函数或变量表达式的素因子，常在前文给出方程或函数定义。

patterns.name: 比较大小或距离
patterns.context: 从给定方程或候选结果出发，要求找最小值、最接近某数的值或最大值。

patterns.name: 求特定位数
patterns.context: 要求对求得的数取近似值，或确定表达式结果的十位数字。

patterns.name: 函数表达式及素数判断
patterns.context: 先定义函数并询问其值是否为素数，之后接续其他方程题。

patterns.name: 短函数或变量定义
patterns.context: 以函数赋值或函数定义作为后续代数题的前置条件；触发本身较弱，段内亦混有其他题目。

patterns.name: 换行或题目边界附近的数字
patterns.trigger: “↵”, 行首或行尾的数字与标点
patterns.context: 多个片段包含换行、编号式残句或前后题目拼接；激活有时落在边界附近，可能与题目分隔或数字格式有关。
patterns.domain: 语料格式／数学题拼接文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across math problems dense with numbers and operators, math instructions and assignment statements, as well as code identifier boundaries, French word forms, and formal mathematical notation in papers; no clear commonality is apparent.

patterns.name: Symbol and number boundaries in math problems
patterns.context: Adjacent to numbers or operators in mathematical expressions; usually part of a problem statement or calculation step

patterns.name: Instructions and variable assignments
patterns.context: Math problem text consisting of variable definitions, given conditions, evaluation or rounding instructions

patterns.name: Identifier and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, punctuation, and assignment operators are adjacent in C# object initialization and method calls

patterns.name: French word forms and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Continuous phrases in French parliamentary text, including articles, prepositions, and within-word subword segmentation

patterns.name: Mathematical notation in formal definitions
patterns.context: Algebraic definitions explained in text, mixing LaTeX mathematical symbols with English sentences

patterns.name: Set construction and variable-index notation
patterns.context: Formal definitions of set families, indices, and membership relations, mixing English and LaTeX

7_446.concept: 混合文本中的符号边界
7_446.description: 激活分布于数字与运算符密集的数学题、数学指令和赋值语句，也见于代码标识符边界、法语词形及论文中的形式化数学记号；共同点不明确。

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号与数字边界
patterns.trigger: 数字串、负号和小数周围的子词片段，如 « -»、«0»、«.»，以及变量符号和等号
patterns.context: 数学表达式中紧邻数字或运算符；通常是题目描述或计算步骤的一部分

patterns.name: 指令与变量赋值语句
patterns.context: 变量定义、给定条件、求值或舍入指令构成的数学问题文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与语法边界
patterns.context: C# 对象初始化及方法调用中，标识符、标点和赋值运算符相邻

patterns.name: 法语词形与句法片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中的连续短语，含冠词、介词及词内子词切分

patterns.name: 形式化定义中的数学记号
patterns.context: 以文字解释代数定义，混排 LaTeX 数学符号与英语句子

patterns.name: 集合构造与变量索引记号
patterns.context: 集合族、索引及成员关系的形式化定义，英语与 LaTeX 混排

en.description: Activation spans multilingual parliamentary texts, math problems and formulas, code, and physics Q&A, with no unified semantic or stable word-form pattern: Danish includes an at fragment, while other trigger points vary.

patterns.name: Danish in-word fragment “at”
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Danish text as part of a word or at a word boundary; examples include “at vi,” “at udtrydde,” and “at udtale.”

patterns.name: Local fragments in mathematical symbols and definitions
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, set definitions, and functional analysis formulas; activation is scattered around symbols and variables, with no clearly consistent single symbol.

patterns.name: Numbers, arithmetic operations, and digit problems
patterns.context: Problems include integers, equations, or questions about digits and approximations; some activation falls on numbers and problem wording.

patterns.name: Slovak word endings and number-comparison contexts
patterns.context: Appears in Slovak sentences about the number of deportees and comparisons between numbers, with activation on in-word fragments and number-related expressions.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in C# object initialization
patterns.context: Appears in code lines that construct an Address object and set its Line1 and Zip properties.

patterns.name: Slab and cylinder descriptions in a Gaussian surface problem
patterns.context: Describes an infinite charged plane and a Gaussian cylinder, and discusses flux; activation falls on the problem statement and words related to the physical objects.

7_446.concept: none
7_446.description: 激活分布跨多语种议会文本、数学题与公式、代码及物理问答，未见统一语义或稳定词形：丹麦语有 at 片段，其余触发点各异。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段“at”
patterns.context: 出现在丹麦语连续文本中，作为词的一部分或词边界片段；包括“at vi”“at udtrydde”“at udtale”等

patterns.name: 数学符号与定义中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式、集合定义及泛函分析公式中；激活位置分散在符号和变量附近，没有明显一致的单一符号

patterns.name: 数字、算术运算与数位问题
patterns.context: 题目包含整数、算式或询问数位、近似值；若干激活落在数字和问题措辞上

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词尾与数字比较语境
patterns.context: 出现在关于被驱逐人数及数字比较的斯洛伐克语句子中，激活分布在词内片段和数字相关表达上
patterns.domain: EuroParl 斯洛伐克语议会文本

patterns.name: C# 对象初始化中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在构造 Address 对象并设置 Line1、Zip 属性的代码行中

patterns.name: 高斯曲面题中的 slab 与 cylinder 描述
patterns.context: 描述无限带电平板与高斯柱面，并讨论通量；激活落在题干和物理对象相关词语上

en.description: Activations cover variable definitions and comparison/ranking questions in math problems, multilingual formal speech in parliamentary remarks, a C# object initializer, and an algebraic relation; these fragments differ markedly in style, with no single semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Comparison/ranking questions in math problems
patterns.context: After mathematical expressions or variable definitions, natural-language questions ask for comparison, ranking, or a specific position; trigger tokens include function words and comparison/ranking terms in the question.

patterns.name: Consecutive variable definitions in math problems
patterns.context: Several adjacent variables and expressions are introduced with Let, often followed by a question or instruction; activations are distributed across the definitions and nearby text.

patterns.name: First-person references and questions in European Parliament remarks
patterns.context: A speaker develops or elaborates on an earlier point in the first person, or addresses/follows up with a question to the chair; includes parliamentary expressions in Swedish, French, and other languages.

patterns.name: Formal Danish parliamentary statement
patterns.context: A longer formal statement turns to concluding or commenting on the difficulty of a speech or discussion; activation is concentrated in Danish phrases and sentence transitions.

patterns.name: C# object initialization and property assignment
patterns.context: Creates an object inside a code method body and initializes its properties with braces, then passes it as an argument to Add.

patterns.name: Variable relations in algebraic systems
patterns.context: Introduces several equations or relations involving variables with Suppose, without yet presenting a natural-language solving instruction.

7_446.concept: 结构化任务与陈述片段
7_446.description: 激活覆盖数学题的变量定义与比较排序问句、议会发言中的多语种正式口语，以及一段 C# 对象初始化和一段代数关系式；这些片段文体差异明显，没有单一的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的比较/排序问句
patterns.trigger: “What is the nearest to”, “Sort … in ascending order”, “What is the second biggest”
patterns.context: 数学表达式、变量定义之后，出现要求比较、排序或找出特定名次的自然语言提问；触发 token 包括问句中的功能词及比较/排序词。

patterns.name: 数学题中连续定义变量
patterns.context: 由若干紧邻的 Let 引入变量和算式，常在末尾接一个问题或指令；激活分布在定义语句及其附近。

patterns.name: 欧盟议会发言中的第一人称回指与提问
patterns.trigger: “Jag skulle bara vilja utveckla vad jag sa tidigare”, “Je … que vous …”, “Vad jag förstår”
patterns.context: 议员发言中以第一人称展开、补充此前观点，或向主席提出/追问；出现瑞典语、法语等议会口语表达。

patterns.name: 丹麦语正式议会陈述
patterns.trigger: “Jeg vil slutte her”, “det er ret svært at tale”
patterns.context: 较长的正式陈述转向收尾或评论发言/讨论的困难；激活集中在丹麦语词组及句子连接处。

patterns.name: C# 对象初始化与属性赋值
patterns.context: 代码方法体内创建对象并用花括号初始化属性，随后作为参数传给 Add。

patterns.name: 代数方程组中的变量关系
patterns.context: 以 Suppose 引入多条含变量的等式或关系，尚未呈现自然语言求解指令。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on wording about minima, comparisons, and ascending or descending order in math problems, and also appears in problems with dense numbers, operators, and algebraic variables; other instances include attorney titles and names in legal documents, and C# collection and object-initialization code.

patterns.name: “Minimum” comparison wording in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in math problems comparing numerical values or algebraic expressions; related words and nearby fragments activate.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, comparison and ordering problems

patterns.name: Ascending and descending number-ordering wording
patterns.context: Asks for numerical or symbolic lists to be ordered; the ordering-direction word and nearby list activate.

patterns.name: “smaller” comparisons in math problems
patterns.context: Compares the magnitudes of two quantities in a math problem.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in math answers or solution text
patterns.context: Algebra problems consisting of long strings of numbers, signs, operators, and variables; activation also occurs without clear comparison or ordering wording.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic or algebra problems

patterns.name: Attorney names and titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in pleadings or case summaries, alongside attorney names, locations, and other information.

patterns.name: C# collection and object-initialization code
patterns.context: C# method declarations, parameters, and object-initialization code.

7_446.concept: 数学比较与排序表达
7_446.description: 激活集中于数学题中的最小值、大小比较与升降序排序措辞，也见于含密集数字、运算符和代数变量的题目；另有法律文书中的律师职衔姓名，以及 C# 集合与对象初始化代码。

patterns.name: 数学题中“最小值”比较措辞
patterns.trigger: “smallest value”“Which is the smallest value?”“second smallest value”
patterns.context: 出现在比较数值或代数表达式的数学题中；相关词语及其邻近部分激活

patterns.name: 数字升降序排序措辞
patterns.context: 要求将数值或符号列表按顺序排列，排序方向词及邻近列表激活

patterns.name: 数学题中的“smaller”比较
patterns.trigger: “Is n smaller than”“Which is smaller: b or t?”
patterns.context: 在数学问题中比较两个量的大小

patterns.name: 数学题答案或解题文本中的数字、符号
patterns.context: 长串数字、正负号、运算符和变量构成的代数题目；即使没有明显的比较或排序措辞，也出现激活

patterns.name: 法律文书中的律师姓名及职衔
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼文书或案件摘要中，并伴随律师姓名、地点等信息

patterns.name: C# 集合及对象初始化代码
patterns.trigger: “Collection : BindingList<Address>”“public void Add(string line1, string zip)”和“new Address { Line1 = line1, Zip = zip}”
patterns.context: C# 方法声明、参数及对象初始化代码

en.description: Activations are distributed across two contexts: On introducing a review matter in FreeLaw case titles, and dense numbers, symbols, and expressions in DM math problems. The math passages involve varied problem types, with no single operation or symbol fully shared.

patterns.name: On in court case titles
patterns.context: Appears in court document title sections, typically introducing a review or motion with “On Petition for Review...” or “On Motion for Authorization...”; On is especially strongly activated here.

patterns.name: Operations and numerical strings in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in math problems composed of random variable names, expressions, and questions, often with wording such as Let, Suppose, What is, Solve, and Is; problem types include comparison, evaluation, and equation solving.

7_446.concept: 结构化文本中的局部标记
7_446.description: 激活分布在两类语境：FreeLaw 案件标题中引出审查事项的 On，及 DM 数学题中密集的数字、符号和算式。数学段落题型各异，未见单一运算或符号完全统一。

patterns.name: 法院案件标题中的 On
patterns.context: 出现在法院文件标题区，通常以“On Petition for Review...”或“On Motion for Authorization...”引出审查或动议事项；这里的 On 激活尤强。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，上诉法院裁判文书标题

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算与数值串
patterns.trigger: 数字、负号、分数或运算符；例如 « 3»、« -»、«/»、«*»
patterns.context: 出现在由随机变量名、算式和问句构成的数学题中，常伴随 Let、Suppose、What is、Solve、Is 等题目措辞；题型包含比较、求值和解方程。

en.concept: Structural words in math problems and legal boilerplate
en.description: Activation is mainly distributed across variables, operators, numbers, and question formats in synthetic math problems; legal documents also activate appellate-review boilerplate, title punctuation, and whitespace. The two corpus patterns are markedly different.

patterns.name: Variables and expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in synthetic DM Mathematics problems defining variables, giving expressions, or asking questions; activation falls on varied variables, operators, and problem words rather than a single specific symbol.

patterns.name: Numerical values and number formats in math problems
patterns.context: Numerical parts of mathematical expressions or problem statements; especially includes decimal operations, fractions, rounding, and digit problems, but activation is not limited to a particular number format.

patterns.name: Appellate-review boilerplate in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed phrase “On Petition for Review of an Order of the” in court-document headings; preceded by memorandum and heading content such as Attorney General and Respondent.

patterns.name: Punctuation or whitespace in legal-document headings
patterns.context: Appears near headings and caption formatting such as case numbers, v., MEMORANDUM, Attorney General, or Respondent; may reflect boundary punctuation and padding whitespace in formatted documents.

7_446.concept: 数学题与法律套语中的结构词
7_446.description: 激活主要分布在合成数学题的变量、运算符、数字及提问格式；另在法律文书中激活上诉审查套语及标题排版标点、空白。两类语料模式明显不同。

patterns.name: 数学题中变量及表达式
patterns.trigger: “Let”, “What is”, “What are”以及变量名和运算符，如 «Let»、«h»、«x»、«=»、«+»、«-»、«/»
patterns.context: 出现在 DM Mathematics 的合成数学题中，定义变量、给出表达式或提问；激活落在多种变量、运算符和题目词上，而非单一特定符号。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与数字格式
patterns.context: 数学表达式或题目数值部分；尤其包含小数运算、分数、取整或数位问题，但激活并不限于某一种数值格式。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的上诉审查套语
patterns.context: 出现在法院文件标题部分的固定短语 “On Petition for Review of an Order of the”；前有备忘录及 Attorney General、Respondent 等标题内容。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题中的标点或空白格式
patterns.context: 出现在案件编号、v.、MEMORANDUM、Attorney General 或 Respondent 等标题与抬头排版附近；可能反映格式化文书中的边界标点和填充空白。

en.concept: Clues from formulaic document and math-problem structures
en.description: Activations occur in two types of highly formulaic text: attorney appearance information and immigration review memorandum headers in legal documents, and math Q&A defining variables and asking about calculations, primes, or equations. Activation locations do not always correspond to the same word.

patterns.name: Attorney appearance information in legal opinions
patterns.context: Lists attorneys appearing or submitting briefs in a legal opinion; activations occur near names, titles, law firms/locations, and related information.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal decisions, attorney information and procedural sections

patterns.name: Immigration case memorandum titles and respondents
patterns.context: Fixed-format wording in a title page or case caption identifying the respondent, Attorney General, and a petition for review; case numbers and line breaks are also common.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw immigration appeals decisions or memoranda

patterns.name: Variables, operations, and problem instructions in arithmetic and algebra
patterns.context: A problem defines variables or expressions in natural language, then asks about primality, factors, a rounded result, or solving an equation; activations often fall on variables, operators, numbers, and question words.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics synthetic math Q&A text

7_446.concept: 程式化文书与数学题结构线索
7_446.description: 激活出现在两类高度程式化文本：法律文书中的律师出庭信息、移民复审备忘录抬头；以及数学问答中定义变量并询问计算、质数或方程的问题。各段激活位置并不总是同一词。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的律师出庭信息
patterns.trigger: « argued»；« on» the» brief»；律师姓名及机构、地点（如 «St.» Louis»,» Mo».）
patterns.context: 法律意见书中列举出庭律师或提交简报的律师，姓名、职务、律所/地点等信息附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决，律师信息与诉讼程序段落

patterns.name: 移民案件备忘录标题与答辩方
patterns.trigger: «MEMORANDUM»；«ERIC H. HOLDER, Jr., Attorney General»；«Respond«ent»»；«On» Petition» for» Review»
patterns.context: 标题页或案件抬头中出现被告/答辩方、司法部长及申请复审等固定格式文字；案件编号和排版换行也常见。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 移民上诉判决或备忘录

patterns.name: 算术与代数题中的变量、运算和问题指令
patterns.trigger: «Let»、«Is»、«What»、«Solve»；变量及数字运算附近，如 «prime»、«factors»、«rounded»、«for» d
patterns.context: 题目以自然语言定义变量或表达式，再询问质数、因数、舍入结果或解方程；激活常落在变量、运算符、数值及提问词上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 合成数学问答文本

en.concept: Symbols and terminology in structured Q&A
en.description: Primarily responds to variable symbols, variable definitions, and references in synthetic math Q&A, especially equation-solving goals; also covers problem types involving primes, factors, denominators, divisors, and numerical properties. There is also a lawyer quotation in a legal document, with a pattern distinct from the math corpus.

patterns.name: Solving for an unknown variable
patterns.context: After an equation is given, asks to solve for a specified unknown; activation is concentrated on the target variable.

patterns.name: Variable definitions and references
patterns.context: Defines variables in multiple steps, constructs expressions, and refers to variables in later questions; activation primarily falls on variable symbols and some mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Primality tests and prime factors
patterns.context: Tests whether a computed number is prime or asks for prime factorization.

patterns.name: Denominators and greatest common divisors
patterns.context: Asks for a common denominator for two expressions, or the greatest common divisor of an expression and an integer.

patterns.name: Numerical properties and approximation
patterns.context: Requests rounding, magnitude comparisons, or the last digit of a result.

patterns.name: Quotation in a legal pleading
patterns.context: An attorney’s name and title appear in counsel-of-record information for a court case; “on” has especially strong activation.

7_446.concept: 结构化问答中的符号与术语
7_446.description: 主要响应合成数学问答中的变量符号、变量定义与引用，尤其是方程求解目标；也覆盖质数、因数、分母、约数及数值性质等题型。另有一段法律文书律师引述，模式与数学语料不同。

patterns.name: 求解未知变量
patterns.context: 方程给出后，要求解明确指定的未知数；激活集中在目标变量上

patterns.name: 变量定义与变量引用
patterns.trigger: «a»、«h»、«j»、«v»、«m»、«g»、«r»、«n»、«x»等；常见于“Let … be”“Let … =”以及后续代入或提问
patterns.context: 多步定义变量、构造表达式，并在后续问题中引用变量；激活主要落在变量符号及部分数学符号上

patterns.name: 质数判断与质因数
patterns.context: 对计算所得数进行质数判断，或要求分解质因数

patterns.name: 分母与最大公因数
patterns.context: 询问两个表达式的共同分母，或表达式与整数的最大公因数

patterns.name: 数值性质与近似
patterns.trigger: “rounded … to two dps”、“at most as big as”、“units digit”
patterns.context: 要求舍入、大小比较或提取结果的个位数字

patterns.name: 法律诉讼文书引述
patterns.context: 律师姓名与职衔出现在法院案件的律师出庭信息中；“on”处激活尤强

en.description: Paragraphs 1, 7, and 8 all come from attorney appearance/list sections in decisions, containing names, titles, locations, and expressions such as argued and on the brief. The remaining math-problem paragraphs contain multiple activated words, but show no contextual pattern consistent with this legal pattern.

patterns.name: Litigant attorney roles and manner of presentation
patterns.context: Lists attorneys representing plaintiffs, defendants, or both sides on appeal in a legal decision; activation falls especially on “on” and nearby short legal formulas

7_446.concept: 判决中的律师出庭信息
7_446.description: 第1、7、8段都来自判决中的律师出庭／律师名单段，含姓名、职衔、地点及 argued、on the brief 等表达。其余数学题段虽出现多个激活词，但未见与该法律模式一致的上下文规律。

patterns.name: 诉讼律师身份与陈述方式
patterns.trigger: “Asst. U. S. Atty.,” “argued,” “on the brief”，以及律师姓名、地点和当事方角色
patterns.context: 法律判决中列出代表原告、被告或上诉双方的律师；激活尤其落在 “on” 及其后的简短法律套语附近

en.concept: Numbers and legal-format fragments in structured text
en.description: Activation is concentrated on numerical values, symbols, and equation fragments in math problems; it also appears in fixed legal ruling formats and one attorney-signature section. In the math problems, activation is not limited to instruction words; the legal examples involve two document contexts.

patterns.name: Arithmetic numbers in math problems
patterns.context: Triggers mainly fall on equations or numerical parts of math problems; problems often ask for division, calculation, rounding, factors, or common factors. Some numbers are embedded in variable definitions, so the feature is not limited to problem instructions.

patterns.name: Legal-opinion format
patterns.context: Appears at the fixed-format opening of court rulings or opinions, especially documents related to Texas criminal procedure; activation is scattered across legal language, heading formats, and procedural narratives.

patterns.name: Attorney signature and litigation brief
patterns.context: A legal-document signature section consisting of attorney names and titles, Attorney General information, and brief-signature details.

7_446.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与法律格式片段
7_446.description: 激活集中于数学题里的数值、符号和算式片段；另见法律文书的固定裁定格式，以及一次律师署名段。数学题中激活位置不局限于指令词，法律段则有两类文书语境。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算数字
patterns.context: 触发主要落在算式或数学题的数值部分；题目常要求除法、计算、舍入、因数或公因数。部分数字嵌在变量定义中，标记并不只对应题目指令。

patterns.name: 法律意见书格式
patterns.trigger: 「Per curiam」「O R D E R」「Pursuant」「Article 11.07」「Code of Criminal Procedure」
patterns.context: 出现在法院裁定或意见书的固定格式开头，尤其是 Texas 刑事程序相关文书；激活分散在法律用语、格式标题及案件程序叙述中。

patterns.name: 律师署名与诉讼 brief
patterns.trigger: 「Asst. Attys. Gen.」「Atty. Gen.」「with them on the brief」
patterns.context: 律师姓名及职务、总检察长信息和 brief 署名说明组成的法律文书署名段。

en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic-solving instructions in DM math problems immediately following polynomial powers and coefficients, especially requests to find values where the derivative or function equals zero; also activates on questions about primes after a variable is defined by an equation, lists of equations, and incomplete polynomial fragments.

patterns.name: Differentiate a polynomial and find its derivative's zeros
patterns.context: A polynomial derivative is defined or given, followed by a request to find the variable that makes the function equal to 0; the polynomial typically contains powers, coefficients, and positive or negative terms.

patterns.name: Find a variable from a function value of zero
patterns.context: A polynomial-style function expression is given, followed by a request to find the input that makes the function equal to zero; some expressions are poorly formatted and do not explicitly indicate a derivative.

patterns.name: Primality test
patterns.context: A variable is first defined by an algebraic equation, followed by a direct question about whether it is prime; True appears near the answer.

patterns.name: Consecutive systems or lists of equations
patterns.context: Several algebraic equations are given consecutively as conditions, ending with List; the available fragment is insufficient to determine the specific goal or relationships between the equations.

patterns.name: Beginning/end fragments of polynomial expressions
patterns.context: The problem contains only an excerpt of a polynomial or parts of adjacent problems; there is not enough complete local instruction to classify it as one of the specific problem types above.

7_446.concept: 多项式代数题求解语境
7_446.description: 主要响应 DM 数学题中紧邻多项式幂次与系数的代数求解指令，尤其是求导数为零点、函数零点；另对用等式定义变量后询问素数，以及方程列表和残缺多项式片段有激活。

patterns.name: 多项式求导并求导数零点
patterns.trigger: “the third derivative of”“Find t, given that q(t) = 0”；“be the second derivative of”“Find i, given that g(i) = 0”；“be the first derivative of”“Find t, given that n(t) = 0”
patterns.context: 先给出多项式导数定义或表达式，再要求求变量，使该函数值为 0；多项式通常含幂次、系数和正负项。

patterns.name: 由函数值为零反求变量
patterns.trigger: “Find y, given that u(y) = 0”；“Find r, given that a(r) = 0”；“Find f, given that v(f) = 0”
patterns.context: 题面给出多项式样式的函数表达式，继而要求求使函数值为零的自变量；部分式子排版破碎，未明确说明是导数。

patterns.name: 素数判断
patterns.context: 先以代数等式定义变量，再直接询问该变量是否为素数，答案附近出现 True。

patterns.name: 连续方程组或方程列表
patterns.trigger: “Suppose”“List”，以及多条含变量、乘积和等号的关系式
patterns.context: 以若干代数方程连续给出条件，末尾出现 List；现有片段不足以确定具体求解目标或方程间关系。

patterns.name: 多项式表达式的开头/尾部残片
patterns.context: 题面仅截取了多项式或前后相连题目的部分内容；没有足够完整的局部指令来归入上述具体题型。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in DM Mathematics exercises: it responds especially to “less than” subtraction questions, as well as problem wording about fractional time conversions, addition and subtraction instructions, common factors, algebraic expressions, and unit conversions.

patterns.name: “less than” arithmetic questions
patterns.context: Asks for subtraction using “What is … less than …?”; numbers may be decimals, negatives, or long numbers split across tokens.

patterns.name: Time conversions and fractions
patterns.context: Asks to convert a fraction of a day into minutes or hours.

patterns.name: Greatest common factor
patterns.context: Problems involving the greatest common factor of algebraic expressions or given numerical values.

patterns.name: Operations on algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Asks to substitute into, evaluate, or combine expressions containing letters; may not use a conventional natural-language arithmetic question.

patterns.name: General arithmetic instructions and addition
patterns.context: Requests an addition calculation; values are often decimals or long numbers.

patterns.name: Unit conversion
patterns.context: Converts a length in millimeters to kilometers.

patterns.name: Colloquial instruction for decimal subtraction
patterns.context: Expresses subtraction using “What is … take away …?”

7_446.concept: 数学练习题题干
7_446.description: 激活集中在DM数学练习题：尤对“less than”减法问句，以及分数时长换算、加减运算指令、公因数、代数表达式和单位换算等题干措辞有反应。

patterns.name: “less than”算术问句
patterns.context: 以“What is … less than …?”询问减法，数字可为小数、负数或被分词切开的长数字。

patterns.name: 时长换算与分数
patterns.context: 询问一天的某个分数换算成分钟或小时。

patterns.name: 最高公因数
patterns.context: 代数式或给定数值的最高公因数题目。

patterns.name: 代数表达式运算
patterns.trigger: “Let … be”“Calculate”“Collect the terms”及变量、幂、运算符
patterns.context: 题目要求代入、计算或合并含字母的表达式；未必出现常规自然语言算术问句。

patterns.name: 一般算术指令与加法
patterns.context: 要求计算加法，数值多为小数或长数字。

patterns.name: 单位换算
patterns.context: 把毫米长度换算成千米。

patterns.name: 小数减法的口语指令
patterns.context: 以“What is … take away …?”表达减法。

en.concept: Symbols and reasoning text in math problems
en.description: All fragments are DM math text, with activations scattered across equations, numbers, and variables; common content includes algebraic equations, function substitution, prime or divisibility tests, and questions, some with True/False answers. Several problems are truncated. No stable single-symbol trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical reasoning text
patterns.context: Primarily formulas, equations, function definitions, and algebraic derivations; activations are distributed near numbers and operators rather than a fixed variable or single symbol

patterns.name: Problem questions
patterns.context: A math calculation or test question ends by asking whether a number is prime, whether divisibility holds, or for a particular digit

patterns.name: Truth-value answer markers
patterns.context: Appears in a short answer position on a new line; it is not always adjacent to the following math problem text

patterns.name: Primality and divisibility tests
patterns.context: The problem asks whether an expression is prime or whether one number divides another

patterns.name: Function evaluation and substitution
patterns.context: A function or variable is defined, followed by a request to substitute a specified argument and calculate the expression

patterns.name: Truncated problem text at the end
patterns.context: The corpus fragment is truncated before the problem is complete

7_446.concept: 数学题中的符号与推理文本
7_446.description: 所有片段均为DM数学文本，激活散布于算式、数字和变量；常见内容包括代数方程、函数代入、素数或整除判断及问句，部分带True/False答案，若干题目被截断。未见稳定的单一符号触发。

patterns.name: 数学推理文本中的数字与运算符
patterns.trigger: 数字、变量、运算符及数学表达式，如「3 = -a - 4*o」和「Suppose」
patterns.context: 以公式、方程、函数定义和代数推导为主，激活分散在数字及运算符附近，而非某个固定变量或单一符号

patterns.name: 题目提问
patterns.context: 数学计算或判断题末尾提出是否为素数、是否整除、求某位数字等问题

patterns.name: 真值答案标记
patterns.context: 出现在换行后的简短答案位置；与其后的数学题正文并不总相邻

patterns.name: 素数与整除判断
patterns.context: 问题要求判断表达式是否为素数或某数是否整除

patterns.name: 函数求值与代入
patterns.trigger: 「Let … be」以及「b(-30)」「d(-1)」「j(q)」等函数定义、带参求值
patterns.context: 定义函数或变量后，要求代入指定参数并计算表达式

patterns.name: 末尾截断的题目文本
patterns.trigger: 片段以未完成的式子或问题结束，如「Does 15 divide」及「What is the tens digit of d」
patterns.context: 语料片段截断，题目尚未完整呈现

en.description: Primarily responds to subtraction questions and arithmetic or algebraic symbols in math problems, including negative numbers and decimals; also activates in job-title abbreviations and list punctuation in a legal document, possibly as a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Subtraction and questions about differences involving negative numbers
patterns.context: An arithmetic exercise asks for the result of subtracting one number from another; values may be negative or decimal, often with line breaks and a calculation-problem format.

patterns.name: Arithmetic expressions and symbolic operations
patterns.context: Combinations of operators, variables, and numbers appear in formulas, algebra, or numerical calculation problems; not necessarily in natural-language subtraction questions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra and calculation problems

patterns.name: Job-title abbreviations and punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists of names, attorney titles, and locations in legal judgments or litigation documents; distinct from the math pattern.

7_446.concept: 数学运算表达
7_446.description: 主要响应数学题中的减法提问及算术、代数符号，涵盖负数和小数；另在一段法律文书的职务缩写与列举标点中激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: 减法及负数差值提问
patterns.context: 数学练习中询问一个数减去另一个数的结果；数值可能为负数或小数，常伴随换行和计算题格式。

patterns.name: 算术表达式与符号化运算
patterns.context: 公式、代数或数值计算题中出现运算符、变量与数字的组合；不一定是自然语言减法问句。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的职务缩写和标点
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼文书的姓名、律师职务与地点列举；与数学模式不同。

en.concept: Algebraic expressions in synthetic math problems
en.description: All examples come from synthetic math exercises, with activation mainly on instruction words, variables, operators, and equals signs in systems-of-equations contexts; other instances include number-theory questions, truth-value labels, and truncated fragments.

patterns.name: Supppose systems of equations in algebra problems
patterns.context: After a word-problem instruction, equations or systems of equations made up of letter variables and numbers appear; activation clusters around the instruction word, variables, operators, and equals signs, rather than a single fixed letter.

patterns.name: Answer-style questions in algebra problems
patterns.context: Appears in questions or solution instructions for algebra or number-theory problems; shares a math-exercise context with systems of equations, but some questions concern divisibility or number properties.

patterns.name: Truth-value labels and problem fragments
patterns.context: Appears as isolated answers or truncated text in math-exercise samples, without enough context to reliably assign them to a specific algebraic structure.
patterns.domain: Answer labels or truncated fragments in math corpora

7_446.concept: 合成数学题中的代数表达
7_446.description: 所有段落均来自合成数学练习，主要激活于方程组求解语境中的指令词、变量、运算符及等号；另见数论问句、真值标记和截断残片。

patterns.name: 代数题中的 Supppose 方程组
patterns.trigger: «Suppose»、«Let»、«Solve»、«Is» 等指令词，以及含字母变量的等式，如 « =»、«*» 和 « -»
patterns.context: 在文字题指令后出现由字母变量和数字构成的方程或方程组；激活集中于指令词、变量、运算符和等号附近，并不只对应某一个固定字母。

patterns.name: 代数题中的答案式问句
patterns.context: 出现在代数运算题或数论题的提问、求解指令中；与方程组上下文同属数学练习，但问句有时讨论整除性或数的性质。

patterns.name: 真值标记及题目残片
patterns.trigger: «True»、«False»，以及 « most»、« as» 等不完整残片
patterns.context: 作为数学练习样本中的孤立答案或截断文本出现，缺少足够上下文将它们可靠地归入具体代数结构。
patterns.domain: 数学语料中的答案标记或截断残片

en.concept: Math problem format and conditional statements
en.description: Primarily responds to DM math Q&A format: variable definitions, algebraic conditions introduced by Suppose, formulas, and final evaluation or test instructions; also covers True/False and questions about mathematical properties. One license-distribution clause also appears.

patterns.name: “Let … be” introduction in DM math problems
patterns.context: Introduces a variable definition after a line break or at the beginning of a problem, usually followed immediately by an algebraic expression; often followed by Suppose.

patterns.name: “Suppose” condition lists in DM math problems
patterns.context: One or more algebraic conditions are stated consecutively after a variable definition, often with minus signs, multiplication, equals signs, and comma separators.

patterns.name: Calculation or test instructions at the end of DM math problems
patterns.context: A request to evaluate, find a remainder, or test a property follows the algebraic conditions.

patterns.name: True/false answer markers
patterns.context: An answer marker appears on a new line after a short yes/no or test question; the question may ask whether a number is composite or compare sizes.

patterns.name: Questions about mathematical properties
patterns.context: A math problem asks about integer properties, greatest common divisors, or size comparisons; appears only in problem fragments.

patterns.name: Distribution wording in license text
patterns.context: Appears in license terms concerning non-commercial distribution, source code, or executable files, surrounded by legal conditions.

patterns.name: Specific punctuation and operation structures in equations
patterns.context: Dense mathematical context; activation markers also fall on parentheses, operators, variables, and numbers, without showing a stable preference for any specific symbol.

7_446.concept: 数学题格式与条件语句
7_446.description: 主要响应DM数学问答格式：变量定义、Suppose引出的代数条件、公式及末尾求值/判断指令；也覆盖True/False和数学性质问句。另有一段许可证分发条款。

patterns.name: DM数学题的“Let … be”引入
patterns.trigger: «Let»、« be»及其后变量和算式，如 «Let j be»
patterns.context: 在换行或题目开头后引入变量定义，通常紧接着给出代数表达式；常与后续 Suppose 连用。

patterns.name: DM数学题的“Suppose”条件列举
patterns.trigger: «Suppose»，后接由变量、数字、运算符构成的等式或条件
patterns.context: 在变量定义之后连续陈述一条或多条代数条件，常见负号、乘法、等号及逗号分隔。

patterns.name: DM数学题末尾的计算或判断指令
patterns.context: 代数条件之后提出求值、求余数或判断性质的问题。

patterns.name: 真假题答案标记
patterns.context: 简短是非题或判断题题干后换行出现答案标记；题干可询问是否为复合数或比较大小。

patterns.name: 数学题中的性质问句
patterns.trigger: «composite number»、«greatest common divisor»、«most as big as»
patterns.context: 数学题干询问整数性质、最大公因数或大小关系；只出现在题面片段中。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的分发措辞
patterns.context: 在非商业分发、源代码或可执行文件的许可条款中出现，周围是法律性条件说明。

patterns.name: 算式中的特定标点和运算结构
patterns.trigger: «)» «=»、«+»、«/»以及变量与数字交织的公式
patterns.context: 公式密集的数学上下文；激活标记也落在括号、运算符、变量和数字上，未显示稳定的某个具体符号偏好。

en.concept: Math problem statements and operation instructions
en.description: Primarily responds to the structure of math exercises: questions about powers and roots rounded to the nearest integer are strongest; also appears in algebraic system questions and one differentiation instruction. The common feature is formal, templated math problem text.

patterns.name: Powers and roots rounded to the nearest integer
patterns.context: Math problems list successive numerical approximation questions about powers or radicals, often with the next similar problem immediately following the answer.

patterns.name: Algebraic word problems involving systems of equations
patterns.context: Conditions are given as equations in several variables, followed by a request to solve or calculate a remainder; formulas contain variables, coefficients, and constants.

patterns.name: Differentiation instruction
patterns.context: A polynomial expression with powers of a variable is given, followed by a request to differentiate with respect to a specified variable.

7_446.concept: 数学题干与运算指令
7_446.description: 主要响应数学练习中的题干结构：幂与根的近似取整问答最强；也见代数方程组的设问，以及一次求导指令。共同点是正式、模板化的数学问题文本。

patterns.name: 幂与根的近似取整问答
patterns.trigger: “to the [序数] power of 1/[分母], to the nearest integer?”；“What is the [序数] root of [数] to the nearest integer?”
patterns.context: 数学题连续列出幂或根式的数值近似问题，常在答案后紧接下一道同型题。

patterns.name: 代数方程组文字题
patterns.context: 以若干变量方程给定条件，再要求求解或计算余数；公式中有变量、系数和常数项。

patterns.name: 微分指令
patterns.context: 给出含变量幂次的多项式表达式，并要求对指定变量求导。

en.concept: Math problem instructions and legal-procedure phrases
