en.description: Primarily responds to questions asking for the nearest integer of roots and fractional powers; also responds to prime factorization instructions, algebra problems with variable equations, and procedural headings and notice wording in legal documents.

patterns.name: Roots and nearest-integer approximation questions
patterns.context: A sequence of questions asks for various roots of a number rounded to the nearest integer, often accompanied by answers and line breaks
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics arithmetic problems and answer lists

patterns.name: Nearest-integer questions about fractional powers
patterns.context: Asks for a fractional power of a number (e.g., one-half, one-third) rounded to the nearest integer, often alongside root problems
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics arithmetic problems and answer lists

patterns.name: Prime factorization instruction
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of a given number or polynomial value, near a mathematical expression or differentiation instruction

patterns.name: Variable relationships in algebraic systems
patterns.context: Algebraic conditions between variables are given consecutively, followed by a question or request to solve; some symbols and context are incomplete

patterns.name: Procedural and notice wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes appeal procedures, consent, and notice requirements in court records or local authorization clauses

7_446.concept: 数学题指令及法律程序短语
7_446.description: 主要响应数学题中“最近整数”的根式、分数幂问法；也响应质因数分解指令、含变量等式的代数题，以及法律文书中的程序标题和公告措辞。

patterns.name: 根式与近似整数问答
patterns.trigger: “What is … square root / cube root / third root / fifth root / ninth root … to the nearest integer?”；“nearest integer”
patterns.context: 连续列出求某数的各类根并要求四舍五入到最近整数，常伴随答案和换行
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术题及答案列表

patterns.name: 分数幂的最近整数问答
patterns.trigger: “to the power of … 1/2 … to the nearest integer?”
patterns.context: 询问数的分数次幂（如二分之一、三分之一）并要求最近整数，常与根式题并列
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术题及答案列表

patterns.name: 质因数分解指令
patterns.context: 要求列出给定数或多项式取值的质因数，附近含数学表达式或求导说明

patterns.name: 代数方程组中的变量关系
patterns.trigger: “Suppose”及变量、等式和系数构成的表达式
patterns.context: 连续给出变量间的代数条件，随后提出判断或求解问题；部分符号及上下文残缺

patterns.name: 法律文书程序与公告措辞
patterns.trigger: “Docket No.”、“Decision Under Appeal”、“public notice shall be given”、“assent”
patterns.context: 法院案卷或地方授权条款中，描述上诉程序、同意及公告要求
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决与法规文本

en.concept: English function words and structural markers
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres: common English function words and demonstratives stand out, and activation also appears in legal boilerplate, mathematical expressions and terminology, algebraic notation, and code syntax; no single specialized semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrases and articles
patterns.context: Common function words appear within continuous phrases in general English sentences or legal provisions; activation is scattered across function words and nearby constituents.
patterns.domain: Legal text, written prose, and math problem statements

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate and document formatting
patterns.context: Permission and notice provisions in statutes, or court-record headings and procedural information.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols, numbers, and operation problems
patterns.context: Equations, variable equalities, precision or exponentiation problems; activation covers numbers, operators, and words in math problem statements.

patterns.name: Demonstrative summary words
patterns.context: Refers back to an object, proposition, or operation in a mathematical discussion or exposition.

patterns.name: Abstract algebra notation
patterns.context: An algebraic geometry question with LaTeX notation discussing an induced map.

patterns.name: Code definitions and resource initialization
patterns.context: Method definitions and initialization calls in code blocks, with nearby resource and runtime-context parameters.

patterns.name: Operators and iteration in mathematical exposition
patterns.context: Academic prose about operator actions and the iterates of a point in a Hilbert space.

patterns.name: Written feedback and expressions of agreement
patterns.context: First-person narration offering written feedback on an article to an acquaintance.

7_446.concept: 英语功能词及结构标记
7_446.description: 激活横跨多种文体：突出常见英语功能词与指示词，也出现在法律固定语、数学算式和术语、代数记号及代码语法中；未见能解释全部片段的单一专门语义模式。

patterns.name: 介词短语与冠词
patterns.context: 一般英语句子或法律条文中，常见功能词处于连续短语内；激活分散在功能词及附近成分上
patterns.domain: 法律、书面散文及数学题干

patterns.name: 法律固定表达与文书格式
patterns.trigger: « assent»、« public»、« notice»、« provided»；« Filed»、« Decision»、« Appeal»
patterns.context: 法条中的许可、公告条款，或法院案卷标题与程序信息

patterns.name: 数学符号、数字和运算题式
patterns.context: 算式、变量等式、精度或幂运算问题；激活覆盖数字、运算符和数学题干词语

patterns.name: 指示性总结词
patterns.context: 在数学讨论或论述中指回前文对象、命题或操作
patterns.domain: 数学问答与说明性散文

patterns.name: 抽象代数记号
patterns.context: 带有 LaTeX 记号的代数几何问句，讨论诱导映射

patterns.name: 代码定义与资源初始化
patterns.context: 代码块中的方法定义及初始化调用，附近还出现资源与运行上下文参数

patterns.name: 数学论述中的算子与迭代
patterns.context: 关于希尔伯特空间中算子作用及点的迭代轨道的学术表述

patterns.name: 书面意见与同意表达
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述向熟人提供对文章的书面意见

en.description: Activations span very different text types: punctuation or function words in parliamentary corpora, variables in math corpora, that in legal documents, and the in an analysis sentence. The math variables j and n and parliamentary commas each recur locally, but no unified cross-corpus trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Commas in Danish political text
patterns.context: Commas occur in consecutive Danish or Latvian parliamentary speeches and formal statements; the comma in [1] follows “meddelelse om”, [4] connects clauses, and [8] appears after “Man arī jāsaka”.

patterns.name: Variable j in math problems
patterns.context: The letter j serves as an algebraic variable in math problems with numbers, operators, and equations; adjacent problems ask for evaluation or rounding.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and algebra problems

patterns.name: that in legal documents
patterns.context: that appears in formal legal English during court appeal proceedings, connecting “heard in that … court”.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, court judgments or appeal documents

patterns.name: Hilbert space iteration context
patterns.context: The definite article the appears in mathematical discussion of an operator T, a Hilbert space, and its iterative orbit.

patterns.name: at in parliamentary speech
patterns.context: An English function word embedded in Danish parliamentary records, appearing after “oplyse”; the context is a speaker's formal statement.

patterns.name: n in math problems
patterns.context: n is a variable for a function evaluation result, appearing in an algebra problem that first defines a polynomial, then sets “n be l(-7)” and continues by constructing w.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, polynomial and number theory problems

7_446.concept: none
7_446.description: 激活覆盖差异很大的文本：议会语料中的标点或功能词，以及数学语料中的变量、法律文书中的 that 和分析学句中的 the。数学变量 j、n 及议会逗号各有局部重复，但未见跨语料统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 丹麦语政治文本中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号位于丹麦语或拉脱维亚语的连续议会发言、正式陈述中；[1]的逗号紧接“meddelelse om”，[4]连接前后分句，[8]出现在“Man arī jāsaka”之后。

patterns.name: 数学题中的变量 j
patterns.trigger: «j»9（[2]、[6]、[7]），以及«j»9附近的变量运算表达式
patterns.context: 字母 j 作为代数变量出现在带数字、运算符和等式的数学题中；相邻题目要求求值或四舍五入。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 that
patterns.context: that 出现在法院上诉审理过程的正式法律英语中，连接“heard in that … court”。

patterns.name: Hilbert 空间迭代语境
patterns.trigger: «the»9，及“the orbit of a point v in H under the iterates of T”
patterns.context: 定冠词 the 出现在对算子 T、Hilbert 空间及其迭代轨道的数学论述中。
patterns.domain: 数学学术散文，泛函分析

patterns.name: 议会发言中的 at
patterns.context: 丹麦语议会记录中夹杂的英文功能词，位于“oplyse”之后；上下文是发言人的正式陈述。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 n
patterns.context: n 是函数求值结果的变量，出现在先定义多项式、再令“n be l(-7)”并继续构造 w 的代数题中。

en.description: Activations occur in plus signs, variables, and problem-solving wording in algebra problems, as well as inside Danish words, license text, two kinds of code, a passage of English prose, and numerical results. No stable shared trigger across domains is apparent.

patterns.name: Plus signs in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: The plus sign appears as an independent operator between variables, numbers, or other terms; it is not a plus sign inside a word.

patterns.name: Mathematical variable letters
patterns.context: Letters serve as mathematical unknowns or variables, often adjacent to equals signs, operators, or numbers; activations are scattered across these fragments, so no single variable can be confirmed as necessary.

patterns.name: Problem-solving instructions in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears in natural-language instructions in math problems, surrounded by equations, variables, or numerical expressions; the words themselves are not consistent triggers and may co-occur with mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Subwords within Danish words
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within continuous Danish text, in contexts involving legal representatives, terrorism, and nations/peoples; distinct from the mathematical-symbol pattern.

patterns.name: Source-code distribution wording in license text
patterns.context: Appears in license terms about providing or distributing the corresponding source code; indentation and function words are also marked, so activations are not limited to technical terms.

patterns.name: Lisp identifiers and parenthesized code
patterns.context: Appears in nested-parenthesis Lisp code, including function calls, identifiers, and string/symbol fragments; activations are distributed across the code rather than concentrated in one syntactic role.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A with Lisp code

patterns.name: Configuration and object-oriented code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in configuration conditions and Ruby-style initialization method code; activations mainly cover identifiers and code structure.

patterns.name: Emphatic action verb in prose
patterns.context: Appears in first-person memoir/argumentative prose, where the author narrates agreeing to write down an opinion and doing so; a single instance, insufficient to establish a stable language pattern.

patterns.name: Numerical results in mixed text
patterns.context: Values appear in rounding instructions and adjacent algebra problems, but these numbers have no shared identifiable semantics or format.
patterns.domain: Math problems and their numerical outputs

7_446.concept: 多领域文本中的零散标记
7_446.description: 激活分布在代数题中的加号、变量与解题措辞，也出现在丹麦语词内片段、许可证文字、两种代码和一处英文散文及数字结果。跨领域未见稳定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的加号
patterns.context: 加号作为独立运算符，出现在变量、数字或其他项之间；不是单词中的加号。

patterns.name: 数学变量字母
patterns.context: 字母作为数学未知数或变量，常邻接等号、运算符或数字；在这些片段里激活较分散，无法确认某个单一变量是必要条件。

patterns.name: 数学文本的解题指令
patterns.context: 出现在数学问题的自然语言指令中，周围包含方程、变量或数值表达式；这些词本身并非一致触发，可能与数学符号环境共同出现。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词语内部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在丹麦语连续文本的词内片段，涉及合法代表、恐怖主义及国家／人民等语境；与数学符号模式不同。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的源代码分发用语
patterns.context: 处于关于提供或分发相应源代码的许可证条款中；缩进空白和功能词也被标记，激活不局限于技术术语。

patterns.name: Lisp标识符与括号代码
patterns.context: 出现在括号嵌套的 Lisp 代码中，包括函数调用、标识符和字符串／符号片段；激活位置散布于代码而非单一语法角色。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 Lisp 代码

patterns.name: 配置与面向对象代码标识符
patterns.context: 出现在配置条件及 Ruby 风格初始化方法代码中；激活主要覆盖标识符和代码结构。

patterns.name: 散文中的强调性动作词
patterns.trigger: «do»，尤其是“to do this”中的 «do»；另有“this”中的 «this»
patterns.context: 出现在第一人称回忆／议论散文中，叙述作者接受写下意见并完成此事；单例，无法据此确定稳定的语言模式。

patterns.name: 混合正文中的数字结果
patterns.context: 数值出现在舍入指令及相邻的代数题文本中，但这些数字没有共同的可确认语义或格式。

en.concept: Symbols and variables in math problems
en.description: Strong activations concentrate in DM math problems with dense algebraic symbols, numbers, single-letter variables, and systems of equations; they also cover problem statements and answer fragments involving variable definitions, solving instructions, rounding, prime factors, and composite-number tests.

patterns.name: Variable and coefficient sequences in algebraic derivations
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, operators, and variables in systems of equations; text is often truncated mid-system and includes instructions such as “Let” and “Solve”.

patterns.name: Let introducing a variable or definition
patterns.context: Introduces a letter variable, assigns an expression to a variable, or defines a quantity from a numerical expression; equation solving often follows.

patterns.name: Solve instruction
patterns.context: Requests solutions to one or more linear or algebraic equations given earlier; usually appears after the system of equations.

patterns.name: Numerical precision and rounding prompt
patterns.context: Requests that an answer be rounded to a specified number of decimal places, followed immediately by a negative decimal; occurs only here.

patterns.name: Prime factor question
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of an expression containing letters, followed by a comma-separated integer answer.

patterns.name: Composite-number test
patterns.context: Asks whether a number is composite, followed by True; an algebra problem may follow.

patterns.name: Fraction or arithmetic-expression definition
patterns.context: A variable is defined by a fraction, negative number, or short arithmetic expression, followed by an equation problem.

patterns.name: Standalone arithmetic expression and definition
patterns.context: Arithmetic expressions and variable assignments appear without a clear problem statement, followed by a system of algebraic equations.

patterns.name: Isolated number and symbol fragments
patterns.context: Short number or symbol strings remain at problem boundaries or truncation points, with insufficient context to determine independent meaning.

7_446.concept: 数学题中的符号与变量
7_446.description: 强激活集中于DM数学题中密集的代数符号、数字、单字母变量及其方程组；也覆盖定义变量、求解指令、取整、质因数和合数判断等题干与答案片段。

patterns.name: 代数推导中的随机变量与系数串
patterns.trigger: “Suppose”后连续出现“=”“*”及单字母变量、整数系数的方程组
patterns.context: 激活落在方程组中的数字、运算符和变量上；文本常在方程组未完处截断，并夹有“Let”“Solve”等指令。

patterns.name: Let 引入变量或定义
patterns.trigger: “Let”以及随后定义式中的变量，如“Let j be”“Let w =”“Let a be”
patterns.context: 在题目中引入字母变量、给变量赋表达式，或定义由数值表达式构成的量；之后常接方程求解。

patterns.name: Solve 求解指令
patterns.trigger: “Solve”及其后的变量名，如“for u”“for t”“for m”
patterns.context: 要求解前文给出的一个或多个线性、代数方程；该指令通常位于方程组之后。

patterns.name: 数值取整精度提示
patterns.context: 以小数位数要求答案取整，紧接一个负小数；只在此处出现。

patterns.name: 质数因数询问
patterns.context: 询问某个带字母表达式的质因数，随后给出逗号分隔的整数答案。

patterns.name: 复合数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is o a composite number?”、“composite number?”及答案“True”
patterns.context: 对某个数是否为合数作是非判断，后接 True；其后可能继续接代数题。

patterns.name: 分数或算术式定义
patterns.context: 变量由分数、负数或简短算术表达式定义，之后进入方程题。

patterns.name: 孤立的算术表达式与定义
patterns.context: 未给出明确题干时出现的算术式和变量赋值，后面接代数方程组。

patterns.name: 孤立数字与符号片段
patterns.context: 题目边界或截断处留下的短数字、符号串，缺少足够语境以确定独立语义。

en.concept: Text markers and subword features across domains
en.description: Activation occurs in math problem questions, variable setup, equation symbols, and calculation instructions, as well as in Danish and Dutch parliamentary text and English legal-document fields; no clear shared cross-domain mechanism is apparent.

patterns.name: Question words in math problems
patterns.context: At the start of a math question or rounding problem, followed by variables, numbers, or an operation request; multiple problem excerpts activate on the question word and nearby words.

patterns.name: Algebra setup and operators
patterns.context: When introducing variables or giving algebraic equations, variables, numbers, and arithmetic symbols activate in clusters; commonly appears in problem prompts or problem text.

patterns.name: Calculation and rounding instructions
patterns.context: Requests a greatest common factor calculation or rounding of a numerical value; the related instruction word and adjacent numbers or variables may activate.

patterns.name: Danish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Continuous Danish text about parliamentary speeches and international health regulation; words are split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Dutch parliamentary speech concerning a committee report on women’s rights and gender equality; multiple in-word subword fragments activate.

patterns.name: Fields in legal judgments
patterns.context: Fixed headings, case numbers, and procedural fields in court judgments or appellate documents.

patterns.name: Danish political text
patterns.context: Danish discussion of legitimate representation, terrorism, and work-related topics, with dense activation on in-word subword fragments.

7_446.concept: 多领域文本标记与子词特征
7_446.description: 激活出现在数学题的提问、变量设定、方程符号和计算指令中，也出现在丹麦语、荷兰语议会正文及英语法律文书字段；跨领域共享机制不明显。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的疑问词
patterns.context: 数学题的提问或舍入问题开头，后接变量、数值或运算要求；多个题目片段在提问词及邻近词上激活

patterns.name: 代数设定与运算符
patterns.context: 引入变量或给出代数方程时，变量、数字和算术符号成片激活；常出现在题目提示或题目正文

patterns.name: 计算与舍入指令
patterns.context: 要求计算最大公因数或将数值舍入；相关指令词及紧邻的数值、变量可能激活

patterns.name: 丹麦语议会发言
patterns.context: 丹麦语连续正文，涉及议会发言及国际卫生监管；词被拆成多个子词 token

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会发言
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会发言，涉及委员会对妇女权利与性别平等的报告；多个词内子词片段激活

patterns.name: 法律判决文书字段
patterns.context: 法院判决或上诉文书的固定标题、案号和程序字段

patterns.name: 丹麦语政治正文
patterns.context: 丹麦语论述合法代表、恐怖主义及工作等议题，词内子词片段密集激活

en.description: Strongly responds to math exercise contexts, especially variable equations, algebraic operations, and solving instructions introduced by Suppose; also appears in true/false answers, number theory, and rounding problems. It additionally activates on the referential phrase “do this” in a passage of literary prose.

patterns.name: Target-variable markers in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Activates near the target quantity in an instruction to solve for or calculate a specified variable at the end of a math problem

patterns.name: Systems of equations introduced by “Suppose”
patterns.context: Suppose introduces conditions in a sequence of linear or algebraic equations; activations are distributed across variables, operators, numbers, and equation endings rather than limited to one word
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics automatically generated algebra problems

patterns.name: Letter variables and variable-containing expressions in algebra problems
patterns.context: Variables are embedded in numerical coefficients, products, powers, or parenthesized expressions, and appear in equations or calculation problems

patterns.name: Boolean answers after true/false questions
patterns.context: A standalone true/false answer follows a math test or question about primality/compositeness; activation is near the answer marker

patterns.name: Numerical precision and rounding instructions
patterns.context: A numerical problem requests rounding to a specified number of decimal places, followed by a value or other problem text

patterns.name: Prime factors and composite-number tests
patterns.context: Asks for an integer's prime factors or whether it is composite, followed by a numerical or true/false answer

patterns.name: “this” referring to earlier text in literary prose
patterns.context: In first-person narration, this refers back to an earlier request for the author to provide a written opinion; activation is concentrated on this, with nearby words such as do and it

7_446.concept: 数学题中的方程与解题语境
7_446.description: 强烈响应数学练习语境，尤其是Suppose引出的变量方程、代数运算及解题指令；也见于真假答案、数论与舍入题。另在一段文学散文的“do this”指代表达中激活。

patterns.name: 数学方程中的目标变量标记
patterns.context: 数学题末尾要求解出或计算指定变量时，指令中的目标量或末尾提示附近激活

patterns.name: “Suppose”引出的方程组
patterns.trigger: “Suppose”及其后的变量、系数、等号与方程
patterns.context: 在一串线性或代数方程中，以 Suppose 引入条件；激活散布在变量、运算符、数字和方程终止处，而不只限于某一词
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics自动生成的代数题

patterns.name: 代数题中的字母变量及带变量表达式
patterns.context: 变量嵌入数字系数、乘积、幂或括号表达式，并出现在方程或计算题中

patterns.name: 真假判断题后的布尔答案
patterns.context: 数学题的判断或质数/合数问题后出现单独的真假答案；激活落在答案标记附近

patterns.name: 数字精度与舍入指令
patterns.context: 数值题中要求按指定小数位舍入，后接数值或其他题目内容

patterns.name: 质因数与合数判断
patterns.context: 询问整数的质因数或是否为合数，题后有数值或真假答案

patterns.name: 文学散文中的“this”指代前文
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，this 回指此前请求作者给出书面意见；激活集中在 this，并伴随 do、it 等邻近词

en.description: In segments 1 and 10, this activates strongly in English narrative that continues prior content; segment 9 shows activation on Danish in-word fragments. Although segments 2–8 are all math problems, activation is scattered across formula variables, numbers, and symbols, with no identifiable shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Referential or discourse-continuation word this
patterns.context: In English, this refers back to opinions, requests, and other prior content; in math segments, the strongest local tokens often fall on equation signs, numbers, variables, or punctuation, with no stable shared trigger word.
patterns.domain: English prose and legal text; also many math problems

patterns.name: Danish in-word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur inside continuous Danish words, especially in passages about the EU internal market; activation spans word boundaries and in-word positions.

7_446.concept: none
7_446.description: 第1、10段在承接前述内容的英语叙述中对 this 强激活；第9段呈现丹麦语词内片段激活。第2–8段虽同属数学题，但标记分散于公式的变量、数字和符号，缺少可确认的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 指代或语篇承接词 this
patterns.trigger: «this»（段1、10）；段2–8 中方程组后的数字、变量及标点附近也有强激活
patterns.context: 英语中 this 指向前文的意见、请求等内容；数学段落中强度最高的局部 token 常落在方程的等号、数值、变量或标点上，并无稳定的同一触发词
patterns.domain: 英语散文、法律文本；另有大量数学题

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段
patterns.context: 这些片段嵌在连续的丹麦语词中，尤其是欧盟内部市场相关表述；激活跨越词边界与词内位置

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments involving personal names and political biographies, medical conditions and treatment terminology, GIS/map software, software technology, email, and critical headlines. “with” appears in several unrelated contexts but is insufficient to explain the overall pattern.

patterns.name: Elizabeth Ann Duke name
patterns.context: The name repeatedly appears in entry titles and biographical openings.

patterns.name: Disease names in medical terminology
patterns.context: In medical or biomedical text, infection and disease names appear; some names are split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Geographic information systems and GIS
patterns.context: Discusses geocoding, geographic information systems, map software, or spatial data.

patterns.name: with and its collocations
patterns.context: The word occurs in different collocations, including “with the sw-precache module”, “problems with my e-mail”, “Wrong with Microsoft Windows”, and “with pharmacotherapy”; the contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Web text, email, news headlines, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Offline-first and sw-precache
patterns.context: The phrase describes an offline-first, fast technical module.

patterns.name: Email-related terms
patterns.context: An email message says that the sender may be having email problems.

patterns.name: Critical headline about Windows 10 S
patterns.context: A web headline uses negative wording to criticize Windows 10 S or Microsoft Windows.

patterns.name: Psychosocial therapy and pharmacotherapy
patterns.context: Discusses combining psychosocial therapy with pharmacotherapy for alcohol dependence.

patterns.name: Political organizations and the radical left
patterns.context: A biography describes the person’s association with radical-left political organizations.

7_708.description: 激活分散于人名与政治传记、医学疾病及治疗术语、GIS/地图软件、软件技术、邮件和批评性标题等片段；“with”在多个无关语境中出现，但不足以解释整体。

patterns.name: Elizabeth Ann Duke 姓名
patterns.context: 人名在条目标题和传记式开头重复出现。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的疾病名称
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学文本中出现感染、疾病名称，部分名称被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 地理信息系统及 GIS
patterns.context: 讨论地理编码、地理信息系统、地图软件或空间数据。

patterns.name: with 及其后的搭配
patterns.context: 该词出现在不同搭配中，包括“with the sw-precache module”“problems with my e-mail”“Wrong with Microsoft Windows”“with pharmacotherapy”；所处语境差异很大。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、新闻标题、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 离线优先与 sw-precache
patterns.context: 短语描述离线优先、快速的技术模块。

patterns.name: 邮件地址相关词语
patterns.context: 邮件正文中说发件人可能遇到电子邮件问题。

patterns.name: Windows 10 S 批评标题
patterns.context: 网页标题以负面措辞批评 Windows 10 S 或 Microsoft Windows。

patterns.name: 心理社会治疗与药物治疗
patterns.context: 讨论将心理社会治疗与药物治疗结合用于酒精依赖。

patterns.name: 政治组织及激进左翼
patterns.context: 人物传记介绍其与激进左翼政治组织的关联。

en.description: Activation is distributed across fragments of proper names and technical terms, “with” and its subsequent context, medical disease and treatment terms, GIS and mapping technology, and distinctive snippets from encyclopedias, technical copy, emails, and forum titles; no single pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names, organization names, or technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments within proper names or technical terms. Examples include segmented medical terms, geographic information systems, and software names; no unified semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Medicine, geospatial information technology, software reviews

patterns.name: “with” and its following content
patterns.context: Occurs in varied syntactic structures: diagnosing an infection with, effects ... with ... on, applications for smartphones (here, “with” occurs in “my problems with”), and titles with “with”; activation strength and nearby content vary.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research plans, web descriptions, emails, titles

patterns.name: Disease and treatment expressions in academic text
patterns.context: Activation occurs near words for diseases, infections, treatments, and research outcomes in medical or public health text; these words are not the sole or consistently strongest triggers in each passage.

patterns.name: Geographic information systems and mapping expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in studies that geocode residential characteristics and link them to census data, or in descriptions of mobile mapping applications and ArcGIS software; GIS-related words show clear activation.

patterns.name: Political descriptions in biographical entries
patterns.context: An encyclopedic biography describing a person's identity, experience, and association with a radical left-wing political organization.

patterns.name: Offline-first and software module descriptions
patterns.context: Brief product or technical descriptions emphasizing offline-first design, speed, and precached modules.

patterns.name: Salutations and personal problems in emails
patterns.context: An email begins with a person's name and a colon, then uses the first person to describe an email problem.

patterns.name: Title-style criticism and emotional language
patterns.context: A HackerNews-style title criticizing a Windows-related product with negative evaluative wording.

patterns.name: Combining psychotherapy and pharmacotherapy
patterns.context: An abstract-title-style phrase describing the combination of psychosocial treatment and pharmacotherapy for alcohol dependence.

7_708.description: 激活分散在专名/术语片段、with及其后续语境、医学疾病治疗词、GIS与地图技术，以及百科、技术文案、邮件和论坛标题等独特片段；没有一个模式能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 专名、机构名或技术词中的局部字串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语内部的字词片段；既包括拆分后的医学名词，也包括地理信息系统和软件名称，未见统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学、地理信息技术、软件评论

patterns.name: with 及其后续内容
patterns.context: 在多种句法结构中出现：诊断感染 with、effects ... with ... on、应用 for smartphones（此处 with 为 my problems with）、标题中的 with；激活强度和邻近内容各异。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、研究计划、网页说明、邮件、标题

patterns.name: 学术文本中的疾病与治疗表达
patterns.context: 医学或公共卫生文本中，疾病、感染、治疗及研究结局等词语附近出现激活；这些词本身并非各段唯一或总是最强的触发项。

patterns.name: 地理信息系统与地图相关表达
patterns.context: 研究中将居住地特征地理编码并链接人口普查资料，或介绍手机地图应用及 ArcGIS 软件时出现；GIS 相关词有明显激活。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、软件介绍

patterns.name: 人物简介中的政治描述
patterns.context: 百科人物简介，介绍其身份、经历及与激进左翼政治组织的关联。

patterns.name: 离线优先与软件模块描述
patterns.context: 简短产品或技术描述，强调离线优先、速度及预缓存模块。

patterns.name: 邮件中的称呼与个人问题
patterns.trigger: «Lissa»:、«I must be having problems with my e-mail»
patterns.context: 邮件以人名加冒号开头，随后用第一人称说明电子邮件问题。

patterns.name: 标题式批评与情绪词
patterns.context: HackerNews 风格标题，以带有负面评价的措辞批评 Windows 相关产品。

patterns.name: 心理治疗与药物治疗结合
patterns.context: 摘要标题式短语，描述将心理社会治疗与药物治疗结合用于酒精依赖。

en.description: Activation is distributed across words for medical diseases, pathogens, treatments, and symptoms, as well as personal names, GIS research terminology, software expressions, and email function words. It often falls on subword fragments or local keywords, with no single reliable semantic rule.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in medical disease terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within medical disease or pathogen names, often in titles or at the beginning of abstracts; it does not consistently correspond to a particular affix or disease category.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, NIH medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Treatment and disease phrases in medical titles
patterns.context: Words and local fragments describing treatment, intervention, disease, or symptoms in medical titles; activation also falls on ordinary words, not only proper names.

patterns.name: Word fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Names at the beginning of biographical entries; activation concentrates on parts of the names rather than most words in the following biographical sentences.

patterns.name: Short words in software engineering terminology
patterns.context: In descriptions of software or web performance, activation occurs near compound expressions and functional modules, especially the preposition “with”.

patterns.name: Geospatial terminology in research methods
patterns.context: In descriptions of cancer research protocols involving neighborhood characteristics, geocoding, and GIS data linkage, activation falls on geospatial terms.

patterns.name: Common function words and email fragments
patterns.context: In private email text, activation occurs on “with” and a local fragment of “e-mail”; the context is insufficient to determine whether there is a stable semantic condition.

7_708.concept: 专业文本中的关键词片段
7_708.description: 激活分布于医学疾病、病原体、治疗和症状词，也见于人名、GIS研究术语、软件表达及邮件功能词；常落在词内片段或局部关键词上，未呈现单一可靠语义规则。

patterns.name: 医学疾病术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学疾病名称或病原体名称的词内子词片段上，常见于标题或摘要开头；并不固定对应某个词缀或疾病类别。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 医学标题中的治疗与疾病短语
patterns.context: 医学标题中，描述治疗、干预或疾病/症状的词语及其局部片段；激活也落在普通词上，不全是专名。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的词片段
patterns.context: 人物条目开头的姓名；激活集中在姓名组成部分，而非后续传记句子的多数词。

patterns.name: 软件工程术语中的短词
patterns.context: 软件或网页性能相关描述中，激活出现在复合表达及功能模块附近，尤其是介词“with”。

patterns.name: 研究方法中的地理信息术语
patterns.context: 癌症研究方案描述邻里特征、地理编码和 GIS 数据关联时，激活落在地理信息相关词上。

patterns.name: 邮件中的常用功能词和邮件词片段
patterns.context: 私人邮件正文中，激活出现在“with”及“e-mail”的局部片段；上下文不足以判断是否有稳定语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical condition terms, a subword fragment of Knowledge, titles or all-caps labels, the beginnings of number strings, and Shape in Shape-controlled. The commonality is mainly titles or prominent subword fragments; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Disease or condition nouns in medical titles
patterns.context: Medical abstract titles contain disease, symptom, or clinical-problem names; activation falls on different subword fragments within the words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments of knowledge
patterns.context: The word Knowledge is split into subwords; these occur in a knowledge-base title and a sentence about a principle.

patterns.name: All-caps titles or document labels
patterns.context: An all-caps title/email-draft label, or a subword at the beginning of a proper name; only the first segment of Mustafa is marked.

patterns.name: Number strings and arithmetic questions
patterns.context: A division question follows a long number string; activation falls only on the beginning of the number string.

patterns.name: Word-initial Shape
patterns.context: In a compound modifier, Shape precedes controlled.

7_708.description: 激活分散于医学病症词、Knowledge 的子词、标题或全大写标签、数字串开头及 Shape-controlled 中的 Shape；共同点主要是标题或显著词片段，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的疾病或病症名词
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题中出现疾病、症状或临床问题名称；激活落在词的不同子词片段上。

patterns.name: knowledge 的分词片段
patterns.context: 单词 Knowledge 被拆成子词；分别出现在知识库标题和关于某原则的句子中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、研究项目描述

patterns.name: 大写标题或文档标签
patterns.context: 大写标题/邮件草稿标签，或专名开头的子词；其中 Mustafa 仅有首段被标记。
patterns.domain: 论文文本、邮件、叙事文本

patterns.name: 数字串与算术提问
patterns.context: 长数字串后接除法问题，激活仅落在数字串的开头部分。

patterns.name: Shape 的词首
patterns.context: 复合修饰词中，Shape 位于 controlled 之前。

en.description: Activation is distributed across within-word fragments, “American,” personal titles or names, and digit strings; contexts include medicine, encyclopedias, academic titles, and mathematical questions, with no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments continuing within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on morpheme fragments at the beginning or middle of words; the subsequent text combines with them to form a complete word or phrase.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, philosophy paper titles, and general text

patterns.name: The word “American”
patterns.context: Activation covers the complete adjective “American,” followed by a disease name, organization name, or ethnic group name.

patterns.name: Proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activation covers titles associated with a person's name or components of the name, appearing in encyclopedic entry titles.

patterns.name: Numerical expressions
patterns.context: Activation covers part of a digit string in an arithmetic question.

7_708.description: 激活分散于词内片段、American、人物称谓或姓名，以及数字串；上下文涵盖医学、百科、学术标题和数学问答，未见统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 词内部续写碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在单词开头或中间的词素片段；后续文字共同组成完整单词或短语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、哲学论文标题及一般文本

patterns.name: American 词项
patterns.context: 激活完整形容词 American，后接疾病名称、机构名称或族群名称。
patterns.domain: 医学、百科全书、人口分类

patterns.name: 专名或称谓
patterns.context: 激活人名相关称谓或姓名组成部分，出现在百科全书式条目标题中。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物消歧条目与人物简介

patterns.name: 数字表达
patterns.context: 激活数字串中的一段，出现在算术提问中。

en.concept: Deletions and terminology fragments in molecular biology text
en.description: Activations occur mainly on the deletion operation (deleting) and nearby sequences in molecular biology text, and also on biochemical terms, split word fragments, and a few general scientific expressions. There is also an HIV muscle-wasting title and malformed text, which cannot be explained by a single pattern.

patterns.name: Deletion/loss
patterns.context: Describes deletion of protein fragments, coding sequences, or DNA regions; [8] introduces a site by PCR and deletes a restriction site.

patterns.name: Subword fragments of biochemical and molecular entities
patterns.context: Activation falls within or near subword fragments of biological macromolecules, protein structure/function, or chemical terms; these fragments do not form a single terminology pattern.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular biology, and chemistry abstracts

patterns.name: English word forms and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on split spelling, number, or symbol fragments; [3] is especially malformed text, and the fragments do not reveal a stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Anti-muscle-wasting statement
patterns.context: A title-like phrase describes muscle wasting in people with HIV infection and measures to counter it.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in general scientific discussion
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across common function words or general scientific expressions; the available samples are insufficient to determine whether they form an independent, consistent pattern.

7_708.concept: 分子生物学文本中的删除及术语片段
7_708.description: 主要在分子生物学文本的删除操作（deleting）及其邻近序列中激活，也出现在生化术语、拆分词片段和少量普通科研表达；另有 HIV 肌肉消耗标题及格式异常文本，不能统一解释。

patterns.name: 删除/缺失
patterns.context: 描述删除蛋白片段、编码序列或 DNA 区域；[8] 是通过 PCR 引入位点并删除限制位点。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学论文

patterns.name: 生化与分子实体的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在生物大分子、蛋白质结构/功能或化学术语内部或其邻近的子词片段；这些片段彼此并非同一术语模式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学与化学摘要

patterns.name: 英文词形与标点边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的拼写、数字或符号片段中；[3] 尤其是非标准格式文本，无法从片段确认稳定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 非正式/格式异常文本及化学命名

patterns.name: 抗肌肉消耗表述
patterns.context: 标题式短语中描述 HIV 感染者的肌肉消耗及其对抗措施。

patterns.name: 一般科研论述词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在常见功能词或普通科研表达中，现有样本不足以判断它们构成独立一致模式。

en.description: The strongest activation is concentrated on the string fragment dim, which appears across compound terms and mathematical notation. There are also isolated high activations on dent, deline, dependent, and noreply, belonging to medical expressions and email text; no unified semantics or context is apparent.

patterns.name: Technical term fragments containing dim
patterns.context: Appears in English compound terms or mathematical notation, e.g. «dim»10ers, «dim»10eth..., «dim»10 V. Usually means dimension/dimensional, but may also occur within dimers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, materials science, mathematics, and theoretical physics text

patterns.name: Dentin-related word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the dental phrase reparative dentin, as a fragment within a medical term.

patterns.name: Delineate fragment in a mechanism description
patterns.context: Occurs in the statement of research aims, “aimed to delineate the mechanism”, meaning to clarify the mechanism.

patterns.name: Dependence in a results description
patterns.context: Describes an in vitro proliferation effect that varies with dose, i.e. “dose dependent”.

patterns.name: noreply in an email address
patterns.context: Appears in an automated-reply email address at the end of a comment.

patterns.name: Dependence in a diagnostic process
patterns.context: Describes the success rate of breast FNA as dependent on adequate specimen preparation.

7_708.description: 最强激活集中在字符串片段 dim，跨复合术语与数学记号出现；另有 dent、deline、dependent、noreply 等孤立高激活，分属医学表述和邮箱文本，未见统一语义或上下文。

patterns.name: dim 的技术术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文复合术语或数学记号中：如 «dim»10ers、«dim»10eth...、«dim»10 V；通常表示 dimension/dimensional，也可能嵌在 dimers 中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料科学、数学与理论物理文本

patterns.name: 牙本质相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在牙科词 reparative dentin 中，属于医学术语内部片段。

patterns.name: 机制描述中的 delineate 片段
patterns.context: 位于研究目的表述“aimed to delineate the mechanism”中，表示阐明机制。

patterns.name: 结果描述中的依赖性
patterns.context: 用于描述体外增殖效应随剂量变化，即“dose dependent”。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的 noreply
patterns.context: 出现在评论文本末尾的自动回复邮箱地址中。

patterns.name: 诊断流程中的依赖性
patterns.context: 描述乳腺 FNA 的成功率取决于标本制备是否充分。

en.concept: nas-related word fragments and sporadic strings
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the “nas” fragment within medical terms such as nasopharyngeal, nasotracheal, and nasal septum. Other isolated triggers include the all-caps email opening THIS, the surname Dernehl, and a fragment in vitelline. The trigger in segments 4 and 7 is unclear.

patterns.name: Nasopharyngeal-related medical terms
patterns.context: The trigger lies within medical terms involving nasopharyngeal cancer, nasopharyngeal swabs, nasotracheal intubation, or nasal septal flaps; not all medical contexts trigger it.

patterns.name: Forced all-caps title opening
patterns.context: The first word of the all-caps phrase “THIS IS THE REVISED DRAFT”.

patterns.name: Letter sequence in a name
patterns.context: Appears in an email-forward signature; the trigger is an internal substring of the surname.

patterns.name: Specific letter fragment within a technical term
patterns.context: Appears within “vitelline duct remnants” in a study of umbilical remnants.

7_708.concept: nas相关词片段与零散字串
7_708.description: 主要对鼻咽、鼻气管及鼻中隔等医学词汇内部的“nas”片段敏感；另有孤立触发：全大写邮件开头THIS、姓氏Dernehl及vitelline中的片段。第4、7段触发原因不明。

patterns.name: 鼻咽相关医学词汇
patterns.context: 触发点位于医学术语内部，涉及鼻咽癌、鼻咽拭子、鼻气管插管或鼻中隔皮瓣；并非所有医学语境都会触发

patterns.name: 强制大写标题开头
patterns.context: 全大写短语“THIS IS THE REVISED DRAFT”的首词

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母序列
patterns.context: 出现在邮件转发署名中，触发点是姓氏的内部子串

patterns.name: 技术词内部的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在脐带残留物研究中的“vitelline duct remnants”一词内部

en.description: Activations are scattered across rare spelling fragments in proper names (Sant-, Nał-), the medical word cannula, Greek diacritic fragments, and mathematical/physical notation. The solar-mass subscript odot recurs in astrophysics papers.

patterns.name: Santana in specific proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on surname fragments beginning with Sant-; the subsequent spellings differ in the two examples.
patterns.domain: Academic author names; names in Greek political text

patterns.name: cannula in a specialized word form
patterns.context: In a medical procedure description, “capno cannula” refers to a nasal cannula; the strongest activation is on the cann fragment.

patterns.name: Proper name mixing Latin letters and Greek characters
patterns.context: The character ł in the Polish writer’s surname Nałkowska receives the highest activation, amid a multilingual list of names.

patterns.name: Solar-mass subscript in an astronomical symbol
patterns.context: In the typeset expression for the solar-mass symbol M☉, the odot fragment strongly activates; it appears near mass functions or numerical values of celestial masses.

patterns.name: Diacritic characters within Greek words
patterns.context: In Greek text, activation falls on accented Greek characters or internal word fragments; it is not fixed to a single word.

patterns.name: Special symbols and variable fragments in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Set, function, or predictor symbols represented in LaTeX in formal definitions; strong activation occurs on mathematical variable fragments.

patterns.name: K in a physical unit
patterns.context: In FeSe research, the unit K following the temperature value 40 is marked; the activation is weaker than in other patterns.

patterns.name: Numbers and mass symbols in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Values and errors in a star-cluster mass estimate, and the solar-mass unit; shares the solar-mass symbol trigger with segments 1 and 4, but also includes number fragments here.

7_708.description: 激活分散于专名的罕见拼写片段（Sant-、Nał-）、医学词 cannula、希腊语重音片段，以及数学/物理排版符号；太阳质量下标 odot 在天体物理论文中重复出现。

patterns.name: 特定专名中的 Santana
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Sant- 开头的人名姓氏片段中；两例后续拼写不同。
patterns.domain: 学术作者署名；希腊语政治文本中的人名

patterns.name: 特殊词形中的 cannula
patterns.context: 医学操作叙述中，词组“capno cannula”指鼻导管；强激活集中于 cann 片段。

patterns.name: 拉丁字母与希腊字符混合的专名
patterns.context: 波兰作家姓氏 Nałkowska 中的 ł 字符获得最高激活，周围为多语种名字列表。

patterns.name: 天文学符号中的太阳质量下标
patterns.context: 太阳质量符号 M☉ 的排版表达中，odot 片段强激活；出现在质量函数或天体质量数值附近。

patterns.name: 希腊词内部的重音字符
patterns.context: 希腊语文本中，激活落在带重音的希腊字符或词内部片段；并非固定于同一个词。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的特殊符号及变量片段
patterns.context: 形式化定义中以 LaTeX 表示的集合、函数或预测器符号；强激活出现在数学变量片段。

patterns.name: 物理量单位中的 K
patterns.context: FeSe 研究中，温度数值 40 后的单位 K 被标记；强度低于其他模式。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的数字与质量符号
patterns.context: 星团质量估算的数值、误差及太阳质量单位；与段1、4共有太阳质量符号触发，但此处还包括数值片段。

en.description: All segments contain expressions proposing a research plan or hypothesis. The core trigger is we/We propose, followed by to plus a research verb, that, the use, Specific Aims, or aims. A few segments also contain other expressions for research proposals.

patterns.name: Proposing a research approach
patterns.context: In grant applications or scientific abstracts, introduces plans, hypotheses, or research aims; “propose” is adjacent to we and followed by to, that, or a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: NIH research proposals; segment 10 is a PMC research article

patterns.name: Research aim verb
patterns.context: Appears in “propose to study”, indicating the proposed research; activation also covers the adjacent phrase “of oral administration”.

patterns.name: Research aim verb
patterns.context: Appears in “propose to examine”, introducing the molecular pathways to be investigated.

patterns.name: Research aim verb
patterns.context: Appears in “propose to characterize”, introducing the effect to be studied.

patterns.name: Research aim verb
patterns.context: Appears in “propose to utilize”, introducing the method or drug to be used.

patterns.name: Specific hypothesis-proposal construction
patterns.context: Presents a specific biomedical hypothesis, followed by content related to CD20 and CD22.

patterns.name: Animal-model research plan
patterns.context: Proposes conducting research with activators and inhibitors; unlike the common propose to + verb construction.

patterns.name: Expansion of a research plan
patterns.context: “propose” is followed by aims, then specific research aims are listed.

patterns.name: Proposed strategy
patterns.context: Does not contain propose; after explaining the focus on mutations, it describes several strategies to be used.

patterns.name: Listing research aims
patterns.context: “propose” is followed by the following aims, then research aims are listed.

patterns.name: Background introduction to proposed research
patterns.context: The sentence begins with We propose to and introduces a research system to be developed; like the preceding proposal texts, it presents a research plan, but in the context of a paper’s main text.
patterns.domain: PMC research article, insect ecology and evolution

7_708.description: 所有段都含提出研究计划或假设的表达，核心触发是 we/We propose；后接 to 加研究动词、that、the use、Specific Aims 或 aims。少数段还出现其他研究计划表达。

patterns.name: 提出研究方案
patterns.context: 基金申请或科研摘要中，介绍计划、假设或研究目标时；“propose”紧邻 we，后接 to、that 或名词短语。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究申请文本；段10为 PMC 科研文章

patterns.name: 研究目标动词
patterns.context: 出现在 “propose to study” 中，说明拟开展的研究；激活也覆盖紧邻的 “of oral administration”。

patterns.name: 研究目标动词
patterns.context: 出现在 “propose to examine” 中，引出拟考察的分子通路。

patterns.name: 研究目标动词
patterns.context: 出现在 “propose to characterize” 中，引出拟研究的作用。

patterns.name: 研究目标动词
patterns.context: 出现在 “propose to utilize” 中，引出拟采用的方法或药物。

patterns.name: 特定提出假设句式
patterns.context: 提出特定生物医学假设，后接 CD20、CD22 相关内容。

patterns.name: 动物模型研究计划
patterns.context: 提出使用激活剂和抑制剂开展研究；与常见的 propose to + 动词结构不同。

patterns.name: 研究计划展开
patterns.trigger: we propose the following Specific Aims
patterns.context: “propose”后接 aims，随后列出具体研究目标。

patterns.name: 拟采用策略
patterns.context: 未出现 propose；在阐述如何聚焦突变后，说明将采用若干策略。

patterns.name: 研究目标列举
patterns.context: “propose”后接 the following aims，随后列出研究目标。

patterns.name: 拟开展研究的背景引入
patterns.context: 句首以 We propose to 引出拟开发的研究体系；和前述申请文本同属提出研究计划，但语境是论文正文。
patterns.domain: PMC 科研文章，昆虫生态与进化

en.description: All segments activate on the combination of first-person plural we and propose, commonly used to introduce research aims, hypotheses, methods, treatment plans, or theoretical solutions; the disciplines and following content vary.

patterns.name: Proposing a research approach
patterns.context: Researchers use we propose to introduce a research plan, method, or theoretical claim; it is often followed by to, a, or an.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research plans; covering policy, medicine, biology, physics, and formal methods

7_708.description: 所有片段都激活在第一人称复数 we 与 propose 的组合上，常用于引出研究目标、假设、方法、治疗方案或理论解答；学科和后续内容各异。

patterns.name: 提出研究方案
patterns.context: 研究者以 we propose 引出研究计划、方法或理论主张；常紧接 to、a 或 an。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究计划；涵盖政策、医学、生物学、物理学及形式化方法

en.concept: Mixed feature of research actions and within-word fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across several kinds of within-word fragments and verbs related to research planning, proposing, or carrying out actions, with a few triggers on complete words; it occurs across domains, without consistent semantic or lexical conditions.

patterns.name: Within-word suffixes of past participles and progressive verbs
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of segmented words rather than complete words; these fragments occur across different words, with no consistent semantic or lexical function.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, historical narrative, patent text; passages [3][5][6][10]

patterns.name: Research, proposals, and carrying out plans
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions of intent or plans for research or action, proposed solutions, or getting started on implementation, often linked to a following infinitive or purpose clause.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research plans, patent background, and policy reporting; passages [1][2][4][7][8][9]

patterns.name: Specific complete-word or phrase triggers
patterns.context: A few activations fall on complete words, respectively involving providing a research basis, importance, forms of address or appeals, and human subjects; they lack a stable shared context.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and policy reporting; passages [2][5][6][7][9][10]

7_708.concept: 研究行动与词内片段混合特征
7_708.description: 激活分布于多类词内片段及研究计划、提出或执行相关动词，也有少量完整词触发；跨领域出现，语义与词法条件不统一。

patterns.name: 过去分词/进行体动词的词内后缀
patterns.trigger: 词内片段，如 «ager»、«sch»、«er»、«recon»；分别出现在 é«ager»ly、Fren«sch»、Min«er»、recon«stitution»、«interrog»«ate»
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分词的内部片段，而非完整词；这些片段在不同词中出现，未见一致的语义或词法功能。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、历史叙述、专利文本；段 [3][5][6][10]

patterns.name: 研究、提出与执行计划
patterns.context: 出现在研究或行动的意向、计划、提出方案或着手实施的表述中，常与后续不定式或目的内容相连。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究计划、专利背景及政策报道；段 [1][2][4][7][8][9]

patterns.name: 特定完整词或短语触发
patterns.context: 少数激活落在完整词上，分别涉及提供研究依据、重要性、称呼/呼吁，以及人类对象；彼此缺少稳定共同上下文。

en.description: Activations are scattered across place names and prepositions, expressions for establishing/creating, numbered lists, scientific and biomedical terms, and multilingual proper names or word-final subwords. There is also EU policy text and French text on mercury bans. No single stable trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Preposition in before destinations or regions
patterns.context: Appears before or near place, country, or region names; sometimes functions as a locative preposition in general English prose.
patterns.domain: News, politics, and general expository text

patterns.name: Setting up or establishing something
patterns.context: Mentions establishing a no-fly zone, goal, or foundation; the specific trigger may fall within the verb or on a nearby word.

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments in multilingual European Parliament text
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subword tokens, often appearing in forms of address for parliamentary speakers, titles, or lists of place names.

patterns.name: Lists and quantity expressions
patterns.context: A quantity word qualifies an object or introduces a list item; one example occurs in a statement about the number of genetic strains.

patterns.name: Research work and data processing
patterns.context: Describes research data analysis, report writing, or work carried out by a research group.

patterns.name: Biomedical processes and research subjects
patterns.context: Involves rat strains, genetics, or immune mechanisms; activation is scattered across terms and adjacent tokens.

patterns.name: French plural or verb-ending fragments
patterns.context: Words in French sentences are split into subwords; fragments often correspond to part of a plural subject or verb inflection.

patterns.name: Natural selection research expressions
patterns.context: Describes a research group tracking or identifying signatures of natural selection.

patterns.name: EU language and regional energy policy
patterns.context: Discusses EU goals and related political figures or policy background.

patterns.name: Mercury-ban and waste expressions
patterns.context: Calls for preventing large amounts of mercury from entering waste constituents.

7_708.description: 激活分散在地名与介词、设立/建立表达、数字列表、科研和生物医学词汇，以及多语种专名或词尾子词；另有欧盟政策和法语禁汞文本。未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 目的地或区域介词 in
patterns.context: 出现在地点、国家或区域名之前或附近；有时在一般英语叙述中作地点介词
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治及一般说明文

patterns.name: 设置或建立某物
patterns.context: 谈及设立禁飞区、目标或基础；具体触发可能落在动词内部或邻近词上

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种文本中的姓名或专名片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词 token，常处于议会发言人称呼、标题或地名列表中

patterns.name: 列表及数量限定表达
patterns.context: 数量词限定对象或引出列表项；其中一例位于基因品系数量说明中

patterns.name: 研究工作与数据处理
patterns.context: 描述研究数据分析、撰写报告或研究群体开展工作
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、学术论文

patterns.name: 生物医学过程与研究对象
patterns.context: 涉及大鼠品系、遗传学或免疫机制；激活分散在术语及其相邻 token 上

patterns.name: 法语复数或动词词尾片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中的词被拆分为子词；片段常对应复数主语或动词变位的一部分

patterns.name: 自然选择研究表达
patterns.context: 描述研究群体追踪或识别自然选择痕迹

patterns.name: 欧盟语言与地区能源政策
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟目标及相关政治人物或政策背景

patterns.name: 禁汞与废弃物表述
patterns.context: 要求避免大量汞进入废弃物成分
patterns.domain: 法语环境政策议会发言

en.description: High activation falls mainly on words such as prepare/preparing and set/setting up that indicate preparation or establishment; there are also strong responses to added, designing, and subword fragments of the name Krüden(e)r, in inconsistent contexts and domains.

patterns.name: prepare / preparing
patterns.context: In progressive or infinitive constructions, indicates preparing for a future action, memorial event, or report; the trigger falls on the stem prepare.
patterns.domain: News, business, historical narrative, religious text

patterns.name: setting up
patterns.context: The phrasal verb set up, referring to establishing a goal, a no-fly zone, or an arrangement; activation concentrates on set/setting.
patterns.domain: International news, diplomacy, and peacekeeping reporting

patterns.name: Past participle or variant Krüden(e)r
patterns.context: A participle-like segmentation of the name Krüden(e)r; high activation concentrates on a subword fragment at the beginning of the name.

patterns.name: Adding
patterns.context: Describes adding something to what already exists; here it refers to electronic funds.
patterns.domain: Popular explanations, monetary and payment history

patterns.name: Designing
patterns.context: A gerund indicating the design of functional foods after further evaluation; the trigger differs from the preparation and establishment uses in other passages.

7_708.description: 高激活主要落在 prepare/preparing、set/setting up 等表示筹备或设立的词上；另对 added、designing 及人名 Krüden(e)r 的子词片段强烈响应，语境和领域并不一致。

patterns.name: prepare / preparing
patterns.context: 在进行时或不定式结构中，表示为未来行动、纪念活动或报告作准备；触发落在 prepare 的词干上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商务、历史叙述、宗教文本

patterns.name: setting up
patterns.context: 短语动词 set up，指设立目标、禁飞区或开展某项安排；激活集中于 set/setting。
patterns.domain: 国际新闻、外交与维和报道

patterns.name: 过去分词或变体 Krüden(e)r
patterns.context: 人名 Krüden(e)r 的分词式切分；高激活集中在姓名开头的子词片段。

patterns.name: 添加
patterns.context: 句中描述在已有事物之外新增某物；此处指电子资金。
patterns.domain: 通俗说明、货币与支付史

patterns.name: 设计
patterns.context: 动名词，表示在进一步评估后设计功能食品；触发词与其他段落的准备、设立用法不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across common English word fragments, complexly spelled personal names, and a few numbers and punctuation marks; the semantics and styles vary widely, and no single stable semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Common English word fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary English words or adjacent words, including function words, common verbs, and phrases; local semantic conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: English narrative, political reporting, financial email, novels, etc.

patterns.name: Specific letter sequences in names
patterns.context: Activation marks tokenization within proper names, especially names containing diacritics or complex spellings; the names need not have a particular semantic role.
patterns.domain: German names, Polish names, and author names

patterns.name: Name fragments in work titles
patterns.context: Names in album/work lists are split into tokens, with activation on name fragments.

patterns.name: Number and punctuation fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur on monetary amounts or quantities and their punctuation, with no consistent number format or semantic condition.

7_708.description: 激活分散在英语常见词片段、复杂拼写人名，以及少量数字和标点上；各处语义与文体差异很大，不能由单一稳定语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 词界内的英语高频词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语词或相邻词上，包含功能词、常见动词及短语；局部语义条件不一致。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、政治报道、金融邮件、小说等

patterns.name: 人名中的特定字母串
patterns.context: 激活标记切分在专名内部，尤其是含变音符号或复杂拼写的姓名；不要求姓名承担特定语义角色。
patterns.domain: 德语姓名、波兰姓名及作者署名

patterns.name: 作品名中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 专辑/作品列表中的人名被分词切开，激活落在人名片段上。

patterns.name: 数字与标点片段
patterns.context: 数字金额或数量及其标点处出现零散激活，缺乏一致的数字格式或语义条件。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several collocations of set, some within-word letter fragments, names, and mathematical and numerical formats, with no unified semantics; triggers often relate to local subwords or token forms.

patterns.name: Fixed collocations with set
patterns.context: set is followed by up, meaning to establish or set up; here the object is “no-fly zone”.

patterns.name: set meaning establish or determine
patterns.context: set is followed by a goal, meaning to establish or set a goal.
patterns.domain: Political and policy discussion in email

patterns.name: The collocation set aside
patterns.context: set is followed by aside, meaning to put aside differences.

patterns.name: Within-word letter fragment ign
patterns.context: Activation falls on the within-word letter fragment ign in Batignolles, Brignola, and consign; these do not share a meaning or part of speech.
patterns.domain: Place and personal names, philosophical discussion

patterns.name: German letter fragments in a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs in the spelling of German names such as Barbara von Krüdener.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and set notation
patterns.context: Set brackets, formula symbols, and variables in mathematical definitions; activation points are scattered across formal notation.

patterns.name: Numbers, hyphens, and percentage fragments
patterns.context: In clinical abstracts, numbers are split into tokens such as spelled-out numbers, digits, and punctuation; activation does not concentrate on a single numerical meaning.

patterns.name: Fragments within an author's name
patterns.context: Activation occurs on subword fragments of the author name Vikram Kamat; other name fragments in the same passage also activate.

7_708.concept: 局部子词与 token 形式
7_708.description: 激活分布于 set 的多种搭配、若干词内字母片段、姓名以及数学和数字格式，未呈现统一语义；可见触发多与局部子词或 token 形式有关。

patterns.name: set 的固定搭配
patterns.context: set 后接 up，构成建立、设立之意；此处宾语为 no-fly zone。

patterns.name: set 作设定或制定
patterns.context: set 后接目标，表示制定或设定目标。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的政治与政策讨论

patterns.name: set aside 搭配
patterns.context: set 后接 aside，表示搁置分歧。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 ign
patterns.context: 激活落在词内字母片段 ign，分别出现在 Batignolles、Brignola、consign；并非相同词义或词性。

patterns.name: 人名中的德语字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Barbara von Krüdener 等德语姓名的拼写中。

patterns.name: 数学符号与集合记号
patterns.context: 数学定义中的集合括号、公式符号与变量；激活点分散于形式化记号。

patterns.name: 数字、连字符与百分比片段
patterns.context: 临床摘要中，数字被拆分为文字数字、数字和标点等 token；激活不集中于单一数值含义。

patterns.name: 作者姓名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在作者姓名 Vikram Kamat 的子词片段中；同段还有其他姓名片段激活。

en.description: Primarily activates in collocations such as set/set up, and also appears in quantities, numbers, and statistical results; there are also place-name fragments and like in business emails. Examples span multiple domains, and the triggering conditions are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Multiword phrases with set
patterns.context: The verb set appears in phrasal verbs or fixed collocations, especially set up; also includes set a target. Activation mainly falls on set and the words that follow it.
patterns.domain: News, politics, academia, research, and general written language

patterns.name: Values, percentages, and measurement results
patterns.context: Sample sizes, proportions, and treatment outcomes in medical research reports; numbers and the adjacent of are highlighted.

patterns.name: Large sample-size expressions
patterns.context: Research sample sizes in parentheses, with numbers split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Historical numbers and ordinals
patterns.context: Compound numbers written out in historical narratives, modifying the number of articles.

patterns.name: Series quantity expressions
patterns.context: Descriptions of the number of works or series following several.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in place names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a Bohemian place name split into multiple tokens, with no clear semantic context.

patterns.name: Requests near a person’s name
patterns.context: In business emails requesting approval, like expresses a desire or intention; activation is concentrated on like.

7_708.description: 主要在 set/set up 等搭配中激活，也见于数量、数字和统计结果；另有地名片段及商务邮件中的 like。各例横跨多个领域，触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: set 的多词短语
patterns.trigger: « set»10« up»4；« set»9 a；« set»9« up»4
patterns.context: 动词 set 出现在短语动词或固定搭配中，尤其是 set up；也包括 set a target。激活主要落在 set 及其后续词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治、学术、科研及一般书面语

patterns.name: 数值、百分比与计量结果
patterns.context: 医学研究报告中的样本数、比例及疗效结果；突出数字和相邻的 of。

patterns.name: 大样本数量表达
patterns.context: 括号中的研究样本量，数字被拆分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 历史数字与序数
patterns.context: 历史叙述中以文字写出的复合数字，修饰 articles 的数量。

patterns.name: 系列数量表达
patterns.context: several 后接作品或系列的数量描述。

patterns.name: 地名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在拆分成多个 token 的波希米亚地名内部，未见明确语义上下文。

patterns.name: 人名附近的请求表达
patterns.context: 商务邮件中请求审批，like 表示希望或意愿；激活集中于 like。

en.description: Primarily responds to set, quantity, or range structures introduced by “of,” especially case statistics in clinical abstracts; it also responds to finite candidate sets. Other activations are sporadic, appearing in proper names and technical terms, within-word Slovenian fragments, and the requesting tone of emails.

patterns.name: “of” and its quantity/range complement
patterns.context: Introduces components, a whole, a range, or a measurement target in noun, quantity, or proportion expressions; the word sometimes activates along with numerical tokens.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: education, biomedicine, mathematical physics, computer science

patterns.name: Numbers and statistical results
patterns.context: Patients, cases, percentages, and their denominators in clinical paper results or abstracts; also includes values spelled out as words.

patterns.name: A restricted set or candidate options
patterns.context: Describes selecting, extracting, isolating, or searching for an object from a finite set, candidate pool, or group of mutants.

patterns.name: Substrings in various modifiers or technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on local tokens in proper names or compound technical terms; contexts include organization names, surgical suturing terms, and properties of mathematical operators, with no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical proper names and surgical terminology, mathematical physics

patterns.name: Within-word Slovenian fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word fragments in Slovenian parliamentary text, involving reform plans, member states, and follow-up actions by the presidency; there is no clear evidence that these fragments share a pattern with other passages.

patterns.name: Requesting tone in emails
patterns.context: A polite request for approval in “would like your approval”; it has no clear connection to the other trigger forms.

7_708.description: 主要响应“of”引出的集合、数量或范围结构，尤其临床摘要中的病例统计；另对有限候选集合有反应。其余激活零散落在专名/术语、斯洛文尼亚语词内片段和邮件请求语气中。

patterns.name: “of”及其数量/范围补语
patterns.trigger: « of»；常见于“a set« of» choices”“«20»« out»« of»«58» patients”“«21» out« of»«30» cases”“a finite number« of» locations”
patterns.context: 在名词、数量或比例表达中引出组成项、总体、范围或测量对象；该词有时与数值 token 一同激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：教育、生物医学、数学物理、计算机科学

patterns.name: 数字与统计结果
patterns.trigger: «29»、“«Forty»-«nine» patients”“«20» out of «58» patients”“«31» of «32» patients”“«21» out of «30» cases”
patterns.context: 临床论文结果或摘要中，患者数、病例数、百分比及其分母等统计数据；也包括以词语拼写的数值。

patterns.name: 限定集合或候选选项
patterns.trigger: “a« set» ... «of» ... «provided» ... choices”“«a»« set» ...« of» ...« temperature»« conditional»« lethal» mutants”“«among» a finite« number»« of» locations”
patterns.context: 描述从有限的集合、候选项或突变体中选择、抽取、隔离或搜索对象。
patterns.domain: 教育、生物学、计算机科学

patterns.name: 不同修饰语或技术词中的子串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合技术术语的局部 token 上；上下文分别是机构名称、手术缝合术名、数学算子性质，未见明确共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学专名与手术术语、数学物理

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在斯洛文尼亚语议会文本中的词内片段，涉及改革计划、成员国和主席国后续行动；没有明显证据表明这些词内片段与其他段共享模式。
patterns.domain: 斯洛文尼亚语政治/议会文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的请求语气
patterns.context: “would like your approval”中以委婉语气提出审批请求；与其他触发形式缺乏清楚联系。

en.description: Activations occur on numbers, counts, proportions, and measurements and nearby words; they also appear in German compound-word fragments, research-screening terms, and several ordinary function words. The semantics of the examples are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Numerals, units, and counts
patterns.context: Numbers occur in quantity, proportion, measurement, or counting expressions, often adjacent to of, in, out of, cases, particles, games, ml, and similar terms. In different samples, highlights fall on the number, unit, or nearby function word.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, sports biographies, mathematics texts

patterns.name: Fragments within German compounds
patterns.context: In German political texts, activation falls on word fragments split into multiple tokens, especially components of compounds or proper nouns; there is no clear numerical-counting context.

patterns.name: Research, screening, and experimental-process terms in papers
patterns.context: When describing experimental research aims, screening methods, sample sets, or published research findings, activation falls on words such as study/studies, screening, set/of, and descriptions of experimental subjects.

patterns.name: Prepositions and connective structures in ordinary phrases
patterns.context: Common function words are also highlighted, but occur in varied phrases involving particles in a system, cells harvested by centrifugation, segments reinforced with a technique, and fewer than k vertices; these do not support a single semantic relation.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and general mathematical discussion

7_708.concept: 定量与结构性文本片段
7_708.description: 激活分布在数字计数、比例和测量值及其邻近词上，也见于德语复合词片段、研究筛选流程词和若干普通功能词；各例的语义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数字量词与单位/计数
patterns.context: 数字出现在数量、比例、测量值或计数表达式中；常与 of、in、out of、cases、particles、games、ml 等相邻。不同样本中高亮落在数字、单位或附近功能词上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、体育传记、数学文本

patterns.name: 德语复合词内部片段
patterns.trigger: « den»2« Sta»2«ats- und« Reg»2«ierung»1schefs ... ho«hen»2« Beau»3«ft»3«rag»10«ten»2« Sol»2«ana»4
patterns.context: 德语政治文本中，激活落在被拆分的词内片段，尤其是复合词或专名的组成部分；没有明显的数字计数语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会德语政治文体

patterns.name: 论文中的研究、筛选与实验流程词
patterns.trigger: « study»1、« among»5« a« set»4« of»10« temperature»3« conditional»4« lethal»5 mutants、« allowing»2« screening»1« of»3« large»4 numbers« of»5« ... published»10 studies
patterns.context: 描述实验研究目的、筛选方法、样本集合或已发表研究结果时，激活落在 study/studies、screening、set/of 等词及实验对象描述上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与微生物学研究文本

patterns.name: 普通短语中的介词与连接结构
patterns.trigger: « of»7、« in»1、« by»3、« with»2、« and»1、« than»3
patterns.context: 常见功能词本身也会被标记，但所处短语各异，分别涉及 particles in a system、cells harvested by centrifugation、segments reinforced with a technique、fewer than k vertices 等；不足以归成单一语义关系。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学、一般数学论述

en.description: Activation is distributed across numbers and their counting units, mathematical variables and set symbols, spelled-out number words, and several proper names or domain-specific words. It often occurs in quantitative academic discourse, but numbers are not the only triggers, and there are local patterns involving places, species, and medical terminology.

patterns.name: Statistical quantities and measurements
patterns.context: Reports sample counts, proportions, measurements, or participation counts; numbers are embedded in narrative or results sentences.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, sports biographies, academic analyses

patterns.name: Numerically represented mathematical objects and parameters
patterns.context: Numbers or variables represent the size, count, or parameters of mathematical objects, appearing in formulas and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Number words, cardinal and ordinal expressions
patterns.context: Quantities expressed in words that modify teams, regions, or species; they need not be statistical results.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic or general explanatory text, biology papers

patterns.name: Narratives involving places or regions
patterns.context: Describes where a game is held or regional representation; numbers co-occur with place and regional concepts.

patterns.name: Classification and set definitions
patterns.context: Introduces a mathematical definition through symbols, sets, and enumeration of elements.

patterns.name: Comparative results for technical methods or categories
patterns.context: Compares different treatments and reports their order or experimental results.

patterns.name: Biological categories and species relations
patterns.context: States that two species are related to each other and describes their properties or effects.

patterns.name: Word combinations in organizations, teams, or proper names
patterns.context: A color word in a proper name; the trigger may relate to the team name that follows rather than to quantities or formula structures.

patterns.name: Adjacent medical anatomical nouns
patterns.context: A numerical examination target is a joint, specifically the elbow joint; this is the only clear instance.

patterns.name: Academic citations and research inclusion wording
patterns.context: Describes searched databases, the number of included studies, and the analysis process.

7_708.description: 激活分散于数字及其计数单位、数学变量与集合符号、文字数词和若干专名或领域词。多见于定量学术叙述，但数字并非唯一触发因素，且有地点、物种、医学术语等局部模式。

patterns.name: 统计数量与测量结果
patterns.trigger: « 21»、« 10»、« 30»、« 39»、« 41»、« 44»、« 94» 等数字，常与 cases、segments、games、studies 等计数单位相邻
patterns.context: 报告样本数、比例、测量值或参与次数；数字嵌在叙述或结果句中
patterns.domain: 医学论文、体育人物传记、学术分析

patterns.name: 数字化的数学对象与参数
patterns.context: 数字或变量作为数学对象的规模、个数或参数，位于公式及其说明文字中

patterns.name: 数词、基数及序数表达
patterns.context: 以文字形式表达数目，修饰球队、地区或物种；不要求是统计结果
patterns.domain: 百科或一般说明文字、生物学论文

patterns.name: 涉及地点或区域的叙述
patterns.context: 描述比赛举办地点或地区代表性；数字与地点、区域概念同现

patterns.name: 分类与集合定义
patterns.context: 通过符号、集合及元素列举来引入数学定义

patterns.name: 对照技术或类别的比较结果
patterns.context: 比较不同处理方式，并报告先后或实验结果

patterns.name: 生物类别与物种关系
patterns.context: 指出两个物种彼此相关，并说明其属性或影响

patterns.name: 机构、团队或专名中的词汇搭配
patterns.context: 专名中的颜色词，触发可能与其后团队名有关，而非数量或公式结构

patterns.name: 医学解剖名词邻接
patterns.context: 数字化检查对象为关节，具体涉及肘关节；仅此处明显

patterns.name: 学术引用与研究纳入措辞
patterns.context: 说明检索数据库、纳入研究数量及分析流程

en.description: Activations occur on relational prepositions, quantities or set sizes, and classification contexts across domains. Medical abstracts also include counts, specimens, and clinical descriptions, while mathematics papers discuss object sizes and structures.

patterns.name: Highlighted preposition or relational word “of”
patterns.context: Connects relations of possession, composition, scope, or position in noun phrases or academic sentences; however, these words are not necessarily the main trigger in every passage.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository writing, papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Quantities and set size
patterns.context: Numbers or variables indicate the quantity of a set, sample, object, region, or category; sometimes they are adjacent to mathematical symbols or units of measurement.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and science papers, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Classification, categories, and divisions
patterns.context: Discusses how to classify objects or divide objects, spaces, diseases, and so on into types, parts, or regions.
patterns.domain: Music discussion, mathematics/machine-learning papers, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Numerical and statistical reporting
patterns.context: Reports observations using counts, ages, percentages, or sample sizes; numbers are often followed by units or nouns.

patterns.name: Relational words “arise/originate”
patterns.context: Explains that integers or mathematical objects arise or appear from a problem.

patterns.name: Quantity and signals of complex sinusoids
patterns.context: Uses K to specify the number of complex sinusoidal components in a signal representation.

patterns.name: Bimodal distribution and disease mixture
patterns.context: Describes the age-at-onset distribution of schizophrenia and the possibility that it comprises two related disorders.

patterns.name: Specimen processing and section thickness
patterns.context: Describes nasal mucosa specimens prepared as serial frozen sections and reports their thickness.

patterns.name: Nutrients and sample size in newborns
patterns.context: Describes vitamin levels in premature infants and reports the number of infants in the study group.

7_708.concept: 关系连接词与数量结构
7_708.description: 激活分布于跨领域文本中的关系介词、数量/集合规模，以及分类划分语境；医学摘要还出现计数、标本和临床描述，数学论文则涉及对象规模与结构。

patterns.name: 介词或关系词“of”的高亮
patterns.context: 名词短语或学术句中用于连接所属、组成、范围或位置关系；但各段中的这些词不一定是核心触发因素。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、论文与医学摘要

patterns.name: 数量与集合规模
patterns.context: 数字或变量表示集合、样本、对象、区域或类别的数量；有时紧邻数学符号或计量单位。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学论文、医学摘要

patterns.name: 分类、类别与划分
patterns.context: 讨论如何给对象归类，或将对象、空间、疾病等划分成类型、部分或区域。
patterns.domain: 音乐讨论、数学/机器学习论文、医学摘要

patterns.name: 数值和统计结果陈述
patterns.context: 以计数、年龄、百分比或样本数报告观察结果；数字后常接单位或名词。

patterns.name: 关系词“arise/originate”
patterns.context: 说明整数或数学对象从问题中产生或出现。

patterns.name: 复数正弦波的数量与信号
patterns.context: 信号表示中用 K 指明复数正弦分量的数量。

patterns.name: 双峰分布与疾病混合
patterns.trigger: « both»2« male»3 and« female»3、« related»3«)»9 disorders
patterns.context: 描述精神分裂症发病年龄分布及其可能由两种相关疾病构成。

patterns.name: 标本处理与切片厚度
patterns.context: 描述鼻黏膜标本被制成连续冷冻切片及其厚度。

patterns.name: 新生儿营养物质与样本数
patterns.context: 描述早产儿体内维生素水平，并报告研究组婴儿人数。

en.concept: Quantities and relational expressions in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to numerical reporting in scientific text, especially sample sizes, numerators and denominators, and proportions; it also responds to comparisons and relative relations. Other examples include patent citation numbers and particle-count notation in physics papers.

patterns.name: Statistical quantities and proportions
patterns.context: Reports sample sizes, numerators/denominators, proportions, or result counts in scientific or medical prose; common when numbers are adjacent to of, parentheses, and percentages.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research reports, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Relative or comparative relations
patterns.context: Describes adjusted relative rates, compares two interventions, or explicitly states similarities and associations between entities.
patterns.domain: Medical research, education intervention studies, biology papers

patterns.name: Patent citation numbers and legal wording
patterns.context: Lists U.S. patent numbers and inventors in a patent background passage, describing them as representative examples of prior applications.

patterns.name: Specific scientific symbols and particle counts
patterns.context: Describes an ensemble consisting of N particles in a discussion of an effective two-level system.

7_708.concept: 科学文本中的数量与关系表达
7_708.description: 主要响应科学文本中的数字化报告，尤其是样本量、分子分母和比例；也响应比较、相对关系。另有专利引文编号及物理论文中的粒子数符号。

patterns.name: 统计数量与比例
patterns.context: 科学或医学叙述中报告样本量、分子/分母、比例或结果数量；常见于数字紧邻 of、括号和百分比时。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、研究报告及科学论文

patterns.name: 相对或比较关系
patterns.trigger: « adjusted» « relative» rates；« comparing» « two»；« closely» « related»
patterns.context: 描述调整后的相对率、比较两种干预，或明确陈述对象之间的相似与关联。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、教育干预研究、生物学论文

patterns.name: 专利引文编号与法律措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景段中列举美国专利号、发明人，并称其为先前申请的代表性例子。

patterns.name: 特定科学符号与粒子数
patterns.context: 在有效二能级系统的物理讨论中，描述由 N 个粒子组成的系综。

en.concept: Function words in relational and quantity phrases
en.description: Activations are distributed across varied academic and news contexts. They commonly occur in quantity, composition, or relational phrases introduced by of, and also involve in/related, sample counts, experimental and model descriptions; there are also within-word fragments and symbol activations, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: “of” in qualifying or comparative relations
patterns.context: In noun phrases, of introduces quantity, composition, possession, or type; the clearest activations fall on of and the words following it.

patterns.name: Relations or associations
patterns.context: Discusses kinship, associations, relative relations between things, or relations between research subjects and diseases or relatives.

patterns.name: Subjects or scope introduced by “in”
patterns.context: The preposition in limits a discussion to a group, scope, or condition, though its specific meaning varies across passages.

patterns.name: Quantity and comparison of research subjects
patterns.context: Methods or mathematical arguments contain sample sizes, numbers of items or objects, or comparisons bounded by quantities.

patterns.name: “are” connecting subjects with classification descriptions
patterns.context: Uses the copula are to classify or describe research subjects.

patterns.name: Experimental treatment and conditions
patterns.context: Describes experimental animals receiving treatment, transplant sources, and observed results.

patterns.name: Methods, models, and applicability
patterns.context: Explains the relevance of immunological methods and animal models to human disease, and introduces research aims.

patterns.name: Results and population associations in academic abstracts
patterns.context: Reports comparisons of healthcare utilization rates across populations, focusing on population samples and comorbidities.

patterns.name: Negative quantity bounds
patterns.context: In set or graph theory arguments, conditions are specified by requiring fewer than a certain parameter’s number of vertices.

patterns.name: Quantity phrases in football transfer reports
patterns.context: Reports multiple players signed by a team on the deadline day of the summer transfer window.

patterns.name: Listing species sampling locations
patterns.context: Explains that collected specimens cover multiple distribution areas and type localities.

patterns.name: Scattered activations without a shared semantic category
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments, symbols, or proper-name fragments; local contexts do not show a stable shared trigger condition.

7_708.concept: 关系与数量短语中的功能词
7_708.description: 激活分散在多种学术与新闻语境，较常见于of引出的数量、组成或关系短语，也涉及in/related、样本计数、实验与模型描述；另有词内片段及符号激活，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 限定或比较关系中的“of”
patterns.trigger: « of»（如“a number «of» deadline day arrivals”“a set «of» real numbers”“«of» six questions”）
patterns.context: 名词短语中用 of 引出数量、组成、归属或类型；最明显的激活落在 of 及其后续词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、数学文本、新闻

patterns.name: 关系或关联表述
patterns.trigger: « related»、« closely» « related»、«relative»；另有“«in» relatives”和“«for» the comorbidities”
patterns.context: 讨论事物之间的亲缘、关联、相对关系，或研究对象与疾病、亲属之间的关系。

patterns.name: “in”引出的对象或范围
patterns.trigger: « in»，如“«in» both male and female relatives”“«in» as much as they speak to human disease”
patterns.context: 介词 in 将论述限定在某个群体、范围或条件中；但不同段落具体语义不一。

patterns.name: 研究对象的数量与比较
patterns.context: 方法或数学论证中出现样本量、项目数、对象数量，或以数量为界进行比较。

patterns.name: “are”连接对象与分类描述
patterns.context: 以系词 are 对研究对象作分类或说明。

patterns.name: 实验处理与条件叙述
patterns.context: 描述实验动物接受处理、移植来源及观察到的结果。

patterns.name: 方法、模型与适用性
patterns.context: 说明免疫方法、动物模型对人类疾病的相关性，并引出研究目标。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的结果与人群关联
patterns.trigger: «Among» 7,241 … adults；«relative» rates；«for» comorbidities；«with» and without COPD
patterns.context: 以人群样本及共病为对象，报告不同群体之间的医疗利用率比较。

patterns.name: 负向数量界定
patterns.context: 集合或图论论证中，用少于某个参数的顶点数设定条件。

patterns.name: 足球转会报道中的数量短语
patterns.context: 报道球队在夏季转会窗口截止日引进的多名球员。

patterns.name: 物种采样地点列举
patterns.context: 说明采集标本覆盖多个分布区域和模式产地。

patterns.name: 难以归入共同语义的分散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子词、符号或专名片段，局部上下文未显示稳定共同触发条件。

en.concept: Word fragments and relational expressions in specialized text
en.description: Activation is distributed across within-word fragments in specialized text, phrase-level function words, purpose or property relations introduced by “as,” and mathematical and statistical numbers; cross-domain commonality is weak, and some markers are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within participles
