patterns.context: Activation falls within a word rather than at a complete word boundary; fragments often combine with surrounding unmarked parts to form a word.
patterns.domain: Greek text, physics and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Function words and word fragments in technical terminology
patterns.context: In technical explanations or papers, activation is distributed across several adjacent words or word fragments in a phrase, and in some passages is especially strong on ordinary content words.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, patents, physics, and online discussions

patterns.name: “as” in relational structures
patterns.context: Appears before a noun or classification label, introducing a purpose, property, or result; occurs in contexts across different domains.

patterns.name: Quantities, sequences, and numerical fragments
patterns.context: Numbers and adjacent symbols are marked in mathematical notation, genome segment sizes, or demographic figures.

patterns.name: Relational and classification words in noun phrases
patterns.context: Several adjacent words within phrases are activated in descriptions of classifications, sets, or research subjects; no single fixed term is apparent.

patterns.name: Low activation without clear commonality
patterns.context: Local words are marked, but their function or semantics is difficult to align with high-activation examples in other passages.

7_708.concept: 专业文本中的词片段与关系表达
7_708.description: 激活分散于专业文本的词内片段、短语功能词、as引出的用途或性质关系，以及数学和统计数字；跨领域共性较弱，部分标记难以解释。

patterns.name: 分词内部的子词片段
patterns.trigger: 希腊词或专业词内部被标记的片段，如«φ»、«δ»、«ή»、«μα»；«Mat»«ula»；«pseud»«oscal»«ars»；«dil»«at»«ons»
patterns.context: 激活落在一个词内部，而不是完整词边界；片段常与周围未标记部分合起来构成词
patterns.domain: 希腊语文本、物理与数学论文

patterns.name: 技术术语中的功能词与词片段
patterns.context: 技术说明或论文语境中，激活分布于短语的多个相邻词或词片段，且在部分段落中特别强于普通内容词
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、物理及网络讨论

patterns.name: 关系结构中的“as”
patterns.trigger: «as»，包括“used as display devices”“transform as scalars”“arise as Matula numbers”
patterns.context: 出现在名词或分类标签前，引出用途、性质或结果；不同领域语境均有出现

patterns.name: 数量、序列及数字片段
patterns.context: 数学符号、基因组片段规模或人口统计数字中，数字及其相邻符号被标记

patterns.name: 名词短语中的关系词和分类词
patterns.context: 分类、集合或研究对象的描述中，短语内部若干相邻词激活；未体现单一固定术语
patterns.domain: 机器学习与生物学论文

patterns.name: 低强度且缺少明确共性
patterns.context: 局部词语被标记，但其功能或语义与其他段的高强度激活难以对应
patterns.domain: 专利、物理论文、医学摘要

en.description: Activations are distributed across representative-example wording, genomic experimental terminology, clustering and set-theoretic mathematical expressions, Greek word fragments, forum questions, medical statistical figures, and vector-space constructions; no single trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Representative-example wording
patterns.context: Uses representative to introduce representative genes or prior applications; [1] also has activation on the name “Kim,” which does not appear in [7].

patterns.name: Genomic fragments and measurements
patterns.context: Describes overlapping genomic fragments in large-scale reporting experiments, alongside the quantity expression “>108”;

patterns.name: Clustering algorithm terminology
patterns.context: Introduces k-means clustering and its cluster centers;

patterns.name: Greek text fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of Greek words; the passage concerns estimates and reserves.

patterns.name: Opening of English questions
patterns.context: Asks readers a question beginning with Are; the topics are office chairs and commercial uses of canvas.

patterns.name: Epidemiological statistics
patterns.context: Compares rates of visits, emergency department use, and hospitalization between COPD patients and non-patients, and reports adult sample sizes and statistical figures.

patterns.name: Mathematical definition of a strongly additive set
patterns.context: Defines a set property and continues stating a theorem using family-of-sets notation.

patterns.name: Product construction in vector spaces
patterns.context: Defines a subspace spanned by products of a particular form, with isomorphism classes of branch covers as a basis in a vector space.

7_708.description: 激活分散于 representative 示例措辞、基因组实验术语、聚类与集合论数学表达、希腊语词片段、论坛疑问句，以及医学统计数字和向量空间构造；没有单一触发模式覆盖所有段。

patterns.name: representative 示例表述
patterns.context: 用 representative 引出具有代表性的基因或既有应用；[1] 另有姓名 “Kim” 激活，但在 [7] 不出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与专利背景

patterns.name: 基因组片段及测量
patterns.context: 描述大规模报告实验中的重叠基因组片段，伴随数量表达 “>108”；

patterns.name: 聚类算法术语
patterns.context: 介绍 k-means 聚类及其聚类中心；

patterns.name: 希腊语文本片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊语词语的子词片段中；段落内容涉及估计与储备量。

patterns.name: 英语疑问句起始
patterns.context: 面向读者提出以 Are 开头的问题；具体话题分别是办公椅和 canvas 的商业用途。

patterns.name: 流行病学统计数字
patterns.context: 比较 COPD 患者与非患者的就诊、急诊及住院率，并报告成人样本量与数字统计。

patterns.name: 强可加集的数学定义
patterns.context: 给出集合性质定义，并以集合族记号继续陈述定理。

patterns.name: 向量空间中的乘积构造
patterns.context: 在向量空间中以分支覆盖的同构类作基，并定义由特定形式乘积张成的子空间。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of expository text: representative objects and set membership, quantity and existence relations, the uses of technical objects, and statements about linear independence/dependence; some triggers may come from common local syntactic fragments.

patterns.name: Statements about representative things or set members
patterns.context: Several objects are listed, followed by a statement that they are representative, related to one another, or belong to a set; common wording includes “are,” “representative,” and “many.”
patterns.domain: Expository text, including biomedicine, patents, and forum comments

patterns.name: Quantity, proportion, and set relations
patterns.context: Describes existence, quantity, proportion, range, or membership in a set, often with numbers and quantifiers.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and computer science papers, biomedical research

patterns.name: Technical objects and their properties or uses
patterns.context: Introduces devices, data, or experimental objects and describes their uses, properties, or related technical functions.

patterns.name: Linear dependence and its consequences
patterns.context: Discusses linearly independent or dependent vectors and states, and their effects on performance or evaluation.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, machine learning, and signal processing

patterns.name: Other local syntactic triggers
patterns.context: Activations occur around common connectives or predicates, but these local fragments do not share enough semantic conditions to confirm a common pattern.

7_708.description: 激活分散于多类说明性文本：代表性对象与集合成员、数量和存在关系、技术对象用途，以及线性独立/依赖表述；部分触发可能来自常见句法局部片段。

patterns.name: 代表性事物或集合成员的陈述
patterns.trigger: “representative genes”“representative of prior applications”“are two closely related species”“many very good shots”
patterns.context: 先列举若干对象，再说明它们具有代表性、相互关联或属于某一集合；常见“are”“representative”“many”等表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、论坛评论等说明性文字

patterns.name: 数量、比例与集合关系
patterns.trigger: “for any rate”“there are”“amongst”“only 1 of 59”“all instances”“a small set of possible classifiers”
patterns.context: 描述存在性、数量、比例、范围或集合中的成员关系，常伴有数字及量词。
patterns.domain: 数学与计算机科学论文、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 技术对象及其属性或用途
patterns.trigger: “flat panel display devices”“are used as display devices”“overlapping genomic fragments”
patterns.context: 介绍设备、数据或实验对象，并说明其用途、属性或相关技术功能。

patterns.name: 线性依赖及其后果
patterns.context: 讨论线性独立或依赖的向量、状态及其对性能或评价的影响。
patterns.domain: 数学、机器学习与信号处理

patterns.name: 其余局部句法触发
patterns.trigger: “Previous studies had shown”“but was seen”“poor performance”“forming heterodimeric structures”
patterns.context: 激活落在常见连接或谓词周围，但这些局部片段未呈现足以确认的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与机器学习论文

en.description: The clearest pattern is the representative-object structure “are representative”; other activations involve plural are, quantity ranges, mathematical terminology, and a few domain-specific words and phrases. Overall, there is no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Introducing representative objects
patterns.context: In the structure “X are representative [members/genes/applications] of Y,” identifies certain objects as representative of a group or method.

patterns.name: Are in existential or declarative constructions
patterns.context: The copula are follows a plural subject and connects it to a property, category, or subsequent statement; representative is not required.

patterns.name: Quantity and range expressions
patterns.context: Quantifiers or degree words occur in expressions such as “too many” and “fewer than,” describing quantity or comparative scope.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, forum discussions, news reports

patterns.name: Mathematical objects and quantity relations
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols or variables occur with terms such as “linearly independent,” describing properties of vectors, sets, or graphs.

patterns.name: Phrasal uses of the polysemous word out
patterns.context: Embedded in phrases such as “come out,” meaning that a project appears, is released, or takes shape; the word itself cannot explain the other activations.

patterns.name: Copycat competitors
patterns.context: The compound copycat modifies competitors, referring to imitators or knockoff competitors.

patterns.name: Expressions related to image quality
patterns.context: Evaluates image quality and photographic performance when discussing cameras or photos.

patterns.name: Scattered domain terms and entities
patterns.context: Specialized terms or entities are activated in individual passages, but belong to different topics and lack a shared local trigger structure.

7_708.concept: 代表性陈述与复数系动词
7_708.description: 最清晰的模式是代表性对象结构“are representative”；另有复数 are、数量范围、数学术语及少量领域词、短语触发，整体并非单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 代表性对象的引入
patterns.context: 在“X are representative [members/genes/applications] of Y”结构中，指明某些对象是某类群体或方法的代表。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、生物学论文

patterns.name: 存在或陈述结构中的 are
patterns.context: 复数主语后的系动词 are，连接对象与其性质、类别或后续陈述；不要求出现 representative。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、新闻、论坛文字

patterns.name: 数量与范围表达
patterns.context: 数量词或程度词处于“too many”“fewer than”等表达中，描述数量多少或比较范围。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、论坛讨论、新闻报道

patterns.name: 数学对象及数量关系
patterns.context: 数学符号或变量与“linearly independent”等术语共同出现，描述向量、集合或图的性质。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学

patterns.name: 多义词 out 的短语用法
patterns.context: 嵌在“come out”等短语中，表示项目出现、发布或形成；该词本身不足以解释其他激活。

patterns.name: 复制竞争者
patterns.context: 复合词 copycat 修饰 competitors，指模仿者或仿制竞争者。

patterns.name: 图像质量相关表达
patterns.context: 在谈相机或照片时评价图像质量与照片表现。

patterns.name: 零散领域术语与实体
patterns.context: 各段中的专业名词或实体被激活，但彼此分属不同主题，缺少共同局部触发结构。
patterns.domain: 语义技术、生物医学、新闻

en.concept: Copular verbs and following descriptive structures
en.description: Activations often occur on English be verbs (especially are/were) and following descriptive or classificatory structures; “representative” collocations recur across three passages. There is also a substring within a Greek word and several one-off contexts with varied semantics and syntax.

patterns.name: “representative” and nearby syntax
patterns.context: The word is used as a pre-nominal modifier, often after a copula (“were representative genes,” “are representative members,” “are representative of”), describing a set of genes, members, or prior applications; activation concentrates on the word and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: “Are all” question structure
patterns.context: A question beginning a sentence or clause with “Are all the …” asks whether a category of things all meet a property; this example is followed by an evaluation of price.

patterns.name: “are always” in existential sentences
patterns.context: An existential sentence in mathematical prose, followed by a quantity or object and a description of its properties.

patterns.name: Substring within a Greek word
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, the trigger substring occurs inside the word “αποθέματα” (reserves); no syntactic or semantic conditions matching the English trigger words are evident.

patterns.name: “are examples of” introducing examples after listing patents
patterns.context: After several patent numbers and inventors, this phrase introduces a known device or technical category.

patterns.name: “were” and appearance description in narrative
patterns.context: In past-tense narration, followed by a group such as “a good many tall … young Englishmen” and a description of their appearance.

patterns.name: Incomplete “a representative” collocation
patterns.context: A biomedical paper uses “a representative” to introduce cells sourced from patients; the displayed context is truncated after the phrase.

patterns.name: “are large” describing celestial bodies
patterns.context: In a discussion of planet formation, the copula is followed by an adjective of size and a description of material composition.

7_708.concept: 系动词及后续描述结构
7_708.description: 激活多见于英语 be 动词（尤为 are/were）及其后续描述或分类结构；“representative”相关搭配在三段中重复出现。另有希腊语词内子串，及多个只出现一次、语义和句式各异的上下文。

patterns.name: “representative”词及邻近句式
patterns.context: 该词用作名词前定语，常出现在系动词后（“were representative genes”“are representative members”“are representative of”），并描述一组基因、成员或先前申请；触发位置集中在该词及其附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: “are all”疑问句式
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头以“Are all the …”询问一类事物是否都符合某性质；本例后接价格评价。

patterns.name: 存在句中的“are always”
patterns.context: 数学论述中的存在句，后接数量或对象及性质描述。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内子串
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中，触发子串出现在“αποθέματα”（储备）一词内部；未见与英语触发词相同的句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 列举专利后举例的“are examples of”
patterns.context: 多个专利号及发明人之后，用该短语引出已知设备或技术类别。

patterns.name: 叙事中的“were”及外貌描写
patterns.context: 过去时叙事中，后接“a good many tall … young Englishmen”等群体及外貌描写。

patterns.name: “a representative”不完整搭配
patterns.context: 医学论文中以“a representative”引出患者来源细胞；所示上下文在短语后截断。

patterns.name: “are large”描述天体
patterns.context: 行星形成论述中，系动词后接大小形容词及物质组成描述。

en.concept: Local English collocations and syntactic structures
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: they include representative structures, questions with all, medical compound modifiers and disease transmission, image evaluation, summaries of business contexts, expressions of conjecture, and descriptions of competitors. Most are local collocations or syntactic positions and are difficult to explain with a single semantic account.

patterns.name: Representative objects
patterns.context: In structures such as “X are representative genes/members of …” or “X are representative of …,” activation concentrates on representative and may extend to the following category noun.

patterns.name: Universal quantifier
patterns.context: In questions, all occurs after the be verb and before a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Modifiers of patient-derived entities
patterns.context: Biomedical text describes cells or samples derived from patients; activation is distributed across the compound modifier and adjacent entity.

patterns.name: Image quality description
patterns.context: Evaluates the quality of photographs or images, with degree adverbs used alongside quantity terms, positive adjectives, and nouns.

patterns.name: Transmission and recurrence of infectious diseases
patterns.context: Arthropods act as vectors transmitting pathogens of emerging or re-emerging infectious diseases.

patterns.name: Practice-area scenarios
patterns.context: Summarizes previously listed professional client relationships or business areas, using scenarios to characterize the situations.

patterns.name: Expressions of possibility
patterns.context: News or commentary uses appear to be to introduce a conjectural judgment.

patterns.name: A few remaining competitors
patterns.context: Discusses market competitors copying a product, declining in number, and assesses their standing.

7_708.concept: 局部英语搭配与句法结构
7_708.description: 激活模式分散：包括 representative 结构、疑问句 all、医学复合修饰与疾病传播、图像评价、业务场景总结、推测表达及竞争者描述。各模式多为局部搭配或句法位置，难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 代表性对象
patterns.context: 在“X are representative genes/members of …”或“X are representative of …”结构中，激活集中于 representative，且可延伸到后续类别名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 全称限定词
patterns.context: 疑问句中 all 位于 be 动词之后、名词短语之前。

patterns.name: 患者来源的实体修饰
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中描述患者来源的细胞或样本；激活分布在复合修饰语及相邻实体上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究资助摘要

patterns.name: 图像质量描述
patterns.context: 对照片或图像质量作评价，程度副词与数量、褒义形容词及名词连用。

patterns.name: 传染病传播与再现
patterns.context: 节肢动物作为媒介传播新发或再现的传染病病原体。

patterns.name: 实践领域场景
patterns.context: 总结此前列举的职业客户关系或业务领域，并以 scenarios 概括情境。

patterns.name: 可能性表达
patterns.context: 新闻或评论中以 appear to be 引出推测性判断。

patterns.name: 少数残存竞争者
patterns.context: 讨论市场竞争者仿制产品、数量减少，并评价其地位。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered and include representative wording, quantity and degree words, relational and classification descriptions, evaluative collocations, and functional or general factual statements. Some patterns may reflect common noun phrases and syntactic frames.

patterns.name: representative / representativeness expressions
patterns.context: Indicates that certain genes or prior patent applications are representative, followed by of, genes, applications, and similar terms.

patterns.name: Quantifiers and counting expressions
patterns.context: Quantifiers occur in counts, degree expressions, or general quantitative statements; trigger words and collocations are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, forums, and biological descriptions

patterns.name: Relatedness, comparison, and classification
patterns.context: Describes species relationships, competition levels, or relations in symmetric structures.

patterns.name: Evaluative descriptions and degree modifiers
patterns.context: Evaluates photos, game levels, or products, with degree adverbs adjacent to positive evaluative words.

patterns.name: Statements of function, role, and use
patterns.context: States the function or characteristics of an entity, or a person’s habit of doing something; lexical collocations vary widely.

patterns.name: Frequent copulas and general statements
patterns.context: Uses copulas and existential constructions in statements, definitions, or examples; these may simply be common syntactic frames.

7_708.concept: 描述性陈述与量化表达
7_708.description: 激活模式较分散：包括“representative”代表性表述、数量与程度词、关系和分类描述、评价性搭配，以及功能或一般事实陈述；若干模式可能反映常见名词短语和句法框架。

patterns.name: representative / 代表性表达
patterns.context: 用于说明某些基因或既有专利申请具有代表性，后接 of、genes 或 applications 等。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 数量词与计数表达
patterns.context: 数量词出现在计数、程度或概括性量化表达中；触发词和搭配并不统一。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、论坛及生物学说明

patterns.name: 相关、比较与归类
patterns.context: 描述物种关系、赛事等级或对称结构中的关系和分类。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、体育百科、动物学说明

patterns.name: 评价性描述与程度修饰
patterns.context: 评价照片、游戏关卡或产品，程度副词与正面评价词相邻。

patterns.name: 功能、作用与用途陈述
patterns.context: 陈述实体的功能或特征，或个人做某事的习惯；词面搭配差异较大。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、动物学资料、论坛

patterns.name: 高频系词及一般性陈述
patterns.context: 在陈述、定义或举例中使用系词与存在句；可能只是常见句法框架。

en.description: Activations occur in local collocations such as statements about representative members, Are all questions, photography reviews, species descriptions, mathematical generalizations, and patient-group qualifiers; no single semantic theme explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Representative examples or members
patterns.context: After a copula comes representative, followed by the genes, prior applications, or member category being represented.

patterns.name: Are all... question structure
patterns.context: A question asks whether a group of objects all have a property or are subject to the same regulation.

patterns.name: Quantity and evaluative modifiers of shots
patterns.context: When discussing photo quality, a quantity term and degree or evaluative words consecutively modify shots.

patterns.name: Species relations and descriptions of harm
patterns.context: Introduces two closely related species and describes their harm as pests.

patterns.name: Non-equivalent generalizations in mathematics
patterns.context: Discusses several mutually non-equivalent generalizations of conditions in the mathematical setting of a semilattice.

patterns.name: Specific patient groups
patterns.context: Identifies a group of severely immunocompromised patients and discusses treatment or preventive measures.

7_708.description: 激活分布于代表性成员表述、Are all疑问句，以及摄影评价、物种描述、数学推广和患者群体限定等局部搭配；没有一个能解释所有片段的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代表性实例或成员
patterns.trigger: «representative»；常见搭配为“were representative genes”“are representative of”“are representative members”
patterns.context: 系动词后接 representative，再说明代表的基因、先前应用或成员类别。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: Are all...疑问结构
patterns.trigger: «Are»...«all»，包括“Are all the”“Are all those”“Are all rrg”“all the”
patterns.context: 疑问句询问一组对象是否全都具有某属性或受到相同调控。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 数量与评价词修饰 shots
patterns.context: 谈论照片质量时，数量词和程度、评价词连续修饰 shots。

patterns.name: 物种关系及危害描述
patterns.context: 介绍两种近缘物种，并描述其作为害虫的危害。

patterns.name: 数学中的非等价推广
patterns.context: 在半格这一数学情形下，讨论若干彼此不等价的条件推广。

patterns.name: 特定患者群体
patterns.context: 限定严重免疫功能低下的患者群体，并讨论治疗或预防措施。

en.description: Activations are distributed across scientific, patent, education, business, gaming, and sports texts: they often occur in category/example expressions and noun phrases, and also in several domain-specific phrases; there is no single stable semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Predicates and nouns following “representative”
patterns.context: “Representative” is followed by a category noun or an “of” structure; both occurrences appear in statements about research findings or prior art.

patterns.name: Category nouns after “as”
patterns.context: In the “transform as” structure, as is followed by a particle category; a parallel contrast category also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: MBA program wording
patterns.context: An educational program description uses MBA with program and notes that the program has several options.

patterns.name: designed in a hyphenated compound
patterns.context: Evaluates a game level; well-designed is preceded by an adverb of degree and followed by a comma.

patterns.name: Professional relationships and practice areas
patterns.context: Business advice summarizes different client types and their referral relationships; activation centers on these practice area scenarios.

patterns.name: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases
patterns.context: Describes arthropods as vectors transmitting emerging or re-emerging pathogens.

patterns.name: Lower-ranked tournaments
patterns.context: An athlete’s career narrative describes winning or participating in lower-tier tournaments; the phrase recurs.

patterns.name: Patent example devices
patterns.context: After listing patent numbers and inventors, “examples of known devices” introduces device functions.

patterns.name: Research aims and related objectives
patterns.context: A research plan or grant abstract first states its main aim, then introduces several related objectives.

7_708.description: 激活分散于科学、专利、教育、商业、游戏与体育文本：常落在类别/例证表达及名词短语，也包括若干领域特有词组；没有单一稳定的语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: “representative”后的谓词与名词
patterns.context: “representative”后接类别名词或“of”结构；两处都处于说明研究发现或现有技术的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: “as”后的类别名词
patterns.context: “transform as”结构中，as 后接粒子类别；同段还出现平行对照类别。
patterns.domain: 理论物理 / 暗物质论文

patterns.name: MBA 项目表述
patterns.context: 教育项目介绍中，MBA 与 program 连用，并说明项目有多个可选类型。
patterns.domain: 教育 / 商业类百科文本

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的 designed
patterns.context: 评价游戏关卡，well-designed 前有程度副词，后接逗号。

patterns.name: 职业关系与专业领域
patterns.context: 商业建议文本总结不同客户类型及其转介关系，触发集中在 these practice area scenarios。
patterns.domain: 小企业 / 专业服务营销

patterns.name: 新发与再发感染病
patterns.context: 描述节肢动物作为媒介传播新发或再发的致病因子。
patterns.domain: 传染病 / 生物医学研究

patterns.name: 低排名赛事
patterns.context: 运动员职业经历叙述中，描述赢得或参加较低级别赛事；短语重复出现。

patterns.name: 专利例证设备
patterns.context: 列举专利编号与发明人后，以“examples of known devices”引出设备功能。
patterns.domain: 专利背景 / 技术说明

patterns.name: 研究目标与相关目标
patterns.trigger: «Related»3« to»1 this primary aim «are»3« several»4« related»9 goals
patterns.context: 研究计划或资助摘要中，先述主要目标，再引出若干相关目标。

en.concept: English noun phrases and overall assertions
en.description: Activations occur in varied contexts. More repeatable cues include “all” as a universal generalization, the copula “are” connecting a subject and predicate, and “of” structures following nouns; the rest involve patents, biology, mathematics, devices, status options, and photography commentary, and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “all” introducing a universal or overall judgment
patterns.context: “All” makes an overall generalization about a group of objects, options, features, or states; it sometimes occurs after a copula and sometimes directly modifies a noun.

patterns.name: Copular “are” and following predicates
patterns.context: The copula “are” connects a subject with a classification, property, or generalizing predicate; the strongly activated words vary across examples.

patterns.name: “of” structures after a noun or noun phrase
patterns.context: A noun or pronoun is followed by an “of” phrase expressing composition, source, or content; activation falls at different positions within the phrase.

patterns.name: “adjective/noun + -ing” formation in compounds
patterns.context: In a technical compound modifier, an -ing form follows a noun and modifies a subsequent noun.

patterns.name: “published” after an entity name and content introduction
patterns.context: A web article describes an organization publishing a large volume of material; activation includes a phrase introducing that content.

patterns.name: “can be used” after a device name
patterns.context: Describes a device that can serve as a component of a system.

patterns.name: “Although” in a concessive contrast
patterns.context: A patent background first acknowledges an existing property or use of a material, then shifts to the subsequent discussion.

patterns.name: Comparison and classification of related species
patterns.context: Two species are introduced together, with their relatedness and ecological significance explained.

patterns.name: Numerical ranges and frequency expressions
patterns.context: A conversational discussion states how many times per week an activity occurs.

patterns.name: Products and divisor classes of mathematical objects
patterns.context: A mathematical statement about Hodge class representations on a self-product of a Jacobian.

patterns.name: Grouped status options
patterns.context: A user interface or collaboration tool lists available work statuses, then summarizes them as customizable.

patterns.name: Image-quality evaluation and sample count
patterns.context: Comments on a camera or lens article, evaluating image quality and mentioning sample photographs.

7_708.concept: 英语名词短语与整体断言
7_708.description: 激活分布于多种语境，较可重复的线索是“all”作整体概括、系词“are”连接主语与谓语，以及名词后的“of”结构；其余涉及专利、生物、数学、器件、状态选项与摄影评论，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “all”引出全称或整体判断
patterns.trigger: “all”及其邻近词，如 “all pretty much what”、 “all the uber-expensive”、 “These are all”
patterns.context: “all”对一组对象、选项、特征或状态作整体概括；有时出现在系词后，有时直接限定名词
patterns.domain: 专利、论坛对话、个人叙述

patterns.name: “are”系词及其后续谓语
patterns.trigger: “are widely known as materials”、“are two closely related species”、“are all”、“These are all”
patterns.context: 系词“are”连接主语与分类、属性或概括性谓语；强激活词分布并不完全相同
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、论坛对话

patterns.name: 名词或名词短语后的“of”结构
patterns.trigger: “products of divisor classes”、“what appear to be CIA spying secrets”、“elements of the light source”
patterns.context: 名词或代词后接“of”短语，表达组成、来源或内容；激活落在短语内部不同位置
patterns.domain: 数学论文、网络文章、专利

patterns.name: 复合词中的“形容词/名词 + -ing”构词
patterns.context: 专业复合修饰语中，-ing形式接在名词后并修饰后续名词

patterns.name: 实体名后的“published”及内容引介
patterns.trigger: “WikiLeaks has published a huge trove of what appear to be CIA spying secrets”
patterns.context: 网络文章中介绍组织发布大量资料；激活包括内容引介短语

patterns.name: 器件名称后的“can be used”
patterns.trigger: “LEDs can be used as the light emitting elements”
patterns.context: 描述一种器件可作为某系统的组成部分

patterns.name: 转折让步句中的“Although”
patterns.trigger: “Although polybenzoxazole and polyimide are widely known”
patterns.context: 专利背景中先承认材料已有性质或用途，再转向后续论述

patterns.name: 相邻物种比较与分类
patterns.context: 两个物种被并列介绍，并说明其亲缘关系及生态意义

patterns.name: 数值范围与频率表达
patterns.context: 口语讨论中说明某行为每周发生的次数

patterns.name: 数学对象的乘积与除子类
patterns.context: 关于雅可比簇自乘积上霍奇类表示的数学陈述

patterns.name: 成组列举的状态选项
patterns.trigger: “Other statuses are ‘On Call’, ‘In the Flow’, or ‘in a meeting’”
patterns.context: 界面或协作工具中列举可选工作状态，随后概括这些状态可定制
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、软件使用讨论

patterns.name: 图像质量评价与样片数量
patterns.trigger: “best article for image quality”、“many very good shots”
patterns.context: 评论相机或镜头文章，评价画质并提及照片样片

en.description: Activations are scattered around be/are/were, to-infinitives, existential there constructions, and clauses or complements; there are also classification descriptions and a few isolated predicate collocations. They occur across domains without a single stable lexical item.

patterns.name: Complements or predicate-complement structures after be
patterns.context: A sentence contains a be verb followed by a noun, adjective, adverb, participle, or other constituent; the strongest activation does not always fall on be itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, academic, and patent texts

patterns.name: Structures introduced by infinitival to
patterns.context: An infinitive marker is followed by a verb or embedded in structures such as “appear to be”; some instances show strong activation on the following word.
patterns.domain: Patents, news, academic writing, and other genres

patterns.name: Existential constructions and verbs of existence
patterns.context: Uses there to introduce an existing entity, followed by a quantity word or noun phrase.

patterns.name: That-clauses or demonstrative structures
patterns.context: Occurs near a clause introducer, demonstrative, or anaphoric element; activation does not consistently fall on the same part of speech or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Complements in lists or classifications
patterns.context: Describes examples, representative objects, material uses, or correspondences, often with noun phrases or complements.

patterns.name: Other local lexical collocations
patterns.context: Predicate collocations appearing only in individual passages, with no unified, clear syntactic trigger condition.

7_708.description: 激活分散在 be/are/were、to 不定式、there 存在句及从句或补语附近；另有分类描述和少量孤立谓词搭配，跨领域出现，未显示单一稳定词项。

patterns.name: be 动词后的成分或谓语补足结构
patterns.context: 句中出现 be 动词，随后接名词、形容词、副词或分词等成分；强激活位置并不总是 be 本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述与学术、专利文本

patterns.name: 不定式 to 引出的结构
patterns.context: 不定式标记后接动词，或嵌在“appear to be”等结构中；部分实例强激活落在后续词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻、学术等多种文体

patterns.name: 存在句与存在动词
patterns.context: 用 there 引出存在的事物，后续接数量词或名词短语。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、数学物理论文

patterns.name: that 从句或指示结构
patterns.context: 出现在从句引导、指示或回指成分附近；激活未稳定落在同一词类或句法位置。

patterns.name: 列举或分类中的后续成分
patterns.context: 描述实例、代表性对象、材料用途或对应关系，常伴随名词短语或补语。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学与数学论文

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇搭配
patterns.context: 仅在个别片段中出现的谓词搭配，无法归入统一的明确句法触发条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across predicate semantics, physics transformation terminology, patent disclosure language, and subword fragments within multisyllabic words; they also involve common function words and paragraph-boundary markers. They span domains and occur at varying within-word positions, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Predication, description, and classification terms
patterns.context: Activates in passages describing the features and role of predicates when discussing linguistic expression, sentence truth, or conceptual classification.

patterns.name: Transformation and scalar terminology
patterns.context: In cosmology or particle physics, describes particle properties under symmetry transformations and distinguishes among different types.

patterns.name: Patent disclosure and exemplification wording
patterns.context: In patent background or technical descriptions, describes what existing devices, procedures, or documents disclose or exemplify; often co-occurs with numbers and apparatus/procedures.

patterns.name: A series of affix-bearing subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Across texts from different fields, activations occur on subword fragments within whole words or compounds; they often appear in multisyllabic words, derived words, or hyphenated compounds, with no stable topical restriction.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical and general web text

patterns.name: General function words and grammatical forms
patterns.context: These fragments are distributed across news, patents, philosophy, research, and forum text, appearing in different syntactic positions; they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-boundary markers after citations and bibliographic lists
patterns.context: Punctuation and newline markers activated after reference lists or citations, followed by a new paragraph or summary statement.

7_708.description: 激活分散于谓词语义、物理变换术语、专利披露用语及多音节词内片段，也涉及常见功能词和段界标记；跨领域且词内位置不一，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 述谓、描述与分类用语
patterns.context: 讨论语言表达、句子真假或概念分类时，在说明谓词的特征及其作用的段落中激活。

patterns.name: 变换与标量类术语
patterns.context: 在宇宙学或粒子物理中，说明粒子在对称变换下的性质，并对不同类型作区分。

patterns.name: 专利披露与例示表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术说明中，描述既有设备、程序或文献所揭示、例示的内容；多与编号和 apparatus/procedures 同现。

patterns.name: 一串词缀处于词内的术语片段
patterns.context: 在多种领域文本中，激活落在完整词或复合词的词内片段上；常见于多音节词、派生词或连字符复合词，未见稳定的主题限制。
patterns.domain: 跨领域科技文本及一般网页文本

patterns.name: 通用功能词及语法形式
patterns.context: 这些片段分散在新闻、专利、哲学、科研及论坛文本中，出现在不同句法位置；难以归结为单一语义条件。

patterns.name: 引文与文献列举后的句界标记
patterns.context: 参考文献或引文列表结束后出现的标点、换行标记被激活，后接新段落或总结性陈述。

en.description: Activations are distributed across many word types and positions: degree or limiting expressions, quantifiers, technical nouns, and academic noun phrases are common; there are also punctuation boundaries and research-plan expressions. The contexts do not support a single stable trigger rule.

patterns.name: Descriptive content following adjectives or adverbs
patterns.context: After words expressing degree, limitation, or evaluation, subsequent words describe an object or property; the exact activation position varies across examples.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including news, forums, papers, literature, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Nouns in academic noun phrases
patterns.context: In academic or technical text, modifiers and head nouns form terms or noun phrases; activation often falls on the noun or part of a term.
patterns.domain: Machine learning papers, biomedical research, education descriptions

patterns.name: Quantifiers and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Quantifiers count or indicate quantities and are followed by countable objects; this also includes “a good many” in literary narration.
patterns.domain: Game descriptions, naval history, email, literary narration

patterns.name: Technical or proper-name vocabulary
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names, domain terms, or words split by tokenization; no common local syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: News, military history, games, literature, poetic email

patterns.name: Word-final or punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: In a few passages, activation falls on sentence-final punctuation, newlines, or hyphens as boundary tokens, with no consistent context.
patterns.domain: Paper citations, forum text, hyphenated words

patterns.name: Research targets and relation expressions
patterns.context: A research plan describes identifying targets, regulatory genes, and their functions or relations.

7_708.description: 激活分散在多类词语与位置：程度或限定表达、数量词、专业名词及学术名词短语较常见；另有标点边界和研究计划表达。上下文不支持单一稳定触发规则。

patterns.name: 形容词副词后接描述性内容
patterns.context: 在程度、限定或评价词后，后续出现描述对象或性质的词语；各例的具体激活位置并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛、论文、文学、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 学术名词短语中的名词
patterns.context: 学术或专业文本中，修饰语与中心名词构成术语或名词短语；激活常落在名词或术语的一部分。
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文、生物医学研究、教育介绍

patterns.name: 数量词与数量表达
patterns.context: 数量词用于计数或表达数量，后接可数对象；也包括文学叙述中的“a good many”。
patterns.domain: 游戏介绍、海军史、邮件、文学叙述

patterns.name: 专业或专名词汇
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、领域术语或被分词切开的词内，未见统一的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、军事史、游戏、文学、诗意邮件

patterns.name: 词尾或标点边界
patterns.context: 个别段落中激活落在句末标点、换行或连字符等边界 token 上，缺少一致上下文。
patterns.domain: 论文引用、论坛文本、连字符词

patterns.name: 研究对象与关系表达
patterns.context: 研究计划描述识别对象、调控基因及其功能或关系。

en.concept: Be structures and local textual features
en.description: Activations occur across varied texts, most notably with to be and modal/passive be structures; other patterns include technical noun components, prepositions and determiners, and scattered patterns involving grouping, quantity, and device descriptions. No single theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: be + infinitive structure
patterns.context: The sentence contains be as an infinitive or a verb after a modal, often in “appear to be” or passive structures; to be is the most prominent pattern.
patterns.domain: News, film reviews, patents, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Technical nouns or term components
patterns.context: A component of a technical compound noun or specialist term activates in patent, scientific, or institutional descriptions; the words are varied, with no stable single category of terms.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, encyclopedias, medical research plans, patents

patterns.name: High-frequency prepositions and determiners
patterns.context: Occurs in noun phrases, relational descriptions, or general statements; the same token appears across different passages and contexts, without a clear distinctive condition.

patterns.name: Organization or grouping
patterns.context: Describes how research subjects are grouped, how devices are configured, or how things function as a particular form.

patterns.name: Possibility or uncertainty judgments
patterns.context: “What appear to be” introduces an inference about the nature of something rather than a direct assertion.

patterns.name: Parameterized and reference-frame expressions
patterns.context: Discusses equivalence classes, parameterization, and reference frames with different orientations.

patterns.name: Counts or quantity descriptions
patterns.context: States the number of items, a finite quantity, or the number of device components.

patterns.name: Research objectives and functional relations
patterns.context: A research plan lists objectives and describes the roles of regulatory genes and their products.

patterns.name: Patent device and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Describes structures and configurations of devices such as transformers, shafts, or honeycomb channels.

patterns.name: MBA program statements
patterns.context: Lists the types of MBA programs available.

7_708.concept: be 结构及局部文本特征
7_708.description: 激活分布于多种文本中，最显著的是 to be 及情态/被动 be 结构；另有技术名词成分、介词限定词，以及分组、数量和设备描述等分散模式。没有单一主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: be + 不定式结构
patterns.context: 句中出现 be 作不定式或情态动词后的动词，常位于“appear to be”或被动结构中；突出程度最高的是 to be
patterns.domain: 新闻、影视评论、专利及一般说明文

patterns.name: 技术名词或术语成分
patterns.context: 专利、科学或机构说明文本中，技术复合名词或专业术语的组成部分被激活；词项分散，未显示稳定的单一术语类别
patterns.domain: 学术论文、百科、医学研究计划、专利

patterns.name: 高频介词及限定词
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语、关系说明或一般陈述中；同一 token 在不同段落、不同语境中出现，缺乏明确的独特条件

patterns.name: 组织或成组安排
patterns.context: 描述研究对象如何分组、设备如何配置或事物如何作为某种形式运作
patterns.domain: 医学研究计划、专利说明

patterns.name: 可能性或不确定判断
patterns.context: 以“what appear to be”引出对事物性质的推断，而非直接断言

patterns.name: 参数化与参照系表达
patterns.context: 讨论等价类、参数化及不同取向的参照系

patterns.name: 计数或数量描述
patterns.context: 说明项目数量、有限数量或设备部件数量

patterns.name: 研究目标与功能关系
patterns.context: 研究计划列举目标，并描述调控基因及其产物的作用

patterns.name: 专利设备与结构描述
patterns.context: 描述变压器、轴系或蜂窝通道等设备结构与配置

patterns.name: MBA 项目陈述
patterns.context: 列举可提供的 MBA 项目类型

en.description: Strong activations concentrate on the phrase “what appears to be” and several technical terms or morpheme fragments: gene relationships, subtype specificity, descriptive predicates, -violating, TF binding, and eLRR receptor. No clear shared trigger is apparent in passages 3 and 6.

patterns.name: The phrase “what appears to be”
patterns.context: Occurs in the structure “what appears to be …,” usually introducing a judgment or description of the following subject.

patterns.name: related expressing a relationship
patterns.context: A research objective asks how multiple genes are related, followed by “in terms of”.

patterns.name: Compound adjective subtype-specific
patterns.context: Modifies a signaling complex to indicate subtype specificity.

patterns.name: Descriptive predicates
patterns.context: Discusses predicate categories, semantic properties, and distinctions from other predicate types.

patterns.name: Inflectional suffix -ing
patterns.context: Follows the compound “flavor-” to form the compound modifier “flavor-violating,” describing a property of a matrix.

patterns.name: TF binding in gene-regulation terminology
patterns.context: Discussion of TF (transcription factor) binding to DNA and its regulatory consequences.

patterns.name: Receptor names and receptor
patterns.context: Focuses on plant eLRR receptors, co-receptors, ligands, interactions, and receptor domains.

7_708.concept: 局部短语与专业术语触发
7_708.description: 强激活集中于“what appears to be”句式及若干专业词汇或构词片段：基因关系、亚型特异性、描述谓词、-violating、TF binding、eLRR receptor。第3、6段未见清晰共同触发。

patterns.name: 句式 “what appears to be”
patterns.trigger: «what»« appear»« to»« be»（[1] 中带标记部分为 « appear»2« to»5« be»10；[2] 为 « appear»2« to»3« be»9）
patterns.context: 出现在 “what appears to be …” 结构中，通常引出对后续对象的判断或描述。

patterns.name: 表示关系的 related
patterns.context: 研究目标中询问多个基因之间如何相互关联，并接续 “in terms of”。

patterns.name: 复合形容词 subtype-specific
patterns.context: 修饰信号复合物，说明其具有亚型特异性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、受体信号研究

patterns.name: 描述谓词
patterns.context: 讨论谓词的类别、语义特征及其与其他谓词类型的区别。

patterns.name: 屈折词尾 -ing
patterns.context: 接在复合词 “flavor-” 后，构成描述矩阵性质的复合修饰语 “flavor-violating”。

patterns.name: 基因调控术语中的 TF binding
patterns.context: TF（转录因子）与 DNA 结合及其调控后果的讨论。
patterns.domain: 基因组学、基因调控研究

patterns.name: 受体名称与 receptor
patterns.trigger: «eLR»«R»« receptor»（并有重复的 eLRR receptor 及 “receptor domains”）
patterns.context: 围绕植物 eLRR 受体、共受体、配体、相互作用及受体结构域展开。
patterns.domain: 植物生物学、受体研究摘要

en.description: Activations are distributed across be/are structures, quantifiers such as all/both, quantity and degree terms, and subword fragments of split plurals or compounds; they span varied styles, with inconsistent trigger conditions and some hits that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: are in plural or quantified noun phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on are or an immediately adjacent element, often where a plural noun, quantifier, or supplementary description follows the subject; however, this syntax is not shared by all examples.
patterns.domain: Q&A, encyclopedias, academic and technical expository text

patterns.name: be with infinitival or participial complements
patterns.context: be occurs in an infinitive or passive construction, possibly preceded by appear, to, or will.
patterns.domain: News, commentary, legal and research-plan text

patterns.name: all/both and following determiner structures
patterns.context: The universal or paired quantifiers all and both occur in noun phrases or at the start of a clause; what follows varies.
patterns.domain: Forums, code comments, research text, and technical patents

patterns.name: Plural noun markers and tokenization splits
patterns.context: Activation spans within-word fragments split into multiple tokens, especially plural endings or abbreviations/compounds.
patterns.domain: Legal text, encyclopedias, and education descriptions

patterns.name: Degree/comparative quantity expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on quantity, degree, or comparative words modifying subsequent nouns; it is unclear whether this shares a source with the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Legal text, commentary, encyclopedias, and academic text

7_708.description: 激活分散在 be/are 结构、all/both 等量词、数量程度词及拆分的复数或复合词片段中；跨多种文体，触发条件不一致，部分命中难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 复数或量化名词短语中的 are
patterns.trigger: «Are»« all»« the»；«There are also other»；«program are»；«types are»
patterns.context: 激活落在 are 或其紧邻成分上，常见于主语后接复数名词、数量词或补充说明；但该句法并非所有例子共有
patterns.domain: 问答、百科、学术及技术说明文

patterns.name: be 与不定式／分词补语
patterns.trigger: «to»« be»；«appear to be»；«will be entered as»
patterns.context: be 位于不定式或被动结构中，前面可能有 appear、to 或 will
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、法律及研究计划文本

patterns.name: all／both 及其后的限定结构
patterns.context: 全称或成对量词 all、both 出现在名词短语或分句开头，后续成分并不固定
patterns.domain: 论坛、代码注释、研究文本及技术专利

patterns.name: 名词复数标记与分词式切分
patterns.context: 激活覆盖被拆成多个 token 的词内部片段，尤其是复数词尾或缩写／复合词

patterns.name: 程度／比较数量表达
patterns.context: 激活位于数量、程度或比较词，修饰后续名词；与其他模式是否同源不明
patterns.domain: 法律、评论、百科及学术文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied texts, including appear to be, all with nouns, legal investigations, receptor research, MBA programs, patent disclose, technical gaps, simple lodging, and several isolated word forms; no single stable trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Nouns following the quantifier all
patterns.context: all denotes the entire group or total quantity and is followed by a noun phrase; modifiers or prepositional phrases often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, code comments, and legal texts

patterns.name: Indefinite pronoun and complement in a clause after be
patterns.context: be appears in the speculative expression appear to be, followed by a noun or full noun phrase.

patterns.name: Legal-investigation wording with state and federal coordination
patterns.context: state and federal jointly modify investigation, with preceding references to multiple investigations or legal disputes.

patterns.name: receptor in research noun phrases
patterns.context: receptor serves as the central noun in plant receptor research, with nearby terms for research, interaction, structure, or function.

patterns.name: MBA program
patterns.context: MBA is adjacent to program in descriptions of different programs or study formats.

patterns.name: disclose in patents
patterns.context: Patent documents cite published texts, with disclose introducing the disclosed device or technical solution.

patterns.name: gaps wording in technical texts
patterns.context: Describes nonlinear regions whose positions are unclear and gives their names or alternative descriptions.

patterns.name: primitive huts in travel accommodation
patterns.context: Introduces simple lodging facilities available at a vacation destination.

patterns.name: Scattered word-form activations
patterns.context: These activations do not share sufficiently stable syntactic or semantic conditions across passages; they may separately involve word forms, common function words, or local collocations.

7_708.description: 激活分散于多种文本：涵盖 appear to be、all 与名词、法律调查、受体研究、MBA 项目、专利 disclose、技术 gaps、简易住宿及若干孤立词形；未见单一稳定触发规律。

patterns.name: 不定数量词 all 后的名词
patterns.context: all 表示全体或全部，后接名词短语；附近常有修饰语或介词短语。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、代码注释及法律文本

patterns.name: be 后接从句中的不定代词与补语
patterns.context: be 出现在推测性表达 appear to be 中，后续接名词或完整名词短语。

patterns.name: state 与联邦并列的法律调查表述
patterns.context: state 与 federal 并列修饰调查，前文提及多项调查或法律争议。

patterns.name: 科研名词短语中的 receptor
patterns.context: receptor 用作植物受体研究的中心名词，附近出现研究、相互作用、结构或功能等术语。

patterns.name: MBA program
patterns.context: MBA 紧邻 program，处在不同项目或学习方式的介绍中。

patterns.name: 专利中的 disclose
patterns.context: 专利文献引用公开文本，disclose 引出所披露的装置或技术方案。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 gaps 表述
patterns.context: 描述位置不明确的非线性区域，并给出其名称或同义说法。

patterns.name: 旅游住宿的 primitive huts
patterns.context: 介绍度假地可提供的简易住宿设施。

patterns.name: 零散的单词/词形激活
patterns.context: 这些激活在各段中没有足够稳定的共同句法或语义条件；可能分别涉及词形、常用功能词或局部搭配。

en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous content: README installation notes, mathematical paper terminology, calculus and time/order questions, base-arithmetic problems, patent technical descriptions, and C/C++ headers and macro definitions. No clear common trigger pattern runs through all segments.

patterns.name: Entity Framework installation instructions
patterns.context: A README contains a NOTE instructing users to install a framework first; activation concentrates on NOTE and the following instructions

patterns.name: Geometric terminology in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: In an abstract describing a mathematical structure, activation falls on left-invariant

patterns.name: Derivative and variable expressions
patterns.context: Asks for a higher-order derivative of a function with respect to variable c

patterns.name: Time conversion and intervals
patterns.context: Given clock times, asks for the number of minutes or a time interval

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems in different bases
patterns.context: Specifies a base and asks for addition or subtraction of signed numbers; activation spans problems in multiple bases

patterns.name: Ordinal ranking queries
patterns.context: Asks for the specified rank after sorting several values

patterns.name: Technical description in a patent background
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph describes coal, sulfur content, and a treatment process

patterns.name: C/C++ header and macro code
patterns.context: Source code first includes a header, then defines a macro that compares and calculates a difference

7_1130.description: 激活分散于异质内容：README安装提示、数学论文术语、微积分与时间/排序题、多进制运算题、专利技术叙述及C/C++头文件和宏定义；没有贯穿所有段的明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Entity Framework 安装说明
patterns.trigger: "NOTE: You should first install the Entity Framework"
patterns.context: README 中出现 NOTE 提示，要求先安装某框架；激活集中在 NOTE 及其后续说明

patterns.name: 数学论文中的几何术语
patterns.context: 摘要描述数学结构时，激活落在 left-invariant 上

patterns.name: 导数与变量表达式
patterns.context: 询问函数在变量 c 上的高阶导数

patterns.name: 时间换算与间隔
patterns.context: 以钟表时间为输入，询问分钟数或时间间隔

patterns.name: 不同进制的算术题
patterns.trigger: "In base 11"、"In base 6"、"In base 9"、"In base 10"、"In base 8"、"In base 14"、"In base 4"、"In base 16"
patterns.context: 题目指定进制并要求对带符号数字进行加减；激活跨越多种进制题目

patterns.name: 序数式排序查询
patterns.context: 要求在若干数值中找出按大小排序后的指定名次

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术叙述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述煤、硫含量及处理过程

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件与宏代码
patterns.context: 源代码先包含头文件，再定义一个比较并求差的宏

en.description: Scattered patterns: README installation prompts, mathematical paper terminology, calculus and various arithmetic questions, patent descriptions of desulfurization, and C/C++ macro code. Base arithmetic is the most concentrated subclass, but does not explain the remaining activations.

patterns.name: Installation instructions in a README
patterns.context: A NOTE prompt appears in a project README, followed by an instruction to install Entity Framework first.

patterns.name: Geometric terminology in a mathematical paper
patterns.context: An abstract describes properties of a pseudo-Kähler structure; activation concentrates on part of a compound term.

patterns.name: Calculus derivative expression
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a function with respect to variable c, interspersed with formula notation and question marks.

patterns.name: Time and minute calculation problems
patterns.context: A series of questions asks for the number of minutes between times or before a given time.

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems in different bases
patterns.context: Asks for integer addition and subtraction results in given bases; covers positive and negative numbers, different bases, and longer digit strings.

patterns.name: Ordinal and ordering problem
patterns.context: Asks which value ranks fourth when a set of values is sorted.

patterns.name: Coal desulfurization description in a patent
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph describes a desulfurization process involving coal, hydrogen, and microwave energy.

patterns.name: Comparison expression in a C/C++ macro definition
patterns.context: After header includes, a macro is defined to accept two arguments, compare them, and calculate their difference using the conditional operator.

7_1130.description: 模式分散：README安装提示、数学论文术语、微积分与多类算术问答、专利脱硫叙述及C/C++宏代码。进制算术是最集中的子类，但不足以解释其余激活。

patterns.name: README中的安装说明
patterns.trigger: «NOTE»: «You should first install the Entity Framework»
patterns.context: 项目 README 中出现 NOTE 提示，随后给出先安装 Entity Framework 的指令。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的几何术语
patterns.context: 论文摘要中描述伪 Kähler 结构的性质；激活集中在复合术语的一部分。

patterns.name: 微积分求导表达式
patterns.context: 询问函数关于变量 c 的三阶导数，夹杂公式记号与问号。

patterns.name: 时间与分钟计算题
patterns.context: 连续的问答题要求计算时刻之间或某时刻之前的分钟数。

patterns.name: 不同进制的算术题
patterns.context: 询问给定进制下整数的加减结果；覆盖正负数、不同进制及较长数字串。

patterns.name: 序数与排序问题
patterns.context: 要求判断一组值中按大小排序的第四项。

patterns.name: 专利中的煤脱硫描述
patterns.trigger: «mixture» thereof；“decreasing or eliminating the sulfur content of coal”
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述煤、氢及微波能量相关的脱硫过程。

patterns.name: C/C++宏定义中的比较表达式
patterns.context: 头文件包含之后定义一个接收两个参数、进行比较并用条件运算符求差的宏。

en.concept: Relational words and structures in math problems and technical text
en.description: Covers Entity Framework installation prompts, geometric paper terminology, ordinal rankings and derivative orders, arithmetic in different bases, time conversion, coal-sulfur treatment in patents, and divisibility checks. Most snippets are math problems, but trigger words and styles vary.

patterns.name: Entity Framework installation prompt
patterns.context: Project documentation or an installation guide in a GitHub README; activation is distributed around NOTE, You should, and Entity Framework.

patterns.name: Geometric terminology
patterns.context: An abstract describes a geometric structure; salient activation falls on invariant.

patterns.name: Ordinal and ranking phrasing
patterns.context: A math problem uses an ordinal to express a derivative order; salient activation falls on third.

patterns.name: Ordinal ranking question
patterns.context: Asks which value is largest by rank in a sequence or set of candidates; salient activation falls near -31 and on fourth.

patterns.name: Arithmetic problems in different bases
patterns.context: Asked as “In base N, what is …?” and interspersed with negative numbers, addition or subtraction, and digit strings; activation also falls on answer numbers between questions.

patterns.name: Clock time and minute conversion
patterns.context: Uses AM/PM times to ask for a number of minutes or the interval between two times.

patterns.name: Sulfur treatment description in a patent
patterns.context: A patent background describes the sulfur content of coal and its treatment process, involving microwave energy and references to prior patents.

patterns.name: Divisibility and multiple checks
patterns.context: A question asks whether a divisibility or multiple relationship holds, answered with True/False.

7_1130.concept: 数学题及技术文本中的关系词和结构
7_1130.description: 涵盖实体框架安装提示、几何论文术语、序数排名与导数阶数、不同进制算术、时间换算、专利煤硫处理及整除判断；多数片段为数学题，但触发词和文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 实体框架安装提示
patterns.trigger: NOTE: You should first install the Entity Framework
patterns.context: GitHub README 中的项目说明或安装指南；激活分布在 NOTE、You should、Entity Framework 附近。

patterns.name: 几何学术语
patterns.context: 论文摘要中描述几何结构；显著激活落在 invariant。

patterns.name: 序数与排名表述
patterns.context: 数学题以序数表示导数阶数；显著激活落在 third。

patterns.name: 序数排名提问
patterns.context: 询问数列或候选值中的第几大；显著激活落在 -31 附近及 fourth。

patterns.name: 不同进制算术题
patterns.trigger: In base 11 / In base 6 / In base 9
patterns.context: 以“In base N, what is …?”提问，并夹杂负数、加减及数字串；激活也落在题目间的答案数字上。

patterns.name: 钟表时间与分钟换算
patterns.trigger: minutes before 12:… AM；How many minutes are there between
patterns.context: 用 AM/PM 时间询问分钟数或两个时刻之间的间隔。

patterns.name: 专利中的硫处理描述
patterns.trigger: decreasing or eliminating the sulfur content of coal
patterns.context: 专利背景叙述煤的含硫量及处理过程，涉及微波能量和既有专利引用。

patterns.name: 整除与倍数判断
patterns.context: 以问句要求判断整除或倍数关系，并由 True/False 作答。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper names beginning with Mont, split entity subword fragments, numbers in mathematical text, technical abbreviation fragments, and individual words in historical and biomedical contexts; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Mont- at the start or within a word
patterns.context: Names of people, places, or organizations beginning with Mont; activation falls on the Mont substring despite differing subsequent spelling and context.

patterns.name: Split subwords within entity names
patterns.context: Activation appears on fragments of proper names or compound words split by tokenization; the highlighted substring itself does not form a consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Numbers in sequences or numerical problems
patterns.context: In mathematical problems or computational contexts, activation falls on number tokens; no clear shared operation condition is evident in any pair of examples.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to writing systems and number updates
patterns.context: Abbreviation or uppercase-word fragments in technical questions; the contexts concern remote updates and SQL updates, respectively.

patterns.name: The term tax farmer
patterns.context: The term is strongly activated when describing tax contractors under the French Ancien Régime.

patterns.name: The word infection
patterns.context: The word is strongly activated when describing the ability of HIV to establish infection in macaques.

7_1130.description: 激活分散在 Mont 开头的专名、拆分的实体词片段、数学文本中的数字、技术缩写片段，以及历史和生物医学语境中的单个词；没有明确统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词首或词内的 Mont-
patterns.context: 以 Mont 开头的人名、地名或机构名；激活落在 Mont 子串上，后续拼写和上下文不同。

patterns.name: 实体词内部的拆分子词
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词拆开的专名或复合词片段中；高亮子串本身不构成一致语义类别。

patterns.name: 数字序列或数值题目中的数字
patterns.context: 数学题或计算上下文中，激活落在数字 token 上；未见两例共享的明确运算条件。

patterns.name: 书写系统、数字更新相关词片段
patterns.context: 技术问句中的缩写或大写词内部片段；上下文分别涉及远程更新与 SQL 更新。

patterns.name: 税农一词
patterns.context: 描述法国旧制度税务承包者时，该词受到强激活。

patterns.name: 感染一词
patterns.context: 描述 HIV 在猕猴中的感染建立能力时，该词受到强激活。

en.description: Activates mainly on mixed-case proper names, within-word letter fragments, and abbreviations; also occurs sporadically on mathematical ordinals and variables, legal text, code field names, and company names. Apart from a few local spellings, there is no consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Words or strings beginning with Mont
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on Mont and adjacent within-word subword fragments; the fragments form spellings such as Monta… and Montenegr….

patterns.name: Colegio spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the initial fragment of the proper name Colegio, followed by unmarked gio.

patterns.name: Stay In phrase
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the phrase Stay In; subsequent unmarked characters formed combine with it to make Informed. A person’s name appears after a line break.

patterns.name: Letters in a name and judicial formatting
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across letter fragments within a circuit judge’s surname and the Before commonly used in judicial opinions; a court docket number and PER CURIAM also appear.

patterns.name: Variables and ordinals in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation occurs on variables, ordinals, and numerical fragments in a derivative problem; another passage is a math problem asking for the maximum. Trigger positions are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: HP abbreviation
patterns.context: In a question about whether remote system updates trigger RDP printing, activation falls on the product or vendor abbreviation HP.

patterns.name: ACPI status identifier
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the _STA field name in an ACPI device definition; the same passage also contains identifiers such as _HID, _CID, and _UID.

patterns.name: Systems in a proper name
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the final word of the company name Top Phone Systems.

7_1130.description: 主要激活于大小写混合的专名、词内字母片段及缩写；另散见数学序数和变量、司法文本、代码字段名与公司名。除若干局部拼写外，触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: Mont 开头的词或字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Mont 及紧邻的词内子词片段；片段分别构成 Monta…、Montenegr… 等拼写。

patterns.name: Colegio 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活于专名 Colegio 的词首片段，后接未标记的 gio。

patterns.name: Stay In 词组
patterns.context: 激活在短语 Stay In 中，后续未标记字符 formed 与其拼成 Informed；换行后出现人名。

patterns.name: 人名中的字母及司法格式
patterns.context: 激活分布在巡回法官姓氏内部的字母片段及司法意见常见的 Before；同时可见法院案号与 PER CURIAM。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的变量与序数
patterns.context: 激活出现在导数问题的变量、序数与数值片段；另一段是询问最大值的数学题。触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: HP 缩写
patterns.context: 在询问远程系统更新是否触发 RDP 打印的问题中，激活落在产品或厂商缩写 HP 上。

patterns.name: ACPI 状态标识
patterns.context: 激活位于 ACPI 设备定义中的 _STA 字段名；同段另有 _HID、_CID、_UID 等标识符。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Systems
patterns.context: 激活于公司名 Top Phone Systems 的末词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across mathematical and scientific text, vehicle patents, medical terms, code fields, and sports commentary. Local cues vary, including numerical comparisons, new, directions, ions, periodic structures, Name fields, and player evaluations; no unified semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and ordinals
patterns.context: Mathematics questions or computational expressions include ordinals, derivatives, variables, or requests to compare a set of values; nearby symbols include parentheses, commas, and minus signs

patterns.name: “new” in research-finding titles
patterns.context: In research titles or abstracts, new introduces a contribution, insight, or method
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts/titles, involving upconversion and species migration

patterns.name: Spatial directions and reverse trajectories
patterns.context: Describes vehicle position changing with a turn, or discusses curved trajectories in the opposite direction

patterns.name: Gallbladder cancer terminology
patterns.context: The cancer name and its repeated mentions; the word is tokenized into fragments such as “gall”, “bl”, and “adder”

patterns.name: Ion effects and sensitivity
patterns.context: Project descriptions discuss the effects of ions, especially potassium and calcium, on a form of sensitivity; the truncated word “neurom” appears at the end

patterns.name: Periodic structures and translation-invariant function spaces
patterns.context: Discusses perturbations of periodic structures and properties of a linearized operator in function spaces

patterns.name: Name fields and identifiers
patterns.context: In code or data records, a field named Name is followed by different types of identifiers and values

patterns.name: Sports commentary and player positions
patterns.context: Comments on whether a player met expectations, as well as their draft position and performance; then shifts to colloquial expressions of preference

7_1130.description: 激活分散于数学与科学文本、车辆专利、医学词项、代码字段及体育评论；局部触发线索各异，包括数值比较、new、方位、离子、周期结构、Name 字段及球员评价，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与序数
patterns.trigger: “the third derivative of u(c) wrt c?”；“biggest value in 2, -0.1, -20”
patterns.context: 数学问句或运算表达中出现序数、导数、变量，或要求比较一组数值；括号、逗号和负号等符号邻近

patterns.name: “new”研究发现标题措辞
patterns.context: 研究标题或摘要中，以 new 引出贡献、见解或方法
patterns.domain: 学术摘要/标题，涉及上转换、物种迁移

patterns.name: 空间方位与反向轨迹
patterns.context: 描述车辆位置随转向变化，或讨论相反方向的曲线轨迹

patterns.name: 胆囊癌词项
patterns.context: 癌症名称及其重复提及；词被分词为“gall”“bl”“adder”等片段

patterns.name: 离子效应与敏感性
patterns.context: 项目说明中讨论离子，尤其钾和钙，对某种敏感性的影响；末尾出现截断词“neurom”
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目说明

patterns.name: 周期结构与平移不变函数空间
patterns.context: 讨论周期结构扰动及线性化算子在函数空间中的性质

patterns.name: Name 字段与标识符
patterns.context: 代码或数据记录中，字段名 Name 后接不同类型的标识符和值

patterns.name: 体育评论与球员位置
patterns.context: 评论球员是否达到预期，以及其选秀位置和表现；随后转为口语化偏好表达

en.concept: Common English word forms and collocations
en.description: Activations concentrate on Always + verb, privat- forms related to privatization, and collocations of major with nouns from different fields; isolated fragments such as Golden State, Calvert, and when given also trigger activation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases with Always
patterns.context: Capitalized Always at the start of a sentence, followed by a verb, indicates consistently performing an action; appears in an option and a recommendation

patterns.name: Privatization root
patterns.context: The stem privat- appears in privatization/privatisation and inflected forms, discussing privatization of industries or enterprises.
patterns.domain: Politics and public policy news, public services research

patterns.name: Collocations with major and superlative descriptions
patterns.context: major functions as an adjective or nominal modifier, referring to major components, complexes, sports leagues, or major investors; specific collocations vary.

patterns.name: Special or residual triggers
patterns.context: Seen only in individual contexts: the proper name Golden State, the tokenized fragment of Calvert, and the dosing expression when given in a clinical trial; no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedia, news, clinical trial abstracts

7_1130.description: 激活集中于 Always + 动词、privat- 私有化词形，以及 major 与不同领域名词的搭配；另对 Golden State、Calvert 和 when given 等孤立片段有响应。

patterns.name: Always 固定短语
patterns.context: 句首大写的 Always，后接动词，表示始终执行某操作；分别出现在选择项和建议语句中。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、软件使用建议

patterns.name: 私有化词根
patterns.context: privat- 词干出现在 privatization/privatisation 及其屈折形式中，讨论行业或企业私有化。
patterns.domain: 政治与公共政策新闻、公共服务研究

patterns.name: major 搭配及最高级描述
patterns.context: major 作形容词或名词性修饰语，涉及主要组成、复合体、体育联盟，或主要投资者；具体搭配各异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、体育百科、商业文本

patterns.name: 特殊或残余触发
patterns.context: 仅见于个别上下文，分别是专名 Golden State、Calvert 的分词片段，以及临床试验中 when given 的给药表达；缺少共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、新闻、临床试验摘要

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across the locative sense of opposite, legal and code terms, proper names, and token fragments; most high activations do not share an obvious semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Locative sense of opposite
patterns.context: When describing the relative position of places or objects, means “across from”; occurs in “opposite the two air intakes” and “opposite the Houses of Parliament”.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within proprietary
patterns.context: In a legal text, proprietary is split into subword tokens; strong activation falls on the final fragment etary, preceded by pri.

patterns.name: Legal use of govern
patterns.context: A legal discussion explains that a constitutional standard applies when medical care is refused.

patterns.name: Exceptionless name
patterns.context: Appears as the beginning of the software client proper name Exceptionless, followed by less.

patterns.name: Callback identifier fragment
patterns.context: In code, occurs in the Future method call f1.addCallback; activation falls on the add fragment of the identifier.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of leader’s
patterns.context: In a course description, the possessive apostrophe in team leader’s role is unusually encoded as a control-character token, which receives strong activation.

patterns.name: TypeScript name
patterns.context: In a headline about automatically converting a React codebase to TypeScript, activation falls on the Script fragment of the language name.

patterns.name: Isolated strong word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the sentence They customarily functions; tokenization splits customarily, and strong activation falls on custom.
patterns.domain: Web text, semantically or syntactically incoherent

patterns.name: Other relatively strong terms
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no shared stable local structure or semantic trigger condition evident.
patterns.domain: Mixed code, technical, and course texts

patterns.name: Weakly related word senses or form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within split ordinary words or word-form fragments; there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger pattern.

7_1130.description: 强激活分散在 opposite 的位置义、法律与代码词项、专名及分词碎片上；多数高激活没有共享的明显语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: opposite 的词义激活
patterns.context: 在描述地点或物体之间相对位置时，表示“在……对面”；出现于“opposite the two air intakes”和“opposite the Houses of Parliament”。
patterns.domain: 汽车维修说明、百科条目

patterns.name: proprietary 内部子词片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中，单词 proprietary 被拆成子词 token；强激活落在词尾片段 etary，前面紧邻 pri。

patterns.name: govern 的法律语境用法
patterns.context: 法律论述中，说明某项宪法标准适用于医疗照护被拒的情形。

patterns.name: Exceptionless 名称
patterns.context: 作为软件客户端专名 Exceptionless 的词首部分出现，后接 less。

patterns.name: Callback 标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中位于 Future 的方法调用 f1.addCallback；激活落在标识符的 add 片段。

patterns.name: leader’s 的分词片段
patterns.context: 课程描述中 team leader’s role 的所有格符号被异常编码为控制字符 token，强激活落在该符号上。

patterns.name: TypeScript 名称
patterns.context: 在将 React 代码库自动转换为 TypeScript 的标题中，激活落在语言名称的 Script 片段。

patterns.name: 独立的强词片段
patterns.context: 出现在句中 They customarily functions；分词将 customarily 拆开，强激活落在 custom。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，语义或句法不连贯

patterns.name: 其他较强词项
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同语境中，未见共同的稳定局部结构或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术、课程等混合文本

patterns.name: 弱相关的词义或词形碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的普通词内部或词形片段；没有足够证据支持共同触发模式。

en.description: The clearest cue is scope terms such as all and most, often co-occurring with content retrieval, provision, access, or listing; other content concerns time, evaluation, technical connections, and segment-specific topics, so the overall theme is scattered.

patterns.name: All, entire, or complete scope
patterns.context: Trigger words indicate totality, complete coverage, or an upper bound of scope; they sometimes directly modify an object and sometimes occur in phrases such as “all the …”.
patterns.domain: Web text, Q&A, technical documentation, patents, popular science, and sports ticketing

patterns.name: Retrieval, configuration, or provision of functionality
patterns.context: Software or service contexts describe obtaining, providing, accessing, or configuring a function; includes expressions about obtaining all items or an interface.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, Q&A, and product promotion

patterns.name: Collecting or presenting information and items
patterns.context: Lists or aggregates multiple items, data, resources, or information; some examples emphasize all available content.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, education, academic publishing, and product promotion

patterns.name: Routing or connection between technical objects
patterns.context: Describes routing, connection, or access relationships between signals, services, or computers.
patterns.domain: Patents, internet services, and computer technology texts

patterns.name: Time, date, or file timestamp
patterns.context: Mentions a date, time, or time-related attribute.

patterns.name: Evaluation and review
patterns.context: Reviews, evaluates, or checks assignments, learning performance, articles, or code.
patterns.domain: Education, academic, and software security texts

patterns.name: Specific terms, proper names, or heading formats
patterns.context: Technical documentation includes headings, section labels, regulatory names, or specialized terms; these forms themselves do not clearly share trigger points with other segments.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, code security, and regulatory technical texts

patterns.name: School learning and student progress
patterns.context: Describes teachers collecting evidence and assessing students’ learning and understanding.

patterns.name: Sports event ticketing and prices
patterns.context: Requests prices and explains prices for Angels opening-day game tickets.

patterns.name: Music service promotion
patterns.context: Promotes accessible online music and subscription services.

patterns.name: Vulnerability disclosure and code security
patterns.context: Notes that software developers failed to check all the code, then discusses a vulnerability.

patterns.name: File-system interface documentation
patterns.context: Describes an interface for reading or setting a file’s last-modified time.

7_1130.description: 最明显的线索是 all、most 等全量或范围词，常与获取、提供、访问或列举内容同现；另有时间、评估、技术连接及各段专属主题，整体主题分散。

patterns.name: 全部、所有或完整范围
patterns.context: 触发词表示全量、完整覆盖或范围上限；有时直接修饰对象，有时出现在“all the …”一类短语中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、问答、技术文档、专利、科普及体育票务

patterns.name: 获取、配置或提供功能
patterns.context: 软件或服务语境中描述取得、提供、访问或配置某项功能；包含关于获取所有项目或接口的表达。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、问答及产品宣传

patterns.name: 汇集、呈现信息或项目
patterns.context: 列举或汇集多项内容、数据、资源或信息；有些例子强调全部可用内容。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、教育、学术出版及产品宣传

patterns.name: 技术对象间的路由或连接
patterns.context: 描述信号、服务或计算机之间的路由、连接或访问关系。
patterns.domain: 专利、互联网服务及计算机技术文本

patterns.name: 时间、日期或文件时间
patterns.context: 提及某项日期、时间或与时间相关的属性。

patterns.name: 评估与审查
patterns.context: 对作业、学习表现、文章或代码进行审阅、评估或检查。
patterns.domain: 教育、学术及软件安全文本

patterns.name: 具体术语、专名或标题格式
patterns.context: 技术文档中出现标题、章节标签、法规名或专门术语；这些形式本身与其他片段的触发点不明显一致。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、代码安全及法规相关技术文本

patterns.name: 学校学习与学生进展
patterns.context: 描述教师收集证据、评估学生学习与理解情况。

patterns.name: 体育赛事票务与价格
patterns.context: 围绕天使队开幕日比赛门票的询价与价格说明。

patterns.name: 音乐服务宣传
patterns.context: 宣传可访问的网络音乐及订阅服务。

patterns.name: 漏洞披露与代码安全
patterns.trigger: “Vulnerability:”“developers forgot to review all the code”
patterns.context: 指出软件开发者未检查全部代码，转入漏洞说明。

patterns.name: 文件系统接口说明
patterns.trigger: “filesystem library”“getting and setting the last write time”
patterns.context: 说明用于读取或设置文件最后写入时间的接口。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numerical expressions, especially percentages followed by of-phrases, as well as quantities, units, and scale; local triggers also include code shuffle, cricket terminology, age limits, and domain-specific terms.

patterns.name: Percentages followed by quantity nouns
patterns.context: A percentage or ratio is followed by an of-phrase describing a share, quantity, or group within a whole.
patterns.domain: News, policy, research, and statistical descriptions

patterns.name: Large numbers and orders of magnitude
patterns.context: Numbers are split across multiple tokens, or scale is described using thousands, millions, and similar magnitudes; often adjacent to nouns or computational contexts.
patterns.domain: General explanatory prose, technical texts, statistical reports

patterns.name: Numbers, units of measurement, and prices
patterns.context: A numerical value combined with currency, weight, age, or other units to indicate cost, output, or a limit.
patterns.domain: Business reporting, mining news, social reporting

patterns.name: Shuffle instruction in program code
patterns.context: Appears in VM IR/code comments and test code, involving the shuffle instruction and vector masks.

patterns.name: Cricket term duck and its definition
patterns.context: Explains being dismissed without scoring in cricket and the usage of “breaking one's duck”, and mentions extended uses of the word outside cricket.

patterns.name: Majority in a proportion description
patterns.context: States that two mobile platforms account for most phones; the passage also includes a percentage of smartphone sales.

patterns.name: Under in an age-limit context
patterns.context: Describes teenagers below the legal drinking age and gives an age limit of 21.

patterns.name: Planned sample and follow-up completion
patterns.context: Reports the sample size, follow-up schedule, and completion rate for a study of BRCA mutation carriers.

patterns.name: Subscription prices and billing periods
patterns.context: Compares an annual fee converted to a monthly rate with a monthly subscription price, mentioning a music service.

patterns.name: Mineral output and monthly comparisons
patterns.context: Reports Peruvian mine gold production by month and relates cumulative output to a proportion.

patterns.name: Infrastructure proportion and water-quality risks
patterns.context: Gives the proportion of water-system pipes in the context of contaminants entering tap water due to aging infrastructure.

patterns.name: Energy supply security and import dependence
patterns.context: Discusses EU energy targets and uses the share of resources from abroad to indicate import dependence.

patterns.name: Specific date or precise time marker
patterns.context: A date at the beginning of a passage, followed by an estimate of readership; co-occurs with other numerical expressions in the passage.

patterns.name: BRCA genetic variant marker
patterns.context: A genetic variant identifier for mutation-positive families, appearing in a description of study samples.

7_1130.description: 主要对数字量化表达敏感，尤其是百分比后接 of 短语，以及数量、单位和规模；另有代码 shuffle、板球术语、年龄界限及若干领域专属名词等局部触发。

patterns.name: 百分比及其后续数量名词
patterns.trigger: «%» 后紧接 «of»，常再出现限定词和名词，如 «%»« of»« the»、«%»« of»« subjects»
patterns.context: 百分比或比例表达后接 of 短语，说明总体中的份额、数量或群体。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政策、科研和统计说明

patterns.name: 大数与数量级表达
patterns.trigger: «000»、«million»、«billion» 或带逗号的数值，如 «10»«000»、«100»« million»、«200»
patterns.context: 数字被拆分为多个 token，或用千、百万等数量级描述规模；常与名词或计算语境相邻。
patterns.domain: 一般说明文、技术文本、统计报道

patterns.name: 数字、计量单位及价格
patterns.context: 以数值加货币、重量、年龄等单位表示费用、产量或界限。
patterns.domain: 商业报道、矿业新闻、社会报道

patterns.name: 程序代码中的 shuffle 指令
patterns.context: 出现在 VM IR/代码注释与测试代码中，涉及 shuffle 指令及向量掩码。
patterns.domain: 程序代码与编译器测试

patterns.name: 板球术语 duck 及其释义
patterns.context: 解释板球中未得分出局和“breaking one's duck”的用法，并提及该词在板球以外的引申使用。

patterns.name: 比例描述中的 majority
patterns.context: 说明两类移动平台占手机的大多数；段中也出现智能手机销量百分比。

patterns.name: under 搭配年龄界限
patterns.context: 描述青少年低于法定饮酒年龄，并给出 21 岁界限。

patterns.name: 计划样本与随访完成情况
patterns.context: 报告 BRCA 突变携带者研究的样本数、随访安排及完成比例。

patterns.name: 订阅价格与计费周期
patterns.context: 比较年度费用折算月费与月度订阅价格，提及音乐服务。

patterns.name: 矿产产量与月份比较
patterns.context: 按月份报告秘鲁矿山黄金产量，并将累计产量与比例联系起来。

patterns.name: 基础设施比例及水质风险
patterns.context: 在老化基础设施导致污染物进入自来水的背景下，给出供水系统管道比例。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与基础设施说明

patterns.name: 能量供应安全与进口依赖
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟能源目标，并以资源来自外部的比例说明进口依赖。

patterns.name: 特定日期或精确时间标记
patterns.context: 段首日期，后接关于读者规模的推算；与本段其他数字表达并存。

patterns.name: BRCA 基因变异标记
patterns.context: 作为突变阳性家系的遗传变异标识，出现在研究样本描述中。

en.description: Every passage includes proportions or numerical quantification; the most salient shared cue is of near percentages and their denominators. Numbers, units, and denominator structures also occur in contexts involving surveys, health, law, business, and personal finance.

patterns.name: Percentage followed by of / of the
patterns.context: A percentage value is followed by of, then a denominator such as a whole, group, or period; the values vary widely and are not limited to a particular proportion
patterns.domain: Statistics, reporting, legal, and everyday financial texts

patterns.name: Numbers in percentage expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in expressions of proportions or shares, often with of; however, numbers and percent signs are not marked identically in every passage
patterns.domain: Statistics, health, law, business, and personal finance

patterns.name: Quantity descriptions of fractions or proportions
patterns.context: States the proportion of a group or whole, or the share of a quantity relative to a total
patterns.domain: Survey results, demographics, health, and legal texts

patterns.name: Amounts or proportions associated with contracts and financial objects
patterns.context: Percentages describe contract shares, income-to-savings ratios, or bill-tip proportions
patterns.domain: Online discussions, travel guides, personal finance

patterns.name: Proportion plus statistical results
patterns.context: Uses percentages to report the composition, coverage, or outcomes of survey or program groups
patterns.domain: Organizational surveys, adoption programs, medical web-promotion research

patterns.name: Non-percentage uses of numbers and units
patterns.context: Numbers and units appear, but respectively refer to work effort, angles, or weight restrictions rather than percentages; if related to this neuron, the response may be to number/unit forms
patterns.domain: Business news, descriptions of legal restrictions

patterns.name: General numerical and denominator structures
patterns.context: Numbers, units, or percentages are followed by of-phrases, with denominators such as populations or working hours; some annotations fall on tokens adjacent to numbers

7_1130.description: 各段都含比例或数字量化表达，最显著的共同线索是百分数附近的 of 及其分母；也见数字、单位与分母结构，涉及调查、健康、法律、商业和个人财务。

patterns.name: 百分比后接 of / of the
