patterns.trigger: «%»…«of»；尤其是“«50»% of the”、“«96» percent of”等
patterns.context: 百分比数值后出现 of，后接总体、群体或某个时期中的分母；数值跨度很大，不局限于特定比例
patterns.domain: 统计、报道、法律与日常财务文本

patterns.name: 百分比表达中的数字
patterns.context: 数字处于比例或占比表达中，常与 of 连用；但数字和百分号并非每段都以相同方式标记
patterns.domain: 统计、健康、法律、商业及个人理财

patterns.name: 分数或比例的数量描述
patterns.trigger: «of»后的总体或部分量词，如“«of» the surveyed organizations”、“«of» the children”、“«of» the Internauts”
patterns.context: 陈述某群体或总体所占比例，或某数量相对于总量的占比
patterns.domain: 调查结果、人口统计、健康与法律文本

patterns.name: 金额或比例与合同、财务对象
patterns.trigger: “«62»3.5«%» of the «contract»”、“«50»% of your «income»”及“«10»% of your … bill”
patterns.context: 百分比描述合同份额、收入储蓄比例或账单小费比例
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、旅行指南、个人理财

patterns.name: 比例加统计结果叙述
patterns.trigger: “«of» the «surveyed» organizations”、“«of» the «children» who participated”、“«of» the «Internauts» were women”
patterns.context: 以百分比报告调查或项目群体的组成、覆盖率或结果
patterns.domain: 组织调查、收养项目、医学网络宣传研究

patterns.name: 数字与单位的非百分比用法
patterns.trigger: “«100» percent of his or her efforts”、“«10» degree”、“«20» pound”
patterns.context: 出现数词和单位，但语义分别是工作投入、角度或重量限制，并非百分比；若与本神经元相关，可能是对数字/单位形式的响应
patterns.domain: 商业新闻、法律限制描述

patterns.name: 一般数值与分母结构
patterns.trigger: “«101»9”、“«81» percent of the Internauts”、“«3»% of children”、“«50»% of the workday”
patterns.context: 数字、单位或百分比之后接 of 结构，具体分母可为人群、工作时间等；部分标注落在数字邻近 token 上
patterns.domain: 医学、法律及调查统计文本

en.description: Responds mainly to an overall or part phrase introduced by of after a number or proportion, covering percentages, monetary magnitudes, and similar expressions; also occurs in corporate initiative language and once in the colloquial question “all about.”

patterns.name: “of” phrases after quantities or proportions
patterns.context: A quantity, percentage, or share is followed by an of phrase that specifies a part or proportion of a whole, or a magnitude; activation often occurs near function words such as of and the, and near numbers or percentage markers.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, personal finance, papers, legal and business reports, and news across domains.

patterns.name: Planning language for corporate initiatives
patterns.context: Describes the goals, initiatives, and expected effects of corporate projects, using formal proposal or internal business language.

patterns.name: “all about” in a question
patterns.context: A colloquial question uses “what … all about” to ask what something is about; this example also contains an of phrase after a percentage.

7_1130.concept: 数量比例及其所指整体
7_1130.description: 主要响应数字或比例后用 of 引出的整体/部分短语，涵盖百分比、金额量级等；另有企业倡议措辞，以及一次口语问句中的“all about”。

patterns.name: 数量或比例后的“of”短语
patterns.trigger: “90%+ of the benefits”“50% of your income”“99.99% of the span”“66% of the fabrication”“a large % of the largest Azure deployments”“37.5 per cent of the work”“75% of revenue”“15 per cent of the UK’s energy generation”“20-30% of the number of trades”；另有“thousands of dev teams”
patterns.context: 数量、百分比或份额后接 of 短语，说明整体中的部分、比例或量级；常在 of、the 等功能词及数字、百分比标记附近激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的技术讨论、个人理财、论文、法律与商业报告、新闻。

patterns.name: 企业倡议的规划措辞
patterns.trigger: “building … brand recognition”“leveraging research exchanges”“initiative should also further … efforts”
patterns.context: 描述企业项目的目标、举措及预期作用，使用正式的提案或内部商务措辞。

patterns.name: 问句中的“all about”
patterns.trigger: “What am I missing? What is the brouhaha all about?” 中的“all”
patterns.context: 口语化问句以“what … all about”询问某事缘由；该例也同时出现百分比后的 of 短语。

en.description: Activations concentrate mainly on further/further…more, indicating further advancement, expansion, or increase; these occur in contexts involving increases in amounts and scale, organizational initiatives, and advancing actions. A few passages concern the scale of technical deployments and cost-sharing in legal projects.

patterns.name: Further indicating advancement, increase, or continuation
patterns.context: At the beginning or within a sentence, introduces a further action, quantity, scope, cost, or delay, often paired with a following noun or verb; strong activation falls on further or nearby words.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, commercial copy, legal, and general online texts

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or scale
patterns.context: Involves quantified statements about amounts, proportions, quantities, or costs; includes comparative more or expressions of scale such as proportions, amounts, and bulk.
patterns.domain: News reports, insurance, software deployment, legal/infrastructure texts

patterns.name: Advancing plans, projects, and organizational action
patterns.context: Describes the launch, support, lobbying, or implementation of projects, initiatives, organizations, or collective action, including related funding situations.
patterns.domain: Community advocacy, political history, business email, event reports

patterns.name: Scaling technical deployments and teams
patterns.context: Software release and cloud deployment contexts emphasize helping teams expand capacity or deployment scale.

patterns.name: Cost-sharing in legal planning
patterns.context: Describes infrastructure plans and the proportions of costs borne by different parties.

7_1130.description: 激活主要集中在 further/further…more，表示进一步推进、扩展或增加；同时见于金额与规模增加、组织倡议和行动推进。少数段落涉及技术部署规模及法律项目费用分担。

patterns.name: further 表示推进、增加或后续
patterns.trigger: “Further”/“further”，后接 “enable”、“lobbying delegations”、“north”、“in annual premiums”、“Enron’s efforts”、“court filings”、“delay”；另有“further … more”
patterns.context: 在句首或句中引出进一步的行动、数量、范围、成本或延误，常与后续名词或动词搭配；强激活落在 further 或其后邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、商业宣传、法律及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 数量或规模的增加
patterns.trigger: “$15,000 more”，“$1,400 more”，“$18.5 million in damage”，“a large % of the largest Azure deployments”，“the bulk of this sewer”
patterns.context: 涉及金额、比例、数量或成本的量化陈述；出现比较性 more，或由比例、金额、bulk 等表达规模。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、保险、软件部署、法律/基础设施文本

patterns.name: 计划、项目及组织行动的推进
patterns.trigger: “launching a … pilot to help further enable”，“delegation … to request”，“This initiative should also further … efforts”，“organizers … fund the anniversary celebration”
patterns.context: 描述项目、倡议、组织或集体行动的启动、支持、游说或落实，也包括相关资金状况。
patterns.domain: 社区宣传、政治史、企业邮件、活动报道

patterns.name: 技术部署和团队规模化
patterns.trigger: “single-handedly helped thousands of dev teams to go beyond …”，“a large % of the largest Azure deployments”
patterns.context: 软件发布和云端部署语境，强调帮助团队扩大能力或部署规模。

patterns.name: 法律规划中的资金分担
patterns.trigger: “pay for the bulk of this sewer”，“Grayslake paying only”
patterns.context: 描述基础设施方案及不同主体承担费用的比例。
patterns.domain: 法律文件、地方基础设施规划

en.description: Responds mainly to contexts where further/more means continuation, addition, or a greater degree, and often occurs with quantities, proportions, amounts, and comparisons; activation is distributed across different terms, and some passages are only weakly related.

patterns.name: Further followed by a degree, quantity, or additional action
patterns.context: In phrases expressing further increase, continued progress, or a need for additional input; further/more often modifies research, support, work, effort, strategy, or resources.
patterns.domain: Across domains; social research, community projects, business, insurance, child placement, technology, and military text

patterns.name: Magnitude expressions in percentages or amounts
patterns.context: Near numerical values, proportions, or amounts, especially when describing a large share, additional costs, proportional distributions, or a need for more input.
patterns.domain: Technical and business narratives, news reports, insurance, project descriptions, and technical forums

patterns.name: Continuation or additions in formal text
patterns.context: Further means continuing existing activities or plans; no numerical context is required, and it usually precedes abstract goals or organizational actions.
patterns.domain: Community and corporate communications, project plans, emails, and forum text

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of distribution, collaboration, and outcomes
patterns.context: Compares or quantifies groups, coverage, outcomes, or degree of collaboration; activation is distributed across numbers, of, more, and other terms.
patterns.domain: Software deployment, child programs, technical discussions, military news

patterns.name: Local term activation, difficult to classify under the main pattern
patterns.context: Each passage has salient local terms, but activation falls on different parts of speech and syntactic positions; [10] in particular lacks clear trigger words related to quantity or further progress.

7_1130.concept: 进一步或更多的量化表达
7_1130.description: 主要响应 further/more 表示继续、额外或更大程度的语境，也常见于数量、比例、金额及比较表达；激活分布于不同词项，个别段落关联较弱。

patterns.name: further 后接程度、数量或行动补充
patterns.context: 在表达进一步增加、继续推进或需要额外投入的短语中；常由 further/more 修饰研究、支持、工作、努力、策略或资源。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；社交研究、社区项目、商业、保险、儿童安置、技术与军事文本

patterns.name: 百分比或金额中的数量级表达
patterns.context: 数值、比例或金额附近，尤其是说明较大份额、额外成本、比例分布或需要更多投入时。
patterns.domain: 技术商业叙述、新闻报道、保险、项目说明、技术论坛

patterns.name: 正式文本中的延续或追加事项
patterns.context: further 表示在现有活动或计划基础上继续推进；不要求数值语境，通常接抽象目标或组织行动。
patterns.domain: 社群与企业沟通、项目计划、邮件及论坛文字

patterns.name: 分布、协作与结果的量化描述
patterns.trigger: «a large % of the largest»（[3]）；«85 to 90 percent of children»、«remaining 10 to 15 percent»（[6]）；«90%+ of the benefits»（[7]）；«coordinating more closely»（[9]）
patterns.context: 围绕群体、覆盖范围、结果或协作程度作比较或量化说明；激活分布在数字、of、more 等词上。
patterns.domain: 软件部署、儿童项目、技术讨论、军事新闻

patterns.name: 局部词项激活，难以归入主模式
patterns.trigger: «part of further»（[1]）；«Community Leaders’ pilot to help»（[2]）；«responsible for a large %»（[3]）；«more to see the swim through»（[4]）；«more in annual premiums»（[5]）；«more work»（[6]）；«benefits of virtualization»（[7]）；«further Enron’s efforts»（[8]）；«coordinating more closely»（[9]）；«join me and Becky»（[10]）
patterns.context: 各段均有局部显著词，但强度落在不同词类与句法位置；[10] 尤其缺乏与数量或进一步推进明确相关的触发词。

en.description: Primarily activates on the adverb further, often in verb phrases indicating advancement, continuation, or further handling; also includes more indicating an increase in quantity and a subword fragment of featured in a hiring list.

patterns.name: Subsequent actions with further
patterns.context: Used adverbially before a verb to indicate continuing, advancing, or adding subsequent action; followed by different elements including enable, sociological research, develop, remove, Enron’s efforts, consideration, raids, and activities
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; community initiatives, research, history, business, and general narration

patterns.name: more indicating an increase
patterns.context: Indicates an additional increase in a comparative or quantitative context; in segment 3, more occurs in the amount difference “$1,400 more in annual premiums”
patterns.domain: News reporting on personal insurance costs

patterns.name: Tokenized form of featured
patterns.context: In a web hiring list, featured is split into two consecutive subword fragments and activated; job openings and candidates are listed afterward

7_1130.description: 主要对副词 further 激活，常见于表示推进、延续或进一步处理的动词短语；另有 more 表示数量增加，以及招聘列表中 featured 的子词片段激活。

patterns.name: further 后续动作
patterns.context: 在动词前作副词，表示继续、推进或增加后续行动；后接 enable、sociological research、develop、remove、Enron’s efforts、consideration、raids、activities 等不同成分
patterns.domain: 跨领域；社区倡议、研究、历史、商业及一般叙述

patterns.name: more 表示增加
patterns.context: 比较或数量语境中表示额外增加；第3段的 more 位于金额差异“$1,400 more in annual premiums”中
patterns.domain: 个人保险费用的新闻报道

patterns.name: featured 切分形态
patterns.context: 网页招聘列表中，词 featured 被分成两个连续子词片段激活，后面列出职位与候选人

en.description: Responds mainly to expressions such as further/more that indicate continuation, increase, or degree comparison; also occurs in part/one/element of structures. A few activations involve quantities and lists, while sporadic words and formatting markers do not support a reliable generalization.

patterns.name: Degree or increment of further/more
patterns.context: Modifies a verb, noun, or adjective to indicate further progress, increase, deepening, or degree comparison; sometimes forms a comparison with than
patterns.domain: News, community outreach, social discussion, academic papers, emails, and technical documents

patterns.name: Part or membership relation
patterns.context: An of phrase indicates that something is part of, a member of, or a component of a whole
patterns.domain: Social discussion, mathematical papers, medical papers, and business emails

patterns.name: Quantity, scope, and list expressions
patterns.context: Involves quantities, scope, or annual cost comparisons; some markers may be only local lexical responses and do not show a stable shared condition
patterns.domain: Community text, academic papers, insurance reports, business emails, and news

7_1130.concept: 进一步或更多及部分关系
7_1130.description: 主要响应 further/more 等表示进一步、更多或程度比较的表达；也出现在 part/one/element of 等部分关系结构中。少数激活涉及数量和列举，另有零散词语及排版标记无法可靠归纳。

patterns.name: 进一步/更多的程度或增量
patterns.trigger: “further enable”“further sociological research”“further consideration”“more”“deeper cooperation”“more closely”“the more complex configurations”
patterns.context: 修饰动词、名词或形容词，表示进一步推进、增加、加深或程度比较；有时与 than 构成比较
patterns.domain: 新闻、社群宣传、社交讨论、学术论文、邮件及技术文档

patterns.name: 部分或成员关系
patterns.context: 用 of 短语表示某物是整体的一部分、成员或组成元素
patterns.domain: 社交讨论、数学论文、医学论文、商务邮件

patterns.name: 数量、范围及列举表达
patterns.trigger: “several”“the two”“all”“one”“$3,500 per year”“$1,400 more in annual premiums”
patterns.context: 涉及数量、范围或年度费用比较；其中部分标记可能只是局部词汇响应，未显示稳定共同条件
patterns.domain: 社群文本、学术论文、保险报道、商务邮件、新闻

en.description: Activations occur in structures such as further, more, and of the, as well as in contexts involving quantity, progress, classification, coordination, and assistance. Trigger words and syntactic positions are inconsistent, so they cannot be reduced to a single stable feature.

patterns.name: Further / degree following than
patterns.context: Occurs before or after verbs or nouns to indicate continued progress, greater depth, or degree comparison; position varies.
patterns.domain: Web text, research, technical Q&A, political reporting

patterns.name: Of the structure
patterns.context: Common in “quantity/part + of the + noun” structures; activations concentrate near of and the.

patterns.name: More degree comparison
patterns.context: More indicates degree, quantity, or additional items in a list, with varying collocations.

patterns.name: Quantity and scale descriptions
patterns.context: Numerical values, units of measure, scale, or proportions; activations occur near quantity expressions.

patterns.name: Coordination or parallel comparison across entities
patterns.context: Describes cooperation between parties or parallel processing and comparison of multiple entities.

patterns.name: List or classification items
patterns.context: Contexts involving the enumeration and classification of items, positions, or questions.

patterns.name: Phased progress or time intervals
patterns.context: Describes project progress or the time and stages following an event.

patterns.name: Community support and assistance
patterns.context: Describes measures to support a community or reliance on aid; differs from the other trigger patterns.

7_1130.description: 激活分布于 further、more、of the 等结构及数量、进展、分类、协调和援助语境；触发词与句法位置不统一，无法归结为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: further / than 后续程度
patterns.context: 出现在动词或名词前后，表示继续推进、深入或程度比较；位置不固定
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科研、技术问答、政治报道

patterns.name: of the 结构
patterns.trigger: “third of the issues” [6]、“rest of the team” [9]、“half of their food” [10]
patterns.context: 常见于“数量/部分 + of the + 名词”结构；激活集中在 of、the 附近
patterns.domain: 法律、技术问答、新闻报道

patterns.name: more 程度比较
patterns.context: more 表示程度、数量或列表中新增内容，搭配方式不一
patterns.domain: 新闻、矿业报道、招聘广告

patterns.name: 数量与规模表述
patterns.trigger: “23,000 metric tons” [7]、“$3 million” [8]、“63 million worth”及“280,000 cattle” [10]
patterns.context: 数值、计量单位、规模或比例信息；激活落在数量表达附近

patterns.name: 跨对象协调或并行比较
patterns.context: 描述双方协作，或多个对象并行处理与比较

patterns.name: 列表或分类项目
patterns.trigger: “featured jobs” [5]、“the third of the issues listed” [6]
patterns.context: 条目、职位或问题的列举与分类语境

patterns.name: 分阶段进展或时间间隔
patterns.trigger: “scheduled for June”及“commissioning was underway” [7]、“Three months after the storm” [10]
patterns.context: 描述项目进度或事件发生后的时间与阶段

patterns.name: 社区支持与援助
patterns.trigger: “Community Leaders’ pilot to help further enable” [1]、“relied upon aid” [10]
patterns.context: 描述支持社区的举措或依赖救济；与其他触发模式不同
patterns.domain: 社区项目、灾害救援报道

en.description: Responds mainly to part-whole or set relations introduced by of, especially the rest of, ordinal/fraction + of the, and quantity + of the; also responds more weakly to more closely and some of the.

patterns.name: Groups following rest of the
patterns.context: In the structure the rest of + a group or set noun; activation often falls on rest or the following of, with the meaning involving the remainder of a group or a share of resources.

patterns.name: of the in ordinals or fractions
patterns.context: Of introduces a set or whole, preceded by an ordinal, quantity, or partitive; strong activation often occurs on of, and the nearby the may also activate.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, legal text, disaster reporting

patterns.name: of the in numerical proportions
patterns.context: A number or proportion is followed by of the, which specifies the relevant set; similar to the part-whole structure in Pattern 2, but with an explicitly counted group.

patterns.name: Degree expression indicating more or greater closeness
patterns.context: More precedes a comparative adverb to indicate an increase in the degree of an action; activation here concentrates on more.

patterns.name: Fixed degree phrase some of the
patterns.context: Some of the is followed by a plural noun and indicates a subset of recommendations; its trigger span resembles the preceding part-whole expressions, but the context is suggestions in an email.

7_1130.description: 主要响应 of 引出的部分—整体或集合关系，尤其是 the rest of、序数/分数 + of the 和数量 + of the；另对 more closely 及 some of the 有较弱响应。

patterns.name: rest of the…群体
patterns.trigger: “the rest of the team”“the rest of his soldiers”“the rest of their food”“the rest of the Rome Group”
patterns.context: 在 the rest of + 群体/集合名词结构中；激活位置多落在 rest 或紧随其后的 of，语义涉及群体其余部分、资源份额。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、历史、灾害报道

patterns.name: 序数或分数中的 of the
patterns.trigger: “the first of many”“the second of two”“half of their food”“first of the Sharpe television dramas”
patterns.context: of 引出集合或整体，前面有序数、数量或部分量词；强激活常出现在 of，邻近 the 也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、法律文本、灾害报道

patterns.name: 数值比例中的 of the
patterns.context: 数字或比例表达后接 of the，再指明所属集合；与第 2 模式的部分—整体结构相近，但对象是明确计数的群体。

patterns.name: 较多/更紧密的程度表达
patterns.context: more 后接副词比较级，表达行动程度增加；此处激活集中在 more。

patterns.name: 固定程度短语 some of the
patterns.context: some of the 后接复数名词，表示从一组建议中取部分；触发范围与前述部分—整体表达相似，但语境是邮件中的建议。

en.concept: Parts and members of a set
en.description: In most passages, “of” connects a quantity or part to a whole, commonly in “one/rest/some of…” and quantity structures; another passage is triggered by the exclusion expression “from further consideration.”

patterns.name: “of” connecting quantities, parts, and wholes
patterns.context: Connects a set with its components in expressions of quantity, ordinals, membership, or parts such as “rest/some”; often near “the” and group nouns.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedic text, legal documents, emails, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Subsequent consideration of excluded entities
patterns.context: Describes excluding certain entities from later evaluation or selection.

7_1130.description: 多数段落中，“of”连接数量或部分与整体，常见于“one/rest/some of…”及数量结构；另有一段触发于“from further consideration”的排除表达。

patterns.name: “of”连接数量、部分与整体
patterns.trigger: «of»，见“first of three”“rest of the team”“rest of the Rome Group”“21 of the 26 partners”“one of 10 defendants”“one of 9 Jalore contingents”“rest of the markup”“some of the companies”
patterns.context: 在数量、序数、成员或“rest/some”等部分表达中，连接集合与其组成部分；常靠近“the”及群体名词
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、法律文书、邮件及技术讨论

patterns.name: 排除对象的后续考量表达
patterns.trigger: «from»« further»« consideration»，尤其是“eliminate from further consideration”
patterns.context: 描述将某些对象排除出后续评估或选择

en.concept: of the and its following constituents
en.description: The main pattern is activation after “of the,” often in part-whole expressions such as rest, most, all, or some of the…; the referents vary, including teams, armies, words, and vacancies. One trigger occurs in “more convenient variable,” with an unclear relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Quantifier/partitive structure after “of the”
patterns.context: The local string contains “of the,” followed by a quantity, group, or part of a whole; it often forms a part-whole expression with rest, most, all, or some, but also occurs with ordinals and other quantifier structures.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including legal, technical discussions, historical narrative, news, emails, and forums

patterns.name: “more” and variable description
patterns.context: A paper introduces variables used in subsequent equations; the marker falls on more, but this is not a common part-whole expression.

7_1130.description: 主要模式是在“of the”之后激活，常见于表示整体与部分的表达（如 rest、most、all、some of the…），也覆盖团队、军队、词语、空缺等不同所指。个别触发出现在“more convenient variable”，与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: “of the”后接量词/部分结构
patterns.trigger: “of” + “the” + 数量词或部分词，如 “of two virtually identical class actions”“of the team”“of the army”“of the word”“of ten our vacancies”
patterns.context: 局部串中出现 “of the” 后，接数量、分组或整体的一部分；常与 rest、most、all、some 等词构成整体—部分表达，但也见于序数和其他量词结构。
patterns.domain: 法律、技术讨论、历史叙述、新闻、邮件、论坛等多种文体

patterns.name: “more”与变量说明
patterns.context: 论文中介绍后续公式所用的变量；该处标记落在 more 上，但不属于常见的整体—部分表达。

en.concept: Quantity and ordinal expressions in sets
en.description: Primarily responds to “of the” and preceding quantifiers, ordinals, or generalizing words, especially “most of the”; also covers set and ordinal expressions such as all the/all these, first of, and second of, as well as one of in a medical context.

patterns.name: Quantity phrase “of the”
patterns.context: In phrases expressing a quantity, proportion, or ranking within a whole, immediately following a number or quantifier; activation centers on the.

patterns.name: “most of the” quantity structure
patterns.context: Most is followed by of the, then a group, object, or component being counted or summarized.

patterns.name: “all the” generalizing structure
patterns.context: Makes a universal generalization about a group; can be followed by a specific noun or modify a range in a comparative sentence.

patterns.name: “first of” in a range or sequence
patterns.context: First of is followed by a quantity or set, indicating that an event or thing is part of a plan or series.

patterns.name: The second of two / second item
patterns.context: Second is followed by a set introduced by of two, or serves as an ordinal modifier of beneficiary.

patterns.name: Non-quantitative “one of”
patterns.context: Classifies a drug within a category, in the form one of + category noun.

7_1130.concept: 集合中的数量与序列表达
7_1130.description: 主要响应“of the”及其前面的数量、序数或总括词，尤其是“most of the”；也覆盖 all the/all these、first of、second of 等集合与序列表达，另有医学语境中的 one of。

patterns.name: 数量短语“of the”
patterns.context: 在表示整体中的数量、比例或排序的短语中，紧邻数字或数量词前；强度集中在 the。

patterns.name: “most of the”数量结构
patterns.trigger: «most»« of»« the»；原文如 “most of the men”“most of its branches”“most of the army”
patterns.context: most 后接 of the，再接被统计或概括的群体、物品或组成部分。

patterns.name: “all the”总括结构
patterns.trigger: «all»« the»，以及“all these places”中的 «all»« these»
patterns.context: 对一组对象作全称概括；可接具体名词，也可在比较句中修饰范围。

patterns.name: 范围或序列中的“first of”
patterns.trigger: “the first of three planned debates”及“the first of many steamboats”
patterns.context: first of 后接数量或集合，说明某事件、事物属于一个计划或系列。

patterns.name: 第二个／两者中的第二项
patterns.trigger: “the second of two virtually identical class actions”与“the second beneficiary”
patterns.context: second 后接 of two 的集合，或作为序数定语修饰 beneficiary。

patterns.name: 非数量性的“one of”
patterns.context: 将某药物归入一个类别，句式为 one of + 类别名词。

en.concept: Parts or subsequent items in a sequence
en.description: In most passages, an ordinal or last is followed by of to introduce a member, quantity, or subsequent item in a sequence, with activation often concentrated on of; a few other patterns include adding consequences, part-whole structures in code, and general problem summaries.

patterns.name: of phrase after an ordinal
patterns.context: An ordinal or ordering word is followed by of, which introduces a member, quantity, or subsequent item in a group; strongest activation often falls on of.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including legal text, news, encyclopedias, parliamentary speeches, and emails

patterns.name: Added or accumulated consequences
patterns.context: Adding to introduces a condition further aggravated by an event, followed by an abstract noun phrase.

patterns.name: of the structure in code
patterns.context: In a code comment, of the connects a part with a whole; the trigger occurs on the phrase and in the code context.

patterns.name: Summary of general issues
patterns.context: A legal email contrasts general issues with specific issues and introduces a general summary.

7_1130.concept: 序列中的部分或后续项
7_1130.description: 多数段落在序数词或 last 后用 of 引出某个序列中的成员、数量或后续事项，激活常集中于 of；另有添加后果、代码中的部分—整体结构及一般性问题概括等少数模式。

patterns.name: 序数词后的 of 短语
patterns.trigger: “first of”／“second of”／“last of”及其后续词，如 «of»10
patterns.context: 序数词或表示次序的词后接 of，再引出一组中的成员、数量或后续事物；最强激活常落在 of 上。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、百科、议会发言、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 添加或累积后果
patterns.context: adding to 引出某事件进一步加剧的状况，后接抽象名词短语。

patterns.name: 代码中的 of the 结构
patterns.context: 代码注释中，of the 连接部分与整体；触发点落在该短语及代码语境。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、代码注释

patterns.name: 一般性问题的概括
patterns.context: 法律邮件中以 general issues 对比具体问题，并引出概括性摘要。

en.description: Primarily responds to the ordinal phrase “first of …”, often identifying the first item in a set, series, or event; also responds once to to in “adding to,” where it indicates addition or intensification.

patterns.name: Ordinal phrase “first of ten”
patterns.context: The ordinal first is followed by of + a quantity or limiting element, indicating the first item in a sequence, category, or set; modifiers may intervene.
patterns.domain: Narrative texts such as encyclopedic, legal, and news writing

patterns.name: “adding to” followed by a quantity
patterns.context: Adding to is followed by a noun phrase and indicates intensifying or increasing something; in this example, the quantity marker falls on to.

7_1130.description: 主要响应序数短语“first of …”，常用于指出集合、系列或事件中的首项；另有一次响应“adding to”中表示增添、加剧的 to。

patterns.name: 序数短语“first of ten”
patterns.context: 序数 first 后接 of + 数量或限定成分，表示某序列、类别或集合中的首项；中间可插入修饰语
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、新闻等叙述性文本

patterns.name: “adding to”及其后接数量
patterns.context: adding to 后接名词短语，表示加剧或增加某事；本例数量标记落在 to

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: more and comparisons of quantity and scope are prominent, but activation also occurs in set membership, additive connectives, job statements, temporal processes, and scientific descriptions of scale. Some patterns consist of only a few heterogeneous words or phrases and lack a unified context.

patterns.name: Comparative more
patterns.context: Occurs in comparative structures, especially when little precedes more or an adjective or nominal expression follows more; local activation concentrates on more and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Legal text, forum comments, scientific papers

patterns.name: Quantity and scope expressions
patterns.context: Involves quantity, proportion, degree, or approximate range; some occur in comparative sentences, others within legal descriptions or technical discussions.

patterns.name: Ordinal or set membership structure
patterns.context: Indicates that an object is one of two or belongs to a set; activation falls on of, a quantifier, or nearby text.

patterns.name: Progression, addition, or result connectives
patterns.context: Adds information to a preceding statement, introduces a subsequent result, or supplies an additional fact; activation concentrates on the connective that adds information and the following text.
patterns.domain: News reports, encyclopedia articles, news narratives

patterns.name: Jobs, identity, and formal statements
patterns.context: Involves a position, appointment, identity, or formal statement, often in institutional and biographical narratives; the shared lexical association across examples is weak.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, legal text, and news reports

patterns.name: Time and process words
patterns.context: Mentions the time of an appointment or event, time lost in a game, or a departure process; apart from time, there is no stable shared construction.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forum comments, legal text, news

patterns.name: Scale or richness expressions in scientific papers
patterns.context: Describes the scope, quantity, or overall properties of samples, variation, experience, signals, and similar items; activation is scattered across words expressing scale and overall quantity.

patterns.name: Explanations, equivalence, and configuration statements
patterns.context: Explains that a method is equivalent to a standard method, or discusses configuration and implementation versions; these examples have no stable shared trigger word.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, technical Q&A, forum comments

7_1130.description: 激活模式分散：more及数量、范围比较较突出，也出现在集合成员、补充连接、职务陈述、时间过程和科学规模描述中；部分模式仅由少数异质词句构成，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: 比较级表达 more
patterns.trigger: «little»6 «more»10 than 10«%»4 but« less»5 than 20«%»4（2）；«a little»5 «more»9（4、5）；«more»9 standard（10）；«more»6 forgiving（5）
patterns.context: 出现在比较结构中，尤其是 more 前有 little，或 more 后接形容词、名词性表达；局部激活集中于 more 及相邻词。
patterns.domain: 法律、论坛评论、科学论文

patterns.name: 数量与范围表达
patterns.context: 涉及数量、比例、程度或近似范围；有的出现于比较句，有的嵌在法律描述或技术讨论中。

patterns.name: 序数或集合成员结构
patterns.context: 表示某对象是两个中的一个，或属于某个集合；激活落在 of、数量词或其附近。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼描述、百科传记

patterns.name: 递进、补充或结果连接
patterns.context: 句中补充前述情况、引入后续结果或附加事实；激活集中于添加信息的连接词及其后文。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、百科条目、新闻叙事

patterns.name: 职务、身份与正式陈述
patterns.context: 涉及职位、任职、身份或正式陈述，常见于机构和人物叙述；各例的共同词面关联较弱。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、法律及新闻报道

patterns.name: 时间及过程词
patterns.context: 提及任职或事件时间、游戏中的时间损失，或离职过程；除 time 外未见稳定统一句式。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛评论、法律、新闻

patterns.name: 科学论文中的规模或丰富度表达
patterns.context: 描述样本、变异、经验、信号等的范围、数量或总体属性；激活散布在表示规模及总体量的词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 解释、等价与配置表述
patterns.context: 说明某方法与标准方法等价，或谈配置、实现版本；这些例子没有稳定的共同触发词。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、技术问答、论坛评论

en.description: Activates mainly in comparative increment expressions such as little/a bit more and more or less, and also in quantity comparisons with more/less and do more work; sporadic triggers include added/adding to, encyclopedic time adverbs, and newest.

patterns.name: Comparative degree phrases
patterns.context: The degree word little immediately precedes more, meaning “slightly more” or a comparative increment; passage 1 also contains the contrastive phrase more or less the same.

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons in sequences or proportions
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts comparing quantity, proportion, or degree; some examples also contain little more.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, web reporting, technical discussions

patterns.name: Expressions of addition or its result
patterns.context: Adding to describes something further worsening a situation; added to describes people being included in a team.

patterns.name: Adverbial expressions of time and events
patterns.context: Marks a period or adds another experience or position when narrating past events; triggers are scattered and do not form the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Degree modifier newest
patterns.context: Uses newest to describe one of three objects in a comparison.

patterns.name: Additional work or comparison
patterns.context: More modifies subsequent work or comparison, indicating that something still needs to be done further.

patterns.name: Legal payment and proportion limits
patterns.context: Defines a payment proportion range by percentage in the context of contract rescission.

patterns.name: Resignation and worsening conditions
patterns.context: A company executive resigns, and the event is reported as one factor worsening ongoing turmoil.

7_1130.description: 主要激活于 little/a bit more、more or less 等比较增量表达，也见 more/less 数量比较及 do more work；另有 added/adding to、百科时间副词和 newest 等零散触发。

patterns.name: 比较程度短语
patterns.context: 程度词 little 紧邻 more，表示“稍多一些”或比较增量；第 1 段也出现对照式 more or less the same。
patterns.domain: 多种文体中的普通比较表达

patterns.name: 序列或比例中的数值比较
patterns.context: 出现在数量、比例或程度的比较语境中；部分例子同时有 little more。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网页报道、技术讨论

patterns.name: 新增或加入的结果表达
patterns.context: adding to 描述某事进一步加剧局面；added to 描述人员被纳入队伍。

patterns.name: 时间与事件的副词表达
patterns.context: 在叙述过去事件时标示期间或补充另一项经历、职务；触发词分散，未形成相同固定短语。

patterns.name: 程度修饰词 newest
patterns.context: 在对三个对象作比较时，以 newest 描述其中之一。

patterns.name: 额外工作或比较
patterns.trigger: «do»« some»« more»« work»；«do»« a bit»« more»« comparison»
patterns.context: more 修饰后续工作或比较，表达尚需进一步进行某事。

patterns.name: 法律支付与比例限制
patterns.trigger: «a little»« more»« than»« 10»«%» but« less» than« 20»«%»
patterns.context: 合同撤销背景下，以百分比界定支付比例区间。

patterns.name: 辞职及局势恶化
patterns.context: 公司负责人辞职，并被报道为加剧持续动荡的一环。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent trigger is “further” for subsequent actions; it also responds to subsequent actions introduced by “to,” degree comparisons with “more/less,” and local structures involving element testing, process duration, team additions, and software implementation. Common words activate weakly and sporadically.

patterns.name: Subsequent actions with “further”
patterns.context: “Further” is followed by a verb or verb phrase, meaning to continue or do something further; this is the most prominent trigger across different sentences.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic prose, news commentary, technical discussion

patterns.name: Infinitives and continued actions
patterns.context: “To” introduces a purpose, result, or subsequent action, often near verbs or action-related expressions; [1] and [2] also show the same structure more weakly.
patterns.domain: Patents, encyclopedias, sports reporting, forum discussions

patterns.name: Increased degree or additional work
patterns.context: In comparison or recommendation contexts, degree words modify configurations, workload, or subsequent operations.

patterns.name: Set elements and property testing
patterns.context: Asks how to test whether all elements in a list satisfy a property, or how to handle an individual element.

patterns.name: Process steps and accumulating duration
patterns.context: Explains how repeated processing steps lead to extra time, cost, or an increase in total duration.

patterns.name: Adding or increasing team members
patterns.context: Reports that a team has announced a new member.

patterns.name: Implementing all middleware methods
patterns.context: A software release note lists changes implementing all middleware methods.

patterns.name: Weak and sporadic triggers from common words
patterns.context: These common words are embedded in different structures, with no stable independent condition or semantic pattern observed.

7_1130.description: 最强且反复的触发是进一步行动的 further；另对 to 引出的后续动作、more/less 的程度比较，以及元素检验、流程耗时、团队增员和软件实现等局部结构有响应。常用词激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: further 后续动作
patterns.context: “further”后接动词或动词短语，表示继续、进一步做某事；不同句子中出现，触发最突出。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、新闻评论、技术讨论

patterns.name: 不定式与动作延续
patterns.context: “to”引出目的、结果或接续动作，附近常出现动词或动作相关表达；[1]、[2]中也有较弱的相同结构。
patterns.domain: 专利、百科、体育报道、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 程度增加或补充工作
patterns.context: 比较或建议语境中，程度词修饰配置、工作量或后续操作。

patterns.name: 集合元素与属性检验
patterns.context: 询问如何测试列表中所有元素是否满足某性质，或处理单个元素。

patterns.name: 流程步骤与耗时累积
patterns.context: 解释重复处理流程导致额外时间、成本或总耗时增加。

patterns.name: 加入或增加团队成员
patterns.context: 报道某队伍宣布新增成员。

patterns.name: 实现全部中间件方法
patterns.context: 软件版本说明中列出实现全部中间件方法的改动。

patterns.name: 弱而零散的常用词触发
patterns.context: 这些常用词嵌在不同结构中，未见稳定的独立条件或语义模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of increase, addition, extra amounts, and comparative degree, especially additional/add/added near quantities, time, durations, or newly added items; also covers comparative words and uses meaning intensification of a situation, with some nearby function words activating as well.

patterns.name: Comparative or additive degree
patterns.context: Compares configurations, quantities, or degree, or proposes making something more forgiving; activations concentrate on comparative words and nearby expressions.

patterns.name: Extra or added
patterns.context: Indicates that something is added or increased, or that something is extra; often used with to or as a noun modifier.
patterns.domain: Patent background, encyclopedias, forums, news emails, legal texts

patterns.name: Added time or duration
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses time taken, extra duration, or a legal time limit; time units or time/period occur near expressions of increase or addition.
patterns.domain: Patent background, legal texts, corporate emails

patterns.name: Extra objects, functions, or maintenance
patterns.context: Describes newly added roles, functions, equipment, or maintenance items, with added time not being the core concept.

patterns.name: Progression to consequences or a change in circumstances
patterns.context: An event is described as worsening an existing situation rather than simply increasing a quantity.

patterns.name: Common function-word combinations in phrases
patterns.context: Activations also fall on articles, prepositions, or nearby nouns in specific phrases; these local collocations do not constitute a unified, independent semantic trigger condition.

7_1130.description: 主要响应增加、添加、额外及比较程度表达，尤其是 additional/add/added 与数量、时间、期限或新增项目相邻；也覆盖比较词和加剧局势的用法，部分邻近虚词一并激活。

patterns.name: 比较或增减程度
patterns.context: 比较配置、数量或程度，或提出让某事更宽松；激活集中在比较词及其邻近表达。

patterns.name: 额外或增加
patterns.context: 表示某项内容被添加、增加，或某事物属于额外部分；常与 to 连用，或修饰名词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科、论坛、新闻邮件、法律文本

patterns.name: 增加的时间或期限
patterns.context: 明确讨论耗时、额外时长或法律期限；时间单位或 time/period 与增加、额外等表达相邻。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、法律文本、企业邮件

patterns.name: 额外的对象、功能或维护
patterns.context: 描述新增的职务、功能、设备或维护项目，不以时间增加为核心。

patterns.name: 递进至后果或局势变化
patterns.context: 某事件被描述为加剧既有局势，而非单纯增加数量。

patterns.name: 短语中的常见虚词组合
patterns.context: 激活也落在特定词组中的冠词、介词或邻近名词上；这些局部搭配不构成统一的独立语义触发条件。

en.description: Strong activations often occur with “additional,” “more,” and expressions such as “a bit more,” involving supplementation, increases, or comparisons; related meanings also include manufacturing time and relative newness. Sporadic activations are distributed across various function words and time expressions.

patterns.name: “Additional” followed by an item
patterns.context: Indicates an extra or supplementary thing or information before a noun; also appears in the structure “these additional …”.

patterns.name: “More/less” comparisons and additions
patterns.context: Compares quantity, degree, or time; a common collocation is “a bit more.” Also includes “do more or less the same.”

patterns.name: Increased degree or scope, cumulative effects
patterns.context: Discusses manufacturing processes adding time or extra maintenance time; some examples relate to additions or more, but do not all contain “more/additional.”

patterns.name: “Bit” and approximate degree expressions
patterns.context: “Bit” appears in degree adverb phrases, indicating degree or quantity; this overlaps with “a bit more,” but does not always express an addition here.

patterns.name: Comparisons of newness
patterns.context: Compares the relative order or newness of three substances; activations concentrate on the superlative and its comparison frame.

patterns.name: Duration expressions
patterns.context: Involves floor ordinals, travel time, or maintenance duration; no specific unified phrase is apparent.

patterns.name: Function words in fixed collocations
patterns.context: These markers are distributed across different syntactic environments, with insufficient evidence to identify an independent trigger condition.

7_1130.description: 强激活多见于 additional、more 及“a bit more”等表达，涉及补充、增加或比较；另有制造耗时、新旧程度等相关语义。零散激活分布于多类功能词与时间表达。

patterns.name: “additional”及其后接补充项
patterns.context: 在名词前表示额外、补充的事物或信息；也出现在“these additional …”结构中。

patterns.name: more/less 比较及追加
patterns.context: 比较数量、程度或时间，常见搭配为“a bit more”；也有“do more or less the same”。

patterns.name: 程度或范围的增加、累积
patterns.context: 谈论制造流程增加耗时，或额外维护时间；部分与追加、更多有关，但不都出现 more/additional。

patterns.name: “bit”及近似程度表达
patterns.context: bit 出现在程度副词短语中，表示程度或数量；与“a bit more”有重叠，但此处并非都表达追加。

patterns.name: 新颖程度比较
patterns.context: 比较三种物质的先后或新旧程度，激活集中在最高级及其比较框架。

patterns.name: 时间长度表达
patterns.context: 涉及楼层序数、行程所需时间或维护持续时长；未见统一的特定短语。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的功能词
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同句法环境中，缺少足够证据确定独立触发条件。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on “additional” or words indicating increase or supplementation; they also occur in “more/less” comparison structures. There is also an intra-word activation in “mainstay.” The patterns span domains, but several activated words do not match these forms.

patterns.name: “Additional”
patterns.context: “Additional” modifies a noun, indicating supplementary people, features, information, or resources; the same form triggers in various structures.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, technical descriptions, Q&A, educational technology

patterns.name: Increasing or supplementing
patterns.context: Expresses adding, replenishing, or providing extra resources; objects include roster depth, lighting, rest, and storage space.

patterns.name: Expansion through quantity or degree comparisons
patterns.context: Compares degree or quantity, often appearing as “more/less” + a description or noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, game discussions, forum conversations

patterns.name: Fixed collocation with “mainstay”
patterns.context: “Mainstay of” describes someone as a mainstay of a team; activation is concentrated within the compound word.

7_1130.description: 多数强激活落在 additional 或表示增加、补充的词上，也见于 more/less 比较结构；另有 mainstay 的词内激活。跨领域出现，但若干激活词与这些词形并不一致。

patterns.name: additional
patterns.context: “additional”修饰名词，表示补充的人员、特征、信息或资源；同一词形在多种结构中触发。
patterns.domain: 百科、技术说明、问答、教育技术

patterns.name: 增加或补充
patterns.context: 表达增加、补足或提供额外资源；对象包括阵容深度、照明、休息、存储空间。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、问答、科技讨论

patterns.name: 数量或程度的比较扩展
patterns.context: 比较程度或数量，常以 more/less + 描述或名词短语出现。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、游戏讨论、论坛对话

patterns.name: mainstay固定搭配
patterns.context: “mainstay of”表示某人是球队的中坚；激活集中在复合词内部。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to structures in which additional precedes a noun, covering new functions, costs, permissions, terms, and more; it also responds to expressions of increased or cumulative results such as added efficiency and adds … total. Other weak activations are scattered across their respective contexts.

patterns.name: Additional followed by a noun
patterns.context: Used attributively before a noun or in an “additional …” noun phrase; the noun phrase often describes new staffing arrangements, functions, efficiency, costs, power, or algorithm components.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, patents, Q&A, emails, and academic papers

patterns.name: Increase and cumulative result
patterns.context: Describes the quantity or result of an increase or addition; one instance uses added attributively, and another uses adds as a verb followed by cumulative time taken.
patterns.domain: Engine patent background; manufacturing-process patent background

patterns.name: Degree and improvement
patterns.context: One passage asks about the extent of an improvement; another emphasizes the complete version in a casual comment. The triggers differ, and the semantic connection is weak.

patterns.name: Quantity comparison and emphasis
patterns.context: Compares gun incidents with the number of gun purchases, using the comparative more and quantity expressions. Activation is weak, with no common trigger phrase immediately nearby.

patterns.name: Incidental activation of general vocabulary or syntax
patterns.context: In passage 1, the strongest activation is on «additional»10, while several ordinary words earlier in the passage show weaker activation; no condition consistent with the main trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in the Nascom 2 feature context
patterns.context: Strong activation still corresponds to additional features; weaker markers such as these and that may simply reflect nearby context and do not show an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent sentence
patterns.context: These words occur in a diesel-engine efficiency comparison, but strong activation corresponds to «added»9 efficiency; the other words do not yet support an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a StackExchange sentence
patterns.context: Discusses adding solar lights to existing fixtures; apart from add and other words related to addition, activations are scattered, so no independent unified trigger condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent manufacturing process
patterns.context: Describes time spent on manufacturing and testing steps; strong activation falls on adds … total. The other activations may relate to the sentence’s cumulative-time expression, but evidence is insufficient to distinguish further patterns.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a patent equipment-cost sentence
patterns.context: Discusses bidirectional information flow and smart-appliance costs; the main strong activation is «additional»9 cost, while the other words do not show an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a HackerNews comment
patterns.context: Several weak activations occur in expressions about the extent of an improvement and the complete version; beyond the degree/improvement pattern noted above, they cannot be classified as a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in an email about legislation
patterns.context: Describes a proposed bill granting coordination authority; the strongest activation is «additional»9, while other words are scattered across the syntactic structure.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a paper sentence
patterns.context: Discusses regularization and the number of tasks in incremental learning; the strongest activation is «additional»9, while surrounding words may be contextual co-activations.

7_1130.description: 主要对 additional 后接名词的结构强烈响应，涵盖新增功能、成本、权限、术语等；也响应 added efficiency、adds … total 等增加及累积结果表达。其余弱激活分散于各自语境。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.trigger: «additional»9/10；以及其后名词，如 «additional»10 ADC、«additional»10 «features»3、«additional»9 efficiency/cost/powers/regularization term
patterns.context: 在名词前作定语，或与后续名词短语构成“额外的……”；名词短语常描述新增的人事安排、功能、效率、成本、权力或算法项。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、问答、邮件、学术论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 增加与累积结果
patterns.context: 描述增加、添加所带来的量或结果；一次以 added 作定语，另一次以 adds 作谓语，后接累积耗时。
patterns.domain: 发动机专利背景；制造工艺专利背景

patterns.name: 程度与改进
patterns.context: 一段询问改进幅度；另一段在口语评论中强调完整版本。两例触发词不同，语义联系较弱。

patterns.name: 数量比较与强调
patterns.context: 围绕枪支事故与枪支购买数量作比较，出现比较级 more 和数量表达。激活较弱，且没有紧邻的共同触发短语。

patterns.name: 一般词汇或句法偶发激活
patterns.context: 第1段的显著激活集中在 «additional»10，但前文若干普通词也有较弱激活；看不出与主触发模式一致的条件。

patterns.name: Nascom 2 功能语境中的零散激活
patterns.context: 强激活仍对应 additional features；these、that 等较弱标记可能只是邻近语境，未呈现独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 专利句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在柴油机效率比较语境，但强激活对应 «added»9 efficiency，其他词暂不足以构成独立模式。

patterns.name: StackExchange 句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 谈论在既有灯具之外增加太阳能灯；除 add 等与添加语境相关外，激活词分散，无法确认独立统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 专利制造流程中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述制造与测试步骤耗时，强激活落在 adds … total；其余激活可能与该句的累积耗时表达有关，但证据不足以细分。
patterns.domain: USPTO 制造工艺专利背景

patterns.name: 专利设备成本句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 讨论双向信息流与智能家电成本；主要强激活为 «additional»9 cost，其他词未显示独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: HackerNews 评论中的零散激活
patterns.context: 改进幅度与完整版本的表达中出现若干弱激活；除前述程度/改进模式外，不能归为统一触发。

patterns.name: 邮件法案语境中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述拟议法案授予协调权限；强激活为 «additional»9，其他词散布于句法结构中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的政策讨论

patterns.name: 论文句中的零散激活
patterns.context: 讨论增量学习中的正则化与任务数；强激活为 «additional»9，周边词可能是上下文伴随激活。

en.description: The most consistent signal is “additional,” often before nouns referring to supplementary content, features, information, maintenance, or wording; it also responds to “of” in “all of” structures and to two specific collocations in email.

patterns.name: “Additional” and subsequent supplementary content
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving supplementary or increased things, information, features, resources, work, or conditions. “Additional” can be attributive or capitalized in a job title.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: encyclopedias, Q&A, patents, research, news, email

patterns.name: “Of” in quantity phrases
patterns.context: Follows a quantity or universal quantifier (such as “all”) and connects it to the relevant whole or set.

patterns.name: Contrasting extra maintenance time with routine schedules
patterns.context: Discusses extra maintenance time alongside or in contrast with normal overnight maintenance time.

patterns.name: “Additional language” in a legislative proposal
patterns.context: Refers to supplementary text or wording required before a proposal proceeds.
patterns.domain: Business email, legislative or policy discussions

7_1130.description: 最一致的信号是 additional，常出现在表示补充内容、功能、信息、维护或措辞的名词前；另对 all of 结构中的 of 有反应，并有两处邮件中的特定搭配。

patterns.name: additional及其后续补充内容
patterns.trigger: “additional”强激活；其后常接名词，如“additional ADC”“additional solar lights”“additional information”“additional language”
patterns.context: 在某事物、信息、功能、资源、工作或条件的补充、增加语境中；“additional”可作定语，也可大写出现在职位头衔中
patterns.domain: 跨领域；百科、问答、专利、科研、新闻、邮件

patterns.name: 数量短语中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of”，尤其“all of these studies”“all of the nationalities”
patterns.context: 位于数量或全称词（如 all）之后，连接所指的整体或集合

patterns.name: 额外维护时间与常规安排的对照
patterns.context: 讨论额外维护时间，并与正常的夜间维护时间并列或对照

patterns.name: 法律提案中的 additional language
patterns.context: 指提案推进前所需补充的文本或措辞
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、立法或政策讨论

en.description: The main activations are on “additional” and the “extra/increased” meaning of the nouns that follow it, covering people, lights, features, powers, expenses, maintenance time, and insights. It also responds to comparison structures such as “more forgiving,” “more incentives,” and “more commonly,” as well as “added efficiency.” The remaining sporadic markers are difficult to group into a unified pattern.

patterns.name: “Additional” modifying a noun
patterns.context: “Additional” precedes a noun to indicate extra people, facilities, features, powers, expenses, time, or information; the following noun is sometimes not shown because of truncation.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, forums, email, and news

patterns.name: Collocation “more forgiving”
patterns.context: Comparative “more” occurs with “forgiving,” describing more lenient judgments or hitboxes in a game.

patterns.name: Collocation “more incentives”
patterns.context: “More” modifies the plural noun “incentives,” expressing a need for more incentives.

patterns.name: Collocation “more commonly”
patterns.context: “More” and “commonly” form a comparative adverb phrase that modifies the common name for a diesel engine.

patterns.name: “Added” as a modifier
patterns.context: “Added” modifies “efficiency,” expressing increased efficiency; it shares an “extra/increased” meaning with “additional” but has a different form.

patterns.name: Other local co-occurrences
patterns.context: These markers are distributed across different syntactic positions and show no consistent local trigger condition; some may be driven by contexts containing “additional,” “more,” or “added.”

7_1130.description: 主要对 additional 及其后接名词的“额外、增加”表达激活，覆盖人员、灯、功能、权力、费用、维护时间和见解；另对 more forgiving、more incentives、more commonly 等比较结构及 added efficiency 有反应。其余零散标记难归为统一模式。

patterns.name: additional 修饰名词
patterns.trigger: «additional»（第 1、2、3、4、5、7、8、9 段）；第 5 段为句首大写 «Additional»
patterns.context: additional 位于名词前，表示额外的人员、设施、功能、权力、费用、时间或信息；其后名词有时因截断未显示。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、邮件、新闻等多种文体

patterns.name: more forgiving 搭配
patterns.context: 比较级 more 与 forgiving 连用，描述游戏中更宽容的判定或 hitboxes。

patterns.name: more incentives 搭配
patterns.context: more 修饰复数名词 incentives，表达需要更多激励措施。

patterns.name: more commonly 搭配
patterns.context: more 与 commonly 构成比较副词短语，修饰柴油机的常见称呼。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、发动机说明

patterns.name: added 作定语
patterns.context: added 修饰 efficiency，表达增加的效率；与 additional 同属“额外/增加”语义但词形不同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、技术说明

patterns.name: 其他局部共现
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同句法位置，未显示一致的局部触发条件；部分可能受 additional、more 或 added 所在语境带动。

en.description: The most stable pattern is “additional” as a pre-nominal modifier denoting a supplementary item; it also responds to expressions of adding, expanding, or increasing, such as “add/adding/added,” “increase,” and “further.” Other activations involve comparisons, quantities, and sporadic participial forms, which are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: “Additional” followed by a noun
patterns.context: Attributively modifies a noun to indicate an extra, supplementary, or newly added item; some examples are preceded by words such as “adding” or “this.”
patterns.domain: News, biographies, business email, forum discussions, Q&A, and energy topics

patterns.name: Further development or expansion
patterns.context: Related to developing science-fiction elements or advancing something further; “further” in paragraph 8 occurs in a truncated context, so the exact collocation is incomplete.

patterns.name: Adding, improving, or increasing
patterns.context: Describes adding something, producing an increment, or improving an attribute; some examples use “add/adding/added” directly, while others use “increase.”
patterns.domain: Business email, forum discussions, Q&A, patent technical descriptions, political news

patterns.name: Comparative degree and quantity emphasis
patterns.context: Activations fall on expressions of comparison, quantity, or scope, but these words occur in different syntactic environments.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, technical descriptions, biographies, political news

patterns.name: Participial or progressive forms
patterns.context: In a few contexts, activations fall on participial, passive, or progressive morphological forms; no stable shared semantic condition is apparent among these words.

patterns.name: Supplementary identity or position titles
patterns.context: “Additional” occurs next to a position or auxiliary appointment title, indicating an additional role or identity.

7_1130.description: 最稳定的模式是 additional 作名词前定语，表示补充对象；还对 add/adding/added、increase 及 further 等增添、扩展或提升表达有反应。另有比较、数量和零散分词形式激活，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.trigger: «additional»，其后接名词，如 «Additional» Superintendent、«additional» ADC、«additional» forms、«additional» insight、«additional» language、«additional» solar lights、«additional» money
patterns.context: 在名词前作定语，表示额外、补充或新增的对象；部分例子前有 adding、this 等词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、人物传记、商务邮件、论坛讨论、问答及能源话题

patterns.name: 进一步发展或扩大
patterns.context: 与开发科幻元素或进一步推进某事相关；第8段中的 further 处于截断语境，确切搭配不完整。
patterns.domain: 影视制作介绍、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 新增、提高或增加
patterns.trigger: «adding» additional forms；«adding» additional insight；«add» these additional solar lights；«add» additional money；«added» efficiency；«increase» understanding
patterns.context: 描述增添事物、带来增量或提升某项属性；有的由 add/adding/added 直接表达，有的用 increase 表达提升。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、论坛讨论、问答、专利技术说明、政治新闻

patterns.name: 比较程度与数量强调
patterns.context: 激活落在比较级、数量或范围表达上，但这些词分布于彼此不同的句法环境。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、技术说明、人物传记、政治新闻

patterns.name: 分词或进行式形式
patterns.context: 仅在个别上下文中落于分词、被动或进行式构词形式；这些词之间看不出稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 影视介绍、人物传记、商务邮件

patterns.name: 附加身份或职务称谓
patterns.context: additional 紧邻职务或辅助任命称谓，表示附加职位或身份。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、军事人物传记

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions such as additional/added and more that indicate increase or added degree; also responds to supplemental content, further development, and the quantity phrase little more. Additional also triggers when used as a title modifier.

patterns.name: Additional / added additions
patterns.context: Indicates extra people, content, tables, capabilities, or efficiency; [8] is Additional in a title.

patterns.name: Degree or quantity of more
patterns.context: Compares or indicates an additional quantity or degree; common structures include more information, more than, more incentives, and more commonly.

patterns.name: Act of adding or supplementing
patterns.context: Explicitly describes adding insight to existing content; occurs alongside additional.

patterns.name: Development and further refinement
patterns.context: Indicates further progress or deepening of an existing project rather than a direct increase in quantity.

patterns.name: Little modifying comparative quantity
patterns.context: Little combines with more to indicate slightly more or slightly exceeding a quantity; [10] also contains “more than half”.

7_1130.description: 主要响应 additional/added、more 等表示增加或额外程度的表达；也响应补充内容、进一步发展，以及 little more 的数量短语。Additional 作职衔修饰语也触发。

patterns.name: additional / added 增补
patterns.context: 表示额外增加的人、内容、表格、能力或效率；[8]为职衔中的 Additional。
patterns.domain: 专利、百科传记、邮件、新闻

patterns.name: more 的程度或数量
patterns.context: 比较或表示额外数量、程度；常见结构为 more information、more than、more incentives，也包括 more commonly。

patterns.name: 添加、补充的动作
patterns.context: 明确描述在已有内容上补充 insight；与 additional 同现。

patterns.name: 发展、进一步完善
patterns.context: 表示继续推进或深化已有项目，而非直接表示数量增加。
patterns.domain: 电视制作相关百科叙述

patterns.name: little 修饰比较数量
patterns.context: little 与 more 连用，表示稍多或略超过某数量；[10]另有“more than half”。

en.description: Responds to words and phrases indicating an increase, something extra, or more: including “additional” modifying newly added items, “more” indicating an increase in quantity or degree, and “added” indicating a new effect or the act of adding.

patterns.name: “Additional” followed by a new item
patterns.context: Precedes a noun to indicate an extra position, dataset, dimension, language, or piece of information; sometimes occurs in a formal title.
patterns.domain: Biographies, patents, research, news, business email, educational technology

patterns.name: “More” indicating a need for more
patterns.context: Indicates an increase in degree or quantity in comparisons or requests; often paired with “little” or “bit,” and can also express a request for more information.

patterns.name: “Added” indicating an addition
patterns.context: The past participle acts as a modifier to indicate a newly added effect, or as a verb describing someone being added to an email distribution list.

7_1130.description: 对表示增加、额外或更多的词语及短语反应：包括 additional 修饰新增项目，more 表示数量或程度增加，以及 added 表示新增效果或执行加入操作。

patterns.name: additional 后接新增对象
patterns.context: 在名词前表示额外的职务、数据、维度、语言或信息；有时处于正式称谓中
patterns.domain: 传记、专利、科研、新闻、商务邮件、教育技术

patterns.name: more 表示需要更多
patterns.trigger: «more»，尤其是“a little more information”“a little more forgiving”“a bit more comparison”
patterns.context: 比较或请求程度、数量增加；常与 little 或 bit 搭配，也可表达需要补充信息

patterns.name: added 表示增加或附加
patterns.trigger: «added»，包括“added efficiency”和“added John Ayres to distribution”
patterns.context: 过去分词作修饰语表示新增的效果，或作动词表示把人加入邮件分发名单

en.description: Primarily responds to “additional” and the nouns that follow it, involving extra information, maintenance, forms, leave, and positions; it also responds to “more” indicating an increment and “adding to” indicating an aggravation of the situation. The common thread is increase or supplementation, though the triggering forms and contexts differ.

patterns.name: “Additional” / “additional information”
patterns.context: The word “additional” itself or its following noun is marked; contexts usually describe extra information, work, forms, leave, or positions. Paragraph 1 also contains “additional ADC,” but the activation marker falls on “ADC.”
patterns.domain: News, technology, medicine, business email, biographies, and general expository prose

patterns.name: “More” / “little more”
patterns.context: “More” indicates an increase or greater quantity; paragraph 4 requests more information, while paragraph 10 compares quantities.

patterns.name: “Adding to”
patterns.context: “Adding” followed by “to” indicates that something further aggravates or increases an existing situation; occurs after news of a resignation.

7_1130.description: 主要响应 additional 及其后续名词，涉及额外信息、维护、表格、假期和职位；也响应表示增量的 more，以及表示使局势加重的 adding to。共同点是增加或补充，但触发形式和语境不完全相同。

patterns.name: additional / additional information
patterns.context: 词 additional 本身或其后名词被标记；语境通常是在说明额外的信息、工作、表格、假期或职位。第1段还出现 additional ADC，但激活标记落在 ADC 上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科技、医疗、商务邮件、人物传记及一般说明文

patterns.name: more / little more
patterns.context: more 表示增加或数量更多；第4段是请求补充更多信息，第10段是比较数量增加。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、新闻或评论文本

patterns.name: adding to
patterns.context: adding 后接 to，表示某事使既有局势进一步加重或增加；出现在辞职消息之后。

en.description: Activations concentrate on words and structures meaning “more, extra, or further”: “little/bit more,” “additional,” and “further.” They share the meaning of increasing or continuing beyond the current state and occur across forums, news, encyclopedias, and contract texts.

patterns.name: “A little more” for increments, comparison, or supplementation
patterns.context: In commentary or requests, indicates a need for more information, degree, comparison, or tolerance; common in forum replies and also occurs in a signature count description.

patterns.name: “Additional”
patterns.context: Indicates extra people, documents, or other supplementary items; appears in noun phrases or supplementary remarks.
patterns.domain: Contract email, news reports, encyclopedic biographies

patterns.name: “Further”
patterns.context: Indicates continuing, advancing, strengthening, or adjusting something, followed by an action verb.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entertainment content and sports video game descriptions

7_1130.description: 激活集中在表示“更多、额外或进一步”的词与结构：little/bit more、additional、further；共同表达相对于现状的增加或延续，跨论坛、新闻、百科及合同文本。

patterns.name: “a little more”递增、比较或补充
patterns.context: 在评述或请求中表示还需要更多信息、程度、比较或宽容度；常见于论坛回复，也见于签名数描述。

patterns.name: additional（额外的）
patterns.context: 表示额外人员、文件或其他补充项；出现在名词短语或补充说明中。
patterns.domain: 合同邮件、新闻报道、百科人物传记

patterns.name: further（进一步）
patterns.context: 表示继续推进、加强或调整某事，后接动作动词。
patterns.domain: 百科娱乐内容与体育电子游戏介绍

en.description: Activations occur most consistently in the incremental expression “little more” and where additional modifies a noun; they also appear in “adding to,” meaning increase or intensification, and “more information,” expressing a need for further information. The contexts span forums, news, legal, business, and encyclopedic texts.

patterns.name: “a little more” expressing an increase in degree or quantity
patterns.context: “Little more” forms an incremental expression of quantity, degree, or a feature, usually preceded by a; it modifies information, forgiving, hitboxes, flippant, or a percentage following rescission.

patterns.name: Additional followed by a noun
patterns.context: Additional precedes a noun to indicate an extra position, person, authorization, table, or maintenance item; capitalization and sentence structure vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, news, police reporting, business and legal texts

patterns.name: Adding to + noun phrase
patterns.context: Adding to introduces an increase or intensification of an existing state, such as turmoil; it need not occur in the same sentence as additional.

patterns.name: Other weaker uses of more
patterns.context: More modifies the noun information to express a need for further information; the same passage also contains little more, but this marker is weaker and adjacent to the highly activated phrase.

7_1130.description: 激活最一致地出现在“little more”递增表达，以及 additional 作名词前置修饰语处；也见于“adding to”表示增加、加剧，和“more information”表达进一步需求。跨论坛、新闻、法律、商务及百科文本。

patterns.name: “a little more”表达程度或数量增加
patterns.context: “little more”构成数量、程度或特征的递增表达，通常前有 a；修饰 information、forgiving、hitboxes、flippant 或 rescission 后的百分比等。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.context: additional 位于名词前，表示额外的职务、人员、权限、表格或维护；大小写不同，所在句式也不同。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、新闻、警务报道、商务法律文本

patterns.name: adding to + 名词短语
patterns.context: adding to 引出某种既有事态的增加或加剧，如 turmoil；不要求与 additional 同句出现。

patterns.name: 其他较弱的 more 用法
patterns.context: more 修饰名词 information，表达需要进一步的信息；同段另有 little more，但此处标记较弱且与高激活短语相邻。

en.concept: Expressions of supplementation, increase, or degree increments
en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on “additional” as a pre-nominal modifier and on the HackerNews structure “little more,” meaning “a little more”; “executive producer” also appears as a film and TV title. Each pattern covers all samples.

patterns.name: “Additional” followed by a noun
patterns.context: Often acts as a pre-nominal modifier when specifying or supplementing a resource, permission, dataset, form, or benefit; some examples are interrupted by sentence boundaries, markers, or word segmentation.
patterns.domain: Expository genres including news, legal policy, business email, research, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: “Little more” structure
patterns.context: “Little” and “more” occur adjacent to one another or in the same phrase, meaning “a little more”; may modify a descriptive adjective or the amount of information.

patterns.name: Title collocation “executive producer”
patterns.context: “Executive” modifies “producer” when introducing film and television production personnel and their roles; this paragraph also contains unmarked text such as “further develop.”

7_1130.concept: 补充、增加或程度增量表达
7_1130.description: 激活主要集中在 additional 用作名词前修饰语，以及 HackerNews 中 little more 表示“稍多一些”的结构；另见影视职衔 executive producer。各模式覆盖全部样本。

patterns.name: additional 后接名词
patterns.context: 在限定或补充某项资源、权限、数据、形式或待遇时，常作名词前修饰语；部分例子中被句界、标记或词形切分打断。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律政策、商务邮件、科研、百科等说明性文体

patterns.name: little more 结构
patterns.context: little 与 more 相邻或处于同一短语中，表示“稍多一些”；可修饰描述性形容词，也可修饰信息量。

patterns.name: executive producer 职务搭配
patterns.context: 在介绍影视制作人员及其职务时，executive 修饰 producer；本段另有 further develop 等未标记内容。

en.description: Strong activations mainly concentrate on expressions of more, extra, or further, commonly involving “more” and its degree modifiers, as well as “additional” and “further”; a few local triggers occur in particular collocations, across scattered contexts.

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or degree
patterns.context: Expresses a need for, provision of, or increase in more of something; sometimes qualified by “a little,” “a bit,” or “additional,” and may use “further” to indicate further development or promotion.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, business emails, news, and encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in lexical or syntactic collocations
patterns.context: These words occur in various syntactic and semantic environments; some do not clearly express increase or comparison, so it is uncertain whether they belong to the same main pattern.

7_1130.description: 强激活主要集中在更多、额外或进一步的表达，常见于“more”及其程度修饰语，也包括“additional”“further”；另有少量搭配中的局部触发，语境分散。

patterns.name: 数量或程度增加
patterns.trigger: “more”后接程度、时间、信息或形式等，如“a little more information”“a little more forgiving”“additional forms”“additional and undefined powers”“a bit more time”
patterns.context: 表达需要、提供或增加更多某物；有时由“a little”“a bit”“additional”限定，也可出现“further”表示进一步发展或促进。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、商务邮件、新闻及百科叙述

patterns.name: 词汇或句法搭配的零散触发
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在多种不同句法和语义环境中；部分并不明确表达增加或比较，无法确定是否与主模式相同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various word-initial or internal token fragments: Inter- (especially interactions), Ass-, Legacy, programmed, Spanish title fragments, and connexin. Most occur in titles or abstracts, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-initial Inter- segmentation
patterns.context: Word-initial Inter is tokenized separately, with subsequent tokens forming a complete word; includes interactions and interictal.

patterns.name: Lexical triggers in titles
patterns.context: Word-initial Ass combines with subsequent fragments to form Assessment or Assets; activation concentrates on the word-initial fragment and immediately following suffix.

patterns.name: Legacy strategy phrase
patterns.context: Legacy policy appears in statements about management systems and network policies.

patterns.name: programmed in patents
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of the field of an invention, describing programmable and reprogrammable logic gate arrays.

patterns.name: Spanish title word fragments
patterns.context: Token fragments from Spanish titles; stronger activations include conjunctions and prepositional fragments between words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the connexin channel term
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical discussions of CL-CT interactions and connexin channels; activation concentrates on the tokenized word connexin.

7_1247.concept: 分词边界／词形片段响应
7_1247.description: 激活分散于多种词首或词内分词片段：Inter-（尤其 interactions）、Ass-、Legacy、programmed、西语标题片段及 connexin。多数来自标题或摘要，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Inter-词首切分
patterns.context: 词首 Inter 被单独切成 token，后续 token 拼成完整单词；包括 interactions 和 interictal。

patterns.name: 标题中的词汇性触发
patterns.context: 词首 Ass 与后续片段组成 Assessment 或 Assets，激活集中于词首及紧邻后缀。

patterns.name: 遗留策略短语
patterns.context: Legacy policy 出现在关于管理系统和网络策略的陈述中。

patterns.name: 专利中的 programmed
patterns.context: 出现在发明领域说明中，描述可编程、可重新编程的逻辑门阵列。

patterns.name: 西班牙语标题字词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语标题的分词片段；较强激活包括单词间的连接词与介词片段。

patterns.name: 连接蛋白通道词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 CL-CT 相互作用及连接蛋白通道的生物医学讨论中；激活集中于被切分的 connexin 词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Inter-initial tokens and interactions, policy management, programmed in patents, Spanish art titles, connexin, Assessment-initial tokens, and financial lists, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Inter-initial and subsequent word fragments
patterns.context: Activates when a word in English technical text begins with Inter; strongest responses fall on subsequent word fragments ict (interictal) or actions (interactions), with the interactions structure repeated in two passages.

patterns.name: Policy management phrase
patterns.context: In the phrase “policy management systems,” policy and management are especially prominent; appears in patent background text.

patterns.name: programmed in patents
patterns.context: programmed strongly activates when describing an invention involving a programmable logic gate array; the surrounding text uses the patent-standard Field of the Invention phrasing.

patterns.name: Spanish art title
patterns.context: In the Spanish title “La estética y el arte más allá de la academia,” short words and fragmented title words activate; includes accented characters and BPE fragments.
patterns.domain: Spanish philosophy or art paper titles

patterns.name: Connexin channel fragment
patterns.context: In a biomedical passage discussing the regulation of connexin channels by CL-CT interactions, the token fragment conne in connexin is especially prominent.

patterns.name: Assessment-initial token
patterns.context: When an English abstract begins with Assessment of the effect of…, the initial token fragment of Assessment and subsequent fragments activate.

patterns.name: Financial item lists
patterns.context: Financial or accounting items appear in parallel lists, with commas also showing clear activation.

7_1247.concept: none
7_1247.description: 激活分散于 Inter 词首及 interactions、政策管理、专利 programmed、西语艺术标题、connexin、Assessment 词首和财务清单，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Inter-词首及后续词片段
patterns.trigger: «Inter»6«ict»10«al»2« changes»4« in»8« behavior»1« and»6« cerebral»1« metabolism»1« in»8；«Inter»6«actions»10
patterns.context: 在英语专业文本中，单词以 Inter 开头时激活；最强响应落在后续词片段 ict（interictal）或 actions（interactions），其中 interactions 结构在两段中重复。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、生物学与生态学摘要

patterns.name: 政策管理词组
patterns.context: 短语 “policy management systems” 中，policy 和 management 尤其突出；位于专利背景文本。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、网络策略管理

patterns.name: 专利中的 programmed
patterns.context: 描述可编程逻辑门阵列的发明时，programmed 强激活；周围是专利常见的 Field of the Invention 句式。

patterns.name: 西班牙语艺术标题
patterns.context: 西班牙语标题“La estética y el arte más allá de la academia”中，短词及被分片的标题词激活；包含重音字符和 BPE 片段。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学或艺术论文标题

patterns.name: 连接蛋白通道片段
patterns.context: 讨论 CL-CT interactions 对 connexin channels 调节作用的生物医学段落中，connexin 的分词片段 conne 特别突出。

patterns.name: Assessment 词首
patterns.context: 英语摘要中以 Assessment of the effect of… 开头时，Assessment 的首个分词片段及后续片段激活。

patterns.name: 财务项目列举
patterns.context: 财务或会计项目以并列清单形式出现，标点逗号也有明显激活。

en.concept: Word-initial and intraword fragments and proper-name segmentation
en.description: Activations are most prominent on words beginning with Inter- and several intraword subword fragments; other strong responses are scattered across programmed and policy in patents, of in academic phrasing, and fragments from Spanish, place names, and capitalized proper names, without forming a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Inter-initial words split into fragments
patterns.context: Triggering fragments begin with Inter; these include both subsequent fragments after a complete word-initial segment and intraword splits. Semantics are not limited to a single topic.

patterns.name: Intraword subword boundaries
patterns.context: Complex words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activations on intraword fragments; these examples do not show a stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: programmed in patent body text
patterns.context: In the Field of the Invention section of patent specifications, descriptions of programmable logic arrays include phrases such as “being programmed and reprogrammed”.

patterns.name: policy in a patent policy phrase
patterns.context: Near the beginning of the sentence is “Legacy policy management systems,” discussing network policy generation and management.

patterns.name: of in anatomical and physiological research
patterns.context: of activates strongly in the research objective phrasing “Understanding of anatomical and physiological relationships”.

patterns.name: Accented forms in Spanish titles
patterns.context: Spanish titles appear segmented into capitalized words and accented characters; prominent fragments are scattered, with no clear consistent word trigger.

patterns.name: Intraword split in the place name Victoria
patterns.context: The ending ia activates strongly when the place name Victoria recurs in an electoral district entry title and body text.

patterns.name: Fragmentation of proper-name place names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into capital-letter fragments and punctuation; may involve the place name “Woodcliff Lake, N.J.”, but with little context the trigger pattern is uncertain.

7_1247.concept: 词首与词内片段及专名切分
7_1247.description: 激活最显著地落在 Inter- 开头的词及若干词内子词片段；其余高响应分散于专利中的 programmed、policy，学术措辞中的 of，以及西语、地名和大写专名的切分片段，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: Inter- 开头的词被拆分
patterns.context: 触发片段以 Inter 起始；既包括完整词首后续片段，也包括词内拆分。语义不限于单一主题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 词内子词边界
patterns.context: 复杂词被拆成多个子词 token，激活落在词内片段；但这些例子未显示稳定的共同词义。

patterns.name: 专利正文中的 programmed
patterns.context: 专利说明书的发明领域段落中，出现“being programmed and reprogrammed”一类可编程逻辑阵列描述。

patterns.name: 专利政策短语中的 policy
patterns.context: 句首附近为“Legacy policy management systems”，讨论网络策略生成与管理。

patterns.name: 解剖生理研究叙述中的 of
patterns.context: “Understanding of anatomical and physiological relationships”这一研究目标表述中，of 获得较强激活。

patterns.name: 西班牙语标题中的重音词形
patterns.context: 西班牙语标题以大写词和重音字符拆分呈现；突出片段分散，未见明确一致的单词触发。

patterns.name: 地名 Victoria 的词内拆分
patterns.context: 地名 Victoria 在选举区条目标题及正文中重复出现时，词尾 ia 激活很强。

patterns.name: 地名专名的片段化
patterns.context: 专名被切分为大写字母片段与标点；可能涉及地名“Woodcliff Lake, N.J.”，但缺少更多语境，触发规律不确定。

en.concept: Lexical and formatting cues at the start of titles
en.description: Strongly responds to the word-initial forms of Interactions and Assessment/Assessing, especially title-style openings in biomedical titles; also responds to Assets in financial enumerations and the form label Assessment Only.

patterns.name: Title opening with “Interactions”
patterns.context: Begins with “Interactions between …”, followed by the interacting entities; all three examples show high activation on “Interactions”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstract headings

patterns.name: Word-initial “Assessment” and title phrasing
patterns.context: Begins with “Assessment of …”, describing the evaluation of an effect, change, condition, or method.

patterns.name: Other forms of Assessment or repeated formatting
patterns.context: Includes a title opening with “Assessing …”, or “Assessment Only” in a table or form, including repeated line breaks.
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, administrative or financial text

patterns.name: Accounting item enumeration
patterns.context: “Assets” appears as the first item in a financial enumeration, followed by liabilities, expenses, and income.

7_1247.concept: 标题开头的词汇与格式线索
7_1247.description: 强烈响应 Interactions 和 Assessment/Assessing 词首，尤其是生物医学标题中的标题式开头；另响应财务列举中的 Assets 及表单标签 Assessment Only。

patterns.name: “Interactions”标题开头
patterns.context: 以“Interactions between …”开头，后接相互作用的对象；三例均以“Interactions”高激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要标题

patterns.name: “Assessment”词首及标题句式
patterns.context: 以“Assessment of …”开头，描述对某种效应、变化、病症或方法的评估。

patterns.name: Assessment 的其他形式或重复排版
patterns.context: 出现“Assessing …”标题开头，或表格/表单中的“Assessment Only”及换行重复。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、行政或财务文本

patterns.name: 会计项目列举
patterns.context: “Assets”作为财务项目列举的首项，后续列出负债、费用和收入。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to title-like research topic openings in biomedical papers followed by “of,” especially “Analysis of”; also responds to nominalized title openings such as “Assignment of” and “Periodicity of”.

patterns.name: Title-like “Analysis of”
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a sentence or title, followed by a research subject or process; this is the clearest shared form.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstract subheadings

patterns.name: Other research title openings
patterns.context: Begins with a nominalized research topic, followed later by “of” introducing the research subject or topic; “Analysis” is absent.

7_1247.concept: 生物医学标题中的“X of”结构
7_1247.description: 主要对生物医学论文中标题式的研究主题开头及其后接“of”敏感，尤其是“Analysis of”；另对“Assignment of”和“Periodicity of”这类名词化标题开头有反应。

patterns.name: 标题式“Analysis of”
patterns.context: 位于句首或标题开头，后接研究对象或过程；是最明显的共同形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要小标题

patterns.name: 其他研究标题开头
patterns.context: 以名词化研究主题开头，并在后文用“of”引出研究对象或主题；未出现“Analysis”。

en.description: All snippets mark from, which has the highest activation; it occurs in expressions of source, origin, derivation, and inverse coordinate transformations. Nearby articles, prepositions, and technical content vary, and no stable trigger pattern independent of from is apparent.

patterns.name: Source or origin expressions introduced by from
patterns.context: Appears in phrases explaining where, from whom, or on what basis something arises, begins, or is transformed; nearby elements often include to, a, the, or formulas/technical terms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English technical explanations, code comments, Q&A, and narrative

patterns.name: Function words and local collocations adjacent to from
patterns.context: These words also activate in multiple snippets, but generally less strongly than from; they occur in varied syntactic positions and show no stable independent semantic condition.

7_1247.concept: from及来源/起点关系
7_1247.description: 所有片段都标记了 from，且强度最高；它出现在来源、起点、推导依据、坐标反变换等表达中。周围冠词、介词及技术内容各异，暂看不出独立于 from 的稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: from 引出的来源或起点表达
