patterns.context: 出现在说明某事物从何处、由何者或根据什么产生、开始、转换的短语中；附近常见 to、a、the 或公式/术语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文技术说明、代码注释、问答及叙述

patterns.name: 与 from 相邻的功能词和局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些词在多个片段中也有激活，但强度通常低于 from，分布于多种句法位置，未显示稳定的独立语义条件。

en.description: Activations concentrate on derivation transitions and explanations following equations in mathematical discourse, especially steps introduced by “Then”; there are also responses to corollaries, proofs, guarantees, definitions, calculations, and “where”-style explanations of conditions.

patterns.name: Derivation steps introduced by “Then”
patterns.context: Follows an equation or prior discussion and introduces the next derivation, calculation, or conclusion; Then is marked in multiple passages

patterns.name: Summary inferences after a theorem, equation, or argument
patterns.context: Explains that an equation or prior conditions support a conclusion, property, or subsequent construction

patterns.name: Explanation of relations or conditions following equations
patterns.context: Adds definitions of variables, functions, or conditions in equations after a formula
patterns.domain: Explanations of formulas in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Proof process and mathematical conclusion terms
patterns.context: Describes proof, guarantees, definitions, or calculations in formal mathematical derivations; the trigger words vary, but all occur near equations

7_1247.concept: 数学推导衔接与说明
7_1247.description: 激活集中于数学论述中的推导衔接和公式后说明，尤其是“Then”引出步骤；另对推论、证明、保证、定义、计算及“where”式条件解释有响应。

patterns.name: “Then”引出的推导步骤
patterns.context: 位于公式或先前论述之后，引入接下来的推导、计算或结论；在多个段落中标记的都是 Then

patterns.name: 定理、等式或论证后的总结推论
patterns.trigger: “So actually”“It follows”“which is consistent with”“which is compatible with”“Then, as you noted”
patterns.context: 说明公式或先前条件支持某个结论、性质或后续构造

patterns.name: 公式后的关系或条件说明
patterns.context: 公式之后补充定义变量、函数或方程中的条件
patterns.domain: 数学论文中的公式说明

patterns.name: 证明过程与数学结论词
patterns.context: 在形式化数学推导中说明证明、保证、定义或计算操作；触发词彼此不同，均出现在公式附近

en.description: Activations occur mainly in mathematical LaTeX text, especially the set-membership symbol \in and nearby formulas, variables, and line breaks; there are also norm formulas and questions about Borel sets.

patterns.name: Set-membership symbol in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical definitions, propositions, or formulas to indicate that an object belongs to a set; often adjacent to variables, set names, and formula punctuation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers and math Q&A, mainly LaTeX

patterns.name: Formula boundaries and line breaks in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on formulas or boundaries between formulas and prose, including multiline layouts; these positions also often co-occur with set-membership symbols, so it is unclear whether line breaks are an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Norms and operator expressions
patterns.context: Formula fragments containing operator norms, matrix quantities, and their definitions; no clear \in trigger is observed.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, possibly linear algebra or analysis

patterns.name: Textual mentions of Borel sets
patterns.context: Natural-language questions repeatedly mention Borel sets, topological space, open, or closed; formulas and \in also occur locally.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的集合隶属符号
7_1247.description: 激活主要出现在数学 LaTeX 文本，尤其集合隶属符号 \in 及其邻近的公式、变量和换行处；另有范数公式与 Borel 集问答。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的集合隶属符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学定义、命题或公式中，表示对象属于集合；常邻接变量、集合名及公式标点。
patterns.domain: 数学论文及数学问答，主要为 LaTeX

patterns.name: 数学排版中的公式边界与换行
patterns.trigger: 公式附近的换行符「↵」，以及 $$、\[、\begin{aligned} 等公式结构
patterns.context: 激活集中于公式或公式与正文的边界、跨行排列处；这些位置也常与集合隶属符号同现，不能确定换行本身是否独立触发。

patterns.name: 范数与算子表达式
patterns.context: 算子范数、矩阵量及其定义所在的公式片段；未见明显的 \in 触发。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，可能涉及线性代数或分析

patterns.name: Borel 集合的文字提及
patterns.trigger: 「Borel subset」及其在拓扑空间中的定义与提问
patterns.context: 自然语言问题中重复出现 Borel 集、topological space、open 或 closed；局部也有公式及 \in。

en.description: Responds broadly to mathematical typesetting: operations, relations, limits, summations, and subscript/superscript structures in formulas are most prominent; also responds to formula line breaks and adjacent English conditions, corollaries, and explanations. Occurs across multiple mathematical fields.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Structured symbols appear in mathematical formulas or displayed equations; surrounding content usually includes variables, sets, functions, or equations
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers and math Q&A; spans [1]–[10]

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers near mathematical formulas
patterns.context: When formulas span lines or are embedded in paper formatting; these markers commonly occur together with mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Connectives in English mathematical discourse
patterns.context: Interleaved with formula content in English explanations or statements of theorems and conditions
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers or math Q&A; spans [2], [3], [4], [6], [7], [8], [9], [10]

7_1247.concept: 数学公式与论文排版
7_1247.description: 对数学排版文本有广泛响应：公式中的运算、关系、极限、求和与上下标结构最突出，也响应公式换行及相邻的英文条件、推论和解释；跨多个数学领域出现。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.trigger: 诸如「\sum」「\oplus」「\lim」「\prod」「\in」「\rightarrow」「\leq」及公式中的上下标、括号
patterns.context: 数学公式或行间公式中出现结构化符号；周围通常是变量、集合、函数或等式
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及数学问答；覆盖 [1]–[10]

patterns.name: 数学公式附近的换行与排版标记
patterns.context: 公式跨行或嵌入论文排版时；这类标记常与数学符号共同出现

patterns.name: 英文数学论述中的连接词
patterns.context: 英文解释或陈述定理、条件、推论时，与公式内容交错

en.description: Activations concentrate on examples, explanations, and transitional expressions, especially for example and commas; they also cover Q&A requests, code callbacks, mathematical instructions, medical associations, and patent phrasing, with some patterns represented by only one example.

patterns.name: Example-introducing expressions and their punctuation
patterns.context: Phrases introducing examples; occur in varied contexts including academic writing, patents, Q&A, and code

patterns.name: Expressions of recency, interest, and use
patterns.context: Introduces recent interest or the use of a material in patent background sections

patterns.name: Introducing a topic and suggesting a fresh review
patterns.context: A paper proposes reanalyzing recent experimental data from a different perspective

patterns.name: Requests or examples in Q&A
patterns.context: Asks about an operation or implementation method in a StackExchange question

patterns.name: Code callbacks and parameter separators
patterns.context: A callback function is separated by commas and a closing parenthesis in an asynchronous JavaScript call

patterns.name: Factorization instruction in a math problem
patterns.context: Requests the prime factorization of a given integer

patterns.name: Statistical association and interaction statements
patterns.context: Reports statistical associations among genetic variants, treatment factors, and disease risk

patterns.name: Factual and conditional statements in explanatory patent phrasing
patterns.context: Describes specific circumstances, conditions, or arguments in patent background text

patterns.name: Examples and citation format in patent text
patterns.context: Lists device examples and introduces a Japanese published application in a patent description

patterns.name: Causal and illustrative transitions in patent technology text
patterns.context: First describes a technical consequence, then gives a communications system as an example

patterns.name: Local high-frequency words or affix triggers
patterns.context: Appears only in individual snippets; insufficient evidence that these each constitute a stable pattern

7_1247.concept: 说明与举例的衔接表达
7_1247.description: 激活集中于例示、解释和衔接表达，尤其是 for example 及逗号；也覆盖问答请求、代码回调、数学指令、医学关联和专利句式，部分模式仅单例。

patterns.name: 例示用语及其标点
patterns.context: 例子引入语；在学术、专利、问答和代码等多种上下文中出现

patterns.name: 近期、兴趣与用途表述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中介绍近期关注或某项材料的用途

patterns.name: 话题引出与建议重新审视
patterns.context: 论文中提出对近期实验数据采用不同视角重新分析

patterns.name: 问答中的请求或举例
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题描述中询问某种操作或实现方式

patterns.name: 代码回调与参数分隔
patterns.context: JavaScript 异步调用中，以逗号和闭括号分隔回调函数

patterns.name: 数学题中的因数分解指令
patterns.context: 要求列出给定整数的质因数

patterns.name: 统计关联与交互作用表述
patterns.trigger: “interaction with HRT”、“interactions between HRT and numbers of”
patterns.context: 报告遗传变异、治疗因素与疾病风险之间的统计关联

patterns.name: 说明性专利句式中的事实与条件
patterns.trigger: “regardless of whether”、“In particular, for example, in view of the fact that”
patterns.context: 阐述专利背景中的具体情形、条件或论据

patterns.name: 专利文本中的举例与引用格式
patterns.trigger: “Examples of this … are as follows. For example, Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication”
patterns.context: 专利说明中列举设备实例并引出日本公开申请

patterns.name: 专利技术因果与示例衔接
patterns.trigger: “with the result that it cannot be done away with”及“in xDSL systems … for example”
patterns.context: 先说明技术后果，再以通信系统举例

patterns.name: 局部高频词或词缀触发
patterns.context: 仅在个别片段中出现；缺乏足够证据表明它们各自构成稳定模式

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal decision boilerplate and citations, gluing in code, quantum-physics assumptions, and biomedical discussions of materials, receptors, cell distribution, and cancer comparisons; there is no clear shared local trigger or unified semantics.

patterns.name: “or” and legal citation punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in appellate decision paragraphs, connecting litigation issues or introducing rules, section numbers, and legal citations in parentheses; both “or” and citation punctuation activate in this passage.

patterns.name: The word form gluing and gluing in code
patterns.context: A code string describes constructing a Scheme by gluing X and Y along U; activation falls on the token fragments of gluing.

patterns.name: Relationship between ceramic morphology and material properties
patterns.context: Discusses the morphology, defects, fracture strength, and improved surface properties of polycrystalline alumina ceramic brackets.

patterns.name: Court decision phrasing and party possessives
patterns.context: A judge states a decision on criminal convictions and sentences, with attorney information and appellate decision boilerplate.

patterns.name: Default judgment and summary judgment
patterns.context: A party fails to respond to a summary judgment motion; the court cites uncontroverted facts and rules; square brackets mark editorial additions in a citation.

patterns.name: A single local setting in mathematical physics
patterns.context: Introduces a single local setting assumption after mathematical statements involving Pauli operators, observables, and multiple observers.

patterns.name: Administrative litigation and legislative or administrative remedies
patterns.context: An appellant seeks judicial review of administrative action; the court finds that relief is available only through legislative or administrative channels and dismisses the request.

patterns.name: Receptor binding and biological response
patterns.context: Compares the effects of gangliosides on CT and hCG binding, action, and response, involving receptor complexes.

patterns.name: Tissue distribution of enteric glial cells
patterns.context: Describes the distribution and numerical differences of GFAP-expressing enteric glial cells in the plexuses and muscle layers of the bovine jejunum.

patterns.name: Cancer mortality comparison
patterns.context: Compares cancer deaths in the U.S. population, with lung cancer compared against several other cancers.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstract or public health statement

7_1247.concept: none
7_1247.description: 激活分散于法律判决套语与引文、代码中的 gluing、量子物理假设，以及生物医学中的材料、受体、细胞分布和癌症比较；没有明显共享的局部触发词或统一语义。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的“or”及法律引文标点
patterns.context: 出现在上诉裁决段落，连接诉讼事项或引出规则、条款编号及括号内的法律引文；本段对“or”和引文标点均有激活。

patterns.name: gluing 词形及代码中的 gluing
patterns.context: 代码字符串描述将 X、Y 沿 U 粘合构造 Scheme；激活落在 gluing 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 陶瓷形貌与材料性能关系
patterns.trigger: «relationship»2« to»2 fracture toughness« and»4 strength；«the»4 morphology；«the»2 surface characteristics
patterns.context: 讨论多晶氧化铝陶瓷托槽的形貌、缺陷、断裂强度及改善表面特性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要，材料性能

patterns.name: 法院判决措辞及当事人所有格
patterns.context: 法官陈述对刑事定罪和刑罚的裁决，并带有律师信息及上诉判决套语。

patterns.name: 缺席答辩与简易判决
patterns.trigger: failed to« file»2« a»2 response；«summary»1 judgment；«[»2«by»5«]»9
patterns.context: 当事人未回应简易判决动议，法院援引未否认事实及规则；方括号标记引文中的编辑补字。

patterns.name: 数学物理中的单一局域设置
patterns.trigger: «Assume»1« that»9 local settings are parameterized« by»3« a»2« single»1
patterns.context: 在 Pauli 算符、观测量及多方观察者的数学表述后，引入单一局域设置假设。

patterns.name: 行政诉讼及立法、行政救济渠道
patterns.trigger: «through»9« legislative»3« or»3« executive»2 channels；«dismissed» the« claim»3
patterns.context: 上诉人寻求对行政行为的司法审查，法院认为救济只能通过立法或行政渠道取得并驳回请求。

patterns.name: 受体结合与生物学响应
patterns.trigger: «the»3« binding»4« and»4 action；«Both»9 hCG-« and»6 CT-receptor complexes
patterns.context: 比较 gangliosides 对 CT 与 hCG 结合、作用和响应的影响，涉及受体复合物。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要，细胞生物学

patterns.name: 肠神经胶质细胞的组织分布
patterns.trigger: «the»3« bovine»3 jejunum；«presence»6« of»« a»4« large»2 subpopulation；«only»9« few»4
patterns.context: 描述牛空肠中表达 GFAP 的肠神经胶质细胞在神经丛和肌层的分布及数量差异。

patterns.name: 癌症死亡率比较
patterns.trigger: die« from»2 lung cancer« than»3« from»9 prostate, breast, colon and rectum
patterns.context: 美国人群癌症死亡数量的比较陈述，肺癌与多种癌症并列比较。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要或公共卫生陈述

en.concept: Relation and condition markers in structured technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across piecewise mathematical definitions, relations or scope introduced by by/in, legal procedural phrasing, code definitions, medical effects, and Java exception logs; no single content theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: Piecewise definitions and conditional branches
patterns.context: Mathematical expressions use a cases environment to define functions, variables, or piecewise values by condition; if conditions are common.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and statistics papers or solutions

patterns.name: Manner or basis introduced by “by”
patterns.context: In body text, by introduces composition, manner, source, or implementation method; nearby connecting structures such as and and along may also occur.

patterns.name: Scope, location, or state introduced by “in”
patterns.context: in is followed by a numerical range, abstract dimension, duration, or mathematical set; typically occurs in a narrative sentence or formula definition.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical abstracts, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: Procedural and remedial phrasing in legal decisions
patterns.context: Describes appeals, jurisdiction, vacating a judgment, remand, or judicial review and other litigation procedures.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Definitions and member calls in code
patterns.context: Code or technical descriptions include method definitions, member access, function declarations, or instructions for using a code block.

patterns.name: Comparison of pain treatment effects
patterns.context: Compares the magnitude and duration of improvements in pain-related behavior after inoculation with different carriers.

patterns.name: Causal marker in an exception stack trace
patterns.context: In Android/Java error logs, Caused by introduces an exception type.

7_1247.concept: 结构化技术文本中的关系与条件标记
7_1247.description: 激活分散于数学分段定义、by/in 引出的关系或范围、法律程序措辞、代码定义，以及医学效果和 Java 异常日志；没有单一内容主题能解释所有例子。

patterns.name: 分段定义与条件分支
patterns.context: 数学表达式中用 cases 环境按条件定义函数、变量或分段取值；常见 if 条件。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理与统计学论文或解答

patterns.name: “by”引出的方式或依据
patterns.trigger: « by»；« by» an interaction；« obtained by»
patterns.context: 正文中 by 引出构成、方式、来源或实现手段；附近也可能出现 and、along 等连接结构。

patterns.name: “in”引出的范围、位置或状态
patterns.context: in 后接数值范围、抽象维度、时长，或数学集合；通常处于叙述句或公式定义中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学摘要与数学文本

patterns.name: 法律判决中的程序与救济措辞
patterns.trigger: « sentence»；« jurisdiction»；« vacate»；« remand»；« judicial»；« dismissed»
patterns.context: 描述上诉、管辖权、撤销判决、发回重审或司法审查等诉讼程序。

patterns.name: 代码中的定义与成员调用
patterns.context: 代码或技术说明中出现方法定义、成员访问、函数声明，或对代码块用法的指示。

patterns.name: 疼痛治疗效果比较
patterns.trigger: « in» pain-related behavior；« magnitude»；« longer in duration»；« inoculation»
patterns.context: 比较不同载体接种后疼痛相关行为改善的幅度和持续时间。

patterns.name: 异常堆栈中的因果标记
patterns.context: Android/Java 错误日志中，以 Caused by 引出异常类型。

en.concept: Conditions and structure in mathematical formulas
en.description: Activations concentrate mainly in LaTeX mathematical text, especially piecewise definitions and condition lines containing if/for, relation symbols, and cases/array structures; they also cover general equation environments and formal statements around formulas that explain objects, conditions, or properties. Some punctuation may be incidental.

patterns.name: “if” conditions in piecewise definitions
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions, conditions in piecewise functions or cases/array are introduced by condition phrases, often accompanied by condition variables and inequalities or relation symbols.
patterns.domain: Formal technical writing in mathematical papers and math Q&A

patterns.name: Equation environments and structural control symbols
patterns.context: Structural boundaries and nearby content in LaTeX formulas, matrices, or piecewise expressions; may co-occur with condition text but does not require if.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, mainly ArXiv; also StackExchange

patterns.name: Mathematical relations and connectives in formulas
patterns.context: In formal mathematical statements, natural language before and after formulas explains objects, conditions, definitions, or properties; trigger words are distributed, with no single fixed term apparent.

patterns.name: Commas and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation and phrase transitions near formulas or mathematical terms; may be an incidental feature of a broader mathematical typesetting/context pattern, with limited explanatory power on its own.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的条件与结构
7_1247.description: 激活主要集中于 LaTeX 数学文本，尤其是分段定义及条件行中的 if/for、关系符号和 cases/array 结构；也覆盖一般公式环境，以及公式周围解释对象、条件或性质的正式表述。个别标点可能只是伴随特征。

patterns.name: 分段定义中的“if”条件
patterns.context: 数学表达式中，分段函数或 cases/array 的各行以条件短语引出，常伴随条件变量与不等式或关系符号。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的正式技术写作

patterns.name: 公式环境与结构控制符
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式、矩阵或分段表达式的结构边界及其紧邻内容；可能与条件文本共同出现，但不要求出现 if。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，主要为 ArXiv；另有 StackExchange

patterns.name: 数学关系与公式中的连接词
patterns.trigger: “where”“for all”“whenever”“is measurable”“the unitary operator”“interaction of the type”
patterns.context: 正式数学陈述中，公式前后用自然语言说明对象、条件、定义或性质；触发词分散，未见单一固定词项。

patterns.name: 逗号及邻接标点
patterns.context: 公式或数学术语附近的标点与短语衔接处；可能是更广泛数学排版/语境模式的伴随特征，单独解释力有限。

en.concept: Condition and relation introducers in formulas
en.description: Primarily responds to words introducing conditions, definitions, and coordination near formulas (such as where, with, if, for, whenever, and and), especially when co-occurring with LaTeX structures such as aligned/cases; also has sporadic responses to in in equations, Then in derivations, and by in abstracts.

patterns.name: Condition/variable introduction in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In mathematical or scientific statements, these words introduce definitions, conditions, cases, or parallel items, often at the boundary between formulas and natural language; both the trigger words and nearby formula tokens activate.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and scientific paper formulas; also mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Piecewise expression markers
patterns.context: In piecewise definitions or formulas, the cases environment and nearby if/for conditions and branch content; occurs in only a few passages.

patterns.name: Aligned formula environment
patterns.context: Near an aligned environment displaying multi-line equations, definitions, or boundary conditions, often accompanied by line breaks and formula structure.

patterns.name: in conditions in problems or equations
patterns.context: After an equation, in specifies a region, space, or condition, followed by a mathematical object such as “\Omega”; especially prominent in passage 4.
patterns.domain: Partial differential equations and boundary value problems

patterns.name: Then in natural-language derivations
patterns.context: In a probability inequality derivation, Then introduces a conclusion after an assumption, followed by a line break and formula.

patterns.name: Treatment or influence introduced by in scientific abstracts
patterns.context: In descriptions of experimental results, by introduces a treatment factor or source of effect, appearing in a pharmacology abstract sentence.

7_1247.concept: 公式中的条件与关系引导
7_1247.description: 主要响应公式邻近的条件、定义和并列关系引导词（如 where、with、if、for、whenever、and），尤其是与 aligned/cases 等 LaTeX 结构共现；另对方程中的 in、推导中的 Then 及摘要中的 by 有零星响应。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的条件/变量引出
patterns.context: 数学或科学陈述中，这些词引出定义、条件、分情形或并列项，常位于公式与自然语言的交界处；触发词本身及其邻近公式 token 激活。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及科学论文公式；也见数学问答

patterns.name: 分段表达式标记
patterns.context: 分段定义或公式中，cases 环境及其附近的 if/for 条件和分支内容；仅出现于少数段。

patterns.name: 对齐公式环境
patterns.context: 展示多行等式、定义或边界条件的 aligned 环境附近，常伴随换行和公式结构。

patterns.name: 问题或方程中的 in 条件
patterns.context: 方程后用 in 指明区域、空间或条件，后接“\Omega”等数学对象；第4段尤其明显。
patterns.domain: 偏微分方程及边界值问题

patterns.name: 自然语言中的 then 推导
patterns.context: 概率不等式推导中，在假设之后以 Then 引出结论，并接换行与公式。

patterns.name: 科学摘要中的由…影响/处理
patterns.context: 实验结果叙述中，by 引出处理因素或作用来源，处于药理学摘要的句子中。

en.description: Most activations occur in condition explanations in mathematical formulas, especially “with”, “if”, “whenever”, and nearby formula delimiters; there are also lists of issues in legal documents and career narratives in football biographies.

patterns.name: Condition-introducing phrases in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Specifies the domain of a variable, function conditions, or index relations in a formula; nearby content often includes braces, alignment environments, or piecewise definitions.

patterns.name: Condition markers in piecewise definitions
patterns.context: A condition is followed by an inequality or variable value, usually within a piecewise formula such as cases/array.

patterns.name: Relation-condition markers in formulas
patterns.context: A natural-language phrase introduces conditions on variables or indices.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, matrix or set-relation formulas

patterns.name: “with” condition phrases in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Immediately after a formula definition, subsequent text gives additional constraints on variables, vectors, or matrices.

patterns.name: Enumeration of issues in legal argument
patterns.context: A legal opinion or decision summarizes a party’s claim that a lower court erred and lists the reasons.

patterns.name: Career description in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A biographical entry introduces a retired footballer and their professional career.

7_1247.concept: 条件引导表达及局部列举
7_1247.description: 多数激活出现在数学公式的条件说明处，尤其是“with”“if”“whenever”及其附近的公式括号；另有法律文书的争点列举和足球人物简介中的生涯叙述。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的条件引导短语
patterns.trigger: “with”后接“in”“if”“whenever”之一，常引出数学条件；如“with { }”, “{ if }”, “{ whenever }”
patterns.context: 公式中说明变量所在区域、函数条件或指标关系；附近常有大括号、对齐环境或分段定义。

patterns.name: 分段定义中的条件标记
patterns.trigger: “if”及其邻近的“{”“\text{”“}”，如“{ if }”“\text{ if } x < 0”
patterns.context: 条件后接不等式或变量取值，通常位于 cases/array 等分段公式中。

patterns.name: 公式中的关系条件标记
patterns.context: 以自然语言短语引出变量或指标成立条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、矩阵或集合关系公式

patterns.name: 数学公式里的“with”条件短语
patterns.context: 紧接公式定义后，后续给出变量、向量或矩阵的附加约束。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的争点列举
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决书中概述一方指称下级法院错误，并列出理由。

patterns.name: 人物简介中的生涯描述
patterns.context: 人物条目介绍退役足球运动员及其职业经历。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、体育人物条目

en.description: Primarily responds to “for all,” which introduces universal conditions in mathematical formulas and formal definitions, especially when followed by a variable or condition; also responds slightly to “on,” describing the object of an operator in mathematical descriptions, and “and” when listing materials in legal documents.

patterns.name: Existential quantifier condition in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Introduces a universal condition in mathematical statements or piecewise definitions, often appearing in a formula environment
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical computer science, and related academic papers

patterns.name: Preposition on in English syntax
patterns.context: Describes an operator or object acting on a space, set, or object; more prominent when followed by a mathematical space

patterns.name: and in legal arguments
patterns.context: Legal documents list litigation materials or parallel arguments, appearing in phrases such as “letters and affidavits”

7_1247.concept: 条件引入与并列连接词
7_1247.description: 主要响应数学公式与形式化定义中引出全称条件的“for all”，尤其后接变量或条件；少量响应数学描述算子作用对象的“on”，以及法律文书列举材料时的“and”。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的存在量词条件
patterns.trigger: «for»« all»« »，尤其它们后接变量或条件
patterns.context: 数学陈述或分段定义中，引入全称条件，常出现在公式环境里
patterns.domain: 数学、理论计算机及相关学术论文

patterns.name: 英文句法中的介词 on
patterns.context: 描述算子或对象作用于某个空间、集合或对象；后接数学空间时更明显

patterns.name: 法律论证中的 and
patterns.context: 法律文书列举诉讼材料或并列论点，位于“letters and affidavits”一类短语中

en.description: Sensitive to conditional statements in mathematical formulas and technical texts, especially words such as “for all,” “if,” and “where,” and nearby formula structures; commonly found in set constraints, piecewise definitions, boundary conditions, and statements of variable scope.

patterns.name: Mathematical conditional phrase “for all”
patterns.context: A conditional word introduces a variable, domain, or piecewise condition; typically appears in English mathematical explanations following a formula.

patterns.name: Piecewise conditions and boundary symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Formulas contain piecewise definitions, set conditions, boundary conditions, or aligned mathematical expressions; activation often falls on conditional lead-ins and nearby structural symbols.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and scientific papers, including typeset formulas

patterns.name: Set and quantifier constraints
patterns.context: Constraints on mathematical objects are stated using set relations, membership relations, and universal conditions.

patterns.name: English explanatory phrases following formulas
patterns.context: Brief English statements near mathematical formulas explain variables, scope, or definitions; these words often occur at the boundary between formulas and natural-language explanations.

patterns.name: Local triggers at word boundaries or in formula contexts
patterns.context: In addition to general conditional expressions, some activations may be triggered by local word forms or typesetting near formula boundaries; the examples available are insufficient for further subdivision.

7_1247.concept: 数学公式中的条件说明
7_1247.description: 在数学公式及技术文本中，对条件性说明尤其“for all”“if”“where”等词及其邻近的公式结构敏感；常见于集合约束、分段定义、边界条件和变量适用范围的表述。

patterns.name: 数学条件引导词“for all”
patterns.context: 条件词引出变量、定义域或分段条件；通常出现在公式后的英文数学说明中。

patterns.name: 公式中条件分段与边界符号
patterns.context: 公式中出现分段定义、集合条件、边界条件或对齐的数学表达；激活常落在条件引导语及其附近的结构符号上。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学论文，含公式排版

patterns.name: 集合与量词约束
patterns.context: 用集合关系、属于关系和全称条件陈述数学对象的约束。

patterns.name: 公式后的英文解释性短语
patterns.context: 数学公式附近以简短英文交代变量、适用范围或定义；这些词常出现在公式与自然语言说明的交界处。

patterns.name: 单词边界或公式语境中的局部触发
patterns.context: 除通用条件表达外，部分激活可能由公式边界附近的局部词形或排版触发，现有例子不足以进一步细分。

en.concept: Structural function words in specific genres
en.description: Primarily activates in appellate legal documents discussing court rulings, errors, claims, and procedures, often on function words such as that, the, and, or, and by; also appears on mathematical condition if and conjunctions and articles in recipe steps.

patterns.name: Issues and rulings in legal opinions
patterns.context: Legal documents discuss whether a district court erred, whether a constitutional claim is arguable, procedural rulings, or appellate issues; activations often fall on function words in these constructions, as well as near numbered issues and headings.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, appellate opinions, decisions, and criminal procedure documents

patterns.name: Condition words in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Introduces a condition in a mathematical formula or piecewise definition (such as if |X|≤1); seen only once in the current sample.

patterns.name: Operational conjunctions in recipe instructions
patterns.context: Recipes use imperative sentences to connect ingredients and actions; activations fall on ordinary function words in the instructions rather than prominent ingredient names.

7_1247.concept: 特定文体中的结构性功能词
7_1247.description: 主要激活于上诉法律文书中讨论法院裁决、错误、主张和程序的句式，常落在 that、the、and、or、by 等功能词；另见数学条件 if，以及食谱步骤中的连接词和冠词。

patterns.name: 法律意见的争点与裁判表述
patterns.context: 法律文书中论述地区法院是否犯错、宪法主张是否可争辩、程序裁决或上诉争点；激活常落在这些句式中的功能词，也包括编号争点和标题附近。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，上诉意见、判决及刑事程序文书

patterns.name: 数学表达中的条件词
patterns.context: 数学公式或分段定义中引入条件（如 if |X|≤1）；当前样本只见一次。

patterns.name: 食谱指令中的操作连接词
patterns.context: 食谱用祈使句连接配料与操作；激活落在说明文字的普通功能词上，而非显著的食材名。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal texts and mathematical formulas: in legal passages they often fall on that-clauses and words related to courts, claims, and procedure; in formulas they repeatedly fall on conditional expressions such as for/all/every and in, with sporadic triggers on equals signs, multiplication signs, and punctuation.

patterns.name: that in English conditional sentences
patterns.context: Introduces a claim, judgment, or conclusion in legal reasoning; also occurs in mathematical corpora in formula conditions «for» ...

patterns.name: Function-word sequences in legal style
patterns.context: Describes court rulings, parties’ claims, and litigation procedures in judicial opinions; activation falls on multiple common function words in continuous argumentation

patterns.name: for conditions in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Specifies the range conditions satisfied by variables or objects in formulas, definitions, or boundary-value problems
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers and StackExchange mathematics content

patterns.name: in and mathematical objects in formulas
patterns.context: Indicates that a variable belongs to a region or set in a mathematical expression; may co-occur with for conditions
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical papers, StackExchange mathematics content

patterns.name: Equals signs in formulas
patterns.context: Defines operators or expressions in mathematical formulas; in this example, the trigger marker occurs on the equals sign

patterns.name: Multiplication signs in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Indicates multiplication or quantities being multiplied in a formula

patterns.name: Commas in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Punctuation in formulas or explanatory text in mathematical papers; occurs in isolation, without a clear shared meaning

patterns.name: that-clauses and disputed conclusions in legal sentences
patterns.context: Addresses legal issues such as arguability, constitutional claims, or withdrawal from a conspiracy defense

patterns.name: Ruling-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses district court rulings on claims or procedural issues

patterns.name: Unpublished-opinion wording
patterns.context: Explains the precedential effect of unpublished decisions in court opinions

patterns.name: Boundary-value problem expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas for partial differential equations or acoustics problems

patterns.name: for x in probability densities
patterns.context: States the range of variable values after a probability density expression

patterns.name: for conditions in asymptotic estimates
patterns.context: Specifies the variable range over which an asymptotic estimate applies

patterns.name: Universal condition for fractional perimeter
patterns.context: States that the fractional perimeter is finite over a range of parameters

7_1247.concept: 条件与从句引导词
7_1247.description: 激活分散在法律文本与数学公式中：法律段落里常落在 that 从句及法院、主张、程序等词；公式里反复落在 for/all/every、in 等条件表达，也有等号、乘号及标点等零散触发。

patterns.name: 英语条件句中的 that
patterns.context: 法律论证中引出主张、判断或结论；在数学语料中也见于公式条件 «for» ...
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院意见书、数学论文

patterns.name: 法律语体中的功能词序列
patterns.trigger: «the»、«his»、«and»、«from»、«of» 等；并伴随 district court、constitutional claims、defense 等法律词语
patterns.context: 司法意见书中描述法院裁定、当事人主张及诉讼程序；激活落在连续论述中的多个常见功能词上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 for 条件
patterns.trigger: «for»，以及相邻的 «all»、«every»；常见结构为 «for» ... «all» 或 «for» ... «every»
patterns.context: 公式、定义或边界值问题中说明变量或对象所满足的范围条件
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及 StackExchange 数学内容

patterns.name: 公式中的 in 及数学对象
patterns.trigger: «in»，邻近 Ω、\mathbb{R}^d、x 等集合或变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中表示变量属于某个区域或集合；可与 for 条件同现
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学内容

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 数学公式定义算子或表达式；本例中触发标记出现在等号上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的乘号
patterns.context: 公式中表示乘法或数量相乘

patterns.name: 数学符号中的逗号
patterns.context: 数学论文公式或说明文字里的标点；孤立出现，缺少明确共同语义

patterns.name: 法律句中的 that 从句与争议结论
patterns.trigger: «that»，后接 «any»、«his» 或 «the» 等从句成分
patterns.context: 论证可争辩性、宪法主张或撤出共谋抗辩等法律问题

patterns.name: 裁定相关词汇
patterns.context: 讨论地区法院对主张或程序问题的裁定

patterns.name: 未发表意见书措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见书中说明未发表判决的先例效力

patterns.name: 边界值问题表达
patterns.context: 偏微分方程或声学问题的数学公式

patterns.name: 概率密度中的 for x
patterns.context: 概率密度表达式后说明变量取值范围

patterns.name: 渐近估计中的 for 条件
patterns.context: 给出渐近估计所适用的变量范围

patterns.name: 分数阶周长的全称条件
patterns.context: 说明分数阶周长对一段参数范围均有限

en.description: Activations mainly occur in federal appellate decisions, especially legal arguments introduced by that, descriptions of appellate procedure, lists of issues, and rulings; two other passages are mathematical paper formulas involving set relations and boundary value problems.

patterns.name: Legal arguments in that-clauses
patterns.context: Appears in the reasoning sentences of court opinions, introducing findings of fact, legal standards, or subordinate claims; often near words such as claims, error, and court.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate decisions, legal documents

patterns.name: Appellate rulings and procedural conclusions
patterns.context: The appellate court states the procedural status of a case or delivers a ruling, usually in the body of an opinion.

patterns.name: Lists of issues and procedural actions
patterns.context: Lists appellate issues by number, or describes procedural/criminal legal matters such as dismissal, dismissal of an indictment, or conspiracy.

patterns.name: Set symbols and mathematical relations
patterns.context: Unions, intersections, empty sets, and index conditions in mathematical formulas; activations occur near formula symbols and conditional expressions.

patterns.name: Boundary value problems for partial differential equations
patterns.context: Defines or writes a partial differential equation and its domain conditions; activations are near text/math environment markers in the formula.
patterns.domain: Mathematics or physics papers, LaTeX formulas

7_1247.concept: 法律论证与形式化陈述
7_1247.description: 激活主要出现在联邦上诉判决中，尤其是 that 引出的法律论证、上诉程序叙述、争点列举与裁判结论；另有两段数学论文公式，分别涉及集合关系和边界值问题。

patterns.name: that 从句中的法律论证
patterns.trigger: “that”及其后接的主语、情态/判断词或论证内容，如 “that reasonable jurists would find”、“that his constitutional claims are debatable”、“show that an error or omission”
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见的论证句中，引出事实认定、法律标准或从属主张；常邻近 claims、error、court 等词。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决、法律文书

patterns.name: 上诉裁判与程序结论用语
patterns.trigger: “appeals the district court’s order”、“seeks to appeal”、“Accordingly, we affirm”、“no reversible error”
patterns.context: 上诉法院陈述案件程序状态或作出裁判结论，常见于意见书正文。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 争点列举与程序动作
patterns.trigger: “(1) by striking various letters and affidavits”、“(2) whether the district court erred”、“dismiss the indictment”、“furtherance of the conspiracy”
patterns.context: 以编号列出上诉争点，或描述撤诉、驳回起诉、共谋等程序/刑事法律事项。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 集合符号与数学关系
patterns.context: 数学公式中集合的并、交、空集及指标条件；激活落在公式符号与条件表达附近。

patterns.name: 偏微分方程边界值问题
patterns.context: 定义或书写偏微分方程及其区域条件，激活靠近公式中的文本/数学环境标记。
patterns.domain: 数学或物理学论文，LaTeX 公式

en.concept: Structured expressions in legal decisions and academic formulas
en.description: Primarily responds to procedural, review, and adjudicative wording in federal appellate decisions, especially dismiss, affirm, appeal, and fixed concluding phrases; also shows sporadic responses to trademark claims, habeas standards, criminal plain-error wording, and two types of mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Procedural wording in federal appellate opinions
patterns.context: In federal appellate court opinions, especially case summaries, reasoning, or conclusion sections; common formats include PER CURIAM, appellate review, and disposition.

patterns.name: Fixed wording at the end of decisions
patterns.context: The opinion concludes by stating that oral argument is unnecessary, often followed by reasons such as the facts and legal arguments being adequately presented.

patterns.name: Trademark infringement and cybersquatting claims
patterns.context: Lists claims related to trademark infringement and cybersquatting after the parties’ names.

patterns.name: Arguability standard for constitutional claims
patterns.context: Discusses whether a habeas petitioner meets the standard for obtaining a certificate of appealability, focusing on whether reasonable jurists would consider the constitutional claim debatable.

patterns.name: Substantial compliance with criminal procedure rules and plain error
patterns.context: Reviews whether a plea procedure substantially complied with the rules of criminal procedure and assesses errors or omissions under the plain-error standard.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation defining a Gamma subset and finite cardinality
patterns.context: Uses set construction or a definition to state that the relevant intersection/cardinality is finite for all Λ.

patterns.name: Acoustic degenerate boundary-value problem
patterns.context: Uses formulas to specify a partial differential equation and its boundary conditions in the region Ω.
patterns.domain: Mathematical or applied mathematics papers, partial differential equations/acoustics

7_1247.concept: 法律判决与学术公式中的结构化表述
7_1247.description: 主要响应联邦上诉判决中的程序、审查与裁判措辞，尤其是 dismiss、affirm、appeal 及固定结尾语；另对商标诉因、habeas 标准、刑事 plain-error 表述及两类数学公式有零星响应。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉意见中的程序性表述
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院意见书中，尤其是案件摘要、裁判理由或结论段；常见格式包括 PER CURIAM、上诉审查与处置。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦判例法律文书

patterns.name: 判决结尾的固定措辞
patterns.context: 意见书结尾说明无需口头辩论，常接事实与法律论点已充分呈现等理由。

patterns.name: 商标侵权与网络抢注诉因
patterns.context: 当事人名称之后列举商标侵权和 cybersquatting 相关诉因。

patterns.name: 宪法主张的可争辩性标准
patterns.context: 讨论 habeas 上诉人是否满足取得上诉证明的标准，关注合理法官是否会认为宪法主张可争辩。

patterns.name: 有限遵守刑事程序规则及 plain error
patterns.trigger: «Fed. R. Crim. P. 11»、«plain error standard»、«error» 或 om«ission»
patterns.context: 审查认罪程序是否实质遵守刑事诉讼规则，并按 plain-error 标准判断错误或遗漏。

patterns.name: 关于 Gamma 子集与有限基数的数学符号定义
patterns.context: 以集合构造或定义形式说明对所有 Λ，相关交集/基数有限。

patterns.name: 声学退化边界值问题
patterns.context: 通过公式给出区域 Ω 内的偏微分方程及其边界条件。
patterns.domain: 数学或应用数学论文，偏微分方程/声学

en.description: Activations most consistently occur on the conjunction and in legal-decision boilerplate, especially in “facts and legal contentions”; also appears on and in judgment dispositions, causes of action, and tort claims, responds sporadically to or in legal contexts, and occurs on colons, quantifiers, and equals signs in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Facts and legal contentions in grounds for decision
patterns.context: Occurs consistently in the appellate decision boilerplate “the facts and legal contentions are …”; activation centers on and, and partly covers a word fragment of contentions

patterns.name: Conjunction in judgment outcomes
patterns.context: Appears as AND connecting parallel outcomes in disposition language; nearby phrases include VACATED IN PART and REMANDED FOR

patterns.name: and in causes of action
patterns.context: Connects malfeasance and intentional infliction as causes of action; local evidence shows activation on and

patterns.name: and in tort claims
patterns.context: Connects claims of trademark infringement and cybersquatting

patterns.name: or in criminal appellate issues
patterns.context: Appears in alternative questions about whether to dismiss an indictment or grant a directed verdict; it is a conjunction but not and

patterns.name: Colon in an algebraic geometry parameter expression
patterns.context: Located inside a parameterized set expression, indicating points generated by parameter values

patterns.name: for all in a mathematical definition
patterns.context: Appears in a universal quantification condition in a set definition

patterns.name: Equals sign in a partial differential equation
patterns.context: Appears at the equality in the equation (P_0-λ)v=…

patterns.name: Unexplained distinctive activation
patterns.context: Markers fall on pronouns or prepositions, and the available excerpts are insufficient to confirm a shared trigger condition with other patterns

7_1247.concept: 连接与关系符号
7_1247.description: 激活最稳定地出现在法律判决套语中的并列连接词 and，尤以“facts and legal contentions”为甚；另见判决处置、诉因及侵权请求中的 and，也零散响应法律语境的 or，以及数学公式中的冒号、量词和等号。

patterns.name: 判决理由中的事实与法律论点
patterns.context: 固定出现在“the facts and legal contentions are …”这一上诉裁判套语中；激活集中于 and，部分也覆盖 contentions 的词片段

patterns.name: 判决结果中的并列连接词
patterns.context: 作为判决处置语中连接并列结果的 AND 出现，附近有 VACATED IN PART、REMANDED FOR 等措辞

patterns.name: 诉因表述中的 and
patterns.context: 连接 malfeasance 与 intentional infliction 等诉因；局部证据显示激活落在 and

patterns.name: 侵权请求中的 and
patterns.context: 连接 trademark infringement 与 cybersquatting 两项请求

patterns.name: 刑事上诉问题中的 or
patterns.context: 出现在是否撤销起诉书或准予 directed verdict 的备选问题中；是连接词但不是 and

patterns.name: 代数几何参数表达式中的冒号
patterns.context: 位于参数化集合括号内，表示参数取值所生成的点

patterns.name: 数学定义中的 for all
patterns.context: 出现在集合定义的全称量化条件中

patterns.name: 偏微分方程中的等号
patterns.context: 出现在方程 (P_0-λ)v=… 的等式位置

patterns.name: 未解释的独特激活
patterns.trigger: 上下文中可见的高激活标记为 «his»9、«of»9
patterns.context: 标记落在代词或介词上，现有片段不足以确认它们与其他模式的共同触发条件

en.concept: Structured markers in academic and legal texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across formula symbols, English function words, and words in structured tables and legal documents: mathematical definitions and equations, appellate issues and infringement claims, and groupings, sample sizes, statistical tables, and genomic figure captions in biomedical research.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and set definitions
patterns.context: Formulas use matrix, set, and polynomial-ring notation to describe objects or conditions; activation concentrates on mathematical symbols and adjacent words

patterns.name: Sample sizes and groups in clinical research tables
patterns.context: Table titles or columns juxtapose disease/status groups and sample sizes

patterns.name: Procedural and issue statements in appellate legal documents
patterns.context: Lists issues at the start of an appellate opinion, or states the parties’ appeal and the cases and requests handled by the court

patterns.name: Partial differential equations and boundary-value formulas
patterns.context: Uses equations, aligned environments, and domains to describe a degenerate boundary-value problem

patterns.name: Infringement claims in trademark litigation
patterns.context: Lists the parties to a case and describes claims such as trademark infringement and cybersquatting

patterns.name: Clinical experiment groups and statistics
patterns.context: Describes animal experiment groups, sample sizes, time points, and scores; includes formatted group labels

patterns.name: Baseline characteristics table and case-control comparison
patterns.context: Table title or headers describe baseline characteristics of cancer patients and controls, and how statistics are presented

patterns.name: Genomic regions and sample counts
patterns.context: Describes identified genomic regions or epigenetic allele sites and lists counts by sample/strain

7_1247.concept: 结构化学术与法律文本标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布于公式符号、英语功能词及结构化表格/法律文书词语：数学定义与方程、上诉争点及侵权诉因，以及生物医学研究中的分组、样本量、统计表和基因组图注。

patterns.name: 数学符号与集合定义
patterns.context: 公式中以矩阵、集合及多项式环记号描述对象或条件；激活集中在数学符号及其相邻词

patterns.name: 临床研究表格中的样本数与分组
patterns.context: 表格标题或列项中并列疾病/状态组别及样本量

patterns.name: 上诉法律文书的程序与争点表述
patterns.context: 上诉意见开头列举争点，或陈述当事人上诉及法院处理的案件与请求

patterns.name: 偏微分方程与边界值公式
patterns.context: 用方程、对齐环境和定义域描述退化边界值问题

patterns.name: 商标诉讼中的侵权主张
patterns.context: 列举案件当事方，并说明商标侵权及网络抢注等诉因

patterns.name: 临床实验分组与统计量
patterns.context: 描述动物实验的分组、样本量、时间点及评分；包含格式化组别标记

patterns.name: 基线特征表与病例对照比较
patterns.context: 表格标题或表头说明癌症患者与对照组的基线特征及统计呈现方式
patterns.domain: 临床流行病学论文表格

patterns.name: 基因组区域与样本计数
patterns.context: 说明基因组区域或表观等位基因位点的识别结果，并按样本/品系列出计数

en.concept: English structural words and quantifier notation
en.description: Across different corpora, activations are scattered across common conjunctions, numbers, and quantifier symbols in academic and legal texts; a few occur on formula formatting, table fields, figure captions, specific domain terminology, or whitespace, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantifier symbols
patterns.context: When numbers, values, or formulas connect with adjacent punctuation, units, or variables; occurs in multiple passages, but marker positions vary
patterns.domain: Statistics, measurement, and mathematical expressions in scientific papers

patterns.name: Prepositions and conjunctions
patterns.context: Serve as connecting elements in English sentences or noun phrases; trigger words and syntactic environments vary across passages
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English academic texts and legal documents

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near LaTeX commands, environment boundaries, or mathematical formatting symbols in formula environments
patterns.domain: Mathematics and partial differential equation papers

patterns.name: Tables and structured fields
patterns.context: In titles, column names, and statistical summaries of baseline characteristic or study population tables
patterns.domain: Medical paper tables and tabular text

patterns.name: Legal case writing
patterns.context: Conjunctions between common legal boilerplate and proper names when describing appeals, judgments, and parties

patterns.name: Quantitative research narratives
patterns.context: When describing annual average concentrations, exposure modeling, spatial resolution, and other research methods
patterns.domain: Environmental epidemiology or air pollution research

patterns.name: Descriptions of experimental treatment and measurement
patterns.context: When describing antibody treatment, tumor volume measurement, and calculation formulas

patterns.name: Figure captions and statistical comparisons
patterns.context: When comparing statistical significance, describing boxplot elements, or directing readers to view figures or tables

patterns.name: Ordinary narrative in scientific text
patterns.context: Describes curves in figures, calculation methods, and factors included in models; this passage also has activations on numbers and prepositions

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Activations fall on specific labels or formatting whitespace and are difficult to explain using other recurring patterns
patterns.domain: Medical table labels; formatting whitespace in mathematics papers

7_1247.concept: 英文结构词与量化排版
7_1247.description: 跨不同语料，激活分散于学术与法律文本中的常见连接词、数字和量化符号；少数落在公式排版、表格字段、图注及特定领域术语或空白上，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字及量化符号
patterns.context: 数字、数值或公式与相邻标点、单位、变量连接时；多段都出现，但标记位置并不一致
patterns.domain: 科学论文中的统计、测量和数学表达

patterns.name: 介词与连接词
patterns.context: 在英文句子或名词短语中充当连接成分；各段触发词及句法环境不同
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语学术文本及法律文书

patterns.name: 数学公式与排版标记
patterns.context: 公式环境中的 LaTeX 命令、环境边界或数学排版符号附近

patterns.name: 表格与结构化字段
patterns.context: 基线特征或研究人群表格的标题、列名和统计摘要中
patterns.domain: 医学论文表格及表格化文本

patterns.name: 法律案件行文
patterns.trigger: « appeals»、« from»、« a»、« award»、« of»、« with»、« respect»
patterns.context: 描述上诉、判决及当事方时，常见法律套语和专名之间的连接词

patterns.name: 定量研究叙述
patterns.context: 描述年均浓度、暴露建模及空间分辨率等研究方法时
patterns.domain: 环境流行病学或空气污染研究

patterns.name: 实验处理与测量描述
patterns.context: 描述抗体处理、肿瘤体积测定及计算公式时

patterns.name: 图表说明及统计比较
patterns.trigger: « than»、« by»、« see»、« center line»、« median»、« upper»、« lower»
patterns.context: 比较统计显著性、说明箱线图元素或引导读者查看图表时
patterns.domain: 生物医学结果与图表说明

patterns.name: 科学正文中的普通叙述
patterns.trigger: « solid»、« blue line»、« shows»、« calculated»、« using»、« account»
patterns.context: 说明图中曲线、计算方法及模型纳入因素；本段也有数值和介词激活

patterns.name: 未解释的零散触发
patterns.context: 激活落在特定标签或排版空白上，难以由其他反复模式解释
patterns.domain: 医学表格标签；数学论文中的排版空白

en.description: Highlights span legal, medical, and mathematical papers, including legal litigation terminology, and repeatedly fall on connectives such as and, of, the, and in, as well as formula punctuation and equals signs; local patterns also occur in statistical results, methods descriptions, and physical parameters.

patterns.name: Syntactic connectives and punctuation
patterns.context: Often occurs between nouns, clauses, or formula elements; activation is not limited to a particular word. Some punctuation and short function words also show strong activation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including legal, medical, and mathematical papers

patterns.name: Legal appeals and adjudication language
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions or headings concerning appeals, court rulings, and litigation disputes; this pattern fits legal style, but specific highlights within passages also include general connectives.

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons in scientific research
patterns.context: Describes experimental measurements, statistical tests, significance, or summaries of results.

patterns.name: Equals signs and mathematical structures in formulas
patterns.context: Occurs inside mathematical expressions, boundary-value problems, or formulas containing variables and symbols; highlights cover formula symbols and a few adjacent function words.

patterns.name: Methods and model descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces measurement formulas, spatial resolution, exposure modeling, or methodological steps.

patterns.name: Case parties and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs around the names of case parties or companies, near litigation issues such as trademark infringement and cybersquatting.

patterns.name: Technical physical quantities and parameter notation
patterns.context: Occurs when explaining a particular physical model or parameter value, mixing natural language and mathematical symbols.

7_1247.concept: 跨文体连接成分与符号
7_1247.description: 高亮跨法律、医学及数学论文，包含法律诉讼术语，也反复落在 and、of、the、in 等连接词及公式标点、等号上；另见统计结果、方法描述和物理参数等局部模式。

patterns.name: 句法连接词与标点
patterns.context: 常出现在名词、从句或公式元素之间，激活并不局限于某个特定词；部分标点和短功能词也有强激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括法律、医学和数学论文

patterns.name: 法律上诉与裁判用语
patterns.context: 出现在上诉、法院裁定及诉讼争议的叙述或标题中；该模式与法律文体相符，但段内具体高亮也包含通用连接词。

patterns.name: 科学研究中的统计比较
patterns.context: 描述实验测量、统计检验、显著性或结果汇总。

patterns.name: 公式中的等号与数学结构
patterns.context: 处于数学表达式、边值问题或带变量和符号的公式内部；高亮覆盖公式符号及少量相邻功能词。

patterns.name: 研究方法与模型描述
patterns.context: 介绍测量公式、空间分辨率、暴露建模或方法步骤。

patterns.name: 案件当事方及实体名称
patterns.context: 出现在案件当事方名称或公司名称周围，邻近商标侵权、网络抢注等诉讼事项。

patterns.name: 技术物理量与参数记号
patterns.context: 在解释特定物理模型或参数取值时出现，混合自然语言与数学符号。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal and scientific texts: legal passages often mark the coordinating word and, occasionally, legal prepositions or terms; scientific passages mark formula symbols, the conditional word if, and parameter assignments. Triggers across contexts show no unified pattern.

patterns.name: Coordinating conjunction and in legal rulings
patterns.context: Appears in legal pleadings, connecting parties, claims, facts, or legal content; in some examples, it appears in sentence-final lists or ruling formulas.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, appellate rulings, and pleadings

patterns.name: Preposition on in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal citations or judicial narratives, followed by a remedy, right, or other legal object; for example, “order denying relief on his 28 U.S.C.”.

patterns.name: Multiplication sign in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Embedded between variables, powers, and formula symbols to indicate multiplication.

patterns.name: Equals sign in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Appears in formulas or mathematical expressions, connecting the expressions on the left and right.

patterns.name: if in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: Appears in piecewise function definitions to introduce a conditional branch.

patterns.name: Parameter assignment symbol
patterns.context: Parameter values in scientific figure captions, with a number immediately following the equals sign.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics papers and figure captions

patterns.name: Decimal point in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears as a separator in U.S. Code abbreviations; activation is weak, and not all similar abbreviations are marked.

patterns.name: Other isolated legal terms
patterns.context: Appears respectively in descriptions of legal precedent, court orders, claims, or attorney negligence; single instances or weak evidence do not establish a shared trigger condition.

7_1247.concept: none
7_1247.description: 激活分散于法律文本和科学文本：法律段落中常标记并列词and，偶见法律介词或术语；科学段落中标记公式符号、条件词if及参数赋值。不同语境的触发缺乏统一规律。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的并列连接词 and
patterns.trigger: «and»（[1]、[3]、[4]、[8]；另有数学文本中的«and»或«and»邻近用法）
patterns.context: 出现在法律诉讼文书中，连接当事人、主张、事实或法律内容；部分例子中处于句末列举或判词句式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、上诉裁判及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的介词 on
patterns.context: 法律引证或裁判叙述中，后接救济、权利或其他法律对象；如“order denying relief on his 28 U.S.C.”。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的乘号
patterns.context: 嵌在变量、幂次与公式符号之间，表示乘法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的测量公式

patterns.name: 数学排版中的等号
patterns.context: 出现在公式或数学表达式中，连接左、右两侧表达式。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的 if
patterns.context: 位于分段函数定义中，引出条件分支。

patterns.name: 参数赋值符号
patterns.context: 科学图表说明中的参数取值，等号后紧邻数值。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理论文及图注

patterns.name: 法律引证中的小数点
patterns.context: 出现在美国法典缩写的分隔符位置；激活较弱，且并非所有相似缩写都标记。

patterns.name: 其他孤立法律词项
patterns.context: 分别出现在法律先例、法院命令、诉讼请求或律师失职叙述中；单例或弱证据，无法确定共同触发条件。

en.concept: Structured quantitative statements in technical writing
en.description: Primarily responds to the style of methods, results, and quantitative information in academic papers, especially sample sizes, statistics, formulas, and parameters; also occurs in legal sentencing/attorney claims and mathematical initial conditions. The specific fourth passage describes recruitment and refusals, and it is unclear whether a shared trigger explains it.

patterns.name: Measurements, statistics, and numerical markers in scientific papers
patterns.context: When reporting sample sizes, statistical tests, experimental conditions, equations, or parameter values; activation often falls on numbers, equals signs, punctuation, or nearby function words
patterns.domain: Biomedical, materials science, computational biology, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Paper descriptions of methods, results, and research subjects
patterns.context: When research papers describe measurements, samples, participants, observations, or analysis steps in methods or results sections, often with domain terminology and statistical information in parentheses
patterns.domain: PubMed Central research papers and scientific papers

patterns.name: Sentencing and ineffective-assistance claims in legal decisions
patterns.context: When a decision discusses whether a sentence complies with statutory or guideline requirements and then reviews the defendant’s claim of ineffective assistance of counsel

patterns.name: Initial conditions and boundary data in mathematical texts
patterns.context: Mathematical exposition specifies initial or boundary conditions for functions, derivatives, and parameters using formulas

patterns.name: Research participant recruitment and reasons for refusal
patterns.context: Describes study recruitment, participants or parents declining to participate, and their reasons; related to other paper statistics/methods patterns, but the specific trigger in this passage is recruitment and refusal

7_1247.concept: 技术文体中的结构化定量陈述
7_1247.description: 主要响应学术论文中方法、结果及定量信息的写法，尤其是样本量、统计值、公式和参数；另见法律量刑/律师主张，以及数学初始条件。第4段具体是招募与拒绝叙述，无法确定是否由共同触发因素解释。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的计量、统计与数值标记
patterns.context: 在报告样本量、统计检验、实验条件、方程或参数取值时；激活常落在数字、等号、标点或邻近的功能词上
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料科学、计算生物学和数学论文

patterns.name: 方法、结果与研究对象的论文叙述
patterns.trigger: “in order to assess”、“scores were assessed at”、“we observed”、“After excluding”、“Materials and methods”、“the consistency scores”
patterns.context: 研究论文以方法或结果段落描述测量、样本、参与者、观察结果或分析步骤时，常伴随领域术语及括号中的统计信息
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 研究论文及科学论文

patterns.name: 法律判决中的量刑与律师帮助主张
patterns.trigger: “Guidelines range”、“minimum required by statute”、“Valderrama’s claim”、“counsel rendered ineffective assistance”
patterns.context: 判决书在讨论量刑是否符合法定或指南要求，并转而审查被告关于律师无效帮助的主张时

patterns.name: 数学文本中的初始条件与边界数据
patterns.context: 数学论述通过公式规定函数、导数及参数的初始或边界条件
patterns.domain: 数学论文，含 LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 研究参与者招募与拒绝原因
patterns.trigger: “Parents of 29 children were invited”、“parents refused participation”、“Reasons for refusal”
patterns.context: 描述研究招募、参与者或家长拒绝参加及其原因；与其他论文统计/方法模式相关，但该段的具体触发内容是招募与拒绝

en.concept: Questions about common denominators and least common multiples
en.description: The most stable pattern is math problems asking for a common denominator or least common multiple; other activations are scattered across conjunctions, parentheses, experimental measurements and results in papers, and partial differential equations, with no unified explanation so far.

patterns.name: common denominator / least common multiple in mathematics
patterns.context: Math problems asking for the common denominator or least common multiple of two numbers or algebraic expressions, often in questions such as “ What is … of … and …?” or “Calculate …”; the objects may include fractions, negative numbers, and variables.

patterns.name: is / of construction in math questions
patterns.context: Questions concern mathematical operations or numerical relationships; this construction may also be an accompanying trigger in the primary pattern rather than an independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: and linking parallel experimental elements in papers
patterns.context: Connects two antibodies, conditions in mathematical expressions, subject outcomes, or material properties in methods or results; triggers are scattered, with no stable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, mathematical formulas, materials physics papers

patterns.name: Experimental doses or measurements in parentheses
patterns.context: Parentheses immediately follow descriptions of experimental reagents, doses, or equipment dimensions; unlike parenthetical expressions in math problems, these are not yet sufficient to establish a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Body weight and grouping in food animal studies
patterns.context: Animal source, body weight, and random grouping are reported consecutively. Seen in only one passage.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central farm animal experimental methods

patterns.name: Patient-reported outcomes and result proportions
patterns.context: Reports pediatric postoperative recovery assessments and result proportions.

patterns.name: Clinical score measurement time points
patterns.context: Reports the canine chronic enteropathy clinical activity index score and treatment-group sample sizes.

patterns.name: Parenthetical figure or reference notes in papers
patterns.context: Parentheses add information about formulas or the physical mechanisms covered by references.

patterns.name: Partial differential equation symbols
patterns.context: Partial derivatives, functions, and variables in formulas; distinct from the common denominator pattern in math word problems.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics or theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Unexplained abbreviations, labels, or truncated text
patterns.context: These fragments contain abbreviations, group labels, or incomplete text, but there is insufficient repeated evidence to identify them as independent trigger patterns.

7_1247.concept: 公分母与最小公倍数问句
7_1247.description: 最稳定模式是数学题询问公分母或最小公倍数；其余激活分散于论文中的并列连接、括号、实验测量与结果，以及偏微分方程，暂缺统一解释。

patterns.name: 数学中的 common denominator / 最小公倍数
patterns.context: 数学题中询问两个数或代数式的公分母或最小公倍数，常出现在问句“ What is … of … and …?”或“Calculate …”中；对象可含分数、负数及变量。

patterns.name: 数学问句中的 is / of 结构
patterns.trigger: “What is”“of”；尤其与“common denominator”或“least common multiple”连用
patterns.context: 问句围绕数学运算或数值关系展开；该结构也可能是主模式中的伴随触发，而非独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 论文中的 and 连接并列实验要素
patterns.context: 在方法或结果陈述中连接两种抗体、数学表达式中的条件、受试者结果或材料属性等；触发位置分散，未显示稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、数学公式、材料物理论文

patterns.name: 括号内的实验剂量或测量量
patterns.context: 括号紧接实验试剂、剂量或设备尺寸等描述；与数学题里的括号表达式不同，暂不足以认定为同一模式。

patterns.name: 食用动物研究中的体重及分组
patterns.trigger: “1051 ± 138 g live weight (LW)”及“were randomly allocated in individual wire-net cages”
patterns.context: 动物来源、体重和随机分组被连续报告。仅见于一段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 农场动物实验方法

patterns.name: 患者报告结局与结果比例
patterns.context: 报告儿童术后恢复评估及结果比例。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 临床研究结果

patterns.name: 临床评分的测量时间点
patterns.trigger: “scores were assessed”“at four different time points”
patterns.context: 报告犬慢性肠病临床活动指数评分及治疗组样本数。

patterns.name: 论文中的括号式图表或文献说明
patterns.trigger: “(which takes into account scattering by both grain boundaries and film surfaces)”
patterns.context: 括号补充公式或文献所涵盖的物理机制。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 材料物理论文

patterns.name: 偏微分方程符号
patterns.context: 公式中的偏导数、函数及变量；与数学文字题的 common denominator 模式不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或理论物理论文

patterns.name: 未解释的缩写、标签或截断文本
patterns.context: 这些片段中虽有缩写、组别标记或不完整文本，但没有足够重复证据说明它们是独立触发模式。

en.concept: Legal boilerplate and scientific statistical formatting
en.description: Activations span two clear contexts: the fixed phrase “dispense with oral argument…materials before this” in court opinions, and statistical numbers (especially formatted n=10), measurements and sampling methods, rankings, and parameter formulas in scientific papers. The latter are semantically scattered and may relate to numerical/statistical formatting.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in court opinions
patterns.context: Appears in court rulings or appellate opinions, often adjacent to “We dispense”; highlights cluster around “in the … materials before this,” especially “in”

patterns.name: Number 10 and its statistical notation
patterns.context: Appears in statistical descriptions of sample sizes, group counts, or time points; activation occurs near the number 10 and may be part of a formatted number string

patterns.name: Methods and results narrative in academic papers
patterns.context: Introduces measurements, samples, time points, and allocation methods in experimental or observational studies; no lexical trigger shared with the legal phrase is evident

patterns.name: Numerical descriptions in rankings, parameters, and models
patterns.context: Discusses ranked data, physical parameters, or model functions, including variables, formulas, and numbers

7_1247.concept: 法律套语与科学统计格式
7_1247.description: 激活覆盖两类明显语境：法院意见中“dispense with oral argument…materials before this”的固定套语；以及科学论文里统计数字（尤其格式化的 n=10）、测量与样本方法、排序和参数公式。后者语义分散，可能与数字/统计排版有关。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的固定套语
patterns.trigger: “dispense with oral argument because the facts and legal contentions are adequately presented in the materials before this”
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或上诉意见中，常与“We dispense”相邻；高亮集中于“in the … materials before this”，尤其“in”

patterns.name: 数字10及其统计符号格式
patterns.context: 出现在样本量、分组数或时间点等统计描述中；数字10附近激活，可能是格式化数字串中的一部分

patterns.name: 学术论文中的方法与结果叙述
patterns.trigger: “in order to assess”“at four different time points”“Data were sampled”“In total”“randomly allocated”
patterns.context: 实验或观察研究中介绍测量、样本、时间点及分配方法；未见与法律套语相同的词汇触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学及实验科学论文

patterns.name: 排序、参数及模型中的数值描述
patterns.trigger: “in descending order”“top n”“values p = 20.8”“functions of δ”
patterns.context: 讨论排序后的数据、物理参数或模型函数，包含变量、公式和数值

en.description: Activations are distributed across symbols, statistical values, methodological connectives, and figure descriptions in various scientific papers, as well as the clause-introducing word that in legal contexts. Patterns span domains and have no consistent trigger form.

patterns.name: that introducing a clause
patterns.context: In legal texts, that appears in a verb-complement clause such as “believes that such a petition would...” ; in [1], the strongest activation falls on that.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula relations
patterns.context: In formulas, operations, and statistical expressions relating numbers, variables, or dimensions, activation falls on symbols or nearby tokens; the specific symbols vary.
patterns.domain: Formulas and quantitative expressions in scientific papers

patterns.name: Statistical results and sample-size expressions
patterns.context: n, N, equals signs, and numbers occur near sample sizes or statistical values; activation primarily falls on equals signs or number tokens.

patterns.name: in in research workflows
patterns.context: in is used in descriptions of methods or analysis workflows, such as “in order to,” “allocated in individual cages,” or “at four time points in …”; the word is marked in only some such positions.

patterns.name: showing in results or figure descriptions
patterns.context: Uses showing to introduce measurements displayed in a figure or the contents of a heatmap.

patterns.name: Scattering and particle phrases in scientific texts
patterns.context: Describes sources of scattering considered in a resistivity model; activation concentrates on and, while most surrounding words are unmarked.

patterns.name: Coordinating connectives in medical texts
patterns.context: Connective elements between coordinated terms, results, or treatments; they occur in multiple passages but vary in position and meaning.

patterns.name: Expressions for numerical measurement ranges
patterns.context: Uses from…to… to give a range of measurement values.

7_1247.concept: 混合的结构与量化标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布于多种科学论文中的符号、统计数值、方法连接词及图示描述，也包括法律语境中从句引导词 that。模式跨领域且触发形式不统一。

patterns.name: that 后接从句引导词
patterns.context: 法律文本中，位于“believes that such a petition would...”一类动词补语从句的 that；[1] 的最强激活落在 that。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式关系记号
patterns.context: 数字、变量或量纲之间的公式、运算及统计表达式中，激活落在符号或符号邻近 token；具体符号不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 科学论文中的公式和量化表达

patterns.name: 统计结果与样本量表达
patterns.context: 样本量或统计数值前后出现 n、N、等号及数字；激活主要落在等号或数字 token。
patterns.domain: 医学与生物学研究论文

patterns.name: 研究流程中的 in
patterns.context: in 用于方法或分析流程表述，如“in order to”“allocated in individual cages”“at four time points in …”；该词仅在部分此类位置标记。

patterns.name: 结果或图示的 showing
patterns.context: 以 showing 引出图表所展示的测量结果或热图内容。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的散射与颗粒边界词组
patterns.context: 描述电阻率模型所考虑的散射来源；激活集中于 and，其他周边词多为未标记。

patterns.name: 医学并列连接成分
patterns.trigger: « and»3« the»2；« and»2 anti-mouse VEGF mAb
patterns.context: 在并列的术语、结果或处理项之间连接成分；多个段出现，但位置和语义各异。

patterns.name: 数字测量区间表达
patterns.context: 以 from…to…给出测量值范围。

en.concept: Relational and quantitative markers in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across numerical values, units, and mathematical symbols in various academic papers, as well as that-clauses, argumentative function words, and name/identity descriptions in legal texts; no single meaning or domain explains all examples.

patterns.name: that in a fixed phrase
patterns.context: In legal text, that introduces an object clause, preceded by believes and followed by such a petition; it is part of the strongest activation passage.

patterns.name: Numerical values, units, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Appears in quantitative measurements, ranges, parameters, or formulas; many examples are marked at multiplication or equals signs.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, environmental science, and physics/materials science papers

patterns.name: Argumentative and adjudicative language in legal opinions
patterns.context: The court explains that oral argument is unnecessary and issues a ruling; activations are scattered across legal reasoning and syntactic function words.

patterns.name: Descriptions of names and identity relationships
patterns.context: Personal names and business names appear alongside ownership or job-title information; activation falls on connecting words and identity terms.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of parties in legal cases

7_1247.concept: 结构化文本中的关系与量化标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布于多类学术论文的数值、单位和数学符号，以及法律文本中的 that 从句、论证功能词和姓名身份表述；没有单一词义或领域能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 固定短语中的 that
patterns.trigger: «that»（[1] 中“believes that such a petition would”）
patterns.context: 法律文本中，that 引导宾语从句，前接 believes、后接 such a petition；是最强激活段中的一部分。

patterns.name: 数值、单位与数学符号
patterns.context: 出现在量化测量、范围、参数或公式中；不少样例的标记落在乘号或等号上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、环境科学、物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 法律意见中的论证与裁决用语
patterns.trigger: «because»、«and»、«are»、«in»；如“because the facts and legal contentions are adequately presented in the materials”
patterns.context: 法院说明无需口头辩论并作出裁决，激活散布在法律论述及句法功能词上。

patterns.name: 姓名及身份关系表述
patterns.trigger: «and»、«doing»、«as»、«and»、«owner»；如“Albrecht, doing business as … and Giordano”及“Albrecht’s owner and chief executive officer”
patterns.context: 人名、商业名称与所有权/职位信息并列出现，激活落在连接词及身份词上。

en.concept: Function words and numerical formatting in scientific/legal texts
en.description: Activations span legal documents and scientific papers, often falling on that, prepositions, and other connecting words or adjacent words; scientific passages also highlight numerical values, units, formulas, and measurement formatting. Other activations correspond to domain-specific terms and sentence structures, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: “that” and conjunctions in following clauses
patterns.context: The trigger appears in legal text, connecting conditional, object, or scope clauses; strong activations also fall on subsequent elements.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Near numerical values, units, statistics, or formulas, especially equals, multiplication, and plus/minus signs, as well as formatting spaces between numbers.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, experiments, and statistical reports

patterns.name: Prepositions and adjacent phrases
patterns.context: Prepositions introduce time, source, scope, method, object, or components; common in continuous academic prose.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, methods and results descriptions

patterns.name: Function words in relative clauses
patterns.context: Connect clauses, parallel elements, or supplementary explanations in longer sentences; some examples activate adjacent function words.
patterns.domain: Academic explanatory prose and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal appellate expression
patterns.context: Near the procedural expression “appeals from a summary judgment,” alongside information about parties, the judgment, and the scope of the dispute.

patterns.name: Time-point markers
patterns.context: Marks study progress in weeks or experimental time points, with numbers joined to units or placed in parentheses.

patterns.name: Subjective music rating scale
patterns.context: Describes a subjective scale for perceptual attributes of music, followed by a rating range and repeated measurement method.

patterns.name: Particle-size exposure model and resolution
patterns.context: Annual modeling description of air pollution exposure, including year, spatial resolution, and study area.

patterns.name: Animal study groups and photoperiod
patterns.context: Groups animals by light-dark cycle in an animal study and reports means, standard errors, and sample sizes.

patterns.name: Pediatric postoperative recovery and questionnaire results
patterns.context: Uses a patient-reported outcome scale to assess pediatric postoperative recovery, involving pain, response proportions, and sample sizes.

patterns.name: Ranking and consistency analysis
patterns.context: Ranks samples in descending order and compares consistency of regulatory direction across different top-n sets.

patterns.name: Experimental diet, blood lipids, and body weight
patterns.context: An animal study first induces changes in blood lipids and body weight through a preparatory diet, then proceeds to subsequent grouping.

patterns.name: Descriptions of numerical values and experimental subjects
patterns.context: Reports farm animal body weights, random allocation, and cage dimensions; symbols activate near measurement values.

patterns.name: Thin-film resistivity parameters
patterns.context: Resistivity model, scattering sources, and carrier fraction parameters in an electrical transport paper.

patterns.name: Claims and attorney judgment
patterns.context: A conditional statement about whether an attorney believes a petition should be filed, in the context of court review.

7_1247.concept: 科学/法律文本中的功能词与数值排版
7_1247.description: 激活跨法律文书与科学论文，常落在 that、介词等连接词及其相邻词；科学段落还突出数值、单位、公式和测量排版。其余激活对应各领域的具体术语与句式，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: “that”及其后的从句连接词
patterns.context: 触发词出现在法律文本中，连接条件、宾语或范围从句；强激活也落在后续成分上。

patterns.name: 数学符号与数字表达
patterns.context: 数值、单位、统计量或公式附近，尤其是等号、乘号、正负号及数字之间的排版空格。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、实验与统计报告

patterns.name: 介词及其邻接短语
patterns.context: 介词引出时间、来源、范围、方法、对象或组成成分；常见于连续的学术说明文字。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、方法与结果描述

patterns.name: 关系从句中的功能词
patterns.context: 在较长句子中连接从句、并列成分或补充说明；部分例子激活落在相邻功能词。
patterns.domain: 学术说明文及法律文书

patterns.name: 法律上诉表达
patterns.context: “appeals from a summary judgment”这一诉讼程序表达附近，另有当事人、判决与争议范围信息。

patterns.name: 时间点标记
patterns.context: 以周数或实验时间点标记研究进程，数字与单位相连或出现在括号中。

patterns.name: 音乐主观评分区间
patterns.context: 描述音乐感知属性的主观量表，随后给出评分范围与重复测量方式。

patterns.name: 粒径暴露模型与分辨率
patterns.context: 空气污染暴露的年度建模描述，出现年份、空间分辨率与研究区域。

patterns.name: 动物实验分组与光周期
patterns.context: 动物实验中按日照光周期分组，并报告均值、标准误和样本量。

patterns.name: 儿童术后恢复与问卷结果
patterns.context: 使用患者报告结局量表评估儿童术后恢复，涉及疼痛、答卷比例及样本量。

patterns.name: 排序与一致性分析
patterns.context: 按降序排列样本，并比较不同前 n 项集合中的调控方向一致性。
patterns.domain: 生物信息学或组学分析

patterns.name: 实验饮食与血脂体重
patterns.trigger: [2] «4 weeks run-in diet»；«mildly elevated lipid levels»；«increase» «in»1 «body weight»
patterns.context: 动物实验先通过预备饮食造成血脂和体重变化，再进入后续分组。

patterns.name: 数值与实验对象的描述
patterns.context: 报告农场动物的体重、随机分配及笼具尺寸，符号与测量数值附近激活。

patterns.name: 薄膜电阻率参数
patterns.context: 电输运论文中的电阻率模型、散射来源和载流子比例参数。

patterns.name: 诉讼请求与律师判断
patterns.context: 律师是否认为应提交请愿书的条件句，包含法院复审语境。

en.description: Activations occur on multiplication signs, comparative expressions, and relational words in formulas in scientific text, and also in heading structures, legal appellate narratives, and figure/method notes; no single lexical pattern covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Multiplication signs and numerical ranges
patterns.context: Multiplication signs between numbers, units, or symbols; also appear in formula parameters.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers: animal experiments, air pollution modeling, mathematics, and genetics

patterns.name: Comparative expressions
patterns.context: Compare quantities, proportions, or statistical results, often accompanied by significance tests or probability expressions.
patterns.domain: Research papers, especially statistics and biomedicine

patterns.name: Connectors and symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Common relational words, punctuation, and symbols near formulas or formal definitions; activations are scattered across multiple formula fragments.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Paragraph headings and divider lines
patterns.context: Section headings and the horizontal line beneath them; activation appears near the text following the heading.

patterns.name: Litigation language in legal rulings
patterns.context: Court narratives about appeals, judgments, and parties; markings fall on words and syntactic connectors.

patterns.name: Figure result descriptions and method citations
patterns.context: Explains plotted curves, calculation methods, and included physical factors.

7_1247.concept: 符号与关系表达
7_1247.description: 激活分布在科学文本中的乘号、比较表达和公式关系词，也见于标题结构、法律上诉叙述及图表方法说明；未见能覆盖全部片段的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 乘法符号与数值范围
patterns.context: 数值、单位或符号之间的乘号；也出现在公式参数中。
patterns.domain: 科学论文：动物实验、空气污染建模、数学及遗传学

patterns.name: 比较关系表达
patterns.context: 比较数量、比例或统计结果，常伴随显著性检验或概率表达。
patterns.domain: 科研论文，尤其统计、生物医学

patterns.name: 数学公式中的连接词与符号
patterns.context: 公式或形式定义附近的常见关系词、标点和符号，激活分散于多个公式片段。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 段落标题与分隔线
patterns.context: 小节标题及其下方横线，激活出现在标题后的正文附近。
patterns.domain: 科学论文的 Markdown/文档结构

patterns.name: 法律判决中的诉讼用语
patterns.context: 法院判决对上诉、判决及当事方的叙述；标记落在词语和句法连接处。

patterns.name: 图表结果说明与方法引用
patterns.context: 解释图中曲线、计算方法及纳入的物理因素。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on common function words in academic English and on formulas, numbers, and typesetting symbols, spanning biomedicine, environmental science, physics, mathematics, and web links; proper names and domain terms are sporadic, with no unified thematic trigger.

patterns.name: English function words and following tokens
patterns.context: Activation falls on several common English prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or the words following them; positions span in-sentence phrases, noun phrases, and relational expressions, with no single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: English academic papers, technical texts, and web links

patterns.name: Numbers, operators, and formula symbols
patterns.context: Near numerical values, units, statistical comparisons, formulas, or mathematical typesetting; some symbols occur around activated words, while others such as «×» and «=» are directly marked.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, statistical results, mathematical formulas, and drug dosage descriptions

patterns.name: Prepositions and subword fragments in web paths
patterns.context: Wikipedia URL paths connect title words with underscores; activation corresponds to separators and ordinary English words in the path.

patterns.name: Relational words in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: When defining spaces and their structures, activated words appear in sentence patterns that introduce objects, additional structures, or families of mappings.

patterns.name: Algebraic relation expressions in formulas
patterns.context: Common function words interleave with formula structures in descriptions of algebraic objects, variables, and relations.

patterns.name: Figure captions and experimental methods
patterns.context: Explains curve meanings, calculation methods, physical effects considered, or experimental measurement methods.
patterns.domain: Materials physics captions and biomedical experimental texts

patterns.name: Statistical results and distribution descriptions
patterns.context: Compares observations with expectations, or describes medians, quartiles, and outliers in boxplots.

patterns.name: Individual terms or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation also covers a few proper names, technical terms, or title fragments that cannot be explained by a shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Agricultural research locations, mathematical terminology, web page titles

patterns.name: Medical and experimental vocabulary
patterns.context: Function-word activations occur amid descriptions of tumors, antibody treatments, and radiopharmaceutical experiments; the domain terms themselves show no stable, consistent trigger relationship.

7_1247.concept: 英语功能词与符号
7_1247.description: 激活主要落在学术英语常见功能词及公式、数字和排版符号上，跨生物医学、环境科学、物理、数学与网页链接；专名和领域词激活较零散，未见统一主题触发。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及连接词后的 token
patterns.context: 激活落在多个常见英语介词、冠词、连词或其后的词上；出现位置横跨句中短语、名词短语及关系表达，并无单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 英语学术论文、技术文本及网页链接
