patterns.name: 数字、运算符与公式符号
patterns.context: 数值、单位、统计比较、公式或数学排版附近；其中部分符号出现在激活词周边，亦有「×」「=」等直接标记。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、统计结果、数学公式及药物剂量描述

patterns.name: 网页路径中的介词与分词片段
patterns.context: 维基百科 URL 路径把标题词用下划线连接，激活对应路径中的分隔符和普通英语词。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的关系词
patterns.context: 定义空间及其结构时，激活词位于介绍对象、附加结构或映射族的句式中。

patterns.name: 公式中的代数关系表达
patterns.context: 代数对象、变量及关系式的介绍中，常见功能词与公式结构交错。

patterns.name: 图表说明与实验方法表达
patterns.context: 说明曲线含义、计算方法、考虑的物理效应或实验测量方式。
patterns.domain: 材料物理图注及生物医学实验文本

patterns.name: 统计结果与分布描述
patterns.context: 比较观察结果与期望，或描述箱线图的中位数、四分位数和离群点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学统计结果与图注

patterns.name: 个别术语或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活还覆盖少数无法由共同语义解释的专名、技术词或标题词片段。
patterns.domain: 农业研究地点、数学术语、网页标题

patterns.name: 医学与实验领域词汇
patterns.context: 肿瘤、抗体处理及放射性药物实验叙述中夹杂功能词激活；领域词本身未显示稳定一致的触发关系。

en.description: Activations occur on scientific numbers and mathematical symbols, academic methods and comparisons, and legal rulings and appellate phrasing. A possible commonality is structured, format-dense professional text, but specific triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Numerical and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, units, comparison symbols, exponents, or operators embedded in scientific prose or formulas; specific numerical forms vary widely across passages

patterns.name: Legal ruling and appellate phrasing
patterns.context: Describes appeals, rulings, petitions, or attorney actions in judicial opinions, often alongside party names, statutes, and line-break formatting

patterns.name: Comparison or filtering narrative in academic text
patterns.context: Reports data processing, statistical comparisons, modeling methods, or calculations based on existing equations; overlaps with the first numerical pattern but includes complete methods/comparison phrases
patterns.domain: Biomedical, environmental science, and materials research

patterns.name: Possible formatting or symbol-boundary triggers
patterns.context: Activation falls inside proper names, LaTeX control words, or truncated algebraic expressions and cannot be clearly explained by shared semantics
patterns.domain: Legal proper names and mathematically formatted text

7_1247.concept: 专业文本中的结构化表达
7_1247.description: 激活分布在科学数值与数学符号、学术方法比较，以及法律裁判和上诉措辞中。共通点可能是结构化、格式密集的专业文本，但具体触发因素并不统一。

patterns.name: 数字与数学符号表达式
patterns.context: 数值、单位、比较符号、指数或运算符嵌在科学叙述或公式中；不同段落的具体数字形式差异很大

patterns.name: 法律判决与上诉措辞
patterns.trigger: “appeals from”“summary judgment”“order denying”“motion”“not appealable”“petition be filed”
patterns.context: 司法意见书中描述上诉、裁定、申诉或律师行动，常伴随当事人姓名、法条与换行排版

patterns.name: 学术文本中的比较或筛选叙述
patterns.context: 报告数据处理、统计比较、建模方法或依据既有方程计算；与第一种数字模式重叠，但有完整的方法/比较短语
patterns.domain: 生物医学、环境科学及材料研究

patterns.name: 可能的格式或符号边界触发
patterns.trigger: “Incorporated”中的“corpor”、公式排版符号“\quad”“\det”及行末运算片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部、LaTeX 控制词或截断的代数表达式上，无法由共同语义明确解释
patterns.domain: 法律专名及数学排版文本

en.concept: Common local symbols and function words
en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous patterns: operators and numbers in symbolic algebra; common function words in papers, citations, and legal documents; and for/the in URL paths. No single trigger word explains all passages.

patterns.name: Operators and numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In symbolic algebraic expressions, especially near variable powers, parentheses, and expansions; triggers are distributed across different operators and numbers rather than one fixed token
patterns.domain: Computer algebra or symbolic mathematics content in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Conjunctions and methods descriptions in papers
patterns.context: In continuous scientific prose, connects parallel elements, introduces methods, or accompanies noun phrases; usually adjacent to technical terms, numbers, or experimental descriptions

patterns.name: and in English citations
patterns.context: Between author names in references, connecting two authors; highlights also appear in link text pointing to papers
patterns.domain: Academic material quoted or linked in HackerNews

patterns.name: for and the in URL paths
patterns.context: Words in Wikipedia link URL paths are separated by underscores; this is not ordinary prose syntax
patterns.domain: URLs and tl;dr in HackerNews posts

patterns.name: Prepositions and conjunctions in legal ruling constructions
patterns.context: In case summaries, describes appeals, judgments, and parties; text also has line breaks and irregular formatting

7_1247.concept: 局部常见符号与功能词
7_1247.description: 激活散布于多项异质模式：符号代数中的运算符与数字；论文、引文及法律文书中的常见功能词；网址路径中的 for/the。没有单一触发词能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的运算符与数字
patterns.context: 符号运算表达式中，尤其是变量幂项、括号及展开式附近；触发分布在多个不同运算符和数字上，并非单一固定 token
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的计算机代数或符号数学内容

patterns.name: 论文中的连接词与方法描述
patterns.context: 科学论文连续叙述中，连接并列成分、引出方法或搭配名词短语；通常邻接技术术语、数值或实验描述
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英文引文中的 and
patterns.context: 参考文献作者姓名之间，连接两名作者；高亮还出现在指向论文的链接文本中
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中引用或链接的学术资料

patterns.name: 网址路径中的 for 与 the
patterns.context: 维基百科链接的 URL 路径中，词语被下划线分隔；不是普通正文句法
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖子中的网址及 tl;dr

patterns.name: 法律判决句式中的介词和连接词
patterns.context: 法院案件摘要中描述上诉、判决及当事方，且文本有换行和不规则排版

en.concept: Structural and operational markers in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations occur in legal ruling boilerplate, litigation narratives, and function words; biomedical statistics and measurement symbols; and operators in mathematical polynomials. There is no single clear semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Litigation and ruling language in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in narratives of appellate cases about court rulings, party claims, or counsel assistance; also includes transitional expressions such as “Finally, as to … claim”

patterns.name: Ruling-disposition boilerplate in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears at the end of rulings, in statements about precedential effect, or in accounts of case procedure

patterns.name: Prepositions, conjunctions, and argumentative expressions in legal text
patterns.context: Connects the grounds for a ruling, claims, and case facts in legal reasoning; some trigger words may also be common function words

patterns.name: Statistical symbols and test results in scientific research
patterns.context: Reports correlation coefficients, significance tests, or statistical distributions in experimental or clinical results

patterns.name: Measurement and formula symbols in scientific experiments
patterns.context: Operators and units appear in numerical measurements, dimensions, or calculation formulas

patterns.name: Operators and coefficients in polynomial expansions
patterns.context: In mathematical expansions, activations fall on plus/minus signs, coefficients, and terms with zero coefficients

7_1247.concept: 异质文本中的结构与运算标记
7_1247.description: 激活分布在法律判决套语、诉讼叙述与功能词，以及生物医学统计和计量符号、数学多项式运算符中；没有单一明确的语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的诉讼与裁定用语
patterns.context: 出现在上诉案件对法院裁定、当事人主张或律师协助的叙述中；也包括“Finally, as to … claim”一类过渡表达

patterns.name: 法律判决的裁判处置套语
patterns.trigger: “VACATED IN PART AND REMANDED FOR”“Unpublished opinions are not binding precedent in this circuit”“summary judgment”
patterns.context: 出现在判决结尾、先例效力说明或案件程序经过中

patterns.name: 法律文本中的介词、连接词及论证表达
patterns.trigger: “within”“as to”“that”“by statute”“with respect to”“in favor of”“and”
patterns.context: 法律论述中连接裁判依据、主张与案件事实；部分触发词也可能只是常见功能词

patterns.name: 科学研究的统计符号与检验结果
patterns.context: 在实验或临床结果中报告相关系数、显著性检验或统计分布

patterns.name: 科学实验的计量与公式符号
patterns.context: 数值测量、尺寸或计算公式中出现运算符号和单位

patterns.name: 多项式展开中的运算符与系数
patterns.context: 数学式展开中，激活落在加减号、系数及零系数项附近

en.concept: Function words in relational and comparative expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across relational and procedural expressions in legal documents and statistical comparisons and numerical reports in scientific papers; they also occur on for in URLs. Several examples are near prepositions, connectives, numbers, or formatting boundaries, so no single word sense can be identified as the trigger.

patterns.name: Relational, claim, and procedural phrases in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences in decisions, appellate opinions, or motions, connecting parties, claims, matters handled by the court, or outcomes.

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons and correlation expressions
patterns.context: Occurs near correlation coefficients, significance tests, numerical comparisons, or measurements, often alongside numbers, units, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Preposition to in phrases
patterns.context: Introduces the object of a claim or matter handled in legal texts, as in “as to Valderrama’s claim”; the passage also contains other activated words, making it difficult to determine whether to alone is the trigger.

patterns.name: for in web URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in Wikipedia link titles cited in Hacker News posts, with for marked twice; the context differs from the other passages.

patterns.name: Function-word activations at sentence or formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at sentence beginnings or paragraph transitions; the current passage does not establish whether the boundary position or adjacent content is responsible.

7_1247.concept: 关系与比较表达中的功能词
7_1247.description: 激活分布在法律文书的关系与程序表达、科学论文的统计比较和数值报告中；也见于 URL 中的 for。多个例子邻近介词、连接词、数字或格式边界，无法确定单一词义触发。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的关系、主张与程序短语
patterns.context: 出现在判决、上诉意见或动议语句中，连接当事人、主张、法院处理事项或裁判结果。

patterns.name: 统计比较与相关性表达
patterns.context: 出现在相关系数、显著性检验、数值比较或测量结果附近，常伴随数字、单位和括号。

patterns.name: 短语中的介词 to
patterns.context: 法律文本中引出主张对象或处理事项，如 “as to Valderrama’s claim”；该片段同时有其他激活词，难以断定 to 单独触发。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的 for
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 帖子引用的维基百科链接标题中，for 两次被标记；与其他片段的语境不同。

patterns.name: 句内或格式边界处的功能词激活
patterns.context: 出现在句首或段落衔接处；当前片段无法确认是边界位置还是相邻内容触发。

en.concept: Structural words and symbols in formal text
en.description: Activations primarily occur on procedural phrasing and function words in legal rulings, relational words connecting formula objects in mathematical papers, and numerical parentheses/symbols in experimental methods, as well as operators and zero terms in polynomial calculations. Triggers are not uniform across contexts.

patterns.name: Function words and procedural phrasing in legal rulings
patterns.context: Appears in continuous prose in U.S. court rulings or legal opinions, often near terms such as judgment, appeal, statute, and remedy, and formal syntax; activations are distributed across multiple ordinary function words and legal phrases.

patterns.name: Relational words and formula-adjacent prose in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears in prose near mathematical papers or formulas, connecting mathematical objects such as definitions, coefficients, operators, and function spaces; sometimes adjacent to LaTeX mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Numerical experimental methods descriptions in scientific papers
patterns.context: Parentheses, error-range symbols, and methodological phrasing appear together in descriptions of experimental subjects, body-weight values, and random allocation to cages.

patterns.name: Local sequences of symbolic operations and zero terms
patterns.context: Appears in polynomial expansions or similar computational output, with activation on arithmetic symbols and zero-coefficient terms.

7_1247.concept: 正式文本中的结构性词符
7_1247.description: 激活主要出现在法律判决的程序性措辞与功能词、数学论文中连接公式对象的关系词；另见实验方法中的数值括号符号，以及多项式计算的运算符和零项。各处触发词并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的功能词与程序性表述
patterns.trigger: 如 «was» «within» «the» «properly-calculated Guidelines range»（2）、«with respect to»（3）、«denying relief»（5）、«was actually charged with»（7）、«unless a circuit justice»（8）
patterns.context: 出现在美国法院判决或法律意见的连续正文中，常与判决、上诉、法条、救济等术语及正式句法相邻；激活分布在多个普通功能词和法律短语上。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的关系词与公式邻接语
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文或公式附近的叙述中，连接定义、系数、算子、函数空间等数学对象；有时紧邻 LaTeX 数学表达式。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的数值实验方法描述
patterns.context: 实验对象、体重数值及随机分配到笼具的描述中，括号、误差范围符号和方法学措辞共同出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 符号运算与零项的局部序列
patterns.context: 出现在多项式展开或类似计算输出中，激活落在算术符号与零系数项上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal and scientific texts, often falling on punctuation, function words, numerical formulas, and formatting boundaries; legal terminology, statistical reports, experimental parameters, biomedical objects, and mathematical notation also occur, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formula symbols
patterns.context: In formulas, numerical values, statistical results, or structured argumentation, symbols occur at boundaries between numbers, variables, units, or text; specific triggers vary across passages
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, mathematical texts, legal texts

patterns.name: Short function words and relational connectives
patterns.context: Common prepositions and conjunctions before or after technical terms, experimental subjects, relations, or methods; trigger words are scattered across different syntactic positions

patterns.name: Legal litigation and quotation formats
patterns.context: Case parties, decisions, or statutory references, accompanied by line breaks, indentation, and quotation-style formatting

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance reports
patterns.context: Reports correlations, significance thresholds, or test results, often with equals signs, numerical values, and statistical symbols

patterns.name: Experimental parameters, measurements, and units
patterns.context: Experimental materials, measurements, equipment dimensions, doses, or results expressed with numbers and units

patterns.name: Animal models, drugs, and biomedical objects
patterns.context: In immunology, oncology, or radiopharmaceutical research, proper names occur alongside experimental descriptions

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and mapping notation
patterns.context: Defines mathematical objects using variables, mappings, matrices, or formulas, including LaTeX typesetting and symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Legal proper names and citation formatting
patterns.context: Case names, company names, or statutory numbers appear in irregularly formatted legal texts

patterns.name: Paragraph and heading boundaries
patterns.context: Section headings, paragraph transitions, or sentence-initial positions after line breaks; may be unrelated to adjacent domain content

7_1247.concept: 专业文本中的结构标记
7_1247.description: 激活分散于法律与科学文本，常落在标点、功能词、数字公式及排版边界；另见法律术语、统计报告、实验参数、生物医学对象和数学记号，缺乏单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 标点与公式符号
patterns.trigger: 逗号「,」、等号「=」、乘号「×」、数学符号「≤」、括号「(」、方括号「[」及其邻近 token
patterns.context: 公式、数值、统计结果或结构化论述中，符号位于数字、变量、单位或文本分隔处；各段具体触发符号并不相同
patterns.domain: 科学论文、数学文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 短功能词及关系连接
patterns.context: 专业名词、实验对象、关系或方法前后的常见介词和连词；触发词分散在不同句法位置

patterns.name: 法律诉讼与引述格式
patterns.context: 案件当事人、判决或法条叙述，伴有换行、缩进及引述式排版

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性报告
patterns.context: 报告相关性、显著性阈值或检验结果，常有等号、数值和统计符号

patterns.name: 实验参数、测量及单位
patterns.context: 实验材料、测量值、设备尺寸、剂量或结果以数字和单位表达

patterns.name: 动物模型、药物与生物医学对象
patterns.context: 免疫学、肿瘤或放射性药物研究中，专名与实验描述相邻

patterns.name: 数学定义与映射记号
patterns.trigger: 「coherent set of maps」「m_k: K_k × X^k → X」「φ(456^(2))」「coefficient of t^2」「det」
patterns.context: 以变量、映射、矩阵或公式定义数学对象，包含 LaTeX 排版及符号
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 法律专名及引文排版
patterns.context: 案件名称、公司名或法条编号出现在格式不规则的法律文本中

patterns.name: 段落及标题边界
patterns.context: 小节标题、段落转换或换行后句首位置；可能与相邻领域内容无关

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and format triggers
en.description: Activations occur on within-word fragments (especially oid), mathematical numbers and operators, with sporadic patterns involving questions, date headings, and chat discussions. Some medical terms can be explained by within-word oid; the remaining triggers are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Within-word oid pattern
patterns.context: The trigger occurs at the end of longer words, usually marked separately from the preceding stem; it is not limited to a single complete term
patterns.domain: Medical text; also see number/symbol segmentation in mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Calculations or numerical descriptions composed of numbers, punctuation, and operators; activations fall on number fragments and symbols

patterns.name: Question-style phrases and numbered prompts
patterns.context: Words in the phrase “Turno de preguntas (preg...” are split into fragments, with parentheses and an abbreviation/the beginning of a following word nearby

patterns.name: Months in date headings
patterns.context: Occurs in date lines containing a weekday, date, and year, and recurs in subsequent headings

patterns.name: chat and related complaints
patterns.context: Discussion of code readability, syntax highlighting, and pasting complete class definitions into chat

patterns.name: Isolated technical-term fragments
patterns.context: Sentences about polyp size and NBI diagnostic accuracy; apart from the general within-word fragment pattern in medical terms, no clear shared trigger is apparent

7_1691.concept: 混合的词片段与格式触发
7_1691.description: 激活分布于词内片段（尤其 oid）、数学数字和运算符，并有问句、日期标题、聊天讨论等零散模式。部分医学术语可由词内 oid 解释；其余触发条件并不一致。

patterns.name: 词内片段 oid 的形式
patterns.context: 触发点在较长词的词尾，通常与前面的词干分开标记；并非只限于一个完整术语
patterns.domain: 医学文本；另见数学表达中的数字/符号切分

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数字、标点和运算符构成的计算或数值描述，激活落在数字片段及符号上

patterns.name: 问句式短语及编号提示
patterns.context: 短语“Turno de preguntas (preg...”的词被拆分成片段，周围有括号及缩写/后续词的开头

patterns.name: 日期标题中的月份
patterns.context: 出现在带星期、日期和年份的日期行，并重复于后续标题

patterns.name: chat 及相关抱怨措辞
patterns.context: 讨论聊天中代码可读性、语法高亮及粘贴完整类定义的问题

patterns.name: 孤立的专业词片段
patterns.context: 有关息肉大小、NBI 诊断准确性的句子；除一般医学词内片段模式外，未见明确共同触发条件

en.concept: Preference for the in-word fragment oid
en.description: The most reproducible cue is oid at the end of words (Rheumatoid, sigmoid, polypoid, corticosteroid); it also activates on mathematical numbers, dates, and various isolated word fragments, inconsistently across corpora.

patterns.name: In-word letter fragment oid
patterns.context: Activation falls on the oid substring at the end of words; it appears across different domains and contexts.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation formats
patterns.context: In numerical expressions, equations, or dates, activation falls on numbers and adjacent symbols; it is unclear whether the trigger is the format itself or specific numbers.

patterns.name: Disease name Rheumatoid Arthritis
patterns.context: Multiple in-word fragments activate in the disease name and its repeated appearance in titles; oid also occurs in other words.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and segmentation
patterns.context: Activation occurs in complex medical terminology or specialized words composed of multiple fragments; some activation overlaps with in-word oid, while other trigger conditions are unclear.

patterns.name: Opening of English questions
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of question content such as “Turn … questions (preg…”; subsequent fragments “p” and “reg” also activate, with the precise conditions unclear.

patterns.name: Software chat discussion
patterns.context: Discusses code display, syntax highlighting, and pasting an entire class definition in chat; activation is scattered across these words, with no clear connection to other patterns.

patterns.name: Drug ingredients in patents
patterns.context: Describes a dual-liquid formulation and mechanism involving a beta agonist and corticosteroid in an inhalation device; overlaps with the in-word oid pattern, while the trigger for B is unclear.

patterns.name: Unidentified neuroscience word fragments
patterns.context: Activates in technical sentences describing neural afferent signals, receptors, and ion channels; a single example cannot establish a consistent condition.

7_1691.description: 最可复现的线索是单词末尾 oid（Rheumatoid、sigmoid、polypoid、corticosteroid）；另在数学数字、日期及多种孤立词片段上激活，跨语料且不统一。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 oid
patterns.context: 激活落在单词末尾的 oid 子串；不同领域和上下文均出现。

patterns.name: 数字与标点格式
patterns.trigger: «2»、«-»、«,»、«.» 等数字或标点附近的分片
patterns.context: 数值表达、运算式或日期中，激活分布在数字及其邻近符号上；不能确定是对格式本身还是具体数字触发。

patterns.name: 疾病名称 Rheumatoid Arthritis
patterns.context: 疾病名称及其重复出现的标题中，多段词内片段有激活；其中 oid 也见于其他词。

patterns.name: 医学术语及分片
patterns.context: 复杂医学术语或由多段组成的专业词中出现激活；部分激活与词内 oid 重合，其余触发条件不明确。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 神经科学文本

patterns.name: 英文疑问句开头
patterns.context: 位于 “Turn … questions (preg…” 这类疑问内容开头；后续分片 “p”“reg”也激活，具体条件不明。

patterns.name: 软件聊天讨论
patterns.context: 讨论聊天中的代码展示、语法高亮和粘贴整段类定义；激活分散在这些词上，未见与其他模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 专利中的药物成分
patterns.context: 描述吸入装置中 beta agonist 与 corticosteroid 的双液体配方和作用；oid 与词内片段模式重合，B 的触发不明。

patterns.name: 未明的神经科学词片段
patterns.context: 在描述神经传入信号、受体和离子通道的技术句中激活，无法从单例判定统一条件。

en.concept: Word-final fragments and local formatting features
en.description: Primarily activates on the word-final fragment “oid,” across various medical terms; it also responds to the date month “October,” numbers and symbols in mathematical expressions, and fragments in parliamentary question titles.

patterns.name: Segmented in-word fragment “oid”
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs at the end of complete words with different beginnings and stems; it does not require a fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Primarily medical abstracts, also NIH research texts

patterns.name: October in English dates
patterns.context: In date formats, the month name is followed by a day and year; activation falls on the month word.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions comprising values, minus signs, decimal points, and operators, some numbers or symbols are marked; no stable condition involving specific values is apparent.

patterns.name: Opening imperative phrase and numbered-style question
patterns.context: The phrase begins with “Turno de preguntas,” followed by parentheses and the segmented fragment “preg...”; possibly a title for a question period in parliamentary text.

7_1691.concept: 词末片段及局部格式特征
7_1691.description: 主要在词末片段“oid”激活，覆盖多种医学术语；另对日期月份“October”、数学表达中的数字与符号，以及议会提问标题的片段有反应。

patterns.name: 切分后的词内片段“oid”
patterns.trigger: «oid»9（[3] 的 “Vanilloid”、[5] 的 “polypoid”、[8] 的 “sigmoid”、[10] 的 “endometrioid”；[2] 的 “Rheumatoid”中也有 «oid»8）
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在完整词的末尾，词首及词干各不相同；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要为主，也见 NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: 英文日期中的 October
patterns.context: 日期格式中，月份名后接日、年份；激活落在月份词。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数值、负号、小数点和运算符组成的数学表达中，若干数字或符号被标记；看不出稳定的具体数值条件。

patterns.name: 起始祈使语及编号式问题
patterns.context: 短语从“Turno de preguntas”起始，后接括号及被切分的“preg...”片段；可能是议会文本中的提问环节标题。

en.concept: Dates, numbers, and local word forms
en.description: Activations occur in dates containing October, mathematical numbers and punctuation, several within-word subword fragments, repeated encyclopedia headings, and line breaks. AI news terminology also activates, but is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: October in dates
patterns.context: October appears in dates or event schedules, sometimes adjacent to a year or specific day
patterns.domain: Biographies, event updates, television program entries

patterns.name: Numerical and arithmetic formats
patterns.context: In math problems, expressions, or parameter lists, activations fall on numbers, punctuation, and variables

patterns.name: Within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across initial or internal subword fragments; the words occur in questions, names, or medical terms
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, biographical entries, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Repeated entry headings and line breaks
patterns.context: An entry heading is repeated after a line break, and parts of the heading text also activate

patterns.name: Terminology in AI algorithm reporting
patterns.context: Reporting describes an AI algorithm acquiring a new kind of memory and solving a game

patterns.name: Proper names and numbers in entry headings
patterns.context: Television program entry headings and air dates; activations involve name fragments and dates

patterns.name: Monday date headings
patterns.context: A document begins with a heading comprising a weekday, date, and year, followed by update content

patterns.name: Question-style openings
patterns.context: Question-related word fragments or parameter labels appear near the start of a paragraph or problem

7_1691.description: 激活分布于含 October 的日期、数学数字与标点、若干词内子词片段，以及百科标题重复和换行；另有 AI 新闻术语激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 日期中的 October
patterns.context: 日期或事件时间表中出现 October；有时紧邻年份或具体日
patterns.domain: 人物传记、事件更新、电视节目条目

patterns.name: 数值及算术格式
patterns.context: 数学题、表达式或参数列表中，激活落在数字、标点及变量上

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在词的开头或内部子词片段；这些词分别处于问题、姓名或医学术语中
patterns.domain: 议会文本、人物条目、医学摘要

patterns.name: 重复的条目标题与换行
patterns.context: 条目标题在换行后重复，标题文字部分也激活

patterns.name: AI算法报道中的术语
patterns.context: 报道描述 AI 算法获得新型记忆并破解游戏

patterns.name: 条目标题中的专名与数字
patterns.context: 节目条目标题及播出日期；激活涉及名称片段和日期

patterns.name: 周一日期标题
patterns.context: 文档开头以星期、日期和年份组成标题，随后进入更新内容

patterns.name: 问题式开头
patterns.context: 段首或题面附近出现提问相关词片段或参数标签

en.concept: English subwords and short word fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across in-word substrings in English texts from various domains, especially and and nearby short words; it also occurs on mathematical numbers and symbols, proper names, and informal email formatting, without a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: In-word English subword fragments
patterns.context: Different subword fragments in words can activate in continuous English text; no consistent word meaning or fixed positional condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including parliamentary, mathematical, email, biomedical, and Wikipedia texts

patterns.name: and and adjacent connective structures
patterns.context: Connects coordinated elements or continues a description in phrases or sentences; commonly seen in biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in math problems
patterns.context: Math problem statements or probability notation composed of numbers and punctuation

patterns.name: Name and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Letters and subword fragments in proper names or organization names; the two passages have no evident shared entity or theme

patterns.name: Informal email language and formatting
patterns.context: Informal email text with conversational laughter, exclamation marks, and a signature-style name

7_1691.description: 激活分布在多领域英语文本的词内子串，尤其可见and及邻近短词；也出现在数学数字符号、专名和邮件口语排版中，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词片段
patterns.trigger: 多段激活落在词内部子串，如 «preg»、«unt»、«culate»、«remainder»、«Ast»、«hma»、«respons»、«termination»、«nas»、«okin»、«ovirus»、«pals»
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中，词的不同子词片段均可激活；没有显示统一的词义或固定位置条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括议会、数学、邮件、生物医学和维基百科

patterns.name: and及相邻连接结构
patterns.context: 短语或句子中连接并列成分、延续描述；多见于生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 数字、标点构成的数学题面或概率记号

patterns.name: 名称与专名片段
patterns.context: 专名或组织名称中的字母与子词片段；两处内容并无明显共同实体或主题
patterns.domain: 商业邮件与维基百科条目

patterns.name: 邮件口语与排版
patterns.context: 带有口语笑语、感叹号及邮件签名式姓名的非正式邮件文本

en.concept: Dates/ formatted text and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations occur in dates and months, encyclopedia entry headings, medical infant contexts, institutional fields, financial news, system notices, email salutations, and Spanish parliamentary phrases. October appears repeatedly in particular, but the passages have no single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English month October
patterns.context: The month name appears in dates, headings, or dates in body text; the second passage also contains other months such as January and May, so October is not the only trigger
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, email subjects and body text, dates/announcements

patterns.name: English date and time expressions
patterns.context: Combinations of dates, years, times, and punctuation, often in headings, time ranges, or birth and death dates

patterns.name: Spanish question-session opening
patterns.context: Word fragments in the Spanish phrase “Turno de preguntas” (question session)

patterns.name: infant in medical text
patterns.context: Occurs in infant case descriptions or the title of a study on infant crying

patterns.name: Institutional/role fields
patterns.context: Fields naming the principal investigator in a form or application record

patterns.name: Press releases and financial terminology
patterns.context: Newsletter headings and entries related to credit derivatives

patterns.name: System availability notices
patterns.context: An all-caps heading with spaces between letters, followed by system downtime or availability ranges

patterns.name: Email salutations and back-and-forth correspondence
patterns.context: Salutations in private email body text and expressions about travel and return plans

patterns.name: Repeated headings and entry names
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry heading is repeated at the start of the body, followed by an introduction or biographical dates

patterns.name: Birth and death dates of encyclopedia subjects
patterns.context: A person's name is followed by birth and death dates in parentheses

7_1691.concept: 日期/格式化文本及专名片段
7_1691.description: 激活分布于日期与月份、百科条目标题、医学婴儿语境、机构字段、金融新闻、系统通知、邮件称呼及西班牙语议事短语；其中日期尤其是 October 多次出现，但各段没有单一明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文月份 October
patterns.trigger: October（第 2 段中还有 «October»9；第 5、8、9、10 段为 «October»8）
patterns.context: 月份名称出现在日期、标题或正文日期中；第 2 段还出现 January、May 等其他月份，故 October 并非唯一触发词
patterns.domain: 百科条目、邮件标题与正文、日期/公告

patterns.name: 英文日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、时间及其标点组合，常处于标题、时间范围或人物生卒日期中

patterns.name: 西班牙语问句开头
patterns.context: 西班牙语短语“Turno de preguntas”（提问环节）中的词片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录/议事文本

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 infant
patterns.context: 出现在婴儿病例描述或婴儿哭闹研究标题中

patterns.name: 机构/职务字段
patterns.context: 表格或申请记录中的负责人姓名字段

patterns.name: 新闻稿与金融术语
patterns.context: 新闻简报标题及信用衍生品相关条目

patterns.name: 系统可用性通知
patterns.context: 字母间插空格的全大写标题，后接系统停机或可用时间范围
patterns.domain: 企业邮件/系统维护通知

patterns.name: 邮件称呼与往返信件用语
patterns.context: 私人邮件正文中的称呼及旅行、返回计划表达

patterns.name: 标题与条目名重复
patterns.trigger: «Pebble Mill at One» 重复出现；«Lambert Tree»重复出现
patterns.context: 百科条目标题在正文开头再次重复，后接介绍或人物生卒信息

patterns.name: 百科人物生卒日期
patterns.context: 人物姓名后以括号标出生与逝世日期

en.description: Activations occur across heterogeneous text, often on dates and times, title-style capitalized phrases, email line breaks, and formatted announcements. Other examples involve finance, security, slang, biochemistry, Spanish Q&A, aviation, and Halloween events, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Date and time expressions
patterns.context: Months and numbers occur together in dates, years, times, or time ranges; some examples also include commas, colons, or weekdays.
patterns.domain: Event announcements, email notices, schedule information

patterns.name: Headings and prominent formatting
patterns.context: Capitalized or title-style phrases appear as email subjects, announcement headings, prominent labels, or section headings, often with line breaks.

patterns.name: Email salutations and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Recipient salutations or paragraph separators in email body text; blank lines and line-break markers stand out in multiple passages.

patterns.name: Financial transactions and energy companies
patterns.context: Mentions of transactions, energy companies, or company recruitment in corporate email body text.

patterns.name: Security vulnerabilities and technical evidence
patterns.context: Describes vulnerabilities as long known, disclosed, or supported by evidence such as diagnostic equipment.

patterns.name: Slang and phrase definitions
patterns.context: Asks or explains whether an expression is slang or difficult to understand, and discusses its context.

patterns.name: Amino acid and protein terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the composition of amino acids and mentions their role in proteins.

patterns.name: Spanish Q&A phrase
patterns.context: A Spanish heading for a question-and-answer session appears; the surrounding passage is incomplete.

patterns.name: Travel regulations and airport baggage
patterns.context: Announces aviation travel policies or fee changes, organizing the notice with prominent labels and effective dates.
patterns.domain: Corporate travel notices, aviation management information

patterns.name: Halloween event planning
patterns.context: Lists autumn or Halloween events and provides their times and details.
patterns.domain: Community event websites or promotional copy

7_1691.concept: 结构化文本中的显著片段
7_1691.description: 激活分布于异质文本，常落在日期时间、标题式大写短语、邮件换行与格式化公告；另分别涉及金融、安全、俚语、生化、西语问答、航空及万圣节活动，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、时刻或时间范围中的月份与数字相邻出现；部分例子还带有逗号、冒号或星期。
patterns.domain: 活动公告、邮件通知、日程信息

patterns.name: 标题与醒目排版
patterns.trigger: “Cobra Update”, “END SYSTEMS AVAILABILITY”, “IMPORTANT!”, “POSITIVE BAG MATCH”, “Event Details”
patterns.context: 大写或标题式短语作为邮件主题、公告标题、醒目标签或小节标题出现，常伴随换行。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、网页活动公告

patterns.name: 邮件称呼及换行格式
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的收件人称呼或段落分隔；空行和换行标记在多个片段中突出。

patterns.name: 金融交易与能源公司
patterns.context: 提及交易、能源企业或公司招聘等信息，出现在企业邮件正文中。

patterns.name: 安全漏洞及技术证据
patterns.context: 叙述漏洞早已被知晓、披露或以诊断设备等方式获得证据。

patterns.name: 俚语与短语释义
patterns.context: 提问或解释某个表达是否属于俚语、是否难以理解，并讨论其语境。

patterns.name: 氨基酸与蛋白质术语
patterns.context: 介绍氨基酸的组成，并提及其在蛋白质中的作用。

patterns.name: 西班牙语问答短语
patterns.context: 出现西班牙语的问答环节标题；上下文片段不完整。

patterns.name: 旅行规定与机场行李
patterns.context: 告知航空出行政策或费用变化，并以醒目标签和生效日期组织通知。
patterns.domain: 企业旅行通知、航空管理信息

patterns.name: 万圣节活动安排
patterns.trigger: “Trick or Treating”, “Cabin decorating”, “Golf Cart decorating”, “Halloween crafts”
patterns.context: 列举秋季或万圣节期间的活动，并说明活动时间和详情。
patterns.domain: 社区活动网页或宣传文案

en.concept: notch phrases and sporadic local features
en.description: Primarily responds to notch phrases (up/down a notch, top notch); also includes in introducing events or times, pin forms, and activations on isolated within-word fragments, line breaks, and sporadic words. The gesture description in passage 4 does not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed expression up a notch
patterns.context: The word notch appears, especially with up, down, or top; “notch” itself and tokens in nearby phrases activate strongly.

patterns.name: in introducing emphasis on time or events
patterns.context: The preposition in occurs within a sentence and introduces an event or time range; activation falls on in.

patterns.name: pin-related forms
patterns.context: The literal form pin or a name containing the root appears; activation concentrates on pin or pinching.

patterns.name: Local fragment in an unusual word form
patterns.context: Activation falls on a within-word fragment of the nonstandard spelling “squeeking”; seals are discussed nearby.

patterns.name: Text fragments and line breaks
patterns.context: Strong activations occur in short passages or around line breaks, but have no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights not explained by shared semantics
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no reproducible shared collocation or condition.

7_1691.description: 主要响应 notch 短语（up/down a notch、top notch）；另见 in 引导活动或时间、pin 词形，以及个别词内片段、换行和零散词的激活。第4段的手势描写无法归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: up a notch固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “up a notch” / “tone that down a notch” / “top notch”
patterns.context: 出现短语 notch，尤其与 up、down 或 top 搭配；“notch”本身及其邻近短语中的 token 有强激活。

patterns.name: in 后强调时间或活动
patterns.context: 介词 in 位于句中并引出活动或时间范围；激活落在 in。

patterns.name: pin相关词形
patterns.context: 出现 pin 的字面词形或包含该词根的名称；激活集中在 pin 或 pinching。

patterns.name: 怪异词形中的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在非标准拼写“squeeking”的词内片段，附近谈论 seals。

patterns.name: 文本片段与换行
patterns.trigger: “Jussi Jumppanen”附近的换行，以及“back”后的换行
patterns.context: 短片段或换行前后出现强激活，但没有稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 无法由共同语义解释的零散高亮
patterns.context: 各自出现于不同语境，未见可复现的共同搭配或条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several contexts: housing, sports game appearances, inheritance, motivation, neighbors, and several one-off word senses. They sometimes cluster locally within word forms, but have no clear unified semantics overall.

patterns.name: houses and housing construction
patterns.context: Involves developers building houses or a shortage of housing supply and a tight rental market.

patterns.name: games in sports
patterns.context: Describes player appearances or the number of games played this season after a suspension.

patterns.name: Inheritance forms
patterns.context: Describes a character inheriting an estate or title; activation concentrates on the inherit stem and its inflections.

patterns.name: Motivation and incentives
patterns.context: Describes someone using incentives or being inspired after watching content.

patterns.name: Neighbors and acquaintances
patterns.context: Mentions neighbors as personal relations or as people observed or interacted with.

patterns.name: The action hit
patterns.context: Used as a sports instruction meaning to watch the ball and hit it.

patterns.name: Benefits of nomad life
patterns.context: Discusses digital nomad life and notes its conveniences or advantages.

patterns.name: stakes and major events
patterns.context: Uses “stakes could be higher” to emphasize the importance of events such as a Super Bowl berth.

patterns.name: Quantity expressed as half
patterns.context: Half of a piece of land is sold, followed by area or quantity information.

patterns.name: Temporal sense of close
patterns.context: “at its close” refers to the end of a life or experience.

7_1691.description: 激活分散在多类语境：住房、体育比赛场次、继承、动机、邻居及若干单次词义。词形内部有时局部集中，但整体没有明确统一语义。

patterns.name: houses及住房建设

patterns.name: 比赛中的 games

patterns.name: 继承词形
patterns.context: 叙述人物继承遗产或爵位；激活集中在 inherit 词干及其变形。

patterns.name: 动机及激励
patterns.context: 描述某人用激励方法，或观看内容后受到鼓舞。

patterns.name: 邻居与熟人
patterns.context: 提及邻居作为人物关系或被观察、交往的对象。

patterns.name: hit 的动作

patterns.name: nomad 的益处
patterns.context: 谈数字游牧生活，并指出其带来的便利或优势。

patterns.name: stakes 与重大赛事

patterns.name: half 的数量表达

patterns.name: close 的时间义

en.concept: Strings containing ugg and competition statistics
en.description: Activations mainly fall on strings containing “ugg” (such as snuggles, smuggled, sluggish), as well as accounts of competition results, wins, rankings, and games played; there is also an activation on the number of degrees in a biography.

patterns.name: Strings containing smugg

patterns.name: Competition records and rankings

patterns.name: Number of degrees

7_1691.description: 激活主要落在含“ugg”的词串（如 snuggles、smuggled、sluggish），以及赛事成绩、胜场、名次和比赛场次等统计叙述；另在一处人物传记的学位数量处激活。

patterns.name: 含有 smugg 的字符串

patterns.name: Score and ranking number strings

patterns.domain: Sports news, event coverage, and sports statistics; [10] may also be financial index data

patterns.name: Sports team and player names

patterns.name: Soccer matches and league accounts

patterns.name: Stock or index movements

patterns.name: Team composition and coaching decisions
patterns.context: Discusses coaches assigning player positions, judging starting eligibility, and opinions on roster decisions.

patterns.name: League teams and venue information

7_1691.concept: 体育新闻中的专名与数据
7_1691.description: 主要响应体育文本中的队名、人名、赛事结果与数字统计，也涵盖足球联赛和球员信息、选秀、伤病及球队评论；另有游戏战斗与金融指数报道等少数语境。

patterns.name: 比分及排名数字串

patterns.domain: 体育新闻、赛事报道与体育统计；[10]也可能是金融指数数据

patterns.name: 体育队伍及球员名称
patterns.context: 队名、人名或队伍昵称出现在比赛、球员表现、伤病、选秀等叙述中；触发有时落在名称内部的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 冰球、美式橄榄球、足球，以及奇幻游戏的队伍/阵营叙述

patterns.name: 足球比赛与联赛叙述
patterns.context: 联赛归属、主场、转会或球员能否稳定出场等足球语境。

patterns.name: 游戏与奇幻战斗

patterns.domain: 游戏/奇幻题材网络帖子

patterns.name: 伤病与赛季缺阵

patterns.name: 个股或指数涨跌数据

patterns.name: 球队配置与教练决策
patterns.trigger: «put everyone where he thinks they fit best»、«starting at LT»
patterns.context: 讨论教练安排球员位置、判断先发资格及对阵容决策的看法。

patterns.name: 赛果评价与球队实力比较
patterns.trigger: «sure victory»、«gutty performances»、«not even the best defensive team»
patterns.context: 评述球队逆转、表现韧性，或比较分区内防守实力。

patterns.name: 赔率与选秀顺位
patterns.context: 描述球队抽中选秀签位的概率和最终顺序。

patterns.name: 联赛球队及场地信息

patterns.context: 小型俱乐部更换联赛并介绍主场及容量。

en.description: Primarily responds to teams, players, games, leagues, coaches, and performance descriptions in sports contexts, spanning multiple sports and levels of competition; also includes PLUNKER in a code example and 50%, GitHub, and DMCA in technology copyright news.

patterns.name: Hockey events and player evaluations

7_1691.description: 主要响应体育语境中的球队、球员、比赛、联赛、教练及表现描述，涵盖多种运动和赛事层级；另有代码示例中的 PLUNKER，以及科技版权新闻中的 50%、GitHub、DMCA。

patterns.name: 冰球赛事与球员评价

patterns.name: 百分比与 GitHub DMCA 通知

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and sports-context features
en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented proper names, sports players and event commentary, statistical numbers, and ordinary function words; business email figures and literary proper-name fragments also occur, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sports names and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within personal, team, or organization names, often as proper-name fragments split by tokenization; also includes numbers, hyphens, or abbreviations adjacent to proper names.

patterns.name: Hockey roster and NHL level
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a player is at NHL level or their tier within a team roster, often alongside player names, position abbreviations, and hyphenated tiers.

patterns.name: Sports performance and statistical descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of player performance, game data, positions, or roles; some activations fall on numerical values, statistical terms, role words, and adjacent fragments.
patterns.domain: Basketball, hockey, and general sports commentary

patterns.name: Common English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Short words or phrase fragments in ordinary syntactic contexts; spans sports reporting, emails, and literary text without a stable specialized semantic condition.

patterns.name: Events and game-action words
patterns.context: Words related to games, stages of an event, or possession, occurring in soccer or basketball reporting.

patterns.name: Email amounts and times with numbers
patterns.context: Emails involving amounts, units of measurement, effective dates, or numerical corrections; organization names also occur around the numbers.

patterns.name: Book titles and character references in literary works

patterns.name: Player appearance and physical characteristics
patterns.context: Describes players' appearance, physique, or fitness, often alongside evaluations of athletic ability.

7_1691.concept: 混杂的词片段与体育语境特征
7_1691.description: 激活分散在专名拆分、体育球员与赛事评论、统计数字和普通功能词上；另有商务邮件数值及文学专名片段，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 体育人名与专名片段

patterns.name: 体育表现与统计描述

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词及短语片段

patterns.context: 出现在普通句法环境中的短词或短语片段；跨越体育报道、邮件和文学文本，未显示稳定的专门语义条件。

patterns.name: 赛事与比赛动作词

patterns.name: 文学作品中的书名与人物称谓

patterns.name: 球员外观与身体特征
patterns.context: 描述球员外貌、身体条件或体能特点，常与竞技能力评价并列。

en.description: Activation is scattered across sports coverage, anime reviews, business emails, and media technology contexts. It includes common function words with, is, and in, as well as teams, proper names, sports phrases, and in-word segmented fragments such as 3-D; no clear unified semantic or stylistic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: English preposition with
patterns.context: Appears in expressions establishing a relationship, pairing, or accompaniment involving people, teams, or things; often connects to a preceding predicate or noun.

patterns.name: Progressive or perfect auxiliary is
patterns.context: Followed by a description, identity, or state; the passages include general explanations and email records.

patterns.name: In-word segmented role/identity words woman, girls, female
patterns.context: Discusses female characters, performers, or anime characters.

patterns.name: Jets football phrases
patterns.context: Mentions having no Jets game to watch and recollections of related players.

patterns.name: In-word segmented Flyers team name

patterns.name: come from behind
patterns.context: Describes a team trailing in a game and catching up, making a comeback, or attempting one.

patterns.name: In-word segmented proper name Equistar

patterns.name: Positional/role expressions with in

patterns.name: 3-D numbers and technical terminology

patterns.name: Sports radio terminology

7_1691.description: 激活分散于体育报道、动漫评论、业务邮件和媒体技术等语境，包含常见功能词 with、is、in，以及球队、专名、体育短语和 3-D 等词内切分片段；没有清晰统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 英文介词 with

patterns.name: 进行时或完成体助动词 is

patterns.name: in 的位置/角色表达

patterns.name: 3-D 数字与技术术语
patterns.context: 讨论 3-D 电影制作、放映或版本，数字与字母跨 token 拆分。

patterns.name: 体育广播电台术语

en.description: Examples of activations divide into fragments of the surname Plimpton, several within-word fragments, and proper names, scores, and terminology in various sports texts. Sports text is the largest category, but trigger locations are scattered, so it is unclear whether the remaining fragments share a mechanism with the sports theme.

patterns.name: Fragment within the surname Plimpton
patterns.context: When the English name Plimpton is tokenized, activation falls on a fragment in the middle of the surname; one passage features a character in a narrative, the other a list of names.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in proper names or words
patterns.context: Activations occur within longer English words or at word-form boundaries; no shared semantics or stable morphological condition is apparent across the three examples.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, personal-experience review, music review

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in sports commentary
patterns.context: Occurs in reports or commentary related to hockey, basketball, football, or wrestling, involving sports, names, scores, positions, or game terminology; specific activation locations vary.

7_1691.description: 激活例子可分为 Plimpton 姓氏片段、若干词内片段，以及多种体育文本中的专名、比分和术语。体育文本覆盖最多，但触发位置分散，不能确定其余片段与体育主题共享机制。

patterns.name: Plimpton 姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 英文人名 Plimpton 被切分时，激活落在姓氏中间的片段；一段是叙事中的人物，一段是人名列表。

patterns.name: 专名或词内的特定片段
