en.description: Primarily occurs near numerical expressions for scores, rankings, statistics, and distances in sports coverage across various sports; also appears in wrestling matchups, age numbers, and one algorithm performance multiplier, making a unified trigger condition difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Numbers and scores in sporting events
patterns.context: Numbers or scores occur in the context of event data, rankings, distances, or comparative results; the tenth passage concerns an algorithm performance multiplier, with a weaker trigger
patterns.domain: Sports coverage (American football, basketball, racing, hockey, golf) and a small amount of technical Q&A

patterns.name: Wrestlers and event names
patterns.context: Wrestler names occur alongside “vs.,” event names, and years in matchup information

patterns.name: Historical years and age numbers
patterns.context: Narrative recalling parents' ages and historical events; numbers concern height and age, with the specific triggering relationship unclear

7_1691.description: 主要出现在体育报道的比分、排名、统计和距离等数字表达附近，涵盖多种运动；另见摔角对阵、年龄数字及一处算法性能倍数，难以确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 体育比赛中的数字与比分
patterns.trigger: 数字、连字符比分及其邻近的比赛术语，如“Jets football”“2-3”“6-7”“13th”“3-for-8”“5 of 6”“twelve-foot birdie putt”“factor of 3”
patterns.context: 数字或比分处在赛事数据、排名、距离或比较结果的语境中；第10段则是算法性能倍数，触发较弱
patterns.domain: 体育报道（美式足球、篮球、赛车、冰球、高尔夫）及少量技术问答

patterns.name: 摔角选手与赛事名称
patterns.context: 选手姓名与“vs.”、赛事名及年份等摔角对阵信息相邻

patterns.name: 历史年份与年龄数字
patterns.trigger: “5”与“8”“5”与“9”出现在年龄表达“5'8”“5'9”中，并邻接“Lincoln shot”
patterns.context: 回忆父母年龄及历史事件的叙述；数字涉及身高和年龄，具体触发关系不确定

en.description: Activations often fall on numbers or numeric suffixes: examples include competition rankings, quantities, player numbers, scores, and scientific multiples. Other examples include faceoff, country music, and split fragments of names or proper nouns. The overall pattern is dispersed, and some proper-noun fragments resist a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and placement
patterns.context: A number followed by the ordinal suffix th indicates a competitor’s placement; activation falls near the number and suffix.

patterns.name: The quantity word “five”
patterns.context: The English number word five indicates a quantity in a sentence estimating that someone was a few years late to an event.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in faceoff
patterns.context: The word faceoff (a hockey face-off) is split into two subword fragments; the latter part activates more strongly.

patterns.name: The phrase “country music”
patterns.context: country is followed directly by music to form a music genre name; it appears twice.

patterns.name: 9 in a number string
patterns.context: 9 appears in a numeric expression after factor; the text describes a change in simulation results by a multiple or a range of galaxy brightness.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split names, event names, or fragments within ordinary words; these examples have no obvious shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, lyrics, and entertainment content

patterns.name: Basketball player numbers and score digits
patterns.context: Activations occur in player numbers or score-like number strings, including separators and adjacent digits.

7_1691.description: 激活多落在数字或数字后缀中：比赛名次、数量、球员号码、比分和科学倍数均有例子；另有 faceoff、country music 及拆分的人名或专名片段。整体模式分散，部分专名片段无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 序数名次与排名
patterns.context: 数字后接序数后缀 th，表示选手在比赛中的名次；激活落在数字及后缀附近。

patterns.name: “five”数量词
patterns.context: 英文数词 five 表示数量，出现在估计晚了几年参加活动的句子中。

patterns.name: faceoff 词内片段
patterns.context: 词组 faceoff（冰球开球争球）被分成两个子词片段；后半部分激活更强。

patterns.name: “country music”词组
patterns.context: country 紧接 music，构成音乐类型名称；两处重复出现。

patterns.name: 数字串中的 9
patterns.context: 9 出现在 factor 后的数值表达中；文中描述模拟结果的变化倍数或星系亮度范围。

patterns.name: 人名及专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在拆分的人名、赛事名或普通词内部片段；这些例子没有共同的明显语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、歌词及娱乐内容

patterns.name: 篮球球员号码与比分数字
patterns.context: 激活出现在球员号码或比分样式的数字串中，包含分隔符及相邻数字。

en.description: Activation is distributed across varied corpora and styles, often falling on internal token fragments of segmented words, and sporadically on common phrase words and ordinary function words; no stable thematic, syntactic-position, or semantic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: In-word affixes or subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on internal fragments of words split into multiple tokens, rather than complete words or fixed syntactic positions; the fragments occur in different word forms across examples.
patterns.domain: Tokenization/token boundaries in texts from multiple domains

patterns.name: Common words in phrases
patterns.context: Common words are marked in coherent phrases, but have no consistent part of speech, position, or semantic role; the same common word appears in different contexts.

patterns.name: Several weak or sporadic activations
patterns.context: A few common function words or ordinary words are marked in sentences, with no stable neighboring structure or shared semantic condition.

7_1691.description: 激活分布于多种语料和文体，常落在拆分词的内部 token 片段，也零散落在短语常见词及普通功能词上；未呈现稳定的主题、句法位置或语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内词缀或子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分成多个 token 的词内部片段，而非完整词或固定句法位置；不同例子中片段所处词形各异。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本中的分词/token 边界

patterns.name: 短语中的常见词
patterns.trigger: « team»；« At» « the» « same» « time»；« on» « the» « field»；«Once» « you» « start»
patterns.context: 常见词在连贯短语中被标记，但没有一致的词性、位置或语义角色；同一常见词在不同上下文出现。

patterns.name: 若干弱或零散激活
patterns.context: 少数常见功能词或普通词在句中被标记，未见稳定的邻接结构或共同语义条件。

en.concept: Word-internal fragment detection; specific feature unclear
en.description: High activations often fall on word-internal substrings or identifier fragments, such as spiky, pimped, fratboy, SPIN_LOCK, Jumpin', spatially, and spindly. Genres and semantics vary; there are also sports and humanoid-robot contexts, making it difficult to assign a single meaning.

patterns.name: The word form spiky
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spiky; examples describe the peak of a power distribution and a person’s hairstyle, which are not in the same semantic field.

patterns.name: Word-internal pim
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a fragment within the spelling pimped. The sentence says a mouse provides instant credibility; no stable lexical meaning or contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal frat
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on frat in fratboy, in a derogatory description of a person.

patterns.name: SPIN lock identifier
patterns.context: The SPIN fragment in the uppercase identifier INIT_SPIN_LOCK; code initializes a lock.

patterns.name: Word-internal jumpin
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within the album title Jumpin' at Capitol, which contains an apostrophe.

patterns.name: Word-internal spatial
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spatially; the context discusses generating spatially coherent 3D scenes from input.

patterns.name: Word-internal spindly
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within spindly, describing a small character’s build.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment Jumpin/spin?
patterns.context: Visible high-activation fragments mainly extend into the place name Peoria and the team name Gophers; no semantic trigger condition consistent with the other cases is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments oid/rob
patterns.context: Discussion of future humanoid robots; activation markers occur in the ending of humanoid and the following rob fragment, with an unclear relationship.

7_1691.concept: 词内片段检测，具体特征不明
7_1691.description: 高激活多落在词内子串或标识符片段，如 spiky、pimped、fratboy、SPIN_LOCK、Jumpin'、spatially、spindly；体裁与语义分散，另有体育、人形机器人语境，难归为单一含义。

patterns.name: spiky 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 spiky 的词内片段；分别描写权力分布的尖端和人物发型，并非同一语义场。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论；人物外貌描写

patterns.name: 词中间的 pim
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写为 pimped 的词内片段，句子说鼠标带来即时可信度；未见稳定的词义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 词中间的 frat
patterns.context: 激活集中于 fratboy 中的 frat，处在对人的贬损性描述中。

patterns.name: SPIN 锁标识符
patterns.context: 大写标识符 INIT_SPIN_LOCK 中的 SPIN 片段；代码初始化锁。

patterns.name: 词中间的 jumpin
patterns.context: 激活落在专辑标题 Jumpin' at Capitol 的词内片段，标题中含撇号。

patterns.name: 词中间的 spatial
patterns.context: 激活落在 spatially 的词内片段；上下文讨论由输入生成空间连贯的 3D 场景。

patterns.name: 词中间的 spindly
patterns.context: 激活落在 spindly 的词内片段，修饰小人物的身形。

patterns.name: 词内片段 Jumpin/spin?
patterns.context: 可见高激活片段主要跨入地名 Peoria 和球队称呼 Gophers，未呈现与其他段一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内片段 oid/rob
patterns.context: 讨论未来人形机器人；激活标记分布在 humanoid 的词尾及后续 rob 片段，关系不明确。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on the in-word fragment “im,” especially in whim/whimper; the remaining activations are scattered across different words, code, and contexts, and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: In-word “im”/“im”-like fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word im or adjacent subword fragments; word meanings and contexts are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Mixed: biographies, reviews, forums, code, scripts

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in “whim/whimper”
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names or nonce words: The Winter Whimper, Lady Worsley's Whim; the strongest position is concentrated on im.

patterns.name: “im” fragments in spelling
patterns.context: Occurs inside ordinary words near content describing hairstyles and a mouse, respectively; the triggering fragment's relationship to the whole-word meaning is unclear.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of people's appearance, forum chat

patterns.name: Generalized scattered subword/symbol activations
patterns.context: Falls on compound words, ordinary words, code identifiers, lyric number phrases, and technology commentary, with no shared local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, code Q&A, encyclopedia plots, lyrics, technology commentary

7_1691.description: 多数强激活落在词内的“im”片段，尤其是 whim/whimper；其余激活分散于不同词、代码和语境，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: “im”/“im”类词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的 im 或相邻子词片段；具体词义和语境不固定。
patterns.domain: 混合：人物传记、评论、论坛、代码、剧本

patterns.name: “whim/whimper”词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名或临时造词中：The Winter Whimper、Lady Worsley's Whim；最强位置集中在 im。
patterns.domain: 网络评论与影视/文学介绍

patterns.name: 拼写中的“im”片段
patterns.context: 出现在普通词内部，邻近内容分别描述发型和鼠标；触发片段与整词语义关系不明确。
patterns.domain: 人物外貌描写、论坛闲聊

patterns.name: 泛化为散落的子词/符号激活
patterns.context: 分别落在复合词、普通词、代码标识符、歌词数字短语及科技评论中，缺少共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、代码问答、百科剧情、歌词、科技评论

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal word fragments, numbers, proper nouns, technical terms, and colloquial descriptions. No stable semantic or stylistic commonality is apparent; the most notable shared feature is that several word fragments are split by tokenization, but the trigger forms also vary.

patterns.name: Specific word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of words split into multiple tokens, often in the middle or at the end of a word; they occur across different words and contexts.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers, quantities, or mathematical notation; some numeric expressions do not trigger continuously.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns and titles
patterns.context: Some subword fragments in names, stage names, song titles, or nicknames activate; no unified category of proper noun is apparent.
patterns.domain: Music catalogs, sports commentary, local news

patterns.name: Technical and future-speculation contexts
patterns.context: A few word fragments activate in discussions of computational complexity, software replication, 3D space, or future technology; the words themselves do not form a stable shared trigger.

patterns.name: Descriptive or slang word fragments
patterns.context: In descriptions of appearance, quantities, or derogatory colloquial language, activations are scattered within words or across adjacent words.

7_1691.description: 激活分布在多种词的内部片段及数字、专名、技术词和口语描述上。未见稳定的语义或文体共性；较显著的共同点是若干被分词切开的词片段，但触发形式也不一致。

patterns.name: 词内特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个 token 的词内部片段，常为词中部或后部；跨不同词与语境出现。
patterns.domain: 通用文本、论坛、音乐条目

patterns.name: 数字与数值表达
patterns.context: 数字、数量或数学记号附近出现激活，部分数字表达并非连续触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、数学/技术文本

patterns.name: 专名及标题中的局部片段
patterns.context: 人名、艺名、歌曲名或戏称中的某些子词片段被激活；未见统一的专名类别。
patterns.domain: 音乐目录、体育评论、地方新闻

patterns.name: 技术与未来设想语境
patterns.context: 讨论计算复杂度、软件复制、3D 空间或未来技术时，少数词片段激活；这些词本身不构成稳定共同触发。

patterns.name: 描述性/俚语词片段
patterns.context: 人物外貌、数量或带贬义的口语描述中，激活分散在词内或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 叙事、体育评论、网络口语

en.description: The activation pattern is heterogeneous: most fragments fall on in-word subword fragments such as im, but there are also asterisk-style name spellings, entertainment recommendations, obfuscated-character spam, and football discussion, with no single semantic theme explaining them.

patterns.name: Character sequence im
patterns.context: Activation often falls on in-word subword fragments, especially words containing or adjacent to the letter sequence im; it occurs across different word forms and contexts and is not always at the beginning or end of a word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, web text, and code discussions

patterns.name: Punctuation in an F* name
patterns.context: In a sentence mentioning Steve saying someone's name, the asterisk-marked abbreviated/substitute spelling triggers strong activation.

patterns.name: Entertainment activities and action words
patterns.context: Recommends getting active through comedy clubs, stand-up comedy, or dancing; activation is distributed across multiple ordinary words and fragments related to dancefloor.

patterns.name: Obfuscated characters in spam comments
patterns.context: Spam text substitutes numbers for letters and contains content about buying medication, growth hacking, and low prices; a seemingly truncated word fragment follows.

patterns.name: American football discussion
patterns.context: Discusses teams, leagues, return scores, and player performance; activation falls on team names, PR, league, and other word fragments.

7_1691.description: 激活模式异质：多数片段落在词内的 im 等子词片段，但另有星号式姓名写法、娱乐建议、混淆字符垃圾文本和橄榄球讨论，难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 字符序列 im
patterns.trigger: 分词片段«im»（以及相邻的«fl»、«-»、«am»、«ik»、«wh»等）
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内的子词片段，尤其是包含或紧邻字母序列 im 的词；不同词形和语境中均出现，且并非总在词首或词尾。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言、网页文本与代码讨论

patterns.name: F* 名称中的标点
patterns.context: 在提及 Steve 说某人名字的句子中，星号标记的缩写/替代写法触发强激活。

patterns.name: 娱乐活动与动作词
patterns.trigger: « comedy»3« club»2« and»2« stand»4«-»3«up»5；« dancing»1« and»1« sh«im»10my
patterns.context: 建议通过喜剧俱乐部、单口喜剧或跳舞来活动；激活分布在多个普通词及 dancefloor 相关词片段上。

patterns.name: 垃圾评论中的混淆字符
patterns.context: 广告垃圾文本以数字替代字母，含购药、增长黑客和低价等内容；随后出现疑似被截断的词片段。

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球讨论
patterns.trigger: « Washington»5« could»2« be»3« fine»1« in»1 a P«PR»5« league»6；« pumps»4« in»4 TDs；« s»4«itt»2«in»9
patterns.context: 讨论球队、联赛、回攻得分及球员表现；激活落在球队名、PR、league 和其他词片段。

en.description: Activations primarily occur on or: commonly in more or less and numeric alternatives. Other scattered local triggers include from in come from behind, an asterisk in a censored swear word, a fragment within tumble, and form.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “more or less”
patterns.context: The trigger is or in the phrase; more precedes it and less follows it. The phrase can mean approximately/about the same, or indicate approximate degree in comparison or enumeration.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, fictional narration, and general prose

patterns.name: “or” linking alternatives
patterns.context: or links adjacent numeric or quantity options, indicating an approximation or an either-or listing.

patterns.name: from in come from behind
patterns.context: In a post-game sports quote, from occurs in come from behind, describing a comeback after trailing.

patterns.name: Asterisk in “F* Michael Dell”
patterns.context: The asterisk immediately follows F and is used as a censored swear word or part of an abbreviation, in a short sentence mentioning a person.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in tum-ble
patterns.context: Activation falls within the word tumble, split by a line break or tokenization; nearby context discusses words slipping out.

patterns.name: Local trigger in form
patterns.context: The word appears in an expression like something form that person, discussing recognition of someone’s writing style; the available material is insufficient to determine a more specific trigger condition.

7_1691.concept: 英语中局部高频词片段
7_1691.description: 激活以 or 为主：常见于 more or less 以及数字备选项；另有 come from behind 中的 from、脏话缩写星号、tumble 的词内片段和 form，呈现零散的局部触发。

patterns.name: 固定短语“more or less”
patterns.context: 触发词是短语中的 or；前有 more、后有 less，可表示“大致/差不多”，也可在比较或列举语境中表示程度近似。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、小说叙述及一般散文

patterns.name: “or”连接备选项
patterns.context: or 连接相邻的数字或数量选项，表示约数或二选一式列举。
patterns.domain: 小说散文、网络安全讨论

patterns.name: come from behind 中的 from
patterns.context: 体育赛后引语中，from 与 come from behind 搭配，描述落后后追赶或逆转。

patterns.name: “F* Michael Dell”中的星号
patterns.context: 星号紧接 F，用作被遮蔽的脏话或缩写的一部分，出现在提及人物的短句中。

patterns.name: tum-ble 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被换行或分词切开的单词 tumble 内部；邻近语境谈到话语脱口而出。

patterns.name: form 的局部触发
patterns.context: 该词出现在 something form that person 一类表达中，谈论识别某人的写作风格；可见材料不足以确定更具体的触发条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across various English texts, commonly occurring on that, negation stems, fixed music phrases, conversational commentary, and numbers or uppercase strings with complex formatting; the passages lack a unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: “that” and following structures
patterns.context: that occurs in reference, clause-introducing, or fixed-phrase uses; it activates in different contexts and cannot be explained by a single semantic condition
patterns.domain: Forums, news commentary, encyclopedia entries, music titles

patterns.name: Negation stems and negative questions
patterns.context: Negative auxiliaries or stems in negative questions, often surrounded by conversational language

patterns.name: Jumpin’ at / Hit That Jive
patterns.context: Fixed word sequences in music titles or song names
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia music catalogs, jazz performance descriptions

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in mathematical expressions, business data, or product models; specific formats vary

patterns.name: Unusually formatted advertising text
patterns.context: Advertising layout with all-caps text, split characters, and irregular spacing and punctuation

patterns.name: English conversational and emphatic expressions
patterns.context: Conversational narrative using first person, colloquial connectives, and informal syntax

patterns.name: Political insults and corruption commentary
patterns.context: Criticizes political figures and discusses scandals, corruption, or media coverage

patterns.name: Ethnic, religious, and LGBTQ topics
patterns.context: Discusses religious groups, attitudes toward homosexuality, and social circumstances

patterns.name: Beard grooming and masculinity
patterns.context: Discusses beard-grooming choices by imagining differences between the past and present

patterns.name: Subscriber growth and numerical statements
patterns.context: Reports a recent sharp increase in subscriber numbers and gives a figure

patterns.name: Music catalog formatting in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Lists albums, compilations, or song titles by year

patterns.name: SO quality and familiarity commentary
patterns.context: Discusses the writing quality of StackOverflow questions and the sense of familiarity evoked by a certain type of content

7_1691.description: 激活分散在多种英语文本中，常见于that、否定词干、固定音乐短语、口语评论及格式复杂的数字或大写串；各段缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: “that”及其后续结构
patterns.trigger: «that»、«That»，以及“hit that”“jumpin’ at”等包含 that 的短语
patterns.context: that 出现在指代、从句引导或固定短语中；在不同语境里激活，无法由单一语义条件解释
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻评论、百科条目、音乐名称

patterns.name: 否定词干与否定问句
patterns.trigger: «isn»、«aren»、«didn»，后接 ’t 或 ’t 的分词形式
patterns.context: 否定助动词或否定问句中的词干，周围常有口语表达

patterns.name: Jumpin’ at / Hit That Jive
patterns.context: 音乐标题或曲名中的固定字词序列
patterns.domain: 百科音乐目录、爵士演出介绍

patterns.name: 数字和字母数字串
patterns.trigger: 公式中的 «=» 与数学符号；«5»、«4000»、«70»及车型型号字符
patterns.context: 数字嵌入数学表达式、商业数据或产品型号中；具体格式各异

patterns.name: 异常格式化的广告文本
patterns.context: 全大写、字符拆分、空格与标点异常的广告排版
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 文档中的分类广告

patterns.name: 英文口语与强调性表达
patterns.context: 对话式叙述，使用第一人称、口语连接词和非正式句法

patterns.name: 政治辱骂与腐败评论
patterns.context: 批评政治人物并谈及丑闻、腐败或媒体报道

patterns.name: 民族宗教与同性恋议题
patterns.context: 讨论宗教群体、对同性恋的态度及社会处境

patterns.name: 胡须护理与男性气质
patterns.context: 以想象过去与现在的差异来谈胡须护理选择
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 博客或生活方式文章

patterns.name: 订阅量增长与数字陈述
patterns.context: 报告近期订阅量显著上升，并给出数字

patterns.name: 百科条目中的音乐目录格式
patterns.context: 按年份罗列唱片、合辑或歌曲标题

patterns.name: SO 质量与熟悉感评论
patterns.context: 讨论 StackOverflow 问题写作质量，以及某类内容带来的熟悉感

en.description: Activations are scattered across several sentence patterns: sentence-final tag questions (“isn’t it”), numeric alternatives or ranges (especially “or” and “-”), the comparative structure “than,” and several local phrases. There is insufficient evidence that these patterns share a single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Tag-question endings
patterns.context: A statement or judgment is followed by a tag question, often to emphasize a point or seek agreement; “isn” and “’t” are split into marked tokens

patterns.name: “or” introducing alternative quantities
patterns.context: Connects two possible numbers, often in the format “X or Y”; the numbers themselves need not be the same
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, economic discussion, fictional narration, technical discussion

patterns.name: Hyphen in numeric ranges
patterns.context: A hyphen connects two numbers to indicate a range or duration, such as “10-20”; activation may also involve nearby numeric expressions

patterns.name: “form” in a quantity or proportion expression
patterns.context: Appears in sentences like “seen something … that person”; the precise grammatical relation is unclear

patterns.name: Hyphen in the compound cash-out
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs between “cash” and “out”; the nearby text also contains the quantity comparison “9 or 10 stories”
patterns.domain: HackerNews startup and employee stock-option discussion

patterns.name: “three” in a repeated-quantity expression
patterns.context: The number “three” describes the number of repeated calls, followed by “or four”

patterns.name: Comparative structure with “than”
patterns.context: Used to compare degree or quantity; the passages contain “more than understandingly” and “more than 2 or three days”

patterns.name: Irregular sentence-initial we
patterns.context: The paragraph begins with lowercase “we,” followed by a hypothetical argument about the money supply and work

patterns.name: “four straight” in a retrospective account
patterns.context: Describes four consecutive events, then discusses losing a game and waiting for the next season

patterns.name: “9 or 10” in a quantity comparison
patterns.context: Compares the number of cash-out stories with other stories, adjacent to the cash-out context

patterns.name: “like” in online colloquial language
patterns.context: “like crazy” indicates strong degree or large quantity, not literal similarity

patterns.name: “people” and “these” in conversation
patterns.context: Discusses contacting others, getting them to speak candidly, and keeping them engaged; these are ordinary referential expressions syntactically

patterns.name: Retrospective time range
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a range of years, followed by a question about whether future hosting costs will be too high

7_1691.description: 激活分散在多类句式中：反问句尾“isn’t it”、数字备选或范围（尤其“or”及“-”）、比较结构“than”，以及若干局部词组。没有足够证据表明这些模式共享单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 反问式句尾
patterns.context: 陈述或判断后接反问，常用于加强语气或寻求认同；“isn”与“’t”被拆成标记 token

patterns.name: “or”引出备选数量
patterns.context: 连接两个可能的数字，常见格式为“X or Y”；数字本身未必相同
patterns.domain: 体育报道、经济讨论、小说叙述、技术讨论

patterns.name: 数字区间的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接两个数字，表示范围或时长，如“10-20”；激活也可能涉及附近的数字表达

patterns.name: 数量或比例表达中的“form”
patterns.context: 在“seen something … that person”一类句子中出现，具体语法关系不明确

patterns.name: 现金套现的复合词连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于“cash”和“out”之间；附近还出现数量比较“9 or 10 stories”

patterns.name: 重复数量表达中的“three”
patterns.context: 以数字“three”描述反复发生的来电次数，后接“or four”

patterns.name: “than”比较结构
patterns.context: 用于比较程度或数量；段中分别出现“more than understandingly”和“more than 2 or three days”

patterns.name: 不规则句首 we
patterns.context: 段落以小写“we”开头，后接关于货币供应和工作的假设性论述

patterns.name: 回顾经历的“four straight”
patterns.context: 描述连续经历的四次事件，随后谈输球及等待下一赛季

patterns.name: 数量比较中的“9 or 10”
patterns.context: 比较套现故事与其他故事的数量，紧邻cash-out语境

patterns.name: 网络口语中的“like”
patterns.context: “like crazy”表示程度强或数量多，不是字面上的相似关系

patterns.name: 对话中的“people”与“these”
patterns.context: 谈到联系他人、让他们坦诚表达并持续参与；句法上是普通指代表达

patterns.name: 回顾性时间范围
patterns.context: 以连字符连接年数范围，并询问未来托管成本是否过高

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on “or” expressing an approximate range between numbers, across various contexts and units; also activates on the n’t strings in negative contractions such as aren’t and weren’t. The two trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: Quantity-range expressions
patterns.context: Connects approximate ranges between numbers, commonly in the form “number or number”; may be followed or preceded by different measured objects or units of time.

patterns.name: n’t in colloquial negative contractions
patterns.context: Appears in English negative contractions, especially aren’t and weren’t; activation is concentrated inside the contraction rather than elsewhere in the sentence.

7_1691.description: 主要对数字间表示近似范围的“or”强烈激活，覆盖多种语境和数量单位；另对 aren’t、weren’t 等否定缩写中的 n’t 字符串激活。两类触发形式不同。

patterns.name: 数量范围表达
patterns.context: 在数词之间连接近似范围，常见形式为“数字 or 数字”；前后可接不同计量对象或时间单位。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的叙述与说明文本

patterns.name: 口语否定缩写中的 n’t
patterns.context: 出现在英语否定缩写中，尤其是 aren’t、weren’t；激活集中于缩写内部，而非其余句子。
patterns.domain: 口语化评论、议论或对话

en.concept: Common English function words and word fragments
en.description: Activations primarily fall on the negative contraction suffix n't (especially isn’t and don’t) and or in quantity ranges. Colloquial phrases, insults, and some proper-noun fragments also appear, but the latter groups lack a unified context.

patterns.name: n't in negative questions
patterns.context: Occurs in negative auxiliary contractions, often at the end of rhetorical or evaluative sentences, but also in ordinary statements.

patterns.name: or in quantity expressions
patterns.context: Connects two quantities to form an approximation or alternative range, such as “three or four,” “five or six,” “six or seven,” and “two or more”; covers the stronger activation locations.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, legal testimony, personal blogs, wrestling commentary, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Other standalone colloquial words and phrases
patterns.context: Triggers vary across passages, with no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition; examples include insults, colloquial expressions, and common phrases.
patterns.domain: News commentary, sports quotes, IRC chat, HackerNews discussion

patterns.name: Proper nouns or proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on partial tokens of proper nouns; no obvious shared contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, music reviews, wrestling commentary

7_1691.concept: 常见英语功能词与词片段
7_1691.description: 激活主要落在否定缩写 n't（尤其 isn’t、don’t）及数量范围中的 or；另见口语词组、辱骂词和若干专名片段，后几类缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: 否定疑问句中的 n't
patterns.context: 出现在否定助动词缩写中，常位于反问或评价性句子的末尾，也可位于普通陈述中。

patterns.name: 数量表达中的 or
patterns.context: 连接两个数量，构成约数或备选范围，如“三或四”“五或六”“六或七”“两种或更多”；覆盖较强激活位置。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、法律证词、个人博客、摔角评论、技术问答

patterns.name: 其他独立的口语词与短语
patterns.context: 在各段中分别触发，未显示稳定的共同句法或语义条件；包括辱骂和口语表达，以及常见词组。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、体育引语、IRC聊天、HackerNews讨论

patterns.name: 专名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的部分 token 上；没有明显共同的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、音乐评论、摔角评论

en.concept: English function words and contraction stems
en.description: The most stable pattern is English negative-contraction stems (isn, don, won, wouldn); another pattern is or used in approximate quantity lists. to, and, and a single ob activate sporadically, with no shared context.

patterns.name: Contractions in negative words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the stem portion of English negative contractions, especially isn’t, don’t, won’t, and wouldn’t; surrounding meaning and style vary.

patterns.name: Approximate-quantity conjunction or
patterns.context: Used to list two approximate quantities or options, such as “five or six”, “10 or 20%”, and “six or seven months”; activation is marked on or.

patterns.name: Sporadic to activation
patterns.context: Appears in infinitives or prepositional phrases, with no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic conjunction activation
patterns.context: Appears when connecting phrases or clauses, with no stable specific semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Sporadic lexical item
patterns.context: A substring within a single anomalous word, with no generalizable contextual condition observed.

7_1691.concept: 英文功能词与缩写词干
7_1691.description: 最稳定的模式是英文否定缩写词干（isn、don、won、wouldn）；另有 or 用于近似数量列举的模式。to、and及单个 ob 激活零散，缺少共同上下文。

patterns.name: 否定词中的缩写
patterns.context: 激活落在英文否定缩写的词干部分，尤其是 isn’t、don’t、won’t、wouldn’t；周边句意和文体不固定
patterns.domain: 英文散文、对话、论坛发言

patterns.name: 约数连接词 or
patterns.context: 用于列举两个近似数量或选项，如“five or six”“10 or 20%”“six or seven months”；激活标注在 or
patterns.domain: 叙述、论坛文字、体育访谈

patterns.name: 零散的 to 激活
patterns.context: 出现在不定式或介词短语中，缺少一致的局部语义条件

patterns.name: 零散的连接词激活
patterns.context: 连接短语或分句时出现，未见稳定的特定语义条件

patterns.name: 零散词项
patterns.context: 单个异常词内的子串，未见可归纳的上下文条件

en.description: Primarily responds to numerical alternatives or approximate expressions joined by “or”, across contexts involving quantities, durations, and ranges; also activates at the lower limit of an integral in a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: Alternative quantity or duration after “or”
patterns.context: In lists of alternatives, approximations, or range expressions, especially when “or” connects two numbers; activation often falls on “or” or the number following it.
patterns.domain: Sports interviews, astrophysics, legal testimony, online forums, parenting records, and technical texts

patterns.name: Integral lower limit in a formula
patterns.context: The lower limit or bounds marker following an integral sign in a mathematical formula; “10” here is formula notation/typesetting, not a natural-language “or” quantity construction.
patterns.domain: Mathematical typesetting in ArXiv scientific papers

7_1691.description: 主要响应“or”连接的数值备选或约数表达，涉及数量、时长、范围等多种语境；另在数学公式的积分下限处激活。

patterns.name: “or”后的备选数量或时长
patterns.trigger: “or”后紧接数词或数量表达，如 “six or seven months”, “factors of two or more”, “three or four”, “after a month or two”, “10-20 years”, “3 or 4”
patterns.context: 在并列备选项、约数或范围表达中，尤其是“or”连接两个数值时；激活位置常落在“or”或其后的数值上
patterns.domain: 跨体育访谈、天体物理、法律证词、网络论坛、育儿记录及技术文本

patterns.name: 公式中的积分下限
patterns.context: 数学公式中积分符号后的下限或上下限标记；该处“10”是公式变量/排版内容，并非自然语言中的“or”数量结构
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文中的数学排版

en.description: Activations occur on n at the end of negative-contraction stems, on operators and relational symbols in numbers and formulas, and on several word-internal subword fragments. Online slang, music narratives, and scattered ordinary words also appear across varied genres, making it difficult to assign a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric equations and connective operators
patterns.context: Connects options, assignments, or relations of magnitude between numbers, variables, or mathematical expressions; sometimes occurs in incomplete formula fragments.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and engineering discussions, as well as everyday numeric expressions; passages 2, 3, 4, 7, 10

patterns.name: n in negative contractions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on n at the end of negative-contraction stems, across different persons, tenses, and moods; nearby text is often negative.
patterns.domain: English narratives, dialogue, and online discussions; passages 1, 5, 6, 8

patterns.name: Adjacent morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on adjacent subword fragments within a word or formula rather than on whole words; may overlap with numeric/symbol patterns.
patterns.domain: Music narratives and mathematically typeset text; passages 1, 2, 9

patterns.name: Social media and online dialogue language
patterns.context: Discusses platform features or waiting and responding in online communication.
patterns.domain: HackerNews and Ubuntu IRC online discussions; passages 5, 8

patterns.name: Performances, music, and performance anxiety
patterns.context: Involves experiences of creating, singing, or performers coping with stage fright.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify local word items in passages
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary words or stems, with no clear shared local collocation; they may be influenced separately by semantics or tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narratives, storage-cost discussions, battery-charging discussions, and personal blogs; passages 1, 5, 7, 10

7_1691.concept: 异质的词形与符号模式
7_1691.description: 激活分布于否定缩写词干末尾的 n、数字和公式中的连接／关系符号，以及若干词内子词片段；另见网络用语、音乐叙述和分散的普通词项，跨语料文体，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数字等式与取值连接词
patterns.context: 在数字、变量或数学表达式之间连接选项、赋值或大小关系；有时处在不完整的公式片段中。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及工程讨论，也包括日常数字表达；段2、3、4、7、10

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的撇号后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在否定缩写词干末尾的 n，出现在不同人称、时态和语气中；周围常有否定句。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、对话及网络讨论；段1、5、6、8

patterns.name: 相邻构词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词或公式中相邻的子词片段，而非完整词；与数字／符号模式可能重叠。
patterns.domain: 音乐叙述与数学排版文本；段1、2、9

patterns.name: 社交媒体与在线对话用语
patterns.context: 谈及平台功能或在线交流中的等待、回应行为。

patterns.name: 演出、音乐及表演焦虑
patterns.context: 涉及创作、演唱或表演者应对舞台紧张的经历。

patterns.name: 片段中较难归类的局部词项
patterns.context: 各段的激活分散于普通词或词干，缺乏明显统一的局部搭配；可能分别受语义或分词边界影响。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、存储成本讨论、电池充电讨论及个人博客；段1、5、7、10

en.concept: Negative contraction stems and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to stem fragments in several negative contractions, especially couldn’t, don’t, isn’t, wouldn’t, and can’t; also activates on words such as anything, fragments, and several isolated local markers that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Negative stem couldn’t
patterns.context: Negative auxiliary form, especially activation on the stem portion couldn; appears in statements about songwriting, businesses operating in China, and photo storage costs.

patterns.name: Negative stem don’t
patterns.context: Negative auxiliary form; examples include people don’t hang around, Facebook doesn’t delete photos, and don’t have solid income streams.

patterns.name: Negative stem isn’t
patterns.context: Negative copula in rhetorical questions or judgments, such as “isn’t it?”.

patterns.name: Negative stem wouldn’t
patterns.context: Negative modal verb in hypotheses, inferences, or evaluations; appears respectively in speculation about hosting costs, counterfactual commentary about entrepreneurs, and an evaluation of a viewpoint.

patterns.name: Other negative contractions
patterns.context: Negative modal verbs; one instance occurs with can’t make these units work, and another lists Facebook doesn’t/can’t/won’t delete photos.

patterns.name: Context for anything
patterns.context: Appears in “be anything close to precise” and “is anything else”, both used to emphasize or qualify a judgment; its distribution differs from that of negative contractions.

patterns.name: Special within-word segmentation or fragment activation
patterns.context: Markers fall on sporadic word fragments or symbols; the available context is insufficient to establish a stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic two- or three-week expression
patterns.context: Describes how long labeling continued; the activation marker is on “or”, with no clear trigger pattern shared with other passages.

patterns.name: Sporadic hear and line break
patterns.context: News or forum text fragments; the local markers do not show the same pattern as negative contractions.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Located at different positions in sentences; no shared trigger condition can currently be inferred from the passage.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: A chat complaint about waiting for a reply; adjacent to negative contractions, but it cannot be confirmed that these words themselves belong to the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: A report fragment about China and Honeywell; apart from negative contractions, the local trigger relationships are unclear.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Discussion of photo hosting costs; the main pattern is negative contractions, but it is unclear whether these adjacent markers have an independent cause.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Discussion of the digital nomad experience; markers related to “nothing” may form an independent local pattern, but evidence is insufficient to group them.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Satirical forum comment; apart from the negative contraction “isn’t”, the shared trigger condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Describes the labeling process on a production line; no clear pattern corresponds to those in other passages.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Discussion of early entrepreneurs; markers outside negative contractions lack stable shared semantics.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local activation
patterns.context: Evaluation of an anti-diversity viewpoint; apart from “wouldn’t”, a shared pattern is difficult to identify.

7_1691.concept: 否定缩写词干及零散词片
7_1691.description: 主要对多类否定缩写中的词干片段起反应，尤其 couldn’t、don’t、isn’t、wouldn’t 和 can’t；另在 anything 等词、碎片及若干孤立局部标记上有激活，后者难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 否定词干 couldn’t
patterns.context: 否定助动词形式，尤其激活落在 couldn 的词干部分；出现在关于歌曲创作、企业在中国开展业务、照片存储成本的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 叙事、商业评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 否定词干 don’t
patterns.context: 否定助动词形式；包括 people don’t hang around、Facebook doesn’t delete photos，以及 don’t have solid income streams。

patterns.name: 否定词干 isn’t
patterns.context: 反问或判断句中的否定系词，如“isn’t it?”。

patterns.name: 否定词干 wouldn’t
patterns.context: 假设、推论或评价中的否定情态动词；分别出现在 hosting costs 的推测、对创业者的反事实评论、对某观点的评价中。

patterns.name: 其他否定缩写
patterns.context: 否定情态动词；一处与 can’t make these units work 连用，另一处列举 Facebook doesn’t/can’t/won’t delete photos。

patterns.name: anything 的语境
patterns.context: 出现在“be anything close to precise”和“is anything else”中，均用于强调或限定判断；与缩写否定词的分布不同。

patterns.name: 词内特殊切分或碎片激活
patterns.context: 标记落在零散词片或符号上；现有上下文不足以确定它们构成稳定的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 叙事、商业评论、论坛文本

patterns.name: 零散的两三周表达
patterns.context: 描述贴标签持续的时间；激活标记在“or”上，未见与其他段落共享的明显触发模式。

patterns.name: 零散的 hear 与换行
patterns.context: 新闻或论坛文本片段，局部标记未显示与否定缩写相同的模式。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 位于句子不同位置，暂无法从该段推出共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 聊天记录中有关等待答复的抱怨；与否定缩写相邻，但不能确认这些词本身属于同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 关于中国与 Honeywell 的报道片段，除否定缩写外，局部触发关系不清楚。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 关于照片托管成本的讨论；主要模式是负向缩写，但这些相邻标记是否独立成因不明。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 谈论数字游民经历；“nothing”相关标记可能是独立局部模式，证据不足以归并。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 讽刺性论坛评论，否定缩写“isn’t”之外的共同触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 描述生产线上贴标签的过程；没有明显对应其他段的模式。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 关于早期创业者的讨论；否定缩写之外的标记缺乏稳定共同语义。

patterns.name: 其他未归类的局部激活
patterns.context: 对反多元化观点的评价；除“wouldn’t”外难以确定共同模式。

en.concept: Reaching an upper limit or target (primary pattern)
en.description: Primarily triggered by “up to” expressing an increase or reaching a target; isolated high responses also occur on the stems of verb forms such as couldn’t, don’t, and rose, as well as on \ge in a formula. The food passage in segment 6 and “outsize talent” cannot yet be explained by these patterns.

patterns.name: up to a range or target
patterns.context: “up” is followed by “to” and a value, quantity, or target position, expressing an increase to an upper limit or gradual progress toward a target.
patterns.domain: Business revenue, toilet training, running training, HackerNews technical discussions

patterns.name: -ough in irregular past-tense verb stems
patterns.context: In “couldn’t”, the stem token “couldn” is marked, in a negative auxiliary form; in both examples, it is followed by a past participle or verb phrase.

patterns.name: Stem of the past tense of rise
patterns.context: Appears in “how Morgan Freeman rose to stardom”, with the past-tense verb followed by “to” and a noun.

patterns.name: Stem of negative auxiliary don’t
patterns.context: Negates a simple-present verb, followed by “hang around”.

patterns.name: Comparison symbol in a metric-matrix inequality
patterns.context: In a LaTeX mathematical expression, between matrix-element expressions, indicating a greater-than-or-equal relationship.

7_1691.concept: 达到上限或目标（主模式）
7_1691.description: 主要触发“up to”表示增加或达到目标；另对 couldn’t、don’t、rose 等动词形式的词干，以及公式中的 \ge 有孤立高响应。第6段食物与“outsize talent”暂无法由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: up 到某一范围或目标
patterns.trigger: “up»9 to «15»%”、 “up»8 to»9 ... where”、 “get»3 up»5 to»9 5 miles”、 “up»9 10 or more”
patterns.context: “up”后接“to”及数值、数量或目标位置，表示增加至上限或逐步达到某个目标。
patterns.domain: 商业收益、如厕训练、跑步训练、HackerNews 技术讨论

patterns.name: 不规则动词过去式词干中的 -ough
patterns.context: “couldn’t”中词干 token “couldn” 被标记，否定助动词形式；两例后文都接过去分词或动词短语。

patterns.name: 过去式 rise 的词干
patterns.context: 出现在“how Morgan Freeman rose to stardom”中，过去式动词后接“to”及名词。

patterns.name: 否定助动词 don’t 的词干
patterns.context: 对一般现在时动词进行否定，后接“hang around”。

patterns.name: 度量矩阵不等式中的比较符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中，位于矩阵元素表达式之间，表示大于等于关系。

en.concept: Multiple local lexical forms and collocation triggers
en.description: Activation is distributed across couldn’t, or in numerical ranges, emphatic even, the fixed legal collocation rise to the level of, one passage evaluating an experience, and one LaTeX formula; the latter two are of unclear relation to the other patterns.

patterns.name: couldn’t in negative auxiliaries
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is the participial form of couldn’t; [1] is followed by have taken, [2] by just…; apostrophe use or within-word segmentation differs.

patterns.name: Numerical ranges with or more
patterns.context: or appears before a number or quantity word and is followed by more or another number; in both examples, “or” is the strongest trigger token.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of even
patterns.context: even emphasizes degree or an unexpected comparison, followed by a noun phrase or comparative.

patterns.name: rise to the level of
patterns.context: Fixed collocation rise to the level of, describing whether an act or error meets a legal or institutional standard.

patterns.name: Holland’s nothing short of statement
patterns.context: Quotes a personal experience and intensifies the evaluation with nothing short of; activation markers fall sporadically on Holland, was, of, and AMAZING.

patterns.name: Specific symbol sequence in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: Beginning of a LaTeX mathematical formula and a summation expression; activation is concentrated on symbols such as parentheses, line breaks, commands, and equals signs.

7_1691.concept: 多种局部词形与搭配触发
7_1691.description: 激活分散于 couldn’t、数值范围中的 or、强调程度的 even、固定法律搭配 rise to the level of，以及一段体验评价和一段 LaTeX 公式；后两者与其余模式关联不明。

patterns.name: 否定助动词中的 couldn’t
patterns.trigger: « couldn»10«’»5«t»3« have»2« taken»4（[1]）；« couldn»10«'t»4 just w«alt»3«z»3« in»3（[2]）
patterns.context: 触发片段是 couldn’t 的分词形式；[1]后接 have taken，[2]后接 just…，拼写中的撇号或词内切分不同。

patterns.name: or more 的数值范围
patterns.context: 数字或数量词前出现 or，后接 more 或另一个数值；两例中“or”是最强触发 token。
patterns.domain: 商业评论、社会经济论述

patterns.name: even 的强调用法
patterns.trigger: « even»5 for a guy（[3]）；be « even»9 higher（[8]）
patterns.context: even 用来强调程度或出乎预期的比较，后接名词短语或比较级。
patterns.domain: 美食人物介绍、个人财务评论

patterns.name: rise to the level of
patterns.trigger: « rise»4« to»9« the»3« level»3（[9]）；« rise»4« to»9« the»2« level»1（[10]）
patterns.context: 固定搭配 rise to the level of，描述某行为或错误是否达到某种法律、制度上的标准。
patterns.domain: 科研诚信行政文件、司法意见

patterns.name: Holland 所言 nothing short of
patterns.trigger: « was»2 nothing« short»1« of»4 A«MA»5ZING!；前文有 «Hol»2land
patterns.context: 引述个人体验，并以 nothing short of 加强评价；激活标记落在 Holland、was、of、AMAZING 等零散位置。
patterns.domain: 个人体验或宣传式文字

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号序列
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式开头及求和表达式；激活集中在括号、换行、命令和等号等符号上。

en.concept: Local word forms and collocational fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across negative auxiliary contractions, anything in degree expressions, up to speed, and numeric and of phrases. There are also several sporadic word-internal fragments and common words, which are difficult to explain with a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary contractions
patterns.context: The stem portion of negative auxiliary contractions is highlighted; covers different word forms and punctuation styles

patterns.name: anything in degree expressions
patterns.context: anything occurs in degree or contrast structures, followed by close, but, or similar elements

patterns.name: to in a degree expression
patterns.context: to occurs in the fixed expression up to speed; preceding text discusses reaching proficiency

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary in the numeral zero
patterns.context: 000 in a digit string is highlighted, near topics such as resale value and other numeric or price-related discussion

patterns.name: Person descriptor followed by an of phrase
patterns.context: The person descriptor guy is followed by an of phrase describing his talent

patterns.name: Adjacent collocation man of
patterns.context: man of is followed by an abstract quality noun, forming an evaluation of a person

patterns.name: Ordinary words or subword fragments
patterns.context: Highlighted positions are scattered, involving ordinary nouns, word-internal segmentation, and spelling fragments, with no shared syntactic environment

patterns.name: Scattered common words and phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall in different semantic and syntactic positions, with no stable shared contextual condition

7_1691.description: 激活分散于否定助动词缩写、anything 与程度搭配、up to speed，以及数字和 of 短语；另有多处零散词内片段与常见词，难以由单一稳定语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 否定助动词缩写
patterns.context: 否定助动词缩写中的词干部分被突出；覆盖不同词形和标点写法

patterns.name: 程度表达中的 anything
patterns.context: anything 出现在程度或对比结构中，后接 close、but 等成分

patterns.name: 程度表达中的 to
patterns.context: to 位于 up to speed 固定表达中；前文谈及达到熟练程度

patterns.name: 数词零的分词边界
patterns.context: 数字字符串中的 000 被突出，邻近 resale value 等数字或价格话题

patterns.name: 人物称谓 of 后接名词
patterns.context: 人物称谓 guy 后接 of 短语，描述其才华

patterns.name: man 与 of 的相邻搭配
patterns.context: man of 后接抽象品质名词，构成对人的评价

patterns.name: 普通词或子词片段
patterns.context: 突出位置分散，分别涉及普通名词、词内切分及拼写片段，缺乏共同句法环境
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论、文学、网页文本

patterns.name: 分散的常见词与短语
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语义和句法位置，未见稳定的共同上下文条件

en.description: Activation shows several local lexical patterns: especially above (covering numerical thresholds, colloquial comparisons, and fixed collocations), as well as words near numbers, ranges, and percentages, forum phrases, and sporadic word fragments; there is no evidence that a single semantic feature drives them all.

patterns.name: above
patterns.context: Indicates a numerical threshold or degree exceeding a limit; in segment 5 it is followed by “80%”, in segment 7 by a line break and “your”, and in segment 9 by “and beyond”.
patterns.domain: Financial trading, colloquial forum text, disc discussions

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Numerical values, ranges, percentages, comparison symbols, and surrounding words; activation sometimes falls on a number or comparison word.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, financial discussions, patent and business descriptions

patterns.name: Common phrases in informal English
patterns.context: Colloquial collocations in forum or commentary styles, with activation points on common words rather than clear proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, personal experiences, online discussions

patterns.name: Ambiguous word fragments and words within sentences
patterns.context: Markers in each passage are distributed across formulas, proper nouns, or ordinary words, with no stable shared contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, personal reflections, product and lifestyle discussions

patterns.name: Words not assignable to a stable pattern
patterns.context: Activation positions vary, and the current sample is insufficient to confirm a reproducible trigger condition.

7_1691.description: 激活呈现多种局部词项模式：尤其是 above（覆盖数值阈值、口语比较及固定搭配），另见数字、范围与百分比附近的词，以及论坛短语和零散词片段；没有证据表明它们都由单一语义特征驱动。

patterns.name: above
patterns.context: 表示数值阈值或程度超出某界限；第 5 段后接「80%」，第 7 段后接换行及「your」，第 9 段后接「and beyond」。
patterns.domain: 金融交易、论坛口语、影碟格式讨论

patterns.name: 数字与量化表达
patterns.trigger: 「to the required」「< \,50」「+1%」「-41%」「2.7%」「15%」等数字或百分比附近的标记；另有「up」「range」
patterns.context: 数值、范围、百分比、比较符号及其前后词语；有时触发落在数字或比较词上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、金融讨论、专利商业说明

patterns.name: 非正式英语中的常用短语
patterns.context: 论坛或评论语体中的口语搭配，激活点落在常见词而非明确专名。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、个人经历与网络讨论

patterns.name: 模糊的词片段及句中词
patterns.context: 各段标记分布于公式、专名或普通词内部，未见稳定的共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、个人感想、产品与生活讨论

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的词
patterns.context: 激活位置各异，当前样本不足以确认可重复的触发条件。

en.description: Activation is distributed across texts from multiple domains, more often near numbers, units, comparison symbols, and expressions of change reaching a threshold (such as up to, down to, below, and above). Function words and domain-specific terms also activate; no single theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Reaching a quantity, time, or degree limit
patterns.context: Describes gradual change, reaching a boundary, or comparing a value with a threshold; no specific topic is required.
patterns.domain: Multidomain narrative, explanatory, and online text

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative thresholds
patterns.context: Numbers express age, year, amount, percentage, measurement, or scientific parameter; tokens around numbers often activate.
patterns.domain: Forums, news, economics, finance, and academic texts

patterns.name: Continuous or gradual increase
patterns.context: Describes development, increase, or gradual attainment of a state; sometimes uses a number or endpoint as a boundary.

patterns.name: Structural particles and function words
patterns.context: Function words occur in different grammatical structures, often alongside nearby quantity or boundary expressions; evidence for them as independent trigger conditions is weak.

patterns.name: Specific terminology or local word strings
patterns.context: Each local string occurs in only an individual passage and cannot be adequately explained by a shared theme; it may overlap with numerical/degree expressions.
patterns.domain: Device reviews, nuclear policy, automobiles, finance, and cosmology

7_1691.description: 激活分布于多领域文本，较常见于数字、单位、比较符号及变化到达某一阈值的表达（如 up to、down to、below、above）。同时有功能词和领域专属词激活，未见单一主题可解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 到达数量、时间或程度上限
patterns.trigger: “up to”“down to”“below”“where”“reach”“above and beyond”等表示移动至某个数量、位置或程度；常伴随数字或阈值
patterns.context: 句中描述逐步变化、达到某个界限，或数值高低与阈值比较；不要求特定主题
patterns.domain: 多领域叙述、说明文及网络文本

patterns.name: 数字与量化阈值
patterns.context: 数字表达年龄、年份、金额、百分比、测量值或科学参数；数字周围 token 常有激活
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻、经济、金融及学术文本

patterns.name: 连续或逐步增加
patterns.trigger: “scale … to”“grow up to”“increasing … amount of time”“way up to”“going above and beyond”
patterns.context: 描述发展、增加或逐渐达到某种状态；有时以数字或终点作界限
patterns.domain: 建议性、叙事及评论文本

patterns.name: 结构助词与功能词
patterns.context: 功能词处于不同语法结构，常与邻近的数量、界限表达同时出现；单独作为触发条件的证据较弱

patterns.name: 特定术语或局部词串
patterns.trigger: “anything close to precise”“breakout times”“Matrix”“DAX”“early dark energy density parameter”
patterns.context: 这些局部词串各只出现于个别片段，无法由共同主题充分解释；可能与数字／程度表达重叠
patterns.domain: 设备评论、核政策、汽车、金融及宇宙学

en.description: Activation often occurs near numbers, formulas, and changes in measured quantities, especially relational words expressing a boundary, upper limit, or reaching an outcome; it also involves time series and a few ordinary collocations, so the pattern is not entirely uniform.

patterns.name: Upper-bound symbols
patterns.context: Indicates that a value or object reaches an upper limit, target, or standard; examples include “< 0.288”, “< 0.24”, “up to the required physical readiness standards”, and “down to zero”.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, military training instructions, policy reporting

patterns.name: Conjunctions in numeric and decimal formats
patterns.context: Appears near numbers, dates, units, quantities, or measurements, connecting or marking numerical expressions; includes decimals, percentages, time points, and quantity descriptions.
patterns.domain: Scientific and statistical texts, agricultural news, medical papers, general reporting

patterns.name: Changes in measured quantities and statements of results
patterns.context: Describes measured values or states changing over time or with conditions, or reaching an outcome; often co-occurs with a number, baseline, or threshold.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, medicine, science, and compliance reporting

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and scientific-symbol boundaries
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in mathematical formulas, variables, or unit expressions, usually interspersed with numbers, relational symbols, and Greek letters; activation falls on several tokens near the symbols.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, cosmology, and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Time series or lists of years
patterns.context: Time points, years, or durations appear alongside numbers, possibly describing measurement changes or event progression.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, policy reporting, consumer news

patterns.name: Collocations with potentially insufficient correlation
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary words or fixed collocations after tokenization, but the available context is insufficient to confirm a stable link with the numerical-relation pattern.

7_1691.description: 激活常见于数值、公式和量值变化附近，尤其是表示边界、上限或达到结果的关系词；也涉及时间序列及少量普通词搭配，模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 范围上限符号
patterns.context: 表示数值或对象达到某个上限、目标或标准；例有“< 0.288”“< 0.24”“up to the required physical readiness standards”“down to zero”。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、军事训练说明、政策报道

patterns.name: 数字与小数格式中的连接词
patterns.context: 出现在数字、日期、单位、数量或测量值附近，连接或标记数值表达；包括小数、百分比、时间点及数量描述。
patterns.domain: 科学与统计文本、农业新闻、医学论文、一般报道

patterns.name: 量值变化及结果表述
patterns.context: 描述测量值或状态随时间、条件变化，或达到某个结果；常与数值、基线或阈值共现。
patterns.domain: 农业、医学、科学及合规报道

patterns.name: 数学公式与科学符号边界
patterns.context: 触发词处于数学公式、变量或单位表达中，通常夹杂数字、关系符号和希腊字母；激活具体落在符号附近的若干 token。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、宇宙学及粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 时间序列或年份列举
patterns.context: 时间点、年份或时长与数值并列，可能用于描述测量变化或事件进程。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、政策报道、消费新闻

patterns.name: 可能相关性不足的词汇搭配
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的普通词或固定搭配中，但现有上下文不足以确认与数值关系模式有稳定联系。
patterns.domain: 军事训练说明、汽车评论

en.concept: Degree expressions introduced by to and relational symbols in formulas
en.description: Activations are mixed: one group occurs in expressions of degree, standards, or roles introduced by to; another concentrates on equals signs, inequality signs, and numeric punctuation in scientific formulas. Other isolated cases include anything close and sentence-final punctuation.

patterns.name: to + abstract degree/standard
patterns.context: to is followed by a degree, standard, or role; examples include “to the required physical readiness standards,” “rise to the level,” and “to be an obnoxious brain box,” but it does not necessarily activate when followed by a specific action.
patterns.domain: General narrative, formal investigation reports, online discussion

patterns.name: be + anything close
patterns.context: In the structure “anything close to precise,” anything emphasizes approaching a certain degree or state.

patterns.name: Relational symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Equals signs and inequality signs occur in formulas or mathematical expressions; they are often surrounded by variables, subscripts/superscripts, and formula layout.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Numeric/formula punctuation
patterns.context: Includes decimals, parameters, and punctuation in formulas near numeric values or mathematical symbols; may overlap with the relational-symbol pattern.

patterns.name: Period after a short time frame
patterns.context: A sentence-final punctuation mark is followed by a line break, then a shift to discussion of automotive resale value.

7_1691.concept: to 引导的程度表达与公式关系符号
7_1691.description: 激活分布较杂：一类出现在 to 引出的程度、标准或身份表达，另一类集中于科学公式中的等号、不等号及数值标点；另有 anything close 和句末标点等孤例。

patterns.name: to + 抽象程度/标准
patterns.context: to 后接程度、标准或角色；包括 “to the required physical readiness standards”“rise to the level”“to be an obnoxious brain box”，但后接具体动作时未必激活。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、正式调查报告、网络讨论

patterns.name: be + anything close
patterns.context: “anything close to precise”结构中，anything 强调接近某种程度或状态。
patterns.domain: 关于器材精度的论坛式叙述

patterns.name: 数学公式中的关系符号

patterns.name: 数值/公式标点

en.description: Activation is distributed across numerical constraints in scientific formulas and papers, threshold-crossing in everyday and news contexts, and descriptions of high-end or unfamiliar things in reviews. Formula symbols, comparison words, and ordinary words all occur; no single stable trigger has emerged.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: In mathematical definitions or inequality formulas, symbols delimit a function, integral, or parameter range.

patterns.name: Numerical upper limits or constraints
patterns.context: Scientific papers state upper limits, ranges, or observational constraints on parameters, densities, or physical quantities, often with errors and scientific notation.
patterns.domain: Cosmology, particle physics, and astrophysics papers

patterns.name: Exceeding or being above a boundary
patterns.context: In everyday or news contexts, describes a value, performance, or state crossing a threshold; sometimes refers to literal spatial direction.

patterns.name: Modifiers for special or high-end categories
patterns.context: Modifies cuisine or experiences, emphasizing a high level, unfamiliarity, or unusualness; activation tokens do not belong to a single part of speech.

7_1691.description: 激活分散在科学公式与论文的数值约束、日常及新闻语境中的阈值跨越，以及评论中的高端或陌生描述。公式符号、比较词和普通词均出现，尚无单一稳定触发项。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式界限
patterns.trigger: 「<」「>」「\infty」「\mid」及公式中的绝对值、积分符号
patterns.context: 数学定义或不等式公式中，符号用于限定函数、积分或参数范围。

patterns.name: 数值上限或约束
patterns.context: 科学论文陈述参数、密度或物理量的上限、范围或观测约束，常伴随误差和科学记数法。
patterns.domain: 宇宙学、粒子物理及天体物理论文

patterns.name: 超出或高于某个界限
patterns.context: 日常或新闻语境中描述数值、表现或状态跨过阈值；有时是字面空间方向。

patterns.name: 特殊或高端类别修饰
patterns.context: 修饰菜系或体验，强调等级较高、陌生或不寻常；激活 token 并非单一词类。

en.description: Activations often occur in technical formulas and numeric comparisons, and also cover economic prices, percentages, output, and time expressions, as well as military fitness-training vocabulary. Passage 4 contains only a potential-energy formula, with no more specific shared trigger feature apparent.

patterns.name: Less-than inequality in mathematics
patterns.context: The comparison symbol occurs in a formula or technical numeric statement, often with a threshold, upper bound, or parameter range on the right; passage 10 also contains >

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in quantitative statements about prices, proportions, output, durations, or scientific parameters; numbers alone are insufficient to establish a unified semantics
patterns.domain: News, economics, agriculture, and scientific text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical typesetting contains dense symbols, variables, brackets, and commands; activations may fall on common short tokens within formulas

patterns.name: Physical parameters and particle symbols
patterns.context: Involves mass, particles, or cosmological parameters, accompanied by values, bounds, or formula derivations

patterns.name: Economic price and increase expressions
patterns.context: Prices, economic growth, or agricultural prices are expressed in monetary amounts and percentages
patterns.domain: News and economic and agricultural reporting

patterns.name: Short-duration expression
patterns.context: A time range is modified by short, in a context summarizing how long something takes

patterns.name: Military fitness-training vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes training manuals for soldiers, training activities, and physical fitness requirements

patterns.name: Potential media-article reference
patterns.context: Automotive resale value is related to oil prices; the passage shifts from a short-duration expression to media or consumer-product narrative

7_1691.description: 激活多见于技术公式及数值比较，也覆盖经济价格、百分比、产量和时间表达；另有军事体能训练词汇。第4段仅呈现势能公式，未见更具体的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学中的小于不等式

patterns.context: 数字嵌在价格、比例、产量、时间长度或科学参数等定量陈述中；单独出现数字并不足以确定统一语义
patterns.domain: 新闻、经济、农业及科学文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学排版中，符号、变量、括号及命令密集出现；激活可能落在公式内部的常见短 token 上

patterns.name: 物理参数及粒子符号
patterns.context: 涉及质量、粒子或宇宙学参数，并伴随数值、界限或公式推导
patterns.domain: 物理、宇宙学与粒子物理

patterns.name: 经济价格与涨幅表达
patterns.context: 价格、经济增长或农产品价格以货币金额和百分比表示

patterns.name: 短时长表达
patterns.context: 时间范围由 short 修饰，语境为对一件事所需时间的概述

patterns.name: 军事体能训练词汇
patterns.context: 描述面向士兵的训练手册、训练项目及体能达标要求

patterns.name: 潜在媒体文章引用
patterns.context: 汽车转售价值与油价相关；片段从短时长表述转入媒体或消费品叙述

en.description: Activations mostly fall on intra-word substrings, affixes, or non-English text fragments across medicine, biology, mathematics, code, Hungarian, and Samoan. Other triggers include isolated Chinese commas, line breaks, and “sudden”; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment “G”
patterns.context: Uppercase letter G as part of a word or the beginning of an abbreviation; no stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Token fragments in English technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within English technical terms or proper nouns, at positions including word beginnings and middles; some involve medical, biological, or technical vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Medicine, biology, code, and general English text

patterns.name: Hungarian accented characters and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Accented characters in Hungarian titles, as well as intra-word fragments in terms related to the financial crisis.

patterns.name: Repeated proper nouns in titles
patterns.context: A proper noun is repeated in a title and at the beginning of the following body text; activations concentrate on fragments within the name.

patterns.name: Samoan intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Intra-word or short-word fragments in Samoan text; the current samples are insufficient to identify more specific semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Punctuation in Chinese prompts
patterns.context: Chinese prompts in code strings, with activations concentrated on Chinese commas; the same passage also has several weakly activated Chinese characters.

patterns.name: Death-related word in a coronary experiment title
patterns.context: A medical paper title describes a canine coronary occlusion-reperfusion experiment and sudden death; this is the only clear semantically meaningful word trigger.

patterns.name: Line breaks in encyclopedia titles
patterns.context: A proper-noun title is followed by consecutive blank lines and then repeated; activation falls on the line-break markers.

patterns.name: Special letter sequence «S»
patterns.context: Uppercase letter S in a Samoan proper noun, with insufficient context to support a more specific interpretation.

7_1819.description: 激活多落在词内子串、词缀或非英语文字片段，跨医学、生物、数学、代码、匈牙利语和萨摩亚语；另有孤立的中文逗号、换行及“sudden”等触发，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内碎片“G”
patterns.context: 大写字母 G 作为词的一部分或缩写开头；未见稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语专业词中的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文专业词或专名内部的子词片段，跨越词首、词中等位置；部分涉及医学、生物或技术词汇。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物、代码及一般英文文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语重音字符及词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语标题中的带重音字符，以及金融危机相关词语的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，匈牙利语标题

patterns.name: 标题中的专名重复
patterns.context: 专名在标题及紧随其后的正文开头重复出现，激活集中于名称的词内片段。

patterns.name: 萨摩亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 萨摩亚语文本中词内或短词片段；当前样本不足以判断更具体的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的萨摩亚语内容

patterns.name: 中文提示语中的标点
patterns.trigger: 中文报错提示中的“，”，尤其“«，»9”
patterns.context: 代码字符串中的中文提示语，激活集中在中文逗号；同一段也有多个弱激活中文字符。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码，中文用户提示

patterns.name: 冠状动脉实验标题中的死亡词
patterns.context: 医学论文标题描述犬模型冠状动脉闭塞-再灌注实验及猝死；仅此处出现明显的语义性词汇触发。

patterns.name: 百科标题换行
patterns.context: 专名标题后出现连续空行，再重复标题；激活落在换行标记。

patterns.name: 特殊字母组合«S»
patterns.context: 萨摩亚语专名中的大写字母 S，缺乏足够上下文支持更具体解释。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的萨摩亚语内容

en.description: Activations mostly fall on subword fragments within words, proper nouns, and non-English word forms; Chinese prompts and line breaks also appear. The fragments span disciplines and share no clear semantics, though a few, such as phyt-, recur in plant-related texts.

patterns.name: Technical term fragments beginning with G
patterns.context: In terms or literature citations, the initial G and following fragments are marked by tokenization; contexts involve biomedical terminology and mathematical citations, but the words themselves differ.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on several consecutive or scattered subwords within words. The phyt- fragment is especially prominent in texts about plant pathogens and phytoplankton, but also occurs in unrelated words.

patterns.name: Chinese error prompts
patterns.context: Chinese user prompts in code strings, with the strongest activation at commas; embedded in PHP conditionals and error-handling code.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within Hungarian compounds or inflected words; the sentences discuss financial and economic crises and their consequences.

patterns.name: Samoan fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within Samoan words; the text includes proper nouns and line breaks.

patterns.name: Line starts and newline characters
patterns.context: Newlines near code indentation or encyclopedia entry titles are marked; they do not co-occur consistently across passages.

7_1819.concept: 词片段与分词边界敏感
7_1819.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段、专名及非英语词形上，另见中文提示语与换行。片段跨学科且不共享明确语义，少数如 phyt- 在植物文本中重复出现。

patterns.name: G 开头的专业术语片段
patterns.context: 术语或文献引用中，词首 G 与后续片段被分词标记；上下文涉及生物医学术语、数学文献引用，词并不相同。

patterns.name: 词内部的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的若干连续或分散子词上；在植物病原体和浮游植物相关文本中，phyt- 片段尤其突出，但也见于无关词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、植物科学、百科文本

patterns.name: 中文错误提示语
patterns.context: 代码字符串中的中文用户提示，逗号处激活最强；嵌在 PHP 条件和错误处理代码中。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在匈牙利语复合词或屈折词内部，句子谈金融与经济危机及其后果。

patterns.name: 萨摩亚语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在萨摩亚语句子中的词内片段，文本含专名和换行。

patterns.name: 行首及换行符
patterns.context: 代码缩进或百科条目标题附近的换行被标记；在各段并非稳定共现。

en.concept: Rare word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across rare proper nouns, compound terms, and words within titles, and also occur in Samoan word fragments, code line breaks, and Chinese prompts. They may favor rare word forms or unusual subword segmentation; no stable semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Segmented subwords within rare words
patterns.context: Activations fall within rare proper nouns, technical terms, or drug names. Several examples share G-initial spellings containing the fragment ir, but their specific meanings and following words differ.

patterns.name: Proper nouns in titles or phrases
patterns.context: Appears in entry titles or biomedical subheadings, with activations concentrated on proper nouns and components of compounds.

patterns.name: Biomedical compound terms and title words
patterns.context: In materials-coating titles or cardiac-experiment paper titles, activations are scattered across domain terms and some common words, with no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Samoan text
patterns.context: In Samoan verses or ceremonial texts, activations fall within complete words; adjacent text is not marked.

patterns.name: Code line breaks and error prompts
patterns.context: PHP code snippets contain line breaks and indentation alongside Chinese error prompts; activations involve both formatting tokens and Chinese characters in the prompts.

7_1819.description: 激活分散在罕见专名、复合术语及标题词内部，也出现在萨摩亚语词片段和代码换行、中文提示中；可能偏好少见词形或不寻常子词切分，未见稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 罕见词内部的切分子词
patterns.context: 激活落在罕见专名、术语或药名的词内；多个例子共享以 G 开头、含 ir 的拼写片段，但具体词义与后续词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、维基百科条目标题

patterns.name: 标题或短语中的专名
patterns.context: 出现在条目标题或生物医学小标题中，激活集中于专名、复合词的组成部分。

patterns.name: 生物医学复合术语和标题词
patterns.context: 材料涂层标题或心脏实验论文标题中，激活分散在领域术语及部分普通词上，未见统一的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 材料科学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 萨摩亚语文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 萨摩亚语诗句或仪式性文本中，激活落在完整词内部；其余相邻文字未标记。
patterns.domain: 维基百科中的萨摩亚语文本

patterns.name: 代码换行及异常提示
patterns.context: PHP 代码片段包含换行缩进和中文错误提示；激活既涉及格式 token，也涉及提示语中的汉字。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on local letter fragments within words, such as ir, Mal, Tree, City, and ionic, as well as Film. These fragments occur in place names, proper nouns, and medical terminology, with no stable semantic or contextual condition apparent.

patterns.name: Intra-word ir sequence
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on letter fragments in the middle of words rather than on complete words; some words begin with G, while others do not.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia place names/articles and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Local letter fragments in proper nouns or technical terms
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on internal fragments of specific words or proper nouns; the context does not reveal a consistent condition based on word meaning.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedia articles, web text

patterns.name: Film at the beginning of a technical term
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the title-style phrase “Film thickness of die coating agents”.

7_1819.description: 激活多落在词内局部字母片段，如 ir、Mal、Tree、City、ionic，也有 Film；这些片段分布于地名、专名及医学术语，未见稳定语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 词内 ir 序列
patterns.context: 强激活落在词中间的字母片段上，而非完整词；有些词以 G 开头，有些并非如此

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的局部字母片段

patterns.name: 专业术语开头的 Film
