en.description: Activations are scattered across the code keyword let, ir/et within several proper nouns, the phrase preposition of, and the title word Film. There is no unified semantic theme; the pattern is more consistent with local responses to specific word forms or subword fragments.

patterns.name: The letters ir within English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on ir within words, often alongside a prefix or following subword fragment; occurs in proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia proper nouns, place names, building names

patterns.name: The keyword let
patterns.context: Activations fall on let, including a standalone JavaScript code line and variable declarations.

patterns.name: The letter sequence et
patterns.context: Activation falls on et within Venetian, forming part of the proper-noun adjective.

patterns.name: The preposition of
patterns.context: Activation covers of with a preceding space; occurs in noun phrases or organization names.

patterns.name: Film at the start of a title
patterns.context: Activation covers the complete word Film at the beginning of a title-like phrase, followed by thickness of.

7_1819.description: 激活分散于代码关键字 let、若干专名内部的 ir/et、短语介词 of，以及标题词 Film；没有统一的语义主题，较像对特定词形或子词片段的局部响应。

patterns.name: 英文词中含字母 ir
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 ir 上，常伴随前缀或后续子词片段；出现在专名中。

patterns.name: let 关键字
patterns.context: 激活落在 let 上；包括独立的 JavaScript 代码行，以及变量声明语句。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 编程说明、GitHub 代码

patterns.name: et 字母序列
patterns.context: 激活落在 Venetian 一词内部的 et 上，前后构成该专名形容词。

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 激活覆盖带前置空格的 of；处于名词短语或组织名称中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 标题、Wikipedia 组织名称

patterns.name: Film 词首
patterns.context: 激活覆盖 Film 这个完整词，位于标题式短语开头，后接 thickness of。

en.description: Primarily responds to indented, newline-separated structured source code, especially HTML/XML tag boundaries, attributes, and configuration key-value pairs. It also appears in build version fields, JSP descriptions, and news headlines in emails, suggesting triggers are not limited to a single tag.

patterns.name: Tags and boundaries in structured source code
patterns.context: Activations often fall on angle brackets, closing tags, and near tag names, especially in multiline, indented markup or configuration data; examples span HTML/XML, plist, and other structures.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, HTML/XML, configuration files

patterns.name: HTML tag attributes and text fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur around attribute names, attribute values, and tag boundaries in HTML; sometimes they include webpage navigation or generator metadata.

patterns.name: Key-value structure in XML/configuration entries
patterns.context: Configuration data is organized into paired tags or key-value entries; activations concentrate on tag boundaries and adjacent indentation. Specific values involve Apple type flags, interface orientation, and similar items.

patterns.name: Build version markers in source code
patterns.context: Appears in build configuration text following a GUID, with activations concentrated near the periods and equals signs in version/build fields.
patterns.domain: GitHub build configuration or generated files

patterns.name: JavaServer Pages mention
patterns.context: An encyclopedia text discusses JSP, with activation near related terminology; it lacks the direct tag structure shared by the other code snippets.

patterns.name: News headlines and email-style formatting
patterns.context: Headlines, editorial notes, and news alerts are formatted with tabs and newlines; activations fall around words in news headlines.

7_1819.concept: 结构化文本标记与边界
7_1819.description: 主要响应带缩进和换行的结构化源码，尤其是 HTML/XML 标签边界、属性及配置键值；也见于构建版本字段、JSP 说明和邮件中的新闻标题，说明触发不只限于单一标签。

patterns.name: 结构化源码中的标签与边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在尖括号、闭合标签、标签名附近，尤其是多行、缩进的标记语言或配置数据；覆盖 HTML/XML、plist 等不同结构。

patterns.name: HTML 标签属性及文本片段
patterns.context: HTML 标签中的属性名、属性值和标签边界附近出现激活；有时包括网页导航或生成器元数据。

patterns.name: XML/配置项的键值结构
patterns.context: 配置数据以成对标签或键值项组织，激活集中在标签边界及相邻缩进处；具体值涉及 Apple 类型标志、界面方向等。

patterns.name: 源码中的构建版本标记
patterns.context: 出现在 GUID 后的构建配置文本中，激活集中于版本/构建字段的点号与等号附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 构建配置或生成文件

patterns.name: JavaServer Pages 提及
patterns.context: 百科文本以 JSP 为话题，并在相关术语附近激活；缺乏与其余代码片段相同的直接标签结构。

patterns.name: 新闻标题与邮件式排版
patterns.context: 标题、编辑提示和新闻提醒以制表符及换行排版，激活落在新闻标题词语周围。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的网页/新闻文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from different domains: biomedical strings in medical passages, physics and astronomy terms or symbols in ArXiv papers, and XML configuration tags. Trigger positions are mostly specific subwords or compound strings; no unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Specific substrings in medical and biological text
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical papers, especially at specific token boundaries in strings such as bronchoalveolar, possessing, enantio-, and bronchiectasis; these fragments do not share a clear meaning or grammatical function.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, NIH project text, PubMed Central biology papers

patterns.name: Physics and astronomy terms/symbols
patterns.context: Appears in academic contexts involving particle physics, astronomy, condensed matter physics, or author names. Activations often fall on compound terms or intra-word substrings; domains and specific trigger forms vary.

patterns.name: XML tags and configuration text
patterns.context: Tags, closing-tag markers, and Spring Boot dependency names in Maven XML configuration; high activations are scattered across formatting markers and technical strings.

7_1819.description: 激活散见于多种领域文本：医学段中的生物医学词串、ArXiv中的物理天文术语或符号，以及XML配置标签。触发位置多为特定子词或复合字符串；看不出统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 医学与生物文本中的特定子串
patterns.context: 出现于生物医学论文中，尤其是特定分词边界处的 bronchoalveolar、possessing、enantio-、bronchiectasis 等字符串；这些片段并不共享明确的词义或语法功能。
patterns.domain: PubMed摘要、NIH项目文本、PubMed Central生物学论文

patterns.name: 物理与天文学术语/符号
patterns.context: 出现在粒子物理、天文学、凝聚态物理或作者姓名等学术上下文中，激活常落在复合术语或词内子串上；领域和具体触发形式各异。

patterns.name: XML标签与配置文本
patterns.context: Maven XML配置中的标签、标签闭合符及 Spring Boot 依赖名称；高激活分散在格式标记和技术字符串中。

en.description: Strong activations occur on several specific word fragments: the lung-related term bronchoalveolar, medical hyper-, and fragments such as AG, spectrophot-, and reson- from different domains. The most prominent repeated pattern is bron-, but overall the triggers include various word fragments that do not form a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of bronchoalveolar lavage
patterns.context: The term bronchoalveolar lavage occurs in medical text, where the neuron responds strongly to the initial subword «bron»; other token boundaries and later components may also activate more weakly.
patterns.domain: Pulmonary medicine, clinical research, and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Word-initial hyper-
patterns.context: Appears in compound medical terms, followed by a component describing a property or physiological state.

patterns.name: AG fragment in equipment name
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper noun AGASA in the context of astrophysical particle or cosmic-ray experiments.

patterns.name: Fluka chemical name fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the chemical supplier name Fluka Chemie AG.

patterns.name: Spectrophotometric measurement term fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the adverb spectrophotometrically, which describes a method for detecting reaction products.

patterns.name: Resonator terminology fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a technical description of radio communications filters, followed by ator to form resonators.
patterns.domain: Patents, radio frequency, and communications engineering

7_1819.description: 对若干特定词片段有强激活：肺部术语 bronchoalveolar、医学 hyper-，以及 AG、spectrophot-、reson- 等不同领域词片段。最明显的重复模式是 bron-，但整体还包含多种无法统一的词汇触发。

patterns.name: bronchoalveolar lavage 词内分段
patterns.context: 在医学文本中出现术语 bronchoalveolar lavage，神经元强烈响应其词首子串 «bron»；不同分词边界和后续组成部分也可能有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 肺部医学、临床研究及 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: hyper- 词首
patterns.context: 出现在复合医学术语中，后接描述性质或生理状态的成分。

patterns.name: AG 设备名称片段
patterns.context: 处于天体粒子或宇宙射线实验的专名 AGASA 中。

patterns.name: Fluka 化学品名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学品供应商 Fluka Chemie AG 的公司名称末尾。

patterns.name: 光谱测量术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述反应产物检测方法的副词 spectrophotometrically 中。

patterns.name: 谐振器术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在无线电通信滤波器的技术描述中，后接 ator 构成 resonators。

en.concept: Structured text markers and technical symbols
en.description: Primarily responds to HTML document markup, attributes, and source structures such as head/title; it also activates on template markers, mathematical subscript variables, and a few astrophysics and acoustics paper terms.

patterns.name: HTML tag boundaries and attributes
patterns.context: Tag names, attributes, and their boundary markers in HTML/XML markup, often accompanied by newlines and indentation; activations are distributed across various tag and attribute tokens.
patterns.domain: Webpage source, templates, and document snippets

patterns.name: HTML document title
patterns.context: The title element and its content in an HTML head, usually adjacent to head markers such as stylesheet.

patterns.name: Paths and resource references in HTML attributes
patterns.context: Tag attributes describe images, stylesheets, viewport settings, or canonical links; activations concentrate on fragments of attribute names and values.

patterns.name: HTML templates and template variables
patterns.context: Template-language markers embedded in an HTML document dynamically populate head or title content.

patterns.name: Subscript symbols and indices in academic tables
patterns.context: Mathematical variables, subscripts, and numeric indices recur in tables or data columns.

patterns.name: Numeric subscripts in astrophysical descriptions
patterns.context: When describing gamma-ray bursts, a variable T with a numeric subscript appears in a parameter list.

patterns.name: Technical terms for compact acoustic resonators
patterns.context: Sentences in papers discussing new resonator materials and measurable displacement; activations fall on several subwords in technical terms.

7_1819.concept: 结构化文本标记与技术符号
7_1819.description: 主要响应 HTML 文档标记、属性及 head/title 等源码结构；另对模板标记、数学下标变量，以及少量天体物理和声学论文术语有激活。

patterns.name: HTML 标签边界与属性
patterns.context: HTML/XML 标记中的标签名、属性及其边界符，常伴随换行和缩进；激活分布于多种标签与属性 token。
patterns.domain: 网页源码、模板及文档片段

patterns.name: HTML 文档标题
patterns.trigger: “<title>…</title>”，以及其中的标题文本，如“ColVis example”“Jumbotron Template”“Fixed Columns example”
patterns.context: HTML head 中的 title 元素及其内容；通常与 stylesheet 等头部标记相邻。

patterns.name: HTML 属性中的路径与资源引用
patterns.context: 标签属性描述图片、样式表、视口设置或规范链接；激活集中在属性名和值的片段。

patterns.name: HTML 模板与模板变量
patterns.context: HTML 文档中嵌入模板语言标记，用于动态填充 head 或标题内容。

patterns.name: 学术表格中的下标符号与编号
patterns.context: 表格或数据列中重复出现的数学变量、下标和数字编号。

patterns.name: 天体物理表述中的数值下标
patterns.context: 描述伽马射线暴时，变量 T 带数字下标并出现在参数列表中。

patterns.name: 紧凑声学谐振器的技术术语
patterns.context: 讨论新型谐振器材料及可测位移的论文句子；激活落在若干专业词的子词上。

en.description: Activations span descriptions of engineering equipment and buildings, proper nouns, map code, biological experimental parameters, and company tax narratives; there is no clear unified semantic trigger, and the passages resemble multiple local patterns.

patterns.name: Mechanical/engineering equipment construction and performance
patterns.context: Describes the structure, function, materials, or performance of equipment, components, or building systems, often using technical nouns and modifiers.
patterns.domain: Patent background, engineering and architecture encyclopedias

patterns.name: Local strings and tokenization in proper nouns
patterns.context: Split character fragments occur within proper nouns, place names, personal names, ship names, and weapon names; trigger positions have no obvious common semantic feature.

patterns.name: Google Maps JavaScript API code
patterns.context: Code instantiates map and polyline objects, including object paths, parentheses, and variable names.

patterns.name: Biological experimental procedures and conditions
patterns.context: Experimental parameters such as temperature, concentration, time, and reagents occur together in cell culture or antibody experimental methods.

patterns.name: Coal company finances and taxes
patterns.context: Describes a company's profits, wage allocation, and income tax payments.

7_1819.description: 激活跨工程设备与建筑描述、专有名称、地图代码、生物实验参数和公司税务叙述；没有明显统一的语义触发条件，各段更像多个局部模式。

patterns.name: 机械/工程设备构造与性能
patterns.trigger: “narrow wire cutting groove or grooves”“machining”“weigh module”；“rearview mirror systems”“interior rearview”“side view mirrors”；“Tubular systems”“interior space”
patterns.context: 描述设备、部件或建筑系统的结构、功能、材料或性能，常出现专业名词及其修饰语。

patterns.name: 专有名称中的局部字符串与分词
patterns.context: 专有名词或地名、人名、舰船名、武器名内部出现被拆分的字符片段；触发位置并无显然统一语义。

patterns.name: Google Maps JavaScript API代码
patterns.context: 代码中实例化地图与折线对象，包含对象路径、括号和变量名。

patterns.name: 生物实验步骤与条件
patterns.context: 细胞培养或抗体实验方法中，温度、浓度、时间及试剂等实验参数相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 煤业公司财务与税务
patterns.trigger: “income tax returns”“no profits”“net profits”“paid out in salaries”
patterns.context: 描述公司利润、薪酬分配及所得税缴纳情况。

en.description: Activations are scattered across domains and word classes: phrase components, numbers, proper nouns and code identifiers, LaTeX commands, and domain-specific terms and evaluative expressions. No stable, consistent semantic or syntactic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Phrase boundaries and phrase completion
patterns.context: Activations fall on consecutive components of common phrases, especially adjacent function words or lexical components within a phrase; however, theme words such as “spectrum” and “autism” also activate in the same passage.

patterns.name: Financial quote numbers
patterns.context: In stock market news, Nasdaq index gains and price figures are split into multiple tokens; activations concentrate on numeric fragments and nearby market terms.

patterns.name: LaTeX title-formatting commands
patterns.context: Commands for setting section or title styles in LaTeX and their arguments; activations occur near command names and formatting options.

patterns.name: Attribute descriptions in patents
patterns.context: A patent-style sentence describes a device's performance when moving over uneven ground, with rocks as an example; activations are distributed across property words, example phrases, and articles.

patterns.name: C++ template type name
patterns.context: Boost MPL template types and long identifiers in a C++ function signature; multiple fragments activate after the identifier is split.

patterns.name: Java test class names and identifiers
patterns.context: Package/class names and class instantiation recur in test configuration code; activations fall on fragments of split identifiers.

patterns.name: Statistical numeric expression
patterns.context: In a public health abstract comparing infection burden by multiples, activations occur near linking verbs and quantity expressions.

patterns.name: Emphatic evaluative phrase
patterns.context: In a review or satirical context, actually and pretty impressive form an emphatic evaluation; activations concentrate on the adverb of degree and evaluative word.

patterns.name: Music release and snippet description
patterns.context: When discussing the production, recording, and release of a live music CD, interspersed dialogue snippets are mentioned; activations fall on words such as snippets and their context.

patterns.name: Dog-breeding terminology
patterns.context: Describes breeding bitches, offspring, and eligibility as breeding stock; activations fall on fragments of breeding terminology such as foundation bitches.

7_1819.description: 激活分散于多种领域与词类：短语成分、数字、专名和代码标识符、LaTeX 命令，以及特定领域术语和评价表达；没有稳定一致的语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 短语边界与词组补全
patterns.trigger: [1] “you can« shake»3« a»7« stick»2 at”及“autism« links»5”
patterns.context: 激活落在常见短语的连续成分上，尤其是短语内部相邻的功能词或词汇成分；但同段也激活“spectrum”“autism”等主题词。

patterns.name: 金融报价数字
patterns.context: 股票市场新闻中，纳斯达克指数涨幅及价格数字被拆分成多个 token；激活集中在数字片段及行情词附近。

patterns.name: LaTeX 标题格式命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 中设置章节或标题样式的命令及其参数；命令名、格式选项附近激活。

patterns.name: 专利中的属性描述
patterns.trigger: [4] “irregular«ity»3”“such as« the»7 …« rocks»4 or« the»9 like”
patterns.context: 专利句式中描述装置在不规则地面行驶时的性能，并用 rocks 等举例；激活分布在性质词、例示短语及冠词上。

patterns.name: C++ 模板类型名
patterns.context: C++ 函数签名中的 Boost MPL 模板类型与长标识符，标识符被拆分后多个片段激活。

patterns.name: Java 测试类名与标识符
patterns.context: 测试配置代码中重复出现的包名／类名及类实例化；激活落在被拆分的标识符片段上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术文本／Java 代码

patterns.name: 统计数值表达
patterns.context: 公共卫生摘要用倍数比较感染负担时，系动词及数量表达附近激活。

patterns.name: 强调性评价短语
patterns.context: 评论或讽刺语境中，actually 与 pretty impressive 构成强调性评价；激活集中在程度副词和评价词。

patterns.name: 音乐发行与片段描述
patterns.context: 讨论现场音乐 CD 的制作、录音与发行时，提及穿插的对话片段；激活落在 snippets 等词及其上下文。

patterns.name: 犬种繁育术语
patterns.context: 描述母犬繁育、后代及作为种犬的资格；激活落在 foundation bitches 等繁育术语片段。

en.concept: Word fragments and the function word can
en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains, often falling on the English function word can or on substrings within segmented words, numbers, and proper nouns. Apart from can, there is no stable shared semantics; many fragments appear to reflect incidental tokenization or proper-noun and number formatting.

patterns.name: The function word can
patterns.context: Appears in English sentences followed by a verb or verb phrase; [1] is the fixed expression “you can shake a stick at”, and [7] is “I can grab”.

patterns.name: Segmented subwords at word beginnings or within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on local tokens in longer words, proper nouns, or numbers, with no indication that these substrings share semantics; segmentation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; sports, library copyright, dog breeds, literature, political science, drug research, etc.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix after a number
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix rd follows the number 3, referring to a team's third-string player.

patterns.name: Copyright permissions and contact information
patterns.context: Explains display permissions for digitized archival materials and provides contact information for copying or permission inquiries; these words are not marked as activation tokens and may be contextual rather than direct triggers.

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical names
patterns.context: Embedded in chemical names or symbols such as selenium, selol, selenitetriglycerides, tr…; different fragments correspond to chemical analyses in paper abstracts.

patterns.name: Dog breed and breeding vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Discusses a dam's offspring, foundation stock, and kelpie breeding stock; activation fragments may relate to proper nouns or within-word segmentation.

patterns.name: Fragments in book titles and publication information
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of Fitzgerald short stories and a 1935 collection and its title.

patterns.name: A repository question in code
patterns.context: Asks whether there is a main repository where all the code can be obtained; can also appears in [1], but the other activation fragments have no clear commonality.

patterns.name: Fragments in voting theory terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in the term Condorcet winner, discussing candidate voting and cases with no Condorcet winner.

patterns.name: Drug lot numbers and purity statements
patterns.context: Lists experimental reagents, lot numbers, and purity; many marked spans are numbers, letters, or within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Citation formatting and the word form educated
patterns.context: Appears in a HackerNews quoted reply discussing an educated community and dropouts; activations are scattered, with no clear semantic pattern.

7_1819.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，常落在英语功能词 can 或被切分的词内子串、编号和专名片段上。除 can 外，缺乏稳定共同语义；不少片段更像偶然的 token 切分或专名、数字格式。

patterns.name: 功能词 can
patterns.trigger: “can”（[1] 的 can 强度最高；[7] 的 can 也激活）
patterns.context: 出现在英语句中，后接动词或动词短语；[1] 为固定表达 “you can shake a stick at”，[7] 为 “I can grab”。

patterns.name: 词首或词内的切分子词
patterns.context: 激活落在较长单词、专名或编号的局部 token 上，且未显示这些子串具有共同语义；局部切分位置各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；体育、图书馆版权、犬种、文学、政治学、药物研究等

patterns.name: 编号序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字 3 后接序数后缀 rd，指球队的第三阵容球员。

patterns.name: 版权许可与联系信息
patterns.context: 说明数字馆藏材料的展示授权，并提供复制或询问许可的联系信息；这些词并未标注为激活 token，可能是上下文而非直接触发。
patterns.domain: 图书馆数字档案版权声明

patterns.name: 化学物质名称片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 selenium、selol、selenitetriglycerides、tr… 等化学名称或符号中；不同片段对应论文摘要中的化学分析。

patterns.name: 犬种与繁育词汇片段
patterns.context: 谈及母犬后代、基础种犬及 kelpie 种犬；激活片段可能与专名或词内切分有关。

patterns.name: 书名与出版信息片段
patterns.context: 出现在菲茨杰拉德短篇小说及其 1935 年文集、书名的介绍中。

patterns.name: 代码仓库问句
patterns.context: 询问是否有可获取全部代码的主仓库；其中 can 与[1]同样出现，但其余激活片段缺少明确共性。

patterns.name: 投票理论术语片段
patterns.context: 处于 Condorcet winner 术语中，讨论候选人投票与无 Condorcet 胜者的情形。

patterns.name: 药品批号与纯度表述
patterns.context: 列举实验试剂、批号和纯度；多处是数字、字母或词内片段。

patterns.name: 引用格式与 educated 词形
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 引用回复中，谈论受教育社区及辍学者；触发分散，未见明确语义模式。

en.description: Activation patterns are heterogeneous: several passages contain expressions of ability, access, or contact introduced by can; others involve dog breeding, discussions of reality and fiction, cricket commentary, financial market reports, test code, and mailing-list moderation. No unified semantics is apparent.

patterns.name: Consecutive can you-style expressions of ability or accessibility
patterns.context: Occurs in clauses expressing that someone can perform an operation, obtain a resource, or access something, often with can; the meanings vary across examples.

patterns.name: Dog-breeding terminology

patterns.name: Distinguishing discussion from reality

patterns.name: Commentary on Australia and historical events

patterns.name: Dow Jones index numbers in financial sections

patterns.name: Variable construction, formatting, and assertions
patterns.context: Code constructs an integer variable, formats a string, and checks a minimum value.

patterns.name: Mailing-list moderation and posting instructions

7_1819.concept: 异质语境中的 can 表述

patterns.name: 财经版面中的道琼斯指数数字

patterns.name: 变量构造、格式化及断言

patterns.name: 邮件列表审核与发帖说明

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: ordinary English phrases, numerical amounts and measurements, action instructions, URLs, dog-breeding terms, literary bibliographies, and humanities commentary all appear. No clear trigger feature spans all passages.

patterns.name: Function words and common phrases
patterns.context: Several common function words and phrase components are marked in ordinary English narration, explanations, or dialogue; there is no stable single-word trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and measurements
patterns.context: Numbers appear in patent parameters, amounts, or business reporting; activations are distributed across numbers and adjacent units or numerical expressions.

patterns.name: Action language in explanations or promotional text
patterns.context: Directs readers to take action or introduces available services and benefits.

en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is just/Just, often used for transitions or emphasis in instructions, suggestions, or comments; there are also scattered activations on CSV format terminology and mathematical symbols in papers. patterns.name: just in irregular colloquial spelling

en.description: The most stable signal is the word “just,” which strongly activates across multiple contexts. There are also local responses to some numbers, monetary amounts, and quantity expressions; the remaining activations are scattered across proper nouns, content words, and forum text, making them difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Activation on “just”
patterns.context: Appears in different syntactic positions, including before suggestions or instructions (“just ask”“Just download”“just DELETE”), in narration or emphasis (“just realised”“just swallowed”“I just want”“Just wish”), and in “used to just buy”. The word itself is the most stable common trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain web copy, forum conversations, news, technical discussions, and narration

patterns.name: Numbers and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers, units, and separators in expressions of amounts, scale, quantity, age, or duration; however, the forms are not entirely consistent, and not all numbers activate.
patterns.domain: News, technical discussions, business cases, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Sporadic words in forum and quoted text
patterns.context: These activations occur in sports forum comments or quoted conversations; there is no clearly consistent trigger substring repeated across passages.
patterns.domain: Forum comments and email-style quoted conversations

patterns.name: Local activations in descriptions of technical rule-set size
patterns.context: When describing the number of Node.js-related rules and the size of individual rule sets, activations appear on action words, quantity expressions, and descriptions of scale. Beyond the number/quantity pattern, there is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific common trigger.

patterns.name: Descriptions of business costs and license counts
patterns.context: In examples calculating development effort, license counts, and annual payments, quantity- and amount-related tokens activate. This is consistent with the number pattern in other passages, but the specific activation distribution is uneven.

patterns.name: Isolated activations on content words, proper nouns, and uppercase forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on words or intra-word fragments in different texts, involving hotel services, uppercase profanity, news, sports abbreviations, and place names; there is insufficient evidence to infer a shared semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Web copy, forum arguments, news, sports, and personal narratives

7_1819.description: 最稳定的信号是词“just”，多种语境中均强激活。另对若干数字、金额和数量表达有局部反应；其余激活分散在专名、实词及论坛文本中，难以统一解释。

en.concept: Proper nouns and structured fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations cover several disparate patterns: compound identifiers in code and configuration are most common, with hash-like strings, mathematical formulas, forum narratives, sports commentary, and business news also appearing; these cannot be grouped under a single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Uppercase identifiers in code and configuration
patterns.context: Identifiers composed of multiple words or abbreviations, often using underscores, camel case, or type names; sometimes adjacent to XML, JSON, or code syntax.
patterns.domain: Github code and configuration; StackExchange code

patterns.name: Alphanumeric strings and hash-like identifiers
patterns.context: Long, non-natural-language alphanumeric sequences containing digits, letters, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formal notation
patterns.context: Greek letters, subscripts, sets, and LaTeX notation occur densely in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: First-person narratives in English forums
patterns.context: First-person expressions of personal feelings, search experiences, or discoveries, in a colloquial tone.

patterns.name: English sports match reports
patterns.context: Discusses teams, goalkeepers, and match performance using sports-related expressions.

patterns.name: Business and management reporting in news
patterns.context: Reports on companies, CEO positions, management, or business amounts.

7_1819.concept: 异质文本中的专名与结构化片段
7_1819.description: 激活覆盖多种离散模式：代码与配置中的复合标识符最常见，另见散列样式字符串、数学公式，以及论坛叙述、体育评论和商业新闻；无法归为单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的大写标识符
patterns.context: 标识符由多个单词或缩写拼成，常见于下划线、驼峰命名或类型名称中；有时与 XML、JSON 或代码语法相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及配置；StackExchange 代码

patterns.name: 字母数字串与散列样式标识符
patterns.context: 长的、非自然语言的字母数字序列，包含数字、字母及连字符。

patterns.name: 数学符号与形式化记号
patterns.context: 数学公式中的希腊字母、下标、集合和 LaTeX 记号密集出现。

patterns.name: 英语论坛式个人叙述
patterns.trigger: 如「I'm interested and a bit concerned」「I can't find the other thread」「I have just realised」
patterns.context: 第一人称表达个人感受、搜索经历或发现，带有口语化语气。

patterns.name: 英语体育比赛报道
patterns.trigger: 如「they are playing well」「the other team」「Their goalies」「plenty of rubber」
patterns.context: 谈论球队、守门员及比赛表现，使用体育语境中的表达。

patterns.name: 新闻中的商业与管理报道
patterns.trigger: 如「$8.8 billion」「new CEO job at Uber」「top management strategy」
patterns.context: 报道公司、CEO 职位、管理层或商业金额。

en.description: Activations are scattered across English contractions and common words, words in poetry, URLs and code strings, C macro definitions, and hyphens in biomedical terms. There is no stable semantic theme, and some highlights are only sporadic subword fragments.

patterns.name: Negation words and apostrophe forms
patterns.context: Contractions, apostrophe forms, or combinations of common function words in English narration or quotations; can't in [1] is most prominent, but the examples do not share consistent lexical or semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Character fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Activations fall inside URLs, mixed-case strings, file paths, hashes, or code identifiers; there is no clear shared character position or string format.
patterns.domain: Web text, code, and machine-generated strings

patterns.name: Words and intra-word fragments in poetry
patterns.context: Appears in poetry or title-like text; activations may fall on complete words, word-form fragments, or near punctuation, and are difficult to reduce to a shared word meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Configuration macros in technical text
patterns.context: Occurs on macro definition directives in C preprocessor configuration code; the same passage also contains ordinary macro names and values, but they do not show comparable intensity.

patterns.name: Hyphenated biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: The hyphenated abbreviation «cis-NATs» recurs in a paper caption; activation falls clearly on the hyphen, not the body of the term.

patterns.name: No unified visible trigger pattern
patterns.context: Beyond the lexical phenomena described above, highlighted positions are scattered across ordinary English words, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

7_1819.description: 激活分布在英语缩写与常见词、诗句词语、URL和代码字符串、C宏定义及生物医学术语连字符上；没有稳定的语义主题，部分高亮仅是零散词片段。

patterns.name: 否定词与撇号形式
patterns.context: 英语叙述或引语中出现缩写、撇号形式或常见功能词组合；[1]的can't最突出，但这些例子并无一致的词法或语义条件。

patterns.name: URL中字符片段
patterns.trigger: [2] URL中的«q»；[3] «S»；[7] 路径/哈希片段«ib»、«9»；[10] 标识符片段«cf»
patterns.context: 激活落在URL、混合大小写字符串、文件路径、哈希或代码标识符内部；没有明显统一的字符位置或字符串格式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码与机器生成字符串

patterns.name: 诗句中的词语与词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在诗歌或类似标题的文本中，激活可能落在完整词、词形片段或标点附近；难以归结为同一词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的配置宏
patterns.context: C预处理器配置代码中，出现在宏定义指令处；同段还有普通宏名和数值，但它们未呈现相同强度。

patterns.name: 生物医学连字符术语片段
patterns.context: 论文图注中反复出现连字符连接的缩写术语«cis-NATs»；激活明确落在连字符，而非术语主体。

patterns.name: 无统一可见触发模式
patterns.context: 除各自可纳入的词法现象外，高亮位置分散在普通英语词语上，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activations often occur on structured symbols and identifiers: underscores, periods, parentheses, and compound names in code, or subscripts, parentheses, and mathematical commands in formulas. The specific semantics span testing, APIs, XML, patents, and physics.

patterns.name: Underscores and identifier separators
patterns.context: Appears in code identifiers, type names, member access, or test statements; often combines with neighboring word fragments to form camelCase or snake_case names
patterns.domain: Github source code and test code

patterns.name: C/C++ tests and assertions
patterns.context: Test macros and assertions verify callback or service behavior, often with uppercase test names, parentheses, and semicolons

patterns.name: Debug block ID enumeration
patterns.context: Assigns hexadecimal values to debug block identifiers, in aligned constant definitions
patterns.domain: Github, C/C++ constant or enumeration definitions

patterns.name: XML list items and security topics
patterns.context: XML-style item tags enclose list entries about topics such as Android security and penetration testing

patterns.name: Java service provider type names
patterns.context: Compound camelCase service/provider type names recur in generic lists and for loops

patterns.name: Pi and parentheses in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical expressions, pi and variable x are combined with parentheses and math font commands

patterns.name: Explanation of level identifiers in patents
patterns.context: Explains which level in a figure corresponds to a numerical identifier, using a conditional description and correspondence

patterns.name: PHP tests and array items
patterns.context: A test of a function that deletes an item checks pool state and iterates over an array containing item strings

patterns.name: Subscripts and infinity symbols in physics formulas
patterns.context: In field theory or phase-transition formulas, subscripted quantities appear alongside infinity values, temperature conditions, and expectation-value symbols

patterns.name: Windows API and event handler types
patterns.context: Calls the Windows API through the global namespace and passes an audio connection-related type as an argument

patterns.name: Mappings and Langevin equations in physics papers
patterns.context: The body text cites an equation and discusses interpreting a mapping as a Langevin equation for a noisy field

7_1819.description: 激活多见于结构化符号与标识符：代码中的下划线、点号、括号及复合名称，或公式中的下标、括号和数学命令；具体语义横跨测试、API、XML、专利和物理。

patterns.name: 下划线及标识符分隔符
patterns.context: 在代码标识符、类型名、成员访问或测试语句中出现；常与邻近词片段共同构成驼峰名或 snake_case 名

patterns.name: C/C++ 测试与断言
patterns.context: 测试宏和断言验证回调或服务行为，常见大写测试名及括号、分号

patterns.name: 调试块 ID 枚举
patterns.context: 对调试块标识符赋十六进制值，呈现对齐的常量定义

patterns.name: XML 列表项与安全主题

patterns.name: Java 服务提供者类型名
patterns.context: 泛型列表和 for 循环中反复出现复合驼峰式服务／提供者类型名

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 pi 与括号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中，pi 与变量 x 以括号和数学字体命令组合

patterns.name: 专利中的级别标识符说明
patterns.context: 解释某个数值标识对应图中级别，句式为条件说明和对应关系

patterns.name: PHP 测试及数组项
patterns.context: 测试删除项目的函数中检查池状态，并遍历包含 item 字符串的数组

patterns.name: 物理公式中的下标及无穷符号
patterns.context: 场论或相变公式中，下标量与无穷值、温度条件和期望值符号并列

patterns.name: Windows API 与事件处理器类型
patterns.context: 通过全局命名空间调用 Windows API，并以音频连接相关类型作为参数

patterns.name: 物理学论文中的映射与 Langevin 方程
patterns.context: 正文引用公式并讨论将映射解释为带噪声场的 Langevin 方程

en.description: Activations are scattered across LaTeX physics formulas and various code and markup fragments, including citation metadata, HTML tags, field names, assembly, and C/C++/Scala code. No stable, specific shared semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: LaTeX symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX source for physics formulas, often adjacent to Greek letters, subscripts, fractions, and line-break commands.

patterns.name: Epoch and offset in code
patterns.context: Scala-style code filters messages or partition records by epoch and extracts offsets; activations span identifiers, punctuation, and code structure.

patterns.name: Bibliography anchors and citation markers
patterns.context: Sequentially numbered citations and HTML/XML-style citation metadata, including link anchors and bib identifiers.

patterns.name: Video encoding field names
patterns.context: Underscore-separated canonical field names embedded in conditional statements, with array indices and figure references.
patterns.domain: Video encoding technical text in USPTO patent backgrounds

patterns.name: HTML navigation and link markup
patterns.context: Anchor links, class names, and closing tags in document navigation lists, mixing HTML with API documentation paths.
patterns.domain: Github documentation or generated API documentation

patterns.name: Field and group symbols in theoretical physics
patterns.context: Mathematically typeset field symbols, superscripts and subscripts, and fractions appear in an introduction to a neutral field, which also mentions an internal symmetry group.

patterns.name: x86 floating-point assembly instructions
patterns.context: A sequence of assembly instructions reads and multiplies doubleword operands in memory, including registers and offsets.

patterns.name: C++ time point types and timing
patterns.context: C++ code declares a system-clock time point and initializes a timer start point, then constructs a pose object.

patterns.name: Address microdata in Wikipedia tables
patterns.context: Rows in a Wikipedia table use HTML class markers to organize address, annotation, and vCard fields; content includes place names.

patterns.name: GPIO sampling edge configuration
patterns.context: C code compares edge strings and uses the result to set a GPIO sampling type enum value.

7_1819.description: 激活分散于 LaTeX 物理公式与多种代码、标记语言片段：包括引用元数据、HTML 标签、字段名、汇编及 C/C++/Scala 代码；未见稳定共享的具体语义触发项。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 符号
patterns.context: 出现在物理公式的 LaTeX 源码中，常与希腊字母、下标、分数及换行命令相邻。

patterns.name: 代码中的 epoch 与 offset
patterns.context: Scala 风格代码从消息或分区记录中按 epoch 过滤并提取 offset；激活跨标识符、标点和代码结构。

patterns.name: 参考文献锚点与引用标记
patterns.context: 连续编号的文献引用及 HTML/XML 式引用元数据，包含链接锚点和 bib 标识。

patterns.name: 视频编码字段名
patterns.context: 下划线连接的规范字段名嵌在条件语句中，带数组索引及图号引用。

patterns.name: HTML 导航与链接标记
patterns.context: 文档导航列表中的锚链接、类名和闭合标签，混合 HTML 与 API 文档路径。

patterns.name: 理论物理中的场与群符号
patterns.context: 介绍中性场时出现数学排版的场符号、上下标和分数，并提及内部对称群。

patterns.name: x86 浮点汇编指令
patterns.context: 连续汇编指令读取并相乘内存中的双字操作数，含寄存器及偏移量。

patterns.name: C++ 时间点类型与计时
patterns.context: C++ 代码声明系统时钟时间点并初始化计时起点，随后还构造 pose 对象。

patterns.name: 维基表格中的地址微数据
patterns.context: 维基表格行使用 HTML class 标记地址、注释和 vCard 组织字段，内容含地点名。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 标记文本

patterns.name: GPIO 采样边沿配置
patterns.context: C 代码比较边沿字符串，并据此设置 GPIO 采样类型枚举值。
patterns.domain: Github 嵌入式或驱动代码

en.description: Activations are distributed across unrelated corpora: technical terms and code identifiers, patent phrases, coordinate-axis variables, auditory science, educational discourse, logic terminology, and legal narratives. No single stable cross-domain trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments in compound terms or identifiers
patterns.context: Technical text contains long identifiers composed of multiple word fragments, underscores, or capitalization boundaries; activations are scattered across their components.

patterns.name: Coding, video frames, and motion-compensation terminology
patterns.context: Several technical words and phrases activate when describing image/video coding workflows, inter-frame differences, or motion compensation.

patterns.name: Zip code parsing and exception handling
patterns.context: In Java method declarations and parsing-exception handling code, strong activation is concentrated on the word throws.

patterns.name: Oil products and heat-treatment patent phrases
patterns.context: Contexts involving oil products, gear heat treatment, and compound compositions in patent claims or technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Coordinate axes and variable names
patterns.context: Discusses plot-axis scaling and includes combined_tracks2 in a variable name.

patterns.name: Measurement information and message timestamps
patterns.context: Code comments describe the time measurement and type suffix for the first message in a channel.

patterns.name: Cochlear auditory channels and noise suppression
patterns.context: Explains gain control in cochlear channels and its role in speech perception.

patterns.name: Learning activities and prompts
patterns.context: Activations fall on words such as learning and prompts in educational activity instructions or exhortative text addressed to readers.

patterns.name: Generation problems in logical paradoxes
patterns.context: Philosophical/logical discussion compares overgeneration and undergeneration, and the effect of TCP on paradox derivations.

patterns.name: Name initials and evidentiary verbs
patterns.context: In legal narratives, the name Harrison appears as initials at the start of a sentence, with the expression points to introducing examples of evidence.

7_1819.description: 激活分布于多种不相干语料：技术术语与代码标识符、专利短语、坐标轴变量、听觉科学、教育论述、逻辑术语及法律叙述。未见跨领域稳定的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 复合术语或标识符中的片段
patterns.context: 技术文本中出现由多个词片段、下划线或大小写边界拼成的长标识符；激活分散在其组成部分上。

patterns.name: 编码、视频帧与运动补偿术语

patterns.name: Zip 代码解析与异常处理
patterns.context: Java 方法声明及解析异常处理代码中，强激活集中在 throws 一词。

patterns.name: 油品与热处理专利短语

patterns.name: 坐标轴及变量名
patterns.context: 讨论绘图坐标轴比例，并在变量名中出现 combined_tracks2。

patterns.name: 度量信息与消息时间戳

patterns.name: 耳蜗听觉通道与噪声抑制
patterns.trigger: « auditory» channels；speech« in» background noise；signal-to-noise ratio
patterns.context: 解释耳蜗各通道的增益控制及其对语音感知的作用。

patterns.name: 学习活动与提示语
patterns.trigger: « learning» their own；«Let»’s keep in mind
patterns.context: 教育活动说明或面向读者的劝勉式叙述中，激活落在学习、提示语等词上。

patterns.name: 逻辑悖论中的生成问题
patterns.context: 哲学/逻辑论述比较过度生成、生成不足及 TCP 对悖论推导的影响。

patterns.name: 人名首字母与陈述动词
patterns.context: 法律叙述中人名 Harrison 以句首首字母形式出现，并有 points to 引出证据例子的表达。

en.concept: Subword fragments and local tokens in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across intra-word subwords/suffixes, technical terms, and common word fragments, spanning code, patents, medicine, and online text. No single semantic or stable syntactic condition explains all examples.

patterns.name: Split English suffixes and intra-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall inside words or near word boundaries; many trigger fragments are not independent words and span multiple word forms and contexts, so they cannot be explained by a single semantic feature
patterns.domain: Multiple text genres, including code, patents, medical papers, and online conversations

patterns.name: Technical phrases and compound-word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments of technical terms or compound nouns in patent technical descriptions; nearby trigger words are often accompanied by contexts involving devices, materials, signals, frames, or programs

patterns.name: Function words and common word fragments
patterns.context: These high-frequency words are embedded in sentences, and activation positions are not stable; some occur alongside intra-word splitting, so they cannot be confirmed as an independent trigger condition

patterns.name: Metric and timestamp identifiers
patterns.context: Constant names and their descriptions in code, involving metric types and message timestamps

patterns.name: Medical diagnosis and treatment terms
patterns.context: Descriptions of urological conditions, diagnoses, and treatments related to postoperative care or treatment

patterns.name: Learning and decision-making in educational contexts
patterns.context: Discusses participants internalizing learning through experiential activities and mentions someone's decision; activations are scattered, with no stable shared phrase

patterns.name: Quoted labels and repeated dialogue

patterns.name: Friction and orthodontic appliances
patterns.context: Describes wire sizes, friction, orthodontic brackets, and ligatures

patterns.name: Patent sentence patterns without a clear specific trigger
patterns.context: Descriptions of embodiments, material connections, or display driving frequencies in patent specifications; may overlap with the technical phrase pattern, but the specific trigger is not unique

patterns.name: Dependency scheduling and compilation issues
patterns.context: Describes a build stopping when program dependencies cannot be adjusted dynamically, as well as scheduling issues for compiling source code pads

7_1819.concept: 词片段与技术文本中的局部 token

patterns.name: 教育语境中的学习与决策
