patterns.context: A MATLAB script concatenates executable names, paths, and grid-file names, with activations on tokenized path/filename fragments

7_1819.concept: 跨领域字符串分词片段
7_1819.description: 激活分布于数学公式、医学和专利复合词、法律引文，以及代码包名、函数名、路径和网页链接等多种被分词切开的字符串；没有稳定的共同语义，似与特殊字符、标识符及词内分段有关。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 J/下标与数学算子
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式或公式中，邻近下标、算子及变量；两段均含 J，但具体公式与触发位置不同

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 ileal conduit
patterns.trigger: «ile»al« conduit»（激活在 ile 的分词片段上）
patterns.context: 描述膀胱切除后尿路重建及相关病症的医学摘要

patterns.name: 专利中的复合技术词及连字符/特殊字符
patterns.context: 专利背景段落列举导电材料与焊料；激活集中于编码后的破折号及连字符复合词片段

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号格式
patterns.context: 税法判决文字中引用法规编号，激活分布在缩写、标点和数字附近

patterns.name: Java 包名/类名中的标识符片段
patterns.context: Android Java import 语句中的多级包路径与类名，激活落在被切分的标识符子串

patterns.name: 人名缩写与书目标题
patterns.context: 网页链接中出现 C. S. Lewis 的书目页面标题，激活集中于姓名缩写和下划线分隔的链接文本

patterns.name: 程序构建术语中的复合名词
patterns.context: 描述组件源代码垫片的调度与编译；高激活落在 source code pads 这一技术复合名词上

patterns.name: 混合大小写、词内切分的长标识符
patterns.context: 重复出现的驼峰式函数名被切分为多个希腊字母名及普通词片段，激活分布在标识符内部

patterns.name: 文件路径与命令参数中的切分片段
patterns.context: MATLAB 脚本拼接可执行文件名、路径和网格文件名，激活落在被分词切开的路径/文件名片段

en.concept: Letter fragments and the biz domain
en.description: The most stable trigger is biz, especially standalone quiz.biz and .biz in domain lists; there are also sporadic activations on the Hus name fragment, biz in tech URLs, medical terms, the title word Search, and the code class name Action.

patterns.name: quiz.biz domain/tag
patterns.context: Appears alone at the end of a sentence or as a website top-level domain; often surrounded by separators or line breaks, and also found in domain lists.

patterns.name: Hus in a name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a personal name, followed by the rest of a surname; found in lists or legal-document signatures.
patterns.domain: Enron email contact lists, court case texts

patterns.name: biz path in a tech URL
patterns.context: Embedded in a news URL path, preceded by tech and followed by a slash and media-related path.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions and links about Google

patterns.name: Search in a paper title
patterns.context: At the start of a title, followed by “for” and a medical imaging abbreviation, on the topic of prostate tumors.

patterns.name: Psychosocial factors term
patterns.context: Describes factors affecting disease relapse in Crohn's disease research.

patterns.name: Android class-name suffix
patterns.context: Appears in Java import class names, forming FloatingActionButton / FloatingActionMenu.

patterns.name: Same letter fragments in other English words
patterns.context: No shared salient context or stable semantics; only sporadic activations.

7_1913.concept: 字母片段及域名biz
7_1913.description: 最稳定的触发是biz，尤其独立的quiz.biz及域名列表中的.biz；另对Hus姓名片段、科技网址biz、医学词、标题Search和代码类名Action等零星片段激活。

patterns.name: quiz.biz域名/标记
patterns.context: 在句尾独立出现，或作为网址顶级域名；周围常有分隔线、换行，亦见于域名清单。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Hus
patterns.context: 作为人名拼写的一部分，后接姓氏余部；出现在名单或法律文书署名中。
patterns.domain: Enron邮件联系人列表、法院案件文本

patterns.name: 科技网址中的 biz 路径
patterns.context: 嵌在新闻网址路径中，前面是 tech，后面接斜线及媒体等路径。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的 Search
patterns.context: 标题开头，后接“for”及医学影像缩写、前列腺肿瘤主题。

patterns.name: 心理社会因素术语
patterns.context: 克罗恩病研究中，描述影响疾病复发的因素。

patterns.name: Android类名后缀
patterns.context: 出现在Java导入语句的类名中，组成 FloatingActionButton / FloatingActionMenu。

patterns.name: 其他英文词中相同字母片段
patterns.context: 没有共同的显著上下文或稳定语义；仅有零星激活。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across biz/quiz.biz domains, the Hus surname fragment, and varied terms such as psychosocial, Search, and Action; there is no consistent semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: quiz.biz domain marker
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone line after a HackerNews comment separator; also occurs at the end of bulk domain lists

patterns.name: biz top-level domain
patterns.context: biz appears as a URL or domain top-level domain, including tech/biz in URL paths and repeated mentions of photosoft.biz

patterns.name: Hus surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the start of surnames, followed by -on or -kins
patterns.domain: Enron email contact lists and legal rulings

patterns.name: psychosocial term
patterns.context: Describes factors affecting disease relapse in Crohn’s disease research

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Search
patterns.context: Appears at the start of short medical search-query titles or query statements

patterns.name: Floating action button class names
patterns.context: Class names FloatingActionButton and FloatingActionMenu in Android Java import paths

7_1913.concept: none
7_1913.description: 强激活分散在 biz/quiz.biz 域名、Hus 姓氏片段，以及 psychosocial、Search、Action 等不同词项；没有统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: quiz.biz 域名标记
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 评论分隔线后的独立行中出现 quiz.biz；也见于批量域名列表的末尾

patterns.name: biz 顶级域
patterns.context: biz 作为网址或域名的顶级域出现；包括 URL 路径中的 tech/biz，也包括重复列举的 photosoft.biz

patterns.name: Hus 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 作为人名姓氏的开头，后续分别接上 -on 或 -kins
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件联系人列表、法律判决

patterns.name: psychosocial 术语
patterns.context: Crohn 病研究中描述影响病情复发的因素
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: Search 句首
patterns.context: 出现在简短的医学检索式标题或查询语句开头

patterns.name: 浮动操作按钮类名
patterns.context: Android Java import 路径中的类名 FloatingActionButton、FloatingActionMenu

en.description: Primarily activates on compound identifiers containing “Action” in code or documentation and on titles; also shows isolated activations for “psychosocial” in medical contexts, “biz” in comments, “Hus” in names, and “48” in sequence problems, with clearly different contexts.

patterns.name: Action identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in compound identifiers, class names, or titles such as “ActionColumn,” “Action Items,” “FloatingActionButton,” “ActionBarContainer,” “DeleteAction,” and “argsToAction”; capitalization and prefixes/suffixes vary
patterns.domain: Code, software error messages, and document titles

patterns.name: Psychosocial factors in Crohn’s disease
patterns.context: Discusses Crohn’s Disease relapse and factors affecting disease progression

patterns.name: “Good biz idea” phrase
patterns.context: In the comment-style phrase “Good biz idea”

patterns.name: Hus surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears in names, respectively a lawyer’s name in a legal document and a recipient’s name in an email

patterns.name: Value in a number sequence problem
patterns.context: Appears as the first term in a sequence problem, followed by other comma-separated values

7_1913.concept: Action 标识符及零散词项
7_1913.description: 主要对代码或文档中的“Action”复合标识符及标题激活；另有医学语境的“psychosocial”、评论中的“biz”、姓名片段“Hus”和数列题中的“48”等孤立触发，彼此语境差异明显。

patterns.name: Action 标识符
patterns.context: 出现在复合标识符、类名或标题中，如“ActionColumn”“Action Items”“FloatingActionButton”“ActionBarContainer”“DeleteAction”“argsToAction”；大小写及前后缀不一
patterns.domain: 代码、软件错误信息及文档标题

patterns.name: Crohn 病心理社会因素
patterns.context: 谈论 Crohn’s Disease 复发及影响疾病进程的因素

patterns.name: biz idea 短语
patterns.context: “Good biz idea”这一评论式短语中

patterns.name: Hus 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名中，分别为法律文书中的律师姓名和邮件收件人姓名
patterns.domain: 法律文书、电子邮件名单

patterns.name: 数字序列题中的数值
patterns.context: 作为数列题给出的首项，后接逗号分隔的其他数值

en.description: Primarily activates on math problem statements asking for the next or a specified term in a number sequence, and on their numerical sequences and algebraic answers; a few separate patterns also occur in ordering problems, medical research, and qualitative research data collection.

patterns.name: Sequence-term prompts
patterns.context: A question is followed by a comma-separated sequence and asks for the next or a specified term; a formula or answer often follows immediately. Repeats across multiple mathematical contexts.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, sequence and algebra exercises

patterns.name: Symbols in sequence answers/formulas
patterns.context: Appears in solutions or general-term expressions following sequence problems; variables often correspond to abbreviated ordinal terms with apostrophes.

patterns.name: Numerical sorting instructions
patterns.context: Asks for a set of positive and negative numbers to be arranged in descending order, then lists the reordered result.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in sequences
patterns.context: Numbers, commas, question marks, and line breaks appear densely in math or sequence problems; the numerical sequence itself may form the triggering context even without a typical prompt.

patterns.name: Disease names and psychosocial factors
patterns.context: Introduces a disease course and discusses factors affecting relapse and worsening.

patterns.name: Qualitative research methods and data collection
patterns.context: Describes a research design and methods of data collection, involving simulation games, discussions, questionnaires, and written reflections.

7_1913.concept: 数列题文本及数学练习
7_1913.description: 主要对数列求下一项或指定项的数学题干及其数字序列、代数答案激活；另见排序题、医学疾病研究和定性研究资料收集等少数独立模式。

patterns.name: 数列求项提示
patterns.trigger: “What is next in”, “What is the next term in”, “What is the [序数] term of”
patterns.context: 提问后给出逗号分隔的数列，要求找下一项或指定项；常紧接着出现公式或答案。多个数学上下文中反复出现。

patterns.name: 数列题答案/公式中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在数列题目之后的解答或通项表达式中，变量常与序数项的撇号缩写相呼应。

patterns.name: 数值排序指令
patterns.context: 要求把一组正负数按降序排列，随后列出重排结果。

patterns.name: 数列中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数学题或序列题中密集出现数字、逗号、问号和换行；即使没有典型题干，数字序列本身也可能构成触发背景。

patterns.name: 疾病名称及心理社会因素
patterns.context: 介绍疾病病程，并讨论影响复发和恶化的因素。

patterns.name: 定性研究方法与资料收集
patterns.context: 描述研究设计及收集资料的方式，涉及模拟游戏、讨论、问卷和书面反思。

en.concept: Multiple text fragments and formatting cues
en.description: Strongly responds to sentence-initial “While” and the following statement; also activates on patent/product information, numbers and instructions in math problems, and depression and immigration terms in medical abstracts. No single content theme spans all passages.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial While
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a sentence, followed by a clause or complete statement; excerpts often end mid-sentence.
patterns.domain: News, general explanations, medical papers, and other expository texts

patterns.name: Patent and product-news wording
patterns.context: Patent numbers appear alongside product-news headlines or classification information.

patterns.name: Content distribution and authentication markers
patterns.context: Patent-style descriptions of methods and the markers they generate.

patterns.name: Sequences and number formatting in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the next term in a sequence or to arrange several integers, negative numbers, and fractions in order.

patterns.name: Depressive episodes and immigrant populations
patterns.context: Depressive episodes among specific immigrant groups in medical abstracts.

7_1913.concept: 多类文本片段与格式线索
7_1913.description: 强烈响应句首“While”及其后续陈述；另对专利/产品信息、数学题中的数字与指令，以及医学摘要中的抑郁和移民术语有激活，未见单一内容主题覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 句首 While
patterns.context: 出现在句首，后接从句或完整陈述；截取内容多在句子中途结束。
patterns.domain: 新闻、一般说明、医学论文及其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 专利及产品新闻用语
patterns.context: 专利号与产品新闻标题或分类信息相邻。

patterns.name: 内容分发与认证标记
patterns.context: 专利式描述方法及其生成的标记。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数列与数字格式
patterns.context: 询问数列下一项，或要求将若干整数、负数、分数按序排列。

patterns.name: 抑郁发作与移民人群
patterns.context: 医学摘要中关于特定移民群体的抑郁发作。

en.concept: Proper nouns and labels in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across several formatted text types: legal case titles and litigation terms such as “Complaint” and “Error” are most prominent; email headers, code and logs, medical titles, and slash-separated software titles also appear. A possible commonality is dense proper nouns, fields, or terminology and clear formatting, but the triggering conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: Specific litigation terms in legal cases
patterns.context: Pleadings, names for appellate parties, and standardized case titles appear in legal texts or case citations.

patterns.name: Mixed-case proper nouns and legal citation formatting
patterns.context: In case titles, citations, and all-caps party names, proper nouns are tokenized or split with unusual capitalization.

patterns.name: Structured labels, fields, and delimiters
patterns.context: Near email headers and recipient fields, with line breaks, tabs, spaces, and slash separators.

patterns.name: Punctuation and control structures in code
patterns.context: JavaScript snippets with dense statement boundaries, indentation, and function calls.

patterns.name: Severity levels and identifiers in program error logs
patterns.context: Timestamped Java error output, with severity fields adjacent to class, method, and package names.

patterns.name: Tokenized terms and complaint language in medical titles
patterns.context: In case or paper titles, disease descriptions are connected to complaint phrases; “Complaint” here refers to a complaint of urinary incontinence.

patterns.name: Slash-separated attributes in software project titles
patterns.context: Project or repository titles link product attributes with slashes, followed by consecutive nominalized words.

7_1913.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与标签
7_1913.description: 激活分布在多种格式化文本中：法律判例标题与“Complaint”“Error”等诉讼词最突出；另见邮件头、代码与日志、医学标题及斜线分隔的软件标题。共同点可能是专名、字段或术语密集且格式结构明显，但触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律判例中的特定诉讼用语
patterns.trigger: “Complaint”“Error”“Defendant in Error”“Plaintiff in Error”及判例中的当事人、案号
patterns.context: 法律文本或判例引文中出现诉状名称、上诉当事人称谓及规范化案件标题

patterns.name: 混合大小写的专名与法律引文排版
patterns.trigger: 如“P.2d”“Labaton v. Universal Leaf Tobacco Co.”、“THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF ILLINOIS”
patterns.context: 判例标题、引文及全大写当事人姓名中，专名被分词或大小写异常切分

patterns.name: 结构化标签、字段与分隔格式
patterns.context: 邮件头部及收件人字段附近，带有换行、制表符、空格和斜线分隔

patterns.name: 代码中的标点及控制结构
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码片段中，语句边界、缩进和函数调用密集出现

patterns.name: 程序错误日志中的严重级别与标识符
patterns.context: 带时间戳的 Java 错误输出，严重级别字段及类、方法、包名相邻

patterns.name: 医学标题中的分词术语及诉状词
patterns.context: 病例或论文标题中，疾病描述与主诉短语相连；“Complaint”在此指排尿失禁主诉

patterns.name: 软件项目标题中的斜线分隔属性
patterns.context: 项目或仓库标题以斜线串联产品属性，并接连出现名词化词语

en.concept: English proper nouns and structured text fragments
en.description: Activations concentrate on the string “biz” (including URL/comment examples) and structured citations and case titles in legal and patent texts; there are also responses to the initial word fragment “Ass” and to numbers and proper nouns in historical narratives.

patterns.name: High activation on the “biz” string
patterns.context: Appears in English words or URLs; segments 1, 4, and 5 include text such as “Good idea,” “quiz,” and “blacklisting,” while segment 2 contains a “tech/biz” URL path.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments and tech news URLs

patterns.name: Volume/page formats in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in highly structured legal case or patent document identifiers, often adjacent to a court, volume number, page number, year, or markers such as “A1”.
patterns.domain: Legal cases and patent background documents

patterns.name: Legal case names and party titles
patterns.context: Case titles, party names, or litigation roles appear as all-caps titles, abbreviations, and formal legal wording.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in title-style phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment “Ass” in a home-renovation article, a legal opinion, and a historical encyclopedia narrative; contexts differ markedly.

patterns.name: Numbers and proper nouns in historical narratives
patterns.context: An encyclopedia-style narrative consisting of medieval castles, years, and historical figures.

7_1913.concept: 英文专名与结构化文本片段
7_1913.description: 激活集中于“biz”字串（含网址/评论用例）、法律与专利文本中的结构化引证和案件标题；另对“Ass”词首片段及历史叙述中的数字、专名有响应。

patterns.name: “biz”串中的高激活
patterns.context: 出现在英文词语或网址中；段1、4、5附近有“Good idea”“quiz”“blacklisting”等文本，段2为“tech/biz”网址路径。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的卷页格式
patterns.context: 数字嵌在高度结构化的法律判例或专利文献编号中，常邻接法院、卷号、页码、年份或“A1”等标记。
patterns.domain: 法律判例与专利背景文献

patterns.name: 法律案件名称与当事方标题
patterns.trigger: 段9“TRAVELERS INSURANCE COMPANY”“Appellant”“v.”“Design ee”“Claims Plan”；段3“Action Center v. FCC”
patterns.context: 案件标题、当事人名称或诉讼身份以大写标题、缩写及正式法律措辞呈现。

patterns.name: 标题式短语中的词形碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在词首片段“Ass”，分别处于家居装修文章正文、法律判决正文和历史百科叙述中；上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的数字与专名
patterns.context: 中世纪城堡、年份及历史人物名称组成的百科式叙述。

en.concept: Proper-noun fragments and heterogeneous text features
en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and their subwords, forum signatures and posts, legal documents, medical titles, sports reports, and encyclopedia lists. Chang stands out in three personal names, but the other triggers have no unified semantics or formatting conditions.

patterns.name: Chang name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in personal names, typically adjacent to other token fragments of a given name or surname; examples include band members, litigants, and book authors.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, legal facts, online forums

patterns.name: Split names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords or fragments of proper nouns, commonly in personal names, band names, company names, or place names; some names may also contain Chang.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal documents, sports reports, and forums

patterns.name: Court case titles and fact paragraphs
patterns.context: Titles, procedural language, or party descriptions in case documents; Chang need not appear.

patterns.name: Products, transactions, and parties in legal documents
patterns.context: Factual paragraphs describing a defendant's online tractor sales and the transactions.

patterns.name: Law firms and employment law services
patterns.context: Emails promoting employment law services and including a law firm signature; proper-noun tokenization may overlap with the name pattern.

patterns.name: Title of a study on attitudes toward problem drinkers
patterns.context: Academic paper title concerning attitudes toward problem drinkers.

patterns.name: Forum signatures and random strings
patterns.context: Near forum post separators, signatures, or apparently random strings; no clear connection to the post topic.

patterns.name: Web comments and personal preferences
patterns.context: First-person forum conversations about websites, browser icons, blogs, or books; occurs alongside the signature pattern.

patterns.name: Soccer season and player injuries
patterns.context: Reports on the Portland Timbers' season record, players, and leg injuries; name subwords may be related to the split proper-noun pattern.

patterns.name: Works and navigation lists in encyclopedia articles
patterns.context: Related articles and references at the end of a biographical entry, including book titles, film titles, and personal names.

7_1913.concept: 专名片段与异质文本特征
7_1913.description: 激活分散于专名及其子词、论坛签名和正文、法律文书、医学标题、体育报道与百科列表；Chang 在三段人名中突出，但其余触发缺乏统一语义或格式条件。

patterns.name: Chang 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名中，且通常紧邻名字或姓氏的其他分词片段；包括乐队成员、诉讼当事人、书籍作者。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、法律事实、网络论坛

patterns.name: 拆分姓名与专名
patterns.context: 激活落在专有名称的子词或词片段上，常见于人名、乐队名、公司名或地名；部分姓名可能同含 Chang。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律文书、体育报道及论坛

patterns.name: 法庭案件标题及事实段落
patterns.trigger: «SL»«APP» motion on the «merits»；«FACTS AND PROCEEDINGS BELOW»；«Fashion 21»
patterns.context: 案件文书中的标题、程序性表述或当事人介绍；不要求出现 Chang。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的商品、交易与当事人
patterns.context: 叙述被告在线销售拖拉机及交易经过的事实段落。

patterns.name: 律师事务所及雇佣法律业务
patterns.context: 邮件中介绍雇佣法律事务服务并附律师事务所署名；专名切分可能与姓名模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、法律服务宣传

patterns.name: 问题饮酒者态度研究标题
patterns.context: 学术论文标题中谈及对问题饮酒者的态度。

patterns.name: 论坛签名与随机字符串
patterns.context: 论坛帖子分隔线、签名或看似随机的字符串附近；与正文主题没有明显联系。

patterns.name: 网页评论与个人偏好
patterns.context: 讨论网站、浏览器图标、博客或书籍的第一人称论坛对话；与签名模式同时出现。

patterns.name: 足球赛季与球员伤情
patterns.context: 报道波特兰伐木者队赛季战绩、球员及腿伤；其中姓名子词可能与拆分专名模式相关。

patterns.name: 百科条目中的作品与导航列表
patterns.context: 人物条目末尾的相关条目及参考文献列表，包含书名、电影名和人物名。

en.concept: Bay spelling fragments and formatting/proper-noun cues
en.description: Activations show heterogeneous patterns: the proper-noun fragment Bay recurs across corpora; other local patterns include all-caps titles, legal document labels, French word forms, proper nouns, and fragments within several title words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Bay proper-noun fragment
patterns.context: Appears as a consecutive letter fragment in place or organization names, followed by different text, such as “Baynard” or “Bay” Area; no standalone common-noun use observed.
patterns.domain: Podcast descriptions, travel copy, nonprofit advertising

patterns.name: All-caps title and chapter formatting
patterns.context: Titles or chapter headings are all caps; other all-caps title words in the same passage also activate.
patterns.domain: Book formatting, tables of contents, or chapter headings

patterns.name: Structural labels in court documents
patterns.context: All-caps factual and procedural section headings in legal opinions.

patterns.name: French endings and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Endings embedded in French adverbs or nouns, such as “sincèrement” and “amendement”; activation is not restricted to word-final positions.

patterns.name: Suck in a title
patterns.context: In the English title “Why Applications Suck,” the word is split into consecutive subword fragments.

patterns.name: Fragment within Buddhism
patterns.context: Appears in the title phrase “From Zen Buddhism to …”.

patterns.name: Words related to women's clothing
patterns.context: A clothing retailer and its owner's name in a legal case's factual introduction; sporadic within-word fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Names and contacts
patterns.context: An email body provides recipient contact information, with strongest activation on the name; several other names also occur with varying activation.

patterns.name: Name fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the name “María Sornosa,” spanning the name internally.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs in the place name “San Diego”; the specific trigger is unclear and may be a spelling fragment rather than semantics.

patterns.name: Words in book titles and chapter headings
patterns.context: Book titles and author names use all-caps formatting, with activations across fragments of multiple words; chapter headings in the same passage also activate.
patterns.domain: Classical novel text and book formatting

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across title words such as “Preying on Vulnerable Women”; a shared semantic trigger is difficult to identify from a single passage.

7_1913.concept: Bay拼写片段与格式/专名线索
7_1913.description: 激活呈现异质模式：跨语料反复出现 Bay 专名片段；另有标题大写、法律文书标签、法语词形、专名及若干标题词内片段等局部模式，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Bay专名片段
patterns.context: 作为地名或机构名中的连续字母片段出现，后接不同内容，如“Baynard”“Bay” Area；未见独立普通名词用法
patterns.domain: 播客介绍、旅游文案、公益宣传

patterns.name: 标题与章节大写格式
patterns.context: 标题或章节标题采用全大写；同段也激活其他大写标题词
patterns.domain: 书籍排版、目录或章节标题

patterns.name: 法庭文书结构标签
patterns.context: 法律判决中大写的事实与程序部分标题

patterns.name: 法语词尾与词形片段
patterns.context: 嵌在法语副词或名词中的词尾，如“sincèrement”“amendement”；并非只在词尾位置激活

patterns.name: 标题中的 Suck
patterns.context: 英文标题“Why Applications Suck”中，词被拆分成连续子词片段

patterns.name: Buddhism词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题短语“From Zen Buddhism to …”中

patterns.name: 女性服饰相关词
patterns.context: 法律案件事实介绍中，服饰零售商及其所有者姓名；同时有零散词内片段激活

patterns.name: 姓名与联系人
patterns.context: 邮件正文提供收件人联系信息，姓名处激活最强；另有多个人名出现但激活不一

patterns.name: 姓名片段
patterns.context: 位于姓名“María Sornosa”中，片段跨姓名内部

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 位于地名“San Diego”中，具体触发依据不明，可能是拼写片段而非语义

patterns.name: 书名与章节标题词
patterns.context: 书名及作者名采用全大写排版，激活分布在多个词内片段；同段章节标题也激活
patterns.domain: 古典小说文本及书籍排版

patterns.name: 偶发词内片段
patterns.context: 分布于“Preying on Vulnerable Women”等标题词中，难以从单段确定共同语义触发条件

en.concept: Multiple types of proper nouns and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords of names, brands, and other proper nouns, and also occur in song titles, legal citations, promotional copy, date schedules, and formatting boundaries; no stable semantic trigger spans all corpora.

patterns.name: Fragments in surnames or personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls within or adjacent to names; examples include party names in legal documents and names in webpages, emails, and literary texts.
patterns.domain: Legal, web, email, and literary texts

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside subwords of proper nouns or brand names, rather than reflecting a stable common-word meaning.

patterns.name: Song titles and title-style phrases
patterns.context: Words or subwords in titles activate across track lists from music albums.

patterns.name: Statutes and citation formats in legal texts
patterns.context: Activation involves statute numbers, code names, and surrounding formal text in legal opinions or legal discussions.

patterns.name: Promotional or exhortative webpage copy
patterns.context: Copy with religious or political appeals, signup prompts, and prominent webpage formatting.

patterns.name: Dates and schedule information
patterns.context: Date-related word fragments activate in webpage or email paragraphs containing dates, update times, or event schedules.

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation occasionally falls on line breaks or page-break control characters, often alongside lists, webpage formatting, or document headers.

7_1913.concept: 多类专名与格式片段
7_1913.description: 激活分散在姓名、品牌及其他专名的子词，也见于歌曲标题、法条引证、宣传文案、日期日程和排版边界；未见贯穿所有语料的稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 姓氏或人名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名内部或姓名相邻的分词片段；既包括法律文件中的当事人姓名，也包括网页、邮件和文学文本中的人名。

patterns.name: 专名中的特定分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名或品牌名称的内部子词，而非稳定的普通词义。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题与标题式短语
patterns.trigger: «Yours»«Is»«No»«Dis»gr«ace»、«Rhythm» of Love、«Heart» of the Sun«rise»、«Make» It Easy
patterns.context: 音乐专辑曲目列表中，标题里的词或子词分散激活。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法条与引证格式
patterns.context: 法律判决或法律论述中，激活涉及法条编号、法典名称及周边正式文本。

patterns.name: 宣传或号召性网页文案
patterns.trigger: «Help» me bring America «back» to God & God’s «Law»!、«EN»«LIST» «HERE»
patterns.context: 带有宗教政治号召、报名提示及醒目网页排版的文案。

patterns.name: 日期与日程信息
patterns.context: 日期、更新时间或活动日程的网页/邮件段落中，日期相关词片段激活。

patterns.name: 格式边界与换行标记
patterns.context: 激活偶尔落在换行或分页控制符上，常伴随列表、网页排版或文书页眉。

en.concept: Word fragments in titles and proper nouns
en.description: Activations are scattered across song names and titles, proper nouns and document names, all-caps or split words, and place and organization names; there is no single stable semantic category, and phrase boundaries, capitalization, and subword tokenization may all be relevant.

patterns.name: Phrases or entity terms in titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on components of phrases in titles, song titles, or proper nouns; phrase boundaries and whether words are split into subwords appear important.
patterns.domain: Music lists, blog titles, proper nouns such as songs or buildings

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper nouns, document names, and capitalized phrases
patterns.context: In proper nouns, plugin names, document titles, or warning messages, words appear in capitalized form, and some are split into multiple subwords; activation does not consistently fall on the whole word.
patterns.domain: Web comments, document names, website warnings

patterns.name: Specific capitalized words and their subword splits
patterns.context: Parts split by the tokenizer in capitalized words or code strings activate; capitalization and subword boundaries may be relevant, but examples differ in semantic function.

patterns.name: Administrative divisions and school names
patterns.context: Place or organization names appear in biographical, educational, and historical texts.

patterns.name: Incomplete or unclear highlighted fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on common words or fragments with no obvious semantic connection; the visible context is insufficient to determine a specific trigger.

7_1913.concept: 标题与专名中的词片段
7_1913.description: 激活分散在歌名与标题、专名和文档名、全大写或被拆分的词，以及地名和机构名中；没有稳定的单一语义类别，词组边界、大写形式和子词切分可能共同相关。

patterns.name: 标题中的短语或实体词组
patterns.trigger: «It»10« Easy»3、«Walker»9 «Who»4 «Put»4 the Temples First、«Fields»9、«Teacher»9 of the Year、«Ch»2«âte»6«au»9
patterns.context: 激活落在标题、歌名、歌曲名或专名中的词组组成部分；词组边界及词语是否被拆分成子词似乎重要。
patterns.domain: 音乐列表、博客标题、歌曲或建筑等专名

patterns.name: 专名、文档名及大写短语中的内部片段
patterns.context: 专名、插件名、文档标题或警示语中，词语以大写形式出现，部分词还被切分成多个子词；激活位置不固定在整词。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、文档名、网站警示语

patterns.name: 特定大写词及其子词拆分
patterns.context: 大写词或代码字符串里被 tokenizer 拆开的部分被激活；触发可能与大写及子词边界有关，但不同例子的语义用途不同。
patterns.domain: 历史文献标题、程序代码

patterns.name: 行政区与学校名称
patterns.context: 地名或机构名出现在人物履历、教育及历史文本中。

patterns.name: 残缺或边界不明的高亮片段
patterns.trigger: « plan»3、« travelled»1 « between»1 « them»1、« or»4 « Bet»4
patterns.context: 高亮落在常见词或语义上缺乏明显关联的词片段；可见上下文不足以判定具体触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur in email headers, title and table-of-contents layouts, poetry indentation, patent terminology, code, and subword fragments; there are local cues, but the triggering conditions are not consistent across passages.

patterns.name: Email headers and subject lines
patterns.context: Email headers contain line breaks, recipient fields, and subject lines with Re:; the body topic is written in all caps.

patterns.name: English word segmentation and suffixes
patterns.context: Activations fall within English words, proper nouns, or inflectional endings assembled across tokens; contexts vary, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Prose, medical papers, code strings, etc.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in informational text
patterns.context: Introduces an additional fact or explanation using expository expressions such as “worth knowing” and “while.”

patterns.name: Poetry line indentation and lyrical vocabulary
patterns.context: Poetry lines have noticeable indentation and lyrical expressions about mothers, faith, or the deceased.

patterns.name: arm/tool in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Long sentences describe tools, positioning mechanisms, bases, and their connections or performance limitations.

patterns.name: Tree themes and chapter formatting
patterns.context: Chapter titles or table-of-contents layouts; titles concern trees, plants, fertility, or divination.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and place names
patterns.context: After a colony identification method, reagents or institutional locations appear in parentheses; activations fall on French place names and fragments within them.

patterns.name: Book titles and all-caps title formatting
patterns.context: Book title pages or chapter lists combine all-caps titles, author information, and Roman numeral chapters with centered spacing.

patterns.name: Code annotations and interface text
patterns.context: Java event-handling code contains indented annotations and scissor-selection text for display in an interface.

patterns.name: Table-of-contents-style academic chapter titles
patterns.context: Book contents or chapter titles use Roman numerals and all-caps subject terms.

7_1913.concept: 格式与词片段特征
7_1913.description: 激活分布于邮件头、标题与目录排版、诗行缩进、专利技术词、代码及多种词内片段；有局部线索，但各段触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 邮件头与主题行
patterns.context: 电子邮件头中出现换行、收件人字段和带 Re: 的主题行；正文主题使用全大写。

patterns.name: 英文词语的切分与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 拼合的英文词、专名或屈折词尾内部；上下文主题各异，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 散文、医学论文、代码字符串等

patterns.name: 知识说明中的强调词
patterns.context: 介绍一条补充事实或解释，使用“worth knowing”“while”等说明性表达。

patterns.name: 诗歌行首缩进与抒情词汇
patterns.context: 诗行带有明显空格缩进，伴随对母亲、信仰或逝者的抒情表达。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述中的 arm/tool
patterns.trigger: « with»3 this« arm»5、« tool»3、« plugging» tool«6
patterns.context: 长句描述工具、定位机构、基座及其连接或性能限制。

patterns.name: 树木主题与章节排版
patterns.context: 章节标题或目录式排版；标题涉及树木、植物、生育或占卜。

patterns.name: 姓名与地名的词内片段
patterns.context: 菌落鉴定方法之后括注试剂或机构所在地，激活落在法语地名及其内部片段。

patterns.name: 书名与大写标题排版
patterns.context: 书籍标题页或章节目录中，大写标题、作者信息和罗马数字章节并伴有居中空格。

patterns.name: 代码注解与界面文本
patterns.context: Java 事件处理代码中包含缩进注解及用于界面显示的剪刀选择文本。

patterns.name: 目录式学术章节标题
patterns.context: 书籍目录或章节标题，以罗马数字编号和大写主题词呈现。

en.description: Activations span multilingual, cross-domain texts, often falling on within-word subword fragments, proper nouns, and title boundaries; a few patent passages describe shortcomings in prior approaches, technical conditions, or functions. No stable semantic theme spans all examples.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual multi-token boundaries
patterns.context: In multilingual text, activation often falls on middle or final subword fragments rather than semantically salient whole words; examples include Portuguese, English, French, and proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Mixed multilingual corpora, including academic citations, patents, encyclopedias, emails, medical literature, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Negation and problem statements in English patents
patterns.context: Background sections state that existing approaches do not solve problems or lack functions or effects; activation is distributed across common function words and some content words.

patterns.name: Technical term fragments in patent descriptions
patterns.context: Local phrases in technical explanations or conditional statements activate, with no single stable terminology trigger.
patterns.domain: Inkjet printing and image-receiving material patents

patterns.name: Title text near paragraph or section boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls near titles, section names, or transition phrases in text with paragraph, list, or line-break structure.

patterns.name: Portuguese citations and place names
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence is followed by a bibliographic citation and place names; activation is mostly on internal word subwords or proper-noun fragments.

patterns.name: French word forms and diplomatic affairs texts
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in French parliamentary text, in statements about EU foreign policy actions and the presidency's agenda.

patterns.name: French bibliography and book titles
patterns.context: Activations occur in French publication lists, book titles, and publication details; the fragments do not form an obvious unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Place name of a microbial identification institution
patterns.context: In the parenthetical institutional address in a colony identification method, activation concentrates on token fragments of the French place name L'Étoile.

patterns.name: Place names in railway and market entries
patterns.context: Proper nouns and place-category words activate near encyclopedia descriptions of Bangladeshi railway passenger traffic and markets.

patterns.name: Email help section
patterns.context: A technical support section heading in an email; preceded by meeting preparation instructions and followed by troubleshooting guidance.

patterns.name: Possibly unexplained phrase-level activation
patterns.context: Although it is in patent background text, activation is scattered, so this passage alone does not identify a fixed technical or syntactic feature.
patterns.domain: Background technology in data communications patents

7_1913.concept: 跨语种子词与文本边界片段
7_1913.description: 激活跨多语种、多领域文本，常落在词内子词片段、专名及标题边界；少数专利段呈现既有方案不足、技术条件或功能描述。没有能贯穿所有例子的稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 跨语言多词元边界
patterns.context: 多语种文本中，激活常落在词的中间或末尾子词片段，而非语义上显著的完整词；出现葡萄牙语、英语、法语及专名。
patterns.domain: 多语种混合语料，包括学术引文、专利、百科、邮件、医学文献、议会文本

patterns.name: 英文专利中的否定与问题陈述
patterns.context: 背景技术段落陈述既有方案未解决问题、缺乏功能或效果；激活分布于常见功能词及部分内容词。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述中的术语片段
patterns.context: 技术说明或条件性论述中，短语局部出现激活，未见单一稳定的术语触发。
patterns.domain: 喷墨打印及图像接收材料专利

patterns.name: 段落或栏目边界附近的标题文本
patterns.context: 激活落在标题、栏目名或转折短语附近，文本带有段落、列表或换行结构。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、用户帮助邮件、专利

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语引文及地名
patterns.context: 葡语句子后接书目引用及地名；激活多在词内部子词或专名片段。

patterns.name: 法语词形与外交议题文本
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中的词内片段，出现在关于欧盟外交行动和主席国议程的语句中。

patterns.name: 法语书目与书名
patterns.context: 法语出版物列表及书名、出版信息中出现激活，词片段并不构成明显统一语义类别。

patterns.name: 微生物鉴定机构地名
patterns.context: 菌落鉴定方法的括号内机构地址中，激活集中在法语地名 L'Étoile 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 铁路与市场条目中的地名
patterns.context: 孟加拉铁路客流和市场的百科叙述中，专名和地点类别词附近有激活。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 地理/交通条目

patterns.name: 邮件帮助栏目
patterns.context: 邮件中的技术支持栏目标题；此前是会议准备说明，之后转入故障处理指引。

patterns.name: 疑似未解释的短语级激活
patterns.context: 虽属于专利背景文本，但激活位置分散，不能仅凭这段确定是某个固定技术或句式特征。
patterns.domain: 数据通信相关专利背景技术

en.description: Patterns include the contrastive “On the other hand,” limitations of existing approaches, and “provided” wording in patent backgrounds, along with isolated activations on chemical patent citations, JavaScript code, and encyclopedia numbering. Overall, the features favor local strings or formatting and cannot be summarized by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: “provided” at the end of a sentence or phrase
patterns.context: In “have not yet provided satisfactory solutions to the problem of providing …,” it appears after a present-perfect negative structure and before a noun phrase; activation centers on provided itself.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections evaluating existing approaches

patterns.name: Contrastive phrase “On the other hand”
patterns.context: Appears after a paragraph break, continuing the preceding statement and introducing a contrasting approach or limitation; activation mainly falls on hand and often also covers On the.
patterns.domain: Comparative discussion in patent background sections

patterns.name: JavaScript factory function syntax and symbol mapping
patterns.context: Code contains factory(moment)-style forms, function calls, or object-literal key-value mappings; different markers are distributed across code syntax and mapping entries.

patterns.name: Examples and conditional sentences in patent background paragraphs
patterns.context: Describes materials, formulations, or process conditions and gives patent numbers as examples; activation does not show the same fixed collocation as other passages.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections on chemical/material processes

patterns.name: Deficiencies or missing functionality in patent solutions
patterns.context: States disadvantages of applications or existing systems, especially failure to provide a capability or feedback; high activation falls on provide, not the earlier contrastive phrase.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections discussing media application systems

patterns.name: Agency names and historical events
patterns.context: An encyclopedia account of a Philippine traffic agency and executive orders during the Marcos era; activation centers on numbered markers, while nearby agency names do not show significant activation.

7_1913.concept: none
7_1913.description: 模式包括专利背景中的“On the other hand”转折、既有方案不足及“provided”表述，另有化学专利引证、JavaScript 代码和百科编号等孤立激活；整体偏向局部词串或格式，不能由单一语义概括。

patterns.name: 句末或短语尾部的 “provided”
patterns.context: “have not yet provided satisfactory solutions to the problem of providing …”中，出现在否定完成时结构之后、名词短语之前；激活集中在 provided 本身。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，评价既有方案

patterns.name: 对照转折短语 “On the other hand”
patterns.trigger: «On»4« the»4« other»3« hand»9（另见“hand”被标记为 10 或 9）
patterns.context: 位于段落换行后，承接前文陈述并引出对比方案或限制；激活主要落在 hand，通常也覆盖 On the。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的对比论述

patterns.name: JavaScript 工厂函数语法及符号映射
patterns.trigger: «factory»«(»、«global»、«.»、«moment»，以及映射对象中的 «'» 和数字 token
patterns.context: 代码中出现 factory(moment) 形式、函数调用或对象字面量键值映射；不同标记分散在代码语法和映射项上。

patterns.name: 专利背景段落的例证与条件句
patterns.trigger: « employed»、«see»、«Japanese Patent» 等引述专利文献的词串
patterns.context: 描述材料、配方或工艺条件，并用专利编号举例；激活未呈现与其他段相同的固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，化学/材料工艺

patterns.name: 专利方案的不足或缺少功能
patterns.trigger: « not»6« provide»9；« huge»2« initial start-up»« costs»4；« intelligent»3« feedback»7
patterns.context: 陈述应用或既有系统的缺点，尤其是不提供某种能力或反馈；此处高激活落在 provide，而非前述转折短语。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，媒体应用系统评述

patterns.name: 行政机构名称及历史事件叙述
patterns.trigger: « No»2«.»9（行政命令编号的一部分）
patterns.context: 菲律宾交通管理机构与马科斯时期行政命令的百科叙述；激活集中在编号标记，周围机构名称未显著激活。

en.concept: Evaluative statements in technical and legal texts
en.description: Activations occur in patent background statements denying the adequacy of existing technologies or solutions, math differentiation problems, and legal passages about license compensation, land grants, bankruptcy claims, and evidence of damages; there is no single shared specific trigger word.

patterns.name: Provision/solution statements in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Commonly found when explaining that existing methods or technologies have failed to provide satisfactory solutions; also includes “has not provided for inclusion”.

patterns.name: Negative descriptions of prior art in patents
patterns.context: Reviews prior art and points out that it does not teach a technical feature, often followed by the patent term inter alia.

patterns.name: Derivatives and variable exponents in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a polynomial, with coefficients, exponents, and a wrt variable; also occurs in mixed math problem contexts.

patterns.name: License revocation and compensation in legal texts
patterns.context: Discusses whether a government-granted license or entitlement constitutes a protected interest, and whether compensation is required upon revocation.

patterns.name: Land grants and property scope
patterns.context: Describes a land grant for municipal use and the scope of its title, waterfront, or littoral rights.

patterns.name: Liens and creditor rights in bankruptcy
patterns.context: Explains that property may be subject to execution and sale before bankruptcy, and the succession of creditor rights under bankruptcy provisions.

patterns.name: Insufficient evidence of damages
patterns.context: The court finds insufficient evidence to establish the amount of damages and rules on the litigation accordingly.

7_1913.concept: 技术与法律文本中的判断性表述
7_1913.description: 激活分布于专利背景中对既有技术或方案不足的否定表述、数学求导题，以及法律文本中的许可补偿、土地授予、破产债权和损害证据等句段；没有单一共享的具体触发词。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的提供/解决表述
patterns.context: 常见于说明现有方法或技术未能提供满意方案；也出现 “has not provided for inclusion”。

patterns.name: 专利现有技术的否定描述
patterns.context: 回顾先前技术并指出其未教导某项技术特征，常接专利术语 inter alia。

patterns.name: 数学题中的导数与变量幂次
patterns.context: 要求对多项式求三阶导数，出现系数、幂次和 wrt 变量；也见于混合数学题目上下文。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的许可撤回与补偿
patterns.context: 讨论政府授予的许可或权益是否构成受保护利益，以及撤回时是否须补偿。

patterns.name: 土地授予及产权范围
patterns.context: 描述市政用途的土地授予及其产权、滨水或沿岸权益范围。

patterns.name: 破产中的留置权与债权人权利
patterns.trigger: “prior to bankruptcy”“lien”“rights, remedies, and powers of a creditor”
patterns.context: 说明破产前财产可能被执行出售，以及破产条款下债权人权利的承继。

patterns.name: 损害赔偿证据不足
patterns.context: 法院认为缺乏足以证明损害金额的证据，并据此处理诉讼。

en.description: Primarily activates on prompts asking for the third derivative of a polynomial and on sequences of variable-power terms, coefficients, and operators; a few answer outputs also appear. Patent application boilerplate is an isolated exception.

patterns.name: Prompt for the third derivative of a polynomial
patterns.context: A prompt is followed by a polynomial and asks for its third derivative with respect to a variable; the variable is often specified using “wrt …”.

patterns.name: Polynomial terms and power expressions
patterns.context: Multiple coefficients, variables, and power terms appear in sequence in a polynomial from a differentiation problem; activations fall on variables, operators, exponents, and adjacent numbers.

patterns.name: Derivative answers or subsequent calculations
patterns.context: Answers or calculation outputs following differentiation problems, usually separated from the prompt by a line break.

patterns.name: U.S. patent application boilerplate
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph cites the title of an abandoned application and introduces its technical content.

7_1913.concept: 三阶多项式求导题
7_1913.description: 主要对数学题中要求求多项式三阶导数的提示语及变量—幂次项、系数和运算符序列激活，也见少量答案输出；专利申请套语是孤立异例。

patterns.name: 多项式三阶求导提示语
patterns.trigger: “Find the third derivative of” / “What is the third derivative of”
patterns.context: 提示语后接一个多项式，要求对其中变量求三阶导数；变量常由“wrt …”指定。

patterns.name: 多项式项与幂次表达式
patterns.context: 在求导题的多项式中，多个系数、变量和幂次项连续排列；激活落在变量、运算符、指数及相邻数字上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 符号化代数文本

patterns.name: 求导答案或后续计算结果
patterns.context: 求导题后续出现的答案或计算输出，通常以换行与题干分隔。

patterns.name: 美国专利申请书套语
patterns.trigger: “the subject application”、“U.S. Patent application Ser. No.”、“now abandoned”、“entitled with”
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，引用已放弃申请的名称并引出其技术内容。

en.concept: Formatting and grammatical markers in structured text
en.description: Primarily appears in procedural problems from DM Mathematics: function definitions and substitution, algebraic expressions, true/false questions, and differentiation instructions. Also appears in code whitespace formatting and WHEREAS statements in legal documents.

patterns.name: Whitespace and formatting symbols in code
patterns.context: Whitespace occurs at the beginning of JavaScript code lines or between expressions; activation is concentrated on spaces and nearby code tokens.

patterns.name: Function definition and substitution in math problems
patterns.context: In step-by-step constructed math problems, a function is defined and a variable from the previous step is used as its input, followed by additional conditions.

patterns.name: Problem and answer formatting in math problems
patterns.context: Asks whether a number is composite or poses a similar true/false question, followed immediately by a True/False answer.

patterns.name: Powers, arithmetic, and polynomials in math problems
patterns.context: Expressions consisting of variables, integers, fractions, and polynomials; especially algebraic expressions in function definitions, equation conditions, or differentiation problems.

patterns.name: Formal statements in legal texts
patterns.context: After meeting minutes, organization names, and litigation matters, uppercase WHEREAS introduces a formal statement.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Requests a specified-order derivative of an expression containing variables and powers, explicitly stating the variable with respect to which to differentiate.

7_1913.concept: 结构化文本中的格式与语法标记
7_1913.description: 主要出现在 DM Mathematics 的程序化题目中：函数定义与代入、代数表达式、真假问答及求导指令；另见代码空格格式和法律文书的 WHEREAS 陈述。

patterns.name: 代码中的空格与格式化符号
patterns.context: 空白字符出现在 JavaScript 代码行首或表达式之间；激活集中在空格及其邻近代码 token。

patterns.name: 数学题中的函数定义与代入
patterns.context: 以逐步构造的数学题为背景，定义函数并将前一步的变量作为函数输入，随后继续给出条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的题干及答案格式
patterns.context: 询问数是否为合数或类似的真假判断，问句后紧接 True/False 答案。

patterns.name: 数学题中的幂、算术与多项式
patterns.context: 变量、整数、分数及多项式构成的计算式；尤其是函数定义、方程条件或微分题中的代数表达式。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的正式陈述
patterns.context: 会议记录、机构名称及诉讼事项之后，以大写 WHEREAS 引出正式陈述。

patterns.name: 求导指令
patterns.context: 要求对含变量和幂次的表达式求指定阶数导数，并明确给出相对于哪个变量。

en.concept: Local vocabulary and symbols in math problems and legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to conversion problem prompts, unit names, decimal numbers, and arithmetic symbols in math exercises; also activates on legal interpretation, evidence, and damages wording in two court opinions. Markers span prompts, units, values, and expressions, with no single narrow trigger word.

patterns.name: Prompt words in unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Prompt words and nearby words activate in questions or commands asking for quantity conversions; units include length, time, mass, and volume

patterns.name: Unit names and their endings
patterns.context: Unit names appear in quantities to be converted or in target units; some words are marked only on an internal subword or plural ending

patterns.name: Decimals and digit strings
patterns.context: Long numbers or decimals occur as inputs or outputs in arithmetic and conversion problems; markers often fall within digit strings rather than only on the prompt

patterns.name: Multiplication signs and negative-number expressions
patterns.context: Expressions include multiplication operators, negative numbers, or products of negative numbers; activation markers cover operators, minus signs, and some values

patterns.name: Fractions and ratio expressions
patterns.context: Quantities or ratios are expressed as fractions, with a question asking for a conversion result

patterns.name: Legal interpretation and rule wording
patterns.context: Discusses principles of statutory interpretation and the idea that legal rules should conform to legislative intent; activations are scattered across legal terms and nearby words

patterns.name: Evidence, damages, and litigation wording
patterns.context: Describes plaintiffs’ damages, whether evidence is sufficient, and the court’s grounds for dismissing a lawsuit

patterns.name: Standalone multiplication wording
patterns.context: A verbal instruction for a negative-number multiplication problem; distinct from legal passages and unit-conversion problems

7_1913.concept: 数学题与法律文本中的局部词汇/符号
7_1913.description: 主要响应数学练习中的换算题干、单位名、数字小数及算术符号；另对两段判决书中的法律解释、证据和损害措辞激活。标记跨越题干、单位、数值与算式，未显示单一窄触发词。

patterns.name: 单位换算题中的题干词
patterns.context: 在以问句或命令句提出数量换算任务时，这些题干词及邻近词激活；涉及长度、时间、质量、体积等单位

patterns.name: 单位名称及其词尾
patterns.trigger: « millilitres», « hours», « milliseconds», « kilometers», « centimeters», « meter», «millimeters», «microgram», «nanograms», «nanoseconds», «months»
patterns.context: 单位名出现在待换算的量或目标单位中；部分词只标记到词内子词或复数词尾

patterns.name: 小数与数字串
patterns.context: 长数字或小数出现在算术练习及换算题的输入、输出中；标记常落在数字串内部，而非只落在题干

patterns.name: 乘法符号与负数算式
patterns.context: 算式包含乘法运算符、负数或负数相乘；激活标记覆盖运算符、负号及部分数值

patterns.name: 分数与比例表达
patterns.context: 以分数形式表达数量或比例，并询问换算结果

patterns.name: 法律解释与规则措辞
patterns.context: 讨论法规解释原则、法律规则应服从立法意图；激活散布在法律术语及附近词语

patterns.name: 证据、损害与诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: « proven», « evidence», « amount», « damage», « action», « reason», « showing»
patterns.context: 描述原告损害赔偿、证据是否充分及法院驳回诉讼的理由

patterns.name: 单独的乘法表述
patterns.context: 负数乘法题的文字运算指令；与法律段落及单位换算题不同

tokens:
What

 product

en.description: Activation spans several local structures: omissions and citations in legal provisions, evaluations of prior art in patent backgrounds, satisfaction surveys, literary rhetorical questions, descriptions of instrument ages in French, and numerical arithmetic. There is no unified lexical theme; the feature appears to respond to several formatted text structures.

patterns.name: Legal provisions and quotation structure
patterns.context: Introduces a statute, provision, or quotation in legal text; asterisks indicate omitted content. Often accompanied by colons, line breaks, quotation marks, and legal terminology.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions, tax law, and code citations

patterns.name: Legal citation format for cases and regulations
patterns.context: Citation formats in decisions, including case names, volume numbers, page numbers, court-report abbreviations, and years.

patterns.name: Evaluative language in patent background sections
patterns.context: Describes limitations and unresolved problems in prior art, methods, or solutions, using generalizing and evaluative phrasing common in background sections.

patterns.name: Satisfaction surveys and direct questions
patterns.context: Quotes survey questions asking respondents “How satisfied...” they are with rehabilitation, training, or information services.

patterns.name: Rhetorical questions
patterns.context: A sequence of rhetorical questions in narrative or argumentative prose discusses what a particular action or belief has achieved.

patterns.name: Descriptions of instrument age in French
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses whether to maintain a sales license for antique measuring instruments, describing the instruments as at least fifty years old and stating subsequent conditions.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, French policy texts

patterns.name: Decimal and negative-number arithmetic fragments
patterns.context: Dense sequences of negative numbers, decimals, products, equals signs, or line-separated numbers; the text consists mainly of numbers and operators.

7_1913.concept: 格式化文本结构
7_1913.description: 激活覆盖多种局部结构：法律条文省略与引证、专利背景技术评价、满意度问卷、文学反问、法语仪器年代描述及数字算术。没有统一的词义主题，较像对若干格式化文本结构的响应。

patterns.name: 法律条文与引文结构
patterns.context: 法律文本中引出法规、条文或引用内容，星号表示省略内容；常伴随冒号、换行、引号及法律术语。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、税法及法典引文

patterns.name: 法规判例引证格式
patterns.context: 判决中出现案件名称、卷号、页码、法院报告缩写及年份等引证格式。

patterns.name: 专利背景技术的评价表述
patterns.trigger: « Such»3« known»3« method»5；« The»1 majority« of»1 ...« conventional»1« arts»9；« All»5 the ...« methods»3 ...« not»7 yet ...« satisfactory»3« solutions»3
patterns.context: 描述现有技术、方法或方案的局限与未解决问题，使用背景技术常见的概括和评价句式。

patterns.name: 满意度问卷及直接提问
patterns.trigger: « questions»5«:»2« "»4«How»4 satisfied ...« with»2 ...« rehabilitation»3 ...« hospital»3；« stroke»4« information»6 ...« provided»9?
patterns.context: 引用问卷题目，以“How satisfied...”询问受访者对康复、训练或信息服务的满意度。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、患者体验调查

patterns.name: 反问式修辞提问
patterns.trigger: «What»2«,»5« then»7«,»9 ...« do»2 they ...« think»2 ...« gained»7«?»2« Why»6
patterns.context: 叙述或论说文字中连续提出反问，讨论某种行为或信念获得了什么。

patterns.name: 法语仪器年代描述
patterns.trigger: «il»3« faut»2 ...« instruments»2 ...« ay»3«ant»4 ...« moins»10 cin«qu»5ante« ans»4« et»2 ét«ant»8
patterns.context: 法语句子谈及是否维持古董测量仪器的销售许可，并以至少五十年及后续条件描述仪器。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、法语政策文本

patterns.name: 小数与负数算术片段
patterns.context: 密集的负数、小数、乘积、等号或换行数字序列；文本主要由数字和运算符构成。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of formatted text: math problems dense with numbers and symbols, all-caps and split-layout table-of-contents entries, French word fragments, and patent terms/numbers and news bylines/dates. There is no stable cross-domain meaning or single grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Formatted content dense with numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers are laid out as problems, tables, or records, often interspersed with punctuation and line breaks; they need not have a particular mathematical meaning.

patterns.name: All-caps formatting in English bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Contents or bibliographies present titles and categories in uppercase letters, spaced and aligned.

patterns.name: All-caps formatting in place-name indexes
patterns.context: Place names appear as table-of-contents entries, spaced and aligned; fragments within uppercase words also activate.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg place-name index or table of contents

patterns.name: Word-final and internal fragments in French
patterns.context: Fragments are embedded in ordinary French sentences, including word interiors and endings, with no single consistent meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: French learner narratives and question forms
patterns.context: Discusses classroom learning and real-world contexts, with examples of French question forms; activations fall on French word fragments and apostrophes.

patterns.name: Technical terms and patent numbers in English patents
patterns.context: Patent descriptions or citation paragraphs contain technical descriptions, material terms, and numbered sections; activations are distributed across multiple words and number fragments.

patterns.name: English news bylines and date fragments
patterns.context: Names, weekdays, and dates appear in compact newswire format; the same passage also contains ordinary English narrative.

patterns.name: Unconsolidated math symbols and equation fragments
patterns.context: Equations, variables, and natural-language instructions are mixed in math problems; this partly resembles the number-formatting pattern, but activation locations are not consistent enough.

7_1913.concept: 格式化文本中的异质片段
7_1913.description: 激活分布在多种格式化文本中：数字与符号密集的数学题、全大写且拆分排版的目录条目、法语词片段，以及专利术语/编号和新闻署名日期。没有跨领域稳定的词义或单一语法触发器。

patterns.name: 数字与标点密集的格式化内容
patterns.context: 数字被排成题目、表格或记录，常与标点和换行交错；不要求数字具有特定数学含义。
patterns.domain: 数学练习或结构化文本

patterns.name: 英文书目标题的全大写排版
patterns.trigger: 全大写标题中被拆开的词，如 «B»«OO»«KS»、«CLASS»«ICAL»« L»ITER«ATURE»
patterns.context: 目录或书目以大写字母、空格和对齐排版呈现标题与类别。

patterns.name: 地名索引式全大写排版
patterns.trigger: 被拆分的大写地名，如 «QUE»«B»«EC»、«SP»«AN»«ISH»« P»«EN»«INS»«UL»«A»
patterns.context: 地名作为目录条目排列，并以空格对齐；大写词内部的片段也有激活。

patterns.name: 法语中的词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在正常法语句子中，涵盖词内部和词尾，未见单一稳定词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 法语学习者叙述与疑问形式
patterns.context: 谈论课堂学习与真实语境，并举法语疑问形式；激活落在法语词片段和撇号等处。

patterns.name: 英语专利中的技术词与专利编号
patterns.context: 专利说明或引证段落中出现技术描述、材料术语和分段编号；激活分布在多个词及编号片段。

patterns.name: 英语新闻署名与日期片段
patterns.context: 人物署名、星期和日期以紧凑的新闻稿格式出现；同段还含普通英文叙述。

patterns.name: 未能归并的数学符号与方程片段
patterns.context: 数学题中方程、变量和自然语言指令混排；与数字排版模式部分相似，但激活落点不够一致。

en.description: Activation fragments span math problems, legal and patent texts, French dialogue, and Portuguese parliamentary speeches. Each type of passage has clear lexical or formatting cues, but no unified semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Number sequences and answers in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises or problems often contain line-separated number sequences, multiplication expressions, or prime factorization; activation sometimes falls on number fragments, operators, or problem wording

patterns.name: Statutory provisions and legal case texts
patterns.context: Formal legal language in statutes or case-law discussions; passages often contain asterisk placeholders or quotations

patterns.name: Prior-art descriptions in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: The background section of a patent specification describes existing technology and what it teaches or does not disclose

patterns.name: Quotations and accented word forms in French
patterns.context: French dialogue or quotations containing diacritics, hyphens, and French word forms

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary forms of address and speeches
patterns.context: Formal forms of address and speech openings in parliamentary speeches, with Portuguese diacritics

7_1913.concept: none
7_1913.description: 激活片段横跨数学题、法律与专利文本、法语对话和葡萄牙语议会发言；各类段落内部有明显词形或格式线索，但看不出统一的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字序列与答案
patterns.trigger: 数字串、负号和小数，如“03 times 2 -247152”“What is the next term”“Calculate”“List the prime factors”
patterns.context: 在数学练习或题目中，常见换行分隔的数列、乘法表达式或质因数分解；触发有时落在数字片段、运算符或题目用语上

patterns.name: 法条及法律判例文本
patterns.trigger: “shall cause”“substantial risk”“knowingly”“master's business”“Taxation is the rule”
patterns.context: 法律条文或判例论述中的正式法律措辞，段落常含星号占位符或引文

patterns.name: 专利背景中的现有技术表述
patterns.context: 专利说明书背景部分，描述既有技术及其教导或未披露的内容

patterns.name: 法语中的引语与重音词形
patterns.context: 法语对话或引语中出现重音符号、连字符及法语词形

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会称谓与发言
patterns.context: 议会发言的正式称呼和演讲开场，带有葡萄牙语变音符号

tokens:
Calculate




 times


What
 is
 the
 product
 of

en.concept: Numerical and formatting patterns in math problems, with sporadic lexical triggers
en.description: Activations are most concentrated on numbers, punctuation, and prime-factor questions and answers in DM math exercises; they also occur on primality judgments, other math problems, then in fiction, rule/not in expository text, and the word-initial fragment in historical entries.

patterns.name: Prime-factorization questions
patterns.context: Math problems ask for the prime factors of an integer or expression; activations may fall on the prompt, number, answer list, and adjacent separators.

patterns.name: Prime or composite judgments
patterns.context: Asks whether a given number is prime or composite, beginning with Is, followed by a True/False answer.

patterns.name: Numbers, expressions, and problem boundaries in math questions
patterns.context: Math problems and answers appear consecutively, with activations across numbers, arithmetic expressions, question words, and problem separators; some problems are not about prime factorization.

patterns.name: then in mystery narrative
patterns.context: In the narrative “never knew until then what…,” activation on then is noticeably stronger than on surrounding words.

patterns.name: Emphasis on rules and causality
patterns.context: When discussing immigration or settlement rules and their outcomes, rule and the emphatic negation not activate.

patterns.name: Name fragments in historical entries
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment Abb is highlighted in chronicle entries containing people, titles, and years.

7_1913.concept: 数学题数值与格式模式（兼有零散词汇触发）
7_1913.description: 激活以DM数学练习中的数值、标点和质因数相关问答最集中；另见质数判断、其他数学题，以及小说 then、论述 rule/not 和历史条目词首片段。

patterns.name: 质因数分解提问
patterns.trigger: “prime factors”及其附近的数值与标点
patterns.context: 出现要求列出某整数或表达式的质因数的数学题；激活可落在题干、数字、答案列表及相邻分隔符上。

patterns.name: 质数或合数判断
patterns.context: 以 Is 开头询问给定数字是否为质数或合数，随后出现 True/False 答案。

patterns.name: 数学题中数值、运算式与题目边界
patterns.context: 数学题目与答案连续排列，激活分布于数值、运算表达式、问句词和题目分隔处；有些题并非质因数分解。

patterns.name: 悬疑叙事中的 then
patterns.context: “never knew until then what…”的叙述中，then 的激活明显强于周围词。

patterns.name: 规则与因果强调
patterns.context: 谈论移民或定居规则及其成果时，rule 与强调否定的 not 激活。

patterns.name: 历史条目中的名称片段
patterns.context: 编年史人物、头衔与年份的条目中，词首片段 Abb 被突出激活。

en.concept: Numbers and proper names/terms in text fragments
en.description: Activation occurs most consistently in math problems about the prime factorization of large integers and prime/composite classification with Boolean answers. It also appears in two types of patent descriptions, Swedish parliamentary speeches, religious discussion of settlement, and campaign-catalog headings, spanning a wide range of semantics.

patterns.name: Prime factorization Q&A for large numbers
patterns.context: Requests the prime factors of an integer, followed by a numerical factorization result; the numbers themselves also often activate.

patterns.name: Prime/composite classification Q&A
patterns.context: Repeated alternation between questions asking whether large integers are prime or composite and Boolean answers.

patterns.name: Fluid passages and citations in patent texts
patterns.context: Patent background sections describe passages and fluid flow, and give European patent applications as examples.

patterns.name: Compounds and citations in patent texts
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds describe compound structures and related European patent documents.

patterns.name: Swedish political/economic text and speaker attribution
patterns.context: Swedish European Parliament text discusses competition and openness in the food industry within the internal market, followed by a speaker's name and country marker.

patterns.name: Advice on clergy settling alongside migrants
patterns.context: Argues that migrants should settle with pastors and churches accompanying them, and presents this as a reason for success.

patterns.name: Campaign-catalog-style headings
patterns.context: An uppercase heading lists a campaign name, year, and page number, followed by another heading.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg table of contents or index

7_1913.concept: 文本片段中的数字与专名/术语
7_1913.description: 激活最稳定地出现在数学中关于大整数的质因数分解、质数/合数判断及布尔答案；另见两类专利描述、瑞典语议会发言、宗教定居论述和战役目录标题，语义跨度较大。

patterns.name: 大数质因数分解问答
patterns.trigger: “What are the prime factors of”“List the prime factors of”，以及逗号分隔的数字答案
patterns.context: 要求列出整数的质因数，后接数值分解结果；数字本身也常有激活。

patterns.name: 质数/合数判断问答
patterns.trigger: “Is [大整数] a prime number?”、“Is [大整数] composite?”及紧随的“True”或“False”
patterns.context: 反复交替出现关于大整数是否为质数或合数的判断题和布尔答案。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的流体通道与引用
patterns.trigger: “channeling type”“fluid or fluid mixture”“passing therethrough”，以及“EP-A-12…”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中描述通道、流体通过，并举欧洲专利申请为例。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的化合物与引用
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述化合物结构及相关欧洲专利文献。

patterns.name: 瑞典语政治/经济文本与署名
patterns.context: 瑞典语欧洲议会文本谈及内部市场食品行业的竞争与开放，随后出现发言者姓名及国别标记。

patterns.name: 宗教人员随移民定居的劝告
patterns.trigger: “resident priest and church should go in with our first settlers”“this good rule”
patterns.context: 论述移民定居时应让牧师和教会同行，并将此视为成功的原因。

patterns.name: 战役目录式标题
patterns.trigger: “THE LINES OF BATTLE AT WATERLOO”“THE LINES OF BATTLE AT TEL EL KEBIR”
patterns.context: 以大写标题列出战役名称、年份和页码，后接另一标题。

en.description: Primarily responds to wording in integer prime-factorization and prime/composite judgment problems, especially “prime factors,” “prime number,” and “composite number”; it also appears in True/False answers to these tasks and in algebra problems asking for the prime factors of a variable.

patterns.name: Prime-factorization questions
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of a given integer; adjacent questions and answers often appear consecutively, and integers may be split across tokens.

patterns.name: Primality judgment questions
patterns.context: Asks whether an integer is prime or composite, usually followed by True/False; numbers are often multi-digit and split across tokens.

patterns.name: Boolean answer markers
patterns.context: Appears as a short answer to prime/composite judgment problems; answers may also remain before a question.

patterns.name: Prime-factor tasks embedded in algebra problems
patterns.context: An equation or algebraic condition is given first, followed by a request to list the prime factors of the resulting variable; activated fragments include residual content between problems.
patterns.domain: Mixed algebra word problems and arithmetic

7_1913.concept: 整数质性与质因数任务
7_1913.description: 主要响应整数质因数分解与质数/合数判断题中的相关措辞，尤其是“prime factors”“prime number”“composite number”；也出现在这些任务的 True/False 答案及代数题中的变量质因数问题。

patterns.name: 质因数分解提问
patterns.context: 要求列出给定整数的质因数；相邻题目与答案常连续出现，整数有时跨 token 分段。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 问答式算术题

patterns.name: 质数判断提问
patterns.trigger: “Is” + 数字 + “prime number?”，或数字 + “a composite number?”
patterns.context: 询问整数是质数还是合数，通常后接 True/False；数字常为多位数并跨 token 分段。

patterns.name: 答案布尔标记
patterns.context: 作为质数或合数判断题的简短答案出现；也有题目前残留的答案。

patterns.name: 质因数任务嵌在代数题中
patterns.trigger: “List the prime factors of y”及“the prime factors of f”
patterns.context: 先给出方程或代数条件，再要求对求得的变量列质因数；激活片段含有题目间的残余内容。
patterns.domain: 代数文字题与算术混合

en.description: Primarily responds to line breaks between questions and answers in math Q&A, as well as fixed phrasing and answer lines in prime-factor questions. It also responds to line breaks in prime-classification sequences and to not in a passage of prose.

patterns.name: Punctuation and line breaks in prime-classification Q&A
patterns.context: In DM Mathematics-style sequences of prime-classification questions, line breaks separate questions, answers, and subsequent questions; local activation falls mainly on line-break tokens.

patterns.name: The negation “not” in narrative text
patterns.context: In continuous narrative prose, not occurs in the negation/emphasis structure “not alone our success”.

patterns.name: Prime-factor prompts listing integers
patterns.context: Math problems ask for the prime factors of a given integer or expression, commonly in the format “List the prime factors of …” or “What are the prime factors of …”, followed by an answer and the next problem.

patterns.name: Answer lines between questions
patterns.context: After a prime-factor or related arithmetic problem, a numerical answer appears on its own line, often followed by a new problem beginning with “Let”, “Suppose”, or “What”.

7_1913.concept: 数学问答的题目—答案边界
7_1913.description: 主要响应数学问答中题目、答案之间的换行，以及素因子题的固定措辞和答案行；另在素数判断序列中响应换行，并在一段散文里响应 not。

patterns.name: 素数判断问答中的标点与换行
patterns.context: DM Mathematics 式的素数判断题序列中，换行分隔问题、答案及后续问题；局部激活主要落在换行 token 上。

patterns.name: 叙述文本中的否定词 not
patterns.context: 连续散文叙述中，not 出现在「not alone our success」这一否定／强调结构里。

patterns.name: 列举整数的素因子题型
patterns.context: 数学题要求给定整数或表达式的素因子，常见格式为「List the prime factors of …」或「What are the prime factors of …」，题目后接答案和下一题。

patterns.name: 题目间隔中的答案行
patterns.context: 素因子题或相关算术题之后，以独立一行给出数值答案，随后常由「Let」「Suppose」或「What」开启下一题。

en.description: Primarily responds to the labels “prime number” and “composite number” and question templates in prime/composite classification tasks. It also responds to prime-factor questions and questions asking whether variables in algebra problems are prime; one example activates on “Jerusalem” in a biblical narrative.

patterns.name: prime in prime-number classification Q&A
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word in the classification target phrase, regardless of whether the sample’s classification is correct; often appears in batches with numbers, the contrasting term composite, and True/False Q&A.
patterns.domain: Synthetic prime-number classification Q&A in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: composite classification label
patterns.context: Paired with prime to determine whether an integer is composite. The question may include “a” or omit it, followed by a question mark and True/False.
patterns.domain: Synthetic prime-number classification Q&A in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: prime factors questions
patterns.context: Requests the prime factors of a given integer. Activation is concentrated on “factors,” rather than being limited to the prime-number classification format.

patterns.name: prime queries in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: An equation or algebraic expression is given first, followed by a question asking whether a variable is prime; this is not a fixed prime-number label template.

patterns.name: Jerusalem in a biblical narrative
patterns.context: Appears in the account in Luke 19, near Jesus, Bethphage, and Mount of Olives; has no clear connection to the mathematical prime-number pattern.

7_1913.concept: 质数相关词与判定任务
7_1913.description: 主要响应质数/合数分类任务中的“prime number”“composite number”标签及问答模板，也响应素因数提问和代数题里的变量质数询问；另有一例对圣经叙事中的“Jerusalem”激活。

patterns.name: 素数判定问答中的 prime
patterns.trigger: “prime number”中的“number”，以及“prime”后接“?”；常见上下文为“Is [数] a prime number?”，随后换行给 True/False
patterns.context: 激活落在分类目标短语的词上，不论样例中的判定结果正确与否；常与数字、composite 对照项及 True/False 问答成批出现
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的合成式素数分类问答

patterns.name: composite 分类标签
patterns.trigger: “composite number”中的“number”，以及“composite”后接“?”；另有标签位置的“composite”
patterns.context: 与 prime 成对用于判断整数是否合数，问题可带“a”，也可省略；后接问号和 True/False
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的合成式素数分类问答

patterns.name: prime factors 提问
patterns.context: 要求列出给定整数的素因数，激活集中在“factors”，而非仅限 prime number 判定格式
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的因数分解题

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的质数询问
patterns.context: 先给方程或代数表达式，再询问变量是否为质数；并非固定的 prime number 标签模板

patterns.name: 圣经叙事中的 Jerusalem
patterns.context: 出现在 Luke 19 的经文叙述中，附近有 Jesus、Bethphage、Mount of Olives；与数学质数模式无明显关联

en.description: Primarily responds to grouped templates for prime/composite classification questions and their Boolean answers; it also responds clearly to prime-factor questions and digit-place questions. The shared context is the repeated, concise math Q&A format of DM Mathematics.

patterns.name: Classification labels in prime-number questions
patterns.context: A sequence of “Is [integer] a prime/composite number?” classification questions and their Boolean answers; activation is distributed across the question template, number fragments, and nearby answers. Answers are sometimes inconsistent with mathematical facts

patterns.name: Prime-factorization questions
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of an integer, followed by a comma-separated factorization or an answer to be continued

patterns.name: Digit-place questions
patterns.context: Asks for the digit at a particular place in an integer; place names include «thousands», «units», «hundred millions», «millions», «ten thousands», «ten millions», «hundreds», «tens», followed by a numerical answer

7_1913.concept: 数学问答模板
7_1913.description: 主要响应成组出现的素数/合数判断题模板及其布尔答案；另对质因数问句和按位取数字问句也有明显响应。共同背景是DM Mathematics中重复、简短的数学问答格式。

patterns.name: 素数判断题中的分类标签
patterns.trigger: «prime»、«composite»、« number»、«?»以及答案 «True»/«False»；也包括题干中的 «Is»
patterns.context: 连续生成“Is [整数] a prime/composite number?”式判断题及其布尔答案；激活分布在题目模板、数词片段和答案附近，答案有时与数学事实并不一致

patterns.name: 质因数分解问句
patterns.context: 询问某整数的质因数，后接逗号分隔的分解结果或待续答案

patterns.name: 按位取数字问句
patterns.context: 询问整数某一位上的数字；位名包括 «thousands»、«units»、«hundred millions»、«millions»、«ten thousands»、«ten millions»、«hundreds»、«tens»，后接数字答案

en.description: Activation is distributed across four text types: Tennessee appellate decision headings, prime/composite judgment questions and true/false answers, integer digit-extraction Q&A, and patent background descriptions of track and roadway resurfacing. Though the latter two types of math problems both belong to Q&A corpora, their specific trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: U.S. Tennessee criminal appellate decision format
patterns.context: Heading or caption information in a court decision or appellate opinion, including the county, judge, case number, and date. The first paragraph also has a similar appellate court caption format.

patterns.name: Prime/composite true-or-false Q&A
patterns.context: A sequence of questions asks whether large integers are prime or composite, with Boolean-style answers.

patterns.name: Digit-extraction Q&A
patterns.context: Asks for the digit at a specified place in a given integer, followed by a brief numerical answer.

patterns.name: Description of track and roadway resurfacing
patterns.context: Patent background description of known methods and the roadway between adjacent tracks that has not been resurfaced.

7_1913.concept: 多种结构化文本格式
7_1913.description: 激活分布在四类文本：田纳西州上诉判决案头格式、质数／合数判断题及真假答案、整数数位提取问答，以及描述轨道与路面翻新的专利背景。后两类数学题虽同属问答语料，具体触发形式不同。

patterns.name: 美国田纳西州刑事上诉判决格式
patterns.trigger: “Appeal from the Criminal Court for … County”“Judge”“No.”及案件编号中的“CCA”“Filed”
patterns.context: 法院判决或上诉意见的标题／案头信息，包含县名、法官、案号和日期；第1段也是相近的上诉法院案头格式。

patterns.name: 真假质数／合数问答
patterns.trigger: “Is … a prime number?”、“Is … composite?”以及后续“True”或“False”
patterns.context: 连续提出关于大整数是否为质数或合数的判断题，并给出布尔式答案。

patterns.name: 数位提取问答
patterns.trigger: “What is the … digit of …?”，如“thousands digit”“ten thousands digit”“units digit”
patterns.context: 询问给定整数某个数位上的数字，随后给出简短数值答案。

patterns.name: 道路轨道翻新描述
patterns.trigger: “actual tracks are refilled”“roadway strip lying between two neighbouring tracks”“is not renewed”
patterns.context: 对已知方法及其未翻新相邻轨道间路面的专利背景描述。

en.concept: Structural cue words in texts from multiple domains
en.description: Covers math Q&A, patent backgrounds, popular-science narrative, and biomedical papers. Question words and number-theory questions recur in the math problems; patent passages activate technical terms and legal citation formulas. The remaining activations are triggered by a single narrative passage or literature citation, with no clear shared lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Selective question words in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in line-by-line arithmetic or number-theory Q&A, often asking about prime factors, primes/composites, or digits; activation also covers numbers and answers in some problems.
patterns.domain: Synthetic math Q&A in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Technical terms and citation formats in patent text
patterns.context: Patent background or technical descriptions involving device structure, patent publication numbers, or standard legal phrasing for incorporating public disclosures into an application.

patterns.name: Proper noun emphasized in a narrative
patterns.context: Popular-science narrative reviewing facts discovered after Darwin; activation is concentrated on “time” at the end of the phrase.

patterns.name: Literature citation marker after biomedical terms
patterns.context: Parenthetical, citation-like markers appear in biomedical discussion of proteins and the nucleolus; proposed also activates in the passage.

7_1913.concept: 多领域文本中的结构性提示词
7_1913.description: 覆盖数学问答、专利背景、通俗科学叙述和生物医学论文。数学题中疑问词及数论问法反复出现；专利段落激活技术术语和法律引文套语。其余为单段的叙述或文献引文触发，未见共同的明确词法模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的选择性提问词
patterns.trigger: «What»、«Is»、«List»；尤以 «What are the prime factors»、«Is ... a composite number?» 为代表
patterns.context: 出现在逐行排列的算术或数论问答中，问题常询问素因数、质数/合数，或数字位；激活还覆盖部分题目里的数字和答案
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 合成数学问答

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术术语及引用格式
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术描述中，涉及装置结构、专利文献编号，或将公开资料并入申请的固定法律表述

patterns.name: 叙述中强调的专有名词
patterns.context: 通俗科学叙述回顾达尔文之后发现的事实；激活集中在短语末尾的 time

patterns.name: 生物医学名词后的文献引文标记
patterns.context: 蛋白质与核仁相关的生物医学论述中，括号内出现类似文献引用的标记；该段另有 proposed 激活
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Most fragments come from patent backgrounds, including prior solutions, technical effects or conditions, and DE/JP patent numbers; it also activates on which clauses and present perfect expressions. Other examples include prime-factor Q&A and exposition about Darwin and human origins.

patterns.name: Technical solutions and citations in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Introduces existing technology, embodiments, or technical effects, often ending with a patent number and followed by a new paragraph or “...discloses”

patterns.name: Effects, problems, and conditional clauses in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Explains the functions, effects, operating conditions, or reaction conditions of technical measures; some fragments are embedded in long sentences after commas or conjunctions

patterns.name: Patent numbers and segmented digit strings
patterns.context: Identifiers in patent citations, composed of letters, hyphens, and segmented digits, often surrounded by parentheses or periods

patterns.name: “which” relative clauses and technical descriptions
patterns.context: Uses which to introduce supplementary or restrictive information describing a component, structure, use, or prior solution

patterns.name: “has been” and present perfect narration
patterns.context: Uses the present perfect to summarize previously described, studied, or considered solutions; not limited to patent text
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions and general expository prose

patterns.name: Prime-factor questions in math Q&A
patterns.context: Repeated short Q&A format: the question is followed by an integer and then a comma-separated list of factors

patterns.name: Exposition about Darwin and human origins
patterns.context: Summarizes human origins, facts discovered since Darwin, and evidence; not patent text

7_1913.concept: 技术与文献说明语境
7_1913.description: 多数片段属于专利背景，包含既有方案、技术效果或条件及DE/JP专利编号；也触发which从句、完成时表达。另有素因数问答和达尔文、人类起源说明文。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术方案与引证
patterns.context: 介绍已有技术、实施方式或技术效果，常在句末给出专利号，后接新段或“...discloses”

patterns.name: 专利背景中的效果、问题与条件句
patterns.trigger: “prevent material falling through”“keep the amount of material wear”“in the event of sudden deceleration”“upon heating in the presence of”
patterns.context: 说明技术措施的功能、效果、工况或反应条件；有些片段以逗号或连接词嵌入长句

patterns.name: 专利号及其分段数字串
patterns.context: 专利引用中由字母、连字符及被切分的数字构成的编号，编号周围常有括号或句点

patterns.name: “which”关系从句与技术描述
patterns.trigger: “which mass has catches”“in which a conventional automatic transmission is utilized”“in a vibration damping manner, which has been considered”
patterns.context: 以 which 引出补充或限定说明，描述部件、结构、用途或此前方案

patterns.name: “has been”及完成时叙述
patterns.trigger: “has been described”“has been made”“has been considered”
patterns.context: 以完成时概述既有描述、研究或考虑过的方案；不局限于专利文本
patterns.domain: 技术说明及一般说明文

patterns.name: 数学问答中的素因数题目
patterns.context: 重复出现的短问答格式，问题后接整数，随后列出逗号分隔的因数

patterns.name: 达尔文与人类起源的说明文
patterns.context: 概述人类起源、达尔文之后发现的事实及证据；不是专利文本

en.description: Primarily responds to sentences in patent backgrounds describing technical objects, functions, or existing approaches, often with patent-number citations; it also activates on math digit Q&A and prime/composite judgment Q&A.

patterns.name: Functions and technical descriptions in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background passages introducing equipment, methods, materials, or control schemes, often accompanied by references to prior art and patent numbers.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, involving machinery, automotive, textiles, pumps, food inspection, chemistry, and locks

patterns.name: Patent publication number formats
patterns.context: Cites Japanese, German, European, and other patent documents in patent backgrounds or technical descriptions; number punctuation and letter combinations vary.

patterns.name: Digit-place Q&A
patterns.context: A natural-language question asks about a specified place in an integer, followed on a new line by a numerical answer.

patterns.name: Prime/composite judgment Q&A
