patterns.context: Asks whether a given integer is prime or composite, followed on a new line by a Boolean-style answer.

7_1913.concept: 技术说明与结构化问答
7_1913.description: 主要响应专利背景中描述技术对象、功能或现有方案的语句，常伴专利编号引用；另对数学数位问答及素数/合数判断问答也有激活。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的功能与技术描述
patterns.trigger: “vibration damping”“driving apparatus”“spinning apparatus”“pump”“cylinder-specific lambda control”“Michael adduct”“key for the locking arrangement”等
patterns.context: 专利背景技术叙述中，介绍设备、方法、材料或控制方案，常伴随现有技术文献及专利号引用。
patterns.domain: USPTO专利背景，涉及机械、汽车、纺织、泵、食品检测、化学及锁具等

patterns.name: 专利文献编号格式
patterns.trigger: “Japanese Patent Publication No. JP-A-11-231291”“Japanese Patent Application No. JP-A-2004-41708”“DE No. 3,209,763 Al”“EP 0,501,682 A”等
patterns.context: 在专利背景或技术说明中引用日本、德国、欧洲等专利文献；编号标点和字母组合形式多样。

patterns.name: 数字位值问答
patterns.trigger: “What is the thousands digit of 2890439?”“What is the units digit of 34819357?”“What is the hundred millions digit of 1641702043?”
patterns.context: 以自然语言提问指定整数的某一数位，并在换行后给出数字答案。

patterns.name: 素数与合数判断问答
patterns.context: 判断给定整数是否为素数或合数，随后换行输出布尔式答案。

en.concept: Patent numbers and heterogeneous text fragments
en.description: The strongest shared pattern is German patent numbers prefixed by DE in patent backgrounds, including their alphanumeric boundaries. Other sporadic activations include math digit Q&A, discussion of Darwin and human origins, Latvian legal citations, and Romanian parliamentary remarks.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in patent numbers
patterns.context: German patent numbers are cited or introduced in patent background paragraphs; active fragments cluster around DE, number characters, and their punctuation boundaries.

patterns.name: Digit-place terms in math Q&A
patterns.context: Asks for a particular digit in a given integer, with a numerical answer on the next line.

patterns.name: Origins and discussion of Darwin
patterns.context: Popular discussion of human origins and discoveries and evidence after Darwin.

patterns.name: EU directive and regulation citations
patterns.context: A Latvian sentence mentions a European Council directive and its requirements.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary remarks
patterns.context: A Romanian parliamentary speech mentions a statement made the previous day and that it can be read on a website.

7_1913.concept: 专利编号与异质文本片段
7_1913.description: 最强的共同模式是专利背景中 DE 德国专利编号及其字母数字边界；另有数学数位问答、达尔文与人类起源论述，以及拉脱维亚语法规引用和罗马尼亚语议会发言等零散激活。

patterns.name: 专利号中的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中引用或介绍德国专利编号；活跃片段集中在 DE、编号字符及其标点边界。

patterns.name: 数学问答中的数字位数词
patterns.context: 询问给定整数的某一数位，并在换行处给出数字答案。

patterns.name: 起源与达尔文论述
patterns.context: 通俗论述人类起源及达尔文之后的发现和证据。

patterns.name: 欧盟指令及法规引用
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子提及欧盟理事会指令及其要求。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会讲话中提及前一日声明及其可在网站阅读。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in USPTO patent texts: citations to patents and numbers, summaries of disclosures, legal boilerplate, priority claims, introductions to fields of invention and technical objects, and transitions from problem to solution.

patterns.name: Patent document citations and numbers
patterns.context: Cites patents, published documents, or application numbers in patent background sections; numbers are often split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Technical disclosure verbs in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Introduces control methods, technologies, or devices disclosed in patent documents, usually adjacent to a document number.

patterns.name: Conventional prior-art phrasing in patents
patterns.context: States that cited material is incorporated into the application or describes the state of the art known before the invention date.

patterns.name: Patent application and priority boilerplate
patterns.context: States the priority claimed by an application and the corresponding application number.

patterns.name: Introduction of the invention’s subject and technical field
patterns.context: Identifies the technical field or introduces the subject matter of the invention in a patent specification.

patterns.name: Patent-style descriptions of technical objects or devices
patterns.context: Identifies devices, equipment, pumps, or other technical objects in a background or field introduction; a patent citation is not required.

patterns.name: Causal or problem-to-solution transitions
patterns.context: First presents a technical problem or need, then introduces the solution proposed by the invention.

7_1913.concept: 专利说明书惯用语
7_1913.description: 激活主要集中于USPTO专利文本：引用专利及编号、概述披露内容、法律套语、优先权声明、发明领域与技术对象引入，也包括问题—方案过渡语。

patterns.name: 专利文献引用与编号
patterns.trigger: «Patent»、«Publication»、«No»及其后的公开号，如“« JP»-«-»«A»”和“« DE»”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中引用专利、公布文本或申请号；编号常被拆分成多个 token

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术披露动词
patterns.context: 介绍专利文献公开的控制方式、技术或装置，通常紧邻文献编号

patterns.name: 专利惯用的现有技术表述
patterns.trigger: « incorporated» « by» « reference»；“« state» of the « art»”
patterns.context: 说明引用材料并入申请，或交代发明日前已知技术状态
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术法律套语

patterns.name: 专利申请及优先权套语
patterns.trigger: “This« application» « claims» … priority of … « Application» « No»”
patterns.context: 陈述申请所主张的优先权及对应的申请编号

patterns.name: 发明主题与技术领域引入
patterns.trigger: “Field of« the» « Invention»”；“« present» « invention» « relates» to”；“The« invention» also« relates»”
patterns.context: 专利说明书中标示技术领域或引出发明所涉及的对象

patterns.name: 技术对象或装置的专利式描述
patterns.trigger: « device»、« apparatus»、« pump»，以及“« pertains» « to» « a»”
patterns.context: 在背景或领域介绍中点明装置、设备或泵等技术对象；不一定伴随专利引用

patterns.name: 因果或问题—方案引出语
patterns.trigger: “« There» « is» « therefore» « a» « need»”；“« To» that« end»”
patterns.context: 先提出技术问题或需求，再引出本发明拟采用的方案
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与发明概述

en.description: Primarily responds to statements about fields of invention, intended uses of topics, and technical backgrounds in patent specifications; it also covers patent application information. Another example is popular discussion of human origins and evidence since Darwin.

patterns.name: Topic introduction in patent specifications
patterns.context: In patent background or field-of-invention sections, fixed phrasing introduces the subject of the invention or a specific use; highlights often fall on invention, relates, to, and nearby content.

patterns.name: Specific objects and uses of patent topics
patterns.context: Patent text first introduces an invention, then states the device, system, or method and its specific use.

patterns.name: Technical structures or processes in patents
patterns.context: Discusses specific mechanical structures, manufacturing steps, or technical backgrounds; may not contain standard field-of-invention phrasing.

patterns.name: Bibliographic and application information in patents
patterns.context: Section headings or priority claims in patent specifications, including application numbers, dates, and other bibliographic information.

patterns.name: Origin arguments and scientific evidence summaries
patterns.context: Introduces research on human origins in an accessible style and reviews discoveries and evidence; not patent prose.

7_1913.concept: 技术说明与主题引入
7_1913.description: 主要响应专利说明书中的发明领域、主题用途及技术背景表述，也覆盖专利申请信息；另有一段关于人类起源与达尔文以来证据的通俗论述。

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的主题引入
patterns.trigger: “the present invention relates to”“The invention also relates”“Field of the Invention”
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明领域段落中，用固定句式引入发明主题或具体用途；高亮多落在 invention、relates、to 及其附近内容。

patterns.name: 专利主题的具体对象与用途
patterns.trigger: “plunger devices”“exercise apparatus”“recreational vehicles”“a key for the locking arrangement”“seismic data acquisition method”
patterns.context: 专利文本先引出发明，再陈述装置、系统或方法及其特定用途。

patterns.name: 专利中的技术结构或工艺描述
patterns.trigger: “groove”“edge of the lens”“machined”“angle of twist”“vibration damping device”
patterns.context: 讨论具体机械构造、加工步骤或技术背景；未必出现发明领域套语。

patterns.name: 专利书目与申请信息
patterns.trigger: “Related Application”“This application claims the priority of German Application No.”
patterns.context: 专利说明书的栏目标题或优先权声明，包含申请编号、日期等书目信息。

patterns.name: 起源论述与科学证据概述
patterns.trigger: “subject of man's origin”“since Darwin's time”“lines of evidence”
patterns.context: 以通俗方式介绍人类起源研究，并回顾发现与证据；不属于专利文体。

en.concept: Local boilerplate and technical narration across genres
en.description: Primarily responds to patent specification boilerplate and technical descriptions of equipment, functions, and processes. It also activates on way/as to, historical figures, copyright attribution, prime-factor Q&A, and a military history passage; no single theme fully explains it.

patterns.name: Patent background and invention-description formats
patterns.context: Boilerplate in patent texts, especially at the start of paragraphs or sections introducing the field of the invention, related applications, embodiments, and similar topics; some trigger words occur in truncated sentences.

patterns.name: Functions, structures, and processes in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Technical narration in patent specifications describing equipment, components, uses, control methods, or operating procedures; no fixed invention boilerplate is required.

patterns.name: Ordinary expressions containing way
patterns.context: way occurs with as to, expressing how to achieve a result; the passage is also a patent technical description, but the phrase itself may be an activation cue.
patterns.domain: Ordinary technical narration in patent specifications

patterns.name: French royal figures and religious education
patterns.context: Historical biographical narrative about lineage, a person’s education, and its religious nature.

patterns.name: Copyright, royalties, and attribution disputes
patterns.context: Narrative discussing whether an author received royalties and the attribution or credit assigned to a work.

patterns.name: Prime-factorization Q&A
patterns.context: First asks for the prime factors of an integer, then lists the answer; activation is also distributed near numbers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Military occupation and siege in French history
patterns.context: Describes troops occupying the outskirts, besieging a city, and events such as ransom.

7_1913.concept: 多文体局部套语与技术叙述
7_1913.description: 主要响应专利说明书的格式套语及技术性设备、功能和流程描述；另对 way/as to、人物史、版权署名、质因数问答和军事史段落有激活，无法由单一主题完全解释。

patterns.name: 专利背景与发明说明格式
patterns.trigger: “Field of the Invention”“The present invention relates to”“This application claims”“Embodiments of the inventive subject matter”
patterns.context: 在专利文本中，尤其是段落或小节开头的发明领域、相关申请、实施例等套语；部分触发词出现在截断的句子中。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述中的功能、结构与过程
patterns.trigger: “way as to prevent”“drive plates pass through”“plunger devices”“controlling access to memory space”“slide-out room roof access system”“angle of twist”“procedure has generally been followed”
patterns.context: 专利说明书中描述设备、部件、用途、控制方式或操作流程的技术性叙述；不要求出现固定的发明套语。

patterns.name: 包含 way 的普通表达
patterns.context: way 与 as to 连用，表达实现某种结果的方式；该段同时是专利技术描述，但该短语本身也可能是激活线索。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书中的普通技术叙述

patterns.name: 法国王室人物与宗教教育
patterns.context: 围绕继承关系、人物教育及其宗教性质的历史传记叙述。

patterns.name: 著作权、稿酬与署名争议
patterns.context: 讨论作者是否获得稿酬、作品署名或信用归属的叙述。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 文学或版权相关散文

patterns.name: 质因数分解问答
patterns.trigger: “List the prime factors”“What are the prime factors of”及其后的数字答案
patterns.context: 先提出求某个整数质因数的问题，再列出答案；激活也分布在数字和标点附近。

patterns.name: 法国历史上的军事占领与围城
patterns.trigger: “army occupied the suburbs”“besieged the city”“payment of a ransom”
patterns.context: 叙述军队占领城郊、围攻城市及赎金等事件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across many unrelated specialized texts: science, biography, literary discussion, history, patents, math, and EU regulations. The triggers in each passage are specific and varied, with no stable shared lexical or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Darwin’s era, origins, and evidence
patterns.context: When discussing human origins, research progress, or evidence.

patterns.name: Patent application and priority information
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs state an application’s priority, number, or related applications.

patterns.name: Biographical introduction and responsibilities
patterns.context: The author introduces a biographical overview and explains the purpose or responsibility of the writing.

patterns.name: Taste, fashion, and place
patterns.context: Evaluates the popularity of a work or object and turns to a specific place.

patterns.name: Human history and conflict
patterns.context: Moves from social order or personal protection to struggles in human history.

patterns.name: Vehicle safety devices and collisions
patterns.context: Describes mechanical structures that work together when a vehicle is subjected to force or sudden deceleration, and cites patent documents.

patterns.name: Unknown forces and transcendent beings
patterns.context: Describes a person acknowledging beings superior to themselves in knowledge, power, or lifespan.

patterns.name: Prime factors and math problems
patterns.context: Poses a prime factorization problem or a related question about an integer.

patterns.name: EU environment, health, and internal market
patterns.context: Explains how EU regulations balance environmental and human health protection with the internal market.

7_1913.concept: none
7_1913.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的专门文本：科学、传记、文学论述、历史、专利、数学及欧盟法规。各段触发内容具体且多样，未见共同的稳定词汇或语义模式。

patterns.name: Darwin时代、起源与证据
patterns.trigger: “man’s origin”“significant facts”“discovered since Darwin’s time”“lines of evidence”
patterns.context: 讨论人类起源、研究进展或证据时

patterns.name: 专利申请及优先权信息
patterns.trigger: “This application claims”“priority”“Application No.”，以及专利号和申请日期
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中陈述申请的优先权、编号或相关申请

patterns.name: 传记式生平介绍与职责
patterns.trigger: “In presenting a sketch of this life”“this life”“First, it is an act of obedience”
patterns.context: 作者引出生平概述，并说明写作目的或责任

patterns.name: 品味、时尚与地点
patterns.context: 评价作品或对象的受欢迎程度，并转向具体地点

patterns.name: 人类历史与冲突
patterns.trigger: “formation of a police force”“protection”“history of human existence”“combat”
patterns.context: 从社会秩序或个人保护引出人类历史中的斗争

patterns.name: 车辆安全装置与碰撞
patterns.context: 描述车辆受力或突然减速时协作的机械结构，并引用专利文献

patterns.name: 未知力量与超凡存在
patterns.context: 描述人物承认某些存在在知识、力量或寿命上高于自己

patterns.name: 质因数与数学题目
patterns.context: 提出整数的质因数分解或相关问题

patterns.name: 欧盟环境、健康与内部市场
patterns.trigger: “protection de l’environnement”“santé humaine”“marché intérieur”“article 95 du traité CE”
patterns.context: 说明欧盟法规兼顾环境和人类健康保护与内部市场

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal judgments and regulations, patent specifications and application numbers, literary descriptions of place, and code indentation structures. Local triggers include legal argument terms, patent formats, here/vicinity, and line breaks, indentation, and field structure; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: U.S. patent application numbers and dates
patterns.context: Fixed formats such as application serial numbers, dates, and foreign application numbers appear in patent application backgrounds or priority statements.

patterns.name: Technical subject matter and functional descriptions in patent specifications
patterns.context: Formal wording introduces the technical field, subject matter of an invention, or device components in patent backgrounds or specifications.

patterns.name: Legal argument and citations in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Describes legal standards, precedents, statutes, and judicial bodies in court decisions or legal discussion.

patterns.name: Locative here in a sentence
patterns.context: Indicates a place in narrative or description, especially in connection with a place and its surroundings.

patterns.name: Structural formatting and indentation in code
patterns.context: Near line breaks, indentation, object fields, or callback structures in JavaScript/JSON-style code.

patterns.name: Patent citation markers and number strings
patterns.context: Other patents or registered applications are cited in patent texts, with numbers, abbreviations, and dates adjacent to citation verbs.

patterns.name: Proper names of institutions or cases in legal texts
patterns.context: Names of parties, institutions, or precedents appear in the body of a judgment or in a quotation.

7_1913.concept: 正式文本中的结构标记
7_1913.description: 激活分布在法律判决与法规、专利说明书及申请编号、文学地点描写和代码缩进结构中；局部触发包括法律论证词、专利格式、here/vicinity，以及换行缩进和字段结构，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 美国专利申请编号与日期
patterns.trigger: « patent» « application» « Ser» « No»、« filed»；« application» « claims» the « priority» of German « Application» « No»
patterns.context: 专利申请书背景或优先权陈述中，出现申请序号、日期、外国申请号等固定格式

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的技术主题与功能描述
patterns.trigger: « inventive subject» « matter» « generally» « relate» to « the» « field» of « computers»；« cooling» « tunnel»
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书以正式措辞介绍技术领域、发明主题或设备部件

patterns.name: 司法意见中的法律论证与引用
patterns.trigger: « was» « pointed» « out»、« distinguished» « the» « case»；« courts» « recognized» « early»；« Practice» « Act»
patterns.context: 法院判决或法律论述中，描述法律标准、先例、法规及司法机构

patterns.name: 句中地点指示词 here
patterns.context: 叙事或描写中指示地点，尤其与地点及其周边环境相连

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性格式与缩进
patterns.context: JavaScript/JSON 风格代码中，换行、缩进、对象字段或回调结构附近

patterns.name: 专利引用标记与编号串
patterns.context: 专利文本引用其他专利或登记申请，编号、缩写和日期紧邻引用动词

patterns.name: 法律文本中的机构或案件专名
patterns.trigger: « Frank»«el» and « C»«ohn»；« Port» of « Boston» Marine « Terminal»
patterns.context: 判决正文或引文中出现案件当事人、机构或判例名称

en.description: Activation spans multiple corpora, with no single content theme. More consistent cues are English function words and syntactic connections, appearing in patent boilerplate and citations, prime-factor questions, and popular science texts. There are also sporadic word-form activations in Portuguese parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: English function words and local syntax
patterns.context: These high-frequency function words occur in syntactic linking positions in continuous English prose or questions; sometimes content words in adjacent phrases are also included
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, popular science, math problems, and English narrative

patterns.name: Patent-background boilerplate phrasing
patterns.context: Patent background sections introduce the field of an invention or a specific technical area

patterns.name: Patent document numbers and citations
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds list prior art or application information, with numbers split across multiple tokens

patterns.name: Math prime-factor question format
patterns.context: An instruction or question asks for the prime factors of an integer, often adjacent to a number and factor answer on the following line

patterns.name: General terminology in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Technical descriptions discuss structures, processes, failures, or material chemical reactions; these terms are scattered across different patent topics

patterns.name: Popular evolution narrative
patterns.context: Summarizes human origins and evidence since Darwin in an expository style for a general audience
patterns.domain: Gutenberg popular science or nonfiction texts

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary address
patterns.context: Formal speech in Portuguese expresses hope, gives thanks, and introduces a topic; word forms are split into subword fragments

7_1913.concept: 文本句法与语域线索
7_1913.description: 激活覆盖多种语料，未见单一内容主题；较一致的线索是英语功能词与句法连接，同时分别出现在专利套语及引文、质因数题、通俗科学文本中。另有葡萄牙语议会发言的零散词形激活。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与局部句法
patterns.trigger: « to»、« the»、« of»、« in»、« and»、« that»、« where»、« which»、« what»、« as»
patterns.context: 英语连续散文或问句中，这些高频功能词出现在句法连接位置；有时也包括紧邻词组中的内容词
patterns.domain: 专利背景、通俗科学、数学题及英语叙述

patterns.name: 专利背景模板措辞
patterns.trigger: «Embodiments»、«inventive subject matter»、«generally relate to»、«the field of»、«more particularly»
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍发明主题所属领域或具体技术方向

patterns.name: 专利文献编号与引用
patterns.context: 专利背景中列举现有技术或申请信息，编号被拆分为多个 token

patterns.name: 数学质因数题式
patterns.context: 以指令或问句要求求整数的质因数，常与换行后的数字及因数答案相邻

patterns.name: 专利技术叙述中的一般术语
patterns.context: 技术说明中描述结构、过程、故障或材料化学反应；这些词分散于不同专利主题

patterns.name: 进化论通俗叙述
patterns.context: 概述人类起源及达尔文之后证据，使用面向大众的说明性文风
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 通俗科学或非虚构文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会致辞
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语正式发言中表达希望、致谢并引入议题；词形被子词切分

en.concept: Templated statements across several types of structured text
en.description: Activations are concentrated in patent documents and citations (5 passages); prime-factor Q&A (3 passages), popular-science writing on human origins (1 passage), and an overview of a patent’s technical field (1 passage) also occur. There is no single shared local trigger word.

patterns.name: Patent application numbers and citations
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs discuss applications, priority, prior art, or patent document numbers, often with dates, country codes, and legal-document phrasing.

patterns.name: Prime-factor problems and numerical answers
patterns.context: Math Q&A or exercises first pose a prime factorization problem for a number and then list the numerical answer, or immediately begin the next problem.

patterns.name: Evolutionary introduction centered on Darwin
patterns.context: Popular explanation of human-origins research, summarizing facts and evidence discovered after Darwin.

patterns.name: Patent field-of-invention subject and technical scope
patterns.context: A patent background begins with templated wording specifying the technical field and specific subject matter of the invention.

7_1913.concept: 多类结构化文本中的模板化陈述
7_1913.description: 激活集中于专利文书及引文（5段），另见素因数问答（3段）、人类起源科普（1段）和专利技术领域概述（1段）；没有单一共享的局部触发词。

patterns.name: 专利申请编号与引文
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中叙述申请、优先权、先前技术或专利文献编号，常带日期、国家代码和法律文书措辞。

patterns.name: 素因数题及数字答案
patterns.trigger: «prime» «factors»，随后出现数字、逗号及因数列表
patterns.context: 数学问答或练习中先提出某数的素因数分解问题，再列出数字答案，或紧接着开始下一题。

patterns.name: 围绕 Darwin 的进化论介绍
patterns.context: 通俗说明人类起源研究，概述 Darwin 之后发现的事实和证据。

patterns.name: 专利领域说明对象及技术范围
patterns.context: 专利背景开头以模板化措辞说明发明所属技术领域及具体主题。

en.concept: Mixed features of document genre and subword boundaries
en.description: Activation spans patent introductions, prior-art citations, and details of automotive, semiconductor, and biomedical patents, as well as evolution, math Q&A, and zoning decisions; it often falls on split word fragments, patent numbers, punctuation, or technical/legal terms.

patterns.name: Patent background introduction
patterns.context: Patent specifications use general statements to introduce the subject of the invention, its field, or a specific use; often followed by field nouns and technical objects.

patterns.name: Patent citations and legal boilerplate
patterns.context: Patent text discusses prior art, cites documents, or introduces existing disclosures with patent numbers, often at the ends of paragraphs.

patterns.name: Word suffixes and intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-internal fragments split by spaces or markers; no single lexical meaning explains it, suggesting sensitivity to word forms, subword boundaries, or local affixes.

patterns.name: Closing language in patent claims
patterns.context: Appears at the end of patent boilerplate about incorporating references and describing prior art.

patterns.name: Automotive engineering background narrative
patterns.context: Describes selective control of engine exhaust and cylinders, then introduces a technical solution with a patent number.

patterns.name: Technical risks and component descriptions
patterns.context: Describes semiconductor chip mounting and the risk that radiation may be absorbed, then introduces a prior-art patent.

patterns.name: Evolutionary narrative
patterns.context: Popularly introduces research on human origins, discoveries since Darwin, and evidence.

patterns.name: Numerical lists in math Q&A
patterns.context: A comma-separated sequence of numbers appears after a prime-factor question, with activation concentrated around punctuation and numbers.

patterns.name: Zoning court opinions
patterns.context: Discusses county land zoning, residential environments, likelihood of uses, and distinctions from precedents.

patterns.name: Automotive safety and body structure
patterns.context: Describes vehicle safety structures during rapid deceleration or the arrangement of luggage-compartment rails and the seat area, accompanied by patent citations.

patterns.name: Biological-fluid probes
patterns.context: A patent introduction presents a probe for monitoring the composition of blood and other biological fluids.

7_1913.concept: 文档体裁与子词边界混合特征
7_1913.description: 激活跨专利导言、现有技术引用及汽车、半导体、生物医学专利细节，也见演化论、数学问答和土地分区判决；常落在拆分词片段、专利号、标点或技术/法律术语上。

patterns.name: 专利背景导言
patterns.trigger: « invention»、« relates»、« more particularly»；“Embodiments … generally relate to …”
patterns.context: 专利说明书用概括句介绍发明主题、所属领域或具体用途；常接领域名词和技术对象。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术领域

patterns.name: 专利引用及法律套语
patterns.trigger: « incorporated» … « by» « reference»；« DE» 后的专利号及 « A»；« discloses»
patterns.context: 专利文本叙述现有技术、引用文件或用专利号引出既有披露，常见于段落末尾。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/现有技术

patterns.name: 分词后缀与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被空格或标记拆分的词内片段；无法由单一词义解释，可能对词形、子词边界或局部词缀敏感。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求结尾语
patterns.context: 出现在关于并入参考文献、说明现有技术的专利套语末尾。

patterns.name: 汽车工程背景叙述
patterns.context: 描述发动机排气与气缸选择性控制，并由专利号引出技术方案。

patterns.name: 技术风险与部件描述
patterns.context: 描述半导体芯片安装及辐射可能被吸收的风险，随后引出现有技术专利。

patterns.name: 演化论叙述
patterns.context: 通俗介绍人类起源研究、达尔文之后的发现及证据。
patterns.domain: 古腾堡科普/历史性科学 prose

patterns.name: 数学问答中的数值列
patterns.context: 质因数问题后出现逗号分隔的数字序列，激活集中在标点和数字附近。

patterns.name: 分区法庭意见
patterns.context: 讨论县级土地分区、住宅环境、用途概率及判例区分。

patterns.name: 汽车安全与车身结构
patterns.context: 描述车辆急减速时的安全结构，或行李厢导轨与座椅区域的布置，并伴随专利引用。

patterns.name: 生物体液探针
patterns.context: 以专利导言介绍监测血液等体液成分的探针。

en.description: Activations are scattered across commas, line breaks, and subword fragments of names: author bylines, lists, legal names, names and greetings in emails, as well as dates, medical titles/research objectives, and encyclopedia proper nouns. The commonality is weak, so these cannot be attributed to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sheila subword fragment in a name
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in the spelling of names such as Sheila or Sheetal; the spelling following Sheila varies across passages, so no single complete name can be identified

patterns.name: Author names and book objectives
patterns.context: Comma-separated name lists commonly contain initials, name fragments, and punctuation; some fragments may simply be name subwords or transliterations

patterns.name: Comma-separated name lists
patterns.context: Multiple names are listed repeatedly in “surname/given-name fragment;” form; the neuron favors commas in the list and nearby name text

patterns.name: Name directories in legal text
patterns.context: Multiple personal names appear consecutively, separated by commas and interspersed with middle initials

patterns.name: Dates, titles, and document text after line breaks
patterns.context: A date is followed by a line break and then a document title or body text; activation is concentrated mainly on the comma in the date and the line break

patterns.name: Biomedical titles and organization names
patterns.context: A company name follows a biomedical technology assessment title; other examples contain terms such as gene therapy and HIV ribozymes

patterns.name: Biomedical research objective phrases
patterns.context: Research objectives introduced by “To optimize,” listing procedures such as cell isolation, transduction, and expansion
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, lymphocyte and HIV research

patterns.name: Email salutations and body formatting
patterns.context: Greetings, line breaks, attachments/body text, and names occur in emails; activation is not restricted to a fixed position in either the salutation or body

patterns.name: Local combinations of dates, commas, and years
patterns.context: Dates use the English month-day-year format and are followed by a line break

patterns.name: Adjacent letter fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Names or capitalized terms in email fragments are split into subwords; there is insufficient context to determine a unified meaning

patterns.name: Artist names and biographical sentences
patterns.context: A complete proper name appears repeatedly; the text describes the subject's birth date, nationality, residence, and artistic work. The name has no clear semantic connection to other trigger words

7_1947.concept: 姓名及结构化文本片段
7_1947.description: 激活散布于逗号、换行及人名子词：包括作者署名、名单、法律姓名、邮件中的姓名和问候，也见日期、医学标题/研究目标及百科专名。共同点较弱，不能归为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 名字中的 Sheila 子词片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在人名 Sheila 或 Sheetal 的拼写中；Sheila 后续拼写在不同段落中不一致，不能据此确定单一完整姓名

patterns.name: 作者姓名与书目标点
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的姓名列表中，常见姓名缩写、名字片段与标点；部分片段可能只是姓名的子词或转写

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的姓名名单
patterns.context: 多个姓名按“姓/名片段;”重复列举，神经元偏向名单中的逗号及附近姓名文本
patterns.domain: 邮件联系人或收件人名单

patterns.name: 法律文本中的姓名目录
patterns.context: 多个个人姓名连续排列，以逗号分隔，夹有中间名缩写

patterns.name: 日期、标题与换行后的文档文字
patterns.context: 日期后换行，再出现文档标题或正文；主要激活集中在日期中的逗号及换行

patterns.name: 生物医学标题与机构名
patterns.context: 生物医学技术评估标题后出现公司名称；也有基因治疗、HIV 核酶等术语

patterns.name: 生物医学研究目标短语
patterns.context: 以“To optimize”引出的研究目标，列出细胞分离、转导和扩增等操作
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要，淋巴细胞与 HIV 研究

patterns.name: 邮件称呼与正文格式
patterns.context: 问候、换行、附件/正文及人名出现在邮件中；激活并非只落在称呼或正文某一固定位置

patterns.name: 日期、逗号与年份的局部组合
patterns.context: 日期采用英文月份、日、年份的格式，之后换行

patterns.name: 专名或标题中相邻字母片段
patterns.context: 邮件片段中的人名或大写名称被拆成子词；上下文不足以确定其统一含义

patterns.name: 艺术家姓名及传记句
patterns.context: 完整专名重复出现，正文介绍其出生日期、国籍、居住地与艺术创作；姓名本身未见与其他触发词的明确语义联系

en.description: The most stable cue is person-related text: names are split into subword fragments, often appear in comma-separated author, recipient, or legal lists, and repeatedly match Sheila/She. Also seen are dates followed by line breaks, HIV biomedical contexts, email phrasing, and encyclopedia-style biographies.

patterns.name: Sheila name continuation
patterns.context: A name is split into subword tokens at a word boundary; it may be Sheila or the She prefix in the author surname Shears.
patterns.domain: Author affiliations, email bodies, legal lists, and paper metadata

patterns.name: Comma-separated name lists
patterns.context: Multiple names or authors are listed consecutively, separated by commas; names may be split into initials, surnames, or subwords, and often appear with initials and semicolons.
patterns.domain: Paper author metadata, email recipient lists, and names in legal documents

patterns.name: Document date followed by a line break
patterns.context: A title or body text follows a date after a line break; this is a singleton and may be triggered by document structure and the line break together.

patterns.name: HIV gene therapy terminology
patterns.context: Terms such as HIV, ribozyme, gene therapy, and lymphocyte isolation/transduction appear in titles, abstracts, or project descriptions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH grant projects

patterns.name: Email greetings and requests
patterns.context: Greetings, requests for advice, or brief replies in email; the name string and email format may both contribute to activation.

patterns.name: List-style legal text
patterns.context: Many names, initials, and abbreviations are arranged as a list; this superficially resembles general author/recipient lists but appears specifically in legal contexts.

patterns.name: Person followed by a biography
patterns.context: An encyclopedia-style biography follows a person's name, with details such as birth date, identity, and location; this differs from the primary name/list pattern.

7_1947.description: 最稳定的线索是人名相关文本：姓名被拆成子词，常处于逗号分隔的作者、收件人或法律名单中，且多次命中 Sheila/She。另见日期换行、HIV 生物医学语境、邮件用语及百科人物简介。

patterns.name: Sheila 名字续写
patterns.context: 姓名在词边界被拆成子词 token；可能是 Sheila，或作者姓氏 Shears 中的 She 前缀。
patterns.domain: 作者署名、邮件正文、法律名单及论文元数据

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的姓名列表
patterns.trigger: 姓名后反复出现 «,»，如 «Williams»…«,»…«D»…«,»、«Fred»…«,»…«Elena»；法律段也有密集的 «,»
patterns.context: 多个姓名或作者按逗号连续列出；姓名可被拆分为首字母、姓氏或子词，且常伴随首字母和分号。
patterns.domain: 论文作者元数据、邮件收件人列表、法律文书姓名列表

patterns.name: 文档日期及换行
patterns.context: 日期后换行，接标题或正文；单例，且可能只是文档结构与换行共同触发。

patterns.name: HIV 基因治疗术语
patterns.context: HIV、核酶、基因治疗及淋巴细胞分离/转导等词汇出现在标题、摘要或项目描述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 资助项目

patterns.name: 邮件问候与请求语
patterns.context: 电子邮件中的问候、请求建议或简短答复；姓名串与邮件格式可能同时贡献激活。

patterns.name: 名单式法律文本
patterns.context: 大量人名、首字母和缩写按名单排列；与一般作者/收件人名单有表面相似，但法律语境单独出现。

patterns.name: 人名后接人物简介
patterns.context: 人物姓名后紧跟出生日期、身份和所在地等百科式简介；与主要的人名/名单模式不同。

en.description: A prominent recurring cue is the token “ She” and comma-separated names, authors, or lists; other activations occur in medical titles/steps, business emails, legal excerpts, and artist biographies, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: “She” subword fragment
patterns.context: The word begins with the standalone token “ She”; it may be part of a name or the pronoun “She”, and subsequent spellings vary.
patterns.domain: Paper author names, email names, biographies, and ordinary narrative

patterns.name: Comma-separated names and author strings
patterns.context: Names, initials, or name entries appear consecutively, usually separated by commas; some lists also use semicolons.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists, legal name lists, email recipients/name lists

patterns.name: Paper titles, institutions, and author fields
patterns.context: Biomedical text contains a title, institution name, or experimental steps; activations fall on title words, author/institution names, and step-related words.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, NIH grant project descriptions

patterns.name: Legal phrase following a date
patterns.context: A date is adjacent to a legal statement following a line break; there is no obvious name string or “She” pattern here.

patterns.name: Business email body and names
patterns.context: Email salutations, requests, and business communication about specific people; the name “Sheila” also appears.

patterns.name: Biographical narrative and work descriptions
patterns.context: A person's name, artist identity, and life/work description; one passage contains the name “Sheena”, while another contains the pronoun “She”.

7_1947.description: 显著重复的线索是 token“ She”及逗号分隔的人名、作者或名单；其余激活分布在医学标题/步骤、商务邮件、法律片段和艺术家传记中，未显示统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: “She”词片段
patterns.context: 词首为独立 token“ She”；既可能是人名的一部分，也可能是代词“She”，后续拼写并不一致
patterns.domain: 论文作者名、邮件人名、人物传记及普通叙述

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的人名与作者串
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的«,»，以及人名后的逗号，如“Williams, D ing B, Zhu X, Fr”“Su M, Niu Y, Dang Q”“Fred; ... Elena; ...”
patterns.context: 姓名、姓名缩写或姓名条目连续排列，常以逗号分隔；部分列表还用分号
patterns.domain: 论文作者署名、法律人物名单、邮件收件人/姓名列表

patterns.name: 论文标题、机构及作者字段
patterns.trigger: «Technology»« evaluation»:« HIV»...«gene»«therapy»,« Gene»«She»«ars»« Pty Ltd».；“To optimize isolation, transduction and expansion...”
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中出现标题、机构名或实验步骤；激活落在标题词、作者/机构名及步骤词上

patterns.name: 日期后接法律短语
patterns.context: 日期与换行后的法律语句相邻；此处没有明显人名串或“She”模式

patterns.name: 商务邮件正文与人名
patterns.trigger: “Good Morning Sara,”、“Please advise if you think...”及«She»«ila»«Gl»«over»
patterns.context: 邮件称呼、请求与关于具体人员的商务沟通；同时出现“Sheila”人名

patterns.name: 传记叙述与作品介绍
patterns.trigger: “Gray was awarded...”及“Gray began carving... Salish artist, Gerry Sheena.”；“Kukuli Velarde ... is a Peruvian artist... She specializes...”
patterns.context: 人物姓名、艺术家身份和生平/创作介绍；一段含人名“Sheena”，另一段含代词“She”

en.description: The most consistent commonality is the comma and comma-separated structures; these occur in biomedical titles, author lists, dates/general text, and mathematical or numerical fragments. Other trigger fragments vary with context and are difficult to assign a single meaning.

patterns.name: Comma and following separators
patterns.context: The comma itself often activates strongly, especially in subsequent lists, fields, or fragments; this spans scientific text, author lists, and mathematical content

patterns.name: Commas in author names
patterns.context: In paper author lists or sequences of name initials, commas and name-token fragments activate; activation does not cover every character in the names

patterns.name: Terms and commas in scientific titles
patterns.context: Biomedical titles or abstract fragments concern lymphocytes, HIV, ribozymes, or gene therapy; commas and some term fragments activate

patterns.name: Date and general-text boundaries
patterns.context: A date is followed by a line break and ordinary text; the comma in the date and some word fragments activate, but the samples do not establish a lexical condition

patterns.name: Comma-separated expressions in mathematics
patterns.context: Commas occur in formulas, numerical expressions, or apparent table/data rows, often alongside negative numbers, variables, equals signs, operators, or question marks; the structures vary

7_1947.description: 最稳定的共同点是逗号及逗号分隔结构；出现在生物医学标题、作者名单、日期/普通文本和数学数值片段中。其余触发片段随语境而异，难以归为单一词义。

patterns.name: 逗号及后续分隔符
patterns.trigger: `,`；多处紧接空格、数字或词片段
patterns.context: 逗号本身常为强激活，尤其在其后续列举、字段或片段中；横跨科学文本、作者列表和数学内容

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的逗号
patterns.context: 论文作者列表或姓名缩写序列中，逗号及姓名的分词片段激活；激活并非覆盖所有姓名字符

patterns.name: 科学标题中的术语与逗号
patterns.trigger: `To optimize isolation, transduction and expansion`；`HIV ribozyme gene therapy`；`Technology evaluation:`
patterns.context: 生物医学标题或摘要片段，涉及淋巴细胞、HIV、核酶或基因治疗；逗号及部分术语片段激活

patterns.name: 日期与普通文本边界
patterns.context: 日期后接换行与普通文字，日期中的逗号和部分词片段激活，无法从样本确认词义条件

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的逗号分隔
patterns.context: 逗号出现在公式、数值或疑似表格/数据行中，常伴随负数、变量、等号、运算符或问号；各式的结构不完全一致

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on commas and immediately following numbers, symbols, or letter fragments, especially mathematical data strings; also activates on terminology, abbreviations, and comma-separated author names in biomedical text.

patterns.name: Comma followed by numeric/symbol strings
patterns.context: A comma is followed by a number, variable, or short string of symbols; several examples end before a question mark or line break.
patterns.domain: Mathematical problems or data snippets in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Proper nouns and abbreviations in biomedical text
patterns.context: Biomedical corpora contain technical terms, virus/cell names, or author initials, often separated by commas.
patterns.domain: Research text and citations from NIH ExPorter and PubMed Central

7_1947.description: 主要对逗号及其后紧邻的数字、符号或字母片段强烈激活，尤其是数学数据串；也在生物医学文本的术语、缩写和逗号分隔的作者姓名处激活。

patterns.name: 逗号及其后的数值/符号串
patterns.trigger: «,»10«，后接数字、负号、等号、星号或字母
patterns.context: 逗号后出现数值、变量或由符号组成的短串；多例在问号或换行前结束
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数学题目或数据片段

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的专名与缩写
patterns.trigger: “To optimize isolation, transduction and expansion of lymphocytes from HIV-”；“Williams… TT, D… B, Zhu X, Fr…”；“Su M, Niu Y, Dang Q,”
patterns.context: 生物医学语料中出现技术术语、病毒/细胞名称或作者姓名缩写，常由逗号分隔
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 与 PubMed Central 的科研文本/引文

en.description: The most consistent pattern is strong activation on the relative pronoun “which” in explanatory or scientific sentences, usually introducing a following relative clause. Other sporadic activations occur in training-program wording, news headlines, and experimental-method drug names.

patterns.name: Which in relative clauses
patterns.context: Introduces a relative clause in a descriptive statement, followed by a predicate or copula; common in patent background and scientific text.
patterns.domain: Patents, scientific abstracts, and other explanatory text

patterns.name: Weaker recurrence of the relative pronoun which
patterns.context: Also occurs at the start of a relative clause, but with lower intensity than the main examples.

patterns.name: Research content following a training plan
patterns.context: A sentence describing a training or research plan; activation is concentrated on the phrase “proposed in this NRSA”.

patterns.name: Headline-style news phrasing
patterns.context: A proper name and dramatic verdict wording in a news or promotional headline; no clear which clause is present.

patterns.name: Methotrexate in experimental methods
patterns.context: Experimental methods describing genetic mutant screening and cell-killing strategies; strong activation falls on the drug name.

7_1947.description: 最稳定模式是在说明性或科研句中对关系代词“which”强烈激活，通常引出后续关系从句；另有训练方案措辞、新闻标题及实验方法药名等零散激活。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 which
patterns.context: 在描述性陈述中引出关系从句，后接谓语或系动词；多见于专利背景和科研文本。
patterns.domain: 专利、科研摘要及其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 关系代词 which 的较弱重复
patterns.context: 同样出现在关系从句开头，但强度低于主要样例。

patterns.name: 训练方案后接研究内容
patterns.context: 训练或研究方案的说明句；激活集中在短语“proposed in this NRSA”。

patterns.name: 标题式新闻措辞
patterns.context: 新闻标题或宣传式标题中的专名及戏剧化判决措辞，未见明显 which 从句。

patterns.name: 实验方法中的甲氨蝶呤
patterns.context: 描述遗传突变体筛选和细胞杀灭策略的实验方法；强激活落在药名中。

en.concept: which as a relative or interrogative word
en.description: The peak in every fragment is which. Most occur in academic relative clauses or supplementary explanations, with some mathematical questions as well. Abstract formatting, technical terms, and within-word segmentation are only sporadic accompanying features.

patterns.name: Which in abstracts
patterns.context: The relative pronoun which occurs within a sentence, usually referring to a preceding noun or proposition and introducing supplementary information; it also appears in an interrogative context, “which n,” but remains an unmarked which
patterns.domain: Mostly paper abstracts, also mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Abstract opening format
patterns.context: ArXiv abstract delimiters and abstract-label formatting; these tokens themselves do not peak, with the peak remaining on a later which

patterns.name: Other clauses and quantifiers in academic discourse
patterns.context: Subordinate conjunctions or relative words introduce conditions, definitions, or supplementary explanations in academic statements or questions; activation on unmarked words is insufficient to establish an independent trigger pattern

patterns.name: Which in mathematical questions
patterns.context: Asks for n satisfying a condition; which follows a recursive square-root definition and is followed by mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Segmentation within words or proper names
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple sub-tokens, with some locally strong fragments, but these fragments are not the unmarked peak; this is more likely an incidental tokenization effect

patterns.name: Sporadic local activation near technical terms and symbols
patterns.context: Sporadic activation occurs near technical terms, formulas, or symbols in various passages, but does not form a stable cross-passage term pattern, and the peak remains which
patterns.domain: Academic text in mathematics, physics, etc.

7_1947.description: 全部片段的峰值均为 which；多为学术文本中关系从句或补充说明，也有数学问句。摘要格式、专业术语和词内切分仅是零散伴随特征。

patterns.name: 摘要中的 which
patterns.context: 句中出现关系代词 which，通常承接前面的名词或整个命题，引出补充说明；也见于疑问语境“which n”，但该处仍是未标记的 which
patterns.domain: 以论文摘要为主，也有数学问答

patterns.name: 摘要起始格式
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要的分隔符和 abstract 标签格式；这些 token 本身未达到峰值，峰值仍落在后文 which

patterns.name: 学术语篇中的其他从句与量词
patterns.context: 学术陈述或问题中，以从属连接词、关系词引出条件、定义或补充说明；未标记词的激活不足以单独确认为独立触发模式

patterns.name: 数学问句中的 which
patterns.context: 询问满足条件的 n；which 前有递归平方根定义，之后接数学符号

patterns.name: 单词内部或专名切分
patterns.context: 词被分成多个子 token，含局部较强片段，但未标记峰值不是 these fragments；更像偶发的分词效应
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景文本、ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 专业术语与符号的局部偶发激活
patterns.context: 各段专业名词、公式或符号附近有零散激活，但不构成跨段稳定的术语模式，且峰值仍为 which

en.concept: Paragraph/sentence-initial formatting and specific token fragments
en.description: Activation often occurs at paragraph-initial background or definitions introduced by “In,” and also in the “In base” format of base-conversion problems; it also responds to cross-token “Over/flow” and document abstract/title line breaks. Passage 9 is difficult to assign to a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial In + gmar
patterns.context: The word is split across tokens, preceded by a paragraph break; the name is then defined

patterns.name: Sentence-initial In + base
patterns.context: A mathematical base-conversion problem asks for the representation or calculation result of a number in a given base

patterns.name: In at the start of paragraphs or abstracts
patterns.context: A sentence or new paragraph begins with “In,” introducing background, a topic, or an explanation; no fixed following word is required

patterns.name: Over and Stack Overflow segmentation
patterns.context: A brand name or compound word in HackerNews text is split across tokens; activation falls on “Over” and neighboring fragments

patterns.name: Sentence-initial and paragraph-format markers
patterns.context: Formatting symbols and line breaks occur near the beginning of a document, abstract, or section heading

patterns.name: Sporadic Over in HackerNews contexts
patterns.context: No strictly fixed syntax; occurs in online comments about mailing lists, office software, or economic arguments

patterns.name: Fragments of mathematical token sequences
patterns.context: In the format of base-conversion problems, digits or letters in the problem data occur next to a line break

7_1947.concept: 段落/句首格式与特定 token 片段
7_1947.description: 激活常见于“In”引出的段首背景或定义，也见于进制题的“In base”格式；另对跨 token 的“Over/flow”及文档摘要、标题换行有反应。第9段难以归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 句首 In + gmar
patterns.trigger: “In”后紧接“g”“mar”，并出现换行及重复的“In gmar”
patterns.context: 词形被跨 token 拆分，前有段落换行；随后定义该名称

patterns.name: 句首 In + base
patterns.context: 数学进制题中询问某个数在给定进制下的表示或计算结果

patterns.name: 段落或摘要中的 In 起始
patterns.trigger: “In”出现在段落开头或标题后，如“In general”“In the manufacture”“In the Swedish calendar”
patterns.context: 句子或新段落以“In”引入背景、主题或说明；不要求后接固定词

patterns.name: Over 与 Stack Overflow 拆分
patterns.context: HackerNews 文本中品牌名或复合词被跨 token 拆分；激活落在“Over”及邻近片段

patterns.name: 句首及段落格式标记
patterns.trigger: “---”“abstract:”及其前后的换行；背景标题后有“==========”
patterns.context: 文档开头、摘要或小节标题附近出现格式符和换行

patterns.name: 零散 HackerNews 语境中的 Over
patterns.context: 非严格固定句法；出现在关于邮件列表、办公软件或经济论述的网络评论中

patterns.name: 数学 token 序列残片
patterns.context: 进制题格式中，数字或字母组成的题目数据紧邻换行

en.concept: Relational and definitional expressions in technical explanatory text
en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of explanatory and technical text, commonly involving sentence-initial In, technical terms, and mathematical symbols; the highest peak is on involving. Other examples cover scientific definitions, formulas, architecture, fashion, and clinical descriptions, making it difficult to assign a single semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Domain transitions with involving
patterns.context: The word occurs in technical or explanatory sentences, introducing the objects or processes involved; in [1] it is followed by a material system and epitaxial growth, and in [2] by an area quantity.

patterns.name: Academic paragraph openings
patterns.context: A paragraph or new discussion begins with In to introduce background, a question, or a definition; activation may also co-occur with a later involving.

patterns.name: Mathematical and scientific symbols
patterns.context: The body text contains LaTeX mathematical expressions, variables, or formulas; activation falls near symbols or in related academic text.

patterns.name: Timescale terminology
patterns.context: Discusses multiple related timescales and Coulomb collisions in collisionless shocks.

patterns.name: Technical definitions and formal descriptions
patterns.context: A section reviews definitions and gives rigorous mathematical characterizations using functions, spaces, and mapping symbols.

patterns.name: Clothing descriptions and brands
patterns.context: Describes clothing, decoration, and design inspiration; incorporates means that a design integrates a particular image in this context.

patterns.name: Explanations of physical concepts
patterns.context: A term appears as an entry heading, followed by an explanation of its physical meaning and related fields or effects.

patterns.name: Architectural components and spatial layout
patterns.context: Describes a roof turret, corner locations, and floor composition in a building.

patterns.name: Hot gas and equations of state
patterns.context: Discusses conditions within a hot gas cooling radius and gives a pressure-density relation.

patterns.name: Clinical disorder definitions
patterns.context: A medical abstract defines a disease by its diagnostic category and typical behaviors and consequences.

7_1947.concept: 专业说明文本中的关系与定义表达
7_1947.description: 激活分布于多种说明性、专业文本，常见段首 In、技术术语及数学符号；最高峰在 involving。其余涵盖科学定义、公式、建筑、时尚与临床描述，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: involving 的领域衔接
patterns.context: 该词出现在技术或说明性句子中，引出所涉及的对象或过程；在 [1] 后接材料系统及外延生长，在 [2] 后接面积量。

patterns.name: 学术段落开头
patterns.context: 段落或新论述以 In 引入背景、问题或定义；激活也可能与随后出现的 involving 同现。

patterns.name: 数学与科学符号
patterns.context: 正文夹杂 LaTeX 数学表达式、变量或公式；激活落在符号附近或相关学术文本中。

patterns.name: 时长尺度术语
patterns.context: 讨论无碰撞激波中多个相关时间尺度及库仑碰撞过程。

patterns.name: 技术定义与形式化表述
patterns.context: 章节回顾定义，并以函数、空间及映射符号作严谨的数学刻画。

patterns.name: 服饰描写与品牌
patterns.context: 描述服装、装饰及设计灵感；incorporates 在此表示设计融入某种意象。

patterns.name: 物理概念说明
patterns.context: 以术语作条目标题，随后解释其物理含义并列举相关场或效应。

patterns.name: 建筑构件与空间布局
patterns.context: 说明建筑屋顶塔楼、角落位置及楼层构成。

patterns.name: 热气体与状态方程
patterns.context: 讨论热气体冷却半径以内的条件，并给出压力与密度关系。

patterns.name: 临床障碍定义
patterns.context: 医学摘要以诊断类别及其典型行为、后果定义疾病。

en.description: Activation spans dense technical information in scientific and technical text: formulas and symbols, parameters and terminology, technical conditions and process steps, as well as the history of logic, quantum processes, and historical quotations. No single lexical trigger explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Structured symbols and variables in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formulas, subscripts and superscripts, operators, and nearby variables occur densely; activation falls on symbols, numbers, mathematical terms, and explanatory text following formulas.

patterns.name: Scientific paper terminology and parameter relations
patterns.context: Technical terms occur alongside parameters, equations, or descriptions of phase transitions or behavior, commonly in paper bodies and formula explanations.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, mathematical physics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Signal and performance descriptions in technical patents
patterns.context: Describes signal quality, noise, channel conditions, and achievable performance in conditional-result statements typical of patent background sections.

patterns.name: Patent process steps and figure/component numbers
patterns.context: Consecutive descriptions of manufacturing steps, materials/structures, and figure labels, including passive voice and process results.

patterns.name: Quotations and character wording in historical narratives
patterns.context: Direct quotations by characters in historical or literary texts, including archaic wording, narration, and rhetorical expressions.

patterns.name: Theorems and system names in the history of logic
patterns.context: Introduces logical systems, theorems, conjectures, their originators, and dates.

patterns.name: Terminology and abbreviations for graph-constrained stochastic processes
patterns.context: First defines a graph-constrained process, then uses abbreviations to list its categories or inclusion relations.

7_1947.concept: 专业文本中的结构化信息
7_1947.description: 激活覆盖科学与技术文本中的密集专业信息：公式和符号、参数与术语、技术条件及工艺步骤，也包括逻辑学史、量子过程和历史引语；没有单一词汇触发器能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的结构化符号与变量
patterns.context: 公式、下标上标、运算符及其附近变量密集出现；激活落在符号、数字、数学术语和公式后接的说明文字上。

patterns.name: 科学论文术语与参数关系
patterns.trigger: “coherent Fermi-liquid regime”“interactions U”“T >> T_crit”“Swift-Hohenberg equation”“periodic patterns”
patterns.context: 专业术语与参数、方程或相变/行为描述共同出现，常见于论文正文及公式说明。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、数学物理与科学论文

patterns.name: 技术专利中的信号与性能描述
patterns.trigger: “spectrum is unusable”“noise floor”“signal-to-noise ratio”“large spectral nulls”“achievable throughput”
patterns.context: 描述信号质量、噪声、信道条件及可达性能，句式为专利背景技术中的条件—结果陈述。

patterns.name: 专利工艺步骤与图号/部件编号
patterns.trigger: “interlayer insulating film”“resist pattern”“as a mask”“grooves 111a to 111h”“FIG. 25”
patterns.context: 连续叙述制造步骤、材料/结构及附图标号，含被动语态和工艺结果。
patterns.domain: 半导体或器件制造专利

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的引语与人物措辞
patterns.trigger: “shouts”“large-minded Peter Martyr”“Upon the surface of that earth”“Spain is spreading her wings”
patterns.context: 历史或文学文本中的人物直接引语，含古旧措辞、叙述和修辞性表达。

patterns.name: 逻辑学史中的定理与系统名称
patterns.context: 介绍逻辑系统、定理、猜想及其提出者和年代。

patterns.name: 图约束随机过程的术语与缩写
patterns.trigger: “quantum stochastic process constrained by a graph”“QSWs”“CRW”“QW”
patterns.context: 先定义图约束的过程，再用缩写列举其类别或包含关系。
patterns.domain: 量子概率/随机过程论文

en.concept: Local markers in formulas and adjacent text
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in academic text with complex LaTeX, favoring formula delimiters, nearby variables, closing parentheses, and where after formulas; it also sporadically falls on function words such as of and on domain-specific terms. Historical text, pump patents, and personal narratives are also present, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Subordination markers in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Between a noun and its possessive, constituent, or limiting element; activation may fall on “of” or near formula symbols and line breaks.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary technical text, historical narratives, and explanatory prose

patterns.name: Right-side/right-parenthesis expressions in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: In mathematical typesetting, especially at closing parentheses or delimiters; this may differ from activation on “of” around formulas.

patterns.name: Parentheses and delimiters in formulas
patterns.context: Near delimiters in long formulas, matrices, or operator expressions; activation may fall on symbols and nearby variables.

patterns.name: Explanatory connectors after equations
patterns.context: When a formula or mathematical statement is followed by explanations of variables, parameters, or normalization conditions; the marker falls on the connective.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on English function words and phrases
patterns.context: Common words embedded in narration, explanations, or patent descriptions; no stable, specific semantic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, historical narratives, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Fluid-pump terminology in patents
patterns.context: Descriptions of pump types that discharge liquid alternately or on every stroke; the specific trigger may simply be a nearby common word.

patterns.name: Quotations and date expressions in historical narratives
patterns.context: Sentences about the arrival of Christianity in France and related historical figures and dates; activation is dispersed across quotations and narrative fragments.

patterns.name: Life arrangements in nontechnical personal narratives
patterns.context: First-person discussion of life, residence, and recollections of time in Nashville; there is no clear shared theme with the other formula passages.

patterns.name: The Swift–Hohenberg equation and pattern formation
patterns.context: Uses an equation to discuss periodic patterns and parameter conditions; explanatory “where” is also marked.

patterns.name: Variables and operators marked in formal formulas
patterns.context: In complex, dense LaTeX formulas, activation falls on numbers, variables, operators, or punctuation; the specific symbols vary and cannot be assigned to one specialized field.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, particle physics, and mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Academic descriptions of scattering and reaction processes
patterns.context: Theoretical passages discuss reaction processes, coupling constants, or absorption and scattering contributions; activation points include terms and nearby function words.

7_1947.concept: 公式与邻近文本中的局部标记
7_1947.description: 激活主要出现在含复杂 LaTeX 的学术文本中，偏向公式定界符、邻近变量、右括号及公式后的 where；也零散落在 of 等功能词和领域词上。另有历史、泵专利与个人叙述，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的从属关系标记
patterns.trigger: 公式或文字中的 “of”，以及 “of the”“of coupling constants”“of the horizontal”“of Christianity”等
patterns.context: 在名词与其所属、组成或限定成分之间；激活点可能落在 “of” 或紧邻公式符号、换行附近。
patterns.domain: 跨学科技术文本、历史叙述及说明文

patterns.name: 数学排版中的右侧/右括号表达式
patterns.trigger: “\right”“\right)”以及与之相邻的 LaTeX 分隔符和公式标点
patterns.context: 数学公式排版中，尤其是括号或分隔符闭合处；可能与公式周围的 “of” 激活不同。

patterns.name: 公式内的括号与定界符
patterns.context: 长公式、矩阵或算符表达式中的定界符附近，激活可出现在符号及其邻近变量上。

patterns.name: 方程后的解释性连接词
patterns.context: 公式或数学陈述后接变量、参数或归一化条件的解释时；标记在连接词上。

patterns.name: 英文功能词及短语的零散激活
patterns.context: 普通散文中嵌在叙述、解释或专利说明里的常见词；未见稳定的专属语义条件。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、历史叙述、专利说明

patterns.name: 专利中的流体泵术语
patterns.context: 交替或每个冲程排液的泵型说明；具体触发也可能只是邻近的常见词。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的引述及年代表达
patterns.context: 叙述基督教传入法国及相关历史人物、年代的句子；激活分散在引述和叙事片段中。

patterns.name: 非技术个人叙述中的人生安排
patterns.trigger: “rectify”“balancing the pieces of my life”“where I call home”
patterns.context: 第一人称谈生活、居住地及回顾在 Nashville 的经历；与其余公式段落无明显共同主题。
patterns.domain: 个人博客或回忆性散文

patterns.name: Swift–Hohenberg 方程及模式形成
patterns.context: 通过方程讨论周期性模式及参数条件；解释性 “where” 也被标记。

patterns.name: 形式化公式中被标记的变量与算子
patterns.context: 复杂、密集的 LaTeX 公式中，激活落在数字、变量、算子或标点上；这些符号具体内容各异，无法归为同一专门领域。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、粒子物理及数学公式

patterns.name: 散射与反应过程的学术表述
patterns.context: 讨论反应过程、耦合常数或吸收与散射贡献的理论段落；激活点包括术语及周边功能词。

en.description: The most prominent shared pattern is a limiting clause introduced by wherein in patent technical text, especially structural and functional conditions for devices; other patent-style cues include figure/patent number references and prior-art phrasing. A few activations occur in hospital descriptions and pin-count descriptions, which cannot be fully reduced to the wherein pattern.

patterns.name: Wherein clauses in claims
patterns.context: In patent claims or technical patent descriptions, wherein introduces a clause specifying a limitation, composition, or functional condition; the trigger often falls on wherein itself.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text across fields such as optical amplification, range imaging, screws, rotors, circuit boards, magnetic-field generators, and logic modules.

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and figure descriptions
patterns.context: The patent background or specification cites figure or patent numbers, or describes figures and the structures shown; activations cluster near numbers and figure references.
patterns.domain: USPTO background sections and patent figure descriptions.

patterns.name: Prior-art phrasing in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes existing technology, conventional structures, or known implementations, often alongside figure references or descriptions of structural components.

patterns.name: Descriptions of patent structures and components
patterns.context: Lists device components, structures, materials, or functional relationships in patent-style technical English; this pattern is widespread, but the marked token does not consistently fall on these words, with activations concentrated mainly near wherein or figure numbers.
patterns.domain: Specifications and claims across engineering fields.

patterns.name: Promotional descriptions of institutions and medical services
patterns.context: Describes a hospital's history, regional services, cancer care, medical education, and research; not a patent claim context.

patterns.name: Memory pin counts and figure labels
patterns.context: Describes data width, address/command/data transfer, and pin counts, using a figure to show representative pin counts.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds concerning electronic or memory hardware.

7_1947.concept: 专利权利要求限定语境
7_1947.description: 最突出的共同规律是专利技术文本中 wherein 引出的限定从句，尤其是装置结构与功能条件；另有图号/专利号引用及先前技术措辞等专利文体信号。少数激活位于医院介绍和引脚计数描述中，不能完全归约为 wherein 模式。

patterns.name: 权利要求中的 wherein 从句
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或技术性专利描述中，wherein 引出限定、组成或功能条件的从句；触发常落在 wherein 本身。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本，涉及光学放大、测距成像、螺钉、转子、线路板、磁场发生器及逻辑模块等不同技术领域。

patterns.name: 专利附图编号及图示描述
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中引用图号、专利号，或说明图示及其所示结构；激活集中在编号与图示引用附近。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景技术及专利图示说明。

patterns.name: 专利背景技术的先前技术措辞
patterns.trigger: «in»2« the»2« art»5、«illustrated»5« by»10（[2]）；«in»2 the prior« art»4（[7]）
patterns.context: 描述既有技术、惯常结构或已知实施方式，常伴随引用图示或结构组成说明。

patterns.name: 专利技术结构与部件描述
patterns.trigger: 如«a plurality of»、«comprises»、«configured»及部件名称；例如«the first»« optical»« amplifier»（[1]）、«a conventional screw»（[6]）、«rotor»«-disk»（[7]）、«circuit board manufacturing process»（[8]）
patterns.context: 以专利式技术英语列举装置部件、结构、材料或功能关系；此模式广泛存在，但所给标记并未稳定落在这些词上，主要激活仍集中于 wherein 或图号附近。
patterns.domain: 不同工程领域的专利说明书与权利要求。

patterns.name: 机构与医疗服务宣传性介绍
patterns.context: 介绍医院历史、区域服务、癌症护理、医学教育与研究；不是专利权利要求语境。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 项目/机构介绍文本。

patterns.name: 存储器引脚数量及图中标注
patterns.context: 说明数据宽度、地址/命令/数据传输及引脚计数，并以图号展示代表性引脚数量。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景技术，电子或存储器硬件。

en.description: Primarily responds to “wherein,” which introduces limitations in patents and technical text; it also responds to the preposition “in,” especially before quotations or work titles, and includes an instance of “in such a way.”

patterns.name: Wherein in patent claims
patterns.context: “wherein” introduces a limitation on a previously mentioned device, method, or structure; activation often occurs in the latter part of a technical description, frequently near a comma
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text, claims, or technical descriptions

patterns.name: In in patent background sections
patterns.context: “in” occurs before citations to technical literature, book titles, or work titles, as in “in the behind-the-scenes feature,” “in 1A Larson,” or “in ... non-patent literature”; the local context is not necessarily a patent
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and citations, also entertainment media text

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in such a way
patterns.context: Indicates that a relation or parameter is selected in a particular way; this example describes a torque relation in a steering system

7_1947.description: 主要响应专利及技术文本中引出限定的“wherein”；也响应“in”这一介词，尤其在引文或作品名之前，另有“in such a way”搭配实例。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的 wherein
patterns.context: “wherein”引出对前述装置、方法或结构的限定；激活位置常在技术描述后段，附近往往有逗号
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本、权利要求或技术描述

patterns.name: 专利背景中的 in
patterns.context: “in”出现在技术文献引用、书名或作品名之前，如“in the behind-the-scenes feature”“in 1A Larson”或“in ... non-patent literature”；局部不一定是专利文本
patterns.domain: 专利背景与引文，也有娱乐媒体文本

patterns.name: in such a way 固定搭配
patterns.context: 表示关系或参数以某种方式选取；此例中描述转向系统扭矩关系

en.description: Strong activations consistently fall on the patent-style qualifier “wherein” and specification boilerplate or connective phrases; scattered triggers also include direction, representation, and prepositions, with no single semantic theme unifying them.

patterns.name: “wherein” in claim syntax
patterns.context: Appears in a long sentence, often after a comma, introducing a further limitation on a previously mentioned device, system, method, or structure; the clause nearby may also contain a relative word such as “which”.
patterns.domain: Patent claims concerning substrates, electrodes, optical amplifiers, shutters, and measuring devices

patterns.name: Embodiment and figure boilerplate in patent specifications
patterns.context: Activates in formal specification boilerplate when introducing embodiments of the invention or figures; the strong activation falls on “wherein” rather than on a single technical term.

patterns.name: Operating instructions and equipment function descriptions in patents
patterns.context: The fixed connective “In this respect” appears when describing how equipment operates or how components move in sequence or function.

patterns.name: Introducing the subject matter/structure of an invention
patterns.context: Uses conventional patent language to introduce the subject matter of an invention, a compound structure, or an illustrated embodiment; activations are distributed across this type of specification phrasing.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications concerning chemical structures and invention embodiments

patterns.name: Directional phrasing in legal and political discussion
patterns.context: Discusses privacy and democratic institutions, using “direction of re-establishing ...” to express the direction of policy or social development.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments on civil liberties and online privacy

patterns.name: Motor control and sensorimotor brain regions
patterns.context: A neuroscience abstract uses “represented by” to introduce measures related to motor cortex and somatosensory input.

patterns.name: Martial arts terminology and behind-the-scenes production descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces martial arts choreography in Avatar: The Last Airbender and a behind-the-scenes feature; strong activation falls on the preposition “in”.

7_1947.concept: 技术说明文中的结构性衔接词
7_1947.description: 强激活较稳定地落在专利语体的限定词“wherein”及说明书套语、衔接语上；另有方向、代表关系和介词等零散触发，无法归并为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 权利要求句式中的“wherein”
patterns.context: 出现在长句中，常在逗号之后引出对前述装置、系统、方法或结构的进一步限定；该词附近的从句也可能出现“which”等关系词。
patterns.domain: 专利权利要求，涉及基板、电极、光学放大器、快门和测量装置

patterns.name: 专利说明书的实施例与附图套语
patterns.trigger: «wherein»10；同段还见 “in conjunction with the accompanying drawings”
patterns.context: 专利说明书的正式套语中，在介绍发明的实施例或附图时激活；此处强激活落在“wherein”而非单一技术术语上。

patterns.name: 专利中的操作说明与设备功能叙述
patterns.trigger: «In»5 «this»1 respect«9»；以及 “the equipment of the invention”
patterns.context: 描述设备如何运作、部件如何依次移动或发挥功能时，出现固定衔接语“In this respect”。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，工具块转移设备

patterns.name: 专利中的发明主题／结构引入
patterns.context: 用专利惯用语介绍发明主题、化合物结构，或引出所示实施例；激活分散在该类说明书表述中。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，化学结构与发明实施例

patterns.name: 法律政治论述中的方向性措辞
patterns.context: 讨论隐私与民主制度时，以“direction of re-establishing ...”表达政策或社会发展的方向。
patterns.domain: HackerNews评论，公共自由与在线隐私

patterns.name: 运动控制与感觉运动脑区
patterns.context: 神经科学摘要中，以“represented by”引出与运动皮层、躯体感觉输入相关的测量指标。

patterns.name: 武术相关词语及幕后制作描述
patterns.context: 介绍《降世神通》中的武术动作设计及其幕后特辑；强激活落在介词“in”。

en.concept: Relational and quotation structures in legal and patent text
en.description: Activations are scattered across patents, legal text, and commentary: wherein, hereinafter, positional relations, and conventional phrasing are most prominent in patents; legal citations and trier of fact also appear, as do where and transitions in commentary. There is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Where clauses or positional relations
patterns.context: The relative adverb where occurs, or a patent claim describes a structure or function within a location or region
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technical descriptions; also commentary

patterns.name: Wherein in patent claims
patterns.context: In long, claim-style patent sentences, wherein introduces a device state, structure, or component relation

patterns.name: In in legal citations
patterns.context: Introduces or quotes the full text of a statute in legal discussion

patterns.name: Fact-finding context
patterns.context: Trier and fact occur together in discussion of the fact-finding responsibilities of a judge or jury

patterns.name: Hereinafter in patents
patterns.context: Defines or specifies a name for use later in the patent text

patterns.name: Conventional narration in patent specifications
patterns.context: A patent specification discusses the invention, prior literature, or subsequent content; trigger points in this pattern are inconsistent

patterns.name: Near citations and section numbers
patterns.context: Citation contexts involving statutes, patent documents, or section numbers; activation may relate to citation formatting after a number

patterns.name: Connectives and list structures
patterns.context: A connective appears in a parallel structure; activation is weak and specific conditions vary

patterns.name: Other technical structural descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Describes component locations, regions, or physical relations, with no single unified trigger word

patterns.name: Narrative transitions in literary commentary
patterns.context: A transition or narrative progression occurs while discussing the function of photographs or film/television performances

7_1947.concept: 法律与专利文本关系/引述结构
7_1947.description: 激活分散于专利、法律和评论文本：专利中的 wherein、hereinafter、位置关系及惯用叙述最突出；法律引文与 trier of fact、评论中的 where/转折也出现。无单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: where 从句或位置关系
patterns.trigger: «where»（如 “as «where» if one wasn’t looking hard enough”）；“locations «where» the photos are captured”；“region, «in» «which»”
patterns.context: 出现关系副词 where，或专利权利要求中描述某位置/区域内的结构或功能
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术描述；另见评论文字

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的 wherein
patterns.trigger: «wherein» the locking device；«wherein» a plurality of apertures
patterns.context: 专利权利要求式长句中，wherein 引出装置状态、结构或部件关系
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/权利要求

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 in
patterns.context: 法律论述中引出或引用法规全文

patterns.name: 裁判事实认定语境
patterns.context: trier 与 fact 连用，谈审判者的事实认定职责

patterns.name: 专利中的 hereinafter
patterns.context: 专利文本定义或指定后文使用的名称
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术说明

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的惯用叙述
patterns.context: 专利说明书以发明、先前文献或后续内容为话题；本模式触发点不够一致

patterns.name: 引文及章节编号周边
patterns.context: 法规、专利文献或章节编号的引用语境；激活位置可能与编号后的引文格式相关

patterns.name: 连接词及列举结构
patterns.context: 并列结构中出现连接词，触发较弱且具体条件不统一

patterns.name: 其他专利技术结构描述
patterns.trigger: “«which» are positioned”；“«in» which a driver circuit”；“«of» the barrel”
patterns.context: 描述部件位置、区域或物理关系，未见统一的单一触发词

patterns.name: 文艺评论中的叙述转折
patterns.context: 评论照片功能或影视表演时，出现转折或叙事推进

en.concept: Patent limiting clauses and specification phrasing
en.description: Strongly responds to technical limiting clauses introduced by wherein in patent text, especially descriptions of structures, components, and functions; it also responds to specification connectives such as Further/Furthermore/Accordingly, type-anaphoric expressions, and statements about liability for cleanup costs in legal citations.

patterns.name: Wherein clauses in patent claims
patterns.context: Wherein is followed by a limitation describing a technical object, structure, or function; it often appears in long claim-style sentences.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text in mechanical, semiconductor, electronic, display, and control fields

patterns.name: Transitional phrases in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Connects supplementary discussion in a patent specification or shifts from background to the purpose of the invention; usually appears at the beginning of a sentence.

patterns.name: Statements of liability in legal citations
patterns.context: A lawsuit or legal narrative quotes a party's claim about costs or liability; activation falls on “of” in the quotation.

patterns.name: Type anaphora in patents
patterns.context: States that an object belongs to a type mentioned earlier, a common anaphoric expression in patent technical descriptions.

7_1947.concept: 专利限定从句及说明书措辞
7_1947.description: 强烈响应专利文本中 wherein 引出的技术限定从句，尤其结构、部件及功能描述；也响应专利说明书的 Further/Furthermore/Accordingly 衔接语、类型回指表达，以及法律引文中关于清理费用责任的语句。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的 wherein 从句
patterns.context: wherein 后接技术对象、结构或功能的限定说明；多出现在权利要求式长句中
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本，机械、半导体、电子、显示、控制等领域

patterns.name: 专利背景中的转折衔接语
patterns.context: 用于连接专利说明书中的补充论述或由背景转向发明目的；通常位于句首
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与说明书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的责任表述
patterns.context: 诉讼或法律叙述中引用当事人对费用、责任的主张；激活落在引述中的“of”

patterns.name: 专利中的类型回指
patterns.context: 说明某对象属于前文所述类型，常见于专利技术描述的回指表达

en.concept: Qualifying statements in technical and legal texts
en.description: Activation is concentrated in the format and syntactic positions of patent specifications, especially wherein restrictive clauses; it also covers descriptions of the invention’s field and purpose, figures and citations, device structures, and prior-art narratives. It also responds to a passage on legal liability and one describing firearm barrels and ammunition.

patterns.name: Wherein clauses in patent claims
patterns.context: In a patent specification or claim, wherein introduces structural, compositional, or functional limitations; the strongest activation often occurs on this word and the following relative clause.

patterns.name: Patent background boilerplate
patterns.context: In a patent background or the opening of a specification, introducing the invention’s subject, field, or later references to terms; often co-occurs with wherein activation.

patterns.name: Descriptions of figures and figure-number references
patterns.context: Describing views, cross-sections, and structures of circuit boards or devices using figure numbers such as FIGS. 1A–1C.

patterns.name: Patent citations and document references
patterns.context: Citing prior-art materials by number or publication name in a specification.

patterns.name: Liability and cost-sharing in legal texts
patterns.context: Describing an environmental remediation or pollution cleanup dispute and arguing that a party should bear cleanup costs or liability.

patterns.name: Invention purpose and structural description
patterns.context: In a patent background, moving from a problem to the invention’s purpose and describing the shape of a tool or the arrangement of its components.

patterns.name: Device structures involving electrodes, layers, and holes
patterns.context: Describing the positions and continuity of holes or protrusions between multilayer substrates and electrodes.

patterns.name: Introduction to a technical field and manufacturing method
patterns.context: The opening of a patent defines the invention’s field and briefly describes a device or its manufacturing method.

patterns.name: Semiconductor devices and integrated-circuit background
patterns.context: Discussing developments in semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, bus configurations, or manufacturing technologies.

patterns.name: Prior-art problems and transitions in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: First describing the inconvenience or cost of an existing approach, then using a contrast or addition to introduce a problem, document, or solution.

patterns.name: Technical description of ammunition and barrels
patterns.context: Describing the motion or containment of a barrel, projectile, and propellant combustion products.

7_1947.concept: 技术与法律文本中的限定性说明
7_1947.description: 激活主要集中在专利说明书的格式与句法位置，尤其 wherein 限定从句；也覆盖发明领域/目的、附图和引文、器件结构及现有技术叙述。另对一段法律责任论述和一段枪管弹药描述有响应。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的 wherein 从句
patterns.context: 专利说明书或权利要求中，用 wherein 引出结构、组成或功能限定；最强激活多出现在该词及其后的关系从句区域。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的发明套语
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书开头，介绍发明主题、领域或后文对术语的指称；常与 wherein 激活共现。

patterns.name: 附图说明与图号引用
patterns.context: 以图号描述电路板或器件的视图、剖面和结构，常出现 FIGS. 1A–1C 等编号。

patterns.name: 专利引文与文献指称
patterns.context: 说明书以编号或出版物名称引用现有技术资料。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的责任与费用分担
patterns.context: 叙述环境治理或污染清理争议，主张某方承担清理费用或责任。

patterns.name: 发明目的及结构描述
patterns.context: 专利背景由问题转入发明目的，并描述工具形状或部件配置。

patterns.name: 电极、层与孔洞的器件结构
patterns.context: 描述多层基板、电极及其孔洞或凸部之间的位置、连续关系。

patterns.name: 技术领域及制造方法介绍
patterns.context: 专利开头界定发明领域，并简述器件或其制造方法。

patterns.name: 半导体器件与集成电路背景
patterns.context: 说明半导体器件、集成电路、总线配置或制造技术发展。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的现有技术问题与转折
patterns.context: 先述现有方案的不便或成本，再以转折或补充引出问题、文献或方案。

patterns.name: 弹药与枪管的技术描述
patterns.context: 描述枪管、弹丸及推进药燃烧产物的运动或阻隔。

en.description: Activations cluster on clause-linking words, most notably “which” in relative clauses in technical descriptions (often “in which”); they also respond to the advantage expression “advantage of”, explanatory “that” clauses, and list-final “things”.

patterns.name: Which in relative clauses
patterns.context: Which introduces or occurs within a relative clause describing an entity, structure, material, or process; often followed by a passive construction or a description of properties.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and technical descriptions; also medical abstracts

patterns.name: Advantage expression with of
patterns.context: Describes the advantages of a technology, method, or thing; common structures include “the advantage of …” or “have the advantage of …”.

patterns.name: Explanatory or clausal that
patterns.context: That introduces an explanation, judgment, or result clause; examples occur in legal quotations, technical discussion, and everyday expressions.
patterns.domain: Legal text, technical descriptions, online colloquial language

patterns.name: Generic list-final things
patterns.context: Refers generically to other items or matters in a list, often in a closing expression such as “among other things”.

7_1947.description: 激活集中于从句衔接词，尤以技术描述中关系从句的“which”（常见“in which”）最突出；也响应优势表达“advantage of”、说明性“that”从句及列举收尾“things”。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 which
patterns.context: which 引出或位于描述实体、结构、材料或过程的关系从句中；常接被动结构或性质说明。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与技术说明，也见医学摘要

patterns.name: of 的优势表达
patterns.context: 说明某技术、方法或事物的优点；常见结构为“the advantage of …”或“have the advantage of …”。

patterns.name: that 引出的说明或从句
patterns.context: that 引出说明、判断或结果从句；此处分别出现在法律引述、技术论述和日常表达中。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、技术说明、网络口语

patterns.name: things 的泛指列举收尾
patterns.context: 泛指列举中的其他项目或事项，常出现在“among other things”一类收尾表达。

en.description: Activation is scattered across several fixed collocations, syntactic structures, and rhetorical expressions: for that matter, either referring to a coordinated pair, honored to have, no eyestrain, advantage of, lie in its, title-initial An, and political-speech rhetoric. No shared trigger across multiple domains is evident.

patterns.name: Expressions involving matter
patterns.context: Using the fixed expression “for that matter” to add a clarification, contrast, or example; [1] also has the adjacent phrase “that matter”

patterns.name: Either in a coordinated structure
patterns.context: The preceding text mentions two actions (“the travel and the writing”), then uses “either” to refer to them

patterns.name: To have expressing honor
patterns.context: Introductory or welcoming text expressing the honor of inviting someone to participate
patterns.domain: Introduction to a fitness and nutrition article

patterns.name: No eyestrain
patterns.context: A patent background describes the advantages of a display element, using “no eyestrain” to characterize its display properties

patterns.name: The collocation advantage of
patterns.context: A patent text describes the advantages of a certain type of axle system under partial load

patterns.name: NEXT week emphasizing time
patterns.context: Expressing surprise or emphasis while confirming the date of a hearing; strong activation falls on the time expression around NEXT

patterns.name: The collocation in its
patterns.context: A project description states where its advantages lie, using the structure “strengths ... lie in its ...”

patterns.name: An in a patent title quotation
patterns.context: A patent background introduces the title of a related technical article; the trigger seems to be at the start of the title after the quotation mark

patterns.name: Broad imagery of a nation or community
patterns.context: Political-speech-style text organizes sentences with rhetoric about a broad nation, a community of people, and similar ideas

patterns.name: Matter introducing an example
patterns.context: Bangladesh is mentioned first, then “For that matter” introduces Cuba as a related example

7_1947.description: 激活分散于若干固定搭配、句法结构和修辞表达：for that matter、either指代并列项、honored to have、no eyestrain、advantage of、lie in its、标题开头An及政治演说修辞；多个领域间未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: matter相关表达
patterns.trigger: « for»1 that« matter»10«;»1 just not well documented；«For that« matter»8
patterns.context: 在补充说明、转折或举例时使用固定表达“for that matter”；[1]还出现紧邻的“that matter”

patterns.name: either并列结构
patterns.context: 前文先提到两个动作（“the travel and the writing”），随后用“either”指代两者

patterns.name: 强调程度的to have
patterns.context: 欢迎/介绍性文字中，表达荣幸能邀请某人参与

patterns.name: 无眼疲劳
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明显示元件的优点，以“no eyestrain”描述显示特性

patterns.name: advantage of搭配
patterns.context: 专利文本说明某类轴系统在部分负荷时的优势

patterns.name: NEXT week时间强调
patterns.context: 对听证会日期作惊讶或强调式确认；强激活落在NEXT前后的时间表达
patterns.domain: 口语化政治/委员会报道

patterns.name: in its搭配
patterns.context: 项目简介中说明项目优势所在，采用“strengths ... lie in its ...”结构

patterns.name: 专利引述中的An
patterns.context: 专利背景介绍相关技术文章标题，触发点似在引号后的标题开头
