patterns.name: 宽广国家/共同体意象
patterns.context: 政治演说式文字中用宽广国家、人民共同体等修辞来组织句子

patterns.name: matter作举例引入
patterns.context: 先提孟加拉国，再以“For that matter”引出古巴作为相关例子

en.concept: Lexical and structural triggers across contexts
en.description: Activations are distributed across varied contexts; a relatively concentrated cue is which introducing an anaphoric clause in long patent sentences. Others include economic recovery, fixed phrases with rate/matter, display properties, publication descriptions, and bibliographic abbreviations.

patterns.name: Which introducing a relative clause
patterns.context: Follows a noun or technical object and introduces a clause describing its composition, position, or properties; often adjacent to patent-style long-sentence structures.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions; also novelistic narrative

patterns.name: Which followed by each
patterns.context: After multiple components have been listed, which refers back to them and is followed by each.

patterns.name: Economic recovery phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses 2004 and the European economy, with the preposition by introducing a change in the form of economic recovery.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speech on economic policy

patterns.name: Rate phrase
patterns.context: A character's evaluation of a place includes a concessive or supplementary judgment phrase.

patterns.name: Matter phrase
patterns.context: In a parenthetical aside, matter appears in a fixed expression meaning “in this regard”.

patterns.name: Eye-strain-free property
patterns.context: Describes a beneficial property of a display element.

patterns.name: Introductory use of have
patterns.context: Introduces or congratulates the first issue of a publication, using have to introduce its authors or completion status.
patterns.domain: Introduction to a fitness and nutrition publication

patterns.name: Vol. in bibliographic citations
patterns.context: A volume abbreviation, Vol., is followed by journal information in a flash-memory technology reference.

7_1947.concept: 多语境词汇与结构触发
7_1947.description: 激活分散于多种语境；较集中的线索是专利长句里 which 引出回指性从句，其余包括经济复苏、固定短语 rate/matter、显示特性、刊物介绍及书目缩写。

patterns.name: which 引导定语从句
patterns.context: 在名词或技术对象之后，引出描述其组成、位置或性质的从句；多处紧邻专利式长句结构
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明；另有小说叙述

patterns.name: which 后接 each
patterns.context: 前文列举多个部件后，以 which 回指这些部件，并接 each

patterns.name: 经济复苏表述
patterns.context: 谈及 2004 年及欧洲经济时，介词 by 引出经济复苏这一变化
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会经济政策发言

patterns.name: rate 短语
patterns.context: 人物对某地作评价时，嵌入让步或补充判断短语

patterns.name: matter 短语
patterns.context: 在括号式补充中，matter 用于“就此而言”的固定表达

patterns.name: 无眼疲劳特性
patterns.context: 说明显示元件的有益特性

patterns.name: have 的引介用法
patterns.context: 祝贺或介绍刊物首期，并用 have 引出其撰写者或完成状态

patterns.name: 引文书目中的 Vol.
patterns.context: 闪存技术参考文献中，卷号缩写 Vol. 后接期刊信息
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的参考文献

en.concept: English function words and collocational structures
en.description: Activation is scattered across various syntactic structures and fixed collocations, including as/as to, the relative clause marker which, legal that, for that matter, their place, and patent-style background statements. Most examples come from patent text, but the trigger words are not consistent.

patterns.name: As to structures
patterns.context: High activation falls on as in structures such as “such ... as ...” or “so adapted as to ...”; there are also weaker examples of “so as to”

patterns.name: Which in patent introductions
patterns.context: In patent background paragraphs, introducing the aspect addressed by the invention or introducing an “in which” clause in a long, technical-title-style sentence

patterns.name: By in patent introductions
patterns.context: Appearing immediately after an introduction to equipment or an electronic device, in “represented by personal computers”

patterns.name: Their in Oracle database contexts
patterns.context: Referring to GTTs in the expression “have their place”

patterns.name: That in legal writing
patterns.context: Introducing an emphatic statement of the court’s requirements for a common-law complaint

patterns.name: So adapted in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describing the construction or function of a weighing hopper, followed by “as to be opened and closed”

patterns.name: Matter in historical narratives
patterns.context: In the fixed parenthetical expression “for that matter”

patterns.name: Aspect to which in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Referring back to a previously mentioned use or protective function and describing the aspect addressed by the invention

7_1947.concept: 英语功能词及搭配结构
7_1947.description: 激活分散在多种句法与固定搭配中：包括 as/as to、关系从句 which、法学 that、for that matter、their place，以及专利标题式背景表述；多数来自专利文本，但触发词并不统一。

patterns.name: as to 结构
patterns.context: 高激活落在 as，出现在“such ... as ...”或“so adapted as to ...”等结构中；也有较弱的“so as to”实例
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及法律论述

patterns.name: 专利引言中的 which
patterns.context: 在专利背景段落中引出发明所针对的方面，或在技术标题式长句中引出“in which”从句

patterns.name: 专利引言中的 by
patterns.context: 紧接对设备或电子装置的介绍，出现在“represented by personal computers”中

patterns.name: Oracle 数据库语境中的 their
patterns.context: 指代 GTTs，位于“have their place”这一表达中

patterns.name: 法学中的 that
patterns.context: 引出法院对普通法起诉书要求的强调性内容

patterns.name: 技术描述中的 so adapted
patterns.context: 描述称重料斗的构造或功能，后接“as to be opened and closed”

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的 matter
patterns.context: 固定插入语“for that matter”中

patterns.name: 专利背景中的 aspect to which
patterns.context: 回指前文提及的用途或保护作用，说明发明所针对的方面

en.description: Activations span many text types, often falling on referential expressions such as it and that, degree or limiting phrases, dash-delimited additions, formula-ending markers, and fixed colloquial phrases; topic-shift expressions also appear. Their positions and functions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final demonstrative it
patterns.context: In English discussion or exposition, activation falls on the demonstrative pronouns it and that and nearby phrases; the exact syntactic position varies.

patterns.name: Emphatic qualifiers or degree expressions
patterns.context: When describing a property or manner, qualifiers, degree words, and adjacent noun phrases activate.

patterns.name: Supplement or explanation introduced by a dash
patterns.context: An explanation, supplement, or rhetorical aside follows a dash; activations are distributed over the dash and subsequent words.
patterns.domain: Academic text, historical narrative, or speeches

patterns.name: Structural markers in formula environments
patterns.context: The end of a LaTeX aligned mathematical environment and adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Colloquial phrase “hands down”
patterns.context: A fixed colloquial expression in forum comments that signals emphatic agreement or emphasis.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial shift to a new topic
patterns.context: An infinitival or contrastive expression appears at the beginning of a sentence or at a topic shift.

7_1947.description: 激活跨越多种文本，常落在 it、that 等指示表达、程度或限定短语、破折号补充、公式结束标记及口语固定短语；另见话题转换表达。各处位置与功能不统一。

patterns.name: 句末指示词 it
patterns.trigger: 段 10 的 «it»9，段 8 的 «point»9 后接 it；段 1 的 «that»4 «reason»10
patterns.context: 英语讨论或说明中，激活落在指示代词 it、that 及其附近的短语上；具体句法位置不完全一致

patterns.name: 强调性限定词或程度表达
patterns.context: 描述特性或方式时，限定词、程度词及邻近名词短语出现激活

patterns.name: 破折号引出的补充或说明
patterns.context: 破折号后接解释、补充或修辞性插入内容，激活分布在破折号及其后续词语
patterns.domain: 学术文本、历史叙述或演说

patterns.name: 公式环境中的结构标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式的 aligned 环境结束处及其相邻标点

patterns.name: 口语短语 hands down
patterns.context: 论坛评论中表示明确赞同或强调的固定口语表达

patterns.name: 句首转入新话题
patterns.context: 句首或话题转换处使用不定式/转折性表达

en.description: Activation is scattered across examples and illustrative expressions, evaluations of properties and outcomes, discussions of time zones, promotional proper names, source-code declarations, and literary language; highlighted words in patent and commentary excerpts also lack a consistent shared pattern.

patterns.name: Example-introducing expressions
patterns.context: Introducing examples, features, or uses in explanatory text; the relevant spans are often followed directly by a specific noun or property.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and technical descriptions; also general narrative and HackerNews technical discussions

patterns.name: Expressions evaluating degree or outcome
patterns.context: Evaluating the degree of a product property, choice, prospect, or performance; the trigger falls on an evaluative word or a nearby word.
patterns.domain: Novel dialogue, technical discussions, patent descriptions, event promotions, and performance reviews

patterns.name: Time/time-zone expressions
patterns.context: Discussing how to combine local time with a time-zone identifier to obtain a unique time representation; highlighting also falls on «case» in a code context.

patterns.name: Examples and transitions in patent arguments
patterns.context: First stating the limitations of a material or approach, then using an example to illustrate potential uses; overlaps with the general example pattern, but activation in this passage is concentrated near «for example».

patterns.name: Proper names or name fragments
patterns.context: In an event-promotion context, the proper name Diane Gilman Trunk Show appears alongside a series introduction; the highlighted word is not a stable general-purpose phrase.

patterns.name: Code declarations and punctuation
patterns.context: Near a C++ class declaration, including a constructor parameter list, semicolon, and comment.

patterns.name: Rate expression in narrative
patterns.context: Using «at any rate» in novel dialogue to add a qualification; it appears in isolation and is difficult to unify with the other highlighted items.

7_1947.description: 激活分散在例示/举例表达、性质与结果评价、时间时区讨论、专名宣传、源码声明及文学用语中；另有专利与评论片段的高亮词缺乏稳定共同规律。

patterns.name: 例示引出语
patterns.context: 在说明性文字中引出实例、特征或用途；相关片段里常紧接具体名词或性质。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与技术说明；也见一般叙述和 HackerNews 技术讨论

patterns.name: 评价程度或结果表达
patterns.context: 对产品性质、选择、前景或表现作程度评价；触发点落在评价词或其邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 小说对话、技术讨论、专利描述、活动宣传和演出评论

patterns.name: 时间/时区表述
patterns.context: 讨论把本地时间与时区标识组合，以得到唯一时间表示；高亮也落在代码语境的 «case»。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论，提及 Python

patterns.name: 专利论述中的例示与转折
patterns.context: 先陈述材料或方案不足，再用例子说明潜在用途；与一般例示模式重叠，但本段激活集中在「for example」附近。

patterns.name: 专名或名称片段
patterns.context: 活动宣传语境中，专名 Diane Gilman Trunk Show 与系列介绍相邻；高亮词并非稳定的通用短语。

patterns.name: 代码声明与标点
patterns.context: C++ 类声明附近，包含构造函数参数列表、分号和注释。

patterns.name: 叙述中的速率词
patterns.context: 小说对话中以「at any rate」作补充或限定；孤立出现，难与其余高亮统一。

en.concept: Proper nouns and formatting markers in diverse text
en.description: Activations cover several formatting cues: academic references in patents, code containing generator names, and legal citations, time-zone discussions, stock marketing, and fitness-column introductions; no single content theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Technical paper references
patterns.context: The patent background cites journals, conference papers, or books, often including authors, volume/issue, pages, and year.

patterns.name: Generator identifiers in code
patterns.context: Code contains generator-related names; examples include C/C++ declarations and Go plugin code.

patterns.name: Legal cases and law citations
patterns.context: Lists cases, statutes, or contract-law references in sequence, including volume, page, and citation information.

patterns.name: Time zones and time representation
patterns.context: Explains how local time and identifiers can produce a consistent time-zone representation, including in a Python context.

patterns.name: Stock-news promotional language
patterns.context: An email-style advertisement invites readers to get the latest market insider information.

patterns.name: Fitness and nutrition content introduction
patterns.context: Introduces a fitness and nutrition column for readers and its author's qualifications.

7_1947.concept: 多样文本中的专名与格式标记
7_1947.description: 激活覆盖多类格式性线索：专利中的学术参考文献、含 generator 名称的代码，以及法律引文、时区讨论、股票营销和健身栏目导语；没有一个内容主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 技术论文参考文献
patterns.context: 专利背景部分引用期刊、会议论文或书籍，常带作者、卷期、页码和年份
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/学术文献引用

patterns.name: 代码中的生成器标识符
patterns.context: 代码中出现 generator 相关名称；有 C/C++ 声明，也有 Go 插件代码

patterns.name: 法律判例与法学引文
patterns.context: 连续列举判例、法典或合同法参考资料，含卷页和引证信息

patterns.name: 时区与时间表示
patterns.context: 解释如何用本地时间和标识符得到一致的时区表示，含 Python 语境

patterns.name: 股票资讯宣传语
patterns.context: 邮件式广告邀请读者获取最新市场内幕信息

patterns.name: 健身与营养内容介绍
patterns.context: 介绍面向读者的健身营养栏目及其作者资历
patterns.domain: 文章导语/健身与军事主题

en.concept: Numbering and punctuation in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to volume numbers and their numeric punctuation in bibliographic citations, extending to the numbering format of legal citations; scattered triggers also occur in technical compounds, time-zone discussions, and code initialization, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Volume, issue, and page-number format
patterns.context: In journal or technical literature citations, the abbreviation Vol is followed by a number, often accompanied by issue number No., page numbers, and a date; volume numbers and their punctuation activate strongly.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in citations
patterns.context: Dense formatting in legal citations or bibliographies, including numbers, abbreviations, periods, commas, parentheses, section symbols, and page numbers.

patterns.name: Specific compound technical terms
patterns.context: A technical title contains a compound word split into multiple tokens or an internal word boundary; activation is weak and does not appear to indicate a shared theme.

patterns.name: Type conversion and compound conditions in code
patterns.context: C/C++-style code with type conversion, compound conditions, struct-like initialization, and dense punctuation; strongest trigger is buffer.

patterns.name: Time and time-zone expressions
patterns.context: Discussing local time, time-zone identifiers, and a unique time representation; activation is concentrated on quotation marks in quoted text and the word timezone.

7_1947.concept: 结构化文本中的编号与标点
7_1947.description: 主要响应文献引文中卷号及其数字标点，并扩展到法律引文的编号格式；另有技术复合词、时区讨论和代码初始化等零散触发，缺乏统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 卷期页码格式
patterns.context: 在期刊或技术文献引文中，卷号缩写 Vol 后接数字，常伴随期号 No.、页码及日期；对卷号数字及其标点有强激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的学术引文

patterns.name: 引文中的数字与标点

en.description: The most prominent common cue is symbols expressing mapping relationships: \mapsto in mathematics and arrow functions => in code. It also activates on fixed phrases with as, Python loop colons, bibliographic volume-number formats, and several specific code and technical-discussion expressions.

patterns.name: Mapping/arrow operator
patterns.context: Represents a mapping in mathematical text or an arrow function in code; usually follows a function, parameter, or mapping expression.

patterns.name: Use or result introduced by as
patterns.context: as appears in fixed phrases expressing use, examples, or purpose.

patterns.name: Colon in a Python for statement

patterns.name: Vol. bibliographic volume-number format

patterns.name: Persistent memory allocation and return

A relatively consistent feature is the presence of structural tokens, punctuation, and formatting fragments common in technical documents, but there is no single clear semantic meaning.

en.description: Activations are distributed across commas and nearby content in code, patent citations, formulas, legal writing, marketing, encyclopedias, papers, and comments; there is no consistent semantic theme, and the feature may primarily be affected by local punctuation or text formatting.

patterns.name: Local triggers after English commas
patterns.context: The comma itself and nearby punctuation, spaces, or following words are marked; there is no stable semantic theme or fixed syntactic context. Marked positions in the snippets occur both before and after commas, so it is unclear whether commas alone trigger the feature.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and separators
patterns.context: Occurs in code expressions or test code, often adjacent to variables, function calls, and statement boundaries.

patterns.name: Patent citations and bibliographic format
patterns.context: References to patent applications or technical documents in patent background text, including fields such as numbers, titles, authors, and dates.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formal expressions
patterns.context: Definitions, sets, or function relationships represented in LaTeX in mathematical papers; activations occur on formula symbols and nearby text.

patterns.name: Jurisdictional statements in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Jurisdiction and review-standard sections of legal opinions, explaining applicable law and the venue of the case.

patterns.name: Promotional food descriptions
patterns.context: Marketing copy for foods such as cakes, using positive taste evaluations and a recommendatory tone.

patterns.name: Proper names and descriptions of locations
patterns.context: Encyclopedic descriptions identify where an event is held and its starting year; markings occur on proper names and nearby place names.

patterns.name: Discussion of experiments and observations

patterns.name: Emphatic expressions in commentary

7_1947.description: 激活分布在逗号及其邻近内容，跨代码、专利引文、公式、法律、营销、百科、论文和评论；没有一致的语义主题，可能主要受局部标点或文本格式影响。

patterns.name: 英语逗号后的局部触发
patterns.context: 逗号本身及其附近的标点、空格或后续词被标记；没有稳定的语义主题或固定句法环境。各段标记位置包括逗号前后，不能确定是否由逗号单独触发。

patterns.name: 代码标点与分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在代码表达式或测试代码中，常与变量、函数调用及语句边界相邻。

patterns.name: 专利引用与书目格式
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中的专利申请或技术文献引用，含编号、题名、作者和日期等字段。

patterns.name: 数学符号与形式化表达
patterns.context: 数学论文中以 LaTeX 表示定义、集合或函数关系；激活落在公式符号及邻近文本上。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的管辖权表述

patterns.name: 食品宣传性描述
patterns.context: 蛋糕等食品的营销文案，使用正面口感评价和推荐语气。

patterns.name: 专名与地点叙述
patterns.context: 百科叙述中介绍活动的举办地点和起始年份，标记落在专名及相邻地名上。

patterns.name: 实验与观测论述

en.description: Activations are scattered across varied contexts: common words or phrases such as you, give, find, to, from, and given, as well as legal case-citation formats and technical titles; there is no stable, unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: you in direct address or dialogue
patterns.context: The second-person pronoun refers to a conversational partner, reader, or person in general; it can appear in threatening dialogue and travel descriptions.

patterns.name: Manner/form in legal phrasing
patterns.context: Fixed or near-fixed phrases in legal documents describing the manner and form in which an action is performed.

patterns.name: Court abbreviation introducing a case citation
patterns.context: An abbreviated court name in a case citation, especially in state-court citation formats.

patterns.name: case in ‘in this case’
patterns.context: A phrase in legal reasoning referring to the case currently being heard; the activation is on case.

patterns.name: give to someone/something
patterns.context: give is followed by a recipient, expressing delivery or giving; here it occurs in threatening dialogue.

patterns.name: Intensifying phrase hit the spot
patterns.context: The fixed expression “hit the spot” in food advertising means that food is satisfying and just right.

patterns.name: Enhancing someone’s status
patterns.context: Historical narration explains the purpose of granting land; the highlighted token is the infinitive marker to.

patterns.name: find meaning discover/locate
patterns.context: Travel descriptions use you’ll find to introduce places one can see or visit locally.

patterns.name: Information from Wall Street
patterns.context: from introduces the source of information in financial email promotional copy.

patterns.name: given in a character profile
patterns.context: In a narrative, profiles were given to someone means character profiles were presented or provided to that person.

patterns.name: Speech Recognition patent title
patterns.context: A technical noun phrase in a patent citation title; activation is on the initial article A.

7_1947.description: 激活分散在多种语境：you、give、find、to、from、given 等普通词或短语，以及法律判例格式和技术标题；没有稳定统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 直接地址或对话中的 you
patterns.context: 第二人称代词指向对话对象、读者或一般人；可出现在威胁式台词和旅游介绍中。

patterns.context: 法律文书中固定或近固定的短语，描述某项行为采用的方式与形式。

patterns.name: 引出案例引文的法院缩写
patterns.context: 判例引文中的法院名称缩写，尤其是州级法院引文格式。

patterns.name: ‘in this case’中的 case
patterns.context: 法律论证中用短语指称当前审理案件；激活落在 case。

patterns.name: 给某人/某物的 give

patterns.name: 强化词 hit the spot

patterns.name: 增强某人声望

patterns.name: 发现/找到的 find

patterns.name: 来自华尔街的资讯

patterns.name: 人物轮廓的 given
patterns.context: 叙事中 profiles were given to 某人，表示人物侧影被呈现或交代给该人物。

patterns.name: Speech Recognition 专利标题

patterns.context: 专利引文标题中的技术名词短语；激活位于标题开头冠词 A。

en.concept: Formatting boundaries and local text fragments
en.description: Activation occurs across formulas, numbers, and typographic symbols in mathematics and physics papers, legal citations and boilerplate, and academic prose structures; it also appears on line breaks and intraword fragments in novels, forums, and webpages, as well as local connective words across genres.

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and formatted mathematical content
patterns.context: Formulas, variables, numbers, LaTeX markers, and line breaks in mathematical or physics texts; the specific symbols triggered differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical physics, and academic typesetting

patterns.name: Legal citations and standardized document wording
patterns.context: Statutes, legal provisions, and judicial boilerplate in legal texts; [3] leans toward statutory citations, while [7] leans toward pleadings and factual statements.

patterns.name: Academic prose and paragraph transitions
patterns.context: Phrases in academic papers that introduce the work or connect to preceding text; they coexist with formulas and subject-specific content in the same passage.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments and line breaks
patterns.context: Words split into multiple tokens or typeset across lines; visible activation falls on intraword fragments, line breaks, or adjacent formatting boundaries, without a consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Novels, forum posts, and webpage text

patterns.name: Local lexical and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Activation involves ordinary English clause-linking words or nearby local phrases, but the contexts are forum commentary, real-estate news, physics papers, and legal statements, with no clear shared semantic condition.

7_1947.concept: 格式边界与局部文本片段
7_1947.description: 激活分布于数学与物理论文中的公式、数字和排版符号，法律引用及文书套语，论文叙述句式；另见小说、论坛和网页文本中的断行、词内片段，以及跨文体的局部衔接词。

patterns.name: 数字、符号及格式化数学内容
patterns.context: 数学或物理文本中的公式、变量、数字、LaTeX 标记及换行等结构化符号；不同片段中具体被触发的符号并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 法律引用与规范化文书措辞
patterns.context: 法律文本中的法规、法条和司法文书套语；[3]偏向法规引用，[7]偏向诉状及事实陈述。

patterns.name: 论文叙述与段落衔接
patterns.context: 学术论文介绍本文工作或承接前文的句式；与同段公式、学科内容并存。

patterns.name: 单词内部片段与断行
patterns.context: 词被切成多个 token，或跨行排版；可见的激活落在词内片段、断行或相邻格式边界，未呈现一致的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 小说、论坛文章及网页文本

patterns.name: 局部词汇及句法片段
patterns.context: 激活涉及普通英语从句衔接词或邻近的局部短语，但语境分别是论坛评论、房地产新闻、物理论文与法律陈述，缺少明确统一的语义条件。

en.concept: Structural cue words in written language
en.description: Activations are scattered across several structures: nouns such as manner/form/field, paper discourse markers, fixed legal phrases, narrative movement and discovery of places, and mathematical expressions of negative numbers. More prominent local triggers include in a manner and in this paper/work.

patterns.name: Emphasis on abstract nouns such as manner/field/form/section
patterns.context: Activations occur on common nouns denoting manner, form, field, or work, especially after a preposition or determiner; these can appear in legal, patent, forum, and academic texts.

patterns.name: Direction and interpersonal relations in narrative
patterns.context: Narrative describes characters moving, sitting down, or facing others, and includes the structure “profiles were given to”; triggers include prepositions and their following noun phrases.

patterns.name: Finding/discovering in descriptions of places
patterns.context: In travel or place descriptions, the subject is “you,” followed by places such as cafes that can be found.

patterns.name: Variable coefficients in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a number, variable, or equation in a formula or algebraic expression; activation may occur on the number token of a negative number.

patterns.name: Time/discourse markers in paper introductions
patterns.context: Academic abstracts use discourse markers to introduce research background, the work in the paper, or its contents; activations are distributed over the marker, work/paper, and nearby commas.

patterns.name: Fixed citation phrases in legal documents
patterns.context: Pleadings, responses, or evidence descriptions use formal fixed structures such as “incorporated herein,” “by reference,” and “in the manner and form.”

patterns.name: Technical manner structure in patents
patterns.context: Patent descriptions explain how technical components or systems are arranged, constructed, or operated; “manner” is introduced by “in a” and followed by a specific mode of operation.

7_1947.concept: 书面语中的结构性提示词
7_1947.description: 激活分散在多种结构：方式/形式/领域等名词、论文篇章指示语、法律固定套语、叙事移动与地点发现、数学负数表达；较突出的局部触发包括 in a manner、in this paper/work。

patterns.name: manner/field/form/section 等抽象名词前的强调
patterns.context: 激活落在表示方式、形式、领域或工作的常见名词上，尤其处于介词或限定结构之后；可在法律、专利、论坛及学术文本中出现。

patterns.name: 叙事中的方向与人物关系
patterns.trigger: « to»10 the«；« into»3« a»5« chair»4« and»2« sat»3
patterns.context: 叙事描写人物移动、就座、面对他人，且出现“profiles were given to”这一结构；触发包含介词及其后续名词短语。

patterns.name: 地点描写中的发现/找到
patterns.context: 旅游或地点介绍中，主语为“you”，后接可找到的咖啡馆等场所。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量系数
patterns.context: 公式或代数表达式中，负号与数字、变量或等式相邻；激活可能落在负数的数字 token 上。

patterns.name: 论文引言中的时间/篇章指示词
patterns.trigger: « Since»6；« In»3« this»6« work»8«,»9；« In»1« this»4« paper»7«,»9
patterns.context: 学术摘要中用篇章标记引出研究背景、本文工作或论文内容；激活分布在指示词、work/paper 及逗号附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书的固定引用套语
patterns.trigger: « herein»5；« by»5 reference；« in»5 the« manner»10 and« form»7
patterns.context: 诉状、答辩或证据说明中使用“incorporated herein”“by reference”“in the manner and form”等正式固定结构。

patterns.name: 专利中的技术方式结构
patterns.trigger: « in»4« a»4« manner»10；« in»4 a« manner»10 that
patterns.context: 专利说明技术部件或系统如何布置、构造或运行；“manner”由“in a”引出，后接具体工作方式。

en.description: Activations occur in locations such as where after formulas, legal citations and this case, to in narratives, technical comments, travel descriptions, weather forecasts, and stock phrases in paper abstracts; no common trigger form explains all snippets.

patterns.name: where in formulas or mathematical contexts
patterns.context: A LaTeX mathematical expression or display equation precedes where, which then introduces explanations of symbols, factors, or functions; activations occur near the formula closing marker and where.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers, abbreviations, and periods appear in citations to case-report numbers and page numbers in court decisions or opinions; activations concentrate on citation-format punctuation.

patterns.name: to in multiword phrases
patterns.context: In narrative prose, to introduces a person or object; in this example, activation is concentrated on to in an infinitive or prepositional phrase.

patterns.name: this case in legal documents
patterns.context: In judicial documents stating jurisdiction, applicable law, and case facts, this case refers to the current case; nearby content also includes a state name and legal analysis.

patterns.name: times in technical discussion
patterns.context: In discussions of data technologies such as Spark and Hadoop, times evaluates whether a technology is outdated, followed by discussion of its features.

patterns.name: find in place descriptions
patterns.context: Travel or place descriptions tell readers where they can find facilities such as cafes near a street or attraction.

patterns.name: will in weather forecasts
patterns.context: Weather forecasts describe the day's weather, sunshine, and wind conditions; activation is on the future-tense auxiliary will.

patterns.name: this work in technology abstracts
patterns.context: Academic abstracts use this work to refer to the research when introducing its goals or methods; this example concerns plasmonic nanoparticle trapping.

7_1947.description: 激活分散于公式后 where、法律引文与 this case、叙事中的 to、技术评论、旅游介绍、天气预报及论文摘要套语等位置；尚无共同触发形式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 公式或数学环境中的 where
patterns.context: 前面有 LaTeX 数学表达式或 display equation，随后用 where 引出符号、因子或函数的说明；激活落在公式结束标记及 where 附近。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 法律判决或意见书中，引用案件报告编号、页码时出现数字、缩写和句点；激活集中在引文格式标点。

patterns.name: 多词组中的 to
patterns.context: 叙事散文中，to 引出人物或对象；本例激活集中在不定式/介词短语中的 to。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 this case
patterns.context: 司法文书陈述管辖权、适用法律及案件事实时，this case 指当前案件；附近还有州名和法律分析。

patterns.name: 技术讨论中的 times
patterns.context: 讨论 Spark、Hadoop 等数据技术时，以 times 评价技术是否过时，随后谈及技术特征。

patterns.name: 地点介绍中的 find
patterns.context: 旅游或地点介绍中，向读者说明在街道或景点附近能找到咖啡馆等设施。

patterns.name: 天气预报中的 will
patterns.context: 天气预报描述当天的天气、阳光和风况；激活在未来时态助动词 will。

patterns.name: 科技摘要中的 this work
patterns.context: 学术摘要介绍研究目标或方法时，用 this work 指代本文研究；本例主题是等离激元纳米颗粒捕获。

en.description: Activations are most clearly concentrated on «supra» in U.S. legal case citations; there are also sporadic activations on «herein» in legal documents and common words such as «in», «it», and «to». The remaining triggers in fiction, mathematics, and online text are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: supra in legal citations
patterns.context: Refers back to a case cited earlier in a case citation; several snippets also include case names and page-number formats, but activation is concentrated on «supra».
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: herein in legal text
patterns.context: Refers to this document or its contents in formal legal documents.

patterns.name: Preposition in
patterns.context: May be an ordinary preposition in legal statements and also appears in mathematical notation explanations; no unified local collocation explains the activation.

patterns.name: Connector to
patterns.context: Appears in an explanation of mathematical notation, specifically “«to» 2^{X^*}”; this activation may be related to an inequality or formula structure.

patterns.name: Common pronouns and colloquial phrasing
patterns.context: The pronoun it recurs in everyday conversation; activation locations are scattered, with no clear semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Online colloquial language or life advice

patterns.name: there is construction
patterns.context: Appears in the aphoristic expression “behind every great man «there» is a great woman”.

patterns.name: Other unclear words and punctuation
patterns.context: Occur in fiction, legal formats, and general articles; the available context is insufficient to identify a common trigger condition.

7_1947.concept: 法律文书中的回指表达
7_1947.description: 激活最清楚地集中在美国法律判例引证中的 «supra»；另在法律文书 «herein» 及若干常见词（如 «in»、«it»、«to»）上有零散激活。小说、数学和网络文本中的其余触发点难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 supra
patterns.trigger: «supra»（常与紧邻的案名、引文页码或 «at» 连用）
patterns.context: 判例引证中回指前文已引用的案件；多段还出现案名与页码格式，但激活点集中在 «supra»。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 herein
patterns.context: 正式法律文书中指代本文件或其中内容。
patterns.domain: 法律诉状或合同式文书

patterns.name: 介词 in
patterns.context: 可能是法律语句中的普通介词，也出现在数学记号说明中；没有统一的局部搭配可解释激活。

patterns.name: 连接词 to
patterns.context: 出现在数学定义的符号说明中，具体为“«to» 2^{X^*}”；该激活可能与不等式或公式结构有关。

patterns.name: 常见代词与口语句式
patterns.context: 日常对话中反复出现代词 it；激活位置分散，未见明确语义条件。

patterns.name: there is 结构
patterns.context: 出现在格言式表达“behind every great man «there» is a great woman”中。

patterns.name: 其他未明晰的词与标点
patterns.context: 分别处于小说叙述、法律格式和一般文章中；现有上下文不足以确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 小说、法律文本、网络文章

en.description: Primarily responds to case citations, supra/page numbers, and formal procedural language in legal documents, often covering punctuation and numeric fragments; there is also activation near Delta in one LaTeX mathematical formula.

patterns.name: Page numbers and statutory citations after legal citations
patterns.context: In legal opinions or pleadings, a case name is followed by a supra reference or other cross-reference, court, and volume/page information; activation often falls on supra, the following number, and adjacent punctuation/prepositions

patterns.name: Fixed wording and procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Formal legal expressions in pleadings, opinions, or legal arguments; triggers include procedural terms, qualifying language, and terms of legal argument

patterns.name: Paired numbers and numeric fragments in citation formats
patterns.context: Page numbers, years, volume numbers, and reporter formats in legal citations; some activation falls inside numeric strings or immediately after them

patterns.name: Citation markers and surrounding punctuation
patterns.context: Activation appears around case names, abbreviations, periods, and quotation marks when an opinion cites another case; this co-occurs with legal citation formatting

patterns.name: Delta symbol in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Activation near the Delta symbol and command boundaries in a mathematical formula’s LaTeX/alignment environment

7_1947.description: 主要响应法律文书中案件引文、supra/页码及正式程序措辞，常覆盖标点和数字片段；另在一处 LaTeX 数学公式的 Delta 附近激活。

patterns.name: 法律引文后的页码与法条引用
patterns.trigger: « supra»10、« supra»9、« at»3、« 547»3、« 407»；常见引文格式如“案件名«,» supra«,» 页码”
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状中，案件名后接 supra 等回指引文、法院与卷页信息；激活常落在 supra、其后的数字及相邻标点/介词

patterns.name: 法律文书中的固定措辞与程序词
patterns.trigger: « herein»6、« manner»9、« incorporated»3、« reference»、« allegations»、« must»；以及« to»2« defendant's« case»
patterns.context: 诉状、判决或法律论证中的正式法律表达；触发点包括程序性词语、限定性措辞和法律论证词

patterns.name: 成对数字及引文格式中的数字片段
patterns.context: 法律引文中的页码、年代、卷号与报告集格式，部分激活落在数字串内部或其后

patterns.name: 引文标记及其周边标点
patterns.context: 判决引用他案时，案件名、缩写、句点和引号等紧邻位置出现激活；与法律引文格式共同出现

patterns.name: 数学排版中的 Delta 符号
patterns.context: 数学公式的 LaTeX/对齐环境中，Delta 符号及其命令边界附近激活

en.concept: Proper names and terminology fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations are scattered across legal case citations, technical or mathematical terminology, source-code identifiers, and astrophysics reference formats; there is no single stable semantic trigger, and activations often occur within words or near structured formats.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case formats
patterns.context: Legal discussion includes case or document names, commas, and citation markers, often including supra and volume/page information; activations may occur within names or near citation formats

patterns.name: Specific word segments in technical terms
patterns.context: In technical or mathematical explanations, relevant words appear in longer terms or ordinary prose; some activations occur on substrings within words

patterns.name: Code identifiers and type names
patterns.context: In code declarations or member-access contexts, activations concentrate within identifiers or on type/member names

patterns.name: Astrophysics bibliographic format
patterns.context: Formatting of author names, abbreviations, years, and journal volume/page information in astronomy references

7_1947.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与术语片段
7_1947.description: 激活散布于法律判例引文、技术或数学术语、源码标识符及天体物理参考文献格式中；未见单一稳定语义触发词，常落在词内片段或结构化格式附近。

patterns.name: 法律引文与判例格式
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现判例或文献名称、逗号及引文标记，常见 supra、卷页信息等；激活可能落在名称内部或引文格式附近

patterns.name: 技术名词中的特定词段
patterns.context: 技术或数学说明中，相关词出现在较长术语或普通叙述中；部分激活落在词内子串

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类型名称
patterns.context: 代码声明或成员访问语境中，激活集中于标识符内部或类型/成员名称

patterns.name: 天体物理文献格式
patterns.context: 天文学参考文献条目中，作者姓名、缩写、年份及期刊卷页的排版格式

en.description: Activations span legal citations, patent devices and processes, abstract discussions of the self/purification, and a few general syntactic fragments. Legal cross-references and technical structural descriptions are relatively concentrated, but no single semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case references
patterns.context: Case discussions include cross-references such as “supra,” case names, and citation information; activations often occur on supra and parts of case names.

patterns.name: Patent process steps and device structure
patterns.context: Patent technical descriptions list semiconductor device regions, electrodes, structures, or manufacturing steps, especially consecutive component limitations and process steps.

patterns.name: Phrases describing abstract qualities or states
patterns.context: General discussion concerns abstract qualities such as personal value and self-esteem, or purification and the true self; triggers concentrate on relevant concept words and following phrases.

patterns.name: Modal be and following complements
patterns.context: be/are or modal constructions connect a sentence to a state, quality, or identity complement; evidence is sporadic, and activations do not always fall on the same word.

patterns.name: Procedural, causal, and result statements
patterns.context: Describes how a result arises from a procedure, causal relation, or sequence of steps; some descriptions concern legal causation or procedure, others technical manufacturing.

patterns.name: it/pronouns and subsequent explanations in phrases
patterns.context: A pronoun refers to an entity or state mentioned earlier and is followed by a question, explanation, or expression of preference; seen in only one passage and not reliably linked to the other high-activation examples.

7_1947.description: 激活分布跨法律引文、专利器件与工艺、抽象自我/净化论述及少量一般句法片段。可见法律交叉引用和技术结构描述较集中，但无法用单一语义模式解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 法律引文与判例引用
patterns.trigger: « supra»10«,»6« expressly»2；« Mark«ham»5«,»4« supra»10；«Pool« Markets»2«,»5« supra«9
patterns.context: 判例讨论中出现“supra”等交叉引用、案件名和引文信息；激活常落在 supra 及案件名片段。

patterns.name: 专利工艺步骤与器件结构
patterns.trigger: « electrode»4；« conduction« region»5；« first impurity« region»7；« grooves» 111…« mark»1
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中列举半导体器件的区域、电极、结构或制造步骤，尤其是连续的构件限定与工艺过程。

patterns.name: 描述抽象性质或状态的词组
patterns.trigger: self-worth« that»3 concerns him« as»3« "»3self-respect；pur«ifying»…« to»5« be»3« who»3« we»10« truly
patterns.context: 一般论述中讨论个人价值、自尊或净化、真实自我等抽象性质；触发位置集中在相关概念词及其后续短语。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、灵性/身心健康文章

patterns.name: 情态助动词 be 与后续补语
patterns.trigger: needs to« be»1 malleable；« be»3« who»3；will not cause…；« are» older
patterns.context: 句子中 be/are 或情态结构连接状态、性质或身份补语；证据零散，激活并不总落在同一个词上。

patterns.name: 程序性、因果性与结果表述
patterns.trigger: causation is« established»2« by»2；« forming»4…« region»10；« step»…« process»3
patterns.context: 叙述某结果如何由程序、因果关系或连续步骤产生；有的描述法律因果或程序，有的描述技术制造。

patterns.name: 短语中的 it / 代词及其后续说明
patterns.context: 代词指向前文实体或状态，后接疑问、说明或偏好表达；仅见于一段，且无法与其余高激活稳定对应。

en.description: Most snippets come from U.S. legal documents and commonly feature supra cross-references, case citations, and formal argumentative language; there are also a few to constructions, spiritual identity statements, philosophical book proofs, and mathematical formulas. Activations are not limited to a single word form.

patterns.name: supra in statutory and case citations
patterns.context: Legal reasoning refers back to a case or source cited earlier, typically followed by the case name, citation number, page number, or other citation information; activations may occur on supra and surrounding citation tokens
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Conventional transitions in legal citations and judicial reasoning
patterns.context: Occurs in argumentation, case citations, or procedural narration in formal legal texts; some examples do not include supra but still contain legal citations or judicial language

patterns.name: Infinitive or prepositional structures introduced by to
patterns.context: In legal or general prose, to is followed by a bare verb, noun phrase, or other complement; only a few snippets show clear activation

patterns.name: be and identity/existence statements
patterns.context: be occurs in philosophical/spiritual statements about the true self, purification, or identity

patterns.name: Academic philosophical terminology and bibliographic layout
patterns.context: Main text of philosophical works is adjacent to page headers, page numbers, and other proof layout elements
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers or academic book proofs

patterns.name: Optimization and summation symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In formulaic machine-learning or mathematical text, activations are distributed across formula symbols, variables, and subscript/superscript tokens

patterns.name: Language of harm and remedies in legal passages
patterns.context: Discusses damages, remedies, or legal consequences; overlaps with other legal citation patterns but is not triggered by supra alone
patterns.domain: Case law and legal discussion of damages

7_1947.description: 多数片段来自美国法律文书，常见 supra 回指、判例引证及正式论证措辞；另有少数 to 结构、灵性身份表述、哲学校样和数学公式。激活并非仅限单一词形。

patterns.name: 法条判例引证中的 supra
patterns.trigger: « supra»9/10/8/5，及其后的引证或页码，如“supra9, 6”“supra10”“supra9, 5”“supra8”
patterns.context: 法律论证中回指前文已引用的案件或资料，通常紧接案件名、引证编号、页码或其他引证信息；激活可落在 supra 及周边引证 token 上

patterns.name: 法律引文与司法论证中的惯用衔接
patterns.trigger: 例如“According to”“in [案名]”“indicated that”“it has been held”“Pursuant to”“will not preclude recovery”，以及引文、案名和法条相关 token
patterns.context: 处于正式法律文本的论证、判例引用或程序性叙述中；部分例子没有 supra，但仍出现法律引证或司法措辞

patterns.name: 由 to 引出的不定式或介词结构
patterns.trigger: “to5 be”“to3 be”“prior to administering”“Pursuant to the remand”“to5”
patterns.context: 法律或一般散文中，to 后接动词原形、名词短语或其他补足成分；仅少数片段有明显激活

patterns.name: be 与身份/存在表述
patterns.trigger: “we are indeed purifying ourselves to be who we truly are”，尤其“be3”“who9”“truly5 are5”
patterns.context: be 位于关于真实自我、净化或身份的哲学／灵性陈述中

patterns.name: 学术哲学术语及书目版面
patterns.context: 哲学论著正文与校样页眉、页码等排版信息相邻
patterns.domain: 哲学论文或学术书籍校样

patterns.name: 数学公式中的优化与求和符号
patterns.context: 公式化机器学习或数学文本，激活分散在公式符号、变量和上下标 token 上
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／机器学习论文

patterns.name: 法律段落中的损害与救济措辞
patterns.trigger: “consequential damages”“probability of damage”“amount will not preclude recovery”“retroactive application”
patterns.context: 讨论损害赔偿、救济或法律后果；与其他法律引证模式重叠，但并非由 supra 单独触发

en.description: Activation spans several text types: it is most concentrated in legal case citations and also appears in legal content about bankruptcy, causation, retroactive application, and the lethal capacity of weapons; it also responds to section guides in papers, spiritual expressions, home repairs, physics terminology, and algebraic simplification, with no unified specific semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Case names and supra in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal argument cites a previously mentioned case, often within or at the end of a sentence; activation is concentrated on the citation structure and nearby case name.

patterns.name: Discourse guides to paragraphs or sections
patterns.context: An author states what a section will present or discuss, usually at the beginning of a section.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, or other academic papers

patterns.name: Spiritual expression emphasizing “who we are”
patterns.context: Using the first-person plural to express self-purification, true nature, or spiritual practice.

patterns.name: Damage and repair of materials or objects
patterns.context: Describing home construction, a repair project, or related damage.

patterns.name: Comparison of creditor recoveries in bankruptcy proceedings
patterns.context: Comparing the amounts secured creditors recover under different bankruptcy proceedings.

patterns.name: Retroactive application of legal rules and judicial administration
patterns.context: Assessing whether retroactive application of a rule would disrupt the administration of justice.

patterns.name: Transaction causation and proxy solicitation
patterns.context: Discussing whether a proxy solicitation can satisfy the transaction-causation requirement and citing circuit-court cases.

patterns.name: Legal determination of whether a weapon is lethal
patterns.context: Assessing whether an indictment sufficiently alleges that a weapon is capable of causing death when used as intended.
patterns.domain: Criminal law or criminal procedure opinions

patterns.name: Exchange interactions in physics
patterns.context: Describing a physical mechanism involving magnetic acceptor ions and the valence band, and referring to a figure.

patterns.name: Instruction to simplify an algebraic expression
patterns.context: An instruction to simplify a symbolic algebraic expression; the specific formula is truncated.

7_1947.description: 激活跨多类文本：法律判例引证最集中，也见破产、因果关系、追溯适用和武器致死能力等法律内容；另响应论文的章节导引、灵性表达、房屋修缮、物理术语及代数化简，缺少统一的具体语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案名与 supra
patterns.trigger: “in”后接案件名，再接“,”和“supra”，如 “in Markham, supra”
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用先前提及的判例，常见于句中或句末；激活集中在引证结构及案名附近。

patterns.name: 段落或章节的篇章导引
patterns.context: 作者说明本节将呈现或讨论的内容，通常位于章节开头。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理或其他学术论文

patterns.name: 强调“我们是谁”的灵性表达
patterns.context: 以第一人称复数表达自我净化、真实本性或精神修行。

patterns.name: 材料或物件的损坏、修缮
patterns.trigger: “repairs included”及“removal of roofing, sheetrock, and wallpaper”
patterns.context: 描述房屋施工、修复项目或相关损害。
patterns.domain: 法律事实陈述、房屋维修

patterns.name: 破产程序中的债权人受偿比较
patterns.trigger: “secured creditor receive as much … in chapter 13 … as … in … chapter 7”
patterns.context: 比较不同破产程序下有担保债权人的受偿金额。

patterns.name: 法律规则的追溯适用与司法管理
patterns.trigger: “retroactive application”及“disruption of the administration of justice”
patterns.context: 评估规则追溯适用是否会扰乱司法运行。

patterns.name: 交易因果关系与招揽投票
patterns.trigger: “causation is established by the mere solicitation of votes”
patterns.context: 讨论投票招揽能否满足交易因果关系要求，并援引巡回法院判例。

patterns.name: 武器是否足以致死的法律判断
patterns.trigger: “named weapon or instrument”与“capable of causing death”
patterns.context: 判断起诉指控是否充分描述武器按预期方式使用时具有致死能力。

patterns.name: 物理学中的交换相互作用
patterns.trigger: “p-d exchange interaction with magnetic acceptor ions”
patterns.context: 描述磁性受主离子与价带相关的物理机制，并提及图示。

patterns.name: 代数式化简指令
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”后接含变量 u 的幂、除法表达式
patterns.context: 要求对符号代数表达式进行化简；具体公式有截断。

en.concept: Markers in structured academic and legal text
en.description: Activations concentrate on citation cross-references in court decisions, especially supra, and legal reasoning; they also occur in section overviews and formula strings in papers, purification/purifying in spiritual texts, and complex algebraic expressions in math problems.

patterns.name: supra in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal opinions or decisions refer back to previously cited cases or authorities, usually within a citation string; “supra” is the most prominent trigger

patterns.name: Section overviews and content introductions
patterns.context: The body of a paper introduces what the section will present or discuss; also includes contexts adjacent to section headings, abstracts, or structural markers

patterns.name: Symbols and operator strings in mathematical/technical formulas
patterns.context: Around formulas or mathematical expressions; sometimes followed by an explanation of variable conditions
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics/technical papers and math problems

patterns.name: Words for purification and self-transformation
patterns.context: Statements linking purification rituals or inner purification with becoming one's true self

patterns.name: General legal reasoning and judicial language
patterns.context: Discusses legal rules, causation, court opinions, case procedures, or remedies; some snippets also contain prominent supra citations

patterns.name: Substrings within English word forms
patterns.context: The trigger seems to occur inside a word rather than as a standalone word; seen only in passages discussing purification

7_1947.concept: 结构化学术与法律文本标记
7_1947.description: 激活集中于法律判决中引证回指（尤为 supra）及法律论证；另见论文的章节导览和公式符号串、灵性文本中的 purification/purifying，以及数学题的复杂代数式。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的 supra
patterns.trigger: « supra»9，常与人名或案件名及引证标点相邻，如“Palmer», supra”“Markham», supra”“Schlick», supra”
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决中回指先前引用的判例/权威，通常出现在引证串中；“supra”是最突出的触发项

patterns.name: 章节导览与内容介绍
patterns.context: 论文正文介绍本节将呈现或讨论的内容；也包括紧邻章节标题、摘要或章节结构标记的语境

patterns.name: 数学/技术公式中的符号与运算串
patterns.trigger: 公式记号与复杂符号串，如“$$\min”“\sum”“A_i”“$\alpha$”及嵌套幂、分式
patterns.context: 公式或数学表达式周围；有时后接对变量条件的说明
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/技术论文及数学题目

patterns.name: 净化与自我转化词语
patterns.context: 把净化仪式或内在净化与成为真实自我联系起来的陈述

patterns.name: 一般法律论证与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: “The Supreme Court”“indicated”“declined to endorse”“We find no error”“Pursuant to the remand”等
patterns.context: 讨论法律规则、因果关系、法院意见、案件程序或救济；部分片段也同时含有显著的 supra 引证

patterns.name: 英文词形内部的子串
patterns.context: 触发似乎落在单词内部，而非独立词；只见于谈论净化的段落

en.description: Activation occurs across unrelated token sequences, paper section-title introductions, mind-body purification, self-esteem, memory circuits, algebraic simplification, C++ type definitions, vaccine evaluation, and home-repair case law; trigger cues vary across domains.

patterns.name: Garbled or random token sequences
patterns.context: Many unrelated short tokens, byte pairs, or words appear consecutively, with little readable semantic content; line breaks are also marked.

patterns.name: Section headings and section introductions
patterns.context: Academic text explicitly introduces what a section will present, often containing words such as section, present, and procedure.

patterns.name: Self-purification and the true self
patterns.context: Discussing samskara and purification of the mind and body, with the goal of becoming one’s true self.

patterns.name: Memory circuits and transistors
patterns.context: Describing connections or control relationships among global word lines, local bit lines, and transistors in memory.

patterns.name: Self-worth and self-esteem
patterns.context: Discussing concepts such as self-worth and self-esteem and citing scholars or literature.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and symbolic operations
patterns.context: An expression composed of variables, powers, parentheses, and division, with an instruction to simplify or perform algebraic operations.

patterns.name: C++ type-definition code
patterns.context: C++ template code defining a type alias and involving Kernel, traits, and their member types.

patterns.name: Evaluation of a vaccine program
patterns.context: Stating that the project’s primary goal is to evaluate the effect of the BCG vaccine on children as quickly as possible.

patterns.name: Home repairs and consequential-damage case
patterns.context: Legal discussion lists home repair costs and cites a case involving property damage.

7_1947.description: 激活分布于杂乱 token 序列、论文节标题导读、身心净化、自尊、存储器线路、代数化简、C++ 类型定义、疫苗评估及房屋维修判例等，跨域且触发线索各异。

patterns.name: 乱码或随机 token 序列
patterns.context: 大量彼此无关的短 token、字节对或词片连续出现，缺少可读语义内容；换行也被标记。

patterns.name: 章节标题与章节导读
patterns.trigger: « this»1« section»10；«Renormalisation» procedure；«We»3« present»2« in»4« this»2« section»10
patterns.context: 学术文本明确介绍某节将呈现的内容或材料，常出现 section、present、procedure 等词。

patterns.name: 自我净化与真实自我
patterns.trigger: «pur»1ifying« ourselves»2« to»5« be»3« who»4« we»10« truly»6« are»4
patterns.context: 讨论 samskara、净化身心，并以成为真实的自己为目标。

patterns.name: 存储器线路与晶体管
patterns.trigger: global word line；local bit lines；«131»3 to« 138»9；«control»1
patterns.context: 描述存储器中全局字线、局部位线和晶体管之间的连接或控制关系。

patterns.name: 自我价值与自尊
patterns.context: 讨论自我价值与自尊等概念，并引用学者或文献。

patterns.name: 代数式与符号运算
patterns.context: 出现变量、幂、括号和除法构成的表达式，要求化简或进行代数运算。

patterns.name: C++ 类型定义代码
patterns.context: C++ 模板代码中定义类型别名，涉及 Kernel、traits 及其成员类型。

patterns.name: 疫苗计划的效果评估
patterns.trigger: « the»2 programme is to evaluate« in»2 an exped«ient»5« manner»9 the effectiveness of BCG vaccination
patterns.context: 说明项目的主要目标是尽快评估 BCG 疫苗对儿童的效果。

patterns.name: 房屋维修与附带损害案例
patterns.trigger: repairs« included»2 additional charges；« removal of roofing, sheetrock»；« Palmer»1«,»5« supra»9
patterns.context: 法律论述列举房屋维修费用，并援引涉及房屋损害的判例。

en.concept: Software library and technical documentation vocabulary
en.description: Primarily responds to software-library-related expressions; also activates in test-pass comments, increases and biochemical topics in medical abstracts, and HTTP request-header configuration.

patterns.name: Library and software-library descriptions
patterns.context: Mentions a software library in a question, project introduction, documentation, or code comment; may include platform, language, or purpose details.
patterns.domain: Software development, technical Q&A, and project documentation

patterns.name: Test-pass expression
patterns.context: Appears in a comment in a Python test class.

patterns.name: “increased” in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Describes an increase in experimental yield or an increase in care needs over time.

patterns.name: “IgA production” fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a medical-abstract fragment about the effect induced by a chemical substance.

patterns.name: Enzyme activity and urine
patterns.context: Serves as the topic description of a prospective study.

patterns.name: HTTP request header
patterns.context: In a JSON-style request configuration, the Accept value ends with a wildcard media type and “q=.2”.

7_2170.concept: 软件库与技术文档词汇
7_2170.description: 主要响应软件库相关表述；另在测试通过注释、医学摘要中的增加及生化主题、HTTP 请求头配置中激活。

patterns.name: 库与软件库描述
patterns.trigger: “library”，包括“3rd party library”“JavaScript library”“imaging library”“Foundation library”
patterns.context: 在提问、项目介绍、文档或代码注释中提到软件库；可伴随平台、语言或用途说明。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、技术问答与项目文档

patterns.name: 测试通过表述
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 测试类的注释中。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的 increased
patterns.trigger: “increased”，分别见“increased hydrogen peroxide production”和“increased during”
patterns.context: 描述实验结果中的产量增加，或护理需求随时间增加。

patterns.name: IgA production 片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学物质诱导效应的医学摘要片段中。

patterns.name: 酶活性与尿液
patterns.context: 作为前瞻性研究的主题描述。

patterns.name: HTTP 请求头
patterns.trigger: “headers”以及“Accept”字段和 MIME 类型值
patterns.context: JSON 风格的请求配置中，Accept 值末尾含通配符媒体类型及“q=.2”。

en.description: Primarily responds to library phrases in software contexts; it also activates on expressions of increase, biomedical term fragments, and Python test comments, which are difficult to group under a single sense pattern.

patterns.name: library phrases
patterns.context: library appears in software, code, or documentation contexts, usually referring to a reusable software library; activation falls on library, with some activation on surrounding words.
patterns.domain: Q&A, HackerNews, software documentation, and code comments

patterns.name: Expressions of increase/enhancement
patterns.context: Describes some quantity, activity, or degree of complexity increasing over time or under certain conditions; this pattern differs from the software-library context.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: Triggered by subword fragments within words and adjacent medical terms; the former concerns induced IgA production, while the latter concerns a study of urinary enzyme activity. They show no clear shared lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Code test comments
patterns.context: Comments at the tops of Python test files and within test classes; activation centers on comment symbols and test-related wording. It partially overlaps with library phrases only in the code-documentation context.

7_2170.description: 主要响应软件语境中的 library 短语；另对 increased 增加表述、生物医学术语片段，以及 Python 测试注释有激活，后几类难以归入同一词义模式。

patterns.name: library 短语
patterns.trigger: «library»（含“3rd party library”“JavaScript library”“imaging library”“foundation library”“JUCE library”等）
patterns.context: library 出现在软件、代码或文档语境中，常指可复用的软件库；激活落在 library 上，部分周边词也有激活。
patterns.domain: 问答、HackerNews、软件文档与代码注释

patterns.name: 增加／增强表达
patterns.context: 描述某种量、活动或复杂程度随时间或条件增加；该模式与软件库语境不同。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.trigger: «De»«ox»«yn»ival«en»«ol»-«induced» IgA« production»；«Pros»pective« study» of« the»« enzymatic» activities« in»« urine»
patterns.context: 由词内子词片段及相邻医学词触发；前者涉及诱导 IgA 产生，后者为尿液酶活性研究，二者无明显共同词面模式。

patterns.name: 代码测试注释
patterns.trigger: «#» -*- coding: utf-8 -*-；«#» All« tests»« should»« pass»
patterns.context: Python 测试文件头部及测试类中的注释，激活集中在注释符号、测试相关表述；与 library 短语仅在代码文档环境上部分重合。

en.concept: software libraries and specialized text fragments
en.description: Activation spans software library names and descriptions, code comments/tests/HTTP fields, and words and tokenized fragments in biomedical titles and abstracts. Software-library examples are relatively concentrated, while medical examples do not show a single stable trigger.

patterns.name: library documentation wording
patterns.context: Describes a software library, its functionality, supported platforms, or how to integrate it; activation falls on library itself or nearby.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, developer Q&A, project descriptions

patterns.name: Test assertion comments
patterns.context: Comments in code test classes stating that a test should pass.

patterns.name: HTTP request header field
patterns.context: An Accept value in request-header configuration, especially one containing a wildcard media type and quality parameter.

patterns.name: Common words in medical titles
patterns.context: Biomedical title or abstract fragments; activation is scattered across words describing research, products/generation, and increase, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Word fragments at the start of titles
patterns.context: Activation occurs in tokenized fragments at the beginnings of titles or proper names, possibly related to word segmentation and subsequent title text.

patterns.name: Python import path fragments
patterns.context: In import statements in Python test modules, activation centers on periods and class-name fragments.

patterns.name: Copyright/library descriptions in code comments
patterns.context: Copyright, licensing, and library-introduction comments at the tops of C source files.

7_2170.concept: 软件库与专业文本片段
7_2170.description: 激活跨越软件库名称与说明、代码注释/测试/HTTP字段，以及生物医学标题摘要中的词语和分词片段；软件库相关用例较集中，医学用例内部也不呈现单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: library 文档用语
patterns.context: 描述软件库、其功能、适用平台或如何集成；激活落在 library 本身或其附近。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、开发问答、项目介绍

patterns.name: 测试断言注释
patterns.context: 代码测试类中的注释，表达测试应通过。

patterns.name: HTTP 请求头字段
patterns.context: 请求头配置中的 Accept 值，尤其包含通配媒体类型和质量参数。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的常见词
patterns.context: 生物医学题名或摘要片段；激活分散在研究描述、产物/生成以及增加等词上，无单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 标题开头的词片段
patterns.context: 标题或专名的开头被分词后出现激活，可能与词形切分及其后续标题文本有关。

patterns.name: Python 导入路径片段
patterns.context: Python 测试模块的导入语句中，激活集中在点号及类名片段。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的版权/库描述
patterns.context: C 源码文件头的版权、许可和库简介注释。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in software libraries and their explanatory contexts, also covering sporadic subword fragments in biomedical experiments, terminology, and compound names; there are also titles, web-archive pages, and document-structure markers, with no single stable semantic feature evident.

patterns.name: Suffixes and subword fragments in English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within words rather than complete semantic units; the fragments occur across contexts.

patterns.name: “library” and surrounding code vocabulary
patterns.context: Introduces a software library, its functionality, or how to use it; activations often center on library, with additional activations on fragments of technical vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, code comments, technical Q&A, and HackerNews

patterns.name: Biomedical experiments and biochemical products
patterns.context: Describes experiments, enzyme activity, or biological-process outcomes; activations span the experimental subject, results, and related terminology.

patterns.name: Section headings and document markers
patterns.context: Markdown-style section headings and structured-document markers.

patterns.name: Web-archive title format
patterns.context: A title template for a web or blog archive page, followed by a tag name.

patterns.name: Tutorial promotional phrase not clearly assigned to another pattern
patterns.context: Introduces a small JavaScript library for making tutorials more interactive.

patterns.name: Qigong review title
patterns.context: A review title discussing a century of development of qigong.

patterns.name: Compound-name fragments
patterns.context: A compound name directly precedes “induced IgA production”; activation falls on multiple subword fragments within the name.

7_2170.concept: 软件库相关词汇与文档片段
7_2170.description: 激活主要集中于软件库及其说明语境，也覆盖生物医学实验、术语和化合物名称中的零散词片段；另有标题、网页归档和文档结构标记，未见单一稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 英语词中的后缀与词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的子词片段，而非完整语义单位；片段本身跨语境出现

patterns.name: “library”及其周边代码词汇
patterns.trigger: «library»，以及“JavaScript”“Foundation library”“Aspose.Imaging”“3rd party library”“networking library”中的相关词片段
patterns.context: 介绍软件库、其功能或如何使用；多处激活集中在 library，另有技术词汇片段激活
patterns.domain: 软件文档、代码注释、技术问答与 HackerNews

patterns.name: 生物医学实验与生化产物
patterns.context: 描述实验、酶活性或生物过程结果；激活分布在实验对象、结果及相关术语

patterns.name: 段落标题与文档标记
patterns.context: Markdown 风格的章节标题和结构化文档标记

patterns.name: 网页归档标题格式
patterns.context: 网页或博客归档页的标题模板，后接标签名称

patterns.name: 未明显归入其他模式的教程宣传语
patterns.context: 介绍一个用于增强教程互动性的 JavaScript 小型库

patterns.name: 气功综述标题
patterns.context: 综述性标题，讨论气功的百年发展

patterns.name: 化合物名称片段
patterns.context: 化合物名称紧接“induced IgA production”，激活落在名称内部多个子词片段

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on specific tokenizations of different words: Selective is the most consistent; there are also within-word segments of Literacy, Prospective, and Deoxynivalenol, as well as an isolated mathematical expression, xp and. The topics and meanings of these segments differ substantially and cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Selective
patterns.context: Selective appears at the start of a sentence, followed by different nouns or research topics; activation centers on the word’s initial and final token fragments, with boundaries falling between different tokens.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Literacy
patterns.context: The phrase Literacy practices appears; activation centers on the initial and final token fragments of Literacy.

patterns.name: xp and in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: The algebraic fragment contains xp followed by and; activation centers on these two tokens.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of Prospective
patterns.context: In the phrase Prospective study, only the within-word prospective fragment shows clear activation.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of Deoxynivalenol
patterns.context: In Deoxynivalenol-induced, multiple noncontiguous fragments within the word activate.

7_2170.description: 强激活主要落在不同词的特定分词上：Selective 最一致；另见 Literacy、Prospective、Deoxynivalenol 的词内分段，以及孤立的数学式 xp and。各段题材和词义差异大，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: Selective 词形分词
patterns.context: 句首出现 Selective，后接不同名词或研究主题；激活集中在词首和词尾分词，且分词边界处于不同 token。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 数据条目

patterns.name: Literacy 词形分词
patterns.context: 出现 Literacy practices；激活集中在 Literacy 的首尾分词。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 xp and
patterns.context: 代数式片段中出现 xp 后接 and，激活集中于这两个 token。

patterns.name: Prospective 的词内片段
patterns.context: Prospective study 短语中，只有词内的 prospective 片段明显激活。

patterns.name: Deoxynivalenol 的词内片段
patterns.context: Deoxynivalenol-induced 一词中，多个不连续的词内片段激活。

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on indentation, tabs, line breaks, and marker boundaries. The material includes email formatting, HTML/XML/plist configurations, web-page scaffolding, and a few specific email tones, legal correspondence, and transaction records.

patterns.name: Tab indentation
patterns.context: Tabs or space indentation occur at line starts or structural levels in forwarded email headers, code, or HTML/XML documents; this recurs across domains.
patterns.domain: Email, GitHub code, and markup documents

patterns.name: Line breaks and structured formatting
patterns.context: Content is organized across multiple lines using indentation and paired tags; activations often appear near line breaks, tag boundaries, or structural elements.
patterns.domain: Email body text and structured text such as HTML/XML and plist

patterns.name: Email forwarding and signature headers
patterns.context: An email body is followed by a forwarding header, signature, email address, or date information, often separated by indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: Property-list/XML key-value structures
patterns.context: In structured configuration files, tags surround keys, arrays, dictionaries, strings, and application-resource values, usually indented line by line.

patterns.name: HTML page and style markers
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, or closing tags are arranged across indented lines; content may include CSS, navigation, or page placeholders.
patterns.domain: HTML in email and GitHub web documents

patterns.name: MIME-type URL configuration
patterns.context: A configuration item wraps a URL in XML tags, with a MIME-type key in an adjacent field.

patterns.name: Casual, lighthearted email tone
patterns.context: An email expresses amusement in a colloquial, friendly tone, followed by a signature on a new line.

patterns.name: Draft and legal-document correspondence
patterns.context: An email requests completion of a client address and handling of a confidentiality-agreement draft, followed by sender or email information.

patterns.name: Transaction quotes or market records
patterns.context: A market record arranged line by line with abbreviations, time periods, transaction volumes, and prices.

patterns.name: Isolated email question
patterns.context: An email opens with a brief question asking whether something has been handled, followed by a forwarded email header.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia page navigation framework
patterns.context: Web-page HTML includes Wikipedia source text and page scaffolding such as a content area and jump navigation.

7_2170.description: 激活最稳定地落在缩进、制表符、换行和标记边界；材料涵盖邮件排版、HTML/XML/plist 配置、网页骨架及少量特定邮件语气、法律往来和交易记录。

patterns.name: 制表符缩进
patterns.context: 在邮件转发头、代码或 HTML/XML 文档中，行首或结构层级处出现制表符、空格缩进；跨不同领域反复出现。
patterns.domain: 邮件、GitHub 代码与标记文档

patterns.name: 换行与结构化排版
patterns.context: 内容以多行、缩进和成对标签组织；激活常出现在换行、标签边界或结构元素附近。
patterns.domain: 邮件正文及 HTML/XML、plist 等结构化文本

patterns.name: 邮件转发与签名头
patterns.context: 邮件正文后接转发头、署名、邮箱或日期信息，常以缩进和换行分隔。

patterns.name: 属性列表/XML键值结构
patterns.context: 结构化配置文件中，标签围绕键、数组、字典、字符串及应用资源值展开，通常逐行缩进。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 plist/XML 配置

patterns.name: HTML页面与样式标记
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性或闭合标签按多行缩进排列；内容可含 CSS、导航或页面占位元素。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的 HTML 与 GitHub 网页文档

patterns.name: MIME类型网址配置
patterns.context: 配置项中以 XML 标签包裹网址，并在相邻字段中出现 MIME 类型键。

patterns.name: 轻松随意的邮件语气
patterns.context: 邮件中以口语化、友好语气表达笑意，随后另起行署名。

patterns.name: 草稿与法律文件往来
patterns.context: 邮件要求补全客户地址并处理保密协议草稿，之后跟随发件人或邮箱信息。

patterns.name: 交易报价或市场记录
patterns.context: 缩写、时段、交易量及价格组成逐行排列的市场记录。
patterns.domain: 能源交易数据/邮件记录

patterns.name: 孤立的邮件问句
patterns.context: 邮件开头以简短问句询问事项是否已处理，后接转发邮件头。

patterns.name: 百科页面导航框架
patterns.context: 网页 HTML 包含维基百科来源文字及内容区、跳转导航等页面骨架元素。

en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: SFR in two astrophysics texts, idiopathic in two medical abstracts, and document classes and packages in two texts containing LaTeX source are the most consistent. Other local triggers include condensed-matter terminology, mixed-script comments, Shell file loops, fungal drugs, encephalopathy descriptions, and personal names.

patterns.name: Strong activation on SFR
patterns.context: In astrophysics, discusses star formation rate and its relation to luminosity or galaxy mass, or the cosmic star formation rate density as it changes with redshift; activation centers on SFR itself.

patterns.name: The word idiopathic
patterns.context: Appears as part of a disease or condition name in medical text, in “idiopathic fascicular ventricular tachycardia” and “idiopathic Parkinson's disease”.

patterns.name: LaTeX document classes and packages
patterns.context: LaTeX source is embedded in or appears next to the main text; multiple package names and document-class-related tokens activate.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source in academic papers (physics, mathematics)

patterns.name: Mixed-script code comment
patterns.context: A Chinese comment in a PHP plugin constructor explains automatic mode switching for IE8; activation is prominent on several Chinese characters in the comment.

patterns.name: Shell file-list loop
patterns.context: A Shell script defines and iterates over a file list; filenames contain date/number patterns and compressed-log extensions.

patterns.name: Rotating electric field and polarization
patterns.context: Discusses rotating electric fields and CNP polarization in dielectric materials; the passage is followed by LaTeX document-setup source.

patterns.name: Transverse conductance and quantum Hall phases
patterns.context: Distinguishes trivial insulating and quantum Hall phases using transverse conductance; LaTeX package source follows.

patterns.name: Rare-disease title in a medical paper
patterns.context: A medical case-report title describes a rare variant of idiopathic fascicular ventricular tachycardia; beyond the idiopathic pattern, the title has no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Encephalopathy and attentional-condition description
patterns.context: Compares abnormalities in a neurodegenerative-disease patient group under low attentional demand and the affected brain regions.

patterns.name: Name in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A name recurs in a biographical entry, followed by a birth date and occupation; no clear trigger shared with other patterns is evident.

patterns.name: Fungus-derived therapies
patterns.context: Introduces therapeutic drugs, including antibiotics, as compounds produced by fungi; activations are scattered across related words and cannot currently be matched to other patterns.

patterns.name: Other terminology in physics
patterns.context: Classifies insulating and quantum Hall phases in condensed-matter physics; unlike the rotating-electric-field topic in passage 4, it concerns transverse conductance.

7_2170.concept: 多领域术语与源码片段
7_2170.description: 激活模式分散：两段天体物理文本中的 SFR、两段医学摘要中的 idiopathic，以及两段含 LaTeX 源码文本中的文档类和宏包最一致；另见凝聚态术语、混合脚本注释、Shell 文件循环、真菌药物、脑病描述和人物姓名等局部触发。

patterns.name: SFR 的强激活
patterns.context: 天体物理学语境中讨论恒星形成率、其与光度或星系质量的关系，或宇宙恒星形成率密度随红移变化；触发集中在 SFR 本身。

patterns.name: idiopathic 一词
patterns.context: 医学文本中作为疾病或病症名称的一部分，出现在“idiopathic fascicular ventricular tachycardia”和“idiopathic Parkinson's disease”中。

patterns.name: LaTeX 文档类及宏包
patterns.context: 正文中嵌入或紧邻 LaTeX 源码；多个宏包名和文档类相关 token 均有激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的 LaTeX 源码（物理、数学）

patterns.name: 混合脚本代码注释
patterns.context: PHP 插件构造函数中的中文注释，说明 IE8 自动切换模式；激活明显落在注释内若干汉字上。

patterns.name: Shell 文件列表循环
patterns.context: Shell 脚本中定义文件列表并遍历，文件名含日期/编号模式和压缩日志扩展名。

patterns.name: 旋转电场与极化
patterns.context: 关于介电材料中旋转电场与 CNP 极化的论述；该段随后混入 LaTeX 文档设置源码。

patterns.name: 横向电导与量子霍尔相
patterns.context: 讨论平庸绝缘相与量子霍尔相，并以横向电导作区分；随后出现 LaTeX 宏包源码。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的罕见病症标题
patterns.context: 医学病例标题，描述一种罕见的特发性束支性室性心动过速变体；除“idiopathic”模式外，标题整体无明显共同触发点。

patterns.name: 脑病与注意条件描述
patterns.context: 比较神经退行性疾病患者组在低注意需求条件下的异常及脑区受累。

patterns.name: 人物传记姓名
patterns.context: 人物条目中重复出现姓名，后接出生日期和职业身份；未见与其他模式共享的明显触发。

patterns.name: 真菌来源疗法
patterns.context: 介绍许多治疗药物（含抗生素）来自真菌产生的化合物；激活分散在相关词上，暂无法与其他模式对应。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学综述

patterns.name: 物理领域其他术语
patterns.context: 凝聚态物理中对绝缘相及量子霍尔相的分类；除横向电导外，与第4段的旋转电场主题不同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across structural symbols, paths and identifiers, patches, and comment formatting in code and technical text; they also cover LaTeX commands and scientific equations. The commonality is technical notation and formatting structure rather than a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting in source code
patterns.context: Appears in code, configuration, or patch text; activation often falls on brackets, slashes, line breaks, indentation, or structural punctuation, across programming languages.

patterns.name: Path and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Words and symbols combine to form hierarchical paths or compound names in Windows Registry paths, code identifiers, or configuration items.

patterns.name: Patch diff format
patterns.context: Added lines are marked with a plus sign, followed by indented configuration content.

patterns.name: Documentation comments and copyright licenses
patterns.context: Comments or file headers contain project descriptions, URLs, copyright, and license text.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, formula symbols, and scientific variables are interleaved in mathematical papers or documents.

patterns.name: Structural markers in Web/framework code
patterns.context: Tag boundaries, escape characters, and class paths appear in HTML/JavaScript or framework tutorial code.

7_2170.description: 激活分布在代码和技术文本的结构符号、路径与标识符、补丁及注释格式，也覆盖 LaTeX 命令和科学公式；共同点偏向技术文本的特殊记法与排版结构，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 源代码中的标点与格式
patterns.context: 出现在代码、配置或补丁文本中；激活常落在括号、斜杠、换行、缩进或结构性标点上，不限于某种编程语言。

patterns.name: 路径与标识符片段
patterns.context: Windows 注册表路径、代码标识符或配置项中，词与符号共同组成层级路径或复合名称。

patterns.name: 补丁差异格式
patterns.context: 新增行以加号标记，后接缩进和配置内容。

patterns.name: 文档注释与版权许可
patterns.context: 注释或文件头中出现项目说明、网址、版权和许可证文字。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版
patterns.context: 数学论文或文档中，LaTeX 命令、公式符号与科学变量混排。

patterns.name: Web/框架代码中的结构标记
patterns.context: HTML/JavaScript 或框架教程代码中，标签边界、转义符及类路径出现。

en.description: Activation samples are interdisciplinary and diverse: orthopedic medicine and diseases, material fracture, mathematical formulas, and HTML markup are all represented. Prominent local vocabulary includes bone, surgical/medical terminology, and structural markers, with no single semantic topic covering them all.

patterns.name: Patellar tendon and ligament surgery
patterns.context: Discusses obtaining tendons from autologous or allogeneic sources, replacing torn ligaments, and related surgical methods.

patterns.name: Bone shape, loading, or repair
patterns.context: Bone curvature and loading, biomechanics, or bone graft harvesting, bone cysts, and intraoperative procedures.

patterns.name: Material fracture, brittleness, and viscoelasticity
patterns.context: Describes how the fibrous structure of meat under chewing shear affects crack propagation, energy dissipation, and perceived brittleness.

patterns.name: Medical diseases, immune evasion, and equipment environments
patterns.context: Covers personality-disorder diagnosis, tumor resistance to antibody-mediated lysis/immune evasion, and air conditioning in an MRI scanning environment; the topics are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and energy distributions
patterns.context: Formulas for a neural-network energy model, or mathematical derivations involving function conjugates and piecewise definitions.

patterns.name: HTML navigation-link markup
patterns.context: Skip-navigation links, anchors, navigation bars, and HTML tags in webpage source code.

7_2170.concept: 跨领域结构化技术文本
7_2170.description: 激活样本跨学科且分散：医学骨科与疾病、材料断裂、数学公式、HTML 标记均有；较显眼的局部词汇包括 bone、手术/医学术语及结构化标记，无法由单一语义主题覆盖。

patterns.name: 髌腱与韧带手术
patterns.context: 讨论从自体或异体来源取得肌腱、替换撕裂韧带及相关手术方法。

patterns.name: 骨的形状、负载或修复
patterns.context: 骨曲率与受力、生物力学，或骨移植采集、骨囊肿和术中操作。

patterns.name: 材料断裂、脆性与黏弹性
patterns.context: 描述咀嚼剪切下肉的纤维结构如何影响裂纹传播、耗散与感知到的脆性。

patterns.name: 医学疾病、免疫逃逸与设备环境
patterns.context: 分别涉及人格障碍诊断、肿瘤对抗体介导裂解的抵抗／免疫逃逸，以及MRI扫描环境的空气调节；主题不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学论文／临床设备描述

patterns.name: 数学公式与能量分布
patterns.context: 神经网络能量模型的公式，或函数共轭与分段定义的数学推导。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／机器学习论文

patterns.name: HTML 导航链接标记
patterns.context: 网页源代码中的跳过导航链接、锚点、导航栏及 HTML 标签。

en.description: Activations span biomedicine, mathematical physics, taxonomy, and code; they include common function words, numerical symbols, domain terminology, and subword fragments within words, with no unified semantic or stable lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Discourse connectors and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Common function words in scientific or technical prose; these markers are scattered and cannot by themselves explain the stronger activations in each passage.

patterns.name: Numbers, formulas, and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Numbers and symbols appear in formulas, numerical results, or content about classification counts; activation targets are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, medical experiments, and taxonomy research

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and diseases/injuries
patterns.context: Medical or biological text discusses diseases, parasites, tissues, or nerve injuries, along with related experiments or diagnoses.

patterns.name: Species names and Latin-name fragments
patterns.context: Scientific or species names, sometimes italicized, appear in paper text; activation falls on multiple subword fragments within the names.

patterns.name: Word fragments within specific technical terms
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on local subwords within terminology, abbreviations, or long words, across domains and without a shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Physics, computer science, ophthalmology, neurotherapy, and experimental medicine

patterns.name: Code and syntax structures
patterns.context: Activations appear near brackets, branches, function definitions, and line breaks in code blocks.

patterns.name: Individuals and perception in neurofeedback descriptions
patterns.context: A therapy that provides audio feedback on brain activity through music is described in terms of individuals receiving feedback and listening.
patterns.domain: Neurotherapy popular science or explanatory text

patterns.name: Histological classification and synonymy judgments
patterns.context: A microbial taxonomy paper makes a judgment about heterotypic synonyms while comparing species names.

7_2170.description: 激活跨越生物医学、数学物理、分类学和代码；包含常见功能词、数字符号、领域术语及词内子词片段，未显示统一语义或稳定词法模式。

patterns.name: 论述衔接词与句法片段
patterns.context: 科学或技术叙述中的常见功能词；这些标记分散出现，无法单独解释各段较强激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、摘要、技术文本

patterns.name: 数字、公式与数学记号
patterns.context: 公式、数值结果或分类数量相关内容中出现数字与符号；激活对象并不统一。
patterns.domain: 物理、数学、医学实验与分类研究

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与疾病/损伤
patterns.context: 医学或生物学文本讨论疾病、寄生虫、组织或神经损伤，以及相关实验或诊断。

patterns.name: 物种名及拉丁学名片段
patterns.context: 学名或物种名称以斜体等方式嵌入论文正文；激活落在名称内部的多个子词片段。
patterns.domain: 植物学、微生物分类与生物医学

patterns.name: 特定专业词内部的字词片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在术语、缩写或长词的局部子词上，跨领域且未见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、计算机科学、眼科、神经疗法与实验医学

patterns.name: 代码与语法结构
patterns.context: 代码块中的括号、分支、函数定义及换行附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 神经反馈描述中的个体与感知
patterns.context: 介绍以音乐声反馈脑电活动的疗法时，描述个体接收反馈并倾听。
patterns.domain: 神经疗法科普或说明文

patterns.name: 组织学分类与同物异名判断
patterns.context: 微生物分类论文在比较菌种名称时，出现关于异型同物异名的判断。

en.concept: Local word forms and formula formatting in heterogeneous contexts
en.description: Activations are distributed across algebra-problem formatting, mathematical-physics formulas, medical statistics and positional descriptions, viewing contexts in patents, and Portuguese policy text. The two patent passages both emphasize viewing; the other patterns depend on different words or formatting.

patterns.name: The word viewing
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases referring to viewing or a viewing position; one passage describes a narrow viewing angle, the other an elevated position for a tablet computer.

patterns.name: Specific formatting fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In symbolic algebra problems, especially after a line break before a simplification instruction or a statement that variables are positive; activation falls on instructions, variables, exponents, and nearby symbols.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words and numerical phrases
