patterns.context: Medical statistical prose around NICU admission rates and infant mortality rates, with numbers and comparisons; “all” in «all-time low» activates especially strongly.

patterns.name: Description of the relative positions of the heart and head
patterns.context: Describes the positions of body parts in a recorded case and shows them on an external monitor.

patterns.name: Greek letters and formula formatting
patterns.context: A LaTeX fragment from a mathematical-physics formula, with symbols, parentheses, and logarithmic expressions interleaved.

patterns.name: Phase-space formulas and differential notation
patterns.context: Formulas contain functions and their variables, differential notation, momentum, and subscripted quantities.

patterns.name: Portuguese vocabulary about financing and regional cooperation
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence discusses the economic dimension of regional cooperation, integration, and partnership.

7_2170.concept: 异质语境中的局部词形与公式格式
7_2170.description: 激活分布于代数题格式、数学物理公式、医学统计与位置描述、专利中的观看语境，以及葡萄牙语政策文本；两段专利都突出 viewing，其余模式各自依赖不同词语或排版。

patterns.name: 词语 viewing
patterns.context: 出现在表示观看或观看位置的名词短语中；一段为窄视角，一段为平板电脑的抬高位置。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定格式片段
patterns.context: 符号化代数题中，尤其是换行后出现简化指令，或说明变量为正；激活落在指令、变量、指数及邻近符号上。

patterns.name: 高频功能词及数字短语
patterns.context: 医学统计叙述中，围绕NICU入院率和婴儿死亡率的数字与比较表达；其中 «all-time low» 的 «all» 激活尤强。

patterns.name: 心脏与头部位置关系描述
patterns.context: 描述记录个案中身体部位位置，并将其显示在外部监视器上。

patterns.name: 希腊字母与公式排版
patterns.context: 数学物理公式的 LaTeX 片段，符号、括号及对数表达式交错出现。

patterns.name: 相空间公式与微分符号
patterns.context: 公式中出现函数及其变量、微分记号、动量和带下标的量。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语融资与区域合作词汇
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子讨论区域合作、融合及伙伴关系的经济层面。

en.concept: Mixed: algebraic symbols and technical text fragments
en.description: Primarily sensitive to dense variables, fractional exponents, and operators in DM algebra problems, especially power-expression results following positive-value assumptions and “Simplify” problem formats; it also shows sporadic activation on a doorstop patent, spine diagnosis, abdominal CT description, and optical-paper citation.

patterns.name: Power-expression answer after symbol assumptions
patterns.context: The preceding text contains fractions, variables, and exponentiation; variables are first declared positive, followed on a new line by a simplified variable power expression, without explanation or prose.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated DM Mathematics algebra simplification problems

patterns.name: Simplification prompt and complex rational power expressions
patterns.context: A complex algebraic expression composed of variables, multiplication/division, parentheses, and fractional exponents appears; a prompt introduces the expression to be simplified.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated DM Mathematics algebra problems

patterns.name: Variables and operators in complex algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Dense variables, asterisks, slashes, parentheses, and fractional exponents, without a clearly identifiable prompt or complete problem structure.

patterns.name: Comparison of doorstop load-bearing and resistance to external force
patterns.context: Explains that a wedge-shaped doorstop can support a door’s weight but cannot withstand force exerted by an intruder.

patterns.name: Complexity of spinal diagnosis and individual differences
patterns.context: Discusses diagnostic examinations, the complexity of spinal structures, and the wide range of patient symptoms.

patterns.name: Abdominal imaging description
patterns.context: Records ascites and a hyperdense appearance adjacent to the abdominal wall in a caption or imaging description.

patterns.name: Optical time-domain reflectometer literature citation
patterns.context: Lists authors, paper title, journal, volume and issue, pages, and year.

7_2170.concept: 混合型：代数符号与技术文本片段
7_2170.description: 主要对DM代数题中密集的变量、分数幂与运算符敏感，尤其是正值假设后的幂式结果和“Simplify”题式；另对门挡专利、脊柱诊断、腹部CT描述及光学论文引文各有零散激活。

patterns.name: 符号假设后给出幂式答案
patterns.context: 前文含分数、变量及幂运算，先声明变量为正，再换行给出化简后的变量幂式；无需解释或叙述。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 自动生成的代数化简题

patterns.name: 化简提示及复杂有理幂表达式
patterns.context: 连续出现变量、乘除、括号和分数指数构成的复杂代数式；提示词引出待化简表达式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 自动生成的代数题

patterns.name: 复杂代数式中的变量与运算符
patterns.context: 密集的变量、星号、斜线、括号及分数幂，没有清楚可辨的提示语或完整题目结构。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 符号化表达式

patterns.name: 门挡承重与抗外力的对比
patterns.trigger: hold ... open；hold the weight ... but not to withstand a force ... intruder
patterns.context: 说明倾斜门挡能够支撑门的重量，却不能承受入侵者施加的外力。

patterns.name: 脊柱诊断的复杂性与个体差异
patterns.trigger: patient history and physical examination；components of the spine；physical symptoms ... patients
patterns.context: 讨论诊断检查、脊柱结构复杂，以及患者症状范围广。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景／医疗诊断

patterns.name: 腹部影像学描述
patterns.trigger: Axial CT angiography of the abdomen；abdominal ascites；hyperattenuation
patterns.context: 以图注或影像描述形式记录腹水及腹壁邻近的高密度表现。

patterns.name: 光学时域反射计文献引文
patterns.trigger: “Real-time long range complementary correlation optical time domain reflectometer”
patterns.context: 列举作者、论文题目、期刊、卷期、页码与年份。

en.concept: No unified concept; predominantly mathematical simplification problems
en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is symbolic mathematical simplification problems, especially powers followed by “Simplify” after a positive-value assumption. Other activations are scattered across fixed legal phrases, citation punctuation, discourse words, thriller narratives, and technical and medical texts, with no shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Exponent simplification tasks following mathematical expressions
patterns.context: After an assumption that symbolic variables are positive, a power, fraction, or nested algebraic expression appears, often followed by “Simplify” to introduce the next problem; activations are scattered across variables, operators, numbers, and other elements

patterns.name: Preposition in an on-phrase
patterns.context: In legal argument, the fixed phrase “on the part of” indicates someone’s motive or attribution of conduct

patterns.name: Reference punctuation and journal information
patterns.context: Journal name, volume/issue, year, and page numbers appear together in a paper reference entry

patterns.name: Common and natural in argumentation
patterns.context: In an argument that an action was common historically but not therefore natural, activation centers on “was” and “common”

patterns.name: Horror sounds and a door-kicking scene
patterns.context: In a narrative, a character hears someone kicking the door at night; activations fall on words such as “terrifying”, “sound”, and “someone”

patterns.name: Title of a vibration-sensor paper
patterns.context: Technical terms and bibliographic formatting in a paper title; activation is distributed across title words
patterns.domain: ArXiv, citation of a photonics and sensing technology paper

patterns.name: Medical imaging description
patterns.context: A figure caption describes an abdominal angiography image and the location of contrast-agent extravasation

7_2170.concept: 无统一概念；偏数学化简题
7_2170.description: 最清晰的重复模式是数学符号化简题，尤其正值假设后接幂式与“Simplify”。其余激活分散于法律固定短语、引文标点、论述词语、惊悚叙事及技术和医学文本，缺少共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学式子后的指数化简任务
patterns.trigger: “assuming d is positive”后接“d**(572/3)”和“Simplify”；类似地有“assuming r is positive”“Simplify”“assuming l is positive”“Simplify”“assuming h is positive”“Simplify”
patterns.context: 符号变量的正值假设之后出现幂、分数或嵌套代数表达式，常以“Simplify”引出下一题；激活散落在变量、运算符、数字等处

patterns.name: on短语中的介词
patterns.trigger: “motive on the part of the servant”中的“on”
patterns.context: 法律论述中，固定短语“on the part of”表示某人的动机或行为归属

patterns.name: 参考文献标点与期刊信息
patterns.context: 论文参考文献条目中，期刊名、卷期、年份和页码相邻出现

patterns.name: 常见与自然的论述
patterns.context: 讨论历史上某行为虽常见、却不因此自然的论证中，激活集中在“was”“common”

patterns.name: 恐怖声响与踢门情境
patterns.trigger: “a terrifying sound—someone kicking at her door”
patterns.context: 叙事中人物夜间听见有人踢门，激活落在“terrifying”“sound”“someone”等词

patterns.name: 振动传感论文题名
patterns.trigger: “Vibration Sensing Based on Phase Extraction From Phase-Sensitive OTDR”
patterns.context: 论文题名中的技术术语及书目格式，激活分布于题名词语
patterns.domain: ArXiv，光子学与传感技术论文引文

patterns.name: 医学影像描述
patterns.context: 图注描述腹部血管造影图像及造影剂外渗位置

en.concept: English local syntax and phrase patterns
en.description: Activation is scattered: many instances fall on common English function words and nearby words (such as on/is, the, a); other instances occur in person-as-agent language, technical logs, patent legal boilerplate, and engine descriptions. There are also isolated cases such as HTTP logs and Greek fragments, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “on a” sequence
patterns.context: High activation centers on English function words and the words following them, especially a preposition or linking verb followed by a noun, pronoun, or participle; not all instances are identical.
patterns.domain: English legal, patent, news, and technical texts

patterns.name: Reduced words in noun phrases
patterns.context: The definite article occurs in a longer noun phrase; individual activations fall on the or nearby function words.

patterns.name: Words related to people or agents
patterns.context: Concerns people acting as agents or as group members; appears in only a few passages, with no consistent trigger word.

patterns.name: Technical error-log phrases
patterns.context: Error messages describe requests being sent, connections closing, and exceptions; activation falls on common function words and technical action words.

patterns.name: HTTP status lines and numeric logs
patterns.context: Special server request logs/status output containing HTTP status codes, durations, and timestamps; no clear semantic connection to other passages.

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate in patents
patterns.context: Fixed wording in patent background sections about whether prior art anticipates or suggests the invention.

patterns.name: Combustion and engine parameters
patterns.context: Discusses air-fuel ratio, engine speed, and mixtures; activation includes ordinary English function words as well as domain-specific words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Greek text
patterns.context: Word fragments split by the tokenizer in Greek sentences; no confirmed connection to the English patterns.

patterns.name: Mechanical-device patent description
patterns.context: Describes a plunger device and its novelty over prior art; appears alongside general syntactic triggers and legal boilerplate.

patterns.name: Direction controls and right-handedness
patterns.context: Discusses keyboard game controls and right-handed preferences; there is no clear evidence that these semantic words themselves are common triggers.

7_2170.concept: 英语局部句法与词串模式
7_2170.description: 激活分布零散：多处落在英语常见功能词及其邻近词（如 on/is、the、a）上，也见于人物施事、技术日志、专利法律套语和发动机描述；另有 HTTP 日志与希腊语碎片等孤例，无法归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “on a”序列
patterns.context: 高激活集中在英语功能词及其后续词，尤其是介词或系动词后接名词、代词或分词；不是所有实例都完全相同。
patterns.domain: 英语法律、专利、新闻及技术文本

patterns.name: 名词短语中的弱读词
patterns.context: 定冠词出现在较长名词短语中；个别激活落在 the 或相邻的控制词上。

patterns.name: 人物或施事相关词
patterns.context: 涉及人物作为动作施事或群体成员；只在少数段出现，触发词不完全一致。

patterns.name: 技术错误日志短语
patterns.context: 错误信息描述请求发送、连接关闭及异常；激活落在常见功能词和技术动作词上。

patterns.name: HTTP 状态行与数字日志
patterns.context: 特殊的服务器请求日志／状态输出，包含 HTTP 状态码、耗时和时间戳；与其他段无明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 专利中的法律套语
patterns.trigger: «implied»7« by»9« any»9« of»5« the»6« prior»2« art（[5]）
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中关于既有技术是否预示或暗示发明的固定表述。

patterns.name: 燃烧与发动机参数
patterns.trigger: « it»4« takes»6« an»2« engine»7；« what»6« is»10« done（[3]）
patterns.context: 讨论空燃比、发动机转速及混合气；激活包含普通英语功能词，也涉及领域词。

patterns.name: 希腊语文本中的子词片段
patterns.context: 希腊语句子中被分词器拆开的词片段；与英语模式无法确认有关联。

patterns.name: 机械装置专利描述
patterns.context: 描述柱塞装置及其相对既有技术的新颖性；与通用句法触发和法律套语同时出现。

patterns.name: 方向控制与右利手
patterns.context: 谈论键盘游戏控制方式及右利手偏好；没有清晰证据表明这些语义词本身是共同触发因素。

en.description: Samples span sports, automobiles, news, technology, chemistry, mathematics, and law; activations often fall on words expressing relations or conditions, while also covering domain-specific content, variables, and numbers. No single semantic topic readily explains them.

patterns.name: Relational words and dependency structures
patterns.context: Connects people, actions, conditions, or objects in a sentence, often appearing in relative clauses, prepositional phrases, or conditional structures; specific activation locations do not fully align with the syntactic relation.
patterns.domain: News, sports narratives, legal text, and general discussion

patterns.name: Automobiles and statements of ownership
patterns.context: Discusses cars personally owned and their use, especially expressions such as “ANY car using this method”.
patterns.domain: Automotive user reviews or experience sharing

patterns.name: Visual verbs in quotations and identity slogans
patterns.context: Describes a slogan being seen somewhere, followed by a Black identity and anti-discrimination slogan.

patterns.name: Embarrassment and ugliness in code evaluations
patterns.context: Explains why code is embarrassing and evaluates its appearance or quality.

patterns.name: Spectroscopy and instrument terminology
patterns.context: An experimental-methods section records the wavenumber range of an infrared spectrum and instrument information; activations fall on numbers and common connective words.

patterns.name: Symbolic algebra and simplification instructions
patterns.context: An algebraic expression composed of variables, powers, fractions, and parentheses, followed by a positive-value assumption or simplification command.

patterns.name: Vicarious employer liability and personal motives
patterns.context: Discusses whether an employer is responsible for an employee’s conduct and distinguishes work-related conduct from personal motives.

patterns.name: Model prediction failure and political betting
patterns.context: Criticizes a model for failing to predict a cooling trend and discusses related political positions.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussion of models and politics

patterns.name: Paid applications and product recognition
patterns.context: A hypothetical sentence discusses whether a product would be well known if it were paid.

7_2170.concept: 关系连接词与上下文特征
7_2170.description: 样本横跨体育、汽车、新闻、技术、化学、数学和法律；激活常落在连接关系或条件的词上，也覆盖各领域专有内容、变量和数字，难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 关系词与依存结构
patterns.context: 在句中连接人物、动作、条件或对象，常位于关系从句、介词短语或条件结构；具体激活位置与句法关系不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育叙述、法律文本及一般论述

patterns.name: 汽车与所有权表述
patterns.context: 谈论个人拥有的汽车及其使用经验，尤其“ANY car using this method”等表述。
patterns.domain: 汽车用户评论或经验分享

patterns.name: 引语与身份标语中的视觉动词
patterns.context: 描述标语在某处被看见，接续黑人身份与反歧视口号。

patterns.name: 代码评价中的尴尬与丑陋
patterns.context: 解释代码为何令人尴尬，评价其外观或质量。

patterns.name: 光谱与仪器术语
patterns.context: 实验方法段落中记录红外光谱的波数范围及仪器信息；激活落在数字和常见衔接词上。

patterns.name: 符号代数与化简指令
patterns.context: 变量、幂、分数和括号组成的代数式，后接正值假设或化简命令。
patterns.domain: 数学题目或符号运算语料

patterns.name: 雇主替代责任与个人动机
patterns.context: 讨论雇主是否对雇员行为负责，并区分工作行为与个人动机。

patterns.name: 模型预测失误与政治押注
patterns.context: 批评模型未预测到降温，并谈及相关政治立场。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 对模型与政治的讨论

patterns.name: 付费应用与产品知名度
patterns.context: 以假设句讨论若产品收费，某产品是否会被人熟知。

en.description: Activation spans different texts, including patent boilerplate, medical disclaimers, sports, and online discussions. A prominent local feature is function words that refer to or delimit an object (such as those, a, whoever, anybody); there is also a repeatedly templated Cureus disclaimer and several one-off contexts, making it difficult to group the examples into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Determiners before generic nouns or complements
patterns.context: Activation falls on function words that delimit a referent, refer generically to people, or introduce a subsequent description, often at noun-phrase or clause boundaries; behavior is not fully consistent across passages.
patterns.domain: Patents, sports commentary, medical disclaimers, forum discussions

patterns.name: Cureus medical disclaimer template
patterns.context: A repeated publisher disclaimer, especially near “a qualified health care professional”; passages 3–6 have identical text and should not be treated as four independent pieces of evidence.
patterns.domain: Publication disclaimers in PubMed Central medical articles

patterns.name: Fixed legal boilerplate in patents
patterns.context: A fixed phrase in a patent background paragraph states that what follows would be obvious to a person skilled in the art; strong activation centers on “those”.

patterns.name: Sports statistics and substitute-performance narrative
patterns.context: After a player’s season statistics, the text describes a substitute entering and the original player returning; strong activation falls on “whoever” and subsequent pronouns and verbs.

patterns.name: Complaint about forum moderation delays
patterns.context: A poster questions the inconsistency between the moderation queue and post publication times; activation is distributed across “mine”, “be”, “up”, and “are”.

patterns.name: Discussion of ugly code
patterns.context: Explains the reason for a technical choice and mentions unattractive or embarrassing code; activation centers on “as” and “it”.

patterns.name: Racial identity slogan and scene description
patterns.context: A news-style account quotes a racial identity slogan and describes where it was located; high activation falls on “by” and “track”.

patterns.name: Skepticism about scientific models
patterns.context: A commenter expresses difficulty believing in a certain type of model; activation centers on “anybody”.
patterns.domain: Hacker News science or public-issue discussion

7_2170.description: 激活跨专利套语、医学免责声明、体育和网络讨论等不同文本，较突出的局部是泛指或限定对象的功能词（如 those、a、whoever、anybody）；另有按固定模板重复的 Cureus 免责声明及若干单次语境，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 通用名词或补语前的限定词
patterns.trigger: «those»10 skilled in the art；«a»10 qualified health care professional；«whoever»10 he filled in for；«it's»10 "ugly"；«anybody»9 can take
patterns.context: 激活落在限定对象、泛指人物或引出后续描述的功能词上，位置多在名词短语或从句边界；跨段表现不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 专利、体育评论、医学免责声明、论坛讨论

patterns.name: Cureus 医学免责声明模板
patterns.trigger: All content published within Cureus ... articles published within Cureus should not be deemed a suitable substitute for the advice of a qualified health care professional
patterns.context: 重复出现的出版免责声明中，尤其是“a qualified health care professional”附近；段3–6文本相同，不能视为四种独立证据。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学文章的出版免责声明

patterns.name: 专利固定法律套语
patterns.trigger: for the reasons stated above, and for other reasons stated below ... those skilled in the art
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以固定套语说明后文对本领域技术人员显而易见；强激活集中在“those”。

patterns.name: 体育统计与替补表现叙述
patterns.trigger: whoever he filled in for came back
patterns.context: 球员赛季统计之后，叙述替补上场及原球员回归；强激活落在“whoever”及其后续代词和动词。

patterns.name: 论坛审核延迟抱怨
patterns.trigger: posts of mine take hours to be put up ... moderated posts ... are put thru
patterns.context: 发帖者对审核队列和帖子发布时间不一致提出疑问；激活分布在“mine”“be”“up”“are”等处。

patterns.name: 代码丑陋的讨论
patterns.trigger: One reason of course is "embarrassment" as it's "ugly" code
patterns.context: 解释某项技术选择的理由，涉及代码难看或令人尴尬；激活集中在“as”和“it”。

patterns.name: 种族身份标语与现场描述
patterns.trigger: A sign reading 'Black is not a crime, I'm proud to be black' is seen by the side of a track
patterns.context: 新闻式叙述中引用种族身份标语并描述其所在位置；高激活落在“by”和“track”。

patterns.name: 对科学模型的质疑
patterns.trigger: I don't know how anybody can take models like this seriously
patterns.context: 评论者表达难以相信某类模型；激活集中在“anybody”。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 科学或公共议题讨论

en.description: Activations appear in content words and fixed expressions across diverse genres: patent boilerplate, moderation and publication, the mathematical variable i, engine parameters, legal cases, cultural commentary, and sports evaluations. There is insufficient evidence to group these triggers into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Patent legal boilerplate and obviousness
patterns.context: Appears in conventional phrasing in patent backgrounds or invention descriptions, stating that reasons, features, or content would be known to a person skilled in the art.

patterns.name: Moderation, publication, and content management
patterns.context: Discusses post moderation and publication delays, or webpage publication status, comment forms, and website content.
patterns.domain: Forum posts and webpage interfaces/site disclaimers

patterns.name: The letter i in mathematical notation
patterns.context: The variable i recurs in dense symbolic calculations; nearby text also contains numbers, operators, and a few textual instructions.

patterns.name: Numerical technical descriptions of combustion engines
patterns.context: Gives technical parameters for air-fuel ratios, engine speed, and millisecond timescales.

patterns.name: Legal effect and exclusion of precedent
patterns.context: States that a ruling may not be used as precedent while listing issues or legal principles that may still be argued.

patterns.name: Identity and literary quotations in cultural commentary
patterns.context: Cultural commentary mentions issues of race, gender, sexual orientation, and other identities, and introduces a quotation about romance novels.

patterns.name: Sports fans evaluating a player
patterns.context: A fan predicts a team will be satisfied with acquiring a player and evaluates the player's receiving ability.

7_2170.description: 激活出现在多种文体的内容词与固定表达中：专利套语、审核发布、数学变量i、发动机参数、法律判例、文化评论及体育评价。没有足够证据将这些触发点归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 专利法律套语与显而易见性
patterns.trigger: « reasons»、« stated»、« above»、« below»、« which»、« become»、« apparent»、« those»、« skilled»、« art»、« upon»
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景或发明说明的惯用句式中，描述理由、特征或内容将为本领域技术人员所知。

patterns.name: 审核、发布与内容管理
patterns.trigger: « posts»、« hours»、« put»、« up»、« moderated»、« thru»；以及 « published»、« fields»、« Comment»、« Name»、« Email»、« content»、« material»
patterns.context: 讨论帖子审核和发布延迟，或网页发布状态、评论表单及网站内容。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子与网页界面/站点免责声明

patterns.name: 数学符号化表达中的字母 i
patterns.trigger: «i»，常与幂、分数、括号、微分符号相邻，如 «i»**«4»、«d»、«/»
patterns.context: 在密集的符号计算式中，i 作为变量反复出现；周围还混有数字、运算符及少量文字指令。

patterns.name: 燃烧发动机的数值技术描述
patterns.trigger: « air»、« ratios»、« stoichiometric»、« engine»、« rotate»、« rpm»、« milliseconds»
patterns.context: 围绕空燃比、发动机转速及毫秒级时间尺度给出技术参数。

patterns.name: 法律效力与判例排除
patterns.trigger: « precedent»、« assertion»、« issues»、« claim»、« preclusion»、« judicial»、« estoppel»、« law»、« Court»、« decision»
patterns.context: 说明某裁定不得作为先例，同时列出仍可主张的争点或法律原则。

patterns.name: 文化评论中的身份与文学引文
patterns.trigger: « events»，以及 “« romantic» « novel» ... « written» ... « America»”
patterns.context: 文化评论提及种族、性别、性取向等身份议题，并引入关于浪漫小说的引文。

patterns.name: 体育迷对球员的评价
patterns.trigger: « Saskatchewan»、« fan»、« think»、« lands»、« guy»、« sticky»、« hands»、« thrown»、« caught»
patterns.context: 球迷预测某队得到球员后会满意，并以接球能力作评价。

en.description: Activation occurs separately in pseudo-Latin placeholder text, rubber-cleaning instructions, a forum moderation complaint, and legal citation restrictions and medical disclaimers; the latter two both concern published content, but differ in trigger location and phrasing.

patterns.name: Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: In pseudo-Latin or placeholder-style paragraphs, activation centers on internal subword fragments of several words; no clear semantic context condition.

patterns.name: Cleaning rubber surfaces
patterns.context: Describes removing residual protective agent from a rubber surface; activation falls on the structure that’s left, which refers to the residue.

patterns.name: Post moderation delay
patterns.context: Compares one’s own post with a later-published post and complains about inconsistent moderation or publication order.

patterns.name: Restrictions on citing legal cases
patterns.context: A California court rule states that unpublished opinions may not be cited or relied upon and specifies an exception.

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer
patterns.context: A medical journal disclaimer emphasizes that an article is for informational purposes only and cannot replace professional medical advice; appears in the journal name and disclaimer wording.

7_2170.description: 激活分别出现在伪拉丁占位文本、橡胶清洁说明、论坛审核抱怨，以及法律引用限制和医学免责声明中；后两类都涉及发表内容，但触发位置与句式不同。

patterns.name: 拉丁占位文本
patterns.context: 伪拉丁文或占位式段落中，激活集中在若干词的内部子词片段；没有明显语义上下文条件

patterns.name: 橡胶表面清洁
patterns.context: 说明清理橡胶表面残留保护剂，激活落在指示残留物的 that’s left 结构

patterns.name: 帖子审核延迟
patterns.context: 比较自己的帖子与较晚发布的帖子，抱怨审核或发布顺序不一致

patterns.name: 法律判例引用限制
patterns.context: 加州法院规则中说明未正式发表意见不得引用或依赖，并指出例外规则

patterns.name: 医学免责声明
patterns.context: 医学期刊免责声明强调文章仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗建议；在期刊名和免责声明句式中出现
patterns.domain: 医学论文页面及免责声明

en.concept: Text fragments from multiple domains, no clear single concept
en.description: Activation examples span legal rules, forum posts, sports, repair, biomedicine, medical imaging, public health, and programming discussions. The clearest recurring pattern is two nearly identical citations of a California court rule restricting citations; the remaining topics differ.

patterns.name: Restrictions on citing legal opinions
patterns.context: Explains the rule barring citation of unpublished opinions, including Rules 8.1115(a) and 8.1115(b).

patterns.name: Forum post moderation delays
patterns.context: A poster complains that their post takes a long time to be moderated and published; the tone is colloquial.

patterns.name: Declining baseball participation
patterns.context: Describes a decline over time in baseball participation among youth and in public attention.

patterns.name: Cleaning rubber surfaces
patterns.context: Discusses attempts to wipe off or remove residual protective dressing from a rubber surface.

patterns.name: Embarrassing code
patterns.context: A forum reply calls code ugly and embarrassing.

patterns.name: Liposome extravasation in tumors
patterns.context: Compares drug-carrier extravasation in tumors and mentions related mechanisms.

patterns.name: Imaging and skeletal anatomy
patterns.context: A case or imaging report describes the skeleton, jaw, and tooth calcification.

patterns.name: Public health agency outbreak briefing
patterns.context: Reports officials praising measures to contain transmission during an outbreak briefing.

patterns.name: Comparing language speeds
patterns.context: A forum discusses programming language performance and data processing in scientific computing.

7_2170.concept: 多领域文本片段，单一概念不明
7_2170.description: 激活样本横跨法律规则、论坛发言、体育、维修、生物医学、病例影像、公共卫生和编程讨论；较明确的重复模式仅为两段几乎相同的加州法院引用限制条文，其余主题各异。

patterns.name: 法律判例引用限制
patterns.trigger: “IAL REPORTS”“California Rules of Court”“prohibits courts and parties from citing or relying”
patterns.context: 关于未正式发表意见不得引用的规则说明，包含规则编号 8.1115(a) 与 8.1115(b)。

patterns.name: 论坛发帖审核延迟
patterns.trigger: “posts”“take hours to be put up”“moderated posts”
patterns.context: 发帖者抱怨自己的帖子审核、发布耗时；语气口语化。

patterns.name: 棒球参与度下降
patterns.trigger: “taken a dip”“youth participation”“baseball”“taken a back seat”
patterns.context: 描述棒球在青少年参与和社会关注度方面随时间下降。

patterns.name: 清洁橡胶表面
patterns.trigger: “dry MF towel”“noise”“cut through any sort of protectant”“rubber”
patterns.context: 讨论擦拭或去除橡胶表面残留保护剂的尝试。

patterns.name: 代码令人难堪
patterns.context: 论坛回复中把代码外观称为难看、令人尴尬。

patterns.name: 脂质体肿瘤外渗
patterns.context: 比较药物载体在肿瘤中的外渗，并提及相关机制。

patterns.name: 影像与骨骼解剖
patterns.trigger: “lower end of femur”“upper end of tibia”“X-ray chest”“mandible”“calcified crowns”
patterns.context: 病例或影像报告中描述骨骼、下颌及牙齿钙化情况。

patterns.name: 卫生组织疫情通报
patterns.trigger: “World Health Organisation”“Country Director in Nigeria”“contain the spread”
patterns.context: 报道官员在疫情简报中称赞遏制传播的措施。

patterns.name: 语言速度比较
patterns.context: 论坛讨论编程语言性能及科学计算中的数据处理。

en.description: Activation patterns vary: they cover expressions of put and its result or destination, code identifiers, uppercase abbreviations in flight records, subword segmentation of long words, and specific vocabulary and contexts involving sports, personal relationships, surface cleaning, and music memories.

patterns.name: put and expressions of result/destination
patterns.context: The verb put combines with a direction or result phrase, or describes arrangements or measures being implemented; appears in contexts such as post moderation and disease control.

patterns.name: Multipart identifiers and field names
patterns.context: Camel-case identifiers, parameters, or field names in code; activation is scattered across identifier fragments and adjacent code tokens.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and alphanumeric codes
patterns.context: Compactly formatted uppercase booking confirmation text containing abbreviations, model numbers, and seat numbers.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation within long words
patterns.context: Long words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation on different internal fragments; occurs in both English quotations and pseudo-Latin.

patterns.name: Sports and draft-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses declining participation in youth sports in Puerto Rico and possible reasons.

patterns.name: Descriptions of personal relationships and social traits
patterns.context: Describes a person’s upbringing, educational performance, and tendency to make friends in parallel.

patterns.name: Product cleaning and protective-layer treatment
patterns.context: Discusses wiping contact areas, treating residual protective agent, and rubber surfaces.

patterns.name: Memories and feelings about listening to songs
patterns.context: First-person recollection of songs on a CD and the enjoyment of listening to them.

patterns.name: General complaint about post moderation times
patterns.context: Asks why one’s post took longer to pass moderation than posts submitted later; overlaps with the put expression in passage 1 but more specifically concerns moderation delays.

7_2170.description: 激活模式多样：涵盖 put 的结果或去向表达、代码标识符、航班记录中的大写缩写、长词子词切分，以及体育、人物关系、表面清洁和音乐回忆等具体词汇与语境。

patterns.name: put及其结果/去向表达
patterns.context: 动词 put 与方向或结果成分组合，或描述安排、措施落实；在帖子审核、疾病控制等上下文中出现。

patterns.name: 多部分标识符与字段名
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式标识符、参数或字段名；激活分散在标识符片段及相邻代码 token 上。

patterns.name: 缩写及字母数字编码
patterns.context: 大写、紧凑排版的预订确认文本，包含缩写、型号和座位号。

patterns.name: 长词内部的子词切分
patterns.context: 较长词被拆成多个子词 token，激活落在词内不同片段；既出现在英文引文，也出现在伪拉丁文。
patterns.domain: 论坛引文、代码／占位文本

patterns.name: 运动赛事与选秀相关词汇
patterns.context: 讨论波多黎各青少年体育参与度下降及其可能原因。

patterns.name: 人物关系和社会特征描述
patterns.context: 并列描述人物成长环境、教育表现与交友倾向。

patterns.name: 产品清洁与保护层处理
patterns.context: 讨论擦拭接触区域、处理残留保护剂和橡胶表面。

patterns.name: 歌曲聆听的回忆与感受
patterns.trigger: “song number 10”“Johnny B. Goode”“feeling so good when I listened”
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆某张 CD 中歌曲及聆听时的愉悦感受。

patterns.name: 一般帖子审核时间抱怨
patterns.trigger: “posts of mine take hours to be put up”“moderated posts”
patterns.context: 询问个人帖子为何比之后提交的帖子更晚通过审核；与第 1 段中的 put 表达重叠，但更具体地涉及审核延迟。

en.description: Activations span domains with no single theme: they occur in clause continuations and temporal or concessive expressions, as well as rubber cleaning, baseball, moderation, code, politics, taxonomy, and medical disclaimers. Paragraphs 8–10 repeat the same disclaimer and do not establish a unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: Connectives and sentence continuation
patterns.context: Activations occur near clause continuations, added conditions, or temporal/concessive phrases; the pattern is inconsistent and often includes ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Post moderation and publication
patterns.context: Discusses posts awaiting moderation and publication, and differences in how quickly posts are handled.

patterns.name: Recurring Cureus medical disclaimer
patterns.context: A disclaimer at the end of a medical article is followed by the article title; the three passages are nearly identical.

patterns.name: Taxonomic names and historical classification
patterns.context: Species descriptions and explanations that they were once considered a variety of a taxonomic group.

patterns.name: Rubber cleaning and protective dressing residue
patterns.context: Describes attempts to clean a rubber surface and remove residual protective dressing.

patterns.name: Baseball's declining status over time
patterns.context: Describes changes in baseball's public attention, youth participation, and talent development.

patterns.name: Ugly and embarrassing code
patterns.context: Discusses code readability or internationalization, in a context containing a quotation.

patterns.name: Systemic corruption and a cost-cutting quote
patterns.context: Quotes another person's comments about the state of a system and its practices.

patterns.name: A concessionary assessment of U.S. conduct
patterns.context: First acknowledges negative conduct by the target of criticism, then makes a comparative defense using “at least…”

7_2170.description: 激活分布跨领域且无单一主题：可见句内承接、时间或让步表达，也覆盖橡胶清洁、棒球、审核、代码、政治、分类学及医学免责声明。第8–10段为同一免责声明的重复样本，不能据此推断统一语义特征。

patterns.name: 关系词与句子延续
patterns.trigger: “that”后的“'s left on the rubber”及“a back seat among”；另有“at some point”“at least”等时间或让步表达
patterns.context: 激活落在句中承接关系、补充条件或时间/让步短语附近；表现不统一，且常伴随普通功能词
patterns.domain: 论坛、说明文字、叙述文本

patterns.name: 帖子审核与发布
patterns.context: 讨论帖子等待审核、发布及不同帖子处理速度

patterns.name: 反复出现的 Cureus 医疗免责声明
patterns.trigger: “research and reference purposes”“qualified health care professional”“Do not disregard or avoid professional medical advice”及“Introduction”
patterns.context: 医学文章末尾的免责声明后接文章标题；三段文本几乎重复

patterns.name: 分类学名与历史归属
patterns.context: 物种描述及其曾被视作某分类单元变种的说明

patterns.name: 橡胶清洁与保护剂残留
patterns.trigger: “cut through any sort of protectant that's left on the rubber”
patterns.context: 描述清洁橡胶表面、去除保护剂残留的尝试

patterns.name: 棒球地位随时间下降
patterns.trigger: “over time, had taken a back seat”
patterns.context: 叙述棒球在社会关注度、青年参与和人才发展方面的变化

patterns.name: 代码丑陋与尴尬
patterns.context: 讨论代码可读性或国际化相关问题，语境含引述

patterns.name: 系统腐败与削减成本的引语
patterns.trigger: “Let’s start cutting corners”及“system can be as rotten as you like”
patterns.context: 引用他人关于系统状况和做法的评论

patterns.name: 对美国行为的让步式评价
patterns.trigger: “For all the bad that the US does, at least they don't invade and annex”
patterns.context: 先承认批评对象有负面行为，再作至少……的对比辩护

en.description: Activation is distributed across several corpora: wording about scope, conditions, and compensation in legal and patent texts; code-platform macros; and local phrases in forums, news, and personal narratives. A few recurring words such as all, from/of, that, if, and over occur, but are insufficient to explain all examples.

patterns.name: all/all of construction
patterns.context: Expresses entirety, totality, or scope in a noun phrase or legal clause; [1] is “all the rubber door seals”, [2] is “any provision ...”, and [9] is “all damages”.

patterns.name: from/from of relational words
patterns.context: Connects source, possession, or quantity relations; [1] has sound “from all four doors”, [6] has “any of the prior art”, and [7] has “one-third of its residents”.

patterns.name: that introducing a clause or relative structure
patterns.context: Connects a modifying clause after a noun or the content of a statement; [9] has “damages that would be available”, and [6] has “features that result”.

patterns.name: Conditional/hypothetical expressions
patterns.context: Introduces a condition or temporal context; [4] discusses the hypothetical of making robots, [7] recounts when an official was angered, and in [1] “if” appears in a parenthetical negative statement.
patterns.domain: Online essays, news narratives, everyday commentary

patterns.name: Changes in degree or over time
patterns.context: Describes change or degree across time or in comparisons; [1] has “over broken pavement”, [10] has “over time” and “taken a back seat”, and [5] has “more into”.

patterns.name: Technical proper nouns and patent claims
patterns.context: Concerns a device and its novelty or obviousness relative to prior art; fixed legal wording in patent backgrounds.

patterns.name: Limitations and conditions in statutes
patterns.context: Introduces statutory exceptions or conditions in a format not limited by other provisions.

patterns.name: Legal damages and payment amounts
patterns.context: Specifies a petitioner’s lump-sum award and form of payment, and defines the damages covered.

patterns.name: Platform macros and conditional compilation in code
patterns.context: Filters source code according to target platform or compilation environment; nearby UI/API identifiers and an unimplemented-feature notice.

patterns.name: Quoted technical terms and their evaluation
patterns.context: A forum discussion of code readability or style, quoting words and describing them as unattractive or embarrassing.

patterns.name: Hypothesis about robots and human similarity
patterns.context: Speculates about the dangers if robots were like humans and discusses the idea of making them weaker.

patterns.name: Music memories and positive feelings
patterns.context: Recalls songs from an album and the enjoyment of listening to them.

patterns.name: Urban poverty and political quotations
patterns.context: Describes urban poverty and reactions to a political figure’s speech.

patterns.name: Other local common words and narrative details
patterns.context: These words appear separately in specific narratives about car noises, song memories, and changes in baseball status, with no clear shared theme.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, music commentary, sports commentary

7_2170.description: 激活分布于多种语料：法律和专利中的范围、条件及赔偿措辞，代码平台宏，以及论坛、新闻和个人叙述中的局部词句。少数反复出现 all、from/of、that、if、over 等，但不足以解释全部样本。

patterns.name: all/all of 构式
patterns.context: 在名词短语或法律条款中表示整体、全部或涵盖范围；[1] 是 “all the rubber door seals”，[2] 是 “any provision ...”，[9] 是 “all damages”。

patterns.name: from/from of 关系词
patterns.context: 连接来源、所属或数量关系；[1] 为声音 “from all four doors”，[6] 为 “any of the prior art”，[7] 为 “one-third of its residents”。

patterns.name: that 引导从句或关系结构
patterns.context: 连接名词后的修饰从句或陈述内容；[9] 为 “damages that would be available”，[6] 为 “features that result”。

patterns.name: 条件/假设表达
patterns.context: 引入条件或时间情境；[4] 讨论制造机器人的假设，[7] 叙述官员受到激怒的时点，[1] 的 “if” 出现在括号内否定说明。
patterns.domain: 网络随笔、新闻叙述、日常评论

patterns.name: 程度或时间变化
patterns.context: 描述跨时间或比较中的变化、程度；[1] 是 “over broken pavement”，[10] 是 “over time” 与 “taken a back seat”，[5] 有 “more into”。

patterns.name: 技术专名与专利权利表述
patterns.trigger: “plunger” [6]；“prior art” [6]；“anticipated, rendered obvious, suggested, or even implied” [6]
patterns.context: 围绕装置及其相对既有技术的新颖性、显而易见性展开；为专利背景的固定法律措辞。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的限定与条件
patterns.context: 以不受其他条文限制的格式引入法定例外或条件。

patterns.name: 法律赔偿与金额支付
patterns.context: 说明请愿人获得的一次性赔偿金额及支付形式，并界定涵盖的损害。

patterns.name: 代码中的平台宏与条件编译
patterns.context: 在源码中根据目标平台或编译环境筛选代码；邻近 UI/API 标识符及未实现提示。

patterns.name: 被引用的技术词语及其评价
patterns.context: 论坛对代码可读性或风格的讨论，引用词语并评价其难看或令人尴尬。

patterns.name: 机器人与人类相似性的假设
patterns.context: 推测若机器人与人类相同会带来的危险，并讨论让其变弱的设想。
patterns.domain: 非正式网络讨论、科幻式议论

patterns.name: 音乐回忆与积极感受
patterns.context: 回忆专辑中的歌曲及聆听时的愉悦体验。

patterns.name: 城市贫困与政治引语
patterns.context: 叙述城市贫困背景及政治人物讲话引发的反应。
patterns.domain: 新闻或历史性城市政治文本

patterns.name: 其他局部常见词及叙事细节
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在汽车异响、歌曲回忆和棒球地位变化的具体叙述中，没有明显共同主题。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、音乐评论、体育评论

en.description: Activations are scattered across clause connections, first-person experiences, morphological subword fragments, code identifiers, proper names and abbreviations, quotations, and discourse from diverse domains; no trigger pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Long-range continuation in conditional/temporal clauses
patterns.context: Conditional, temporal, or concessive clauses connect to subsequent events, states, or judgments; activations often fall on the clause introducer or an adjacent token within the clause.
patterns.domain: Narrative, legal argument, news/historical text, forum posts; cross-domain

patterns.name: First-person experiences and evaluations
patterns.context: First-person narration describes personal experiences, feelings, or opinions, often alongside evaluations or causal explanations.

patterns.name: Morphological fragments in nominalizations/derived words
patterns.context: A longer word contains decomposable affix or stem fragments; [4] is a code context mixing HTML/CSS with placeholder Latin text, while [6] is a technical discussion.
patterns.domain: Automotive commentary, webpage markup/placeholder text, programmer discussion

patterns.name: Identifiers and type/member access in code
patterns.context: In code or markup languages, identifiers are structured with capitalization, periods, parentheses, hyphens, and similar elements.

patterns.name: Proper names, abbreviations, and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Proper names, organization/brand abbreviations, or entities mixing digits and letters appear in the text.
patterns.domain: Music commentary, professional wrestling commentary, news/historical text

patterns.name: Quotations or emphasis in quotation marks
patterns.context: Quotation marks enclose words under discussion or quoted material, near explanatory or reporting context.

patterns.name: Calls for readers to support or join
patterns.context: Directly asks readers to join or support an effort, using a second-person call-to-action tone.
patterns.domain: Fundraising copy on a nonprofit news site

patterns.name: Liability and motive arguments in law
patterns.context: Explains conditions for attributing conduct between an employer/master and employee/servant, distinguishing personal motives.

patterns.name: Forum moderation and expressing opinions
patterns.context: Discusses post moderation delays and notes when a stated opinion aligns with the community's views.

7_2170.description: 激活分散于从句衔接、第一人称经历、词内形态片段、代码标识符、专名缩写、引语及多种领域话语；没有一个触发模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 条件/时间从句中的长距离续写
patterns.trigger: "as long as I have"（[10]）；"when I listened"（[1]）；"if done"、"while engaged"（[9]）；"when he encouraged"（[3]）
patterns.context: 条件、时间或让步从句连接后续事件、状态或判断；激活常落在从句引导词或从句中的相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 叙述、法律论述、新闻/历史文本、论坛发言；跨领域

patterns.name: 第一人称经历与评价
patterns.trigger: "I remember feeling"、"I listened"（[1]）；"I never had a problem"、"I washed"（[2]）；"I have an opinion or observation"（[10]）
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述自身经历、感受或观点，常与评价或因果说明相连。
patterns.domain: 评论、消费者/汽车体验、论坛帖子

patterns.name: 名词化/派生词的形态片段
patterns.context: 较长词内部出现可分解的词缀或词干片段；[4] 为 HTML/CSS 与占位拉丁文混杂的代码上下文，[6] 为技术讨论。
patterns.domain: 汽车评论、网页标记/占位文本、程序员讨论

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与类型/成员访问
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中，标识符由大小写、点号、括号、连字符等结构组成。

patterns.name: 专名、缩写及字母数字串
patterns.context: 专名、组织/品牌缩写或数字与字母混排的实体出现在文本中。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、职业摔角评论、新闻/历史文本

patterns.name: 引语或强调性引号
patterns.context: 引号框定被讨论的词语或引述内容，附近有解释或报道语境。

patterns.name: 面向读者的支持/加入号召
patterns.context: 直接向读者发出加入或支持的请求，使用第二人称号召语气。
patterns.domain: 非营利新闻网站募捐文案

patterns.name: 法律中的责任与动机论证
patterns.trigger: "a master is liable for his servant's negligent acts"、"external, independent and personal motive"（[9]）
patterns.context: 阐述雇主/主人与雇员/仆人行为之间的归责条件，并区分个人动机。

patterns.name: 论坛审核与意见表达
patterns.trigger: "moderated posts"、"I have an opinion or observation"（[10]）
patterns.context: 讨论帖子审核延迟，并指出发言观点与社区意见一致时的情形。

en.description: In multiple passages, activation falls on when or nearby positions, especially when I, introducing the time or conditions under which an experience, feeling, or behavior occurs. The remaining passages vary in language, topic, and style, with no confirmed shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: when clauses in first-person experiences
patterns.context: Describes personal feelings, memories, or behavior; when introduces the situation that triggers a feeling or behavior. Clearly appears in “when I listened to it” and “when I did it”; passage 2 also uses when to introduce an event.
patterns.domain: Online essays, personal narratives, and news quotations

patterns.name: when introducing a condition or temporal background
patterns.context: when is followed by a clause that provides the conditions or background for an event, not limited to personal feelings.

patterns.name: Local pairing of when followed by a personal pronoun
patterns.context: Activation centers on when immediately followed by I, while subsequent clause content and style vary; passages 1 and 10 are especially consistent with this pattern.

patterns.name: when in sporadic contexts
patterns.context: In a report on a political speech, when introduces an official’s reaction to urban crime; this use differs from personal narrative.

7_2170.description: 多段激活落在 when 或其邻近位置，尤其是 when I，用于引出经历、感受或行为发生的时间与条件。其余段落语种、主题和文体各异，缺乏可确认的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 第一人称经历中的 when 条件句
patterns.context: 叙述个人感受、记忆或行为；when 引出触发某种感受或行为的情境。明显出现在“when I listened to it”“when I did it”中；第2段也有 when 引出事件。
patterns.domain: 网络随笔、个人叙述及新闻引语

patterns.name: when 引出条件或时间背景
patterns.context: when 后接从句，交代事件发生时的条件或背景，不限于个人感受。
patterns.domain: 新闻/政治引语、论坛讨论

patterns.name: when 后接人称代词的局部搭配
patterns.context: 激活集中于 when 后紧跟 I 的位置，之后从句内容和文体各异；第1、10段尤其符合。

patterns.name: 零散语境中的 when
patterns.context: 在政治演说报道中，when 引出官员对城市犯罪问题的反应；这一用例与个人叙事不同。

en.concept: Local subword fragments in text and code
en.description: The most consistent frequent pattern is HTML declarations of JavaScript/CSS types and references to scripts or stylesheets. Activations also occur in HTML placeholder text, Russian subword fragments, Objective-C identifiers, and several unrelated English narratives and stock advertising phrases; overall, this is not a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: JavaScript references in HTML
patterns.context: HTML tags declare JavaScript MIME types and include scripts via src; activations concentrate near tag attributes and paths.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS resources and style tags
patterns.context: HTML links to CSS files or embeds styles with style tags; these often occur in adjacent markup to script references.

patterns.name: Pronouns and verbs in English narrative
patterns.context: First-person recollection of listening to music; activations occur in natural-language text rather than HTML or code.

patterns.name: Word forms in HTML placeholder Latin text
patterns.context: Lorem ipsum placeholder text is split into subword fragments, embedded in an HTML div.

patterns.name: Russian subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in Russian technical text segmented into subwords, especially character or root fragments within words.

patterns.name: Objective-C lifecycle method and comment
patterns.context: A callback for an UIKit app entering the foreground, with a comment about state transitions; activations fall on the identifier and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Conditionals and pronouns in English hypotheticals
patterns.context: Informal hypothetical discussion about technology, robots, and their dangers, repeatedly using we/us and conditional structures.
patterns.domain: Online colloquial text, science fiction or technical discussion

patterns.name: Sponsored-ad transition wording
patterns.context: A broadcast-style transition to an advertisement appears after the body of a webpage article.

7_2170.concept: 文本与代码中的局部词片段
7_2170.description: 最一致的高频模式是 HTML 中声明 JavaScript/CSS 类型、引用脚本或样式资源；此外也激活于 HTML 占位文、俄语词内片段、Objective-C 标识符，以及若干彼此不同的英文叙述和固定广告措辞，整体并非单一语义特征。

patterns.name: HTML 中的 JavaScript 引用
patterns.context: HTML 标签用 MIME 类型声明 JavaScript，并通过 src 引入脚本；激活集中在标签属性及路径附近。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 资源与样式标签
patterns.context: HTML 中链接 CSS 文件，或用 style 标签嵌入样式；与脚本引用常出现在相邻标记中。

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的代词与动词
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆听音乐的体验；激活分布于自然语言词句，不是 HTML 或代码语境。

patterns.name: HTML 占位拉丁文中的词形
patterns.context: Lorem ipsum 占位文本被拆成子词片段，片段嵌在 HTML div 中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页片段、占位文本

patterns.name: 俄语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词切开的俄语技术文本中；尤其是词内的字符或词根片段。

patterns.name: Objective-C 生命周期方法与注释
patterns.context: UIKit 应用进入前台的回调及其关于状态转换的注释；激活落在标识符和说明文字上。

patterns.name: 英文假设句中的条件与代词
patterns.context: 关于技术、机器人及其危险性的口语化假设讨论，反复使用 we/us 与条件结构。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、科幻或技术讨论

patterns.name: 赞助广告转场措辞
patterns.context: 网页文章正文后出现广播式广告转场句。
patterns.domain: 邮件/网页转载文本、广告文案

en.description: Activations occur across JavaScript tags, forum moderation and comment guidelines, first-person experiences and emotions, hypothetical clauses, and Bulgarian political text. No clear commonality is apparent; the feature may respond to cues from multiple formats and contexts.

patterns.name: JavaScript script tags
patterns.context: JavaScript script tags opened or closed in HTML, often alongside src paths, indentation, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Forum moderation and post review
patterns.context: Forum rules or user complaints about delays in post review and inconsistent moderation processes.

patterns.name: Opinions, comments, and their guidelines
patterns.context: Discussing the expression of opinions, responding to others’ comments, or rules governing comment content.

patterns.name: First-person recollections and feelings
patterns.context: Recounting personal experiences and describing emotions, feelings, or guilt at the time.

patterns.name: Modal and hypothetical conditional structures
patterns.context: Discussing hypothetical situations and their possible consequences, such as dangers posed by humanoid robots.

patterns.name: Bulgarian political names and institutional terms
patterns.context: Bulgarian-language passages mentioning names and political institutional terms such as committees and regional development.

7_2170.description: 激活分布于 JavaScript 标签、论坛管理和评论规范、第一人称经历与情绪、假设句及保加利亚语政治文本；共同点不明显，可能对多种格式与语境线索响应。

patterns.name: JavaScript 脚本标签
patterns.context: HTML 中引入或闭合 JavaScript 脚本标签；常伴随 src 路径、缩进和换行。

patterns.name: 论坛管理与发帖审核
patterns.context: 论坛规则或用户抱怨发帖审核延迟、管理流程不一致。

patterns.name: 意见、评论及其规范
patterns.context: 谈论表达观点、回应他人评论，或规定评论内容的行为规范。

patterns.name: 第一人称回忆与感受
patterns.trigger: `I remember feeling`、`I listened`、`I felt`、`I did it`
patterns.context: 叙述个人经历，并描述当时的情绪、感受或内疚。

patterns.name: 情态与假设条件结构
patterns.context: 讨论假设情境及其可能后果；如制造类人机器人所带来的危险。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语政治姓名与机构词
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句段，提及姓名及委员会、区域发展等政治机构语汇。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in JavaScript script tags and file paths in HTML/source code, and also occur in Latin placeholder text on webpages. Scattered narrative evaluations, reports of historical speeches, and conditional discussions of robots also appear, with no unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: JS script tags
patterns.context: Consecutive HTML script tags declare or reference external JavaScript files, often with indentation, line breaks, and paths.

patterns.name: Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: Pseudo-Latin placeholder text appears in paragraph form, often with HTML formatting markup or line breaks.

patterns.name: Emotional recollection and evaluation
patterns.context: A narrator recalls a musical experience or a person's abilities in emotional or evaluative terms; activations concentrate near connectives and evaluations.

patterns.name: Year and speech narrative
patterns.context: Mentions a specific year, a political figure's speech, and the reaction it prompted; activations fall on the year and subsequent narrative words.

patterns.name: Conditionals about robots
patterns.context: Uses conditional sentences to discuss understanding technology, building humanoid robots, and potential dangers.

7_2170.description: 激活主要集中于 HTML/源码中的 JavaScript 脚本标签与文件路径，也见网页拉丁占位文；另有零散叙事评价、历史演讲报道及机器人条件讨论，未见统一词义模式。

patterns.name: JS 脚本标签
patterns.context: HTML 中连续声明或引用外部 JavaScript 文件的脚本标签；常伴随缩进、换行及路径。

patterns.name: 拉丁文假文本
patterns.context: 以段落形式出现的伪拉丁占位文，常含 HTML 排版标记或换行。

patterns.name: 情感回忆与评价
patterns.trigger: `I remember feeling so good when I listened to it`；`What made Jess so special was her uncanny ability`
patterns.context: 叙述者以情绪或评价性措辞回顾音乐体验、人物能力；触发更集中于连接词及评价附近。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、新闻或人物报道

patterns.name: 年份与演讲叙述
patterns.trigger: `1974 inaugural speech`、`when he encouraged the city's criminals`
patterns.context: 提及具体年份、政治人物演讲及其引发的反应；激活落在年份和后续叙述词上。

patterns.name: 条件句谈机器人
patterns.trigger: `if we get the technology`、`we would have to make them weak if we were to make them exactly like us`
patterns.context: 以条件句讨论理解技术、制造类人机器人及潜在危险。

en.description: Activations span natural language and code: in natural language they often occur near the, conditional or evaluative expressions, and proper-name subword fragments; in code they occur around HTML tags, attributes, line breaks, indentation, and source snippets. Some sporadic words are difficult to explain consistently.

patterns.name: “the” appearing abruptly in context
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the or consecutive tokens after it. This occurs in varied contexts such as narratives, comments, and fantasy text, but not every instance of the is marked.

patterns.name: Words in English emotional expressions
patterns.context: In personal recollections or advice, activations occur near expressions of emotion, degree, and need; co-occurrence with the may be only a local overlap.

patterns.name: Markup and attribute fragments in English source code
patterns.context: Activations occur near tags, attribute values, and paths in code; other activations occur near Objective-C comments and identifiers.

patterns.name: Conditional and hypothetical structures in sentences
patterns.context: In conditional, temporal, or hypothetical subordinate clauses, conjunctions and subsequent words in the clause show stronger activations.

patterns.name: Proper-name or rare-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of proper names or word endings; they may reflect rare words or subword boundaries, but no stable shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Proper names, sports reporting, and general narratives

patterns.name: Indentation and line breaks in web code
patterns.context: In structured web text, activations occur around line breaks, indentation, and tag boundaries, partly overlapping with code-markup patterns.

patterns.name: Narrative evaluations about people
patterns.context: A person or speaker serves as the subject, followed by an evaluation, recollection, or description of ability. Samples are sparse, so this may not be an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations that do not fit a stable pattern
patterns.context: Local words vary, with no identifiable shared trigger.
patterns.domain: News quotations, hypothetical dialogue, fantasy plots

7_2170.concept: 多语境中的局部词法/边界线索
7_2170.description: 激活横跨自然语言与代码：自然语言中常落在the、条件/评价表达及专名子词附近；代码中落在HTML标签、属性、换行缩进和源码片段。部分零散词难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 语境中突然出现的“the”
patterns.trigger: the（如“feel the need”“the internet”“the city's”“the powerful”）
patterns.context: 激活常落在 the 或其后的连续 token；出现在叙述、评论、奇幻文本等多种语境中，但并非所有 the 都被标记。

patterns.name: 英语情感表达中的词语
patterns.context: 个人回忆或劝告语境，激活分布在情感、程度和需求表达附近；与 the 的共现可能只是局部重叠。

patterns.name: 英文源码中的标记与属性片段
patterns.context: 代码中标签、属性值及路径附近出现激活；另有 Objective-C 注释与标识符附近激活。

patterns.name: 句中条件与假设结构
patterns.trigger: “if we…”“if we were to…”“when he encouraged…”
patterns.context: 条件、时间或假设从句中，连接词及从句后续词有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 论述、假设性对话、新闻叙述

patterns.name: 专名或罕见词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的专名/词尾片段；可能反映罕见词或子词边界，尚无稳定共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 专名、赛事报道及普通叙述

patterns.name: 网页代码中的缩进与换行
patterns.context: 结构化网页文本中，换行、缩进和标签边界附近出现激活，和代码标记模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 围绕人物的叙述性评价
patterns.trigger: “What made Jess so special was”“I remember feeling…”
patterns.context: 用人物或说话者作为主语，接续评价、回忆或能力描述；样本很少，未必是独立规律。

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的零散激活
patterns.context: 局部词语各异，缺少可确认的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻引文、假设对话、奇幻剧情

en.description: Activations are scattered across annotations on application foreground/background states, web resource tags, patent prior-art phrasing, and narratives about music memories, urban politics, religious courtship, and dog racing. Apart from code/API and fixed legal language, there is little evidence of a unified semantics.

patterns.name: Foreground lifecycle callback
patterns.context: iOS Objective-C method names and comments describing an app moving from the background to the foreground and restoring state; activations also occur in the comment phrase “changes made on entering the background.”
patterns.domain: iOS application code and API comments on Github

patterns.name: Pleasure evoked by music memories
patterns.context: A first-person recollection of how listening to a particular song on an album felt; activations occur alongside words describing emotion and the listening experience.

patterns.name: Urban poverty and quoted narrative
patterns.context: First states the proportion of urban residents living in poverty, then quotes a historical figure’s speech and remarks about urban criminals; activations occur near the end of the passage.
patterns.domain: Urban or political history reporting, quoted narrative

patterns.name: Religious belief and marriage proposal
patterns.context: A biographical account of a woman’s belief about her relationship with God and an older widower proposing to her.

patterns.name: HTML script resource tags
patterns.context: JavaScript type specified via script tags in HTML, referencing local script files; several passages show consecutive or adjacent script resource references.

patterns.name: Patent prior art and obviousness phrasing
patterns.context: Patent background or claims comparing a device with prior art and using fixed legal phrases such as “not anticipated or obvious.”

patterns.name: Dog-racing events and animal abilities
patterns.context: Describes a sheepdog’s competition placement, then a dog’s unusual ability to read a flock of sheep.

patterns.name: CSS stylesheet resource tags
patterns.context: HTML references CSS files for themes or components; the passage also contains a text/css type attribute.

7_2170.description: 激活分散于应用前后台状态注释、网页资源标签、专利先有技术措辞，以及音乐回忆、城市政治、宗教婚恋和赛狗叙述；除代码/API与固定法律用语外，难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 进入前台生命周期回调
patterns.context: iOS Objective-C 方法名及其注释中，描述应用从后台转入前台、恢复状态的语境；激活也落在注释里关于 changes made on entering the background 的短语上。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 iOS 应用代码与 API 注释

patterns.name: 回忆音乐带来的愉悦感
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆听专辑中特定歌曲时的感受；激活随表达情绪和聆听经历的词串出现。

patterns.name: 城市贫困与引语叙述
patterns.trigger: «residents» «living at or below the federal poverty line»；«inaugural speech» «encouraged»
patterns.context: 先陈述城市居民贫困比例，接着引用历史人物演讲及其对城市犯罪者的言论；片段结尾处出现激活。
patterns.domain: 城市或政治历史报道、引文叙述

patterns.name: 宗教信念与婚姻求亲
patterns.context: 传记叙述女性对自身与上帝关系的信念，以及一位年长鳏夫向她求婚。

patterns.name: HTML 脚本资源标签
patterns.context: HTML 中通过 script 标签指定 JavaScript 类型并引用本地脚本文件；多段显示连续或相邻的脚本资源引用。

patterns.name: 专利先有技术与显而易见性表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利性论述，比较装置与既有技术，并使用固定的“未被预见或显而易见”等法律措辞。

patterns.name: 赛狗赛事与动物能力叙述
patterns.context: 叙述牧羊犬比赛名次，继而说明一只狗辨读羊群的特殊能力。

patterns.name: CSS 样式表资源标签
patterns.context: HTML 中引用主题或组件的 CSS 文件；片段还包含 text/css 类型属性。

en.concept: Triggers from local common words and code fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered: when followed by he/it recurs in narrative and legal text; two similar iOS comments highlight made on; activations also appear in various webpage source fragments and individual English narrative words.

patterns.name: Pronouns following when
patterns.context: In narrative or legal argument, when is immediately followed by he/it and then an action or judgment; activations concentrate especially on the pronoun and nearby text.

patterns.name: made on in code
patterns.context: An iOS lifecycle callback comment describes changes made when entering the background.

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript markup and paths
patterns.context: Activations occur in script tags, resource paths, comments, or HTML/CSS fragments; the specific highlighted substrings vary across passages.

patterns.name: Individual English narrative words
patterns.context: These words show strong activation in ordinary narrative, but the two passages differ in meaning and genre, with no shared local collocation evident.

7_2170.concept: 局部常见词及代码片段触发
7_2170.description: 激活分布零散：when 后接 he/it 在叙述和法律文本中重复出现；两段相似的 iOS 注释突出 made on；另在不同网页源码碎片及个别英语叙述词上激活。

patterns.name: when 后接代词
patterns.context: 叙述或法律论证中，when 后紧跟 he/it，后续为动作或判断；激活尤其集中在代词及其附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的 made on
patterns.trigger: «changes»« made»« on»；[3][5]均出现，且 made、on 激活较强
patterns.context: iOS 生命周期回调注释中，描述进入后台时所作的更改。

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript 标记与路径
patterns.context: 激活出现在脚本标签、资源路径、注释或 HTML/CSS 片段中；各段具体高亮子串不相同。

patterns.name: 个别英语叙述词
patterns.context: 普通叙述中出现这些词时有较强激活，但两段语义与文体不同，未见共享的局部搭配。
patterns.domain: 用户评论、动物赛事报道

en.description: Activations occur across varied text: in natural language they often appear in judgment or action clauses introduced by when, as well as narrative state words; in source code they occur in HTML tags, attributes, and script text. No single clear semantics explains all triggers.

patterns.name: Judgments, reactions, or outcomes after “when”
patterns.context: “When” introduces a clause in which a person or institution takes action, makes a judgment, or causes an outcome. Activation need not be adjacent to when; in passage [5], the relevant token occurs later in the clause.
patterns.domain: News narratives, personal recollections, legal decisions

patterns.name: HTML/code markup and attribute values
patterns.context: Activations occur in source text made up of HTML tags, attributes, and script references; highlights fall on tokens inside tags or on attribute values.
patterns.domain: Web source code, code and technical text

patterns.name: Words in narrative or descriptive discourse
patterns.context: General copulas, pronouns, degree expressions, or state expressions in natural-language narratives; trigger positions and specific meanings vary across passages.

7_2170.description: 激活分布于多种文本：自然语言中常见于 when 引出的判断或行动从句，也见于叙述性状态词；源码中则落在 HTML 标签、属性及脚本文本。无法用单一清晰语义解释全部触发。

patterns.name: “when”后的判断、反应或结果
patterns.context: “when”引出人物或机构采取行动、作出判断或导致结果的从句；触发并不要求紧邻 when，段[5]中相关 token 在后续从句中。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、个人回忆、法律判决

patterns.name: HTML/代码标记与属性值
patterns.trigger: HTML 片段中的 “<” “>” “div” “class” “script” “text” “javascript” 等高亮部分
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性及脚本引用组成的源码文本中激活；高亮落在标签内部的 token 或属性值。
patterns.domain: 网页源码、代码与技术文本

patterns.name: 叙事或描述性语篇中的词语
patterns.context: 自然语言叙述中的一般系词、代词、程度或状态表达；各段触发位置和具体语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 人物介绍、个人评论、体育报道

en.concept: Relational and narrative words across contexts
en.description: Activations occur in evaluative and emotional expressions, reports of people and events, conditional and temporal clauses, quantitative descriptions, technical explanations, and accounts of sports performance. They often fall near predicates, function words, or nouns in these contexts, with no stable single trigger word.

patterns.name: Emotional or evaluative predicates and complements
patterns.context: Often occurs in sentences expressing feelings, traits, evaluations, or identity, especially copulas, emotion verbs, or complements introduced by interrogatives; trigger locations vary and are not limited to a fixed word.

patterns.name: Verbs or quotations in reports about people and events
patterns.context: News or legal narratives involving a person’s identity, quotations, disclosures, or explanations of responsibility for events; activation locations vary.

patterns.name: Function words in conditional or temporal relations
patterns.context: In conditional, temporal, or recurring-situation clauses, stronger activations occur around if/when/every time and nearby pronouns or predicates.

patterns.name: Quantitative and statistical descriptions
patterns.context: Factual descriptions involving numbers, proportions, statistics, or time spans; activations may fall on words near the numbers.

patterns.name: Technical objects and explanations of their functions
patterns.context: Explaining the purpose, properties, or use of hardware components, materials, or web technologies; activations often fall on technical nouns and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Sports competitions and performance descriptions
patterns.context: Accounts of scores, player performance, or game state; this occurs across different sports, with no consistent trigger term.

7_2170.description: 激活分布在评价与感受表达、人物事件报道、条件时间从句、数量统计、技术说明及体育表现叙述中；多落于这些语境的谓语、功能词或名词附近，未见稳定单一触发词。

patterns.name: 情绪或评价性谓语及其补语
patterns.context: 常出现在表达感受、特质、评价或身份意义的句子中，尤其是系词、感受动词或疑问词引出的补语；触发点分散，不限于某个固定词。
patterns.domain: 叙事、音乐体验、非正式议论

patterns.name: 人物与事件报道中的动词或引述
patterns.context: 新闻或法律叙述中，涉及人物身份、引述、披露或对事件责任的说明；激活位置不固定。

patterns.name: 条件或时间关系中的功能词
patterns.context: 条件、时间或反复发生的情境从句中，较突出的激活落在 if/when/every time 一带及相邻代词或谓语。

patterns.name: 数量与统计描述
patterns.context: 数字、比例、统计数据或时间跨度构成的事实描述；激活可能落在数字周边的词语上。
patterns.domain: 体育统计、社会数据、新闻

patterns.name: 技术对象及其功能说明
patterns.context: 解释硬件部件、材料或网页技术的用途、特性或使用方式；激活多落在技术名词及说明语境中。

patterns.name: 体育比赛与表现描述
patterns.trigger: «goalies»8 «were»9 «off»5；«rookie»5 «allowed»5 «9»5 «catches»7；«third»4 «in»4 «the»2 O'Sullivans Transport Australian Yard Dog Championship
patterns.context: 比赛成绩、球员表现或比赛状态的叙述；不同项目中出现，未见统一的特定术语触发。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal enactment and judicial phrasing, evidence and observations in research, error or bias detection, and discussions of funding and news attribution. Many involve stating conclusions, existence, or causality, but there is no stable single trigger word.

patterns.name: Legal phrase “into law”
patterns.context: Describes a law or institution being passed or becoming law; “into” and nearby words activate strongly

patterns.name: Evidence and research statements in scientific papers
patterns.context: Statements of research findings, literature evidence, or statistical analysis, especially indicating that a phenomenon exists or that evidence supports a conclusion

patterns.name: Political figures and urban crime reporting
patterns.context: Quoting a political figure’s speech concerning cities, crime, and social issues

patterns.name: Discussion of compensation, funding, and beneficiaries
patterns.context: Discusses compensation for project contributors, funding, and other parties benefiting from it

patterns.name: Error paths in program analysis
patterns.context: Describes abstract-state-space analysis finding error paths and related edges

patterns.name: Intentional conduct and knowledge
patterns.context: A court determines an actor’s motive, intent, or knowledge

patterns.name: Legal instruction “as nearly as practical”
patterns.context: Quotes a jury instruction discussing whether driving conduct met the standard of what was practically feasible

patterns.name: Recent bias analysis
patterns.context: Evaluates whether data or measurements show recent bias

patterns.name: An error causing an event to occur
patterns.context: News narrative attributes an error to a party and explains that the error allowed an event to occur

patterns.name: Observed distribution and medical findings
patterns.context: Reports a distribution in medical data and how common a particular outcome is

7_2170.description: 激活分散于法律通过与裁判表述、研究中的证据和观察结果、错误或偏差检测，以及资金讨论和新闻归责等情境；多处涉及陈述结论、存在性或因果关系，但没有稳定单一触发词。

patterns.name: 法律术语“into law”
patterns.context: 描述法律或制度通过、成为法律；“into”及附近词激活较强

patterns.name: 科学论文中的证据与研究表述
patterns.context: 研究结果、文献证据或统计分析的陈述中，尤其是表明某现象存在或证据支持某结论

patterns.name: 政治人物与城市犯罪报道
patterns.context: 引述政治人物讲话，涉及城市、犯罪及社会议题

patterns.name: 补偿、资金与受益讨论
patterns.context: 讨论项目贡献者的报酬、资金及其他主体从中受益

patterns.name: 程序分析中的错误路径
patterns.context: 描述抽象状态空间分析发现错误路径及相关边

patterns.name: 故意行为与明知
patterns.context: 法院认定行为人的动机、故意或明知

patterns.name: “as nearly as practical”法律指令
patterns.trigger: “as nearly as practical within a single lane”
patterns.context: 引用陪审团指示，讨论驾驶行为是否符合实际可行标准

patterns.name: 近期偏差分析
patterns.context: 评估数据或测量结果是否存在近期偏差

patterns.name: 失误导致事件发生
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中归责于某方的失误，并说明失误使某事件得以发生

patterns.name: 观察到的分布与医学发现
patterns.context: 报告医学数据中的分布及某结果的常见程度

en.description: Activation passages span news, code, legal history, statistical research, email, forums, and biomedicine, with no stable shared theme. Local triggers vary, and the distribution of activation strength is not explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Text related to Suburban
patterns.context: In a news or quoted passage, “he encouraged the city's criminals to ‘hit…’”, activation concentrates on suburban officials and the following words he, the city's criminals, and others.

patterns.name: HTML list and anchor markup
patterns.context: Activations occur in HTML documents with consecutive list items, anchors, and line-break tags.

patterns.name: Airport and collective failure narrative
patterns.context: A news context accuses airport-related agencies of collective failure; activations concentrate on parastatals and that.

patterns.name: Trademark history and law
patterns.context: Describes the origins of the trademark system, when the law was passed, and the country involved.

patterns.name: Recent bias and time windows
patterns.context: Uses statistics such as multi-day cumulative medians and peaks to assess possible recent bias; activations concentrate on bias was.

patterns.name: HTML comments and browser compatibility warning
patterns.context: A code comment explains IE8 support, media queries, and limitations of viewing a page through file://.

patterns.name: Program analysis error paths
patterns.context: Describes an abstract reachability graph and how analysis handles the discovery of an error path.

patterns.name: Email confidentiality and misdelivery notice
patterns.context: An email footer mentions confidentiality, legal privilege, and a notice for unintended recipients.

patterns.name: Contributor compensation and funding discussion
patterns.context: Discusses how project contributors might receive more compensation or funding if they were not working for free.

patterns.name: Tumor pathways and experimental validation
patterns.context: Studies tumor-related downstream pathways and validates literature reports using transcription factors and protein kinase arrays.

7_2170.description: 激活片段横跨新闻、代码、法律史、统计研究、邮件、论坛和生物医学，未见稳定共同主题；局部触发各异，强度分布也未显示可由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: Suburban 相关文本
patterns.context: “he encouraged the city's criminals to ‘hit…’”一段新闻或引语中，激活集中在 suburban officials 及其后 he、the city's criminals 等词。

patterns.name: HTML 列表与锚点标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档中连续列举列表项、锚点及换行标记时激活。

patterns.name: 机场与集体失职叙述
patterns.trigger: “parastatals handling the nation’s airports”“their collective lapses”
patterns.context: 新闻语境中指责机场相关机构的集体失误；激活集中在 parastatals 和 that。

patterns.name: 商标历史与法律
patterns.context: 叙述商标制度的起源、法律通过时间及国家。

patterns.name: 近期偏差与时间窗口
patterns.context: 以多日累计中位数、峰值等统计量评估可能的近期偏差；激活集中在 bias was。

patterns.name: HTML 注释与网页兼容性警告
patterns.context: 代码注释中说明 IE8 支持、媒体查询及通过 file:// 查看页面的限制。

patterns.name: 程序分析错误路径
patterns.context: 描述抽象可达图及分析发现错误路径后的处理。

patterns.name: 邮件保密与误收通知
patterns.trigger: “This e-mail is confidential”以及“received it in error”
patterns.context: 邮件页脚提示保密、法律特权及误收者应知悉相关通知。

patterns.name: 贡献者报酬与资助讨论
patterns.context: 讨论项目贡献者若非免费劳动，可能获得更多报酬或资助。

patterns.name: 肿瘤通路与实验验证
patterns.context: 研究肿瘤相关下游通路，并以转录因子和蛋白激酶阵列验证文献报告。

en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres, often in dense noun phrases and relational structures such as “of.” Individual passages also cover legal rulings, medical tumors, technical explanations, sports, code, public health, and news topics, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Relational word “of” and possessive structures
patterns.context: Connects possession, part-whole relations, or modification within noun phrases or prepositional structures, especially in syntactically dense passages.
patterns.domain: News, law, medicine, public health, and expository text

patterns.name: Legal reasoning and judicial phrasing
patterns.context: Formal legal contexts involving court review of rulings, defense arguments, or exclusion of evidence.

patterns.name: Medical descriptions of tumors and metastasis
patterns.context: Describes tumor invasiveness, propensity for recurrence, and sites of metastasis.

patterns.name: Electronic detection and component installation
patterns.context: Describes detection markings on electronic components or installation steps for a filter frame.

patterns.name: Ice hockey goalies and goals
patterns.context: Discusses a goalie’s performance or training, or a team system collapsing.

patterns.name: Compatibility notes in HTML comments
patterns.context: HTML source comments explaining support and limitations in older browsers.

patterns.name: Translating research findings into practice
patterns.context: Discusses how public health intervention research should be designed for dissemination and application in practice.

patterns.name: Urban poverty and political quotations
patterns.context: Reporting on urban poverty statistics and controversy prompted by a political figure’s speech.

patterns.name: Airport negligence and diplomatic personnel incident
patterns.context: Attributes a person’s infiltration to lapses in airport management.

7_2170.concept: 多领域文本中的关系结构
7_2170.description: 激活分布于多种文体，常见于密集名词短语与“of”等关系结构；各段还分别呈现法律裁判、医学肿瘤、技术说明、体育、代码、公共卫生及新闻主题，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: 关系词“of”及所属结构
patterns.context: 在名词短语或介词结构中连接所属、部分与整体或修饰关系；尤其句法较密集处。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、医学、公共卫生及说明文

patterns.name: 法律论证与裁判措辞
patterns.context: 法院审查裁定、辩方主张或证据排除等正式法律语境。

patterns.name: 医学肿瘤与转移描述
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤侵袭性、复发倾向及转移部位。

patterns.name: 电子检测与器件安装
patterns.context: 说明电子部件的检测标记，或滤网框架的安装步骤。

patterns.name: 冰球守门员与球门
patterns.context: 谈守门员发挥、训练或球队体系崩溃。

patterns.name: HTML 注释中的兼容性说明
patterns.context: HTML 源码注释，解释旧版浏览器支持与限制。

patterns.name: 研究成果向实践转化
patterns.context: 讨论公共卫生干预研究如何设计传播并应用于实践。

patterns.name: 城市贫困与政治引语
patterns.context: 城市贫困统计及政治人物演讲引发争议的报道语境。

patterns.name: 机场失职与外交人员事件
patterns.context: 把人员潜入归因于机场方面的管理疏漏。

en.concept: it and layout cues in legal text
en.description: Activations are relatively concentrated on it in clauses about court actions in legal decisions, and on line breaks, paragraphs, and layout artifacts in legal text. Other sporadic activations occur on words or formatting tokens in code comments, comment guidelines, news, and medical abstracts, and are difficult to explain through a unified semantics.

patterns.name: Clauses introduced by it in legal decisions
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, it refers to the court or adjudicator and occurs in clauses about ruling, finding, dismissing, or procedural actions; several passages also contain the court, when, and that.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal memoranda

patterns.name: Function-word it within sentences
patterns.context: The pronoun it or possessive its occurs in ordinary statements; the available passages do not establish whether this follows the same pattern as in legal text.
patterns.domain: News, commentary, and other general text

patterns.name: you in code comments
patterns.context: An HTML comment warning addresses the reader directly and explains limitations when viewing a page through file://.

patterns.name: Common words in code comments
patterns.context: Comments for Objective-C lifecycle methods describe many changes that can be reversed when switching from the background to the active state; it is difficult to determine whether these words are independent triggers.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and comment text
patterns.context: An old-browser compatibility comment mentions Respond.js, IE8, and HTML5; activations may involve code/comment formatting or token boundaries.

patterns.name: Function words in medical text
patterns.context: In an abstract sentence describing the nutritional requirements of Leishmania, these words occur within a clause about pathogen characteristics; the relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: Reporting verbs and tokens in a narrative
patterns.context: Reports a quotation from a mayor’s speech and its impact on suburban officials; it also contains tokenized en/raged, so no single semantic trigger can be identified.

patterns.name: Prohibited words in comment rules
patterns.context: Website comment guidelines prohibit personal attacks, profanity, and defamation; activations are scattered across words that may simply be common in the sentence.

patterns.name: Text boundaries in a trial-witness narrative
patterns.context: Legal material describes federal agents contacting a witness; salient activations cluster around line breaks, indentation, or apparent layout-artifact numbers rather than clear content words.

patterns.name: Line breaks and footnote artifacts in legal material
patterns.context: Court opinions contain page numbers, paragraph markers, line breaks, or footnote formatting; the cause of activation on these layout tokens is unclear.

patterns.name: Application foreground/background transitions
patterns.context: Code comments explain that changes can be reversed when an application switches from the background to the active state; the words themselves are unmarked, so it is uncertain whether this forms an activation pattern.

patterns.name: Nonspecific lexical or layout activations
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur across legal, web, comment, and biomedical materials, with no shared lexical meaning or grammatical function identifiable from these passages.

7_2170.concept: 法律文本中的 it／版式信号
7_2170.description: 激活较集中于法律判决中法院行为从句里的 it，以及法律文本的换行、段落和版面残留；此外还散见代码注释、评论守则、新闻与医学摘要中的词语或格式 token，难以由统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 it 引导从句
patterns.trigger: «it»（尤其是“when it determined”“when it did not allow”“when it determined”“that counsel was ineffective”一类结构）
patterns.context: 法律论述中，it 指代法院或裁判者，并处于判决、认定、驳回或程序行为的从句中；多段还出现 the court、when、that。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 句内或句首的功能词 it
patterns.context: 代词 it 或所有格 its 出现在普通陈述中；现有片段不足以确认其与法律模式相同。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 you
patterns.context: HTML 注释警告里直接称呼读者，说明通过 file:// 查看页面时的限制。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的常见词语
patterns.context: Objective-C 生命周期方法的注释中，描述从后台切到活动状态时可撤销的许多更改；难以确定这些词是否为独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及注释文本
patterns.context: 旧版网页兼容性注释，提及 Respond.js、IE8、HTML5；激活可能涉及代码／注释格式或词元边界。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的功能词
patterns.context: 描述利什曼原虫营养需求的摘要句中，这些词出现在病原体特征从句内；关系不明。

patterns.name: 叙事中的引语动词及词元
patterns.context: 报道引述市长演说及其对郊区官员的影响；同时包含分词切分的 en/raged 等，无法确定单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 评论规则中的禁用词语
patterns.context: 网站评论守则禁止人身攻击、脏话与诽谤；激活词分散，可能只是句中常见词。

patterns.name: 庭审证人叙述中的文本边界
patterns.context: 法律材料叙述联邦探员联系证人；显著激活集中在换行、缩进或疑似版面残留数字，而非明确的内容词。

patterns.name: 法律材料中的断行与脚注残留
patterns.context: 法院意见书中出现页码、段落标记、换行或脚注格式；这些版面 token 激活原因不明确。

patterns.name: 应用前后台状态转换
patterns.context: 代码注释说明应用从后台切换到活动状态时可以撤销更改；这些词本身未标记，是否构成激活模式不确定。

patterns.name: 非特异性的词元或版式激活
patterns.context: 跨法律、网页、评论和生物医学材料均有零散激活，无法从这些片段确定共同的词义或语法功能。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: they are prominent on words such as in and following, and also occur in HTML comments, line breaks and indentation in legal documents, citation formatting, patent boilerplate, prohibitions, and academic phrasing. There is no stable single semantic trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Preposition “in” within a sentence
patterns.context: Activation falls on the preposition in: passage 1 has the phrase “in nature,” while passage 2 has “in simplified form.”
patterns.domain: Forum rules, patent specifications, and other general prose

patterns.name: “following” introducing subsequent content
patterns.context: Occurs in “the following Detailed Description / description,” introducing the subsequent explanation.

patterns.name: Punctuation or warning fragments in HTML comments
patterns.context: Multiple markers in HTML comments and warning text activate; the strongest are the colon and you, with no clear single semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Paragraph and layout markers in legal text
patterns.context: Whitespace and layout boundaries near line breaks, indentation, or page breaks activate strongly in court opinions, statutory citations, and record excerpts.

patterns.name: Citation and numbering formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Numbers, parentheses, periods, and other markers occur in the numbering formats of statutory provisions, footnotes, or case citations; trigger forms vary somewhat across passages.
patterns.domain: Court opinions, statutory citations, case records
