patterns.name: Prohibitions or alternative suggestions in instructions
patterns.context: In reader-facing rules or support guidance, not and do not occur in prohibitions; passage 6 also gives an alternative channel.
patterns.domain: Forum moderation rules and user support instructions

patterns.name: Patent scope and implementation boilerplate
patterns.context: Fixed patent phrasing concerning the scope of an invention, claims, and specific embodiments; this passage also includes the aforementioned following pattern.

patterns.name: Researcher references in research dissemination language
patterns.context: In a discussion of dissemination strategies for health intervention research, researchers is followed by are developed and related text.

7_2170.description: 激活分散在多类文本：显著落于 in、following 等词，也出现在 HTML 注释、法律文书的换行缩进与引证格式、专利套语、禁止指令及学术措辞中。跨段没有稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 句中介词“in”
patterns.context: 激活落在介词 in 上：第1段是短语“in nature”，第2段是“in simplified form”。
patterns.domain: 论坛规则、专利说明书等一般书面语

patterns.name: 指向后续内容的“following”
patterns.context: 出现在“the following Detailed Description / description”中，引出后文说明。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书的固定表达

patterns.name: HTML注释中的标点或警示片段
patterns.context: HTML注释与警告文字中多个标记均有激活；强度最高的是冒号和 you，未显示出明确的单一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 法律文本的段落及版面标记
patterns.context: 法律判决、法规引文及记录摘录中，换行、缩进或分页附近的空白和版面边界出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的引用与编号格式
patterns.context: 数字、括号、句点等出现在法规条款、脚注或案卷引证的编号格式中；各段触发形式不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 判决、法规引用、案卷记录

patterns.name: 指令中的禁止或替代建议表达
patterns.context: 在面向读者的规则或支持指引中，not 与 do not 等禁止表达相邻；第6段还给出替代渠道。
patterns.domain: 论坛管理规则与用户支持说明

patterns.name: 专利权利范围及实施方式套语
patterns.context: 围绕发明的范围、权利要求及具体实施例的专利固定措辞；该段还包含前述 following 模式。

patterns.name: 研究传播措辞中的研究者称谓
patterns.context: 健康干预研究的传播策略讨论中，researchers 后接 are developed 等内容。

en.description: The most stable clue is the common preposition in, which appears in every passage, but its high activation is not specific to it. Legal rulings and procedures, forum rules, code comments, patent boilerplate, and biomedical terminology also appear, and cannot be fully explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English preposition in
patterns.context: The token in appears within sentences or phrases; sometimes it is part of a common collocation.
patterns.domain: Forums, legal, patent, technical, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial Because
patterns.context: Because introduces a reason or argument.

patterns.name: Legal conclusions and judicial language
patterns.context: A court addresses an appeal, denies a motion, or explains its reasoning.

patterns.name: Citations to legal rules and procedural motions
patterns.context: Cites civil procedure rules and discusses a trial, motion, or procedural matter.

patterns.name: Web forum conduct rules
patterns.context: Tells users what rules to follow when posting, commenting, or contacting a moderator.

patterns.name: Legal description of error in a judgment
patterns.context: Describes the standard under which a reviewing court finds an error in the original judgment.

patterns.name: HTML comments and compatibility warning
patterns.context: An HTML source comment describes scripts and browser compatibility limitations.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Discusses pathogen nutritional requirements, lipids, and phagocytosis.

patterns.name: Patent specification boilerplate
patterns.context: Introduces a detailed description, drawings, or conceptual summary in a patent specification.

patterns.name: Legal citations and motion language
patterns.context: Describes litigation claims, attorney incompetence, or a motion to amend a complaint.

7_2170.description: 最稳定线索是普通介词 in（各段均出现），但高激活并不专一；另散见法律裁判与程序、论坛规范、代码注释、专利套语和生物医学术语，无法由单一语义充分解释。

patterns.name: 英文介词 in
patterns.context: 词元 in 出现在句中或短语中；有时是常见搭配的一部分
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、专利、技术及科学文本

patterns.name: 句首或句中 Because
patterns.context: Because 引出原因或论证

patterns.name: 法律结论与裁判用语
patterns.context: 法院处理上诉、驳回动议或说明裁判理由

patterns.name: 法律规则引用及程序动议
patterns.context: 援引民事诉讼规则并讨论审判、动议或程序事项

patterns.name: 网页论坛行为规范
patterns.context: 告知用户发帖、评论或联系版主时应遵守的规范

patterns.name: 法律判决错误表述
patterns.context: 描述审查法院认定原判存在错误的标准

patterns.name: HTML 注释与兼容性警告
patterns.context: HTML 源码注释中说明脚本及浏览器兼容限制

patterns.name: 生物医学专业名词
patterns.context: 讨论病原体营养需求、脂质及吞噬作用

patterns.name: 专利说明书套语
patterns.context: 引入专利说明书的详细描述、附图或概念摘要

patterns.name: 法律引用与动议措辞
patterns.context: 叙述诉讼主张、律师失职或申请修订诉状

en.concept: Relational words and technical explanations in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations are scattered across text types, often falling on prepositions, relational words, and nearby structures. Other examples occur in code markup, patent boilerplate, and domain-specific passages about licenses, community rules, law, biomedicine, and plant breeding.

patterns.name: Function words and prepositional structures
patterns.context: Often occurs in prepositional or subordinate-clause structures expressing relations, time, location, or manner; highlighted words are mostly common function words, and their specific meanings vary by sentence.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, legal, academic, and expository text

patterns.name: Code and markup in technical text
patterns.context: Markup languages, library names, and browser versions occur in code, HTML comments, or web compatibility notes; activations also fall on surrounding common words.
patterns.domain: Github, web code, and technical comments

patterns.name: Patent-style boilerplate
patterns.context: In background, purpose-of-invention, or section-transition statements in patent specifications.

patterns.name: Interactive-use requirements in software licenses
patterns.context: Explains how a program should display or print information when run interactively.

patterns.name: Conduct rules and violation handling
patterns.context: Community comment rules list prohibited conduct and the corresponding consequences.

patterns.name: Confidentiality and redaction of legal information
patterns.context: Legal provisions specify the redaction of sensitive or privileged information submitted at a party’s request.

patterns.name: Biomedical mechanisms and nutritional requirements
patterns.context: Discusses Leishmania, phagocytosis, and pathogen nutritional requirements.

patterns.name: Plant breeding and population decline
patterns.context: Describes a line’s origin and population changes in each generation due to seeds failing to germinate or plants failing to set seed.

7_2170.concept: 异质文本中的关系词与技术说明
7_2170.description: 激活分散于多类文本，常落在介词、关系词等功能词及其邻近结构；另见代码标记、专利套语，以及许可证、社区规则、法律、生物医学和植物育种的领域词句。

patterns.name: 功能词与介词结构
patterns.context: 常出现在关系、时间、位置或方式等介词/从句结构中；高亮词本身多为常见功能词，具体语义随句子而变。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的技术、法律、学术与说明性文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的代码与标记
patterns.context: 代码、HTML 注释或网页兼容性说明中出现标记语言、库名及浏览器版本；激活也落在周围普通词上。

patterns.name: 专利文体套语
patterns.context: 专利说明书的背景、发明目的或章节过渡语句中。

patterns.name: 软件许可证的交互使用要求
patterns.trigger: “If the modified program normally reads commands interactively”、“ordinary way”
patterns.context: 说明程序在交互式运行时应如何显示或打印信息。

patterns.name: 行为规范与违规处理
patterns.trigger: “do not engage in personal attacks or name-calling”、“will be removed without warning”
patterns.context: 社区评论规则列举禁止行为及处置方式。

patterns.name: 法律信息保密与删节
patterns.context: 法律条文规定当事人请求删节所提交的敏感或特权信息。

patterns.name: 生物医学机制与营养需求
patterns.context: 讨论利什曼原虫、吞噬作用及病原体营养需求。

patterns.name: 植物育种与种群递减
patterns.context: 描述品系来源及每代因种子未萌发或植株不结种而导致的种群变化。

en.concept: Function words and formatting patterns in mixed text
en.description: Activations are distributed across code, forums, patents, and legal texts; common highlighted words include in, this, it, you, and the, but semantic or syntactic trigger conditions are inconsistent. There are also domain-specific terms and stock expressions, making it difficult to identify a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Activation at the position of to
patterns.context: Common function words such as in/this/it/you/the occur near syntactic or text boundaries; the specific word and position marked vary.
patterns.domain: Mixed: code comments, forum instructions, legal texts, patent texts, and ordinary narrative

patterns.name: HTML comments and webpage compatibility
patterns.context: HTML comments in webpage source introduce scripts for compatibility with older browsers and warn about viewing pages through file://.

patterns.name: Judicial decision narrative
patterns.context: Describes a court's ruling on a procedural or defense request and discusses whether it constitutes error.

patterns.name: Forum conduct and community rules
patterns.context: Guides users in using a forum and contacting moderators, or sets rules for commenting and handling violations.

patterns.name: App returning from background to foreground
patterns.context: An Objective-C lifecycle callback explains that changes made when entering the background may be undone when becoming active.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and prior art
patterns.context: Patent boilerplate states the purpose of an invention and its effects relative to existing technology.

patterns.name: Compile-time compatibility assertion
patterns.context: Explains compile-time compatibility between generated code and a proto package, and what a failed assertion means.

patterns.name: Patent specification introduction
patterns.context: Introduces the detailed description, drawings, and concepts presented in the abstract of a patent text.

patterns.name: Court procedure and reconsideration
patterns.context: Legal argument concerns the court's authority, a motion for reconsideration, and the government's position.

patterns.name: Redaction procedure for confidential information
patterns.context: Sets deadlines and conditions, including trade secrets and privilege, for parties seeking to redact information they submit.

7_2170.concept: 混合文本中的功能词与格式模式
7_2170.description: 激活分布于多种代码、论坛、专利和法律文本；常见高亮落在 in、this、it、you、the 等词，但语义或句法触发条件不统一。另有各领域特定术语与惯用表达，难归为单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: to 的位置激活
patterns.context: 对常见功能词 in/this/it/you/the 等，在句法或文本边界附近出现；被标记的具体词和位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 混合，包括代码注释、论坛指引、法律文本、专利文本及普通叙述

patterns.name: HTML 注释与网页兼容性
patterns.trigger: «<!--»、« Shim and« Respond»…« IE»…« support»…« HTML»…« elements»、« WARN»ING»
patterns.context: 网页源码的 HTML 注释中，介绍旧版浏览器兼容脚本并警告通过 file:// 查看页面的问题。

patterns.name: 司法裁判叙述
patterns.trigger: « court»…« erred»…« when»…« it»…« did» not»…« allow»
patterns.context: 描述法院对程序或辩护请求的裁定，并论述是否构成错误。

patterns.name: 论坛行为与版规
patterns.trigger: « please»…« not» use»…« link»；« difficulties» posting»；« personal» attacks»、« name»-»calling»、« profanity»
patterns.context: 指导用户使用论坛、联系版主，或规定评论行为及违规处理。
patterns.domain: 论坛帮助文本／社区版规

patterns.name: 应用从后台返回前台
patterns.context: Objective-C 生命周期回调说明从后台转为活动状态时可撤销此前更改。

patterns.name: 专利目的与现有技术
patterns.trigger: « object» of» the» present» invention»、« prior» art»
patterns.context: 以专利惯用措辞陈述发明目的、设备及相对现有技术的效果。

patterns.name: 编译期兼容性断言
patterns.trigger: « compile»‑»time assertion»、« compilation» error» at» this» line»
patterns.context: 说明生成的代码与 proto 包的编译兼容性，并解释断言失败的含义。

patterns.name: 专利说明书导言
patterns.trigger: « present»…« description»、« Detailed» Description»、« accompanying» drawings»、« summary»
patterns.context: 专利文本中引出详细说明、附图及摘要所介绍的概念。

patterns.name: 法院程序与重新审议
patterns.trigger: « district» court»、« motion» for» reconsideration»、« government» suggests»
patterns.context: 法律论证中涉及法院权限、重新审议动议及政府意见。

patterns.name: 保密信息删节程序
patterns.trigger: « request» redaction»、« furnished» by» that» party»、« trade» secret»、« privileged»
patterns.context: 规定当事人申请删节其提交信息的期限及商业秘密、特权等条件。
patterns.domain: 法律规则／法院程序文本

en.description: Strongly activates primarily on the English substring “culture,” whether it refers to organizational culture, cell culture, compound farming, or a word form in a URL; a few highlighted fragments show no common clue or appear unrelated to this trigger.

patterns.name: culture substring (within a word or standalone)
patterns.context: Activates when this English substring appears; it may be a standalone word or embedded in a hyphenated compound or URL.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, biomedical papers, news headlines, and links; varied meanings including organizational culture, cell culture, and farming

patterns.name: culture in unrelated word contexts
patterns.context: The highlighted tokens shown do not contain a recognizable culture substring; they may be undisplayed tokenization or noise, so no specific trigger condition can be inferred.
patterns.domain: Game tags, medical abstracts, Chinese software documentation

7_2497.concept: culture 子串
7_2497.description: 主要对英文子串“culture”强烈激活，不论其指组织文化、细胞培养、复合养殖还是网址中的词形；少数片段高亮处看不出相同线索，或与该触发无关。

patterns.name: culture 子串（词内/独立）
patterns.context: 该英文子串出现时激活；可以是独立词，也可以嵌在连字符复合词或网址中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、生物医学论文、新闻标题及链接；涉及组织文化、细胞培养、养殖等不同语义

patterns.name: 无关词境中的 culture
patterns.trigger: 第 [7] 段游戏名 “Red Dead Redemption”，第 [9] 段 “exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation”，第 [10] 段 “剪切板”
patterns.context: 所示高亮 token 并未呈现可识别的 culture 子串，可能是未显示的分词或噪声，无法据此归纳具体触发条件。
patterns.domain: 游戏标签、医学摘要、中文软件说明

en.description: High activations fall on tokens such as culture, based, 板, and Red across biomedical text, web titles, game names, and Chinese software documentation. culture occurs in the most segments, but its triggering forms and semantics are inconsistent, making it difficult to assign a single stable meaning.

patterns.name: culture-related forms
patterns.context: culture itself or culture in hyphenated compounds; appears in technical prose, URLs, and titles, with inconsistent meanings.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; biomedicine, news headlines, web titles

patterns.name: based compound expressions
patterns.context: Appears in “exercise-based,” modifying cardiac rehabilitation.

patterns.name: 剪切板
patterns.context: In Chinese software documentation, in “剪切板了,” meaning saved to the clipboard.
patterns.domain: Github; Chinese interface or user documentation

patterns.name: Red
patterns.context: Red recurs in the game title “Red Dead Redemption.”
patterns.domain: Pile-CC; game title and download information

7_2497.concept: 不一致的高频词片段
7_2497.description: 高激活分别落在 culture、based、板、Red 等 token 上，横跨生物医学、网页标题、游戏名和中文软件说明；其中 culture 覆盖最多段，但触发形式与语义并不统一，难以归为单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: culture 相关词形
patterns.context: culture 本身或连字符复合词中的 culture；出现在技术正文、网址、标题中，语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；生物医学、新闻标题、网页标题

patterns.name: based 复合表达
patterns.context: 出现在“exercise-based”中，修饰 cardiac rehabilitation。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要；医疗综述标题

patterns.name: 剪切板
patterns.context: 中文软件说明中，位于“剪切板了”，指保存到剪切板。

patterns.name: Red
patterns.context: 游戏标题“Red Dead Redemption”中，Red 重复出现。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several fixed substrings: based in academic compounds, culture forms across domains, and a few instances in Chinese software documentation, game titles, marine biomarkers, and project identifiers. No single semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: based compounds
patterns.context: Part of a compound modifier, preceded by a domain or method term; occurs in “exercise-based,” “actomyosin-based,” “sensing-based,” and “Network-based”

patterns.name: culture forms
patterns.context: Appears in biological or tissue-research contexts, including hyphenated compounds, common nouns, and derived forms

patterns.name: Clipboard in Chinese software documentation
patterns.context: Describes an image URL being saved to the clipboard

patterns.name: Access tokens in Chinese software documentation
patterns.context: Explains using a token to access a resource that requires authentication

patterns.name: Red Dead Redemption game title
patterns.context: Appears in the game title and related download text

patterns.name: Environmental pollution biomarkers
patterns.context: Describes organisms such as mussels being used to assess marine environmental quality

patterns.name: Project identifiers
patterns.context: Project names or identifiers recurring in NIH project descriptions

7_2497.concept: based/culture 等片段及杂项
7_2497.description: 激活分散于若干固定子串：学术复合词中的 based、多个领域中的 culture 词形，以及少数中文软件说明、游戏名、海洋生物标志物和项目编号；看不出单一语义主题。

patterns.name: based 复合词
patterns.context: 作为复合修饰语的一部分，前面有领域或方法词；在 “exercise-based”“actomyosin-based”“sensing-based”“Network-based” 中出现

patterns.name: culture 词形
patterns.context: 出现在生物学或组织研究语境中，包括连字符复合词、普通名词及其派生形式
patterns.domain: 生物医学、组织研究、海洋养殖

patterns.name: 中文软件文档中的剪贴板
patterns.context: 描述图片地址被保存到剪切板

patterns.name: 中文软件文档中的访问令牌
patterns.context: 说明使用令牌访问需要鉴权的资源

patterns.name: Red Dead Redemption 游戏名
patterns.context: 出现在游戏标题及下载相关文字中

patterns.name: 环境污染生物标志物
patterns.context: 描述贻贝等生物用于评估海洋环境质量

patterns.name: 项目编号
patterns.context: NIH 项目描述中反复出现的项目名称或编号

en.description: All fragments contain title-style compounds, with the strongest activation concentrated on based (or its subword fragment) after a hyphen; nearby hyphens, terminology fragments, and title nouns may also activate. Domains and topics vary, and some local subword patterns cannot be further unified.

patterns.name: “based” compounds in titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or abstract, a hyphen connects a method, technology, platform, design object, etc. to based; preceding terms may include Network, exercise, alert, sensing, actin, intensity-modulated, Receptor, network, method, cluster, etc.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed/NIH scientific titles, plus USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Domain terms or proper names at the start of titles
patterns.context: A term or proper name appears at the start of a title, with activation distributed across its split word fragments; no stable shared semantic condition is apparent among these terms.

patterns.name: Title-style noun phrases and methods/research frameworks
patterns.context: An evaluation, comparison, design, or optimization topic is presented as a noun phrase, commonly in a paper title; these words are not shared across all fragments.

patterns.name: Hyphen boundaries in multiword terms
patterns.context: Hyphens connect components of compound terms; activation appears not only on based but also on several hyphens and adjacent word fragments.
patterns.domain: Scientific and technical titles and abstracts

patterns.name: 3D urban landscape visualization topic
patterns.context: The title describes network-based visualization and an urban model; this specific topic does not recur across fragments.

7_2497.concept: 连字符复合词中的 based
7_2497.description: 所有片段都含有标题式复合词，且最强激活集中于连字符后的 based（或 based 的词片段）；周围还可激活连字符、术语片段及标题名词。各段领域和主题不同，部分局部词片段模式未能进一步统一。

patterns.name: 标题中的“based”复合词
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头，用连字符把方法、技术、平台、设计对象等与 based 连接；前面的词可为 Network、exercise、alert、sensing、actin、intensity-modulated、Receptor、network、method、cluster 等
patterns.domain: 主要为 PubMed/NIH 科学标题，另有 USPTO 专利背景

patterns.name: 标题开头的领域术语或专名
patterns.context: 标题开头出现术语或专名，激活分散在被拆分的词片段上；未见这些术语之间稳定的共同语义条件

patterns.name: 标题式名词短语与方法/研究框架
patterns.context: 以名词短语呈现评估、比较、设计或优化主题，常见于论文标题；这些词并非所有段共有

patterns.name: 多词术语中的连字符边界
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合术语成分，激活不仅落在 based，也出现在若干连字符及其相邻词片段

patterns.name: 3D 城市景观可视化主题
patterns.context: 标题描述网络为基础的可视化及城市模型；这组具体主题没有跨段复现

en.description: Most segments highlight “-based” and its preceding method or application domain, spanning medicine, remote sensing, and network technology. Other activations are scattered across historical years, pirate narratives, split name fragments, and “among” in philosophical text, which the main pattern cannot explain.

patterns.name: Methods or systems based on an object
patterns.context: Compound modifiers connect a method, design, or application with “-based”; emphasis falls on “based” and the preceding hyphen.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, engineering and technical text

patterns.name: Number ranges and historical narratives
patterns.context: Historical narratives include years, people’s actions, and pirate attacks; no “-based” structure is present.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on split name fragments; another segment contains “among” in non-name text, with no clear shared context.

7_2497.concept: “-based”复合表达
7_2497.description: 多数段落突出“-based”及其前置方法或应用对象，涉及医学、遥感与网络技术。其余激活分散于历史年份、海盗叙述、拆分人名及哲学文本中的“among”等，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 基于某对象的方法或系统
patterns.context: 复合修饰语以“-based”连接方法、设计或应用；重点是“based”及前面的连字符。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、工程与技术文本

patterns.name: 数字范围与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现年份、人物行动及海盗袭击等内容；未见“-based”结构。
patterns.domain: 百科全书传记或历史条目

patterns.name: 专名内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分的姓名片段上；另有一段非姓名文本中的“among”，没有明显共同语境。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目；另含哲学文本

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is they (including they’ve) used as the subject in English sentences; other activations occur on き in Japanese 起き, the internal fragment nes in Spanish viernes, and indentation spaces in configuration code. The remaining fragments lack a clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: they and its contracted form
patterns.context: Used as a subject or clause subject in an English sentence, followed by a predicate; [10] marks they’ve internally.
patterns.domain: English prose, quotations, Q&A, and narratives

patterns.name: き in a Japanese action verb
patterns.context: An internal part of the Japanese verb 「起きる」, meaning an event occurs; adjacent Japanese tokens are not similarly marked.

patterns.name: Spanish date fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the Spanish date phrase “viernes, 22 de abril de 2011”; activation falls on an internal fragment of the date word.

patterns.name: JSON/configuration indentation spaces
patterns.context: Appears within a nested configuration structure, near default, lists, and objects; unmarked content also includes an AWS MQ resource name.

patterns.name: Blank
patterns.context: The fragment contains no identifiable positive activation markers.

7_2497.concept: they 主语与零散模式
7_2497.description: 最明显的重复模式是英文句中作主语的 they（含 they’ve）；另有日语「起き」中的「き」、西语 viernes 的词内片段「nes」及配置代码缩进空格。其余片段缺乏清楚的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: they 及其缩写形式
patterns.trigger: they（[2] 的 “what they are going to say”，[7] 的 “if successful, they would join”，[8] 的 “they want”，[9] 的 “but they reflect”，[10] 的 “they’ve just swallowed”）
patterns.context: 英文句中作为主语或从句主语，后接谓语；[10] 为 they’ve 的词内标记。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、引语、问答及叙事

patterns.name: 日语动作词中き
patterns.context: 日语动词「起きる」的词内部分，表示事件发生；其余相邻日文 token 未同样标记。

patterns.name: 西班牙语日期片段
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语日期短语“viernes, 22 de abril de 2011”中；激活落在日期词的词内片段。

patterns.name: JSON/配置缩进空格
patterns.context: 出现在嵌套配置结构中，位于 default、列表及对象附近；未标记的内容同时包含 AWS MQ 资源名。

patterns.name: 留空
patterns.context: 片段中没有可辨认的正激活标记。

en.concept: Specific word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across code comments and comment-related words, string in PHP/type checking, and tokenized fragments of several English words or proper names; overall, this appears more sensitive to specific word forms/subword fragments than to a single semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: PHP strings and comments
patterns.context: PHP code or PHP documentation-related contexts; includes both comment markers and following text, as well as string type names.

patterns.name: string type in code
patterns.context: Represents the string type in type declarations, parameter types, or validation logic; mixed with other code tokens.

patterns.name: comment words and comment contexts
patterns.context: Code comments, doc comments, or comment-related identifiers; activation sometimes falls on the word itself and sometimes on text after a comment marker.
patterns.domain: Github source code, StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of a specific name
patterns.context: The proper name Nikos Karageorgiou activates across multiple tokenized subword fragments and recurs in the body text.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in a proper name
patterns.context: Some subword fragments activate after the brand name AdYoYo is split.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC news headlines and web text

patterns.name: improving in natural language
patterns.context: A subword fragment of the ordinary English word improving activates in a chart data object's label string.

patterns.name: disproving in mathematical terminology
patterns.context: The latter tokenized fragment of disproving activates in the body of a mathematics paper.

7_2497.concept: 特定词形与子词片段
7_2497.description: 激活分散于代码注释及 comment 相关词、PHP/类型校验中的 string，以及若干英语词或专名的分词片段；整体更像对特定词形/子词片段敏感，而非单一语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: PHP 字符串与注释
patterns.context: PHP 代码或 PHP 文档相关上下文；既包括注释标记及其后续文字，也包括字符串类型名称。
patterns.domain: PHP 编程、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 代码中的 string 类型
patterns.context: 类型声明、参数类型或校验逻辑中表示字符串类型；与其他代码 token 混杂。

patterns.name: comment 词及注释语境
patterns.context: 代码注释、文档注释或注释相关标识符；有时激活落在词本身，有时落在注释标记后的文本。
patterns.domain: Github 源码、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 特定名字的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名 Nikos Karageorgiou 在分词后的多个子词片段上激活，且正文中重复出现。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 品牌名 AdYoYo 被拆分后，部分词片段激活。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 新闻标题与网页正文

patterns.name: 自然语言中的 improving
patterns.context: 图表数据对象的 label 字符串中，普通英语词 improving 的分词片段激活。
patterns.domain: Github 前端代码/图表配置

patterns.name: 数学术语中的 disproving
patterns.context: 数学论文正文中，disproving 一词的后半分词片段激活。

en.concept: Common English word forms and contextual collocations
en.description: Activation concentrates on a few English word forms: finally introduces a result or contrast, actively emphasizes deliberate action or research, and there are also Olympic as a classification term, wouldn't negating an expectation, and invasive in a medical description; no corresponding clue is apparent for [1].

patterns.name: finally as an in-sentence contrast/result connective
patterns.context: Appears within a sentence or clause to introduce a summary, result, or new stage; usually surrounded by complete narration.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal narration, and argumentation

patterns.name: actively emphasizing an action being performed
patterns.context: Combines with a verb to emphasize that an action is being performed deliberately; [2] is “actively employed”, [7] is “actively resisting”.
patterns.domain: Legal documents involving actions such as using a weapon or resisting arrest

patterns.name: actively researched indicating research activity
patterns.context: Combines with researched to indicate that a topic is being actively studied.

patterns.name: Olympic in a category label
patterns.context: Appears in an encyclopedia entry's category line, describing an athlete's sport or category.

patterns.name: wouldn't negating an expectation
patterns.context: In a programming Q&A, appears in expressions such as “I assumed this wouldn't work”, negating an expectation about whether code would work.

patterns.name: invasive in a medical risk description
patterns.context: Describes a treatment as invasive, paired with permanent treatment.

7_2497.concept: 常见英文词形与语境搭配
7_2497.description: 激活集中在少数英文词形：finally 引出结果或转折，actively 强调主动行为或研究，另有 Olympic 分类词、wouldn't 否定预期及 invasive 医疗描述；[1]未见对应线索。

patterns.name: finally 作句中转折/结果连接词
patterns.context: 位于句中或从句中，引出后续总结、结果或新阶段；前后通常是完整叙述。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律叙述与论证

patterns.name: actively 强调行为正在实施
patterns.context: 与动词搭配，强调行为是主动实施的；[2]为“actively employed”，[7]为“actively resisting”。
patterns.domain: 法律文书，涉及使用武器、抗拒逮捕等行为

patterns.name: actively researched 表示研究活动
patterns.context: 与 researched 搭配，表示某议题受到积极研究。

patterns.name: 类别标签中的 Olympic
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目的分类行，描述运动员所属项目或类别。

patterns.name: wouldn't 否定预期
patterns.context: 代码问答中，位于“I assumed this wouldn't work”一类表达里，否定对代码能否工作的预期。

patterns.name: invasive 医疗风险描述
patterns.context: 与永久性治疗并列，描述治疗具有侵入性。

en.description: Most activated fragments consist of formulas, symbols, and derivations in mathematical and scientific texts, including a discrete probability problem; there are also ASCII borders, TypeScript type code, and a passage debating climate, with no common trigger feature covering all fragments.

patterns.name: LaTeX tensors and partial derivatives
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas, partial derivative symbols occur with Greek-letter subscripts, superscripts, and tensor notation.

patterns.name: Laurent expansion and rational functions
patterns.context: Derivations involving complex functions, power series, and expressions for numerator polynomials.

patterns.name: Complex logarithms and arguments
patterns.context: Discusses the logarithm formula for a product of complex numbers and its argument, including modulus and branch differences.

patterns.name: Polynomial factorization argument
patterns.context: Uses unique factorization to derive the form of a polynomial or Laurent polynomial.

patterns.name: Set influence and coordinate derivatives
patterns.context: Discusses the influence of coordinates on a set using derivatives or norms of the set's indicator function.

patterns.name: Discrete probability and draw counts
patterns.context: Describes a sample by letters and their counts, then calculates the probability of drawing without replacement.

patterns.name: Cosmological equations and variables
patterns.context: The cosmological wave function, Wheeler–DeWitt equation, and a variable that changes over time.

patterns.name: ASCII borders and table characters
patterns.context: Rows of dots, dashes, and border characters appear in code or text.

patterns.name: TypeScript middleware type code
patterns.context: Interface or generic type declarations containing a middleware array and an action field.

patterns.name: Statements in a climate debate
patterns.context: Comments on the credibility of climate data and science, then transitions to hypothetical reasoning.

7_2497.concept: 数学科学及技术文本
7_2497.description: 激活片段多数是数学与科学文本中的公式、符号及推导，也包括离散概率题；另有 ASCII 边框、TypeScript 类型代码和一段气候争论文字，未见能覆盖所有片段的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: LaTeX 张量与偏导数
patterns.context: 在数学公式中，偏导符号与希腊字母下标、上标及张量记号连用。

patterns.name: Laurent 展开与有理函数
patterns.context: 围绕复变函数、幂级数及分子多项式表达式的推导。

patterns.name: 复对数与辐角
patterns.context: 讨论复数乘积的对数公式及辐角，涉及模长与分支差异。

patterns.name: 多项式因式分解论证
patterns.context: 用唯一分解性质推导多项式或 Laurent 多项式的形式。

patterns.name: 集合影响与坐标导数
patterns.context: 以集合指示函数的导数或范数讨论坐标对集合的影响。

patterns.name: 离散概率与抽取计数
patterns.context: 按字母及其出现次数描述样本，再计算不放回抽取的概率。

patterns.name: 宇宙学方程与变量
patterns.context: 宇宙波函数、Wheeler–DeWitt 方程及随时间变化的变量。

patterns.name: ASCII 边框与表格字符
patterns.context: 代码或文本中出现成行的点线、横线和边框符号。

patterns.name: TypeScript 中间件类型代码
patterns.context: 接口或泛型类型声明，含中间件数组与动作字段。

patterns.name: 气候争论中的论述语句
patterns.trigger: 「more honest about the data and the science of climate」「lying about it」「two things」
patterns.context: 评论气候数据与科学的可信度，并转入假设论证。

en.description: Several fragments activate when two is followed by plural or paired objects, covering graph vertices, selected vertices in software operations, and images; there are also sporadic responses to quantity bins, code indices, and numbers in matrix data.

patterns.name: Plural objects after two
patterns.context: The local context contains the cardinal number two followed by a plural object; activation often falls on two or nearby punctuation or the object word.
patterns.domain: Mathematical graph theory, software documentation, patent technical text

patterns.name: one/two in count categories
patterns.context: Presents categories or quantity bins in parallel, describing the relationship between the number of problems people encounter and the proportion of behavior.
patterns.domain: Research report, statistics, or public health text

patterns.name: Numbers 0/2 in indices or subscripts
patterns.context: In code or code-like expressions, numbers occur in bracketed indices, array subscripts, or structured symbol sequences.
patterns.domain: Code, numerical computation, or technical Q&A

patterns.name: Numbers 5/4/9 in matrix data
patterns.context: Numbers occur as data items in matrix construction code, alternating with string labels; no trigger word two is apparent.

7_2497.concept: two及数量/索引数字
7_2497.description: 多段在 two 后接复数对象或成对对象时激活，涵盖图论中的顶点、软件操作中的选中顶点及图像；另对数量分档、代码索引和矩阵数据中的数字有零星响应。

patterns.name: two 后接复数对象
patterns.trigger: “two”及其后的复数名词或对象表达，如 “two distinct vertices”“two selected vertices”“two images”
patterns.context: 局部上下文出现基数词 two，后接复数对象；激活常落在 two 或紧邻的标点、对象词上。
patterns.domain: 数学图论、软件说明、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 计数档位中的 one/two
patterns.trigger: “zero, one, two or more than two problems”
patterns.context: 并列呈现类别或数量档位，描述人数所遇问题数量与行为比例的关系。
patterns.domain: 研究报告、统计或公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 索引或下标中的数字 0/2
patterns.context: 代码或类代码表达式中，数字出现在方括号索引、数组下标或结构化符号序列内。
patterns.domain: 代码、数值计算或技术问答

patterns.name: 矩阵数据中的数字 5/4/9
patterns.context: 数字作为矩阵构造代码中的数据项，与字符串标签交替出现；未见 two 的触发词。

en.description: Activation occurs broadly on boundaries and symbols in structured text: line breaks, indentation, parentheses and commas, numbers, and formula/code markers; there are also sporadic responses to connectives in formal disclaimers and some title words.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers
patterns.context: In multiline formatted text, activation falls near line breaks, indentation, or bold markers, often adjacent to headings, tables, or item boundaries.

patterns.name: Separators in structured code and data
patterns.context: In code or numeric lists, parentheses and commas divide parameters, vectors, or matrix elements; activation is distributed across separators and some numbers.

patterns.name: Enumerative statements in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Formal sentences in a confidential email disclaimer that connect parallel objects and list authorized or prohibited actions.

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols and numbers activate in short math problems involving variable definitions, ordering, or fraction operations.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in English titles or labels
patterns.context: A paragraph contains a bold heading, field label, or proper name; activation appears on part of a title word and adjacent formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: LaTeX markers in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, variables, and macros appear in formulas or source code; activation falls on mathematical letters or macro fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic number and letter-parameter patterns
patterns.context: Numbers and single-letter parameters alternate in parameter sequences or function calls; this partly overlaps with the general code-separator pattern.

7_2497.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
7_2497.description: 激活广泛出现在结构化文本的边界和符号上：换行、缩进、括号逗号、数字及公式/代码标记；另对正式免责声明的连接词和部分标题词有零散响应。

patterns.name: 换行与排版结构标记
patterns.context: 多行排版文本中，激活落在换行符、缩进或加粗标记附近；常与标题、表格或条目边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 会议通知、报告、论文片段

patterns.name: 结构化代码与数据分隔符
patterns.context: 代码或数值列表中，括号和逗号用于划分参数、向量或矩阵元素；激活分布于分隔符及部分数字。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的列举语句
patterns.context: 保密邮件免责声明中，连接并列对象和列举授权或禁止行为的正式句子。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与运算符
patterns.context: 变量定义、排序或分数运算的简短数学题目中，符号与数字处有激活。

patterns.name: 英文标题或标签中的专名词片段
patterns.context: 段落含粗体标题、字段标签或专名，激活出现在标题词的一部分及相邻排版边界。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的 LaTeX 标记
patterns.context: 公式或源码中出现 LaTeX 命令、变量及宏，激活落在数学字母或宏片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文及 TeX 源码

patterns.name: 零散数字与字母参数模式
patterns.context: 参数序列或函数调用中，数字与单字母参数交替出现；与通用代码分隔符模式部分重叠。

en.description: Strong activations commonly occur in number-dense content: numeric lists and their decimal points, commas, minus signs, and parentheses. Mathematical ordering problems are especially prominent. Activations also occur in RGB decimals, paper identifiers/citations, and two lists of parallel occupational nouns; no single semantics explains all cases.

patterns.name: Punctuation in decimals and numeric sequences
patterns.context: In lists, coordinates, or tables containing multiple values, digits alternate with decimal points, commas, and minus signs; there is no evidence of sensitivity to a particular numerical operation.
patterns.domain: Math problems, StackExchange numerical data, and ArXiv figures/data

patterns.name: Numeric decimals and RGB parameters
patterns.context: Decimals appear as RGB components in color definitions; activations are distributed around the digits, decimal points, and separators.

patterns.name: Bibliographic entries and numbering markers
patterns.context: Appears near references, numbers, and titles in paper excerpts; local activations involve quotation marks, square brackets, digits, and title text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and reference markers

patterns.name: Adjacent lists of authors/professional nouns
patterns.context: Lists parallel nouns for people or organizations involved in designing, developing, or providing a system; activations occur near some nouns and conjunctions.

patterns.name: Film and television production job lists
patterns.context: Lists parallel film and television production roles within a narrative about others’ motives and creators’ concerns.

patterns.name: Math ordering instructions and answer formats
patterns.context: Requests values to be sorted in ascending order, followed by sorted answers containing negative numbers, fractions, decimals, or parameters; the main trigger text contains explicit sorting instructions.

7_2497.concept: 数字与列表分隔符
7_2497.description: 强激活常见于数字密集内容：数值列表及其小数点、逗号、负号和括号；数学排序题尤为突出。也见于 RGB 小数、论文编号/引文，以及两种并列职业名词列表，未见单一语义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 小数与数值序列中的标点
patterns.context: 在由多个数值组成的列表、坐标或表格中，数字与小数点、逗号、负号交替出现；未见其只对某种数值运算敏感。
patterns.domain: 数学题、StackExchange 数值数据与 ArXiv 图表/数据

patterns.name: 数值小数与 RGB 参数
patterns.context: 小数作为颜色定义中的 RGB 分量出现，激活分布在数字、小数点及分隔符附近。

patterns.name: 文献条目与编号标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文片段的参考文献、编号及标题附近；局部激活涉及引号、方括号、数字和标题文字。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及文献标记

patterns.name: 相邻作者/职业名词列表
patterns.context: 多个并列名词列举参与设计、开发或提供系统的人员/组织；激活落在部分名词及连接词附近。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，说明性 prose

patterns.name: 影视创作职位列表
patterns.context: 并列列举影视制作相关职位，处在关于他人动机与创作者关注事项的叙述中。

patterns.name: 数学排序指令与答案格式
patterns.trigger: “Sort … in increasing order”、“Put … in increasing order”
patterns.context: 要求按递增顺序排列数值，后接负数、分数、小数或参数的排序答案；主要触发文本含有可见排序指令。

en.concept: Local symbols and values in comma-separated sequences
en.description: Activation is most concentrated in comma-separated numeric sequences, especially math answers requiring ascending order; it also appears on SQL integer values, floating-point numbers and parameters in code, parliamentary identifiers, and English prose words, with no single stable trigger condition covering all fragments.

patterns.name: Ascending order of numeric values
patterns.context: A math exercise asks for the given numbers to be sorted from smallest to largest; activation concentrates on numbers and separators in the answer, especially the sorted result.

patterns.name: Comma-separated number sequences
patterns.context: Numbers are listed consecutively, separated by commas; this is sometimes not an ascending-order task, and sequences may contain duplicates or large numbers.
patterns.domain: Amendment identifiers in parliamentary text, mathematical lists

patterns.name: Incrementing integer values in SQL examples
patterns.context: Repeated SQL insertion examples have mostly identical string values, while the integer value changes from 4 to 5.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, SQL Q&A or terminal logs

patterns.name: Floating-point numbers and their formatting
patterns.context: Numbers and the floating-point format specifier f appear in code snippets; activation falls on numbers, f, and related punctuation.

patterns.name: TikZ drawing parameters in code
patterns.context: LaTeX Beamer code defines nodes with borders, rounded corners, and centered text; activation is distributed across parameter words.

patterns.name: Ordinary words in English narration
patterns.context: Activation falls on common words and nouns in continuous English prose, rather than on numeric sorting or code structure.

patterns.name: Slovenian parliamentary amendment text
patterns.context: Parliamentary text discusses a committee rejecting an amendment, followed by comma-separated amendment identifiers.

7_2497.concept: 逗号分隔序列中的局部符号与数值
7_2497.description: 激活最集中于逗号分隔的数值序列，尤以要求升序排列的数学答案为主；也出现在SQL整数值、代码中的浮点数与参数，以及议会编号和英文散文词语，未见能覆盖所有段的单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 数值的升序排列结果
patterns.trigger: “ascending order”“in increasing order”“Sort”，以及其后的负数、分数、小数和整数列表
patterns.context: 数学练习要求把给定数字从小到大排列；激活集中在答案中的数字与分隔标点上，尤其是排序结果

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的数字序列
patterns.context: 数字以逗号连续列出；有时不是升序排序任务，序列也可能包含重复值或大数
patterns.domain: 议会文本中的修正编号、数学列表

patterns.name: SQL 示例中的递增整数值
patterns.context: 重复的 SQL 插入示例中，字符串值基本相同，仅整数值从4变为5

patterns.name: 浮点数及其格式化表示
patterns.context: 数字与浮点格式标记 f 出现在代码片段中；激活落在数字、f及相关标点上

patterns.name: 代码中的 TikZ 绘图参数
patterns.context: LaTeX Beamer 代码定义带边框、圆角和居中文本的节点；激活分散在参数词上

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的普通词语
patterns.context: 激活落在连续英文散文中的常见词及名词，并非数字排序或代码结构

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语议会修正文本
patterns.trigger: “spremembe”“Komisija zavrača naslednje:”及其后的编号列表
patterns.context: 议会文本中谈及委员会拒绝修正案，后接逗号分隔的修正编号
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会记录

en.description: Activations are distributed across several structures: number-dense lists, fractions and decimals, years/identifiers, and review and prohibition actions in legal text. Numeric sequences and formatted values recur, but the legal passages do not fit the pattern.

patterns.name: Legal review language
patterns.context: Multiple review actions occur in parallel in sentences describing an appellate court’s review of the record, evidence, and reasonable inferences

patterns.name: Prohibited actions in disclaimers
patterns.context: A confidentiality/privilege disclaimer tells unauthorized recipients not to use, copy, or disclose information

patterns.name: Numbers and fractions in ordering problems
patterns.context: Numbers are elements of a list to be sorted, often near “Put,” “Sort,” and “in increasing/descending order”

patterns.name: LaTeX RGB values
patterns.context: An RGB triple of decimal values appears in a LaTeX color definition

patterns.name: Dense numeric sequences
patterns.context: Numbers are listed in a sequence, with too little surrounding text to determine their meaning
patterns.domain: EuroParl corpus excerpt; specific use unclear

patterns.name: Years and page numbers in references
patterns.context: A year follows the author names, followed by comma-separated numeric information

patterns.name: Author metadata
patterns.context: The document metadata section lists multiple authors in an author field, with footnote markers

patterns.name: Archive directory ordered by descending year
patterns.context: Gutenberg paths are followed by etext directory numbers ordered by descending year

7_2497.concept: 数字序列及结构化列表
7_2497.description: 激活分散于多种结构：数字密集的列表、分数与小数、年份/编号，以及法律文本中的审查和禁止动作。数字序列与格式化数值是反复出现的线索，但法律片段并不吻合。

patterns.name: 法律复审措辞
patterns.context: 描述上诉法院审查记录、证据及合理推论的句子中，多个审查动作并列出现

patterns.name: 免责声明中的禁止动作
patterns.context: 保密/特权信息免责声明中，告知非授权收件人不得使用、复制或披露信息

patterns.name: 排序题的数字与分数
patterns.trigger: 数字、负号、小数或分数字符，如“3/4”“-0.04”“9”
patterns.context: 数字作为待排序列表的元素，常出现在“Put”“Sort”及“in increasing/descending order”附近

patterns.name: LaTeX RGB 数值
patterns.context: LaTeX 的颜色定义中，RGB 三元组由小数数值构成

patterns.name: 密集数字序列
patterns.context: 数字成串列举，缺少足以确定其语义的周边文字
patterns.domain: EuroParl 语料片段，具体用途不明

patterns.name: 参考文献中的年份与页码
patterns.context: 作者姓名后跟年份，再跟逗号分隔的数字信息

patterns.name: 作者元数据
patterns.trigger: “author:”及作者姓名后的标点、编号和分隔符
patterns.context: 文档元数据区以 author 字段列出多位作者，并带有脚注标记

patterns.name: 按年份递减的档案目录
patterns.context: Gutenberg 路径后列出按年份递减的 etext 目录编号

en.description: Most fragments activate on coordinate conjunctions and comma-separated lists, especially multiple review factors, people or objects, locations, and numeric lists in legal texts; there are also local patterns involving legal evidence terms, number sequences, paper authorship, and emotional backlash.

patterns.name: Coordination and listing
patterns.context: Connects multiple nouns, actions, conditions, or numbers; common in longer lists and may co-occur with other patterns.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, product descriptions, news, and general prose

patterns.name: Review and evidence in legal argumentation
patterns.context: Discusses how an appellate court reviews evidence, the validity of an arbitration award, or the evaluation of an object and its record.

patterns.name: Numeric and identifier sequences
patterns.context: Numbers occur densely as lists, sorting exercises, or numbered items.

patterns.name: School performance and family background
patterns.context: Describes relationships among students, parental support, school conditions, and achievement.

patterns.name: Academic paper authorship and formatting
patterns.context: Author metadata, names, and institutional or authorship formatting appear after paper content.

patterns.name: Manufacturing and equipment cleaning
patterns.context: Lists manufacturers, service providers, or users related to precision components, and discusses equipment contamination and cleaning.

patterns.name: Listing product-use locations
patterns.context: Describes locations where equipment can be used, using coordinated locations to form a list.

patterns.name: Expressions of emotion and backlash
patterns.context: Narrates how narcissism or emotions affect the people involved in turn; not clearly shared with the other frequent coordination patterns.

7_2497.concept: 并列列举结构
7_2497.description: 多数片段在并列连接词及逗号列举处激活，尤其是法律文本中的多项审查因素、人物或对象、地点和数字列表；另有法律证据术语、数字序列、论文署名及情绪反作用等局部模式。

patterns.name: 并列连接与列举
patterns.trigger: « and»、« or»、逗号分隔的并列项
patterns.context: 连接多个名词、动作、条件或数字；常见于较长列举，也可与其他模式同时出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、产品说明、新闻及一般散文

patterns.name: 法律论证中的审查与证据
patterns.trigger: « court»、« evidence»、« review»、« record»、« fact»、« inferences»
patterns.context: 讨论上诉法院如何审查证据、仲裁裁决效力或评估对象及其记录。

patterns.name: 数字及编号序列
patterns.context: 数字以列表、排序题或编号条目形式密集出现。

patterns.name: 学校表现与家庭背景
patterns.context: 描述学生、家长支持、学校条件和成绩之间的背景关系。

patterns.name: 学术论文署名与格式
patterns.context: 论文内容之后出现作者元数据、姓名和机构或署名格式。

patterns.name: 制造与设备清洁
patterns.context: 列举精密部件相关的制造商、服务方或用户，并讨论设备污染与清洁。

patterns.name: 产品使用场所列举
patterns.context: 说明设备可在哪些场所使用，借助并列地点形成列举。

patterns.name: 情绪与反作用表达
patterns.context: 叙述自恋或情绪如何反过来影响相关人物；与其他高频并列模式不明显相同。

en.description: Activations fall on local strings across several domains: terms, mappings, and formulas in mathematical literature, as well as bibliographic formatting, descriptions of secondary education, and “so long as” in legal and geometric statements. These fragments do not show a single unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “so long as” conditional phrase
patterns.context: The phrase is followed by a conditional clause, often stating the condition under which a conclusion holds.

patterns.name: Nonlinear mathematical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a technical statement about how the dissipative part of an equation of motion depends on variables.

patterns.name: High school students and educational background
patterns.context: Describes graduating high school students and their family, school, and grade backgrounds.

patterns.name: G-space embeddings and closed subsets
patterns.context: Defines a property of a topological space in the form of a mathematical definition and conditional statement.

patterns.name: Outer automorphism/involution terminology
patterns.context: Discusses objects related to Lie algebras and their classification relationships.

patterns.name: Bibliographies and citation formats
patterns.context: Bibliographic entries include journal, volume, pages, plates, and author-year information.

patterns.name: Floquet operators and equivalence relations
patterns.context: States an operator’s name and notation, as well as unitary equivalence under parameter values.

patterns.name: Injective maps and indexed objects
patterns.context: Uses mappings to relate sets of objects with different indices, including set and arrow notation.

patterns.name: Probability/joint-distribution summation
patterns.context: Defines or expands a joint probability expression for finite-valued random variables.

7_2497.concept: 异质文本局部模式
7_2497.description: 激活落在多种领域的局部词串上：数学文献中的术语、映射与公式，另有书目格式、高中教育描述，以及法律和几何语句中的“so long as”。这些片段未显示单一统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “so long as”条件短语
patterns.context: 该短语后接条件从句，常用于陈述某个结论成立的条件。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、数学/几何解释；段4、5

patterns.name: 非线性数学术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于方程运动中耗散部分如何依赖变量的技术陈述里。

patterns.name: 高中生与教育背景
patterns.context: 描述高中毕业年级学生及其家庭、学校和成绩背景。

patterns.name: G-空间嵌入与闭子集
patterns.context: 定义拓扑空间满足的性质，句式为数学定义与条件陈述。

patterns.name: 外自同构/对合术语
patterns.context: 讨论李代数相关对象及其分类关系。

patterns.name: 文献目录与引文格式
patterns.trigger: “Proceedings of the Malacological Society of London”“24–32, pl. 3”“2004 Catalog”
patterns.context: 书目条目中出现期刊、卷页、图版及作者年份等信息。

patterns.name: Floquet 算符及等价关系
patterns.context: 陈述算符名称、记号以及参数取值下的酉等价性。

patterns.name: 注入映射与带指标对象
patterns.context: 用映射联系不同指标下的对象集合，含集合与箭头记号。

patterns.name: 概率/联合分布求和式
patterns.context: 定义或展开有限取值随机变量的联合概率表达式。

en.description: Primarily responds to phrasing in mathematical papers that states definitions or properties using existential quantifiers, universal conditions, and formulaic objects; a few domain-specific activations also concern physical dissipation terms, government legal liability, and software license rights.

patterns.name: Sequences of existential quantifiers in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: Introduces the existence of objects, sequences, or mappings in formal mathematical definitions or proofs; similar structures appear in [1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [8], and [10], though this is not always where activation is strongest in each passage.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, especially definitions, propositions, and proofs

patterns.name: Indefinite articles after existential quantifiers
patterns.context: Mathematical text first asserts existence, then uses an indefinite article to introduce an object satisfying a condition; this local pattern appears in [1], [2], [3], [4], and [5].

patterns.name: Definitions of mathematical objects and relations
patterns.context: States what properties or category an object belongs to, or defines a term; a conditional clause or “we call” introduces the definition.
patterns.domain: Definitions and terminology in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Generic quantification in mathematical text
patterns.context: A definition or property makes a universal statement about “any” or “every” object, often in combination with existential quantifiers.

patterns.name: Dense mathematical notation and formal conditions
patterns.context: The activated spans contain object symbols, set relations, mappings, or construction steps; this context occurs alongside the definition patterns above, but notation alone cannot explain all activations.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers spanning algebra, topology, metric spaces, graph theory, and analysis

patterns.name: Dissipation terms in physical equations
patterns.context: Descriptions of equations of motion or operators explicitly discuss a dissipative part and mention linear or nonlinear dependence.

patterns.name: Government liability and immunity in legal texts
patterns.context: A court opinion states whether the government, an agency, or an employee bears legal liability; the passage does not exhibit the main mathematical definition patterns.

patterns.name: Software licenses and rights
patterns.context: Explains software copyright and licensing to users, including permissions to copy, distribute, and modify; activation occurs on rights-related language in license explanations.

7_2497.concept: 形式化定义与条件陈述
7_2497.description: 主要响应数学论文中用存在量词、全称条件和公式对象陈述定义或性质的句式；另有物理耗散项、政府法律责任及软件许可权利等少数领域特异激活。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的存在量词序列
patterns.trigger: “there is”后紧接 «a»10；以及 [3] 中的 “there is a sequence”
patterns.context: 形式化数学定义或证明中，引入对象、序列或映射的存在性；[1]、[2]、[3]、[4]、[5]、[8]、[10] 都可见类似结构，但并非每段都在该位置激活最强。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，尤其是定义、命题及证明

patterns.name: 存在量词后的不定冠词
patterns.context: 数学文本先提出存在性，再用不定冠词引出一个满足条件的对象；[1]、[2]、[3]、[4]、[5] 均出现此局部模式。

patterns.name: 数学对象与关系定义
patterns.trigger: «is»8（[3] “is strong measure zero”）；«if»6（[1] “is called Koszul if”、[4] “is connected if”）；“is … if”或“we call … if/when”
patterns.context: 陈述一个对象属于何种性质、类别，或给术语下定义；条件从句或 “we call” 引出定义内容。
patterns.domain: 数学论文中的定义、术语说明

patterns.name: 数学文本的泛指量化
patterns.context: 定义或性质以“对任意”“对每个”对象作全称陈述，常与存在量词结合。

patterns.name: 数学符号和形式化条件密集出现
patterns.trigger: «subseteq»、«\in»、«\geq»、«sequence»、«vertices»、«diffeomorphism» 等数学术语或公式结构
patterns.context: 激活片段包含对象符号、集合关系、映射或构造步骤；这类背景与前述定义句式共同出现，但单靠符号不能解释所有激活。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，涵盖代数、拓扑、度量空间、图论与分析

patterns.name: 物理方程中的耗散项
patterns.trigger: «dissipative»；附近有 “operator … represents the … part of the equation of motion”
patterns.context: 方程运动或算符的描述中，明确讨论耗散部分，并提及线性或非线性依赖。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的政府责任与豁免
patterns.trigger: “the Government … is not liable under VARA”及 “The district court correctly held”
patterns.context: 法院意见陈述政府、机构或雇员是否承担法律责任；该段未呈现主要数学定义句式。

patterns.name: 软件许可证与权利说明
patterns.context: 面向用户说明软件版权、授权，以及复制、分发和修改的许可；激活落在法律许可说明中的权利相关表达。

en.description: Activations occur both on “1.” and the space after theorem or assumption numbers, and across mathematical conditional phrases, license distribution terms, legal terminology and citations, email headers, crystallographic values, and physics terms; trigger locations vary across domains.

patterns.name: Space after numbered clauses
patterns.context: A paragraph/theorem/assumption begins with the number “1.”, followed by a line break and a space; activations cluster on the number, period, and following space
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical papers, theorem or assumption lists

patterns.name: Software distribution
patterns.context: Appears in a software license describing permission to copy, distribute, or modify software

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and conditional statements
patterns.context: After a mathematical expression, explains variables, gives conditions, or introduces a definition/assumption

patterns.name: Formal legal rights and regulations
patterns.context: Discusses whether public officials may challenge the constitutionality or validity of a regulation

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-law punctuation
patterns.context: Court names, case citations, and parenthetical court and year information

patterns.name: Email headers and name/date information
patterns.context: Email header fields such as sender and sent time in a forwarded email

patterns.name: Values and statistics in crystallographic data
patterns.context: SADABS data-processing description reporting transmission factors and the number of diffraction reflections

patterns.name: Nonlinear expressions in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Describes the dissipative part of an equation of motion as depending linearly or nonlinearly on an operator

7_2497.concept: none
7_2497.description: 激活既落在定理或假设编号“1.”及其后空格，也分散于数学条件连接语、许可证分发词、法律术语与引证、邮件头、晶体学数值和物理术语；各域中触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 编号条款后的空格
patterns.trigger: 换行后的 «1»«.» 以及其后的 «  »；随后接正文或数学式
patterns.context: 段落/定理/假设以“1.”编号，编号后换行并留空格；激活集中在编号、句点和编号后的空格
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论论文，定理或假设列表

patterns.name: 分发软件
patterns.context: 出现在软件许可证中，描述复制、分发或修改软件的权限

patterns.name: 数学定义与条件陈述
patterns.context: 数学表达式之后解释变量、给出条件或引出定义/假设

patterns.name: 正式法律权利与法规
patterns.context: 讨论公职人员能否质疑法规合宪性或有效性

patterns.name: 法律引证与判例标点
patterns.context: 法院名称、判例引证及括号内法院和年份信息

patterns.name: 邮件头及姓名/日期信息
patterns.context: 转发邮件中的发件人、发送时间等邮件头字段

patterns.name: 晶体学数据中的数值与统计量
patterns.context: SADABS 数据处理说明，报告透射率和衍射反射数量

patterns.name: 科学术语中的非线性表达
patterns.context: 描述运动方程的耗散部分可线性或非线性地依赖某算符

en.description: Activations span multiple genres: mathematical notation and its boundaries, numbers, and citation formats are common; Polish words with diacritics, legal provisions, encyclopedia citations, and patent manufacturing language also occur. There is no single clear semantic trigger.

patterns.name: L, $, and hyphens in mathematical notation
patterns.context: In mathematical or formal text, variables, domains, or object notation are surrounded by dollar signs and hyphens; activation often falls on hyphens, mathematical symbol boundaries, and nearby tokens.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, especially algebra, logic, and geometry

patterns.name: Decimal values and measurement data
patterns.context: Numbers occur in precise measurements, statistics, or citation-like data strings, with punctuation, spaces, or formatting markers between digits.

patterns.name: Citation and reference formats
patterns.context: Bibliographic citations consisting of author names, years, square brackets, or punctuation; activation may occur on the year after an author name, formatting markers, or nearby short tokens.

patterns.name: Numbering and item structure
patterns.context: The body is organized using numbered propositions, footnotes, or headings/table-of-contents entries; activation occurs near numbers and structural delimiters.

patterns.name: Polish words with diacritics
patterns.context: Non-ASCII letters within Polish words and their tokenized fragments activate, especially accented or diacritic letters in the middle or at the end of a word.

patterns.name: Statutory language in legal cases
patterns.context: A court decision cites a legal provision and explains its scope; activation clusters near legal terms or short function words.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia narrative and language of belief
patterns.context: Quotes a scientist’s statement about belief, followed by an encyclopedia-style publication or book entry.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and manufacturing cost language
patterns.context: The patent background states the invention’s objectives, structural reliability, and manufacturing costs; activation occurs near words related to materials, cost, or labor.

7_2497.concept: 格式与符号敏感
7_2497.description: 激活分布跨多种文体：数学记号及其边界、数字与引用格式较常见，也见波兰语变音词、法律条文、百科引文和专利制造措辞；没有单一明确的语义触发因素。

patterns.name: 数学符号中的 L、$ 与连字符
patterns.context: 数学或形式化文本中，变量、域或对象记号被美元符号和连字符包围；激活常落在连字符、数学符号边界及其邻近 token。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，尤其代数、逻辑与几何

patterns.name: 小数数值与测量数据
patterns.context: 数值嵌在精确测量、统计或引文式数据串中，数字之间夹杂标点、空格或格式标记。
patterns.domain: 晶体学论文及法律引文

patterns.name: 引文和参考文献格式
patterns.context: 作者名、年份、方括号或标点构成的书目引用；激活可出现在作者名后的年份、格式标记或相邻短 token。

patterns.name: 编号与条目结构
patterns.context: 正文以编号命题、脚注或标题/目录条目组织；编号和结构性分隔符附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 波兰语中带变音符号的字词
patterns.context: 波兰语词内部的非 ASCII 字母及其分词片段获得激活，尤其词中或词尾的重音/变音字母。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会正式文件，波兰语

patterns.name: 法律判例中的条文表述
patterns.context: 法院判决引用法律条文并说明其适用范围；激活集中在法律术语或短功能词附近。

patterns.name: 百科叙述与信仰措辞
patterns.context: 引述科学家关于信仰的陈述，后接百科式出版物或书籍条目。

patterns.name: 专利目的与制造成本措辞
patterns.trigger: “a new plunger device”“low cost of manufacture”“materials and labor”
patterns.context: 专利背景中陈述发明目标、结构可靠性及制造成本；激活落在材料、成本或劳动相关词附近。

en.concept: Direct/indirect parallel expressions and formatting patterns
en.description: Primarily responds to parallel expressions such as “directly or indirectly”; it also activates on “1.” and a following space after mathematical theorem numbers, legal citations and procedural language, and comma-grouped numbers in encyclopedia statistics.

patterns.name: Direct/indirect parallel phrasing
patterns.context: Direct and indirect are parallel modifiers of an action, effect, or causal pathway; commas often occur nearby, followed by a verb or result.

patterns.name: Statute/case identifiers in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case citation formats, with numbers adjacent to legal reporter abbreviations, court, or year.

patterns.name: Number and space after a mathematical theorem
patterns.context: A theorem statement is followed by a line break and the start of a numbered list; a distinct space follows the number and period, before a formula or condition.

patterns.name: Comma-grouped statistics
patterns.context: Comma-separated thousands occur beside units or statistical nouns in population, household, or housing statistics.

patterns.name: Procedural rules and evidence lists in legal documents
patterns.context: The main text summarizes a summary judgment standard, cites procedural rules, and introduces a list of litigation materials with a colon.

7_2497.concept: 直接/间接并列表达及格式模式
7_2497.description: 主要响应“directly or indirectly”这类直接/间接并列表达；另对数学定理编号后的“1.”与空格、法律引文和诉讼规则措辞、百科统计中的逗号分组数字也有激活。

patterns.name: 直接/间接并列措辞
patterns.trigger: « directly»…« or»…« indirectly»（[1] «directly or indirectly»；[3] «both directly and indirectly»；[10] «either directly or indirectly»）
patterns.context: 直接与间接作为并列方式修饰行为、作用或因果路径；前后常有逗号，后接动词或结果。
patterns.domain: 邮件免责声明、科研计划/生物医学论文

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法条/判例编号
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文格式中，数字与法律报告集缩写、法院或年份相邻。

patterns.name: 数学定理后的编号与空格
patterns.context: 定理陈述后以换行、编号列表开头，编号和句点后跟明显空格，再进入公式或条件。
patterns.domain: 数学/理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 统计数字中的逗号分组
patterns.context: 人口、家庭或住房统计中，逗号分隔的千位数字与计量单位或统计名词相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科全书人口统计条目

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼规则与证据列举
patterns.context: 总结判决标准的正文中引用程序规则，并以冒号引出诉讼材料清单。

en.description: Activations occur across numbers and mixed-symbol strings, mathematical formulas and numbering, legal enumerations, ordinal technical components, and action and negation language in disclaimers. A shared feature may be local boundaries or enumerative structure, but semantic triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Numeric boundaries in numbers and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Activation clusters around numbers, punctuation, and mixed alphanumeric strings; examples include mathematical symbols and formulas, demographic figures, hexadecimal constants, and line-initial numbering
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mathematical papers, encyclopedia entries, code, and patent texts

patterns.name: Qualifying or enumerative language in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in syntactic enumerations, parenthetical supplements, and scope limitations in legal provisions or judicial opinions

patterns.name: Ordinals and repeatedly numbered objects in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes multiple components and their connections, positions, or operating sequence in patents or technical documentation

patterns.name: Theorem structure and formal notation in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Statements of theorems, propositions, or results, with formulas alternating with prose
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Enumerated prohibitions and actions in disclaimers
patterns.context: An email misdelivery disclaimer asks the recipient to take or refrain from several actions

7_2497.concept: 列举与结构化标记
7_2497.description: 激活分布于数字及混合符号串、数学公式和编号、法律列举、技术部件序数，以及免责声明的动作与否定表达；共同点可能是局部边界或列举结构，但语义触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 数值与字母数字串中的数字边界
patterns.trigger: 如 «$,»、«705»、«1»、«0x»、«b»，以及数字串中的逗号、点号或字母
patterns.context: 激活集中在数字、标点和字母数字混排处；包括数学符号及公式、人口统计数字、十六进制常量，也包括行首编号
patterns.domain: 跨领域；数学论文、百科条目、代码、专利文本

patterns.name: 法律文本中的限定或列举表达
patterns.context: 出现在法律条文或判决书的句法列举、括号补充及适用范围限定中

patterns.name: 技术描述中的序数与重复编号对象
patterns.trigger: «first»、«second»、«third»，以及相邻对象或步骤的编号式列举
patterns.context: 在专利或技术说明中描述多个部件及其连接、位置或操作顺序

patterns.name: 数学论文中的定理结构与形式化符号
patterns.context: 定理、命题或结果的陈述，公式与正文交替出现
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 免责声明中的否定与动作列举
patterns.context: 邮件错误投递免责声明中要求收件人采取或禁止若干动作

en.description: Activations occur mainly in text that first states a condition or rule and then introduces a subsequent list/equivalent; they also cover custom in configuration comments, crystallographic values and parameter notation, and language about legal effect in contractual disclaimers.

patterns.name: Introductions to lists/equivalents
patterns.context: Introduces assumptions, a theorem, or a rule before presenting a numbered list or equivalent conditions; activations often fall near “following,” “equivalent,” “:”, and the numbering
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, legal texts, license clauses

patterns.name: custom in Sphinx configuration comments
patterns.context: A configuration-file comment names an extension module; the triggering token is custom at the end of the line

patterns.name: Crystallographic values after a chemical formula
patterns.context: A molecular weight or crystal structure parameters and units immediately follow a chemical formula

patterns.name: h and extrema markers in crystallographic data
patterns.context: A diffraction/structure-determination data table or a compactly formatted row of crystallographic parameters

patterns.name: Contractual legal-effect language
patterns.context: States that a communication does not constitute a contract and may not be used to claim a contractual relationship

7_2497.concept: 结构化条款与技术文档标记
7_2497.description: 激活主要出现在先陈述条件或规则、再引出后续列表/等价项的文本中；此外也覆盖配置注释中的 custom、晶体学数值与参数记号，以及合同免责声明中的法律效力措辞。

patterns.name: 清单/等价项引导
patterns.trigger: “the following are equivalent:”以及其后的“1.”；另有“the following characterization”和“the following conditions”
patterns.context: 先介绍假设、定理或规则，再引出编号列表或等价条件；激活常落在“following”“equivalent”“:”及编号附近
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、法律文本、许可证条款

patterns.name: Sphinx 配置注释中的 custom
patterns.context: 配置文件注释说明扩展模块名称，触发 token 位于行尾的 custom

patterns.name: 化学式后的晶体学数值
patterns.context: 化学式后紧接分子量或晶体结构参数与单位

patterns.name: 晶体学数据中的 h 与极值标记
patterns.context: 衍射/结构测定数据表或压缩排版的晶体学参数行

patterns.name: 合同法律效力措辞
patterns.trigger: “binding and enforceable contract”“contract by estoppel or otherwise”
patterns.context: 声明通信不构成合同、不得据以主张合同关系
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的法律免责声明

en.description: Patterns span case law, mathematical papers, experimental reports, configuration comments, and license texts, responding respectively to legal terminology and litigation language, mathematical definitions, experimental parameters, code comments, and disclaimers; no specific trigger pattern unifies all domains.

patterns.name: Federal and state law terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussion of the application of law, jurisdiction, state-law questions, or conflicts of law in federal court; often contrasts federal/state law
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal discourse

patterns.name: Civil procedure rules and judicial language
patterns.context: Formulaic legal language about summary judgment standards and how courts review facts and issue rulings

patterns.name: Judicial discretion and legal citations
patterns.context: An opinion cites precedent and describes the discretion of a judge or special master
patterns.domain: U.S. case citations and judicial reasoning

patterns.name: Definitions, objects, and properties in mathematics
patterns.context: Formal mathematical text defines mappings, curves, or theoretical properties, accompanied by symbols, theorem, and proof structure
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry and model theory papers

patterns.name: Crystallographic experimental parameters and numbers
patterns.context: Reports absorption correction, transmission ranges, and measured/independent reflection counts

patterns.name: Configuration comments and extension settings
patterns.context: A comment beginning with a hash sign explains how to enter the name of an extension module

patterns.name: Software license disclaimer
patterns.context: Explains restrictions in different states on disclaimers of implied warranties and exclusions of consequential damages, and whether the terms apply

7_2497.concept: none
7_2497.description: 模式跨判例、数学论文、实验报告、配置注释和许可文本，分别响应法律术语与诉讼措辞、数学定义、实验参数、代码注释及免责声明；未见能统一覆盖各域的具体触发模式。

patterns.name: 联邦法与州法术语
patterns.context: 出现在联邦法院对法律适用、管辖权、州法问题或法律冲突的讨论中；常与 federal/state law 对照

patterns.name: 民事诉讼规则与判决措辞
patterns.context: 摘要判决标准及法院审查事实、作出裁决的固定法律措辞

patterns.name: 司法裁量与法律引证
patterns.trigger: «discretion»、«reduce»，以及引证中的法院、卷页和年份
patterns.context: 判决援引先例并说明法官或特别主事官的裁量权
patterns.domain: 美国判例引证与裁判理由

patterns.name: 数学中的定义、对象与性质
patterns.context: 形式化数学文本中定义映射、曲线或理论性质，伴随符号、定理及证明结构
patterns.domain: 代数几何与模型论论文

patterns.name: 晶体学实验参数与数字
patterns.context: 报告吸收校正、透射率范围及测量/独立反射数值

patterns.name: 配置文件注释与扩展设置
patterns.context: 以井号开头的注释说明如何填写扩展模块名称

patterns.name: 软件许可免责声明
patterns.context: 说明不同州对默示保证免责声明及后果性损害排除的限制，及条款是否适用

en.concept: Local high-frequency words and structural fragments
en.description: Activations span legal, web, patent, materials, and mathematical texts: they may fall on facts and inferences, forum selection, lists of system components, and specialized definitions or values. There is no single stable meaning; some hotspots may arise from common words or formatting.

patterns.name: “all” and facts/inferences in court opinions
patterns.context: In legal arguments, especially when facts and inferences must be construed in favor of a party, activations cluster near words such as all, facts, and inferences.

patterns.name: All factual allegations presumed true
patterns.context: A court describes reviewing a complaint or an insurance dispute and states that all factual allegations are accepted as true.

patterns.name: Forum navigation instructions
patterns.context: Instructs website users to choose the forum they want to access; activations stand out near select, the, and forum.

patterns.name: Multiple uses and components of information systems
patterns.context: A patent background section introduces the various software and hardware components an information processing system may contain; nearby lists of uses may also accompany activations.

patterns.name: Crystal structure parameters
patterns.context: Orthorhombic unit-cell parameters and values are listed after a chemical formula.

patterns.name: Definition of a map on a manifold
patterns.context: A mathematics paper uses a definition or list of conditions to describe a map from a manifold to a graph.

7_2497.concept: 局部高频词与结构片段
7_2497.description: 激活跨法律、网页、专利、材料和数学文本：可落在事实与推论、论坛选择、系统组件列举及专业定义或数值上；无单一稳定语义，部分热点可能来自常见词或格式。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的“all”与事实/推论
patterns.context: 法律论述中，尤其是要求将事实及推论作有利于一方的理解时，激活集中在 all、facts、inferences 等词附近。

patterns.name: 对事实指控一概视为真实
patterns.context: 法院描述审查诉状或保险争议时，表示接受全部事实指控为真。

patterns.name: 论坛导航指引
patterns.context: 指引网站用户选择欲访问的论坛；select、the、forum 附近激活突出。

patterns.name: 信息系统的多种用途与组件
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍信息处理系统可包含多类软硬件组件；相邻的用途列举也可能伴随激活。

patterns.name: 晶体结构参数
patterns.context: 化学式之后列出晶体晶胞的正交晶系参数及数值。

patterns.name: 流形上的映射定义
patterns.context: 数学论文以定义或条件列表描述流形到图的映射。

en.concept: Structured terminology and markers in specialized texts
en.description: Activations cover formatted terminology, numbers, and proposition markers across specialized texts: prominent examples include citations and litigation rules in U.S. legal opinions, as well as statutory provisions, crystallographic parameters, and numbered or equivalent proposition structures in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Case-law citation formats and citation punctuation
patterns.context: Volume, page, court, or year information in U.S. case citations, as well as numbered items in legal tests; numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation are often split into tokens
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, statutes, and case citations

patterns.name: Summary judgment standards and reasoning language
patterns.context: Formulaic language about construing facts and inferences in favor of a party when discussing summary judgment, evidentiary review, burden of proof, or the nonmovant

patterns.name: Statutory interpretation and legislative language
patterns.context: Courts discuss how statutes should be interpreted, whether to look first to the plain text or public policy, and cite legislative intent or interpretive principles

patterns.name: Language of the federal supplemental jurisdiction statute
patterns.context: The text of a statute enumerates the supplemental jurisdiction of federal district courts over related additional claims

patterns.name: Standard for determining abuse of discretion
patterns.context: An opinion enumerates standards for when judicial action constitutes an abuse of discretion
patterns.domain: Standards of review in U.S. opinions

patterns.name: Crystallographic values, chemical formulas, and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Chemical formulas, unit-cell parameters, crystal systems, and units of length are mixed together in descriptions of crystal structures or compound characterization

patterns.name: Crystallographic data collection and refinement parameters
patterns.context: Reports absorption-correction software, minimum/maximum transmission, and the numbers of measured and independent diffraction reflections

patterns.name: Lists of equivalent propositions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Theorem conditions, definitions, or characterizations are organized using line breaks, numbering, and equivalence relations; the mathematical objects and propositions differ

7_2497.concept: 专业文本中的结构化术语与标记
7_2497.description: 激活覆盖多种专业文本中的格式化术语、数字及命题标记：重点包括美国法律判决的引文和诉讼规则，也包括法条、晶体学参数，以及数学论文的编号或等价命题结构。

patterns.name: 判例法引用格式与引文标点
patterns.context: 美国判例引用中的卷页、法院或年份信息，以及法律测试的编号条目；数字、缩写和标点往往被拆分标记
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法条与判例引文

patterns.name: 简易判决标准及其推理表述
patterns.context: 讨论简易判决、证据审查、举证责任或非动议方时，出现有利于一方理解事实和推断的公式化表述

patterns.name: 法条解释与制定法用语
patterns.context: 法院讨论应如何解释法条、先看明文还是公共政策，并援引立法意图或解释原则
patterns.domain: 美国判决中的法条解释

patterns.name: 联邦补充管辖权法条措辞
patterns.context: 法条正文列举联邦地区法院对相关其他请求的补充管辖权
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法条（民事管辖权）

patterns.name: 裁量滥用的判定标准
patterns.context: 判决以列举标准说明司法行为何时构成滥用裁量
patterns.domain: 美国判决中的审查标准

patterns.name: 晶体学数值、化学式与结构描述
patterns.context: 晶体结构或化合物表征中，化学式、晶胞参数、晶系与长度单位混排

patterns.name: 晶体学数据采集与精修参数
patterns.context: 报告吸收校正软件、最小／最大透射率及实测和独立衍射反射数

patterns.name: 数学论文中的等价命题列表
patterns.context: 以换行、编号和等价关系组织定理条件、定义或刻画；数学对象和命题内容彼此并不相同
patterns.domain: 数学论文（几何与集合论）

en.concept: Recognition of letters and word-ending markers
en.description: Activation often falls on the final s in legal English, especially possessives and litigation language. Other examples include the dimension marker D in physics papers, d in Slovenian, and the element symbol O in chemical formulas; these cannot be fully unified.

patterns.name: Legal possessive apostrophe s
patterns.context: A legal noun followed by possessive ’s, with activation concentrated on s; also includes district court’s in citations
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and statutory citations

patterns.name: s in statutory or legal wording
patterns.context: Plural or final s in legal phrases, especially fixed expressions such as statutory language and mere allegations; a possessive apostrophe is not required
patterns.domain: Legal arguments and civil procedure rules

patterns.name: Dimension marker D
patterns.context: In physics or astrophysics papers, a number combines with D to form a dimension marker, with D as the salient activation position
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers on ultracold atoms or magnetic geometry

patterns.name: Internal s in Slovenian words
patterns.context: Slovenian word forms and internal segmentation in non-English parliamentary text; strong activation in this passage clearly falls on d, not on legal English or the D marker

patterns.name: O in chemical formulas
patterns.context: The element symbol O in molecular formulas, with formatting markers or subscript encodings adjacent

7_2497.concept: 字母及词尾标记识别
7_2497.description: 激活常落在法律英语的词尾 s，尤其所有格及诉讼措辞；另见物理论文维度标记 D、斯洛文尼亚语中的 d，以及化学式元素符号 O，不能完全归并。

patterns.name: 法律所有格撇号 s
patterns.context: 法律名词后接所有格 ’s，激活集中在 s；也包括引文中 district court’s
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、法规引文

patterns.name: 法定或法律措辞中的 s
patterns.context: 法律短语中的复数或词尾 s，尤其 statutory language、mere allegations 等固定表达；不要求撇号所有格
patterns.domain: 法律论证及民事诉讼规则

patterns.name: 维度标记 D
patterns.context: 物理或天体物理论文中，数字与 D 组成维度标记，D 为突出激活位置
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文，冷原子或磁几何研究

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内 s
patterns.trigger: z«d»10aj（该处实际为 d）、Gospod« Costa»、Komis«iji»；高亮 token 为 z«d»10aj
patterns.context: 非英语议会语料中的斯洛文尼亚语词形与词内分词；该段强激活明确落在 d，而非法律英文或 D 标记
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会斯洛文尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 化学式中的 O
patterns.context: 分子式中元素符号 O 前后带有排版标记或下标编码

en.concept: Rules and technical terminology in specialized texts
en.description: Activations cover crystallographic parameters and diffraction data, court authority and statutory interpretation in legal cases, summary judgment and burden of proof, and software license disclaimers; there is also a technical passage about independent and constrained refinement. Most samples contain terminology, rules, or formulas in specialized genres.

patterns.name: Rules and judicial determinations in legal opinions
patterns.context: Discusses how a court determines a claim or legal issue, often alongside case citations.

patterns.name: Plain-text interpretation of statutes
patterns.context: Emphasizes analyzing the express text of a statute before drawing conclusions from public policy.

patterns.name: Congressional power and court selection
patterns.context: Discusses Congress’s choice of court within the bounds of its constitutional authority.

patterns.name: Independent and constrained refinement
patterns.context: The phrase appears in a technical description containing formulas and parameters.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and diffraction data
patterns.context: Crystal structures, unit-cell parameters, absorption corrections, or diffraction reflection data; formulas, numbers, and symbols are interspersed.

patterns.name: Legal standard for summary judgment
patterns.context: States the evidentiary review standard courts use to determine whether summary judgment applies.

patterns.name: Reasonable-jury standard for summary judgment
patterns.context: Explains the conditions for summary judgment in terms of whether a reasonable jury could find for a party.

patterns.name: Burden shifting under Rule 56
patterns.context: Explains that once one party has fulfilled its Rule 56 obligation, the nonmovant must present further evidence or arguments.

patterns.name: Software license disclaimer
patterns.context: Standard disclaimer following a copyright notice, excluding express or implied warranties.

7_2497.concept: 专业文本中的规则与技术术语
7_2497.description: 激活覆盖晶体学参数与衍射数据、法律判例中的法院权限和法条解释、简易判决及举证责任，以及软件许可证免责声明；另有一段关于独立与受约束精修的技术文字。多数样本是专业文体中的术语、规则或公式。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的规则与法院判断
patterns.trigger: “the courts to determine whether the claim, on its face”
patterns.context: 讨论法院如何判定诉求或法律问题，常伴随案件引证。

patterns.name: 依成文法字面解释
patterns.context: 强调先分析法律条文的明文，而非先依公共政策推断。

patterns.name: 国会权力与法院选择
patterns.trigger: “Congress, acting within its constitutional powers, may freely choose the court”
patterns.context: 讨论国会在宪法权限范围内选择审理法院。
patterns.domain: 美国宪法及管辖权判例

patterns.name: 独立与受约束的精修
patterns.context: 短语出现在带公式和参数的技术说明中。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与衍射数据
patterns.context: 晶体结构、晶胞参数、吸收校正或衍射反射数据；夹杂公式、数字和符号。

patterns.name: 简易判决的法律标准
patterns.trigger: “Summary judgment”“viewing the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmoving party”
patterns.context: 陈述法院判断是否适用简易判决的证据审查标准。

patterns.name: 简易判决的合理陪审员标准
patterns.trigger: “Summary judgment is appropriate when a court can conclude that no reasonable juror could find”
patterns.context: 以合理陪审员能否作出有利于一方的认定说明简易判决条件。

patterns.name: Rule 56 下举证责任转移
patterns.trigger: “the burden of production shifts”“the nonmoving party must do more”
patterns.context: 一方完成 Rule 56 义务后，说明非动议方必须提出更多证据或论据。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦民事诉讼判例

patterns.name: 软件许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS”“AS IS”“IMPLIED WARRANTIES”
patterns.context: 版权声明后的标准免责条款，排除明示或默示保证。

en.concept: Structured parameters and legal citations in specialized literature
en.description: Activation is concentrated in two types of specialized formatting: crystallographic parameters, units, and numerical fields; and citation numbers and abbreviations in U.S. case law. Legal text also covers fixed expressions about court review, precedential effect, litigation evidence, and appellate standards.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and diffraction data format
patterns.context: Consecutive fields in crystal structure reports, including parenthesized uncertainties, unit-cell parameters, radiation source, absorption coefficient, and temperature; the neuron mainly activates on these fields and nearby values or units
