patterns.domain: Crystallography and chemistry papers in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Page numbers and citation abbreviations in U.S. case citations
patterns.context: Legal case citations, especially numbers and court or case-reporter abbreviations in citation strings

patterns.name: Fixed wording in legal arguments
patterns.context: Discussing whether a court should review a claim; in both passages this wording follows a case citation

patterns.name: Three-judge panels and statements about precedential effect
patterns.context: Stating that a decision by a certain type of panel has no precedential effect

patterns.name: Civil procedure burden-of-proof rules
patterns.context: Explaining that the burden of proof shifts after the moving party meets its burden, and that the nonmoving party must present further evidence

patterns.name: Habeas corpus appellate review standard
patterns.context: Explaining how a petitioner satisfies the appellate burden or standard of review
patterns.domain: FreeLaw constitutional or habeas corpus decisions

7_2497.concept: 专业文献中的结构化参数与法律引证
7_2497.description: 激活集中于两类专业排版：晶体学参数、单位和数值字段；美国判例中的引证数字与缩写。法律文本中也覆盖法院审查、先例效力及诉讼举证和上诉标准等固定表述。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与衍射数据格式
patterns.context: 晶体结构报告中的括号不确定度、晶胞参数、辐射源、吸收系数、温度等连续字段；神经元主要激活在这些字段及其数值/单位附近
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的晶体学、化学论文

patterns.name: 美国判例引证中的页码与引证缩写
patterns.trigger: “U.S.”、“L.Ed.”、“S.Ct.”、“Ill. App.”以及逗号分隔的页码、卷号
patterns.context: 法律判决引证，尤其引证串中的数字和法院/判例报告缩写

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定措辞
patterns.trigger: “it is for the courts to determine whether”
patterns.context: 讨论法院是否应审查某项主张；两段中该措辞位于判例引证之后

patterns.name: 三法官合议庭与先例效力表述
patterns.trigger: “three-justice panel”及“not to be considered as precedent”
patterns.context: 说明某类合议庭裁决不具有先例效力

patterns.name: 民事诉讼举证责任规则
patterns.context: 阐述动议方满足责任后举证责任转移，以及非动议方须提出更多证据
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 民事诉讼判决文本

patterns.name: 人身保护令上诉审查标准
patterns.context: 说明申请人如何满足上诉证明/审查标准
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 宪法或人身保护令判决文本

en.concept: Numbers and terminology in structured specialist texts
en.description: Activation is concentrated on numbers and their decimals, percentages, units, and citation numbers. It also covers fixed wording in U.S. cases about court rulings, evidence review, and appellate disposition, as well as mathematical formal notation and algebraic terms.

patterns.name: Numbers and units in scientific tables
patterns.context: In tables or sequences of parameters, values appear interspersed with decimal places, parenthesized values, percentages, units, or scientific notation; number fragments are often split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Biomedical tables, crystallographic/material parameters, demographic encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Legal ruling language and procedural terminology
patterns.context: Fixed expressions in U.S. cases or legal opinions concerning courts, standards of decision, evidence review, or appellate rulings; activation spans multiple content and function words in legal phrases.
patterns.domain: U.S. cases and appellate court opinions

patterns.name: Mathematical formal language and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Logical symbols, variables, names of algebraic structures, and surrounding words co-occur in formal mathematics papers.

patterns.name: Isolated table or citation number activations
patterns.context: Numbers and citation numbers occur in legal citations or demographic descriptions; these may overlap with number patterns, but adjacent unactivated text cannot be fully explained by legal wording.

7_2497.concept: 结构化专业文本中的数值与术语
7_2497.description: 激活集中于数字及其小数、百分比、单位和引文编号，也覆盖美国判例中法院裁判、证据审查与上诉处置的固定措辞；另在数学形式化符号及代数术语中出现。

patterns.name: 科学表格中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 表格或连续参数中，数值及其小数位、括号内数值、百分比、单位或科学符号交错出现；数字片段常被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 生物医学表格、晶体学/材料参数、人口统计类百科文本

patterns.name: 法律裁判措辞与程序用语
patterns.context: 美国判例或法律意见书中出现法院、裁判标准、证据审查、上诉裁定等固定表达，激活覆盖法律短语中的多个实词和功能词。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与上诉法院意见书

patterns.name: 数学形式语言与符号化表达
patterns.context: 形式化数学论文中，逻辑符号、变量、代数结构名称及其周围词语共同出现。

patterns.name: 孤立的表格/引文数字激活
patterns.context: 数字和引文编号出现在法律引证或人口统计叙述中；可能与数字模式重叠，但未激活的相邻文本不能完全由法律措辞解释。
patterns.domain: 判例引证、百科人口统计

en.description: Activations cover varied content: summary judgment and burden of proof, case citations and court powers, scientific symbols and units, Polish forestry policy, polynomial answers to sequence problems, and software disclaimers. Legal passages have clear internal thematic connections, but there is no single stable trigger pattern overall.

patterns.name: Inference language in summary judgment
patterns.context: Describes how courts view evidence and draw inferences for the nonmovant when reviewing summary judgment; appears in case citations and judicial reasoning.

patterns.name: Burden-of-proof standards and party responsibilities in summary judgment
patterns.context: Addresses genuine disputes of material fact, evidentiary sufficiency, and the burdens of the movant and nonmovant in summary judgment.

patterns.name: Case citations and statements about court/Congressional powers
patterns.context: After a case name and citation, discusses Congress’s power to select courts within its constitutional authority; not the same local topic as summary judgment burdens of proof.

patterns.name: Physical quantity symbols and units
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, parameters with subscripts and superscripts, radiation terminology, and units of measurement appear together; activation is distributed near numbers and symbols.

patterns.name: Polish forestry protection language
patterns.context: A Polish sentence discusses improving forests’ resistance to biotic and abiotic threats; activation occurs on several words and intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Polynomial answers in sequence problems
patterns.context: A sequence is given and the nth term is requested, followed by a polynomial answer composed of variable powers and coefficients; activation involves numbers and algebraic symbols.

patterns.name: Software license disclaimer
patterns.context: An all-caps disclaimer formatted with line breaks, disclaims implied warranties, and limits liability.

7_2497.concept: none
7_2497.description: 激活覆盖多类内容：摘要判决与举证责任、判例引注及法院权力、科学符号和单位、波兰语林业政策、数列多项式答案、软件免责声明。法律段落内部有明确主题联系，但整体没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 摘要判决中的推论措辞
patterns.trigger: “viewing the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmoving party”及“drawing all inferences in favor”
patterns.context: 描述法院审查摘要判决时如何看待证据、作有利于非动议方的推论；出现在判例引文和司法论证中。

patterns.name: 摘要判决的举证标准与双方责任
patterns.trigger: “genuine issue of material fact”“substantial evidence”“burden of production shifts”“nonmoving party”“summary judgment”
patterns.context: 围绕摘要判决中实质事实争议、证据充分性，以及动议方与非动议方的举证责任展开。
patterns.domain: 美国民事诉讼法律文本

patterns.name: 判例引注及法院／国会权力表述
patterns.context: 判例名称与引注之后，讨论国会在宪法权限内选择法院的权力；与摘要判决举证标准并非同一局部主题。

patterns.name: 物理量符号与单位表达式
patterns.context: 数学符号、带上下标的参数、辐射术语和度量单位交错出现；激活分布于数值和符号附近。

patterns.name: 波兰语林业保护表述
patterns.trigger: “zwiększenia odporności lasów na tę grupę biotycznych i abiotycznych zagrożeń”
patterns.context: 波兰语句子讨论提高森林对生物和非生物威胁的抵抗力，激活落在若干词及词内片段上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本／林业政策

patterns.name: 序列题中的多项式答案
patterns.context: 给出数列并询问第 n 项，随后呈现以变量幂次和系数构成的多项式答案；激活涉及数值和代数符号。

patterns.name: 软件许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED”及“IN NO EVENT SHALL”
patterns.context: 全大写、换行排版的免责条款，否认默示担保并限制责任。

en.concept: Symbols and numbers in structured specialist texts
en.description: Primarily responds to symbolic parameters, values, and unit sequences in crystallographic reports. It also activates on legal rulings and liability language, adsorption research terminology, and mathematical variables or powers. The triggering forms are not fully consistent across fields.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameter tables
patterns.context: Consecutive listings of unit-cell parameters, radiation source, absorption coefficient, temperature, or crystal dimensions; values, units, and symbols are interspersed
patterns.domain: PubMed Central crystal structure and diffraction experiment reports

patterns.name: Diffraction data correction and statistics
patterns.context: Describes multi-scan absorption correction and the numbers of measured and independent reflections, accompanied by correction program names and decimal values

patterns.name: Legal decisions and liability clauses
patterns.context: Legal text discussing summary judgment, standards of court review, scope of liability, or contractual or tort liability
patterns.domain: FreeLaw decisions and legal disclaimer text on Github

patterns.name: Quantitative results in adsorption research
patterns.context: Describes adsorption mechanisms or isotherm results and gives adsorption capacity and units
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, materials and environmental science research

patterns.name: Variables and powers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, exponents, and arithmetic expressions appear in a math problem or definition

7_2497.concept: 结构化专业文本中的符号与数值
7_2497.description: 主要响应晶体学报告中的符号化参数、数值与单位序列；另对法律判决及责任措辞、吸附研究术语和数学变量/幂式有激活。各领域触发形式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数表
patterns.context: 连续列出晶胞参数、辐射源、吸收系数、温度或晶体尺寸；数值、单位和符号交错出现
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的晶体结构/衍射实验报告

patterns.name: 衍射数据校正与统计
patterns.context: 描述多扫描吸收校正及测得/独立反射数量，伴随校正程序名和小数值
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的晶体学实验方法

patterns.name: 法律判决与责任条款
patterns.context: 法律文本中讨论简易判决、法院审查标准、责任范围或合同/侵权责任
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决书及 Github 中的法律免责声明文本

patterns.name: 吸附研究的定量结果
patterns.context: 说明吸附过程机理或等温线结果，并给出吸附容量及单位
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，材料/环境科学研究

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与幂
patterns.context: 变量、幂次和算术表达式出现在一道数学题或定义中

en.description: Strong responses are concentrated in structured information: crystallographic parameters and units, population or housing statistics tables, Polish parliamentary text and its word-ending segmentation, and contact details in business email signatures. The commonality is broad and cannot be assigned to a single topic.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameter tables and values
patterns.context: Tables or entries in crystal structure papers list groups of parameters, including unit-cell volume or chemical formula units, radiation source, absorption coefficient, temperature, and unit-cell dimensions; numbers and units are interspersed.
patterns.domain: Crystallography papers and structure determination data in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Polish word endings and segmentation
patterns.context: Polish sentences in which words are split into stems and endings; case, number, and gender inflections occur, as do line breaks or truncated words.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Polish parliamentary text concerning forest threats or policy statements

patterns.name: Demographic tables and percentages
patterns.context: A research paper first gives population or fertility statistics, then tables age groups, counts, and percentages; triggers are distributed across the prose and table fields.
patterns.domain: Population and social medicine research in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Population, households, and housing census figures
patterns.context: County profiles describe statistics such as population, numbers of households and housing units, and density per unit area; numbers use comma separators and are followed by units.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary speeches and dates
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech or record mentions the date of euro adoption, followed by a speaker's name and formal speech text.

patterns.name: Legal email signatures and contact details
patterns.context: Lawyer titles, company abbreviations, phone and fax numbers, and email addresses at the end of business emails.

7_2497.concept: 结构化数据与文档字段
7_2497.description: 强响应集中于结构化信息：晶体学参数与单位、人口或住房统计表，也出现波兰语议会文本及其词尾切分、商务邮件联系方式签名；共同点较宽泛，无法归为单一主题。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数表与数值
patterns.context: 晶体结构论文的表格或条目中，成组列出晶胞体积/化学式单位数、辐射源、吸收系数、温度、晶胞尺寸等参数；数字和单位交错出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central中的晶体学论文、结构测定数据

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾与分词
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，词被拆分成词干和词尾；出现格、数、性变化以及断行或截断的词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl波兰语议会文本，涉及森林威胁或政策表述

patterns.name: 人口统计表与百分比
patterns.context: 研究论文先给出人口或生育相关统计，再以表格列出年龄分组、人数及百分比；触发分散在正文和表格字段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central中的人口/社会医学研究

patterns.name: 人口、家庭与住房普查数值
patterns.context: 县域概况以人口、家庭、住房数量和单位面积密度等统计数据描述；数字使用逗号分组并附单位。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 波兰语议会发言与日期
patterns.context: 议会发言或记录提及采用欧元的日期，之后出现发言人名及正式演说语句。

patterns.name: 法律邮件签名与联系方式
patterns.context: 商务邮件结尾处的律师职衔、公司缩写、电话、传真和邮箱签名栏。

en.concept: Structured numbers and statements in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres: scientific numerical tables, legal arguments, demographics, theoretical equations, recipe instructions, and sequence algebra. There is no single stable semantic trigger; scientific data and equations show some clustering.

patterns.name: Numbers and units in scientific tables
patterns.context: Measurement data in tables or figure-caption formats in physics or materials science papers, often containing parentheses, superscripts, multiplication signs, and units

patterns.name: Argumentation in legal decisions
patterns.context: Discusses court jurisdiction, evidentiary standards, and legal inferences in cases or legal opinions

patterns.name: Census demographic statements
patterns.context: Introduces a location's population in an entry-like format and gives counts by gender

patterns.name: Equation derivation and theoretical description
patterns.context: Explains a physical system using equations, variables, or theoretical models

patterns.name: Cooking instructions in recipe steps
patterns.context: A recipe describes mixing ingredients and heating them in sequential steps

patterns.name: Numbers and algebraic expressions in sequence problems
patterns.context: A math question gives a sequence and asks for the jth term, followed by an algebraic expression

7_2497.concept: 异质文本中的结构化数值与陈述
7_2497.description: 激活跨多种文体：科学数值表、法律论证、人口统计、理论方程、食谱指令和数列代数。未见单一稳定语义触发；科学数据与方程略有聚集。

patterns.name: 科学表格中的数值与单位串
patterns.context: 物理或材料科学论文中，表格/图注式的测量数据，常含括号、上标、乘号和单位

patterns.name: 法律判决中的论证措辞
patterns.trigger: «Congress»3,« acting»3« within»2« its»6« constitutional»6« powers»10»；«substantial»1« evidence»4»；«fair»1-«minded»4« persons»7
patterns.context: 判例或法律意见中，讨论法院管辖、证据标准及法律推论

patterns.name: 人口普查统计陈述
patterns.context: 条目式介绍地点人口，并按性别列出人数

patterns.name: 方程推导与理论描述
patterns.context: 以方程、变量或理论模型说明物理系统

patterns.name: 食谱步骤中的烹饪指令
patterns.context: 食谱按步骤描述混合食材并加热

patterns.name: 数列题中的数字与代数式
patterns.context: 数学问答给出数列并要求求第 j 项，随后呈现代数表达式

en.concept: Numbers and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations span multiple genres: census demographics, email contact lists, encyclopedia navigation categories, legal arguments, and crystallographic parameters and experimental values. Shared surface features include numbers, proper nouns, formatting markers, and structured text, but domains and specific trigger patterns vary considerably.

patterns.name: Census population and housing statistics
patterns.context: Census descriptions of a county or region; numbers often use thousands separators and refer to population and housing density per square mile

patterns.name: Pager numbers and contact information
patterns.context: Contact information in a table or directory format; the Pager label, line breaks, and numbers recur

patterns.name: Demographic survey percentages and education sections
patterns.context: A local or community entry describes religious or demographic survey results, then moves on to education

patterns.name: Navigation and category links at the end of an entry
patterns.context: References, external links, and category lists after the body of an entry; the passage also contains a link to station information

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and diffraction experiment values
patterns.context: Variables, units, asterisks or superscripts, and precise values appear together; unit-cell dimensions, reflection counts, radiation sources, absorption coefficients, or temperatures are present

patterns.name: Statutory interpretation in legal reasoning
patterns.context: A case citation discusses principles courts should follow when interpreting statutes, contrasting public policy with the statutory text

patterns.name: Court selection and congressional authority
patterns.context: Case citations and discussion of congressional constitutional authority and selection of a court for litigation

7_2497.concept: 结构化文本中的数值与标记
7_2497.description: 激活分布于多种文体：普查人口统计、邮件联系表、百科导航分类、法律论证，以及晶体学参数与实验数值。共同可见的表面特征是数字、专名、格式标记与结构化文本，但领域和具体触发模式差异明显。

patterns.name: 普查人口与住房统计
patterns.trigger: “were”后接分组数字及“people”“households”“families”“population density”“housing units”“average density”等
patterns.context: 县或地区的人口普查描述，数字常带千位逗号，并出现每平方英里及住房密度

patterns.name: 页码与传呼机联系方式
patterns.context: 表格或目录式的联系信息；重复出现 Pager 标签、换行和号码

patterns.name: 人口调查比例与教育章节
patterns.trigger: “individuals”“about”“%”“of the population”“did not answer the question”，以及“Education”标题
patterns.context: 地方或社区条目中描述宗教/人口调查结果，随后转入教育情况

patterns.name: 条目尾部导航与分类链接
patterns.context: 条目正文结束后的参考资料、外部链接和分类列表；段中还出现车站信息链接

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与衍射实验数值
patterns.trigger: “Å”、带不确定度的晶格参数数字、“V*”“a/b/c”“Cell parameters”“reflections”“θ”以及“Mo Kα radiation”“μ”“T”
patterns.context: 变量、单位、星号或上标与精密数值交错；出现晶胞尺寸、反射数、辐射源、吸收系数或温度

patterns.name: 法律论证中的法条解释
patterns.context: 判例引文中讨论法院解释成文法时应遵循的原则，并对照公共政策与法条原文

patterns.name: 法院选择与国会权限
patterns.trigger: “City of Rochester v. Bond”“Congress”“constitutional powers”“choose the court”
patterns.context: 判例引用及对国会宪法权限、诉讼法院选择的论述

en.concept: Numbers and function words in heterogeneous text fragments
en.description: Activation occurs in legal arguments and citations, as well as encyclopedia demographics, scientific table values, and author contribution statements. There is no clear shared semantics across passages; several highlights fall on numbers, common words, or word fragments.

patterns.name: Function words in legal arguments
patterns.context: These words occur in continuous legal reasoning, often involving courts, evidence, rulings, or statutory interpretation; no single stable word explains all high-activation positions.

patterns.name: Legal terms or compound-word fragments
patterns.context: Legal terms and their component fragments occur in legal discussion; activation falls on local fragments of words or phrases.

patterns.name: Demographic numbers and proportions
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in descriptions of regional population, transport modes, or religious statistics.

patterns.name: Numerical cells in tables
patterns.context: Densely arranged values, parenthesized values, and letter markers form table- or formula-like content; the meaning of specific values cannot be determined from the fragment.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper tables or numerical data (PubMed Central)

patterns.name: Initials and experimental actions in author contributions
patterns.context: Lists author initials and their research work under the heading “Author contributions”.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper author contribution statements (PubMed Central)

patterns.name: Bibliographic numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to court names, volume numbers, page numbers, years, or citation formats.

patterns.name: No clearly specific trigger in ordinary legal prose
patterns.context: Occurs in legal arguments or case descriptions, but the snippets alone do not establish that these words constitute a stable trigger pattern.

7_2497.concept: 异质文本片段中的数字与功能词
7_2497.description: 激活见于法律论证与引文，也见于百科人口统计、科学表格数值和作者贡献声明。跨段没有明确共同语义；多处高亮落在数字、常见词或词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的功能词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在法律句子的连续论证中，常涉及法院、证据、判决或法条解释；没有一个稳定的单独词项解释所有高激活位置。

patterns.name: 法律术语或复合词片段
patterns.context: 法律术语及其组成片段处于法律论述语境；激活落在词语或短语的局部片段上。

patterns.name: 人口统计数字与比例
patterns.context: 数字嵌在地区人口、交通方式或宗教统计的叙述中。

patterns.name: 表格中的数值单元
patterns.context: 密集排列的数值、括号内数值及字母标记组成表格或公式样式内容；具体数值含义无法从片段确定。
patterns.domain: 科学论文表格或数值数据（PubMed Central）

patterns.name: 作者贡献中的姓名缩写与实验动作
patterns.context: 在“Author contributions”标题下列出作者缩写及其研究工作。
patterns.domain: 科学论文作者贡献声明（PubMed Central）

patterns.name: 法律引文中的书目数字
patterns.context: 数字与法院名称、卷号、页码、年份或引文格式相邻。

patterns.name: 普通法律叙述中无明显专属触发项
patterns.context: 出现于法律论证或判例叙述，但仅凭所示片段无法确认这些词本身构成稳定触发模式。

en.description: Responds to numbers and their grouping in formatted text, legal terms and citations, encyclopedia navigation headings, and mathematical variable expressions; it also covers demographics, scientific parameters, and legal arguments in different contexts.

patterns.name: Population statistics and counts
patterns.context: Activation occurs on numbers and number groupings in population, household, density, gender, or percentage statistics; passage [1] also has an isolated activation on the heading “Education”.

patterns.name: Legal arguments and statutory language
patterns.context: Legal opinions or decisions discuss evidentiary standards, statutory interpretation, application of legal rules, or elements of liability; citations, cases, and statutory terminology accompany them.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal decisions and legal discussion

patterns.name: Reference-style numbers and scientific parameters
patterns.context: Numbers occur in scientific experimental parameters, reflection measurements, publication years, or legal case citations; often adjacent to parentheses, commas, abbreviations, and number strings.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia navigation and category templates
patterns.context: Navigation, references, external links, and category labels at the end of an entry or at section boundaries; activation is concentrated on headings or template words.

patterns.name: Algebraic factorization and variable expressions
patterns.context: Variables, coefficients, powers, and parentheses form polynomials or factorization expressions in math problems.

patterns.name: Incomplete passage-opening fragment
patterns.context: A scientific sentence begins midway through a word, as if “absorption correction” were truncated; otherwise, activation mainly remains on numerical parameters.

7_2497.concept: 结构化文本中的关键片段
7_2497.description: 响应格式化文本中的数字及其分组、法律术语和引文，也响应百科导航标题、数学变量表达式；还覆盖人口统计、科学参数与法律论证等不同语境。

patterns.name: 统计人口与数量
patterns.context: 人口、家庭、密度、性别或百分比统计中，数字和数字分组受到激活；段[1]还出现单独激活的 “Education” 标题。
patterns.domain: 百科全书人口普查、地理条目

patterns.name: 法律论证与法条表述
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决中，论述证据标准、法条解释、法律规则适用或责任要件；伴有引文、判例和法条术语。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决与法律论述

patterns.name: 参考文献式数字与科学参数
patterns.context: 数字出现在科学实验参数、反射测量值、文献年份或法律判例引注中；常与括号、逗号、缩写及数字串相邻。

patterns.name: 百科条目导航与分类模板
patterns.context: 条目末尾或章节边界的导航、参考文献、外链和分类标签；激活集中在标题或模板词。

patterns.name: 代数因式分解与变量表达式
patterns.context: 数学题中变量、系数、幂次和括号组成的多项式或因式分解表达式。

patterns.name: 不完整的段首残片
patterns.context: 科学句子从词语中部开始，像是被截断的 “absorption correction”；除此之外主要激活仍落在数字参数上。

en.concept: Structured numbers and specialized text fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of structured text: legal decisions and citations, demographic numbers, email phone numbers, algebraic expressions, and crystallographic parameters. Numbers, punctuation, abbreviations, and compact table-like formats recur, but there is no single trigger pattern across fields.

patterns.name: Inference and evidence review in legal decisions
patterns.context: Legal language concerning whether factual findings are supported by substantial evidence, whether a ruling is clearly erroneous, or how a court reviews evidence; mostly case citations or standards of judicial review.

patterns.name: Statutory interpretation and its rules
patterns.context: Discusses the purpose of statutory interpretation, legislative intent, or standards of review by courts.

patterns.name: Dense numbers and abbreviations in case citations
patterns.context: Case citations in legal sentences contain state names, volume and page numbers, and reporter abbreviations, often alongside legal arguments.

patterns.name: Census demographic statements
patterns.context: Statistics such as population, households, housing units, or religious affiliation describe local populations and proportions.

patterns.name: Fragmented sequences of numbers and percentages
patterns.context: Statistical numbers and percentages consist of consecutive digits, punctuation, and percent signs; they accompany demographic content, but activation also falls on multi-digit numbers.

patterns.name: Phone numbers and pager labels in business emails
patterns.context: Email-style formatting places phone numbers with area codes and repeated pager markers beside contact or department labels.

patterns.name: Algebraic polynomials and factorization
patterns.context: Math exercises or computational text contain variables, polynomials, multiplication, and factorization, with a line break and the instruction «Find» nearby.

patterns.name: Values in crystallographic parameter tables
patterns.context: Table-like fragments list unit-cell parameters, diffraction reflection counts, and angle ranges, with values followed by units such as Å.

patterns.name: Self-defense in law and subjective belief
patterns.context: Discusses whether a defendant believed self-defense was necessary and whether that belief was reasonable, citing state court cases.

7_2497.concept: 结构化数字与专门文本片段
7_2497.description: 激活分布于多种结构化文本：法律判决及引证、人口统计数字、邮件电话号码、代数式和晶体学参数。数字、标点、缩写及紧凑表格样式反复出现，但缺少跨领域唯一触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的推断与证据审查
patterns.context: 围绕事实认定是否有实质证据支持、判决是否明显错误或法院如何审查证据的法律表述；多为判例引文或司法审查标准。

patterns.name: 法律条文解释及其规则
patterns.trigger: «When interpreting a statute»、«court’s goal»、«Legislature’s intent»；«Statutory construction»、«question of law»
patterns.context: 讨论法院解释法规的目的、立法意图或审查标准。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的密集数字与缩写
patterns.context: 法律句子中出现州名、卷页、报告集缩写等判例引证，常与法律论证并列。

patterns.name: 人口普查统计表述
patterns.context: 以人口、家庭、住房单位或宗教归属等统计数字描述地方人口及比例。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、人口普查资料

patterns.name: 数字与百分比的碎片化序列
patterns.context: 统计数字和百分比以连续数字、标点及百分号组成；与人口统计内容相伴，但激活也落在多位数字上。

patterns.name: 企业邮件中的电话号码与寻呼机标签
patterns.context: 邮件式排版中，联系人或部门标签旁出现带区号的电话号码及重复的寻呼机标记。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、通讯录样式文本

patterns.name: 代数多项式与因式分解
patterns.context: 数学练习或运算文本中出现变量、多项式、乘法和因式分解，附近有换行与指令 «Find»。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数表中的数值
patterns.context: 以表格式片段列出晶胞参数、衍射反射数及角度范围，数值带 Å 等单位。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文献、晶体学数据

patterns.name: 法律中的自卫抗辩与主观信念
patterns.context: 讨论被告是否相信自己需要自卫，以及该信念是否合理，并引用州法院判例。

en.description: Primarily responds to terminology in legal opinions concerning courts, evidence, statutory interpretation, and standards of review; it also activates on dense crystallographic parameter values, email telephone-number formats, and population counts and percentages.

patterns.name: Legal standards and legal reasoning
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in discussions of standards of review, evidentiary sufficiency, statutory interpretation, or appellate review, often alongside words such as court, evidence, statute, and judgment.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal opinions

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and precise numbers
patterns.context: Scientific papers contain dense structured numerical data, including measurements, uncertainty parentheses, units, symbols, and reflection counts.

patterns.name: Telephone number and extension formats
patterns.context: Numbers are arranged using area codes, parentheses, hyphens, and grouped digits, alongside Pager, department abbreviations, and line-break alignment.
patterns.domain: Enron internal email directories or signatures

patterns.name: Demographic proportions
patterns.context: Religious affiliation statistics list counts alongside percentages in parentheses to describe population proportions.

7_2497.concept: 结构化证据与数值陈述
7_2497.description: 主要响应法律意见书中法院、证据、法条解释与审查标准等术语；另对晶体学参数的密集数值、邮件电话号码格式及人口统计人数与百分比也有激活。

patterns.name: 法律判决标准与法律推理
patterns.trigger: “substantial evidence”“abuse of discretion”“court must”“manifest weight of the evidence”“legislative intent”
patterns.context: 触发词出现在法院审查标准、证据充分性、法条解释或上诉审查的论述中，常伴随 court、evidence、statute、judgment 等词。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与法律意见书

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与精密数字
patterns.context: 科学论文中密集出现测量值、误差括号、单位、符号及反射数量等结构化数值。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学/衍射数据

patterns.name: 电话号码与分机格式
patterns.context: 数字按区号、括号、连字符和分组数字排列，并伴随 Pager、部门缩写及换行对齐。
patterns.domain: Enron 内部邮件通讯录或签名档

patterns.name: 人口统计比例
patterns.trigger: “613 (or about 13.06% of the population)”和“174 individuals (or about 3.71% of the population)”
patterns.context: 宗教归属统计中，人数与括号内百分比并列，描述人口比例。

en.concept: Local patterns in legal contexts and number strings
en.description: Primarily responds to negation and limitation, judicial reasoning, legal terminology, and case citations in formal legal text; it also activates on number strings in scientific parameters and population or labor statistics. The relationship between number patterns and legal patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Negation and limitation in legal arguments
patterns.context: High activation falls on the negation not, commonly when a court explains that a particular interpretation, remedy, or form of review may not be adopted; modal constructions such as may not and will not also occur.

patterns.name: Legal inference and ruling language
patterns.context: Formal statements of judicial reasoning, evidence review, statutory interpretation, and decision standards; there is no single fixed trigger word, and the context often contains modal verbs, a court as subject, and legal judgments.

patterns.name: Salient vocabulary in legal terminology
patterns.context: Legal terms or fixed ruling language concerning sufficiency of evidence, statutory interpretation, and evidentiary weight; activation is distributed across multiple positions in the phrase.

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs near case citations, volume and page numbers, and years; it may also co-occur with negation in adjacent judicial text.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and number formats
patterns.context: Unit-cell parameters, reflection counts, angles, and decimal values in tables or structured experimental reports; activation is distributed around numbers, symbols, and units.

patterns.name: Percentage statistics
patterns.context: Activation occurs on portions of number strings and near percent signs in percentages or population counts; topics vary and no specific numerical meaning is required.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and Wikipedia population and labor statistics

7_2497.concept: 法律语境及数字串局部模式
7_2497.description: 主要响应正式法律文本中的否定限制、司法推理、法律术语与判例引文；另在科学参数和人口、劳动力统计的数字串中激活。数字模式与法律模式的联系不明确。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的否定与限制
patterns.trigger: «not»10« look»2« to»6；«will»7« not»9« grant»6；«may»7« not»9« disturb»7；«may»7« not»9« merely»7« substitute»5
patterns.context: 高激活落在否定词 not，常见于法院说明不得采取某种解释、救济或审查方式；也出现 may not、will not 等情态结构。

patterns.name: 法律推论与判决措辞
patterns.trigger: «reasonably»9« infer»10；«courts»7« need»5« only»9« give»6« effect»3；«court»4« must»7« assume»6；«jury»2« instructions»3
patterns.context: 司法推理、证据审查、法条解释及裁判标准的正式表述；没有单一固定触发词，语境中常出现情态动词、法院主体和法律判断。

patterns.name: 法律术语中的显著词汇
patterns.trigger: «substantial»2« evidence»5；«plain»3« and»4« unambiguous»4；«surplusage»2« or»2« nugatory»2；«manifest»1« weight»2« of»1« the»1« evidence»2
patterns.context: 法律术语或固定裁判表述，涉及证据充分性、法条解释及证据权重；激活分布在短语内多个位置。

patterns.name: 法律引文与案卷格式
patterns.context: 判例引文、卷页与年份等格式化信息附近出现激活；也可能与相邻司法文本的否定措辞共同出现。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数及数字格式
patterns.context: 表格或结构化实验报告中，晶胞参数、反射数、角度及带小数的数值；激活分散在数字、符号和单位周围。

patterns.name: 百分比统计数字
patterns.context: 百分比或人口数量等统计数据中，数字串的若干分段及百分号附近激活；主题各异，不要求特定数值含义。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要和 Wikipedia 人口、劳动力统计

en.concept: Statements of facts and standards in formal texts
en.description: Activations cover evidence review, statutory interpretation, and trial standards in legal opinions, as well as encyclopedia entries’ population and commuting statistics, medical dosage comparisons, and crystallographic parameter tables; the weak commonality is factual, standard-based, or numerical statements in formal genres.

patterns.name: Legal standards and evidentiary determinations
patterns.context: Discusses whether facts are supported by evidence and how courts review or infer facts; often includes words such as evidence, fact, court, and judgment
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal opinions

patterns.name: Court interpretation of statutory provisions
patterns.context: Explains that courts interpreting statutes should avoid making provisions surplusage or nugatory and should determine legislative intent
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal opinions

patterns.name: Judicial discretion and trial proceedings
patterns.context: Describes standards for appellate review of discretion, jury instructions, or whether a new trial should be granted
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal opinions

patterns.name: Quantitative statistics and census data
patterns.context: Lists census statistics such as regional population, households, housing, and counts by sex

patterns.name: Percentages and transportation/labor statistics
patterns.context: Reports the proportions of labor sources or commuting methods

patterns.name: Treatment dosage comparisons in medical research
patterns.context: Compares stimulation or medication dosages for patients and control donors and provides statistical values

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameter tables
patterns.context: Presents unit-cell parameters, reflection counts, and angular ranges in a table or data row

7_2497.concept: 正式文本中的事实与标准陈述
7_2497.description: 激活覆盖法律判决中的证据审查、法规解释与审判标准，也覆盖百科条目的人口及通勤统计、医学用量比较和晶体学参数表；共同点较弱，偏向正式文体中的事实、标准或数值陈述。

patterns.name: 法律标准与证据判断
patterns.trigger: “substantial evidence”“genuine issue of material fact”“manifest weight of the evidence”“reasonably infer”
patterns.context: 围绕事实是否有证据支持、法院如何审查或推断事实的论述；常出现 evidence、fact、court、judgment 等词

patterns.name: 法院解释法律条文
patterns.trigger: “court must assume that each word has some meaning”“construing a statute”“determine and give effect to the Legislature”
patterns.context: 说明法院解释法规时应避免使条文内容成为 surplusage 或 nugatory，并确定立法意图

patterns.name: 法院裁量与审判处理
patterns.trigger: “abuse of discretion”“jury instructions”“grant a new trial”“appellate court may not merely substitute”
patterns.context: 描述上诉法院审查裁量、陪审团指示或是否应重审的标准

patterns.name: 数量统计与人口普查
patterns.context: 列出地区人口、家庭、住房及性别人数等普查统计

patterns.name: 百分比与交通/劳动力统计
patterns.context: 报告劳动力来源或通勤方式的比例

patterns.name: 医学研究中的治疗用量比较
patterns.trigger: “patients with PCOS”“required significantly less gonadotropin”“used 367 fewer”
patterns.context: 比较患者与对照供者的刺激或药物用量，并给出统计数值

patterns.name: 晶体学参数表
patterns.context: 以表格或数据行给出晶胞参数、反射数及角度范围

en.concept: Women-related themes and highly distinctive subword fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across women-related themes, angiogenesis, lipogenesis, stock-market figures, and biomedical terms and proper-name subwords. Women-related themes span multiple segments, while the remaining triggers vary and are difficult to explain with a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Women-related research topics
patterns.context: Women appear as research subjects in a title or body text; [1]–[4] are medical/psychological titles, and [6] is a biographical entry

patterns.name: Angiogenesis terminology
patterns.context: Angiogenesis and lymphangiogenesis terms appear together in a corneal pathology study

patterns.name: De novo lipogenesis terminology
patterns.context: Mechanistic descriptions of impaired insulin extraction, hyperinsulinemia, and insulin resistance

patterns.name: Stock-index quote number format
patterns.context: Number strings with thousands separators, prices, and percentage changes in stock-index quotes

patterns.name: Proper-name token fragments
patterns.context: The proper name Phosfolan is split into multiple subwords; the name is repeated nearby

patterns.name: Embryogenesis terminology
patterns.context: Discussion of AhR’s role in normal or abnormal embryogenesis

7_2513.concept: 女性主题及高辨识度词片段
7_2513.description: 激活分散于女性主题、血管生成、脂质生成、股票行情数字及生物医学术语和专名子词；女性主题覆盖多段，但其余触发各异，难以用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 女性相关研究主题
patterns.context: 标题或正文中出现女性作为研究对象；[1]–[4]为医学/心理学标题，[6]为人物介绍

patterns.name: 血管生成术语
patterns.context: 角膜病理研究中并列出现血管生成与淋巴管生成术语

patterns.name: 新生脂质生成术语
patterns.context: 胰岛素提取受损与高胰岛素血症、胰岛素抵抗的机制描述中

patterns.name: 指数行情数字格式
patterns.context: 股票指数行情中带千位分隔符、价格及涨跌幅的数字串

patterns.name: 专名分词片段
patterns.context: 专名 Phosfolan 被切分成多个子词；附近重复出现该名称

patterns.name: 胚胎发生术语
patterns.context: 讨论 AhR 在正常或异常胚胎发生中的作用

en.description: Primarily responds to the word women across medical titles and biographies; also shows isolated responses to endings such as angiogenesis and lipogenesis, segmentation of Phosfolan, and financial quote formats. These cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: women
patterns.context: Appears as a research subject or group label in medical paper titles or biographical text; in segment 6, it occurs in the phrase “eleven women.”

patterns.name: Angiogenesis word ending
patterns.context: In a corneal pathology context, a complete angiogenesis-related word is tokenized, with activation concentrated on the ending of “angiogenesis.”

patterns.name: Lipogenesis word ending
patterns.context: Describes de novo lipogenesis in the liver, with activation on the end of the term.

patterns.name: Segment within a name
patterns.context: The proper name “Phosfolan” activates across multiple fragments due to token segmentation; the context is limited to Wikipedia article titles or openings.

patterns.name: Financial quote numbers
patterns.context: Stock tickers, percentages, prices, and similar items appear consecutively in a compact table/quote format.

patterns.name: Residual patterns
patterns.context: Abbreviations/numbers in a medical genetics title; «embry»«ogenesis»9 in an AhR reproductive toxicology abstract; other scattered activations are difficult to group under the patterns above.

7_2513.concept: 分词词尾与专名/格式触发
7_2513.description: 主要响应 women 一词，跨医学标题与人物传记；另对 angiogenesis、lipogenesis 等词尾、Phosfolan 分段及金融行情格式有孤立响应，不能由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: women
patterns.context: 作为研究对象或群体称谓出现于医学论文标题或人物传记文本；段6中出现在“eleven women”短语内。

patterns.name: 血管生成词尾
patterns.context: 眼角膜病理学语境中，完整的血管生成相关词被分词呈现，激活集中在“angiogenesis”末尾部分。

patterns.name: 脂质生成词尾
patterns.context: 描述肝脏中的 de novo lipogenesis，激活落在术语末尾。

patterns.name: 名称中的分段子串
patterns.context: 专名“Phosfolan”因 token 分段而在多个片段激活；上下文仅为 Wikipedia 条目标题或开头。

patterns.name: 金融行情数字
patterns.context: 股票代码、百分比、价格等以紧凑表格/行情格式连续出现。

patterns.name: 残余模式
patterns.trigger: 未见明确与其他模式相同的强触发子串；包括«D»、«ACT»、«1»等
patterns.context: 医学遗传学标题中的缩写/编号；AhR 生殖毒理学摘要中的«embry»«ogenesis»9；其余分散激活难以归为上述模式。

en.description: High activation falls on subwords or endings of terms from several fields: female research subjects, phosfolan, angiogenesis, excavators, hepatic lobes, lipogenesis, and embryogenesis; contexts differ substantially across segments.

patterns.name: Women in titles and as research subjects
patterns.context: Appears in paper titles or abstracts to refer to female research subjects; segment 7, however, is in a question-form title.

patterns.name: Subwords centered on phosfolan
patterns.context: The entry name appears on its own and is partially repeated on the next line.

patterns.name: Pathological angiogenesis term ending
patterns.context: In a histopathological description of corneal tissue, specifically refers to angiogenesis and lymphangiogenesis.

patterns.name: Excavator subword
patterns.context: An excavator is used as an example in a patent background section, with the subword repeated.

patterns.name: Hepatic lobe torsion phrase
patterns.context: In a veterinary case title, “hepatic lobe torsion” describes torsion of a hepatic lobe.

patterns.name: Lipogenesis term ending
patterns.context: Appears in “de novo lipogenesis” in a description of liver metabolism.

patterns.name: Embryogenesis term ending
patterns.context: Discusses the role of AhR in normal and abnormal embryogenesis.

7_2513.description: 高激活落在多个领域术语的词片或词尾上：女性研究对象、phosfolan、血管生成、挖掘机、肝叶、脂质生成、胚胎发生；各段上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 女性标题与研究对象
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题或摘要中，指研究对象为女性；但第7段是在标题问题句中

patterns.name: 以 phosfolan 为核心的词片
patterns.context: 词条名称独立出现并在下一行部分重复

patterns.name: 病理性血管生成术语尾部
patterns.context: 角膜组织病理描述中，具体指血管生成与淋巴管生成
patterns.domain: 生物医学专利或摘要文本

patterns.name: 挖掘机词片
patterns.context: 专利背景段以挖掘机为例，词片重复出现

patterns.name: 肝叶扭转短语
patterns.context: 兽医学病例标题中，“hepatic lobe torsion”描述肝叶扭转

patterns.name: 脂质生成术语尾部
patterns.context: 肝脏代谢描述中，出现在“de novo lipogenesis”一词内

patterns.name: 胚胎发生术语尾部
patterns.context: 讨论AhR在正常及异常胚胎发生中的作用

en.concept: Rare proper names and terminology fragments
en.description: Activations mainly fall on subword fragments of rare or structured strings, including proper names, technical terms, and legal citations. Plant names, medical terminology, legal identifiers, and patent terminology each show local patterns; there is also an isolated activation on the abstract adverb also.

patterns.name: Token fragments in botanical names
patterns.context: Activations cluster on consecutive subword fragments in botanical names, especially at the beginning of a name or within a genus name; fragments are followed by a newline, and some contexts repeat the name.

patterns.name: Terminology fragments in medical paper titles
patterns.context: In medical titles or abstracts, activations fall on the initial, stem, or internal fragments of technical terms; some terms are hyphenated or form title phrases with adjacent words.

patterns.name: Legal citation identifiers
patterns.context: Activations cluster on identifier fragments such as case citation volume numbers, court report abbreviations, and page numbers, followed by case names.

patterns.name: Excavator fragment in patent terminology
patterns.context: In patent background passages describing engineering machinery work units, activation occurs on an internal fragment of excavator and repeats when the word appears again.

patterns.name: Also in abstracts
patterns.context: The adverb also, between the sentence-initial subject We and completed, activates strongly on its own; there is insufficient evidence to connect it to the surrounding biochemical terminology.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts or research descriptions

7_2513.description: 激活主要落在专名、专业术语及法律引文等罕见或结构化字符串的子词片段；植物名称、医学术语、法律编号和专利词各有局部规律，另有摘要副词 also 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 植物学名的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在植物学名称中的连续子词片段，尤其是名称开头或属名内部；片段后接换行，部分上下文重复名称。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 植物条目或人名条目

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的术语片段
patterns.trigger: «Hep»atic« lobe»；« torsion»；« requirement»；« assessment»；« induced»...« hem»...«angi»...«ogenesis»
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中，激活落在专业术语的词首、词干或词内片段；有的术语带连字符或与相邻词构成标题短语。

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 激活集中在判例引文的卷号、法院报告缩写及页码等编号片段，后接案件姓名。

patterns.name: 专利术语中的 excavator 片段
patterns.context: 在描述工程机械工作单元的专利背景段落中，激活出现在 excavator 一词的词内片段，并在该词再次出现时重复。

patterns.name: 摘要中的 also
patterns.context: 句首主语 We 后、completed 前的副词 also 单独获得强激活；没有足够证据将其与周围生化术语联系起来。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要或研究描述

en.concept: Word-initial subword fragments and entry formatting
en.description: Activation often falls on word-initial fragments, especially Ophthalm-, Opioid, and several unrelated words; entry line breaks and repetition also occur. Text domains and semantics vary widely, and isolated case citation numbers are difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Word-initial subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the beginning of a word or its first subword after segmentation; the different words do not share a consistent semantic category.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including Wikipedia, PubMed, NIH ExPorter, and FreeLaw

patterns.name: Line breaks and repeated entries
patterns.context: An entry, name, or title is separated by a line break or repeated on adjacent lines; activation also covers fragments within partially repeated words.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries or similar title and entry formatting

patterns.name: Veterinary case titles
patterns.context: The title describes hepatic lobe torsion and explicitly lists dogs and cats as case subjects.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers
patterns.context: A number appears at the start of a case citation, followed by a volume or reporter format such as « F.2d ».

patterns.name: Genomic imprinting term
patterns.context: The term appears in a statement about a mammal-specific phenomenon.

patterns.name: Endometriosis-related term
patterns.context: The term appears in a title about pelvic endometriosis, followed by an introduction to related mechanisms.

patterns.name: Ophthalmic term
patterns.context: The word is used in an ophthalmology-related entry or description of disease manifestations; one instance has entry-style line breaks.

patterns.name: Opioid-related terms
patterns.context: One instance concerns the co-use of opioids and cannabis; another concerns opioid peptide responses to spinal cord stimulation.

patterns.name: Danon disease manifestation
patterns.context: Appears in a title describing the clinical manifestations of Danon disease.

7_2513.concept: 词首子词片段及条目格式
7_2513.description: 激活多落在词首片段，尤其是 Ophthalm-、Opioid 和若干无关词；另见条目换行与重复。文本领域和语义差异很大，孤立的判例数字难以解释。

patterns.name: 词首子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词的开头或拆分后的首个子词上；不同词语之间没有一致的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括 Wikipedia、PubMed、NIH ExPorter 和 FreeLaw

patterns.name: 换行及重复词条
patterns.trigger: «↵»；词条或姓名片段重复，如 «Ber»«yl» 和 «Ph»«os»«fol»«an»
patterns.context: 词条、姓名或标题被换行分隔，或在相邻行重复出现；激活也覆盖部分重复的词内片段。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 词条或类似标题、条目排版

patterns.name: 兽医病例标题
patterns.context: 标题描述肝叶扭转，并明确列出狗和猫等病例对象。
patterns.domain: 兽医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 数字出现在判例引文开头，后接卷册或报告集格式，如 « F.2d »。

patterns.name: 基因组印记术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在关于哺乳动物特异性现象的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 遗传学或生物医学说明文本

patterns.name: 内异症相关术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在盆腔子宫内膜异位症标题中，后文引出相关机制。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 眼科术语
patterns.context: 词语用于眼科相关词条或疾病表现描述；有一例词条样式的换行。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 词条和生物医学文本

patterns.name: 阿片相关术语
patterns.context: 一处涉及阿片与大麻共同使用，另一处涉及脊髓刺激的阿片肽反应。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: D​​anon 病表现
patterns.context: 出现在描述 Danon 病临床表现的标题中。

en.description: Primarily responds to technical terms and their token fragments in biomedical titles; there are also sporadic activations on scientific-name entries, email-title formatting, mathematical expressions, legal-document whitespace and court headings, and test-code structure.

patterns.name: Anatomy and disease paper titles
patterns.context: Anatomical structures, diseases, drugs, or pharmacological terms in medical or biomedical titles and abstracts; activation also falls on initial fragments split across tokens, such as «Ph».

patterns.name: Italicized scientific names and entry line breaks
patterns.context: Species names are split into multiple tokens and followed by a newline, resembling the beginning of an encyclopedia entry.

patterns.name: Email title and date formatting
patterns.context: An email or newsletter title is followed by a newline, padding whitespace, and a date.

patterns.name: Operators and numbers in arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Compact mathematical expressions composed of parentheses, division, multiplication, minus signs, and numbers.

patterns.name: Formatting whitespace and court headings in legal documents
patterns.context: Long whitespace, a newline, and a court-name heading follow an order date.

patterns.name: Test names and arrow functions in test code
patterns.context: A test framework call names a test with a descriptive string and uses an arrow function and code block.

7_2513.concept: 专业文本标题与结构线索
7_2513.description: 主要响应生物医学标题中的专业术语及其分词片段；另对学名条目、邮件标题排版、数学运算式、法律文书空白与法院抬头、测试代码结构有零星激活。

patterns.name: 解剖学与疾病论文标题
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学标题、摘要中的解剖结构、疾病、药物或药理学术语；激活也落在跨 token 切分的词首片段，如 «Ph»。

patterns.name: 斜体式学名与条目换行
patterns.context: 物种学名被拆成多个 token，后接换行，类似百科词条开头。

patterns.name: 邮件标题与日期排版
patterns.context: 邮件或新闻通讯的标题后接换行、空白填充和日期。

patterns.name: 算术表达式中的运算符与数字
patterns.context: 由括号、除法、乘法、负号和数字组成的紧凑数学表达式。

patterns.name: 法律文书的排版空白与法院抬头
patterns.context: 命令日期之后出现长空白、换行和法院名称抬头。

patterns.name: 测试代码中的测试名与箭头函数
patterns.context: 测试框架调用，以描述性字符串命名测试，并使用箭头函数和代码块。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different words and formats: went, stunningly, Matching, latching, as well as legal formatting, legal citations, and HTML tags/whitespace. No common semantics or stable word-form pattern spans all segments.

patterns.name: English past-tense went
patterns.context: Used as a predicate in ordinary English sentences describing a vehicle traveling and a person taking action; activation falls on went.

patterns.name: English adverb suffix -ly
patterns.context: An adjective takes -ly to form an adverb in a complimentary description of a person; activation is mainly on stunning.

patterns.name: Legal forms and column formatting
patterns.context: Multi-line directory or table-style column labels containing many line breaks and aligned whitespace.

patterns.name: Matching donation amount phrase
patterns.context: An uppercase word appears in a donation description next to an amount and Gift limit, describing a matching donation cap.

patterns.name: Legal heading or case citation formatting
patterns.context: Headings, court names, or case citations in legal documents, often with left indentation; trigger positions vary across segments.

patterns.name: HTML form markup and whitespace layout
patterns.context: Closing table tags and submit-button form HTML in webpage source, accompanied by formatted whitespace.

patterns.name: The word latching
patterns.context: A technical explanation describes a microcontroller emulating a latching shift register; activation clusters on a subword fragment of latching.

7_2513.description: 激活分散于不同词与格式：went、stunningly、Matching、latching，以及法律排版、法律引文和 HTML 标签/空白；未见能覆盖所有段的共同语义或稳定词形。

patterns.name: 英文过去式 went
patterns.context: 在普通英文句子中作谓语，分别描述车辆行驶和某人采取行动；激活落在 went 上。

patterns.name: 英文副词词尾 -ly
patterns.context: 形容词加 -ly 构成副词，出现在对人的赞美描述中；主要激活在 stunning。

patterns.name: 法律表格与栏目排版
patterns.context: 多行目录或表格样式的栏目标签，包含大量换行和对齐空白。

patterns.name: 匹配捐赠金额短语
patterns.context: 大写词出现在捐赠说明中，紧邻金额及 Gift limit，描述匹配捐赠额度。

patterns.name: 法律标题或判例引文排版
patterns.trigger: «S»及大量缩进空格；«United»及法院名称；«2017»、«IL»、«App»及引文编号
patterns.context: 法律文档中的标题、法院名称或判例引文，常伴随左侧缩进；各段触发位置不完全相同。

patterns.name: HTML 表单标记与空白布局
patterns.context: 网页源码中的闭合表格标签和提交按钮表单 HTML，伴随格式化空白。

patterns.name: latching 一词
patterns.context: 技术解释中描述微控制器模拟锁存移位寄存器；激活集中在 latching 的词片段。
patterns.domain: 电子与嵌入式编程问答

en.description: Activations are distributed across action words, questions, and forwarding formats in emails; narrative emotion or impact words; and tags, punctuation, and path components in Github XML/HTML documents. Although some local repetitions occur, there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: English internal fragments/suffixes
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments of words or abbreviations, often adjacent to email forwarding markers, path/file formats, or token boundaries in ordinary English words; the trigger is unstable

patterns.name: File, receipt, and submission actions
patterns.context: When asking whether someone has encountered a file problem, or requesting a receipt and preparing to submit reimbursement materials, activations appear on question and action words

patterns.name: Forwarded-email separator
patterns.context: A long dash separator and forwarding header appear after the email body; activation is concentrated on the separator and the stem of Forward

patterns.name: Words related to intensity or change
patterns.context: Narratives describe emotions, an impact lasting for a while, or a process of being quickly eliminated; trigger words are scattered in the sentence

patterns.name: XML tag and attribute punctuation
patterns.context: In structured XML/HTML fragments, activations occur around angle brackets, attribute-value boundaries, and tag names

patterns.name: Document navigation links and path components
patterns.context: Links/filenames in HTML document navigation lists, or example repository URLs split into components, activate multiple path separators and name fragments

patterns.name: Invitation or company question in conversation
patterns.context: The recipient is asked whether they would attend something together, with a question at the end of the sentence

patterns.name: Business requests and internal coordination in email
patterns.context: Mentions internal requests from the past few weeks and asks the recipient for feedback

patterns.name: Expense month and company bill
patterns.context: Discusses this year’s receipts and reimbursements and mentions a PrimeCo bill

patterns.name: Organizations that may benefit and moral emotions
patterns.context: Narrates guilt after donating to or helping an organization, as well as others’ reactions and the guilt subsiding

patterns.name: Extinction claims in research arguments
patterns.context: Discusses the context of an ecology paper using human-caused megafauna extinction as an argument

patterns.name: XML numeric attributes and line indentation
patterns.context: An XML fragment contains numeric attributes and newline indentation; activations cluster around attribute boundaries and nearby digits/punctuation

7_2513.concept: 混合格式与词片段特征
7_2513.description: 激活分布于邮件中的动作词、疑问与转发格式，叙事情绪或影响词，以及 Github XML/HTML 文档的标签、标点和路径组件。虽有若干局部重复，但没有单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段/后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在词或缩写的子词片段上，常与邮件转发标记、路径/文件格式或普通英语词的分词边界相邻；触发条件不稳定

patterns.name: 文件、收据与提交动作
patterns.context: 询问他人是否遇到文件问题，或索取收据并准备提交报销材料时，激活出现在疑问词及动作词上

patterns.name: 转发邮件分隔标记
patterns.context: 邮件正文后出现长横线分隔符及转发头；激活主要集中于分隔符和 Forward 的词干

patterns.name: 强烈程度或转变相关词
patterns.context: 叙述情绪、影响持续一段时间或被迅速消除的过程；触发词分散在句中
patterns.domain: 个人叙述/社会科学文章

patterns.name: XML 标签与属性标点
patterns.context: 结构化 XML/HTML 片段中，尖括号、属性值边界及标签名附近出现激活

patterns.name: 文档导航链接与路径组件
patterns.context: HTML 文档导航列表中的链接/文件名，或示例仓库地址按组件拆分时，多个路径分隔符和名称片段激活

patterns.name: 交谈中的邀约/同行询问
patterns.context: 向收件人询问是否一起参加某事，且句末为问句

patterns.name: 邮件业务请求与内部协调
patterns.context: 提及过去数周出现的内部请求，并要求对方反馈意见

patterns.name: 报销月份与公司账单
patterns.context: 讨论本年度收据及报销，提到 PrimeCo 账单

patterns.name: 可能受益的组织与道德情绪
patterns.context: 叙述捐助或帮助组织后的内疚感，以及他人反应和内疚消退

patterns.name: 研究论证中的灭绝表述
patterns.context: 讨论生态学论文将人类导致巨型动物灭绝作为论据的情境

patterns.name: XML 数值属性与行缩进
patterns.context: XML 片段含数值属性及换行缩进，激活集中在属性边界和数字/标点周围

en.description: The most salient pattern is hyphens in HTML link filenames, especially deprecated-list; hyphens also occur in separators and various compound words. Remaining activations are scattered across webpage copy, instructions, technical Q&A, and narrative language, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Hyphenated links in HTML navigation
patterns.context: In href paths in HTML navigation lists, a hyphen and the following word form a filename; activation also covers adjacent link markers such as Tree and Deprecated.

patterns.name: Other hyphens and compound words
patterns.context: Hyphens occur in email signature separators or within words, joining two parts; there is also a hyphen marker before «w»1«ache»1«ena»2.

patterns.name: Objects that were wiped/cleared
patterns.context: A narrative describes image-type information being cleared after editing; this occurs in only this segment, with the trigger on wiped.

patterns.name: User-information operation instructions
patterns.context: A series of imperative sentences instructs the reader to open a contact card, find a name, and add it; these verbs co-occur only in this set of instructions.

patterns.name: Intimate date-night promotional copy
patterns.context: Suggests watching a show at home, cuddling, and taking date night up a notch, in a light marketing tone.

patterns.name: Goals and year-ahead outlook phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses someone’s goals for the coming year and contrasts the new year with the previous one; includes the compound word do-over.

patterns.name: Personal retrospection and catching up
patterns.context: The author reflects on how their views changed over five years and says they did not specifically make up or catch up on related progress.

patterns.name: Software dispute request for help
patterns.context: The questioner says their application was copied or stolen and asks whether they can seek recourse from Apple.

patterns.name: IRS and financial Q&A page fragment
patterns.context: An email excerpt contains IRS, financial questions, and editing/Q&A prompts, mixed with webpage buttons and separators.

patterns.name: PHP debug output and image issue
patterns.context: A code dump shows errors and size fields, followed by a description of an editing operation clearing the image type.

7_2513.concept: 连字符及局部词语/标记
7_2513.description: 模式最显眼的是 HTML 链接文件名中的连字符，尤其 deprecated-list；连字符也出现在分隔线和多种复合词中。其余激活分散于网页文案、操作说明、技术问答及叙述用语，未显出统一语义。

patterns.name: HTML 导航中的连字符链接
patterns.context: HTML 导航列表的 href 路径中，连字符与后续单词构成文件名；激活还覆盖相邻的 Tree、Deprecated 等链接标记。

patterns.name: 其他连字符及复合词
patterns.context: 连字符出现在邮件签名分隔线或词内，将两个部分连接；另有 «w»1«ache»1«ena»2 前的连字符标记。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛帖子、个人叙述

patterns.name: 被抹除/清除的对象
patterns.context: 叙述编辑后图像类型信息被清除；只在这一段出现，触发点是 wiped。

patterns.name: 用户信息操作指令
patterns.context: 连续的祈使句指导打开通讯录卡片、查找并添加姓名；这些动词只在该操作说明中共同出现。

patterns.name: 亲密约会宣传语
patterns.context: 建议在家看剧、拥抱并升级约会之夜，语气轻松带有营销色彩。

patterns.name: 目标与年度展望表述
patterns.context: 谈论某人来年的目标，并把新一年与上一年区分；含复合词 do-over。

patterns.name: 个人回顾与追赶进度
patterns.context: 作者回顾五年来观点变化，并说明没有专门补做或追赶相关进度。

patterns.name: 软件纠纷求助
patterns.context: 提问者称自己的应用被抄袭或盗用，并询问是否能向 Apple 追索。

patterns.name: IRS 与财务问答页面片段
patterns.context: 邮件摘录包含 IRS、财务问题及编辑问答提示，混杂网页按钮与分隔符。

patterns.name: PHP 调试输出与图像问题
patterns.context: 代码转储显示错误和尺寸字段，随后描述编辑操作导致图像类型被清除。

en.description: Primarily activates in contexts where free means complimentary or a benefit, and also commonly in the email politeness formula feel free to; additionally involves contact information, email requests, and corporate outage notices. The French parliamentary fragment has no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Promotional or benefit-related use of free
patterns.context: Free means complimentary and appears in advertising, service descriptions, invitations, or event benefits; it is sometimes preceded by feel, forming a polite expression.
patterns.domain: Advertising copy, online services, business emails

patterns.name: Polite expression feel free
patterns.context: Emails invite recipients to get in touch, ask questions, or comment; activation may fall on feel, free, or the phrase as a whole.

patterns.name: Email contact information and instructions
patterns.context: Lists contacts or contact information, or tells recipients how to get in touch; free need not appear.

patterns.name: Suggestion or request phrasing in business emails
patterns.context: Politely asks recipients to review materials and provide feedback; feel free to also appears, but this pattern includes independent request phrasing.

patterns.name: Disaster and system outage notices
patterns.context: Reports outage duration or facility operating status, or explains access restrictions.

patterns.name: Legal documents and parliamentary report fragments
patterns.context: French parliamentary texts mention committees, reports, and document numbers; these are not obviously similar to the common email and free-related uses in the other samples.

7_2513.concept: 免费与礼貌性邮件措辞
7_2513.description: 主要对 free 表示免费或福利的语境激活，也常见于邮件礼貌套语 feel free to；另涉及联系信息、邮件请求及企业停机通知。议会法语片段缺乏明显共同触发点。

patterns.name: free 的促销或福利用法
patterns.context: free 表示免费，出现在广告、服务说明、邀请或活动福利中；有时前接 feel，构成礼貌表达。
patterns.domain: 广告文案、网络服务、商务邮件

patterns.name: feel free 礼貌表达
patterns.context: 邮件中邀请收件人联系、提问或评论；也可能激活到 feel、free 或短语整体。

patterns.name: 邮件联系信息与联系指引
patterns.context: 列出联系人或联系方式，或告诉收件人如何取得联系；不要求出现 free。

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的建议或请求措辞
patterns.context: 礼貌地要求收件人查看材料并提供意见；同时出现 feel free to，但此模式还包含独立请求用语。

patterns.name: 灾情与系统停机通知
patterns.context: 报告停机时间、设施运行状态，或说明访问权限限制。

patterns.name: 法定文件及议会报告片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中提及委员会、报告和文件编号；与其他样本的常见邮件及免费用法不明显相同。

en.concept: Salient word fragments and webpage calls to action
en.description: Activations cover various webpage promotions and calls to action, titles/proper names, and local word fragments in legal, film, forum, and political texts. There is no stable single semantic theme; activations often fall on formatting, proper names, or salient wording.

patterns.name: Statutory punctuation and citation boundaries
patterns.context: Legal texts contain full act names, abbreviations, citations, or identifiers; activations are scattered across punctuation and fragments of statutory strings
patterns.domain: U.S. legal rulings and statutory citations

patterns.name: Book titles and promotional headlines
patterns.context: Title words, promotional terms, or calls to action appear consecutively in book titles or advertising-style headlines
patterns.domain: Blogs, book recommendations, self-publishing marketing copy

patterns.name: Dogs in a proper name
patterns.context: Dogs appears in a proper name/quotation; the surrounding text describes a historical novel’s account of a sign in a Shanghai park

patterns.name: Film titles and title phrases
patterns.context: Title words are split into marked fragments in descriptions of film production, sequels, or works

patterns.name: Uppercase advertising words and financial terminology
patterns.context: Uppercase or split-spelled advertising slogans mixed with financial sales language about loans, eligibility, and sale-leasebacks

patterns.name: Forum abbreviations and navigation words
patterns.context: Explains how members can access something and directs users to forum sections or private messages
patterns.domain: Website help and community support copy

patterns.name: News-site calls to action and donations
patterns.context: Subscription, social-media links, and donation requests near a news site’s footer/navigation
patterns.domain: News website promotion and fundraising copy

patterns.name: Free cybersecurity report advertisement
patterns.context: After describing a data breach or stolen credentials, a free scan report is offered as a call to action

patterns.name: Accessibility-related wording in political argument
patterns.context: Discusses electoral systems and their freedom from fraud, discrimination, and partisan influence, emphasizing public accessibility

7_2513.concept: 醒目词片段与网页行动号召
7_2513.description: 激活覆盖多种网页宣传与行动号召、标题/专名，以及法律、电影、论坛和政治文本中的局部词片段；没有稳定的单一语义主题，常落在格式化、专名或醒目措辞上。

patterns.name: 法条标点与引文边界
patterns.trigger: «.»、«("»、«A»、«ED»、«PA»；法律缩写、年份与引文中被标记的标点或碎片
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现法案全称、缩写、引文或编号；激活分散在标点和法条字符串的片段上
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决及法条引注

patterns.name: 书名与宣传标题
patterns.context: 书名或广告式标题中，连续出现标题词、促销词或行动号召
patterns.domain: 博客、书籍推荐、自助出版营销文案

patterns.name: 专名中的 Dogs
patterns.context: 专名/引语中出现 Dogs；周边为历史小说对上海公园标牌的描述

patterns.name: 电影标题与片名词组
patterns.context: 电影制作、续集或作品名称的介绍中，标题词被拆分标记

patterns.name: 大写广告词与金融术语
patterns.context: 大写或拆分拼写的广告语，夹杂贷款、资格、售后回租等金融推销措辞
patterns.domain: 直邮/电话营销式汽车金融广告

patterns.name: 论坛缩写及导航词
patterns.context: 说明会员访问方式，并引导用户去论坛板块或私信
patterns.domain: 网站帮助与社区支持文案

patterns.name: 新闻网站行动号召与捐助
patterns.context: 新闻网站页脚/导航附近的订阅、社交连接及捐助请求
patterns.domain: 新闻网站宣传与募捐文案

patterns.name: 网络安全免费报告广告
patterns.context: 数据泄露或凭证被盗说明之后，以免费扫描报告作行动号召

patterns.name: 政治论述中的可及性词语
patterns.context: 讨论选举系统及其免受舞弊、歧视和党派影响，并强调公众可及性
patterns.domain: 政治评论/公共政策论述

en.concept: Lexical triggers: free and evaluative words
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to free/Free (meaning provided without charge or able to believe freely), especially in advertising contexts; also responds to evaluative titles using Good/Bad and to a methodological flaw in a poorly blinded study.

patterns.name: Free / provided without charge
patterns.context: In promotional or explanatory text emphasizing access to goods, services, content, downloads, or participation without payment; capitalization varies, and the word may appear alone or within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Advertising, marketing, website promotion, and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Good and good/bad evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates programmers’ quality or appears in the title-like phrase “Good Thing”; in the current sample, not all contexts with “Good” are related to being free.

patterns.name: Methodological flaw in blinding
patterns.context: In a medical methods description, notes that the study was not randomized and was inadequately blinded; the trigger is a negative evaluation of study quality.

7_2513.concept: 词汇触发：free 与评价词
7_2513.description: 主要对 free/Free（免费提供或可自由相信等表达）强烈响应，尤其广告宣传语境；另对 Good/Bad 评价性标题和 poorly blinded 的研究方法缺陷响应。

patterns.name: 免费/免费提供
patterns.context: 在强调无需付费即可获得商品、服务、内容、下载或参与机会的宣传或说明中；大小写不一，既可能独立出现，也可能处于句中。
patterns.domain: 广告、营销、网站宣传及一般说明

patterns.name: Good 与坏/好坏评价
patterns.trigger: «Bad»4 Program«mers»2« Are»4« Not»7« Good»10 Program«mers»6；«Good»9« Thing»5
patterns.context: 评价程序员质量，或出现在标题式短语“Good Thing”中；当前样本中并非所有“Good”语境都与免费相关。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、标题/媒体文案

patterns.name: 盲法研究质量缺陷
patterns.context: 医学研究方法描述中，指出研究未随机化且盲法不足；触发词是对研究质量的负面评价。

en.concept: Common English words and compound-word fragments
en.description: Activations cluster on words such as Good and free/Free, and also occur at compound boundaries in All-Girl and Multi-Tenancy, as well as in money-related discussions; these uses span titles, promotions, and forum discussions.

patterns.name: Good as an evaluative word
patterns.context: Appears in titles or title-like phrases; common expressions near Good include “Not Good,” “a Good Business,” and “Goodnight,” with inconsistent capitalization.
patterns.domain: Forum titles, article titles, film-title lists

patterns.name: Free-related expressions
patterns.context: Refers to free expression/beliefs, complimentary lodging, or free content; common in promotional or advocacy contexts.
patterns.domain: Social issues, hotel marketing, nonprofit media introductions

patterns.name: Component boundaries in compound words
patterns.context: The marker occurs in hyphenated compounds, respectively in a band name and a technical term; trigger positions are in the first part of the compound or at the hyphen.
patterns.domain: Music names, software and cloud security

patterns.name: Money and making a living
patterns.context: Discusses the situation of doing excellent work without making money and still needing to work.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions, programming and creative careers

7_2513.concept: 常见英文词及复合词片段
7_2513.description: 激活集中在 Good 和 free/Free 等词，也见于 All-Girl、Multi-Tenancy 的复合词边界，以及谈论赚钱的 money；这些用例横跨标题、宣传和论坛讨论。

patterns.name: Good 评价词
patterns.context: 出现在标题或标题式短语中；多为“Not Good”“a Good Business”“Goodnight”等邻近 Good 的表达，大小写不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 论坛标题、文章标题、电影片名列表

patterns.name: Free 相关表达
patterns.context: 指自由表达/信念、免费住宿或免费内容；常见于宣传或倡议语境。
patterns.domain: 社会议题、酒店营销、非营利媒体介绍

patterns.name: 复合词中的成分边界
patterns.context: 标记位于带连字符的复合表达中，分别是乐队名称和技术术语；触发位置在复合词前部或连字符处。
patterns.domain: 音乐名称、软件与云安全

patterns.name: 金钱与谋生
patterns.context: 讨论做出优秀作品却赚不到钱、还得工作的处境。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 讨论、编程与创作职业

en.concept: Good and several local word fragments
en.description: The strongest activation repeatedly falls on the complete word Good; additional local fragments such as Not and An occur in Notepad++, Not Work, Making An, and Make an. Prefix and suffix segmentation is inconsistent, and neither a single word meaning nor a grammatical pattern fully explains the activations.

patterns.name: The word Good
patterns.context: Good appears as a complete word; contexts include titles, evaluative sentences, and product names. It is often adjacent to a, but not every instance is the same.
patterns.domain: Mixed: titles, reviews, web text, product names

patterns.name: Within the name Notepad++
patterns.context: Not is the first part of the software name Notepad++; preceding text mentions opening a continuously updated log file in Windows.

patterns.name: Within the phrase Not Work
patterns.context: Not and Work form repeated phrases, “Not Work people / Not Work things,” referring to a home environment as opposed to work.

patterns.name: Title fragment Making An
patterns.context: Appears inside quotation marks in the title, followed by archtop guitar, forming the title Making An Archtop Guitar.

patterns.name: Imperative phrase Make an
patterns.context: Sentence-initial imperative followed by example, meaning to punish a few people as a warning to others.

7_2513.description: 最强激活反复落在完整单词 Good；另有 Notepad++、Not Work、Making An 和 Make an 中的 Not、An 等局部片段，且前后缀切分并不一致，无法由单一词义或语法模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 单词 Good
patterns.context: Good 作为完整单词出现；上下文包括标题、评价性句子及产品名。多处紧邻 a，但并非所有出现都相同。
patterns.domain: 混合：标题、评论、网页文本、产品名

patterns.name: Notepad++ 名称内部
patterns.context: Not 是软件名称 Notepad++ 的开头部分，前文提到在 Windows 中打开持续更新的日志文件。

patterns.name: Not Work 短语内部
patterns.context: Not 与 Work 连续构成重复的 Not Work people / Not Work things，表达与工作相对的家庭环境。

patterns.name: Making An 书名片段
patterns.context: 出现在书名引号内，后接 archtop guitar，构成书名 Making An Archtop Guitar。

patterns.name: Make an 命令短语
patterns.context: 句首祈使表达，后接 example，意为惩罚少数人以儆效尤。

en.description: Multiple segments activate near good/bad evaluative expressions, often in titles and forum comments; there are also scattered patterns involving technical operations, webpage copy, financial support, and political media texts. No single cue explains all segments.

patterns.name: good/bad evaluative phrases
patterns.context: Evaluates an object, choice, or idea; both “good” and “bad” occur and are often modified by a. Activation is especially on good/bad and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, comments, article body text and titles

patterns.name: Verb do/does and following content
patterns.context: Auxiliary/verb constructions in questions or suggestions; activation is weak, and the two instances use them differently.

patterns.name: Making money, earning a living, and skills
patterns.context: Discusses skills, money, or expressing support through purchasing; these words co-occur in only a few segments and may not have one fixed trigger word.

patterns.name: Action/interaction language in promotional or webpage copy
patterns.context: Explains steps, posts a comment, or uses salient uppercase words to encourage a purchase; the examples are superficially similar but differ in style and content.
patterns.domain: Software instructions, web forms, product discussions

patterns.name: Title capitalization and short title-like phrasing
patterns.context: A title or title-like text uses a phrase with prominent initial capitalization; it is unclear whether title formatting itself is a direct trigger.
patterns.domain: Link titles, forum post titles, magazine titles

patterns.name: Religious or independent-media fundraising phrasing
patterns.context: Involves media funding, political or religious groups; these segments do not show the same clear local word-form pattern as the other triggers.

7_2513.description: 多段在 good/bad 评价表达附近激活，常见于标题和论坛评论；另有技术操作、网页文案、金钱支持及政治媒体文本等零散模式，不能由单一线索解释全部段落。

patterns.name: good/bad 评价词组
patterns.trigger: “good” 后接名词或名词短语（如 “Good Thing”“Good Business”“good game”）；“bad” 后接名词或名词短语（如 “bad skill”“bad idea”“bad bet”）
patterns.context: 评价某个事物、选择或想法；“good”与“bad”都出现，且两者常由 a 修饰。激活尤其落在 good/bad 及其附近的词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论、文章正文及标题

patterns.name: 动词 do/does 与后续内容
patterns.trigger: “do”见于“you can ... and then ask it to”，以及“does”见于“What’s a Good Business for a College Student to Run?”
patterns.context: 疑问句或建议中的助动词/动词结构；触发较弱，且两处用法不同。

patterns.name: 赚钱、谋生与技能
patterns.trigger: “made money”“bad skill to learn”“supporting”“vote with your wallet”
patterns.context: 谈论技能、金钱或以购买行为表达支持；该组词只在少数段落共同出现，未必有单一固定触发词。

patterns.name: 宣传式或网页文案中的行动/互动用语
patterns.trigger: “print to a file”“Post Comment”“click the button”“BUY”
patterns.context: 说明操作步骤、发布评论或以醒目大写词号召购买；各处表面相似，但文体和内容不同。
patterns.domain: 软件使用说明、网页表单、商品讨论

patterns.name: 标题大小写与短标题式措辞
patterns.trigger: “Hard ware, OS Get New Names -- And That's a Good Thing”“Ask HN: What's a Good Business ...?”“How To Use Twitter and Not Be a Douchebag”
patterns.context: 标题或标题式文本，采用显著首字母大写的词组；无法确定标题格式本身是否是直接触发条件。
patterns.domain: 链接标题、论坛帖子标题、杂志标题

patterns.name: 宗教或独立媒体筹资表述
patterns.trigger: “a free and independent press is essential”“religiously conservative voters”“his political survival”
patterns.context: 涉及媒体资助、政治或宗教群体；这些段落未呈现与其他触发相同的明确局部词形模式。

en.description: Activation involves words such as good, fully, and free, as well as positive evaluative words; it includes titles, compounds, and expressions of degree or value in different domains, with no single stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: good and its use in titles
patterns.context: Appears in film titles, album titles, or sentences evaluating whether a game is good; activation falls on the beginning or within the word good.

patterns.name: fully + participle or adjective
patterns.context: Fully modifies representativeness, captured state, or degree of saturation; it may occur with the negation not.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent backgrounds, art descriptions

patterns.name: Expressions involving free
patterns.context: Free means free of charge/independent or is part of the compound free-wheeling.

patterns.name: Positive evaluation and the value of success
patterns.context: Describes success, value, or returns; segment 1 also includes contrasts such as miserable and hard, while segment 4 discusses the value of a degree.

7_2513.description: 激活涉及 good、fully、free 等词及正面评价词；包括标题、复合词和不同领域中的程度或价值表达，未见单一稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: good 及其标题用法
patterns.context: 出现在电影名、专辑名或评价游戏好坏的句子中；激活落在 good 的词首或词内

patterns.name: fully + 分词或形容词
patterns.context: fully 修饰代表性、捕获状态或饱和程度；可带否定 not
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利背景、艺术说明

patterns.name: free 相关表达
patterns.context: free 表示免费/独立，或作为 free-wheeling 复合词的一部分
patterns.domain: 新闻媒体介绍、专利背景

patterns.name: 正面评价与成功价值
patterns.context: 描述成功、价值或回报；第1段还出现 miserable、hard 等对照，第4段谈学位价值
patterns.domain: 建议性评论、演讲或回忆文字

en.description: Activations are concentrated on “a good + noun” and various make collocations; there are also responses to free in media descriptions, different uses of full, and several local lexical items. The feature spans domains and does not correspond to a single meaning.

patterns.name: “a good” evaluative phrase
patterns.context: In evaluative or advisory contexts, good is often preceded by a and followed by a noun or noun phrase; the object may be a game, thing, belief, or starting point.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news discussions, legal texts, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Expressions involving “make”
patterns.context: make appears in various collocations, followed by a noun, object complement, or fixed expression; the trigger is not limited to any particular meaning.

patterns.name: “free” and descriptions of public-interest media
patterns.context: free describes content or news media as free of charge, and occurs in connection with advertising, paywalls, costs, and reader support.
patterns.domain: News organization descriptions, media economics discussions

patterns.name: “full” and work titles
patterns.context: One instance describes the degree of effort put into a blog, while another is part of a movie title; the meanings differ by context.

patterns.name: Local activations not explained by the patterns above
patterns.context: These snippets do not consistently fit the phrase patterns above; they are more likely triggered by different local lexical items or collocations, and the available context is insufficient to group them into a unified pattern.
patterns.domain: Media descriptions, business discussions, forum reviews

7_2513.description: 激活主要集中于“a good + 名词”和多种 make 搭配；另对 free 媒体描述、full 的不同用法及若干局部词汇有响应，跨语域且并非单一语义。

patterns.name: “a good”评价短语
patterns.trigger: «a»…«good»，常接评价对象，如“a good game”“a Good Thing”“a good faith effort”“a good starting point”
patterns.context: 在评价或建议语境中，good 前常有 a，后接名词或名词短语；对象既可为游戏、事物，也可为信念或起点。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻讨论、法律文本、百科条目

patterns.name: “make”相关表达
patterns.trigger: «make»，包括“make blogging a full-time job”“make it by selling”“make this site a TC RSS feed”“Make an example”
patterns.context: make 出现在不同搭配中，后接名词、宾语补足语或固定表达；触发并不局限于某一特定含义。

patterns.name: “free”与公益媒体描述
patterns.trigger: «free»，以及“free and independent press”“free … our content is free”
patterns.context: free 描述内容或新闻媒体的免费属性，并与广告、付费墙、成本和读者支持相联系。
patterns.domain: 新闻机构介绍、媒体经济讨论

patterns.name: “full”与作品标题
patterns.trigger: «full»，见“a full-time job”和专名“Full Moon Murders”
patterns.context: 一次是博客工作投入程度的表达，一次是电影片名中的组成词；上下文含义不同。

patterns.name: 无法由上述模式解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些片段没有稳定落入上述短语模式；较可能是不同局部词汇或搭配触发，现有上下文不足以归为统一模式。
patterns.domain: 媒体介绍、商业讨论、论坛评论

en.description: Primarily responds to words evaluating quality, accuracy, adequacy, or experience, especially good/bad and good + noun constructions; it also covers value statements about free media, a blog versus full-time work, and character activation in a project title.

patterns.name: Evaluating the quality or effectiveness of something
patterns.context: In reviews, advice, or explanations, evaluates articles, games, organizations, events, work experiences, equipment, or opinions; sometimes appears in negative or contrasting constructions.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, blogs, sports reports, patent descriptions, life advice

patterns.name: “good + noun” and related evaluative constructions
patterns.context: Good modifies the object being evaluated; degree words or other elements may intervene, and it often occurs alongside or in contrast with evaluative words such as bad or not.

patterns.name: Degree expressions for quality, completeness, or adequacy
patterns.context: Evaluates whether something is sufficiently presented, its degree, or product tier; the trigger word may differ from the direct quality evaluations in the main pattern.
patterns.domain: Patent text, forum comments, sports commentary

patterns.name: Promotional value statements about inexpensive or free services
patterns.context: Describes free content from independent media, its funding, and social value; includes positive value judgments but is not a general product review.

patterns.name: Contrast between blogging effort and full-time work
patterns.context: Discusses the difficulty of personal blogging and states an intention not to turn blogging into a full-time job; differs from the common evaluative constructions in other segments.

patterns.name: Character activation in a software or product name
patterns.context: Appears in a Show HN project title, with activation within the name and title phrase; no clear evaluative semantics are evident.

7_2513.description: 主要响应对事物质量、准确性、充分性或体验的评价词，尤其是 good/bad 及 good+名词搭配；也覆盖免费媒体价值陈述、博客全职工作对比，以及一个项目标题中的名称字符激活。

patterns.name: 评价某事物的质量或效果
patterns.context: 在评论、建议或说明中，对文章、游戏、组织、活动、工作体验、设备或观点作评价；有时出现在否定或对比结构中。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、博客、体育报道、专利说明、生活建议

patterns.name: “good + 名词”及相关评价搭配
patterns.context: good 修饰被评价的对象；中间可有程度词或其他成分，且常与 bad、not 等评价词并列或对照。

patterns.name: 质量、完整度或充分性的程度表达
patterns.context: 评价呈现是否充分、程度高低或产品档次，触发词可能与主模式中的直接质量评价不同。
patterns.domain: 专利文本、论坛评论、体育评论

patterns.name: 价廉或免费服务的宣传性价值陈述
patterns.context: 介绍独立媒体的免费内容、资金来源及社会价值；含正向价值判断，但不属于一般产品评论。

patterns.name: 博客投入与全职工作的对比
patterns.context: 谈个人写博客的困难，并说明不打算把博客变成全职工作；与其他段落的常见质量评价搭配不同。

patterns.name: 软件或产品名称中的字符激活
patterns.context: 出现在 Show HN 项目标题，激活落在名称及标题短语内部；未见明确评价语义。

en.description: Multiple passages evaluate the quality of things, services, designs, articles, or outcomes, commonly using good, bad, and not bad, often with make; other topics include full-time, work competence, free media, investment returns, and blogging.

patterns.name: Evaluating the quality of things
