patterns.context: When reviewing, comparing, or judging something, a service, article, design, or outcome; not bad sometimes conveys a positive evaluation.
patterns.domain: Blog reviews, Hacker News discussions, web content

patterns.name: make with evaluations or outcomes
patterns.context: make/making is followed by an object of evaluation, an outcome, or something being made; evaluative collocations are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: Online reviews, discussions, and blog posts

patterns.name: Expressions involving full and full-time
patterns.context: full occurs with a hyphenated compound or a feature description.
patterns.domain: Personal blogs and website design reviews

patterns.name: Evaluations of work performance and competence
patterns.context: Criticizing professionals who hold a title but cannot do the job.

patterns.name: Funding and value of free, independent media
patterns.context: Describing how a nonprofit news organization relies on reader support, has no advertising, and offers free content.

patterns.name: Evaluating amounts and investment returns
patterns.context: Comparing an investment amount with its potential value and assessing the returns.

patterns.name: Personal blogging and time commitment
patterns.context: The author says they do not intend to turn the blog into a full-time job; the preceding text mentions editing photos, organizing ideas, and time constraints.

7_2513.description: 多段对事物、服务、设计、文章或结果作好坏与质量评价，常见 good、bad、not bad，并常与 make 搭配；另涉及 full-time、工作能力、免费媒体、投资回报及博客写作。

patterns.name: 评价事物的好坏或质量
patterns.trigger: “good”与“bad”及其修饰语，如 “a good game bad, not gonna”“a good full-featured site design”“bad enough”“good starting point”“Not bad”
patterns.context: 在评论、比较或判断某物、服务、文章、设计或结果时；有时以“not bad”表达正面评价
patterns.domain: 博客评论、Hacker News 讨论、网页内容

patterns.name: make 与评价或结果搭配
patterns.trigger: “make a good”[2]、“make this site a TC RSS feed”[5]、“make a good starting point”[9]、“making banners”[10]
patterns.context: make/making 后接评价对象、结果或制作对象；评价类搭配尤为明显
patterns.domain: 在线评论、讨论与博客文字

patterns.name: full 及 full-time 相关表达
patterns.trigger: “a full-time job”[1]、“a good full-featured site design”[6]
patterns.context: full 与连字符复合词或 feature 描述共同出现
patterns.domain: 个人博客与网站设计评论

patterns.name: 工作表现与能力评价
patterns.context: 批评专业人士虽有头衔却不能胜任工作

patterns.name: 免费与独立媒体的资金及价值
patterns.context: 说明非营利新闻机构依靠读者支持、无广告且内容免费的处境
patterns.domain: 新闻机构介绍、倡议性文字

patterns.name: 数额与投资回报的评价
patterns.context: 以投资额和可能价值作对比，并评价收益

patterns.name: 个人博客写作与时间投入
patterns.context: 作者说明不打算把博客变成全职工作，前文提到编辑照片、组织想法和时间困难

en.description: Activation is distributed across many text types: evaluative degree adverbs and adjectives, negative criticism, and forum-norm wording are prominent; web code/forms, media descriptions, music reviews, and group decision-making also occur. Overall, this does not resemble a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Degree adverb and adjective combinations
patterns.context: Modifies evaluative adjectives or participles to express degree, quality, or evaluation; strong activation often falls on the adjective or adverb.
patterns.domain: General narrative, commentary, and argumentative prose

patterns.name: Evaluative expressions and negative criticism
patterns.context: Describes people’s abilities, the quality of things, or social evaluations, often with a negative judgment; activation occurs near evaluative words.

patterns.name: Functional word strings in web pages and interfaces
patterns.context: In web code or form interfaces, involves operations such as creating elements, scripts, or submitting comments.

patterns.name: Negative or corrective forum wording
patterns.context: Opposes, discourages, or points out flaws, commonly in discussion, advice, or criticism.

patterns.name: Free-media funding statements
patterns.context: Explains that media without ads or a paywall rely on reader support, while emphasizing costs and public value.
patterns.domain: News organization statements, fundraising, or organization descriptions

patterns.name: Descriptions of music and drug effects
patterns.context: Describes the energizing effect of music or acid house on sleepy people, and includes a quotation.

patterns.name: Arguments about group decision-making and cohesion
patterns.context: Discusses members following collective decisions despite disagreement and avoiding groupthink.

patterns.name: Criticism of news reposting on the web
patterns.context: Criticizes forum users for repeatedly reposting news and turning a website into an aggregator of news sources.

patterns.name: Game review after a comment form
patterns.context: A colloquial game review follows a website comment form.
patterns.domain: Mixed website interface and game discussion text

patterns.name: Code initialization after legal copyright text
patterns.context: JavaScript data-grid initialization code immediately follows copyright or license text.
patterns.domain: Software source code and license headers

7_2513.description: 激活分布于多类文本：评价性程度副词与形容词、否定批评及论坛规范措辞较突出；另见网页代码/表单、媒体说明、音乐评论和群体决策等。整体不像单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 程度副词与形容词搭配
patterns.context: 修饰评价性形容词或分词，表达程度、质量或评价；强激活常落在形容词或副词上。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、评论及论证文体

patterns.name: 评价性表达与否定批评
patterns.trigger: «incapable»4 of« doing»3 a« job»3« well»9；«awful»4；«No»4 one…« thought« poorly»9
patterns.context: 描述人的能力、事物质量或社会评价，常含负面判断；评价词附近激活。
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛讨论、一般论述

patterns.name: 网页与界面中的功能性词串
patterns.context: 网页代码或表单界面中，涉及创建元素、脚本或提交评论等操作。

patterns.name: 否定或纠正性论坛措辞
patterns.trigger: «Please»1« don»2«'t»2« make»6 this« site»4 a« TC RSS» feed；«No»4 one…；«not»3
patterns.context: 反对、制止或指出缺点，常见于讨论、建议或批评语境。

patterns.name: 独立媒体的免费与资金说明
patterns.context: 说明无广告、无付费墙的媒体依赖读者支持，同时强调成本及公共价值。
patterns.domain: 新闻机构声明、募款或机构介绍

patterns.name: 音乐与药物效果的描述
patterns.context: 描述音乐或酸屋音乐对困倦者的提神效果，并带有引语。

patterns.name: 群体决策与凝聚力论述
patterns.trigger: commit to the decision of the group for« cohes»1ion and productivity；prevent groupthink
patterns.context: 讨论成员即使不同意仍遵从集体决定，以及避免群体迷思。
patterns.domain: 组织协作、社会心理讨论

patterns.name: 网页新闻转载的批评
patterns.trigger: «regurg»itation»1 of the original news source；« TC RSS» feed
patterns.context: 批评论坛用户重复转载新闻、把网站变成新闻源聚合。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 社群规范讨论

patterns.name: 评论表单后的游戏评价
patterns.context: 网页评论表单之后接一段关于游戏评价的口语评论。
patterns.domain: 网站界面与游戏讨论混合文本

patterns.name: 法律版权文本后的代码初始化
patterns.trigger: OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE…«createElement»1
patterns.context: 版权或许可证文本结束后紧接 JavaScript 数据网格初始化代码。
patterns.domain: 软件源码及许可证头部

en.description: Activations are scattered across expressions of degree, quantity, and evaluation, especially modifiers before adjectives or nouns; they also include negation and make constructions. A code string literal is not explained by these semantic patterns.

patterns.name: Evaluations formed with degree adverbs and adjectives
patterns.context: When evaluating people, products, works, or things, a degree word modifies an adjective or noun; also includes evaluative words with negative prefixes.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, reviews of works, and general narrative

patterns.name: Expressions of quantity or degree
patterns.context: In expressions of quantity, degree, or scale, activation falls on words that qualify the degree; sometimes they emphasize insufficiency or limitation.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, weather small talk, car prices, and reviews of works

patterns.name: Responses to make constructions and their evaluative outcomes
patterns.context: make is followed by an evaluative outcome or nominal complement; one example is a commenter’s request concerning website content.

patterns.name: Expressions of negation and opposition
patterns.context: Negation words, negative prefixes, or negative contractions occur in statements about judgment, affordability, or behavior.

patterns.name: String literal in code
patterns.context: A JavaScript call to createElement takes a quoted HTML tag name as its argument.

patterns.name: Comment wording after a form instruction
patterns.context: A debate about whether a game is good or bad follows a webpage comment-form prompt; the specific activation may result from common function words combined with evaluative collocations.

patterns.name: Descriptions of community cloning behavior
patterns.context: Discussing the tendency of open-source communities to copy successful products, with activation on degree words and near the end of the argument.

7_2513.description: 激活分散在程度、数量及评价表达中，尤见于形容词或名词前的限定词，也包括否定形式和 make 结构；另有代码字符串字面量无法由这些语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 程度副词与形容词构成的评价
patterns.context: 评价人物、产品、作品或事物时，程度词修饰形容词或名词；也包括带否定前缀的评价词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、作品评论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 数量或程度表达
patterns.context: 数量、程度或规模表达中，激活落在限定程度的词上；有时强调不足或有限。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、天气闲谈、汽车价格与作品评论

patterns.name: 对 make 结构及其评价结果的响应
patterns.context: make 后接评价性结果或名词补语；一个例子是评论者对网站内容的请求。
patterns.domain: 评论区对话、HackerNews 社区讨论

patterns.name: 否定与反对表达
patterns.context: 否定词、否定前缀或否定缩写出现在判断、可负担性或行为表述中。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串字面量
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中调用 createElement，参数是带引号的 HTML 标签名。

patterns.name: 表单指令后的评论措辞
patterns.context: 网页评论表单提示之后紧接着一段对游戏好坏的争论；具体激活或由常见功能词与评价搭配共同造成。

patterns.name: 社区克隆行为的描述
patterns.context: 讨论开源社区复制成功产品的倾向，激活落在程度词及论述结尾附近。

en.description: The main pattern is full in hyphenated compounds (full-featured, full-time, full-blown); there is also the hyphen in no-no and several scattered within-word substrings and article activations. Semantics and style are not uniform.

patterns.name: full compounds
patterns.context: Full is followed by a hyphenated compound describing completeness, full-time status, or fully built form; activation concentrates on full and the adjacent hyphen.
patterns.domain: Technology reviews, personal blogs, software discussions, music descriptions

patterns.name: Hyphen in no-no
patterns.context: When repeating “absolutely not,” the hyphen falls between the repeated no forms and receives the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Email conversations and discussions of word usage

patterns.name: Emphatic words in product and opinion reviews
patterns.context: In review or debate contexts, describes degree, evaluation, or position; however, trigger locations vary, so a stable shared part-of-speech pattern cannot be established.

patterns.name: Criticism of web news/RSS content
patterns.context: In a context criticizing a website for turning into a news source, activation is concentrated on the article a; nearby words also include make and site.

patterns.name: A in news headlines or promotional copy
patterns.context: The capitalized article A occurs at the beginning of a slogan-like, headline-style phrase.
patterns.domain: Public-interest news website promotion / web copy

patterns.name: Other scattered high-activation words
patterns.context: Occur separately in discussions of anti-drug positions, conspiracy-style news commentary, and racial terminology; the triggering substrings differ and share no common contextual pattern.

7_2513.concept: 英文连字符及词内子串
7_2513.description: 主要规律是 full 出现在连字符复合表达中（full-featured、full-time、full-blown）；另有 no-no 连字符，以及若干分散的词内子串和冠词激活，语义与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: full 复合词
patterns.context: full 后接连字符复合词，描述完整、全职或完整构建的程度；激活集中在 full 及其邻近连字符处。
patterns.domain: 科技评论、个人博客、软件讨论、音乐介绍

patterns.name: no-no 的连字符
patterns.context: 重复表达“绝对不行”时，连字符夹在重复的 no 之间，激活最强。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的对话及用词讨论

patterns.name: 产品与观点评论中的强调词
patterns.context: 评论或争辩语境中，描述程度、评价或立场；但触发位置各异，无法确认是稳定的同一词类模式。

patterns.name: 网页新闻／RSS 内容批评
patterns.trigger: « make»5« this»2« site»4« a»9 TC RSS« feed»4
patterns.context: 批评网站将内容变成新闻源的语境；激活集中在冠词 a，周围也出现 make、site 等词。

patterns.name: 新闻标题或宣传文案中的 A
patterns.context: 大写冠词 A 位于宣传口号的标题式短语开头。
patterns.domain: 公益新闻网站宣传／网页文案

patterns.name: 其他零散高激活词
patterns.context: 分别出现在禁毒立场、阴谋论式新闻评论、种族称谓讨论中；触发子串互不相同，缺少共同上下文模式。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、博客评论、邮件

en.concept: “full” and collocations expressing degree or completeness
en.description: Most passages activate full/Full, especially in collocations such as full stop, full-featured, full blown, full TLS, full understanding, and full-service; there are also evaluative uses of good and to be tracked. The third passage contains words such as free but shows no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: full collocations and extensions
patterns.context: Appears in adjective phrases or fixed collocations, modifying degree, completeness, service scope, or extent of understanding; also includes the standalone label “Full article”.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, webpage descriptions, technical discussions, research abstracts, business descriptions, and webpage labels

patterns.name: Evaluative collocations with good
patterns.context: Appears in phrases evaluating or comparing the quality of things; passage 2 evaluates a game, and passage 4 evaluates website design.
patterns.domain: Online reviews and website design discussions

patterns.name: Local collocation in a to be infinitive
patterns.context: Appears in “want to be tracked”, constrained by the infinitive construction and passive-voice context.
patterns.domain: Forum comments about privacy and tracking

7_2513.concept: full 及程度、完整性搭配
7_2513.description: 多数段落激活 full/Full，尤其在 full stop、full-featured、full blown、full TLS、full understanding、full-service 等搭配中；另有 good 的评价用法及 to be tracked。第3段虽有 free 等词，但未见明显共同触发。

patterns.name: full 搭配及其扩展词
patterns.context: 在形容词短语或固定搭配中出现，修饰程度、完整性、服务范围或理解程度；也包括单独的 “Full article” 标签。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、网页描述、技术讨论、科研摘要、商业介绍及网页标签

patterns.name: 评价性 good 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在评价或比较事物质量的短语中；第2段对游戏评价，第4段评价网站设计。
patterns.domain: 网络评论与网站设计讨论

patterns.name: to be 不定式局部搭配
patterns.context: 出现在 “want to be tracked” 中，受不定式结构及被动语态上下文限定。
patterns.domain: 隐私与追踪相关的论坛评论

en.concept: English word formation and evaluative expressions
en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is the non- prefix and negative evaluative expressions; there are also repeated activations on full modifying nouns from different categories. Other activated words are scattered across positive/negative evaluation, degree, and descriptive contexts in forum, blog, business, technology, and adult-content styles, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Non-/not + word formations expressing negation or underestimation
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the non- prefix and the following word, or on evaluative expressions after the negation not; hyphens, token boundaries, or line breaks may intervene.
patterns.domain: Ordinary English in HackerNews discussions, blogs, Wikipedia, and business copy

patterns.name: full with following scale or service-category terms
patterns.context: Full modifies a compound or noun to mean complete, full-time, full-service, or full-length; affixes/hyphens may be marked separately.
patterns.domain: Product discussions, company profiles, blogs, and adult-content copy

patterns.name: Scattered evaluative or emphatic phrases
patterns.context: These evaluative words occur in their respective sentences, with no shared local syntactic or semantic trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, adult content, company profiles, blogs, and technical descriptions

7_2513.concept: 英语词语构成与评价表达
7_2513.description: 最明显的重复模式是 non- 前缀及否定评价表达；另有 full 修饰不同类别名词的多次激活。其余激活词分散在褒贬、程度及描述性语境中，跨论坛、博客、商业、技术和成人内容文体，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 非／不＋词语构成否定或低估性复合词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 non- 前缀及其后续词，或否定词 not 后的评价性表达；有时连字符、词语跨 token 或换行。
patterns.domain: HackerNews讨论、博客、维基百科与商业文案中的普通英语

patterns.name: full 与后续规模或服务类别词
patterns.context: full 修饰复合词或名词，表示完整、全职、全服务或完整长度；词缀/连字符可分开标记。
patterns.domain: 产品讨论、企业简介、博客及成人内容文案

patterns.name: 零散评价或强调词组
patterns.context: 上述评价性词语在各自句子中出现，未见共同的局部句法或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、成人内容、企业简介、博客和技术说明

en.concept: English compound words and collocational fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to full and its compounds and collocations; also responds to non- compounds and several hyphenated words. A few activations involve well borne out, the pornographic term Spanking, and PR headings Thought Leadership/Media Relations. These share sensitivity to internal compound structure or fixed collocations, but the evidence is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: full compounds and collocations
patterns.context: In adjectival or adverbial use, full forms common collocations or compounds with the following word; also includes full of. Forms with different capitalization, punctuation, and hyphenation occur.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: web application discussions, reviews, food and travel descriptions, personal blogs, pornographic webpages, and technical discussions

patterns.name: non- compounds
patterns.context: non- acts as a negative prefix and forms a compound with the following noun or proper name; in segment 6, non and starter are separated by a line break.
patterns.domain: Organizational publicity, critical commentary, software and web technology discussions

patterns.name: well with a past participle
patterns.context: well modifies the past participle borne in the fixed expression well borne out.

patterns.name: Pornographic use of spanking
patterns.context: Appears in pornographic video titles and adult-content keywords.

patterns.name: Spencerian “Thought Leadership”-type heading
patterns.context: Appears in award or publicity campaign category names.

patterns.name: Spencerian “Media Relations”-type heading
patterns.context: Appears in award or publicity campaign category names.

patterns.name: Hyphenated prefix before Asian
patterns.context: A hyphen connects Southern and Asian, forming a compound modifier for a food style.

patterns.name: time in a hyphenated collocation
patterns.context: time combines with the preceding full to form full-time; the marker falls on the hyphen and time in the compound.

7_2513.concept: 英语复合词与搭配片段
7_2513.description: 主要响应 full 及其复合词、搭配；另响应 non- 否定复合词和若干连字符词。少数激活涉及 well borne out、色情词 Spanking、公关标题 Thought Leadership/Media Relations。各类共享对词内复合结构或固定搭配的敏感性，但证据不完全一致。

patterns.name: full 复合词与搭配
patterns.context: 在形容词或副词性用法中，full 与后续词构成常见搭配或复合词；也包括 full of。不同大小写、标点和连字符形式均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：网页应用讨论、评论、餐饮和旅游介绍、个人博客、色情网页及技术讨论

patterns.name: non- 复合词
patterns.context: non- 作否定前缀，与后续名词或专名构成复合词；分段 6 中 non 与 starter 因换行分开。
patterns.domain: 机构宣传、评论性论述、软件与网页技术讨论

patterns.name: well 与过去分词搭配
patterns.context: well 修饰过去分词 borne，构成固定表达 well borne out。

patterns.name: spanking 色情用语
patterns.context: 出现在色情视频标题和成人内容关键词中。

patterns.name: Spencerian「Thought Leadership」类标题词
patterns.context: 出现在奖项或宣传活动类别名称中。

patterns.name: Spencerian「Media Relations」类标题词
patterns.context: 出现在奖项或宣传活动类别名称中。

patterns.name: 带连字符的 Asian 前词尾
patterns.context: 连字符连接 Southern 与 Asian，形成饮食风格复合修饰语。

patterns.name: 搭配中的连字符 time
patterns.context: time 与前面的 full 构成 full-time；标记落在复合词的连字符及 time 上。

en.description: Activations often occur near degree or state adverbs such as well, fully, and poorly, especially when they modify following words. However, many scattered evaluative words and function words also activate, which cannot be explained by a single collocation.

patterns.name: Highlighted words near well
patterns.context: When well appears in a sentence, activation falls on well itself. It is often followed by participles or adjectives such as established and borne out, forming well + word collocations, but the following content is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Business discourse, online reviews, scientific papers

patterns.name: Highlighted words near fully
patterns.context: Fully modifies a following word, with activation on fully. It is followed by hyphenated compounds, length-related words, or participation-related words, across varied meanings and sentence types.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, adult websites, public advocacy

patterns.name: Evaluative or cognitive states after poorly
patterns.context: Poorly modifies a following word to express inadequate preparation, poor condition, or insufficient definition; one passage also contains not well understood.

patterns.name: Other activations on evaluative or degree words
patterns.context: These occur in isolated evaluative or descriptive expressions, with no shared stable collocation or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Business reviews, forum discussions, adult websites, policy research

patterns.name: Highlighted short function words and common words
patterns.context: These occur in negation, copular constructions, or ordinary narration; the distribution is sporadic, with no apparent shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Business discourse, reviews, scientific and medical texts

7_2513.description: 激活较常见于 well、fully、poorly 等程度或状态副词附近，尤其修饰后续词语时；但也有大量分散的评价词和虚词激活，无法由单一搭配解释。

patterns.name: well 附近的高亮词
patterns.context: 句中出现 well 后，激活落在 well 本身；其后常接 established、borne out 等分词或形容词，形成 well + 词语的搭配，但后接内容并不固定。
patterns.domain: 商业论述、网络评论、科学论文

patterns.name: fully 附近的高亮词
patterns.context: fully 修饰后续词语，激活落在 fully；后接连字符复合形式、长度词或参与类词语，语义和句型各异。
patterns.domain: 市场宣传、色情网页、公共倡议

patterns.name: poorly 后接评价或认知状态
patterns.context: poorly 修饰后续词语，表达准备不足、状况不佳或定义不足；有一段同时含 not well understood。
patterns.domain: 政策研究、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 评价性或程度性词语的其他激活
patterns.context: 孤立出现于评价或描述性表达中，没有共享的稳定搭配或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 商业评论、论坛对话、色情网页、政策研究

patterns.name: 高亮的短虚词与常见词
patterns.context: 出现在否定、系词结构或普通叙述中；分布零散，暂看不出共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 商业论述、评论、科学与医学文本

en.description: Primarily responds to local phrases such as poorly understood, fully + state word, well borne out, and make a/an; it also activates on non- compounds and scattered function words and affix fragments, across biomedical, business, and online text.

patterns.name: poorly understood collocation
patterns.context: poorly immediately precedes understood, describing mechanisms, associations, or causal relationships that have not been adequately explained.

patterns.name: fully modifying completion or degree
patterns.context: fully precedes words indicating the degree of market development or business integration; tokenization may split the same word across tokens.

patterns.name: make an
patterns.context: make is followed by an, forming a fragment of an imperative suggesting that someone listen to a podcast.

patterns.name: well borne out
patterns.context: well modifies borne out, appearing in an assessment of whether someone else’s view is supported by facts.

patterns.name: make a good
patterns.context: make a good is followed by an object of evaluation, expressing that certain criticisms are insufficient to constitute a particular judgment.
patterns.domain: Web comment form and user comments

patterns.name: non- compounds
patterns.context: The non- prefix combines with the following word to form a negative or non-category compound; activation is concentrated near the split prefix and stem.

patterns.name: Scattered high-frequency function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Besides the clearer local collocations above, several high activations fall on common adverbs, articles, negation, or affix fragments; their semantic and syntactic conditions differ, making them difficult to combine into a single trigger.
patterns.domain: News comments, business copy, forums, and email

7_2513.description: 主要响应 poorly understood、fully+状态词、well borne out、make a/an 等局部词组；也对 non-复合词及分散的功能词、词缀片段有激活，语域跨生医、商业和网络文本。

patterns.name: poorly understood 搭配
patterns.context: poorly 紧接 understood，描述机制、相关性或因果关系尚未得到充分解释。

patterns.name: fully 修饰完成或程度
patterns.context: fully 后接表示市场发展程度或业务整合状态的词；分词标记可能把同一个词拆开。

patterns.name: make an
patterns.context: make 后接 an，构成建议听播客的祈使句片段。

patterns.name: well borne out
patterns.context: well 修饰 borne out，出现在对他人观点是否得到事实支持的判断中。

patterns.name: make a good
patterns.context: make a good 后接评价对象，表达某些批评不足以构成某种判断。
patterns.domain: 网页评论表单及用户评论

patterns.name: non-复合词
patterns.context: non- 前缀与后续词拼成否定或非某类的复合词；激活集中在被拆分的前缀及词干附近。

patterns.name: 分散的高频功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 除以上较明确的局部搭配外，若干高激活落在常见副词、冠词、否定或词缀片段上；各处语义与句法条件不同，难以合并为单一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、商业文案、论坛及邮件

en.description: Activations often fall on degree adverbs or modifiers: emphasizing severe problems or insufficient knowledge, as well as adequate documentation, established status, extensive experience, or organizational integration. Also observed: non-article and fine event.

patterns.name: Strong degree adverbs modifying negative evaluations or cognitive states
patterns.context: A degree adverb immediately precedes an adjective or past participle, expressing a severe problem, insufficient knowledge, or an urgent need.

patterns.name: well modifying positive attributes
patterns.context: Well functions as a degree adverb modifying documented or established, indicating sufficient evidence or stability.

patterns.name: Highly experienced
patterns.context: Highly immediately precedes experienced to describe a research team’s credentials.

patterns.name: Fully modifying organizational integration
patterns.context: Fully immediately precedes integrated to describe the business organization of a pharmaceutical company.

patterns.name: Classification label with non-
patterns.context: Non- combines with article to form a negative classification term, commenting that an article is not a real article.

patterns.name: Fine modifying an activity or event
patterns.context: Fine immediately precedes event as a positive evaluation praising an event.

7_2513.description: 激活常落在程度副词或修饰语上：强调问题严重/知识不足，也强调记录充分、地位稳固、经验丰富或组织整合；另见 non-article 与 fine event。

patterns.name: 强程度副词修饰负向评价或认知状态
patterns.context: 程度副词紧邻形容词或过去分词，表达问题严重、知识不足或需求迫切。

patterns.name: well 修饰正向属性
patterns.context: well 作程度副词，修饰 documented 或 established，表示证据充分或稳固。

patterns.name: 高度经验丰富
patterns.context: highly 紧邻 experienced，描述研究团队资历。

patterns.name: fully 修饰组织整合状态
patterns.context: fully 紧邻 integrated，描述制药企业的业务组织状态。
patterns.domain: 企业介绍、医药行业文案

patterns.name: 非文章的分类标签
patterns.context: non- 与 article 组成否定分类词，评论某篇文章不算真正的文章。

patterns.name: fine 修饰活动或事件
patterns.context: fine 紧邻 event，作正面评价，称赞赛事活动。

en.description: Primarily responds to the prefix non and compounds formed with it, as well as expressions in research texts indicating insufficient understanding, definition, or information. Also observed are urgent calls for research and the fixed emphatic phrase make no mistake.

patterns.name: non- compounds
patterns.context: The trigger is the prefix non, usually preceding a noun to form a negation or category label; the specific meaning varies with context.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including HackerNews, NIH ExPorter, and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Statements of research gaps
patterns.context: In research backgrounds, describes mechanisms, relationships, or information that have not yet been adequately understood, defined, or obtained.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter and PubMed Central research abstracts or project texts

patterns.name: Need or recommendation for action
patterns.context: In research proposal contexts, points to an urgent need for further research or research work of a certain kind.

patterns.name: Emphatic phrase make no mistake
patterns.context: A fixed expression in colloquial commentary used to introduce emphasis or a warning.

7_2513.description: 主要响应 non 前缀及其构成的复合词，也响应科研文本中表示理解、定义或信息不足的表达；另见迫切需要研究和固定强调语 make no mistake。

patterns.name: non-复合词
patterns.context: 触发点是前缀 non，通常出现在名词前构成否定或类别标签；具体词义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、NIH ExPorter、PubMed Central 等多种文体

patterns.name: 对研究不足的表述
patterns.context: 科研背景中描述机制、关系或信息尚未被充分理解、界定或获得。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter、PubMed Central 科研摘要或项目文本

patterns.name: 需要或建议采取行动
patterns.context: 科研提案语境中，指出某类进一步研究或研究工作的迫切必要性。

patterns.name: 强调句式 make no mistake
patterns.context: 口语化评论中用固定表达引出强调或警告。

en.description: Primarily responds to academic judgments that something is “not yet sufficiently understood or defined,” especially negation or weakening expressions before words for understanding or definition; it also activates on complete-state expressions formed with fully and a few word-internal prefix uses.

patterns.name: Knowledge or mechanisms remain unclear
patterns.context: Judgments about mechanisms, processes, or phenomena, often formed as is/are + not/poorly/less + well/defined/understood; negation or weakening words are close to words for “understanding/definition”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in physics, biomedicine, and neuroscience

patterns.name: Urgency of research or action
patterns.context: After identifying a shortage in the research subject or work, badly modifies needed.

patterns.name: fully modifying participation or business state
patterns.context: fully precedes a compound or adjective to express a complete or sufficient state; hyphenated split forms also occur.
patterns.domain: News, business promotion, nonprofit organization descriptions

patterns.name: Non/negative prefix in a fixed expression
patterns.context: non- attaches to article to form a compound expression, and the context says it can be rewritten.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment formed with un-
patterns.context: un- is written together with the following root, indicating that a need has not been met.

7_2513.concept: 不足或未完成状态表达
7_2513.description: 主要响应“尚未被充分理解或界定”的学术判断，尤其是理解/界定词前的否定或弱化表达；另对 fully 构成的完整状态表达及少数词内前缀用法有激活。

patterns.name: 知识或机制尚不清楚
patterns.trigger: “not well understood”“less well defined”“poorly defined”“not well defined”
patterns.context: 对机制、过程或现象作判断，常由 is/are + not/poorly/less + well/defined/understood 构成；否定或弱化词与“理解/界定”词邻近
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涉及物理、生物医学、神经科学

patterns.name: 研究需求或行动迫切
patterns.context: 在指出研究对象或研究工作不足后，以 badly 修饰 needed

patterns.name: fully 修饰参与或商业状态
patterns.context: fully 位于复合词或形容词前，表达达到完整、充分状态；也出现连字符拆分形式
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业宣传、公益组织介绍

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的非/否定前缀
patterns.context: non- 接在 article 前构成复合表达，且上下文称其可被改写

patterns.name: un- 构成的词内片段
patterns.context: un- 与后续词根连写，表示需求尚未满足

en.description: Activations primarily occur on expressions in research contexts meaning that understanding or mechanisms are unclear, including poorly/not well understood and less well defined. There are also responses to emphatic expressions of research need, full participation, and warning-style negation.

patterns.name: Research phrasing with “poorly understood”
patterns.context: The subject is usually a relationship, mechanism, or interaction; the passive construction states that it has not been adequately understood.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, research papers and proposals

patterns.name: “not well understood” variants
patterns.context: States that a phenomenon, mechanism, or its properties are unclear; often follows a research question or technical description.
patterns.domain: Research papers, including physics and perception research

patterns.name: Other expressions of “insufficient understanding”
patterns.context: Degree adverbs and “well” modify “defined,” expressing that a mechanism is not yet clear; the meaning is close to understood but the wording differs.

patterns.name: Emphasizing research needs
patterns.context: Makes a strong judgment about the need for future or additional research.

patterns.name: Emphasizing participation and inclusion
patterns.context: “Fully” emphasizes a group’s full participation in community life, followed by a description of inclusion.
patterns.domain: Mission statements of autism advocacy organizations

patterns.name: Emphatic negation and warning
patterns.context: Colloquial, with a warning or assertive tone; used to emphasize a subsequent prediction about 5G.

7_2513.description: 主要对科研语境中“理解或机制尚不清楚”的表达激活，涵盖poorly/not well understood及less well defined；另对研究需求、充分参与和警告式否定等强调表达有响应。

patterns.name: “poorly understood”研究表述
patterns.context: 主语通常是某种关系、机制或相互作用；被动式判断其尚未得到充分理解。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科研论文及研究计划

patterns.name: “not well understood”变体
patterns.context: 说明某现象、机制或其性质尚不清楚；常接在研究问题或技术性描述之后。
patterns.domain: 科研论文，涉及物理与感知研究

patterns.name: 其他“不充分理解”表述
patterns.context: 以程度副词和“well”修饰“defined”，表达机制尚未明确；语义接近但措辞不同于 understood。

patterns.name: 研究需求的强调
patterns.context: 对未来研究或补充研究的必要性作强烈判断。

patterns.name: 参与和包容的强调
patterns.context: “fully”强调群体充分参与社区生活，后接包容性描述。
patterns.domain: 自闭症倡议组织的使命陈述

patterns.name: 否定强调与警告
patterns.context: 口语化、带警告或断言语气；用于强调后续关于5G的预测。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several phrase structures: not well + participle, well up, fully/full, the non- negating prefix, un-enjoyable, and fixed expressions such as come on now and make no mistake. Shared cues are not apparent.

patterns.name: well with negation/evaluative words
patterns.context: Well follows not to form evaluative or epistemic expressions of the pattern “not well + past participle”; there is also the literal phrase well up.

patterns.name: Colloquial emphasis with come on now
patterns.context: A fixed colloquial phrase in conversation expressing impatience, rebuttal, or exasperation.

patterns.name: Emphasizing participation with fully participating
patterns.context: Fully modifies participating to emphasize full participation; nearby text describes community inclusion.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation full-time
patterns.context: Full-time functions as a compound adjective modifying job.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation full of
patterns.context: Full is followed by of to mean filled with something.

patterns.name: Non-content/negative content
patterns.context: The non- prefix combines with a hyphen to form a concept of negation or absence; the latter example refers to non-content on a page.
patterns.domain: Public health academic texts, mobile webpage reviews

patterns.name: Decomposed spelling of un-enjoyable
patterns.context: The same word un-enjoyable appears repeatedly in the text, describing a poor mobile reading experience.

patterns.name: Emphatic warning with make no mistake
patterns.context: A fixed phrase introducing an emphatic assertion or warning.

7_2513.description: 激活分散在若干词组结构上：not well + 分词、well up、fully/full、non-否定前缀、un-enjoyable，以及 come on now、make no mistake 等固定表达；共享线索不明显。

patterns.name: well 与否定/评价词
patterns.trigger: « not»5« well»10« borne»3« out»4；« not»6« well»10« understood»2；« eyes»5« well»10« up»2
patterns.context: well 位于 not 后，构成“not well + 过去分词”评价或认识表达；另有字面短语 well up
patterns.domain: 评论、学术论文、叙事散文

patterns.name: come on now 口语强调
patterns.context: 对话中表达催促、反驳或不耐烦的固定口语短语

patterns.name: fully participating 强调参与
patterns.context: fully 修饰 participating，强调充分参与；附近是社群包容性表述

patterns.name: full-time 固定搭配
patterns.context: full-time 作为复合形容词修饰 job

patterns.name: full of 固定搭配
patterns.context: full 后接 of，表示充满某物

patterns.name: 非内容/否定内容
patterns.context: non- 前缀与连字符构成否定或缺失概念；后一例指页面上的非内容
patterns.domain: 公共卫生学术文本、移动网页评论

patterns.name: un-enjoyable 拼写分解
patterns.context: 同一词 un-enjoyable 在文本中重复出现，描述移动端阅读体验差

patterns.name: make no mistake 强调警告
patterns.context: 固定短语用于引出强调性断言或警告

en.description: Activations often occur on English expressions of degree, sufficiency, and emphatic negation, especially various collocations with fully and evaluative expressions involving poorly and well; however, trigger words and contexts are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: poorly understood expressions
patterns.context: In academic or research contexts, describes a relationship, mechanism, or phenomenon that has not been adequately understood.
patterns.domain: Research papers, biomedical and scientific discourse

patterns.name: Negative expression with well borne out
patterns.context: In discussion or debate, evaluates a view as lacking sufficient evidential support; activation centers on “well.”

patterns.name: well as a degree expression
patterns.context: In discussions of complex knowledge or comprehension, modifies “understand” to indicate degree of understanding.

patterns.name: Expressions involving fully
patterns.context: “Fully” emphasizes completeness, sufficiency, or commitment; following collocations concern corporate integration, social participation, market maturity, and personal belief.
patterns.domain: Corporate profiles, nonprofit missions, marketing copy, and recruitment materials

patterns.name: Negation and degree intensification
patterns.context: Negation or degree words strengthen a judgment; this pattern occurs across different contexts, with no single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Public health research, online comments, and recruitment materials

patterns.name: Other scattered emphatic words
patterns.context: Words serve general degree, evaluative, or emphatic functions in sentences, but their collocations and contexts vary substantially, making it difficult to group them into a single stable trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Corporate promotion, forum discussions, and marketing texts

7_2513.description: 激活常见于英语中的程度、充分性及否定强调表达，尤其是 fully 的多种搭配，以及 poorly understood、well 相关评价；但触发词和语境并不完全一致。

patterns.name: poorly understood 表达
patterns.context: 学术或科研语境中，描述某种关系、机制或现象尚未被充分理解。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、生物医学与科学论述

patterns.name: well borne out 否定表达
patterns.context: 在讨论或争辩中，评价某种观点未获充分证据支持；激活集中在“well”。

patterns.name: well 程度表达
patterns.context: 在复杂知识或理解能力的讨论中，修饰“understand”，表示理解程度。

patterns.name: fully 相关表达
patterns.context: “fully”强调完整、充分或投入；后续搭配分别涉及企业整合、社会参与、市场成熟和个人信念。
patterns.domain: 企业介绍、公益使命、市场宣传与招聘文案

patterns.name: 否定及程度强化表达
patterns.context: 通过否定词或程度词加强判断；此模式在不同语境中出现，未见统一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、网络评论与招聘文案

patterns.name: 其他零散强调词
patterns.trigger: “passionate commitment”“mob mentality”“very well”以外的“much different”“pretty quickly”“y”后的“niche”等局部词形
patterns.context: 词语在句中承担一般程度、评价或强调功能，但彼此搭配及语境差异较大，难以归并为单一稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: 企业宣传、论坛讨论与市场文本

en.concept: Common English expressions of emphasis and state
en.description: Activations are distributed across expressions of degree or state (well/poorly understood, fully, badly needed), emphatic negation, colloquial reproach and exclamation, well up, and full-time. The examples span different meanings and styles, with no unified triggering structure.

patterns.name: Degree adverbs modifying understood
patterns.context: In statements about complex phenomena or mechanisms, activation falls on well, often near understood; “poorly understood” also occurs.

patterns.name: Reproachful use of dense
patterns.context: dense is used as an insult directed at a person, at the end of an imperative sentence.

patterns.name: Degree use of fully
patterns.context: fully modifies states such as participation or integration; both instances are positive, formal descriptions.

patterns.name: Strong negation and emphasis
patterns.context: The negation words no/No appear in sentences emphasizing, rejecting, or excluding something.
patterns.domain: Fantasy setting descriptions or narrative copy

patterns.name: badly needed
patterns.context: badly modifies needed, expressing that a research project or action is urgently necessary.

patterns.name: Emotional response with well up
patterns.context: well and up form a phrasal verb describing tears welling up in someone’s eyes.

patterns.name: Time attribute in full-time
patterns.context: full and time form a compound adjective modifying job; activation is concentrated on full, the hyphen, and time.

patterns.name: Exclamatory response with punctuation
patterns.context: In dialogue, Oh man is followed by a comma and a comment; activation falls mainly on man, the comma, and the article a.

7_2513.concept: 英语常见强调与状态短语
7_2513.description: 激活分布于程度或状态表达（well/poorly understood、fully、badly needed）、强调否定、口语责备与感叹、well up，以及 full-time。各例跨语义与文体，未见统一触发结构。

patterns.name: understood 的程度副词修饰
patterns.context: 在关于复杂现象或机制的陈述中，激活落在 well，附近常有 understood；也有“poorly understood”。

patterns.name: dense 的责备语气
patterns.context: dense 用作对人的贬责，位于祈使句末。

patterns.name: fully 的程度用法
patterns.context: fully 修饰参与或整合等状态；两处均为正面、正式的描述。

patterns.name: 强烈否定与强调
patterns.context: 否定词 no/No 出现在强调、拒斥或排除某事物的句子中。
patterns.domain: 奇幻设定介绍或叙事文案

patterns.name: badly needed
patterns.context: badly 修饰 needed，表达某项研究或行动迫切必需。

patterns.name: well up 的情绪反应
patterns.context: well 与 up 构成短语动词，描述眼中涌出泪水。

patterns.name: full-time 的时间属性
patterns.context: full 与 time 组成复合形容词，修饰 job；激活集中在 full 和连字符、time。

patterns.name: 带标点的感叹回应
patterns.context: 对话中以 Oh man 开头，随后接逗号和评论；激活主要落在 man、逗号及冠词 a。

en.description: The strongest responses often fall on adverbs modifying participles, adjectives, or relational expressions, especially fully, closely, badly, heavily, directly, finely, and authentically. The register varies widely, and the meanings are not uniform.

patterns.name: fully and its combinations
patterns.context: As a degree adverb, it modifies expressions related to participation or representation; it occurs in “be fully participating” and “not fully representative,” with opposite polarity.
patterns.domain: Nonprofit mission statements, public health papers

patterns.name: closely involved
patterns.context: The adverb closely modifies involved, describing the extent of a parent’s involvement in a child’s life.

patterns.name: badly needed
patterns.context: Badly functions as a degree adverb modifying needed, emphasizing the urgent need for research or action.

patterns.name: heavily modifying participles
patterns.context: Heavily functions as a degree adverb modifying a past participle or participial adjective; the examples mean highly dependent and severely deforested, respectively.
patterns.domain: European Parliament political reporting, global health project profiles

patterns.name: directly related
patterns.context: Directly modifies related, stating that programming speed and code quality are not directly related.

patterns.name: finely modifying handmade goods
patterns.context: Finely modifies hand-crafted, describing finely made jewelry and beadwork.

patterns.name: authentically Black
patterns.context: Authentically functions as a manner adverb modifying Black, appearing in a book title.

patterns.name: Adverbial degree or manner expressions among lower activations
patterns.context: Other -ly adverbs or degree expressions occur nearby, but their activation peaks are lower; these include virtually modifying nonexistent and the segmentation within peacefully.

7_2513.description: 最强响应多落在修饰分词、形容词或关系表达的副词上，尤其 fully、closely、badly、heavily、directly、finely、authentically；语域跨度大，语义并不统一。

patterns.name: fully及其组合形式
patterns.context: 作为程度副词，修饰参与或代表性相关表达；出现于“be fully participating”和“not fully representative”中，极性不同。
patterns.domain: 非营利组织使命陈述、公共卫生论文

patterns.name: closely involved
patterns.context: 副词 closely 修饰 involved，描述父母参与孩子生活的程度。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述或社会议题文本

patterns.name: badly needed
patterns.context: badly 作程度副词修饰 needed，强调研究或行动的迫切必要性。
patterns.domain: 神经科学研究计划、学术论述

patterns.name: heavily 修饰分词
patterns.context: heavily 作程度副词，修饰过去分词或形容词性分词；分别表示高度依赖、严重砍伐。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治报道、全球健康项目介绍

patterns.name: directly related
patterns.context: directly 修饰 related，用于说明编程速度与代码质量之间并非直接相关。

patterns.name: finely 修饰手工制品
patterns.context: finely 修饰 hand-crafted，描述精工制作的珠宝和串珠制品。

patterns.name: authentically Black
patterns.context: authentically 作方式副词修饰 Black，出现在书名中。
patterns.domain: 书目列表、文化与语言主题

patterns.name: 非最高激活中的副词性程度或方式表达
patterns.context: 附近另有多种 -ly 副词或程度表达，但激活峰值较低；包括 virtually 修饰 nonexistent，以及 peacefully 的词内分段。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、政治报道

en.description: Activations are scattered across adverbs, evaluative words, and subword fragments. A more evident recurring pattern is adverbs such as poorly/well modifying states or evaluations, but the remaining trigger words and contexts vary widely, showing no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Evaluative or cognitive states following poorly
patterns.context: The adverb modifies degree of preparation, understanding, evidential support, documentation condition, or tearful reaction; common collocations include poorly prepared/understood and well borne out/documented/up.

patterns.name: Degree adverb followed by an adjective
patterns.context: A degree adverb modifies a following adjective, participle, or expression of need, emphasizing degree or manner.
patterns.domain: Research project texts, research proposals, product promotion

patterns.name: Evaluative adjectives or emotional expressions
patterns.context: Evaluative words occur when describing tasks, creative works, people, experiences, or technology; there is no stable shared syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, promotional copy, blogs, and forums

patterns.name: Other isolated affixes and lexical fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on participial affixes, compound components, or subword fragments; the provided contexts show no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Research project texts, forums, blogs, bibliography titles

7_2513.description: 激活分散在副词、评价词及词内片段上；较明显的重复是 poorly/well 等副词修饰状态或评价，但其余触发词和语境差异很大，未显示统一语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: poorly 后接评价或认知状态
patterns.context: 副词修饰准备程度、理解程度、证据是否支持、记录状况或含泪反应；常见搭配为 poorly prepared/understood、well borne out/documented/up
patterns.domain: 学术论述、论坛对话、叙事

patterns.name: 程度副词后接形容词
patterns.context: 程度副词修饰后续形容词、分词或需求表达，强调程度或方式
patterns.domain: 科研项目文本、科研申请、商品宣传

patterns.name: 评价性形容词或情绪表达
patterns.context: 在描述任务、创作、人物、体验或技术时出现评价性词语；没有稳定的共同句法位置
patterns.domain: 学术文字、宣传文案、博客与论坛

patterns.name: 其他孤立的词缀与词汇片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分词词缀、复合词成分或词内片段上；所给上下文不显示一致语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 科研项目文本、论坛、博客、书目标题

en.description: Activations mainly occur in contexts where degree adverbs or degree expressions combine with following words, especially poorly, fully, heavily, well, finely, badly, and not straight forward; across academic, promotional, news, and business texts.

patterns.name: poorly + adjective/participle
patterns.context: Poorly immediately precedes a past participle or adjective, indicating inadequate preparation or insufficient understanding.

patterns.name: fully + participation/belief
patterns.context: Fully modifies expressions such as participation or belief, emphasizing completeness.

patterns.name: heavily + descriptor
patterns.context: Heavily functions as a degree adverb modifying a following adjective, participle, or verb.
patterns.domain: Environmental and health research, political news

patterns.name: well + established status
patterns.context: Well modifies established, describing a company’s status or development.

patterns.name: Negation of straightforward
patterns.context: Not combines with the adjective phrase whose parts are straight/forward, meaning difficult to understand.

patterns.name: finely + handmade
patterns.context: Finely modifies handmade/handcrafted items.

patterns.name: badly + needed
patterns.context: Badly modifies needed, expressing urgent need.

7_2513.description: 激活主要出现在程度副词或程度表达与后续词组合的语境中，尤其是 poorly、fully、heavily、well、finely、badly，以及 not straight forward；跨学术、宣传、新闻和商业文本。

patterns.name: poorly + 形容词/分词
patterns.context: poorly 紧邻过去分词或形容词，表示准备不足或理解不充分
patterns.domain: 政策研究、神经科学论文

patterns.name: fully + 参与/相信
patterns.context: fully 修饰参与或相信等表达，强调充分程度

patterns.name: heavily + 描述词
patterns.context: heavily 作为程度副词修饰后续形容词、分词或动词
patterns.domain: 环境与健康研究、政治新闻

patterns.name: well + 建立状态
patterns.context: well 修饰 established，描述企业地位或发展状态

patterns.name: straightforward 的否定
patterns.context: not 与分词为 straight/forward 的形容词短语连用，表示难以理解

patterns.name: finely + 手工制作
patterns.context: finely 修饰 handmade/handcrafted 一类手工制作物品

patterns.name: badly + needed
patterns.context: badly 修饰 needed，表达迫切需要

en.description: Activations are concentrated on degree adverbs and their modifying structures: emphasizing degree or sufficiency, while also expressing insufficiency, absence, or incomplete understanding; close association and strong suspicion also occur.

patterns.name: Strong degree or emphatic description
patterns.context: A degree adverb or expression modifies a particular state, quality, or manner; some words are split across tokens.
patterns.domain: Project descriptions, event promotion, recruitment copy

patterns.name: Insufficiency, difficulty understanding, or absence
patterns.context: Negative-degree or absence expressions indicate research needs, insufficient ability, nonexistent information, or problems that remain unclear.

patterns.name: Full participation or belief
patterns.context: fully modifies a state of participation or belief in a brand, expressing sufficiency or completeness.

patterns.name: Close association
patterns.context: The adverb closely modifies linked, describing a close association between entities; this example also contains nearby expressions such as fairly available.

patterns.name: Strong suspicion
patterns.context: strongly modifies the cognitive-attitude verb suspect, expressing the speaker’s strong suspicion.

7_2513.description: 激活集中在程度副词及其修饰结构：强调程度或充分性，也表达不足、缺失、未充分理解；另见紧密关联和强烈怀疑。

patterns.name: 强程度或突出描述
patterns.context: 程度副词或程度表达修饰特定状态、品质或方式；有的词在分词间被拆开标记。
patterns.domain: 项目介绍、活动宣传、招聘文案

patterns.name: 不足、理解困难或缺失
patterns.context: 负面程度或缺失表达说明研究需求、能力不足、信息不存在或问题尚未理解。

patterns.name: 全然参与或信念
patterns.context: fully 修饰参与状态或对品牌的信念，表达充分、完全。
patterns.domain: 公益组织介绍、招聘文案

patterns.name: 近距离关联
patterns.context: 副词 closely 修饰 linked，描述对象之间的紧密关联；本例也有 fairly available 等邻近表达。

patterns.name: 强烈怀疑
patterns.context: strongly 修饰认知态度动词 suspect，表达说话者强烈怀疑。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various adverbs and their following expressions: fully introduces integration, participation, belief, or maturity; degree adverbs emphasize states, judgments, and needs; there are also local collocations such as well-understood, finely hand-crafted, and members-only.

patterns.name: fully and following participation/integration expressions
patterns.context: After the adverb fully, an adjective, participle, or compound expresses full integration, participation, strong belief, or mature development; activation sometimes extends to an adjacent word.
patterns.domain: Corporate promotion, mission statements, recruitment materials, market reporting

patterns.name: Words emphasizing degree or necessity
patterns.context: Degree adverbs modify following states, judgments, or needs, such as heavily deforested, strongly suspect, and badly needed.
patterns.domain: Research funding texts, forum comments, academic or research statements

patterns.name: Negative evaluative collocation with well
patterns.context: The negator not is followed by well and then understood, meaning that something has not been adequately understood.

patterns.name: finely modifying craftsmanship
patterns.context: Finely precedes words related to handcrafted production, modifying the degree of refinement of the craft or finished product.

patterns.name: Compound expression members-only
patterns.context: Members combines with a hyphen and only to form a compound restricting access; activation falls mainly on the hyphen.
patterns.domain: Website login and membership feature descriptions

7_2513.description: 激活分布于多种副词及其后续表达：fully 引出整合、参与、信念或成熟；程度副词强调状态、判断和需求；另有 well-understood、finely hand-crafted 与 members-only 等局部搭配。

patterns.name: fully 及其后续参与/整合表达
patterns.context: 在副词 fully 后接形容词、分词或复合词，表达完整整合、充分参与、深信或成熟发展；有时激活延伸到相邻词。
patterns.domain: 企业宣传、使命陈述、招聘文案、市场报道

patterns.name: 强调程度或必要性的词
patterns.context: 程度副词修饰后续状态、判断或需求，如 heavily deforested、strongly suspect、badly needed。
patterns.domain: 研究资助文本、论坛评论、学术或科研陈述

patterns.name: well 的否定评估搭配
patterns.context: 否定词 not 后接 well，再接 understood，表示某事尚未被充分理解。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其科学论述

patterns.name: finely 修饰制作工艺
patterns.context: finely 位于手工制作相关词之前，修饰工艺或成品的精细程度。
patterns.domain: 艺术、工艺品或活动介绍

patterns.name: members-only 复合表达
patterns.context: members 与连字符及 only 构成限定访问权限的复合词；主要激活落在连字符。
patterns.domain: 网站登录与会员功能说明

en.description: Activations are distributed across expressions of degree and emphasis: fully, heavily, badly, strongly, closely, and virtually; they also cover the negated form un-enjoyable, the colloquial exclamation Oh man, and exclamation marks. Contexts span research, business, academia, and forums.

patterns.name: Degree adverb fully
patterns.context: Directly modifies an adjective, participle, or state of participation, emphasizing completeness, sufficiency, or degree; it appears in different syntactic environments.
patterns.domain: Business descriptions, recruitment copy, social issues

patterns.name: Strong degree word heavily
patterns.context: Precedes “deforested”, indicating extensive forest clearance.
patterns.domain: Research grant application / environment and public health

patterns.name: Urgency marker badly
patterns.context: Precedes “needed”, expressing the urgent need for research or action.

patterns.name: Degree adverb strongly
patterns.context: Modifies “suspect”, strengthening the speaker’s judgment that evidence is lacking.

patterns.name: Degree adverb closely
patterns.context: Modifies “linked”, describing a close connection between two types of entities.

patterns.name: Adverb virtually and negative existence
patterns.context: “virtually” modifies the hyphenated “non-existent”, meaning almost nonexistent.

patterns.name: Negative form unpleasant
patterns.context: In a complaint about the mobile web experience, a negative prefix combines with “enjoyable” to form a negative evaluation; the page content and app prompt are also mentioned.
patterns.domain: Online forum comment / mobile web experience

patterns.name: Colloquial exclamation and emotional punctuation
patterns.context: A colloquial exclamation in a reply about books, accompanied by a comma and an exclamation mark.

7_2513.description: 激活分布于程度和强调表达：fully、heavily、badly、strongly、closely、virtually；也覆盖否定式un-enjoyable及口语感叹Oh man和感叹号。横跨科研、商业、学术与论坛语境。

patterns.name: 程度副词 fully
patterns.context: 直接修饰形容词、分词或参与状态，强调完整、充分或程度；在不同句法环境中出现。
patterns.domain: 商业介绍、招聘文案、社会议题

patterns.name: 强程度词 heavily
patterns.context: 置于“deforested”前，表示森林砍伐程度很高。
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请／环境与公共卫生

patterns.name: 迫切程度词 badly
patterns.context: 置于“needed”前，表达研究或行动的迫切需要。
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请／神经科学

patterns.name: 程度副词 strongly
patterns.context: 修饰“suspect”，加强说话者对缺乏证据的判断。

patterns.name: 程度副词 closely
patterns.context: 修饰“linked”，描述两类对象之间联系紧密。

patterns.name: 副词 virtually 与否定存在
patterns.context: “virtually”修饰带连字符的“non-existent”，表示几乎不存在。

patterns.name: 否定形式 unpleasant
patterns.context: 在移动网页体验的抱怨中，以否定前缀和“enjoyable”构成负面评价；同时提及页面内容及应用提示。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛评论／移动网页体验

patterns.name: 口语感叹与情绪标点
patterns.context: 书籍话题回复中的口语感叹，伴随逗号及感叹号。

en.concept: Heterogeneous triggers, with reduces as the core
en.description: Activations occur sporadically across heterogeneous materials: legal document header formats and house or name fragments in emails; also responds strongly to reduces in medical and patent texts, followed by a disease measure, delay, lifespan, or device performance being reduced.

patterns.name: Sentence-final reduces
patterns.context: The verb appears in a sentence or abstract, followed by a negative outcome or object being reduced, such as “Aβ plaques”, “the rate”, “battery life”, or “driving ability”; it also appears mid-sentence in longer sentences.

patterns.name: Header of an unpublished appellate court opinion
patterns.context: Court heading and docket-number format preceding the body of an opinion; unpublished-opinion markers, court names, and numbers appear together.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: U.S. Code and Supreme Court header format
patterns.context: Short, header-style lines comprising legal citations, case titles, and court names.

patterns.name: house in a home-purchase closing context
patterns.context: A personal email describes completing a home purchase closing on Friday; house refers to the home being purchased.

patterns.name: Name fragments in email addresses
patterns.context: Near the signature and email address after the email body, a name is split into multiple subword tokens.

7_2521.concept: 异质触发，核心为 reduces
7_2521.description: 激活在异质材料中分散出现：法律文书案头格式与邮件中的 house、姓名片段；另在医学和专利文本里显著响应 reduces，后接被减少的疾病指标、延迟、寿命或器件性能。

patterns.name: 句末 reduces
patterns.context: 动词出现在句子或摘要中，后接负面结果或被减少的对象，如“Aβ plaques”“the rate”“battery life”“driving ability”；也出现在长句中段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利技术背景

patterns.name: 未公开上诉法院判决页眉
patterns.trigger: «UN»…«PUBL»…«ISHED»、«UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS»、«FOR THE FOURTH CIRCUIT»、«No.»
patterns.context: 判决正文前的法院抬头与案号格式；未公开判决标记、法院名称和编号集中出现。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 美国法典及最高法院案头格式
patterns.trigger: « U».«S». 后接数字和«↵»；«IN RE»或案件当事人名称；«No.»案号；«Supreme Court»
patterns.context: 法律引证、案件标题和法院名称构成的短行式案头信息。
patterns.domain: 美国最高法院相关法律文书

patterns.name: 买房交割语境中的 house
patterns.context: 个人邮件中描述周五完成购房交割，house 指正在购买的房屋。

patterns.name: 邮件地址姓名片段
patterns.context: 邮件正文后签名及邮箱地址附近，姓名被拆成多个子词 token。

en.description: The most stable activating term is reduces, appearing across biomedical, patent, and email contexts. There are also localized responses to federal court opinion-title formats, email signatures, home-buying terms, and semiconductor terminology.

patterns.name: Legal opinion headers and docket-number formats
patterns.context: Court headings, unpublished-opinion labels, and docket numbers at the beginning of opinions, often with all caps, centered spacing, and line breaks

patterns.name: Supreme Court citations and case titles
patterns.context: The title area comprising citations, case names, and docket numbers in Supreme Court opinions

patterns.name: reduces term
patterns.context: The form reduces activates strongly in different syntactic contexts, including research findings, patent effects, and ordinary transaction narratives

patterns.name: Email addresses and dates in signatures
patterns.context: Signatures/contact information and timestamps after the body of an email

patterns.name: house in home-buying narratives
patterns.context: First-person emails mentioning a home purchase, closing, and a specific day of the week

patterns.name: gate dielectric in technical literature
patterns.context: Patent passages explaining depletion regions, gate capacitance, and device drive capability

7_2521.concept: reduces及文档标题局部特征
7_2521.description: 激活最稳定的词项是 reduces，横跨生物医学、专利和邮件语境；另对联邦法院判决标题格式，以及邮件签名、购房词和半导体术语有局部响应。

patterns.name: 法律判决页眉/案号格式
patterns.context: 判决文本开头的法院抬头、未发表标记和编号，常有全大写、居中空格与换行

patterns.name: 最高法院引证与案件标题
patterns.trigger: « U».«S». 后接页码；«IN RE» 或案件当事方名称与 «v.»；«No.» 后接案号
patterns.context: 最高法院判决的引证行、案件名及案号组成的标题区

patterns.name: reduces 词项
patterns.context: 词形 reduces 本身显著激活；分别处于研究结果、专利效果及普通交易叙述等不同句法语境

patterns.name: 邮件签名中的邮箱与日期
patterns.context: 邮件正文之后的签名/联系信息及时间戳

patterns.name: 房屋购买叙述中的 house
patterns.context: 第一人称邮件提及购房、交割及具体星期

patterns.name: 技术文献中的 gate dielectric
patterns.context: 解释耗尽区、栅电容和器件驱动能力的专利技术段落

en.concept: Mixed feature of document formats, “reduces,” and house
en.description: Activations concentrate on legal opinion headers and Supreme Court citation formats. The feature also triggers consistently in statements across domains where “reduces” describes a decrease in an outcome, and shows one strong response to “house” in a home-buying email.

patterns.name: Court opinion headers and docket numbers
patterns.context: Unpublished-opinion labels, court names, and case numbers at the beginning of opinions; “02” in a docket number is also strongly marked.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: U.S. Supreme Court citations and case names
patterns.context: Document headers arranged with Supreme Court volume and page citations, case titles, and docket numbers.

patterns.name: Repeated triggers on reduces
patterns.context: The word is marked in statements where an intervention, condition, or mechanism lowers an outcome or metric; it appears across domains and collocations.

patterns.name: house in a home-purchase closing context
patterns.context: house activates most strongly in the home-purchase narrative “closing on the house we are buying”; other nearby words also activate strongly.

7_2521.concept: 文书格式与“减少”词及 house 的混合特征
7_2521.description: 激活集中于法律判决书页眉与最高法院引证格式；另在多领域“reduces”降低结果的陈述中稳定触发，并对购房邮件中的“house”有一次强反应。

patterns.name: 法院判决书页眉与案号
patterns.context: 判决书开头的未公开判决标识、法院名称及案件编号处；编号中的“02”也被强烈标记。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 美国最高法院引证与案名
patterns.context: 最高法院卷页引证、案件标题和案号排列的文书头部。
patterns.domain: 美国最高法院法律文书

patterns.name: reduces 的反复触发
patterns.context: 该词在涉及某种干预、条件或机制降低结果/指标的陈述中被标记；不同领域和搭配均出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利技术说明

patterns.name: 买房交割语境中的 house
patterns.context: “closing on the house we are buying”这一购房交易叙述中，house 激活最强；其他相邻词也有较强激活。

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: optional is prominent (sports, field documentation, plugins), alongside local patterns involving name tokens, medical abstracts, legal headers, event titles, HTML fields, and SVG paths, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: optional
patterns.context: The word optional appears in contexts describing optional items or features; followed by exercises, field annotations, or plugins and effects.
patterns.domain: Sports, software/code documentation, and other genres

patterns.name: English name tokens
patterns.context: Names appear as split subword tokens, specifically Felix Götze and Myakka; there is no clear unified semantic context.

patterns.name: Neuropeptide-related cells
patterns.context: Describes cells and fibers in the hypothalamus and pituitary.

patterns.name: Treatment and outcomes in medical abstracts
patterns.context: The abstract describes a medical intervention and its effect in reducing an outcome or pathological measure.

patterns.name: Legal document format
patterns.context: Court names, docket numbers, and opinion titles appear as formatted legal document headers.

patterns.name: Split event name and results table
patterns.context: An entry introduces an Olympic gymnastics event and transitions to competition results or qualification details.

patterns.name: HTML field descriptions
patterns.context: An HTML list explains field meanings and marks a field as optional.

patterns.name: URLs and SVG links
patterns.context: A resource path ending in .svg appears in a webpage link or Markdown link.

7_2521.concept: none
7_2521.description: 激活模式分散：突出出现的 optional（体育、字段文档、插件），另有姓名词元、医学摘要、法律抬头、赛事标题、HTML 字段及 SVG 路径等局部模式，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: optional
patterns.context: 词 optional 出现在描述可选项目或功能的上下文中；后接 exercises、字段标注或 plugins and effects。
patterns.domain: 体育、软件/代码说明及其他文体

patterns.name: 英文姓名词元
patterns.context: 姓名以拆分子词元形式出现，分别是 Felix Götze 与 Myakka；没有明显统一的语义上下文。

patterns.name: 神经肽相关细胞
patterns.context: 描述 hypothalamus 和 pituitary 中的细胞与纤维。

patterns.name: 医疗摘要中的治疗与结果
patterns.context: 摘要陈述医疗干预及其降低某种结果或病理指标的效果。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式
patterns.context: 法院名称、案号及判决标题等以格式化的法律文书抬头出现。

patterns.name: 拆分的赛事名称与结果表格
patterns.context: 条目介绍奥运会体操赛事，并转入比赛结果或预赛内容。

patterns.name: HTML 字段说明
patterns.context: HTML 列表中说明字段含义，并标注字段为 optional。

patterns.name: 网址与 SVG 链接
patterns.context: 网页链接或 Markdown 链接中出现以 .svg 结尾的资源路径。

en.description: Strong activations occur on proper names split across repeated line breaks, the term Neuropeptide, BL83 product titles, and fields or technical/sports phrases containing optional. Shared cues are weak; the feature may mix subwords, formatting, and local collocations.

patterns.name: Segmented spellings of specific names and places
patterns.context: A proper name is split into multiple subword tokens, followed by a line break, and often repeated as the beginning or full form of the name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles or headline-style text

patterns.name: Neuropeptide-related term
patterns.context: The word Neuropeptide is split and followed by cells in a description of the hypothalamus and pituitary gland.

patterns.name: BL83 product titles
patterns.context: Product or model titles beginning with BL and containing a number; one example is followed by a line break and Share.
patterns.domain: Product catalogs or web product listings

patterns.name: Structured form fields and optional repeated entries
patterns.context: HTML list items organized using numbers, abbreviated field names, and parenthetical glosses; fields can be marked optional and repeated.
patterns.domain: Structured documents or code snippets on Github

patterns.name: optional exercises in sports
patterns.context: In descriptions of gymnastics competitions, optional is paired with exercises and contrasted with compulsory exercises.
patterns.domain: Olympic event results or sports encyclopedia

patterns.name: Optional property of software plugins and effects
patterns.context: Describes loading content into an engine and then adding plugins and effects; optional modifies plugins.

7_2521.concept: 混合词片与格式触发
7_2521.description: 强激活分布于换行重复的拆分专名、Neuropeptide 词项、BL83 商品标题，以及含 optional 的字段或技术/体育短语；共同线索较弱，可能混合了词片、格式与局部搭配。

patterns.name: 特定人名/地名的分词拼写
patterns.context: 专名被拆分成多个子词 token，后接换行，并常再次出现该名称的开头或完整名称。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题或标题式文本

patterns.name: Neuropeptide 相关词项
patterns.context: Neuropeptide 一词被拆分后紧接 cells，置于下丘脑与垂体的描述中。

patterns.name: BL83 商品标题
patterns.trigger: «BL»8UBOO D1 With Dual Rear；«BL»83M Floor Lamp
patterns.context: 以 BL 开头并含数字的型号/商品标题；其中一例接换行和 Share。
patterns.domain: 商品目录或网页商品列表

patterns.name: 结构化表单字段与可选重复项
patterns.trigger: Service Group；PID (Patient Identification) optional；PSL (Product/Service Line Item) optional repeating
patterns.context: HTML 列表项中以编号、缩写字段名和括号释义组织，字段可标为 optional，且可重复。
patterns.domain: Github 中的结构化文档或代码片段

patterns.name: 体育项目中的 optional exercises
patterns.context: 体操比赛说明中，optional 与 exercises 搭配，和 compulsory exercises 对举。
patterns.domain: 奥运会赛事结果或体育百科

patterns.name: 软件插件与效果的 optional 属性
patterns.context: 描述将内容加载进引擎后添加插件与效果；optional 修饰 plugins。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the capitalized string Post and its cross-word-boundary forms, appearing in medical compounds, academic events, and webpage text; also has sporadic activations on patent citations, DOIs, neuroendocrine terms, and mathematical values.

patterns.name: Post-related strings
patterns.context: Post, capitalized with an initial P, appears in compounds, phrases, or within words; includes medical terms, academic event names, and webpage copy.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, conference descriptions, and web text

patterns.name: Patent application citation
patterns.context: In the patent background, the author refers to an application and its number and date in the first person.

patterns.name: Medical literature identifier
patterns.context: A DOI label and number appear in a journal citation.

patterns.name: Neuroendocrine cell terminology
patterns.context: Neuroendocrine descriptions concerning the hypothalamus, pituitary, or prolactin cells; activation falls on terms and cell-related words.

patterns.name: Values in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Values are embedded in a math problem involving integer operations and a defined function, with no obvious Post string or medical context.

7_2521.concept: Post 字符串及异质词组
7_2521.description: 主要对大小写为 Post 的字符串及其跨词边界形式敏感，出现在医学复合词、学术活动和网页词语中；另有专利引文、DOI、神经内分泌术语及数学数值等零散激活。

patterns.name: Post 相关字符串
patterns.context: 大小写 P 开头的 Post 出现在复合词、短语或词内；包括医学术语、学术活动名称和网页文案。
patterns.domain: 跨医学论文、会议介绍、网页文本

patterns.name: 专利申请引文
patterns.trigger: «My» «patent» «application» «Ser». «No»，后接编号、提交日期及引号中的标题
patterns.context: 专利背景部分，以第一人称提及申请及其编号和日期。

patterns.name: 医学文献标识符
patterns.trigger: «DOI»及其后的期刊 DOI 字符串
patterns.context: 期刊引文中出现 DOI 标签和编号。

patterns.name: 神经内分泌细胞术语
patterns.context: 关于下丘脑、垂体或催乳素细胞的神经内分泌描述，激活落在术语及细胞相关词上。
patterns.domain: 神经科学与内分泌医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数值
patterns.trigger: «279»，以及带激活标记的数字、分数和符号
patterns.context: 数值嵌在整数运算与定义函数的数学题中，没有明显的 Post 字符串或医学语境。

en.description: Primarily activates on English Five, including time or quantity expressions, and on the within-word kn in knitted, knurled, and knocks; also has local fragment activations on sulphated and the name Mehta. No clear corresponding trigger is apparent in segments 1 and 9.

patterns.name: Within-word kn substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on the kn substring inside English words, appearing in knitted, knurled, and knocks; kn need not be word-initial.

patterns.name: Five numeral
patterns.context: Activates on the complete word Five, followed by a time unit or quantity noun; occurs in three different contexts.

patterns.name: sulphated in a medical term
patterns.context: Activates on an internal fragment of sulphated, near biochemical terms such as 25-hydroxyvitamin D3.

patterns.name: Mehta in a proper name
patterns.context: Activates on an internal fragment of the name Mehta, appearing in a cast or people list.

patterns.name: Time expression five years ago
patterns.context: Activates in a retrospective time expression with years ago following Five; shares a numeral trigger with other Five instances, but has an explicit retrospective time structure here.

7_2521.concept: 局部词形片段与 Five
7_2521.description: 主要激活英语 Five（含时间或数量表达），以及 knitted、knurled、knocks 中的词内 kn；另有 sulphated 与人名 Mehta 的局部词片段激活。第1、9段未见清楚对应触发。

patterns.name: 词中 kn 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的 kn 子串，分别出现在 knitted、knurled、knocks 中；并不要求 kn 位于词首。
patterns.domain: 专利说明、文学/通俗叙述

patterns.name: Five 数词
patterns.context: 激活完整单词 Five，后接时间单位或数量名词；在三个不同语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、文学、医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 sulphated
patterns.context: 激活 sulphated 的词内片段，处于 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 等生化术语附近。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Mehta
patterns.context: 激活人名 Mehta 的词内片段，出现在演职员或人物名单中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物/影视条目

patterns.name: 时间长度 five years ago
patterns.context: 在 Five 后接 years ago 的回溯时间表达中激活；与其他 Five 实例共享数词触发，但此处有明确的时间回溯结构。

en.concept: Rare proper names and word fragments
en.description: Activations occur across domains, including domain names, brands, medical and technical terms, legal names, and product copy, often landing on rare words, proper names, or split word fragments; there are also activations in lists, titles, and numerical data, spanning a wide range of semantics.

patterns.name: Domain suffixes and repeated URLs
patterns.context: “photosoft.” is followed by multiple URLs consisting of the same name with different top-level domains

patterns.name: Browser names and brand comparisons
patterns.context: Browser brands appear in uppercase segmented form after a date, in a context comparing browsers

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of a disease name
patterns.context: A medical term and the abbreviation “MtD” in parentheses

patterns.name: Streaming protocol and audio terminology
patterns.context: Asks about a Flash player, 5.1 surround sound, and how to stream via RTMP

patterns.name: Neurofilament protein terminology
patterns.context: A protein name is followed by “proteins” and other biological descriptions

patterns.name: Name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists of attorneys and parties; activation falls on split fragments within names

patterns.name: Network protocols and Ethernet
patterns.context: Protocol classifications and external-link entries involving SCSI and Ethernet

patterns.name: Legal entity term in a case name
patterns.context: Company name “Structured Asset Services” in a case title

patterns.name: Percentage data and fish species name
patterns.context: A genomic abstract first reports base percentages, then mentions a mitochondrial genome species name

patterns.name: Product names and size descriptions
patterns.context: Product marketing copy describing a screen product, manufacturer, and supported screen sizes

7_2521.concept: 罕见专名与词片段
7_2521.description: 激活分布于域名、品牌、医学与技术术语、法律姓名及商品文案等处，常落在罕见词、专名或被切分的词片段；另有列表、标题和数字数据中的激活，语义跨度很大。

patterns.name: 域名后缀与重复网址
patterns.context: “photosoft.”后列出多个由相同名称加不同顶级域名构成的网址

patterns.name: 浏览器名称及品牌对比
patterns.context: 日期之后以大写分段形式出现浏览器品牌，语境是浏览器间比较

patterns.name: 疾病名称的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语及括号中的缩写“MtD”

patterns.name: 流媒体协议与音频术语
patterns.context: 询问 Flash 播放器、5.1 环绕声及如何通过 RTMP 推流

patterns.name: 神经纤维丝蛋白术语
patterns.context: 蛋白质名称后接“proteins”等生物学描述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 律师及当事人姓名列举；激活落在姓名内部的分词片段

patterns.name: 网络协议与以太网
patterns.context: 协议分类和外部链接条目，涉及 SCSI 与 Ethernet

patterns.name: 案件名称中的法律实体词
patterns.context: 案件标题中公司名称“Structured Asset Services”

patterns.name: 百分比数据与鱼类学名
patterns.context: 基因组摘要先报告碱基百分比，再提及线粒体基因组物种名称

patterns.name: 产品名称与尺寸描述
patterns.context: 商品宣传文案，描述屏幕产品、生产商及可容纳的屏幕尺寸

en.concept: net string and structured text fragments
en.description: Activations occur across multiple text formats: the letter string net and fragments within names are prominent, alongside encyclopedia templates, year categories, legal representation labels, email headers, sports transfers, music entries, and address descriptions; there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: net within or at the end of a word
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on the continuous spelling net; it may occur within a name or at the end of a domain or technical term, with no unified syntactic position. In [5], “non-«contract»” also appears, but it is not net.
patterns.domain: Legal names, email subjects, Wikipedia links, and network technology

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation hits letter fragments within multisyllabic proper names; the names refer to different people, and the letter fragments are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Sports news, musician/song entries, legal documents, and business emails.

patterns.name: Wikipedia categories and entry templates
patterns.context: Template-like structures at the end of entries, such as categories, references, external links, or infoboxes; activation is scattered across template terms and nearby content.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries and their lists, categories, and links.

patterns.name: Year and entry-list format
patterns.context: Years appear in entry-style text such as sports event lists, birth categories, or song categories, often adjacent to line breaks and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia directories, categories, and reference lists.

patterns.name: Legal litigation counsel format
patterns.context: After attorney names, law firms, and locations, the represented litigants are identified.

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: Metadata fields at the beginning of an email, followed by a date, recipient, or subject.

patterns.name: Transfer and player recruitment phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses player signings, loans, or recruitment, including team and player names.

patterns.name: Album releases and musical collaborations
patterns.context: A musician entry describes album releases and remix production for other artists; activation also falls on fragments of artist names.

patterns.name: Songwriting categories
patterns.context: Entry categories group songs by lyricist or creator, followed by a name.

patterns.name: Address/property descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptive text about street names and residential properties; activation includes word fragments in place names.
patterns.domain: Real estate or address-related entry text.

7_2521.concept: net 字串与结构化文本片段
7_2521.description: 激活分布在多种文本格式中：net 字母串及人名内部片段较突出，另覆盖百科模板、年份分类、法律代理标注、邮件头、体育转会、音乐条目和地址描述；未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 词中或词尾的 net
patterns.context: 强激活落在拼写为 net 的连续字母上；可位于人名内部或域名、技术词末尾，未见统一句法位置。
patterns.domain: 法律姓名、邮件主题、Wikipedia 链接与网络技术；[5]中也出现 “non-«contract»”，但不是 net。

patterns.name: 人名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活命中多音节专名内部的字母片段；这些名字分属不同人物，且字母片段不固定。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、音乐家/歌曲条目、法律文书及商务邮件。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 分类与条目模板
patterns.context: 条目尾部的分类、参考文献、外部链接或资料栏等模板化结构；激活分散在模板词及邻近内容。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目及其列表、分类和链接。

patterns.name: 年份与条目列表格式
patterns.context: 年份出现在体育赛事列表、出生分类或歌曲分类等条目式文本中，常邻接换行与标点。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 目录、分类及参考列表。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼代理人格式
patterns.context: 律师姓名、律所和地点之后，标注其代表的诉讼当事人。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件开头的元数据字段，后接日期、收件人或主题。

patterns.name: 转会与球员招募表述
patterns.context: 谈到球员签约、租借或招募，含球队及球员姓名。

patterns.name: 专辑发行与音乐合作
patterns.context: 音乐人条目中描述专辑发行及其为其他艺人制作混音；激活还落在艺人姓名片段。

patterns.name: 歌曲创作分类
patterns.context: 条目分类按作词或创作者归类歌曲，后接姓名。

patterns.name: 地址/物业描述
patterns.context: 路名及住宅物业的描述性文字，激活包含地名中的词片段。
patterns.domain: 地产或地址相关条目文本。

en.concept: Proper names and rare word fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across rare internal fragments or word endings in names, proper nouns, and compounds: legal names, McDonnell, film and bibliographic titles, aircraft names, Chinese transliterations, and interviewee. There is no unified semantics or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: McDonnell surname
patterns.context: Appears in a person's name or the full name of an aircraft manufacturer; activates only when this surname appears

patterns.name: Rare surnames or name fragments
patterns.context: Attorney, judge, or party names in legal texts; spans different names with no unified spelling pattern

patterns.name: Film titles or character names
patterns.context: A voice actor's work entry in a table, or a name in a children's rhyme directory; trigger positions differ

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in aircraft names
patterns.context: Appears within aircraft names in a list of military aircraft models

patterns.name: Name fragment in Chinese transliteration
patterns.context: Chinese transliteration of a processor entry's name; activation concentrates on syllable fragments

patterns.name: Rare word ending related to interviewees
patterns.context: Mentions an interviewee in philosophical commentary; occurs only here

7_2521.concept: 专名及罕见词片段
7_2521.description: 激活分散在姓名、专名及复合词的罕见内部片段或词尾：法律人名、McDonnell、影视与书目名称、飞机名、中文转写及 interviewee。未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: McDonnell 姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在人名或飞机制造商全名中；只在该姓氏出现时激活

patterns.name: 人名中的罕见姓氏或姓名片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中的律师、法官或当事人姓名；覆盖不同姓名，未见统一拼写模式

patterns.name: 影视标题或角色名
patterns.context: 表格中的配音演员作品条目，或儿童韵文目录中的名字；触发位置不同
patterns.domain: 百科影视条目、书目目录

patterns.name: 航空器名称中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 列举军用飞机型号时，出现在机名内部

patterns.name: 中文转写的姓名片段
patterns.context: 处理器条目的中文名转写，激活集中于音节片段

patterns.name: 访谈对象相关的罕见词尾
patterns.context: 哲学评论文字中提到受访者；仅此一处

en.description: Primarily responds to split subwords in names, especially names of people and judge or attorney signatures in legal documents; also responds to disposition terms, court opinion headings, titles, and case metadata. A few non-legal names appear in biographies and research project text.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in names of attorneys, judges, parties, or other people, especially when names are split into multiple subwords; activation often falls on the end or an internal fragment of a name.
patterns.domain: Primarily court opinions, case titles, and attorney directories; also appears in Wikipedia biographies and NIH project descriptions; covers [1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

patterns.name: Disposition and procedural terms in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in the court's ruling or conclusion, often near remand, reversal, judgment, and subsequent proceedings.
patterns.domain: Appellate opinions and judicial decisions; covers [3][10]

patterns.name: Name signatures and case metadata in court layouts
patterns.context: Court level, judicial title, case number, originating appeal, or opinion title appears around names; some activations fall on headings, titles, or case fields rather than names.
patterns.domain: Front pages of U.S. court opinions, headers, and signature blocks; covers [2][6][7][8]

7_2521.concept: 姓名与法律文书格式
7_2521.description: 主要响应姓名中被拆分的子词，尤见法律文书的人名与法官、律师署名；也响应裁判结论词及法院意见标题、职衔和案件元数据。个别非法律姓名出现在简介和科研项目文本中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人名及姓名片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名内部或姓名边界附近的片段，如 «K»5«erm»5«it»10« Hill»4、«Mart»4«one»10、«Dix»2«it»10、«Mc»2«El»4«we»9«e»4、«S»2«AN»7«DE»10«NA»6«W»6
patterns.context: 出现在律师、法官、当事人或其他人物姓名中，尤其姓名被分词切成多个子词；激活常落在姓名末尾或姓名内部片段。
patterns.domain: 以法院意见、案件标题和律师名录为主，也出现维基百科人物简介与 NIH 项目介绍；覆盖 [1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

patterns.name: 法律意见的裁判结论与程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对案件的裁定或结论部分，常与发回重审、撤销、判决及后续程序相邻。
patterns.domain: 上诉法院意见与裁判文书；覆盖 [3][10]

patterns.name: 法院版式中的姓名署名与案件元数据
patterns.context: 姓名周围出现法院层级、法官职衔、案件号、上诉来源或意见标题等版式信息；部分激活落在标题、职衔或案件字段而非姓名。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见首页、案头信息及署名栏；覆盖 [2][6][7][8]
