en.description: Primarily responds to the headings and formulaic language of U.S. appellate opinions: court and circuit, judges and panel, docket numbers and dates, attorneys and parties, opinion type, and affirmance or reversal. Also covers merits language, citations to Tennessee rules, and docket numbers.

patterns.name: Judge names in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Judge names or opinion-author signatures in legal opinions; activation concentrates on subword fragments within names, especially surnames

patterns.name: Circuit court panel judge lists
patterns.context: Panel-member sections at the beginning of opinions, typically introduced by Before and listing judges and titles
patterns.domain: U.S. federal circuit court of appeals opinions

patterns.name: Appellate case-header information and court identifiers
patterns.context: Formatted metadata in an opinion’s first page or case-title area, often appearing with line breaks, numbers, and abbreviations

patterns.name: Opinion disposition markers
patterns.context: Disposition at the end of an appellate opinion or in its title area; includes both affirmance and reversal

patterns.name: Court opinion or memorandum document type
patterns.context: Labels indicating the nature or author of an opinion or memorandum

patterns.name: Counsel and party information
patterns.context: Counsel appearance information before the body of a case, or party labels in the header
patterns.domain: Opinion documents and case docket metadata

patterns.name: Tennessee appellate rule citations
patterns.context: Citations to state appellate procedure rules in Tennessee appellate opinions, followed by a rule number or adjudicative language

patterns.name: Conclusions and error-review language in judicial reasoning
patterns.context: The court states in the body that the evidence supports a conclusion or that no error was found

patterns.name: Administrative case numbers and other docket fields
patterns.context: Numbers, agency fields, and party names in docket or case indexes, not presented as ordinary opinion text

patterns.name: Dates and scanned opinion-header layout
patterns.context: Dates on the first page of appellate opinions, or number formatting split by scanning/OCR

7_2521.concept: 美国上诉判决文书格式
7_2521.description: 主要响应美国上诉判决的案头与格式化语言：法院及巡回区、法官姓名和合议庭、案号日期、律师与当事方、意见类型及维持或撤销结果；也覆盖正文裁判措辞、田纳西规则引文和档案编号。

patterns.name: 上诉法院意见中的法官姓名署名
patterns.trigger: 姓名被分词大写标记，如 «AL»…«AN»…« E»…« GL»…«ENN»、«BE»…«N»…«NET»…«T»；随后常见 «J»., « delivered» the «opinion»
patterns.context: 法律意见书中法官姓名或意见作者署名；激活集中在姓名内部片段，尤其是姓氏
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决文书

patterns.name: 巡回法院合议庭法官名单
patterns.context: 意见书开头的合议庭成员栏，通常以 Before 引出，并列出法官姓名与职务
patterns.domain: 美国联邦巡回上诉法院判决文书

patterns.name: 上诉案件案头信息与法院标识
patterns.trigger: «United» «States» Court of «Appeals»、«Circuit»，以及 «No.»、案号、日期、地区法院缩写
patterns.context: 判决首页或案件标题区的格式化元数据；常与换行、数字和缩写并列
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决文书

patterns.name: 判决结果标记
patterns.context: 上诉法院判决结尾或标题区的裁判结果；既包括维持，也包括撤销

patterns.name: 法院意见或备忘录文书类型
patterns.context: 判决文书标注意见或备忘录的性质、作者

patterns.name: 出庭律师与当事方信息
patterns.trigger: «for» «appellees»，以及律师姓名、事务所或地点；«Defendants-»
patterns.context: 案件正文前的律师出庭信息，或案头区的当事方标注
patterns.domain: 判决文书及案件档案元数据

patterns.name: 田纳西州上诉规则引文
patterns.context: 田纳西州上诉判决中引用州上诉程序规则，后接规则号或裁判措辞

patterns.name: 判决理由中的结论与错误审查措辞
patterns.context: 法院在正文中说明证据支持结论或认定未发现错误

patterns.name: 行政案件编号等档案字段
patterns.context: 档案或案件索引中的编号、机构字段和当事人名称，不呈现为通常判决正文

patterns.name: 日期与扫描版案头排版
patterns.context: 上诉判决首页的日期或扫描/OCR后被分开的数字排版

en.concept: Legal document layout and name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to legal opinion pages: specific letter fragments in names, court headers, judge and party sections, judicial language, and reasoning; also responds once to the book conclusion heading “CONCLUDING REMARKS”.

patterns.name: Tokenized names in court opinions
patterns.context: In court headers, party names, or judge names, names are split into irregularly capitalized subword fragments; activation falls on specific internal name fragments

patterns.name: Court layout and document structure
patterns.context: Appears in fixed layout positions such as court headers, presiding judge sections, party sections, or the end of an opinion, often accompanied by line breaks, whitespace, and docket numbers

patterns.name: Disposition and procedural phrasing
patterns.context: Phrases about the ruling, whether a judge participated, and the conclusion of an opinion

patterns.name: Legal terminology in judicial reasoning
patterns.context: The body discusses evidence, findings of fact, legal conclusions, or grounds for appeal, rather than just formatted header text

patterns.name: Heading for a book's conclusion
patterns.context: A conclusion chapter heading at the end of a book, rendered in all caps

7_2521.concept: 法律文书版式与姓名片段
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律判决页面：姓名中的特定字母片段，以及法院抬头、法官与当事人栏、裁判措辞和判决理由；另对书籍结论标题“CONCLUDING REMARKS”有一次响应。

patterns.name: 法院判决中的人名分词
patterns.context: 法院抬头、当事人姓名或法官姓名中，姓名被拆分为大小写不规则的子词片段；激活落在姓名内部特定片段上

patterns.name: 法院版式与文书结构
patterns.context: 出现在法院抬头、审理法官栏、当事人栏或判决结尾等固定版式位置，常伴随换行、空白和案号

patterns.name: 裁判结论及程序措辞
patterns.context: 判决结果、法官是否参与，以及意见书结尾等裁判程序语句

patterns.name: 判决理由中的法律术语
patterns.trigger: «trial»« court»、«evidence»、«findings»« of»« fact»、«conclusions»« of»« law»、«clear and convincing evidence»
patterns.context: 正文讨论证据、事实认定、法律结论或上诉理由，而非仅有抬头的格式文本

patterns.name: 书籍结论部分标题
patterns.context: 书籍正文末尾的结论章节标题，标题以全大写呈现
patterns.domain: 学术／宗教与科学主题书籍

en.concept: Uppercase headings and proper-name formatting in formal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to title words and proper-name fragments split into uppercase subwords in formal documents, especially legal citations, names, institutions, places, and judicial formatting. Also appears in statistical catalogs and email contact lists. Triggers on ordinary words in the first segment are sporadic.

patterns.name: Uppercase headings and title-word subword fragments
patterns.context: When an uppercase heading or proper name is split into multiple subword tokens, activation falls on uppercase word fragments; sometimes only part of a word activates.
patterns.domain: Book titles, legal document titles, names, etc.

patterns.name: Court and case layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Formal document formatting in court opinions, headers, or legal citations, with abbreviations, numbers, punctuation, and line breaks; not all citation tokens activate.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Names and uppercase name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Names appear among case parties, attorneys, judges, or signatories, often alongside titles, representation, court information, or comma-separated listings; activation favors uppercase name fragments.

patterns.name: Case disposition or judicial markers in legal documents
patterns.context: Near the disposition or panel description in an opinion; only a few disposition-word fragments are marked.

patterns.name: Abbreviations in directories and institution/law-firm names
patterns.context: Institution, law firm, or company names in formal directory format, often listed alongside names and locations.
patterns.domain: Attorney listings in legal documents and business email address books

patterns.name: Place names and regional labels
patterns.context: In listings of court jurisdictions, attorney addresses, or city and state names; locations appear alongside court or personnel information.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and attorney address directories

patterns.name: Catalog-style statistical headings
patterns.context: Books with uppercase, phrase-style headings or table-of-contents entries; triggers also cover split words in headings and a few adjacent uppercase fragments.
patterns.domain: Contents pages or chapter headings in historical/statistical publications

patterns.name: Loosely triggering words in general prose
patterns.context: Ordinary words appear in discussion text, but do not form a stable pattern across other examples; the same passage also contains a prominent chapter-heading format.
patterns.domain: Book prose on religious and scientific topics

patterns.name: Email contact names and address formatting
patterns.context: Email recipient/contact lists; names appear in all caps or split into subwords, followed by email addresses.

7_2521.concept: 正式文档中的大写标题与专名格式
7_2521.description: 主要对正式文档中大写、分词的标题词与专名片段反应，尤其是法律判决的引注、姓名、机构、地点和裁判格式；也见于统计目录及邮件联系人名单。第1段普通词触发较零散。

patterns.name: 大写标题及标题词的分词片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «REM»«AR»«KS»（REM AR KS）、«STAT»IST«ICS»、«Christ»«ine»、«MILL»«ER»；多个被标记片段也出现在 «CONCLUDING REMARKS»、«GENERAL STATISTICS» 等标题中
patterns.context: 全大写标题或专名被拆成多个子词 token 时，激活落在大写词片段上；有时同一词内只有部分片段激活。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、法律文书标题、姓名等

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法院与案件版式
patterns.context: 法院判决、案头信息或法律引注中，缩写、编号、标点与换行排成正式文书格式；并非所有引注 token 都激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书的人名及大写姓名片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名中被标记的大写或拆分片段，如“WILLIS SAMUEL”“VOGEL”“HECHT”“VAITHESWARAN”“ANDY D. BENNETT”“LAKEITH AMIR-SHARIF”“MILLER”
patterns.context: 姓名出现在案件当事人、律师、法官或签署者名单中，常伴随职务、代表关系、法院信息或逗号分隔的列名；激活偏向姓名的大写片段。
patterns.domain: 判决书及律师/当事人名录

patterns.name: 法律文书中的结案或裁判标记
patterns.context: 判决书的裁判结果或合议庭说明附近；只有少数裁判词片段被标记。

patterns.name: 名单和机构/律所名称中的缩写
patterns.trigger: «LLP»、«SC»以及“Department of Labor”“Foley & Lardner LLP”等名称内被标记的片段
patterns.context: 机构、律所或公司名称以正式名录形式出现，常与人名和地点并列。
patterns.domain: 法律文书的代理律师名单及商务邮件地址簿

patterns.name: 地名与地区标注
patterns.context: 法院辖区、律师地址或城市州名列示中；地点与法院或人员信息并列。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及律师地址名录

patterns.name: 目录式统计标题
patterns.context: 书籍中以大写、短语式标题或目录项目排列；触发也覆盖标题中的拆分词和少量相邻大写词片段。
patterns.domain: 历史/统计类出版物的目录或章节标题

patterns.name: 一般段落中的松散触发词
patterns.context: 讨论文字中出现普通词，但这些词没有在其他样本中形成稳定模式；同段还包含突出的章节标题格式。
patterns.domain: 宗教与科学议题的书籍正文

patterns.name: 邮件联系人姓名与地址格式
patterns.trigger: “RICK BROWN <…>”“PATRICK G. GOLDEN <…>”“PAUL KEELER <…>”中的大写姓名片段及尖括号邮箱地址
patterns.context: 邮件收件人/联系人列表；姓名以全大写或拆分子词呈现，邮箱紧随其后。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件及联系人名单

en.description: Primarily responds to formatted judicial information, judge names, and subword fragments of some attorneys or case names in legal documents; also activates on the proper name CHSH and a passage of ordinary Greek text, whose relation to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Split surnames in court judge names
patterns.context: In judge lists in U.S. federal appellate opinion headers, surnames are split into multiple subword tokens; activation concentrates on fragments within surnames.

patterns.name: Opinion titles and judicial dispositions
patterns.context: Formatted front matter such as the title, date, presiding judges, and disposition of an opinion or order; some uppercase titles are split into marked tokens.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and judicial documents

patterns.name: Case-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations or titles, proper names are split into subword tokens; not all case-name fragments activate.

patterns.name: Attorney and party names, locations
patterns.context: Attorneys, parties, or their addresses appear in litigation representation information; some subwords of surnames and place names activate.

patterns.name: Proper name in a statistical-physics inequality
patterns.context: A compound eponym related to Bell inequalities is segmented; activation falls on the hyphen and name fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word Greek letter fragments
patterns.context: Several Greek-letter subwords within ordinary words in continuous Greek text are marked; there is no clearly visible syntactic or semantic trigger.

7_2521.concept: 文书与专名片段识别
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律文书中的格式化判决信息、法官姓名及部分律师或案件专名的子词片段；也在 CHSH 专名和一段希腊语普通文本中激活，后两者与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: 法院法官姓名中的切分姓氏
patterns.context: 法院判决页眉的法官名单中，姓氏被拆成多个子词 token；激活集中在姓氏内部片段。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决格式

patterns.name: 判决标题及裁判结论
patterns.context: 判决或裁定的标题、日期、审理法官和裁判结果等格式化前言；部分大写标题被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与司法文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案件名片段
patterns.context: 判例引用或案件标题中，专有名称被拆分成子词 token；并非所有案件名片段都激活。

patterns.name: 律师及当事人姓名、地点
patterns.trigger: « Hogan»；« Hogan» & Hogan；« Leach»；« Washington»；« Rock»«ville»
patterns.context: 律师、当事人或其地址出现在诉讼代理信息中；姓氏和地名的部分子词有激活。
patterns.domain: 法院诉讼文书及律师名录

patterns.name: 统计物理不等式专名
patterns.context: Bell 不等式相关术语 CHSH 的复合人名被分段，激活落在连字符及人名片段上。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中，普通词内部的若干希腊字母子词被标记；没有明确可见的句法或语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to formatting markers in U.S. opinions: line breaks, Affirmed, judge signatures, attorney representation information, and opinion titles. Also includes the Greek word form for “scientist,” Weyerhaeuser in a case citation, and proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Opinion headers, conclusions, and judge signatures
patterns.context: Appears near line breaks, opinion conclusions, or trial-judge lists, often with court or attorney information
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Listing litigation attorneys and represented parties
patterns.context: Lists attorney names, cities, and the parties they represent, often in attorney information at the beginning of an opinion
patterns.domain: U.S. opinions and bankruptcy court documents

patterns.name: Case titles and procedural disposition markers
patterns.context: Appears in formatted headings such as case numbers, opinion types, or judicial dispositions
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, especially Pennsylvania appellate opinions

patterns.name: Specific Greek word-stem fragment
patterns.context: A Greek sentence contains a form of the word meaning “scientist,” followed by a negation such as «δεν»

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a legal citation
patterns.context: Appears in a citation name in a U.S. insurance-contract opinion, near a company name and case citation
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Fragments in company or law-firm names
patterns.context: Appears within fragments of personal/place names and the proper name “Streit”; there is insufficient context to establish a connection to other triggers
patterns.domain: Proper names in U.S. legal documents

7_2521.concept: 法律判决文书格式
7_2521.description: 主要响应美国判决书的格式标记：换行、Affirmed、法官署名、律师代理信息及判决标题；另有希腊语“科学家”词形、判例引证中的Weyerhaeuser及专名片段。

patterns.name: 判决书页眉、结论及法官署名
patterns.context: 出现在司法意见的换行、判决结论或审判法官名单附近，常伴有法院或律师信息
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律文书

patterns.name: 诉讼律师及代理方列举
patterns.trigger: «for»« appellee»；«for»« appellant»；«for» Debtor；«for»« Mov»ant；«for»« Respondent»；«of»« counsel»
patterns.context: 列出律师姓名、城市和其代理的当事方，常见于判决开头的律师信息
patterns.domain: 美国判决书及破产法院文书

patterns.name: 案件标题与程序性判决标记
patterns.trigger: «MEM»«ORANDUM» OF« DEC»«ISION»；«NON»«-»«PRECED»«ENTIAL»« DEC»«ISION»；«DEC»«ISION»« WITHOUT»« PUBL»«ISHED»« OPINION»；«J»-«S»编号
patterns.context: 出现在案件编号、判决类型或裁判结果等格式化标题中
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决，尤其宾夕法尼亚州上诉判决

patterns.name: 特定希腊语词干片段
patterns.context: 希腊语句子中出现指“科学家”的词形，后接«δεν»等否定语境

patterns.name: 法律引证中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在美国保险合同判决的引证姓名中，邻近公司名称与判例引文
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见及判例引证

patterns.name: 公司或律师事务所名称中的片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在姓名/地名残片及“Streit”等专名内部，缺少足以确认与其他触发相关的上下文
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书中的专名

en.concept: Proper names and formatting markers in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names and template strings in legal documents that are unusually capitalized, split, or formatted: attorneys, parties, court and judge names, institution names, court headers, and case citations; also occurs on intra-word fragments in Swedish parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Names and titles in court opinions
patterns.context: In the header or conclusion of a court opinion, attorney, party, and judge names and titles are formatted with unusual capitalization or word segmentation; often accompanied by AFFIRMED/Affirmed.

patterns.name: Party names and docket-number formatting
patterns.context: On a case cover page or in a caption, names are split into uppercase letter fragments and co-occur with parentheses, docket numbers, aligned spaces, and similar formatting.

patterns.name: Attorney names and law-firm credits
patterns.context: Credits for counsel appearing or representing a party in a decision, listing names, law firms, and cities.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Swedish political speeches
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, words are marked as segmented; the passage mentions Jean-Marie Le Pen, applause by members, and his latest statement.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records / Swedish political speeches

patterns.name: Institution and party names in case captions
patterns.context: Institution names, party names, and litigation capacities such as representatives of an estate appear in uppercase or split-uppercase form in a case caption.

patterns.name: Pennsylvania appellate court non-precedential decision header
patterns.context: The header contains a docket number, a non-precedential designation, the Superior Court of Pennsylvania, and Commonwealth of Pennsylvania; similar templates recur.

patterns.name: Case citations and cited company names
patterns.context: Legal arguments contain ambiguous provisions, case citations, citation signal words, and company or insurance company names.

7_2521.concept: 法律文书中的专名与格式标记
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律文书中被异常大写、拆分或格式化的专名与模板词串：律师、当事人、法院及法官姓名、机构名称、法院标头和判例引证；另见瑞典语议会发言中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法庭意见中的姓名及头衔
patterns.context: 法院意见的页眉或结尾，律师、当事人、法官姓名和职衔以异常大小写或分词形式排版；常伴随 AFFIRMED/Affirmed。

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人姓名与案号排版
patterns.context: 案件首页或标题区，姓名被拆成大写字母片段，并与括号、案号、对齐空格等格式共现。

patterns.name: 律师姓名及律所署名
patterns.context: 判决中的出庭律师或代理律师署名，列出姓名、律所及所在城市。

patterns.name: 瑞典语政治发言中的词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，词语被拆分标记；谈及让·玛丽·勒庞、议员鼓掌及其最新声明。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录／瑞典语政治演讲

patterns.name: 案件标题中的机构与当事人名称
patterns.context: 案件标题区以大写或拆分大写形式呈现机构名、当事人名及代表遗产等诉讼身份。

patterns.name: 宾夕法尼亚州上诉法院非先例判决标头
patterns.context: 标头包含案件编号、非先例声明、宾夕法尼亚州高级法院及 Commonwealth of Pennsylvania；重复出现近似模板。
patterns.domain: 宾夕法尼亚州上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 判例引证及引用的公司名称
patterns.trigger: « Corp» ... « (»quoting ... We«yer»«ha»«e»«user» Co. ... Commercial« Union» Ins
patterns.context: 法律论证中出现模糊条款、判例引证、引文提示词及公司或保险公司名称。

en.description: Strongly responds to the layout and formulaic content of legal opinions: line breaks, judge lists, attorney and party information, case metadata, and disposition words. Also includes specialized fragments related to benefits review, unpublished opinions, and criminal reversals.

patterns.name: Page-boundary line-break markers
patterns.context: At paragraph beginnings or after names and court information; markers are often followed by judge lists, dispositions, or docket numbers

patterns.name: Appellate court judge lists
patterns.context: Formulaic passages listing the judges who heard the case; often near the disposition

patterns.name: Disposition words
patterns.context: Brief dispositions near the end of a case or around the judge list

patterns.name: Attorney and party signature information
patterns.context: Lists counsel, party identities, and locations at the beginning of an opinion; names may be split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Legal opinions and appellate case records

patterns.name: Header language for labor benefits review boards
patterns.context: Case titles or review-source text related to labor benefits review boards

patterns.name: Criminal case disposition language
patterns.context: States that a conviction or sentence is reversed in a criminal appeal; this is not the common affirmed disposition

patterns.name: Unpublished opinions and Florida docket numbers
patterns.context: Unpublished opinions and their docket numbers and dates in Florida’s Fifth District Court of Appeal

patterns.name: Fragments of state litigation titles
patterns.context: Government, defendant, and appellant status text in a title or party section; the passage does not show the full opinion format
patterns.domain: Criminal case file or opinion excerpt

patterns.name: Other case numbers and court-division information
patterns.context: Case identifiers, court divisions, or page numbers, without a consistent nearby context

7_2521.concept: 上诉判决书程式语
7_2521.description: 对法律判决书的版式与程式化内容反应强：换行、法官名单、代理律师及当事人信息、案件元数据和结论词；兼含福利审查、未公开意见、刑事撤销等专门片段。

patterns.name: 页边界换行标记
patterns.context: 段首或姓名、法院信息后的换行处；标记后常接法官名单、判决结果或案号

patterns.name: 上诉法院法官名单
patterns.trigger: «Before»、«Circuit» Judges，以及全大写或分段大写的法官姓名，如«M»«UR»«NA»«GH»«AN»、«HOLLOW»«E»«LL»
patterns.context: 判决书中列出审理法官的程式化段落；常在判决结果附近

patterns.name: 判决结果词
patterns.context: 案件结尾或法官名单附近的简短处置结论

patterns.name: 律师及当事人署名信息
patterns.trigger: «for appellee»、«for Respondent»、«for appellant»及律师姓名、职务或地点
patterns.context: 判决书开头列明代理律师、当事人身份和所在地；姓名内部可能被拆分成多个 token
patterns.domain: 法律意见书及上诉案件记录

patterns.name: 劳动福利审查委员会案头语
patterns.trigger: «Ben. Rev»«.»« Bd»或«ON APPEAL FROM THE BENEFITS REVIEW BOARD»
patterns.context: 与劳动福利审查委员会相关的案件标题或审查来源文字
patterns.domain: 劳动法、福利审查上诉判决

patterns.name: 刑事案件处置措辞
patterns.context: 刑事上诉中说明定罪或量刑被撤销；此处不属于常见的affirmed结论

patterns.name: 未公开意见及佛州案号
patterns.context: 佛罗里达第五上诉区的未公开意见及其案号、日期

patterns.name: 州政府诉讼标题片段
patterns.context: 标题或当事人栏中的政府、被告与上诉人身份文字；该段未呈现完整判决格式
patterns.domain: 刑事诉讼案卷或判决书片段

patterns.name: 其他案件编号与法院分区信息
patterns.context: 案件识别、法院分区或页码等元数据，缺少统一的紧邻语境

en.description: Activations center on names and their segmented spellings, especially parties, attorneys, and judges in legal documents; they also occur in historical quotations, classical bibliographies, and email contacts. Often accompanied by legal formatting, roles, addresses, or citations.

patterns.name: Names in court case citations and captions
patterns.context: Names in legal case citations, captions, or party names are split into multiple subword fragments; names contain common name fragments or company names.

patterns.name: Names and job information in legal documents
patterns.context: Names of attorneys, judges, parties, and others appear in court documents, often adjacent to titles, courts, jurisdictions, or litigation roles.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, decisions, and court directories

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and concluding language in decisions
patterns.context: Near formulaic legal language concerning participant status, appellate roles, judicial opinions, or case outcomes.

patterns.name: Segmented headings and court formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatting positions such as headings, court abbreviations, judge signatures, and line breaks in decisions or memoranda.

patterns.name: Place names and addresses in legal texts
patterns.context: City, state, or regional addresses appear after the names of attorneys or representatives.
patterns.domain: Representative address blocks in legal documents

patterns.name: Signature names in U.S. historical documents
patterns.context: Names in quotations or bibliographies of historical documents are split into multiple subword fragments; here, the name appears in a letter signature.
patterns.domain: U.S. Revolutionary-era historical documents and quotations

patterns.name: Classical personal names in bibliographies or catalogs
patterns.context: Segmented names of classical writers or figures appear in bibliographic entries or catalog-style formatting.

patterns.name: Name fields in email address books
patterns.context: Contact names appear in email address lists, immediately followed by email addresses enclosed in angle brackets.

7_2521.concept: 姓名及人名片段识别
7_2521.description: 激活集中于姓名及其分段拼写，尤其是法律文书中的当事人、律师和法官；也出现在历史引文、古典书目及邮件联系人中。常伴随法律文书格式、角色、地址或引文。

patterns.name: 法院案件引文与案名中的姓名
patterns.context: 法律判例的引文、案名或当事人姓名中，姓名被切成多个子词片段；姓名中含有常见姓名片段或公司名称。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人名与职务信息
patterns.trigger: «TIM»5«OT»4«HY»4« P»3«.»2« DON»2«AH»5«ER»9»；«D»2«UNC»1«AN»5« W»4«.»4« KE»4«IR»9»；«Tim»1«othy»4« James»2 Paul«us»2»
patterns.context: 法庭文件中出现律师、法官、当事人等姓名，常与职位、法院、地区或诉讼角色相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律意见、判决及法院名录

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决结语
patterns.context: 诉讼参与人身份、上诉角色、法官意见或判决结果等法律套语附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的分段标题和法院格式
patterns.context: 判决或备忘录的标题、法院缩写、法官署名及换行排版等格式位置。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的地名与地址
patterns.context: 律师或代理人姓名之后列出城市、州或地区地址。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的代理人地址栏

patterns.name: 美国历史文献中的署名姓名
patterns.context: 历史文献引文或书目中，人物姓名被分成多个子词片段；此处是信件署名。
patterns.domain: 美国革命时期历史文献、引文

patterns.name: 书目或目录中的古典人物姓名
patterns.context: 书目条目或目录式排版中出现古典作家、人物的分段姓名。
patterns.domain: 文学书目、古典文学目录

patterns.name: 邮件地址簿中的姓名字段
patterns.trigger: L P«ERSON»4；L«ARR»4«Y»2« BL»3«ACK»4；« LU»1IS« MAN»3«U»9«EL»3 P«AD»1«ILL»6«A»2
patterns.context: 电子邮件地址列表中显示联系人姓名，姓名后紧邻尖括号包围的邮箱地址。

en.concept: Uppercase proper-name fragments in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase name fragments split into subwords in the disposition and judge-signature sections at the ends of legal opinions. Also appears in a party surname and “EXPERIMENTS” in a scientific book title, so it cannot be fully reduced to a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Judge names after opinion dispositions
patterns.context: After the judgment or conclusion, often followed by judge names, initials, and a note about participation in the opinion; activation mainly falls on uppercase name fragments split into subwords.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal opinions, especially disposition and signature sections at the end

patterns.name: Subword fragments of uppercase judge names
patterns.context: Appears in judge lists, panel lists, or presiding-judge lines at the end of court opinions; names are often printed in uppercase and split into multiple fragments by the tokenizer.
patterns.domain: Signatures, panels, and judge-participation notes in U.S. legal opinions

patterns.name: Fragment of the word experiments in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the book chapter title “THE EXPERIMENTS AND SPECULATIONS OF BOYLE, MAYOW, AND HALES”; there is no legal context or opinion formatting.
patterns.domain: Classical history of science or scientific book titles

patterns.name: Surname fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Appears in the party name “Maria Kristina HERNANDEZ” after a case citation; the name is printed in uppercase but is not a judge signature.
patterns.domain: Legal case titles or party names

7_2521.concept: 法律文书中的大写专名片段
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律意见末尾判决处置和法官署名中被拆分的全大写姓名片段；也见于当事人姓氏及一处科学书名中的“EXPERIMENTS”，无法完全归为单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 判决结论后的法官姓名
patterns.context: 判决主文或结论之后，常接法官姓名、缩写及其参与意见的说明；主要激活落在被拆分成子词的全大写姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律意见，尤其是结尾的裁判处置和签署部分

patterns.name: 全大写法官姓名的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见末尾的法官名单、合议庭名单或出庭法官行中；姓名往往以全大写形式排印并被分词器切成多个片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决的署名、合议庭及法官参与说明

patterns.name: 标题中的实验一词片段
patterns.context: 出现在书籍章节标题 “THE EXPERIMENTS AND SPECULATIONS OF BOYLE, MAYOW, AND HALES” 中；没有法律语境，也未见判决格式。
patterns.domain: 古典科学史或科学著作标题

patterns.name: 人名中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在案件引注后的当事人姓名“Maria Kristina HERNANDEZ”中；姓名为全大写排印，但不属于法官署名。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题或当事人姓名

en.concept: Signatures and end formatting in legal documents
en.description: Strongly responds to signature blocks at the ends of legal opinions, internal fragments of judge names, and titles such as JJ./J.; favors decision line breaks and concluding formats. Also responds to case citation abbreviations and one historical author name.

patterns.name: Chief justice / panel signature format in decisions
patterns.context: After the reasoning or disposition concludes, judge names, abbreviated titles, and concluding formats such as concur and affirmed appear; activations concentrate on segmented name fragments and nearby signatures.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions, appellate opinions, and case citations

patterns.name: Fragments in judge names and titles
patterns.context: Appears in judge or attorney names, often alongside commas, JJ., J., Circuit Judges, or Before; activations fall on internal name fragments rather than fixed complete words.
patterns.domain: Legal signature blocks, lists of judicial officers

patterns.name: Decision endings and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Near line breaks, disposition language, and signature blocks at the end of court opinions; whitespace and punctuation also provide layout context.
patterns.domain: Decision layout and legal document endings

patterns.name: Abbreviations and citation formatting in court references
patterns.context: Appears in case citations, volume numbers, or legal abbreviations, where digits, letters, and punctuation are interspersed.

patterns.name: Author names in historical document citations
patterns.context: Internal letter fragments in the titles and author names of historical documents; distinct from legal decision signature formatting.

7_2521.concept: 法律文书署名与末尾格式
7_2521.description: 强烈响应法律意见末尾的署名块、法官姓名内部片段及JJ./J.等职衔，并偏好判决换行和结尾格式；另响应判例缩写与一处历史作者名。

patterns.name: 判决书中的首席大法官／合议庭签署格式
patterns.trigger: «SM»3«ITH»10« and»3 K«5«AH»7«N»6«,»4 JJ«.,»5« concur»3；«BO»6«OTH»10« and»6 BR«6«OWN»8«ING»6；«PER»2« CURIAM»1；«MA»2«STR»6«O»4
patterns.context: 判决理由或裁判结果结束后，出现法官姓名、职衔缩写及 concur、affirmed 等结尾格式；激活集中在姓名被拆分的片段和署名附近。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、上诉法院意见及判例引证

patterns.name: 法官姓名及称谓中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在法官或律师姓名中，常伴随逗号、JJ.、J.、Circuit Judges 或 Before；不同姓名中激活的是姓名内部片段，而非固定完整词。
patterns.domain: 法律署名栏、审判人员名单

patterns.name: 判决结尾及换行排版
patterns.context: 法院意见末尾的换行、判决处置语与署名块附近；空白及标点也构成版式背景。
patterns.domain: 判决书排版与法律文书结尾

patterns.name: 法院引用中的缩写与引证格式
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、卷号或法律缩写中，局部数字、字母和标点交错。

patterns.name: 历史文献引文中的作者名
patterns.context: 历史文献书名和作者名的内部字母片段；与法律判决署名格式不同。

en.concept: Proper names and formatting in legal opinions
en.description: Primarily responds to judge names split into subwords in opinions, especially signature blocks and panel lists. Also appears in New York appellate division titles, disposition language, attorney lists, and a few rule citations and layout headings.

patterns.name: Fragmented spellings of judge names in signature blocks
patterns.context: Names appear as subword fragments in judge signatures or panel lists after the body or title of an opinion; titles, punctuation, or concur may also appear.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw opinion signatures, panels, and court headings

patterns.name: New York appellate division title format
patterns.context: Fixed title, department/division, and presiding-judge sections on the first page of New York court dockets, with docket numbers, line breaks, and spacing.
patterns.domain: New York appellate division opinion titles or docket first pages

patterns.name: Disposition and procedural language
patterns.context: At the end of an opinion or in its disposition section, announcing affirmance, reversal, or remand; often near judge signatures.

patterns.name: Appellate attorneys and counsel listings
patterns.context: Lists attorneys, law firms, and the parties they represent at the beginning of an opinion or in case information.
patterns.domain: Opinion case introductions and attorney appearance information

patterns.name: Citations to specific legal procedures or rules
patterns.context: Legal terms related to judicial rules, bankruptcy procedure, or appellate relief appear in the body of an opinion; this pattern is represented by only a few passages.
patterns.domain: Legal reasoning, procedural rules, and remedies

patterns.name: Section headings or opinion markers
patterns.context: Standalone uppercase headings at the beginning of an opinion or as note markers within an opinion.

7_2521.concept: 法律判决中的专名与版式
7_2521.description: 主要响应判决中被分词拆开的法官姓名，尤其署名栏和合议庭名单；也见于纽约州上诉庭标题、裁判处置语、律师名单及少量规则引用和版式标题。

patterns.name: 法官姓名在署名栏中的分片拼写
patterns.trigger: 姓名被拆成带引号的子词片段，如«SM»«ITH»、«BL»«ACK»«B»«URN»、«BO»«OTH»、«BR»«OWN»«ING»、«H»« O»«LLY»、«K»«UT»«SON»；常伴随«,»、«JJ»、«J»、«concur»
patterns.context: 判决正文或标题之后的法官署名/合议庭名单中，姓名以分词片段呈现；有时同时出现职衔、标点或 concur。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决书署名、合议庭与法院标题

patterns.name: 纽约州上诉庭标题格式
patterns.trigger: «ME COURT OF»« THE»« STATE»« OF»« NEW»« YORK»；«Appellate»« Division»、«Fourth Judicial»« Department»、«PRES»«ENT»
patterns.context: 纽约州法院案卷首页的固定标题与庭别/部门、审理法官栏，伴随案号、换行和排版空格。
patterns.domain: 纽约州上诉庭判决标题或案卷首页

patterns.name: 判决结论及程序性处置用语
patterns.trigger: « affirmed»、«AFFIRMED»、«Jud»«gment»« affirmed»、« remanded»、« vac»«ATING»« revocation order»
patterns.context: 判决末尾或处置部分，宣布维持、撤销或发回重审；常邻近法官署名。

patterns.name: 上诉律师与代理人名单
patterns.trigger: « for appellant»、« for respondent»、« for appellee»、« for»« the»« mother»、« for»« the»« child»
patterns.context: 判决开头或案件信息部分，列出律师、律所及其代理方。
patterns.domain: 判决案情介绍与律师出庭信息

patterns.name: 特定法律程序或规则的引用
patterns.trigger: « Tenn»«.»« R»«.»« App»«.»« P»«.»、« Chapter»« 13»、« remittitur»、« limitation period»、« damages»
patterns.context: 判决正文中出现司法规则、破产程序或上诉救济等法律术语；本模式仅由个别段落呈现。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、程序规则与救济

patterns.name: 段落标题或意见标记
patterns.context: 意见正文开始处或判决中的附注标记，呈现为独立大写标题。

en.concept: Proper names and signature formatting in formal documents
en.description: Strong responses commonly occur in judge signatures, decision dispositions, citations, and attorney lists at the ends of judicial opinions; also appears on book title pages, in Latvian parliamentary commentary, and in email address lists. The shared form is segmented fragments and formatting markers in proper names or formal document fields.

patterns.name: Judge signatures at the end of judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears at the end of decision text or after an opinion heading, often followed by commas, judicial titles, JJ., or signature formats such as concur(s); particularly responsive to segmented fragments within surnames

patterns.name: Decision conclusions and procedural dispositions
patterns.context: At the end of a decision or judicial opinion, expressing affirmance, reversal, remand, or a judge's opinion; often adjacent to judge signatures

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket-number formatting
patterns.context: Appears in legal arguments or footnote-style citations containing volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and case names

patterns.name: Attorney and party representation information
patterns.context: Lists attorneys, parties, and their roles in decisions, often ordered by name, location, and represented party

patterns.name: Publication information on book title pages
patterns.context: Title-page elements such as title, intended audience, place of publication, and publisher, accompanied by uppercase formatting and line breaks

patterns.name: Commentary and forms of address for legislators in Latvian
patterns.context: Latvian sentences mention commentary and members of parliament; words are split into subwords, with a personal name at the end

patterns.name: Email recipient address lists
patterns.context: Multiple contacts and organizational addresses in email headers or correspondence lists are separated by commas, slashes, and line breaks

7_2521.concept: 正式文书中的专名与署名格式
7_2521.description: 强响应多见于司法意见末尾的法官署名、判决处置语、引文和律师名单；另见书籍扉页、拉脱维亚语议会评论及邮件地址列表。共同形式是专名或正式文书字段中的分词片段与格式标记。

patterns.name: 司法意见末尾的法官署名
patterns.trigger: 大写姓氏被切成多个子词，如 «BO»5«OTH»10« and»4« BR»6«OWN»10«ING»6；«SM»4«ITH»9；«KN»5«UT»9«SON»5
patterns.context: 出现在判决正文末尾或意见标题之后，常接逗号、法官职衔、JJ.、concur(s) 等署名格式；对姓氏内部被分词的片段反应突出

patterns.name: 判决结语与程序处置
patterns.context: 判决或司法意见末尾，表达维持、撤销、发回或法官意见；常与法官署名相邻

patterns.name: 法律引文和案号格式
patterns.context: 出现在法律论证或脚注式引用中，含卷号、记者名缩写、页码及案件名称

patterns.name: 律师及当事人代理信息
patterns.trigger: « Gordon»…« for appellant»；« for»…« respondent»；« Attorney General»；« for»…« the mother»
patterns.context: 判决书中列出代理律师、当事人及其身份，常按姓名、地点、代表对象排列

patterns.name: 书籍扉页的出版信息
patterns.context: 书名、读者对象、出版地、出版社等扉页元素，伴随大写排版和换行

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语中的评论与议员称呼
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子中提到评论及议员，词语被切分成子词；句末接人名

patterns.name: 邮件收件人地址列表
patterns.trigger: «Commun»ications…@«Enron»；姓名与公司路径、邮箱地址连续排列
patterns.context: 邮件头或通信名单中，多名联系人及其组织地址以逗号、斜杠和换行分隔

en.concept: Legal document formatting and uppercase proper names
en.description: Primarily responds to the formatted structure of U.S. case-law documents: dispositions, judge lists, and judges’ uppercase names split into segments; it also covers citations, headers, attorney and party information. Other triggers include uppercase segmented text on book title pages and a few procedural and evidentiary discussions in legal prose.

patterns.name: Opinion conclusions and judicial dispositions
patterns.context: At the end of an opinion, stating affirmance, reversal, remand, or a judge’s opinion

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase formatting of judge names
patterns.context: Lists panel judges and their opinions at the end of an opinion; names appear as irregular subword fragments

patterns.name: Case citations and volume/page information
patterns.context: Legal text containing reporter volume numbers, reporter names, page numbers, or citations

patterns.name: Opinion titles, dates, and court headings
patterns.context: Dates, courts, districts, and judges identified at the beginning of a formal opinion or in procedural information

patterns.name: Legal personnel and party counsel information
patterns.context: Personnel information about party counsel or litigation roles in an opinion

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase text in publication titles and publication information
patterns.context: English words split into uppercase subword fragments on book title pages or in publisher names

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase party or institution names
patterns.context: Institutions, place names, or proper names in legal prose; uppercase words may appear split into subwords but are not necessarily judge lists

patterns.name: Legal reasoning about defendants and burden of proof
patterns.context: Discusses whether a statute is unconstitutional and how the burden of proof is allocated; functional words appear split or marked within sentences

patterns.name: Conviction reversal and new hearing procedure
patterns.context: States that the trial court will conduct a new violation hearing on remand

7_2521.concept: 法律文书格式与大写专名
7_2521.description: 主要响应美国判例文书的格式化结构：判决结果、法官名单及其分块大写姓名，也覆盖引注、抬头、律师与当事人信息；另有书籍扉页大写分词，以及少数法律正文程序和举证论述。

patterns.name: 法院判决结尾与裁判处置
patterns.context: 判决正文末尾，说明维持、撤销、发回等结果，或法官意见

patterns.name: 法官姓名的分块大写格式
patterns.context: 判决末尾列出合议庭法官及其意见；姓名以不规则子词片段呈现

patterns.name: 判例引注与卷页信息
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现报告集卷号、法院报告集名称、页码或引注

patterns.name: 判决书的标题、日期与法院抬头
patterns.trigger: «Decided» September 18, 1958；«SUPRE»ME COURT OF« THE»« STATE» OF« NEW» YORK
patterns.context: 正式判决书开头或程序信息部分，标示日期、法院、司法区及法官

patterns.name: 法律人员身份与当事人律师信息
patterns.trigger: «lem»«ire»… for« the» mother；«Christ»«ine»… for« the» child；Plaintiffs and Appellants
patterns.context: 当事人代理律师或诉讼身份出现在判决书中的人员信息段

patterns.name: 出版物题名与出版信息中的分词大写
patterns.context: 书籍扉页或出版者名称中，英文词被拆成大写子词片段

patterns.name: 案件当事方或机构名称中的分块大写
patterns.context: 法律正文中的机构、地名或专名；大写词可能分词呈现，但不一定是法官姓名列表

patterns.name: 被告与举证责任的法律论述
patterns.trigger: « the» burden of proof to« the» defendant；« the» public
patterns.context: 论述法规是否违宪及举证责任配置，正文句中出现拆分或标记的功能词

patterns.name: 定罪撤销与新听证程序
patterns.trigger: « hold»…« another» violation« hearing»；« a»« new»« hearing»
patterns.context: 说明发回后由初审法院进行新的违规听证

en.description: Primarily responds to legal decision layout and language: uppercase, segmented judge surnames and signatures, and formulaic expressions such as affirmed, appeals, and court opinions. Also occurs in court headings, email addresses, weather headings, football commentary, and isolated subword activations.

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase fragments in judge names
patterns.context: Names are printed entirely in uppercase but split into multiple subword tokens; activations concentrate on internal letter fragments, especially surname fragments
patterns.domain: Court decisions, judge signatures, and panel lists

patterns.name: Decision and court closing format
patterns.context: Disposition, opinion notation, or judge signature section at the end of a decision, often accompanied by line breaks, punctuation, and uppercase formatting

patterns.name: Court names and jurisdiction headings
patterns.context: Court or state names appear in decision headers, court descriptions, or case backgrounds

patterns.name: Case procedure and adjudicative language
patterns.context: Describes appeals, injunctions, disputed matters, or court rulings, usually in the body or conclusion of a decision

patterns.name: Email contacts and organizational addresses
patterns.context: Names, departments, or company email addresses are separated by directory-style commas and include slashes, @, and line breaks

patterns.name: Weather layout headings
patterns.context: An all-uppercase section heading appears after the body, followed by weather forecast text
patterns.domain: News/weather layout in email or correspondence

patterns.name: American football commentary
patterns.context: Discusses team performance and how to limit an opponent, adjacent to a weather section heading

patterns.name: Highly activated subword fragments within names or words
patterns.context: Some activations fall on segmented name fragments or isolated common words and cannot be consistently explained solely by legal semantics or name formatting

7_2521.concept: 法律判决排版与署名
7_2521.description: 主要响应法律判决的排版与用语：大写、拆分的法官姓氏和署名，以及 affirmed、上诉和法院意见等公式表达。另见法院抬头、邮件地址、天气标题、橄榄球评论及孤立子词激活。

patterns.name: 法官姓名的拆分大写片段
patterns.context: 姓名以全大写形式排印，但被切分成多个子词 token；激活集中在姓名内部的字母片段，尤其是姓氏片段
patterns.domain: 法院判决、法官署名及合议庭名单

patterns.name: 判决与法院结尾格式
patterns.context: 判决末尾的裁判结果、意见说明或法官署名区，常伴随换行、标点和大写排版

patterns.name: 法院名称与司法管辖区标题
patterns.context: 法院或州名出现在判决抬头、法院说明或案件背景中

patterns.name: 案件程序与裁判用语
patterns.trigger: «Judgment affirmed»、«order of protection»、«appellant's remaining contention»、«The People appeal»
patterns.context: 描述上诉、保护令、争议事项或法院裁判；通常处于判决正文或结尾

patterns.name: 邮件联系人与组织地址
patterns.context: 人名、部门或公司邮箱地址以目录式逗号分隔，含斜线、@及换行

patterns.name: 天气版面标题
patterns.context: 正文后出现全大写栏目标题，后接天气预报文字
patterns.domain: 邮件或通讯中的新闻/天气版面

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球评论
patterns.context: 谈球队表现及如何限制对手，且邻接天气栏目标题

patterns.name: 姓名或词语内部的高激活子词片段
patterns.context: 个别激活落在拆分姓名片段或孤立常用词上，无法仅由法律语义或姓名排版稳定解释

en.concept: Legal judicial opinion format and wording
en.description: Primarily responds to court and judge names, party and counsel information, appellate outcomes, and orders in U.S. judicial opinions; also covers dates, case numbers, citations, and other formatting. Sporadic activation also occurs on weather headings and Latvian procedural terms in European Parliament records.

patterns.name: Court names, locations, and jurisdictions
patterns.context: Court or regional judicial authority names appearing in opinion captions, citations, or descriptions of rulings

patterns.name: Judge names and titles
patterns.context: Judge names, chief judges, or lists of panel members, including near judicial signatures

patterns.name: Case parties, attorneys, and representation roles
patterns.context: Case captions, counsel information, or descriptions of the parties and their representation

patterns.name: Terms for judgments, appeals, and outcomes
patterns.context: A court affirms, dismisses, or evaluates an appeal, often in the conclusion or summary of a ruling

patterns.name: Court orders and enforceable language
patterns.context: Formal wording of judicial orders, protective orders, or requests that a court issue an enforcement document

patterns.name: Judgment dates, case numbers, and publication status
patterns.context: Dates, case numbers, or publication status shown in the heading or conclusion of a judgment

patterns.name: Legal citations and law firm/attorney names
patterns.context: Citing precedent or listing attorneys, law firms, and related names involved in a case

patterns.name: Weather forecast headings in non-legal text
patterns.context: A weather forecast section heading appears abruptly after sports or conversational text

patterns.name: European Parliament procedure and Latvian names
patterns.context: Procedural records before a parliamentary vote, Latvian text, and speaker names

7_2521.concept: 法律裁判文书格式与措辞
7_2521.description: 主要响应美国判决文书中的法院与法官姓名、当事人及代理信息、上诉裁判结果和命令，也覆盖日期案号、引注等格式内容；另对天气标题和欧洲议会拉脱维亚语程序词有零星激活。

patterns.name: 法院名称、地点与司法辖区
patterns.trigger: « COURT OF»« THE»« STATE»« OF»« NEW»« YORK»；«Supreme Court of Wisconsin»；«District Court of Appeal of Florida»
patterns.context: 法院名称或地域司法机关名称出现在判决抬头、引注或裁判说明中

patterns.name: 法院法官姓名与职衔
patterns.context: 法官姓名、首席法官或合议庭成员列举，以及裁判署名附近

patterns.name: 案件当事人、律师及代理身份
patterns.context: 案件抬头、律师代理信息或对当事人及代理关系的说明

patterns.name: 判决、上诉及裁判结果用语
patterns.trigger: «Judgment affirmed»；«appeal»；«Affirmed»；«appeal is» «ordered dismissed»；«contention is without merit»
patterns.context: 法院对上诉作出确认、驳回或评价，常出现在裁判结尾或摘要

patterns.name: 法院命令及执行性措辞
patterns.trigger: «It is ordered that»；«special mandate»；«issuance of the order of protection»
patterns.context: 裁判命令、保护令或要求法院发出执行文书的正式表述

patterns.name: 判决日期、案号与出版状态
patterns.context: 判决抬头或结尾标示日期、案号、是否公开发表

patterns.name: 法律引注与律师事务所/姓名
patterns.context: 引述先例，或列出参与案件的律师、律所及相关姓名

patterns.name: 非法律文本中的天气预报标题
patterns.context: 体育或对话文本后突然转入天气预报栏目标题

patterns.name: 欧洲议会程序与拉脱维亚语姓名
patterns.context: 议会表决前的程序记录，拉脱维亚语文本及发言人姓名
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（拉脱维亚语）

en.concept: Proper names and formatting markers in structured text
en.description: Most activations occur on segmented uppercase names, judge signatures, court headers, party designations, and case citations in legal documents; other patterns include procedural disposition language, Latvian word forms, and cautious-advice phrases in forums.

patterns.name: Names in court decisions
patterns.context: In court documents, names appear in uppercase or segmented uppercase form, often in lists of judges, parties, or litigants; paragraph [4] also contains a recipient name.

patterns.name: Judge and panel title/list formatting
patterns.context: Lists of judges, judicial officers, or panel members appear around names; uppercase names, titles, commas, and line breaks jointly form court signature or decision formatting.

patterns.name: Court decision headers and document layout
patterns.context: Court names, reporters, dates, and other header information are presented with line breaks, abbreviations, and uppercase formatting.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions and official case reporters

patterns.name: Case parties and litigation designations
patterns.context: In case facts or the case cover page, names are associated with party status and litigation roles; especially evident in paragraph 1.

patterns.name: Case citations and docket numbers
patterns.context: Reporter abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and years appear in decision text in citation format.

patterns.name: Legal procedural disposition language
patterns.context: Appellate decisions discuss procedural remedies such as reversal, remand, and a new hearing; this pattern is prominent only in paragraph 10.

patterns.name: Complex inflected Latvian word forms
patterns.context: A sequence of Latvian word forms is split into multiple subword fragments in EU parliamentary text; unlike the surrounding legal English case format.

patterns.name: Cautious advice in webpage comments
patterns.context: A non-legal forum comment advises readers to interpret LSP cautiously; activations fall on common English phrases rather than proper names or court formatting.

7_2521.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与格式标记
7_2521.description: 多数激活出现在法律文书的分块大写人名、法官署名、法院抬头、当事人称谓及判例引证；另有程序处置语、拉脱维亚语词形和论坛中的谨慎建议短语。

patterns.name: 法院判决中的人名
patterns.trigger: 分块大写的人名，如 «HE»«CH»«T»、«JO»«E»« KE»«IM»、«W»«ILL»«IAM»« F»«.»« MA»«STR»«O»、«SM»«ITH»、«K»«AH»«N»
patterns.context: 法院文书中，姓名以大写或分块大写形式出现，常见于法官、当事人或诉讼参与者名单；段[4]也出现收件人姓名。

patterns.name: 法官及合议庭职衔/名单格式
patterns.context: 姓名周围出现法官名单、审理者或合议庭格式；大写姓名与职衔、逗号及换行共同构成法院署名或判决格式。

patterns.name: 法院判决抬头与文书排版
patterns.context: 法院名称、报告集、日期等抬头信息以换行、缩写和大写排版呈现。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及官方判例汇编

patterns.name: 案件当事人及诉讼称谓
patterns.context: 法院案情或案件首页中，姓名与当事人身份、诉讼角色相连；段1尤为明显。

patterns.name: 判例引证与案号
patterns.context: 判决文本中出现报告集缩写、卷页和年份等引证格式。

patterns.name: 法律程序处置用语
patterns.context: 上诉判决讨论撤销、发回及再次听证等程序性救济；本模式只在段10突出。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语复杂屈折词形
patterns.context: 一串拉脱维亚语词形被拆成多个子词片段，出现在欧盟议会文本中；与周围法律英语判例格式不同。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、拉脱维亚语

patterns.name: 网页评论中的谨慎建议
patterns.context: 非法律论坛评论中，提醒读者谨慎理解 LSP；激活落在常见英语短语而非专名或法院格式。

en.concept: Local subword fragments and name recognition
en.description: Activations span function words in several languages, fragments within Swedish words, and fragments of legal names, bibliography authors, and email contacts. Legal examples are especially concentrated on uppercase judge surnames, but the triggering forms are not consistent across contexts.

patterns.name: Function words and following collocations
patterns.context: In continuous English text, activation falls on common function words or prepositions; examples differ widely in syntactic position and meaning, with no single fixed collocation identifiable.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments and “överenskommelse”
patterns.context: Activation appears within words in Swedish parliamentary text; the strongest activation is on the final segment of “överenskommelse.”

patterns.name: Uppercase fragments in judge names
patterns.context: In judicial opinion headings, signatures, or lists of judges, names are split into uppercase subword fragments; activation is strongest on surname fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within bibliography author names
patterns.context: In bibliographic citations, activation falls on spelling fragments of an author's surname rather than other parts of the citation format.

patterns.name: Fragments within email recipient names
patterns.context: In email address lists, activation appears on surname fragments in contact names, followed by email addresses.

7_2521.concept: 局部词片段与姓名识别
7_2521.description: 激活分布在多种语言的功能词、瑞典语词内片段，以及法律姓名、参考文献作者和邮件联系人姓名片段；法律样本尤其集中于大写法官姓氏，但各处触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 功能词及其后续搭配
patterns.context: 英文连续文本中，激活落在常见功能词或介词上；不同例子对应的句法位置和语义差异很大，无法确定单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛文章、健康免责声明

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段及「överenskommelse」
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，激活出现在词内片段；高激活位于“överenskommelse”一词末段。

patterns.name: 法院法官姓名中的大写片段
patterns.context: 司法意见书标题、署名或法官列名处，姓名被拆成大写子词片段；最强激活集中于姓氏片段。

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名内部片段
patterns.context: 书目引用中，激活落在作者姓氏的拼写片段，而非引用格式的其他部分。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景技术/参考文献

patterns.name: 邮件收件人姓名内部片段
patterns.context: 邮件地址列表里，激活出现在联系人姓名的姓氏片段，后接邮箱地址。

en.concept: Fragments in proper names and cautionary prompts
en.description: Includes cautionary reminders and recommendation wording in health disclaimers; courts, judge names, and formatted headings in legal texts; and subword fragments in folk-music terms and email contact names. Activation also often falls on proper names, capitalization, or token boundaries.

patterns.name: Cautionary reminders and recommendations
patterns.context: Activation falls on words in be/careful/how/they and be/sure/consult/your/physician/before, among others; the former advises careful interpretation, while the latter recommends seeking medical advice in a product disclaimer.

patterns.name: Formatted proper names and headings in court documents
patterns.context: Appears in formatted positions in legal documents such as judgments, appellate opinions, citations, or court headings; activation often falls on subword fragments of uppercase names and on institution names.

patterns.name: Musicians and folk-related word fragments
patterns.context: A biographical profile mentions a folk band or musician; activation appears on the word folk and adjacent word fragments.

patterns.name: Name fragments in email addresses
patterns.context: Appears in email recipient names and address lists; activation corresponds to internal fragments of uppercase names rather than ordinary sentence meaning.

7_2521.concept: 专名及提示语中的片段
7_2521.description: 包括谨慎提醒与健康免责声明中的建议措辞；法律文本中法院、法官姓名及格式化抬头；另有民谣词片段和邮件联系人姓名的子词片段。激活也常落在专名、大小写或分词边界上。

patterns.name: 谨慎提醒及建议
patterns.trigger: “be careful about how they interpret”及“be sure to consult your physician before”
patterns.context: 激活落在 be/careful/how/they 和 be/sure/consult/your/physician/before 等词上；前者提醒谨慎解读，后者是产品免责声明中的就医建议。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、健康产品免责声明

patterns.name: 法院文书中的格式化专名与标题
patterns.trigger: 法院及司法机关名称、法官姓名或姓名片段，如“SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK”“WILLiam F. MAstro”“KNUTSON”；也包括“BOOTH”和“BROWN”“BR”“OWNING”等姓名分片
patterns.context: 出现在判决、上诉意见、引证或法院抬头等法律文书的排版位置，激活常落在大写姓名的子词片段及机构名称上。

patterns.name: 音乐人及民谣相关词片段
patterns.context: 人物简介中提到民谣乐队或音乐人；激活出现在 folk 一词及相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件收件人姓名及邮箱地址列表中，激活对应大写姓名的内部片段，而非普通句子语义。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件与联系人列表

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting in multilingual text
en.description: Activations are distributed across text types: be careful/consult in English advice, citations, proper names, and argument strings in legal cases, and sporadic subword fragments in Swedish and Portuguese parliamentary texts and code comments; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Advice wording in health disclaimers
patterns.context: Tells readers that the content is not intended to diagnose or treat disease and advises consulting a physician before taking a product.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffix fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within Swedish vocabulary, such as “vilket,” “övervägande,” and “överenskommelse”; the sentence concerns proposals, framework decisions, or energy.

patterns.name: Cautionary advice in English
patterns.context: Reminds readers to interpret a technical concept cautiously, preceded by “Once again reminding people to”.

patterns.name: Cautious translation guidance in program comments
patterns.context: A code comment explains that screen readers may not pronounce non-English words correctly and advises caution when translating.

patterns.name: Names and citation fragments in legal references
patterns.context: Case names, institutions, volume and page numbers, and case reporter citations appear in legal case references; activations include segmented proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Function-word strings in legal argument
patterns.context: Discusses not reading into a statute what is not in it and argues that legislative intent can be expressed through omission.

patterns.name: Character fragments in names of court personnel
patterns.context: In names and lists of judges, attorneys, and other court personnel, activations fall on character or subword fragments in capitalized proper names.
patterns.domain: U.S. appellate court decision signatures/appearance information

patterns.name: Digits and proper-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations occur near volume numbers, page numbers, years, and institution names in reporter citation formats.

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary votes and applause markers
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech says a political group supports a commitment and hopes to receive Parliament's support, followed by a parenthetical applause marker.

7_2521.concept: 多语文本中的局部词片段与格式
7_2521.description: 激活分布于多类文本：英语劝告中的 be careful/consult，法律判例的引证、专名与论证词串，以及瑞典语、葡萄牙语议会文本和代码注释中的零散子词片段；缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 健康免责声明中的建议措辞
patterns.trigger: « be»« sure»、« consult»« your»« physician»« before»« taking»
patterns.context: 告知读者内容不用于诊治疾病，并建议服用产品前咨询医生。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词汇内部的子词片段，如“vilket”“övervägande”“överenskommelse”；句子涉及提案、框架决定或能源。

patterns.name: 英语劝告中的谨慎提示
patterns.context: 提醒读者谨慎理解某项技术概念，前接“Once again reminding people to”。

patterns.name: 程序注释中的谨慎翻译提示
patterns.context: 代码注释说明屏幕阅读器可能无法正确朗读非英语词汇，要求翻译时小心。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释/无障碍本地化

patterns.name: 法律引用中的名称与引证片段
patterns.context: 法律判例引用中出现案名、机构名及卷页和判例汇编引证；激活包含被拆分的专名片段。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的功能词串
patterns.trigger: «into»« a»« statute»« that»« is»« not»« there»，以及« anything»、« well»、« as»
patterns.context: 讨论不得把法条中不存在的内容读入法条，并论述立法意图可由遗漏表达。

patterns.name: 法院人员姓名的字符片段
patterns.context: 法官、律师等姓名及法院人员名单中，激活落在大小写专名的字符或子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决书署名/出庭信息

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字及专名片段
patterns.context: 报告引证格式中，卷号、页码、年份及机构名称附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 葡语议会表决与掌声标记
patterns.context: 议会发言称政治团体支持承诺并希望获得议会支持，随后以括号标注掌声。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会记录

en.description: Activations span fragments within Swedish and Latvian words, legal terminology, citations, and signatures; English examples also include caution/consultation prompts, disclaimers, code comments, and physical formulas. Marked spans are scattered and do not reduce to one stable lexical meaning or grammatical feature.

patterns.name: English while clauses and careful
patterns.context: In advisory or explanatory contexts, be careful is followed by while + an action; similar examples occur in instructions such as be sure to / before taking.
patterns.domain: Software comments, academic papers, and medical disclaimers

patterns.name: Procedures and wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal opinions, litigation rules, or affidavit text; activation is distributed across legal terms, common function words, and areas near attorneys' names/signatures, with no evident single trigger word.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal substrings
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur inside continuous Swedish words, such as vilket, över…g…, and …om…; markings inconsistently fall at multiple positions within words.

patterns.name: Latvian fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments in Latvian parliamentary speeches; markings span different words and character sequences, with no clear shared meaning or stable syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Disclaimers and website liability wording
patterns.context: Reader-facing disclaimers, limitations of liability, or action prompts; markings are scattered across common function words and prompts.

patterns.name: Code comments and direction attributes
patterns.context: Direction attributes and screen-reader-related comments in code snippets; the same passage also includes translation reminders, with activation not concentrated on a single identifier.

patterns.name: Numbers and citations in legal references
patterns.context: Several activation fragments occur near court abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and year numbers in case citations.

patterns.name: Attorney names and signature formatting
patterns.context: Activation appears near attorney names, law firm names, and all-uppercase signatures broken across lines at the end of legal opinions.

patterns.name: Physics symbols and cautionary prompts
patterns.context: A limiting condition appears in a derivation, followed by while taking as a caution; whether the formula symbols themselves trigger activation is uncertain.

7_2521.concept: none
7_2521.description: 激活跨瑞典语、拉脱维亚语词内碎片，以及法律术语、引证和署名；英语中还见谨慎/咨询提示、免责声明、代码注释与物理公式。各处标记分散，难以归结为单一稳定词义或语法特征。

patterns.name: 英语中的 while 小句及 careful
patterns.trigger: [3] “be careful while translating it”; [10] “be very careful while taking”；另有 [2] “Please be sure to consult your physician before taking”
patterns.context: 在劝告或说明语境中，be careful 后接 while + 动作；相近地也出现在 be sure to / before taking 的指示语中。
patterns.domain: 软件注释、学术论文及医疗免责声明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与措辞
patterns.trigger: [5] “administer oaths or affirmations”, “affidavit”; [7] “a party may amend his pleading only by leave of court”; [8] “Affirmed by unpublished per curiam opinion”, “Appellant Pro Se”
patterns.context: 法律意见、诉讼规则或宣誓书文本，激活分布在法律术语、常见功能词及律师姓名/署名附近，没有显然统一的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子串
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续词内部出现被标记的片段，如 vilket、över…g…、…om…；标记不稳定地落在词内多个位置。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语碎片
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语议会发言中的词内片段，标记跨越不同词及字符组合，未见明确共同词义或稳定句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 免责声明与网站责任措辞
patterns.trigger: [2] “not intended to diagnose…”, “consult your physician”; [9] “remove it ASAP”, “DMCA”, “no control and take no responsibility”
patterns.context: 面向读者的免责声明、责任限制或行动提示；标记散布于常见功能词及提示语中。
patterns.domain: 网页医疗及版权/网站免责声明

patterns.name: 代码注释与方向属性
patterns.context: 代码片段中方向属性和屏幕阅读器相关注释；同段还含翻译提醒，激活未集中于单一标识符。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与引证
patterns.context: 判例引证的法院缩写、卷页和年份编号附近出现若干激活片段。

patterns.name: 律师姓名与署名排版
patterns.context: 法律意见末尾的律师姓名、律所名及排版拆分的全大写署名附近激活。

patterns.name: 物理学符号与谨慎提示
patterns.context: 公式推导中出现极限条件，并以 while taking 提醒谨慎处理；公式符号本身是否触发不确定。

en.concept: Local word fragments and cautionary wording
en.description: Activations are scattered across professional-consultation, liability, and cautionary language in disclaimers; cautious translation reminders in software comments; fairness language in legal texts; and word-internal fragments and uppercase name fragments in multilingual text. There is no single stable trigger across these passages.

patterns.name: Consult a professional first
patterns.context: In disclaimers or risk notices, readers are advised to consult a doctor or advisor before taking medical or investment action; activation is strongest near “before” and the subsequent action phrase

patterns.name: Careful handling and translation
patterns.context: Notes about screen readers and non-English words advise caution when translating

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Subword fragments within continuous Swedish text; activation falls near split word forms or affixes, without consistent word meaning

patterns.name: Name fragments in lists
patterns.context: Fragments within player names in a tennis qualifying tournament list

patterns.name: Uppercase name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within names printed in uppercase in judgment signatures or judge names

patterns.name: Legal rules and fairness wording
patterns.context: A citation to rules for amending pleadings discusses permission to amend and the standard of justice

patterns.name: Liability and cautionary wording in disclaimers
patterns.context: In disclaimers about website links, third-party content, and users' own judgment, activation spans negation, liability, and relational words

7_2521.concept: 局部词片段与谨慎措辞
7_2521.description: 激活分散于免责声明中的专业咨询、责任与谨慎措辞，软件注释中的谨慎翻译提示，法律文本的公正语境，以及多语种文本中词内片段和大写人名片段；各段没有统一的稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 建议先咨询专业人士
patterns.trigger: “before« taking»”及“« your» physician”“« Consult»”“« before» making”
patterns.context: 免责声明或风险提示中，建议采取医疗或投资行动之前征询医生或顾问；在“before”及其后行动短语附近激活较强
patterns.domain: 健康与投资网站免责声明

patterns.name: 谨慎处理与翻译
patterns.context: 关于屏幕阅读器和非英语词汇的说明中，提示翻译时应谨慎

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段及词界
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中的词内子词片段；激活落在拆分的词形或词缀附近，具体词义并不统一

patterns.name: 名单中的名字片段
patterns.context: 网球赛事资格赛球员名单中的人名内部片段

patterns.name: 法律引文中的大写姓名片段
patterns.context: 判决书署名或法官姓名以大写形式排印，激活落在姓名内部片段

patterns.name: 法律规则与公正用语
patterns.context: 诉状修订规则的引文中，谈及法院准许修订及公正标准

patterns.name: 免责声明中的责任与谨慎措辞
patterns.context: 网站链接、第三方内容及用户自行判断的责任免责声明中，激活覆盖否定、责任及关系词

en.description: Activation often occurs on a prior action or prompt introduced by before; it also appears with cautious behavior after while, legal conditional clauses, and split word forms. The word-internal fragment in a Swedish agreement term does not readily fit the English pattern.

patterns.name: Advice or action following before
patterns.context: before introduces an action that must be taken first, often in medical, investment, licensing, or purchasing advice; across contexts, activation falls on before or a following word

patterns.name: Cautious behavior following while
patterns.context: while introduces an action such as translating or browsing, with a preceding reminder, caution, or disclaimer

patterns.name: Conditions or discretion in legal texts
patterns.context: Judicial discussion contains a condition introduced by when, or split word forms in statutes and provisions; a judgment conclusion also emphasizes that a party has lost

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, activation falls on split fragments within a word; the surrounding passage concerns an agreement reached last year

7_2521.concept: 先行条件与审慎提示
7_2521.description: 激活常见于 before 引出的先行行动或提示，也见于 while 后的谨慎行为、法律条件句及拆分词形；瑞典语协议词中的词内片段难与英语模式统一。

patterns.name: before 后接建议或行动
patterns.context: before 引出需要先做的行为，常见为医疗、投资、许可条款或购买建议；不同语境下激活落在 before 或其后续词上
patterns.domain: 免责声明、许可说明、产品信息

patterns.name: while 后接审慎行为
patterns.context: while 引出翻译或浏览等行为，前文带有提醒、谨慎或免责语气
patterns.domain: 软件注释、网站免责声明

patterns.name: 法律条文中的条件或裁量
patterns.context: 司法论述中出现 when 引导的条件句，或法规、法条的拆分词形；另有判决结论强调当事人败诉

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，激活落在被拆分的词内片段，周围谈及去年达成的协议

en.concept: Relational words and local boundaries in context
en.description: High activations often fall on relational words in clauses or phrases: before in advice contexts, when/while in conditional or ongoing contexts, and way in expressions of scope; unusually high activations also occur on hyphens in legal text and fragments in case names.

patterns.name: before preceding advice
patterns.context: After advice, a warning, or a disclaimer, before introduces an action to take first; common collocations include consult your physician/adviser or read it carefully. Activation falls on before.
patterns.domain: Medical product disclaimers, investment risk disclosures, and fund promotional materials

patterns.name: when in legal conditionals
patterns.context: Legal reasoning describes the circumstances under which a court permits amendment of a complaint; activation falls on when, followed by justice so requires.

patterns.name: while in translation guidance
patterns.context: Software comments remind translators of considerations during translation; activation falls on while, followed by a gerund phrase.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments, accessibility, and localization

patterns.name: while in disclaimers
patterns.context: Website disclaimers or usage guidance advise users to exercise judgment when browsing links; activation falls on while, followed by an action.

patterns.name: way in patent scope
patterns.context: In language disclaiming limitations on the scope of a patent abstract, way occurs in the phrase in any way; activation falls on way.

patterns.name: omission in legal terminology
patterns.context: The word “omission” is hyphenated across a line break in statutory interpretation, discussing omissions and legislative intent; high activation falls on the hyphen, possibly due to line wrapping or word form.

patterns.name: LAWLOR in a case name
patterns.context: The name LAWLOR in an appellate case caption is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on WL in the middle of the name, with no apparent semantic condition shared with other highly activated words.

7_2521.concept: 语境关系词及局部边界
7_2521.description: 高激活多落在从句或短语中的关系词：建议语境的 before、条件或进行语境的 when/while，以及范围表述中的 way；另有法律文本断词连字符和案名片段的异常高激活。

patterns.name: 建议前的 before
patterns.context: 在提供建议、警告或免责声明后，以 before 引出应先做的事情，常见搭配为 consult your physician/adviser 或 read it carefully；激活落在 before 上。
patterns.domain: 医疗产品免责声明、投资风险披露与基金宣传材料

patterns.name: 法律条件句中的 when
patterns.context: 法律论述中，说明法院准许修改诉状的条件；激活落在 when，后接 justice so requires。

patterns.name: 翻译指引中的 while
patterns.context: 软件注释中提醒译者在进行翻译时注意事项；激活落在 while，后接动名词短语。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释、无障碍与本地化

patterns.name: 免责声明中的 while
patterns.context: 网站免责声明或使用提示中，建议用户浏览链接时自行判断；激活落在 while，后接动作。

patterns.name: 专利范围中的 way
patterns.context: 专利摘要不限制发明范围的表述中，way 与 in any way 连用；激活落在 way。

patterns.name: 法律术语中的 omission
patterns.context: 法条解释论述中出现断词换行的“omission”，讨论遗漏与立法意图；高激活落在连字符上，可能受断行或词形影响。

patterns.name: 案名中的 LAWLOR
patterns.context: 上诉案件标题中的人名 LAWLOR 被拆成多个标记，激活落在名字中部的 WL；看不出与其他高激活词共享的语义条件。

en.description: Activations occur across various legal and disclaimer texts, often highlighting any, not, while, when, way, before, careful, and wording that qualifies, warns, conditions, or explains. The topics and trigger words differ across passages, and no single reliable rule covers them all.

patterns.name: while in cautionary prompts
patterns.context: Activation centers on a situation or ongoing action introduced by while; following content varies, including surfing, translating, taking, and incarcerated as described in legal provisions, with no consistent meaning.
patterns.domain: Website disclaimers, code comments, physics papers, legal texts

patterns.name: Legal expressions such as any way / any suit
patterns.context: any appears near negation, scope restrictions, or legal wording; following words such as way/suit also show strong activation.

patterns.name: Legal conditions and discretion
patterns.context: when/where introduces conditions or circumstances for applying a legal rule; justice and possible express discretion or conditions.

patterns.name: Product-consultation wording in disclaimers
patterns.context: Text limits the purpose of medical information and advises consulting a doctor before taking a product; not, before, and any show strong activation.

patterns.name: Third-party content disclaimers on websites
patterns.context: A website states that it is not responsible for linked third-party content and asks users to judge browsing risks for themselves.

patterns.name: Translation accessibility notes
patterns.context: Code comments remind translators to consider screen readers and non-English content.

patterns.name: Permission to amend pleadings
patterns.context: Discusses the standard for permission to amend a pleading after a deadline and the requirement of judicial fairness.

patterns.name: Procedural rules and imprisonment facts in legal judgments
patterns.context: Describes the timing of a prisoner's civil action or appeal and their incarceration status.

patterns.name: Constitutional jurisdiction and litigation
patterns.context: Cites the Eleventh Amendment and explains that judicial power may not be extended to certain types of suits.

patterns.name: Interpretation of legislative intent
patterns.context: Discusses that statutory interpretation must not read content into a statute and addresses legislative intent.

patterns.name: Procedural rules encouraging settlement
patterns.context: A regulation encourages parties to settle and states that the rule must not be interpreted to prohibit settlement.

patterns.name: Non-limiting nature of patent abstracts
patterns.context: A patent text specifies that the abstract does not define the invention or limit the scope of the claims.

patterns.name: Statutory text and headings in legal documents
patterns.context: A passage fragment mentions reading content into a statute and a heading on legislative intent; visible activations are scattered.

7_2521.concept: none
7_2521.description: 激活分布于多种法律及免责声明文本，常见高亮包括 any、not、while、when、way、before、careful，以及限定、警示、条件和解释措辞；各段主题与触发词并不完全一致，尚无单一可靠规则覆盖。

patterns.name: 谨慎提示中的 while
patterns.trigger: “while”后接动作或过程，如 “while«10 surfing»2”、“while«9 translating”、“while«9 taking”、“while«9 he”
patterns.context: 触发集中在 while 引出的情形或进行中的动作；后续内容分别是 surfing、translating、taking、法律规定所描述的 incarcerated 等，具体语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网站免责声明、代码注释、物理学论文、法律文本

patterns.name: any way / any suit 等法律表达
patterns.trigger: “in« any»5« way»10”、“in« any»5« way»9”、“« any»9« suit»8”
patterns.context: any 位于否定、范围限制或法律表述附近；way/suit 等后续词也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 法律条件与裁量语句
patterns.trigger: “when«9 justice»2 so«5 requires”、“« where»5 such deadlines”、“when»4 possible”
patterns.context: when/where 引出法律规则的条件或适用情形，justice、possible 等词表示裁量或条件。

patterns.name: 免责声明中的产品咨询措辞
patterns.trigger: “« not»5« establish»2 a«2 doctor…relationship”、“« before»10 taking…product”、“« any»4« disease”
patterns.context: 说明文字限定医疗信息用途，并建议服用产品前咨询医生；not、before、any 等词激活较强。

patterns.name: 网站第三方内容免责声明
patterns.trigger: “« no»5 responsibility”、“« any»5 content”、“which«8 we link to… while«10 surfing”
patterns.context: 网站声明对第三方链接内容不负责，并要求用户自行判断浏览风险。

patterns.name: 无障碍翻译注意事项
patterns.trigger: “screenreaders are« not»2…« capable”、“« non»-English”、“« careful»5 while«9 translating”
patterns.context: 代码注释提醒翻译者注意屏幕阅读器及非英语内容。

patterns.name: 法院准许修改诉状
patterns.trigger: “«a» party may« amend»… only… by leave of court”、“leave… freely given… when justice so requires”
patterns.context: 讨论逾期修改诉状的许可标准及司法公正要求。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的程序与监禁事实
patterns.trigger: “« any»3 civil« action»6… filed« while»9 he…«incarcerated”
patterns.context: 描述囚犯提起民事诉讼或上诉的时间条件与监禁状态。

patterns.name: 宪法管辖权与诉讼
patterns.trigger: “« any»9« suit»8 in law or equity”、“shall« not»4 be« construed”
patterns.context: 援引第十一修正案，解释司法权不得扩张至某类诉讼。

patterns.name: 立法意图解释
patterns.trigger: “not… read anything direct and plain out of a statute”、“Intent of the Legislature”
patterns.context: 讨论解释成文法时不得凭空读入法条内容，以及立法机关意图。

patterns.name: 程序规则鼓励和解
patterns.trigger: “All parties to proceedings… encouraged… settlements”、“in« any»5« way»10 to prohibit settlements”
patterns.context: 法规规定鼓励当事人和解，并说明规则不得被解释为禁止和解。

patterns.name: 专利摘要的非限定性
patterns.trigger: “« neither» intended to define”、“nor… intended to be limiting”、“in« any»5« way»9”
patterns.context: 专利文本限定摘要并非界定发明或限制权利要求范围。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的进入法条与标题
patterns.context: 段落残片提及将内容读入法条及立法意图小节标题；可见激活较分散。

en.description: Activations occur in judicial wording and formatting in legal documents, negation and liability qualifications in disclaimers, “jautājumā” in Latvian parliamentary text, and “careful while” in a translation note. A possible commonality is formal qualifying or document-boundary wording, but the evidence is not conclusive.

patterns.name: Conclusions and judicial wording in legal opinions
patterns.context: Legal documents discuss statutory interpretation, vacating or remanding rulings, legislative intent, and related matters; often appearing in formal argumentation or at the end of a judgment

patterns.name: Headings, parties, and personnel lists in legal documents
patterns.context: Court opinion headers, lists of attending judges, attorney signatures, or case formatting; can trigger even when the body text differs

patterns.name: Negation in disclaimers or restrictive notices
patterns.context: Disclaimers state that content is not for diagnosis, limit liability for website links, or specify that patent abstracts do not limit claim scope; qualifications concern negation, liability, and scope
patterns.domain: Health website legal notices, website disclaimers, patent text

patterns.name: Latvian issue/question term and its subword fragments
patterns.context: A word meaning “issue/question” appears in Latvian parliamentary text; strong activation is concentrated on character or subword fragments within the word

patterns.name: “careful while” in a translation warning
patterns.context: A code comment advises caution during translation; activation spans “careful” and “while” rather than an obvious legal or disclaimer context

7_2521.concept: 法律与正式限定措辞
7_2521.description: 激活分布在法律文书的裁判措辞与版式、免责声明的否定和责任限定、拉脱维亚语议会文本中的“jautājumā”，以及一条翻译注释中的“careful while”。共同点可能是正式限定或文书边界措辞，但并不充分统一。

patterns.name: 法律意见书的结论与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: “vacate the judgment”“remand”“All the Justices concur”“into a statute”“Legislature: Intent”
patterns.context: 法律文书中讨论法律解释、撤销或发回裁判、立法意图等；常出现在正式论证或判决结尾

patterns.name: 法律文书的版式标题、当事人及人员名单
patterns.trigger: “Gordon Wright, Minneapolis”“for appellant”“OPINION”“KNUTSON, Chief Justice”“PRESENT”“JJ.”及判例编号
patterns.context: 法院意见书的页眉、出席法官名单、律师署名或案件版式；即使正文内容不同也会触发

patterns.name: 免责或限制性免责声明中的否定措辞
patterns.context: 免责声明说明内容不用于诊断、网站链接责任有限，或专利摘要不限制权利要求范围；围绕否定、责任与范围作限定
patterns.domain: 健康网站法律声明、网站免责声明、专利文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语中的问答议题词及其分词
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语议会文本中出现“问题/议题”一词；强激活集中于该词内部的字符或子词片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 翻译警示语中的“careful while”
patterns.context: 代码注释提醒翻译时谨慎；激活覆盖“careful”及“while”，而非明显的法律或免责声明语境

en.concept: Conditional and qualifying expressions and text fragments
en.description: Visible triggers include prior-action reminders with before, situations or conditions introduced by while/when, in any way, and All the in judicial boilerplate, as well as subword fragments of uppercase names; the Greek passage shows only word-internal subword activation.

patterns.name: Advice or warnings introduced by before
patterns.context: In instructions reminding readers to consult a doctor, read a document, or take other action before proceeding, before is followed by the matter or action that must be completed first.
patterns.domain: Health disclaimers, financial product marketing materials

patterns.name: Behavioral contexts introduced by while
patterns.context: while is followed by ongoing actions: surfing the links, translating it; both remind readers to be cautious during the action.

patterns.name: Conditions or timing introduced by when
patterns.context: when is followed by a condition or timing: justice so requires, possible; appears in rules or procedural wording.

patterns.name: The collocation any way
patterns.context: The phrase in any way is used to negate or limit the scope of rules or patent specifications.

patterns.name: All in legal judicial boilerplate
patterns.context: All the is followed by Justices, forming judicial boilerplate describing agreement among judges in a court opinion.

patterns.name: Uppercase subword fragments in names
patterns.context: Appears near headings or signatures in judicial opinions; the trigger falls on uppercase surname fragments split into multiple subwords.

patterns.name: Greek word-internal subword activation
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, activation falls on fragments within words split by the tokenizer, with no clear English semantic cues.

7_2521.concept: 条件与限定表达及文本片段
7_2521.description: 可见触发包括 before 的事前提醒、while/when 引导的情境或条件、in any way，以及司法套语中的 All the 和大写姓名子词；希腊语段仅见词内子词激活。

patterns.name: before 引导的建议或警示
patterns.context: 在提醒读者采取行动、服用或投资之前先咨询医生、阅读文件等指令中，before 后接需先完成的事项或动作。
patterns.domain: 健康免责声明、金融产品宣传材料

patterns.name: while 引导的行为情境
patterns.context: while 后接正在进行的行为：surfing the links、translating it；均为提醒读者在该行为过程中谨慎行事。
patterns.domain: 网站免责声明、软件注释

patterns.name: when 引导的条件或时机
patterns.context: when 后接条件或时机：justice so requires、possible；出现在规则或程序性表述中。

patterns.name: any way 固定搭配
patterns.context: 短语 in any way，用于否定或限定规则、专利说明书的适用范围。

patterns.name: 法律裁判套语中的 All
patterns.context: All the 后接 Justices，构成法院意见中说明法官意见一致情况的裁判套语。

patterns.name: 人名的大写分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在司法意见标题或署名附近；触发落在被拆分成多个子词的大写姓氏片段上。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内子词激活
patterns.trigger: «κ»7 等希腊语词内片段；同段另有 «πισ»6、«υ»5
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中，激活落在被分词器拆开的单词内部片段，未见清晰的英语语义线索。

en.description: Activations are scattered across text types: English cue words such as before, while, and when; an internal fragment of the Latvian word jautājums; Greek intra-word fragments; and areas near legal document layout and headings. Only some examples show recurring word forms, and the whole set is difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Advice/caution wording or contrastive cue words
patterns.context: Introduces a temporal, conditional, or accompanying circumstance in a sentence, often in warnings, disclaimers, legal rules, or instructions; activation falls on the complete word itself, with inconsistent meanings across contexts.
patterns.domain: Website disclaimers, legal texts, software comments

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a Latvian question word
patterns.context: The Latvian word jautājums (question) is tokenized into multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on the medial «aut»; both instances occur in a topic/question-related context.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in a Greek letter string
patterns.context: A part of the Greek word ἐκκλησία (church), appearing in non-English text of a parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Layout/headings in legal opinions
patterns.context: Line breaks, page numbers, and opinion headings after attorney signatures; activations include punctuation and name tokens, with no clear lexical trigger.

patterns.name: before in investment warnings
patterns.context: Fund investment risk disclosures advise considering objectives, risks, and fees before investing; the same word as the before in [1], but in a different disclaimer context.

7_2521.concept: none
7_2521.description: 激活分散于多类文本：英语 before、while、when 等引导词，拉脱维亚语 jautājums 词内片段、希腊语词内片段，以及法律文档排版与标题附近。仅部分例子呈现重复词形，整体难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 建议/注意用语或转折引导词
patterns.context: 在句中引出时间、条件或伴随情境，常出现在警告、免责声明、法律规则或操作说明中；激活落在完整词本身，不同上下文语义并不一致。
