patterns.domain: 网页免责声明、法律文本、软件注释

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语问句词内部片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语词 j jautājums（问题）被分词为多个 token，激活集中在词中间的 «aut»；两处均处于议题/问题相关语境。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 希腊字母串中的词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语词 ἐκκλησία（教会）的一部分，出现在议会发言的非英语正文中。

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的排版/标题结构
patterns.context: 律师署名之后的换行、页码及意见书标题附近；激活包括标点和姓名 token，未见明确词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 投资警示中的 before
patterns.context: 基金投资风险提示中，要求投资前考虑目标、风险和费用；与[1]的 before 同词但属于不同免责声明语境。
patterns.domain: 基金招募说明书/投资者材料

en.description: Activations are scattered across conditions, permissions, and scope wording in legal rules; Greek word-internal fragments; and individual tokens in disclaimers, case names, and place names. Apart from some legal wording, no unified and confirmed trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Conditions, permissions, and discretion in legal or rule text
patterns.context: Near conditional clauses, permission/discretion standards, and way phrases indicating an unrestricted scope in formal legal argument or rules; specific syntax differs across passages.
patterns.domain: Case law, rules of procedure, administrative regulations

patterns.name: Greek word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within words in continuous Greek text, especially word segments split into multiple tokens; these examples do not establish a stable Greek lexical meaning or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: surfing in a website disclaimer
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the word surfing in a website disclaimer discussing third-party links and users' own judgment.

patterns.name: before in a medical disclaimer
patterns.context: In a medical disclaimer advising readers to consult a doctor before taking a product, activation centers on before, which marks temporal precedence.

patterns.name: Name fragments in court case headings
patterns.context: In a list of attending judges in a court judgment, names appear as segmented uppercase tokens; this example does not show a broader reproducible trigger.

patterns.name: Split tokens in proper names
patterns.context: In a description of Merced River, activation falls on a subword token of the proper name Joaquin; this is a single example and does not establish a general proper-name pattern.

7_2521.concept: none
7_2521.description: 激活分散在法律规则的条件、许可及范围措辞，希腊语词内片段，以及免责声明、案卷姓名和地名中的个别 token；除部分法律措辞外，没有统一且可确认的触发规律。

patterns.name: 法律或规则文本中的条件、许可与裁量措辞
patterns.context: 在正式法律论述或规则条文中，条件从句、许可/裁量标准，以及表示不受限制范围的 way 短语附近；不同段落的具体句法并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 判例、诉讼规则、行政法规

patterns.name: 希腊语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在连续希腊语文本的词内部，尤其是被拆分成多个 token 的词段；无法从这些样本确立稳定的希腊语词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 网页免责声明中的 surfing
patterns.context: 网站免责声明说明第三方链接及用户自行判断时，激活出现在 surfing 一词。
patterns.domain: 网页内容与法律免责声明

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明中的 before
patterns.context: 建议服用产品前咨询医生的医疗免责声明中，激活集中在表示先后条件的 before。

patterns.name: 法院案卷标题中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 法院判决的出席法官名单中，姓名以分段大写 token 呈现；该样本没有显示更广泛的可复现触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的拆分 token
patterns.context: 地名 Merced River 的介绍中，激活落在专名 Joaquin 的子词 token；单例，不能确认是否具有一般专名模式。

en.description: Activations often occur in formal notices or regulatory contexts involving restrictions, scope, and cautionary wording, as well as in an isolated disclaimer, code translation guidance, and Greek subwords; they do not reduce to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Broad negative/scope language in law or rules
patterns.context: In formal legal texts, negation words occur beside any, way, or suit and other scope or object words, often describing inapplicability, what may not be prohibited, or jurisdictional scope.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, regulations, and procedural rules

patterns.name: Disclaimers and advice before taking action
patterns.context: A health product disclaimer limits the intended use of the information and advises consulting a professional before taking action; activation is especially prominent on before physician.

patterns.name: Website liability and cautious browsing notices
patterns.context: A website disclaimer states that it lacks control over third-party links and reminds readers to use their judgment and browse cautiously.

patterns.name: Translation cautions in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments address localizers or translators and flag issues involving screen readers and non-English content.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword activations in Greek parliamentary text
patterns.context: Greek body text is represented as segmented byte-level or subword tokens; visible fragments concern appeals, shared political heritage, and Greek thought.

7_2521.concept: 限制与谨慎告知措辞
7_2521.description: 激活多见于正式告知或规范语境中的限制、范围与谨慎措辞，也见单例免责声明、代码翻译提示及希腊语子词；无法归结为单一词义。

patterns.name: 法律或规则中的宽泛否定/范围措辞
patterns.trigger: “not ... any ... way”、“shall not ... any suit”以及“when ... possible”
patterns.context: 在正式法律文本中，否定词与 any、way、suit 等范围或对象词相邻，常用于说明不适用、不得禁止或管辖范围。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规和程序规则

patterns.name: 免责声明与行动前劝告
patterns.trigger: “before taking this or any other product”
patterns.context: 健康产品免责声明中，告知信息用途有限，并建议行动前咨询专业人士；激活尤其突出 before physician。

patterns.name: 网站内容责任与浏览谨慎提示
patterns.trigger: “take no responsibility”“use your own discretion while surfing the links”
patterns.context: 网站免责声明说明对第三方链接缺乏控制，并提醒读者自行判断、谨慎浏览。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的翻译注意事项
patterns.context: 代码注释面向本地化或翻译工作者，提示屏幕阅读器及非英语内容的处理问题。

patterns.name: 希腊语议会文本的词内子词激活
patterns.context: 希腊语正文中以拆分的字节级或子词 token 呈现；可见片段涉及呼吁、共同政治遗产与希腊思想。

en.description: The core trigger is running, typically placed between a subject and software, a service, or an object of analysis to express a running state; it also has a running-apparel sense. Other activations involve question-and-answer formats, code paths, and domain-specific vocabulary in individual passages.

patterns.name: running software or services
patterns.context: Appears in expressions about running instances, programs, tests, analyses, services, or code; [5] describes a “running t-shirt” intended for use as clothing.
patterns.domain: Software Q&A, academic abstracts, product descriptions

patterns.name: Q&A titles and question formats
patterns.context: Q&A markers and title/body separators at the start of StackExchange questions; newline markers also occur in other formats.

patterns.name: Paths and code-file structures
patterns.context: Lists project directories and Python test files, then mentions using Pytest to run unit tests.

patterns.name: Flight behavior and motor skills
patterns.context: The abstract discusses the role of experience in fruit fly flight behavior and vertebrate motor skill acquisition.

patterns.name: Product titles and marketing copy
patterns.context: The product page describes an item as a running T-shirt for hot weather and includes e-commerce fields such as price and a sold-out notice.

patterns.name: Software test coverage
patterns.context: Mentions Angular.js, Karma, and Jasmine, and describes running coverage analysis on an application.

patterns.name: HTML lists and web generators
patterns.context: Discusses a display issue with HTML ordered lists when they encounter tables, and compares Jekyll with using Kramdown directly.

patterns.name: Puppet commands and environment errors
patterns.context: A Puppet command cannot resolve the production environment or find the master.pp file when run.

patterns.name: Queue and data-center code
patterns.context: Describes adding SocketHolder to a queue and discusses where code runs in a data-center environment.

patterns.name: Directory services and certificates
patterns.context: Discusses a read-only domain controller running on Windows Server 2012 R2 Core, as well as third-party certificates and internal names.

7_2600.description: 核心触发词是 running，常置于主语与软件、服务或分析对象之间，表达运行状态；另有跑步商品义。其余激活还涉及问答格式、代码路径及各段特定领域词汇。

patterns.name: running 软件或服务
patterns.context: 出现在正在运行实例、程序、测试、分析、服务或代码的表达中；[5]则是描述衣物用途的“running t-shirt”。
patterns.domain: 软件问答、学术摘要、商品描述

patterns.name: 问答标题与问题格式
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题开头的问答标记、标题与正文分隔格式；换行标记也见于其他格式。

patterns.name: 路径与代码文件结构
patterns.context: 列出项目目录和 Python 测试文件，后文提到用 Pytest 运行单元测试。

patterns.name: 飞行行为与运动技能
patterns.context: 摘要讨论经验在果蝇飞行行为及脊椎动物运动技能习得中的作用。

patterns.name: 商品标题和营销文案
patterns.context: 商品页面将产品描述为适合炎热天气的跑步 T 恤，并含价格、售罄提示等电商字段。

patterns.name: 软件测试覆盖率
patterns.context: 提及 Angular.js、Karma、Jasmine，并描述对应用运行覆盖率分析。

patterns.name: HTML 列表与网页生成器

patterns.name: Puppet 命令与环境错误
patterns.context: 运行 Puppet 命令时无法解析 production 环境或找到 master.pp 文件。

patterns.name: 队列与数据中心代码
patterns.context: 描述队列中添加 SocketHolder，并以数据中心环境讨论代码运行位置。

patterns.name: 目录服务与证书
patterns.context: 讨论 Windows Server 2012 R2 Core 上运行的只读域控制器及第三方证书、内部名称。

en.description: The strongest cross-context pattern is running: it is often used to describe software or services operating, and also appears in contexts involving running as an activity and running apparel. Structural markers such as line breaks and slashes also activate.

patterns.name: running as a verb form
patterns.context: Describes a program, service, environment, analysis, or operation in progress; the clearest shared trigger across multiple technical contexts

patterns.name: Other technical uses of running
patterns.context: Means operating or taking place in code and academic contexts; also refers to running as a skill or to merchandise described as suitable for running. The meaning is not software execution.

patterns.name: List markers and line-break structure
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and path separators in directory trees or lists; structural tokens outside the word running in prose also activate
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, file paths/list text

7_2600.description: 最强且跨语境的模式是 running：多用于描述软件或服务运行，也出现于跑步行为和跑步服装。另有换行及斜杠等结构标记激活。

patterns.name: running 作动词形式
patterns.context: 描述某个程序、服务、环境、分析或操作正在运行；是最明显的共同触发，覆盖多种技术语境

patterns.name: running 的其他技术用法
patterns.context: 在代码与学术语境中表示运行或进行：技能中的跑步行为，或商品所称适合跑步穿着；语义并非软件执行

patterns.name: 列表标记及换行结构
patterns.context: 目录树或列表中的换行、缩进和路径分隔符；与正文中的 running 之外的结构性 token 也有激活
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、文件路径/列表文本

en.description: All snippets contain highlighted “running/running down”; most refer to software running programs, tests, commands, or analyses, while others refer to biological movement, running apparel, or content extending downward on a page.

patterns.name: running as a verb form
patterns.context: The word appears in prose; it can mean a program, command, service, or test is operating, or describe movement, clothing, or content extending downward. In most snippets, the word itself is marked as the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Natural-language and technical text across domains

patterns.name: Running a program, service, or analytical task
patterns.context: In software or computing contexts, running means executing or operating a program, test, analysis, command, or service.

patterns.name: Movement or flight behavior
patterns.context: Paired with animal motor skills and flight, running refers to physical activity rather than software execution.

patterns.name: Use description in apparel copy
patterns.context: Running modifies t-shirt to describe clothing suitable for running, not an ongoing task.

patterns.name: Page layout or content extending downward
patterns.context: In a description of a PDF output problem, refers to content extending down one side of the page; distinct from the software-operation sense.

7_2600.description: 全部片段均含高亮的“running/running down”；多数是软件运行程序、测试、命令或分析，另有生物运动、跑步服装用途及版面向下延伸等义项。

patterns.name: running 作为动词形式出现
patterns.context: 词本身在正文中出现；可作程序、命令、服务或测试正在运行，也可描述运动、服装或内容向下延伸。多数段中该词直接标为最强激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言及技术文本

patterns.name: 运行程序、服务或分析任务
patterns.trigger: “running”及邻近的任务或对象，如“running a post-fix-dovecot email”“running some Python program”“running unit testing”“running Code Coverage analysis”“running all commands”“code is running”
patterns.context: 软件或计算机语境中，running 表示执行、运行某程序、测试、分析、命令或服务。

patterns.name: 运动或飞行行为
patterns.context: 与动物的运动技能和 flight 并列，running 指身体活动而非软件执行。

patterns.name: 服装文案中的用途描述
patterns.context: running 修饰 t-shirt，描述适合跑步穿着的衣物，而非正在执行的任务。

patterns.name: 版面或内容向下延伸
patterns.context: 出现在 PDF 输出问题的描述中，指内容沿页面一侧向下延伸；与运行软件的义项不同。
patterns.domain: 技术问答中的文档排版故障

en.description: Strongly responds to running (including sentence-initial capitalization and weaker variants of running), covering program execution, animal movement, running apparel, and the term running lights; domains and senses vary.

patterns.name: running meaning program execution
patterns.context: running occurs in the context of computing tasks such as code, programs, tests, or analyses, meaning currently executing or running

patterns.name: running meaning animal movement
patterns.context: Appears alongside flight behaviour and motor skills to describe animal movement or motor skills

patterns.name: running meaning apparel use
patterns.context: Modifies t-shirt to indicate clothing suitable for running

patterns.name: Fixed phrase running lights
patterns.context: running combines with lights to form a term for work lights hidden from theater audiences, not meaning “currently running”

7_2600.description: 强烈响应 running（含句首大写及较弱变体 running），涵盖程序运行、动物奔跑、跑步服装和 running lights 术语；跨领域与词义均有变化。

patterns.name: running 表示程序执行
patterns.context: running 出现在代码、程序、测试或分析等计算任务的语境中，表示正在运行或执行

patterns.name: running 表示动物运动
patterns.context: 与 flight behaviour、motor skills 并列，描述动物的运动行为或运动技能

patterns.name: running 表示服装用途
patterns.context: 修饰 t-shirt，表示适合跑步穿着的衣物

patterns.name: running lights 固定词组
patterns.context: running 与 lights 构成术语，指剧院中观众看不到的工作灯，并非“正在运行”

en.concept: The running word form and sporadic code markers
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the word “running,” across senses such as operating, taking place, and physical movement; also responds once to a code-comment separator and once to a namespace declaration.

patterns.name: The word form “running”
patterns.context: The word appears as a verb meaning that a program, service, system, or device is operating; it can also refer to a theatrical lighting term or animal movement. Its meaning and domain vary.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including Q&A, encyclopedias, and abstracts

patterns.name: Long-dash comment separator
patterns.context: Appears in a module header comment in a code file.

patterns.name: Code namespace declaration
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a code file, followed by a library identifier and braces.

7_2600.concept: running 词形及零散代码标记
7_2600.description: 主要对单词“running”强烈响应，涵盖运行、进行及运动等不同语境；另有一次对代码注释分隔线、一次对 namespace 声明的响应。

patterns.name: “running”词形
patterns.context: 该词作为动词出现，指程序、服务、系统或设备正在运行，也可指剧场灯光的术语、动物运动行为；语义和领域不固定。
patterns.domain: 问答、百科、摘要等多种文体

patterns.name: 长横线注释分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在代码文件的模块头部注释中。

patterns.name: 代码命名空间声明
patterns.context: 出现在代码文件开头，后接类库标识与花括号。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the complete word Conditions across multiple domains, often in titles or noun phrases; weaker responses also occur to Population in medical research titles and to a few health terms and sentence-initial Recently. The activations show no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “Conditions”
patterns.context: The complete word Conditions appears in Terms and Conditions, descriptions of conditions, or titles; it can occur in a phrase, sentence, or title.
patterns.domain: Business terms, web forms, patents, mental health materials, regulations, general prose

patterns.name: Population in medical titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of a medical abstract title, followed by pharmacokinetics or -based validation.

patterns.name: Modifiers and terms in medical titles
patterns.context: Words describing population health, lower levels, or comorbidities in health research titles or abstracts.

patterns.name: Title-like Recently near the end
patterns.context: The sentence-initial time adverb Recently, followed by a comma and an indefinite article.

7_2600.description: 主要强烈响应完整单词 Conditions，跨多领域但常见于标题或名词短语；另对医学研究标题中的 Population 及少数健康术语、Recently 句首有较弱响应。各次触发未显现明确统一语义。

patterns.name: 固定短语“Conditions”
patterns.context: 完整单词 Conditions 出现在 Terms and Conditions、描述条件或标题中；可位于短语、句子或标题内。
patterns.domain: 商务条款、网页表单、专利、心理健康材料、法规、一般叙述

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 Population
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题开头，后接 pharmacokinetics 或 -based validation。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的限定词与术语
patterns.context: 健康研究标题或摘要中描述人群健康、较低水平或合并症的词语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 文末附近的标题式 Recently
patterns.context: 句子开头的时间副词 Recently，后接逗号和不定冠词。

en.description: The strongest activations are scattered across wait, the beginning of skeptic, part of the case name Trib, and the abbreviation ASAP; there are also how within a URL and several isolated subword fragments. Contexts span forums, email, legal texts, and patents, with no unified semantic or stylistic trigger condition.

patterns.name: wait string
patterns.context: Appears as a complete word or a URL path fragment; context is not consistent.

patterns.name: skeptic substring
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion of the word “skeptic,” as a subword fragment at the beginning of the word.

patterns.name: Trible case-name substring
patterns.context: Appears in a legal case citation as part of a case name.

patterns.name: ASAP abbreviation
patterns.context: Means as soon as possible in a business email; appears at the end of a sentence related to planning.

patterns.name: how substring
patterns.context: The how fragment in a URL activates strongly, but peaks at 6, below this batch’s peak of 10.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Each appears in a different sentence, with no shared stable sense or context; recorded alongside the peak fragments.
patterns.domain: Pandemic discussions, astronomy, science fiction reviews, patent technical texts

7_2600.description: 最强激活分散在 wait、skeptic 词首、Trib 案名片段及 ASAP 缩写等；另有 URL 内 how 和多个孤立词片段。语境跨论坛、邮件、法律与专利文本，未见统一语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: wait 字符串
patterns.context: 作为完整单词或 URL 路径片段出现；上下文并不固定。

patterns.name: skeptic 子串
patterns.context: 出现在对“skeptic”一词的讨论中，位于单词开头的分词片段。

patterns.name: Trible 案名子串
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引注中，属于案名的一部分。

patterns.name: ASAP 缩写
patterns.context: 商务邮件中表示尽快；位于规划用途相关语句末尾。

patterns.name: how 子串
patterns.context: URL 中的 how 片段激活较强，但峰值为 6，低于本批峰值 10。

patterns.name: 其他零散片段
patterns.context: 各自在不同句子中出现，缺乏共同稳定的词义或上下文；与峰值片段并列记录。
patterns.domain: 疫情讨论、天文学、科幻评论、专利技术文本

en.description: All passages contain highly activated “qualify”; in legal texts it means meeting the conditions for a legal category or program, while in sports contexts it means qualifying to compete.

patterns.name: Legal qualification
patterns.context: In legal argument, determining whether a fact, status, offense, or case meets the conditions for a statutory category or exception
patterns.domain: Case law, criminal and family law

patterns.name: Eligibility for legal or policy programs
patterns.context: Determining whether a person qualifies for programs such as loan modification or rehabilitation; also involves meeting conditions for a specific legal program
patterns.domain: Case law, housing finance, and public services

patterns.name: Competition or funding eligibility
patterns.context: Meeting an entry threshold or qualifying for a subsequent event; associated with competition results, slots, or selection

patterns.name: Recurring qualify word form
patterns.context: Repeatedly activated across domains; the shared trigger is clear, but the meanings of legal qualification and advancing in competition differ
patterns.domain: Legal, everyday narrative, and sports texts

7_2600.description: 所有片段都包含高激活的“qualify”；法律文本中表示满足法律类别或项目条件，体育语境中表示取得参赛资格。

patterns.name: 法律资格认定
patterns.context: 在法律论证中判断某事实、身份、罪名或案件是否满足法定类别或例外条件

patterns.name: 法律或政策项目资格
patterns.context: 判断个人是否符合贷款修改、康复等项目的资格；也涉及符合特定法律项目条件
patterns.domain: 判例、住房金融与公共服务

patterns.name: 比赛或资助资格
patterns.context: 达到参赛门槛或获得后续赛事资格；与比赛成绩、名额或选拔相连

patterns.name: 持续出现的 qualify 词形
patterns.context: 跨领域反复激活；共同触发词明确，但法律条件认定与参赛晋级的语义不同
patterns.domain: 法律、日常叙述及体育文本

en.description: Activations occur on symbols and variables in mathematical physics equations, as well as emphasis or negative contexts in various prose, segmented proper names or word fragments, and narrative details; the categories have no stable shared semantics or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and formal symbols
patterns.context: Numbers, variables, subscripts, superscripts, and operators occur together in mathematical expressions or equations; activations fall on a range of symbols and variables rather than a single variable.

patterns.name: Emphasis in contrastive or negative contexts
patterns.context: Sentences express rebuttal, failure, potential negative consequences, or emphasis; trigger words are scattered across positions, without a stable shared syntactic construction nearby.
patterns.domain: Email, forums, novels, and web text

patterns.name: Proper names and compound-word fragments
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple tokens; activations may fall on internal fragments of proper names, place names, or compound words, with no consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: People or event details in narratives
patterns.context: Actions, changes of state, or introductory wording in narrative or reporting sentences; no shared theme or fixed context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, promotional copy, and novels

7_2600.description: 激活分布于数学物理公式中的符号与变量，也见于多类散文中的强调或负面语境、被切分的专名/词片段及叙事细节；各类之间缺乏稳定共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 数字与形式符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或公式中，数字、变量、上下标及运算符交错出现；激活落在多种符号与变量上，并非只对应单一变量。

patterns.name: 转折或否定语境中的强调词
patterns.context: 句子表达反驳、失败、潜在负面后果或程度强调；触发词分散在不同位置，周边并无稳定的共同句法构式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛、小说及网页文字

patterns.name: 专名与复合词片段
patterns.context: 词语被分成多个 token；激活可能落在专名、地名或复合词的内部片段，缺少一致的词义类别。

patterns.name: 叙述中的人物或事件细节
patterns.context: 叙事或报道句子中的动作、状态变化或介绍性措辞；未见共同主题或固定上下文。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、宣传文案及小说

en.description: Activations span cross-domain texts, including punctuation and numeric boundaries, speculation or uncertainty, event timing, degree evaluation, and quotation. Local patterns also include outdoor nature, narrative turns, news quotations, and colloquial exclamations; no single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation at sentence or clause boundaries activates across genres; commas and periods occur in multiple passages
patterns.domain: General texts such as encyclopedias, legal texts, news, and forums

patterns.name: Years and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in years, percentages, legal provisions, amounts, or statistics, often with numeric separators
patterns.domain: History, salaries, law, disasters, and public health

patterns.name: Inference, uncertainty, and cognitive states
patterns.context: Describes speculation, lack of knowledge, unresolved questions, or subjective thoughts, often in negative or quoted contexts
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, legal argument, news, and commentary

patterns.name: Events and their temporal order
patterns.context: Narrates the occurrence, change, emergence, or confirmation of events, organizing information by time or sequence
patterns.domain: History, social news, natural disasters, and medical reporting

patterns.name: Degree, comparison, and extremes
patterns.context: Evaluates degree, raises questions about sufficiency, or reports extremes, quantities, and severity
patterns.domain: Salary discussions, legal texts, disasters, and news reporting

patterns.name: Internal boundaries in proper names and compound words
patterns.context: Split subword fragments, proper names, or numeric segments are marked; this may reflect tokenization boundaries rather than stable semantics

patterns.name: Outdoor activities and wildlife
patterns.context: Introduces outdoor recreational activities and wildlife returning to the foothills
patterns.domain: Local introduction or natural environment text

patterns.name: Discoveries and unnoticed facts
patterns.context: The narrator points out that a person was unaware of a fact at the time, then adds a discovery or turn

patterns.name: News quotations and reporting verbs
patterns.context: Quotes sources or presents people’s views in reporting

patterns.name: Informal exclamations and questions
patterns.context: Expresses approval of something through a colloquial rhetorical question or exclamation

7_2600.description: 激活分布跨领域文本，涵盖标点与数字边界、推测/未知、事件时序、程度评价及引述。另有户外自然、叙事转折、新闻引语和口语赞叹等局部模式；未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 句末标点

patterns.name: 年代与数字表达

patterns.name: 推断、未知与认知状态

patterns.domain: 百科叙述、法律论证、新闻与评论

patterns.name: 事件及其时间顺序

patterns.name: 程度、比较与极值

patterns.name: 专名及复合词中的内部边界

patterns.name: 户外活动与野生动物

patterns.domain: 地方介绍或自然环境文本

patterns.name: 发现与未察觉的事实

patterns.name: 新闻引语与引述动词

patterns.name: 非正式赞叹与疑问
patterns.context: 以口语化反问或赞叹表达对某事的认可

en.description: Activations are scattered across make and its constructions, legal findings, b in formulas, plants and voting commentary, and webpage titles and URL fragments; apart from make, there is no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: General make constructions

7_2600.description: 激活分散于 make 及其构式、法律认定词、公式中的 b、植物与投票评论，以及网页标题和 URL 片段；除 make 外，缺少统一语义或上下文。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 b
patterns.context: 作为分段函数公式中的常数项，紧邻 “+ rx”

patterns.name: 物理公式中的 b 算符
patterns.context: 下标模式 b_k，出现在谐振子浴的哈密顿量中

patterns.name: 植物名称 poplars
patterns.context: 描述树木生长过高并破坏景观线路

patterns.name: BJP 投票结果
patterns.context: 叙述投票按钮导致选票总是计入 BJP 的争议

patterns.name: 标题和链接中的片段
patterns.context: YouTube URL 的视频 ID 内部片段；也可能只是偶然字符串激活

patterns.name: 标题中的 Security Breach
patterns.context: 网站标题提及安全漏洞，后接破折号和署名

patterns.name: 网页路径片段
patterns.context: TV Tropes URL 的路径文本，激活分散在路径子串上

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to expressions formed by make/made/makes and clear, especially clear; sporadic activations include the reagent letter B and time-point numbers in biomedical abstracts, and line breaks in legal text.

patterns.name: “make/made/makes clear” to indicate or clarify
patterns.context: The core trigger is make/made/makes immediately adjacent to clear, with clear activating most strongly; it may be separated by it, quite, absolutely, or publicly. It is often followed by content introduced by that/whether/how, or by the matter to be clarified.
patterns.domain: Explanatory, narrative, legal, and forum texts across domains; spans snippets 1–7, 9

patterns.name: Reagent name B in a paper
patterns.context: B is the final letter of a compound name, appearing among experimental treatment conditions alongside staurosporine; the core clear phrase is absent.

patterns.name: Experimental time points and numbers
patterns.context: Numbers occur in a description of gene expression over time: expression is detected on day 5 and increases by day 25.

patterns.name: Layout line-break marker
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph or quotation layout boundaries, with no semantic relationship to “make clear”; more likely activation of a small number of layout tokens.

7_2600.description: 主要对 make/made/makes 与 clear 构成的“使某事明确”表达强烈响应，尤其 clear；另有生物医学摘要中的试剂字母 B、时间点数字，以及法律文本换行符等零散激活。

patterns.name: “make/made/makes clear”表明或澄清
patterns.trigger: “make clear”“made clear”“makes clear”；常见搭配包括“make it clear”“should make it quite clear”“must make it absolutely clear”
patterns.context: 核心触发是 make/made/makes 紧邻 clear，clear 激活最强；中间可有 it、quite、absolutely 或 publicly。前后常接 that/whether/how 引导的内容，或说明待澄清的事项。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明、叙述、法律论述及论坛讨论；覆盖段 1–7、9

patterns.name: 论文中的试剂名称 B
patterns.context: B 是化合物名称末尾的字母，处在与 staurosporine 并列的实验处理条件中；未见核心 clear 短语。

patterns.name: 实验时间点与数字
patterns.context: 数字位于基因表达随时间变化的描述中，句意是表达在第 5 天检测到、到第 25 天增加。

patterns.name: 版式换行标记
patterns.trigger: 法律文本中的“↵”换行符及相邻引号
patterns.context: 出现在段落或引文的排版边界，周围没有与“make clear”相关的语义关系；更像是少量版式 token 激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different genres and syntax: they include legal judgment, clarity, and uncertainty; claims, comparisons, and time series in biomedicine; and expressions such as make sense and easy, as well as the test string World. No unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: been in an auxiliary verb chain
patterns.context: In “would seem to have been all but made,” it appears in a perfect-aspect auxiliary chain; the strongest activation falls on the final main word “made.”

patterns.name: Verb expressing a proposition or claim
patterns.context: A relative clause follows “theory,” with the predicate posits introducing the claim proposed by the theory.

patterns.name: equal in experimental results
patterns.context: Compares insulin sensitivity in two groups of mice, with the predicate stating that the results are equal.

patterns.name: make sense in a negative sentence
patterns.context: The first person expresses a lack of understanding of the numbers, with activation concentrated on make.

patterns.name: easy evaluating convenience
patterns.context: A rhetorical question assesses whether it is easy for women to balance work and family.

patterns.name: made clear in legal writing
patterns.context: The passive construction “should be made clear” calls for a clear explanation of a legal rule.

patterns.name: World in test text
patterns.context: The final word in the Hello\tWorld test string, following an escaped tab character.

patterns.name: make in a negative judgment
patterns.context: In “does not make the notice ineffective,” make combines with negation to express a judgment about legal effect.

patterns.name: The record leaves uncertainty
patterns.context: “the record leaves doubt as to whether or not” introduces uncertainty about whether a fact occurred.

patterns.name: Time markers in a time series
patterns.context: Reports changes in cell density and staining intensity over a date range.

7_2600.description: 激活分散于不同文体与句法：涵盖法律中的判断、明确与不确定性，生物医学中的主张、比较和时间序列，以及 make sense、easy 等表达和测试字符串 World；看不出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 助动词链中的 been
patterns.context: 在“would seem to have been all but made”中，出现在完成体助动词链里；强激活落在句末核心词“made”上。

patterns.name: 表示提出或主张的动词
patterns.context: “theory”之后接关系从句，谓语 posits 引出理论提出的主张。

patterns.name: 实验结果中的 equal
patterns.context: 比较两组小鼠的胰岛素敏感性，谓语说明结果相等。

patterns.name: 否定句中的 make sense
patterns.trigger: « don»1«'t»1« seem»4« to»3« make»10« any»6« sense»8
patterns.context: 第一人称表达对数字缺乏理解，激活集中在 make。

patterns.name: 评价便利程度的 easy
patterns.context: 反问句中评估女性兼顾工作与家庭是否容易。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 made clear
patterns.context: 被动结构“should be made clear”，用于要求明确阐释法律规则。

patterns.name: 测试文本中的 World
patterns.context: 作为 Hello\tWorld 测试字符串的末词，处于转义制表符之后。

patterns.name: 否定判断中的 make
patterns.context: “does not make the notice ineffective”中，make 与否定结构共同表达法律效力判断。

patterns.name: 记录留下不确定性
patterns.context: “the record leaves doubt as to whether or not”引出事实是否发生的不确定性。

patterns.name: 时间序列中的时间标记
patterns.context: 以日期区间报告细胞密度和染色强度的变化。

en.description: Activations are scattered across patent numbers, legal judgments, philosophical evaluations, promotional headlines, mathematical formulas, clinical research phrasing, URL characters, and household topics; no unified meaning or stable syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Patent variety and number
patterns.context: A variety or seed number appears in patent background text, which explains whether it is patent-protected.

patterns.name: Judgment and uncertainty in law
patterns.context: Legal argument or case records explain appellate rules or express doubts about evidence or facts.

patterns.name: Norms, cooperation, and evaluation
patterns.context: When discussing fairness, reciprocity, and cooperation rules, evaluates the weight of an objection or argument.

patterns.name: Headline-style evaluation
patterns.context: A brief evaluative subheading appears after a company introduction or press release.
patterns.domain: Business email or reposted promotional material

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and vector expressions
patterns.context: Multiple variables, vectors, and Greek letters appear interspersed in LaTeX formulas.

patterns.name: Cautious phrasing in research plans
patterns.context: Clinical research grant or protocol text notes that the research is still at an early stage and cautions against drawing conclusions about treatment approaches.

patterns.name: Character fragments in URLs
patterns.context: The video identifier in a YouTube URL is split into characters or short fragments; no clear natural-language semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Women and household workload
patterns.context: Discusses women balancing work and family, and the difficulty of shouldering household responsibilities.

7_2600.description: 激活分散于专利编号、法律判断、哲学评价、宣传标题、数学公式、临床研究措辞、网址字符及家务议题；未见统一词义或稳定句法触发。

patterns.name: 专利品种与编号
patterns.context: 专利背景文字中出现品种或种子编号，并对是否受专利保护作说明。

patterns.name: 法律中的判断与不确定性
patterns.context: 法律论述或案件记录中，对上诉规则作说明，或表述证据、事实存在疑问。

patterns.name: 规范、合作与评价
patterns.context: 讨论公平、互惠及合作规则时，对某项异议或论点的分量作评价。

patterns.name: 标题式评价
patterns.context: 公司介绍或新闻稿后出现简短的评价性小标题。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件或转载宣传材料

patterns.name: 数学符号与向量表达
patterns.context: 公式中多个变量、向量和希腊字母以 LaTeX 形式交错出现。

patterns.name: 研究计划的审慎措辞
patterns.context: 临床研究资助或方案文本中，说明研究尚处早期、不宜对治疗方式作结论。

patterns.name: 网址中的字符片段
patterns.context: YouTube URL 的视频标识符被切分成字符或短片段；没有明显的自然语言语义触发。

patterns.name: 女性角色与家务负担
patterns.context: 讨论女性兼顾工作与家庭，以及她承担家务负担的难易。

en.description: Activations are scattered across patent numbers and legal wording, make/makes collocations, vector notation in equations, and statistical terminology; no clear semantic or syntactic pattern accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Specific wording in legal or patent documents
patterns.context: Patent numbers and descriptions, or wording in legal opinions about whether the record leaves doubt or whether a point should be clarified; activations fall near number fragments or common legal phrasing.

patterns.name: make followed by an action or result
patterns.context: make/makes is followed by a noun or complement, forming expressions such as changes, clear, comments, and sense; activations are usually near make.
patterns.domain: Business email, technical discussion, news, lifestyle, and commentary

patterns.name: Vector notation in mathematical symbols or equations
patterns.context: Bold vectors, subscripts, and component notation in LaTeX equations; activations are near formula symbols, with no evident connection to ordinary-language semantics.

patterns.name: chance level in statistical discussion
patterns.context: Compares an experimental error rate with the chance level expected from random guessing.

7_2600.description: 激活分散在专利编号与法律措辞、make/makes 搭配、方程向量记号及统计术语中；未见一个能覆盖所有段的明确语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 法律或专利文书中的特定措辞
patterns.trigger: [1] «code»« number»、«P»«J» 等专利分类/编号片段；[2] «leaves»；[4] «made» «clear»
patterns.context: 编号及专利描述，或法律意见中关于记录是否留下疑问、应说明某点的表述；激活落在编号片段或常见法律措辞附近。

patterns.name: make 与后续动作或结果
patterns.context: make/makes 后接名词或补语，构成 changes、clear、comments、sense 等表达；激活通常在 make 附近。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、技术讨论、新闻、生活方式与评论

patterns.name: 数学符号或方程中的向量标记
patterns.trigger: «n»、«b» 及其带下标的数学记号
patterns.context: LaTeX 方程中粗体向量、下标和分量记号；激活位置邻近公式符号，未见明显的普通语言语义联系。

patterns.name: 统计讨论中的 chance level
patterns.context: 比较实验误差率与随机猜测所预期的机会水平。

en.concept: make/makes constructions and direction words for turning
en.description: Primarily sensitive to make/makes and their object structures, commonly make a/any/an + noun or makes it clear; also responds to turns and right/left direction expressions in patent passages.

patterns.name: A noun or determiner after “make”
patterns.context: Activation falls on make/makes, commonly in the structure make(s) + object; the object may be an abstract action, argument, change, or clarification.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal texts, emails, forums, encyclopedias, and philosophy

patterns.name: Direction words for turning
patterns.context: The position of a vehicle's wheels depends on the direction of the turn; direction words correspond to the front wheels' left/right positions.

patterns.name: Cross-word-boundary trigger
patterns.context: A noun-phrase fragment precedes the trigger word, and the subsequent sentence discusses judging direction; the form in this passage is not the common make(s) + object structure.

7_2600.concept: make/makes 构式及转向方向词
7_2600.description: 主要对 make/makes 及其宾语结构敏感，常见 make a/any/an + 名词或 makes it clear；另在专利段落中响应 turns 与 right/left 的方向表达。

patterns.name: “make”后接名词或限定词
patterns.trigger: «make»（含 «makes»）后接 «a» / «any» / «an» 或名词，如 “make any changes”“make a payment”“make an additional claim”“makes it clear”
patterns.context: 激活落在 make/makes 上，常见结构为 make(s) + 宾语；宾语可以是抽象行为、主张、改变或清楚说明。
patterns.domain: 法律、邮件、论坛、百科、哲学等多种文体

patterns.name: 转向方向词
patterns.context: 车辆车轮的位置由转向方向决定，方向词与前轮左右位置对应。

patterns.name: 跨词边界触发
patterns.context: 触发词前接名词短语片段，后续句子讨论方向判断；本段可见形式并非常见的 make(s) + 宾语结构。

en.description: Diffuse activation patterns: include wish-to infinitives, left/right directions, code size operations, fixed legal expressions, mathematical symbols, regulatory temperature thresholds, and chance level in experiments; trigger words and contexts differ markedly.

patterns.name: Expressions with to after wish
patterns.context: A to-infinitive follows wish; examples occur with different meanings, including “hope to improve a method,” “wish someone a pleasant journey,” and “express gratitude.”
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, diplomatic correspondence, historical prefaces

patterns.name: Directional and left/right position words
patterns.context: Describes a wheel turning and then being positioned to the front left or right; left/right direction words are strongly activated.

patterns.name: Code contexts with resize and size
patterns.context: A C++ function resizes something and compares parameters with member variables; activation involves the function name and the size identifier.

patterns.name: makes clear in legal decisions
patterns.context: After citing a precedent or legal authority, uses makes clear to introduce the conclusion it establishes.

patterns.name: Greek letters and indices in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Formulas contain Greek letters, subscripts and superscripts, and tensor/vector notation; activation falls on symbol fragments.

patterns.name: Temperature thresholds in regulations
patterns.context: Regulatory provisions specify that sludge granules or dryer outlets must meet a temperature condition exceeding 80°C.

patterns.name: chance level in experimental results
patterns.context: Describes stimulus contrast, error rates, and the chance level expected under a guessing model.

7_2600.description: 激活模式分散：包括 wish to 不定式、左右方位、代码尺寸操作、法律固定表达、数学符号、法规温度阈值及实验中的 chance level；各处触发词和语境差异明显。

patterns.name: wish 后接 to 的表达
patterns.context: wish 后接 to 不定式；分别出现在“希望改进方法”“祝旅途顺利”“表达感谢”等不同语义中
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、外交信函、历史序言

patterns.name: 方向与左右位置词
patterns.context: 描述车轮转向后位于前方左侧或右侧，左右方位词受到强激活

patterns.name: resize 与 size 的代码上下文
patterns.context: C++ 函数中调整大小，并比较参数与成员变量；激活涉及函数名及 size 标识符

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 makes clear
patterns.context: 引用判例或法律权威后，用 makes clear 引出其确立的结论

patterns.name: 数学排版中的希腊字母及指标
patterns.context: 公式中出现希腊字母、上下标和张量/向量记号；激活落在符号片段上

patterns.name: 法规中的温度阈值
patterns.context: 法规条文规定污泥颗粒或干燥器出口需满足超过 80°C 的温度条件

patterns.name: 实验结果中的 chance level
patterns.context: 描述刺激对比度、错误率及猜测模型所预期的机会水平

en.concept: Heterogeneous lexical triggers, with a preference for make(s)
en.description: Repeatedly activates make/makes, especially when followed by an evaluation, result, or issue to be resolved; other local patterns include left-turn direction words, employment and pay, class categories, formal wishes, mathematical vector symbols, and direction and trade-off language in regulatory emails.

patterns.name: Evaluation or judgment after make(s)
patterns.context: The trigger token is the past or third-person singular form make/makes; subsequent text often gives an evaluation, finding, or result judgment, such as “Jess so special,” “finding…,” or “the mechanics… unlikely”.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including news, personal narratives, academic discussion, and business emails

patterns.name: Left-turn direction words
patterns.context: left indicates the left side of a vehicle or wheel, or the direction of a left turn; snippet 1 also contains direction and motion words such as front, right, and turns.

patterns.name: Occupation and pay context
patterns.context: Discusses changes in jobs and average pay; activations fall on substrings of job, pay, and city.

patterns.name: Class-category labels
patterns.context: These words appear with non-manual/manual work, class Roman numerals, and quoted category labels.
patterns.domain: Public health or social science research

patterns.name: Diplomatic courtesy expression
patterns.context: In formal letter-style language, wish is followed by the addressee and a wish such as success.

patterns.name: Mathematical vector symbols
patterns.context: Appears in formulas containing Greek letters, subscripts, equations, and boldface vector notation.

patterns.name: Expressions of direction and trade-offs
patterns.context: directions refers to opposing views or pressure, followed by a description of leaning toward discarding a value and leaving the decision to an agency.

7_2600.concept: 异质词项触发，偏好 make(s)
7_2600.description: 主要重复激活 make/makes，尤其在其后引出评价、结果或待解决问题时；另有左转方向词、就业薪酬、阶层分类、正式祝愿、数学向量符号及监管邮件中的方向与取舍等局部模式。

patterns.name: make(s) 后接评价或判断
patterns.context: 触发 token 为 make/makes 的过去式或第三人称形式；句中后续常接评价、发现或结果判断，如 “Jess so special”“finding…”“the mechanics… unlikely”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、个人叙述、学术论述、商务邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 左转方向词
patterns.context: left 表示车辆或车轮左侧／左转方向；第 1 段同时出现 front、right、turns 等方向与运动词。

patterns.name: 职业与薪酬语境
patterns.context: 讨论就业岗位变化及平均薪酬；激活分布在 job、pay 及 city 的子串上。

patterns.name: 阶层分类标签
patterns.context: 这些词与 non-manual/manual work、class 罗马数字及引号中的分类标签共同出现。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或社会科学研究

patterns.name: 外交礼貌表达
patterns.context: 正式信函式表达中，wish 后接祝愿对象与成功之类的祝愿内容。

patterns.name: 数学向量符号
patterns.context: 出现在含希腊字母、下标、等式和向量粗体标记的公式中。

patterns.name: 方向与取舍表达
patterns.context: directions 指相反意见或压力，随后描述倾向于放弃某数值、将决定留给机构。

en.description: The strongest recurring cue across genres is make/made/makes (often used causatively, to indicate formation, or in fixed expressions); other activations are scattered across local words and contexts involving turning direction, legal facts, employment, email, web homepages, and table-of-contents headings, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: makes in causative/causal constructions
patterns.context: The verb make/made/makes occurs in a sentence, followed by an object or complement; its meaning varies with the collocation and may indicate causing or forming, or occur in a fixed expression.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, legal texts, online discussions, and historical texts

patterns.name: Direction and turning words
patterns.context: Describes a wheel turning and its forward position, with left/right direction corresponding to the turning action.

patterns.name: Facts and records in legal documents
patterns.context: Concerns court proceedings, evidence, claims, or records; activated words are scattered across judicial reasoning sentences.

patterns.name: roof/building in specific collocations
patterns.context: Recounts someone complaining about a leaking roof, authorizing and paying another person to re-roof a building, then discussing whether the record can prove the relevant facts.

patterns.name: Work, employment, and alternatives
patterns.context: Discusses increases or decreases in jobs, average city wages, or proposes alternatives for creating jobs.

patterns.name: whether or not in negative/interrogative constructions
patterns.context: Appears in legal reasoning or statements of factual uncertainty; it is not an independent theme stable across passages.

patterns.name: Time pressure and changes in business email
patterns.context: An email explains that a change of email address caused communication problems, the schedule is tight, and little time remains.

patterns.name: Front-page exposure in comments
patterns.context: An online comment explains why a story reached the homepage and mentions that readers did not understand the content.

patterns.name: Book titles and chapter numbers in a table of contents
patterns.context: A table of contents includes the chapter title 「Beggars in the Making」 and a page number; the activated word is embedded at the end of the title.
patterns.domain: Classical book table of contents/typeset text

7_2600.description: 最强且跨文体的重复线索是 make/made/makes（常见于因果、形成或固定搭配）；其余激活分散于转向方向、法律事实、就业、邮件、网络首页和目录标题等局部词汇与语境，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 使役/因果结构中的 makes
patterns.trigger: «made»9（[1] «makes»9（[3]「made no difference」、[4]「made sense」、[6]「makes it plain」、[7]「wouldn’t make」、[9]「has probably made it」）
patterns.context: 动词 make/made/makes 位于句中，后接宾语或补语；意义随搭配变化，既可表示造成、形成，也可构成固定表达。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、法律文本、网络讨论与历史文本

patterns.name: 方向及转向词
patterns.context: 描述车轮转向及其前方位置，左右方向与转向动作相互对应。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的事实与记录
patterns.context: 围绕法院审理、证据、诉讼主张或记录展开；激活词分散在司法论证句中。

patterns.name: 特定搭配中的 roof/building
patterns.context: 叙述某人投诉屋顶漏水、授权并支付他人给建筑物换屋顶，随后讨论记录是否能证明相关事实。

patterns.name: 工作、就业与替代方案
patterns.context: 讨论就业岗位的增减、城市平均薪酬，或提出创造就业的替代方案。

patterns.name: 否定/疑问结构中的 whether 或 not
patterns.trigger: «whether»、«not»（如「whether or not」及「could not be considered」）
patterns.context: 出现在法律论证或事实不确定性表述中；此处不是跨段稳定的独立主题。

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的时间紧迫与变更
patterns.context: 邮件说明邮件地址变更造成沟通问题，排期严格、剩余时间不多。

patterns.name: 评论中的前页/首页传播
patterns.context: 网络评论解释某个故事为何登上首页，并提到读者没理解内容。

patterns.name: 目录中的书名与章节编号
patterns.trigger: «Making»9，及相邻的«XXX»、罗马数字章节号和书名
patterns.context: 目录排版中出现章节标题「Beggars in the Making」及页码；激活词嵌在书名末尾。
patterns.domain: 古典书籍目录/排版文本

en.description: Most snippets activate the leave/left word family, often as verbs meaning to leave something, cause a state, or hand something over for handling; other uses include the direction left, make constructions, and a song-title phrase, which are not the same usage.

patterns.name: The leave/left word family
patterns.context: Used as a verb meaning to leave something, cause something to be in a state, or hand decision-making authority to someone else; objects and complements vary.
patterns.domain: Emails, web copy, academic papers, technical reviews, and legal texts

patterns.name: Left turn/left side
patterns.context: Describes wheel turning and position; left indicates direction and differs from the leave word family.

patterns.name: Past and third-person singular forms of make
patterns.context: Used in the constructions “make someone special” and “make sense”.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in a song title
patterns.context: Appears in a song title in an album track list.

7_2600.description: 多数段落激活 leave/left 词族，常作动词表达留下、造成状态或交由处理；另有方向 left、make 结构及一处歌曲标题短语，彼此并非同一用法。

patterns.name: leave/left 词族
patterns.context: 作为动词，表示留下、使某事处于某状态或将决定权交给他人；宾语和补语各异。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文案、学术论文、技术评论、法律文本

patterns.name: 左转／左侧
patterns.context: 描述车轮转向及其所在位置；left 表示方向，与 leave 词族不同。

patterns.name: make 的过去式与三单
patterns.context: 用于“make someone special”和“make sense”结构。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的固定短语
patterns.trigger: «Be»«en»« Here»« Before»（原文为“Have Always Been Here Before”）
patterns.context: 出现在专辑曲目列表的歌曲标题中。

en.concept: Triggers in common English sentence patterns
en.description: Strong triggers cluster in explanatory or evaluative constructions with makes/made; there are also varied collocations with leave, makes sense judgments, and sentence-initial Like comparisons. Although trigger forms recur, their meanings and contexts are not entirely the same.

patterns.name: Explanation/evaluation triggered by makes
patterns.context: The causative verb makes or made appears in constructions asking or explaining why something is different, prominent, special, or feasible; often followed by What, then an object of evaluation or a reason.
patterns.domain: Promotional copy, interview quotations, narration, forum discussions

patterns.name: Idiomatic expressions with leave
patterns.context: leave and its variants occur in common collocations concerning leaving a message, omitting information, or ending/shelving a discussion; the contextual conditions differ.
patterns.domain: Website copy, sports commentary, forum posts

patterns.name: Reasonableness judgments with makes sense
patterns.context: Past or present makes sense indicates that an action or decision is reasonable.

patterns.name: General analogies introduced by Like
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Like introduces an analogy about a group, followed by a summary of traits shared by its customers.

7_2600.description: 强触发集中在 makes/made 的解释或评价句式；另有 leave 的多种搭配、makes sense 判断及句首 Like 类比。触发形式虽重复，但涉及的语义和上下文并不完全相同。

patterns.name: makes 触发的解释/评估
patterns.trigger: “What Makes Our Center Different”“What makes these shows standout”“What made Jess so special”“What makes that work”“what in particular makes you say”中的 makes/made
patterns.context: 使役/因果动词 makes 或 made 出现在询问、说明某事物为何不同、突出、特殊或可行的结构中；常接 What，后续评价对象或原因
patterns.domain: 宣传文案、采访引语、叙述、论坛讨论

patterns.name: leave 的惯用表达
patterns.context: leave 及其变体出现在常见搭配中，分别涉及留言、遗漏信息或结束/搁置讨论；上下文条件彼此不同
patterns.domain: 网站文案、体育评论、论坛发帖

patterns.name: makes sense 的合理性判断
patterns.trigger: “it made sense then”“it makes sense now”
patterns.context: 过去式或现在式 makes sense，用来说明某行动或决定合理

patterns.name: Like 引出的泛指类比
patterns.context: 句首 Like 引出群体类比，接着概括客户共有的特点

en.concept: The leave/left word forms and neighboring words
en.description: Strong triggers in many snippets cluster around leave/left/leaves and their complements, but meanings differ across contexts; other patterns include left/right turning in patents, acknowledgment/chapter terms in papers, words evaluating reading, and word-internal fragments with no stable semantic connection.

patterns.name: leave/left and following complements
patterns.context: The sentence uses leave/left/leaves, or pairs make with connection; activation often falls on the verb and following words, such as “leave it behind,” “left us,” “left something,” and “leaves open”.
patterns.domain: Reviews, emails, technical discussion, academic writing, and web text

patterns.name: Direction and turning words
patterns.context: Describes wheel position as determined by turning direction; left/right words are contrasted in consecutive conditional clauses.

patterns.name: Academic acknowledgments and chapter markers
patterns.context: Chapter references and an acknowledgment section at the end of a paper; high activation falls on the acknowledgment heading and around “would like”.

patterns.name: Words evaluating reading and texts
patterns.context: Discusses a story, work, or reading experience; also includes review-style evaluations or readers recalling a work's publication and their reading of it.
patterns.domain: Book reviews, literary criticism, and reader quotations

patterns.name: Terminology or local word-form triggers
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within words, with no clear shared semantic or stylistic conditions in the surrounding sentences.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, philosophical reviews, paper citations, business emails

patterns.name: Proper nouns and spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs within fragments of proper nouns; spelling and context vary, with no stable shared condition apparent.

7_2600.description: 多段的强触发集中在 leave/left/leaves 及相邻补语，但在各类语境中含义不同；另有专利中的左右转向词、论文致谢/章节词、阅读评价词，以及若干无稳定语义联系的词内片段。

patterns.name: leave/left 与后续补语
patterns.context: 句中使用 leave/left/leaves，或 make 与 connection 搭配；激活常落在动词及其后续词上，如“leave it behind”“left us”“left something”“leaves open”。
patterns.domain: 评论、邮件、技术讨论、学术写作与网页文本

patterns.name: 方向与转向词
patterns.context: 描述车轮的位置由转向方向决定，左右方向词在连续的条件句中对举。

patterns.name: 学术致谢与章节标记
patterns.context: 论文末尾的章节引用和致谢段落；高激活落在致谢标题及“would like”一带。

patterns.name: 阅读及文本评价词
patterns.context: 谈论故事、作品或阅读经历；同时出现书评式评价，或读者回忆作品出版与阅读。
patterns.domain: 书评、文学评论与读者引语

patterns.name: 术语或局部词形触发
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的子词片段，所在句子没有清楚共享的语义或文体条件。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、哲学评论、论文引用、商务邮件

patterns.name: 专名与拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名的内部片段；具体拼写和上下文各异，未见稳定共同条件。

en.concept: Forms of left/leave and local technical uses
en.description: Primarily responds to the forms of left/leave and their different semantic uses; activation also occurs on spatial-interface/height terminology in patents, the “Fewer than” quantity construction in research texts, and the typesetting command \left in formulas.

patterns.name: left/leave and inflected forms
patterns.context: English forms meaning to depart, leave something behind, cause something to remain in a state, or appearing as a verb in a title; surrounding contexts vary across infinitive, perfect, past tense, third-person singular, and title capitalization.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, reader comments, business email, research papers, news headlines

patterns.name: Interface, surface, and height
patterns.context: Spatial geometry, imaging regions, object surfaces, or phase interfaces in technical or patent descriptions; in [6], height occurs repeatedly and in adjacent triggers, while [7] contains the explicit term vapor-liquid interface.

patterns.name: English expressions for quantities below a threshold
patterns.context: The fixed comparative construction “Fewer than” is followed by a proportion or quantity to indicate a value below a threshold; activation falls on different parts of Few/er and than.

patterns.name: left in formulas
patterns.context: Part of the LaTeX typesetting command \left in mathematical formulas, used to delimit brackets rather than as the English verb “to leave.”

7_2600.concept: left/leave 词形及局部技术用法
7_2600.description: 主要响应 left/leave 的词形及其不同语义用法；另对专利中的空间界面/高度术语、科研文本里的“Fewer than”数量结构，以及公式排版命令 \left 有激活。

patterns.name: left/leave 及其屈折形式
patterns.context: 英语中表示离开、留下、使某事保持某种状态，或作为标题中的动词；周围语境有不定式、完成时、过去时、第三人称单数及标题大小写等变化。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、读者评论、商务邮件、科研论文、新闻标题

patterns.name: 界面、表面与高度
patterns.context: 技术或专利描述中的空间几何位置、成像区域、物体表面或相界面；[6]中 height 连续出现且相邻触发，[7]中 vapor-liquid interface 是明确术语。

patterns.name: 少于数量的英文表达
patterns.context: 固定比较结构 “Fewer than” 后接比例或数量，表示低于某个数值；激活落在 Few/er 及 than 的不同部分。

patterns.name: 公式中的 left
patterns.context: 数学公式中作为 LaTeX 排版命令 \left 的一部分，用于括号定界，而非英语动词“离开”。

en.concept: Sensitive to word fragments and formatting
en.description: Highlights span many domains and often fall on word-internal fragments, common words, punctuation, or formatting markers; local recurring phenomena such as “left/leaves” and category labels are insufficient to establish a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Specific word-boundary or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Triggers often fall on part of a complete word, especially subword fragments within words; some co-occur with adjacent punctuation, spaces, or line breaks. There is no stable syntactic position or semantic role.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including web pages, reviews, medicine, law, forums, and mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: left in reviews or explanatory prose
patterns.context: Appears in English prose with meanings including the political left, leaving something or causing it to be in a state, or a mathematical typesetting command; meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Reviews, technology discussions, academic prose, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: Function words in sentence-initial or informational expressions
patterns.context: A few highlights fall on common function words or nearby text, with no consistent syntactic structure; they often occur near sentence or clause boundaries.
patterns.domain: Web descriptions, medical abstracts, forum text, and academic texts

patterns.name: Sequence labels and category descriptions
patterns.context: In a quoted list of occupational manual-labor categories, category numbers, level words, and nearby punctuation are activated.
patterns.domain: Categorization in PubMed Central academic text

patterns.name: Molecular symbols and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across formula variables, subscripts, superscripts, arrows, and LaTeX/MathJax formatting markers; no more specific unified trigger can be identified.

patterns.name: Negation and display terms in web license clauses
patterns.context: A license clause requires retention of a Powered by mark, with an exception if technically infeasible; activation clusters on split parts of Notices and words in the conditional clause.

patterns.name: Granularity words in measurement and walking narratives
patterns.context: A personal narrative discusses tracking walking activity, then shifts to fine-grained scales; highlights fall on level and a page-count expression.

patterns.name: Words about software labor and willingness to give
patterns.context: When discussing whether to release small software at no charge, the effects of labor, and personal hesitation, words about desire, impact, and first-person pronouns are activated.

7_2600.description: 高亮跨多领域且多落在词内碎片、常见词、标点或格式标记上；“left/leaves”及类别标签等局部重复现象，尚不足以说明统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 特定词边界或词尾碎片
patterns.context: 触发常落在完整词的一部分，尤其是词内子词片段；有些与相邻的标点、空格或换行共同出现。没有稳定的句法位置或语义角色。
patterns.domain: 跨域文本，包括网页、评论、医学、法律、论坛和数学排版

patterns.name: 评论或解释性文字中的 left
patterns.context: 在英语散文中出现，含义可为政治左派、留下/使处于某状态，或数学排版命令；意义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 评论、科技讨论、学术散文与数学文本

patterns.name: 句首或句中信息性表达中的功能词
patterns.context: 少数高亮落在常见功能词或其附近，未见一致的句法结构；多为句首或分句边界附近。
patterns.domain: 网页说明、医学摘要、论坛文字与学术文本

patterns.name: 序列标签与类别描述
patterns.context: 在职业体力劳动类别的引号列表中，类别数字、等级词及其附近标点被激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术文本中的分类表述

patterns.name: 分子符号与排版碎片
patterns.context: 激活分布在公式变量、上下标、箭头和 LaTeX/MathJax 排版标记上，无法确认更具体的统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 网页许可条款中的否定与显示词
patterns.context: 在要求保留 Powered by 标志的许可条款中，若技术上不可行则适用例外；激活集中在被拆分的 Notices 和条件条款词语。

patterns.name: 度量与步行叙述中的颗粒度词
patterns.context: 个人叙述谈及追踪步行活动，随后转向细粒度尺度；高亮落在 level 和页数表达上。

patterns.name: 软件劳动与给予意愿的词语
patterns.context: 讨论是否免费发布小型软件、劳动影响及个人犹豫时，愿望、影响和第一人称代词被激活。

en.concept: Mixed responses to English phrases and local structures
en.description: High activation often falls on expressions such as would like to and leave/left/leaves, and also appears in make perseverance, web imperatives, mathematical minus signs, and What is; other function-word activations are sporadic, and the patterns are not semantically or syntactically unified.

patterns.name: Fixed expression for being willing to do something
patterns.context: After the first-person plural subject (We), expresses willingness or politely introduces an action; activation is concentrated on like, with weaker activation on neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: Leaving an impression or state on something
patterns.context: leave/leaves is followed by an object, expressing leaving something unfinished or causing someone to feel confused; activation falls on the verb and its immediate object.

patterns.name: Abstract noun after make
patterns.context: make is followed by the abstract noun perseverance, with an emphatic or evaluative tone; found in only one example.

patterns.name: leave in a comment-related imperative
patterns.context: Imperative leave is followed by a comment, inviting readers to leave a comment; this differs from the “leave/cause” uses in other passages.

patterns.name: Definite article and possessive
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases; this passage has no clear, coherent local syntactic pattern and may represent sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Minus signs in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign precedes numbers, fractions, or algebraic expressions; it recurs in math problems, though most numbers and arithmetic symbols are unmarked.

patterns.name: What is in mathematical questions
patterns.context: What is introduces a question asking for a value or a common denominator; it occurs in problem text containing many formulas.

patterns.name: Ordinary sentence-initial or medial function words
patterns.context: These triggers are scattered across web sentences, narrative sentences, and academic acknowledgments, with no consistent local collocation or semantic condition.

7_2600.concept: 英语短语与局部结构的混合响应
7_2600.description: 高激活较常落在 would like to、leave/left/leaves 等表达中，也见于 make perseverance、网页祈使句、数学负号及 What is；另有零散功能词激活，各模式语义与句法并不统一。

patterns.name: 愿意做某事的固定搭配
patterns.context: 在第一人称复数主语（We）后，表达意愿或礼貌地引出行动；激活集中在 like，前后 token 也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢、技术说明

patterns.name: 使某物留下某种印象或状态
patterns.context: leave/leaves 后接宾语，表达留下未尽之处，或使人感到困惑；激活落在动词及其紧邻宾语。

patterns.name: make 后接抽象名词
patterns.context: make 后接表示抽象性质或状态的名词 perseverance，带有强调、评价意味；只见于一例。

patterns.name: 评论性祈使句中的 leave
patterns.context: 命令式 leave 后接 a comment，邀请读者留言；不同于其他段落中 leave 的“留下/使得”用法。

patterns.name: 定冠词与所有格
patterns.context: 在名词短语中出现；这段没有明显连贯的局部句法模式，可能是零散激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的负号
patterns.context: 负号出现在数字、分数或代数表达式前；数学题中负号反复出现，但多数数字和算术符号未标记。

patterns.name: 数学问句的 What is
patterns.context: 以 What is 提出求值或求公分母的问题；出现于带有大量公式的题目文本。

patterns.name: 普通句首或句间功能词
patterns.context: 这些触发项分散在网页句子、叙述句和论文致谢中，缺少一致的局部搭配或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、叙述、学术论文

en.description: Activations span multiple genres. More salient local cues include left/leave, numeric punctuation, social-class labels, negative recollections, scientific formulas, and personal-experience phrasing. There is no stable, unified semantics; some activations may reflect tokenization or formatting effects.

patterns.name: leave-related expressions
patterns.context: After “Discontinuing leap seconds,” the text contains left something to be desired; elsewhere, “hard to leave it behind.” The trigger may involve forms such as leave/left, but “leap” occurs only once, and the contexts are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: proc in a time-related text
patterns.context: The word is marked by tokenization in the context of “procure new hardware.” Activation is weak and may reflect a local subword fragment or tokenization-boundary effect.

patterns.name: Editorial complaint template and punctuation
patterns.context: A news site's editorial standards statement lists grounds for complaints; commas and complaint-related wording both show activation.

patterns.name: Numbers in statistical tables
patterns.context: Income figures, currency symbols, and decimal-point/comma formatting in a demographic passage.

patterns.name: Social-class category labels
patterns.context: Social-class groupings pair occupational categories such as manual/non-manual work and farmers with Roman numeral grades.

patterns.name: Duration in a legal-profession self-description
patterns.context: A lawyer describes professional enthusiasm and time invested in a personal voice; the same than construction also appears in descriptions of years of work.

patterns.name: Negative recollection in forum dialogue
patterns.context: A first-person reply to a technical question says the speaker did not keep records; activation is concentrated in recollection/record-keeping expressions after a negative auxiliary.

patterns.name: Biochemical terms and formula values
patterns.context: Enzyme names, thermodynamic parameters, and values/units with minus signs in a scientific paper.

patterns.name: Skincare experience and anticipation
patterns.context: A first-person product review describes the product as pleasant to the touch and says it makes the reviewer look forward to using it.

patterns.name: Expression of leaving in a writing review
patterns.context: In a review of a literary work, leave it behind describes how readers find it hard to forget; this may relate to the left form in the first passage.

patterns.name: Mathematics/engineering experience statement
patterns.context: A speaker describes algebra, functions, and years of work experience as an engineer and mentor; years also occurs in other personal-experience contexts.

7_2600.description: 激活分布于多种文体：较显眼的局部线索包括 left/leave、数字标点、阶层高低标签、否定回忆、科学公式及个人体验措辞；整体缺乏稳定统一语义，部分可能是分词或格式效应。

patterns.name: leave 相关表达
patterns.context: 在“Discontinuing leap seconds”后出现 left something to be desired；另有“hard to leave it behind”。触发可能涉及 leave/left 一类词形，但“leap”本身仅出现一次，且上下文不完全一致。

patterns.name: 时间文本中的 proc
patterns.context: 词语被分词标记，处于“procure new hardware”的语境；激活较弱，可能是局部子词或分词边界效应。

patterns.name: 编辑投诉模板及标点
patterns.context: 新闻网站编辑标准声明，列举投诉事由；逗号及投诉相关措辞均有激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻网站法律/编辑声明

patterns.name: 统计表格中的数字
patterns.context: 人口统计段落中的收入数值、货币符号及小数点/逗号格式。

patterns.name: 社会阶层分类标签
patterns.context: 社会阶层分组中，以 manual/non-manual work、农民等职业类别配合罗马数字等级。

patterns.name: 法律职业自述中的时长
patterns.context: 律师以个人口吻描述职业热情及投入时长；同一 than 结构也见于工作年限表述。

patterns.name: 论坛对话中的否定回忆
patterns.context: 第一人称回应技术问题，称自己没做记录；激活集中在否定助动词后的回忆/记录表达。

patterns.name: 生化术语与公式数值
patterns.context: 科学论文中酶名称、热力学参数及带负号的数值/单位。

patterns.name: 护肤体验与期待
patterns.context: 第一人称产品体验中，描述产品触感良好并使自己期待使用。

patterns.name: 写作评价中的离开表达
patterns.context: 评论文学作品时，以 leave it behind 描写读者难以忘怀；可能与第1段 left 的词形相关。

patterns.name: 数学/工程经验陈述
patterns.context: 以工程师和导师身份描述代数、函数及多年工作经验；years 也出现在其他个人经历语境。

en.description: Responds to several kinds of text containing specialized labels or structural markers: policy/license webpage wording, statistics, social-class categories, forum production instructions and proper names, and JSON and HTML template fields; no single stable word sense is evident.

patterns.name: Web consent and terms-of-service wording
patterns.context: Website privacy/advertising notices, editorial complaint policies, or software license text; activation falls on words such as service, license, and complaint and their neighboring words.
patterns.domain: Website copy, legal/policy notices, open-source software licenses

patterns.name: Numbers, monetary amounts, and demographic statements
patterns.context: Numbers such as ages, proportions, and amounts occur densely in demographic or income statistics sentences.

patterns.name: Social-class classification terms
patterns.context: Social classes are divided by occupation type and hierarchical level, with category labels listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Shape and production instructions
patterns.context: An author introduces an image they made from common geometric shapes, identifying as a non-designer.

patterns.name: Split subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Forum discussions contain usernames, product names, or organization names; activation falls within the names or on adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: Structured data fields
patterns.context: In JSON-like records, field names, counts, years, and dates are arranged as key-value pairs.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS class names and template variables
patterns.context: HTML templates contain Angular directives, CSS class names, and interpolation variables.

7_2600.concept: 专门标签与结构化文本
7_2600.description: 响应多类含有专门标签或结构标记的文本：政策/许可网页措辞、统计数字、社会阶层分类、论坛制作说明与专名，以及 JSON 和 HTML 模板字段；未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 网页同意与服务条款措辞
patterns.context: 网页隐私/广告说明、编辑投诉政策或软件许可文本；激活落在服务、许可、投诉等词及相邻词上
patterns.domain: 网页文案、法律/政策声明、软件开源许可

patterns.name: 数字、金额及人口统计表述
patterns.context: 人口统计或收入统计句中，年龄、比例、金额等数字密集出现

patterns.name: 社会阶层分类术语
patterns.trigger: “non-manual work middle (class II)”“non-manual low”“manual work high / middle”“class V”
patterns.context: 按职业类型与高低层级划分社会阶层，分类标签连续列举
patterns.domain: 医学/公共卫生研究文本

patterns.name: 形状与制作说明
patterns.trigger: “made all these images”“Google Slides”“basic shapes such as square, circle, triangle”
patterns.context: 作者以非设计师身份介绍自己用常见几何形状制作图片

patterns.name: 专名中的拆分词片段
patterns.context: 论坛对话中出现用户名、产品或组织名称，激活落在名称内部或邻近片段

patterns.name: 结构化数据字段
patterns.context: JSON 类记录中字段名、计数值、年份及日期以键值形式排列
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的结构化数据

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 类名与模板变量
patterns.context: HTML 模板中出现 Angular 指令、CSS 类名及插值变量

en.description: Most activations come from the fixed instruction “if not, write” when a license is missing. Other examples include the legal construction “would find,” a return deadline in a text, Find in a name, and “then please” after a complaint condition. The commonality is weak; activations mainly reflect local word forms or phrases.

patterns.name: Mailing instruction when a GNU license is missing
patterns.context: The license text says a copy should accompany the library; if it was not received, write to the foundation. Activation is concentrated around “not, write”.

patterns.name: “find” in a judicial-review standard
patterns.context: A legal discussion describes how a reasonable judge would find that a lower court's assessment was wrong; activation falls on “find”.
patterns.domain: Federal court opinion concerning prisoner relief or appellate standards

patterns.name: Returning media within a specified period
patterns.context: Electronic-text license instructions state that, after receiving physical media, the recipient may request and return the media within a specified period.

patterns.name: Emphasis on a name or phrase
patterns.context: In a discussion of Nokia, HERE, and the Point & Find team, the marker falls on Find in the product or team name.

patterns.name: Conditional conjunction in an editorial complaint process
patterns.context: A news site's editorial guidelines say to contact the editor if a complaint concerns content accuracy or infringement of rights; activation is concentrated on “then please,” which introduces the action after the condition.

7_2600.description: 多数激活来自许可证缺失时“if not, write”这一固定指示；另有法律句式“would find”、文本中的退回期限、名称中的 Find，以及投诉条件后的“then please”。共同点较弱，主要是局部词形或短语触发。

patterns.name: GNU许可证缺失时的邮寄指示
patterns.trigger: “if not, write to the Free Software Foundation”及标记的“not”“,”“write”
patterns.context: 许可证文本说明应随库附带一份副本；若未收到，则写信联系基金会。激活集中在“not, write”附近。

patterns.name: 司法审查标准中的“find”
patterns.context: 法律论述中描述合理法官会认定下级法院的评估有误；激活落在“find”上。
patterns.domain: 联邦法院意见，涉及囚犯救济或上诉标准

patterns.name: 规定期限内退回介质
patterns.context: 电子文本许可说明：收到实体介质后，可在规定期限内请求并退回介质。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg电子文本法律/使用条款

patterns.name: 对名称或短语的强调
patterns.context: 讨论 Nokia、HERE 与 Point & Find 团队时，标记落在产品或团队名称中的 Find。

patterns.name: 编辑投诉流程中的条件连接词
patterns.context: 新闻网站编辑准则说明，若投诉涉及内容准确性或侵犯权益，则请联系编辑；激活集中在条件句后引出行动的“then please”。
patterns.domain: 新闻网站编辑规范说明

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered across license boilerplate, even numbers and calculations, patent figure labels, temporal narration, types and method calls, land-use percentages, and punctuation around license text. There is no single reliable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: GPL license notice
patterns.context: Standard license text in a software copyright notice, especially the sentence asking recipients to write to the foundation if they did not receive a copy of the license

patterns.name: Even numbers and numerical calculations
patterns.context: Discussion of even numbers, integer operations, or computational performance; activation falls on the word for even numbers and adjacent numbers or operation text

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and device labels
patterns.context: A patent describes semiconductor devices and drawings, with consecutive figure numbers, cross-section lines, and device abbreviations

patterns.name: Time, sequence, and realization
patterns.context: Narration of the sequence in which a feature or demo occurred before a certain time or after viewing; triggers are scattered through the sentence

patterns.name: Types and method calls
patterns.context: Discussion of the underlying types and available methods of C# objects, including type names and method-call examples

patterns.name: Land-use percentages
patterns.context: Land uses such as agriculture, forest, and built-up areas are listed as percentages; activation is distributed across numbers, punctuation, and adjacent text

patterns.name: Punctuation before medium
patterns.context: Electronic-text license terms describe examples of physical media; activation is concentrated near parentheses and commas, with no identifiable independent semantic trigger

7_2600.description: 激活模式分散：涵盖许可证套语、偶数与计算、专利图号、时间叙述、类型和方法调用、土地百分比，以及许可文本标点邻域；没有单一可靠的语义触发因素。

patterns.name: GPL 许可证通知
patterns.trigger: “You should have received a copy of the GNU Lesser General Public License”; “if not, write to the Free Software Foundation”
patterns.context: 软件版权声明中的标准许可证文本，尤其是要求收件人未收到许可证副本时写信联系基金会的句子
patterns.domain: 软件源码注释、许可证文本

patterns.name: 偶数及数值计算
patterns.context: 讨论偶数、整数运算或计算性能；激活落在偶数一词和相邻的数字、运算文本上

patterns.name: 专利图号与器件标号
patterns.context: 专利描述半导体器件及附图时，连续出现图号、剖面线和器件缩写

patterns.name: 时间、先后与想到
patterns.context: 叙述某功能或演示在某时间之前或观看之后的先后过程；触发分散在句中
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、口语化技术叙述

patterns.name: 类型与方法调用
patterns.context: 讨论 C# 对象的底层类型及可用方法，出现类型名和方法调用示例

patterns.name: 土地用途百分比
patterns.context: 以百分比罗列农业、森林、建成区等土地用途；激活分布于数字、标点及相邻文本

patterns.name: medium 前的标点
patterns.context: 电子文本许可条款中描述实体介质示例；激活集中在括号和逗号附近，无法确定独立语义触发因素

en.description: Activations are scattered across license disclaimers and GPL contact instructions, demographics and monetary amounts, computational discussions, positive/negative mathematical components, and instructions for returning electronic texts; there is no stable shared semantic trigger. GitHub samples are mostly repetitions of the same passage.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases in license disclaimers
patterns.context: Software license terms describe software as provided as-is and without warranty; activation is concentrated around this disclaimer.

patterns.name: GPL copies and contact instructions
patterns.context: A copyright notice requires the GPL to accompany the code and instructs readers to write to the Free Software Foundation if they have not received a license copy; multiple samples are the same passage.

patterns.name: Demographic and income statements
patterns.context: Demographic sentences describe age distribution, median household income, and figures listed by gender.

patterns.name: Even numbers and computational performance discussions
patterns.context: Discusses large numbers or repeated computations, using Project Euler problems as examples; «even» is strongly activated, but surrounding context also involves computational performance.

patterns.name: Positive and negative components in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A theoretical or mathematical derivation explains that an evolution contains two components with positive and negative signs.

patterns.name: Electronic text return instructions
patterns.context: Explains how to make a request and return a physical-media version if one is received; activation falls near line breaks and media examples.

7_2600.description: 激活分散在许可证免责声明与 GPL 联系指引、人口统计和金额、计算讨论、数学正负分量及电子文本退回说明中；没有稳定共享的语义触发点。GitHub 样本多为同一段落的重复。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的固定短语
patterns.context: 软件许可证条款中，描述软件按现状提供且不作担保；激活集中在该免责声明附近。

patterns.name: GPL 副本及联系指引
patterns.context: 版权注释要求随代码附上 GPL，并指示未收到许可证副本时写信给自由软件基金会；多个样本是同一段文本。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码许可证注释

patterns.name: 人口统计与收入表述
patterns.context: 人口统计句子描述年龄分布、家庭收入中位数和按性别列出的数值。

patterns.name: 偶数与计算性能讨论
patterns.context: 谈论较大数字或多次计算，并以 Project Euler 问题为例；«even» 强激活，但周围还有计算性能语境。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的正负分量
patterns.context: 理论或数学推导中，说明一个演化包含两个带正负号的分量。

patterns.name: 电子文本退回指引
patterns.context: 说明收到实体介质版本时如何提出请求并退回；激活落在换行及介质示例附近。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子文本许可条款

en.description: Activation is scattered across age and numbers, arithmetic symbols and results, knowledge and connective words in papers and patents, proper-name segmentation, quantity expressions, and formula symbols. Many cases look like tokenization or incidental co-occurrence; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Age phrases
patterns.context: Biographies or profiles mention age, age milestones, or lifespan; activation on the numbers and surrounding words is inconsistent.

patterns.name: Arithmetic operations and numerical results
patterns.context: Math problems present specific numerical calculations, addition or subtraction, or operation results; number segmentation and symbols may both contribute.

patterns.name: Knowledge- or information-related words
patterns.context: Statements, introductory phrases, or knowledge-related expressions in scientific papers or patent technical descriptions; these words are scattered, with no shared fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Paragraph transitions and narrative words
patterns.context: Narrative, causal, or contrastive expressions at paragraph openings or sentence transitions; they occur in only a few texts.

patterns.name: Proper names or internal segmentation fragments
patterns.context: Names of people, stage names, or places are segmented into multiple tokens; activation fragments vary and may be incidental tokenization effects.

patterns.name: Quantity or degree expressions
patterns.context: Expressions of quantity, multiple objects, or broad scope, but their meanings and syntactic environments are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Internal English word fragments or grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within word forms or on high-frequency function words; no stable semantic or syntactic condition holds across passages.
patterns.domain: Papers, math problems, patents, and general text

patterns.name: Formulas and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Activation appears near symbols, variables, and formula boundaries in formulas or symbolic expressions in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Unexplained local patterns
patterns.context: Occurs only in a single snippet or local context and cannot be assigned to a more stable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, patents, online text, encyclopedias

7_2600.description: 激活分散在年龄与数字、算术符号和结果、论文及专利中的知识/衔接词、专名切分、数量表达和公式符号等局部模式；多处更像分词或偶然共现，未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 年龄词组
patterns.trigger: «age»，以及其后的数字，如 «age»« of» 92、«age»« of»« 19»
patterns.context: 人物传记或人物介绍中，提及年龄、年龄节点或寿命；数字本身及周围词的激活不完全一致。

patterns.name: 算术运算与数字结果
patterns.context: 呈现具体数值计算、加减法或运算结果的数学题目；数字分段和符号可能共同参与。

patterns.name: 知识或信息相关词语
patterns.context: 科技论文或专利技术说明中的陈述、引导语或知识表述；这些词分散出现，未见共同的固定短语。

patterns.name: 段落连接与叙述词
patterns.context: 段落开头或句间衔接位置的叙述、因果或转折表达；只在少数文本中出现。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、专利说明、问答

patterns.name: 专名或内部切分片段
patterns.context: 人名、艺名或地名等专名被切分成多个 token；激活片段形态各异，可能是分词偶然性。

patterns.name: 数量或程度表达
patterns.context: 谈及数量、多种对象或广泛范围，但词义和句法环境并不一致。
patterns.domain: 问答、新闻评论、网络文本

patterns.name: 英语词内部或语法片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词形内部片段或高频功能词上；跨段缺乏稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论文、数学题、专利及一般文本

patterns.name: 公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学论文的公式或符号表达中，符号、变量和公式边界附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部模式
patterns.context: 仅在单个片段或局部语境中出现，无法归入更稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学问答、专利、网络文本、百科

en.concept: Strings dense with numbers and symbols
en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous text: symbols, numbers, variables, and operations in mathematics and code; chemical formulas and identifiers in patents; and local strings such as proper names and ages. No single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Comparison symbols in angle brackets
patterns.context: When discussing the use of less-than and greater-than signs as delimiters, the comparison symbols and related wording are activated.

patterns.name: Numerical age expression
patterns.context: In the age expression “by the age of 19,” “age” and its number are strongly activated.

patterns.name: Integer parity and ±1
patterns.context: In code explaining how to choose n−1 or n+1 depending on whether n is even, the parity condition and adjacent-integer expressions are activated.

patterns.name: Chemical names and formula quantities
patterns.context: When listing stevia-leaf glycosides and their weight percentages, chemical-name fragments and numerical values are activated.

patterns.name: Patent-number strings
patterns.context: In patent document identifiers, sequences segmented into letters, hyphens, and numbers are activated.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and material names
patterns.context: Activated when a patent's related-art section lists photoconductive materials and their chemical formulas.

patterns.name: Programming-pulse indices and variables
