patterns.context: When describing programming pulses and threshold-voltage levels, alphanumeric indices and indexed expressions are activated.

patterns.name: Matrix elements and symbols
patterns.context: In matrix notation and its numerical elements with positive or negative signs, variable subscripts, numbers, and symbols are activated.

patterns.name: Positive and negative signs in mathematical components
patterns.context: When describing evolution as comprising positive and negative components, the signs and adjacent text are activated.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Names, hyphens, and album-release wording appear in descriptions of songs and artists; activation falls on names and alphanumeric fragments.

7_2600.concept: 数字与符号密集字符串
7_2600.description: 激活分布于异质文本：数学与代码中的符号、数字、变量和运算表达，专利里的化学式及编号，以及专名、年龄等局部字符串；未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 尖括号中的比较符号
patterns.context: 讨论把小于号和大于号用作分隔符时，比较符号及相关用词被激活。

patterns.name: 年龄数字表达
patterns.context: “by the age of 19”这一年龄表述中，“age”及其数字被强烈激活。

patterns.name: 整数奇偶与 ±1
patterns.context: 按 n 是否为偶数来选择 n−1 或 n+1 的代码说明中，奇偶条件与相邻整数表达被激活。

patterns.name: 化学名称与配方数字
patterns.context: 列举甜菊叶糖苷及其重量百分比时，化学名称片段和数值被激活。

patterns.name: 专利号字符串
patterns.context: 专利文献编号中，字母、连字符和数字的分段序列被激活。

patterns.name: 化学式与材料名称
patterns.trigger: "(b) Description of the Related Art"、"selenium (Se)"、"cadmium sulfide (CdS)"、"zinc oxide (ZnO)"、"a-Si"
patterns.context: 专利文本的相关技术章节列举光导材料及其化学式时被激活。

patterns.name: 编程脉冲的序号与变量
patterns.context: 描述编程脉冲和阈值电压等级时，混合字母数字的序号、索引表达被激活。

patterns.name: 矩阵元素与符号
patterns.context: 矩阵记号及其带正负号的数值元素中，变量下标、数字和符号被激活。

patterns.name: 数学分量中的正负号
patterns.context: 描述演化包含正、负两个分量时，正负号及其相邻文字被激活。

patterns.name: 专名内部的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 歌曲与艺人叙述中的姓名拼写、连字符及唱片发行用语出现；激活落在名称和字母数字片段上。

en.concept: Expressions of wishing and discourse-turn markers
en.description: The main responses are wish/wished (expressing hope, willingness, or thanks) and the sentence-initial contrastive phrase “That said”. Other isolated words are activated across passages without consistent contexts and are difficult to subsume under these two main patterns.

patterns.name: wish and its inflections
patterns.context: wish/wished followed by an infinitive, object, or that-clause, expressing hope, willingness, or thanks
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, book narration, medical acknowledgments

patterns.name: Contrastive-concessive phrase
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or paragraph, “That said” introduces an addition, concession, or contrast
patterns.domain: Online forums, informal discussions such as interior design

patterns.name: Scattered word and phrase activations
patterns.context: Isolated words or phrases in various passages; no contextual condition supports a shared pattern
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes parliamentary speeches, novels, technical discussions, and acknowledgments

7_2600.concept: 意愿表达与话语转折标记
7_2600.description: 主要响应 wish/wished（表达希望、意愿或致谢）和句首转折语“That said”；此外还有分散于各段的孤立词语激活，缺少一致上下文，难以并入两种主模式。

patterns.name: wish 及其变形
patterns.context: wish/wished 后接不定式、宾语或 that 从句，表示希望、意愿或致谢
patterns.domain: 议会发言、书籍叙述、医学致谢

patterns.name: 转折让步语
patterns.context: 句首或段落开头，以“话虽如此”引出补充、让步或转折
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、室内设计等非正式论述

patterns.name: 零散词句激活
patterns.trigger: « discriminate»、« last»、« turns»« out»、« made»、« bl»«ames»、« scarcely»、« recognize»、« ubiquitous»、« triv»ially、« Finally»、« build»
patterns.context: 各段中的孤立词语或短语；未见足以归纳为共同条件的上下文
patterns.domain: 跨领域；涉及议会、小说、技术讨论、致谢等

en.description: Activations are scattered across cognitive evaluation, argumentation, and state-change expressions, and also occur in legal reasoning, numerical operations, concessive limitations, and contexts involving commitment; trigger words vary widely across corpora, with no unified stable local feature.

patterns.name: Emphasis in evaluation or inference
patterns.context: In opinions, judgments, or arguments, activation often falls on verbs expressing cognition, evidence, or evaluation, or on the complement immediately following them; the specific trigger words differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Narration, film criticism, legal argumentation, technical discussions

patterns.name: Expressions of time and state transitions
patterns.context: Involves duration, completion, unrealized outcomes, or a change of state at a given stage; some examples occur in time phrases or fixed legal expressions.

patterns.name: Legal reasoning and statutory language
patterns.context: Occurs in the context of arguments about decisions, legal tests, or eligibility for remedies; activation is distributed across legal terminology and argumentative connectors.

patterns.name: Quantification and numerical operations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numbers, arithmetic operations, or multiplicative relationships, but no single mathematical mechanism explains all locations.

patterns.name: Concession, negation, and limitation
patterns.context: Includes expressions of concession, negation, exception, or degree limitation; activation falls near subordinating conjunctions, negative constructions, or degree-related contexts.

patterns.name: Commitment, attachment, and attitude
patterns.context: Describes commitment to a cause or viewpoint, persistence, attachment, or related donation behavior.

7_2600.description: 激活散布于认知评价、论证与状态变化表达，也见于法律推理、数字运算、让步限制和投入态度语境；触发词跨语料差异较大，尚无统一稳定的局部特征。

patterns.name: 评价或推断中的强调
patterns.trigger: thought« it»4 a»1 particularly nice« place»2；«should've been« one；«don't think»7；«makes»9 clear»7；«shows»9；«doesn't»4« make»9 it
patterns.context: 在观点、判断或论证中，激活常落在表达认知、证据或评价的动词上，或其后紧接的补语；各例的具体触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 叙事、影视评论、法律论证、技术讨论

patterns.name: 时间与状态转换表达
patterns.context: 涉及持续、完成、未实现或某一阶段的状态变化；有的出现于时间短语或法律固定搭配中。

patterns.name: 法律推理与法条表述
patterns.context: 在判决、法律测试或救济资格的论证语境中；激活分布于法律术语和论证连接处。

patterns.name: 量化与数字运算
patterns.context: 数字、算术操作或倍数关系附近有激活，但单一数学机制无法解释全部位置。

patterns.name: 让步、否定与限制
patterns.context: 包含让步、否定、例外或限制程度的表达；激活分别落在从属连词、否定结构或程度语境附近。

patterns.name: 投入、依附与态度
patterns.context: 描述对事业或观点的投入、坚持、依附，或相应的捐赠行为。
patterns.domain: 历史叙事、网络技术评论

en.concept: Age expressions and heterogeneous text fragments
en.description: Activation peaks are concentrated in the “age of number years” structure. Other highly activated examples are scattered across alphanumeric technical strings in patents, split or compound words, and game narratives; there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Age values and units
patterns.context: age followed by of and a specific age value, then years; the age value and adjacent structure are most strongly activated.

patterns.name: Opaque patent technical forms or codes
patterns.context: Patent background sections interleave letters, numbers, hyphens, and technical terms; no unified trigger word can be inferred from these fragments.

patterns.name: Unusual strings in inflected forms or terminology
patterns.context: Split or hyphenated words, proper names, and compound terms occur in different domains; no clear shared semantic condition is apparent across these examples.
patterns.domain: Immigration and labor, astrophysics, workaholism research, book titles

patterns.name: Game difficulty and narrative transition
patterns.context: A game-experience narrative mentions difficulty settings, then recalls information learned years later from a history book; triggers are scattered.

7_2600.concept: 年龄表达及异质文本片段
7_2600.description: 激活峰值集中在“age of 数字 years”结构；其余高激活例子分散于专利中的字母数字技术串、拆分或复合词，以及游戏叙述，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 年龄数值及其单位
patterns.context: 出现 age 后接 of 和具体年龄数值、years；年龄数值及相邻结构激活最强。
patterns.domain: 社会科学或人物介绍类文本

patterns.name: 不透明的专利技术词形或编码
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，字母、数字、连字符及技术术语交错；无法从这些片段确定一个统一触发词。

patterns.name: 形态变化或术语中的特殊字串
patterns.context: 不同领域中出现被拆分或带连字符的词语、专名和复合术语；这些例子之间未见明确共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 移民与劳动、天体物理、工作成瘾研究、图书标题

patterns.name: 游戏难度与叙事转折
patterns.context: 游戏体验叙述中提到难度设置，随后回忆多年后从历史书中获知的信息；触发点分散。

en.description: Activation is scattered across cross-disciplinary prose, formulas and chemical formulas, technical terms, and literature citations, as well as social-issue words and several ordinary syntactic fragments. These examples show no single stable semantic or formatting trigger.

patterns.name: Marked quotations and literature-citation formats
patterns.context: Neurons show strong activation near references, author-year citations, or example markers; however, activation also covers body text and formulas across fields, so citation format cannot explain all highlights.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent background sections, and encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and symbol strings
patterns.context: Letters, numbers, and symbol combinations in mathematical notation, LaTeX formulas, and elemental chemical formulas can all trigger activation; this pattern is evident in mathematical and materials-chemistry content.

patterns.name: Scientific and technical terms and combinations
patterns.context: Activation occurs around domain terms, substance names, or descriptions of mechanisms in technical prose; examples involve biology, physics, astrophysics, and numerical computation, without a unified topic.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, ecology, physics, astrophysics, and computational science

patterns.name: Authors and years in parenthetical citations
patterns.context: Author names are tokenized or occur near years, square brackets, commas, and other citation punctuation; some strong activations fall within citation formats.

patterns.name: Violence, exclusion, and social resistance
patterns.context: Activation occurs near these concepts in accounts of social issues or social impact; the two passages have different contexts and do not explain the other scientific texts.

patterns.name: Local common words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: In several passages, activation falls on ordinary prepositions, conjunctions, or common syntactic collocations; no consistent specialized semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Unifying explanation unavailable for domain-specific details
patterns.context: Highlights involve scattered words or formats across different topics, making it difficult to infer a consistent trigger mechanism from shared semantic or local-form conditions.
patterns.domain: Education, materials chemistry, medical imaging, and music culture

7_2600.description: 激活分散在跨学科正文、公式与化学式、专业术语和文献引用中，也覆盖社会议题词及若干普通句法片段；这些例子未显示单一稳定的语义或格式触发条件。

patterns.name: 标记性引文与文献引用格式
patterns.context: 神经元在参考文献、作者年份引用或举例标记附近有较强激活；但激活还覆盖了各领域的正文与公式，引用格式并不能解释全部高亮。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利背景及百科文章

patterns.name: 数学公式与符号串
patterns.context: 数学记号、LaTeX 公式和元素化学式中，字母、数字及符号组合均可触发；该模式在数学和材料化学内容中表现明显。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、材料化学专利

patterns.name: 科学技术主题词及其组合
patterns.context: 技术性叙述中出现领域术语、物质名称或机制描述时激活；涉及生物、物理、天体物理和数值计算，主题并不统一。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、生态学、物理、天体物理与计算科学

patterns.name: 引文括号中的作者与年份
patterns.context: 作者姓名被分词或与年份、方括号、逗号等引文标点相邻时出现；部分强激活落在引用格式内部。
patterns.domain: 带文献引用的学术文本

patterns.name: 暴力、排斥与社会抵抗
patterns.context: 社会议题或社会影响的叙述中，这些概念词附近激活；两段语境不同，且不能解释其他科学文本。

patterns.name: 局部常用词及句法片段
patterns.trigger: “Due to outward pushing”“In case of”“under natural conditions”“can be utilized”等
patterns.context: 若干段落中激活落在普通介词、连接词或常见句法搭配上；未见一致的专门语义条件。

patterns.name: 无法统一解释的领域特异细节
patterns.trigger: “tr(u)ancy”、材料价态“+2”、磁共振“eddy currents”、音乐杂志“Clash”等局部片段
patterns.context: 高亮涉及不同主题中的零散词语或格式，难以从共享的语义或局部形式条件中推出一致触发机制。
patterns.domain: 教育、材料化学、医学成像及音乐文化

en.concept: Specialized markers in scientific and technical text
en.description: Activation spans multiple disciplines, mainly falling on technical terms, numbers and statistics, and citation formats in scientific papers and patents. Clearer local patterns include gamma-ray sources, medical statistics, author citations, and chemical reaction descriptions, but these do not reduce to a single topic.

patterns.name: Gamma-ray sources and observational descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of gamma-ray sources, flares/bursts, flux, and multiwavelength observations; also occurs in astronomical source-catalog text near image templates.

patterns.name: Numbers and significance in medical statistics
patterns.context: When a medical paper reports incidence rates between groups, age associations, or statistical tests, activation is concentrated on values, percent signs, p-values, and significance-related wording.

patterns.name: Author-year citations with references
patterns.context: Authors, et al., years, or citation markers appear in literature reviews or discussions; citation formats and topics vary across passages.

patterns.name: Clinical and experimental terminology in biomedicine
patterns.context: In medical or life-science discussions, activation falls on terms for diseases, clinical care, molecular/cellular processes, age measures, or experimental analyses; the topics differ across examples.

patterns.name: Chemical processes and reaction products
patterns.context: Descriptions of process steps in patent background sections, involving reactants, catalysts, temperature, and products.

patterns.name: Astrophysical coordinates and distance values
patterns.context: Astrophysics text gives celestial-object identifiers, distances, or signed measurements; it shares an astronomy context with gamma-ray source descriptions but focuses on numerical and coordinate information.

patterns.name: Fragments that resist grouping
patterns.context: Activation involves varied word chunks; aside from medical statistics or experimental terminology, there is no evidence of a more specific shared trigger condition.

7_2600.concept: 科学技术文本中的专业标记
7_2600.description: 激活跨多个学科，主要落在科学论文/专利中的专业术语、数字与统计量、引用格式；较明确的局部模式包括伽马射线天体、医学统计、作者引文及化学反应描述，无法归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: γ 射线天体与观测描述
patterns.context: 描述伽马射线源、耀发/爆发、通量及多波段观测；也见于图像模板周围的天体源目录文本。

patterns.name: 医学统计结果中的数字与显著性
patterns.context: 医学论文报告组间发生率、年龄关联或统计检验时，激活集中在数值、百分号、p 值和显著性相关表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及图表引用

patterns.name: 带引文的作者-年份文献引用
patterns.context: 文献综述或论述中出现作者、et al.、年份/引用标记；不同段落的引用格式和主题并不相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及天体物理学论文

patterns.name: 生物医学中的临床与实验术语
patterns.context: 在医学或生命科学论述中，激活落在疾病、临床照护、分子/细胞过程、年龄指标或实验分析术语上；各例所指主题不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究申请

patterns.name: 化学工艺与反应产物
patterns.context: 专利背景中的工艺步骤描述，涉及反应物、催化剂、温度和产物。

patterns.name: 天体物理坐标与距离数值
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中给出天体标识、距离或带符号的测量值；与伽马射线源描述同属天文学语境，但触发内容偏向数值和坐标信息。

patterns.name: 无法归并的片段
patterns.context: 激活涉及多种词块；除医学统计或实验术语外，尚无证据表明存在更具体的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activation spans mathematical symbols and typesetting in formulas, indented code, aligned data/table formats, and also a small number of device terms and clinical statistical statements; the shared cue is mainly structured symbols, abbreviations, and formatting in technical texts, not a unified topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and formula structure
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, set definitions, or matrix entries, often with alignment symbols, brackets, subscripts, and superscripts; no specific mathematical topic is required.

patterns.name: Indented code and control structures
patterns.context: Code blocks contain file/directory checks, method calls, and newline indentation.

patterns.name: Structured data and aligned whitespace
patterns.context: Fields, values, or table cells are arranged in rows and columns, with whitespace and punctuation serving formatting purposes.
patterns.domain: Configuration/log-style data, medical tables, or extracted table text

patterns.name: Hyphens and alphanumeric combinations in device names
patterns.context: Technical terms combine letters, hyphens, and abbreviations and occur in device descriptions.
patterns.domain: Patent background, circuit and semiconductor technology

patterns.name: Medical terminology and statistical reporting
patterns.context: Clinical research describes cases, group differences, or statistical significance.

7_2600.description: 激活覆盖公式中的数学符号与排版、缩进代码、对齐的数据/表格格式，也包括少量器件术语和临床统计表述；共同线索偏向技术文本中的结构化符号、缩写与排版，主题并不统一。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与公式结构
patterns.trigger: 数学符号、下标/上标及 LaTeX 命令，如「q^{-1}(C_p)」「\underbrace」「\begin{pmatrix}」「\tau」
patterns.context: 出现在公式、集合定义或矩阵条目中，常伴随对齐符号、括号、下标和上标；不要求特定数学主题

patterns.name: 缩进代码与控制结构
patterns.context: 代码块中出现文件/目录判断、方法调用和换行缩进

patterns.name: 结构化数据与对齐空白
patterns.trigger: 「REPORT」「{sync}」、数值列表，以及大量对齐空格和换行
patterns.context: 字段、数值或表格单元按行列排列，空白和标点承担格式化作用
patterns.domain: 配置/日志式数据、医学表格或表格抽取文本

patterns.name: 器件名称中的连字符与字母数字组合
patterns.context: 技术名词由字母、连字符和缩写组合，出现在器件说明中
patterns.domain: 专利背景、电路与半导体技术

patterns.name: 医学术语与统计报告
patterns.context: 临床研究叙述病例、组间差异或统计显著性

en.concept: Structured terms and markers in technical text
en.description: Activation is scattered across technical texts in multiple domains, often falling on compound terms, category/status labels, quantified results, section/table references, and formula or code structures. There are also isolated examples involving astronomical events and educational outcomes, making a single semantic feature difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Category or status labels in technical text
patterns.context: Marks objects, categories, conditions, or states expressed as words or compounds; sometimes appears in technical terms and sometimes in code conditionals.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, physics papers, code

patterns.name: Numerical and quantitative results
patterns.context: Numbers, units, ranges, or statistics occur near quantitative discussion, formulas, or table references.
patterns.domain: Patents, medicine, radiotherapy research, mathematics papers

patterns.name: Paper structure and cross-references
patterns.context: Sections, tables, and internal reference markers, often accompanied by paper discussion or results reporting.

patterns.name: Tokenization or boundary fragments in terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on professional compound terms or word-form fragments spanning tokens, without a single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Tables, formulas, and markup syntax
patterns.context: Structural tokens in symbolic expressions, LaTeX/HTML-like markup, or program syntax.

patterns.name: Time intervals and astronomical observation events
patterns.context: Descriptions of observational activity and its timing, wavelength, or astronomical object.

patterns.name: Educational impact and social outcomes
patterns.context: Lists social, psychological, or behavioral effects related to students.

7_2600.concept: 技术文本中的结构化术语与标记
7_2600.description: 激活分散于跨领域技术文本，常落在复合术语、类别/状态标签、数字量化结果、章节表格引用及公式或代码结构上；另有天文事件和教育结果等孤例，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的类别或状态标签
patterns.context: 标记由词或复合词构成的对象、类别、条件或状态；有时出现在技术术语中，有时出现在代码判断中。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、物理论文、代码

patterns.name: 数值与量化结果
patterns.context: 数字、单位、范围或统计量出现在定量论述、公式或表格引用附近。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、放疗研究、数学论文

patterns.name: 论文结构与交叉引用
patterns.context: 章节、表格及内部引用标记，常伴随论文叙述或结果报告。

patterns.name: 术语中的分词或边界碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 拼接的专业复合词或词形片段上，未显示单一稳定词义。
patterns.domain: 医学、材料科学、物理、生物学

patterns.name: 表格、公式与标记语法
patterns.context: 符号化表达、LaTeX/HTML式标记或程序语法中的结构性 token。

patterns.name: 时间区间与天体观测事件
patterns.context: 描述观测活动及其时间、波段或天体对象。

patterns.name: 教育影响与社会结果
patterns.context: 列举学生相关的社会、心理或行为影响。

en.description: Primarily responds to dense sequences of formal symbols: variables, operators, numbers, and punctuation in LaTeX scientific formulas; it also appears in structured code/data and semiconductor patent terminology, with no single fixed trigger word.

patterns.name: Mathematical/scientific formula symbols
patterns.context: Dense LaTeX mathematics or scientific formulas; activation falls on symbols, numbers, punctuation, and adjacent formula tokens, rather than on a single mathematical symbol.
patterns.domain: Mathematical, physics, and scientific texts from ArXiv, StackExchange, and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Structured data and numbers in code
patterns.context: Parentheses, delimiters, numbers, and identifiers are interspersed in code or data sequences.

patterns.name: Technical patent materials and layer names
patterns.context: Describes the formation, material composition, and growth temperature of semiconductor layers.

7_2600.description: 主要响应密集的形式化符号序列：LaTeX 科学公式中的变量、运算符、数字和标点；也出现在结构化代码/数据及半导体专利术语中，未见单一固定触发词。

patterns.name: 数学/科学公式符号
patterns.trigger: 如“\rho”“\nabla”“\lambda”“\infty”“\pi”“\sum”“\begin{pmatrix}”及公式中的上下标、运算符
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学或科学公式密集出现；激活落在符号、数字、标点及公式相邻 token 上，并非单一数学符号
patterns.domain: ArXiv、StackExchange、PubMed Central 的数学、物理及科学文本

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化数据与数字
patterns.trigger: [1] 中的 JSON 样式片段“:[”“]”；[6] 中的“Reals.Expo(2.0)”及行号注释“(* 127 *)”
patterns.context: 代码或数据序列中，括号、分隔符、数字与标识符交错出现

patterns.name: 技术专利材料与层名
patterns.context: 描述半导体层的形成、材料组成及生长温度

en.concept: Difficult to assign to a single concept
en.description: Activation is most concentrated on prisoner and incarceration or judicial contexts; it also occurs on intra-word fragments in medical terminology, especially musculoskeletal terms and adrenal, as well as in an email-draft context. Surface trigger forms vary substantially across groups.

patterns.name: prisoner and related judicial contexts
patterns.context: The word prisoner appears, covering prisoners, political prisoners, detainees, and parties in judicial cases; it sometimes occurs mid-sentence or in quotations.
patterns.domain: Prisons, political narratives, news quotations, legal documents

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls within medical vocabulary or compound terms, including stems/subwords marked as split; the trigger position is not fixed at the word beginning.

patterns.name: Email draft and NDA
patterns.context: Email-like short sentences include a recipient salutation, an expression introducing a draft, and an abbreviation for a confidentiality agreement.

7_2794.description: 激活最集中于 prisoner 及监禁、司法语境；另见医学术语中的词内片段，尤其是肌肉骨骼相关词和肾上腺，以及一条邮件草稿上下文。各组表面触发形式差异较大。

patterns.name: prisoner 及相关司法语境
patterns.context: 出现单词 prisoner，涵盖囚犯、政治犯、被拘押者及司法案件中的当事人；有时处于句中或引述中。
patterns.domain: 监狱、政治叙事、新闻引语、法律文书

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学词汇或复合术语内部，包括被拆分标记的词干/子词；触发位置并不固定在词首。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、医学资料

patterns.name: 邮件草稿与 NDA
patterns.context: 邮件式短句中出现收件人称呼、引出草稿的表达及保密协议缩写。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly on “prisoner” and technical fragments in medical corpora. Other isolated patterns include exercise names, anatomical structures, and “Here” at the start of an email; no consistent, clear semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: The word prisoner
patterns.context: The word “prisoner” appears directly, referring to a prisoner, political prisoner, or detainee; it occurs in narratives, encyclopedic text, news quotes, or legal documents.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedic text, legal documents, and general narratives

patterns.name: Subword fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Technical terms in medical abstracts are split into multiple subwords; strong activation falls on fragments within the term rather than on the complete word.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper names or entity names
patterns.context: Appears in the specific exercise name “Baduanjin exercise”; the sentence reports its effect on symptoms.

patterns.name: Fragments of anatomical structure names
patterns.context: Appears in the anatomical structure name “adrenal medulla,” followed by a neurophysiological description.

patterns.name: Salutation in an email draft
patterns.context: The email body begins “Fred - Here is a draft NDA”; activation falls on “Here,” which introduces the draft.

7_2794.description: 强激活主要出现在“prisoner”及医学语料中的专业词片段；另有运动名称、解剖结构和邮件开头“Here”等孤立模式，未见统一的明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: prisoner 词语
patterns.context: 直接出现单词“prisoner”，用于描述囚犯、政治犯或被拘押者；可出现在叙事、百科、新闻引语或法律文书中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、法律及一般叙事

patterns.name: 医学专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的专业术语被切分为多个子词；强激活落在术语内部片段，而不是完整词上。

patterns.name: 专名或实体名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Baduanjin exercise”这一具体运动名称中；句子报告其对症状的影响。

patterns.name: 解剖结构名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在“adrenal medulla”这一解剖结构名称中，后接神经生理描述。

patterns.name: 邮件草稿中的称呼
patterns.context: 邮件正文以“Fred - Here is a draft NDA”开头，激活落在引出草稿的“Here”。

en.description: Activation patterns are diffuse: prisoner repeatedly activates strongly across several types of narrative; other cases include medical term fragments, a specific exercise name, a biliary morphology term, and Here in an email.

patterns.name: The lexical item prisoner
patterns.context: The word prisoner itself is marked as strongly activating; it may be preceded by modifiers or appear in military- or incarceration-related contexts.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, legal documents, science fiction/political narratives, and film synopses

patterns.name: Anatomical term fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of medical anatomical or physiological terms; medulla and tendon-related terminology both occur, but the available context is insufficient to establish a more specific shared condition.

patterns.name: Exercise name
patterns.context: Activation occurs on a specific exercise name and the word exercise; the sentence reports improvement in premenstrual syndrome symptoms.

patterns.name: Fusiform in a biliary term
patterns.context: In a medical description of a choledochal cyst, activation centers on a fragment meaning fusiform.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, descriptions of disease morphology

patterns.name: NDA document fragment
patterns.context: The email body begins with a name and hyphen, followed by Here is a draft NDA; activation centers on Here, with weaker marks on the name and hyphen.

7_2794.description: 激活模式分散：prisoner 在多类叙述中反复强激活；另见医学术语片段、具体运动名称、胆道形态词，以及邮件中 Here。

patterns.name: prisoner 词项
patterns.context: 单词 prisoner 本身被标记为强激活；前面可有修饰语或军事、监禁相关上下文。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、法律文书、科幻/政治叙述及电影剧情简介

patterns.name: 解剖学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学解剖或生理术语的词片段上；medulla 与肌腱相关术语均出现，但所给上下文不足以确定更具体的共同条件。

patterns.name: 运动名称
patterns.context: 激活出现在具体运动名称及 exercise 一词上，句子报告其改善经前综合征症状。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、运动干预研究

patterns.name: 胆道术语中的 fusiform
patterns.context: 胆总管囊肿的医学描述中，激活集中在表示梭形的词片段。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、疾病形态描述

patterns.name: NDA 文书片段
patterns.context: 邮件正文以人名和连字符后接 Here is a draft NDA；激活集中在 Here，另有较弱标记的人名和连字符。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、合同草稿沟通

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the word prisoner; it also responds to various biomedical or taxonomic proper-name fragments, intra-word Dutch fragments, and the email name Fred. Samples span domains, with no unified semantic interpretation yet.

patterns.name: prisoner / prisoner-related text
patterns.context: The word prisoner appears directly, or is followed by related phrases such as prisoner of war and prisoner task forces; these occur in texts about violent mobilization, film plots, historical explanations, and legal judgments.

patterns.name: Biomedical proper names and terminology fragments
patterns.context: Anatomical, biological-interaction, or pregnancy-complication terms in biomedical text, or standalone Latin botanical names; activation falls within terms or adjacent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Dutch compounds
patterns.context: In Dutch annotations or documents, activation occurs on intra-word fragments in compound expressions such as materiële historie.

patterns.name: Names in correspondence
patterns.context: An email begins by addressing the recipient as Fred, followed by a dash and Here is a draft NDA.

7_2794.description: 激活最稳定地落在 prisoner 一词上；另对多种生物医学或分类学专名片段、荷兰语词内片段及邮件人名 Fred 有反应。样本跨领域，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: prisoner / prisoner-related text
patterns.context: 直接出现单词 prisoner，或其后接 prisoner of war、prisoner task forces 等相关短语；分别出现在暴力动员文本、电影剧情、历史说明和法律判决中。

patterns.name: 生物医学专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的解剖、生物交互、妊娠并发症术语，或独立的植物学拉丁学名；激活落在术语内部或相邻子词片段。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研文本、分类学

patterns.name: 荷兰语复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语注释或文档中，激活出现在 materiële historie 等复合表达的词内片段。

patterns.name: 通信中的人名
patterns.context: 邮件开头以人名 Fred 称呼收件人，后接破折号和 Here is a draft NDA。

en.concept: Word fragments and proper names across domains
en.description: Activation most clearly falls on proper names, long-word subwords, and biomedical term fragments across domains. It also includes local strings such as oid and ē, as well as prisoner, commas, and email/title phrasing; no unified semantic category emerges.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names and word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of proper names or longer words; a fragment may be a root, affix, or tokenizer-split subword, and its specific semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles and body text, Baltic-language text, emails, biographical entries, and historical texts

patterns.name: Medical or biological term fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in technical vocabulary in medical, biological, or related paper titles and abstracts, including adrenal medulla, triterpenoid saponins, marine mammal strandings and mortality, and tendon terminology.

patterns.name: The suffix oid
patterns.context: In words such as Human-«oid» and triterpen-«oid», activation centers on the oid fragment; the two examples differ in meaning and domain.

patterns.name: Formatted titles and email drafts
patterns.context: Title-like text includes Interaction Through the Use of BCI, or an email body introduces an NDA draft; trigger points are diffuse and may relate to title/document phrasing, but evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Diacritic letters in a foreign language
patterns.context: Appears in the Latvian-like string «Dējejvistu labturī», with activation centered on the repeated macron-bearing letter.

patterns.name: Personal names and biographical entries
patterns.context: A person's name is split into multiple subwords, followed by a line break and a biographical introduction.

patterns.name: prisoner in violent threats
patterns.context: One instance refers to jailers/prisoners in a violent threat passage; another uses prisoner of war in a war narrative. The same word form activates across different contexts.

patterns.name: Commas and in-sentence lists
patterns.context: A comma activates in a list in a threatening passage; it also appears in punctuation around paper authors or compound names, suggesting a weak and nonspecific punctuation pattern.

7_2794.concept: 多领域词语片段与专名
7_2794.description: 激活最明确地落在多种领域的专名、长词子词及生物医学术语片段，也包括 oid、ē 等局部字符串；另见 prisoner、逗号及邮件/题名措辞，未形成统一语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名与词形内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或较长词语的片段上；片段本身可能是词根、词缀或由分词器切出的子词，具体语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题与正文、波罗的海语种文本、邮件、人物条目及历史文本

patterns.name: 医学或生物学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在医学、生物学或相关论文题目/摘要中的专业词汇，包括肾上腺髓质、三萜皂苷、海洋哺乳动物搁浅与死亡率，以及肌腱术语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 词尾 oid
patterns.context: 在 Human-«oid» 与 triterpen-«oid» 这类词中，激活集中于 oid 片段；两例语义和领域不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题或化学/植物学摘要

patterns.name: 格式化题名与邮件草稿
patterns.context: 标题式文字中出现 Interaction Through the Use of BCI，或邮件正文引出 NDA 草稿；触发点分散，可能与标题/文书措辞有关，但证据有限。

patterns.name: 外语中的变音符号字母
patterns.context: 出现在拉脱维亚语样的字符串 «Dējejvistu labturī» 中，激活集中在重复出现的长音字母。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、非英语文字

patterns.name: 人名及传记条目
patterns.context: 人物姓名被分成多个子词，后接换行及传记式介绍。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目

patterns.name: 激烈威胁性话语中的 prisoner
patterns.context: 一处在暴力威胁语段中指 jailers/prisoners；另一处在战争叙述中作 prisoner of war。相同词形跨不同语境激活。
patterns.domain: 网络叙事、战争电影剧情简介

patterns.name: 逗号及句中列举
patterns.context: 逗号在威胁性段落的列举中激活；也出现在论文作者/化合物名称的标点位置，提示标点模式较弱且不专一。

en.description: The most consistent cue is the intra-word fragment -omatic, especially in automatic, aromatic, idiomatic, and psychosomatic; a split fragment of sagittal also appears. The passages span diverse domains, and two other passages lack a clear shared word form.

patterns.name: Automation
patterns.context: Words contain or end in -omatic; case varies, and split tokens occur.

patterns.name: Aromatic compounds
patterns.context: Occurs within the word aromatic, often in names of chemical materials or pollutants.

patterns.name: Ending of idiomatic
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intra-word fragment of idiomatic.

patterns.name: Anatomical directional term
patterns.context: Activation falls on a split fragment of sagittal, which describes a body plane.

patterns.name: Psychosomatic term
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter fragment of psychosomatic.

patterns.name: No clear word-form pattern
patterns.context: The highlighted words in this passage do not match the evident word-form triggers in the other passages.

7_2794.description: 最稳定的线索是词内片段 -omatic，尤其 automatic、aromatic、idiomatic、psychosomatic；另有 sagittal 的拆分片段。各段领域多样，另两段缺乏明确共同词形。

patterns.name: 自动化
patterns.context: 词语中含有或以 -omatic 结尾；跨大小写、可拆分的词片出现。

patterns.name: 芳香族
patterns.context: 出现在 aromatic 一词内部，常见于化学材料或污染物名称。

patterns.name: idiomatic 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 idiomatic 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 解剖方位术语
patterns.context: 激活落在 sagittal 一词的拆分片段中，描述身体平面。

patterns.name: 精神身心术语
patterns.context: 激活落在 psychosomatic 一词的后部片段中。

patterns.name: 无法明确归入词形模式
patterns.trigger: 未见可确认的共同触发子串
patterns.context: 该段的高亮词与其他段的明显词形触发不一致。

en.concept: Multisyllabic word segments and technical terminology
en.description: Activation often falls on technical terms, technical words, or segments containing “omatic”; it also occurs on “awards” and section headings. There is no unified semantic condition across passages; some similarities are only in word form or register.

patterns.name: Technical terms or the suffix “-omatic”
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokens corresponding to this letter sequence, while the words' contexts vary; there is no consistent semantic context
patterns.domain: Biographies, StackExchange troubleshooting descriptions, patent text

patterns.name: Technical terms in academic texts
patterns.context: Multisyllabic technical words in medical, biological, chemical, or materials-science contexts; activation often falls on a word-internal or suffix segment
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, medical papers, materials-science abstracts

patterns.name: Student awards and activities
patterns.context: Describes students' performance at school, awards, or extracurricular activities; nearby terms include “outstanding student”, “acting”, and “debates”

patterns.name: Business services and product descriptions
patterns.context: Lists products, services, or activities offered by an organization, alongside “certification”, “conferences”, and “networking opportunities”

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in academic terminology
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across terminology or proper-name fragments in research abstracts; no shared trigger condition is evident beyond the academic register

patterns.name: Patent titles and section formatting
patterns.context: Appears in patent background-section headings and technical descriptions related to LCD panels; salient activation falls mainly on “Description”

patterns.name: Scientific vocabulary in titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on the material name “hematite” at the end of a title; the body discusses doping and conductivity

7_2794.concept: 多音节词段与专业术语
7_2794.description: 激活多落在专业术语、技术词或包含“omatic”的词段，也见于“awards”和章节标题；跨段缺少统一语义条件，部分相似仅是词形或语体重合。

patterns.name: 术语或词尾“-omatic”
patterns.context: 激活落在该字母串对应的 token 上，且词的语境各不相同；没有一致的语义上下文
patterns.domain: 人物传记、StackExchange 故障描述、专利文本

patterns.name: 学术文本中的专业术语
patterns.context: 医学、生物、化学或材料科学语境中的多音节专业词，激活常落在词中间或后缀部分
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、医学论文、材料科学摘要

patterns.name: 学生获奖及活动表述
patterns.context: 描述学生在校表现、奖项或课外活动；附近有“outstanding student”“acting”“debates”等

patterns.name: 商业服务与产品介绍
patterns.context: 列举组织提供的产品、服务或活动，和“certification”“conferences”“networking opportunities”并列
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目中的组织介绍

patterns.name: 学术术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在研究摘要的术语或专名片段中；除学术语体外未见共同触发条件

patterns.name: 专利标题及章节格式
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景技术章节标题及液晶面板相关技术描述中；显著激活主要落在“Description”

patterns.name: 标题中的科学词汇
patterns.trigger: “Why Silicon Doping Accelerates Electron Polaron Diffusion in Hematite”
patterns.context: 激活落在标题末尾的材料名称“hematite”上，正文讨论掺杂与电导率
patterns.domain: 材料科学论文标题与摘要

en.description: The most prominent shared cue is the word politicians, found in political news and commentary; sporadic triggers also occur in organizational certifications and awards, UK Muslim issues, and astronomical imaging, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: politicians
patterns.context: The word politicians appears directly, especially when discussing terms of office, corruption, public reaction, or political arrangements; no fixed syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Institutional certifications and awards lists
patterns.context: Introductions to companies or organizations list services, quality, standards, certifications, awards, and other qualifications or activities.
patterns.domain: Corporate promotions, organization descriptions, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: British Muslims and citizenship
patterns.context: Discusses Muslims in the UK, discrimination, citizenship, or the background of perpetrators of terrorist attacks.

patterns.name: High-resolution imaging
patterns.context: The phrase high resolution is strongly activated in technical discussions of astronomical data processing and ionospheric imaging.

7_2794.description: 最突出的共同线索是 politicians 一词，见于政治新闻与评论；另有组织认证奖项、英国穆斯林议题及天文成像等零散触发，难以归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: politicians
patterns.context: 直接出现 politicians 一词，尤其在谈论任期、腐败、公众反应或政治安排时；无须固定句法位置。

patterns.name: 机构认证与奖项清单
patterns.context: 企业或组织介绍中，列举服务、质量、标准、认证、奖项等资质与活动。
patterns.domain: 企业宣传、组织介绍、百科条目

patterns.name: 英国穆斯林与公民身份
patterns.context: 讨论英国境内穆斯林、歧视、公民身份或恐怖袭击者背景。
patterns.domain: 社会政治论述、新闻或评论

patterns.name: 高分辨率成像
patterns.context: 天文观测数据处理与电离层成像的技术讨论中，短语 high resolution 获强激活。

en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse English texts. Marked content includes token fragments, short words, line breaks, and truncation markers, and spans varied semantics such as medicine, technology, professions, webpages, and forums; no consistent theme or contextual condition explains all passages.

patterns.name: English token-fragment boundaries
patterns.context: Marked words often occur in ordinary English sentences, with no fixed fragment boundary; sometimes part of a word is marked, sometimes a complete word, with no stable syntactic position.

patterns.name: Short words and function words
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in news, email, forum comments, and web text, without consistent semantic or grammatical context.

patterns.name: Unusual or rare strings
patterns.context: Often occurs at truncation points or paragraph or comment separators; may also be a special token or formatting artifact. The specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Medical-paper phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses attribution, improvements in diagnosis/prognosis, and the relationship between patient characteristics and long-term survival.

patterns.name: Career advice and compensation discussions
patterns.context: Considers whether to prioritize learning opportunities early in a career and mentions compensation after several years in a comment excerpt.

patterns.name: Web entries and date bylines
patterns.context: A read-more prompt and author/date byline at the end of an article.

patterns.name: Proper names or topic words
patterns.context: A comment discusses a founder's elevator pitch and nostalgia for the late Soviet period; no specific trigger condition shared with other passages is evident.

patterns.name: Technical-paper terminology
patterns.context: Describes the performance and radiation characteristics of reconfigurable antennas in millimeter-wave MIMO.

patterns.name: Brain-training game promotional text
patterns.context: A webpage introduces mini-games for brain training and explains how to play them.

patterns.name: Email congratulating a career promotion
patterns.context: An email congratulates the recipient on a promotion and mentions surprise at their promotion to manager.

patterns.name: News-report phrasing
patterns.context: Reports a state legislature's proposal to establish a fund to help care for infants who suffered neurological injuries at birth.

patterns.name: Automotive nostalgia and popular culture
patterns.context: Recalls the old style of BMW racing cars and contrasts it with the Batmobile and Bruce Wayne.

patterns.name: Application idea in a forum comment
patterns.context: A commenter says that after completing a task, they thought it could be made into a standalone app; a user signature and comment separator appear nearby.

patterns.name: Bitmap formats and ambiguity of zero values
patterns.context: Explains that different zero values in a binary format cannot be distinguished, followed by forum comments and a repeated prompt.

7_2794.description: 激活分布于多种英文文本，标记内容包括分词片段、短词、换行及截断符，也覆盖医学、科技、职业、网页和论坛等各异语义；没有一致的主题或上下文条件可解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 英文分词片段边界
patterns.trigger: 分词或子词 token，如 «Cong»…«r»…«ats»、«brain»、«M»…«Wave»、«BMW» 以及 «-»
patterns.context: 被标记的词常处于普通英文句子中，片段边界并不固定；有时标记词的一部分，有时标记完整词，未见稳定句法位置。

patterns.name: 短词及功能词
patterns.context: 零散出现在新闻、邮件、论坛评论和网页文本中，缺乏一致的语义或语法上下文。

patterns.name: 异常或罕见字符串
patterns.context: 多出现在截断处、段落或评论分隔处，也可能是特殊 token 或格式残留；具体触发原因不明。
patterns.domain: 网页、论坛及格式化文本

patterns.name: 医学论文措辞
patterns.context: 讨论归因、诊断/预后改善，以及患者特征与长期生存的关系。

patterns.name: 职业建议与薪酬讨论
patterns.context: 谈职业早期是否优先选择学习机会，并在评论片段中提及多年薪酬。

patterns.name: 网页条目与日期尾注
patterns.context: 文章末尾的阅读更多提示和作者日期署名。

patterns.name: 专名或主题词
patterns.context: 评论谈及创始人的电梯演讲及其对苏联晚期的怀旧；未见与其他段共享的特定触发条件。

patterns.name: 科技论文术语
patterns.context: 描述毫米波 MIMO 中可重构天线的性能与辐射特性。

patterns.name: 脑训练游戏宣传语
patterns.context: 网页介绍训练脑力的小游戏及其玩法。

patterns.name: 职业晋升祝贺邮件
patterns.context: 邮件祝贺收件人晋升，并提及对晋升为经理的意外。

patterns.name: 新闻报道句式
patterns.context: 报道州议会建议设立基金，帮助照护出生时遭受神经损伤的婴儿。

patterns.name: 汽车怀旧与流行文化
patterns.context: 回顾 BMW 赛车的旧日风格，并以蝙蝠车及布鲁斯·韦恩作对照。

patterns.name: 论坛评论中的应用设想
patterns.trigger: «app»及«hey»、«this could totally be its own app»
patterns.context: 评论者讲述完成任务后想到可将其独立做成应用，附近有用户署名和评论分隔符。

patterns.name: 位图格式与零值歧义
patterns.context: 解释二进制格式中不同零值会无法区分，后接论坛评论及重复出现的提示。

en.concept: Closing parentheses and a few isolated words
en.description: The most consistent pattern is a closing parenthesis after a parenthetical quotation, taxonomic name, or number. Other isolated high activations involve gate voltage, immune cells, molecular clocks, and anecdotal evidence, with no clear shared condition.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis
patterns.context: Appears after parenthetical content such as quotations, taxonomic names, or numbers, closing the parenthesis; it is sometimes followed by a period or continued prose
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent background sections, medical literature, and technical texts

patterns.name: Gate voltage
patterns.context: Occurs with gate and swept back and forth, describing hysteresis in the resistance of a graphene device

patterns.name: Cell populations
patterns.context: Appears in the name VH34 cells, in a context discussing autoreactive B-cell populations

patterns.name: Molecular clock
patterns.context: Used with molecular and analysis to estimate species distributions and lineage changes

patterns.name: Anecdotal evidence
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase Anecdotal evidence, followed by suggests

7_2794.description: 最稳定的模式是括号内引文、分类名称或编号后的右括号闭合符。另有栅极电压、免疫细胞、分子钟和轶事证据等孤立高激活，彼此缺乏明确共同条件。

patterns.name: 右括号闭合
patterns.context: 出现在引文、分类学名称或编号等括号内容之后，作为括号闭合符；有时后接句号或继续正文
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利背景、医学文献及技术文本

patterns.name: 栅极电压
patterns.context: 与 gate、swept back and forth 共同出现，描述石墨烯器件电阻的滞后行为
patterns.domain: 石墨烯与器件物理学论文

patterns.name: 细胞群体
patterns.context: 出现在 VH34 cells 的命名中，语境讨论自反应 B 细胞群体

patterns.name: 分子钟
patterns.context: 与 molecular、analysis 连用，用于估计物种分布和谱系变化
patterns.domain: 系统发育与生物地理学论文

patterns.name: 轶事证据
patterns.context: 出现在 Anecdotal evidence 一词组中，后接 suggests

en.description: The ten passages span diverse domains, with activation on unrelated words and subwords; there is neither a stable semantic or stylistic theme nor an evident shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: Specific letter-string suffixes of the “sh/shi” type
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across different positions, word classes, and contexts; it cannot be explained by consistent lexical meaning, syntactic position, or domain conditions.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, patents, papers, product descriptions, email

7_2794.description: 十段横跨多领域，激活落在彼此不相干的词及子词上；既无稳定语义或文体主题，也无明显统一上下文条件。

patterns.name: 特定字母串“sh/shi”类后缀
patterns.trigger: [1] “« shell»”“« see»”；[2] “« held»”“« guides»”“« expansion»”“« deflection»”；[3] “« defensive»”“« shots»”；[4] “« shield»”“« sides»”；[5] “« light»”“« scratches»”“« noticeably»”“« glossy»”；[6] “« illumination»”；[7] “« resolution»”“« readout»”；[8] “« source»”“« info»”；[9] “« structure»”“« resolution»”“« coverage»”；[10] “« sight»”“« suggests»”
patterns.context: 激活分散在不同位置、词类和上下文中；无法由一致的词义、句法位置或领域条件解释。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、专利、论文、产品描述、邮件

en.concept: Descriptions of object states and performance
en.description: Activation is distributed across technical detection and parameter descriptions, evaluations or experience narratives about products and devices, and descriptions of color and lighting. There is no single clear trigger word; activation often falls on key object, state, or performance words.

patterns.name: Detection, measurement, and signal strength
patterns.context: In technical or scientific descriptions, refers to the object being detected, a measurement result, or signal/measurement capability; activation often falls on related nouns.
patterns.domain: Astronomy, sensors and biological detection, detector electronics

patterns.name: Numerical values and technical parameters
patterns.context: Technical descriptions mention devices, physical quantities, performance, or parameters; the trigger need not be the number itself and may instead be the object or action described by the parameter.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observations, aircraft models, patented probes, encoding software

patterns.name: Product evaluations and consumer experiences
patterns.context: Informal narratives or reviews discuss products, device condition, purchases, or usage experiences; activation may fall on state words or experience-related words.

patterns.name: Color, lighting, and visual space
patterns.context: Describes the color of interior design or lighting fixtures, natural light, sense of space, or the reach of a beam.

7_2794.description: 激活分散于技术检测与参数描述、商品和设备的评价或体验叙述，以及颜色和光照描述；没有单一明确触发词，常落在关键对象、状态或性能词上。

patterns.name: 检测、测量与信号强度
patterns.context: 在技术或科学描述中，表示检测对象、测量结果或信号/测量能力；激活常落在相关名词上。
patterns.domain: 天文学、传感器与生物检测、探测器电子学

patterns.name: 数值与技术参数
patterns.context: 技术说明中出现设备、物理量、性能或参数；触发词未必是数值本身，也可能是参数所描述的对象或动作。
patterns.domain: 天文观测、航空模型、专利探针、编码软件

patterns.name: 产品评价与消费体验
patterns.context: 非正式叙述或评论，谈到商品、设备状况、购买或使用体验；激活可落在状态词或体验相关词上。

patterns.name: 颜色、光照与视觉空间
patterns.context: 描述室内设计或照明设施的颜色、自然光、空间感或光束范围。
patterns.domain: 室内设计对话、百科说明

en.description: Activation is distributed across colors and brightness, mechanical power, fading, portability, and specific expressions in sports, news, and forum texts; no unified semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Bright colors and light
patterns.context: Describes clothing colors or indoor lighting and color; related words appear nearby

patterns.name: Power
patterns.context: Describes the power of an engine or mechanical equipment, often alongside words such as engine, reliability, or transmission

patterns.name: Fading
patterns.context: Describes paint fading in multiple areas of a vehicle

patterns.name: Lightweight and portable
patterns.context: Describes a jump rope as lightweight and easy to pack for travel

patterns.name: Center-line attacking pair
patterns.context: Describes a strong center combination in the context of hockey drafts

patterns.name: Looks like
patterns.context: After «Certainly», expresses the judgment that something is taking shape

patterns.name: Screenshot
patterns.context: Appears alongside game trailers, viewing, and promotional content

patterns.name: Text correction
patterns.context: A small correction is given after a forum quotation, with a colon introducing the correction

7_2794.description: 激活分散于颜色与明亮度、机械动力、褪色、轻便携带，以及体育、新闻和论坛文本中的特定表达；未见一个能解释全部段落的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 明亮颜色与光线
patterns.context: 描述服装颜色，或室内采光及色彩；相关词在附近共同出现
patterns.domain: 赛事服装规定、室内设计

patterns.name: 动力/功率
patterns.context: 描述发动机或机械设备的动力，常与引擎、可靠性或变速箱等词同现

patterns.name: 褪色
patterns.context: 描述车辆漆面在多处区域褪色

patterns.name: 轻便易携
patterns.context: 描述跳绳重量轻，便于放进行李携带

patterns.name: 中路进攻搭档
patterns.context: 冰球选秀语境中描述组成稳固的中路组合

patterns.name: 看起来像是
patterns.context: «Certainly»后表达对某事正在成形的判断

patterns.name: 截图
patterns.context: 与游戏预告片、观看和宣传内容并列

patterns.name: 文本纠错
patterns.context: 论坛引用后给出小幅更正，冒号引出修正内容

en.description: Activation occurs in varied contexts: sports combinations, ratings, appearance, injury, surprise, power, feedback, and evaluations of light weight. These fragments do not establish a shared trigger feature; several high activations fall on words from different parts of speech and semantic categories.

patterns.name: Specific English word form
patterns.context: In a hockey draft discussion, the phrase “1-2 punch” refers to a lineup combination; activation falls on punch.

patterns.name: Ratings and star expressions
patterns.context: Contexts involving review scores or star ratings, including “5.0/5 star rating”; the same passage also contains color words such as “bright” and “light colors.”
patterns.domain: Business promotion; also clothing policy text

patterns.name: look in an appearance evaluation
patterns.context: Gives a positive evaluation of the overall appearance of a cross-platform GUI framework.

patterns.name: Injury word form
patterns.context: Describes a player getting injured and consequently missing a game; the word occurs in the split phrase ankle sprain.

patterns.name: The emotion word shocked
patterns.context: A first-person narrator expresses surprise; one instance concerns a TV giveaway, another lemon-poppy-seed food.

patterns.name: Power and performance evaluation
patterns.context: Praises the power and reliability of a model engine.

patterns.name: Feedback evaluation
patterns.context: Expresses hope of being invited back and discusses positive feedback others gave the show.

patterns.name: Lightweight evaluation
patterns.context: A product review describes a jump rope as lightweight and easy to pack in luggage.

7_2794.description: 激活散见于多种语境：体育组合、评分、外观、受伤、惊讶、动力、反馈和轻便性评价。仅凭这些片段无法确定共同触发特征；若干高激活落在不同词类及语义上。

patterns.name: 特定英语词形
patterns.context: 在冰球选秀讨论中，短语“1-2 punch”指阵容组合；激活落在 punch。

patterns.name: 评分及星级表达
patterns.context: 围绕评价分数或星级的语境，包含“5.0/5 star rating”；同段也有“bright”“light colors”等颜色词。
patterns.domain: 商家宣传；另有服装规则文本

patterns.name: 外观评价中的 look
patterns.context: 对跨平台 GUI 框架整体外观作正面评价。

patterns.name: 受伤词形
patterns.context: 描述球员受伤并因此缺席比赛；词在拆分的 ankle sprain 中。

patterns.name: 情绪评价词 shocked
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述者表达惊讶；一处谈电视礼物，一处谈柠檬罂粟籽食品。

patterns.name: 动力及性能评价
patterns.context: 称赞模型发动机动力与可靠性。

patterns.name: 反馈评价
patterns.context: 表达希望获邀返场，并谈到他人对节目给出的正面反馈。

patterns.name: 轻便性评价
patterns.context: 商品评论称跳绳轻巧、便于放进行李携带。

en.description: Activation is distributed across evaluative noun phrases, descriptions of portability or color, numerical ratings, webpage/email formatting, and proper names or abbreviations. Several instances occur near adjective-modified nouns, but there is no single stable trigger word or unified context.

patterns.name: Adjective-noun combinations
patterns.context: When evaluating or describing an object, result, or performance, activation often occurs in adjective-modified noun phrases; different lexical combinations can appear.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news, film descriptions, user reviews, and general prose

patterns.name: Descriptions of portability and color
patterns.context: Describes clothing colors or an item being portable and lightweight; activation occurs around light/colors.

patterns.name: Quantities and measurements
patterns.context: Numerical values, ratings, or measurements occur; activation does not consistently fall on the values themselves in these passages and may relate to nearby words or formatting.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, product and service reviews, interviews

patterns.name: Document formatting and webpage markup
patterns.context: Web promotional text or quoted email combines line breaks and layout markers with prose; activation occurs near formatting markers.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper names, abbreviations, or token boundaries may trigger local activation; acclaim recurs in two film-related texts.
patterns.domain: Sports regulations, technical commentary, film descriptions

7_2794.concept: 评价性表达与名词短语
7_2794.description: 激活分散于评价性名词短语、轻便或颜色描述、数值评分、网页/邮件格式和专名缩写等；多处落在形容词修饰的名词附近，但没有单一稳定触发词或统一语境。

patterns.name: 形容词与名词的搭配
patterns.trigger: “great emotional blow”“great overall look”“huge critical acclaim”“positive feedback”等评价性修饰语，常见激活落在名词或名词短语末尾，如 “blow”“look”“acclaim”“feedback”
patterns.context: 评价或描述某事物、结果、表现时，激活常出现在形容词修饰的名词短语中；不同词汇组合均可出现。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、影视介绍、用户评价及一般叙述

patterns.name: 轻便与颜色描述
patterns.context: 描述服装颜色或物品便于携带、重量轻；激活落在 light/colors 一带。
patterns.domain: 体育服装规定、商品评价

patterns.name: 数量与度量表达
patterns.context: 出现数值、评分或计量表达；这些片段中激活并不稳定地落在数值本身，可能与邻近词及格式有关。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、商品与服务评价、访谈

patterns.name: 文档格式与网页标记
patterns.trigger: “↵↵”“SUBSCRIBE TO OUR NEWSLETTER”“FOLLOW US ON:”及引文前缀“>”
patterns.context: 网页宣传文本或邮件引用中，换行、版式标记与正文并存；激活出现在格式标记附近。

patterns.name: 专名与缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或分词边界可能触发局部激活；acclaim 在两处影视相关文本中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 体育规章、技术评论、影视介绍

en.description: Activation is scattered across several evaluative nouns, nouns denoting power or efficacy, heat in a low-temperature materials context, and the competition time word left. Local collocations differ, making it difficult to identify a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Heat/temperature word in a fixed phrase
patterns.context: In “low enough heat capacity at low temperatures,” heat occurs in a description of material properties.
patterns.domain: Academic papers; low-temperature detectors and materials

patterns.name: Nouns following evaluations or descriptions
patterns.context: An earlier passage gives an appearance evaluation, success evaluation, or star rating, and activation falls on the noun being described.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, web promotions, entertainment reporting

patterns.name: Nouns related to power and efficacy
patterns.context: The noun denotes power, a blow/impact, offensive strength, or business returns; preceding text respectively includes engines, emotional, drafting…down the middle, or strong.
patterns.domain: Aviation reviews, business emails, sports reporting, financial news

patterns.name: Game time point
patterns.context: In a game narrative, time remaining appears in a score or game-winning shot context, indicating time left before the end.

7_2794.description: 激活分散在若干评价名词、力量或效能名词，以及低温材料语境的 heat 和比赛时间词 left；各例的局部搭配不同，难以归为单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语中的热量/温度词
patterns.context: “low enough heat capacity at low temperatures”中，热量词 heat 处于材料物理性质描述中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文；低温探测器与材料

patterns.name: 评价、描述后的名词
patterns.context: 前文给出外观评价、成功评价或星级评分，激活落在所描述的名词上。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、网页宣传、娱乐报道

patterns.name: 力量与效能相关名词
patterns.context: 名词表示动力、打击/冲击、进攻力量或商业回报；前文分别有 engines、emotional、drafting…down the middle、strong。
patterns.domain: 航空评论、商务邮件、体育报道、财经新闻

patterns.name: 比赛时间节点
patterns.context: 比赛叙述中剩余时间置于比分或制胜球语境，表示终场前剩余时间。

en.description: Activation falls on final words in various evaluative or technical and sports expressions: acclaim, hit, look, output, noise, rating, punch, etc.; also left for remaining time in a game. Semantics and word forms are inconsistent.

patterns.name: acclaim suffix
patterns.context: When “acclaim” is split into subwords, strong activation falls on the ending claim; the context is a work or performance receiving praise

patterns.name: hit as a success evaluation
patterns.context: Hit means popular or successful, preceded by an intensifier such as huge

patterns.name: look as an appearance evaluation
patterns.context: Look refers to the overall visual effect, preceded by overall or great

patterns.name: Final item in a compound term: output
patterns.context: In the technical compound expression input/output, activation falls on output

patterns.name: Game-winning context
patterns.context: Describes the final stages of a game, time remaining, and a winning goal or score

patterns.name: Appearance and gloss evaluation
patterns.context: Describes the wet appearance and gloss produced by a polishing product

patterns.name: Rating term
patterns.context: Customer reviews express ratings in stars; the preceding text mentions receiving a rating

patterns.name: Signal-to-noise terminology
patterns.context: In the expression signal-to-noise, activation falls on noise

patterns.name: Sports compound expression with punch
patterns.context: “1-2 punch” metaphorically describes the combined strength of a team’s center positions

7_2794.description: 激活落在多类评价或技术、体育表达的末词：acclaim、hit、look、output、noise、rating、punch 等；另有比赛剩余时间 left。语义与词形不统一。

patterns.name: acclaim 后缀
patterns.context: “acclaim”被拆分为子词时，强激活落在词尾 claim；语境是作品或表演获得好评

patterns.name: hit 作为成功评价
patterns.context: hit 指受欢迎或成功，前有 huge 等程度修饰词

patterns.name: look 的外观评价
patterns.context: look 指整体视觉效果，前有 overall、great

patterns.name: output 复合术语末项
patterns.context: 在 input/output 技术复合表达中，激活落在 output

patterns.name: 比赛胜利语境
patterns.context: 描述比赛末段、剩余时间及制胜球或得分

patterns.name: 外观与光泽评价
patterns.context: 描述抛光产品带来的湿润外观和光泽

patterns.name: 评分词
patterns.context: 客户评价中以星级表示评分，前文提及收到评分

patterns.name: 信噪比术语
patterns.context: signal-to-noise 表达中激活落在 noise

patterns.name: 体育 punch 复合表达
patterns.context: “1-2 punch”比喻球队中锋位置上的组合实力

en.description: Activation centers on evaluative or argumentative expressions such as acclaim and evidence, and also includes isolated words for positive effects or ratings, such as returns, look, and rating. Trigger words appear in entertainment, research, business, and product texts.

patterns.name: acclaim in critical acclaim / reception
patterns.context: In contexts evaluating a film or performance, acclaim is split into ac + claim, with acclaim as the activation center; it often co-occurs with words such as critical, received, performance, and success.

patterns.name: evidence in compelling evidence
patterns.context: In scientific discussion or research abstracts, evidence appears in the structure “compelling evidence that ...”; preceding text often describes research findings, observations, or data.

patterns.name: returns
patterns.context: In a corporate earnings sentence, strong modifies returns to describe a business unit generating strong returns.

patterns.name: look / gloss
patterns.context: In an automotive care product review, look refers to the appearance produced by the product and occurs near words such as gloss and protection.

patterns.name: rating
patterns.context: In business promotional copy, a star rating precedes rating, describing Google customer reviews.

7_2794.description: 激活集中于 acclaim、evidence 等评价或论据表达，也包括 returns、look、rating 等孤立的正向效果或评分词；触发词分布于娱乐、科研、商业及产品文本。

patterns.name: critical acclaim / reception 中的 acclaim
patterns.context: 影视作品或表演的评价语境中，acclaim 被拆分为 ac + claim，且 acclaim 是激活中心；常伴随 critical、received、performance、success 等词。

patterns.name: compelling evidence 中的 evidence
patterns.context: 科学论述或研究摘要中，evidence 出现在“compelling evidence that ...”结构；前文常描述研究结果、观察或数据。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: returns
patterns.context: 企业财报句中，strong 修饰 returns，描述业务部门带来强劲回报。

patterns.name: look / gloss
patterns.context: 汽车护理产品评论中，look 指产品带来的外观效果，并与 gloss、protection 等词相邻。

patterns.name: rating
patterns.context: 商家宣传语中，rating 前出现星级评分，描述 Google 客户评价。

en.description: Strong activation often falls on exclamation marks and final words in positive evaluations or promotional copy; also includes look in aesthetic evaluations, acclaim for praise, and evidence in medical literature. No clear shared lexical or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Exclamation mark at sentence end or before punctuation
patterns.context: An exclamation mark ends promotional, evaluative, or explanatory sentences; usually it appears at sentence end, possibly followed by a space, line break, or new sentence.
patterns.domain: Website copy, reviews, recommendations, emails, etc.

patterns.name: look before a positive evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates appearance, visual effect, or presentation; examples include “great overall look” and “deeper, wet look gloss.”

patterns.name: Praise for performance
patterns.context: The latter part of the word for praise in “critical acclaim,” referring to a work receiving positive reviews.

patterns.name: Evidence reported after a percentage
patterns.context: Appears in the evidence statement “strong evidence to show” after a percentage, research findings, and citations.

7_2794.description: 强激活多落在感叹号及正面评价、宣传语的句末；另有 look 的审美评价、acclaim 的赞誉和医学文献中的 evidence，未见它们共享明确的词法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 句末或标点前的感叹号
patterns.context: 感叹号结束宣传、评价或说明性句子；多在句末，之后可能接空格、换行或新句。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、评论、推荐、邮件等

patterns.name: 正面评价词前的 look
patterns.context: 评价外观、视觉效果或呈现方式；一例为“great overall look”，另一例为“deeper, wet look gloss”。

patterns.name: 对表现的赞誉
patterns.context: “critical acclaim”中赞誉一词的后半部分，指向作品获得好评。

patterns.name: 百分比后报告证据
patterns.context: 在百分比、研究结果和引用之后，出现在“strong evidence to show”这一证据陈述中。

en.description: Patterns include evaluative statements about evidence in academic contexts, research promotion, sports results and terminology, firearm apparel advertising, stock subscription marketing, and neuroimaging technology descriptions; there is no unified semantics across topics.

patterns.name: Evaluative collocations with evidence
patterns.context: In academic or research contexts, evidence supports findings, screening, or treatment claims; it also appears in project abstracts.

patterns.name: Promotional language for research topics
patterns.context: Promotes a research topic or call for submissions, emphasizing researchers, discoveries, and the field's impact.

patterns.name: Sports game scoring result
patterns.context: Describes a late-game shot that scores and wins the game.

patterns.name: Football kicking terminology
patterns.context: Discusses how moving the field goal attempt back turns what would have been a field goal attempt into a point-after kick.

patterns.name: Firearm brand merchandise promotion
patterns.context: Promotes clothing merchandise printed with a brand logo.

patterns.name: Stock trading subscription ad
patterns.context: Offers the recipient a free, limited-time trial of stock trading news.

patterns.name: Neuroimaging technology description
patterns.context: Describes developing and optimizing imaging technology to detect neural activity.

7_2794.description: 模式包括学术语境中对证据的评价性表述，以及研究推广、体育赛况与术语、枪械服饰广告、股票订阅营销和神经成像技术描述；跨主题缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: evidence 的评价性搭配
patterns.trigger: “evidence”前的评价词，如 “strong evidence”“good evidence”“significant evidence”“compelling evidence”，以及紧邻的 “evidence”
patterns.context: 学术或研究语境中，用证据支持研究发现、筛查或治疗主张；也出现在项目摘要中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究摘要

patterns.name: 研究主题宣传语
patterns.trigger: “Research Topics”“influential”“latest key findings”“historical advances”“hot research area”
patterns.context: 宣传研究专题或征稿内容，强调研究人员、发现和领域影响力

patterns.name: 体育比赛进球结果
patterns.trigger: “game winner”“3” “seconds” “left”“beat”，并伴随球员、球队和比分结果
patterns.context: 叙述比赛末段投篮得分并赢球

patterns.name: 橄榄球踢球术语
patterns.context: 讨论把射门位置后移后，原本的任意球尝试变成附加分踢球

patterns.name: 枪械品牌商品宣传
patterns.context: 宣传印有品牌标志的服装商品

patterns.name: 股票交易订阅广告
patterns.context: 向收件人推销免费的限时股票交易资讯试用

patterns.name: 神经影像技术描述
patterns.trigger: “fMREIT”“neural activity”“signal to noise ratio”“magnetic field strengths”
patterns.context: 描述开发和优化成像技术以检测神经活动

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to evaluative wording such as “critical acclaim/reception” in entertainment entries; sporadic responses also occur to exclamation marks in promotional copy, chat headline wording, placeholders in research abstracts, and public-health labels, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Review and positive reception wording
patterns.context: Descriptions of reviews of a film or television work, commonly including “critical acclaim” or “critical reception”; nearby text may mention the work, performance, or review outcome.

patterns.name: Final exclamation mark
patterns.context: Promotional or sales copy ends with an exclamation mark; activation falls on the punctuation itself rather than a topic-specific word.

patterns.name: Unreadable placeholder in a research abstract
patterns.context: An NIH abstract contains a text placeholder labeled unreadable, especially near sentence or abstract-fragment boundaries; strong activation falls around the placeholder.

patterns.name: goodness in chat promotion
patterns.context: A website or product update headline uses “goodness” to describe a new chat feature; seen only once, the trigger may be the word or its collocation.

patterns.name: Promotional “and more!” ending for an event
patterns.context: After listing sports stars or autographs, a promotional passage ends with “and more!”
patterns.domain: Promotional or event copy in Enron emails

patterns.name: Public-health relevance heading in a research abstract
patterns.context: An uppercase label introduces a statement about public-health significance in a research abstract.

7_2794.concept: 文本评价与宣传式强调
7_2794.description: 主要对娱乐条目中的“critical acclaim/reception”评价措辞强烈响应；另对宣传文案的感叹号、聊天标题用语、科研摘要占位符及公共卫生标签有零星响应，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 评论与好评措辞
patterns.context: 电影或电视作品介绍中描述评论界评价，常见搭配为“critical acclaim”或“critical reception”；附近可能出现作品、表演或评价结果。

patterns.name: 感叹号结尾
patterns.context: 宣传或促销语句以感叹号收尾；激活落在标点本身，而非特定主题词。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的不可读占位符
patterns.context: NIH 摘要中出现被标注为 unreadable 的文本占位符，尤其在句子或摘要片段边界附近；此处强激活落在占位符周围。

patterns.name: 聊天宣传中的 goodness
patterns.context: 网站或产品更新标题中以“goodness”描述新增聊天功能；仅见一次，触发点可能是该词或其搭配。

patterns.name: 活动宣传的 more 感叹式收尾
patterns.context: 列举体育明星或签名等内容后，用“and more!”作宣传式收尾。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的促销或活动文案

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的公共卫生相关性标题
patterns.context: 研究摘要中以大写标签引出公共卫生意义说明。

en.description: Activation often occurs in evaluative or emphatic expressions: “strong/good evidence” in research texts, positive praise for performance or works, and words emphasizing degree in descriptions of weather or packaging. It also appears in advertising calls to action and institutional space-related wording; triggers may differ.

patterns.name: Evidence-strength phrases
patterns.context: Before a factual statement or recommendation, evidence refers to research evidence and is modified by strong or good.

patterns.name: Positive evaluation and praise
patterns.context: Positively evaluates performance, works, packaging, design, or products; activation falls on an evaluative word or the praise that follows it.
patterns.domain: Financial news, encyclopedic narratives, music reviews, business promotion

patterns.name: Emphasis of degree or quantity
patterns.context: Describes significant results, breadth of coverage, severe weather, or specific packaging and color features; this does not fully align with the positive evaluation pattern.
patterns.domain: Financial reporting, local news, product reviews

patterns.name: Imperatives and emphasis in promotional copy
patterns.context: Product ads or promotional copy directly address the audience and use an exclamation mark to intensify the tone.

patterns.name: Insufficiently explained institutional space wording
patterns.context: Describes the space requirements of animal facilities; high activation falls near an unreadable marker, leaving the trigger uncertain.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, research institution administrative text

7_2794.description: 激活常见于评价或强调性的表达：包括科研文本中的“strong/good evidence”、业绩或作品的正面赞誉，以及天气、包装等描述中的突出程度词；另见广告号召和机构空间措辞，触发可能并不相同。

patterns.name: 证据强度词组
patterns.context: 在事实陈述或建议前，用 evidence 表示研究证据，并由 strong 或 good 修饰。

patterns.name: 正面评价与赞誉
patterns.context: 对业绩、作品、包装、设计或产品作正面评价；激活落在评价词或其后的赞誉表达上。
patterns.domain: 财经新闻、百科叙述、音乐评论、商业宣传

patterns.name: 程度或数量突出
patterns.trigger: “strong returns”；“blanket of snow”“sub-freezing”；“double-jewel packaging”“black and gold color scheme”
patterns.context: 描述显著的结果、覆盖范围、天气严寒，或具体包装与颜色特征；与正面评价模式并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 财经报道、地方新闻、产品评论

patterns.name: 宣传语中的祈使与强调
patterns.context: 产品广告或推广文案中直接号召受众，并用感叹号加强语气。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的机构空间措辞
patterns.context: 描述动物设施的空间需求；高激活落在不可读标记附近，触发因素不确定。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、科研机构行政文本

en.description: Activation often falls on evaluative or summative words at the end of a sentence or paragraph, and also appears in headings of evaluative sections; additionally includes academic emphasis on evidence and descriptions of guitar feel and tone, generally favoring salient summative or evaluative expressions.

patterns.name: Evaluative concluding word
patterns.context: A word with a summarizing, judgmental, or evaluative meaning appears at the end of a review or description, often near the end of a sentence or paragraph.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, media reviews, biographies, product descriptions, etc.

patterns.name: Evaluation-related section heading
patterns.context: A title or section label; “Reception” is also adjacent to positive evaluation in the following text.

patterns.name: Appreciative expression in a product review
patterns.context: Consumers evaluate clothing or food using concise, explicit positive wording.

patterns.name: Emphasis on academic significance or evidence
patterns.context: A health research abstract emphasizes the weight of evidence in its public-health significance section; activation falls on “evidence.”

patterns.name: Tone description of a traditional instrument
patterns.context: Compares guitar body designs and summarizes playing feel and tone.

7_2794.description: 激活常落在句末或段落末的评价、总结性词语，也见于评价类小节标题；此外包括学术证据强调及吉他手感、音色描述，整体偏向显著的总结或评价表达。

patterns.name: 评价性结尾词
patterns.context: 评论或描述末尾出现带总结、判断或评价意味的词语；常位于句子或段落结尾附近。
patterns.domain: 商品评论、媒体评论、人物介绍、产品描述等

patterns.name: 评价相关章节标题
patterns.context: 标题或小节标签；其中“Reception”还与后文正面评价相邻。

patterns.name: 商品评论中的赞赏表达
patterns.trigger: “The bow detail on these is great!”, “These socks are terrific!”, “very pleasant lemon flavor”
patterns.context: 消费者以简短、明确的正面措辞评价服饰或食品。

patterns.name: 学术意义或证据强调
patterns.context: 健康研究摘要中，在公共卫生意义部分强调证据分量；激活落在“evidence”。

patterns.name: 传统乐器音色描述
patterns.context: 比较吉他琴体设计，并概括其演奏手感与音色。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on positive evaluative words (nice, terrific, well written, timely, great) and evidence in research texts. It also responds to product attributes, clothing details, and one instance of boys/girls in a parallel construction.

patterns.name: Evaluative praise
patterns.context: Positively evaluates designs, products, or articles, especially in exclamations or a review tone; paragraphs 1, 4, 7, and 10.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, article reviews, design introductions

patterns.name: Evidence statements
patterns.context: The word evidence appears in research abstracts or project descriptions, often with a claim supported by evidence introduced by “is/that”; «evidence» itself is marked 10 in every instance.
patterns.domain: Medical, research, and public health texts

patterns.name: Product attributes and user experience
patterns.context: Discusses the size, comfort, and appearance details of socks or clothing in consumer reviews.

patterns.name: Parallel listing of identities or target groups
patterns.context: When describing a brand image designed for children, two target groups are explicitly listed in parallel; activation falls on «girls».

7_2794.description: 激活主要落在正面评价词（nice、terrific、well written、timely、great）及科研文本中的 evidence；另对商品属性、服饰细节和一次 boys/girls 并列有反应。

patterns.name: 评价性赞美
patterns.context: 在对设计、商品或文章等作正面评价时，尤其是感叹句或评论语气；第1、4、7、10段。
patterns.domain: 商品评论、文章评论、设计介绍

patterns.name: 证据陈述
patterns.context: 证据一词出现在研究摘要或项目描述中，常由“is/that”引出证据支持的主张；«evidence» 本身均标为 10。
patterns.domain: 医学、科研与公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 商品属性与使用感受
patterns.context: 谈论袜子或服装的尺寸、舒适度和外观细节，出现在消费者评论中。

patterns.name: 身份或目标群体的并列
patterns.context: 设计面向儿童的品牌形象时，明确并列两个目标群体；激活落在 «girls»。

en.concept: Emphasis on positive evaluations and evidence
en.description: Activation commonly occurs in positive evaluations or emphatic conclusions, especially on words such as evidence, influence, received, great, terrific, and scent; product reviews also include exclamation marks. Domains include academic, encyclopedic, news, and consumer texts.

patterns.name: Emphasis on evidence or influence
patterns.context: Occurs in statements of positive evaluation, influence, or research conclusions, often near evaluative or evidence-related words; also appears with performance statistics in sports reporting.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, encyclopedia entries, news reports

patterns.name: Product praise and purchase experience
patterns.context: Product reviews or descriptions positively evaluate socks, clothing details, or shampoo scent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final exclamation mark
patterns.context: An exclamation mark follows a positive evaluative word or product description and may be triggered jointly by the evaluative tone.

7_2794.description: 激活常见于积极评价或结论性强调处，尤其是 evidence、influence、received、great、terrific、scent 等词；商品评论中还伴随感叹号。涵盖学术、百科、新闻与消费文本。

patterns.name: 证据或影响的强调
patterns.context: 处于正面评价、影响或研究结论的陈述中，常见于评价性词语或证据类词语附近；另有体育报道中的表现数据。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、百科条目、新闻报道

patterns.name: 商品赞誉与购买体验
patterns.context: 商品评论或产品描述中，对袜子、服饰细节或洗发水气味作积极评价。

patterns.name: 句末感叹号
patterns.context: 感叹号紧随积极评价词或商品描述，可能与评价语气共同触发。

en.concept: Cannot be classified as a single concept
en.description: Activations appear both on “evidence” and evidence-related sentence patterns in research discussions, and on words describing sensory qualities and product evaluations. Other instances involve the email subject field “Subject:” and “momentum” in a business-performance context.

patterns.name: Evidence and its argumentation framework
patterns.context: Statements in scientific or research discussions that present conclusions supported by evidence; activation falls on evidence.

patterns.name: Sensory qualities and product evaluations
patterns.context: Describes the experience and quality of products, materials, or artistic styles, often with positive adjectives; strongest activations fall on feel, flavor, scent, or influence.
patterns.domain: Product copy, consumer reviews, introductions to artists’ styles

patterns.name: Email subject field
patterns.context: In an email header, the Subject field label is followed by a colon and the subject.

patterns.name: Business performance momentum
patterns.context: In company reports, “gained a good deal of momentum” describes performance or business growth.

7_2794.description: 激活既出现在研究论述的“evidence”及其证据句式，也出现在感官品质和产品评价词上；另有邮件主题字段“Subject:”与商业业绩语境中的“momentum”。

patterns.name: evidence 及其论证框架
patterns.trigger: “evidence”后接“to show”“that”或评价性修饰语，如“strong evidence to show”“compelling evidence that”“good evidence that”
patterns.context: 科学或研究论述中陈述证据支持的结论；激活落在 evidence 上。
patterns.domain: 医学、公共卫生、研究摘要

patterns.name: 感官品质与产品评价
patterns.trigger: “feel” “flavor” “influence” “scent” “taste”等品质词及其修饰语；包括“feel of satin or silk”“lemon flavor”“spicy woody scent”
patterns.context: 描述产品、材料或艺术风格的体验与品质，常有正面形容词；最强激活落在 feel、flavor、scent 或 influence。
patterns.domain: 商品文案、消费者评论、人物艺术风格介绍

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段
patterns.trigger: “Subject:”，后接主题内容“RE: Superior Natural Gas Corp.”
patterns.context: 邮件头部，Subject 字段标签后紧跟冒号及主题。

patterns.name: 商业业绩势头表述
patterns.context: 公司经营报道中，以“gained a good deal of momentum”描述业绩或业务发展势头。

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and formatting features
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in Enron email headers, RE/forward boundaries, and blank lines or numeric fragments following them; it also appears in research abstracts’ evidence statements, descriptions of fur texture, and introductions to musical styles. Sporadic activation also occurs in apologies, replies, and friendly expressions in email bodies.

patterns.name: Blank lines and forwarding separators in email reply chains
patterns.context: Activation often occurs after email headers (From/Sent/To/Subject) or at forwarded-message boundaries, before the body appears or just as it begins.

patterns.name: Standalone numbers or placeholder content in emails
patterns.context: Appears near email headers, reply separators, or blank message bodies; these numbers seem more like formatting fragments, and it is unclear whether they represent meaningful amounts or identifiers.

patterns.name: Descriptions of texture and shimmer
patterns.context: Describes the feel, color, or shimmering appearance of Bengal cat fur.

patterns.name: Musical style and classical influence
patterns.context: Emphasizes classical music influences when introducing a musician and their style.

patterns.name: Research evidence and data supporting an argument
patterns.context: Research papers or abstracts use data or preliminary results to support an interpretation, intervention, or conclusion.

patterns.name: Polite or responsive language in everyday replies
patterns.context: Email body fragments involving a lack of response, an apology, or evaluating whether someone is too friendly; may overlap with email-format triggers.

7_2794.concept: 多种局部词汇与格式特征
7_2794.description: 激活主要出现在 Enron 邮件头、RE/转发边界及其后的空行或数字残片；另在研究摘要的证据表述、皮毛质地描写和音乐风格介绍中激活，邮件正文的道歉、回应及友善表达也有零星激活。

patterns.name: 邮件回复链中的空白行与转发分隔
patterns.context: 邮件头部（From/Sent/To/Subject）之后或转发邮件边界处，常在正文尚未出现或仅刚开始时激活。

patterns.name: 邮件中的独立数字或占位内容
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头、回复分隔符或空白正文附近；这些数字更像格式残片，不能确定是有语义的金额或编号。

patterns.name: 质地与闪光效果描述
patterns.context: 描写孟加拉猫皮毛触感、色泽或闪光外观。

patterns.name: 音乐风格与古典影响
patterns.context: 介绍音乐人及其音乐风格时，强调古典音乐影响。

patterns.name: 研究证据与数据支持论点
patterns.context: 研究或论文摘要中，以数据或初步结果支持某种解释、干预或结论。

patterns.name: 日常回复中的礼貌或回应
patterns.context: 邮件正文片段，涉及未回复、道歉或评价某人是否过于友善；与邮件格式触发可能重叠。

en.concept: Descriptive summary words and email structure markers
en.description: Activations often fall on summary nouns in descriptive sentences, especially those related to scent, texture, rhythm, performance, and expression; music-related words also stand out. In Enron emails, activations respond prominently to subject lines, reply/forward markers, and blank lines. Research texts trigger on evidence-related terms such as evidence.

patterns.name: Evaluative nouns or noun phrases in descriptive sentences
patterns.context: Activations cluster on central descriptive nouns in the middle or at the end of sentences. These often summarize texture, scent, rhythm, appearance, performance, or manner of expression; the pattern is not tied to a single fixed vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, animal breed introductions, sports reports, web reviews, music introductions

patterns.name: Structural markers and whitespace in email formatting
patterns.context: Activations occur on email headers, forward/reply markers, and nearby line breaks or indentation; many strong activations fall on formatting tokens rather than semantically meaningful words.

patterns.name: Evidence nouns in research discussions
patterns.context: Academic discussion summarizing research materials, evidence, and statements supporting a judgment; the strongest trigger is evidence.

patterns.name: Descriptions of musical style and listening experience
