patterns.context: Centers on music, performance, or works, describing rhythm, instruments, melody, and listening experience. Overlaps with the general pattern of descriptive core nouns, but the vocabulary is more concentrated on music.

7_2794.concept: 描述性概括词与邮件结构标记
7_2794.description: 激活常落在描述性语句的概括名词上，尤其是气味、质感、节奏、表现和表达；音乐相关词也突出。Enron 邮件中则显著响应主题栏、回复/转发标记及空白换行。研究文本中响应 evidence 等证据论述词。

patterns.name: 描述性语句中的评价性名词或名词短语
patterns.context: 激活集中在句中或句末的描述性核心名词，常承载对质地、气味、节奏、外观、表现或表达方式的概括；不是单一固定词汇。
patterns.domain: 产品描述、动物品种介绍、体育报道、网页评论、音乐介绍

patterns.name: 邮件格式中的结构标记和空白
patterns.context: 邮件标题、转发/回复标记及其周围换行或缩进处出现激活；多处高激活落在格式 token 而非有明确语义的实词上。

patterns.name: 研究论述中的证据名词
patterns.context: 学术论述中归纳研究材料、证据及支持某项判断的语句；最强触发是 evidence。
patterns.domain: 医学/干预研究摘要或论文

patterns.name: 音乐风格与听感描述
patterns.context: 围绕音乐、演奏或作品展开，描述节奏、乐器、曲调及听感；与一般描述性核心名词模式有重叠，但词项更集中于音乐。

en.description: All excerpts are corporate emails; activations cluster on the Subject field, its punctuation, tabs, and line breaks, often alongside sender/recipient metadata, forward markers, and the start of the body. A few also involve time colons and attachment notices.

patterns.name: Email subject field
patterns.context: A Subject field appears in the email header; subjects may concern credit, forwarding, meetings, or business, and are often followed by the body or a forwarded-message marker.

patterns.name: Time colon in email headers
patterns.context: A colon appears between hours and minutes in a sent time or timestamp; some formats contain unusual or nonstandard digits.

patterns.name: Forwarded/replied email structure
patterns.context: A subject or body header indicates a forwarded or replied-to email, often followed by an original-message separator or forwarded content after a blank line.

patterns.name: To and Cc fields in email headers
patterns.context: Email metadata lists recipients or copied recipients, often alongside the Subject field.

patterns.name: Body opening after a blank line
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks separate the email header from the body; the body begins with a greeting, request, question, or statement.

patterns.name: Attachment notice
patterns.context: An attachment notice appears after the body of an email whose subject concerns weekend nomination changes.

patterns.name: Capitalized business terms in subject lines
patterns.context: The subject line contains all-caps names, business terms, or meeting topics; these words alone do not establish a shared semantic trigger.

7_2794.description: 所有片段均为企业邮件；激活集中在Subject主题字段及其标点、制表符和换行，常伴随收发件人元数据、转发标记与正文起始。少数还涉及时间冒号和附件提示。

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段
patterns.trigger: «Subject»、后接主题内容的«:»，以及主题前后的制表符/换行
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现 Subject 字段；主题可涉及信用、转发、会议、业务等不同内容，后续常接正文或转发邮件标记。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的时间冒号
patterns.context: 发送时间或日期时间戳中，冒号位于时分之间；部分格式包含异常或非标准数字。

patterns.name: 转发/回复邮件结构
patterns.context: 邮件主题或正文头部表示转发、回复，常在空行后出现原始邮件分隔线或转发内容。

patterns.name: 邮件头收件人与抄送字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据中列出收件人或抄送人，常与 Subject 字段并列。

patterns.name: 空行后的正文开头
patterns.trigger: “«Please» find”“«Where do you want»”“«Dear» Jason”“«The» PA”“«I» would like”“«Hi»”
patterns.context: 邮件头与正文之间有多个换行；正文以称呼、请求、问题或陈述开头。

patterns.name: 附件提示
patterns.context: 主题为周末提名变更的邮件正文后出现附件提示。

patterns.name: 标题中的大小写业务术语
patterns.trigger: “«Subject»: «FW»: DAVE BARRY”“«Subject»:«»off system capacity”“«Subject»:«»Market making document”
patterns.context: 主题行包含全大写名称、业务术语或会议事项；仅凭这些词无法确认它们是共同语义触发条件。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on email structure markers: field names, colons, line breaks, reply/forward boundaries, and dates and times; it also covers common email components such as body requests, salutations, brief replies, subjects, and signatures.

patterns.name: Email header fields and delimiters
patterns.context: High activation occurs near field names, colons, line breaks, and email boundaries in headers or forwarded headers; sometimes the subject contains «RE:»

patterns.name: Polite requests or prompts at the start of an email body
patterns.context: Requests to view an attachment or update prices appear at the start of the email body or after a salutation; this is not triggered in every message

patterns.name: Reply, forward, and original-message markers
patterns.context: Subject lines and original-message quotation boundaries in reply or forward threads

patterns.name: Conventional business-email greetings and closing expressions
patterns.context: Near a body salutation, brief status reply, or apology

patterns.name: Proper nouns and business topics in email subjects
patterns.context: Names of events, projects, products, or business matters in the subject field; subject wording varies considerably

patterns.name: Date and time formats
patterns.context: Send dates and times in email headers, interspersed with numbers and punctuation

patterns.name: Sporadic body words and tone
patterns.context: Short, informal reply fragments whose specific meaning depends on missing context

patterns.name: Names and signatures
patterns.context: Name or signature fragments at the end of the body or in an email signature

7_2794.description: 激活主要集中在邮件结构标记：字段名、冒号、换行、回复/转发边界及日期时间；另覆盖正文请求、称呼、简短回复、主题和签名等邮件常见成分。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与分隔符
patterns.trigger: «Sent»、«To»、«Cc»、«Subject»、«:»及«↵»，常见于日期、收件人和主题行
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件头中，字段名、冒号、换行及邮件边界附近出现高激活；有时主题含«RE:»

patterns.name: 邮件正文开头的礼貌请求/提示
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头或称呼之后，提出查看附件、更新价格等请求；触发并非每段都有

patterns.name: 回复、转发与原始邮件标记
patterns.context: 回复或转发线程中的主题和原始邮件引用边界

patterns.name: 常规商务邮件称呼/收尾式表达
patterns.context: 正文称呼、简短状态回复或道歉语句附近

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的专名与业务主题
patterns.trigger: «Baby Shower»、«Winning the cultural war»、«Agave Pricing»、«BuySideDirect»、«Credit worth»iness、«Click Paper Approvals»
patterns.context: 主题字段内的活动、项目、产品或业务事项名称；主题措辞差异较大

patterns.name: 日期时间格式
patterns.trigger: 日期如«Friday, October 26, 2001»及时间中的«:»
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发送日期和时间，数字与标点交错

patterns.name: 零散正文词语与语气
patterns.context: 短小的非正式回复片段，具体语义依赖缺失的上下文

patterns.name: 姓名与签名
patterns.context: 正文末尾或邮件签名处出现的姓名/签名残片

en.description: Activations occur in requests, greetings, and apologies in emails, as well as rulings and statements of dissent in legal opinions. Other difficult-to-classify email excerpts involve creditworthiness, counterparties, and isolated phrases.

patterns.name: Polite requests in email
patterns.context: The email body makes or introduces a request using polite language, such as “Can you please update…” and “Please find below…”

patterns.name: Email greetings or small talk
patterns.context: Brief small talk or colloquial evaluative expressions in the email body; the sample size is small, and trigger forms are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Apology or explanation for not replying
patterns.context: The email body explains a failure to reply promptly and includes an apology.

patterns.name: Rulings in court opinions
patterns.context: A brief statement of the court’s disposition at the end of a paragraph in a judicial opinion or ruling.

patterns.name: Dissent and requests for review in judicial texts
patterns.context: A judge expresses dissent and discusses whether the court should hear a constitutional issue.

patterns.name: Unclear fragmentary activations
patterns.context: The visible context does not make a common trigger identifiable; local syntax or undisplayed context may be involved.

7_2794.description: 激活分布于邮件中的请求、寒暄和道歉，以及法律意见中的裁判结论、异议表达；另有信用worthiness、交易对手和孤立短语等难以归类的邮件片段。

patterns.name: 邮件中的礼貌请求
patterns.context: 邮件正文以礼貌用语提出或引出请求，如“Can you please update…”和“Please find below…”

patterns.name: 邮件问候或寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的简短寒暄或带有评价的口语表达；样本很少，触发形式不完全一致

patterns.name: 道歉或未回复说明
patterns.context: 邮件正文说明未能及时回复，伴随道歉

patterns.name: 法院意见中的裁判结论
patterns.trigger: «The application is denied»、«Judgment in accordance with opinion»
patterns.context: 司法意见或裁判文本中，段落末尾简短陈述法院处理结果

patterns.name: 司法文本中的异议及审查请求
patterns.context: 法官表达异议，讨论法院是否应审理宪法问题

patterns.name: 不明的片段性激活
patterns.context: 仅凭可见上下文难以确认共同触发条件；可能受局部语法或未显示上下文影响

en.description: Most examples are Enron emails, with activations in headers, subject lines, and body openings, often involving energy trading, pricing, contracts, or credit business. Other examples include greetings, information notices, and the ending of a legal ruling.

patterns.name: Email header fields and punctuation
patterns.context: Near email addresses, recipients, or subject lines, often with colons, blank fields, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Salutations and body openings
patterns.context: After the email header, at the salutation or start of the body; some examples activate near a greeting, name, or sentence opening.

patterns.name: Energy trading and business emails
patterns.context: Email bodies or subjects involving pricing, trades, contract revisions, market making, or credit assessment.

patterns.name: Reply or forward markers in subject lines
patterns.context: A subject line marks a reply or forward, followed by a business topic.

patterns.name: Ending of a legal ruling and publication notice
patterns.context: Ruling language at the end of a decision and a notice about whether it will be published.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify email with a proper-noun subject
patterns.context: The subject contains only an abbreviation or proper noun; the body begins with a salutation and a reference to a prior matter.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify subject and data notice
patterns.context: The subject mentions an error, and the body includes the name of an information source.

patterns.name: Brief small talk
patterns.context: A colloquial greeting opens after the recipient’s salutation.

7_2794.description: 多数样例是 Enron 邮件，在邮件头、主题与正文开头处激活，且常涉及能源交易、定价、合同或信用业务；另有寒暄、资讯提示及一段法律判决结尾。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与标点
patterns.context: 邮件地址、收件人或主题行附近，常出现冒号、空白字段和换行

patterns.name: 邮件开场称呼与正文起始
patterns.context: 邮件头之后，称呼或正文开头处；部分样例激活落在问候、姓名或句首附近

patterns.name: 能源交易与业务邮件
patterns.context: 涉及定价、交易、合同修订、市场做市或信用评估的邮件正文或主题

patterns.name: 主题行中的回复或转发标记
patterns.context: 邮件主题中标明回复或转发，后接业务主题

patterns.name: 法律判决结尾与出版说明
patterns.context: 判决文本末尾的裁决用语及关于是否刊载的说明

patterns.name: 难以归类的专名主题邮件
patterns.context: 主题仅含缩写或专名，正文以称呼和先前事项开头

patterns.name: 难以归类的主题与数据提示
patterns.context: 主题提及错误，正文出现资讯来源名称

patterns.name: 简短寒暄
patterns.context: 收件人称呼后以口语问候开场

en.concept: Formatting and local string features across domains
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: baseball scores and innings, email boundaries and body formatting, and line breaks/page markers in legal documents. Music descriptions of rhythm and personal expressions of tone also appear. Email formatting markers form a more consistent pattern; the rest seem driven by domain or local strings and do not reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Baseball scoring and inning reports
patterns.context: Near score numbers and scoring or inning expressions such as “lead” in baseball accounts; activations cluster on score digits/hyphens and related game text.

patterns.name: Email formatting and boundary markers
patterns.context: Formatting markers such as separators, line breaks, and field labels occur in email headers or forwarded-message boundaries; consecutive line breaks are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Paragraph and page markers in legal rulings
patterns.context: Near paragraph breaks, page numbers, or ruling markers in the body of a decision; the legal prose itself does not show a unified lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Rhythm and gradual progression in music descriptions
patterns.context: A guitar provides background accompaniment as a steady rhythm is described as continuing to build; activations cover rhythm-related words and participial forms.

patterns.name: Tone and personal emotional expression
patterns.context: “tone” activates nearby when a first-person speaker discusses personal experiences, ups and downs, and optimism; only one example.
patterns.domain: Personal profiles/artist interviews or promotional copy

patterns.name: Brief greetings or requests in email bodies
patterns.context: An informal greeting at the beginning of an email body, or a polite request for an update; the trigger words differ and may relate to the email context and common body format.

7_2794.concept: 多领域格式与局部词串特征
7_2794.description: 激活模式分散：棒球比分与局次、邮件边界及正文格式、法律文书换行/页码标记；另见音乐节奏描写和个人语气表达。邮件内格式标记较一致，其余更像领域或局部词串触发，不能归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 棒球比赛记分与局次报道
patterns.context: 棒球比赛叙述中，比分数字及“lead”等记分、局次表达附近；激活集中在比分中的数字/连字符及相关赛事文本。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻/棒球比赛报道

patterns.name: 邮件格式与边界标记
patterns.context: 邮件头部或转发邮件边界处，包含分隔线、换行、字段标签等格式标记；尤其是连续换行。

patterns.name: 法律判决的段落与页码标记
patterns.context: 判决正文中，段落换行、页码或裁判结果标记附近；法律正文内容本身未显示统一词汇触发。

patterns.name: 音乐描写中的节奏与渐进效果
patterns.context: 吉他作为背景伴奏，描写稳定节奏持续推进；激活覆盖节奏相关词及分词形式。

patterns.name: 语气与个人情绪表达
patterns.context: 第一人称谈论个人经历、起伏与乐观表达时，“tone”附近激活；仅此一例。
patterns.domain: 个人介绍/艺术家访谈或宣传文案

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的简短寒暄或请求
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头的随意问候，或礼貌请求更新信息；触发词并不相同，可能与邮件语境及常见正文格式有关。

en.concept: Document structure and local context markers
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in business email header fields, requests, and forwarding markers; it also appears in baseball reports’ expressions for a lead and game progress, and in medical abstracts’ descriptions of effects and topics.

patterns.name: Email header fields and punctuation
patterns.context: Recipient, cc, and subject fields in Enron email headers and the line breaks following them; activation in multiple passages falls near colons, line breaks, or field names.

patterns.name: Requests or collaboration in email bodies
patterns.context: Work-related communication in email bodies involving requests, apologies, or questions, often after a salutation or quoted email.

patterns.name: Email forwarding and quotation markers
patterns.context: Subject or body contains forwarding or original-message separators, with activation concentrated near message-forwarding markers.

patterns.name: Expressions of a lead in the score
patterns.context: A baseball report describes a team taking the lead, usually followed by the score and inning information.

patterns.name: Research findings and topic introduction
patterns.context: An abstract’s conclusion states the effect of an intervention, or introduces research background with “What is known about the topic?”

patterns.name: Numbers and descriptions of game progress
patterns.context: A baseball report includes scores, innings, hits, or game action; this is adjacent to but distinct from descriptions of taking the lead.

7_2794.concept: 文档结构与局部语境标记
7_2794.description: 激活主要出现在商务邮件的头字段、请求与转发标记；另见棒球报道中的比分领先及比赛进程词，以及医学摘要的效果与主题表述。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段及标点
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头中的收件人、抄送、主题字段及其后的换行；多段激活落在冒号、换行或字段名附近。

patterns.name: 邮件正文请求或协作表达
patterns.context: 邮件正文出现请求、道歉或询问等工作沟通语句，常在称呼或引用邮件之后。

patterns.name: 邮件转发与引用标记
patterns.context: 主题或正文包含转发、原始邮件分隔线，激活集中在消息转发标记附近。

patterns.name: 比分领先表达
patterns.context: 棒球比赛报道中描述球队取得领先，通常紧接比分并带有局数信息。

patterns.name: 研究成果与主题介绍
patterns.context: 摘要末尾陈述干预效果，或以“What is known about the topic?”引出研究背景。

patterns.name: 数字与比赛进程描述
patterns.context: 棒球报道中出现比分、局数、安打或比赛动作；与领先表达相邻，但不完全相同。

en.description: Activations cluster on whitespace after email headers and at the start of the body, and also occur on email field markers. Other instances cover baseball scores, innings and statistics, car performance evaluations, and corporate performance language, possibly mixing formatting-position and lexical triggers.

patterns.name: Whitespace between email header and body
patterns.context: At the end of the email header, before or just as the body begins; activations often occur on blank lines or indentation.

patterns.name: Salutation or content at the start of an email body
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body, often a salutation, forwarded content, or brief opening sentence after a blank line; some examples show only the start of the body.

patterns.name: Baseball score lead statements
patterns.context: Describes a team taking the lead in an inning; “lead” is connected to the score and inning.

patterns.name: Performance descriptions in product reviews
patterns.context: A subjective evaluation or performance judgment follows a description of a vehicle’s features.

patterns.name: Corporate performance and growth momentum
patterns.context: Describes quarterly results or growth trends in accounts of company performance or executive quotations.

patterns.name: Time and subject markers in email metadata
patterns.context: Date/time, Subject fields, or forward/reply markers appear in email headers; activations are distributed over field punctuation and nearby text.

patterns.name: Innings and batting statistics in sports reports
patterns.context: Batting performance, runs batted in, and innings in baseball game reports.

patterns.name: Atypical phrases and punctuation
patterns.context: The direct relationship to other topics is uncertain; local word forms, punctuation, or formatting positions may trigger activation.

7_2794.concept: 文本片段边界与报告性叙述
7_2794.description: 激活集中在邮件头结束后的空白与正文起始，也见邮件字段标记；另覆盖棒球比分、局数和统计、汽车性能评价及企业业绩措辞，可能混合格式位置与词汇触发。

patterns.name: 邮件标题与正文分隔处的空白
patterns.trigger: 邮件头后的连续换行及空白，如「Subject: April deal↵↵↵  Got」「Subject: RE: ↵↵↵↵↵」
patterns.context: 邮件头结束、正文尚未开始或刚开始时；常在空行、缩进处激活

patterns.name: 邮件正文开头的称呼或内容
patterns.trigger: 「Where do you want to live」「isn't that being too nice」「Mark, What's up???」「Chris/Joe」「BLOOMBERG」
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头，常在空行后出现称呼、转发内容或简短首句；有些样本只显示正文起始

patterns.name: 棒球比分领先表述
patterns.context: 描述球队在某局取得领先；「lead」前后连接比分与局次

patterns.name: 产品评价中的性能表述
patterns.context: 车辆配置介绍后给出主观评价或性能判断

patterns.name: 企业业绩与增长势头
patterns.trigger: 「sales and profitability」「gained a good deal of momentum」
patterns.context: 公司经营表现或高管引语中描述季度业绩、增长态势

patterns.name: 邮件元数据中的时间与主题标记
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现日期时间、主题字段或转发回复标记；激活分布于字段标点与附近文本

patterns.name: 体育报道中的局数与击球统计
patterns.context: 棒球比赛报道中的击球成绩、打点和局次叙述

patterns.name: 非典型短语及标点
patterns.trigger: 「and two walks while fanning five.」「2 offering over the left field wall」「???」
patterns.context: 与其他主题的直接对应关系不确定；可能是局部词形、标点或格式位置触发

en.description: All passages are emails, with activations concentrated on line breaks separating headers and bodies, email header fields, and punctuation. Some activations occur in reply subjects, body salutations, and polite expressions, as well as unrelated proper nouns, meeting terms, and numeric formats.

patterns.name: Line-break markers in email formatting
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks after email header information or blank lines before the body; activations mainly fall on line-break markers rather than subject or body content.

patterns.name: Punctuation in email header fields
patterns.context: Near colons in email header labels, recipient information, or time fields; activation strength and position vary by passage.

patterns.name: Salutations or greetings at the start of the body
patterns.context: A recipient salutation or brief polite expression appears at the beginning of the email body; not every passage has one.

patterns.name: Re: in email subjects
patterns.context: The subject field marks a reply; some passages also contain forwarding markers or other subject text.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and business terms in subjects or bodies
patterns.context: A subject or body contains a company, product, project, or business name; the listed terms have no obvious semantic commonality.

patterns.name: Polite expressions or general colloquial language
patterns.context: Common conversational language in the body, such as an apology, thanks, evaluation, or greeting; activations are scattered.

patterns.name: Meetings and legal matters
patterns.context: The subject mentions scheduling a meeting with the legal team.

patterns.name: Numeric or time formats
patterns.context: In strings of digits representing dates, times, or similar identifiers, markers cluster on separators or nearby content.

patterns.name: Question marks and nearby body text
patterns.context: A question mark appears at the start of the body or in a short sentence; this occurs in only a few passages.

7_2794.description: 所有段落均为邮件，激活集中在头尾分隔换行、邮件头字段及标点；部分激活出现在回复主题、正文称呼与礼貌用语，也包括互不相关的专名、会议词和数字格式。

patterns.name: 邮件格式中的换行标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»（多段中出现在邮件头和正文分隔处）
patterns.context: 邮件头信息后连续换行，或正文开始前的空行；激活主要落在换行标记，而非主题或正文内容。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段标点
patterns.context: 邮件头字段标签、收件人信息或时间字段中的冒号附近；各段激活强度和出现位置不一。

patterns.name: 正文开头的称呼或寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头出现收件人称呼，或简短礼貌用语；并非每段都有。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的 Re:
patterns.context: 主题栏标示回复邮件；有的段落还包含转发或其他主题文字。

patterns.name: 主题或正文中的专名、业务术语
patterns.context: 主题或正文包含公司、产品、项目或业务名称；所列词汇彼此并无明显语义共同点。

patterns.name: 礼貌表达或一般口语
patterns.context: 正文中的道歉、感谢、评价或问候等常见交际用语；激活位置分散。

patterns.name: 会议与法律事项
patterns.context: 主题提及与法律团队的会议安排。

patterns.name: 数字或时间格式
patterns.context: 日期、时刻或类似编号的数字串中，标记集中于分隔符或邻近内容。

patterns.name: 问号及其邻近正文
patterns.context: 正文开头或简短句子中出现问号；仅在少数段落出现。

en.concept: Text structure boundaries and local formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: baseball scores followed by descriptions of taking the “lead”; line breaks, whitespace, salutations, Subject fields, and forwarded-message separators in Enron emails; and punctuation and current in a technical Q&A. Email formatting is a recurring pattern, but the specific high-activation positions vary across passages.

patterns.name: “lead” in score and game narration
patterns.context: In sports reporting, “lead” follows a score and describes a team taking the lead; two passages are baseball reports, while another is a football report with a result and win/loss narration but no lead marker.

patterns.name: Line-break separators in email formatting
patterns.context: Line-break activations recur between Enron email headers and bodies, in blank lines after the body, or at forwarded-message separators; some passages also activate on body tokens.

patterns.name: Blank lines around email salutations or body openings
patterns.context: Multiple blank lines separate the header from the body, which often begins with a recipient salutation; line-break activations are prominent, with additional activations near the salutation.

patterns.name: Email forward markers
patterns.context: A forwarded email contains an original-message separator; activations cover the separator and some header text.

patterns.name: Activation near punctuation and technical terms in a sentence
patterns.context: A technical Q&A describes the advantages of an I/O expander; activation falls on punctuation and “current,” without an apparent link to the email-format or sports-score patterns.

patterns.name: Email subject field
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near the Subject field in email headers; subject content varies, and activation emphasis differs across passages.

patterns.name: Football match-result narration
patterns.context: A football report states a team’s win and the score; it lacks the same lead expression as the baseball passages.

7_2794.concept: 文本结构边界与局部格式标记
7_2794.description: 激活分散于多类文本：棒球比分后描述取得“lead”；Enron 邮件中的换行、空白、称呼、Subject 与转发分隔符；另有足球赛果及技术问答中的标点、current。邮件格式是重复模式，但各段具体高激活位置不一。

patterns.name: 比分与比赛叙述中的“lead”
patterns.context: 体育报道中，比分后出现“lead”，描述某队取得领先；两段都是棒球报道，另有一段足球报道包含比赛结果和胜负叙述但未标记 lead。

patterns.name: 邮件格式中的换行分隔符
patterns.trigger: «↵»，尤其是连续多次出现；也包括邮件正文或头部附近的制表符
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头部与正文之间、正文结束后的空行或转发邮件分隔处反复出现换行激活；部分段落中的正文 token 也同时激活。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼或正文起始处的空行
patterns.trigger: 称呼前后连续的 «↵»，以及其后的称呼，如 «Mark», «Jeff»:
patterns.context: 邮件头部之后以多行空白隔开正文，正文常以收件人称呼开头；换行激活显著，称呼附近亦有激活。

patterns.name: 邮件转发标记
patterns.context: 转发邮件中出现原始邮件分隔线；激活覆盖分隔符和部分标题文字。

patterns.name: 句中标点与技术名词附近的激活
patterns.context: 技术问答中描述 I/O 扩展器的优点，激活落在标点和“current”上，未明显对应邮件格式或体育比分模式。

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部的 Subject 字段附近有弱激活；主题内容不同，且各段激活重点并不一致。

patterns.name: 足球比赛结果叙述
patterns.context: 足球报道陈述球队获胜及比分；没有与棒球段落相同的 lead 表达。

en.description: Appears mainly in business email header fields, forwarding separators, and various business or event announcements; it also activates in a baseball report describing a team taking the lead, which does not fit the email pattern.

patterns.name: Email headers and field separators
patterns.context: Colons after field names, field line breaks, and blank lines before the body in email metadata; activation in multiple passages is concentrated near these formatting markers

patterns.name: Forwarded emails and original-message separators
patterns.context: A fixed separator or forwarding wording appears when an email includes a forwarded or quoted original message

patterns.name: Invitations and event arrangements in emails
patterns.context: Notifies recipients to respond, attend an event, or view an invitation; includes dates, lunch, or private celebrations

patterns.name: Business, legal, and credit-related content
patterns.context: Discusses transaction documents, lawyers’ conflicts of interest, regulatory investigations, or credit assessments; activation does not fall only on these business words and also involves email formatting
patterns.domain: Corporate legal, transaction, and credit business emails

patterns.name: Internal email matters and transaction communication
patterns.context: Subjects concern forms, missing transactions, or counterparties; the body is brief and often appears in internal correspondence

patterns.name: Greetings and interpersonal communication in emails
patterns.context: The email body begins with a salutation or personal questions about where someone lives, rather than purely business content

patterns.name: Baseball game progress and taking the lead
patterns.context: Describes a team taking the lead in an inning of a baseball game, with nearby information about players, batting, and the score

7_2794.concept: 邮件格式与消息边界标记
7_2794.description: 主要出现在企业邮件的头部字段、转发分隔符和多种业务或活动通知中；另有一段棒球报道在叙述球队取得领先时激活，无法归入邮件模式。

patterns.name: 邮件头部与字段分隔
patterns.trigger: «:»、«Subject»、«↵»，以及收件人、抄送和主题字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据中字段名后的冒号、字段换行及邮件正文前的空行；多段中激活集中在这些格式标记附近

patterns.name: 转发邮件与原邮件分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件包含转发或引用的原始邮件时，出现固定分隔线或转发措辞

patterns.name: 邮件中的邀请与活动安排
patterns.context: 通知收件人回复、参加活动或查看邀请函；含日期、午餐或私人庆祝活动信息
patterns.domain: 企业内部活动通知邮件

patterns.name: 商业、法律与信用业务内容
patterns.trigger: «continental»« power» trading« documents»、«SEC inquiry»、«Credit»« worth»iness、«credit»«worth»«iness» criteria
patterns.context: 讨论交易文件、律师利益冲突、监管调查或信用评估；激活并非只落在这些业务词上，也涉及邮件格式
patterns.domain: 企业法律、交易与信用业务邮件

patterns.name: 内部邮件中的事项与交易沟通
patterns.trigger: «Subject»«:» New PA form、«The PA:»、«Subject» Re: Missing deal?、«counterpart»
patterns.context: 主题涉及表格、缺失交易或交易对手，正文简短，常出现在内部往来邮件中

patterns.name: 邮件问候与人际交流
patterns.trigger: «Jeff:»、«Where do you want to live»、«which area, condo/house?»
patterns.context: 邮件正文从称呼或对居住地的个人询问展开，而非纯业务内容
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的私人交流

patterns.name: 棒球比赛进程与得分领先
patterns.context: 描述棒球比赛某队在某局取得领先，附近有球员、击球和比分信息

en.concept: Sports scores, document formatting, and local vocabulary
en.description: Activations cover baseball scores and leads, football results, legal document headings, and headers/layout in corporate emails; they also respond strongly to current in an electronics context. No single shared meaning or style explains all instances.

patterns.name: Scores and leads in baseball reports
patterns.context: In baseball narration, score digits and hyphenated scores appear near “lead,” meaning a team is ahead; [7] strongly activates on the 0 in a score, while [2] activates on lead.

patterns.name: Headings and templated layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Headings, section labels, and conclusions in court or appellate documents, often with all-caps headings, line breaks, and whitespace.

patterns.name: Email headers, signatures, and layout in Enron emails
patterns.context: Email metadata, brief body text, signatures, or date blocks; some examples involve the power business. Activations are distributed across header punctuation, whitespace, or business terms.

patterns.name: Electrical current in technical explanations
patterns.context: When explaining the advantages of an I/O expander, the text mentions that it can provide more current; activation focuses on current in the electrical sense.

patterns.name: Team records and results in football reports
patterns.context: In English football reports, teams, wins, and scores appear in match-result narration.

7_2794.concept: 体育比分、文档格式及局部词汇
7_2794.description: 激活覆盖棒球比分与领先、足球赛果、法律文书标题，以及企业邮件头/排版；另对电子技术语境的 current 强烈响应。没有一个共同的词义或文体能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: 棒球比赛报道中的比分与领先
patterns.context: 棒球比赛叙述中，比分数字和连字符构成的比分，以及表示领先的 lead 邻近出现；[7] 的强激活落在比分中的 0，[2] 落在 lead。

patterns.name: 法律文件的标题与模板化排版
patterns.trigger: «WIT»NESS AT HEARING ON APPEAL»；«Veteran»；«ATTORNEY FOR THE BOARD»；«IN»TRODUCTION»；«AFFIRMED»
patterns.context: 法院或上诉文件的标题、栏目名及判决结尾，常有全大写标题、换行和空白排版。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件中的邮件头、署名与排版
patterns.context: 邮件元数据、正文短句、署名或日期区块；部分实例涉及电力业务。激活分布在标题标点、空白或业务词上。

patterns.name: 技术说明中的电流属性
patterns.context: 解释 I/O 扩展器的优点时，提到能提供更多电流；激活集中在 electrical 意义的 current。

patterns.name: 足球报道中的球队战绩与赛果
patterns.context: 英格兰足球赛事报道中，球队、赢球和比分出现在赛果叙述里。

en.description: Activation often occurs at email format boundaries, salutations, and business email requests; it also covers baseball game reports, car performance reviews, and soccer results, presenting several distinct genre cues.

patterns.name: Email headers and salutations
patterns.context: Email metadata, salutations, or the start of the body, often accompanied by line breaks and signatures

patterns.name: Requests and business content in emails
patterns.context: The email body makes requests, asks about transactions, or discusses credit and pricing

patterns.name: Strong line-break / blank-space boundaries
patterns.context: Between the email body and signature, between the header and body, or at the end of the text

patterns.name: Baseball game narration
patterns.context: Game reports describing batting, scoring, and innings

patterns.name: Car specifications and evaluation
patterns.context: Introduces vehicle features and evaluates performance

patterns.name: Soccer match results
patterns.context: Describes a team’s match result and related advancement or season information

7_2794.description: 激活多见于邮件格式边界、称呼及商务邮件请求；另覆盖棒球比赛报道、汽车性能评论和足球赛果，呈现为若干不同文体线索。

patterns.name: 邮件头与称呼
patterns.context: 邮件元数据、称呼或正文起始处，常伴随换行和署名

patterns.name: 邮件中的请求与业务内容
patterns.context: 邮件正文提出请求、询问交易或谈论信用与定价

patterns.name: 强换行/空白边界
patterns.trigger: 连续 «↵»，以及尾部大片空白后的 «↵»
patterns.context: 邮件正文与署名之间、邮件头与正文之间或文本结尾处

patterns.name: 棒球比赛叙述
patterns.context: 描述击球、得分及局次的比赛报道

patterns.name: 汽车参数与评价
patterns.context: 介绍车辆配置并给出性能评价

patterns.name: 足球赛果叙述
patterns.context: 叙述球队比赛结果及晋级/赛季相关信息

en.description: The most stable trigger is the in-word character fragment mim, spanning different contexts such as mimicking, mimetype, mimosa, and mimetic. There are also sporadic activations on the legal word estopped, case-title formatting, and a few scientific and web text fragments.

patterns.name: In-word fragment beginning with mim-
patterns.context: Activation centers on the in-word character fragment mim; the same word-initial fragment occurs across varied meanings and word forms, without requiring a specific syntactic or semantic context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: research abstracts, technical documents, prose, legal texts, websites, and research funding descriptions

patterns.name: In-word letter fragment stoppel
patterns.context: In legal text, appears as an in-word fragment in “were estopped from maintaining the action”; distinct from the primary mim pattern.

patterns.name: Legal case-title formatting
patterns.context: Formatting of case citations and party titles; no mim fragment appears.

patterns.name: Sporadic non-mim in-word activations
patterns.context: Individual words or word fragments are marked in their respective contexts; no shared semantic, formatting, or stable trigger condition is apparent.

7_2890.concept: 词内 mim 字符片段
7_2890.description: 最稳定的触发是词内字符片段 mim，横跨 mimicking、mimetype、mimosa、mimetic 等不同语境。另有法律词 estopped、案件标题格式及少量科研和网页词片段的零散激活。

patterns.name: mim- 开头的词中片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内的字符片段 mim；同一词首片段出现在多种不同词义和词形中，并不要求特定句法或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：科研摘要、技术文档、散文、法律文本、网页及研究资助说明

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 stoppel
patterns.context: 法律文本中，作为“were estopped from maintaining the action”里的词内片段；与主要 mim 模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题格式
patterns.context: 案件引注与当事人标题的排版格式；没有出现 mim 片段。

patterns.name: 非 mim 的零散词内激活
patterns.context: 个别词或词片段在各自语境中被标记；未见共同语义、格式或稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 化学科研摘要；网页评论

en.concept: In-word fragments and sparse lexical triggers
en.description: The most stable pattern is the in-word fragment beginning with mim, covering mimicking, mimetype, mimiced, and mimosas; other activations include estopped and Civ. in legal contexts, as well as isolated activations on matters and fragment.

patterns.name: Word-initial “mim” fragment
patterns.context: All trigger positions occur inside words beginning with mim; their meanings and subsequent spellings differ.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, technical documents, online discussions, and general prose

patterns.name: Legal term “estopped”
patterns.context: Appears in an alternative defense raised by a party, as part of a legal term.

patterns.name: Civ. in legal citations
patterns.context: Abbreviation used in civil case citations or as the name of a legal division.

patterns.name: Matter fragment in “matters”
patterns.context: Appears in an informal discussion about a collar’s sun-shading function.

patterns.name: “fragment”
patterns.context: Appears in a research abstract about a synthetic route and fragment-coupling strategy.

7_2890.concept: 词内片段与少数词汇触发
7_2890.description: 最稳定模式是词内以 mim 开头的片段，涵盖 mimicking、mimetype、mimiced、mimosas；另有法律语境中的 estopped 与 Civ.，以及孤立的 matters、fragment 激活。

patterns.name: “mim”词首片段
patterns.context: 触发位置都是以 mim 开头的词内部；语义和后续拼写各异
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、技术文档、网络讨论及一般叙述

patterns.name: 法律术语“estopped”
patterns.context: 出现在当事人提出的替代抗辩中，构成法律术语的一部分

patterns.name: 法律引注中的 Civ.
patterns.context: 作为民事案件引注或法律部门名称的缩写

patterns.name: “matters”中的 matter 词段
patterns.context: 出现在关于衣领遮阳功能的口语化讨论中

patterns.name: “fragment”
patterns.context: 出现在合成路线与片段偶联策略的科研摘要中

en.description: Activations are scattered across different contexts: the shared word-initial mim in mimicking, mimetype, and mimicked; plus several isolated in-word segments, proper names, legal citations, and ordinary sentence words, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Inflected form of mimicking
patterns.context: When describing something imitating, emulating, or reproducing something else; the trigger falls on an in-word segment of mimicking.

patterns.name: String inside mimetype
patterns.context: The MIME type field in an XML attribute, specifically an internal substring of mimetype; no imitation-related meaning is required.

patterns.name: Past participle of mimic
patterns.context: Discussing someone or something being imitated; the trigger is an in-word segment of mimicked.

patterns.name: Initial segment of Bowling
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the phrase “Bowl win caps,” possibly as a tokenized split of Bowling or a local string; this is the sole example.

patterns.name: In-word segment of Civic
patterns.context: In the proper-name phrase “Rip Curls and Civic Engagement,” activation falls at the beginning of Civic.

patterns.name: ville in Shelbyville
patterns.context: An in-word segment of the place name Shelbyville; it occurs twice in the same passage, with stronger activation on the second occurrence.

patterns.name: Case number in a citation
patterns.context: In the legal citation “09 Civ. 499,” activation falls on Civ and the adjacent numbering format; other legal title words do not show comparable strength.

patterns.name: Sentence-final word matters
patterns.context: Predicate position in the ordinary sentence “it matters,” following a discussion of collar sun protection and exposure to sunlight; a single example.

patterns.name: Semantic word disconnected
patterns.context: Commenting that a story is disconnected from reality, with reality nearby; however, activation is not on reality.

patterns.name: Vocabulary and marker in a goal sentence
patterns.context: At the beginning of a goal statement following GOAL: in an NIH abstract; it has no clear morphological or semantic commonality with the other activated fragments.

7_2890.concept: 局部字符串与词内分段
7_2890.description: 激活分散于不同语境：mimicking、mimetype、mimicked 的共同词首 mim；另有若干孤立的词内分段、专名、法律引注及普通句中词汇，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: mimicking 分词形式
patterns.context: 在描述某物模拟、仿照或再现其他事物时；触发点落在单词 mimicking 的词内分段上。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划摘要

patterns.name: mimetype 字符串内部
patterns.context: XML 属性中的 MIME 类型字段，具体是 mimetype 一词的内部子串；不要求出现模仿含义。
patterns.domain: Github 代码与序列化 XML

patterns.name: mimic 的过去分词
patterns.context: 谈论某人或事物被模仿时；触发点是 mimicked 一词的词内分段。

patterns.name: Bowling 开头分段
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “Bowl win caps” 的开头，可能是 Bowling 一词的分词式拆分或局部字符串；只有此例。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或标题式短语

patterns.name: Civic 的词内分段
patterns.context: 专名短语 “Rip Curls and Civic Engagement” 中，激活落在 Civic 一词开头。

patterns.name: Shelbyville 中的 ville
patterns.context: 地名 Shelbyville 的词内分段；在同一段重复出现，且第二次出现时激活更强。

patterns.name: case 的文书编号
patterns.context: 法律案件引注 “09 Civ. 499” 中，激活落在 Civ 及相邻编号格式；其他法律标题词未显示相同强度。

patterns.name: matters 的句末词
patterns.context: 普通句子中 “it matters” 的谓语位置，前文讨论衣领遮阳和是否晒到太阳；孤例。

patterns.name: disconnected 的语义词
patterns.context: 评论某个故事与现实脱节，且附近出现 reality；但激活不在 reality 上。

patterns.name: 目标句中的词汇与标记
patterns.context: NIH 摘要中 GOAL: 之后的目标陈述开头；与其余激活片段没有清楚的词形或语义共同点。

en.description: Activations are sporadic: > at the start of email quotation lines recurs most clearly; the rest are scattered across sentence-initial capitalized word fragments, mathematical formatting, URLs, and ordinary words, with no shared semantic or syntactic pattern explaining all fragments.

patterns.name: Greater-than sign marker
patterns.context: Before email quotations or quoted text, activation centers on the literal >; one segment also includes a line break.

patterns.name: Capitalized initial letters or word fragments
patterns.context: Split positions vary between text beginnings and inside words; some are capitalized initial words/fragments, and others begin with digits, with no uniform semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: cert in a URL
patterns.context: Appears in a path fragment of an ENISA cybersecurity URL; activation is related to URL segmentation, with weaker activations on other nearby URL fragments as well.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in common words and phrases
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in full sentences or in-word fragments; segments lack shared local morphological, syntactic, or semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Line break after formula or number
patterns.context: In a math problem, a line break after numbers, symbols, and letters is followed by the instruction “Find the third derivative of”; the trigger may relate to formatting or symbols, but there is only one example.

patterns.name: Word fragment in sports reporting
patterns.context: Appears at the start of sports reports such as “Bowl win caps amazing season turnaround,” with activation on a split fragment of Bowl.

7_2890.concept: none
7_2890.description: 激活分布零散：邮件引用行首的 > 最明显地重复出现；其余分散于句首大写词片段、数学格式、网址及普通词语中，未见能解释全部片段的共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 大于号标记
patterns.context: 在邮件引用格式或被引用文本前，激活集中在字面上的 >；其中一段还伴随换行。

patterns.name: 词首大写字母或词片段
patterns.context: 文本开头或词内部的切分位置不一；部分是大写词首/片段，另有数字开头，缺乏统一的词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 网址中的 cert
patterns.context: 出现在 ENISA 网络安全网址的路径片段中；激活与网址切分相关，周围其他 URL 片段也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 常见词与短语中的零散激活
patterns.context: 在完整句子或词内片段中零散出现；各段缺少共同的局部词形、句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 公式或数字后的换行
patterns.context: 数学题文本中，数字、符号和字母后换行，再接指令“Find the third derivative of”；触发可能与格式或符号有关，证据仅一例。

patterns.name: 比赛报道词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Bowl win caps amazing season turnaround”一类体育报道开头，激活落在 Bowl 的切分片段。

en.description: The most stable trigger cues are the line-initial quotation marker > and newline boundaries; activations also occur across in-word segmentation, mixed-case fragments, and email headers, without a shared semantics or topic.

patterns.name: Line-initial or quotation marker
patterns.context: A quotation marker > appears at the start of the context, or text follows a newline; most strong activations are on >.
patterns.domain: Email, forums, code, and web text

patterns.name: GOAL initial fragment
patterns.context: Consecutive token fragments that can be combined to form GOAL, followed by a colon and a statement of purpose.

patterns.name: Mixed case, token fragments, or proper names
patterns.context: Unusual capitalization, in-word segmentation, or short abbreviations appear at the start of a line or in quoted text; the activated parts do not consistently correspond to a specific word meaning.
patterns.domain: Forums, email, code, and web text

patterns.name: Email headers and forwarded content
patterns.context: Quoted email or header fields followed by a sender, abbreviation, or message body.

patterns.name: Quotations and greetings
patterns.context: A quotation marker is followed by an aphoristic statement or a direct form of address and greeting.

7_2890.concept: 行首引用/边界标记
7_2890.description: 最稳定的触发线索是行首引用符 >，以及换行边界；此外激活散布于词内分词、大小写碎片和邮件头等不同局部结构，未见统一语义或主题。

patterns.name: 行首或引用标记
patterns.context: 上下文开头出现 > 引用符，或换行后接文本；其中多数强激活在 > 上。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛、代码及网页文本

patterns.name: GOAL 起始片段
patterns.context: 连续出现可拼成 GOAL 的分词片段，后接冒号和目的陈述。

patterns.name: 混合大小写、分词碎片或专名
patterns.context: 异常大小写、词内切分或短缩写出现在行首/引用文本中；被激活部分并不一致地对应特定词义。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、代码及网页文本

patterns.name: 邮件头与转发内容
patterns.context: 邮件引用或头部字段，后跟发件人、缩写或正文。

patterns.name: 引语与寒暄文本
patterns.context: 引用符后接格言式陈述或直接称呼及问候。

en.description: Strong activations mainly center on minus signs and adjacent numbers, variables, and algebraic expressions in math problems, and also occur at problem line breaks and instructions; there is also an NIH GOAL marker and a dash after an email salutation, possibly reflecting different punctuation or boundary patterns.

patterns.name: GOAL/AL format
patterns.context: Appears in an NIH project description, followed by a colon and the goal statement “To decrease the morbidity and mortality”.

patterns.name: Minus signs and number sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Mostly fragments of math exercises, where minus signs are often part of a number or algebraic expression; some problem fragments activate immediately after a minus sign.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problems and practice materials

patterns.name: Negative-coefficient algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Minus signs occur adjacent to coefficients, variables, or multiplication signs; common in expressions from polynomial, equation, or sequence problems, rather than natural-language usage.

patterns.name: Problem boundaries and math-problem instructions
patterns.context: Adjacent to negative numbers or algebraic expressions, appearing at problem line breaks, question beginnings, or in question wording; activation is not limited to instruction words.

patterns.name: Dash as separator
patterns.context: A dash appears after an email salutation, like a separator or em dash in the email body; no mathematical expression is nearby.

7_2890.concept: 负号及文本边界标记
7_2890.description: 强激活主要集中在数学题里负号及其邻接的数字、变量和代数式，也见于题目换行与指令；另有 NIH 的 GOAL 标记和邮件称呼后的短横线，可能反映不同的标点或边界模式。

patterns.name: GOAL/AL 格式
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 项目描述中，后接冒号及“To decrease the morbidity and mortality”这一目标陈述。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负号与数字序列
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 « -»，以及其后的数字、逗号、问号或换行
patterns.context: 多为数学练习题的片段，负号常作为数值或代数式的一部分；部分题目片段在负号后立即出现激活。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 题目与练习材料

patterns.name: 负系数代数式
patterns.context: 负号与系数、变量或乘号相邻；常见于多项式、方程或数列题中的表达式，而非自然语言用法。

patterns.name: 题面边界与数学题指令
patterns.context: 与负数或代数式相邻，作为题目换行、题干开头或提问措辞出现；激活并非只落在指令词上。

patterns.name: 短横线分隔语
patterns.context: 短横线位于邮件称呼后，像是邮件正文中的分隔符或破折号；周围不含数学表达式。

en.concept: Math problem structure and sequence queries
en.description: Mainly responds to numbers and structured formulas in mathematical question answering, especially “nth term” sequence problems; also covers ordering/comparison, continuing a sequence, finding the number of digits, and weaker or localized patterns such as problem line breaks.

patterns.name: nth term of an arithmetic sequence
patterns.context: Asks for a term in a sequence of integers, usually followed by a linear general-term expression such as “5*k**2 + 21*k + 1994” or “s**2 - 9*s - 133”; the trigger centers on the ordinal-variable suffix “'th term”.

patterns.name: Order statistics among sequence choices
patterns.context: Determines which item is largest, smallest, or closest to a target among a finite set of candidate values or choices; options and numbers often appear nearby.

patterns.name: Asking for the next sequence term
patterns.context: Provides a sequence of numbers and asks for the next term; the sequence may follow a regular or irregular numeric pattern.

patterns.name: Asking for the number of digits
patterns.context: Asks for a specific digit position, such as the ones or hundreds place, of a number or expression; variable definitions and formulas may be nearby.

patterns.name: Numbers and operator strings in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Dense spans of math tokens contain numbers, minus signs, multiplication and division symbols, variables, and question marks; these local fragments do not have a stable shared problem type.

patterns.name: Math task boundaries/line breaks
patterns.context: A line break separates a problem, answer, and following problem or new derivation; activation may occur near the line break marker, but also co-occurs with numbers and problem templates.

7_2890.concept: 数学题结构与数列查询
7_2890.description: 主要响应数学问答中的数字与结构化算式，尤其是“第n项”数列题；也覆盖排序/比较、续写数列、求数字位数，以及题目换行边界等较弱或局部模式。

patterns.name: 等差数列的第 n 项
patterns.trigger: “What is the «l»'th term of -143, -312, -481?”；“What is the «o»'th term…”；“What is the «t»'th term…”；“What is the «b»'th term…”
patterns.context: 问由若干整数构成的数列第几项，随后通常给出线性通项表达式，如“5*k**2 + 21*k + 1994”或“s**2 - 9*s - 133”；触发点集中在序数变量后缀“'th term”。

patterns.name: 选择序列中的次序统计量
patterns.trigger: “Which is the second biggest value?”；“What is the third biggest value…”；“Which is the closest to f?”；“What is the second smallest”
patterns.context: 从有限候选值或选项中判断最大、最小、接近目标的第几项；附近常有选项标记与数字。

patterns.name: 询问数列下一项
patterns.context: 给出一串数字并要求续写下一项；序列可能是常规或不规则数字模式。

patterns.name: 询问数字位数
patterns.trigger: “What is the units digit of”及“what is the hundreds digit of”
patterns.context: 对数或算式求个位、百位等特定位数，附近可有变量定义与算式。

patterns.name: 数学算式中的数字与运算符串
patterns.context: 大段数学 token 中出现密集数字、负号、乘除符号、变量和问号；这些局部片段自身没有稳定的共同题型。

patterns.name: 数学任务边界/换行
patterns.context: 题目、答案与下一道题或新推导以换行分隔；换行标记附近可激活，但也与数字和题目模板共现。

en.concept: Negative numbers and signed expressions in mathematics
en.description: Mainly responds to minus signs and negative numbers in mathematical text, including hexadecimal data in code and various algebra problems; also has localized responses to comparatives, question templates, variable operations, and questions about sequence terms.

patterns.name: Negative numbers/math text beginning with a minus sign
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a number or used as a subtraction operator in an algebraic expression; often mixed with variables, operators, and numbers.
patterns.domain: Math question answering and algebra problems; in [1], hexadecimal numbers in code

patterns.name: Ordinal apostrophe in sequence-term questions
patterns.context: Asks for the nth term of a given sequence, with the variable connected to an apostrophe-style ordinal.
patterns.domain: Sequence problems, automatically generated math question answering

patterns.name: Comparative cue in comparison problems
patterns.context: Compares two expressions or values, with the comparative word itself clearly activating.

patterns.name: Compound math question-template word
patterns.context: Appears in short question forms; “composite” is often followed by an integer or variable.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal literals in code
patterns.context: Appears as code data in comma-separated key-value pairs enclosed in braces.

patterns.name: Algebraic variable and coefficient operation fragments
patterns.context: Polynomial or equation fragments composed of variables, coefficients, multiplication, or powers; no single variable or operator explains all activations.

7_2890.concept: 数学中的负数与符号表达
7_2890.description: 主要响应数学文本中的负号及负数，覆盖代码十六进制数据和多种代数题；还对比较级、提问模板、变量运算和数列项次问法有局部响应。

patterns.name: 负数/减号开头的数学文本
patterns.context: 负号紧邻数字，或作为代数表达式中的减法运算符；常与变量、运算符和数字混排。
patterns.domain: 数学问答与代数题；[1]中则是代码里的十六进制数

patterns.name: 序列项次提问中的撇号序数
patterns.context: 询问给定数列的第 n 项，变量与撇号序数形式相连。
patterns.domain: 数列题、自动生成的数学问答

patterns.name: 比较题中的比较级提示
patterns.context: 比较两个表达式或数值，比较级词本身激活明显。

patterns.name: 复合数学问答模板词
patterns.context: 出现在简短的题目提问句式中；“composite”后常接整数或变量。

patterns.name: 代码中的十六进制字面量
patterns.context: 出现在花括号包围、逗号分隔的键值对中，作为代码数据。

patterns.name: 代数变量与系数运算片段
patterns.context: 变量、系数、乘法或幂组成的多项式/方程片段；并非单一变量或运算符能解释全部激活。

en.concept: Prominent terms and numbers in technical text
en.description: Activations cover magnitude terms (especially million), various programming code structures, API documentation about team members, script and web technology terms, and UI loading prompts and typography discussions; trigger conditions span domains, with no unified local syntax.

patterns.name: Large numbers and magnitude text
patterns.context: Numbers or quantities include magnitude terms such as million/billion; often used with descriptions of the scale of users, elements, etc. [1] also involves a numerical rounding issue.
patterns.domain: Math problems, product discussions, business/social media descriptions, news comments

patterns.name: Calls and return statements in code
patterns.context: Method calls, parameters, assignments, or return statements in code snippets; activations are distributed around punctuation, keywords, and code identifiers, without a single fixed syntactic structure.
patterns.domain: Go, C#, Objective-C code and programming Q&A

patterns.name: API documentation for project members and roles
patterns.context: Lists operations related to team members and their functions in sequence, including compound identifiers and permissions/role terminology.

patterns.name: Script and web code terminology
patterns.context: Explains the concept of a scriptlet across platforms and lists scripting languages, components, and web code.

patterns.name: UI loading prompts and typography suggestions
patterns.context: Discusses whether to show a loading prompt in UI design and whether typography/content should be presented online; “Loading…” activates especially strongly.
patterns.domain: Product design discussions, web or interface UX

7_2890.concept: 技术文本中的显著术语与数值
7_2890.description: 激活覆盖数量级词（尤以 million 为主）、多种编程代码结构、团队成员 API 文档、脚本与网页技术术语，以及界面加载提示和排版讨论；触发条件跨领域，未见统一局部句法。

patterns.name: 大数字及数量级文本
patterns.trigger: “one million”前的“million” [1]；“300 million” [5]；“billion”与“25 million” [7]；“70 million”“300 million” [10]
patterns.context: 数字或数量表达中出现 million/billion 等数量级词；常与用户、元素等规模描述连用。[1] 中还出现了数值舍入问题。
patterns.domain: 数学题、产品讨论、商业/社交媒体介绍、新闻评论

patterns.name: 代码中的调用与返回语句
patterns.context: 代码片段中的方法调用、参数、赋值或返回语句；激活分布在标点、关键字和代码标识符附近，并无单一固定语法结构。

patterns.name: 项目成员与角色的 API 文档
patterns.context: 连续列出团队成员相关操作及其功能说明，包含复合标识符和权限/角色术语。

patterns.name: 脚本及网页代码术语
patterns.context: 解释不同平台中的 scriptlet 概念，并列举脚本语言、组件与网页代码。

patterns.name: 界面加载提示与排版建议
patterns.context: 讨论界面设计中是否显示加载提示，以及排版/内容是否应在线呈现；“Loading…”处激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 产品设计讨论、网页或界面 UX

en.concept: Code and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activations mainly fall on code and its boundaries, paths, and technical identifiers, and also occur in patent-style technical descriptions and programming Q&A; specific topics are varied, including databases, exception logs, user lookup, barcodes, and web hosting.

patterns.name: Code and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across code formatting and syntax boundaries, spanning HTML, Java, Swift, C/C++, and other code; they are not specific to a single language or API.
patterns.domain: Source code, code snippets, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Paths and filenames
patterns.context: Path- or filename-related strings occur in code, comments, or technical descriptions; in [1], activations are especially concentrated on path and extension fragments.
patterns.domain: Software development, code, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Databases and encryption
patterns.context: Descriptions or questions about database encryption, re-encryption, and processing at startup.

patterns.name: Offline folder processing
patterns.context: A patent-style statement describing a folder hierarchy in a client database and offline module flags for messages that must be retained.

patterns.name: Error handling and logs
patterns.context: After an exception is caught, parsing failure information is logged and execution continues.

patterns.name: User lookup and row nodes
patterns.context: A code comment describes local user lookup; separate tree row-node key-value handling code also appears.

patterns.name: User interface and conditional checks
patterns.context: Swift-style cell configuration and string conditional checks.

patterns.name: Barcodes and multimedia access
patterns.context: Patent-style claims describe generating and obtaining a barcode associated with multimedia content.

patterns.name: Free virtual hosting
patterns.context: Explains “unlimited” hosting service promises and recommends free hosting, also mentioning ads.

patterns.name: C/C++ Q&A code
patterns.context: A short C/C++ program snippet followed by a programming help question.

7_2890.concept: 技术文本中的代码与标识符
7_2890.description: 激活主要落在代码及其边界、路径和技术标识符，也出现在专利式技术描述与编程问答；具体主题分散，包括数据库、异常日志、用户查找、条码和网站托管。

patterns.name: 代码与标点边界
patterns.context: 激活分散在代码排版与语法边界，横跨 HTML、Java、Swift、C/C++ 等不同代码；并非单一语言或 API。
patterns.domain: 源代码、代码片段及技术问答

patterns.name: 路径与文件名
patterns.context: 路径或文件名相关字符串出现在代码、注释或技术描述中；其中 [1] 对路径及扩展名片段尤为集中。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、代码与技术文档

patterns.name: 数据库与加密
patterns.context: 围绕数据库加密、重新加密以及启动时处理的说明或问题描述。

patterns.name: 文件夹离线处理
patterns.context: 描述客户端数据库中的文件夹层级，以及离线模块标记需保留消息的专利式陈述。

patterns.name: 错误处理与日志
patterns.trigger: «catch (Exception e)»、«Level.FINE»、«Failed to parse schema»、«ignoring and moving on»
patterns.context: 异常被捕获后记录解析失败信息并继续执行。

patterns.name: 用户查找与行节点
patterns.context: 代码注释说明本地用户查找，另有树形行节点键值处理代码。

patterns.name: 用户界面与条件判断
patterns.context: Swift 风格单元格配置及字符串条件判断。

patterns.name: 条码与多媒体访问
patterns.context: 专利式权利要求描述生成并获取与多媒体内容关联的条码。

patterns.name: 免费虚拟主机
patterns.context: 解释主机服务的“无限”承诺并建议免费主机，同时提及广告。

patterns.name: C/C++ 问答代码
patterns.context: 短小的 C/C++ 程序片段后接编程求助问题。

en.description: Activations are scattered across text types, often on words introducing focus or degree (most, main, primary, more, really) and several specific phrases; there are also isolated phenomena such as Portuguese word forms, URL symbols, and pronouns, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Main conclusion/focus in comments or posts
patterns.context: Introduces the main point, question, or subsequent focus in an explanation, question, or discussion; activations often fall on focus-marking words.

patterns.name: Emphasis words most / more
patterns.context: In degree or comparative constructions, especially when emphasizing what is most important or prominent, or shifting to a more serious topic.

patterns.name: Help or positive evaluation
patterns.context: Describes a tool or ability as helpful or worthy of praise to the speaker; activation centers on “help”.

patterns.name: Reference/use of the pronoun he
patterns.context: In an account of Windows usage, he refers to the son mentioned earlier; activation falls on “he”.

patterns.name: Portuguese decision-related word form
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence discusses Descartes’s decision; strong activation centers on “decis”.

patterns.name: Symbols and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: A browser extension URL is shown split up, with activations on several punctuation marks and URL substrings.

patterns.name: Uniqueness of code/identifier strings
patterns.context: Discusses generating and validating unique strings to avoid user resource conflicts; activation falls on descriptions of code correctness and conflict avoidance.

patterns.name: Emphasis shifting to blockchain and art commerce
patterns.context: Discusses blockchain tracking the provenance of digital files and protecting transfers, while emphasizing that the project is fundamentally still an art business.

patterns.name: Introducing the main question in technical Q&A
patterns.context: Introduces the question to be answered after describing an encrypted-message workflow.

patterns.name: Windows habits and content already used
patterns.context: Mentions that the son does not know how to use Windows and describes the tools he has actually used.

patterns.name: Most extreme expression in golf satire
patterns.context: Poses a challenge to write the most insulting content possible using as few characters as possible.

patterns.name: Personal qualification in a method-overriding question
patterns.context: The questioner notes that the problem may be affected by other factors and hopes the question is specific enough.

patterns.name: Emphasis on how a project is supported
patterns.context: A project description states that its main support channel is a mailing list.

7_2890.concept: 强调重点或程度词
7_2890.description: 激活分散于多类文本，常落在引出重点或程度的词（most、main、primary、more、really）及若干特定短语上；另有葡语词形、URL 符号和代词等孤立现象，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 评论或帖子中的主要结论/重点
patterns.trigger: “the most important thing”“The main questions”“a more serious note”“the primary support”
patterns.context: 在说明、提问或讨论中引出主要观点、问题或后续重点；激活常落在重点标记词上。

patterns.name: 强调词 most / more
patterns.trigger: “most”“more”，如“the most important”“the most insulting”“a more serious note”
patterns.context: 程度或比较结构中，尤其是强调某项最重要、最突出或转向较严肃话题时。

patterns.name: 帮助或积极评价
patterns.context: 描述工具或能力对说话者有帮助、值得肯定；激活集中于“help”。

patterns.name: 代词 he 的指代/使用
patterns.context: Windows 使用情况的叙述中，he 指前文提到的儿子；激活落在“he”。

patterns.name: 葡语决定相关词形
patterns.context: 葡语句子中谈到笛卡尔的决定；强激活集中于“decis”。

patterns.name: URL 中的符号及路径片段
patterns.trigger: “Url -”及“chrome-extension://…/chrome_ex_oauth.html”中的换行、斜线、点号和路径片段
patterns.context: 浏览器扩展 URL 被拆分展示，激活落在多种标点和 URL 子串上。

patterns.name: 代码/标识符字符串的唯一性
patterns.trigger: “globally unique strings”“no user will overwrite another user's image”
patterns.context: 讨论如何生成并验证唯一字符串以避免用户资源冲突；激活落在代码正确性及无冲突的表述上。

patterns.name: 区块链与艺术商业的转折强调
patterns.context: 讨论区块链追踪数字文件来源、保护转移，并强调项目本质仍是艺术商业。
patterns.domain: 区块链与艺术相关说明

patterns.name: 技术问答中的主问题引出
patterns.context: 在描述加密消息流程后引出待回答的问题。

patterns.name: Windows 使用习惯及已用内容
patterns.context: 谈到儿子不懂如何使用 Windows，并说明其实际使用过的工具。

patterns.name: 讽刺高尔夫的最极端表达
patterns.trigger: “the most insulting thing possible in the least characters”
patterns.context: 提出以尽可能少字符写出最侮辱性内容的挑战。

patterns.name: 方法重写问题的个人限定语
patterns.trigger: “i hope the question is sufficiently specific”
patterns.context: 提问者说明问题可能受其他因素影响，并希望问题足够具体。

patterns.name: 项目支持方式的重点说明
patterns.context: 项目介绍中指出其主要支持渠道是邮件列表。

en.description: Activations are most clearly concentrated on newlines following sentence-final punctuation or code delimiters, and also occur around diff addition/deletion markers, code identifier boundaries, and path fragments. Other sparse triggers include English function words, Swedish subwords, and answer lines in math; no single semantic condition explains them all.

patterns.name: Newline after sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Activations often occur at a newline immediately after a period, comma, or code delimiter; in [1], a left parenthesis also follows the period.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including web text, documents, code, and Q&A

patterns.name: Patch markers and diff lines
patterns.context: Occurs near file paths, addition/deletion markers, and newlines in Git diffs; the strongest trigger is on an added-line marker.

patterns.name: Internal boundaries in technical identifiers
patterns.context: In code, commands, filenames, or paths, activation occurs near identifier components, punctuation boundaries, or extensions; some tokens are subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Linux commands, programming Q&A, and code comments

patterns.name: English function words and connective expressions
patterns.context: A few function words, inter-sentence connectives, and phrase boundaries are marked in ordinary English prose or explanations; trigger positions are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Web comments, technical Q&A, and forum text

patterns.name: In-word Swedish subword fragments
patterns.context: Words or in-word segments in continuous Swedish text; no clear specialized semantic condition.

patterns.name: Answer character after a newline in a math problem
patterns.context: The question asks for the second-smallest of several numbers; the answer is the letter c on its own line, with activation concentrated on the answer and adjacent newline.

7_2890.concept: 文本与代码边界标记
7_2890.description: 激活最明确地集中在句末标点或代码分隔符后的换行，也见于 diff 增删标记、代码标识符边界及路径片段。另有英语功能词、瑞典语子词和数学答案行等零散触发，无法由单一语义条件解释。

patterns.name: 句末标点后的换行
patterns.context: 激活常出现在句号、逗号或代码分隔符后紧接换行的位置；[1]中句号后还跟左括号。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、文档、代码及问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 补丁标记与差异行
patterns.context: 出现在 Git diff 的文件路径、增删标记和换行附近；最强触发位于新增行标记。

patterns.name: 技术标识符内部边界
patterns.context: 在代码、命令、文件名或路径中，标识符的组成部分、标点边界或扩展名附近出现激活；部分 token 是子词切分片段。
patterns.domain: Linux 命令、编程问答与代码注释

patterns.name: 英语功能词与续接表达
patterns.trigger: « that»1、« so»1、« end»4、« If»2、« get»1、« Right»4« now»2、« to»2、« the»2
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述或说明中，少量功能词、句间衔接词和短语边界被标记；触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、技术问答、论坛文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子词片段
patterns.trigger: «ande»4、« Jag»3、« måste»7、« sä»ga、« hell»er、« all»var、« st»ora
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中的词或词内切分片段；没有明显对应的专门语义条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中换行后的答案字符
patterns.context: 问题询问多个数中的第二小值，答案以独占一行的字母 c 给出，激活集中在答案及相邻换行。

en.concept: less, programming source code, and path fragments
en.description: Activations center on comparative uses of less/Less, C++ compilation and source code, and lib in code paths; they also involve JS module loading, implementation discussions, and kernel driver filenames. These patterns are not obviously unified.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Less for degree comparison
patterns.context: Less/less appears in a comparative or degree expression, followed by than, a noun phrase, or an adjective; capitalization varies.

patterns.name: C/C++ and compiled source code
patterns.context: Programming contexts such as C++, source file extensions, compilation commands, or project directory structures.

patterns.name: lib directory in paths
patterns.context: lib occurs in filesystem paths or filenames; meanings involve Python package directories, JS module paths, and kernel source files.

patterns.name: JavaScript module formats and conditional branches
patterns.context: Uses conditional branches to detect CommonJS/AMD environments and load modules.

patterns.name: Discussion of implementation and its quality/standards
patterns.context: Discusses differences between tutorial examples and implementations that better conform to industry standards.

patterns.name: Digit zero and filename fragments in code
patterns.context: rt2x00 and rt2800 filenames in Linux wireless adapter driver paths; activations center near the patch path.

7_2890.concept: less、编程源码与路径片段
7_2890.description: 激活集中于 less/Less 的比较用法、C++ 编译与源码，以及代码路径中的 lib；另涉及 JS 模块加载、实现讨论和内核驱动文件名。各模式表面上并不统一。

patterns.name: 句首 Less 的程度比较
patterns.trigger: «Less»10（另见 less）：第1段“Less than 12 hours after…”，第2段“Less code, more ‘magic’”，第6段“the less savvy users”
patterns.context: Less/less 出现在比较或程度表达中，后接 than、名词短语或形容词；大小写不同

patterns.name: C/C++ 与编译源码
patterns.context: C++、源文件扩展名、编译命令或项目目录结构等编程上下文

patterns.name: 路径中的 lib 目录
patterns.context: lib 出现在文件系统路径或文件名中；语义分别涉及 Python 包目录、JS 模块路径和内核源码文件

patterns.name: JavaScript 模块格式与条件分支
patterns.context: 以条件分支检测 CommonJS/AMD 环境并加载模块

patterns.name: 提及实现及其质量/标准
patterns.context: 讨论教程示例与更符合行业标准的实现之间的差异

patterns.name: 代码中数字零与文件名片段
patterns.context: Linux 无线网卡驱动路径中的 rt2x00、rt2800 文件名；激活集中在补丁路径附近

en.description: Activations span diverse text: C/C++ build configuration, testing and software status, Linux driver patches, and Spanish and Swedish parliamentary text and Portuguese journal introductions. No common trigger word explains all fragments.

patterns.name: C/C++ build configuration in code
patterns.context: Compiler options, libraries, and header paths appear in CMake, compiler commands, or build instructions; [1] involves module-loading code but only weakly fits this broad code-text feature.
patterns.domain: GitHub code and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Software testing and runtime status
patterns.context: Describes missing test dependencies, tests not being run, or software services that have started but whose functionality and security are still being evaluated.

patterns.name: Spanish aviation policy text
patterns.context: Discusses airline and passenger border or security-check procedures in an EU Parliament context.

patterns.name: Technology and finance topics in Swedish parliamentary text
patterns.context: A Swedish parliamentary speech mentioning technology systems, microfinance institutions, and questions.

patterns.name: Inquiries and testing in Swedish parliamentary text
patterns.context: Parliamentary text expressing concern about delays in progress and asking the Commission and Council for information about technical test results.

patterns.name: Linux driver source diff path
patterns.context: Kernel driver file paths and addition markers appear in patch diff lines.

patterns.name: Parliamentary text fragment outside Swedish
patterns.context: A Spanish sentence related to aviation policy; this short fragment alone does not establish whether it shares the same policy-discourse pattern as [4].

patterns.name: Editorial introduction text
patterns.context: Introduces a new journal issue and provides an editor’s signature or editorial information.

7_2890.concept: 多领域技术与文本标记
7_2890.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的文本：C/C++构建配置、测试与软件状态、Linux驱动补丁，以及西班牙语和瑞典语议会文本、葡萄牙语期刊介绍。未见能解释全部片段的共同触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的C/C++构建配置
patterns.context: CMake、编译命令或构建说明中出现编译器选项、库和头文件路径；[1]涉及模块加载代码，但仅弱地符合代码文本这一宽泛特征。

patterns.name: 软件测试与运行状态
patterns.trigger: «WARNING»、«JUnit is not present»、«Tests not executed»、«up and running»
patterns.context: 描述测试依赖缺失、测试未执行，或软件服务已启动但仍在评价其功能与安全性。

patterns.name: 西班牙语航空政策文本
patterns.context: 欧盟议会语境中讨论航空公司及旅客的边境或安检流程。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会文本中的技术与金融议题
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言，提及技术系统、微型金融机构及提问。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会文本中的调查与测试
patterns.context: 议会文本表达对进展延误的担忧，并询问委员会及理事会关于技术测试结果的信息。

patterns.name: Linux驱动源码差异路径
patterns.context: 补丁差异行中出现内核驱动文件路径及新增标记。

patterns.name: 瑞典语以外的议会文本片段
patterns.context: 与航空政策相关的西班牙语句子；无法仅凭该短片段确认是否与[4]是同一段政策表述模式。

patterns.name: 编辑部介绍文字
patterns.context: 介绍期刊新一期并署名或提供编辑部信息。

en.concept: Local comparative words and technical text fragments
en.description: Activations are relatively prominent in more/less used in comparisons or contrasts, and also cover file paths, module code, command lines, and error logs; there are also scattered everyday words, platform comments, and Markdown markers that cannot be explained uniformly.

patterns.name: more in contrast or elaboration contexts
patterns.context: Used to compare degree, shift to a more serious or general topic, or specify a category of work; activation may fall on more/less or adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, technical descriptions, encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Less in negation or correction contexts
patterns.context: In comparative descriptions, less is followed by a quantity or property; strong activation is not limited to more.

patterns.name: Paths and library filenames
patterns.context: Multiple path fragments and filenames activate in slash-separated filesystem paths, shared library names, or code module paths.

patterns.name: Commands, options, and repeated execution
patterns.context: When explaining how to repeatedly run a compilation command, command-related words and command-line syntax fragments activate.

patterns.name: Short words/word fragments in informal text
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across everyday phrases, word fragments, and neighboring function words, without stable shared contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Conditional code module definition
patterns.context: Multiple code tokens activate when loading and defining a module in a CommonJS/AMD branch; this may neighbor the path pattern but has a more specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: Error logs and stack paths
patterns.context: When log filenames, configuration file locations, and stack output occur in sequence, error identifiers and path components activate.

patterns.name: Social platforms and comment contexts
patterns.context: Activations occur in comment text mentioning Reddit posts and platform rules, without a stable, specific semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Text markers and code fences
patterns.context: A few activations occur near Markdown fences or line breaks in forum content, possibly an incidental formatting pattern.

7_2890.concept: 局部比较词与技术文本片段
7_2890.description: 激活较明显地出现在比较或转折中的 more/less，也覆盖文件路径、模块代码、命令行及错误日志；另有零散日常词、平台评论和 Markdown 标记，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 对比、补充语境中的 more
patterns.context: 用于比较程度、转向较严肃或较一般的话题，或限定作品类别；激活点可能落在 more/less 或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术说明、百科叙述

patterns.name: 否定或纠正语境中的 Less
patterns.context: 比较性描述中 less 后接数量或性质，强激活并不局限于 more。

patterns.name: 路径及库文件名
patterns.context: 斜杠分隔的文件系统路径、共享库名或代码模块路径中，路径片段及文件名多个 token 均激活。

patterns.name: 命令、选项及重复执行
patterns.context: 说明如何重复执行编译命令时，命令相关词和命令行语法片段激活。

patterns.name: 非正式文本中的短词/词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在日常短语、词语片段和邻近功能词上，未见稳定的共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 条件式代码模块定义
patterns.context: CommonJS/AMD 分支中加载并定义模块时，多个代码 token 激活；可能与路径模式相邻但触发条件更具体。

patterns.name: 错误日志与堆栈路径
patterns.context: 日志文件名、配置文件位置和堆栈输出连续出现时，错误标识及路径组件激活。

patterns.name: 社交平台与评论语境
patterns.context: 提及 Reddit 帖子及平台规则的评论文字中出现激活，未显示稳定的特定语义触发词。

patterns.name: 文本标记与代码围栏
patterns.context: 论坛内容中的 Markdown 围栏或换行附近有少量激活，可能是格式相关的偶发模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across comparatives, code and shell commands, Portuguese and Italian word fragments, and local patterns such as unsafe configuration and s'more; there is no unified trigger condition covering all examples.

patterns.name: Comparatives and expressions of degree
patterns.context: Comparative or degree modifiers occur near adjectives, participles, or noun phrases; sometimes a comparative construction is present.

patterns.name: Commands and repeated execution
patterns.context: Discusses how to invoke a compiler command, especially running a command repeatedly.

patterns.name: Compiler commands and build paths
patterns.context: Gives C++ compiler commands, header paths, or linker options.

patterns.name: Shell commands and file paths
patterns.context: An installation script joined by newlines and backslashes contains commands for extraction, changing directories, or moving files.

patterns.name: Verbs and annotation wording in Portuguese sentences
patterns.context: A Portuguese technical explanation uses an infinitive to express the steps for using a property.

patterns.name: Italian relative pronoun
patterns.context: A relative pronoun in a formal Italian sentence refers back to a previously mentioned person or institution.

patterns.name: unsafe configuration option and path fragment
patterns.context: When discussing software library security and configure switches, path fragments and configuration options receive strong activation.

patterns.name: s'more word-form fragment
patterns.context: A stem fragment after an apostrophe appears in a narrative about campfires, food, and supplies.

patterns.name: Encoded punctuation and format boundaries
patterns.context: Hyphens, uppercase letters, and newlines appear in code- or command-related text.

7_2890.concept: none
7_2890.description: 激活分散于比较级、代码与 shell 命令、葡语和意大利语词片段，以及 unsafe 配置和 s'more 等局部模式；没有覆盖全部例子的统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 比较级与程度表达
patterns.context: 比较或程度修饰语出现在形容词、分词或名词短语附近；有时包含比较结构。

patterns.name: 命令及其重复执行
patterns.context: 讨论如何调用编译命令，尤其是重复执行某命令。

patterns.name: 编译命令与构建路径
patterns.context: 给出 C++ 编译命令、头文件路径或链接参数。

patterns.name: Shell 命令与文件路径
patterns.context: 以换行和反斜杠连接的安装脚本中，出现解压、目录切换或移动文件命令。

patterns.name: 葡语句中动词与标注用语
patterns.context: 葡语技术说明中，用不定式表达使用某属性的步骤。

patterns.name: 意大利语关系代词
patterns.context: 意大利语正式句中，关系代词承接前述人物或机构。

patterns.name: unsafe 配置选项与路径片段
patterns.context: 讨论软件库安全性及 configure 开关时，路径片段和配置选项受到强激活。

patterns.name: s'more 词形片段
patterns.context: 撇号后的词干片段出现在营火、食物及供应品叙述中。

patterns.name: 编码标点与格式边界
patterns.context: 连字符、大小写字母和换行出现在代码或命令相关文本中。

en.concept: Local word forms and technical text fragments
en.description: Activation cues are scattered: degree or extension expressions such as English less/more, Unix path fragments, and code words in technical text; also includes multilingual subword fragments and a few fixed expressions, with no single semantic explanation.

patterns.name: “less” and its following word forms
patterns.context: Appears when comparing or describing degree; activation falls on less or adjacent word-form fragments. [7] also contains s’mores, possibly due to local substring overlap.
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, spam-link discussion, everyday narration

patterns.name: Path separators and system library paths
patterns.context: Appears in Unix-like file paths or shared-library paths, often adjacent to directory names, architecture names, or version numbers.
patterns.domain: Command-line build logs, Linux debugging logs

patterns.name: Code, encryption, and file I/O
patterns.context: Technical discussions listing required functionality or discussing how much code to write; there is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Generic stuff for complex things
patterns.context: Describes the complexity of tasks or content, from simple to complex; in [8], more involved stuff is associated with UI improvements.

patterns.name: more in generalizing expressions
patterns.context: Used to introduce a more general description or elaboration, such as «more generically»; the trigger may relate to degree-comparison uses in other segments.

patterns.name: Multilingual subword fragments
patterns.context: Fragments fall inside Portuguese or Hungarian words split by tokenization, with no clear semantic link to English patterns.

patterns.name: Emphasis about a difficult experience
patterns.context: English narration uses “learned this the hard way” to express learning from experience.

7_2890.concept: 局部词形与技术文本片段
7_2890.description: 激活线索分散：英语中的 less/more 等程度或扩展表达、Unix 路径片段，以及技术文本中的代码词语；另有多语言词内片段和少数固定表达，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: “less”及其后续词形
patterns.context: 在比较或描述程度时出现；激活落在 less 或相邻的词形片段上。 [7] 中还出现 s’mores，可能是局部子串重合。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、垃圾链接讨论、日常叙述

patterns.name: 路径分隔符与系统库路径
patterns.context: 出现在 Unix 类文件路径或共享库路径中，常与目录名、架构名、版本号相邻。
patterns.domain: 命令行构建日志、Linux 调试日志

patterns.name: 代码、加密与文件 I/O
patterns.context: 技术讨论中列举实现所需功能，或谈论要编写的代码量；没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 泛指复杂事物的 stuff
patterns.context: 描述任务或内容从简单到复杂的程度；[8] 中 more involved stuff 与 UI 改进相连。

patterns.name: 泛化表达中的 more
patterns.context: 用于引出更一般的描述或扩展说明，如 «more generically»；触发可能与其他段的程度比较用法有关。

patterns.name: 多语言词内子词片段
