patterns.name: 多次比较/转折词序列
patterns.context: 句子对比、解释原因或引出后续问题；激活分布稀疏，未见统一结构

patterns.name: 独立的 C++ 代码符号与路径片段
patterns.context: 模板/函数对象代码及编译器诊断路径，激活覆盖多个代码片段
patterns.domain: StackExchange C++ 代码与错误输出

patterns.name: 独立的小说对话与叙述片段
patterns.context: 人物谈话及叙述，未显示稳定技术或专名模式

patterns.name: 独立的软件复用与并发说明
patterns.context: 说明编译器对象状态及多线程复用限制

en.concept: “more” and local code and emoji patterns
en.description: Activations most consistently appear with uses of more indicating comparison, increase, or degree; other patterns include C++ headers/debugging symbols, concurrency discussions, and sentence-final emoji activations in two instances, spanning different sections.

patterns.name: Comparative or degree use of more
patterns.context: More modifies an adjective, noun, or quantity expression to indicate increase, comparison, or degree; often appears in explanations, recommendations, or comparisons of options
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, technical Q&A, and general comments

patterns.name: C++ headers and standard library symbols
patterns.context: Headers, paths, and standard-library-related symbols appear in C++ source code or compiler diagnostics

patterns.name: Structural markers in program code
patterns.context: Lambda expressions, the this pointer, and hexadecimal values in code snippets or debugging output

patterns.name: Threads, concurrency, and shared state
patterns.context: Explains that an object is updated during compilation and therefore should not be used concurrently by multiple threads

patterns.name: Sentence-final emoji
patterns.context: A colloquial comment ends with ;-) and nearby text discusses code design and reuse

patterns.name: IRC emoji
patterns.context: Uses the :P emoji after self-deprecation in an IRC conversation

7_2890.concept: more 及局部代码、表情符号模式
7_2890.description: 激活最一致地出现在 more 表示比较、增加或程度的用法中；另有 C++ 头文件/调试符号、并发讨论及两处句末表情符号激活，覆盖各段。

patterns.name: more 的比较级或程度用法
patterns.trigger: 反复触发于 «more»10（第1、4、6、7、8、10段），也出现在 “more straightforward”“more readable”“more serviceable”“more than”“more formal”等短语中
patterns.context: more 修饰形容词、名词或数量表达，表示增加、比较或程度；常处于解释、建议或比较方案的语境
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、技术问答与一般评论

patterns.name: C++ 头文件与标准库符号
patterns.context: C++ 源码或编译器诊断中的头文件、路径及标准库相关符号

patterns.name: 程序代码中的结构性标记
patterns.context: 代码片段或调试输出中的 lambda 表达式、this 指针与十六进制值
patterns.domain: C++ 调试或模板相关输出

patterns.name: 线程并发与共享状态
patterns.trigger: “« control»2« of»2« the»1 same Processor”“« more»10 than»3 one« thread»2« concurrently»1”
patterns.context: 说明对象在编译期间被更新，因此不应被多个线程同时使用
patterns.domain: 技术文档或 StackExchange 答案

patterns.name: 句末表情符号
patterns.context: 口语化评论以 ;-) 收尾，附近在讨论代码设计与复用

patterns.name: 聊天中的 IRC 表情
patterns.context: IRC 对话中在自嘲后使用 :P 表情

en.description: Primarily sensitive to compilation commands and compiler test directives, especially gcc/clang and their flags; also appears in C++ paths and debugging output, and terminal prompts. A few activations fall on differs in chat, so within a sentence, or an emoji, without a unified explanation.

patterns.name: GCC compiler command
patterns.context: Appears in a code example, shell prompt, or command line, followed by compiler options and a filename; activations often fall on an option or command fragment.

patterns.name: Clang test directive
patterns.context: A test execution directive in a code comment, followed by compiler flags; the two command structures are similar.

patterns.name: C++ standard library path
patterns.context: A system header path in compilation errors or debugging output.

patterns.name: Sporadic expressions of “different”
patterns.context: Indicates in natural-language sentences that two parts or objects are not the same; appears in discussions of document differences and an unavailable frontend.

patterns.name: Arrow prompt in code output
patterns.context: Appears in an interactive terminal or code snippet as a prompt or output boundary; segment 5 also includes a gcc invocation.

patterns.name: Colloquial “so”
patterns.context: Expresses degree or inference within a sentence, with no consistent programming context nearby.

patterns.name: Colon-slash emoji in IRC
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a chat sentence as an emoji or tone marker.

patterns.name: C++ lambda and address debugging text
patterns.context: Lambda expressions, object addresses, and member fields are mixed into template- or type-related output.

7_2890.concept: 编译命令与技术文本
7_2890.description: 主要对编译命令及编译器测试指令敏感，尤其是 gcc/clang 及其参数；另见于 C++ 路径与调试输出、终端提示符。少数激活落在聊天中的 differs、句中 so 或表情上，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: GCC 编译器命令
patterns.context: 出现在代码示例、shell 提示符或命令行中，后接编译选项及文件名；激活常落在选项或命令片段上。

patterns.name: Clang 测试指令
patterns.context: 代码注释形式的测试运行指令，后跟编译器参数；两段命令结构近似。

patterns.name: C++ 标准库路径
patterns.context: 出现在编译错误或调试输出中的系统头文件路径。

patterns.name: 零散的“不同”表达
patterns.context: 在自然语言句子中表示两个部分或对象不相同；出现于描述文档差异及前端不可用的对话。

patterns.name: 代码输出中的箭头提示符
patterns.context: 出现在交互式终端或代码片段中，作为提示符或输出边界；段 5 还伴随 gcc 调用。

patterns.name: 口语化的“so”
patterns.context: 在句中表达程度或推论，附近没有稳定的编程语境。

patterns.name: IRC 中的冒号斜杠表情
patterns.context: 出现在聊天句尾，作为表情或语气符号。

patterns.name: C++ lambda 与地址调试文本
patterns.context: 模板或类型相关输出中混有 lambda 表达式、对象地址及成员字段。

en.concept: Structural markers in code and command contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to clang_cc1 RUN commands in compiler test comments and if in code conditionals; other sporadic patterns include frontend-related words and so expressing inference in email.

patterns.name: Clang test execution directive
patterns.context: Appears in comments in C/C++ compiler test files, followed by compiler flags or test options; strongest responses are to command prefixes such as clang_cc1.

patterns.name: if in conditional statements
patterns.context: Appears in code, followed by a conditional expression; includes nil checks and Interpreter state checks.

patterns.name: Frontend-related phrases
patterns.context: Discusses settings, metadata, and the frontend being temporarily unavailable in an IRC conversation.

patterns.name: Language expressing logical inference
patterns.context: An email discusses the inference about the rationale for charging after a price increase; «so» immediately follows a comma at the end of the sentence.

7_2890.concept: 代码与命令语境中的结构标记
7_2890.description: 主要响应编译测试注释中的 clang_cc1 运行命令，也响应代码条件判断中的 if；另有前端相关词和邮件中表示推论的 so 等零散模式。

patterns.name: Clang 测试运行指令
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 编译器测试文件的注释中，后接编译器参数或测试选项；主要强响应于 clang_cc1 这类命令前缀。
patterns.domain: Github 上的编译器测试代码

patterns.name: 条件语句中的 if
patterns.context: 出现在代码中，后接条件表达式；包括 nil 检查及 Interpreter 状态检查。

patterns.name: 前端相关短语
patterns.context: 在 IRC 对话里谈论设置项、元数据及暂时无法查看前端。

patterns.name: 逻辑推论措辞
patterns.context: 邮件中讨论价格上涨后对收费理由的推论；«so» 紧接在句末逗号后。

en.description: Activations are distributed across C/C++ code and compilation/debugging text, and also often occur near line boundaries, delimiters, terminal punctuation, and emoticons in forum comments and IRC messages; English lexical items are scattered, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: C/C++ code and compilation syntax
patterns.context: Code, command-line compiler arguments, debugger output, or code examples in technical discussions; activation often falls on punctuation, keywords, and subwords in compiler options.

patterns.name: Emoticons and terminal punctuation in forum text
patterns.context: Activations occur at emoticons and surrounding punctuation, line breaks, and reply separators at the ends of forum or chat messages.

patterns.name: Forum reply separators and signatures
patterns.context: At the ends of HackerNews comments, signatures, quotations, or comment separators; sometimes appears with emoticons.

patterns.name: Real-time reply contexts in chat
patterns.context: When IRC discusses waiting for answers, response speed, or conversational turns, activation falls on reply-related words and message boundaries.

patterns.name: Local high-frequency words and punctuation in ordinary English
patterns.context: In English forum narration or comments, triggers are scattered across common words, terminal punctuation, and nearby emoticons, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code snippets
patterns.context: Occurs at line boundaries and indentation in multiline code, terminal output, or formatted text; overlaps with code syntax and forum boundary markers.

7_2890.concept: 代码与论坛文本边界
7_2890.description: 激活分布在C/C++代码及编译/调试文本中，也常出现在论坛评论、IRC消息的行边界、分隔符、结尾标点和表情附近；英文词项较零散，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: C/C++代码与编译语法
patterns.context: 代码、命令行编译参数、调试器输出或技术讨论中的代码示例；激活常落在标点、关键字和编译选项的子词上。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的表情与结尾标点
patterns.context: 论坛或聊天消息末尾，表情符号及其前后标点、换行和回复分隔符处激活。

patterns.name: 论坛回复分隔符与署名
patterns.trigger: «~~~»、«------»、«↵»及其附近的用户名或回复尾部
patterns.context: HackerNews评论的结尾、署名、引用或评论分隔处；有时与表情同时出现。

patterns.name: 聊天中的即时回复语境
patterns.context: IRC中讨论等待回答、回复速度或对话轮次时，激活落在回复相关词和消息边界。

patterns.name: 普通英文中的局部高频词与标点
patterns.context: 英文论坛叙述或评论中，触发分散在常见词、句末标点和表情附近，缺少一致的语义条件。

patterns.name: 代码片段中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 多行代码、终端输出或格式化文本的行边界和缩进处出现；与代码语法及论坛边界标记交叠。

en.description: Primarily responds to C/C++ compilers, compilation commands, source code, and build configuration; also involves C#/.NET metadata, as well as a small number of non-programming topics such as startup discussions and language learning.

patterns.name: C/C++ compilation and compiler commands
patterns.context: Includes code compilation, compiler invocations, command-line options, or build targets; also includes discussion of modifying code and recompiling it.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, developer discussions, compiler tests, and build scripts

patterns.name: C/C++ code, types, and diagnostic output
patterns.context: C/C++ syntax fragments, template/lambda types, or standard library paths appear in code and debugging output.
patterns.domain: C++ debugging information, standard library implementations, and source snippets

patterns.name: C# and IL metadata signatures
patterns.context: Documentation presents C# member signatures and corresponding IL constructor information using XML-like tags.

patterns.name: Build configuration and package queries
patterns.context: Makefiles or shell build snippets set parallelism, locate dependency paths, or append compiler flags.

patterns.name: Port test program and terminal commands
patterns.context: A terminal session uses a heredoc to enter a small C program, then invokes gcc to compile it and displays the result.

patterns.name: Funding and market size discussion
patterns.context: A comment asks why a company was sold soon after a funding round and speculates that the team considered the market too small.

patterns.name: Minecraft and the path to learning Java
patterns.context: Discusses first encountering Java through Minecraft, then learning Java semantics or other languages.

7_2890.concept: 编程与软件开发文本
7_2890.description: 主要响应 C/C++ 编译器、编译命令、源码与构建配置；另涉及 C#/.NET 元数据，以及少量编程之外的创业讨论和语言学习话题。

patterns.name: C/C++ 编译与编译器命令
patterns.context: 出现编译代码、编译器调用、命令行选项或构建目标；也包括讨论如何修改代码再编译。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、开发者讨论、编译器测试及构建脚本

patterns.name: C/C++ 代码、类型与诊断输出
patterns.context: C/C++ 语法片段、模板/lambda 类型或标准库路径出现在代码与调试输出中。
patterns.domain: C++ 调试信息、标准库实现与源码片段

patterns.name: C# 与 IL 元数据签名
patterns.context: 文档以 XML 式标签呈现 C# 成员签名及对应 IL 构造函数信息。

patterns.name: 构建配置与软件包查询
patterns.context: Makefile 或 shell 构建片段设置并行度、查找依赖路径、追加编译标志。

patterns.name: 端口测试程序与终端命令
patterns.context: 终端会话中通过 heredoc 输入小型 C 程序，再调用 gcc 编译并显示结果。

patterns.name: 融资与市场规模讨论
patterns.context: 评论询问融资轮之后很快出售的原因，并推测团队认为市场规模不足。

patterns.name: Minecraft 与 Java 学习路径
patterns.context: 讨论先通过 Minecraft 接触 Java，再学习 Java 语义或其他语言。

en.description: Primarily responds to if conditional branches in code, especially checks inside methods in various languages; also appears in Objective-C initialization/singleton idioms, C# methods and event handlers, and a few resource-loading and Win32 message-handling examples.

patterns.name: Objective-C method and memory-management idioms
patterns.context: Objective-C method definitions, initializers, singleton creation/return, and object allocation code; often accompanied by braces and method bodies.

patterns.name: if in conditional branches
patterns.context: An if condition appears in code, often for null, type, callback, or message checks; activation falls on the if token, while surrounding condition contents vary.

patterns.name: Method returns and control-flow endings
patterns.context: Returns an object, button, or callback result from a method body; adjacent to local control flow and method-ending structure.

patterns.name: C# method declarations and event/UI handling
patterns.context: Private/public methods, progress events, button clicks, or Dispose handling in C# classes.

patterns.name: Resource name supplied by a text box
patterns.context: Uses text-box text as an image resource name and immediately follows with a conditional assignment; activation is mainly concentrated on if.

patterns.name: Win32 message preprocessing
patterns.context: Checks Windows message handling for keyboard events in a discussion of keyboard focus issues in embedded controls.

patterns.name: Code formatting and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Newlines, indentation, braces, and preprocessor/region markers in code snippets; activations do not consistently cover these symbols.

7_2890.concept: 代码条件与方法体结构
7_2890.description: 主要响应代码中的 if 条件分支，尤其多种语言方法体内的判断；同时出现在 Objective-C 初始化/单例惯用结构、C# 方法与事件处理，以及少量资源加载和 Win32 消息处理示例中。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法与内存管理惯用结构
patterns.context: Objective-C 方法定义、初始化器、单例创建/返回及对象分配代码；常伴随花括号和方法体。

patterns.name: 条件分支中的 if
patterns.context: 代码中出现 if 条件，常见于空值、类型、回调或消息判断；激活落在 if token 上，周边条件内容并不一致。

patterns.name: 方法返回与控制流收尾
patterns.context: 方法体中返回对象、按钮或回调结果；与局部控制流及方法结束结构相邻。

patterns.name: C# 方法声明与事件/界面处理
patterns.context: C# 类中的私有/公共方法、进度事件、按钮点击或 Dispose 处理。

patterns.name: 资源名由文本框提供
patterns.context: 用文本框文本作为图像资源名，并紧接条件赋值；激活主要集中在 if。

patterns.name: Win32 消息预处理
patterns.context: 嵌入控件键盘焦点问题中，通过检查 Windows 消息处理键盘事件。

patterns.name: 代码格式与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码片段中的换行、缩进、花括号及预处理/区域标记；但激活并非一致覆盖这些符号。

en.description: Primarily activates on if conditions in source code, Objective-C initialization/implementation markers, and Clang test commands; also appears with C++ range-for loops, gcc compilation commands, and image-list examples, making it difficult to reduce to a single feature.

patterns.name: if conditions in Objective-C/Clang
patterns.context: An if is followed by parentheses and a conditional expression in code; strong activations center on the if token and do not require a particular condition.
patterns.domain: Objective-C source and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Compilation options in Clang RUN directives
patterns.context: A compilation command and its options immediately follow RUN in a comment in Clang test code; high activations fall on command arguments or option fragments.
patterns.domain: Compiler test code/source comments on GitHub

patterns.name: Initialization-related markers
patterns.context: A pragma mark in an Objective-C implementation file marks the initializer section.

patterns.name: Objective-C method declarations and initialization calls
patterns.context: Near method signatures or initialization calls in a class implementation; snippet 2 also contains an if condition, while snippets 5 and 7 contain implementation sections.

patterns.name: C++ range-for and standard options
patterns.context: Range-for syntax and g++ compilation flags appear in discussions of equivalent loop forms or compilation standards.

patterns.name: gcc compilation commands and source filenames
patterns.context: Explains how to compile code and gives a gcc command; source filenames and command arguments also activate locally.

patterns.name: Image-list resource example
patterns.context: Selects a resource image using a name from a text box and creates an image list in the example code; activation appears near a code conditional.

patterns.name: Code token fragment, cause unclear
patterns.context: Visible only in a compiler test command; it is unclear whether this responds to the full command pattern or to a specific subtoken.

7_2890.concept: 代码语法与编译上下文
7_2890.description: 主要激活于源码中的 if 条件、Objective-C 初始化/实现标记及 Clang 测试命令；另见 C++ 范围 for、gcc 编译命令和图像列表示例，难归为单一特征。

patterns.name: Objective-C/Clang 中的 if 条件
patterns.context: 代码中出现 if 后接括号及条件表达式；强激活集中在 if token，而不一定要求某种具体条件。
patterns.domain: Objective-C 源码及 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: Clang RUN 指令中的编译选项
patterns.context: Clang 测试代码注释中，紧跟 RUN 的编译命令及选项；高激活落在命令参数或选项片段。
patterns.domain: Github 上的编译器测试/源码注释

patterns.name: 初始化相关标记
patterns.context: Objective-C 实现文件中，以 pragma mark 标出初始化方法区域。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法声明与初始化调用
patterns.context: 类实现中的方法签名或初始化调用附近；片段2同时含 if 条件，片段5、7含实现区段。

patterns.name: C++ 范围 for 与标准选项
patterns.context: 讨论范围 for 的等价写法或编译标准时，出现循环语法及 g++ 编译选项。

patterns.name: gcc 编译命令与源码文件名
patterns.context: 说明如何编译代码，给出 gcc 命令；源码文件名及命令参数也有局部激活。

patterns.name: 图像列表资源示例
patterns.context: 通过文本框中的名称选择资源图像，并在示例代码中创建图像列表；激活出现在代码条件附近。

patterns.name: 代码 token 碎片，成因不明
patterns.context: 仅在编译器测试命令中可见；无法确定是对完整命令模式的响应，还是对特定子 token 的响应。

en.description: Primarily responds to C/C++ compilation and build text, especially compiler options introduced by hyphens and -O optimization levels; also covers macro definitions, Makefiles, Clang test commands, Objective-C methods and initialization code, and adjacent C/C++ code and terminal examples.

patterns.name: Compiler optimization options
patterns.context: Part of GCC/Clang compilation commands, followed by an optimization level; the level varies by example or configuration.
patterns.domain: C/C++ compilation commands, build scripts, container configurations

patterns.name: Option separators in compiler commands
patterns.context: A hyphen introduces compiler arguments on the command line; commonly adjacent to gcc/g++/clang commands and argument values.
patterns.domain: C/C++ command lines and build configurations

patterns.name: Objective-C methods and control-flow markers
patterns.context: Near method declarations or implementations in Objective-C code, method signatures, class implementation markers, and conditional branches.

patterns.name: C++ code and language-standard markers
patterns.context: Discusses or shows C++ range-for loops, forwarding references, compilers, and standard options; code and compilation notes occur together.
patterns.domain: C++ technical discussions and command lines

patterns.name: Ordinary C functions and compilation examples
patterns.context: A short C program snippet followed by a terminal compilation command or program output.

patterns.name: Preprocessor macro-definition options
patterns.context: The -D option in gcc defines a preprocessor macro; one example substitutes character spelling, another enables GNU extensions.

patterns.name: Shell variable assignment and command substitution
patterns.context: A Makefile calls pkg-config through the shell and sets or appends variable values.

patterns.name: Clang container run directives
patterns.context: Test-run instructions given as comments, including the Clang internal compiler, optimization options, input placeholders, and target triple.

patterns.name: Objective-C initialization and object allocation
patterns.context: An Objective-C initializer allocates and initializes an object, or checks the result of self initialization.

patterns.name: Shell prompts and filename fragments
patterns.context: A gcc command runs after a terminal prompt, with a short filename or number present.

7_2890.concept: 编译与构建代码

patterns.name: C/C++ source code and syntax examples

patterns.name: pkg-config and compilation variables in Makefiles

patterns.name: 编译器选项中的 -O

patterns.name: 编译器选项中的 -D

patterns.name: gcc 命令与编译过程
patterns.context: 出现 gcc 编译命令、编译器说明或其参数；激活也落在周边命令文本上
patterns.domain: C/C++ 编译、终端示例、构建文档

patterns.name: C/C++ 源码与语法示例

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments such as proper-name segmentation, NB identifiers, months, humid, numbers, and common function words. They span domains and vary widely by context; some patterns occur only once or twice.

patterns.name: Split fragments and case boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Fragments occur in proper names, organization names, identifiers, or comments; common cases include splits within words, case boundaries, or punctuated abbreviations.

patterns.name: Month or duration unit months
patterns.context: The noun months appears in phrases about durations or elapsed time; once in parentheses and once in a news headline.

patterns.name: humid and related word forms
patterns.context: When describing cultivation environments or climate, humid appears as an adjective or as the stem of humidified.

patterns.name: Numbers, years, identifiers, or statistics
patterns.context: Numbers occur within years, sample sizes, durations, or numeric constants in code; activation positions vary.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Prepositions, articles, and common phrase components in general prose or technical explanations; trigger words are scattered, with no stable collocations observed.

patterns.name: NB identifiers and component class names in code
patterns.context: NB occurs in CSS class names or platform constants in Angular/UI code, near mixed hyphens, underscores, and capitalization.

patterns.name: Named astronomical event titles
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entry titles consist of a year followed by an event name; activation concentrates on the year fragment and Great.

patterns.name: Equals signs and line continuation in option descriptions
patterns.context: Option definitions in email wrap across lines due to formatting, with equals signs adjacent to numbers and continuation text.

patterns.name: NB in cryptography code comments
patterns.context: NB is used as a cue in code comments introducing an explanation of the initialization vector.

7_2896.description: 激活分散在专名切分、NB 标识符、months、humid、数字及普通功能词等局部片段；跨领域且上下文差异大，部分模式仅见一两次。

patterns.name: 专名中的切分片段与大小写边界
patterns.context: 片段落在专名、机构名、标识符或注释中；常见于词内部切分、大小写边界或带标点的缩写。

patterns.name: 月份或时长单位 months
patterns.context: 月份名词出现在时间长度或经过时间的短语中；一次在括号内，一次在新闻标题中。

patterns.name: humid 及其词形延续
patterns.context: 描述培养环境或气候时，humid 作为形容词或 humidified 的词干出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、地理气候条目

patterns.name: 数值与年份、编号或统计量
patterns.context: 数字嵌在年份、样本数、时间长度或代码中的数值常量里；激活位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、邮件、新闻

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 普通散文或专业说明中的介词、冠词及常见短语成分；触发词分散，未见稳定固定搭配。

patterns.name: 代码中的 NB 标识符及组件类名
patterns.context: NB 出现在 Angular/界面代码的 CSS 类名或平台常量中，附近有连字符、下划线和大小写混排。

patterns.name: 有名天文事件标题
patterns.context: 百科条目标题以年份加事件名称构成；激活集中在年份片段及 Great。

patterns.name: 期权说明中的等号和行续接
patterns.context: 邮件中期权定义因格式换行，等号与数字、续行文字相邻。

patterns.name: 密码学代码注释中的 NB
patterns.context: NB 作为代码注释中的提示语，引出初始化向量说明。

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and formatting patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and NB subwords in code, the humid root, month or duration expressions, and sporadically punctuation, title numbers, quotations, and fragmented technical terms; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: NB substring in a proper name or word
patterns.context: Local tokens in proper names or identifiers are highlighted. In code, NB often appears in className, macro names, or comments; in Wikipedia passages, it appears in personal and institutional names.

patterns.name: humid word forms
patterns.context: The humid root is triggered in climate descriptions or experimental culture conditions.

patterns.name: Month or duration expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to durations or follow-up time points; month-related words and numbers are highlighted, but not all time expressions trigger activation.

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundaries in structured code
patterns.context: Parentheses, commas, semicolons, and adjacent identifiers are activated in code or API snippets; activation locations are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Title with a year number
patterns.context: A year number appears next to an event name in an encyclopedic title; this occurs only in this passage, and the trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Opening of a news quotation
patterns.context: A title or quotation begins with a phrase in quotation marks, followed by a news-style statement; it is unclear whether the trigger is the quotation marks, a negation, or a fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Local highlighting of terms and text fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of medical terms, formatting or encoding artifacts in emails, and subwords in names, without a shared, clear semantic condition.

7_2896.concept: 异质词片段与格式模式
7_2896.description: 激活分散于专名及代码中的 NB/子词、humid 词根、月份或月数表达，并零星出现在标点、标题数字、引语和术语分词片段；未见单一稳定语义触发器。

patterns.name: 专名或词中 NB 子串
patterns.context: 专名或标识符中的局部 token 被突出；代码中 NB 常出现在 className、宏名或注释里，维基百科段落中则出现在人名与机构名中。

patterns.name: humid 词形
patterns.context: 触发词根 humid，出现在气候描述或实验培养条件中。

patterns.name: 月份或月数表达
patterns.context: 与时间长度或随访时点相邻；月份相关词和数字突出，但并非所有时间表达都触发。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、金融邮件、新闻

patterns.name: 结构化代码中的标点与边界
patterns.context: 代码或 API 片段中，括号、逗号、分号及相邻标识符受到激活；激活位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数字年份标题
patterns.context: 百科标题中年份数字紧邻事件名称；只见于此段，触发原因不确定。

patterns.name: 新闻引语开头
patterns.context: 标题或引语以引号包围短语开头，后接新闻标题式陈述；是否由引号、否定词或固定短语触发不明。

patterns.name: 术语及文本片段局部突出
patterns.context: 激活落在医学术语的分词片段、邮件中的排版/编码痕迹，以及姓名的子词上，缺乏共同的明确语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragmented spellings of proper names, the code class NB, years, and legal citation numbers; sample counts in medical abstracts also activate. The main commonality may be numbers or short, segmented tokens, but the passage contexts differ considerably.

patterns.name: Tokenization in the name Imam Sadiq
patterns.context: Character fragments combine to form the proper name Imam Sadiq University, which appears at the beginning of the entry; after a line break, “The Im” also appears.

patterns.name: NB class names and form code
patterns.context: className strings in JavaScript/HTML-style code; add-folder form-related attributes also appear.

patterns.name: Segmented representation of year numbers
patterns.context: Years are typically 19xx and immediately precede historical events, sports seasons, elections, or biographical entry titles; some numbers are split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers
patterns.context: A legal citation consisting of a volume number, federal reporter name, and page number, followed by a line break and a text fragment.

patterns.name: Postoperative month numbers
patterns.context: An animal study abstract describes sample counts, surgery, and postoperative follow-up times; the activation marker itself falls on the sample count.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于专名的碎片化拼写、代码类名 NB、年份及法律引文数字；另有医学摘要中的样本数。主要共同点可能是数字或被切分的短 token，但各段语境差异明显。

patterns.name: Imam Sadiq 名称中的分词
patterns.context: 字符片段拼成专名 Imam Sadiq University，且名称位于条目开头；换行后还有“The Im”。

patterns.name: NB 类名与表单代码
patterns.context: JavaScript/HTML 风格代码中的 className 字符串；同时可见 add-folder 表单相关属性。

patterns.name: 年份数字的分段表示
patterns.context: 年份通常为 19xx，紧接历史事件、体育赛季、选举或人物条目标题；部分数字由多个 token 拆分。

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 卷号、联邦判例汇编名称及页码构成的法律引用，后接换行和正文残片。

patterns.name: 术后月份数字
patterns.trigger: « 12»，出现在“in 12 dogs”中；同段另有“Four months”
patterns.context: 动物实验摘要描述样本数、手术及术后随访时间；激活标记本身落在样本数量上。

en.description: Primarily responds to year or date fields beginning with «19», covering multiple types of encyclopedia titles and one legal citation; there are also isolated activations in the segmented proper name Imam Sadiq University and at a period in a sentence about the European single market.

patterns.name: Years or dates beginning with 19
patterns.context: Trigger point is the year prefix represented by token «19»; following digits often form years or dates such as 1906, 1907, 1913, 1922, 1915, and 1927. These often occur in titles, entry openings, or date fields.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles and legal citations

patterns.name: Segmented spelling of Adiaq
patterns.context: Activates in subword fragments of the proper name Imām Ṣādiq University; character boundaries do not align with ordinary word boundaries. Occurs alongside a blank line after the title and the beginning of the body text.

patterns.name: Single Market phrase
patterns.context: Activation falls on a period token, immediately followed by text about the European single market and parentheses; distinct from the date-prefix pattern.

7_2896.concept: 以19开头的日期字段为主
7_2896.description: 主要对以 «19» 开头的年份或日期字段起反应，涵盖多类百科标题及一处法律引文；另有伊玛目萨迪克大学专名分词和欧洲单一市场句点处的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 以 19 开头的年份或日期
patterns.context: 触发点是以 token «19» 表示的年份前缀，后续数字常组成 1906、1907、1913、1922、1915、1927 等年份或日期；常出现在标题、条目开头或日期字段。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题及法律引文

patterns.name: Adiaq 的分词拼写
patterns.context: 在专名 Imām Ṣādiq University 的词片段中激活，字符边界与常规词界不一致；伴随标题后的空行和正文开头。

patterns.name: 单一市场短语
patterns.context: 激活落在句点 token，且该处紧接欧洲单一市场相关表述与括号；与日期前缀模式不同。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to years or number strings beginning with 19, commonly found in encyclopedic titles; also activates on SVG letter strings, fragments of legal numbers, and parentheses or line-break punctuation. The latter patterns are not clearly related to the year pattern.

patterns.name: Years beginning with 19
patterns.context: A year beginning with 19 appears at the start of a passage. Activation is concentrated on “19,” though subsequent year digits may also activate; these often occur in entry titles or date expressions

patterns.name: 19 in legal numbers
patterns.context: The beginning of a number string or citation in legal text

patterns.name: Letter sequence in the abbreviation SVG
patterns.context: The letters SVG activate strongly when SVG-based technology or a library is mentioned; the other contexts do not show the same year structure

patterns.name: Punctuation near parentheses and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks after parentheses, as well as line breaks at the ends of some titles or entries, also activate; the trigger is weak and may differ from the other patterns
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text and Wikipedia entry formatting

7_2896.description: 主要对以19开头的年份/数字串敏感，常见于百科标题；另对SVG字母串、法律编号片段及括号或换行标点有激活，后几类与年份模式的关系不明确。

patterns.name: 年份以19开头
patterns.context: 段首出现以19开头的年份，激活集中在“19”上，后续年份数字也可能激活；常位于条目标题或日期表达中

patterns.name: 法律编号中的19
patterns.context: 法律文本中编号或引文式数字串的开头

patterns.name: SVG 缩写中的字母序列
patterns.context: 提及基于 SVG 的技术或库时，SVG 字母被显著激活；其余上下文不显示相同的年份结构

patterns.name: 括号与换行附近的标点
