patterns.name: Specific symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols occur in formulas, variable operations, or function definitions; only individual symbols are marked, with no stable common mathematical meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Dates and historical event narratives
patterns.context: News reports or historical events are linked by years and event order.

patterns.name: Motivational vision language
patterns.context: A quotation forms an inspiring declaration using vision, potential, and a call to action.

patterns.name: Chemical process terminology
patterns.context: Explains how colloidal particles in water are neutralized and kept dispersed, followed by a figure reference.

patterns.name: Oxidative damage repair description
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of oxidative damage to HSA and oxidized molecules repaired by quercetin.

patterns.name: Wave functions and half-shell terminology
patterns.context: Discusses potential functions and wave-function properties at support points in the EST scheme.

patterns.name: Answer markers in math problems
patterns.context: Develops an argument about functions over an algebra or ring through setup, definitions, and comments.

patterns.name: Anomalous or hard-to-classify fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall on terms or ordinary prose in their respective passages; the samples alone do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, medical abstracts, and grant texts

7_2896.concept: 英语常见局部搭配与异质文本特征
7_2896.description: 激活模式分散：最明显的重复线索是 well（know、studied、over、well-defined），另有普通英语功能词；其余分别落在代码构造、数学符号、历史叙述、愿景引文及科学术语中，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: well 的局部搭配
patterns.context: 在英语文本中，well 作程度副词，修饰 know/studied/over，或与连字符词 defined 构成 well-defined；触发位置多在短语内部。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、资助摘要、数学问答

patterns.name: well 后接词的英语语法上下文
patterns.context: 激活散布于普通英语短语中，常处于助动词、系动词或从句连接词之后；但这些词在多段中只是普通上下文，未见一致的特定句法结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与技术文本

patterns.name: 代码中的对象构造
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中通过 Object.create 构造原型，并处于子类原型赋值语句内。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定符号
patterns.context: 符号出现在公式、变量运算或函数定义中；仅个别符号被标记，未显示稳定的共同数学语义。
patterns.domain: 数学解答与形式化论文

patterns.name: 日期与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 以年份和事件顺序串联新闻报道或历史事件。
patterns.domain: 百科全书传记/历史叙述

patterns.name: 励志愿景措辞
patterns.context: 引用中以愿景、潜能和行动号召构成鼓舞性宣言。

patterns.name: 化学过程术语
patterns.context: 解释水中胶体颗粒如何被中和并保持分散，后接图示引用。

patterns.name: 氧化损伤修复表述
patterns.context: 报告槲皮素对 HSA 氧化损伤及氧化分子的修复比例。

patterns.name: 波函数与半壳术语
patterns.context: 在 EST 方案的支持点处讨论势函数及波函数性质。

patterns.name: 数学题中的答案标记
patterns.context: 以设定、定义和注释推进代数或环上的函数论证。

patterns.name: 异常或难以归类的碎片
patterns.context: 这些激活落在各自段落的术语或普通叙述中，无法仅凭样本确定共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学、医学摘要与资助文本

en.description: Activations span ordinary words, collocations, code assignments, mathematical terminology, and semantically related words across multiple domains; there is neither a stable single trigger word nor a unified style.

patterns.name: Fixed collocations or adjacent function words
patterns.context: Activations occur at different positions in common words and collocations, with no consistent word form or fixed syntactic trigger; these examples alone do not establish a specific condition.
patterns.domain: Patents, philosophy, advocacy writing, biomedicine, encyclopedias, and literary prose

patterns.name: Variables and assignment structures in code
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript code, especially near variable assignments or loop initialization; activations fall on multiple tokens, including variables and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Hacker News and StackExchange code snippets

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and representation-theory terminology
patterns.context: Symbols appear alongside discussion of representations, operators, and groups in mathematical papers; no single term is a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Political-topic word context
patterns.context: Commentary prose mentions the author occasionally turning to political subjects; activations are distributed across several ordinary words.

patterns.name: Proper names and historical event narratives
patterns.context: Historical events, place names, and proper names in local newspaper reports or encyclopedic narratives; activations cover multiple adjacent proper names and ordinary words.

patterns.name: Secrecy and silence semantics
patterns.context: Narratives about keeping secrets, concealing experiences, and remaining silent; some words are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Colloid coagulation process
patterns.context: Explains how colloidal particles cease to remain separated through neutralization; the target words occur throughout a scientific process description.

patterns.name: Vision and potential expressions
patterns.context: An inspirational statement urging people to realize humanity’s spiritual potential.

patterns.name: Philosophical explanation and theoretical connections
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between facts and theories, and how datasets are interpreted.

patterns.name: Maintaining membrane fluidity in biomedicine
patterns.context: Maintains constant membrane fluidity through insertion of molecules, in a list of experimental optimization methods.

7_2896.description: 激活分布于多领域的普通词、搭配、代码赋值、数学术语及语义相关词；既无稳定单一触发词，也无统一文体。

patterns.name: 固定搭配或功能词邻接
patterns.trigger: [1] «that»« keep»；[2] «The»« time»« has»；[3] «know»« well»；[7] «keep»« the»；[9] «before»« the»；[10] «our»
patterns.context: 激活分散在常见词及搭配中的不同位置，未见一致的词形或固定句法触发条件；只凭这些例子无法确定具体条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、哲学、倡议文字、生物医学、百科及文学散文

patterns.name: 代码中的变量与赋值结构
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 代码中，尤其是变量赋值或循环初始化附近；激活落在变量和标点等多个 token 上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 与 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: 数学符号与表示论术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中，符号表达与关于表示、算子及群的论述相邻；未显示单一术语稳定触发。

patterns.name: 政治主题词语境
patterns.context: 评论散文提及作者不时转向政治题材；激活分布在若干普通词上。

patterns.name: 专名与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 地方报纸报道或百科叙述中的历史事件、地名和专名；激活覆盖多个相邻专名及普通词。

patterns.name: 保密与沉默语义
patterns.context: 叙述应当保守秘密、隐瞒经历并保持沉默；部分词被拆分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 胶体凝聚过程
patterns.context: 解释胶体颗粒因中和作用而不再保持分离；目标词散布于科学过程说明中。

patterns.name: 愿景与潜能表达
patterns.context: 号召人们实现人类精神潜能的励志陈述。

patterns.name: 哲学解释与理论联系
patterns.context: 讨论事实与理论的联系，以及数据集如何得到解释。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的维持膜流动性
patterns.context: 通过膜插入分子维持恒定膜流动性，处于实验优化方法的列举中。

en.description: Activations occur across varied texts, often on copulas, auxiliaries, and assignment code. Other activations involve relations of maintaining/adopting/possessing, expressions of necessity, variable positions, academic structural descriptions, and a few isolated word fragments. There is no stable unified theme across these contexts.

patterns.name: Copulas and following structures
patterns.context: In code, quotations, technical explanations, and prose, copulas or auxiliaries occur in subject-predicate structures, definitions, state descriptions, or existential sentences; they often connect to a complement or action.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: code, popular science, religion, social science, and academic text

patterns.name: Assignment and variables in programming
patterns.context: JavaScript code declares variables, assigns values, or retrieves object properties; whitespace indentation also shows weak activation.

patterns.name: Relations of keeping, maintaining, or bearing
patterns.context: Semantically describes something maintaining a state, adopting a form, granting an expression, or possessing a qualification; trigger words are scattered across different syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Scientific explanations, network models, quotations, and religious texts

patterns.name: Expressions of time or necessity
patterns.context: Uses has/have constructions to express completion or necessity, indicating that the time has come or something must be addressed.

patterns.name: Equation, distance, and position calculations
patterns.context: Code assigns numeric values or query results to variables, especially geographic distances and web element positions.

patterns.name: Symmetry or structural relations in physics and mathematics
patterns.context: Academic papers describe band symmetry, network construction, or their forms; the highly activated words are not a single unified set of terms.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics and network theory papers

patterns.name: Possessive own / inherent property
patterns.context: A historical town is described as having its own order, with own adjacent to the property it refers to.

patterns.name: Ticket or admission eligibility expression
patterns.context: Religious polemic uses “a ticket into heaven” as a metaphor to describe the state of believing oneself to be saved.

patterns.name: Within-word substrings and technical terms
patterns.context: A few high activations fall on word fragments spanning tokens or on specific terms; this does not support inferring a unified semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Colloid chemistry, physics, and urban theory

7_2896.description: 激活分布于多种文本，常见于系词、助动词及赋值代码；另对维持/采取/拥有关系、必要性表达、变量位置、学术结构描述和少数孤立词片段有激活。各处缺少稳定统一的主题。

patterns.name: 系词及其后续结构
patterns.context: 在代码、引文、技术说明和散文中，系词或助动词出现在主谓结构、定义、状态描述或存在句里；常与后续补语或动作相连。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码、科普、宗教、社会与学术文本

patterns.name: 编程中的赋值与变量
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中声明变量、赋值或取得对象属性；空格缩进也有弱激活。

patterns.name: 保持、维持或承载关系
patterns.context: 语义上描述某物维持状态、采取某种形式、赋予表达或拥有某种资格；触发词分散在不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 科学说明、网络模型、引文及宗教文本

patterns.name: 时间或必要性表达
patterns.trigger: « has»10« come»、« has»7« to»10« be»8« done»
patterns.context: 以 has/have 构成完成或必要结构，表达时机已到或事情必须处理。

patterns.name: 方程、距离与位置计算
patterns.context: 代码里将数值或查询结果赋给变量，尤其是地理距离及网页元素位置。

patterns.name: 物理与数学中的对称性或结构关系
patterns.context: 学术论文中描述能带对称性、网络构造或其形式；高激活词并非统一术语。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理与网络理论论文

patterns.name: own 所有格／自身属性
patterns.context: 历史城镇被描述为具有自身的秩序，own 与其所指属性紧邻。

patterns.name: 票券或入场资格表达
patterns.context: 宗教论辩中用“有进入天堂的票”作比喻，描述自认已获救的状态。

patterns.name: 词内子串与技术术语
patterns.context: 少数高激活落在跨 token 词语片段或特定术语中；不能据此归纳成统一语义模式。
patterns.domain: 胶体化学、物理与城市理论

en.description: Activations span function words and possessives, necessity constructions, abstract concept words, and technical terms from multiple fields; they also appear in contexts involving secrecy, social vision, waste treatment, and urban order. No single stable topic or trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Function words, possessives, or pronouns
patterns.context: High-frequency function-word positions expressing possession, reference, modality, or necessity; their local contexts are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, advocacy writing, environmental topics

patterns.name: Abstract nouns and qualifying constructions
patterns.context: When discussing abstract objects such as facts, theories, reality, order, or potential; specific vocabulary and syntax vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, social theory, advocacy writing, mathematics

patterns.name: Highly activated fragments in technical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in terminology, mathematical objects, and their descriptions in physics, mathematics, or patent technology texts; there is no shared technical word or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Secrecy and silence semantics
patterns.context: Describes keeping something from others or being entrusted with an experience; activations are scattered across multiple words in the passage.

patterns.name: Advocacy vision and exhortation
patterns.context: Uses collective vision and inspirational language to invoke human spiritual potential and call for action.

patterns.name: Choice and necessity in waste treatment
patterns.context: After asking which option is supported, emphasizes that waste must be treated.

patterns.name: Change and internal order in historic towns
patterns.context: Discusses how towns cannot isolate themselves from new economic, social, and aesthetic processes, yet retain an order of their own.

7_2896.description: 激活分布于功能词及所有格、必要性结构、抽象概念词和多领域技术术语，也见于保密、社会愿景、废弃物处理和城镇秩序等语境；未显示单一稳定的主题或触发词。

patterns.name: 功能词与所有格或指代词
patterns.trigger: “our” (1 中的 “our”=10；3 中的 “Our”=3，“our”=3)；“has to be” (2 中 “has”=6、“to”=10、“be”=9；3 中 “has”=10)；“their” (6 中 “their”=9)
patterns.context: 在句中表示所属、指代或情态/必要性的高频功能词位置；这些词的局部上下文并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、倡议文字、环境议题

patterns.name: 抽象名词及限定结构
patterns.trigger: “the” (5 中“the facts”=4、“the theory”=3；4 中“the”=9)；“reality” (7 中=5)；“order” (6 中=3)；“potential” (3 中)
patterns.context: 谈论事实、理论、现实、秩序或潜能等抽象对象时；各例中的具体词汇与句法不同。
patterns.domain: 哲学、社会理论、倡议文字、数学

patterns.name: 技术术语中的高激活片段
patterns.context: 出现在物理、数学或专利技术文本的术语、数学对象及其描述中；没有一个共同的技术词或固定搭配。

patterns.name: 保密与沉默语义
patterns.context: 描述应对他人保密、受托保守的经历；激活分散在该段多个词上。

patterns.name: 倡议式愿景与号召
patterns.trigger: “Our vision”及“gives expression to the highest potential” (3)；“The time has come” (3)
patterns.context: 以集体愿景和鼓舞性语言提出人类精神潜能及行动号召。

patterns.name: 废弃物处理的选择与必要性
patterns.trigger: “has to be done with the waste” (2)
patterns.context: 在询问支持哪种方案后，强调废弃物必须得到处理。
patterns.domain: 环境议题、问答式网页文字

patterns.name: 历史城镇的变化与自身秩序
patterns.context: 论述城镇无法隔绝新经济、社会和审美过程，但仍有自身秩序。

en.description: Activations are distributed across English auxiliary verbs and sporadic words, JavaScript DOM APIs and assignment syntax, as well as mathematical symbols, photonics abbreviations, and place-name subwords; there is no single stable semantic or lexical pattern.

patterns.name: has come / has to
patterns.context: In English, auxiliary has/have is followed by a participle, noun phrase, or infinitive, often in sentences expressing change, necessity, or possession; activation occurs on the auxiliary and nearby words.
patterns.domain: English prose, philosophical argument, public issues, and persuasive writing

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM method name
patterns.context: JavaScript code contains document.getElementsByTagName; activation is concentrated on the DOM API method name, split across multiple tokens, and nearby code.

patterns.name: JavaScript assignment operator
patterns.context: In a variable declaration, the identifier is is immediately followed by the assignment symbol =; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: Z in mathematical text
patterns.context: A symbol for the set of integers in a mathematical paper’s LaTeX formula, near mathematical discussion of amenability, limit points, and related topics.

patterns.name: TR symmetry in topological photonics
patterns.context: TR appears in a photonics paper describing symmetries of a crystal system; activation is strongly concentrated on this abbreviation.

patterns.name: Place name Suffolk
patterns.context: An English geographical entry describes the Suffolk region and village boundaries; activation falls on subword fragments of the place name.

patterns.name: Sporadic English content words
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different English sentence and semantic context and cannot be explained by a shared local trigger.
patterns.domain: Inspirational writing, philosophical argument, literary prose

7_2896.description: 激活分散于英语助动词与零散词、JavaScript DOM API/赋值语法，以及数学符号、光子学缩写和地名子词；没有单一稳定的语义或词法模式。

patterns.name: has come / has to
patterns.trigger: “has”10 in “The time has come” [1]；“has”10 in “something has changed” [2]；“has”9、“to”10 in “Something has to be done” [3]；“have”10 in “We all have our share” [5]
patterns.context: 英语中助动词 has/have 后接分词、名词短语或不定式，常处于表达变化、必要性、拥有的句子中；激活落在助动词及其附近词上。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、哲学论述、公共议题及劝说文字

patterns.name: JavaScript DOM 方法名
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中出现 document.getElementsByTagName，激活集中在被拆分成多个 token 的 DOM API 方法名及其邻近代码。

patterns.name: JavaScript 赋值运算符
patterns.context: 变量声明中标识符 is 后紧接赋值符号 =；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 Z
patterns.context: 数学论文 LaTeX 公式中表示整数集合的符号，附近为 amenability、limit points 等数学论述。

patterns.name: 拓扑光子学 TR 对称性
patterns.context: 光子学论文描述晶体系统的对称性时出现 TR，激活显著集中于该缩写。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/光子学论文

patterns.name: 地名 Suffolk
patterns.context: 英文地理条目介绍英格兰萨福克地区及村镇边界，激活落在地名的拆分子词上。

patterns.name: 零散英语内容词
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同英语句子与语义环境中，无法由共同的局部触发条件解释。
patterns.domain: 励志文字、哲学论述、文学散文

en.description: The clearest repeated pattern is mathematical operators having a discrete spectrum (2, 7); other activations are scattered across possessives, necessity expressions, physical symmetries, code assignments, urban processes, and mathematical subscripts, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Possessives and possession
patterns.context: Possessives or possessive relations refer to things owned, experienced, or possessed by a person, group, or object; sometimes preceded by have, sometimes appearing before a noun
patterns.domain: Literature, commentary, editorials, and technical texts

patterns.name: Existence, obligation, and necessity expressions
patterns.context: Describes something that must happen, needs to be addressed, or is continuing; activation is concentrated on auxiliary or modal constructions and nearby words

patterns.name: Discrete spectra and mathematical operator terminology
patterns.context: An operator is called self-adjoint and has a discrete spectrum; this mathematical collocation is nearly repeated in [2] and [7]
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, functional analysis or spectral theory

patterns.name: TR symmetry abbreviation
patterns.context: Discusses symmetry conditions satisfied by band structures

patterns.name: Equals sign in code
patterns.context: The assignment operator in the JavaScript statement `var is = require(...)`

patterns.name: Penetration and involvement in new processes
patterns.context: Discusses how historic towns cannot isolate themselves and are entered or influenced by new processes

patterns.name: Subscript numbers within a proper name
patterns.context: Mathematical notation in a definition of modular forms, with subscript 44

patterns.name: Sporadic activation of general grammatical words
patterns.context: The highlighted words have no specific collocation or semantic condition in their sentences that can be jointly confirmed by the other passages

7_2896.description: 最清楚的重复模式是数学算子具有离散谱（2、7）；其余激活分散在所有格、必要性表达、物理对称性、代码赋值、城镇过程及数学下标等局部特征，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 所有格与占有关系
patterns.context: 所有格或所有关系用来指向某人、某群体或某对象所拥有、经历或具有的事物；有时前接 have，有时出现在名词前
patterns.domain: 文学、评论、社论及技术文本

patterns.name: 存在、义务与必要性表达
patterns.context: 描述某事必须发生、需要处理，或仍在持续；激活集中在助动/情态结构及其邻近词上
patterns.domain: 公共议题与评论性文本

patterns.name: 离散谱及数学算子术语
patterns.context: 算子被称为 self-adjoint，且具有 discrete spectrum；[2]、[7] 中这一数学搭配近乎重复
patterns.domain: 数学论文，泛函分析或谱理论

patterns.name: TR 对称性缩写
patterns.context: 讨论能带结构所满足的对称性条件
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理／拓扑材料论文

patterns.name: 代码中的等号
patterns.context: JavaScript 语句 `var is = require(...)` 中的赋值符号

patterns.name: 穿透与介入新过程
patterns.context: 谈历史城镇无法隔绝，会被新的过程进入或影响

patterns.name: 专名内部的下标数字
patterns.context: 模形式定义中的数学记号，下标为 44

patterns.name: 一般性语法词的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些高亮词在各自句中没有可由其余段共同确认的特定搭配或语义条件

en.concept: Local word forms and syntactic fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across English possessives and be constructions, the penetr- root, and code, mathematical physics terminology, and occasional fixed expressions. No single cross-domain semantic theme is apparent; the pattern more likely reflects a mixture of local word-form and grammatical triggers.

patterns.name: our / their possessive constructions
patterns.context: In English narration or argument, a possessive determiner is followed by a noun, especially in “our share” and “their own order”; have may also occur.

patterns.name: Syntactic constructions with be and following constituents
patterns.context: Activation falls on the verb be and nearby constituents in copular, passive, or modal/obligation constructions; the specific collocations vary.
patterns.domain: General English prose, argument, and online text

patterns.name: penetrate / penetrable word forms
patterns.context: The same root appears in “impenetrable silence” and in a description of a town being penetrated by a new process; the first passage has the tokenized form impenetrable, the second penetrated.
patterns.domain: Literary prose, urban and social theory

patterns.name: JavaScript properties and DOM method chains
patterns.context: Code calls a DOM query method via document, with assignment and chained property/method access.

patterns.name: JavaScript require import
patterns.context: After a strict-mode declaration, var is assigned a call to require to import a module.

patterns.name: Simplify instruction in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: An instruction to simplify follows a complex power and rational-exponent expression; activation also falls on formula symbols.

patterns.name: Discrete spectrum statement in spectral theory
patterns.context: After defining an unbounded positive self-adjoint operator, the text states that it has discrete spectrum.

patterns.name: Bohr radius in atomic physics
patterns.context: Discusses mechanical signals generated by the fine-structure constant or modulation of electron mass, and mentions the Bohr radius.

patterns.name: Half-line compound
patterns.context: Paired with line to describe the space on which a Dirac operator acts under a symmetry condition.

patterns.name: Emphasis on the need to act
patterns.context: When discussing nuclear-waste disposal options, has to be done expresses that action is necessary.

patterns.name: Ongoing disarray expressed by keep slipping aside
patterns.context: A first-person, social-media-style exclamation describes important matters continually being sidelined; social-emotional words such as leaders, trust, and hate also appear.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于英语所有格与be结构、penetr-词根，以及代码、数学物理术语和个别固定表达；未见单一跨领域语义主题，较像混合的局部词形与语法触发。

patterns.name: our / their 所属结构
patterns.context: 在英语叙述或论述中，所有格限定词后接名词，尤其是“our share”“their own order”；可能伴随 have。

patterns.name: be 与后续成分的句法结构
patterns.context: 激活落在 be 动词及其邻近成分，出现在系表、被动或情态/义务结构中；具体搭配并不一致。
patterns.domain: 一般英语散文、论述及网络文本

patterns.name: penetrate / penetrable 词形
patterns.context: 同一词根在“不可穿透的沉默”与“城镇被新进程渗透”中出现；首段是分词切分的 impenetrable，第二段为 penetrated。
patterns.domain: 文学散文、城市与社会理论

patterns.name: JavaScript 属性与 DOM 方法链
patterns.context: 代码中以 document 调用 DOM 查询方法，出现赋值和链式属性/方法访问。

patterns.name: JavaScript require 导入
patterns.context: 严格模式声明之后，以 var 赋值调用 require 导入模块。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 Simplify 指令
patterns.context: 复杂幂与有理指数表达式后出现要求化简的指令，激活也落在公式符号上。

patterns.name: 谱论中的离散谱表述
patterns.context: 定义无界正自伴算子后，说明其具有离散谱。
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 原子物理中的玻尔半径
patterns.context: 讨论精细结构常数或电子质量调制所产生的机械信号，并提及玻尔半径。
patterns.domain: 理论物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: half-line 复合词
patterns.context: 与 line 并列，描述对称条件下 Dirac 算子所在的空间。
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 强调必须采取行动
patterns.context: 谈论核废料处理选项时，以 has to be done 表达必须采取行动。

patterns.name: keep slipping aside 的持续失序表达
patterns.context: 第一人称社交媒体式感叹中，描述重要事务持续被搁置；同时出现 leaders、trust、hate 等社会情绪词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the English possessives our/their, the, equals signs in code assignments, mathematical multiplication, division, and exponentiation symbols, and colons in formal definitions; some inter-line breaks also activate weakly. No single semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Possessive pronoun “our”
patterns.context: The pronoun our is followed by a noun, often in narrative or argumentative sentences; activation is concentrated on our and nearby words.

patterns.name: Possessive pronoun “their”
patterns.context: their is followed by a noun, and the sentence emphasizes a feature belonging to a group or thing; activation also extends to nearby words.

patterns.name: Assignment symbol in code
patterns.context: An equals sign connects a variable and an expression in a JavaScript assignment statement.

patterns.name: Multiplication, division, and exponentiation symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in algebraic expressions composed of variables, exponents, and parentheses; most are simplification problems.

patterns.name: Colon in LaTeX mathematics
patterns.context: A colon appears in a formal operator definition in LaTeX, followed by a set or mapping expression.

patterns.name: English definite article “the”
patterns.context: An ordinary definite article before a noun, appearing in noun phrases about history, law, and other subjects.

patterns.name: Newline token
patterns.context: A newline marker appears between lines in code or mathematical text; activation is weak and may reflect a formatting-boundary effect.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于英语所有格 our/their、the、代码赋值等号、数学乘除幂符号及形式化定义冒号；部分行间换行也弱激活。未见单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 所有格代词“our”
patterns.context: 代词 our 后接名词，常出现在叙述或论说句中；激活集中在 our 及邻近词。

patterns.name: 所有格代词“their”
patterns.context: their 后接名词，句中强调某群体或事物所拥有的特征；激活也延伸至邻近词。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值符号
patterns.context: JavaScript 变量赋值语句中，等号连接变量与表达式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的乘除与幂运算符号
patterns.context: 符号嵌在变量、指数及括号构成的代数式中；多为化简题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号出现在 LaTeX 形式化算子定义中，后接集合或映射表达式。

patterns.name: 英文定冠词“the”
patterns.context: 名词前的普通定冠词，出现在历史、法律等名词短语中。

patterns.name: 换行 token
patterns.context: 换行标记出现在代码或数学文本的行间；激活很弱，可能是格式边界效应。

en.concept: Mixed response to mathematical symbols and English function words
en.description: Strong activations mainly occur in two types of material: algebra-simplification problems with variables, exponents, and multiplication/division parentheses; and common function words in English prose. There is also local activation in a seasonal reversal metaphor and a “their own order” discussion context, but its relation to the main patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Variable markers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in formal power-expression simplification problems, especially where variables recur with exponents, followed by “assuming … is positive” or “↵…**(…)↵Simplify”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; exercises and symbolic algebra

patterns.name: Relational or function words in English narration
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous English prose, embedded in narrative or argumentative syntax; no clear condition involving mathematical symbols or a specific fixed phrase

patterns.name: Winter-summer seasonal reversal
patterns.context: Describes warm, bright weather and uses winter-summer reversal as a metaphor; these words cluster in this passage

patterns.name: Possessive pronoun and its referent
patterns.context: Argues that towns cannot isolate themselves from new processes and notes that these processes have an order of their own; “their own order” forms a local semantic combination
patterns.domain: PhilPapers humanities and social sciences argument

7_2896.concept: 数学符号与英文功能词的混合响应
7_2896.description: 强激活主要出现在两类材料：含变量、指数和乘除括号的代数化简题；以及英文散文中的常见功能词。另有季节互换比喻和“their own order”论述语境中的局部激活，无法确认它们与主模式同因。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量标记
patterns.trigger: 变量字母及其周围的算术符号，如 «o»、«h»、«n»、«p»、«y»、«u»、«a»，以及指数、乘除和括号
patterns.context: 出现在形式化幂运算化简题中，尤其变量反复出现并带指数，随后有“assuming … is positive”或“↵…**(…)↵Simplify”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；练习题与符号代数

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的关系或功能词
patterns.context: 出现在连续的英文散文句子中，嵌在叙述或论述句法里；没有明显的数学符号或特定固定短语条件
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 文学散文、PhilPapers 论述

patterns.name: 冬夏季节反转表述
patterns.context: 描写气候温暖明亮，并用冬夏互换作比喻；这些词在此段集中出现

patterns.name: 所有格代词及其所属对象
patterns.context: 论述城镇无法隔绝新过程，并指出这些过程具有自身秩序；“their own order”构成局部语义组合

en.concept: Features of professional and expository texts across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across mathematical expressions, mathematical physics terminology, geographic and political proper names in encyclopedias, secrecy narratives in literature, and classifications of research materials in plant studies; no single stable lexical trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Local operators in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In formula-heavy or symbol-dense mathematical text, activations are scattered across operators, powers, variables, and adjacent mathematical terminology; the DM problems also include “assuming … is positive” and “Simplify”

patterns.name: Specialized terms in scientific and technical text
patterns.context: Mathematical or physics terminology appears within definitions, operator descriptions, or theoretical explanations; no single fixed term is the trigger

patterns.name: Proper names and classificatory text
patterns.context: Encyclopedic entries introduce geographic locations, roads, or political parties and associated organizations

patterns.name: Narratives of confidentiality and difficult experiences
patterns.context: Literary prose discusses secrets that should be kept, the obligation to remain silent, and unpleasant experiences

patterns.name: Classification of materials in research methods
patterns.context: The methods section of a paper introduces research samples or breeding materials by category

7_2896.concept: 多领域专业与说明文本特征
7_2896.description: 激活分布于数学表达式、数学物理论文术语、百科中的地理与政治专名、文学中的保密叙述及植物研究材料分类；未见单一稳定的词汇触发模式。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的局部运算符号
patterns.trigger: DM 片段中的 «))/»、«*»、«**»、«/»、«+»，以及变量和数字；另见 «derivative»
patterns.context: 公式或符号密集的数学文本中，激活分散在运算符、幂、变量和相邻数学术语上；DM 题目还出现“assuming … is positive”和“Simplify”

patterns.name: 科学技术文本中的专门术语
patterns.context: 数学或物理学术语嵌在定义、算子描述或理论解释中；并非一个固定术语触发

patterns.name: 专名与分类性文字
patterns.context: 百科条目中介绍地理位置、道路或政党及其关联机构

patterns.name: 保密义务与沉重经历的叙述
patterns.context: 文学散文中谈及应保守的秘密、沉默义务及不愉快经历

patterns.name: 研究方法中的材料分类
patterns.context: 论文方法部分按类别介绍研究样本或育种材料

en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains and parts of speech, with no reliable unifying feature. keep (and inflected forms) appears occasionally in multiple passages, Simplify is common in math problems, and of occurs in several places, but the contexts differ substantially; it is unclear whether these are shared trigger patterns.

patterns.name: Uses of keep
patterns.context: The verb keep occurs in sentences, often taking objects or complements such as only, a nonzero mass, and our notations; there is no fixed collocation, and capitalization varies.

patterns.name: Simplify in mathematical simplification problems
patterns.context: After a complex algebraic expression and its simplified result, an imperative introduces the next problem; fractional powers, variables, and positivity assumptions recur in the passage.

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: An English preposition in varied contexts, connecting nouns or noun phrases, such as «Straits of Gibraltar» and «physics of heavy quarks»; trigger position and syntactic function are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: keep in a physics context
patterns.context: In an infinitive, keep takes «a nonzero mass», expressing the operation of retaining a nonzero mass during calculation.

patterns.name: keep in general explanatory contexts
patterns.context: keep introduces a constraint or operation: taking only the upper sign or simplifying notation; the two examples differ in field and complement.

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: These words occur in code, physics discussion, book titles, or encyclopedia definitions; the local fragments are insufficient to establish a shared condition with the other activations.

7_2896.description: 强激活分散于不同领域与词类，未见可靠统一特征；多段偶见 keep（及其变形），数学题多见 Simplify，另有多处 of，但语境差异明显，无法确认这些就是共同触发模式。

patterns.name: keep 的用法
patterns.context: 作为动词 keep 出现在句中，常接 only、a nonzero mass、our notations 等宾语或补语；并非固定搭配，大小写不同。
patterns.domain: 叙述、物理学论文、数学说明

patterns.name: 数学化简题中的 Simplify
patterns.context: 复杂代数式及其化简结果之后，以命令形式引出下一道题；段内还反复出现分数幂、变量及正值假设。

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 多种语境中的英语介词，连接名词或名词短语，如 «Straits of Gibraltar»、«physics of heavy quarks»；触发位置和句法功能并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 物理语境中的 keep
patterns.context: 不定式中 keep 接 «a nonzero mass»，表达计算时保留非零质量这一操作。

patterns.name: 一般说明语境中的 keep
patterns.context: 用 keep 引出限制或操作：只取上号、简化记号；但两例所在领域及补语不同。

patterns.name: 其余零散触发
patterns.context: 这些词出现在代码、物理论述、书名或百科定义中；局部片段不足以确认其与其他激活的共同条件。

en.concept: Mixed response to mathematical symbols and narrative words
en.description: Most strong activations come from algebra simplification problems involving powers and fractional exponents, especially operators, exponents, and standard problem instructions; in two passages of sea narratives, there are also responses to words about seasons, the passage of time, and sailing at sea. These are difficult to explain with a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in algebra simplification tasks
patterns.context: Occurs mainly in nested expressions with powers, multiplication, division, and parentheses, especially passages where the problem asks for simplification, states that variables are positive, and gives an answer in power form; activations often fall near operators, exponents, and some variables.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics instructional problems or synthetic algebra exercises

patterns.name: Time and season words in sea-voyage narratives
patterns.context: In continuous prose recounting a voyage, experiences at sea, or the passage of time; high activations are concentrated on words describing seasonal change or the tedium of time passing.

patterns.name: Sea and navigation-related words
patterns.context: In contexts describing ships passing through straits, along Mediterranean coasts, and near ports, related geographic or navigation words receive weak to moderate activation.

7_2896.concept: 数学符号与叙事词的混合响应
7_2896.description: 多数强激活来自幂与分数指数构成的代数化简题，尤其是运算符、指数及标准题目指令；另在两段海上叙事中，对季节、时间流逝及海域航行词有响应，二者难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 代数化简任务中的数值与运算符
patterns.context: 主要出现在嵌套的幂、乘除和括号表达式中，尤其是题目要求化简、声明变量为正并给出幂形式答案的片段；激活常落在运算符、指数及部分变量附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 教学题目或合成代数练习

patterns.name: 海洋航行叙述中的时间与季节词
patterns.context: 在叙述航行、海上经历或时间流逝的连续散文中；高激活集中于描写季节更替或时间难熬的词。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 小说/旅行叙事散文

patterns.name: 海域与航行相关词
patterns.context: 在描述船只经过海峡、地中海沿岸及港口的语境中，相关地理或航行词获得较弱至中等激活。

en.description: Activations are distributed across diverse genres: algebraic factorization, seasonal reversal descriptions, category compounds, identity labels, horse-racing lineage, descriptions of change in papers, chronological place names, and code removal operations. No single word sense or structural pattern covers all samples.

patterns.name: Polynomial factorization output
patterns.context: In symbolic computation or math solutions, a polynomial is given and then factorized; activation is distributed around Factor, operators, variables, and factors.

patterns.name: Unusual winter-summer contrast
patterns.context: Describes warm, bright weather and uses winter-summer reversal as a metaphor; stronger activations are concentrated on winter, changed, and summer.

patterns.name: Compound words in category labels
patterns.context: Compound words occur in Wikipedia category names, with activation on word fragments in the label; samples are sparse.

patterns.name: Identity labels and discussion of their wording
patterns.context: Email text discusses a hyphenated identity label and presents the speaker identifying as Native American; God’s sake also receives activation.
patterns.domain: Private email / discussion of identity and wording

patterns.name: Horse-racing lineage and event names
patterns.context: In horse-racing results and accounts of horses’ descendants, activation occurs near kinship terms and proper-name phrases.

patterns.name: Change and behavior in technical papers
patterns.context: When discussing the effect of a fixed parameter N on RTE behavior, activation is concentrated on major changes; the surrounding text is technical argument.

patterns.name: Place names and building records in chronologies
patterns.context: Historical events, construction of monasteries or castles, and locations are listed by year; activation falls around Forest and Dartmoor.

patterns.name: Removal operations and style attributes in code
patterns.context: A jQuery chain selects a menu element and removes a class or style attribute; activation is concentrated on remove-related method names and code symbols.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于多种文体：代数因式分解、季节互换描写、分类复合词、身份称谓、赛马谱系、论文变化表述、编年地名和代码移除操作。没有可覆盖全部样本的单一词义或结构模式。

patterns.name: 多项式因式分解输出
patterns.context: 符号计算或数学题解中，先给多项式，再输出因式分解；激活分布在 Factor、运算符、变量和因式附近。

patterns.name: 冬夏季节反常对照
patterns.context: 描写天气温暖明亮，并以冬夏互换作比喻；较强激活集中在 winter、changed、summer。

patterns.name: 分类标签中的复合词
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类名中出现复合词，激活落在标签内容的词语片段上；样本很少。

patterns.name: 身份称谓及其词形讨论
patterns.context: 邮件文字讨论连字符身份称谓，并以说话者自称为 Native American 的语境呈现；God’s sake 也有激活。
patterns.domain: 私人邮件 / 身份与措辞讨论

patterns.name: 赛马血统与赛事名称
patterns.context: 赛马赛事成绩及马匹后代叙述中，激活出现在亲属称谓和专名短语附近。

patterns.name: 技术论文中的变化与行为
patterns.context: 讨论固定参数 N 对 RTE 行为的影响时，激活集中于 major changes；周边是技术性论证。

patterns.name: 编年史地名与建筑记录
patterns.context: 按年份列举历史事件、修道院或城堡建造及地点；激活落在 Forest、Dartmoor 一带。
patterns.domain: 百科年表 / 历史编年

patterns.name: 代码中的移除操作与样式属性
patterns.context: jQuery 链式调用中，选择菜单元素并移除类或 style 属性；激活集中于 remove 相关方法名及代码符号。

en.description: Concentrated mainly in two constructions with matter: “a matter of time,” meaning something will happen sooner or later, and “a matter of,” meaning something is determined by rules. Other activations are scattered across poetic scenery, sports titles, expressions of obligation, and literary lists, spanning several parts of speech and contexts that cannot be fully explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “a matter of time”
patterns.context: In sentences expressing that something will happen sooner or later or that the speaker expects it to happen; may also be “just/only a matter of time”
patterns.domain: Modern English prose, including news, online dialogue, and commentary

patterns.name: “a matter of” referring to rules or conditions
patterns.context: matter is followed by an of phrase, meaning something is determined by rules, conditions, or factors; this is not a time expression

patterns.name: “snow on ...” in winter scenery poetry
patterns.context: A repeated poetic line describing snowfall covering grass

patterns.name: Dark sky in winter scenery poetry
patterns.context: A line describing hills, cold ground, and the sky overhead; activation falls on Dark rather than on general winter vocabulary in ordinary narration

patterns.name: Literary descriptions of winter and seasonal change
patterns.context: Warm, bright weather described through personification or a seasonal exchange metaphor

patterns.name: Fixed title “man of the match”
patterns.context: Sports coverage stating that a player earned the best performance or title in a match

patterns.name: Obligation to “take action”
patterns.context: Discussion of waste-disposal options emphasizing that something must be done; activation falls on to
patterns.domain: Public issues, discussion, or advocacy texts

patterns.name: Literary list of fears
patterns.context: A narrator climbs a hill overlooking a city and says they bring fear, desolation, and death

7_2896.description: 主要集中于 matter 的两种构式：表示迟早发生的“a matter of time”，以及表示由规则决定的“a matter of”。其余激活分散在诗歌景物、体育称号、义务表达和文学列举中，包含多个不同词类与语境，无法由单一语义规律充分解释。

patterns.name: “a matter of time”固定表达
patterns.trigger: “a matter of time”，尤其是 matter；前接 a，常接 of time，后续常见 before
patterns.context: 在表示某事迟早会发生或说话者预期某事会发生的句子中；也可能是“just/only a matter of time”
patterns.domain: 新闻、网络对话、评论等现代英语散文

patterns.name: “a matter of”表示取决于规则或条件
patterns.trigger: “a matter of”及其后的名词，如 “a matter of the rules”
patterns.context: matter 后接 of 短语，表示某事由规则、条件或因素决定，不是时间表达

patterns.name: 冬季景物诗句中的“雪在……上”
patterns.trigger: “snow’s on”；激活分布集中于 “on the meadow”
patterns.context: 诗歌引文中描写降雪覆盖草地的重复句式

patterns.name: 冬季景物诗句中的暗色天空
patterns.context: 诗行描写土丘、寒冷大地与头顶天空；激活落在 Dark，而非一般叙述中的冬季词语

patterns.name: 冬季与季节转换的文学描写
patterns.trigger: “winter had changed places with summer”中的 “winter”；同段另有 “changed” 强激活
patterns.context: 以拟人或季节交换比喻描写温暖明亮的天气

patterns.name: “man of the match”固定称号
patterns.trigger: “man of the match”中的两个 “of the”
patterns.context: 体育比赛报道，说明球员获得单场最佳表现或称号

patterns.name: “要采取行动”的义务表达
patterns.context: 讨论废弃物处置选项，强调某事必须完成；激活落在 to
patterns.domain: 公共议题、讨论或倡议文本

patterns.name: 恐惧的文学性列举
patterns.context: 叙述者登上俯瞰城市的山丘，并称自己带来恐惧、荒凉与死亡

en.description: Activations are distributed across several local collocations: two instances of “in keeping with,” two expressions of state change, a sports phrase, a fixed financial phrase, code comments and web-code markers, and Rust “very core”; no single semantic pattern covers all samples.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “in keeping with”
patterns.context: The phrase “in keeping with” means consistent with or in accordance with; paragraph 2 concerns newspaper policy, while paragraph 10 concerns a mathematical property.

patterns.name: “change” and state transitions
patterns.context: Expresses a seasonal reversal or a change in a system’s organization; occurs respectively in “winter had changed places with summer” and “there is a change in the organization”.

patterns.name: “man of the match” award expression
patterns.context: In sports reporting, describes a player delivering the best performance in a match; activation is concentrated on the fixed noun phrase.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “matter of time”
patterns.context: “just a matter of time before” means that something will happen sooner or later.

patterns.name: Parameter markers in code comments
patterns.context: A function parameter and its type are documented using JSDoc-style annotations.

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript markup and attributes
patterns.context: HTML tags, attribute assignments, and JavaScript DOM/canvas code; these are not natural-language phrases.

patterns.name: Rust core-level expression
patterns.context: “at its very core” emphasizes the fundamental or core level of Rust.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于若干局部搭配：两个“in keeping with”、两处状态变化表达，以及体育、财经固定短语、代码注释和网页代码标记、Rust“very core”；没有单一语义模式覆盖全部样本。

patterns.name: 固定表达“in keeping with”
patterns.context: 短语“in keeping with”表示符合、与……一致；第2段为报纸政策，第10段为数学性质。

patterns.name: “change”及状态转变
patterns.context: 表示季节互换或系统组织状态发生变化；分别位于“winter had changed places with summer”和“there is a change in the organization”中。

patterns.name: “man of the match”荣誉表达
patterns.context: 体育报道中描述球员获得全场最佳表现；激活集中在固定名词短语。

patterns.name: “matter of time”固定表达
patterns.context: “just a matter of time before”表示某事迟早会发生。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的参数标记
patterns.context: 文档注释中用 JSDoc 风格标注函数参数及类型。

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript 标记与属性
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性赋值和 JavaScript DOM/画布代码；并非自然语言短语。

patterns.name: Rust 核心层级表达
patterns.context: “at its very core”强调 Rust 的根本或核心层面。

en.concept: Structural shifts in technical and narrative texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across changes of state, evaluative reporting, code comments using @param, mathematical factorization, and specialized phrasing in mathematics and control-theory papers; there is no single stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Change, transition, or shift in state
patterns.context: Describes a change in an object's state, condition, or organizational structure; sometimes the change word itself is activated, and sometimes the context is a phase transition.

patterns.name: Evaluated performance and its outcome
patterns.context: In sports coverage, a performance is rated the best in a match; in financial reporting, “just a matter of time” expresses a judgment about a future outcome.

patterns.name: Parameter notation in code documentation
patterns.context: Appears in a code comment or documentation block, followed by a parameter name and its type or description.

patterns.name: Multiplicative factors in polynomial factorization
patterns.context: In a high-degree polynomial problem or solution, the factorized result lists parenthesized factors and exponents.

patterns.name: Operators and space notation in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: Introduces an elliptic partial differential operator and its domain using LaTeX mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Spacecraft trajectory and attitude control in technical papers
patterns.context: Describes numerical experiments validating optimal trajectory or attitude-control results.

7_2896.concept: 技术与叙述文本中的结构性转折
7_2896.description: 激活分散于状态变化、评价性报道、代码注释@param、数学因式分解，以及数学和控制论文的专门表述；没有单一稳定的词面触发器。

patterns.name: 变化、转变或状态改变
patterns.context: 描述某物状态、条件或组织结构发生改变；有时直接激活变化词，有时出现在相变语境。

patterns.name: 带评价的表现及其结果
patterns.context: 体育报道中表现被评价为比赛最佳；财经报道中以“只是时间问题”表达对未来结果的判断。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的参数标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释或文档块中，后接参数名及其类型、说明。
patterns.domain: Github 代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 多项式因式分解中的乘法因子
patterns.context: 高次多项式题目或解答中，因式分解结果列出括号因子及幂。

patterns.name: 数学符号化定义中的算子与空间记号
patterns.context: 介绍椭圆偏微分算子及其定义域，使用 LaTeX 数学记号。

patterns.name: 技术论文中的航天器轨迹与姿态控制
patterns.trigger: «of»« a»« spacecraft»« on»« the»« Lie»« group»
patterns.context: 描述数值实验验证最优轨迹或姿态控制结果。
patterns.domain: 控制理论／航天研究论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: “man of the match” in sports coverage, ordinary preposition of and “of the Hills” in a book title; code punctuation and @param; r in the names Shruti/Shraddha; religious accounts of fulfillment; the term irreversibility; and seasonal-exchange metaphors. No single semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: “man of the match” in sports coverage
patterns.context: In the phrase “man of the match,” the preposition of is followed by the match; found in player-performance or match reports.

patterns.name: Ordinary prepositional use of of
patterns.context: of connects a noun with its complement or modifier; the context does not require sports-related meaning.

patterns.name: Hills phrase in a book title
patterns.context: In a bibliographic entry title, of the introduces the landform noun Hills; appears alongside words such as Birds and Land.

patterns.name: Period and annotation markers in code documentation
patterns.context: In code or JSDoc comments, activation falls on markers such as periods and @param and neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: The letter sequence r within names
patterns.context: The letter r is strongly marked in the spelling of the given names Shruti or Shraddha; both occur near author or actor lists.
patterns.domain: Paper author information, movie cast lists

patterns.name: Narrative of time coming to fruition
patterns.context: Discusses a prophecy or promise appearing or being fulfilled at the right time, with nearby words such as “God’s promises” and “unfold.”

patterns.name: Irreversibility terminology
patterns.context: A hyphenated “irreversibility” appears in a technical title, alongside concepts such as determinism and quantum mechanics.
patterns.domain: Interactive entertainment design, patent background technology

patterns.name: Expression of winter and summer exchanging places
patterns.context: A seasonal exchange is used as a metaphor in a travel description of warm, bright weather.

7_2896.description: 激活分散在多类文本中：体育报道的“man of the match”、普通介词of及书名中的“of the Hills”；代码标点和@param、人名Shruti/Shraddha中的r、宗教应验叙述、irreversibility术语及季节互换比喻。没有覆盖全部样例的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 体育报道中的“man of the match”
patterns.context: 短语“man of the match”中，介词 of 后接 the match；见于球员表现或比赛报道。

patterns.name: of 的普通介词用法
patterns.context: of 连接名词与其补足语或修饰成分；上下文并不要求体育语义。

patterns.name: 书名中的 Hills 短语
patterns.trigger: “« of»9« the»6 Hills”及“« of»4« the»2 Hills”
patterns.context: 书目条目标题中，of the 引出地貌名词 Hills；伴随 Birds、Land 等词。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的句点与注释标记
patterns.context: 代码或 JSDoc 注释中，激活落在句点、@param 等标记及邻近 token 上。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 姓名内部的 r 字符串
patterns.context: 人名首名 Shruti 或 Shraddha 的拼写中，r 被强烈标记；两处均在作者或演员名单附近。
patterns.domain: 论文作者信息、电影演员表

patterns.name: 时间成熟、应验的叙述
patterns.trigger: “the« time»8 for their appearance« is»5« ripe»5”
patterns.context: 谈及预言或承诺在合适时机显现、应验，周围有“God’s promises”“unfold”等词。

patterns.name: 不可逆性术语
patterns.context: 技术标题中出现被切分标记的“irreversibility”，并列于决定论、量子力学等概念。
patterns.domain: 互动娱乐设计、专利背景技术

patterns.name: 冬夏交换的表达
patterns.context: 天气温暖明亮的旅行描写中，用季节互换作比喻。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various contexts: change/changed, code-comment @ param, proper names beginning with Pr, a mountain-themed book title, Lie group notation, encyclopedia geography formatting, and company date records; there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: change and its affixes
patterns.context: A phase transition changes an organization, weather seasons change, or something will change in the future; the semantics and syntax differ.

patterns.name: @ in documentation comments
patterns.context: In source-code documentation comments, @param is followed by a parameter name and description.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in place names
patterns.context: An English proper name contains a word fragment beginning with Pr; the first two examples are a family name and a place name, while the third is a game term.

patterns.name: Mountain-themed title phrases
patterns.context: Book titles in a bibliography contain landscape terms such as Hills and Glens.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial lowercase of
patterns.context: A prepositional phrase at the start of a literary narrative fragment, followed by a year and travel narrative.

patterns.name: Mathematical group notation
patterns.context: Lie group notation expressed in LaTeX in a technical abstract.

patterns.name: Line-break marker before a section heading
patterns.context: A Geography heading follows a line break in an encyclopedia entry, accompanied by a special marker.

patterns.name: Road and riverside descriptions in geographic entries
patterns.context: A place entry uses directions, road numbers, and a river to describe a village’s location.

patterns.name: Date and company relocation records
patterns.context: Records a shareholder meeting date and the company’s transfer of operations, offices, and archival arrangements.

patterns.name: Phase transition and layered structure in a scientific abstract
patterns.context: Discusses changes to the internal organization structure during a phase transition and a resonance frequency shift.

7_2896.description: 激活分散于多种场景：change/changed、代码注释@ param、Pr开头专名、山地书名、李群符号、百科地理格式及公司日期记录；没有统一语义模式。

patterns.name: change 及其前后缀
patterns.context: 相变导致组织发生改变，天气季节转换，或将来某事改变；语义和句法均不同。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的 @
patterns.context: 源码文档注释里 @param 后接参数名和说明。

patterns.name: 地名中的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 英文专名中以 Pr 开头的词片段；前两例是家族名和地名，后一例是游戏名词。

patterns.name: 山地标题词组
patterns.context: 书目列表中包含 Hills、Glens 等山地景观词汇的书名。

patterns.name: 句首小写 of
patterns.context: 文学叙述中句首残接的介词短语，后续为年份和行程叙述。

patterns.name: 数学群符号
patterns.context: 技术摘要中以 LaTeX 表示的李群记号。

patterns.name: 章节标题前的换行标记
patterns.context: 百科条目中换行后出现 Geography 标题，伴随特殊标记。

patterns.name: 地理条目中的道路与河岸描述
patterns.context: 地点条目用方位、道路编号和河流描述村镇位置。

patterns.name: 日期及公司迁移记录
patterns.context: 记录股东会议日期及公司业务转移、办事处和档案安排。

patterns.name: 科学摘要中的相变与层结构
patterns.context: 讨论相变时内层组织结构变化及共振频移。

en.description: Activations span common function words, word-internal fragments, capitalization and title formatting, code comments and punctuation, mathematical symbols, and vocabulary from multiple genres. Local patterns are identifiable, but they do not reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Case-sensitive word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on case-sensitive word fragments, often in all-caps titles or proper and common nouns in body text; there is no obvious shared meaning
patterns.domain: Book titles, inscriptions, narrative texts, encyclopedic and academic texts

patterns.name: Common function words such as articles and conjunctions
patterns.context: Common short words in natural-language sentences, with varied positions and grammatical functions; activation is usually low

patterns.name: Code punctuation and indentation
patterns.context: Formatting structure in code lines, indentation, and documentation comments; code-identifier fragments also appear in the same segment
patterns.domain: Github source code and JSDoc comments

patterns.name: JSDoc parameter comments
patterns.context: Documentation format declaring parameters with @param in code comments

patterns.name: Mathematical expression symbols
patterns.context: Punctuation and symbols near formulas or mathematical typesetting; the segments also contain LaTeX mathematical notation

patterns.name: Names in titles and bibliographies
patterns.context: Title words in works and bibliographic entries, often using title case

patterns.name: Fragments of specific academic terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical or physical terms and variable descriptions in academic sentences; these activations are scattered across papers on different topics

patterns.name: Seasonal and scenery words in narrative texts
patterns.context: Continuous prose describing weather, seascapes, and seasonal change

patterns.name: Praise in inscriptions
patterns.context: Praise, virtue, and dedication language on book front matter or in inscriptions; includes all-caps formatting

7_2896.concept: 混合的文本与格式片段
7_2896.description: 激活分布在常见功能词、词内片段、大小写与标题排版、代码注释和标点、公式符号及多类文体词语上。各段局部模式可辨，但难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 大小写切分的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写敏感的词语片段上，常见于全大写标题或正文中的专名、普通词；没有显而易见的统一词义
patterns.domain: 书籍题名、题词、叙事文本、百科与学术文本

patterns.name: 冠词、连接词等常见功能词
patterns.context: 自然语言句子中的常见小词，位置和语义功能各异，强度通常较低

patterns.name: 代码标点与缩进
patterns.context: 代码行、缩进及注释文档的格式结构；同段也出现代码标识符片段
patterns.domain: Github 源代码及 JSDoc 注释

patterns.name: JSDoc 参数注释
patterns.context: 代码注释中以 @param 声明参数的文档格式

patterns.name: 数学表达式符号
patterns.context: 公式或数学排版附近的标点与符号，片段中也有 LaTeX 数学记号

patterns.name: 标题与书目中的名称片段
patterns.trigger: «Birds of the Loch and Mountain»、«Charm»、«Hills»、«Land of the Hills and the Glens»
patterns.context: 作品名和书目条目中的标题词语，常采用标题式大写

patterns.name: 特定学术术语片段
patterns.context: 学术句子中出现数学、物理术语或变量表述；这些激活分散在不同主题论文里

patterns.name: 叙事文本中的季节与景物词
patterns.context: 描写天气、海景与季节变换的连续散文

patterns.name: 题词中的赞美表达
patterns.context: 书籍扉页或题词中赞美、美德与献辞措辞；包含全大写排版

en.concept: Heterogeneous text structures and local word forms
en.description: Activations span HTML tags and attributes, Android imports, year-based bibliographies, of/the in proper names, formulas and technical terms in mathematics papers, and literary scenery descriptions; there is no single stable semantics, suggesting a mixed response to varied structured text fragments and local word forms.

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript tags and attributes
patterns.context: Near script tags, closing tags, and their attributes in HTML documents or code snippets; activation falls on tag syntax and adjacent code.

patterns.name: HTML document structure and attributes
patterns.context: Headings and table tags and attributes presenting method summaries in an HTML document.

patterns.name: Android Java UI class names and import statements
patterns.context: Android widget/UI components imported in Java import lists; activation clusters around package separators and class names.

patterns.name: Bibliography entries and dates
patterns.context: Entries in lists arranged by year and containing author, title, and publication information.

patterns.name: The and title phrases in proper names
patterns.context: Function words such as the/of connect nouns in longer proper names, book titles, or organization names; not all such words trigger activation.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia narrative, book titles, and organization names

patterns.name: Formulas and terminology in mathematics papers
patterns.context: In the body text or around formulas in mathematics/physics papers; may involve classification conventions, orbifold cohomology, or physical viewpoints. The trigger is not confined to one mathematical symbol.

patterns.name: Scenery descriptions in narrative prose
patterns.context: Descriptions of nighttime scenes, light, and architecture in literary narratives; this segment has no obvious shared code or academic formatting feature.

7_2896.concept: 异质文本结构与局部词形
7_2896.description: 激活跨 HTML 标签与属性、Android 导入、年份书目、专名中的 of/the、数学论文公式术语及文学景物描写；没有单一稳定语义，较像对多种结构化文本片段及局部词形的混合响应。

patterns.name: HTML/JavaScript 标签与属性
patterns.context: HTML 文档或代码片段中，script 标签、闭合标签及其属性附近；激活落在标签语法和相邻代码上。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML/JavaScript 源码

patterns.name: HTML 文档结构与属性
patterns.context: HTML 文档中呈现方法摘要的标题和表格标记及属性。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML/Javadoc 文档

patterns.name: Android Java UI 类名与导入语句
patterns.context: Java import 列表中导入 Android widget/UI 组件，激活集中在包名分隔符及类名附近。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Android/Java 源码

patterns.name: 书目与年代条目
patterns.context: 按年份排列、包含作者/书名/出版信息的列表条目。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 的参考书目或作品年表

patterns.name: 专名中的 the 与标题短语
patterns.context: 较长专名、书名或机构名称中，the/of 等功能词连接名词；并非所有此类词都触发。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 叙述、书名与机构名称

patterns.name: 数学论文中的公式与术语
patterns.context: 数学/物理学论文正文或公式周围，可能涉及分类约定、orbifold 上同调或物理观点；触发位置并不固定为单一数学符号。

patterns.name: 叙事散文中的景物描写
patterns.context: 文学叙事中对夜间景象、光线及建筑的描写；此段没有明显共享的代码或学术格式特征。

en.concept: English of phrases and adjacent structures
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the fixed phrase “point of view,” especially its use for an observational perspective in academic papers; also activates on proper-name or title constructions such as House of and Land of, as well as isolated numbers, abbreviations, and technical-term fragments.

patterns.name: The phrase point of view
patterns.context: Introduces a perspective in academic writing, often preceded by qualifiers such as “physical,” “mathematical,” or “theoretical”; paragraph [10] also contains “From another point of view”.

patterns.name: House of proper-name construction
patterns.context: Appears in proper names or organization names such as “House of Labor,” “House of Commons,” and “Old House of Representatives”; “of” in “House of” activates strongly.

patterns.name: Land of title construction
patterns.context: Begins a book title, followed by a place or topic noun; “Land” activates strongly.

patterns.name: of the Hills place-name or title construction
patterns.context: Appears in a book-title-like heading; “of the” and “Hills” activate.

patterns.name: Hyphenated numbers in a time span
patterns.context: Numbers joined by a hyphen in a bibliographic title or date range; the marker is on the number after the hyphen.

patterns.name: Abbreviation and punctuation in a tower name
patterns.context: A proper-name abbreviation followed by a person’s name; activation is concentrated on the period.

patterns.name: k=10 embedded in mathematical notation
patterns.context: A variable assignment in a mathematical expression; activation falls near the equals sign and number.

patterns.name: Non-perturbative terminology
patterns.context: A hyphenated compound in a physics term, with both the stem and suffix marked.

7_2896.concept: 英语中的 of 短语及相邻结构
7_2896.description: 主要对固定短语“point of view”敏感，尤其学术论文中表示观察角度的用法；另对 House of、Land of 等专名或书名结构，以及若干孤立的数字、缩写和技术术语片段激活。

patterns.name: point of view 短语
patterns.trigger: “point” 后接 “of” 和 “view”，其中 “point” 最强；例：“point of view”
patterns.context: 在学术表述中引出观察角度，前面常有 “physical”“mathematical”“theoretical” 等限定词；第 [10] 段也出现 “From another point of view”。

patterns.name: House of 专名结构
patterns.context: 出现在专名或机构名称中，如 “House of Labor”“House of Commons”“Old House of Representatives”；“House of” 中的 “of” 激活较强。
patterns.domain: 书目、历史叙述、百科条目

patterns.name: Land of 书名结构

patterns.name: of the Hills 地名或书名结构
patterns.context: 出现在书名式标题中；“of the”及 “Hills” 有激活。

patterns.name: 时间段中的数字连字符
patterns.context: 书目标题或年代范围内，数字之间以连字符连接；该处标记在连字符后的数字。

patterns.name: 塔名中的缩写与标点

patterns.name: 嵌入数学符号的 k=10

patterns.name: 非扰动术语
patterns.context: 物理术语中由连字符连接的复合词，词干及后缀均有标记。

en.description: Activations often occur in “X of Y” noun phrases, especially House of…, Land of…, and book or institution names; they also cover bibliographic titles and place-name phrases. Other sporadic contexts include a waste-disposal discussion, Changing World, and a film title, which are difficult to group under a single theme.

patterns.name: “of” followed by a noun phrase
patterns.context: In varied contexts, “of” and some tokens in the following noun phrase are marked; some examples are followed by common nouns such as House, Land, or Hills.
patterns.domain: Book titles, institution names, entry titles, and general text

patterns.name: Book titles and bibliographic entries
patterns.context: Multiple words within a title are marked in bibliographic lists or descriptions of works; the pattern is not limited to one topic.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia bibliographies, book descriptions, and HackerNews quotes

patterns.name: Phrases related to House of Representatives
patterns.context: House of + institution name occurs in institutional names or historical text; of or House in the phrase is marked.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia history/politics entries, Gutenberg fiction, election entries

patterns.name: Place-name phrases in directional or regional names
patterns.context: Geographical descriptions or place names contain locations, landforms, or regional names connected by of.

patterns.name: waste in a waste-disposal discussion
patterns.context: When discussing contracts, garbage-disposal options, and their necessity, waste and nearby words are marked.

patterns.name: Time-span or change expression
patterns.context: An expression describing a changing world appears in a publication title, with local tokens activated.

patterns.name: Film and recollections of old movies
patterns.context: Discusses audience age and 3-D films from the past; activation occurs near the title House of Wax.

7_2896.description: 激活常见于“X of Y”名词短语，尤其 House of…、Land of…及书名、机构名；也覆盖书目标题、地名短语。另有 waste 处置讨论、Changing World 和电影标题等零散语境，难以归为单一主题。

patterns.name: “of”后接名词短语
patterns.trigger: “of”后出现名词，如 “House of Labor”“House of Representatives”“Land of Lisp”“Land of the Hills”“Charm of the Hills”
patterns.context: 在多种语境中，“of”及其后名词短语中的若干 token 被标记；部分例子后接高频名词 House、Land 或 Hills。
patterns.domain: 书名、机构名称、条目标题及一般文本

patterns.name: 书名及书目条目
patterns.trigger: 书名或出版物标题，如 “Ecological Imperialism”“The Fall of the House of Labor”“The Charm of the Hills”“Land of the Hills and the Glens”“Security and Intelligence in a Changing World”
patterns.context: 书目列表或介绍作品时，标题内部多个词被标记；并非只限于某类主题。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 书目、书籍介绍及 HackerNews 引文

patterns.name: House of Representatives 相关短语
patterns.context: 在机构名称或历史文本中出现 House of + 机构名；相关短语中的 of 或 House 被标记。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 历史/政治条目、Gutenberg 小说文本、选举条目

patterns.name: 方位或地域名称中的地名词组
patterns.trigger: “Land of the Hills”“south end of city”“bank of Saryu river”
patterns.context: 地理描写或地名中出现由 of 连接的地点、地貌或区域名。

patterns.name: 废物处理讨论中的 waste
patterns.trigger: “waste”“burying the waste”“Something has to be done with the waste”
patterns.context: 讨论合同、垃圾处置选项及其必要性时，waste 一词及附近词语被标记。

patterns.name: 时间跨度或变化表达
patterns.context: 出版物标题中描述世界发生变化的表达，局部 token 获得激活。

patterns.name: 电影与旧片回忆
patterns.context: 谈论观众年龄及过去的 3-D 电影；激活落在 House of Wax 标题附近。

en.concept: Of-related structures and miscellaneous lexical triggers
en.description: Activations are scattered across several structures: in mathematical texts, “of” commonly connects properties, possession, or classification, and algebraic terms also appear; bibliographic titles contain “of the” and modifiers; there are also scattered activations in HTML tags and informal political commentary.

patterns.name: “of” and “of the” structures
patterns.context: “of” connects modifiers, possession, or quantity expressions; strong activation often appears in “of the” or “field of,” but also occurs in different syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, bibliography entries, web text, commentary

patterns.name: Numerical or classificatory descriptions after “of”
patterns.context: In mathematical contexts, “of” introduces properties such as characteristics, conditions, genera, or coefficients; some examples also include a marked “10,” but do not form a single fixed phrase.

patterns.name: “of the” in place, work, or title names
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographic titles, where the prepositional phrase is part of the work’s name; “of” and “the” are marked.

patterns.name: “algebra(s)” in mathematical noun phrases
patterns.context: “algebra(s)” refers to mathematical objects; activation falls on the word and adjacent words, but “algebra” itself is not necessarily marked in every example.

patterns.name: Title and proper-name phrases containing “the”
patterns.context: The article appears in a title or body-text noun phrase; the marked position is not always the same word and may be another word in the phrase.

patterns.name: Modifier in “Changing World”
patterns.context: Appears in the book title “Security and Intelligence in a Changing World”; activation falls on “Changing” in the title.

patterns.name: HTML script tags and body markup
patterns.context: In an HTML document fragment, activation clusters on tag names, tag boundaries, and comment openers; difficult to explain together with ordinary-language activations in other segments.

patterns.name: Phrase in informal political commentary
patterns.context: In informal expressions such as “we gotta keep saber rattling,” activation falls on the colloquial contraction and verb.

7_2896.concept: of 相关结构及杂项词法触发
7_2896.description: 激活分散在多种结构：数学文本中常见“of”连接属性、所属或分类，也出现代数术语；书目标题含“of the”及修饰词；另有 HTML 标签和口语政治评论中的零散激活。

patterns.name: “of”与“of the”结构
patterns.context: “of”用于连接定语、所属或数量表达；强激活常出现在“of the”或“field of”中，但也见于不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、书目条目、网页文本、评论

patterns.name: “of”后的数值或分类描述
patterns.trigger: “a field of characteristic zero”“surface of initial conditions”“surface of genus 2”“field of coefficients”
patterns.context: 数学上下文中，“of”引出特征、条件、属或系数等属性；部分样例同时包含被标记的“10”，并非同一固定短语。

patterns.name: “of the”与地名、作品名或标题
patterns.trigger: “Birds of the Loch”“Charm of the Hills”“Land of the Hills”
patterns.context: 出现在书目标题中，介词短语构成作品名的一部分；“of”“the”被标记。

patterns.name: 数学名词短语中的“algebra(s)”
patterns.context: 以“algebra(s)”指称数学对象；激活落在该词及相邻词上，但多个例子中“algebra”本身未必被标记。

patterns.name: 含“the”的标题、专名短语
patterns.context: 冠词出现在标题或正文名词短语中；标记位置并不总是同一个词，可能是短语中的其他词。

patterns.name: “Changing World”中的修饰词
patterns.context: 出现在书名“Security and Intelligence in a Changing World”中，激活落在标题里的“Changing”。

patterns.name: HTML 脚本标签及正文标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档片段中，激活集中在标签名、标签边界及注释起始符上；与其他段落中的普通语言激活难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 口语化政治评论中的短语
patterns.context: “we gotta keep saber rattling”一类非正式表达中，激活落在口语缩写及动词上。

en.concept: Local phrases and structural patterns in English text
en.description: Activations occur in English function-word connections, mathematical terminology and syntax, bibliography titles, HTML tags, football coverage, political commentary, and paper formatting; they also involve several split word fragments. No single semantic theme covers all examples.

patterns.name: Function words and phrase linking in sentences
patterns.context: In continuous English narrative or explanatory text, especially when prepositions, articles, conjunctions, and following words form syntactic phrases
patterns.domain: English prose across domains, academic writing

patterns.name: Academic field and characteristic phrases
patterns.context: Technical noun phrases in mathematics papers that define concepts, state theorems, provide background, or introduce methods

patterns.name: English bibliography entries and titles
patterns.context: Bibliographies or lists of works containing authors, titles, publishers, locations, and years

patterns.name: HTML script markup
patterns.context: At script imports, closing HTML tags, or the start of body text in webpage source code

patterns.name: Football match coverage
patterns.context: Sports narratives describing seasons, match errors, cup victories, and player performances

patterns.name: Political figures and campaign satire
patterns.context: After listing U.S. presidential election opponents, uses colloquial language to criticize a continuing hardline or bellicose stance

patterns.name: Text structure markers
patterns.context: Near paper titles, separators, or Markdown-style section formatting; activation also occurs alongside mathematical content in the body

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and spelling continuations
patterns.context: Markers fall inside split or cross-token English words, without a stable independent semantic condition

7_2896.concept: 英文文本中的局部短语与结构模式
7_2896.description: 激活分布于英文功能词衔接、数学论文术语与句法、书目标题、HTML标签、足球报道、政治评论及论文排版；亦涉及若干拆分词片段，未见单一语义主题覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 句中功能词与短语衔接
patterns.trigger: 频繁标记 of, and, in, a, the, is, that, for, over 等短词，常与后续内容词连成短语
patterns.context: 在连续英文叙述或说明文字中，尤其是介词、冠词、连词及其后的词形成句法短语时
patterns.domain: 多领域英文散文、学术写作

patterns.name: 学术领域与特征短语
patterns.trigger: “Burnside algebras”, “symmetric algebras”, “field of characteristic zero”, “Weyl algebra”, “simple Noetherian domain”, “polynomial of degree”, “field of coefficients”, “tensor products”, “automorphic representations”, “local field”, “number field”, “dependent and independent variables”
patterns.context: 数学论文中定义、定理、背景或方法介绍的专业名词短语

patterns.name: 英文书目条目与标题
patterns.trigger: “Security and Intelligence in a Changing World: New Perspectives”以及“Birds of the Loch and Mountain”, “The Charm of the Hills”, “Hill Birds of Scotland”, “Land of the Hills and the Glens”
patterns.context: 作者、书名、出版社、地点和年份组成的书目或作品清单

patterns.name: HTML脚本标记
patterns.context: 网页源码中脚本引入、HTML标签闭合或正文开始处

patterns.name: 足球赛事报道
patterns.trigger: “Dudek rebounded”, “man of the match performance”, “Manchester United”
patterns.context: 描述赛季、比赛失误、杯赛胜利及球员表现的体育叙述

patterns.name: 政治人物与竞选讽刺
patterns.trigger: “McCain vs. Obama”, “Bush II vs. Kerry”, “Dole vs. Clinton”及“keep saber rattling”
patterns.context: 列举美国总统选举对手后，以口语表达批评持续强硬或好战姿态

patterns.name: 文本结构标记
patterns.context: 论文标题、分隔线或Markdown式章节排版附近；激活与正文数学内容同时出现

patterns.name: 词内片段与拼写延续
patterns.context: 标记落在被拆分或跨token呈现的英文单词内部，未显示出稳定的独立语义条件

en.description: Activations are scattered across several local patterns: common English “of the” phrases, “in a” in titles, algebra and field-characteristic terminology in mathematics papers, and HTML, JavaScript, and C# structures in code; no clear shared theme.

patterns.name: Combination “of” and “the”
patterns.context: The preposition “of” is followed by the article “the”; the phrase sometimes continues into a proper name, book title, or place name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, book titles, ordinary text, and academic text

patterns.name: “in a” in titles
patterns.context: The preposition “in” is followed by the indefinite article “a,” then a title noun or phrase.

patterns.name: HTML markup in method summaries
patterns.context: Headings and HTML attributes in a method-summary table on a Java documentation page.

patterns.name: Algebraic terminology
patterns.context: Continuous descriptions of algebraic objects and their properties.

patterns.name: Fields and characteristics in mathematics papers
patterns.context: Describes conditions under which a mathematical object applies, using a field and its characteristic.

patterns.name: Script and page-structure tags
patterns.context: Script references and document-structure tags in webpage source code, alongside JavaScript types or paths.

patterns.name: C# namespaces and JSON
patterns.context: Uses System.Text.Json and declares a namespace in C# code.

7_2896.description: 激活分散在多种局部模式：常见英语“of the”词组、标题中的“in a”、数学论文的代数与域特征术语，以及代码中的 HTML、JavaScript 和 C# 结构；共同主题不明显。

patterns.name: “of”与“the”组合
patterns.context: 词组中介词“of”后接冠词“the”；有时延续为专名、书名或地点名。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书名、普通文本及学术文本

patterns.name: 标题中的“in a”
patterns.context: 介词“in”后接不定冠词“a”，后续为标题名词或短语。

patterns.name: 方法摘要 HTML 标记
patterns.context: Java 文档页面中方法摘要表格的标题和 HTML 属性。

patterns.name: 代数术语
patterns.context: 代数对象及其性质的连续描述。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的域与特征
patterns.context: 以域及其特征描述数学对象的适用条件。

patterns.name: 脚本与页面结构标签
patterns.context: 网页源码中脚本引用及文档结构标签，伴随 JavaScript 类型或路径。

patterns.name: C# 命名空间与 JSON
patterns.context: C# 代码中使用 System.Text.Json 并声明命名空间。

en.description: Activations are distributed across local phrases in mathematical terminology and papers, of/Land of in book titles, HTML method summaries, and seasonal descriptions in travel literature; no single semantic theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: Preposition of followed by a domain noun
patterns.context: Often occurs in noun phrases or book titles, with of followed by a feature, place, or object; different forms and meanings appear.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, encyclopedia bibliographies, literature, and online discussions

patterns.name: field in mathematical text
patterns.context: field refers to an algebraic field and often occurs with characteristic, local, number, and related terms.

patterns.name: Mathematical algebra terminology
patterns.context: Abstract algebra context, near a theorem, property, or name of a mathematical object; not all examples appear to be triggered by the same specific word.

patterns.name: Method Summary HTML markup
patterns.context: Method summary headings and table markup in HTML/documentation code.

patterns.name: Phrase related to critical points
patterns.context: Discusses critical points of a map f and their positions relative to special points.

patterns.name: aplectic tensor products terminology
patterns.context: A specialized term appears in the context of research on automorphic representations and GL notation.

patterns.name: Land of in book titles
patterns.context: A book or title uses Land of to introduce a place or topic.

patterns.name: Winter-summer alternation in narration
patterns.context: Travel writing uses seasonal contrast to describe warm, bright weather.

patterns.name: Asymptotic change and scale descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the asymptotic behavior of y, quasi-periodic change, and multiscale methods.

patterns.name: Changing World title phrase
patterns.context: Abstract title wording in a book subtitle.

7_2896.description: 激活分布在数学术语与论文叙述、书名中的 of/Land of、HTML 方法摘要、旅行文学季节描写等多种局部词组；没有单一语义主题能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 介词 of 后接领域名词
patterns.context: 多出现在名词短语或书名中，of 后接特征、地点或对象；不同词形和语义均有出现。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、百科书目、文学与网络讨论

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 field
patterns.context: field 指代代数中的域，常与 characteristic、local、number 等词搭配。

patterns.name: 数学代数术语
patterns.context: 抽象代数语境，附近有定理、性质或数学对象名称；未显示所有例子都由同一具体词触发。

patterns.name: Method Summary HTML 标记
patterns.context: HTML/文档代码中的方法摘要标题与表格标记。

patterns.name: critical points 相关词组
patterns.context: 讨论映射 f 的临界点及其相对特殊点的位置。

patterns.name: aplectic tensor products 术语
patterns.context: 专门术语出现在自守表示与 GL 记号的研究语境中。

patterns.name: 书名中的 Land of
patterns.context: 书名或标题中以 Land of 引出地点或主题。

patterns.name: 冬夏更替叙述
patterns.context: 旅行叙述中用季节对照描写天气温暖明亮。

patterns.name: 渐近变化与尺度描述
patterns.context: 描述 y 的渐近行为、准周期变化及多尺度方法。

patterns.name: 变化中的世界标题短语
patterns.context: 书籍副标题中的抽象标题措辞。

en.description: Activations do not represent a single stable concept: they are prominent in title phrases such as “Land of …” and similar regional or historical expressions, and also occur in various English of noun phrases. Other scattered patterns include obligation to act, literary abstract words, HTML script markup, and mathematical terminology; they cannot be unified by a single word sense.

patterns.name: “Land of …” phrases in titles
patterns.context: Appears in book titles, work titles, or fixed expressions with rhetorical coloring; not arbitrary occurrences of land in ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic titles, online discussions, rhetorical expressions

patterns.name: World/Changing World book titles
patterns.context: Embedded in a book title or subtitle, around title-style noun phrases such as “Security and Intelligence in a …”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic bibliographies, academic and policy publications

patterns.name: of + subject-area noun phrase
patterns.context: “of” is followed by a field-specific term, property, or noun in a title; in algebra papers it especially occurs within mathematical noun phrases.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, book titles, and work titles

patterns.name: Land/land forms and place-name-like expressions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates in expressions with a proper-name or generalized regional or historical sense, rather than the ordinary use referring to land.
patterns.domain: Titles, online commentary, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: Modal expression of the need to act
patterns.context: In a waste-disposal discussion, responds to a question about which option is supported by expressing that action must be taken.

patterns.name: Abstract noun time and action/waiting
patterns.context: Prose states that it is time to work and wait; depths appears in a metaphorical description of an inner essence.

patterns.name: Webpage script markup
patterns.context: Tags and JavaScript type fields in HTML document source; activation falls on script tags and adjacent markup.

patterns.name: Mathematical term critical points
patterns.context: Refers to critical points of a map in a mathematical discussion of curve maps and their resolution.

7_2896.description: 激活并非单一稳定概念：突出于标题中的“Land of …”及类似地域/时代表达，也见于多种英语 of 名词短语；另有行动义务、文学抽象词、HTML 脚本标记和数学术语等零散模式，无法由一个词义统一解释。

patterns.name: 标题中的“Land of …”短语
patterns.trigger: «Land»…« of»…« the»… 后接地名或名词，如 «Land»3« of»9« Lisp»、«Land»3« of»9« the»7« Hills»、«Land»1« of»9« the»8« Free»
patterns.context: 出现在书名、作品名或带修辞色彩的固定短语中；不是普通正文里的任意 land。
patterns.domain: 书目标题、网络讨论、修辞表达

patterns.name: World/Changing World 书名标题
patterns.context: 嵌在书名或副标题中，周围有 “Security and Intelligence in a …” 等标题式名词短语。
patterns.domain: 百科书目、学术与政策出版物

patterns.name: of + 学科名词短语
patterns.trigger: « of»3« Burn»1«side»2 algebras；« of»6« characteristic»5« zero»；« of»…« Hills»；« of»…« Lisp»
patterns.context: “of”后接领域术语、性质或标题中的名词；在代数论文中尤其出现在数学名词短语内部。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、书名与作品标题

patterns.name: Land/land 词形与地名式表达
patterns.context: 激活集中在带专名或概括地域、时代意味的表达，而非明确指称土地的普通用法。
patterns.domain: 标题、网络评论及书目文字

patterns.name: 需要采取行动的情态表达
patterns.context: 废物处置讨论中，回应“支持哪种方案”的追问，表达必须采取行动。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、公共议题评论

patterns.name: 抽象名词 time 与行动/等待
patterns.context: 散文中出现“是时候去工作和等待”的判断；depths 位于关于内在本质的比喻性描述中。

patterns.name: 网页脚本标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档源码中的标签和 JavaScript 类型字段；激活落在脚本标签及相邻标记。

patterns.name: critical points 数学术语
patterns.context: 关于曲线映射及其分辨率的数学论述中，指映射的临界点。

en.description: Activations are distributed across structural markers in code and HTML, bibliographies or title-like text, and terminology in mathematics papers. “Land” recurs in two book titles, but the triggers in the mathematical passages vary; overall, there is no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Code, markup, and structural boundaries
patterns.context: In code or HTML documents, the neuron responds to markers, punctuation, and line breaks; the specific trigger positions differ across passages.

patterns.name: Titles, tables of contents, and book-like text
patterns.context: Titles, bibliography entries, or quoted book titles, especially noun phrases and title text; paragraph 6 marks only “Land of Lisp” in a book title.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia bibliographies, web documents, and Hacker News quotes

patterns.name: Land in book titles
patterns.context: Occurs in book titles or title-like phrases; the two instances are a bibliography title and a quoted computer book title.

patterns.name: Terms and entities in academic prose
patterns.context: In mathematics papers, activation occurs near terminology, conceptual descriptions, and related nouns; triggers are distributed, with no single stable local word form apparent.

7_2896.description: 激活分布于代码和 HTML 的结构标记、书目或标题式文本，以及数学论文中的术语；“Land”在两段书名中重复出现，但数学段落的触发词各异，整体未呈现单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 代码、标记与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或 HTML 文档中，神经元响应标记、标点及换行等结构性 token；不同段落中具体触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 标题、目录与书名式文本
patterns.trigger: «Method Summary»、«Birds of the Loch and Mountain»、«Land of the Hills and the Glens»、«Land of Lisp»
patterns.context: 标题、书目条目或被引用的书名中，尤其是名词短语和标题文字；第6段仅标记书名中的“Land of Lisp”。
patterns.domain: 维基百科书目、网页文档及 Hacker News 引文

patterns.name: 书名中的 Land
patterns.context: 出现在书名或书名式短语中；两处分别为书目中的书名及被引用的计算机书名。

patterns.name: 学术叙述中的术语与实体
patterns.context: 数学论文文本中，术语、概念描述及相关名词附近出现激活；触发词分散，未显示单一稳定的局部词形。
