en.description: Strong activations primarily occur on centrifugation terminology (especially centrifugation) and de in multilingual proper names; there are also sporadic activations on line breaks, web fields, and fragments of several proper names and abbreviations, with no unified context.

patterns.name: Centrifugation-related terminology
patterns.context: When centrifugation operations or method names appear; sometimes paired with words such as “gradient” and “density”

patterns.name: de in personal names
patterns.context: In Portuguese or French names and place names, with de followed by a proper name; often at the start of a title or entry

patterns.name: Token fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across different proper names, abbreviations, or cross-word fragments, with no stable shared context
patterns.domain: Biomedical, satellite encyclopedia, web text, etc.

patterns.name: Line breaks and entry-title formatting
patterns.context: Blank lines or line breaks appear after titles or entry names; some markers occur next to line breaks
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, parliamentary texts, web text

patterns.name: Experimental materials and chemical formulas
patterns.context: Descriptions of solution composition or experimental steps after centrifugation; only sporadic activations occur near chemical formulas

patterns.name: Social-icon web header
patterns.context: A web page or template header field followed by film promotional copy

7_2931.description: 强激活主要落在离心术语（尤其 centrifugation）及多语种专名中的 de；另有换行、网页字段和若干专名/缩写片段的零散激活，未形成统一上下文。

patterns.name: 离心相关术语
patterns.context: 离心操作或方法名称出现时；有时与“gradient”“density”等词搭配

patterns.name: 人名中的 de
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语或法语姓名、地名中，de 后接专名；常位于标题或条目开头

patterns.name: 特定词内的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活散布于不同专名、缩写或跨词片段，未见稳定共同上下文
patterns.domain: 生物医学、卫星百科、网页文本等

patterns.name: 换行与条目标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或条目名后出现空行、换行，部分标记与换行相邻
patterns.domain: 百科条目、议会文本、网页文本

patterns.name: 实验材料与化学式
patterns.context: 离心后描述溶液组成或实验步骤，化学式附近仅有零散激活

patterns.name: 社交图标网页头部
patterns.context: 网页或模板头部字段，后接电影宣传文案

en.concept: Centrifugation terms and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The most consistent strong trigger is “centrifugation” in experimental text, especially centrifugation methods. Other samples sporadically mark “de” and internal fragments in Portuguese/French text or personal and place names, webpage fields, and technical terms in encyclopedias, without forming a stable unified pattern.

patterns.name: Centrifugation terminology
patterns.context: The term itself triggers directly in sentences describing separation, purification, or experimental steps; [1] also contains “gradient centrifugation processes”.

patterns.name: Internal Portuguese fragments and accented characters
patterns.context: In Portuguese text, activation falls on subword fragments within words, especially words containing accented letters and common fragments such as “de”; sentence-initial “A” and adjacent word fragments also appear.

patterns.name: de and word fragments in personal names
patterns.context: In encyclopedia article titles or opening sentences, “de” and neighboring fragments in personal and place names are commonly marked; not all such fragments activate with equal strength.

patterns.name: de la in French phrases
patterns.context: In French institutional-name phrases, “de la” and subword fragments of adjacent words are marked after webpage header fields.

patterns.name: Internal fragments related to centrifugation
patterns.context: In experimental-method passages containing salt formulations, numbers, and chemical formulas, numbers and symbols are also weakly marked; the main strong activation remains on centrifugation terminology.

patterns.name: Terms and structural fields in satellite articles
patterns.context: When an encyclopedia article introduces a Colombian satellite and its features, activation falls on internal fragments of technical terms and section headings.

patterns.name: Webpage markup and trailer text
patterns.context: French movie-trailer titles and descriptions follow webpage template/social-icon fields; marking spans formatting fields and some internal word fragments.

7_2931.concept: 离心术语与零散词片段
7_2931.description: 最一致的强触发是实验文本中的“centrifugation”，尤其离心分离方法；其余样本分散地标记葡语/法语或人名地名中的“de”及词内片段、网页字段和百科技术词，未形成稳定统一模式。

patterns.name: 离心分离术语
patterns.context: 词语本身直接触发，出现在描述分离、纯化或实验步骤的句子中；[1]还出现“gradient centrifugation processes”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验方法、科研论文

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段与重音字符
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中，激活落在词内子词片段，尤其含重音字母的词及“de”等常见片段；也有句首“A”与相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 人名中的 de 与词片段
patterns.trigger: «de»10，见“Diego de Branco”“Col de Pelouse”“Pierre de Gondi”；另有«Sol»5、«Pel»2、«Gond»2等
patterns.context: 百科条目标题或首句的人名、地名中，常见介词“de”及其前后词片段被标记；并非所有此类片段激活强度相同。

patterns.name: 法语短语中的 de la
patterns.context: 法语机构名称短语中，“de la”及其相邻词的子词片段被标记，位于网页头部字段之后。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法语机构名称

patterns.name: 离心相关的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «NaCl»等配方符号及“«3»3”“«7»2”；同段稍后出现«centrifugation»9
patterns.context: 盐类配方、数字和化学式的实验方法段落中，数字/符号也有弱标记；主要强激活仍在离心术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验论文、化学配方

patterns.name: 卫星条目中的术语与结构字段
patterns.context: 百科条目介绍哥伦比亚卫星及其特征时，激活落在技术术语内部片段和小节标题。

patterns.name: 网页标记与预告片文本
patterns.context: 网页模板/社交图标字段后接法语电影预告片标题与简介，标记横跨格式字段及部分词内片段。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本、电影简介

en.description: The most stable trigger is “centrifugation” in experimental methods, commonly in sample processing, purification, or recovery. Other experimental-text signals include buffers and chemical formulas. A few activations fall on Portuguese names, French place names, and webpage structural markers, which are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Centrifugation step terminology
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe samples, cells, or tissues being centrifuged; this may occur alongside density gradients, recovery, or other experimental steps

patterns.name: Fragments in Portuguese names
patterns.context: Words in Portuguese biographical entries or titles are split into marked subwords; activation falls on names and related Portuguese text fragments

patterns.name: Fragments in French place names
patterns.context: French place names or phrases contain “de” and adjacent name fragments

patterns.name: Special markers and structured webpage headers
patterns.context: Webpages or corpus-scraped text begin with structured fields, title markers, and line breaks

patterns.name: PolyFlo product-name fragments
patterns.context: Protein purification method descriptions contain a sequence of PolyFlo-related terms

patterns.name: Common experimental buffers
patterns.context: Buffer components are mentioned while describing experimental sample processing or purification

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and numeric fragments
patterns.context: Chemical formulas, concentrations, or numbers in salt formulations are presented as split fragments

patterns.name: Biomedical headings and experimental-procedure wording
patterns.context: Section headings in experimental reports or sample-collection descriptions; the passage also contains a centrifugation step

patterns.name: Ordinary function words in English sentences
patterns.context: Ordinary syntactic words near the main activating term, with no independent, stable trigger condition observed

patterns.name: Residual fragments without a clear shared explanation
patterns.context: Isolated word fragments or name/text fragments whose trigger relationship is uncertain beyond the listed language, webpage-structure, or experimental contexts

7_2931.description: 最稳定的触发是实验方法中的“centrifugation”，常见于样品处理、纯化或回收；另有缓冲液、化学式等实验文本信号。少数激活落在葡语姓名、法语地名及网页结构标记上，难以归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 离心步骤术语
patterns.context: 实验方法中描述样品、细胞或组织经离心处理；可能与密度梯度、回收或其他实验步骤相邻

patterns.name: 葡语人名中的片段
patterns.context: 葡语人物条目或标题中的词语被拆成子词标记；激活落在姓名及相关葡语文本片段上

patterns.name: 法语地名中的片段
patterns.context: 法语地名或法语短语中出现“de”及相邻名称片段

patterns.name: 特殊标记与结构化网页头
patterns.context: 网页或语料抓取文本以结构化字段、标题标记及换行开始

patterns.name: PolyFlo产品名片段
patterns.context: 蛋白纯化方法描述中出现串联 PolyFlo 相关术语

patterns.name: 常见实验缓冲液
patterns.context: 描述实验样品处理或纯化时提及缓冲液成分

patterns.name: 化学式和数字碎片
patterns.context: 盐类配方中化学式、浓度或数字被拆分呈现

patterns.name: 生物医学标题与实验流程用语
patterns.context: 实验报告的分节标题或样本采集描述；该段另有离心步骤

patterns.name: 英文句中普通功能词
patterns.context: 主激活术语邻近的普通句法词，未见独立且稳定的触发条件

patterns.name: 无明确共同解释的残余片段
patterns.context: 孤立词片段或名称/文本碎片，除已列的语种、网页结构或实验语境外，触发关系不确定

en.description: Activations cluster around two types of local strings: de in French or Portuguese proper names, dates, and expressions; centrifugation in biomedical method descriptions; and 3 in digit strings within chemical formulas.

patterns.name: de in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese date expressions such as “período de sessões” and “12 de Novembro”, or in place and institution names; capitalization may be De.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Portuguese Wikipedia entries, website metadata

patterns.name: de in French proper names
patterns.context: Appears in French personal or place names, such as “Louis de Roll”, “Col de Pelouse”, and “Agence de la biomédecine”; the trigger word is not necessarily sentence-initial.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries about people and places, French-language website content

patterns.name: centrifugation in centrifugation terminology
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of scientific methods such as “gradient centrifugation” or “differential centrifugation”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, experimental methods, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Digit 3 in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Occurs in digit strings in inorganic salt formulas, for example MgSO~34~ and 0.7 g; local number formatting and adjacent element symbols form the context.
patterns.domain: Reagent or buffer recipes in biomedical papers

7_2931.concept: 特定字符串与格式模式
7_2931.description: 激活集中于两类局部字符串：法语或葡语专名、日期及表达中的 de；生物医学方法描述中的 centrifugation；另有化学式数字串中的 3。

patterns.name: 葡语词中的 de
patterns.context: 出现在葡语日期表达“período de sessões”“12 de Novembro”或地名、机构名中；大小写可为 De。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡语维基百科条目、网站元数据

patterns.name: 法语专名中的 de
patterns.context: 出现在法语姓名或地名中，如“Louis de Roll”“Col de Pelouse”“Agence de la biomédecine”；触发词本身不一定是句首。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物与地名条目、法语网站内容

patterns.name: 离心术语中的 centrifugation
patterns.context: 出现在“gradient centrifugation”或“differential centrifugation”等科学方法描述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、实验方法与科研摘要

patterns.name: 化学式中的数字 3
patterns.context: 位于无机盐化学式的数字串中，例如 MgSO~34~、0.7 g；局部数字格式和相邻元素符号构成上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的试剂或缓冲液配方

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the word “centrifugation” and its split forms across experimental procedures, technical descriptions, and research contexts; it also activates on “de” in the name “de Roll” and in Portuguese phrases.

patterns.name: Centrifugation-related terminology
patterns.context: The term appears in experimental methods, procedural descriptions, or technical explanations; no fixed collocation is required, and it may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experiments and patent technical text

patterns.name: de Roll in a personal name
patterns.context: The name appears repeatedly, with activation focused on the connective «de».

patterns.name: de in Portuguese phrases
patterns.context: Appears in the Portuguese passage “Alberto do período de sessões” as a preposition within the phrase.

7_2931.description: 主要对“centrifugation”一词及其拆分形式强烈响应，涵盖实验流程、技术说明和科研语境；另在姓名“de Roll”和葡语短语中的“de”上激活。

patterns.name: 离心相关术语
patterns.context: 词项出现在实验方法、流程描述或技术说明中；不要求固定搭配，可能被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 de Roll
patterns.context: 姓名重复出现，重音落在连接词 «de»。

patterns.name: 葡语短语中的 de
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语片段“Alberto do período de sessões”中，是短语内的介词。

en.description: Activations are dispersed across multiple contexts: the English contraction ’ll, hl in names, the tens digit in math problems, and legal titles or phrasing, program output, and experimental terminology; no stable common semantics link these patterns.

patterns.name: ll in contractions with an apostrophe
patterns.context: Appears in English contractions such as we’ll or you’ll; occurs across several unrelated contexts

patterns.name: hl syllable in names
patterns.context: Appears within the spelling of personal names or surnames, such as Ahlgren, Kunstmann and Uhl, Coghlan, and Kniehl
patterns.domain: Academic citations, legal cases, and proper names in body text

patterns.name: tens digit in math problems
patterns.context: The prompt asks for the tens digit of a number, surrounded by equations and numbers

patterns.name: Background in document titles
patterns.context: The uppercase heading BACKGROUND appears as a section title in a legal document after a line break

patterns.name: Standard error in program output
patterns.context: Explains that an index entry is generated and written to stderr when register conditions are met

patterns.name: broad power in legal opinions
patterns.context: Discusses a court’s authority under Rule 38 to sanction frivolous or unreasonable appeals

patterns.name: Centrifugation in experimental procedures
patterns.context: Compares the purity and recovery of products obtained by chromatography with those obtained by gradient centrifugation

7_2931.description: 激活分散在多种语境：英语缩写’ll、人名中的hl、数学题的tens digit，以及法律标题/措辞、程序输出和实验术语；未见这些模式之间稳定的共同语义。

patterns.name: 撇号缩写中的 ll
patterns.context: 出现在 we’ll 或 you’ll 等英语缩写中；多个非相关语境都出现

patterns.name: 姓名中的 hl 音节
patterns.context: 出现在人名或姓氏的拼写内部，如 Ahlgren、Kunstmann and Uhl、Coghlan、Kniehl
patterns.domain: 学术引文、法律判例及正文中的专名

patterns.name: 数学题中的 tens digit
patterns.context: 以询问某个数的十位数字为题干，周围有算式和数字

patterns.name: 文档标题中的背景
patterns.context: 换行后以大写标题 BACKGROUND 作为法律文档章节标题

patterns.name: 程序输出中的标准错误
patterns.context: 说明寄存器条件满足时生成索引项并输出到 stderr

patterns.name: 法律意见中的 broad power
patterns.context: 讨论法院依据 Rule 38 对轻率或无理上诉进行制裁的权限

patterns.name: 实验流程中的离心
patterns.context: 比较色谱流程所得产品的纯度与回收率和梯度离心流程

en.description: Activations are dispersed across multiple local patterns: expressions with another, maxima in scientific writing, math problems and arithmetic, and question-and-answer phrasing; several isolated words are also difficult to explain in a unified way. No single stable theme covers all fragments.

patterns.name: another／another post
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “another post earlier”, “another optimal way”, and “another rough patch”; it can modify a post, method, or abstract event.

patterns.name: maxima
patterns.context: Describes maxima of functions, spectra, or data in mathematical or scientific contexts; in both instances it is adjacent to local references to peaks.

patterns.name: Math tokens and formulas
patterns.context: Problem statements and computational expressions alternate in math problems, proofs, or arithmetic exercises.

patterns.name: Question-and-answer phrasing
patterns.context: Organized as a question, solution, answer, or review of a solution process; some triggers are unrelated to the specific topic.

patterns.name: Unexplained local activations
patterns.context: These strongly activated words belong to different expressions or technical terms and cannot be reliably explained by the patterns above.

7_2931.description: 激活分散在多种局部模式：another 的表达、科学文中的 maxima、数学问题与算术，以及问答措辞；另有若干孤立词无法统一解释。没有单一稳定主题能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: another／another post
patterns.context: 出现在“another post earlier”“another optimal way”“another rough patch”等表达中；既可修饰帖子、方法，也可修饰抽象事件。

patterns.name: maxima
patterns.context: 数学或科学语境中描述函数、光谱或数据的最大值；两处均紧邻局部峰值相关表述。

patterns.name: 数学 token 与公式
patterns.context: 数学问题、证明或算术练习中，问题陈述与计算表达式交替出现。

patterns.name: 问答中的提问与回答措辞
patterns.context: 以提问、求解、回答或回顾解决过程的方式组织；部分触发与具体主题无关。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些强激活词分属不同表达或技术术语，无法由上述模式可靠解释。

en.concept: Introductory and classification phrasing in patent texts
en.description: The core activation is another introducing a new item in patent texts, especially another embodiment/example/object and variants such as Yet/Still another; there is also a strong response to generally called in term-definition sentences.

patterns.name: Patent-style introduction of another item
patterns.context: Often occurs at a paragraph or sentence transition, followed by nouns such as invention, embodiment, example, limitation, or type; it serves as a transition introducing another invention objective, embodiment, or example.

patterns.name: another in patent objective statements
patterns.context: Follows objective statements such as “It is … object of [the/this] invention to provide …”, indicating an additional objective of the invention; the fragments also include “Still another object”.
patterns.domain: Statements of the invention’s objectives in patent specifications

patterns.name: generally called in patent term-classification definitions
patterns.context: Used to explain what a term or component is collectively called; occurs twice and includes “herein”.

patterns.name: Other uses of another
patterns.context: Introduces a limitation in “Yet another limitation” or directly introduces “another invention”. These are common collocations outside embodiments, objectives, or examples.
patterns.domain: Patent background narratives and prior-art descriptions

7_2931.concept: 专利文本中的引出与分类措辞
7_2931.description: 激活核心是专利文本中引出新项的 another，尤其 another embodiment/example/object，以及 Yet/Still another 变体；另对术语定义句中的 generally called 强烈响应。

patterns.name: 专利式引出另一项内容
patterns.context: 常位于段落或句子转折处，后接 invention、embodiment、example、limitation、type 等名词；作为引出另一项发明目的、实施例或例子的过渡语。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与说明书

patterns.name: 专利目的句中的 another
patterns.context: 接在“It is … object of [the/this] invention to provide …”等目的句式中，表示又一个发明目的；片段中也有“Still another object”。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书的发明目的陈述

patterns.name: 专利术语分类定义中的 generally called
patterns.context: 用于说明术语或部件被统称为何种名称；出现两次并带有 “herein”。

patterns.name: 其他 another 用法
patterns.context: 与“Yet another limitation”搭配引出限制；或直接引出“another invention”。不属于实施例、目的或 example 的常见搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景叙述与现有技术说明

en.concept: Independence and state qualifications in technical descriptions
en.description: The most robust cross-fragment cue is independently (3, 5, 8, 10); temporarily (4, 6) and generally (2, 9) each recur. Other responses are scattered across linking verbs, springs, shifting gears, vehicle positioning, and plunger descriptions in patents, without forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: Describes components, motion, systems, or states as independent of one another, commonly in “independently of” or “independently and separately”; [8] also describes a system remaining independently in respective states.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions; also a Wikipedia definition of thermodynamics

patterns.name: temporarily
patterns.context: Modifies temporary absorption or rerouting processes; [4] temporarily absorbs a speed difference, while [6] temporarily redirects torque through another gear set.

patterns.name: generally
patterns.context: Indicates an approximate or typical shape or orientation in descriptions of components or geometry, such as “generally vertical” and “generally circular”.

patterns.name: Determining position or state
patterns.context: Patent descriptions use linking verbs to introduce positions determined by direction, or to describe equipment configuration and state; this may simply be sporadic activation associated with common patent phrasing.

patterns.name: Mechanical spring and sliding components
patterns.context: A sliding shutter moves a slider and deforms or loads a torsion spring; this occurs in only one passage and may be a local mechanical-terminology pattern.

patterns.name: Independent suspension motion
patterns.context: Each vehicle wheel moves up and down independently relative to the frame; “independently” also fits the cross-fragment pattern.

patterns.name: Fabric folding and plunger
patterns.context: Describes a process of folding fabric and inserting it with a plunger to form a bag; this example does not contain the recurring high-response words above and stands alone.

patterns.name: Paths operating independently
patterns.context: Two paper-feed paths in an adhesive-processing operation function independently of one another.

patterns.name: Gear-shift rerouting
patterns.context: During a shift between gears within the same gear set, torque is temporarily transmitted through another gear set.

patterns.name: Independent thermodynamic states
patterns.context: Discusses systems on either side of a wall of interest each maintaining their previous state; this matches the “independently” pattern but concerns a different topic.

patterns.name: Independent configuration of multiple shafts
patterns.context: Each shaft in a multi-shaft gas turbine power plant is configured independently; this matches the “independently” pattern.

patterns.name: Other unclear patent descriptions
patterns.context: [1] Vehicle front, rear, left, and right positions are determined by the steering direction; [9] describes the housing and end shape of a plunger device. The fragments alone do not clearly link them to other triggers.

7_2931.concept: 技术描述中的独立性与状态限定
7_2931.description: 最稳健的跨段线索是 independently（3、5、8、10）；temporarily（4、6）与 generally（2、9）各有重复。其余响应散见专利中的系动词、弹簧、换挡、车辆定位及柱塞描述，未形成统一语义。

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: 描述部件、运动、系统或状态彼此独立，常见于“independently of”或“independently and separately”；[8]也有系统保持 independently in respective states。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明；另有维基百科热力学定义

patterns.name: temporarily
patterns.context: 修饰暂时发生的吸收或改道过程；[4]暂时吸收速度差，[6]暂时经另一齿轮组重新导引扭矩。

patterns.name: generally
patterns.context: 在部件或几何描述中表示大致、通常的形状或方位，如“generally vertical”“generally circular”。

patterns.name: 判定位置或状态
patterns.context: 专利说明中用系动词引出由方向决定的位置，或描述设备构成、状态；这可能只是与高频专利句式相关的零散触发。

patterns.name: 机械弹簧与滑动部件
patterns.context: 滑动快门带动滑块并使扭簧变形或蓄力；仅此段出现，可能是局部机械术语模式。

patterns.name: 独立悬架运动
patterns.context: 车辆各车轮相对车架独立上下运动；“independently”也符合跨段模式。

patterns.name: 织物折叠与柱塞
patterns.context: 描述将织物折叠并以柱塞插入、成袋的工艺；该处未见上述重复高响应词，单独成例。

patterns.name: 路径各自运作
patterns.trigger: “transport path … functions independently of a transport path”
patterns.context: 粘合加工中的两条纸张输送路径彼此独立运作。

patterns.name: 齿轮换挡改道
patterns.context: 同一齿轮组内跨挡位换挡时，扭矩暂时经另一齿轮组传递。

patterns.name: 热力学状态独立
patterns.trigger: “remain independently in their own previously established respective states”
patterns.context: 讨论感兴趣壁面两侧系统各自保持先前状态；与“independently”模式一致，但主题不同。

patterns.name: 多轴设备独立设置
patterns.context: 多轴燃气轮机发电厂中，各轴分别独立配置；与“independently”模式一致。

patterns.name: 未明的其余专利描述
patterns.trigger: 未见清楚重复的高响应子串
patterns.context: [1]车辆前后左右位置依转向方向判定；[9]描述柱塞装置外壳与端部形状。仅凭片段难与其他触发归并。
patterns.domain: 车辆定位及柱塞装置专利

en.description: Activations are dispersed across varied semantics and styles: hand positions, set intersection properties, stable conveyance, and patent descriptions of components, motion, position, and design; there is also lawyer discipline. No unified trigger or reliable shared semantics is apparent.

patterns.name: hands
patterns.context: Describes the position of arms, hands, or posture; activations also occur on adjacent «one or both your» and «clasped».

patterns.name: Set intersection properties
patterns.context: Definitions or properties of families of sets and their subfamilies.

patterns.name: Stable paper conveyance
patterns.context: Compares the quantity and stability of paper conveyance under different binding processes.

patterns.name: Positioning block and component configuration
patterns.context: Describes the movement of a positioning block relative to a backing plate and guide rail, and explains its purpose in receiving a socket.

patterns.name: Vehicle wheel layout
patterns.context: Introduces the configuration of a vehicle’s front and rear wheels and related patent solutions.

patterns.name: Golf club performance
patterns.context: Discusses club design, swing, or the measurement and coordination of ball-flight height.

patterns.name: Welded cutting-head structure
patterns.context: Describes the blank area, materials, and welding process at the joint between a cutting tip and a shank.

patterns.name: Lawyer discipline
patterns.context: When a lawyer fails to repay an excess amount, they are required to show why they should not be struck from the roll of attorneys.

patterns.name: Motion relationships of movable components
patterns.context: Describes how a storage-box door rotates or moves relative to the box, and how it is raised and stowed.

patterns.name: Position deviation and failed correction
patterns.context: Describes an overlap in a packaging container deviating from its intended position and attempts to correct it potentially failing.

7_2931.description: 激活分散于多种语义与文体：手部姿势、集合交叉性质、稳定传送，以及专利部件、运动、位置和设计描述；另有律师纪律处分。未见统一触发词或可靠共同语义。

patterns.name: hands
patterns.context: 描述手臂、双手或姿势的位置；激活也落在相邻的«one or both your»和«clasped»上。

patterns.name: 集合论交叉性质
patterns.context: 集合族及其子族的定义或性质说明。

patterns.name: 稳定传送纸张
patterns.context: 比较不同装订工艺下纸张传送的数量和稳定性。

patterns.name: 定位块与部件配置
patterns.context: 描述定位块相对背板和导轨的运动，并说明其接收插座的用途。

patterns.name: 车辆车轮布局
patterns.context: 介绍车辆前后轮的配置及相关专利方案。

patterns.name: 高尔夫球杆性能
patterns.context: 讨论球杆设计、挥杆或击球轨迹高度的测量与协调。

patterns.name: 切削头焊接结构
patterns.context: 描述切削刀尖与柄部结合处的空白区、材料及焊接工艺。

patterns.name: 律师纪律处分
patterns.context: 律师未偿还超额款项时，要求其说明为何不应从执业名册除名。

patterns.name: 活动部件运动关系
patterns.context: 描述储物箱门相对箱体转动或移动、升起和收纳的方式。

patterns.name: 位置偏差与纠正失败
patterns.context: 描述包装容器重叠部分偏离预定位置，以及纠正尝试可能失败。

en.description: Activations often occur on words such as remain/remained that denote a continuing or unchanged state, and also on another in one another and parties in legal contexts; these triggers belong to distinct semantics and contexts.

patterns.name: remain/residual state
patterns.context: Describes something or a state continuing, remaining unchanged, or not being covered; appears in legal, patent, and narrative texts.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, patent specifications, general narratives

patterns.name: one another / reciprocal relationship
patterns.context: Describes a reciprocal relationship or separation among multiple objects; the trigger another spans a phrase.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications involving paper conveyance or equipment components

patterns.name: parties / litigants
patterns.context: Refers to the parties to a legal dispute, near discussion of issues and legal provisions.

7_2931.description: 激活多出现在持续或未变化状态的 remain/remained 一类词上，也见于 one another 的另一方，以及法律语境中的 parties；这些触发形式分属不同语义和语境。

patterns.name: remain/残留状态
patterns.context: 描述某物或状态继续保持、不改变或未被覆盖；在法律、专利和叙事文本中均出现。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利说明书、一般叙事

patterns.name: one another / 相互关系
patterns.context: 描述多个对象之间的相互关系或彼此分离，触发跨越短语的另一（another）。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，涉及纸张输送或设备部件

patterns.name: parties / 诉讼双方
patterns.context: 法律争议中指涉诉讼双方，邻近讨论争点与法律条文。

en.description: Activations are distributed across patent, legal, religious, and poetic contexts, often falling on the continuation, maintenance, or change of a state or relationship and its conditions (such as remain, stand, shift, moved, unpaid). However, there is no clear shared trigger pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Entity moved and then reset/repositioned
patterns.context: After the position of a device or workpiece changes, the area or parameters must be reset.

patterns.name: Procedural statements about dates and charges
patterns.context: In a criminal case narrative, charges from different dates are consolidated.

patterns.name: Uncovered areas remain unchanged
patterns.context: Describes areas missed by a device and their unchanged state.

patterns.name: Debt remains unpaid
patterns.context: A statute discusses the property owner's liability when a bill remains unpaid.

patterns.name: Ordinary and inevitable circumstances
patterns.context: In legal/tax discussion, assesses whether a failure is due to the nature of the business and whether it could be expected.

patterns.name: Multiple objects maintain their relative positions
patterns.context: During the feeding of folded, bound sheets of paper, the sheets do not noticeably shift relative to one another.

patterns.name: Staying within a boundary
patterns.context: A machining path or groove must be confined to the edge of a lens.

patterns.name: Standing/gathering together
patterns.context: A religious context depicts believers standing together before God after the resurrection.

patterns.name: Document signing and property location
patterns.context: A real-estate transfer case describes the preparation and signing of a deed and the condition of the property.

patterns.name: Preserving beauty to prevent decline
patterns.context: A poem urges cherishing beauty and preventing it from being damaged by time.

7_2931.description: 激活分散于专利、法律、宗教与诗歌语境，常落在状态或关系的持续、保持、改变及其条件上（如 remain、stand、shift、moved、unpaid）；但不存在贯穿全部段落的明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 实体移动后重新设定/复位
patterns.trigger: “body is moved”; “area set … must be set again”
patterns.context: 设备或工件位置改变后，需要重新设定区域或参数。

patterns.name: 日期与指控的程序性陈述
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中归并不同日期的指控。

patterns.name: 未覆盖区域保持原状
patterns.trigger: “intermediate strip remains at the original, low road level”
patterns.context: 描述设备遗漏的地带及其未被改变的状态。

patterns.name: 欠款仍未支付
patterns.context: 法律条文讨论账单未付时财产所有人的责任。

patterns.name: 通常且必然发生的情形
patterns.context: 法律/税务论述中判断某种失败是否属业务性质所致、是否可预期。

patterns.name: 多个物件相互保持位置
patterns.context: 折叠、装订的纸张输送时，纸张之间不发生明显位移。

patterns.name: 保持在边界范围内
patterns.trigger: “groove … made to remain within the boundaries”
patterns.context: 加工轨迹或槽需限制在透镜边缘范围内。

patterns.name: 共同站立/聚集
patterns.context: 宗教语境描写复活后信徒共同在上帝面前。

patterns.name: 文书签署与财产位置
patterns.context: 地产转让案件中叙述契据的制作、签署及物业状况。

patterns.name: 保存美好以避免衰败
patterns.context: 诗歌劝诫珍藏美貌、避免其随时间损毁。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal decisions and contracts, patent technical descriptions, overdue taxes, and poetry. Local high activations often occur on words denoting a continuing or unchanged state, degree or boundary, equipment adjustment, and legal relationships; there are also distinctive patterns involving poetic imagery and damage classification that are difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Long-term or continuing state
patterns.context: Involves a state persisting over time, remaining unchanged, or continuing up to a certain point; appears in both legal discussions and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Boundaries of degree or scope
patterns.context: Specifies the degree or spatial scope of a property, or a requirement that continues to be met as conditions change

patterns.name: Legal rights, responsibilities, and adjudicative relationships
patterns.context: Legal texts describe parties, rights and obligations, claims, or allocation of liability; the passage contains other strongly activated words as well
patterns.domain: Decisions, contracts, legal definitions, and quotations

patterns.name: Binary classification of damage states and findings of fact
patterns.context: Compares whether damage is permanent or temporary and classifies the determination as a question of fact

patterns.name: Emotion and change in poetry
patterns.context: Stanzas and lyrical contexts expressing sadness, solemnity, or a changing world

patterns.name: Movement, control, or adjustment of technical equipment
patterns.context: Describes machining, resetting after a change in equipment position, or controlling the orientation of a component

patterns.name: Overdue unpaid taxes
patterns.context: Taxes remain unpaid after their due date, with associated penalties and interest also described

patterns.name: Degree or quantity modifiers in legal texts
patterns.context: Discusses the standards for measuring damages and distinguishes permanent from temporary damage

patterns.name: Local stanza numbers or structural markers
patterns.context: Roman numerals mark divisions of a poem; there is no clear independent evidence that the numbering itself triggers activation

7_2931.description: 激活分布于法律裁判与合同、专利技术说明、税款逾期和诗歌。局部高激活常落在持续/未改变状态、程度或边界、设备调整与法律关系词；另有诗歌意象及损害分类等独特模式，难归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 长期或持续状态
patterns.trigger: “for the time being”中的«being»10；“no longer”中的«longer»9；“remain”9；“remain unpaid”中的«unpaid»9
patterns.context: 涉及状态在一段时间内持续、尚未改变或已延续到某个时间点；既可出现在法律论述，也可出现在技术说明

patterns.name: 程度或范围的边界
patterns.trigger: «slightest»9、“within the boundaries”、“must be set again whenever”、“always”9
patterns.context: 说明某属性的程度、空间范围，或条件变化下持续满足的要求

patterns.name: 法律权利、责任及裁判关系
patterns.trigger: «parties»5、“should be granted a divorce”、“costs and liabilities”、“borne and paid”、“party against whom a witness is produced”、“seeks to set aside a judgment”
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述当事人、权利义务、诉讼请求或责任分配；段内另有较强词语激活
patterns.domain: 判决、合同、法律定义及引文

patterns.name: 损害状态的二分及事实认定
patterns.context: 比较损害是永久还是暂时，并将判断归为事实问题

patterns.name: 诗歌中的情绪与变化
patterns.trigger: “heavy heart”中的«heart»6、“solemnly”7、“face of all the world is changed”中的«world»5及«is»9
patterns.context: 诗歌分节、抒情语境，表达悲伤、庄严感或世界发生变化

patterns.name: 技术设备的运动、控制或调整
patterns.context: 说明机械加工、设备位置变化后重新设定，或控制部件朝向

patterns.name: 税款逾期未缴
patterns.context: 税款超过到期日仍未支付，连带描述罚款与利息

patterns.name: 法律文本中的程度或量值修饰
patterns.context: 讨论损害赔偿的衡量标准，并区分永久与暂时损害

patterns.name: 局部诗节编号或结构标记
patterns.context: 以罗马数字标记诗歌分节；未见编号本身有明确独立触发证据

en.description: Activations have no unified semantic theme: they are scattered across legal, patent, and poetic texts, falling respectively on debt allocation, temporary states, change, inclusion, sharing, boundaries, expectation, disappointment, periodicity, and judicial closing language.

patterns.name: “owed” debt relationship
patterns.context: Describes a debt as held by a creditor or similar party; contracts, leases, notes, debt instruments, and attorney-fee clauses also appear.

patterns.name: Temporary state in a marital judgment
patterns.context: After findings concerning divorce, cruel treatment, or similar matters, mentions the “current/temporary” situation.

patterns.name: The world changing and imagery of standing
patterns.context: Poetic context; surrounded by first-person, emotional, or solemn lyrical language.

patterns.name: Inclusion of criminal elements
patterns.context: Explains how a lesser offense is included in a greater offense, based on the elements and statutory provisions.

patterns.name: Sharing and payment of costs and responsibility
patterns.context: An agreement lists each party’s share of interests and specifies who bears and pays operating costs and responsibilities.
patterns.domain: Commercial or operating agreement, legal text

patterns.name: Staying within a boundary
patterns.context: When machining a groove, it must remain within the edge of the lens.

patterns.name: Ordinarily and inevitably expected
patterns.context: Discusses whether an inventory valuation error stems from the nature of the business and whether it could ordinarily and inevitably be expected.

patterns.name: Disappointment leading to low spirits
patterns.context: Grouped with expressions about life’s pains and thwarted ambitions; describes emotional ups and downs in poetic language.

patterns.name: Periodic regeneration
patterns.context: After a filter becomes clogged with dust, it needs periodic regeneration; the following text explains that this is usually done by heating.

patterns.name: Formal closing of a ruling
patterns.context: After hearing a case, a court formally declares its disposition of a petition for a writ.

7_2931.description: 激活没有统一语义主题：分散在法律、专利和诗歌中，分别落在债务归属、暂时状态、变化、包含、分担、边界、预期、失望、周期性及裁判结语等局部表达。

patterns.name: “owed”债务关系
patterns.context: 描述债务由债权人或类似一方享有；同时出现合同、租约、票据、债务工具及律师费条款。

patterns.name: 婚姻裁判中的暂时状态
patterns.context: 在离婚、残酷对待等裁判事实之后，提及“眼下/暂时”状况。

patterns.name: 世界改变及站立意象
patterns.context: 诗歌语境；周围有第一人称、情感或庄严抒情表达。

patterns.name: 刑法要件包含关系
patterns.context: 解释较轻罪如何被较重罪包含，依据构成要件及法律条文判断。

patterns.name: 费用与责任的分担支付
patterns.context: 协议列明各方权益份额，并规定运营成本和责任由谁承担、支付。
patterns.domain: 商业或运营协议，法律文本

patterns.name: 保持在边界内
patterns.context: 加工沟槽时，要求其维持在镜片边缘范围之内。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，机械加工

patterns.name: 通常且必然预期
patterns.context: 讨论库存评估失误是否源于业务性质，并判断其是否通常、必然可预期。

patterns.name: 失望导致情绪低落
patterns.context: 与人生刺痛、抱负受挫等表达并列，以诗性语言描述情绪起伏。

patterns.name: 周期性再生
patterns.context: 过滤器积灰堵塞后需要定期再生，后文说明通常通过加热完成。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，过滤设备

patterns.name: 裁定的正式结语
patterns.context: 法院在审理后正式宣告对令状申请的处理结果。

en.concept: Completeness or continuing state and its effect
en.description: Activations cluster around expressions of complete scope, continuing or periodic states, conditions of obligation, and final effect in legal or technical sentences; there are also sporadic responses to phrases about procedures, inventory, and debts.

patterns.name: Final, complete, or continuing state
patterns.context: Emphasizes a continuing state, full coverage, complete satisfaction, or final effect; common in legal texts, with continuing or periodic cases also appearing in technical descriptions
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, contracts, patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Termination of legal acts and legal effect
patterns.context: In judicial or contractual contexts, declares a legal relationship terminated, a claim dismissed, a judgment effective, or an obligation discharged

patterns.name: Rules and procedural requirements
patterns.context: Explains statutory or procedural duties, deadlines, conditions, and requirements for specificity
patterns.domain: Legal rules, tax-law interpretations, litigation procedure

patterns.name: Operating and maintenance states in patent technology
patterns.context: Describes periodic regeneration of a filter and the operating requirement that fan blades continuously face the wind

patterns.name: Activations that cannot be grouped into a stable pattern in the source
patterns.context: These local trigger words occur respectively in contexts involving document copies, inventory exemptions, and debt relationships, with no clear common trigger condition

7_2931.concept: 完备或持续状态及其效力
7_2931.description: 激活集中于法律或技术语句中的范围完备、持续/周期状态、义务条件与终局效力表达；另对若干程序、库存和债务短语有零散响应。

patterns.name: 终局、完全、持续状态
patterns.context: 强调状态持续、覆盖全部范围、达到完全满足或具有终局效力；在法律文本中常见，也有技术描述中的持续/周期情形
patterns.domain: 法律判决、合同、专利技术说明

patterns.name: 法律行为的终结与法律效力
patterns.context: 司法或合同语境中宣告权利关系终止、请求被驳回、裁判生效或义务得到清偿

patterns.name: 规则与程序要求
patterns.context: 说明法定或程序上的义务、期限、条件和明确性要求
patterns.domain: 法律规则、税法解释、诉讼程序

patterns.name: 专利技术中的运行与维护状态
patterns.context: 描述过滤器周期性再生，以及风机叶片持续朝向风向的运行要求

patterns.name: 原文中无法归入稳定模式的激活
patterns.context: 这些局部触发词分别处于文书副本、库存免税和债务关系语境，未见明确共同触发条件

en.concept: Determination and boundary language in legal texts
en.description: Activations cluster around formal adjudicative and procedural language in legal texts, and also respond to permanent/final effect, extreme degree, insurance exclusions, and contractual ambiguity. A patent passage on weighing also contains the technical expression “equal to or closest to the target.”

patterns.name: Court dispositions and conclusions
patterns.context: Formulaic judicial language in which a court formally announces dismissal of a petition, affirmance of a judgment, or issuance of an order

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and document rules
patterns.context: Explains procedural requirements such as amending a pleading, replacing it, responding, and deadlines

patterns.name: Permanent, indefinite, or finality language
patterns.context: Emphasizes indefinite duration, irrevocability, or permanent termination; describes the effect of a legal relationship
patterns.domain: Contracts, family law, and legal documents

patterns.name: Expressions of extreme degree
patterns.context: Evidence concerning witness credibility may be offered if it could have even a very slight effect

patterns.name: Negative conditions in insurance coverage definitions
patterns.context: Defines an insurance incident by requiring that the damage was not expected or intentionally caused by the insured

patterns.name: Optimization expression for the value closest to a target
patterns.context: Compares combined weighing results with a target weight and selects the equal or closest result

patterns.name: Ambiguity and its resolution
patterns.context: External evidence is first used to determine the parties’ intent, followed by a discussion of any ambiguity that remains unresolved

7_2931.concept: 法律文本中的判定与界限措辞
7_2931.description: 激活集中于法律文本中的正式裁判与程序措辞，也响应永久/终局效力、极限程度、保险否定条件及合同歧义；另有专利称重中“等于或最接近目标”的技术表述。

patterns.name: 法院处分与裁判结论
patterns.context: 法院正式宣布驳回申请、维持判决或作出命令的裁判套语

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与文书规则
patterns.context: 说明修订诉状的替换、回应及期限等程序要求

patterns.name: 永久、无限期或终局性措辞
patterns.context: 强调持续无期限、不可撤销或永久终止；在法律关系中描述其效力
patterns.domain: 合同、家庭法及法律文书

patterns.name: 程度极限表达
patterns.context: 证人可信度相关证据只要可能产生哪怕极微影响，即可提出

patterns.name: 保险责任定义中的否定条件
patterns.context: 界定保险事故，要求损害并非被保险人预期或故意造成

patterns.name: 数值最接近目标的优化表述
patterns.context: 把组合称重结果与目标重量比较，选择相等或最接近者

patterns.name: 歧义及其消解
patterns.context: 先借外部证据查明当事人意图，再讨论仍未消除的歧义

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in U.S. legal texts, especially summary-judgment language such as “no genuine issue(s) of material fact” and related review and ruling language; also covers amended pleadings, highway regulations, witness credibility, court orders, and one passage of Portuguese political language.

patterns.name: No genuine dispute of material fact
patterns.context: The legal formula itself and adjacent expressions such as “there is/are” and “and the moving party”; often used to explain whether summary judgment may be entered.

patterns.name: of in legal sentence structures
patterns.context: Occurs in prepositional constructions in formal legal texts; especially in “issue of material fact,” though paragraph 2 has “extent possible” and paragraph 3 “time remaining,” so the triggering positions are not identical.

patterns.name: Basis and procedure for summary judgment
patterns.context: Describes the conditions for summary judgment, the review standard, its procedural function, or an appellate ruling.

patterns.name: Formal ruling language in court orders
patterns.context: A court uses formal, formulaic language to address a motion or issue an order.

patterns.name: Procedural rules for amended pleadings
patterns.context: Explains how an amended document replaces the original and how the response deadline is calculated.

patterns.name: Federal highway system regulatory language
patterns.context: Regulations specify how routes in the highway system are selected.

patterns.name: Witness credibility and the right to cross-examine
patterns.context: Discusses a party’s right to present evidence affecting a witness’s credibility.

patterns.name: Portuguese expression of support for independence
patterns.context: Expresses complete support in Portuguese for an institution’s independence; unlike the other U.S. legal passages.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, political or institutional discussion

7_2931.concept: 法律文本中的程式化措辞
7_2931.description: 激活主要集中于美国法律文本，尤其简易判决中“no genuine issue(s) of material fact”及相关审查、裁判措辞；另覆盖修订诉状、公路法规、证人可信度、法院命令，并有一段葡语政治表述。

patterns.name: 无真实争议的重大事实
patterns.context: 该法律套语本身及其相邻的“there is/are”“and the moving party”等表达；常用于说明是否可作简易判决。
patterns.domain: 美国判例法、简易判决标准

patterns.name: 法律句式中的of
patterns.context: 出现在正式法律文本中的介词结构内；尤见“issue of material fact”，但第2段为“extent possible”，第3段为“time remaining”，触发位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、程序规则

patterns.name: 简易判决的裁判依据与程序
patterns.context: 描述简易判决的适用条件、审查标准、程序作用或上诉裁判。

patterns.name: 法院命令的正式裁定措辞
patterns.trigger: “ordered, adjudged and decreed”“Petition for Writ of Mandamus”“should be denied”
patterns.context: 法院以正式、程式化措辞处理申请或发布命令。

patterns.name: 修订诉状的程序规则
patterns.context: 说明修订后的文件如何替代原文件，以及回应期限如何计算。

patterns.name: 联邦公路系统法规措辞
patterns.trigger: “greatest extent possible”“shall be selected by joint action”
patterns.context: 法规规定公路系统路线的选择方式。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法规、交通政策

patterns.name: 证人可信度与质证权
patterns.context: 讨论对方当事人有权提出影响证人可信度的证据。

patterns.name: 葡语关于支持独立性的表达
patterns.context: 以葡萄牙语表达对某机构独立性的完全支持；与其余美国法律段落不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、政治或机构讨论

en.description: Activations are distributed across finality, extremes, and judicial formulas in legal texts, as well as expressions of reasonable grounds, having someone else fulfill a personal wish, and “closest to target” in a technical solution. The common feature is unstable and mostly driven by specific phrases and context.

patterns.name: Finality or extremum expressions in legal sentences
patterns.context: Legal arguments or rules describe evidentiary thresholds, permanent duration, full payment, explicit reasons, or remaining time; the terms occur near phrase or sentence endings.
patterns.domain: Legal texts such as judgments, contracts, and procedural rules

patterns.name: Formulaic judicial dispositions in legal documents
patterns.context: After the court’s opinion, a fixed formula announces the disposition of a petition or a formal order.

patterns.name: Expressions of desire and having someone else do the work
patterns.context: First-person writing about wanting something but hoping someone else will make it; appears in informal personal writing.

patterns.name: Reasonable grounds and offeror obligations
patterns.context: Discusses whether an offeror has reasonable grounds to make an offer and believes the relevant facts.
patterns.domain: Discussion of securities-trading compliance in legal or regulatory email

patterns.name: Optimal matching in a technical process
patterns.context: Describes calculating multiple combinations and selecting the combination whose total weight is equal or closest to the target weight.
patterns.domain: Weighing-device technical description in patent background

7_2931.description: 激活分布于法律文本中的终局、极限及裁判公式，也包括合理依据、个人愿望代劳和技术方案中“最接近目标”的表达；共同特征不稳定，主要受特定短语与上下文触发。

patterns.name: 法律句式中的终结性或极限表达
patterns.context: 法律论证或规则中描述证明门槛、永久期限、完全清偿、明确理由或剩余期限；词项处于短语或句末附近。
patterns.domain: 判决、合同、程序规则等法律文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的裁判处分公式
patterns.context: 法院意见之后，以固定公式宣布请愿的处理结果或正式命令。

patterns.name: 愿望与他人代劳的表达
patterns.context: 第一人称谈个人想要某物、但希望由别人来制作；出现在非正式个人写作中。

patterns.name: 合理依据与要约人义务
patterns.context: 讨论要约人提出要约时应具有合理依据并相信相关事实。
patterns.domain: 法律或监管邮件中的证券交易合规讨论

patterns.name: 技术流程中的最优匹配
patterns.trigger: «equal» or closest to a target weight
patterns.context: 描述计算多个组合并选择总重量与目标重量相等或最接近的组合。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的称重设备技术说明

en.concept: Normative conditions and grounds for judgment
en.description: Primarily responds to wording about facts, evidence, reasonable grounds, and standards of judicial discretion in legal texts; also appears in testing and needs assessment, interpretation of transaction terms, and a help-seeker’s expression of willingness to try.

patterns.name: Legal facts and evidentiary standards
patterns.context: In court decisions or legal rules, discusses whether facts are relevant, whether evidence can prove facts, whether a factual dispute exists, or which standard of judgment applies.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, rules of evidence, civil procedure (paragraphs 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 10)

patterns.name: Judicial discretion and standards of review
patterns.context: A court explains a judge’s discretionary authority, the appellate standard of review, or the threshold for overturning a discretionary decision.

patterns.name: Reasonable grounds and belief
patterns.context: A legal text requires someone to have a reasonable reason or basis to believe something, followed by an evidentiary fact or action.

patterns.name: Testing and needs assessment
patterns.context: Discusses whether testing is adequate and links performance improvements to the needs for a new product or variety.
patterns.domain: Patent background or agricultural variety assessment text (paragraph 4)

patterns.name: Opportunity to try in a programming help request
patterns.context: The questioner expresses uncertainty and says they are willing to try any workable approach.

patterns.name: Recurring transaction terms
patterns.context: Explains how regulatory or contractual language applies repeatedly with each new transaction.

7_2931.description: 主要对法律文本中的事实、证据、合理依据及司法裁量标准相关措辞起反应；另见测试与需求评估、交易条款解释，以及求助者表示愿意尝试的表达。

patterns.name: 法律事实与举证标准
patterns.trigger: “relevant factors”“reasonable cause”“neither expected nor intended”“evidence is relevant”“material fact”“genuine issue of material fact”“substantial issues of fact”
patterns.context: 在法院判决或法律规则中，讨论事实是否相关、证据能否证明事实、是否存在事实争议或适用何种判断标准。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据规则、民事诉讼（段1、2、3、5、8、10）

patterns.name: 法律裁量与审查标准
patterns.trigger: “sound discretion”“except … plainest ground”“abuse of discretion”“Standard of Review”
patterns.context: 法院说明法官的裁量权限、上诉审查标准或撤销裁量决定的门槛。

patterns.name: 合理依据与相信
patterns.trigger: “reasonable cause to believe”“reasonable basis to believe”
patterns.context: 法律文本规定某人须有合理理由或合理依据相信某事，后接待证事实或行为。
patterns.domain: 刑事判决、证券监管法律邮件（段2、6）

patterns.name: 测试与需求评估
patterns.trigger: “Proper testing should detect”“there must be a demand”
patterns.context: 论述测试是否充分，并将性能改进与新产品或品种的需求相联系。
patterns.domain: 专利背景或农业品种评估文本（段4）

patterns.name: 编程问题求助中的尝试机会
patterns.trigger: “I will take every chance I have”
patterns.context: 提问者表达不确定，并表示愿意尝试任何可行办法。

patterns.name: 重复交易条款
patterns.trigger: “deemed repeated each time a new transaction is entered into”
patterns.context: 解释监管或合同用语如何随每笔新交易重复适用。

en.concept: Conditional and judgment structures in formal texts
en.description: Activations cluster around qualification and judgment structures in formal legal texts: conditions, causation, reasonable grounds, evidentiary inference, procedural discretion, claim notices, and allocation of liability. Patent text also describes combination weighing step by step and matching a target value.

patterns.name: Legal condition, causation, and inference language
patterns.context: Legal standards or rules use conditions, causation, mental states, or evidentiary inferences to qualify liability, conduct, or legal conclusions; common structures include alternative conditions linked by “or”.
patterns.domain: Judgments, contracts, and statutory legal style

patterns.name: Procedural and discretionary language in legal provisions
patterns.context: Courts or statutes describe procedures, judicial discretion, relevant considerations, or conditions for seeking judicial relief.

patterns.name: Allocation of legal liability and insurance/contract risk
patterns.context: Insurance defines incidents or damage, or contracts allocate risks and liability for property damage and personal injury.
patterns.domain: Insurance clauses, lease agreements, and quoted judgments

patterns.name: Insurance claims and notice clauses
patterns.context: Insurance or liability provisions define claims, relevant conduct, reporting, and the scope of notice.

patterns.name: Patent-abstract-style technical steps and value selection
patterns.context: A sequence of gerunds or participles describes device operations and selects combinations based on a numerical target.

patterns.name: Legal assessment of caregiving relationships
patterns.context: Determining a de facto guardianship/caregiving relationship requires consideration of several relevant factors.

patterns.name: Lease pleadings and indemnity clauses
patterns.context: Lease documents, in consideration of payment, assign the tenant liability for damage on the premises and exclude landlord negligence.

7_2931.concept: 正式文本中的条件与判定结构
7_2931.description: 激活集中于正式法律文本中的限定与判断结构：条件、因果、合理依据、证据推断、程序裁量、索赔通知及责任分配；另有专利文本按步骤描述组合称重并匹配目标值。

patterns.name: 法律条件、因果与推断措辞
patterns.context: 法律标准或规则用条件、因果、认知状态或证据推断来限定责任、行为或法律结论，常见结构包括“or”连接的备选条件。
patterns.domain: 判决书、合同与法规法律文体

patterns.name: 法律条款中的程序与裁量表述
patterns.context: 法院或法规叙述程序、法官裁量、考量因素或启动司法救济的条件。

patterns.name: 法律责任与保险/合同风险分配
patterns.context: 保险定义事故或损害，或合同分配财产损坏、人身伤害的风险与责任。
patterns.domain: 保险条款、租赁合同及判决引文

patterns.name: 保险索赔与通知条款
patterns.context: 保险或责任条款界定索赔、相关行为、报告及通知范围。
patterns.domain: 保险合同/诉讼法律文本

patterns.name: 专利摘要式技术步骤与数值选择
patterns.context: 以连续动名词或分词描述装置操作步骤，并按数值目标选择组合。

patterns.name: 照护关系的法律因素判定
patterns.context: 判断事实上的监护/照护关系时，要求考量若干相关因素。

patterns.name: 租赁诉状与赔偿责任条款
patterns.context: 租赁文书中以对价为背景，规定承租人承担场所内损害责任并排除房东过失。
patterns.domain: 租赁合同或相关诉讼文本

en.concept: Formulaic legal conditions and expressions of grounds
en.description: Primarily responds to formulaic relations and procedural language in legal corpora, especially cause (good/sufficient cause, cause of action), conditional conjunctions, and procedural uses of shown; also activates on insurance damage clauses and several legal terms.

patterns.name: Causal or conditional relations in law
patterns.context: Connects conditions, outcomes, alternatives, or scope limitations in legal rules, decisions, or insurance clauses; paragraphs 1, 3, 4, and 6 especially feature several such relational words adjacent to legal terms.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw; insurance, criminal law, civil procedure, and judicial opinions

patterns.name: cause paired with grounds or reasons
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed legal expressions to mean sufficient grounds, good cause, or a cause of action; activations center on cause and adjacent modifiers or shown.
patterns.domain: Litigation procedure, legal provisions, and decisions

patterns.name: Procedural legal verbs and claims
patterns.context: Describes legal claims, filings, notice, appeals, or procedural conditions; “«substantial» «showing»” and “«good» «cause» «shown” are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: Appeals, motions, insurance claims, and court proceedings

patterns.name: Statements of judgments and rights and obligations
patterns.context: Legal texts state a ruling, rights, a stay of litigation, or a court’s standard of judgment; typically in a normative or judicial-reasoning context.

patterns.name: Definitions of damage and accidents in insurance clauses
patterns.context: Insurance coverage clauses define an accident, the coverage period, and whether the insured expected or intentionally caused damage; “«nor»” activates most strongly in this definition.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and qualifying structures in legal texts
patterns.context: Frequent prepositions, relational words, or scope qualifiers in legal sentences; activation depends on their occurrence in formulaic legal expressions, and they have no consistent specific meaning in isolation.
patterns.domain: Legal provisions, contract clauses, and decisions

patterns.name: Unexplained activations on legal collocations
patterns.context: Some subword fragments or legal terms activate, but they lack a clear, independent shared trigger with the main collocations in other passages.

7_2931.concept: 法律公式化条件与事由表达
7_2931.description: 主要响应法律语料中的公式化关系与程序表达，尤其是 cause（good/sufficient cause、cause of action）、条件连接词及 shown 等程序用语；另对保险损害条款和若干法律术语有激活。

patterns.name: 法律中的因果或条件关系
patterns.context: 法律规则、判决或保险条款中，连接条件、结果、并列选项或限定范围；第1、3、4、6段尤其突出多个这类关系词与法律术语相邻。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw；保险、刑法、民事诉讼及司法意见

patterns.name: cause 与理由/事由搭配
patterns.context: 出现在法律固定搭配中，表示充分理由、正当事由或诉因；激活集中在 cause 及相邻的限定词或 shown。
patterns.domain: 诉讼程序、法律条文及判决

patterns.name: 程序性法律动词与主张
patterns.context: 描述法律主张、提交、通知、上诉或程序条件；其中“«substantial» «showing»”和“«good» «cause» «shown”较明显。
patterns.domain: 上诉、动议、保险索赔及法院程序

patterns.name: 判决与权利义务表述
patterns.context: 法律文本中说明裁判结果、权利、诉讼暂停或法院判断标准；通常处于规范性或司法论证语境。

patterns.name: 保险条款中的损害与事故定义
patterns.context: 保险责任条款界定事故、承保期间及被保险人是否预期或故意造成损害；“«nor»”在该定义中激活最强。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的连接词与限定结构
patterns.context: 法律句式中的高频介词、关系词或范围限定词，激活取决于其处在法律公式化表达中；单独看并无一致的具体语义。
patterns.domain: 法律条文、合同条款及判决

patterns.name: 未经解释的法律搭配激活
patterns.context: 若干分词或法律专门用语处激活，但它们与其他片段中的主要搭配缺少清晰、独立的共同触发条件。

en.description: This neuron activates near legal adjudicative standards and procedural requirements in U.S. court opinions: factual disputes, appeal authorization, insurance liability, criminal elements, guardianship factors, statutory risks, and motions to dismiss and challenge jurisdiction.

patterns.name: Factual-dispute standard for summary judgment
patterns.context: Discusses whether a court can grant summary judgment without a trial or review such a judgment; often co-occurs with “no”, “without a trial”, and “summary judgment”.
patterns.domain: U.S. civil procedure judgments and appellate opinions

patterns.name: Substantial showing for authorization to appeal
patterns.context: Explains that an applicant must show denial of a constitutional right before a court may issue a certificate of appealability; nearby text also contains “if” and “applicant”.

patterns.name: Unexpected or unintended damage in an insured event
patterns.context: Insurance provisions qualify liability by whether the event or covered damage was expected or intended.

patterns.name: Criminal elements and knowledge requirements
patterns.context: Lists offense elements as First/Second/Third and describes the defendant knowing or having reason to believe that something would be used for a particular purpose.

patterns.name: Child-custody factor review
patterns.context: A court must consider relevant factors when deciding child-custody arrangements; the context mentions de facto custodian and a statute.

patterns.name: Risk and harm language in statutes
patterns.context: A local ordinance is quoted to define unlawful conduct and describe a substantial risk of causing or creating physical injury.

patterns.name: Motion to dismiss a complaint and jurisdictional defense
patterns.context: The defendant moves to dismiss under the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure and separately raises lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.

7_2931.description: 该神经元在美国法院意见中的法律裁判标准和程序性要件附近激活：事实争点、上诉许可、保险责任、刑事构成、监护因素、法规风险及驳回与管辖权动议。

patterns.name: summary judgment 的事实争点标准
patterns.context: 讨论法院能否在无审判情况下作出简易判决，或复核相关判决；常与“no”“without a trial”“summary judgment”连用。
patterns.domain: 美国民事诉讼判决与上诉意见

patterns.name: 上诉许可的实质性证明
patterns.context: 说明申请人须证明宪法权利遭拒，法院才可签发 certificate of appealability；相邻文字也出现“if”“applicant”。
patterns.domain: 联邦人身保护令上诉程序

patterns.name: 保险事故中非预期或非故意损害
patterns.context: 保险条款定义事故或承保损害时，用预期、故意与否限定责任。

patterns.name: 刑事构成要件与明知要素
patterns.context: 以 First/Second/Third 列举犯罪要件，描述被告明知或有合理理由相信某物将被用于特定用途。

patterns.name: 儿童监护因素审查
patterns.context: 法院在决定儿童监护安排时，要求考量相关因素；上下文提到 de facto custodian 和法规。

patterns.name: 法规中的风险与伤害表述
patterns.trigger: “cause, or create a substantial risk of physical harm”
patterns.context: 引用地方条例界定违法行为，描述造成或形成身体伤害的重大风险。

patterns.name: 驳回诉状与管辖权抗辩
patterns.trigger: “failure to state a claim upon which relief can be granted”及“lack of subject matter jurisdiction”
patterns.context: 被告依据联邦民事诉讼规则提出驳回动议，并另提缺乏事物管辖权。

en.description: In mathematical passages, responds to equation symbols, numbers, and problem-solving instructions; in legal passages, also responds to enumerated elements, language about grounds and court dispositions, and definitions of insurance accidents, injuries, and damage.

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in math problems
patterns.context: Near algebraic expressions, equations, fractions, or remainder operations, often mixing variables and numbers; positions vary across problems.

patterns.name: Instructions and relational words in math problems
patterns.context: In problem statements or step-by-step instructions, especially when introducing variables, giving conditions, asking for a solution, or asking for the greatest common divisor.

patterns.name: Enumerations and legal conditions in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal reasoning or quoted provisions, when enumerating elements, stating reasonable grounds, or setting conditions for a court’s disposition.

patterns.name: Accident and damage language in insurance clauses
patterns.context: When defining the scope of insurance coverage, describes an accident during the policy period and the resulting bodily injury or property damage.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, insurance contracts or cited decisions

7_2931.concept: 结构化问题与条件表达
7_2931.description: 数学段落中对算式符号、数字及解题指令有反应；法律段落中也响应要件列举、理由/法院处置措辞，以及保险事故、伤害和损害定义。

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号与数字
patterns.trigger: 数字、变量和运算符，如 « 3»、«**»、« -»、« =»；在数学题片段中多次激活
patterns.context: 代数式、方程、分数或余数运算附近，往往伴随变量和数字的混合；不同题目中出现的位置不固定

patterns.name: 数学题的指令与关系词
patterns.trigger: «Let»、« Suppose»、« Solve»、« Calculate»、« remainder»、« divided»、« highest»、« common»、« factor»、« divisor»
patterns.context: 数学题的题干或步骤指令中，尤其是引入变量、给定条件、要求解或询问最大公因数时

patterns.name: 法律文本中的列举与法律条件
patterns.trigger: «First»、« Second»、« Third»、« reasonable»、« cause»、« orders»、« unless»
patterns.context: 法律论证或法规引文中，列举构成要件、陈述合理理由或规定法院处置条件时

patterns.name: 保险条款中的事故与损害措辞
patterns.trigger: « bodily»、« injury»、« property»、« damage»、« occurrence»、« accident»、« neither»、« expected»、« intended»
patterns.context: 定义保险责任范围时，描述保单期间发生的事故及其造成的伤害或财产损害

en.description: Responds mainly to solving equations in math exercises and boundaries between problems; it also responds to ground/cause phrases denoting a legal basis in legal texts and the patent section heading Field. Patterns vary across contexts and lack a unified trigger word.

patterns.name: “ground” in legal provisions
patterns.context: When explaining the basis for an appeal, ruling, or legal issue, activation centers on “ground” and the phrase that follows; this pattern appears only in this passage.

patterns.name: Reason and proof in legal arguments
patterns.context: In legal facts or procedural rules, “cause” means reason or basis; activation falls on cause and nearby words expressing cognition or proof.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, criminal judgments and appellate procedure

patterns.name: Solution prompts in math equations
patterns.context: When an algebra problem gives an equation and asks for a variable, activation covers the 0 at the end of the equation, “for”, and the variable being solved for; in multiple passages it also activates at problem boundaries or the start of a subsequent problem.

patterns.name: Separators and line-break markers in math problems
patterns.context: Activations appear at line breaks or separators between or within math problems; not all markers correspond to the same mathematical content.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, problem formatting and boundaries

patterns.name: Patent section heading
patterns.context: Appears after the heading number in the background section of a patent, with strong activation on the heading word itself; nearby “Aspects” is also split into fragments.

7_2931.description: 主要响应数学练习中求解方程及题目分隔处；另响应法律文本里表示法律根据的 ground/cause 短语，以及专利章节标题 Field。不同语境下模式分散，缺乏统一触发词。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的“ground”
patterns.context: 法律上说明上诉、裁判或法律问题成立条件时，激活集中在“ground”及其后续短语；此模式只见于该段。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的原因与证明
patterns.context: 在法律事实或程序规则中，“cause”表示理由、根据；激活落在 cause 及邻近的表示认知、证明的词上。

patterns.name: 数学题中方程的解答提示
patterns.context: 代数题在给出方程并要求求某变量时，激活覆盖方程末尾的 0、for 及待求变量；多段还在题目边界或后续题目起始处激活。

patterns.name: 数学题的分隔与换行标记
patterns.context: 数学题之间或题目内部换行、分隔处出现激活；并非所有标记都对应同一数学内容。

patterns.name: 专利章节标题
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的标题编号后出现，标题词本身激活较强；附近还有被拆分的“Aspects”。

en.description: Primarily activates on cause, ground(s), and fixed expressions that mean grounds or basis in legal contexts, especially “good cause shown”; also involves reasonable judgment and legal disagreements, and grounds for contract rescission.

patterns.name: Legal phrase “good cause shown”
patterns.context: The phrase occurs in statutes, decisions, or procedural rules to indicate that a measure is allowed, a delay granted, a restriction lifted, or another procedural action taken for sufficient grounds; common forms include “for good cause shown” and “for good cause.”
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal provisions

patterns.name: Reasonable grounds or basis
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s awareness of an item’s intended use or the reasonable judgment on which an officer acted; activations center on “cause” or “belief.”

patterns.name: Grounds for disagreement in standards for appellate permission
patterns.context: Describes the legal question and disagreement of opinion required for permission to take an interlocutory appeal; the trigger is “ground,” within a grouped statement of statutory criteria.

patterns.name: Legal basis for contract rescission
patterns.context: An arbitration clause states that the grounds for rescinding the agreement are those that generally apply to rescission of a contract; the trigger is “grounds.”

7_2931.description: 主要对法律语境中表示理由或依据的 cause、ground(s) 及固定搭配激活，尤其是“good cause shown”；也涉及合理判断与法律分歧、合同撤销依据。

patterns.name: good cause shown 法律短语
patterns.context: 短语出现在法条、判决或程序规则中，表示因充分理由而获准、延期、解除限制或采取其他程序措施；常见搭配是“for good cause shown”，也有“for good cause”。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律条文

patterns.name: 合理理由／根据的论述
patterns.context: 描述被告对物品用途的认知，或警员采取行动所依据的合理判断；激活集中在“cause”或“belief”。

patterns.name: 上诉许可标准中的分歧理由
patterns.context: 说明中间上诉许可所需的法律问题及意见分歧；触发点是“ground”，并处于成组的法定标准表述中。

patterns.name: 合同撤销的法律根据
patterns.context: 在仲裁协议条文中指出，撤销协议的理由适用于合同的一般撤销依据；触发点为“grounds”。

en.description: Primarily responds to enumeration markers, legal-basis phrases such as cause/grounds, and procedural, discretionary, fact-finding, and conditional language in legal texts; also appears in religious-clause tests, literary moral narratives, and Who in work titles.

patterns.name: First in enumerated legal structures
patterns.context: Opens a sequence in legal reasoning or a list of elements; often followed by second, third, or itemized criteria.

patterns.name: Grounds/cause in legal formulas
patterns.context: In legal standards or procedural formulas, cause/grounds denotes a reason, basis, or ground; often paired with reasonable, good, shown, and similar terms.

patterns.name: Conditional or possibility statements in law
patterns.context: Describes possible but unperformed litigation acts, or gives a conditional explanation of purpose.

patterns.name: Legal review and discretionary language
patterns.context: Discusses standards of judicial review, discretion, or the scope of discretion.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and litigation facts
patterns.context: Judicial text concerning res judicata, matters already litigated, evidentiary findings, or fact review.

patterns.name: Reservation of exceptions/unless clauses in law
patterns.context: A statute or quotation limits a general rule by an exception, condition, or court order.

patterns.name: Legal decision document format
patterns.context: Fixed expressions in decision headings, procedural background, or the basis for an order.

patterns.name: Religious-clause legal test
patterns.context: Lists, item by item, the constitutionality test and effects standard for a religious clause.

patterns.name: Emotional and moral vocabulary in literature
patterns.context: Literary prose describing characters’ experiences, wrongdoing, and moral judgments.

patterns.name: Who in a list of work titles
patterns.context: A work title appears in an itemized list; activation is concentrated on Who within the title.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, film or work lists

7_2931.description: 主要响应法律文本中的列举标记、cause/grounds 等法律依据措辞及程序、裁量、事实认定和条件句；另见宗教条款测试、文学道德叙述与作品标题中的 Who。

patterns.name: 列举结构中的 First
patterns.context: 法律论证或要件列举中，作为序列开头；后文常接 second、third 或分项标准。

patterns.name: 法律公式中的 grounds/cause
patterns.context: 法律标准或程序性公式中，cause/grounds 表示理由、事由或依据；常与 reasonable、good、shown 等词搭配。

patterns.name: 法律中的条件或可能性表述
patterns.context: 描述可能发生但未发生的诉讼行为，或对用途作条件性说明。

patterns.name: 法律审查及裁量用语
patterns.context: 讨论法院审查标准、裁量权或裁量范围。

patterns.name: 法律程序及诉讼事实表述
patterns.context: 关于既判力、已诉事项、证据认定或事实审查的司法文本。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的保留例外/除非
patterns.context: 条文或引文以例外、条件或法院命令限定一般规则。

patterns.name: 法律判决文书格式
patterns.context: 判决书标题、程序背景或命令依据等固定文书表达。

patterns.name: 宗教条款法律测试
patterns.context: 逐项列出宗教条款合宪性测试及其效果标准。

patterns.name: 文学中的情感与道德词汇
patterns.context: 叙述人物遭遇、过错与道德评价，句式为文学性散文。

patterns.name: 作品标题列表中的 Who
patterns.context: 条目式作品清单中出现标题；激活集中于标题内的 Who。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、电影或作品列表

en.concept: Expressions of legal grounds and basis
en.description: Primarily responds to statements of the basis for a decision, reasons, or procedural conditions in legal documents, especially grounds/cause; also has weaker, sporadic responses to legal credibility arguments, poetic emotional language, and work titles.

patterns.name: grounds/cause expressions of reasons in legal documents
patterns.context: Explains the reasons or basis supporting a legal outcome, in connection with a ruling, legal standard, or procedural application; activations often center on cause/grounds.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions, regulations, and pleadings

patterns.name: Credibility and evidentiary flaws in legal judgments
patterns.context: Describes an employer’s reasons as flawed, allowing the factfinder not to believe them.
patterns.domain: Legal reasoning in employment discrimination and other decisions

patterns.name: love and imperative expressions in poetry
patterns.context: A poetic line directly addresses someone and includes emotional expressions such as love, requests, or reproaches; the activating words are not uniform legal terms.

patterns.name: Title-like phrases in work lists
patterns.context: Film or work titles listed on separate lines; titles contain prepositions, relative pronouns, and place phrases.

7_2931.description: 主要响应法律文书中说明裁判依据、理由或程序条件的表述，尤其 grounds/cause；另对法律可信度论证、诗歌情感表达及作品标题有较弱的零散响应。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 grounds/cause 理由表述
patterns.trigger: “grounds as exist”, “reasonable cause to believe”, “good cause shown”, “any ground”
patterns.context: 围绕裁判、法律标准或程序申请，说明支持某项法律结果的理由、原因或依据；多处激活集中在 cause/grounds 附近。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、法规及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律判断的可信度与证据缺陷
patterns.context: 描述雇主提出的理由存在缺陷，因而事实认定者可以不予相信。
patterns.domain: 就业歧视等法律判决论证

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 love 及祈使表达
patterns.context: 诗行中直接向对象说话，出现爱、请求或指责等情感性表达；激活词并非统一的法律用语。
patterns.domain: 诗歌（布朗宁《How Do I Love Thee?》）

patterns.name: 作品目录中的标题性短语
patterns.context: 换行列出的电影/作品名称；标题包含介词、关系代词和地点短语。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of sufficient cause, grounds, and judicial review in legal texts, especially “good cause”; also covers credibility assessments and negative words, as well as an unrelated passage of classical love poetry.

patterns.name: “good cause” phrase in law
patterns.context: Legal documents state sufficient cause for granting a motion or taking a procedural step; often followed by “shown,” and may also be followed by “to believe.”
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, legal procedure and statutes

patterns.name: Reasons and grounds in legal reasoning
patterns.context: Legal arguments enumerate bases, reasons, or conditions of belief; not all instances use the fixed phrase “good cause.”

patterns.name: Discretion and standards of review in law
patterns.context: Discusses judicial discretion, abuse of discretion, and reasonableness review, often alongside grounds/reasons.

patterns.name: Contract arbitration and grounds for revocation
patterns.context: Cites arbitration law, explaining that grounds for revoking a contract also apply to the validity of an arbitration agreement.

patterns.name: Negative evaluations and credibility judgments
patterns.context: Evaluates a publication’s trend or the credibility of an employer’s stated reasons; semantically involves negation, flaws, or lack of credibility, but with varied specific collocations.

patterns.name: Love and speech in poetry
patterns.context: A classical poetic lyric in a second-person context, with no clear connection to the procedural and reasons language of the legal corpus.

7_2931.description: 主要响应法律文本中的充分理由、依据及其司法审查表达，尤其是“good cause”；另覆盖可信度评价与否定词，及一段无关的古典爱情诗歌。

patterns.name: 法律中的“good cause”短语
patterns.context: 法律文书中说明有充分理由、允许申请或采取程序措施；常接“shown”，也可接“to believe”。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、法律程序与法条

patterns.name: 法律推理中的理由与依据
patterns.context: 法律论证中列举判断依据、理由或主观认知条件；并非都出现固定短语“good cause”。

patterns.name: 法律中的裁量与审查标准
patterns.context: 讨论法院裁量、滥用裁量及合理性审查，常与 grounds/reasons 同现。

patterns.name: 合同仲裁及撤销理由
patterns.trigger: “grounds … exist … for the revocation … of any contract”
patterns.context: 引用仲裁法，说明合同撤销依据也适用于仲裁协议效力。

patterns.name: 负面评价词及可信度判断
patterns.context: 评价文章趋势或雇主所提理由的可信度；语义上涉及否定、缺陷或不可信，但具体搭配不同。
patterns.domain: 网络评论；就业歧视判例

patterns.name: 诗歌中的爱情与言说
patterns.context: 古典诗歌的抒情第二人称语境，与法律语料中的程序、理由表达无明显联系。

en.description: Legal passages emphasize terms for reasons or statutory standards such as cause and grounds, especially good/reasonable cause; mathematical passages activate on polynomials, powers, fractions, and factorization expressions. The surface patterns differ.

patterns.name: Cause collocations in law
patterns.context: Appears in legal decisions or rules within statements of reasons, standards, or conditions; includes good cause, reasonable cause, and the legal sense of grounds as a basis.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw: federal appellate rules, criminal cases, withdrawal of pleas, contract arbitration, and other legal texts

patterns.name: Polynomials and algebraic factorization
patterns.context: Math problems or solutions contain variables, powers, fractions, and polynomial factors; activation is scattered across expressions and solution text.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics: algebraic operations, factorization problems

7_2931.concept: 理由/因式条件触发，可能异质
7_2931.description: 法律段落中突出 cause、grounds 等理由或法定标准词，尤其 good/reasonable cause；数学段落则激活于多项式、幂、分数和因式分解表达式，二者表面模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律中的 cause 搭配
patterns.context: 法律判决或规则中，出现在理由、标准或条件表述里；包括 good cause、reasonable cause，以及 grounds 的法律理由义
patterns.domain: FreeLaw：联邦上诉规则、刑事案件、认罪撤回、合同仲裁等法律文本

patterns.name: 多项式与代数因式分解
patterns.context: 数学题或解答中包含变量、幂、分数和多项式因式；激活分散在表达式及步骤文字中
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics：代数运算、因式分解题

en.description: Activations are distributed across expressions of legal grounds and reasonable basis, mathematical formula symbols, German parliamentary speech, and evaluation and attribution in online comments; specific triggers vary across contexts.

patterns.name: grounds / cause / reasons in English legal texts
patterns.context: Occurs in statements of legal judgments or standards, often with grounds/reasons/cause followed by a condition or evaluation.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal texts

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Located in algebraic expressions or fractions, often in line-broken formulas and at the beginning of text following a formula.

patterns.name: Infinitives and discourse expressions in German parliamentary texts
patterns.context: First-person plural or personal statements in German sentences, discussing intention, cognition, or topics about to be addressed.

patterns.name: Evaluation and attribution in English online comments
patterns.context: A commenter positively evaluates an article or technical content and contrasts it with an earlier negative trend.

7_2931.description: 激活分布在法律理由与合理根据的表述、数学公式符号、德语议会发言，以及网络评论中的评价和归功；各语境的具体触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 英语法律中的 grounds / cause / reasons
patterns.context: 出现在法律判断或法律标准的陈述中，常见结构是 grounds/reasons/cause 与后续条件或评估相连。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量和运算符
patterns.context: 位于代数式或分式中，常出现在换行公式及公式后的文字开头。

patterns.name: 德语议会文本中的不定式和话语表达
patterns.trigger: « wollen»2、« wir»1、« uns»2、« darüber»8；以及 « will»1、« mir»1、« bin»2、« bewusst»1
patterns.context: 德语句子中的第一人称复数或个人发言，讨论意图、认知或即将展开的议题。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言或议事文本

patterns.name: 英语网络评论中的评价与归功
patterns.trigger: « ages»2、« negative»2、« giving»2 « credit»1 « where»4 « it»7 « is»8 « due»6
patterns.context: 评论者对文章或技术内容作正面评价，并对先前的负面趋势作对照。

en.description: Primarily responds to the format of setting a polynomial equal to zero in math problems and the answer line; also appears in wording about arbitration agreements and contract-revocation exceptions in statutes. Some scattered markers in truncated snippets cannot be interpreted independently.

patterns.name: Zero equations in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: A complex algebraic expression is set equal to zero, followed by a question asking for the value of a variable or requesting a solution; activation is concentrated near the equals sign, zero, and periods.

patterns.name: Math answer lists and line breaks
patterns.context: A line break and candidate answers or a numerical list follow an equation; some lists contain numbers such as “0” and “4.”

patterns.name: Statutory exception for contract revocation
patterns.context: Cites a statute stating that an arbitration agreement is valid, while reserving grounds that may apply to contract revocation as an exception.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic activations
patterns.context: The snippets are truncated and the markers are scattered, so the available context does not confirm an independent trigger pattern.

7_2931.description: 主要响应数学题中令多项式等于零的格式及其答案行；另有一段响应法律条文中仲裁协议与合同撤销例外的措辞。若干截断片段的杂散标记无法单独解释。

patterns.name: 代数式中的零点方程
patterns.context: 复杂代数表达式被设为零，随后询问变量的值或要求求解；激活集中在等号、零和句点附近。

patterns.name: 数学答案列表与换行
patterns.trigger: “↵”以及其前后的“-”和逗号分隔数字
patterns.context: 方程后出现换行及候选答案或数值列表；部分列表含“0”“4”等数字。

patterns.name: 法律合同撤销例外条款
patterns.context: 引用法规，说明仲裁协议有效，但保留可适用于合同撤销的理由作为例外。

patterns.name: 未能解释的杂散激活
patterns.trigger: 局部数字、变量及残缺表达式，如“371”“10*”
patterns.context: 片段截断且标记分散，无法从现有上下文确认独立触发模式。

en.concept: Local patterns across multiple text structures
en.description: Activation primarily appears on operators, numbers, variables, and factorization steps in algebraic formulas; it also appears in legal arbitration contracts, literary counsel about nature and hardship, and moral judgments in online discussions.

patterns.name: Arithmetic symbols in polynomial notation
patterns.context: Polynomials, fractions, or equations in mathematical text; activation is scattered across operators, numbers, variables, and punctuation, with no single consistent symbol.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, formulas and algebra problems

patterns.name: Coefficients and polynomial factorization results
patterns.context: A factorized form or explicit instruction to factor appears after a formula in polynomial calculations or factorization problems.

patterns.name: Agreements and grounds for revocation in legal contracts
patterns.context: A statutory citation states that an arbitration agreement is valid while preserving existing grounds for revoking a contract.

patterns.name: Nature’s mysteries and limits of human ability
patterns.context: Narration or argument describes how limited intelligence and strength prevent people from understanding or controlling nature and cosmic forces.

patterns.name: Advice on facing worries and hardship
patterns.context: Urges people to face unavoidable troubles wisely and do their best to cope.

patterns.name: Moral judgment and the moral compass
patterns.context: Discusses people’s lack of moral understanding and difficulty distinguishing right from wrong; the sentence also concerns a dispute over racial terminology.

7_2931.concept: 多种文本结构中的局部模式
7_2931.description: 激活主要出现在代数公式的运算符、数字、变量及因式分解步骤；另见法律仲裁契约、文学中的自然与困境劝诫，以及网络讨论中的道德判断词句。

patterns.name: 多项式排版中的算术符号
patterns.context: 数学文本中的多项式、分式或方程；激活散落在运算符、数字、变量与标点上，未见统一的单一符号

patterns.name: 系数与多项式因式分解结果
patterns.context: 多项式计算或因式分解题中，公式之后出现因式形式或明确的分解指令

patterns.name: 法律契约中的约定及撤销事由
patterns.trigger: “agreement to submit controversies to arbitration”“grounds as exist for the revocation of any contract”
patterns.context: 成文法引用中说明仲裁协议有效，但保留可撤销合同的既有事由

patterns.name: 自然界的奥秘与人类能力局限
patterns.context: 叙述或议论人因智力与力量有限而无法理解、控制自然及宇宙力量

patterns.name: 面对忧虑与困境的劝勉
patterns.trigger: “worries and annoyances”“trials”“wise man”“make the best of them”
patterns.context: 劝人以明智态度面对无法避免的烦恼，并尽力应对

patterns.name: 道德判断与道德指南针
patterns.context: 讨论人缺乏道德理解、难以判断对错；句中还涉及种族称谓的争议

en.description: Activation spans diverse contexts: reasons, elements, weighing evidence, and litigation claims in legal texts; love and prayer in literature; justifications in argumentative writing; reports on institutional challenges; and a maxim about distributing according to ability and need. A possible common thread is relational or justificatory wording in abstract discussion, but it is not consistent.

patterns.name: Contract validity and revocation exception in statutes
