patterns.context: Cites a statute stating that a written arbitration agreement is valid while excepting grounds for revocation; strong activation is concentrated on “grounds” and the surrounding wording.

patterns.name: Elements, knowledge, and evidentiary judgments in criminal law
patterns.context: Criminal case narratives define whether a defendant knew or had reasonable cause to believe; also includes legal language concerning indictments, discretion, evidentiary weight, and balancing prejudice.

patterns.name: Summary of litigation materials in judicial documents
patterns.context: A court memorandum notes that the litigation claims are extensive and will not be discussed individually here.

patterns.name: Love and prayer in poetry
patterns.context: Poetry or prayer-like text expresses love, hope, courage, or solidarity in the first person; activation also falls on several ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Reasons and self-justification in argumentative prose
patterns.context: An essayist discusses whether an action is justified or can be defended or excused.

patterns.name: Challenges and uncertainty facing institutions
patterns.context: Reports on institutional funding, demand, or industry conditions, describing uncertainty caused by unexpected circumstances.

patterns.name: Distribution principle in a maxim
patterns.context: Quotes a political maxim about contributing according to ability and distributing according to need.

7_2931.description: 激活覆盖多种语境：法律文本中的理由、要件、证据权衡与诉讼主张，文学中的爱与祈愿，论说中的辩护理由，机构挑战报道，以及按能力和需要分配的格言。共同线索可能是抽象论述中的关系或理由措辞，但并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的合同效力与撤销例外
patterns.trigger: “a written agreement to submit controversies to arbitration is valid”以及“save upon such grounds as exist for the revocation of any contract”
patterns.context: 引用法规，说明书面仲裁协议有效，但适用可撤销合同的理由作为例外；强激活集中在“grounds”及其前后措辞。

patterns.name: 刑事法律中的要件、认知与证据判断
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中界定被告知情或有合理理由相信；也包括起诉书、裁量、证据证明力及偏见权衡等法律措辞。

patterns.name: 司法文书对诉讼材料的概述
patterns.trigger: “The allegations made in these four suits are voluminous”及“set them forth in detail”
patterns.context: 法院备忘录说明诉讼主张篇幅庞大、不会在此逐项详述。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的爱与祈愿
patterns.trigger: “How do I love thee? Let me count the ways”及“Let me unite them, O Lord”
patterns.context: 诗歌或祈祷式文字，以第一人称表达爱、希望、勇气或团结；激活也落在若干普通功能词上。

patterns.name: 论说文中的理由与自我辩护
patterns.trigger: “on any ground to defend or to excuse the practice”
patterns.context: 散文作者谈论行为是否有理由、是否能够为之辩护或开脱。

patterns.name: 机构面临的挑战与不确定性
patterns.context: 报道机构资金、需求或行业状况，描述意外情况造成的不确定性。

patterns.name: 格言中的分配原则
patterns.trigger: “From each according to his ability, to each according to his need(s)”
patterns.context: 引用关于按能力贡献、按需要分配的政治格言。

en.concept: Judgments and statements across multiple contexts
en.description: Activations span legal, literary, forum, and narrative texts, often around copular is/are, quantity or singularity expressions, infinitives, and negation and judgment contexts; other topic-specific groups of vocabulary appear without a single clear semantic theme.

patterns.name: is in singular existential sentences
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the copula is, and also occur on are; nearby subjects and complements are mostly nouns or adjectives, forming judgments, definitions, or statements of existence. Triggers are not limited to fixed collocations, and activation positions vary across passages.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal arguments, literature, forum comments, and narratives

patterns.name: One/single and quantity emphasis
patterns.context: Involves quantity, singularity, or repeated emphasis on quantity; activations fall on one, only, or nearby quantity expressions, with no uniform syntactic position.

patterns.name: Infinitives and expressions of purpose or requests
patterns.context: to introduces a verb infinitive expressing submission, purpose, request, or action; activations also involve its object or an adjacent word, and not all uses are alike.

patterns.name: Contract and legal-effect language
patterns.context: Formal legal wording about the validity of arbitration agreements, contract rescission, or lease termination and obligations.

patterns.name: Emotion and address in poetry
patterns.context: Poetic lines, Roman numeral section markers, and archaic second-person forms, with themes of love.

patterns.name: Unknowable forces of nature
patterns.context: Describes cosmic or natural forces that humans cannot understand or control.

patterns.name: Negation and value judgments
patterns.context: Negates the meaning, purpose, or reason for something, or discusses moral judgment; activations occur near negation and evaluative words.

patterns.name: Historical and interest-related exposition
patterns.context: Describes historical or knowledge-related topics and evaluates their importance or interest; passages have the tone of written exposition.

patterns.name: Lease surrender and damage exceptions
patterns.context: Surrender of a property after a lease expires or terminates early, with requirements for cleanliness and exceptions for damage.

patterns.name: Startup investment and risk of failure
patterns.context: Discusses startup investment, the possibility of failure, and the consequences of missed opportunities.

patterns.name: Disaster losses and cherished things
patterns.context: Narrates the loss of lives and cherished things caused by a disaster, followed by “one thing is certain” introducing a judgment.

7_2931.concept: 多种语境中的判断与陈述
7_2931.description: 激活跨法律、文学、论坛和叙述文本，常见于系动词 is/are、数量或单一性表达、不定式及否定和判断语境；另有多种各自成组的题材词汇，缺少单一清晰语义主题。

patterns.name: 单数存在句中的 is
patterns.trigger: “one is certain”“it is wrong”“it is a claim”“there are”“which is valid”；尤以 “one” 后的 «is»9、«is»5 和 «is»4 为代表
patterns.context: 激活常落在系动词 is，也见 are；附近主语、补语多为名词或形容词，构成判断、定义或存在陈述。触发并不局限于固定搭配，且各段激活位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、文学、论坛评论、叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 一／单一与数量强调
patterns.context: 涉及数量、单一性或反复强调数量；激活落在 one、only 或相邻数量表达上，未见统一句法位置。

patterns.name: 不定式与目的／请求表达
patterns.trigger: “«to» «submit»”“«to» be respected”““An endeavour «to» fulfil «this» «request»”；另有 “«to» receive”“«to» be”
patterns.context: to 引出动词不定式，表达提交、目的、请求或动作；激活还涉及其宾语或紧邻词，并非所有此类用法都相同。

patterns.name: 合同与法律效力措辞
patterns.trigger: “agreement to submit controversies to arbitration is «valid»”“grounds … for the revocation of any contract”“Tenant shall … expiration or … termination of this lease”
patterns.context: 法律文本中关于仲裁协议效力、合同撤销或租约终止及义务的正式措辞。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的情感与称呼
patterns.trigger: “«How» do I love thee? Let me count the ways”“«Bel»oved, «thou»”
patterns.context: 诗行、罗马数字分节及古体第二人称称呼，含爱情主题。

patterns.name: 不可知的自然力量
patterns.trigger: “mysteries in the universe which his feeble intellect can never fathom”“forces which his puny hands can never control”
patterns.context: 描写人类无法理解或控制的宇宙、自然力量。

patterns.name: 否定与价值判断
patterns.trigger: “it has «no» meaning … «no» purpose … «no» reason”“moral compass … what is «right» and what is «wrong»”
patterns.context: 否定某事物的意义、目的或理由，或讨论道德判断；激活落在否定词及评价词附近。

patterns.name: 兴趣与历史说明
patterns.trigger: “of itself of «great» interest”“history of the discovery … constituents of the atmosphere”
patterns.context: 说明历史或知识主题，并评价其重要性、兴趣；片段带有书面说明文语气。

patterns.name: 租约交还与损坏例外
patterns.trigger: “surrender the premises … in «good» condition, broom clean”“damage from causes beyond the reasonable control of Tenant”
patterns.context: 租约到期或提前终止后交还房屋，并规定清洁状况及损坏例外。

patterns.name: 创业投资失败风险
patterns.trigger: “plow money into shoot-the-moon me-too startups”“no discernable chance of success”“missed opportunities”
patterns.context: 讨论创业投资、失败可能性与错失机会的后果。

patterns.name: 灾难损失与珍爱之物
patterns.trigger: “buildings left standing”“tragedies occurred”“loss of life”“things that they had cherished”
patterns.context: 叙述灾难造成的生命及珍爱事物损失，随后以“one thing is certain”引出判断。

en.description: Activation is scattered across several contexts: conditions, reasons, and a single injury in law; assessments of money and chances of success; repeated negation; and “something is certain” judgments. It also appears in an Italian statement of importance and a novel’s emphasis on chance.

patterns.name: General judgments or statements of certainty
patterns.context: Refers broadly to something or a conclusion and emphasizes certainty with “is certain”; sometimes preceded by an experience or evaluation.

patterns.name: Conditions and legal consequences in statutes
patterns.context: Appears in legal contexts such as contract revocation, review of court decisions, or criminal cases, expressing conditions of applicability, grounds, or a basis for belief.

patterns.name: Expressions concerning amounts, property, and money
patterns.context: Mentions a person’s savings or money invested in a startup.

patterns.name: Emphasis on a single error or injury
patterns.context: A legal claim combines multiple allegations into a single error and injury.

patterns.name: Repeated negation and questioning significance
patterns.context: Lists things as having no meaning, purpose, or reason, then questions whether they deserve respect.

patterns.name: Assessing chances and opportunities for success
patterns.context: Evaluates the likelihood that a startup investment or choice will succeed and contrasts it with a missed opportunity.

patterns.name: Statements of importance in Italian
patterns.context: An Italian-language parliamentary speech says an issue has great relevance or importance.

patterns.name: Emphasis on chance or accident
patterns.context: A novel describes savings and inserts a parenthetical emphasis that a certain amount was never mentioned by chance.

7_2931.description: 激活分散于多种语境：法律中的条件、理由与单一侵害，金钱及成功机会评估，重复否定，以及“某事确定”式判断；另见意大利语重要性表述和小说中的偶然强调。

patterns.name: 总括判断或确定性表达
patterns.context: 泛指某事或某结论，并以“is certain”强调确定；有时前接经历或评价。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的条件与法律后果
patterns.trigger: «grounds»（“grounds as exist for the revocation”）；«for»、«sufficient»、«cause»（“for sufficient cause”）；«reasonable»、«cause»（“reasonable cause to believe”）
patterns.context: 出现在合同撤销、法院判决复审或刑事案件等法律语境，表达适用条件、理由或认知依据。

patterns.name: 数量、财产与金钱相关表达
patterns.context: 提到个人储蓄金额或投入创业公司的资金。

patterns.name: 强调单一错误或侵害
patterns.trigger: «only»、«one»（“only one wrong and only one invasion”）
patterns.context: 法律主张中将多项指控归并为单一错误和侵害。

patterns.name: 重复否定并质疑意义
patterns.context: 连续列举某事物没有意义、目的或理由，随后质疑其应受尊重。

patterns.name: 成功可能性与机会评估
patterns.context: 评估创业投资或选择的成功可能，并与错失机会形成对比。

patterns.name: 意大利语中的重要性表述
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中称某议题具有重大相关性或重要性。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、意大利语正式发言

patterns.name: 偶然或意外强调
patterns.context: 小说叙述储蓄时，插入括注强调某金额从未被偶然提及。

en.concept: Multiple modes: problem-solving instructions and legal/narrative passages
en.description: The main pattern is an algebra problem template: solve an equation and specify the variable, followed by a line break and number markers, found in six mathematical passages. The other four passages concern an arbitration-contract exception, a single-injury claim, elements of a criminal offense, and a novel’s depiction of savings, with distinct triggers.

patterns.name: Target variable in equation-solving instructions
patterns.context: After a linear equation or system of equations, a prompt asks for a solution with a specified unknown as the target; activation often occurs near the instruction and target variable.

patterns.name: Number markers after a line break in equation problems
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers appears at the line break after the Solve instruction and target variable; it accompanies the algebra-problem template.

patterns.name: Statutory validity exception in an arbitration clause
patterns.context: States that a written arbitration agreement is valid while preserving grounds for revoking a contract as an exception.

patterns.name: Single error and injury in litigation
patterns.context: A party claims that all defendants jointly caused a single injury or legal error.

patterns.name: Criminal elements and lack of authorization or malice
patterns.context: Lists the elements of an offense that the state must prove beyond a reasonable doubt.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, criminal decisions or jury instructions

patterns.name: Narrative depiction of savings
patterns.context: A character saves money for the off-season, with narration about the savings and a habit of never mentioning them.

7_2931.concept: 多模式：求解指令与法律/叙事片段
7_2931.description: 主要模式是代数题模板：Solve 方程并指定求解变量，随后换行出现数字标记，见六段数学文本。其余四段分别涉及仲裁合同例外、单一侵害主张、刑事犯罪要件和小说中的储蓄描写，触发内容各异。

patterns.name: 方程求解指令中的目标变量
patterns.context: 线性方程或方程组后，要求解并以指定未知数为目标；指令及目标变量附近常有激活。

patterns.name: 方程题换行后的数字标记
patterns.context: Solve 指令及目标变量之后，换行处出现数字序列；与代数题模板相伴。

patterns.name: 合同仲裁条款的法定有效性例外
patterns.trigger: “save upon such grounds as exist for the revocation of any contract”
patterns.context: 说明书面仲裁协议有效，但保留合同可撤销理由这一例外。

patterns.name: 诉讼中的单一错误与侵害
patterns.trigger: “only one wrong and only one invasion”
patterns.context: 当事人主张所有被告共同造成单一侵害或法律错误。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪要件与无授权、无恶意
patterns.trigger: “proven beyond a reasonable doubt”及“without authority of law and without malice aforethought”
patterns.context: 列举州方须排除合理怀疑证明的犯罪构成要件。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，刑事判决或陪审团指示

patterns.name: 储蓄与积蓄的叙事描写
patterns.trigger: “his savings of nearly six thousand dollars”及“never by any chance alluded”
patterns.context: 人物为应对淡季存钱，并叙述其积蓄及从不提及的习惯。

en.description: Activation is distributed across poetry, law, commentary, mathematics, and novels, landing on different words; local contexts include meter, legal grounds, or right and wrong, but there is no stable shared trigger word or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinary words highlighted in poems or song titles
patterns.context: Common words appear in English verse, lyrics, or work titles, often near a metrical position or line ending; the specific trigger differs across passages.

patterns.name: Words describing exceptions or grounds in legal documents
patterns.context: In statutes or quoted decisions, the word occurs in statements about causes of injury, discretion, or exception conditions.

patterns.name: Words denoting error or injury
patterns.context: Focuses on wording about wrongs, injuries, or right and wrong when discussing rights violations or moral judgment; the highlighted words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Norm terminology in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears directly next to “norm,” describing a vector with finite norm.

patterns.name: “chance” in a passage about savings
patterns.context: Embedded in the expression “by any chance alluded” in a narration about a character’s savings and money.

7_2931.description: 激活分布于诗歌、法律、评论、数学及小说中，落在不同词上；局部可见韵律、法律理由或对错等语境，但没有稳定共享的触发词或句法模式。

patterns.name: 诗歌或歌名中的普通词汇被突出
patterns.context: 英语诗行、歌词或作品标题中，常见词出现在韵律或句尾附近；不同段的具体触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 法律文书中描述例外或理由的词
patterns.context: 法律条款或判决引文中，词处于损害原因、裁量或例外条件的表述里。

patterns.name: 表示错误或侵害的词
patterns.trigger: «one»10（出现在“only one invasion”）；«wrong»及«something»（出现在“what … is wrong”）
patterns.context: 讨论权利侵害或道德判断时，聚焦于错误、侵害或对错的表述；高亮的具体词并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的范数术语
patterns.context: 紧邻“norm”，用于描述向量的有限范数。

patterns.name: 储蓄相关叙述中的“chance”
patterns.context: 叙述人物储蓄与钱款时，嵌在“by any chance alluded”这一表达中。

en.concept: Expressions of conditions, negation, and judgment
en.description: Legal passages concern conditions of validity, grounds, and exceptions to obligations; other examples include “one wrong,” negation introduced by no, moral judgments of right and wrong, and first-person emotion and introspection in poetry.

patterns.name: Conditions and legal effect in legal clauses
patterns.context: Legal texts explain exceptions to an agreement’s validity, criminal knowledge requirements, obligations after lease termination, or exceptions to liability; activations fall on wording related to conditions, grounds, and legal effect.
patterns.domain: Case law and contract legal documents

patterns.name: Statement about a single wrong or infringement
patterns.context: A party claims that multiple targets are subject to the same wrong or infringement; activations center on the quantity word “one” and the following “invasion.”

patterns.name: Negation of grounds, meaning, or likelihood of success
patterns.context: Negates the meaning, purpose, or reason for something, or the chance of success; “no” appears together with the noun or possibility it negates.

patterns.name: Moral judgment and distinguishing right from wrong
patterns.context: Discusses whether a person has moral understanding and whether something is right or wrong; activations include expressions related to moral judgment and the contrast between right/wrong.

patterns.name: First-person emotion and introspection in poetry
patterns.context: Poetry uses the first person to express love, the unknown, hope, or disappointment, often with a lyrical tone and line breaks; activations include “I,” words related to emotion or thought, and poetic diction.

7_2931.description: 法律段落涉及效力条件、理由和义务例外；另有“one wrong”、no引出的否定、道德是非判断，以及诗歌中的第一人称情感与自省。

patterns.name: 法律条款中的条件与法律效力
patterns.trigger: “grounds as exist for the revocation of any contract”；“reasonable cause to believe”；“expiration or sooner termination”；“causes beyond the reasonable control”
patterns.context: 法律文本中，说明协议有效性的例外、犯罪认知要件、租约终止后的义务或责任例外；激活落在条件、理由及效力相关措辞上

patterns.name: 对单一错误或侵害的陈述
patterns.trigger: “only one wrong and only one invasion”
patterns.context: 当事人主张多个对象所涉的是同一个错误或侵害，激活集中于数量词“one”及其后的“invasion”

patterns.name: 否定理由、意义或成功可能
patterns.trigger: “has no meaning”; “has no purpose”; “has no reason”；“no discernable chance of success”
patterns.context: 否定某事物的意义、目的、理由或成功机会；共同出现“no”及其后被否定的名词或可能性

patterns.name: 道德判断与是非辨别
patterns.context: 讨论人是否具备道德理解、判断某事对错；激活包括道德判断相关表达及对立的 right/wrong

patterns.name: 诗歌中的第一人称情感与自省
patterns.trigger: “I sow”；“I thank”；“How do I love thee?”；“my thoughts … disappointments”
patterns.context: 诗歌以第一人称表达爱、未知、希望或失望，常见抒情语气与分行；激活包括“I”、情感/思考词及诗体措辞

en.concept: Expressions of constraint and state across contexts
en.description: Activation is distributed across poetry, exhortation, contracts, decisions, and mathematical texts. The word strings cover repayment and obligations, conditional constraints, emotional expression, and several legal and mathematical terms; no single vocabulary or style runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Returning, owing, and obligations
patterns.context: Discusses whether to repay what was received, return property, or fulfill an obligation; the words may occur in poetry or contracts.

patterns.name: Extreme limits on degree and conditions
patterns.context: Limits the conditions and boundaries for applying rules, liability, evidence, exceptions, or judgments.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions and arguments; also poetry

patterns.name: Emotional states, hope, and happiness
patterns.context: Directly describes people’s emotions, hopes, joy, or resentment; common in poetry or hortatory writing.

patterns.name: Proof and offense elements in legal decisions
patterns.context: Lists criminal charges, standards of proof, and offense elements.

patterns.name: Legal disputes and procedural remedies
patterns.context: Describes judicial discretion, contract revocation, or dispute-resolution procedures.

patterns.name: Vectors with finite norm in mathematical spaces
patterns.context: Describes vector nonzeroness and norm conditions when discussing invariant subspaces and projections.

patterns.name: Joyful movement and singing
patterns.context: Poetry depicts a person moving joyfully, singing, and feeling happy.

patterns.name: Unclear poetic diction and syntax
patterns.context: A verse contains uncommon words and elliptical or inverted syntax; it does not align with the legal and mathematical contexts.

patterns.name: Return of property and damage exception in contracts
patterns.context: Requires premises to be returned after a lease ends and defines exceptions to the tenant’s liability.

patterns.name: Property claims and injury
patterns.context: Argues about property claims and the nature of the alleged injury.

patterns.name: Prayer-like exhortation and helping others
patterns.context: Addresses God and expresses a desire to unite with, protect, or encourage others.

7_2931.concept: 多语境下的限制与状态表达
7_2931.description: 激活分布于诗歌、劝勉、合同、判决和数学文本。可见词串涵盖回报与义务、条件限制、情感表达及若干法律和数学术语；没有单一词汇或文体贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 归还、欠付与义务
patterns.context: 谈及是否回报所获、交还财物或承担义务；词语本身可位于诗歌或合同语境。

patterns.name: 程度与条件的极端限制
patterns.context: 限定规则、责任、证据、例外或判断适用的条件与边界。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及论述，也见诗歌

patterns.name: 情感状态、希望与幸福
patterns.context: 直接描写人的情绪、希望、欢乐或怨恨；多见诗歌或劝勉性文字。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的证明与犯罪要件
patterns.trigger: “proven beyond a reasonable doubt”“without authority of law”“feloniously”“malice aforethought”
patterns.context: 列举刑事指控及证明标准、犯罪要件。

patterns.name: 法律争议与程序性救济
patterns.context: 描述法院裁量、撤销合同或争议处理程序。

patterns.name: 数学空间中的有限范数向量
patterns.context: 讨论不变子空间及投影时，描述向量的非零性和范数条件。

patterns.name: 愉快的动作与歌唱
patterns.trigger: “totter forth with joyous fancy wild”“sing the lullaby”“heart bounds”
patterns.context: 以诗歌描写人物欢快移动、歌唱和心情。

patterns.name: 不明朗的诗歌用词与句法
patterns.context: 诗句中出现较少见词语及省略或倒装结构；与法律和数学语境不吻合。

patterns.name: 合同中的交还与损害例外
patterns.trigger: “surrender the premises”“damage from causes beyond the reasonable control”
patterns.context: 租约终止后交还场地，并界定承租人责任的例外。

patterns.name: 所有权主张与侵害
patterns.context: 论证财产权主张及其所称侵害的性质。

patterns.name: 祈祷式劝勉与援助他人
patterns.trigger: “O Lord”“give hope”“those who have ceased to hope”
patterns.context: 呼告上帝，并表达团结、保护或鼓舞他人的愿望。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal judgments, negation and uncertainty, poetic emotional and moral vocabulary, and contexts involving quantity, money, and surprise; there is no single stable lexical item, and some patterns may reflect only local co-occurrence.

patterns.name: ground after a negative or indefinite determiner
patterns.context: In legal reasoning or general statements, ground/chance follows determiners or negators such as plainest, any, and no; not every occurrence of ground/chance triggers activation.

patterns.name: Strong negation in sentence-final or emphatic position
patterns.context: A negation and the following material occur in emphatic judgments, rhetorical questions, or sentence-final expressions.

patterns.name: Epistemic states in questions or indirect questions
patterns.context: Discusses whether something exists, what it is, or whether it can be justified, often with negation, questions, or uncertainty.

patterns.name: Emotional and relational words in poetry
patterns.context: Words related to emotion, kinship, or moral evaluation appear in groups in verse; activations are distributed across the relevant lines.

patterns.name: Judicial judgments and offenses in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal wording about judicial procedure, discretion, or offenses; paragraph 1 also has a ground-related trigger.

patterns.name: Quantity, degree, and emphatic evaluation
patterns.context: Specific numbers or expressions of degree occur near evaluative statements; activations are unstable and may not reflect a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Money, savings, and investment
patterns.context: Discusses savings, money, or investment opportunities, often alongside judgments about opportunity or success and failure.

patterns.name: Uncertainty or surprise
patterns.context: A poem discusses unexpected, surprising, or unpredictable circumstances.

7_2931.description: 激活分散于法律判断、否定与不确定表达、诗歌情感道德语汇，以及数量、资金和意外情境；没有单一稳定词项，部分模式可能只是局部共现。

patterns.name: 否定或不定限定词后的 ground
patterns.context: 在法律论证或一般陈述中，ground/chance 前出现 plainest、any、no 等限定或否定形式；并非所有 ground/chance 都触发。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、论坛评论、叙事

patterns.name: 句末或强调位置的强否定
patterns.trigger: «nothing»« back»« at»« all»；«do»« not»« know»；«not»« in»« my»；«not»« to»« defend»
patterns.context: 否定词及其后续成分处于强调性判断、反问或句末表达中。
patterns.domain: 诗歌、叙事、论坛评论、论述

patterns.name: 疑问或间接疑问中的认识状态
patterns.context: 谈及某事是否存在、是什么或能否辩护，常伴随否定、疑问或不确定性。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的情感与关系词
patterns.context: 韵文中情感、亲属关系或道德评价词成组出现；激活散布在相关诗句中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的司法判断及罪名
patterns.context: 司法程序、裁量或罪名的法律表述；段1另有 ground 相关触发。

patterns.name: 数量、程度与强调性评价
patterns.context: 具体数字或程度表达与评价性陈述相邻；激活不稳定，可能并非统一触发。

patterns.name: 资金、储蓄与投资
patterns.context: 谈论储蓄、资金或投资机会，且段内常同时有机会或成败判断。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事、创业论坛评论

patterns.name: 不确定或意外情境
patterns.context: 诗句谈及意外、惊奇或难以预料的情形。
